summary: At the start, I became a rich second-generation heir with a beautiful wife and a stunning school belle for a sister-in-law. But Xu Mu couldn’t bring himself to rejoice. The reason? Fortunately, Xu Mu awakened the "Justice System," and he was determined to rewrite his doomed fate. A wife should be cherished, and of course, his sister-in-law deserved to sleep in the villa’s cozy bed. When the Dragon King finally returned, he was greeted by a loving and harmonious family. Xu Mu soon realized that aside from the Dragon King, countless other protagonists began emerging—all targeting him—forcing him to fight back. You have a few breathtakingly beautiful senior sisters? Sorry, but they’re my senior sisters now. You’re a retired soldier king searching for your first love? Too bad—your "white moonlight" already sees me as hers. …

title: The Villain Who Invests in a Witch to Survive

The proud Elf Princess visits him in the dead of night, seeking a dangerous bargain. The Sword Duke’s daughter challenges him every week, firmly believing that defeating him is her life’s mission. And the Empire’s most dazzling Second Princess has quietly drawn a circle around his name in her intelligence dossiers. Ryan looks at his empty purse, and at the flashing death warnings in the Eye of Probability, and sighs. “Wasn’t this supposed to be a yuri romance game?” “So why does it feel like I’m playing Empire Strategy and Witch-Raising Simulator instead?”

The people and soldiers of the border city all called her the General's Lady. As for me, the true General's Lady, no one even knew I existed. She was the eagle of the Northern Frontier. I was a sparrow trapped in the inner courtyard. But disaster was already creeping closer.

title: Guide to Happiness for a Supporting Female Character in the 1970s
summary: At the first thunderclap of Jingzhe (Awakening of Insects), Chu Xia unexpectedly learns that she is a lovestruck supporting female character in a male-centered period novel, doomed to spend her entire life sacrificing for the male lead. When he needs love, she gives up life-changing opportunities for the woman he loves. When he needs a family, she marries him, offering her dowry and support. When he needs a career, she sells her family’s courtyard house and small restaurant, investing everything to help him start a business. When he becomes successful, she not only takes care of his parents at home, she also raises the illegitimate child that the female lead brings to him. Chu Xia: ??? Are you kidding me? If someone wants to play this tragic character, be her guest—but she’s not doing it! What, does having money mean she doesn’t know how to spend it? Does owning assets mean she doesn’t know how to profit from them? Breaking free from the male and female leads, she refuses to be a pitiful sacrifice. Armed with her courtyard home, she opens a restaurant and cooks delicious meals. From beauty to wealth, she stages a full-spectrum comeback. title: Horror Movie Survival Rules
summary: In the world of horror movies, how can an ordinary person survive through layers of danger and make it to the end? Thanks to all the horror movies she had watched before transmigrating, Everly summarized countless foolproof survival rules— Horror Movie Survival Rule #1: Stay away from desolate ruins, campsites, castles, cabins in the woods, suspicious caves, or any similar locations. So when her classmates enthusiastically invited her to explore a ruin, she firmly said no. Those classmates never returned even by the time she graduated from middle school. … Horror Movie Survival Rule #2: Always know your escape routes wherever you go. So when a killer suddenly appeared in the theater, she immediately slipped into the ventilation ducts, becoming one of the few survivors of the incident. … Horror Movie Survival Rule #3: Stick close to the protagonist. Although this could sometimes make you a mere cannon fodder, in most cases it’s useful. That’s why, even while injured, she was able to escape the pursuit of a cannibal and survive. … Everly didn’t know when any of this would end. She only knew one thing: she wanted to live. To live freely in a world full of evil gods, monsters, madmen, and death. … == Transmigrating into a world of horror movies, though all the horror movies are made up by the author. Roughly a story about how an ordinary person uses wisdom and caution to survive in a horror movie world, with a little “cheat” but not much. The female lead is not a saint, not a perfect character, and has some moral flaws. If you mind, proceed with caution.

title: Chasing Jade
summary: After her parents passed away, Fan Changyu faced a string of hardships—her childhood sweetheart broke off their engagement, greedy relatives wanted to seize her inheritance, and with a five-year-old sister to care for, she decided to take a husband in name only. Her plan centered on a man she had saved: wounded, with nothing to his name but a strikingly handsome face. They quickly reached an agreement: she would take him in to recover, and he would pretend to marry her, helping her hold on to her family assets. Once the family business was secure, Fan Changyu prepared to write the divorce agreement, as promised. However, a war erupted, and soldiers were recruited; her “husband” was conscripted and vanished without a trace. The next time she saw him, he was drenched in blood, lying in a wounded soldiers’ tent. His handsome face was smeared with blood, while his simple soldier’s uniform was torn to shreds. Seeing the hardship he had endured, Fan Changyu’s eyes reddened with tears. “Don’t be a soldier anymore,” she whispered, her voice choked. “Come back. I’ll slaughter pigs to support you.” He barely opened his eyes, coughing up blood. “You… wanted a divorce…” Her eyes filled with tears. “No divorce, no divorce!” [Mini Theater] Xie Zheng, the Marquis of Wu’an, became renowned at a young age, his achievements in battle granting him the title of marquis before he even turned twenty. His methods in military command were famously strict and ruthless, making him unmatched across the entire Dayin dynasty. Recently, however, the soldiers noticed something peculiar about their marquis. He no longer resided in his spacious command tent, preferring instead to squeeze into the cramped and shabby tent designated for the wounded. Though he’d taken a serious injury—a wound deep enough to bleed through his armor—under normal circumstances, he’d be back on his feet within a couple of days. Yet this time, he’d been lying there for over ten days with no sign of improvement. The camp’s grizzled strategist clicked his tongue after visiting him. “Hmph. If someone is by your side to wipe your brow and feed you medicine, of course the wound takes longer to heal!” It wasn’t until the marquis’s mysterious wife—who had never shown herself before—snuck into the barracks, wearing her husband’s tattered soldier’s uniform, and took his place on the front lines, fearing her “delicate, sickly husband” might die on the battlefield. Only then did the “gravely wounded” marquis leap up from his bed in shock, hastily don his armor, and rush to chase after her. As the blood-red sun set, a lone goose cried across the vast sky. With a butcher knife in hand, Fan Changyu hacked off the enemy general's head and squinted toward the distant friendly troops kicking up clouds of yellow dust as they approached. She pulled over a nearby soldier and asked, "The one charging at the front, wearing that bright armor with the Qilin shoulder guards and riding that big horse… why does he look a bit like my husband?" The soldier: …Isn’t it possible that he actually is? Naive but fierce Little Sunshine (Female Lead) vs. "That woman is so crude" to "Why doesn't that woman like me?" summary: Valiant’s Legacy — a game where customization is extremely free, combining academy life, RPG mechanics, and dating sim elements. In that game, I created a swordsman built around an extreme concept — the Defensive Swordsman. A swordsman with only the bare minimum of offensive ability, who invested every single skill point into defensive swordsmanship. And now, I’ve possessed that swordsman— no, someone just like that swordsman.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: Vanished for a Millennium, How Did My Dilapidated Sect Become a Sacred Site?
summary: Gu Changyuan crossed over to the cultivation world and awakened a Sect Development System. His starting gift was a patch of barren land, and disciples were all picked up along the way. He spent fifty years diligently building three "ramshackle little sects," thinking he could finally live a carefree life relying on his disciples. But right at the fifty-year mark, he was suddenly swept away by a spatial rift and exiled to the Chaos Desolation, the Disorderly Ruins. There was no spiritual energy there, only slaughter. Relying on the cultivation feedback from his disciples, Gu Changyuan hacked his way through a sea of blood for eleven hundred years. When the system finally fished him back out, he discovered the ramshackle little sects he'd built back then had developed a rather... unusual style. Hold on... I vanished for a thousand years, so how did my ramshackle little sects become holy lands?!

title: The Regressed Dark Magician is a Divine Genius
summary: The direct descendant of one of the four great houses of the Dark Empire, which specializes in black magic— Aaron Bayonel. "I'm going to cast black magic on time. That way, I can travel to the past." "You should've told me that sooner..." The Sword of Light, a Stigma bearer of the Holy Empire. From her hands, the Stigma flows into mine. "If you go to the past, that Stigma will be of great help to you." ……? Wait… but I'm a black mage?

title: Pampered Poisonous Royal Wife
summary: The Capital’s girls look on with hatred, “You’re just a country girl without any knowledge. Do you have Niyun Shop’s clothes? Do you have Brilliant Treasure Pavillion’s jewellery? Do you even know how eminent and domineering the famous Yue Wang is?" Mu Yunyao looked at them lazily, “Niyun Shop? I opened it. Brilliant Treasure Pavillion? I opened it. As for Yue Wang…when are you returning my silver?” Yue Wang’s face was cold: “I will pay with my body.” (Wang means Prince. In this case, “Yue Wang” was a title given by the Emperor to his son.) After being reincarnated, Mu Yunyao believes in three things: One, do not have good intentions towards others. Two, do not let the enemy have the chance to rise again. Three, do not believe in feelings. Thus, she is merciless. She is fearless. She would rather have everything destroyed than to compromise for everything. However, after one fateful meeting, a cold-blooded prince keeps following her, silently plotting on making her his wife and bringing her back to pamper her…

title: I Was Forced to Marry a “Trash” Cultivator, But She Turned Out to Be a Reborn Empress!
summary: Shen Xian just wanted to sleep. Transmigrated into a cultivation world with tr*sh aptitude (Rank 9 Spirit Root), he decided to give up on immortality and live the life of a lazy, rich young master. But his family had other plans. They forced him into a political marriage with Ye Qingxian, the once-genius daughter of a rival clan who had lost all her cultivation. A tr*sh husband and a crippled wife. The whole city laughed at them. But on their wedding night, Shen Xian awakened the [Marriage Blessing System] ! Rule 1: When your wife cultivates, you gain 10x the experience! Rule 2: When you gift your wife an item, you get a Crit-Rebate (10x to 100x) reward! Shen Xian: “Here, take this tr*shy pill I found.” [System: You gifted a Rank 1 Pill. Triggering 20x Rebate! You received: Rank 4 Golden Soul Pill!] Shen Xian: “Wife, you should cultivate more. I’ll watch.” [System: Your wife broke through to Foundation Establishment. You received: Instant Level Up to Golden Core!] While Ye Qingxian—who is actually a Reborn Empress from the Upper Realm—thinks she is protecting her useless husband, she doesn’t realize one thing… He is already stronger than the ancestors! Join Shen Xian as he conquers the cultivation world by simply pampering his wife and sleeping in the sun.
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: Fun Territory Defense of the Easy-Going Lord ~The Nameless Village Is Made Into the Strongest Fortified City by Production Magic~
summary: The child of an aristocrat, Van, suddenly remembers his past life when he became two years old. Van was once rumored to be a child prodigy. However, at the age of eight, He was found to have had an aptitude for production magic, a useless aptitude. He was then promptly banished from his noble family. Braving the hardships of village life, Van continues to develop and defend his village. Soon, the nameless village is turned into a city... though it would be nice if the dragons stopped attacking us.

title: Which Family’s Young Miss Is So Arrogant?
summary: Hong Xiaoduo, who was tricked into traveling to ancient times, declares: Although having good martial arts skills and being a heroic woman who eliminates violence and maintains peace is pretty cool, you can't solve everything with force, right? That would be way too much trouble! Hey, weird old man, I'm talking to you! Don't think that just because you deceived me into ancient times, everything's fine. Let me give you a heads up: this young lady can't endure hardship and won't tolerate being wronged, so hurry up and provide some matching cheat systems and new technology, otherwise this young lady will just lie flat and quit playing... And you, whoever you are, who are you calling a s*umbag woman? Those princes, young masters, generals, and various heroes - they all threw themselves at me, I didn't provoke them! Aaah, I can't explain this clearly...
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Martial Arts, Slice of Life

title: Transmigrated as the Villain’s Wife
summary: Su Xiaoman was a fake daughter of a wealthy family. She is not loved by her biological parents. She was also rejected by her adoptive parents. When she woke up again, she found herself in a book and became the village flower Su Xiaoman in the 1970s. Su Xiaoman is the wife of a villain male supporting role. The original Su Xiaoman, who disliked poverty and loves the rich, is devoted to climbing high branches, and is obsessed with Jiang Yantang, the educated youth male protagonist who just went to the countryside. Su Xiaoman was unwilling to marry Xie Mingtu because of his poverty, and is still obsessed with the male protagonist Jiang Yantang. Who knows that not long after, the second brother of the male protagonist Jiang Yantang went to the countryside to visit relatives, and found that the poor boy Xie Mingtu was the real child of the Jiang family, and the male protagonist Jiang Yan Tang was held wrong. Xie Mingtu returned to Jiang’s house in the courtyard, but he was ridiculed because he was gloomy and vulgar, and he couldn’t compare to the fake boy Jiang Yantang, and his wife was also even more obsessed with Jiang Yantang… In this way, Xie Mingtu had completely blackened, mad and ruthless, and became the biggest villain in the book, and ended up tragically. When Su Xiaoman opened her eyes, Xie Mingtu, the biggest villain in the book, was about to feed her rice soup. His clothes were tattered and his bones were visible. When he saw her wake up, his tone was humble and cautious: “Manman?” When Xie Mingtu thought that the woman would not give him any response, a pair of slender and tender hands grabbed his thin wrist.
genres: Completed, Adventure, Comedy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Have a Sensory Deprivation Skill
summary: An another world where special abilities called 'Skills' exist. [Sensory Block Lv.1: Blocks sensory reception below a certain threshold.] My skill is this.
genres: Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem

title: Green Grapes
summary: When I was sixteen, the Zhou Family bought me to be a breeder for their lame son, Zhou Yuqing, to bear him children. Though the agreement was for me to arrive in June, I reported to the Zhou Family in March. I did this for two reasons: first, to save my own family some grain, and second, to leave a good impression on my future master. But Zhou Yuqing despised me for being a country bumpkin and called me s*upid. He said I wasn't nearly as delicate or pretty as Miss Su next door. Even as he shared my bed, he looked down on me for being dirty. "You must bathe four times with green jasmine and white champaca, then comb your hair with osmanthus oil. Miss Su uses osmanthus oil-have you got that through your head? "If you serve me well next time, this young master might just grant you a formal title." I nodded, scrubbing myself with a loofah until I nearly rubbed my skin raw. Suddenly, someone grabbed me by the scruff of the neck and hauled me, dripping wet, out of the tub. It was Madam Liu, the broker who had sold me. She was in a frantic rush as she dragged my naked, fragrant body toward the door. "Good heavens! It's all wrong, all wrong! It wasn't the Zhou Family who bought you-it was the Zou Family!"

title: Transmigrated with a Sanity Gauge
summary: Transmigrated into a new world, Lu Yuan finds himself facing hell mode right from the start. A chilling Victorian-style clinic, wriggling mists outside the window, and at his feet—the scaly, mysterious corpse of his predecessor. In this mad world where knowledge equals corruption, Lu Yuan possesses a unique cheat: he can see the [Experience Bar] of all things. Reading forbidden tomes? [Occultism +1] Dissecting Deep Ones? [Anatomy +10] Gazing upon the Unspeakable? [Sanity -1, Willpower +5] While others descend into madness at a mere glimpse of the truth, Lu Yuan decides to use raw data to crush the eldritch horrors. Taking over the clinic, he treats not only human ailments but aberrations as well. He performs surgery on gilled sailors, listens to the dreams of deep-sea kin, and through relentless grinding, transforms cosmic terrors into controllable skills. When the rest of the world loses its mind to the truth, Lu Yuan looks at his maxed-out skill tree, adjusts his monocle, and smiles: "There is no such thing as the supernatural. If it seems that way, it just means I haven't farmed enough XP yet."
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: The Swords I Raised Are Too Strong
summary: You undergo a bizarre experience. You overcome it. Those are the conditions for Awakening. Shin Si-woo, a seventeen-year-old orphaned by the Gate Catastrophe, was convinced he'd Awaken from a niche game called [Raise a Sword] . He was wrong — or so everyone told him. Dismissed as a gaming addict, he gave up on becoming an Awakened and instead became a civil servant at the Awakened Management Agency. Ten years and over ten thousand playthroughs later, twenty-seven-year-old Si-woo finally sees his game through to the end — and the System answers. His class: Sword Master. His power: to summon and wield the very swords he spent twelve years raising, each one forged through an NPC's entire lifetime of battle, tragedy, and transcendence. The swords he raised conquered worlds. Now, they answer to him.

title: They Mistook Me for the Mastermind Warden
summary: We've finally succeeded in reforming the disaster-level prisoners. But none of them seem to have any intention of leaving... No, I said you're all going to be released?

title: Slimes Have the Potential to Be the Strongest ~ In My Second Life, I’ll Face Slimes Head on ~
summary: Life hasn't always been smooth sailing for an old man living in the forest. While everyone else lives by making a contract with a monster, the old man's companion is a slime. He still makes a living by disposing of garbage, but when he talks to the slime, he discovers that it too has intelligence. The old man is overjoyed as his bond with the slime deepens, but the old man, already elderly, passes away peacefully in his sleep. He wakes up in his familiar old house. His best friend, who was supposed to be dead, appears young. He himself has also become younger. He doesn't know what happened. But he has been given a second chance at life, and this time he is living it upright, this time with the slime ...
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Supernatural

title: Who Let Him Cultivate Immortality
summary: A parody of Cultivation novels, similar to Konosuba but set in a Xianxia world. Absolutely a hidden gem for the English audience, this novel has been Top 10 on Qidian (the website where most Chinese novels are uploaded) for 11 months in a row, ever since the start of the year. Official description: “I’ve repeatedly emphasized that the cultivation world’s atmosphere was already crooked – I didn’t make it that way,” Sword Immortal Lu Yang declared during a press interview, expressing great anger. “They say history is written by the victors, so why am I still being falsely accused even though I’ve won?” The next day. “I’ve repeatedly emphasized that I’m the one who made the cultivation world’s atmosphere crooked. History is written by the victors, and I’ve won!” Sword Immortal Lu Yang declared during the press interview, expressing great anger. — As reported by the Cultivation Daily News
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: I Became the Protagonist’s Inner Evil
summary: I possessed the inner evil. I pretended to be a villain to help the protagonist grow, but... "Lord Devil, is this the right way to do it?" "Lord Devil! The ultimate move you taught me is super strong! ...Huh? You're saying this is just a basic attack?" "Lord Devil, you aren't leaving me, right...?" Is this really right?
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological

title: The Easygoing Journey of a Novice Witch in Another World: The Former Middle-Aged Corporate Drone Who Fell into Another World Claims to Be a Witch’s Apprentice and Enjoys Her Second Life
summary: Ino Eri, who had been working for a cutthroat production company, suddenly found herself reincarnated in another world—and before she knew it, she had wandered into the so-called “Demonic Forest.” Taken in by the “Witch of Wishes” who lived there, she became her apprentice. Three hundred years later, Eri, now calling herself Ellie, decides to leave her master and set out on a journey. To accomplish something in the human world and earn the title of witch like her master, though mostly to enjoy the scenery and food of this other world, Ellie, accompanied by her master’s familiar Hokuto, finally ventures beyond the Forest of Demons for the first time! And so begins the carefree witch’s endless journey.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The Disabled Prince Stood Up
summary: Introduction In the palace selection, the crippled Prince Hui, exuding an aura of lifelessness, was avoided by the maidens like the plague. Only Yao Huang couldn't help but sneak glances at him several times, thinking: He's already in a wheelchair; he probably won't cause much trouble after marriage, right? Not long after, Prince Hui told his newlywed princess: "My stipend is five thousand taels; you can spend it as you please." "On the 5th and 10th of every month, I will accompany you. Otherwise, we’ll sleep in separate rooms." Yao Huang was overjoyed: Little trouble and lots of money? Perfect! • Post-marriage romance, daily life vibes. • Lighthearted tone, with the male lead recovering later on.

title: Beast Taming: Starting From Zero
summary: When Qiao Sang opened her eyes, She realized she had become a middle-school student Immediately afterwards, She was greeted with a mock test. Having graduated from a 985 university, would such a puny test still intimidate her? Yes. Yes, it would. What on earth is this exam about! What is the final evolved form of the stinky loach called? Which planets have humans already migrated to? …… …… …… …… Welcome to the world of Beast Taming
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, School Life, Sci-fi, Xuanhuan

title: I Became a Villain Perfect for Leveling Up
summary: I possessed a villain in a dark fantasy soul game. – Upon death, opponent’s level increases by +10 …If you die, you have the privilege of raising the other person’s level.
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Psychological, School Life, Tragedy

title: The Daily Life of Farming and Raising Children in Ancient Mountain Residences
summary: Sang Luo traveled through time and was faced with a broken thatched hut and two children who were so hungry that they lost their looks. Being poor and being a widow was still better than losing your life. As for the lack of food at home, as long as they had hands, feet, and vast mountains, was there still a fear of starvation? Sang Luo wasn’t afraid; she rolled up her sleeves and got to work! ~ Shen Lie was pushed by his third uncle to serve in the military. After more than two years, when he returned to the village, the villagers were shocked to see him alive. Upon inquiry, he found out that not only had he “died,” but he also gained an unseen wife. Moreover, his wife and two younger siblings were all divided up and sent away by his third uncle and aunt. They lived in the area where the Shen family was exiled, in the makeshift thatched cottage in the mountains. A shabby thatched cottage which could kill people in windy and snowy days? He didn’t bother to go home and question his uncle; he suppressed his anger and hurried to the mountains. When he arrived in front of the thatched cottage in the wind and snow, he could hardly recognise it as the place where he had lived. This is a little different from what he thought… The house has obviously been repaired and is no longer as dilapidated as before. A high courtyard wall has been built with yellow mud outside the house, and an extra stove has been built in the courtyard. It was dinner time when a young woman came out of the kitchen carrying a bowl of hot food, followed by two children carrying rice, bowls, and chopsticks. As soon as they saw each other, the two children’s eyes widened, then they yelled “big brother” and rushed out. What if a husband falls from the sky? Waiting online it’s quite urgent.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: My 10 Quintillion Paid Currency
summary: [Welcome to the Cash Shop!] [Current Balance: 1,000,000,000,000,000,000] “……” I possessed a game that was about to shut down— while holding 10 quintillion worth of paid currency.
genres: Action, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: A Refined and Lovely Girl from My Class Takes Refuge in My Kitchen Only After School. ~A Secret Relationship: Less Than Cohabitation, More Than Dinner~
summary: The one rule is simple: don’t pry. And over warm dinners, the two of them slowly fall in love. Minoshima Asaki’s one-man apartment, if described in a single word, was a mess. He had supposedly earned his “castle of solitude” on one condition: as long as his grades didn’t slip, he was free to live however he liked. But in reality, that castle was overrun with convenience store bags and unwashed dishes. Then one day, Asaki’s castle suddenly became a refuge. The graceful, beautiful girl from his class──Shinomiya Shiori──started dropping by his apartment after school and staying there. Because she couldn’t bring herself to eat at home. “Am I always causing you trouble?” “If you were, I’d have sent you home a long time ago.” “...Minoshima-kun, you’re really kind.” “Quit it. Here, use the kitchen however you want. Just make as much of whatever you think tastes good as you want.” He won’t pry. In exchange, she cooks dinner. And so begins an awkward arrangement: a relationship built around dinner, something just short of living together. The stockpot of miso soup in the kitchen starts lasting longer. Before they know it, grocery shopping becomes something they do as a pair. Their hands somehow move in sync as they dry the dishes side by side. His best friend catches on and teases him, and before he can help it, Asaki draws a line to protect her. And little by little, Shiori stops covering up those occasional days when she doesn’t want to go home with a smile. At first, Shiori was nothing but restraint and hesitation, but little by little, she starts allowing herself to lean on him. At first, Asaki wanted nothing to do with anyone else’s problems, but little by little, he starts letting her into his world. This is a heartwarming romantic comedy about two lonely people finding salvation through dinner──a relationship that’s less than living together, but more than just sharing a meal.
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: My Multiverse Supermarket
summary: [Female Lead Without CP | Business Management] Zhou Li only wanted to run her small supermarket well. But after being bound to a system, she was forced to take her little store wandering across countless worlds (well, not exactly)—as a supplier to the multiverse. World 1: Ancient Times | Chaos | Refugees Zhao Changyan, a noblewoman of the Chu royal clan, narrowly survived the extermination of her entire family. To escape her pursuers, she disguised herself among a group of refugees fleeing south. When the refugees arrived at a miasma-filled land, Zhao Changyan discovered an immortal's cave hidden deep in the mountains. Inside, there was food, water, clothing, paper, and even many unheard-of goods. Refugees: "This is the Peach Blossom Land! We can settle here!" Zhao Changyan: "This is my chance for revenge." ... As more and more refugees arrived, the once-desolate mountains turned into a thriving new town—and the supermarket's supplies were in constant shortage. Zhou Li: "Poor planning... I'm almost out of stock." World 2: Interstellar | Apocalypse | Survival A rare disaster struck a colony planet, cutting off communication with the homeworld, Blue Star. Transport ships loaded with supplies failed to arrive. Hundreds of thousands of humans were trapped on the planet-its harsh environment and scarce resources plunging the world into an apocalyptic crisis. Amid the endless snow and ice, a small supermarket quietly appeared. ... Zhou Li just wanted to run her supermarket normally, but the demand from all worlds was overwhelming. Before long, her little shop had become the wholesale hub of the multiverse. Tips: A light-hearted story about running a supermarket across different planes. A brainless, feel-good read-just for fun. One-sentence summary: A traveling mini-supermarket-with everything in stock.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The Gangster Took the Scumbag Script
summary: In every book, there would be a s*umbag who’s despicable, selfish and insidious, and hurts others miserably. When the boss got the s*umbag script, he turned things around in minutes and wrote the face-slapped script. Of course, it was someone else’s face!

title: I Stomped on a Bug, and the System Said I Slaughtered a Dragon?
summary: “Ding! Congratulations on slaying the Beast King. Reward: tenfold amplification. You have obtained an Undying Body and a sixty-year cultivation base!” Qin Yang looked at the big c*ckroach he had just crushed underfoot, and his face was completely shocked. “Alert! A Beast Sovereign-class star beast has been detected. Host, please flee immediately or you will die a horrible death!” Qin Yang looked at the little purple spider in front of him, and a huge question mark appeared over his head. What do you mean, “Beast Sovereign”? Inside the library, Qin Yang was reading when a little girl walked in. “Ding! Empress aura detected. Host, please kneel and beg for her to take you as an apprentice. Your future is boundless!” Qin Yang looked at the girl in front of him, who was looking very earnestly at the book she held. His expression stiffened. This System must be sick!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: I’m Writing a Diary in a Fantasy World — I Really Am Not a ‘Cao Thief’!
summary: After transmigrating into a fantasy world, Chu Ge finally awakens a system at the age of eighteen. But the name of the system nearly makes him break down: The Villain Diary Check-In Sign-In System. What kind of ridiculous patchwork system is this? Day 1: Spirit Body reward. Day 7: King Body reward. Day 30: Saint Body reward. As Chu Ge keeps writing his daily diary, the world around him quietly begins to change. Destiny’s chosen sons rise one after another, while breathtaking female immortals start gathering around him. Years later, standing at the peak, facing countless protagonists and surrounded by peerless beauties, Chu Ge can only shout in despair: “System, you’ve completely misunderstood me! I really am not a Cao thief!”

title: Return of Mount Hua Sect
summary: The 13th generation disciple of the Great Mount Hua Sect. One of the Three Great Swordsmen. The Plum Blossom Sword Saint, Chung Myung. After slicing the head of the peerless Heavenly Demon, who threw the world into chaos, he slept an eternal sleep on the peak of the Hundred Thousand Great Mountains. Jumping over a hundred years, he comes back in the body of a child. But… what? Mount Hua declined? What the hell are you talking about!? It’s only natural to want to live if you’re going broke. “Decline? Even though I’m here? Who would dare!” Plum blossoms eventually fall. But when the cold winter passes and spring comes, plum blossoms shall bloom again. “But I’m gonna die first before Mount Hua gets revived! If you’re gonna go bust, might as well do it right, you bastards!” The beginning of the Plum Blossom Sword Saint, Chung Myung’s solitary struggle to save the thoroughly declining Mount Hua Sect.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Martial Arts, Mature, Psychological, Tragedy, Wuxia

title: I Can Hear All Your Thoughts
summary: There’s nothing good about being able to read someone’s true thoughts. All it’s done is make me quicker at catching on than everyone else.
genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Return of the Corpse King I, a Former Hero, Am Summoned Back to Another World to Stop the Chuunibyou Secret Society I Created
summary: Resummoned with My Former Chuunibyou Revived? The Birth of an Embarrassing Dark History Comedy in Another World! “How could my past self have done such embarrassing things with such enthusiasm?!” Nisaki Shio, a hero who was summoned to another world in his third year of middle school and saved it. After defeating the Demon King and being forcibly returned to the modern world, three years later, he is summoned to the other world again—to stop the rampage of the secret society “Helheim.” However, it turns out this organization is actually the embarrassingly cringeworthy dark history that he had created when he suffered from chuunibyou, calling himself the “King of Corpses”!? Who on earth is impersonating “Helheim” and spreading its notorious reputation? To solve this mystery and restore the organization’s name, the Corpse King begins to reassemble the executives who once made Helheim the strongest—the “Eight Precepts”—and resumes his activities in the other world… while writhing in embarrassment. First stop is the steel city of Gagiul. Save the struggling city and rescue the countess of dull colors who stands in peril. “—Helheim, the operation begins now.”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Supernatural

title: Genius Card Maker
summary: Ning Zhu accidentally picks up a mysterious card, and an entirely new world unfolds before her eyes. It is a world belonging to Card Masters — people who study card crafting and use cards for everything imaginable. From everyday utility cards like Cleaning Cards, Cooking Cards, Farming Cards, Beauty Cards, Hair Growth Cards, and Sleep-Well Cards… to combat-oriented Equipment Cards, Character Cards, Spirit Arts Cards, Secret Arts Cards, and Illusion Cards… If people can imagine it, Card Masters can create it. Among the countless cards in existence, one stands completely unique. Rumor says this card lay dormant for a hundred years before finally choosing its rightful master. Rumor says every person who has ever possessed it was an unparalleled genius. Rumor says this genius Card Maker has countless followers, and with a single command, could unite the world and achieve an unprecedented legend. After arriving at Spirit Card Academy, Ning Zhu curiously asks: “So… what’s the name of this genius Card Maker?” Her classmates answer with endless admiration: “Ning Zhu!” Ning Zhu: “???”

title: Isekai de Slow Life wo (Ganbou)
summary: By the will of the goddess, Itsuki Shinomiya was given the privilege of choosing various abilities and being reborn in another world. However, before going to the other world, he didn’t want to involve himself in scary, dirty, gross things like battles. Fiercely determined to live a slow life, he chose the unique skill [Pocket Money], giving him an amount of money once per day. “With this, I can hang out with girls without having to work!” Dreaming of avoiding battles and living with cute girls, Itsuki stepped into the other world! But the reality was not that simple. Getting attacked by giant bugs, getting caught up in arguments at the guild, and getting stuck with s*aves?! In the end, will Itsuki be able to live his ideal slow life?! Using unique skills and manufacturing skills, an exciting other-world slow life with beautiful girls starts now! (hopefully)

title: After Turning into a Zombie, I Was Caught by My Ex-boyfriend
summary: In the third year of becoming a zombie, Xue Ling mingled with a group of wandering zombies and encountered a convoy that was exterminating them. What a coincidence! The man standing on the roof of the car and pointing a gun at her was none other than her ex-boyfriend, Wen Jiuze. One-Sentence Summary: Captured by my ex-boyfriend after turning into a zombie. Theme: Never give up hope.

title: After Recognizing a Passerby as My Father, I Got the Villain Family Bundle
summary: In her previous life, Shen Yi was taken back to her wealthy biological family, only to find her s*umbag father and younger brother already living a blissful, father-child harmonious life with the adopted daughter. Because she opposed the adopted daughter, Shen Yi was bullied and ultimately chose to take her own life. Reborn at the entrance of an orphanage, before her s*umbag father could come looking for her, she decisively clung to a man with an unremarkable face. She shamelessly insisted on following him. In this life, she no longer wanted any wealthy parents; a simple, ordinary life was the real truth! A certain killer who happened to be passing by and got hugged: “?” In the days that followed, Shen Yi lived a simple life, and she was very satisfied with her current situation. Later, she learned from a system that she was living inside a comic book, where the male and female protagonists were her classmates. While slacking off in the back row of class, Shen Yi accidentally overheard the main characters discussing the names of the villains. “…Wait, the utterly wicked evildoers you’re talking about… all seem to be my family members’ names?” Shen Yi thought her family were all insignificant background characters in the comic. In reality, her gentle mother would eliminate anyone who stood in her way. Her antisocial doctor older brother, while committing heinous acts, never forgot to pick her up from and drop her off at school. Her neurotic criminal second brother, her extremely unhinged third brother, her highly intelligent evil-genius fourth brother—even her grandfather, whom she had never met, was the comic’s ultimate villain. One day, terrorists attacked the school, and both she and the adopted daughter were kidnapped. Her long-missing, corporate-drone father had people surround the school, shot the kidnapper dead, smiled slightly with the air of a mastermind villain making his entrance, and waved to her, “Shen Yi, come here.” Everyone thought she was doomed. Instead, under the shocked gazes of the entire school, Shen Yi grabbed the man’s hair and demanded, “Dad, why are you styling yourself like this? Your slicked-back hair is so ugly!”

How did the Pavilion expose my identity as a demonic cultivator?” The Lord of the Forbidden Zone: “The Master of the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets is terrifying! I have lived for three million years and believed myself to be unrivaled, yet I am ranked a mere seventeenth on the Leaderboard!”

title: I Reincarnated as Earnest, But This World’s Morals Are Broken
summary: A mentally weak middle-aged man who cannot refuse women when asked “do it” finds himself swap-reincarnated with a boy in a medieval fantasy world. In this new realm, s*very, polygamy, and might-makes-right are the norm. Using his modern knowledge and past experiences, he begins to stand out. However, by modern Earth standards, his actions are those of a s*mbag. The catch? He remains completely unaware of this fact. This is the story of a man who thinks he is serious and earnest, while inadvertently becoming a villain in the eyes of morality—a tale of war, politics, and harem building in a world where ethics are fluid.

title: Living leisurely in Tang Dynasty
summary: During an interview with prominent Tang Dynasty ministers: You have known Li Yuanying for a long time. What do you think about his character? Wei Zheng: Shameless! Fang Xuanling: Shameless! Sun Simiao: Shameless! His Majesty Li Er: My most shameless brother. Li Yuanying: Continue talking guys! I’m leaving first. This is a light-hearted novel documenting the adventures (or more accurately ruckus) of Li Yuanying, youngest brother of Emperor Taizhong of Tang Dynasty.

title: Necromancer: I Am A Disaster
summary: Game has become reality, shattering the rules of the world. Humanity has entered an era of global class awakening. Demonic creatures run rampant! Secret realms and dungeons proliferate! Terror and treasure go hand in hand, danger and opportunity side by side! Only by becoming a class user, raising your level, and growing stronger can one reach the pinnacle of the world! On the day of his class awakening, Lin Moyu became a Necromancer—a unique hidden class. He gained a godly talent that, even at level 1, amplifies all of his skills tenfold. He also acquired a godly passive skill that transfers all damage he receives to his summons. As long as his summons remain, Lin Moyu is virtually unkillable. “Countless Godly Skeletal Warriors, Skeletal Mages, Lich Generals, undead Dragons! Can you handle it?” Subjected to curses, Gods turn into bones. When corpses explode, the sky topples and the world collapses. “I sit high upon a throne of bones, treading the boundary between life and death.” “I am a disaster!”

title: Star Instructor, Master Baek
summary: After his qi center is destroyed, a martial arts instructor of the Blood Demon Cult is assigned to learn and research the martial arts of four captured murim masters. However, when the Cult betrays him and decides to kill him, he fights back and everyone in the Cult dies, including himself. He then mysteriously wakes up in the body of Baek Suryong, a young martial arts instructor in the rural countryside with a disease that will kill him within three years. He realizes that the martial arts he had learned holds the key to healing his new body’s illness, but in order to do that, he needed money. A LOT of money. Baek Suryong thus embarks on a journey to become the Star Instructor of the Azure Dragon Martial Arts Academy, and earn enough money to save his own life! Perhaps he would even manage to educate some kids along the way…
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: I Reincarnated as a Villainous Noble Doomed to Die, but I’ll Stay In the Background for the Sake of Saving All the Heroines ~I Just Wanted to Be the One Who Suffers, but Somehow All the Heroines’ Love Is Way Too Heavy~
summary: I was reincarnated into the world of my favorite adult game. But my role is the worst. I attack the heroine, get spectacularly beaten back, and end up surrounded by monsters deep in the labyrinth— a third-rate villain who screams “I don't want to die, help me!” before getting eaten. No way am I accepting such a lame ending. —No, wait. Honestly, I don't care what happens to me. I just want a future where the heroines who were supposed to die can laugh and come back alive. The original protagonist and those strong, dazzling girls fight on the front lines of the labyrinth. Then I'll support them so they can fight without a care, fully prepared. Leave the heroics to them. I'll keep breaking my death flags. Dangerous tasks, painful duties—I'll take them all on myself. If only I get hurt, that's fine. —That's all I ever wanted. “You mean everything to me. A world without you…” “If you disappear, I'll truly break. So please… don't leave me?” “Taking everything on alone is your bad habit, you know? Rely on me more…” “Please. Take better care of yourself. Without you, I…” “Please, please… don't leave my side…” …For some reason, none of them will let me go. This is the story of a villain who should have died miserably in the labyrinth, who put his own life on hold to keep protecting only the girls' futures. And then— The story of how the girls he saved never let him go.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: It Was the Villain Who Had Been Protecting Them. By the Time the Heroines Realized It, It Was Already in Tatters
summary: The protagonist who has been reincarnated into the world of a depressing game Huh? Isn’t this guy the villain? ……The protagonist, who had suffered the worst possible reincarnation—being reborn as the villain in a depressing game—pondered. It was a given that his reincarnated character would die near the end of the story. Besides… “If I’m already hated, there’s no need for me to be active in the spotlight, right?” To save the heroine he loved, the villain worked behind the scenes. And then, one day, the heroines realized who it was that had been saving them all along. And then…….
genres: Action, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Supporting Female Character Isn’t Getting Involve
summary: Lin Dan is bound to an auxiliary system. She does tasks to maintain the plot of countless small worlds. Simply put, she is just a supporting role or cannon fodder, a stepping stone for others to achieve greatness. Confusion, desperation, madness, loving who she can’t love, wanting what she can’t have: Lin Dan experienced too much loss and misery. When she finally achieved enlightenment and decided to unbind from the system and return to her original world, something interrupted her return journey and she was sent back into the three thousand worlds to continue struggling. Although she lost her memory, Lin Dan was no longer confused. She decided to take her own path and finally discovered that she had to love herself before others could love her. As long as you live your life well, no matter how insignificant it seems, you will become a protagonist one day. If you bloom, the butterflies will naturally come.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance

title: I Became the NTR Bastard of the Labyrinth City
summary: It has been two years since arriving in the Labyrinth City. Cain forms a party with his childhood friends, Claude and Sia, and regularly explores the labyrinth. He had been traversing the labyrinth while possessing a mysterious blessing with a name so unidentifiable it couldn't even be pronounced. Then, one day, his level increased, and a new blessing appeared. Within three seconds, she decides to shut herself off, pretending to be crazy and foolish, living day by day. Everyone knows that the fifth daughter of the Li family is a fool. Out of kindness, the Li family neither confines her to the courtyard nor sends her to a village to fend for herself. Later, an imperial decree made the fifth daughter of the Li family the Regent’s consort, and no one dared to openly discuss her anymore. They only privately joke that a madman paired with a fool is a perfect match. Later, the Regent’s actions become less shocking and appalling, and people start to hope that the Regent’s consort lives a long life, as long as she doesn’t die before the Regent. Li Mu: “I always feel like I’ve been turned into a chain for a mad dog.” Regent: “Then, Consort must keep me tightly chained so I don’t go out and bite people.”

That said, he is not pessimistic at all. While peeking into his classmates’ private lives, he goes around writing farewell messages on their smartphones…… in other words, he is a completely harmless existence who merely causes mildly annoying supernatural phenomena. summary: Shu Qingqing transmigrated into a campus romance novel, becoming the stepmother of the school heartthrob male lead. Lu Bochuan: The shares are yours, and you are mine. Shu Qingqing: What to do when a stuffy old man suddenly starts spouting cheesy pick-up lines? Asking for a friend, it's urgent!

The slacker-minded Yue Fuguang has a solution: outsource it! She leaks carefully selected "thoughts" to the Emperor and officials of Great Yan, then crowns herself with the divine title of Immortal Lord Undergoing Trials. With advanced technology, seeds, and other benefits dangled before them—plus the ever-looming threat of national destruction— Great Yan’s court becomes a melon field for the little Immortal Lord (Yue Fuguang) and the System Deity to gossip and milk tasks from. Sipping tea and munching on melons, the duo casually complete side quests. [What? This minister starves to death on the run after the country falls!] [Brutal—this official gets trampled by enemy horses? And his chubby grandson...

title: Wizard: Starting With Synthesized Gems

In a wizarding world heavily reliant on resources, transmigrator Locke Augustine uses his cheat, the Synthesis Cube, to transform low-grade materials into high-grade ones. He embarks on a path toward truth through breeding, potion-making, alchemy, and more, developing new magical plants, potions, and bloodlines. “I care not for the fate of this world or the lives of strangers within it. But as wizards, we must pioneer all, conquer all, and forever advance toward the unknown.”

This woman was elegant, intelligent, and had guided him in business, helping him succeed. They shared everything, with nothing left unspoken between them. She was poised, respectful of boundaries, and never demanded attention or favor, yet Cheng Yanyu was madly in love with her, treating her as his ideal, wanting to present the world to her feet. Meanwhile, from the moment Wen Yang discovered the affair and investigated, she felt utterly defeated. Cheng Yanyu’s eyes were now filled only with the other woman. Wen Yang had assumed this woman was simply someone interfering with her marriage. To her surprise, the woman was already married, and her husband was an incredibly wealthy and attractive man. To address her marriage, Wen Yang reached out to the woman’s husband, Fu Xingzhou. 1. The male lead is Fu Xingzhou. 2. An intense and emotionally charged narrative. 3. A story of mature adults, with the development between the main leads occurring after divorce. Translator’s Note: After discovering her husband cheating on her with a married woman, Wen Yang reached out to the mistress’ husband to discuss their spouse’s affairs. This is a story about a housewife’s growth after divorce and how she was able to move on and be happy with the help of her friends, her new career and new love. It’s a bit angsty at first, but the story progresses happily and ends on a happy note. The second husband is doting. The cheating spouses gets their face slaps.

title: Bind This Card to Change Class Into a Level 1 Farmer
summary: [Highly imaginative] + [Unique worldbuilding] Xu Mu, carrying the money for his wife’s life-saving surgery, is transported with his daughter into an apocalyptic world of another realm. A hundred flavors of Sichuan cuisine, each dish with its unique style. From then on, a small town in southern Sichuan gains a small restaurant famous near and far. Diners sit around small tables eating Qiao Jiao beef, young people love bobo chicken skewers for one cent a stick, and veteran gourmets drool over a basin of Linjiang eel shreds. In this life, he will earn money properly and live life slowly. No pretentious face-slapping, only delicious food and leisurely daily life. [a purely gourmet fiction, warm daily life plus Sichuan and Chongqing tyrannosaur!] Alternate titles: “State banquet, and you just cook a cabbage?” “It is just a courtyard outdoor banquet, and you serve the full Manchu Han feast?” “Is the Sichuan and Chongqing tyrannosaur also inheritance?”

summary: (Devoid of harem tropes, predictable patterns, invincible protagonists, repetitive motifs, mindless narratives, and satisfying storytelling; this work may not appeal to everyone. Enter at your own risk.) When I had assumed it was just an ordinary day, I found myself abducted to a mysterious realm known as End Point. When I had assumed escaping merely required participating in these perilous games, I soon discovered my fellow captives were awakening supernatural abilities. When I had assumed that this land was the {Creation Ground of God}, everything was hurtling towards annihilation.

title: Becoming the Emperor in a Female-Oriented Novel, and You Want Me to Kneel and Apologize?
summary: Qin Xiao suddenly finds himself transmigrated into the Great Qin Empire. His literary and martial prowess are unmatched, commanding a million-strong army! Yet, the Emperor wants to depose him for the sake of a false prince? Hold on, are you throwing me into some female-oriented romance plot? How can I tolerate this? With a grand wave of his hand—the Nine Clan Extraction Technique! Slander the Emperor? Very well, all of you shall die! ... The False Prince: "Although I am not the biological son, Father and Mother love me more. The throne should be mine!" The Female Lead: "Qin Xiao, you are the Emperor, and I am a commoner. If you wish to marry me, you must abdicate. Otherwise, you will never have me!" The Empress: "After we divorce, you must give me half the empire!" The Transmigrator Consort: "You worthless Emperor, why should I kneel to you? All men are equal—I advise you to be kind!" The Great General: "The enemy general is my childhood sweetheart. For her sake, I willingly abandon the frontier defenses!" The Retired Emperor: "Although Yu'er was adopted, I prefer him. Qin Xiao, you should abdicate and let him become Emperor!" ... Very well! So this is how you want to play? Facing this twisted world of female-oriented tropes, Qin Xiao grins and raises his hand to unleash—the Nine Clan Extraction Technique! I am the Emperor. Why would I bother reasoning with you? Seal the gates! Leave none alive!

summary: Jobs, hobbies, lifestyles—the world has advanced to a point where nothing can be separated from VR anymore. And now, a VR game was released using the most cutting-edge technologies; its name was “Boot Hour, Shoot Curse.” Our protagonist had no choice but to play solo during the closed beta test, but once the game officially launched, she made lots of friends (but not necessarily with the players), formed a huge clan (but not a clan of players), and matured as an individual.

summary: God asked me to develop the magic medicine in my world, and when I was reincarnated, there were magic medicines with three sets of “lowest quality”, “completely disgusting”, and “no longer poison” waiting for me. Even though he thought that he had to do something about the magic potion, the spirit of a child who loves making things that he originally possessed stood in the way of Julius! The story of Julius, who was born as the third son of the Margrave, gradually develops magic potions while making magic tools and stuffed animals.
