title: I became an Idol Company CEO in a Game.
summary: Because it was just a game, he worked his idols like zombies. Because it was just a game, he disbanded hopeless groups without a second thought. “If I’d known I’d end up inside the game, I never would’ve done that!” [Mission] Save the struggling entertainment company and make it the top in the industry. Time limit: 3 years Failure penalty: Return to the moment of possession Success reward: Return to the real world He’s rich from the tricks he used in the game, but his idols hate him, and the company’s reputation is terrible. He’s already failed nine times because of those bad conditions. “This time... this time for sure...!” After falling just short of becoming number one in the last round, he’s determined to learn from his mistakes, take a more active role, and lead his idols to the very top — and finally escape this cursed game!

title: A Thirty-Something Becomes a VTuber
summary: After quitting a toxic, overworking job on the brink of burnout, I, a thirty-something, somehow ended up becoming a VTuber named Kanzaka Rei under the virtual talent agency “UnderLive,” all thanks to my little sister’s persuasion. “I don’t really get this VTuber thing, but I’ll give it my all!” I thought, brimming with enthusiasm. However, in the female-dominated world of UnderLive, just being a male VTuber gets me bashed by viewers. To make matters worse, on just my second day, a fellow debutant causes a massive scandal, leading to their firing! Will this thirty-something VTuber, swarmed by haters, have any future at all!? …Well, it’s probably still better than working myself to death, right?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Invasion
summary: As a despised assault-type guide, Lin Yuan has a fiancé matched to her by the state. Her fiancé is from a prestigious family, handsome, wealthy, and impeccably mannered, making her the envy of many. Why would such an excellent partner be assigned to her? She doesn’t even meet the standards for tea ceremony, and her cooking skills only earned a “B” grade. “He’ll get tired of her eventually.” “That’s right, they’re doomed to fail.” After hearing these kinds of remarks so often, Lin Yuan also came to believe that she and Jiang Yangshuo were destined to break up. So, when her fiancé appeared before her with a gentle and lovely young woman, she didn’t hesitate to take off her engagement ring and toss it down the drain in front of them both. From then on, Lin Yuan enjoyed a life of freedom, where the sky was the limit, and the sea was vast enough for her to roam as she pleased. Who knew that after a few years of living unrestrained, her ex-fiancé would corner her at a royal banquet, his eyes red-rimmed, and declare that he had been regretting his decision all these years, that he was consumed with longing for her. No, no, no, thank you, please don’t. Lin Yuan, who had become accustomed to her wild ways, had not a single desire to return to her previous life. Her ex-fiancé’s face turned livid as he gritted his teeth, “I don’t mind your type, and I can try my best to tolerate your shortcomings. You won’t find a sentinel who indulges you more than I do.” “Well, you see, I already have a new sentinel.” To completely shake off his entanglement, Lin Yuan casually threw out a name as a shield. She quickly reviewed the images of the sentinels she had met on the battlefield, choosing the name of a brother with whom she had shared life-and-death experiences. She figured the man wouldn’t mind. “He just happens to be a receptive type, a perfect match for me, and he likes me a lot. He doesn’t care about any of my flaws.” Just after sending off her devastated ex-fiancé, Lin Yuan turned around and bumped into the very man she had just name-dropped. That man, who had killed countless enemies on the battlefield and had achieved remarkable merit, had a slightly flushed, handsome face. He turned his head and said softly, “You…when did you know I liked you?” Lin Yuan: “…”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mature, Psychological, Romance, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Marriage of the Di Daughter
summary: The young lady from the Xue family was talented and beautiful, and married the dream husband at the age of 16. They had a loving and harmonious relationship and were together for 3 years when her husband attained the title of Imperial Scholar. Now that he had attained glory and honor, he was dissatisfied with his commoner wife. He craved power and wealth; in his quest to become prince consort, he regarded her as an obstacle to marrying the princess and was willing to mu*der both his wife and children. The arrogant and willful princess stood before her and ridiculed her: “So what if you are exceptionally beautiful and have unparalleled talents? After all, you are only a small official’s daughter, for this princess to crush you – is just as simple as crushing an ant to death!” Her reputation was smeared, she committed su*cide by hanging, her brother was mu*dered while seeking justice for her, and her old father fell ill from the chain of grievous news and passed away. During the 42nd year of Hong Xiao’s reign, Yanjing’s no. 1 beauty, Xue Fang Fei, passed away. She reincarnated into the body of the Grand Secretariat’s daughter, Jiang Li, who drowned and was granted new life! She got into a prominent family and engaged in dirty, underhanded dealings non-stop. She came across all sorts of bad characters, be they monsters or freaks, she dealt with them accordingly. An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Once she was soft-hearted, but now she has become heartless! Jiang Li swore never to be an insignificant character again, and never to allow anyone to trample over herself again. This lifetime, she would seek justice by having her revenge and resolving this blood feud! He is Northern Yan’s youngest duke, he is unrestrained and beautiful, he is capricious, and he collects the world’s strangest flowers. Everyone said that the Grand Secretariat’s second daughter is spirited and lovely, pure and kind, and that she is likened to a white lotus. He is clad in beautiful, red clothes, and retorted with a smile, “A white lotus? She is clearly a man-eating flower that eats people without spitting out bones!” Jiang Li: “Duke, careful you don’t break your hand.” Ji Heng: “Such a ferocious man-eating flower, of course I’m going to snatch it home to safeguard.” An unrestrained hunk vs a daughter from an aristocratic family. The pair of wolves in sheep’s clothing join hands to tyrannize the world.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Romance

title: I Arrived At Wizard World While Cultivating Immortality
summary: Jie Ming discovered he had transmigrated, his golden finger being the Immortal Cultivation Encyclopedia [Great Dao Book Pavilion] . But why had he crossed into a wizard world?! The Star Ring Federation, the Crimson Court, the Void Architecture Academy, the Anti-Entropy Alliance… the wizard civilization, in its era of great expansion, waged war like ravenous wolves and tigers against every discovered plane. This was the best of times and the worst of times. Faced with the reality of potentially becoming an experimental subject or cannon fodder in an impending planar war, Jie Ming chose to lay low, diligently honing his skills, amassing resources, and leveraging the knowledge of two worlds to quietly grow stronger in the perilous depths of the Star Abyss. “No need to fear. I’m just a logistics guy, without the power of a combat wizard. I’m only here to gather some raw materials.” With that, Jie Ming gazed at the plane before him, reached out, and in an instant, refined it!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Surviving the Apocalypse with Hundreds of Millions in Supplies
summary: Rainstorms, extreme cold, earthquakes, mutated plants and animals, extreme heat, acid rain, blizzards… various natural disasters come one after another, the established order collapses, survival supplies decrease, and animals and plants mutate. Everywhere is dangerous, and all of humanity faces a huge survival challenge. Lin Ruo, a Level 5 dual-attribute Psionic, struggled in the apocalypse for five years, originally thinking she could survive until the end of the apocalypse, but she self-destructed under the betrayal of her teammates. With her previous life's psionic ability, she is reborn one month before the apocalypse, and using the antiques stored in her space, she begins to frantically hoard supplies. She wants to use these supplies to survive the natural disasters.

title: The Heroine of the 1st Playthrough Remembers My Training
summary: A hardcore adult game enthusiast finds himself as Yujin Calliope, the protagonist of “Academy’s Trainer”. Armed with knowledge from his first playthrough, he must navigate death events and train the heroines, all virg*ns except married women. But when Lucia, the heroine from his first run, remembers his previous “training”, new challenges arise. Can Yujin use his gaming expertise and unique abilities to conquer the game and achieve a happy ending in this unpredictable reality-turned-game world?
genres: Action, Adult, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: After the Doll Becomes Woman, the Male Lead Goes Even Crazier
summary: Bella stayed up all night finishing the tomato novel her roommate had insisted she recite from cover to cover, then fell straight asleep. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself transformed into the doll on the male lead’s desk—a literal, actual doll! To escape being trapped in the doll’s body, she must make physical contact with the male lead to extend her life force. But just as her mind was racing, the boy at the desk stared at her coldly—”Bella, you’re crying.” …

title: Cheat Roulette! ~I Got the Worst Cheat When I Reincarnated, So I’ll Live a Slow Life in the Countryside~
summary: On my way home from a part-time job, I died after a goddess stepped on the back of my head. As an apology, the goddess offered to reincarnate me into a world of swords and magic. But I had no confidence in battles or harems, so I asked to be sent to a more peaceful and relaxed world instead. What awaited me as a result was…over eight hours of long, long persuasion. Or rather, it felt more like blackmail or brainwashing than persuasion… Before I knew it, I had agreed to be reincarnated into a world of swords and magic with a cheat ability. The so-called cheat sounded good on paper: 『You can choose from all kinds of cheat skills and cheat items.』 But in reality, it was just a lottery. Apparently, I’d throw a dart at something called the 『Cheat Roulette』 and get whatever cheat it landed on. …There’s no helping it anymore. I just have to go through with it! I can’t handle another eight hours of brainwashing!! For the sake of a peaceful afterlife, I’m putting everything into this single throw— ※ This is a full-on comedy, filled with ridiculous antics alongside the goddess and the people of another world. I hope it brings a smile to your face. If you’re interested, please give it a read.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: The Ninth Lady is Rebellious and Arrogant Person
summary: The Ninth Lady of the Marquis of Kaiping’s household, Lang Jiuchuan, returned to the capital after spending more than ten years away recuperating, only to attend a funeral. Yet, upon reunion, her birth mother disliked her, her family distanced themselves, and she was regarded as nothing but a troublemaker and a jinx. Entering the capital’s noble circle for the first time, the aristocrats mocked her as a country bumpkin with the face of someone destined for an early death, her manners crude, like wild grass from the mountains—utterly unfit for the grand stage. But Lang Jiuchuan thought: wild grass is the best! Full of life, growing tall with the wind—it resonated with her heart completely! While people secretly placed bets on when this seemingly insignificant, short-lived girl would perish, they forgot—she was a “calamity,” one that could last a thousand years. That’s right, she might look delicate, soft, and easy to bully, but—just try and touch her. Do they sigh that she has no one to protect her? What a joke. She can grow her own wings—why bother climbing anyone else’s ladder? By day she severs the yang, by night she severs the yin. With divine powers that shook the world, nobles knelt with riches, begging to invite her aid. Yet all Lang Jiuchuan wanted was to accumulate merit, reshape her body, extend her life, recover her soul—and settle old scores along the way. So what if her beginning was hell itself? She would carve her way out in blood!
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural

title: I Took in a Peerless Sword Immortal in an Abandoned Residential Building
summary: 【Invincible + Multiple Heroines + Multiverse + Romantic Daily Life + Light Combat + High Martial Arts + Rent Collection Wealth】 At the start, he inherited a rundown house in the urban village from his grandfather. The house had no tenants, but the moment he was diagnosed with a terminal illness, a self-proclaimed empress from the Tianxuan Continent arrived as his first tenant. Ye Chuan soon discovered that with every new tenant moving in, not only did he receive massive daily payments, but he also obtained unique items related to their backgrounds. 【Acquired Bai Qianshuang’s related item: Tiger Strength Pill—dramatically enhances physical power!】 【Acquired Bai Qianshuang’s related item: Deer Blood Pill—significantly boosts vitality!】 …… From that day on, all sorts of bizarre tenants began appearing in the house: the empress from Tianxuan Continent, an apocalyptic sorceress from the Magic Realm, a mysterious scientific girl who fell through a spacetime rift… Every single day, he received strange, powerful items and endless money. Then one day, he suddenly realized—he had become invincible. Enough, enough! Stop giving me more!

title: Cheat Magician Life That Started From Being Judged Useless
summary: I am Kokubu Kento, an eighth grader. While I was sleeping in class, the whole grade was summoned to a different world. According to the princess who summoned us, we weren’t summoned as heroes. Instead, we were meant to be replacements for dead soldiers. As we were being checked for magic, I got a useless rating, and I was about to get exiled but was given a last chance… I have a bad feeling about it… I wonder if I can go back… a cheat that awakens in desperate situations? The evilest skeletons are my guards? I’m in a different country after leaving the forest? A life without cheats in the world where I was abandoned started. Dungeon? Still haven’t gotten permission. Today I will be working the whole day at the warehouse to carry sweet potatoes, getting 350 helt daily. The guild debt and the living money are… Well, I live in a restaurant so the food is delicious.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Marquis Mansion’s Elite Class
summary: [Sweet Baby + Parenting + Doting In-laws + Light-hearted + Redemption] Xu Wan became a widow right after her marriage, initially hoping to enjoy a carefree life as a Marquis's wife. Unexpectedly, on her very first day at the mansion, that notorious troublemaker of a stepson, infamous throughout the capital, tried to intimidate her twice. Xu Wan grabbed a knife and rushed out, instantly becoming the talk of the entire capital! Though she thought her dreams of being the Marquis's wife were over, her in-laws surprisingly retaliated by entrusting the little devil to her care for reformation. Xu Wan: "???" Little Devil: "???" At first, no one believed it would work... But later, the maids would exclaim in amazement every day: "The young master who never studied is actually going to the study room!" "The young master is even bringing foot-washing water for the old Marquis!" "The young master actually saved all the children in the slums!" ... The Marquis's mansion was shocked, the entire capital was shocked, even His Majesty in the palace was shocked. Word spread that the Marquis's wife had a special talent for reforming troublesome children. Soon, court officials began sending their rebellious sons to the mansion, and the mansion's "elite class" kept growing! Three years later. The Minister of Rites, responsible for the imperial examinations, wailed to the heavens: "It's impossible to choose! They're all top candidates!"
genres: Completed, Comedy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Debut Is Your Only Option
summary: The eternal top trainee of Korea’s number one major entertainment agency. So what? After six years of trainee life, all I had left was a failed college entrance exam score. While preparing to retake the exam, a system window appeared one day. And its contents? [Debut at Xso Entertainment, where there are no staff, no trainees, and no know-how!] “…” Rejection is not an option. Fine, if I have to do it anyway, let’s do it properly.

title: YuuShou Gaiden: Six☆Stars
summary: In the world of Trinia, which consists of three realms, the God Realm, the Human Realm, and the Demon Realm…… within one of them, in the Demon Realm, reigns overwhelming beings known as the Six Kings. This is a lively and cheerful tale depicting the daily lives of one of the Six Kings, the Death King Isis Remnant, and her subordinates.

title: Game Invasion: Stealing the Male and Female Leads’ Opportunities Is Addictive
summary: [Rerolling Talents at the Start + Early Beta Test Access] Early Talent: [God of Thieves] (S-Level) Midgame Evolution: [One-Person Party] (SS-Level) "A free soul is never bound by the thorns of nobility. There’s no need to ascend to the divine altar or sugarcoat our deeds. We are thieves lurking in the shadows—know yourself, and then revel in unbridled joy." As the world turns into a game, every player awakens a divinely bestowed talent: [Holy Light] , [Immortal] , [Breath of Winter] , [Frozen Throne] , [Elegance Never Goes Out of Style] , [Clock Out, Then Become a Chef God] , [Best Supporting Role] , [Marshmallow] , [Butter Beer] , and so on... After being reborn, the first thing Yu Xunge does is rush home to force-feed her brother—soon to marry into the Su family—a bottle of liquor, ensuring he misses the first beta test of the game. In her past life, this s*umbag had manipulated her endlessly. It wasn’t until her dying moments that she discovered he had been scheming against her from the shadows all along. On her deathbed, she learned she was nothing more than the villain in a male-oriented novel about a live-in son-in-law’s rise to power. All the malice and suffering she endured? It was him shifting blame onto her from behind the scenes. This time, it’s her turn to operate in the shadows. Male and female leads? All your fortunes? They’re mine now. Join the beta, reroll talents, and wreak havoc from behind the curtain!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: My Villainous Fiancée Always Changes Her Persona
summary: Pei Du was Xie Jingci’s fiancé, a man she had barely met. After she was bound to a quick-transmigration system and returned from completing her missions, she learned of a shocking turn of events. Pei Du had suffered grave injuries, lost all his cultivation, and was cast out by his family. According to the original plot, he would eventually succumb to darkness, turning into a demonic villain whom the entire world would hunt down. Just as Xie Jingci prepared to seek him out, a sudden ding-dong echoed in her mind: [World fusion incomplete! Host’s character settings have been disrupted! Current persona: Enchanting and seductive demoness of the Devil Sect.] And so, deep into the night, Pei Du found his nominal fiancée standing before him, holding a box of pastries. Under the bewitching moonlight, the woman traced her fingers along his neck—not like an immortal, but like a soul-stealing temptress. “I came here just for you.” At the time, Xie Jingci had no idea that Pei Du had secretly adored her for years. Pei Du was born with a sword spirit bone, but after sacrificing himself to slay a demon using forbidden arts, his cultivation was shattered, leaving him powerless and at the mercy of others. Fortunately, his fiancée never abandoned him. Except… this fiancée of his seemed a little… unusual. When enemies provoked them, she flawlessly framed them with teary eyes, embodying the essence of a white lotus: “Don’t blame him… it’s all my fault…” When his family bullied him, she beat every last one of them bloody, tossing a million spirit stones at their feet: “One million—now get lost and leave Pei Du alone.” And when he lay battered and covered in filth, she pressed a soft kiss to his wounds, her voice sweet as honey: “Do you like it?” Pei Du: “Miss Xie…” (blushing) [Reading Guide] 1. A sweet, wish-fulfillment romance—the male lead has been pining from the start. 2. A bloodthirsty tsundere x an easily flustered young master. 3. Personas include: Seductress / White Lotus / Dominant Alpha / Yandere / Spoiled Brat / and more.

title: The Fake Heiress’s Inner Thoughts Were Heard by Her Entire Family
summary: [Mind Reading + Transmigration into a Novel + Sweet Love in a Wealthy Family + CEO + Family’s Darling + Entertainment Industry] Jing Yi transmigrated into a sweet romance novel about a true and false heiress in a wealthy family. The good news: at a young age, she could live a life of luxury! The bad news: she was the villainous fake heiress who ultimately faces retribution… In the original story, Jing Yi was adopted by the Jing family as a child. However, consumed by jealousy towards the female lead, she resorted to various schemes to frame her. She even colluded with rival companies to sabotage the Jing family’s business. After her actions were discovered by the Jing family, she not only lost everything but also lived a miserable life thereafter. After transmigrating, Jing Yi behaved herself for two years. She hadn’t met any family members except Grandmother Jing and was working hard to become an inconspicuous member of the wealthy household! That is, until the dying grandmother arranged for her to meet the rest of the Jing family… [Oh no! They’ve finally reunited as a family. I shouldn’t go and be a bother!] Suddenly, silence fell. The Jing family members looked at Jing Yi’s nervous expression with puzzled faces. * Jing Yi still ended up being brought back to the country by the Jing family. [Big brother really lives up to his ‘workaholic’ title. The Jing family is so lucky to have you! Keep it up! Here’s to the rest of my life!] Jing Ze Yu silently watched Jing Yi, who was showing concern for his health. [Wow! A living, breathing brother complex princess?!] Jing Ze Qian silently clenched his fists as he looked at the seemingly obedient Jing Yi in front of him. [Jing Ze Jun and Actor Wen are truly a match made in heaven! No one can break up my OTP!] Jing Ze Jun’s face turned bright red as she lowered her head, noticing the looks her family members were giving her. #Sincerity is always the ultimate secret weapon!# #When my inner thoughts have no script, will you still love me?#
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Magician Kunon Sees Everything
summary: Kunon was born blind and aims to be the first person ever to use water magic to create new eyes for himself. After five months of study, he has already surpassed his teacher, and continues to grow his talents. Not only can his magic help him sense the color, but he can also use it to make handy items and even conjure a whole cat! Word of his skills and ingenuity soon reach the court and earn him a spot as disciple to the most powerful magician in the land. But is his ultimate goal even attainable?
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, School Life, Slice of Life

title: I Am a Landlady in the Apocalypse
summary: Kicked out of her home by biased parents and a vicious sister, Su Tao decides to cut ties with them completely. She'd rather starve, freeze, or wander the streets for a lifetime than ever go back. By a twist of fate, she binds to the "Landlady System," which grants her a 3,000-square-meter safe zone. While her scummy dad's family crams into a single room, barely scraping by, Su Tao lives alone, tidying up her cozy little home, building new houses one after another. When business booms, finding a room becomes nearly impossible. On the side, she plays with cats and dogs, meets a group of powerful tenants, and relies on collecting rent to become a little rich lady, living her life to the fullest.

title: Today, The Villain Couple is Settling Scores Again
summary: Jian Huan found herself transported into a xianxia novel as the fiancee of the main antagonist. Feeling her empty wallet, she recalled the pitiful fate of the original owner of the body who stubbornly refused to annul the marriage. Without hesitation, she took the marriage contract and went to the antagonist for a friendly negotiation. At this moment, Shen Jizhi, the future scourge of the cultivation world, was still a righteous disciple. He silently looked at the marriage contract with a cold expression, asking, “How can I get you to annul this marriage?” “One hundred thousand spirit stones,” Jian Huan held up ten fingers, “as long as you pay one hundred thousand spirit stones, our marriage will be void.” Shen Jizhi fell into silence for a moment. “Is there nothing else you want me to do?” Jian Huan shook her head. “None.” Shen Jizhi asked sternly, “You will only accept this condition?” Without hesitation, Jian Huan replied, “Yes.” Shen Jizhi’s tone turned harsh. “Then there’s no annulment.” Jian Huan was confused. “?” Shen Jizhi looked at her and said, “I won’t annul the marriage. We can get married whenever you want.” He bid farewell. “I have other matters to attend to. Goodbye.” Jian Huan exclaimed, “???”
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Xianxia

title: Miss Ruyi’s Unremarkable Daily Life
summary: Shen Ruyi, after unexpectedly transmigrating and being rescued scarred and bruised, only wanted to live a quiet life as a salted fish, eating and waiting to die. But as she continued to live quietly, how did she become the Miss Ruyi whom everyone respected? Wangfu Wet Nurse: The desolate patch of land in a corner of the side room is now green with vegetables. It seems this girl wasn't lying; she's the daughter of an old farmer. Client A: The yard-sweeping girl who recently arrived actually knows carpentry. Is it true that in this world, women are used like men and men are used like oxen and horses? Street Vendor Outside the Gate: Even for a rough maid in the Prince's Mansion, her accounting is incredibly fast and accurate. Miss, can you teach me? Advisor B: Who exactly revised that dropped document? It's making him uneasy about his promotion to advisor in the Prince's Mansion! Who is it? Who on earth is it? She wrote a family letter for a colleague, and the letter was intercepted. The letter arrived on a certain Prince's desk. The small, elegant script was flowing, dignified, clear, and graceful, truly the work of a master. A certain Prince looked up: Is this the "old maid" you claimed could absolutely not be an enemy spy? Shen Ruyi: … Clearly, he's an old man. She even thought the ox was too old, right? A certain Prince: … An old ox eating young grass? Shen Ruyi: …
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Rescuing the Beautiful and Strong yet Miserable Second Lead Character
summary: Luo Han read a xianxia novel in which everyone is in love and sacrifices everything for love. Later, she was summoned and transmigrated into the book. She then learned that she was actually the incarnation of the Heavenly Law in the novel. In the later part of the novel, the protagonists waged war for love and almost destroyed the world. In order to save herself, she had to embark on the journey to save the world. The best way to stop the war was to prevent the blackening of the second male lead character. Ling Qingxiao, the second male character, was the most beautiful and strong yet miserable in the entire book. He was originally the legal son, but was exchanged with the illegitimate son, the male lead. Ling Qingxiao grew up as an illegitimate son and suffered from extensive ab*ses. Later, their identity was revealed, but his biological mother and adoptive mother all protected the male lead, and even the female lead stabbed Ling Qingxiao fatally for the male lead. Ling Qingxiao fell into the abyss with a slight chance of survival, he literally crawled back from hell. From then on, he blackened and thoroughly dominated the whole world. It was too late when Luo Han transmigrated, Ling Qingxiao had fallen into the abyss. She could only rescue Ling Qingxiao and talk to him about truth, kindness and beauty every day, trying to get him to do a good job in his career and not to fall in love. Later… Ling Qingxiao indeed did a good job in his career, unifying the six realms, dominating heaven and earth, yet she was detained. “I heard that if someone wants a child, they need to plead a wish to the Heavenly Law?” “I want to stay together for a long time, with generations of offspring filling the house. I don’t know whether Heavenly Law will allow it or not.” ****** Luo Han was the incarnation of the consciousness of the Heavenly Law. In the six realms, she could hear all kinds of swearing to heaven every day. Such as– The original male lead: “The Heavenly Law is not fair, I want to go against the heaven!” Luo Han: Don’t be a scam, I don’t even know who you are. Some random male character: “If anyone under the heaven dares to bully her, I will kill everyone in the world!” Luo Han: What did you say? Say that again?! The beautiful and strong yet miserable second lead character: “I only wish my heaven to be safe, happy, in good health, and well.” You are the only thing I want in my whole life.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Mature, Romance, Xianxia

title: Gacha Addict’s Fusionpunk Life
summary: Even if this world is a dark fantasy, I seek today's dopamine.

title: The Cannon Fodder Female Supporting Character Becomes an Unfettered Immortal
summary: Gu Ningyun transmigrated into a novel. And of all roles, she became the cannon fodder female side character—destined to have her spiritual root dug out by the heroine right at the start. So what should she do? Simple. She packed up and ran. What, the heroine is searching for her like crazy? No problem—Gu Ningyun is already busy looting all of the heroine’s opportunities.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: After the Story ended, I came Back
summary: I was the cannon fodder villainess in a xianxia novel. Highborn, untouchable, reckless. I trampled over others at will. s*upid, vicious and admittedly beautiful. That, at least, was how the girl who stole my body chose to describe me. She had a strategy system at her side, guiding her to “redeem” a man destined to one day plunge the Three Realms into chaos, to keep him from turning dark. Every time I saw her wear my face, flaunt my name, and then lower herself before that worthless brat who wasn’t even worthy to carry my shoes, bowing and scraping like a dog, I wanted nothing more than to tear them both to pieces. What I hated most was that no one around me noticed anything wrong. Even if they did, they thought the imposter was a better version of me. My own family and friends betrayed me, showering her with more affection than they had ever given me. My resentment grew with each passing day, until the story reached its end when, before all their friends and family, the two of them held a grand wedding. On that day, the system gave her a choice: stay in this world with the male lead for a lifetime of love, or return to reality. After much hesitation, she chose the latter. The moment she left, I returned to my body. I opened my eyes and there he was. The so-called redeemed villain stood before me, gazing at me with eyes brimming with tenderness, and placed an exquisite token of love into my hand. He said the hairpin could break his undying body, that he was entrusting me with the only blade that could kill him, to prove his devotion. I accepted the hairpin, deeply moved. Then, with a smile, I turned it in my hand and drove the sharp point straight into his chest. Clutching his wound, he stared at me in disbelief. “Why?” he asked. I widened my eyes innocently, lips curling into a smile. “I just wanted to see if it worked. Who would’ve thought it really did?” And with that, I pushed the hairpin two inches deeper into his heart.

title: The Riverboat of My Heart
summary: [1] Xu Cheng approaches Jiang Xi and destroys the Jiang family; the Jiang family is shattered, and Jiang Xi’s whereabouts remain unknown. [2] Over the years, Xu Cheng can no longer tell whether he feels guilt or love for Jiang Xi. Is it love born from guilt, or guilt born from love? Jiang Xi can no longer tell whether he hates or loves Xu Cheng. Does love turn to hate, or hate turns to love? What difference does it make? [3] She thought he was her boat, but it was actually a spear to her heart. [4] She is his white moonlight, and also his cinnabar mole.
genres: Completed, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Tragedy

title: I Became the Hot Northern Duke in a Romance Fantasy
summary: I just wanted to live quietly. But this face is the problem. “Young lord, what is this?” the princess asks. “Young lord, play with me.” the tower master’s daughter grabs my arm. I want to keep my head down, but the Empire won’t let me.

title: How Did I Become the White Moonlight Just by Acting Up?
summary: “You are a cannon-fodder character in this world. Your character tags are: beautiful, vicious, and s*upid. When you were eight years old, you were adopted by the Shen family, the number one wealthy family in Jingang. For the past twelve years, Shen Zhuang has treated you like a treasure, yet you joined hands with your villainous mother to scheme against the Shen family. You are obsessed with the male lead, and in the end, you used disgraceful means to obtain the position of the Shen family’s young madam. But the male lead does not love you. In order to win back his heart, you keep courting death in all kinds of ways, pushing the male lead and his destined true heroine into an unbreakable romance. In the end, you will be expelled from the Shen family by the male lead, abandoned by your villainous mother, and commit su*cide by jumping into the river…” As cannon fodder who suddenly awakens self-awareness, Jiang Huashan says: This plot? Absolutely impossible to follow.

title: Promised to Be a Temporary Dao Companion, But the Fairy Insists It’s Permanent
summary: Qin Hao transmigrated into the world as the young master of a primordial ancient clan, awakening the [Dao Companion Rental System] . By renting himself out as a temporary dao companion to daughters of destiny, Qin Hao could obtain generous rewards. His service philosophy was simple: play the role of the devoted lover, resolve their troubles, depart without a trace once the matter was settled, and absolutely avoid entangling karma. However, those daughters of destiny didn't see it that way. That night, all the major powers across the Three Realms and Nine Heavens jointly besieged the Qin Clan, plunging it into an unprecedented crisis. "It's Su Qingyue! The peerless sword immortal who attained the Dao and became an Immortal Emperor in a thousand years, the one who severed the River of Time with a single sword strike! When... when did our Qin Clan make an enemy of her?" Qin Hao stepped forward, clearing his throat lightly: "Ahem, Ancestors, don't panic. She's here for me. To be honest... she's my ex-girlfriend." From another direction, the newly ascended Empress of the Demon Realm arrived with ten thousand demons pressing on the border: "Qin Hao! Today, the entire Qin Clan shall be buried with you!" Hearing this, the Qin Clan ancestors all turned their eyes sharply towards Qin Hao. Qin Hao scratched his head somewhat sheepishly: "The Demon Empress... she's also my ex-girlfriend." Before the Qin ancestors could process this, an aloof figure traversed the River of Time: "The Qin Clan deserves annihilation!" Recognizing the newcomer, the Qin ancestors paled in terror: "It's her! Liu Ruyan, the Extinction Empress who ventured alone into the alien realm and suppressed it for an entire epoch! Didn't she vanish into the River of Time long ago? Why would she cross it just to target our clan?" Qin Hao scratched his head again, looking even more embarrassed: "My fault, my fault. She's an ex-girlfriend too." Watching countless celestial maidens descend, the Qin Clan ancestors were utterly astounded: "You scoundrel! Just... just how many women have you gotten involved with over the years?"

title: I Am a Green Tea Cat in a Domineering CEO Novel
summary: Su Jiujiu was conscripted by the Book Traveling Agency to portray a vicious female antagonist. Her task involved acting like a manipulative Green Tea around the male protagonist, highlighting the heroine's kindness and innocence. However, there was an error when the system selected her body, transforming her into a cat instead! Su Jiujiu broke down, crying out, "Quickly, give me a different body! How can I fulfill my mission as just a cat?!" The system who was equally distraught, responded, "Not enough points; c-can't change it!" Fine, being a cat shouldn't be that scary! She could still be a cunning Green Tea Machiavellian Cat! Su Jiujiu infiltrated the male protagonist's home as a pet, playing the role of Green Tea one day and scheming the next, determined to earn more points for a new body! ----------- Tan Chen who was constantly harassed by various female supporting characters, even found himself reluctantly adopting a Green Tea Cat. This cat wasn't just a classic Green Tea; she was also finicky, lazy, gluttonous, and surprisingly flirtatious! Impressive! He decided he'd toss her out in a couple of days. But mere moments after banishing the cat, news arrived about it getting hit by a car. Abandoning his company affairs, Tan Chen rushed back immediately. As long as the cat was unharmed, he vowed to treat her like his own daughter! ---------- Ever since Tan Chen adopted the Green Tea Cat, his attention became solely focused on her, causing the other female supporting characters to finally reach their breaking point. "Mr. Tan, don't you feel like this cat is overly scheming?" "Could it have learned bad habits from someone?" Tan Chen, with the Green Tea Machiavellian Cat draped around his neck, was quite displeased upon hearing these words. "You mean, learned bad habits from me?" The side character hesitated, silently protesting, "No, not at all!" In the battle between Female Supporting Character vs. Scheming Cat, the former failed miserably! As Su Jiujiu continued to dominate the protagonist's bed, mercilessly stomping on his face, she finally accumulated enough task points. Instantaneously, the system redeemed them for a perfect human body! And just like that, Su Jiujiu transformed directly into the protagonist's arms! Lifting her head, she met Tan Chen's astonished gaze and instantly crumbled, exclaiming, "I wanted a different identity, not a direct transformation from cat to human!" Tan Chen watched wide-eyed as a feline girl, adorned with cute little tiger stripes, suddenly appeared on top of him before swiftly changing back into the familiar cat within mere seconds. His eyes slowly narrowed, and he grabbed the cat attempting to flee. "What's going on here?" "Change again, let me see."

title: Golden Cage Shines on Mountains and Rivers
summary: I was meant to marry the Emperor of Great Liang, but a decree for a political marriage sent me to Northern Yan instead. On our wedding night, I mixed blood from the tip of my tongue into the wedding wine, intending to poison the tyrannical prince. Yet, he drained the poisoned cup for me and said with a smile, "Don't be in such a hurry. The heads of every official in this court-I will cut them off for you, one by one."
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Tragedy

title: Transmigrated Life of a Salted Fish Family
summary: After a family of three transmigrates into a novel, they realize that the protagonist of this old-fashioned story is actually their original body's eldest uncle. In the original plot, they had been leeching off their uncle, were kicked out of the family early on, and only reappeared at the end as pitiful background characters living in misery. At this point in the story, their cousin’s reputation had been ruined, their uncle had been beaten up while seeking justice, the wheat in the fields was on the verge of rotting if not harvested soon, they had no money at all, and Yan Lao’er was even burdened with a twenty-tael gambling debt… Just when they were at their wit’s end, the Support Trade Platform arrived like a blessing from the heavens. Support Trade Platform: Connecting multiple dimensions, dedicated to assisting struggling users, overcoming difficulties, and getting through hard times together. "Yes, yes! We’re poor! We need help!" The three of them: Prepare to accept their fate, work hard, and survive on their own. But unexpectedly—their eldest uncle was reborn!!! After careful consideration, he made up his mind to protect the whole family and take a completely different path. Reality: What? No separation?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Historical, Slice of Life

title: Became a Special Monster in Hero City
summary: I possessed someone in a female-dominated gacha game where only women can use their powers. And as a special monster at that.

title: Martial Cultivator
summary: Chen Chao dreamt of becoming a powerful immortal cultivator, flying on his sword and vanquishing enemies with daoist magic. His hopes were dashed when he discovered that he had absolutely no talent for immortal cultivation. Refusing to submit to his fate, Chen Chao joined the ranks of countless other talentless martial artists and embarked on the path of martial cultivation, a path scorned by the immortal cultivators. In this era of strife where martial cultivators, immortal cultivators, and demonic cultivators wrestled for hegemony, Chen Chao will either rise to the top or fall into eternal damnation.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: White-Winged Harpy
summary: At the Wedge Tower, where any and all magical knowledge is gathered, the mages of the Empire collaborate and compete, and once every three years, they recruit new apprentice mages. “I want to fly.”—Tia, a young girl who aspires to be a mage for that reason alone, challenges the Wedge Tower’s entrance examination. This is a story of mages, and of monsters on the brink of extinction.
genres: Fantasy, School Life, Slice of Life

title: General, Madam Called You To Farm
summary: She had just taken a nap in the lounge, and when she awoke, she was an illiterate chubby peasant girl in ancient times. Not to mention that this girl enjoys eating and slouching, but she behaved like a village bully. No one in the village desired to marry her, and it was difficult to eventually find a wealthy husband, but the groom fled on the wedding day. Her father, enraged, headed down the street and abducted a husband for her. Dad, I think you caught a troublemaker.. * Su Pangya became very busy after her marriage. Busy transforming her bully dad and brother. Busy rescuing her gorgeous husband. Busy parenting three little cute bullies. She unintentionally became Dayan's most powerful female marquis!

title: So I Became a Witch and Started Doing Daily Quests
summary: "Hello, esteemed Miss Janna Roland. How do you feel about having received the title of [Most Charming Witch] , awarded by Wizard Weekly, for three consecutive years?" "To be honest, rather than that title, I prefer the way other wizards refer to me." "You don't mean: Master of Life, Keeper of Summoning Laws, Spirit Realm’s Dearest, Guardian of the Four Seasons, Soul Singer...?" "None of those." "I prefer to be called — the Erudite Wizard."
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Mystery, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Became a God-Level Martial Artist
summary: Martial gods live in my Inn.

title: Marrying the Nine Thousand-Year-Old Lord in Place of My Sister
summary: 【Double virg*n + Exclusive Favor + Sister Swap Marriage + Ruthless Imperial Steward vs. Lazy Beauty】Jiang Yunshu transmigrated into the life of a lowly concubine-born daughter of the Western Ping Marquis Household. With food to eat and a roof over her head, she was content to laze around, hoping to remain an unnoticed shadow in the household. Her legitimate elder sister, Jiang Zhaohua, was renowned throughout the capital, and an imperial decree summoned her to enter the palace as a concubine. But after a high fever, Jiang Zhaohua refused to go, even if it meant death—instead, she forced Jiang Yunshu to take her place. Jiang Yunshu: "…Has my sister lost her mind? Handing such immense fortune to me?" — The marquis’s legitimate daughter, Jiang Zhaohua, had been reborn! In her past life, on the very night she entered the palace, the emperor died suddenly. She was seized by the all-powerful Imperial Steward, going from the emperor’s concubine to the Nine-Thousand-Year Eunuch’s woman. Yet after seeing her once, the Steward never laid eyes on her again. She went from a noble daughter to a lowly maidservant, living in unbearable misery… Then, she heard that the concubine-born sister she once despised had married a poor scholar—who later topped the imperial examinations, rising step by step to become the Prime Minister, elevating her sister to the rank of First-Class Noble Consort! After her rebirth, Jiang Zhaohua made her younger sister take her place in the palace while she married the poor scholar. After the sister swap, she waited eagerly for her husband to rise to power. But she waited… and waited… and waited… Her husband never climbed the ranks. Instead, she found herself kneeling at the feet of her once-lowly sister, Jiang Yunshu, no longer even worthy of looking up at her. The Imperial Steward, ruthless and cruel to the world, doted on Jiang Yunshu alone, showering her with unparalleled glory and favor.

title: The Day We Broke Up, It Rained So Hard
summary: Beneath Nanshan stands a tree, said to be blessed. They say if you hang a couple's lock with the names of two people you love on it, you'll be together forever. That day, someone in the class group chat posted a photo of a couple's lock— Xia Tian & Xu Buzhou: A lifetime together. Xia Tian is an ordinary girl, so ordinary that when her name is placed alongside that of a radiant boy, people laugh. Xu Buzhou had just finished playing basketball. White jersey, black sneakers, carrying the fresh scent of summer youth as he walked into the classroom. The boys playfully handed him the photo. Xia Tian buried her flushed face in her book, wishing she could die right there on the spot. The tall, lean boy opened an ice-cold cola with his left hand and asked carelessly— "Who the hell is this?" * Later, when Xu Buzhou rode past the camphor tree, he said with carefree abandon, "Want to come with me?" In that moment, Xia Tian was happy enough to feel dizzy. Much later, she learned from others that it was all a bet. Everyone wagered that the school heartthrob couldn't last two weeks with this dull, unremarkable, plain-looking bookworm. The prize was a basketball signed by a star player. The day of the breakup it rained so hard. Xia Tian held back her tears, removed the couple's lock from Nanshan that promised a lifetime together, and threw it into the mountains. * It's unclear who broke their promise first. She never knew that on the day she threw away the lock, Xu Buzhou searched the mountains all night long. And she would never have the chance to know that later, Xu Buzhou spent his entire life with her ashes.
genres: Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: My Master and Senior Sister Want Me to Help Them With Their Cultivation
summary: [Tags: All C, all take, HE (happy ending), Forced love, 1 vs many] After a hundred lifetimes of cultivation, Chen Yuyang refined the Primordial Sacred Body. But in his final cycle of reincarnation, he was unexpectedly taken in by the Hehuan Sect. “Master is only helping you get used to the heart-method for resisting s*xual temptation — disciple, you must hold back, okay~” “Junior brother, if you refuse me now, you might just become my new inner demon~ You don’t want to see your senior sister die, do you?” “Junior brother, now you either dual-cultivate with me to help me breakthrough, or we die together here.” “Senior brother, senior brother — how did you, a man, join the Hehuan Sect? Surely you didn’t come to be the sacrificial furnace? If so, you should shoulder the furnace’s duties and help your junior sister train properly!” “Fellow cultivator, you look like someone I once knew… a heartless man! Never mind — today I’ll kill you and be done with it—”

title: After Severing Her Emotions, the Whole Sect Was Overwhelmed with Grief
summary: In her previous life, Bai Ying gave everything she had to the sect—her heart, her soul, her loyalty. But all she got in return was disdain. Her Master despised her, her senior brothers abandoned her, and in the end, they even cut open her Golden Core for the sake of a newly arrived junior sister. She died with her eyes open, full of resentment. In this life, she cut off all her emotions. She severed all ties with everyone. But why were those who once looked down on her now kneeling one by one before her, begging for forgiveness? Bai Ying stared coldly at them. A heart that has died—how could it come back to life? She would never forgive them.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Martial Arts, Mystery, Xianxia

title: Everyone Wants To Harm Me
summary: As the only granddaughter of the Duke of Peng, cherished like a precious gem by her grandfather, and the most beloved niece of the Empress, He Qi Yao’s first fifteen years of life were like living in a honey jar. Except for one incident where she got drunk on her first matchmaking outing, clung to a pillar while declaring love for two hours, and was thoroughly embarrassed by her grandfather's arch-enemy and political rival, she had never faced any real difficulties. However, on the eve of her sixteenth birthday, life suddenly took a turn for the worse for this little kitten... After being bitten by a snake, she suddenly gains the ability to see through people’s true thoughts. Everyone's hidden agendas and dark motives are vividly revealed, with no place to hide. But strangely, the rival who holds her dark secrets turns out to be a miraculous white lotus?

title: I Am Not the Mastermind [Infinite]
summary: This is a terrifying, never-ending game initiated by the gods themselves, known as the Playground of the Pantheon. And somehow, Yi Fengchu, a mere supernatural-phenomena enthusiast, obtained a strange cellphone capable of contacting the Playground of the Pantheon. In return for listening to all manner of eerie ghost stories, he ended up helping one group of players after another escape from certain doom, witnessing the rise of countless legends. But he never imagined that while he remained addicted to watching the players’ stories as an uninvolved spectator, a rumor began spreading within the Playground, a rumor about Him. Some extremely fortunate players claimed they once picked up a mysterious phone left behind by an unknown existence within the dungeons. As long as they were willing to trade a terrifying experience of their own, they would receive a chance to survive their moment of utter despair. They called Him the Narrator, a being detached from all webs of causality, who could speak of life and death as casually as breathing. He was destiny, and he was eternity. He was the Ouroboros coiled along the edges of the world, the colossal serpent of the mortal realm, the king of silver-white serpents. “Without a doubt, this is the Pantheon’s infiltration. And clearly, He has already succeeded, most of the top players have received His blessing and follow His guidance.” Yi Fengchu: “…I have not.” “Perhaps He is the ultimate mastermind behind all these nightmares, a witness and observer from a higher dimension.” Yi Fengchu: “…Who are you talking about?”

title: Apocalypse: My Items Have Unlimited Upgrades
summary: The sun disappeared, alien swarms attacked, and humanity fell into a dark age. Inferior Handgun lv1/9, Damage 3, Effective Range 15 meters After accumulating ten instances of effective damage, it can be upgraded to: Normal Pistol lv2/9, Damage 4, Effective Range 30 meters, Activate Extra Attributes: Bullet Recovery 1/1h Facing the coming menacing insect tide, Lin Feng obtained the Item Upgrade System, which allows bound equipment to be upgraded infinitely by killing enemies and accumulating upgrade points. Pistol → Bombard Gun → Nuclear Cannon... → Star Annihilator Cannon Upgrades can also grant extra attributes: Bullet Recovery, Spatial Magazine. RV → Armored Vehicle → Mobile Fortress... → Space Battleship When others were still struggling to escape, Lin Feng was already driving an armored vehicle, holding a Bombard Gun with infinite bullets, and enjoying the fun of leveling up by farming monsters.

title: The Returned War Hero Became the Empire’s Mastermind
summary: After 500 years, I returned to find the empire I saved on the brink of collapse. So, I just planned to fix the country as regent and then go home, but... [Don't bother being a regent; why not just usurp it completely? I'm quite content just being the ancestor's concubine.] [Where are you going? You are absolutely not leaving. I've waited 500 years; if you run away again, I'll lock you in the magic tower.] ...Am I even going to be able to go home?

title: Bought a Joyous Union Sect Manual for Ten Yuan
summary: Qin Ge, who was terminally ill, accidentally bought a Joyous Union Sect manual from a street vendor. He practiced Yin Yang and Joyous Union techniques, embarking on the path of cultivation. This world... seems to be changing in strange ways!
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Supernatural

title: Transmigrated into a Poor Family, Getting Rich Quietly with the Whole Family
summary: Yu Chunmiao dies in an accident and wakes up as a “silly” village girl from a poor family. Sold by her gambling father, she becomes a bought daughter-in-law of the Qi family—three brothers, an ailing mother-in-law, and a household so poor it can barely survive. No golden cheat. No powerful background. With only the memories of her past life, Yu Chunmiao keeps a low profile and quietly changes her fate. From small businesses to smarter farming, from poverty to stability, she leads the whole family step by step toward prosperity. No face-slapping. No overnight riches. Just steady growth, family warmth, and getting rich in silence.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Steel, Guns, and the Industrial Party in Another World
summary: Magical beasts trample, dragons roar, wizards curse, and the dazzling light of magic illuminates the beacon of knowledge! Emperor of Gabella: The Imperial Legion is invincible on land. Orc Chieftain: Each of our tribal warriors is worth ten of any other. Elven King of the Emerald Realm: Our forest rangers never miss their mark. President of the Horn Bay Alliance: The Alliance fleet reigns supreme over the seas. A Mysterious Organization: The prophesied era will eventually arrive. Paul Grayman: I’m not singling anyone out, but everyone here is tr*sh. Embark on a journey with firearms and cannons, crushing the low-magic planes…

title: You Cultivate, I Farm
summary: Upon awakening, Lu Xuan found himself as an ordinary spirit plant cultivator, tending to an acre of land merely scraping by in the realm of cultivation. Fortunately, he stumbled upon an unexpected revelation: with each maturing spiritual plant, he received additional rewards. Harvesting a The Firefly Grass yielded a Golden Sword Technique. From the Blood-Devouring Vine, he obtained a Purification Talisman. And the Phantom Spring Flower gifted him a prescription for the elusive Luminous Flame Pill. Henceforth, he contentedly tended to his own spiritual fields, observing the tumultuous tides and shifts in the world of cultivation. "Duels and clashes, expeditions into secret realms, immortal fortunes, obtaining mystical treasures... None of it concerns me!" "I simply wish for peace and quiet to tend to my fields."
genres: Adventure, Martial Arts, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: 100,000/Hour Professional Stand-in
summary: Ji Fanyin realized the moment she transmigrated over that she was a stand-in, a substitute for her younger twin sister, Ji Xinxin. “Sure, I can be her stand-in. Here is my list of prices. Take a look at it first, and make sure to reserve a slot in advance. I won’t accept any last-minute calls, and do take note that it’ll only be a platonic relationship. Thank you for your cooperation,” she said. In a western restaurant, a rich young master looked at her with eyes filled with affection as he said, “Xinxin, I would like to ask you out for a movie tomorrow night…” An alarm suddenly went off. Ji Fanyin took a glance at her phone before reining in her business smile, saying, “Time’s up. I need to rush for my next appointment. Make sure to foot the tab, and farewell.” The rich young master’s smile froze up. “I’ll reserve four hours for tomorrow’s movie.” In the middle of the night, a drunk, tyrannical young master dialed her number and whined, “Big sis, when will you come over to meet me?” “In order to ensure the quality of service, this call will be recorded. It’s four in the morning right now, and my services will be ten times the usual price. Are you certain you want to proceed?” asked Ji Fanyin. “… Hurry up and start acting!” Ji Fanyin’s phone suddenly rang in the midst of a date with a domineering CEO at Tokyo’s tower. With a smile on her lips, she rejected the call and said, “Sorry, it’s another customer.” “… I’ll pay you ten times the price. Switch off your phone.” … By the time Ji Xinxin finally returned back to the country, Ji Fanyin successfully retired from the scenes with the massive fortune she had amassed. Heh, bad women will never get hurt!

title: She Became a Sword Cultivator
summary: “Look at the three thousand worlds, and the heavens beyond the heavens—where is there I cannot go, and where is there that is not my place?” She doesn’t ask for love, and she doesn’t indulge in empty longing. She doesn’t chase transcendence or eternal life, either. From the moment Zhao Chun first drew her sword, she chose one thing: to walk a path no one has ever taken—her own.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Unable to Cultivate, I Can Only Raise Soul Pets

She happened to meet the male lead even before the apocalypse began, and from then on she was targeted by him. Day after day, he teased her until her legs went weak, leaving her shame level bursting through the roof. “Hey, male lead, do you even realize your character setting has completely collapsed?”

title: Blue Fog
summary: "Don't always look at him. Please also look at me." Chen Qing Wu believed that she would marry Meng Qi Ran in the future— Both of them were childhood sweethearts and were very close. On a Friday, Meng Qi Ran's band performed, and Chen Qing Wu took a midnight flight to support him. Meng Qi Ran was drunk, and the one who went to pick him up was his brother Meng Fu Yuan. The eldest son of the Meng family was serious, reserved, and taciturn. When sitting in the car and working, he wouldn't even give her a smile. Chen Qing Wu always felt that Meng Fu Yuan might hate her. Until someday, Meng Fu Yuan went abroad on a business trip and brought her back a set of porcelain made by a the grandmother of a friend as a gift. Such thin porcelain was wrapped in five layers of soft shock-proof packaging and transported thousands of miles back without any damage. It was too much trouble for her to unpack, let alone for the one who packed it himself. A ridiculous thought suddenly occurred to her: it can't be that Meng Fu Yuan likes me, right. Later, when the two families got together, Meng Qi Ran wanted to propose, but when he searched all over for Chen Qing Wu, he couldn't find her . No one knew that in the study on the third floor, Meng Fu Yuan was kissing Chen Qing Wu's ear, telling her with a deep voice to be quiet. - Meng Qi Ran was the turbulent wind when she was 16 years old, the butterfly she caught and released. Meng Fu Yuan was the silent abyss when she was 26 years old, and the snow that grew old together in her life.

title: Because I’m Too Strong, They’ve Mistaken Me for the Male Lead
summary: Shi Hanli, with her coolly handsome features and a sharp, short haircut, found herself transmigrated into a post-apocalyptic novel. When she first awoke, her body was covered in mud and blood, the sound of flesh being chewed echoed nearby, and a knife was hurtling toward her forehead, poised to execute her as a "zombie." The System arrived belatedly, informing Shi Hanli that due to a programming error, she hadn't become the naive and sweet female supporting character she was supposed to be. Instead, her original self had transmigrated, meaning she didn't need to follow the plot. However, the System's built-in Evolution System still belonged to her. From now on, her sole mission was to "survive." As Shi Hanli gazed at the zombie-infested world, her eyes gleamed with the predatory hunger of a wolf spotting a flock of sheep. As time passed, everyone in this world seemed to have developed some kind of mistaken perception. One of the male lead's subordinates knelt on one knee, his eyes filled with reverence. "Big Brother Shi, your will is the direction my sword points. I will follow you for life." The male lead's confidante blushed shyly. "Han Li, you are the only warmth I can feel in this cruel apocalypse." A world-destroying villain willingly abandoned his obsession for her, reverting to his former brilliant self. "If it's you, I won't oppose you." The male lead himself was utterly awestruck. "Brother Shi! Dad!" When others in the apocalypse mentioned Shi Hanli's name, they would say, "Lord Shi? He's the jade-faced god of death. How many lives do you have to dare provoke him?" Shi Hanli: ...... Isn't this supposed to be the male lead's script? Why does everyone seem to think I'm the male lead?

After waking up, Song Tang found herself transmigrated into this novel. She thought it might be an immersive experience of the plot and wondered if she was the female lead. Instead, she discovered she had become the male lead’s vicious first love, a vicious supporting character whose ending was to jump into a river and die. She was not worried. Soon, the male lead would dump her, she would receive a large breakup fee, and then move on to a new life. As the female lead appeared and was about to kiss the second male lead, the male lead still showed no intention of breaking up with her. Since he would not do it, she decided to end things herself. Her own brother, a domineering yet devoted male supporting character in a sweet romance novel, selflessly gives everything for the innocent female lead, only to have her steal trade secrets, causing the company's bankruptcy, yet her brother remains unrepentant. Her sister-in-law, a pitiful tool in a typical BL (Boys' Love) novel where the husband is the male lead, begs for her to return, only to have her ashes scattered in the process. Her mother-in-law, a cannon fodder supporting character in a scheming stepmother novel was slowly poisoned to death by her best friend, innocently becoming her father-in-law's confidante, faking a one-night stand and used pregnancy to climb the social ladder before suffering a miscarriage. Just as Nan Tao was enjoying the gossip, powerful figures quietly joined forces to spoil her rotten! Her older brother gave her a black card with a multi-million dollar limit to spend at will, her sister-in-law showered her with expensive jewelry every day, and her mother-in-law transferred a large sum of her company's shares to her… As Nan Tao frequently trended on social media, the entire internet became aware of this gossip-loving figure. If you must, just plant it on me instead.” The young man gazed at her quietly, his strange-colored, deep pupils glistening with moisture, gently stroking the scorpion tattoo on the back of her hand. The girl’s weak, involuntary tears soaked into the bedding, her voice too hoarse to make a sound. At this moment, wasn’t he supposed to release the gu insects to devour her? Why was he the one doing the devouring personally?! Exactly which part went wrong??

title: Reborn After Widowhood

She disliked his sullen face every day, disliked him for lying on the bed full of sweat, and even disliked his lack of restraint at certain moments. But when he really died and she became a widow, Hua Yang actually began to miss his good qualities one by one, such as his figure walking steadily in the heavy rain carrying her on his back, such as his blazing hot chest in the cold winter. Once reborn, Hua Yang decided to be nice to him.

But in the real world, where spiritual resurgence has only just begun, let alone Qi Refinement, there are barely any who have even stepped onto the path. summary: After being overthrown in a classic case of “the student surpasses the master,” Lin Wei—the former Demon King—wants nothing more than to abandon his old identity and live a peaceful life among humans. His dream? Settle down, buy a small fief, marry a beautiful woman from the church’s lower clergy, and enjoy a quiet life as a country noble with his lovely wife. But reality refuses to let him rest. Adventurer parties keep passing suspiciously close to his doorstep. The proud Judgement Knight is always waving her spear around, pestering him to join the church. Then there’s the haughty imperial princess edging ever closer, the new Demon King on a manhunt for him, and the Elf Queen proposing marriage alliances. All Lin Wei wants is peace and obscurity. Yet one day, when he sneaks into the Holy City, he catches sight of a regal, cold-faced woman presiding over the masses—a presence so commanding, even he, who has never known fear, breaks into a nervous sweat. Turns out, the wife he’s been sharing a bed with every night… is actually the Pope?! What should he do now? Advice urgently needed!

Opening her eyes to find herself surrounded by zombies with only two pitifully thin adorable children by her side, Gu Wanyin thought: This is the end of me! System: Impossible, absolutely impossible! After binding to the most powerful hotel system in the post-apocalyptic world, Gu Wanyin embarked on a delightful journey of raising children and managing a hotel. As the hotel's guests increased, so did her rewards! But could someone explain to her why a hotel that unlocked noodle shops, hot pot restaurants, and buffets was understandable, but why did it also have KTV, movie theaters, libraries, amusement parks, hot springs, schools, and hospitals? And even a zombie-killing simulation training camp? Wait, there's even more... It seems she's destined to transform this hotel into the only paradise in the post-apocalyptic world!

summary: "Earth attribute... a miss." Noah Willard. The man with that name was the third son of the Marquis Willard family, a powerful family in the great nation of the Kingdom of Lunoa. He was born with earth magical power, a trait considered unfortunate among the four elements, the others being fire, water, and wind. Because he was born with earth magical power, his father branded him incompetent, and he lived a life looked down upon by his siblings. "(Hmm, this is a different world.)" This situation would have made a normal child sick, but Noah was a reincarnated person with knowledge of his previous life. Noah was satisfied with the comfortable life he enjoyed as the child of an aristocrat, and he simply enjoyed the other world, not really minding that he was looked down upon. But then a great war struck Noah. Earth's first The power to build trenches, defend against artillery fire, and keep supply lines running—these were the most powerful forces in this new war. In the midst of a war that engulfed the entire world, the third son, once labeled incompetent, was swallowed up by the raging waves of war as a hero.

title: After Being Read, I Became the Favorite of the Palace Fighting Literature Group
summary: Ji Jinyou traveled into a bloody palace fighting novel and became a cannon fodder three-year-old princess, living with her unpopular biological mother in a remote palace. In the book, the concubines fought to the death and were dead one after another. The princes died or were disabled, and none of them survived. In the end, the throne fell into the hands of a sinister and s*upid clan member, and soon, it was destroyed by the enemy country. The nine princesses and their daughters were poisoned to death at the palace banquet where the concubines competed. — Ji Jinyou counted on her fat fingers, oh, there are still three months to live. It is better to live than to die, so she decided to actively save herself. But every time she tried to change the plot, she would suffocate for no reason. Risking the risk of almost dying, she tried several times to remind the relevant parties, but no one paid attention to her, the three-year-old baby. Unable to change, Ji Jinyou had to give up. But she didn’t know that everyone could suddenly hear her voice.

title: Mr. Feng, Your Wife Has Wanted a Divorce for a Long Time
summary: Married for seven years, Feng Tingshen treated her with icy indifference, yet Rong Ci always smiled in response. Because she deeply loved him, and believed that one day she could warm his heart. But what she received was his instant infatuation with another woman, showering her with affection. She still stubbornly held onto their marriage. Until her birthday, when she flew abroad to find him and their daughter, he took their daughter to be with that woman, leaving her alone in their empty house. She finally gave up completely. Seeing her daughter, whom she had raised, with another woman as her mother, Rong Ci felt no more pity. She drafted the divorce papers, relinquished custody, and left gracefully, ignoring them completely, waiting for the divorce certificate to be issued. Abandoning her family, she returned to her career, easily amassing a fortune of over a hundred billion yuan—a fortune once looked down upon by everyone. However, as she waited and waited, not only did the divorce certificate not arrive, but the man who used to avoid home began returning more and more frequently, clinging to her more and more. Upon learning of her desire for a divorce, the usually aloof and cold man cornered her against the wall: "Divorce? Impossible."

title: Stolen Life of the Poor Girl, Top Luxury Family’s Group Favor
summary: [Face-slapping satisfying story] [Beloved by all] [Smart female lead, adult CP with Sheng Yuxiao] Li Xiaoya was born in a poor mountain village. Her mother died when she was three, and her father ran off with a mistress. When she was seven, the "Life Swap" TV show crew came to the small village and immediately chose Xiaoya. But when filming began, they suddenly switched to the village chief's granddaughter instead. Later, the chief's granddaughter went to the big city and appeared on TV. Netizens praised her for being poised and well-behaved, saying she'd become the goddaughter of an incredibly wealthy family. How enviable! The netizens also said that Xiaoya from the same village was originally chosen, but supposedly she stole and grabbed things, cursed constantly - good thing she didn't make it on the show! Xiaoya had no idea a chapter of life that should have been hers had been stolen... *** On the second day of filming, the rich young master who was swapped to experience life in the small mountain village met the dirt-covered Xiaoya. Despite her young age, Xiaoya would stand on a stool to cook for him, trek through mountains to dig up wild vegetables for him, and even save the one piece of candy given out in the village to bring back to him, holding it until it melted. The arrogant young master's heart completely melted. * So while the village chief's granddaughter was touring Disneyland in the big city, The young master was helping Xiaoya dig in the fields and carry manure. The life was too hard; the young master really couldn't take it anymore. In a fit of anger, he summoned a group of rich second-generation kids to dig fields and carry manure together... Instantly it went viral online, crushing the ratings of the other group. ** Later, she was recognized and taken back by a top wealthy family. Her grandfather was gravely ill, her uncles and aunts were either crazy or disabled. No worries! The young master helped her with everything! Even the fiercest villains fought to be her father!

title: The Military Wife is Delicate and Charming: The Rough Military Man Dotes on his Wife
summary: As soon as Jiang Rou opened her eyes, she found herself transformed into a fake rich daughter in a period novel. Not only was she a pitiful cannon fodder supporting character, but she had also been knocked out by the real rich daughter and forced to marry an old man in her place. Legend had it that the old man was disfigured, crippled, and burdened with two dependents—one big and one small. She was supposed to struggle desperately to return to the city, but instead, she took the initiative to walk toward the man in military uniform. “Comrade, I’m looking for Zhou Chongshan. I’m his fiancée, and I’ve come to marry him.” “The marriage report has already been submitted. From now on, I am your husband.” “Husband~ Kiss me~” Jiang Rou knew that in this era, the safest place was on the island! And this so-called old man—he wasn’t disfigured or disabled at all. Instead, he was tall, strong, had eight-pack abs, and was the Chief of the Legion! Jiang Rou’s legs went weak just looking at him. It seemed her married life was going to be quite exciting! Three months later… The blushing Jiang Rou: “There won’t be a next time!” The gentle yet coaxing old man: “Wife, I was wrong. But next time, I’ll still dare.”

title: Nightmare Assault
summary: Wake up and an unknown door has appeared in your home… Behind each door is a completely unfamiliar world. The Fatty almost cried in fear hearing it. “My whole family will be strung upside down for blood-letting if I die here?” “That’s what I heard.” “Then, how come you don’t look scared at all?” The fatty widened his eyes. title: Obsession
summary: Before their arranged marriage, Min Xizhi learned that Fu Yanzhou had feelings for someone else. He asked his secretary, “What has Xixi been up to lately?” Pausing for a moment, he continued, “How is she doing emotionally?” Secretary: “I heard she’s been going on blind dates.” Fu Yanzhou fell silent. A few weeks later, Min Xizhi confronted him, “Why did you ruin my blind dates?” Fu Yanzhou: “I’m sorry for what happened in the past.” He said in a low voice, “Xixi, would you like to start over with me?” Min Xizhi was momentarily stunned. “There’s no need. She was the one who proposed the arranged marriage, thinking that Fu Yan Zhou would refuse. After marriage, she suggested sleeping with her head on his arm. Fu Yan Zhou sighed and pulled her back into his embrace, offering his arm for her to rest on. After two years of marriage, Min Xi felt that she still couldn’t make Fu Yan Zhou fall in love with her; he only indulged her. She decided to end her years of infatuation with Fu Yan Zhou and handed him a divorce agreement. Fu Yan Zhou hesitated for a long time, but eventually signed it and asked, “What are your plans now?” Min Xi didn’t respond. But she thought to herself: I won’t secretly love you anymore; I’ll forget you. After the divorce, Fu Yan Zhou couldn’t let go of Min Xi. One early morning, his secretary called him and nervously reported, “Min Xi has been busy with blind dates lately.” He thought he misheard, “Busy with what?” Secretary: “Busy… with blind dates.” When Min Xi was about to go on a blind date, Fu Yan Zhou intercepted her. She couldn’t believe that this man would actively pursue someone. He had flown back from another city in the middle of the night and appeared at her doorstep early in the morning. He looked at her and said, “Xi Xi, do you want to start over with me?” PS: A sweet story. Male lead doesn’t have a white moonlight.
