I’m the only one you can count on.” “…….” “I’m the only one for you.” “…….” “Only me.” What an abominable delusion. * * * For more than 10 years, my body was possessed by someone else. It would have been nice of ‘that person’ if she used my body and returned it in a good condition, but not only did she get married with my own body, she’s also clinging to her husband like a stalker..?! “First, let’s get divorced.” I tried to start a new life by dumping my husband, who has been treating me like tr*sh, and my family who treated me like dirt. But. “Leaving? You will leave me?” My husband who doesn’t believe me. “Why are you taking his side, sister?” A younger brother who’s suddenly jealous. “Stay in this house. You can’t go anywhere.” Even my father who hated me all along is suddenly obsessed? What’s wrong with them all of a sudden?

title: 1980s: Sickly Educated Youth Raising Cubs in the Countryside
summary: After struggling to survive in a post-apocalyptic wasteland for over a decade, Song Wei finally dies. Her only regret is never having a full stomach. When she opens her eyes again, she became an educated youth who went to the countryside in Northeast China. Bad news: Her new identity is a frail beauty—a “vase” type who’s all looks and a hopeless romantic. Good news: Everything around her is normal. No radiation, no mutated creatures. She’s in a rural village by the mountains, brimming with wild resources. Finally, she can eat to her heart's content! Before long, the once-helpless Song Wei, who couldn’t lift a finger, turns into a fierce villager who can throw punches at wild boars, carry logs on her shoulder, chase off local bullies, and stand her ground against any nosy aunties in the village. Villagers in Ping'an Commune: “Don't Provoke Comrade Song. She’s no pushover!” Song Wei, meanwhile, just wants to enjoy the countryside. When she isn’t working, she’s foraging in the mountains, stocking up on food, and sharing gossip with the local aunties. She’s reasonable… mostly. Then, unexpectedly, she adopts a poor, scruffy little kid nobody wants. But what about this tall, rough guy with eight-pack abs who returned to the village after retiring from the army? Why did he follow her? Oh, it turned out to be the kid's brother. Song Wei holds up the chubby, well-fed child she’s been raising. “Here, take your brother.” The child wails, clinging to her. “I don’t want my brother; I want my sister!” The man ignores his little brother, gazing intently at her. “I don’t have a home.” Song Wei: “What’s that supposed to mean?” Man: “You’re already taking care of my little brother… would it be too much trouble to take me in too? I’m strong, you know.” Song Wei: “…Are you two just trying to mooch off me?”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Reincarnated as a Dungeon Master in Another World: Creating a Hot Spring Dungeon
summary: “You have been reincarnated as the master of my dungeon. Lure countless adventurers with desire, and create a dungeon that can drain their blood, mana, and life through exploration and battle, Master.” One day, a man on the verge of death in a hospital in the modern world hears a strange, hallucinatory voice. It tells me to become a Dungeon Master and manage a dungeon. Faced with an oddly specific hallucination, the man loses himself in thoughts of dungeon management until he succumbs to his illness and dies. And now, just as the voice had said, the man has been reincarnated as a Dungeon Master. He turns to the Dungeon Core, the source of that voice, and declares: “Alright… I’m going to create a hot spring dungeon.” And so, my dungeon management journey began.
genres: Action, Adventure, Ecchi, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Battle Through the Heavens
summary: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and the weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancée suddenly shown up?
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Xuanhuan

title: Being a Salted Fish Second Generation in Various Worlds
summary: Yu Qian has bound herself to a Conquest System. System: “You must conquer the protagonists of various worlds and win their love.” Yu Qian draws a beginner’s gift pack and gets a Bloodline Potion. Without hesitation, she transforms into a three-year-old child and uses the potion on herself—becoming the biological daughter of the target. System: “WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!!!” — World 1: The School Tyrant Raising a Child Zai Ye is the infamous school tyrant of No. 2 High School. His parents divorced, leaving him with nothing but an empty house. Arrogant and rebellious, he indulges in reckless behavior—street racing, fighting, you name it. One day, he meets a two-year-old child who looks just like him. Zai Ye smirks coldly: “My dad’s illegitimate daughter?” Then the DNA test results come out. The once-smirking school tyrant completely breaks down: “She’s… my… daughter???” As he watches his long-separated parents pick up broomsticks and slippers, Zai Ye collapses: “I SWEAR I DIDN’T DO ANYTHING! I’M STILL A virg*n!” At the parent-teacher meeting, the perpetually grumpy school tyrant carries an adorable, chubby little girl into the school. His underlings, cigarettes dangling from their lips, laugh: “Yo, Boss, that your little sister?” Zai Ye: “Spit out the cigarette. She’s my daughter.” Underlings: “???” — World 2: The Ice Dragon Dad Raising a Child The Ice Dragon Lacia has lived in the human empire for many years. A learned scholar, he is a renowned professor at the Central Academy of Magic, feared by students for his strictness. One day, he senses a bloodline connection and retrieves a dragon egg to hatch. But when it finally hatches— The baby dragon looks nothing like him. Long and slender, seemingly… mutated? Yu Qian: “I’m a Chinese dragon!”
genres: Completed, Adventure, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: The Worst-Matched Guide
summary: “I’m quitting.” A Guide with only a 3% match rate no matter which Esper they were paired with—ignored by everyone, dismissed by the system. The decision to walk away from Guiding, something they’d dedicated their whole life to, had finally been made. If nothing else worked out, well… they figured they could always take up farming.

title: After Wearing the Same Clothes as My High-School Classmate on the Subway
summary: 1. After being tricked into going on a blind date, Shu Yao bumped into her high school classmate Chen Ye, whom she hasn’t seen in seven years, on the subway. Once, her best friend and his buddy were sweetly in love, and the two of them could only sit awkwardly and look at each other in silence. And now, something even more embarrassing happened— They are wearing the same outfit. Fortunately, Chen Ye didn’t seem to remember her. Shu Yao secretly felt happy and was about to grab her bag and run away when someone suddenly passed by. That person hesitated, stopped, looked them up and down, and suddenly exclaimed with wide eyes: “You two are still together?! Wearing couple outfit is quite romantic! I believe in love again!” Shu Yao: “…?” 2. Faced with various blind dates, between asking for help and pleading for mercy, Shu Yao chose to propose. “I have no expectations for marriage. Since the photo of us wearing matching clothes has turned into a couple’s photo, and you also need this, how about we cooperate?” Chen Ye leaned against the table leisurely and asked her: “What do you like about me?” Shu Yao made up something, but remained calm: “Your occasionally unpredictable state of mind is quite charming.” “……” Chen Ye agreed. The reason was he appreciated those who can insult others elegantly. 3. After marriage, the two respected each other like guests. So Shu Yao always thought he began liking her after they were married. Until a long time later, at a gathering, during a game of truth or dare, Chen Ye’s friend was asked about the most speechless moment in his life. Without hesitation, he pointed at Chen Ye: “About a year ago, in the middle of the night, he sent me 10 voice messages bragging that he was getting married.” Other friends gasped and quickly pulled out their phones to ask: “How many people did you send this to?” “Not many.” Chen Ye leaned back lazily, somewhat regretfully adding, “Too bad my dog doesn’t have a phone.” Shu Yao: “……” How would a dog use a phone? Shu Yao glanced at the man beside her. Oh no, it seems possible.

title: One Day I Became a Hatchling
summary: Only 1 year! I died with a year left. But something is strange...?

title: After Being Read, She Became a Full-Time Daughter
summary: Tan Li was pulled into the world of infinite flow at the most immature and irritable age. After successfully passing the level and returning, Tan Li, who had become loving, peaceful and calm, realized that she was still using the script of the control group of real and fake daughters in a novel. As a real daughter, she was disgusted by everyone and ended up miserable because she was obsessed with competing for family property and love with the fake daughter. Tan Li: ??? ? With a seven-digit pocket money every month and extra subsidies from time to time, what else is there to be dissatisfied with? She has worked hard for so many years and finally has the opportunity to lie down. If not now, when will she lie down?

title: The Demon King Overrun by Heroes
summary: [The Demon King’s Standard, First. The Demon King kidnapped the princess….] “I would not follow such a tr*shy standard!” And with that, he became a hard-headed fool.

title: The Quest for Immortality
summary: The Dao Court has ruled the world of cultivators for over twenty thousand years. The noble families maintain a strict hierarchy, making life difficult for independent cultivators. At ten years old, Mo Hua, who comes from a background of independent cultivators, struggles with his cultivation journey. This changes when a Dao stele appears in his mind. The stele is damaged and mysterious, but it can enhance spiritual awareness and help understand mystical formations. Mo Hua plans to use this stele to develop a supreme spiritual awareness, learn the secrets of celestial formations, and pursue the ultimate path of immortality. His goal is to change not only his own destiny but also the destiny of all lesser cultivators across the world. The path to greatness starts with the smallest steps, and the journey to immortality is long and challenging. Through dense fog and treacherous terrains, past horrors and chaos, where demons dance wildly, he must plant the seeds of his spiritual quest, survive the deadliest of trials, and prove his worth on every dangerous step… In the grand scheme of heaven, where the universe is the game board and all creatures its pieces, the strategic game of life and death begins, shaping destinies through its intricate moves…
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Xianxia

title: The Empty Hourglass: Criminal Investigation
summary: At eight years old, Hai Shu ran along the banks of the old factory river, proudly telling a little boy that she would become an international superstar. At the tail end of summer, she reluctantly said goodbye to him again and again along the way. Yet it wasn’t until he walked her all the way to her doorstep that they truly said, “Goodbye.” She thought they would reunite soon. But on the day she left the old factory, the wings of misfortune stirred up a storm—dragging them, along with those they had forgotten, into its depths… At twenty-eight, before being transferred to serve as captain of the First Criminal Investigation Unit in Huiyong City, Hai Shu attended a confidential informant’s wedding. Unexpectedly, on the very day of the wedding, a tragedy tore open the wounds of the small town, and horrifying secrets began to spill endlessly from within. Amid the haze of suspicion, Hai Shu’s gaze once again meets those familiar eyes. “You didn’t become an international superstar?” “…And you didn’t become the Monkey King either?”

title: Soul Devourer of Infinite Growth ~ Defeat Monsters and Humans to Steal Not Just Skills, but Stats Too!?
summary: Dungeons have appeared in modern society, and the world has changed completely. The protagonist graduates from high school and begins his career as a rookie hunter. The unique skill that manifests in him is a powerful skill that can grow infinitely. Aspiring to become a hunter, he discovers that he can become endlessly strong, but what fate awaits him in the future...?

title: Flower Stealing Master
summary: When the protagonist woke up, he discovered that he had become Song Qingshu, who had his meridians destroyed in a contest of martial arts and was banished from his sect. He also found out that this was a chaotic world that incorporated Jin Yong’s 14 novels. What will he do now?
genres: Adult, Adventure, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Wuxia

title: The Emperor Has An Illness
summary: When Liao Qing Qing wakes up, she has transmigrated into an unfavoured young wife. After entering the imperial palace, she becomes the unfavoured Liangyi.[1] She wants to live to the end of her life with the motto ‘sitting around and doing nothing’; therefore, she follows the noble consort and the others in a low profile and being a wallflower. But —— The Emperor suddenly approaches her requesting a kiss, hug, cuddle… and he wants a daily dose of it. This angered all of the imperial concubines. Before she could make a move, the imperial concubines treated her increasingly respectfully. Liao Qing Qing, “??” Emperor, “Beloved Concubine, look, this is the imperial harem that I have conquered for you!” Liao Qing Qing, “As expected, Your Majesty has a sickness!” Note: [1] 良仪(liángyí)- Liangyi is sixth-class (higher) rank. It has the same rank as Ladies of Excellence (良娣)and Filial Ladies of Excellence(良媛)

title: Dad! Please Stop Getting Promoted, Our Family Are Really Treacherous Officials!
summary: Xu Qinghuan transmigrated into a book, becoming the only daughter of Xu Youde, the number one corrupt official of the Great Qian Dynasty. Staring at the room filled with gold, silver, and jewels, she did not smile, because she knew that in three years, the entire Xu family would be executed, and she would be hung on the city wall as a public spectacle. Fortunately, she was bound to the [Heartless Tycoon System] . As long as she completed the task of amassing ten billion through unscrupulous means and utterly ruining her reputation, she could return to the modern era with a billion in retirement funds! Overjoyed, Xu Qinghuan immediately switched into her "recklessly courting death" mode: Her father embezzled disaster relief funds? She turned around and bought up all the city's moldy, stale rice at a high price, then publicly served it as porridge to humiliate the victims! Her eldest brother abducted commoners' daughters? She spent a fortune to build a "Hundred Flowers Pavilion," locking the girls inside to study books, forbidding them to receive clients! Her second brother committed treason? She packed up all the family's luxury glassware and sent it to the enemy nation's ruler! Looking at the emptied family coffers, Xu Qinghuan thought it was a sure thing now, just waiting for exile. But then, imperial decrees arrived one after another: Lady Xu Qinghuan, with a heart for the realm, sacrificed her family fortune to relieve hardship, saving countless lives, is a female sage of our time! Xu Youde, for his exemplary parenting, is promoted to Chief Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat! Staring at her father, now dressed in purple official robes with a jade belt, gazing at her with utter admiration, Xu Qinghuan broke down: "Father! Please, be a little corrupt! I'm begging you, stop improving! Our family are supposed to be treacherous officials!"

title: After Resigning: I Bound the Enjoy Life System
summary: 【Urban Wealth God + Slice-of-Life + Multiple Heroines + Enjoying Life – No exaggerated starting billions, keeping it grounded and realistic】 After quitting his job, office worker Su Yang accidentally binds with the "Enjoy Life System." As the name suggests, simply by indulging in life's pleasures, he can earn random rewards from the system—no need to spend money on beautiful women or grovel before anyone. Just enjoy, and the money follows, making it all about effortless fun. The system comes with a scanning feature, allowing him to establish a favorability bond with women rated 85 points or above. Every 20-point increase in favorability unlocks additional rewards. After suffering through over twenty years of hardship, Su Yang trembles with excitement, his dull eyes suddenly gleaming with newfound hope. "Enjoy life? How hard could that be?"

title: A Guide to Time-Traveling in the Northern Song
summary: If you travel back to the Song Dynasty, should you recite poetry and appreciate the arts, or should you train your troops and conquer the world? No matter what, you need to fill your stomach first.

title: Hello Happy Hell
summary: On that day, where I finally received my college acceptance letter after a hellishly bad year of studying. I possessed someone else’s spirit. In a hotel management simulation game that once rocked the youth of a million otakus. If you’re thinking to yourself, isn’t a management simulation just an easy relaxing game? Then you don’t know anything. [If you discover a bug, please delete your account immediately and remove the app from your phone completely. It would be even better if you replaced your phone with a new one.] [Please do not waste your time saving your play history. The most important thing above anything else is your safety.] This is the game that users have dubbed as the “Neapolitan Ghost Story Relaxation Game”…! A deranged game full of all sorts of bizarre bugs, full of blood and violence! “Send me home…!” There is only one way to escape the game. To have complete control of the hotel and become a general manager acknowledged by everyone. To escape this buggy hell, you must master the game at breakneck speed! Even if I nearly drown in a sea of blood because of the guests. Even if I almost get myself killed in the hands of a fellow hotelier. “I’m sorry for making you have such an unpleasant experience. Please hang in there a little longer.” Even if my only partner dies before my eyes…. It’s okay. After all— “Even if you die in this hotel, you’ll come back to life.” *** [Welcome to Hotel ~/?¿□☞!] [Don’t hold anything back anymore. Let’s be together in eternal paradise.]

title: After Reloading and Reviving, They Regret It and Begin Chasing Their Husband
summary: Su Mu wakes up from a dream—only to find that he has reincarnated as a prince in a Western fantasy world, surrounded by all kinds of beautiful girls. There’s a cold, black-haired personal maid. An aloof, silver-haired younger sister. And a gentle, healer-like young lady. But… why do all of these beautiful girls want to kill him?! After gaining the ability to reload and revive, Su Mu decides to stay as far away from them as possible. Yet, after he distances himself, the girls start coming to him one after another…

title: The Gossip-Lover Wants to Stay Anonymous
summary: These days, transmigrating into a book is all the rage, and Zhu Yaya has caught up with the trend. She found herself inside the recently hugely popular masterpiece "The Domineering Him, The Purest Love," complete with a brand-new, bottom-tier system. Transmigrating was one thing, but she ended up as an extra with zero screen time!! System: Your task from now on is to eat melons. Zhu Yaya was secretly delighted. How hard could that be? So, she began her days of tailing the male and female leads to eavesdrop on gossip. System: I meant eat mel-ons- Thus began Zhu Yaya's days of braving wind and rain, carrying a watermelon while stealthily following the original protagonists to listen in on their drama. But while indulging in her melon-eating, she kept noticing a figure who appeared all too frequently. Zhu Yaya thought for a moment, then raised half a watermelon and asked sincerely, "Hey, buddy, want some melon?" Tagline: Even an extra in the crowd can have her own springtime.

title: As the Beloved Eldest Disciple, I Just Want to Get Off Work
summary: Lu Fengmian transmigrated and got bound to the “Perfect Senior Brother System.” He thought he was about to live the life of an overpowered protagonist. Instead, the system gave him one job: Become the perfect senior brother of the entire sect. To everyone in the sect, Lu Fengmian was the very model of perfection. His cultivation was unfathomable, his temperament gentle and gracious. He handled everything with fairness and selflessness, was cherished by the sect master, admired by his junior brothers and sisters, and hailed as one of the brightest rising stars in the cultivation world. Only Lu Fengmian knew the truth: this number one sect in the cultivation world was basically a rehabilitation center for troublesome disciples. The second junior sister was an orphan taken in after her family was destroyed. She looked cold and distant, but was actually a full-blown senior-brother fanatic who secretly hid his dao robes in the middle of the night. The junior brother who had broken off an engagement loved declaring, “Do not bully the young and poor!” in public with all the cold, domineering flair of a classic protagonist, yet came knocking on his door with red eyes every time he hit a cultivation bottleneck. The neglected princess of a mortal dynasty seemed timid and insecure, needing praise for her extraordinary talent by day and heartfelt bedtime encouragement like “you deserve to be loved” by night. And beyond them were even more bizarre junior brothers and sisters, lined up all across the sect, waiting for him to save them... Lu Fengmian: Where is the carefree world of immortal cultivation I was promised? Why am I working harder than a 996 schedule?! System: Host, please remember your motto—“The sect may fall, but the perfect senior brother persona must never collapse!”

title: The Legendary Newbie of the Ghost Story Labyrinth
summary: I fell into a glitched space hidden in the real world. And the only ones who can guide me are the dead veterans residing in an online forum.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural

title: Apocalypse: Infinite Supplies, Neighbor’s Wife Brings Sister To Beg For Entry
summary: The black mist covered the surface, and the Insectoid Race rushed out of the sinkholes, leaving humans to survive by hiding in tall buildings! Supplies were scarce, food was short, but Lu Zheng obtained the 'Shelter System'. As long as survivors meeting the requirements of 'Virtuous and Kind, Beautiful and Intelligent' were taken in, Infinite Material Cards could be obtained. Meeting two criteria would grant a Basic Material Card: instant noodles, mineral water, milk tea and beverages, egg fried rice, hamburgers, self-heating hot pots... Meeting three criteria would grant an Advanced Material Card: firearms, rocket launchers, off-road vehicles, fighter jets, luxury cruise ships... Meeting four criteria would grant an Extraordinary Material Card: Beast Taming Ring, Divine Speed Talisman, Sword Control Technique mastery skill book... All of these were in unlimited quantities!
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Harem, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Pampered by the Escape Boss
summary: Other people’s escape games: “Run!” “AHH, I’M GOING TO DIE!” “Help! Help!” Gu Yian’s escape games: The BOSS pets her head: “Be good, let’s watch the show together.” Gu Yian: “???” The BOSS smiles lightly: “Listen, their screams bring people such joy.” In front of them, several players were either screaming or blindly running. Gu Yian: “……” So, am I winning without doing anything? #My escape games seem to be wrong somewhere# #Every stage’s BOSS pampers only me# #I might be playing a romance game?#

title: I Clean Up Garbage in a Wasteland World
summary: Zhu Ning, who had been leading the charge against zombies in the apocalypse, found herself transported to a post-apocalyptic world. In this world, 80% of the land was polluted, and humanity was divided into five classes. She ended up as the lowest class, a fifth-class citizen—essentially an unlucky, defective product. Completely broke, Zhu Ning had no choice but to become a cleaner, sweeping up garbage. It was said that cleaning jobs in the wasteland paid well and were easy, practically a dream job. But... why does this cleaning job seem so different from what she expected? On the mysteriously disappeared Line 1, she encountered mermen in suits carrying briefcases, with fish heads. At a famous hotpot restaurant, the hotpot itself tried to eat people! In a haunted house, the furniture moved around at night and even tried to kill the owner. Even the supposedly warm and healing aquarium was filled with aggressive mermen demanding to reproduce, bloodsucking mechanical jellyfish, and unknown transparent creatures. She visited a dental clinic, and as soon as she reached out her hand, it started raining teeth. ... And that wasn’t all. The cleaning company seemed to be hiding a big secret. The AI might be the mastermind behind everything. The pharmaceutical companies looked completely shady! Zhu Ning found herself inexplicably drawn into conflicts, where one wrong move could lead to a short life. In the wasteland, everyone had eight hundred schemes up their sleeve. Zhu Ning: Is heaven messing with me?
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-fi, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: The Essence Is the Moon, and I Am the Greatest Mystery in This World
summary: Two suns and three moons cycle in the sky, a hundred cities and eight races share the world. Chen Miemie, male, Race: Moon. Hobby: Collecting anomalies. At first, he thought he possessed two systems: the Crimson Rainbow Moon and the Clear Cold Frost Moon. One day, he discovered that he himself could also become a system for others, holding the chessboard of fate. The Eighth Epoch, also known as the Eternal Moon Epoch. Humans, witches, elves, bloodline descendants, specters, demons, and spirits together compose a new history. Walking the path on behalf of the moon, before he knew it, Chen Miemie's footsteps were followed by all manner of strange and wondrous anomalies. As time passed, many titles circulated about him—The King in Yellow, Lord of Anomalies, Heart of the Eternal Moon, and more. "Me? I'm just a traveler who enjoys collecting interesting creatures," Chen Miemie said.

title: I Became a Legend Just by Studying in a VR Game Without Even Trying to Beat It
summary: Amidst the world’s excitement over full-dive VRMMOs brought by new technology, there appeared the figure of a girl joining in. However, she was greatly different from the many around her who sought to find enjoyment in this new world. “With this, I can study longer than everyone else!!” Yes. She was an exam student. One who cast herself into the terrifying place called entrance exam war, day by day shaving away mind and body as she tried to get ahead of others. What she sought from the new game was an increase of experienced time. In a full-dive VRMMO, where time was extended and one could spend three times as long inside the game compared to reality, she thought she could study for more hours than the other exam students. With such an aim, she began the seemingly contradictory action of studying with all her strength inside the game. And thus, just like that, she kept studying every day inside the game for the sake of passing her desired school… though for the most part this was realized, unforeseen events occurred one after another. NPCs who took interest in her study content. Players who came up with ideas similar to hers. Participation in events. And, waiting beyond, activities and successes she had never expected. Contrary to her simple wish of only wanting to study for exams, she would go on to create a legend inside the game.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Reborn as the Male Friend in a 1:99 Gal Game, But Why Is This So Hard!?
summary: I reincarnated as Tachibana Tomoki, the helpful male friend character who supports the protagonist of the cheat-ratio gal game Hani-Gaku, where the gender ratio is 1:99 and c*astity roles are reversed. At first, I thought I’d just flirt with the girls in Class 2, who are seen as the rival class of the protagonist, and also with our homeroom teacher, enjoying this distorted-ratio, c*astity-reversed world, and as long as I got along reasonably well with Haruto, the sole boy in Class 1 and the protagonist, things would be fine. Yes, that was what I thought at the beginning… But it turns out that I, Tachibana Tomoki—the supposed helper character—seem to have various secrets that never appeared in the original game, and once I noticed them, I tried steering things back toward the original scenario. Yet the kindness I had shown the girls early on backfired and made that impossible… Just what the hell is going to happen to me now?
genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Made-Up Martial Arts, Have You Really Mastered Them, Disciple?
summary: Li Xuan had transmigrated to another world, with no abilities, no perks, and could only temporarily survive in a small mountain village. However, one day, someone mistook him for a reclusive master of martial arts and insisted on becoming his disciple. As an honest person, Li Xuan didn’t want to deceive anyone and firmly refused. However, the other person offered so much that he had no choice but to make up a set of martial arts techniques to bluff his way through. Surprisingly, the disciple actually succeeded in practicing them! … Staring at his disciple, whose muscles and bones resonated like thunder, and whose qi and blood surged like a raging river, Li Xuan was dumbfounded, “I just made that all up! How come you succeeded in practicing it? What kind of monster are you?” At this moment, the Golden Finger appeared, “Your disciple’s practice of the techniques you made up is still at beginner level, but you, the master, must have already mastered them to perfection. Your strength is a hundred times greater than those in this world!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Lying Low While Cultivating Immortality in Two Worlds
summary: [From the Author of ‘Warlock of the Magus World’] The abundance or scarcity of the years, the circulation of spiritual qi, the alternation of yin and yang—these are but the minor achievements of one who tends the seasons at their end. This is the story of a young man who crosses between two realms to cultivate immortality, groping his way forward until he becomes a [Year Arbiter]
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Starting with an All-Purpose Fishing Rod, Becoming a Lord on the Sea
summary: 【Sea Survival】+【Hoarding & Farming】+【Item Upgrade System】 —Tonight, I'm setting sail on a long voyage, with my cruise ship and my dreams, heading toward the sun~ Yu Chi opens her eyes to find herself standing on a rickety raft, surrounded by an endless sea. 【Please claim your novice benefit!】 【Ding! Acquired Talent Item: All-Purpose Fishing Rod】 With the All-Purpose Fishing Rod in hand, from tr*sh to treasure chests, anything and everything can be fished up! 【Ding! You have fished up a skill book and acquired First Aid!】 【Ding! You have fished up a seed!】 【Ding! You have fished up a super-intelligent toilet!】 *** Storms, tsunamis, extreme cold and scorching heat, thunderstorms and hurricanes... the sea is in constant turmoil. Contaminated creatures and special abilities continuously emerge as humanity struggles to survive amidst suffering. While others are killing enemies and fighting monsters, Yu Chi is hoarding supplies and farming land; While others struggle to survive natural disasters, Yu Chi looks at the protective shield she fished up and is moved to tears. I'll take one of everything.】 Yu Chi: ...Are you talking to me? 《On Humanity's Misunderstanding of Farming & Life-Skill Players》 《Starting with a Fishing Rod, I Reached the Pinnacle of Life》 Yu Chi puts away her fishing rod and gazes into the distance.
