Tu Hua answers with a blunt “Okay,” then feeds the convoy past hunger, sickness, ambushes, and staged “accidents,” while proof videos turn Xie Yu Chuan’s sleep into a front-row seat. Every miracle earns offerings that pile up in her living room—until a phoenix crown and bridal robes arrive, and the system warns that accepting them means she must manifest in Da Liang. Now court killers follow the trail of impossible survival, and Tu Hua has to keep a family alive without becoming the next target. Expect cross-time bartering, exile-road survival, and a reluctant house god who steps out of the shrine and into the dynasty’s line of fire.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance

title: S-Rank Adventurer Betrayed by His Fiancée in the Hero’s Party Sets Off on a Journey to Heal His Broken Heart ~The Strongest Betrayed Adventurer Ends Up Forming a Harem Party~
summary: His beloved fiancée was summoned to join the Hero’s party, and they were separated. For three years, he desperately supported the Hero’s party from afar, eventually becoming an S-rank adventurer. However, when they finally reunited, his fiancée had been unfaithful—with the Hero. “Things turned out like this, and I couldn’t even repay my gratitude… At least, I want to return the swords.” Abel Sixam, known as the wielder of the “Four Swords,” lost the purpose of living with his fiancée. He sets off on a journey to return the magic swords that had become his symbol to the person who gave it to him. —Little did he know that along the way, he would be entangled with beautiful women from his past adventures and come to understand the meaning of what he had done and the purpose of his life. Meanwhile, his ex-fiancée desperately tries to get back together with him, but the women block her completely. She, along with the Hero, falls into a hellish life of regret.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Romance

title: Stop It! Your Archrival Can’t Become Your Wife
summary: 【Campus】【Slice of Life】【Comedy】【Romance】【Lighthearted】【Ensemble Cast】【No Toxicity】【Non-Supernatural】 【Prologue: The Beginning of It All – Use holy water to heal the saintess tainted by demonic energy, then converse with her.】 Shen Nian stared at his older sister sipping yogurt, lost in thought. So you’re telling me my sister is the saintess, and yogurt is the holy water? 【Main Quest 1: Brave Youth, Become an Adventurer! Reward: Rookie Adventurer Title.】 【Side Quest 1: Find the Adorable Kitty! Reward: 1000 Gold Coins.】 Shen Nian: "Wait, I’m a high school senior here—did some guy who got isekai’d accidentally bind his system to me?" Hold on, completing quests gives gold rewards? Titles even boost stats? Is this for real? (A lighthearted, absurd campus comedy—not a revenge power fantasy.)
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Everyone in the Family Except Me is a Transmigrated Bigshot
summary: Four-year-old Juanjuan was unloved by her father, ignored by her mother, and bullied by her older brothers. Left to shoulder the burden of a broken family all on her own. Then one day, her parents and brothers went to the market and were caught in a rockslide. Man and ox-cart alike tumbled down the mountain. But when they woke up, something was... different. Even stranger, though their mouths never moved, Juanjuan could hear their voices loud and clear. Mother: "Is this... ancient times?" Father: "Holy shit! We've transmigrated? And to ancient times, no less! Time for me to rise to power and become a marquis!" Eldest Brother: "Did I... ascend successfully? But why is the spiritual energy here so weak?" Second Brother: "Damn those Di Kingdom bastards, ambushing me like that!" Third Brother: "Finally! No more zombies. I almost forgot what fresh air smelled like." Curled up in the corner, little Juanjuan trembled as she listened to all this nonsense. Life had to go on. But now, the adults in the house were constantly on edge, terrified their secrets would be exposed. After all, they couldn’t let the family know their souls had been swapped. When troublesome relatives came knocking, Mother’s award-worthy acting skills finally had a chance to shine. With the family dirt poor, Father secretly started building a fortune, leading them all to a life of luxury. Juanjuan saw it with her own eyes—Eldest Brother pointed at a pebble and turned it into gold. When they ran into bandits on the road, the usually mild-mannered Second Brother took them down one by one with a single slash each. Only the sweet and innocent Third Brother spent his days doting on Juanjuan, sneaking her chocolates, little cakes, lollipops... and when danger struck, casually pulled out an AK-47 and took out the enemy with a single shot. When the whole family’s covers were blown, silence fell. It was fine. Luckily, Juanjuan didn’t know anything.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Historical, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Broke the Survival Game with My BUG Physique
summary: (Strong Female Lead + No Romance + Power Fantasy + Apocalypse Survival) Cheng Shuili dropped dead after working 72 hours straight overtime. When she came back to life, she unexpectedly found herself transported into a highway survival game world. Right at the start, she draws an SSS-tier talent: [Bug Physique] —allowing her to exploit system loopholes for her own benefit. A supply crate spawns a monster? She turns around and scores the server’s first kill! The crate doesn’t disappear after being opened? Infinite farming unlocked! While others are gnawing on compressed biscuits, she’s enjoying self-heating hot pot. While others tremble in fear hiding from monsters, she chases them down with a metal pipe and beats them senseless. While everyone else is still struggling to survive, Cheng Shuili is already speeding down the highway in a shopping cart blaring a hypnotic ad: “Everything Half Price!” “Honestly, this crappy game is way more fun than fixing code—whoever wants to go back to overtime can go ahead!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Psychological, Supernatural

title: After The Empresses Rebelled Against Villain, He Whitewashed Himself
summary: Gu Changqing transmigrated into the cultivation world and became the ‘utterly evil’ villain. At the beginning, he was in imminent danger as he was jointly targeted by the protagonist and the empresses of various realms. Deep in crisis, he awakened the Life Editor. In his childhood, he found Gu Yuwei in a pile of corpses. He treated her as his sister and allowed her to step on his fate and enter the immortal path. In his youth, he achieved unparalleled mastery in swordsmanship, dominating the world with his sword, but because of his sworn brother, he severed his arm in the heavy snow: no longer practicing swordsmanship... In his destitution, he once encountered the tragically fated White Emperor of his childhood, and they lived and died together, redeeming each other. On the day the White Emperor tragically died, he slaughtered thousands of miles, using the Dao Fruit of the Great Emperor to reverse the cycle: I promise you, a lifetime of prosperity. While wandering the mortal world, he encountered the Goddess Chang Xi. She was resurrected by her sister, the Demon Spirit into the mortal world. To protect Chang Xi, Gu Changqing silently endured the condemnation of humanity for eternity, and bore the enmity of Chang Xi toward humanity. .... All his actions throughout his life, to...
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Harem, Mature, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: You Said You Only Wanted to Die—So How Did You Ascend?
summary: After being blown to death, Li Nanzhu transmigrates into a beloved “group pampering” novel—as nothing more than a cannon-fodder female supporting character. She thought she was already unlucky enough, only to discover that the sect she randomly joined is actually a gathering place for villains! But what does that have to do with someone like her—someone who just wants to die? Every time she thinks about giving up and rotting away to death, someone always reaches out and pulls her back from the pain. “Why? Why choose me?” “We chose you—because it’s you.” “The sky won’t fall. Someone will always hold it up for you.” Live on. Only by living do you earn the right to become the strongest. Whether it’s redeeming others or redeeming yourself, only by standing at the very peak of the clouds do you gain the right to pursue the truth. And those youths who refused to believe in fate etched their laughter into her destiny, branding warmth into her Dao heart. Even after a thousand years of wind and snow pass—when she looks back, the laughter carved into her fate still echoes through the ages.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Transmigrated into a Wealthy Family, Acting as Sickly Stepmother
summary: Sheng Xia woke up to find herself transmigrated into a Sweet and Pampered stepmother story. Through a system, she learned that in the future, she would participate in a family-oriented reality show as the female lead's foil. Not only would she be criticized as a terrible stepmother across the internet, but she would also have a tragic ending. The Rebellious stepson is a star in Entertainment Industry, The Charming younger Brother-in-law attracts numerous admirers too busy to even go home, and The introverted Little sister-in-law engrossed in painting not wanting to leave her room. Even the Two Little ones are afraid to appear in front of her. The Wealthy Husband rarely returns home, remaining indifferent and stating that she can treat him as if he doesn't exist. Wow, My ideal retired life is here. Just as Sheng Xia, who returned from the apocalypse, wanted to lie low and enjoy life, the system forced her to maintain the original owner's character and advance the plot to complete tasks. Sheng Xia: fine :) So — The rebellious stepson angrily barged in, "Sheng Xia, are you really crazy? If you really want to die, don't involve me!" Sheng Xia looked innocent, covering her chest delicately, "Oh, what are you saying?" The stepson's expression distorted, gritting his teeth, "No, nothing at all —" The charming younger brother smirked, squinting his peach blossom eyes, "So it's Sister-in-law —" Sheng Xia held her head, swaying as if about to collapse, her lips pale. The younger brother-in-law dutifully brought tea and water, "Well, sister-in-law, since you just had a car accident, you should rest. Just tell me if you need anything; I can still help." The introverted sister resisted, "Don't, don't talk to me." Sheng Xia manipulated the wheelchair to move slowly away, her figure more desolate than the others. The little sister-in-law hesitated and caught up, "Do you, do you want to see my paintings?" The twin siblings in unison, "Wicked stepmother —" Sheng Xia lazily embraced them, feeling drowsy. The blushing little ones buried in her soft embrace, "Bullying is not allowed..." Original female lead: "Do you know why your husband never comes home? He actually has someone he likes — I lied to you!" Sheng Xia, preparing to faint with skilled movements, suddenly opened her eyes wide. Original female lead: "...Can't you be more skilled at pretending!!!" Helpless system watching all this happen without knowing where it went wrong: ...??? Sheng Xia: ^_^ And when the Wealthy Husband returned home, he found that everyone in the family had been fooled. Even a slightly louder voice would bring condemning looks from the younger siblings, blaming him for not being considerate of Sheng Xia. Recalling Sheng Xia's latest health report, the husband addressed the assistant, "...?" She is clearly healthy, where is the illness? Sheng Xia: ^_^ Who says laziness isn't an illness? Shortly after. The workaholic husband declined the dinner, calmly explaining, "There's a beautiful and delicate wife at home who needs my attention. Excuse me." Everyone: ... ?!
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Transmigrated as the Vicious Supporting Female Who Pretended to Be the Amnesiac Tycoon’s Girlfriend
summary: After transmigrating into a novel, Song Yunfei becomes the supporting female character who pretends to be the amnesiac CEO’s girlfriend. In the original story, the supporting female character accidentally hits the president of Yanjin Group with her car. Afraid of going to jail, she takes advantage of his amnesia and pretends to be his girlfriend. Not only does she lie to him and tell him he is just a poor man, she also takes him to a remote city to hide away and constantly manipulates and gaslights him. Later, the male lead is found by his family. He has only just regained his memory when he discovers that his fiancée is about to marry someone else, and so begins his wife-chasing crematorium arc. As for Song Yunfei, the vicious supporting female character, the man settles accounts with her afterward. He not only forces her to abort the child, but also sends her to prison for five years. After her release, she dies miserably on the streets. When the transmigrated Song Yunfei opens her eyes and sees the man returning from delivering takeout, her vision goes dark, and the last bit of hope in her heart finally dies. With no other choice, Song Yunfei can only keep up the act. While living a poor life together with Chu Jinhan, she also secretly prepares to run away. However, when the long-awaited day to escape finally arrives, the man furiously drags her back. “You lied to me and now you think you can run?” Song Yunfei is shocked. Good grief, when exactly did this guy secretly regain his memory? — After recovering his memory, Chu Jinhan’s friend asks him, “She tricked you into suffering so much. How are you planning to get revenge on her?” Chu Jinhan replies calmly, “She only lied to me because she loves me.” ?

title: Reborn as a Titan God, My Cells Are All Players
summary: Gu Yuan transmigrated, becoming an ancient Titan whose body floated in the cosmic abyss, its size comparable to a galaxy. The bad news: he was on the verge of death, his body filled with void viruses capable of devouring planets, abyssal parasites that tore through dimensions, and countless rebellious cancerous kin. The good news: he had awakened the [Divine Body System] , allowing him to connect to Blue Star and disguise his internal world as a holographic online game called "Titan: Genesis"! Thus, a group of crazy fourth-disaster players descended. In Gu Yuan's eyes: These were diligent white blood cells devouring pathogens, platelets repairing blood vessels, and antibodies precisely eliminating cancer cells. In the players' eyes: "Holy shit! The graphics in this game are explosive! Surfing in the Scarlet Star River (blood vessels) at the start!" "Brothers! That ten-thousand-meter demon dragon (roundworm) lurking in the Abyssal Rift Valley (intestines) is dropping divine artifacts! Let's team up and hunt it!" "Extra! The hidden class [Thunder Envoy] (neuron) job transfer scroll only costs 100,000 bio-energy. Hurry if you want to Cultivate Immortality!" ... Unknowingly, the players went crazy. They turned Gu Yuan's lungs into the "Divine Realm of Wind," his stomach into the "Sea of Alchemical Poison," and his heart into the "Royal Court of Gods." And when the players logged off, they were astonished to discover— Terminal illness had miraculously healed, nearsightedness had become clairvoyance, and they could even conjure fireballs with their bare hands! The world went crazy! The moment Gu Yuan fully recovered and stood up from the cosmic abyss, the gods and demons of all heavens trembled. "Who said I am alone? Within me, there are billions of gods!"

title: Doomsday Train: The True Lucky Koi Pretends to Be Weak and Crushes Scum
summary: A horror game descends upon Blue Star. All of humanity is dragged aboard a never-ending Doomsday Train. In her previous life, Luo Feihua drew the SSS-tier talent “Lucky Koi”, only to be cruelly mu*dered by her vicious younger sister and adoptive parents. In this life, she decisively pins the “Lucky Koi” persona onto her sister instead, disguising herself as an F-tier tr*sh talent—quietly looting entire instances and getting rich in silence! In front of others, she appears frail and useless. Behind the scenes, she empties entire instance maps of supplies, hiding her achievements. While everyone follows the fake Lucky Koi and starves three days out of nine, she lounges in a luxurious castle, enjoying hotpot with air conditioning. In the later stages of the game, instance difficulty skyrockets—water and food are cut off. Only then do people realize that the most overlooked nobody is actually: The owner of the luxury castle aboard the Doomsday Train The Rank #1 player who clears entire instances solo Even the Boss gets farmed like a minor mob by her The crowd wails: “You’re the real Lucky Koi—why didn’t you say so earlier?!” Luo Feihua replies: “With my strength, do I even need the Lucky Koi title?” Her family and brother regret everything, kneeling to beg forgiveness. Luo Feihua: “Get lost.” The apocalypse elites she personally nurtured exchange stunned glances: “Wasn’t she just our team mascot and money tree? How did she become Rank #1?” Even the instance boss shakes its head— “You didn’t know? She’s the most distinguished VVVVVIP rich lady of this train!”

title: Useless Skill “Small Box” ~Even in Another World, You Can Survive With Just a Four-and-a-Half Tatami Mat Room~
summary: At the age of seven, Ren received a skill called "Small Box" during the "Blessing Ceremony." When he activated it, a small, faintly glowing box appeared. In a world where martial arts skills are highly valued, Ren, the third son of a baron's family, was expected to have the "Swordsmanship" skill. However, he drew "Small Box," a skill that wasn't even a combat skill, and was deemed a dud. When his younger brother obtained a better skill, his father declared he wouldn't pay for his schooling. So, Ren decided he had to earn money to become independent and headed to the adventurer's guild. Although the "Small Box" skill was considered a dud, Ren liked it and continued to use it. And then, the skill began to evolve...
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Refrain from Obsession
summary: In the novel, the sh*t car character ends up being scrapped. Furthermore, it's inevitable for the family of the sh*t car to also meet ruin. However, I have something to say. Speaking as the daughter of that tr*sh. "I want to say that my life has also been difficult because my father was a piece of shit." *** Aer, who survived from drowning, recalled memories of her past life. She realized that the place she lived in was from a web novel called 'Under the Moonlit Moonflower.' Moreover, she was enraged by the fact that she was a minor character who barely appeared in the story. So, she tried to secure money before her family's downfall, but... Why are they so obsessed and going crazy? If it's the obsession of an awakened individual, it's very persistent. Because of her father's foolish obsession, the house was always cold. By seeing her father longing for his mate, she realized how tedious an awakened person's fixation could be. So how could an Awakened's obsession be seen as a good thing? "So. You, and you. You." Since you're the ambassadors of obsession, could you please stay away? I don't even like the smell of an Awakened. But....... Aer looked at the man laughing quietly beside her. The affectionate smile remained unchanged. Surely it wouldn't be ..... Why does it feel so intense?

title: Cultivation Return: I Am the Earth’s Only Cultivator
summary: The protagonist is max level, in a normal world without martial arts or powerful clans. I crossed over to a world of cultivation and returned invincible. Modern medicine is child's play compared to elixirs; technological might crumbles before true cultivation. My name is Qin Ning, Earth's sole cultivator!

title: Electronic Girlfriend: First Top-Up of 6 Yuan Grants the Demonfallen Sword Immortal
summary: My name is Xu Jiang. I ended up in a world of urban cultivation... Drowning in millions of debt, hounded by loan sharks, abandoned by my parents, unrecognized by my sister, no system activation, no talent—completely broke. My last remaining “asset” was 6 yuan left on a credit card, just enough to top up a mobile game. In despair, I launched a game with an AI girlfriend, hoping that maybe, just maybe, a virtual lover could spare me from the crushing loneliness. I picked the most useless, lowest-ranking drunken sword maiden... and poured my final 6 yuan into the game...
genres: Action, Adult, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: I Am Unaware That I Am the Peerless Martial God
summary: Yi Feng was transported to a cultivation world, but unfortunately had no hope of cultivating immortality and could only live as an ordinary mortal. He only wished to live a peaceful life. Yet he didn’t know— The dog he adopted, because it ate his food, became a legendary demon king. The kitchen knife he casually forged became a peerless divine weapon, causing numerous experts to fight desperately for it. The young disciple he took in became an immortal lord that led an era, due to cultivating the techniques Yi Feng taught him. Even the skeletons he looked down on the most were ominous demon kings that suppressed countless worlds. Many years later, looking at the void shattered with a punch, Yi Feng murmured to himself: It turns out the peerless kings were myself all along…
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Lemon Soda Candy
summary: In high school, the second-bravest thing Zhou Anran ever did was, on a day when Chen Luobai seemed unhappy, she secretly placed two lemon soda candies into his desk. Back then, he was the proud son of heaven, adored by everyone. She was just an ordinary classmate whose name he couldn’t even remember. Later, they met again in university. Zhou Anran, who'd fought her way into the top university, was still just as inconspicuous in a sea of academic prodigies. While Chen Luobai instantly became the centre of attention the moment he arrived. Zhou Anran figured that was the end of it. Their paths wouldn't cross again. Then, one elective class, Chen Luobai placed two of the familiar lemon soda candies on her desk. “Have you tried this candy?” He seemed to ask casually. Zhou Anran’s heart jumped, she lowered her head, not answering the question. Chen Luobai continued, “I came to know this candy from someone in high school who secretly left two pieces on my desk. Everyone else slipped love letters into my desk. This person just put two candies in there. But—" He paused. Zhou Anran turned her head before she could stop herself. Her gaze landed directly in his smiling, focused eyes, staringat her like he meant something by it. “It’s pretty sweet.” The same words he would say on the night he kissed her for the first time. ——All that you wish for will one day come true.
genres: Completed, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: You’ll Regret Stealing Him from Me — My Sister Who Took My Fiancé and Celebrated Was a Fool
summary: Lady Seraphina of House Altvier had her engagement publicly annulled by Roderick, heir to the Duke of Vandering, during a high-society party. The reason given for breaking off their betrothal was a completely fabricated accusation: "She stole party management ideas from her own sister Isabella. The one truly deserving recognition is Isabella, not Seraphina." Though Seraphina understood this was her sister's scheme, the overwhelming influence of House Vandering forced her to surrender all her accomplishments to Isabella even her engagement. But was this truly misfortune? Her new fiancé emerged in the form of Maximilian, a military noble who properly recognized Seraphina's true capabilities. Meanwhile, Isabella and Roderick faced the harsh reality of being crushed beneath the weight of "stolen achievements." Falsehood. The gathered nobility at the party rendered their judgment with perfect clarity about who the truly capable one was. The thief would weep while the robbed would laugh.

title: Girls in a Matriarchal World Are Just Too Scary
summary: Transported to a female-dominated world and endowed with a submissive "shou" physique, he faces the threat of being hacked to death with a cleaver due to his "green tea" behavior. "I must change my fate!" Su Yan raised his hand and swore. However… "Little Junior Brother, I’ve noticed you’ve been getting prettier lately. Let your Senior Sister study you a bit." "Why are you distancing yourself from me? Is it because you’ve taken a liking to some other woman?" "I’m going to lock you up at home, so you’ll belong to me forever."
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, Xianxia

title: The End of the World Scavenger: I Win by Turning Waste into Treasure
summary: Forensic expert Lin Chu was suddenly thrown into an infinite apocalypse. When others see zombies: “Oh my god, disgusting creatures covered in blood and flesh, stay away!” When Lin Chu sees zombies: “Moving 206 bones! Walking points, the more, the better!” Relying on her old profession, she quickly adapted to the bloody apocalyptic world. In a place full of chaos, others avoid it, but Lin Chu’s eyes gleam as she charges forward. In her left hand, a thigh bone; in her right, expired medicine—both are good items, after all, she has the ability to turn waste into treasure. Zombies, storms, earthquakes, fire rains, acid rains, locust plagues… one apocalyptic dimension after another attacks. Fortunately, even though she’s in an apocalyptic world, the system kindly arranged a safehouse for her. She only needs to find an intact door and settle it within the specified time. While others scramble and fight, Lin Chu calmly pulls out a door from her space that she had picked up in the last dimension while scavenging…
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Supernatural

title: After the Divorce, Enjoying a Feast with Mother, While the Jerk Father’s Family Frets
summary: Having transmigrated into this world and witnessed her Mother being divorced, Lian'er saw the ugly face of the Song Family and resolutely decided to leave with her Mother. Want a divorce? No way, bring the Divorce Deed. Younger Brother backstabbing? Okay, press a fingerprint on the Disownment Letter, and there's no longer any relationship. Change the surname, grandson becomes family grandson, from now on she is Qiao Family. Mother has a lame leg, and the Qiao Family is so poor they're drinking the western wind, but it doesn't matter, she has a thousand ways to survive, and also has the Farm Space to help, silver clinking, heartily eating meat. The jerk father, who joined the army and hadn't been heard from in ten years, finally returned, bringing a mother and son, only then realizing the divorce was a scheme. Seeing Mother dressed in fine clothes and jewelry, the jerk father wasn't calm, no matter his sweet words, Lian'er drove him away with a beating. The entire Qiao Family stepped up, whipping, throwing stones, how dare they come again to have ideas about our Qiao Family's Daughter? The jerk father then sent the ungrateful Younger Brother to play the family affection card, it's alright, pack up and leave together. Coming to this world, Lian'er only wants to take the people who love her with her: To Get Rich, To Become Rich, become extremely wealthy, become extremely beautiful. As for Tom, Dick, and Harry, go wherever it's cool.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Slice of Life

title: Dimension Plunderer Leveling Up with NTR
summary: I crossed dimensions after receiving a request from the gods. There is only one mission. 'Steal the protagonist's heroine.'
genres: Action, Adult, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological, Romance

title: Unstoppable Ace Detective My 90s Promotion Journey
summary: Twenty-first-century detective expert Gu Ping’an, who once clawed her way to the top through sheer hard work, transmigrates to the 1990s. Originally a disgraced officer demoted to a small town, Gu Ping’an thinks this might be a chance to finally live a laid-back, healthy life. But this era, with its backward investigative technology, is a golden age for criminals, and her crime-fighting soul just can’t sit still. When the entire city’s police force is hunting a mu*derer who slaughtered a family of five, Gu Ping’an points at the surviving family head—who’s just fainted from grief—and declares, “You’re the killer!” Everyone is shocked: How could the survivor, the head of the household, kill his own parents and children? Yet Gu Ping’an is proven right. Even with investigative technology set back a century, nothing can escape her sharp eyes. Victims she saves cling to her, swearing to marry her. Exonerated suspects send her commendatory banners, even staging public thanks at the police headquarters. mu*derers she interrogates cough up blood after just a few of her pointed words. Colleagues can’t figure out how Gu Ping’an—the laziest, most food-loving, comfort-seeking officer who never works overtime, always eats on time, and often snacks on apples and milk—could be so brilliant. “See that? That’s Gu Ping’an, the disgrace of the city police—demoted to the ‘frontier’ after a misconduct record!” Days later, she’s transferred directly to the city’s criminal investigation team. “Heard they’re short-handed, so she’s on loan. She’ll be sent back soon.” Weeks later, Gu Ping’an aces the unified exam and joins the team officially. “With that record, she’s hit her ceiling.” Not long after, Gu Ping’an is promoted to team leader. By the time she becomes captain, everyone’s forgotten their earlier doubts. “Captain Gu, please, take a look at this case!” “Captain Gu, I’m stuck—give me a hand!” “Captain Gu, come on—I’ll give you all my leave and benefits this year, just help me interrogate this suspect!” Surrounded by her team, Gu Ping’an leisurely munches an apple and realizes she’s somehow gotten swept up in the grind again… but maybe it’s not so bad after all.

title: Losing Money to Be a Tycoon
summary: Recently, a special correspondent conducted an exclusive interview with Pei Qian, President of Tengda Group. Tengda Group, now valued at hundreds of billions, operates across various sectors such as gaming, internet services, digital hardware, cultural media, and restaurants, significantly impacting numerous aspects of daily life. Pei Qian himself is widely regarded as the "World’s Best Boss," an unparalleled investment genius, and a brilliant game developer. He is known for his effortless leadership style and keen ability to precisely forecast industry trends. However, during the interview, Pei Qian expressed deep frustration: “I’m truly not some kind of business genius!” “My success is entirely due to luck!” “My initial goal was merely to lose fifty thousand yuan…” See? This is exactly how a genuine business genius maintains humility and modesty.

title: You Can’t Beat Me in Terms of Beauty
summary: Shi Jian is a popular actress, with fair skin, stunning beauty, and long legs—she's born to be the main character. She has a strong performative personality, and whenever Shi Jian is around, beautiful men and women seem to pale in comparison, relegated to mere background roles. Shi Jian: “I’m going to live forever and stay beautiful forever.” Then, Shi Jian, young and full of life, unexpectedly dies and is thrown into a terrifying game streaming app, where there are countless monsters, and the only way to revive is to survive within the game. Shi Jian: “…” How scary! They’re really trying to push her—this delicate flower—to her death. Maybe she should just give up and die quietly. QWQ Shi Jian trembles in fear, lying flat, waiting for death. Just as the monster is about to finish her off, she suddenly slaps its hand away. Shi Jian, furious, shouts, “Don’t touch me, change positions! My left side looks better on camera than my right side!” The monster being questioned: ??? Shi Jian, who has always been the main character, insists on staying the center of attention, even in this situation. ... So, the other players, hiding in the dark, hold their breath. She moves straight toward the ghostly monsters—not because she’s afraid, but because the lighting is better there. Beauty, like jewels, needs proper lighting! Shi Jian runs in the battle royale, drawing eyeliner with her bare hands, using the cold wind effects from a small boss as a makeshift fan, and stealing a female ghost’s beautiful wedding dress to wear. When a woman wants something, she gets it. The ghosts hold a meeting: "This is definitely a provocation. It may not be very damaging, but it’s incredibly insulting." After some discussion, some of them have been slapped by Shi Jian, others have been slapped across the face, and some even had their hair pulled. They need the highest executive officer’s legal assistance! The highest executive officer, who is untouchable, remains silent: "I’m henpecked, don’t cue me, don’t ruin me..." ... At first, the viewers in the livestream chat predicted: “The host won’t last more than three minutes!” But by the end, the viewers were watching in awe: “Look at the various ways the host tortures the monsters! It’s so addictive! A day without watching feels off!” At first, the viewers thought Shi Jian was just a delicate flower, doomed to be eliminated in a few episodes, but they didn’t expect her to be a powerhouse! Shi Jian, the delicate flower: “So scary, but the main character can only be me!”
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural

title: Gods of the Nation: You Worship the God of Longevity, I Worship the King of Hell!
summary: “What? I can get stronger just by offering incense?” Lu Chen finds himself transported to a world where everyone worships deities. By offering incense, one can communicate with the gods and receive their blessings. However, the masses flock to worship the most popular deities, causing these incense-rich gods to be so flooded with offerings that they take the incense but refuse to do anything in return! Lu Chen: “If that’s the case, I’d rather go all in on a few unpopular gods with little incense and warm up their cold altars!” So, while others worship the God of Wealth, Zhao Gongming, Lu Chen goes straight to worshipping the Sovereign God of Wealth! Lu Chen: “Lord Sovereign God of Wealth, You are the Emperor of Wealth, the most honored among all wealth gods. The rest of them have eyes but fail to see it.” Sovereign God of Wealth: “Young friend, you truly understand me! I’ve been down and out with little incense for years, already ready to give up. You’ve reignited my confidence. Rest assured, I will surely ensure your path to prosperity.” Lu Chen (beaming): “Thank you, Lord Sovereign of Wealth, for your protection!”
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, School Life, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Fertility Value 0? Fluffy Husbands Are All Top Dogs
summary: Transmigrated into a Book + Sci-Fi Fluff Transmigrated into the book as a cannon fodder useless female with 0 fertility value and mental power, to change her fate, Shi Lan ran to a remote star to become a warden. The prison here held top strong individuals whose mental power had collapsed. The previous wardens had fled quickly, unable to bear the responsibility, leaving behind a thick, bold, and red management manual. She thought the work ahead would be full of difficulties, but no one told her that the prison was filled with large furballs. Prisoner No. 1, the majestic White Lion, the most popular Major General in the Interstellar, outwardly gentle and stable, but in private, “Lan Lan, can you look at me more? I need your comfort too…” Prisoner No. 2, the stunningly beautiful Bird of Paradise, one of the young masters of the Empire’s Four Great Families, always arrogant and narcissistic, but secretly performing a courtship dance, “Shi Lan, do you like it?” Prisoner No. 3, the taciturn and aloof Black Panther, the Empire’s former Heir, rumored to be uninterested in women, but in reality, “Lan Lan, I can do somersaults too.” Prisoner No. 4, the tsundere furball Pallas’s Cat, one of the young masters of the Empire’s Four Great Families, spoke with bared teeth and aggressive momentum, but whimpered and acted spoiled when touched, “Lan Lan, if you dare, touch me again… Awooo…” Prisoner No. 5, the gorgeous and noble Nine Tails Red Fox, the former leader of the Space Pirates before the Empire’s amnesty, rumored to be the most ruthless and scheming, but said with a gentle expression, “Lan Lan, will other Beastmen have nine tails for you to pet like me?” While the previous wardens suffered immensely, Shi Lan was at a loss facing the furballs vying for her affection…
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Sci-fi

title: I Became a Disaster-Class Mage Inside a Romance Fantasy
summary: I recovered memories of my past life, only to realize I was inside a romance fantasy novel. My talent as a mage is disaster-class. The female protagonist of this novel, the regressor Imperial Princess, keeps approaching me. But I prefer the Duke's daughter though?
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: The Manga Pariah’s Guide to Self-Salvation
summary: (Featuring forums, hidden identities, and mastermind elements) Holy Healer Ye Zheng has just saved a squad of superpowered fighters when her system drops a bombshell: this world is a manga. Good news: She is the female lead. Bad news: She is a universally despised female lead, so loathed that readers have petitioned the creator to write her out! Blessed with beauty and healing powers, Ye Zheng’s overflowing compassion repeatedly endangers the protagonist team, making her a troublesome burden to the male lead. Even the male lead’s chemistry with the antagonist garners more fans than his “official” pairing with her. [Another token female lead, just a plot device to pass censorship.] [Wait, this manga has a female lead? Dropped!] [Her design is pretty hot, though—c’mon, creator, give us some fanservice!] [Ugh, I just want to see dudes fight! Why’s there a girl in my shonen manga?] The system warns: “The creator plans to ditch you, having you take a tragic hit for the male lead and exit the story in the later arcs.” “Only by reversing your popularity can you change the creator’s and readers’ minds to avoid being written off!” The delicate, beautiful healer lowers her tearful eyes. “So… everyone really hates me.” But with a soft smile, she adds, “That’s okay. I’ll do my best to turn things around.” King of the Demonic Domain is the hottest shonen manga of the moment. Its thrilling world-building, electrifying battles, and richly crafted characters have birthed a legion of wildly popular “paper people.” The upright, stoic male lead; the chaotic, morally gray second male; the noble, self-sacrificing third male… Yet, in this action-packed, male-driven story, the forum’s hottest topic is always that woman. At first, she’s the saintly fool whose attempt to save a cat traps her team in a beastly crisis, earning her the title of Most Hated Character. Then, readers uncover her truth: a suppressed madwoman saint, oppressed by the superpower clergy, her kindness twisted into obsession—a witch they can’t help but root for. And later, jaws drop as she plays them all: unleashing apocalyptic floods, stealing the guarded dragon bones, and delivering calamity with ruthless fairness. Beneath Ye Zheng’s gentle, holy facade lies unyielding ambition and ferocity. [Did Ye Zheng show up today? I’m obsessed with this villainous queen!] [Zheng-jie, go easy on the protagonists, don’t hurt my fave!] [Guys, I’ve switched sides—Ye Zheng is too cool!] [Shaking here… who remembers when we thought she was just a healer tool?] [I’m out, grabbing merch—this woman’s terrifyingly awesome!] Even the system is stunned: “Wake up! You’re supposed to be the gentle, kind shonen heroine!” Ye Zheng flashes a serene smile. “Who says a villainous queen can’t be the female lead?” Reading Guide: - The female lead is a righteous-to-ruthless villain. - Inspired by the unfair treatment of female characters in some shonen manga. - She starts weak but rises to become the world’s strongest.

title: The Crimson Moon Returns
summary: Under the blood-red moonlight, listening to the whispers of ancient gods, a transmigrator steps into this new world of steam and steel. The Twelve True Gods sit high upon their thrones, while the Great Old Ones linger within memory. Mysteries from the Dreamlands, unfathomable artifacts, potions of the new world, and secret arts of the old. On Victorian-style streets, Lynch opens the door to his detective agency—and falls into deep thought at the tent**les knocking outside. Is there any saving someone with excessively high ‘inspiration’? Waiting online. Urgent.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural

title: My Military Branches Can Evolve Infinitely
summary: Mu Yuan accidentally obtained the qualification for a mysterious game which mirrors the real world. In this game, players could recruit troops, establish territories, and even manifest items from the game into reality. His game started with ten Little Skeletons, but... Little Skeleton→Skeleton Soldier→Skeleton Warrior→Skeleton General.....→ King of Skeleton "What if I evolve the Little Skeleton into an Emperor of Skeletons? How would you respond to that?" "Evolution Points, let's see what your limit is!" Several years later, when the worlds overlapped, Mu Yuan, amidst a throng of gods and demons, had ascended to the extreme peak.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-fi, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Living with the Arrogant Queen from High School Is Surprisingly Not Uncomfortable (LN)
summary: One late night, Yamamoto, a college student working the night shift at a convenience store, is approached at the register by a woman in sweats. Her name is Megumi Hayashi—his classmate from high school, known as the most beautiful girl in their year. Headstrong and arrogant, she was the kind of person everyone called “the Queen.” Back in high school, they didn’t exactly get along—in fact, Yamamoto had always found her hard to deal with. But as they engage in some casual small talk, he notices something disturbing: a painful-looking bruise on her wrist. When he presses her for the reason, she admits, “My boyfriend hit me.” Acting on impulse, Yamamoto brings her back to his apartment to hide her for the time being. But just as he’s about to fall asleep… Hayashi suddenly clings to him from behind!? Thus begins a cohabitation between a jaded guy and a wounded “queen,” starting from the worst possible circumstances. Where will their unexpected living arrangement lead…?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: Starting With a Reef [Global Survival]
summary: Just moments ago, Yun Luohe was struggling to pull a garbage bag over a tr*sh can. The next second, she found herself standing on the edge of a massive reef, with salty waves crashing at her feet. 【Welcome to the Doomsday Ocean Survival Kit.】 The so-called “starter pack” proudly included: One tattered fishing net that might rip apart if you even looked at it wrong, Two legendary moldy buns perfect for cultivating penicillin, And five waterlogged, cracked wooden planks. “Is this seriously my beta test reward?!” she hissed with disgust. 【Zing! An epic-level cheat detected —【Magic tr*sh Can】】 【Magic tr*sh Can — Level 1 (Upgradeable)】 【Skill: Recycle and Reuse】 【Tip: Toss in any junk to recover useful materials.】 Armed with her “baby tr*sh can,” Yun Luohe grinned: “Your tr*sh is my treasure. Just watch — I’ll build an empire out of garbage!”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The Cultivation World Forbids Species Discrimination
summary: The Half-Demon Healer: From Outcast to Legend "A human gives birth to a human, a demon gives birth to a demon. Your father is human, your mother is a demon, so you are—" Yu Youyou shoved her fluffy tail under her robe and deadpanned, "I’m a half-demon!" A top-tier post-apocalyptic medical expert transmigrates into the body of a frail half-demon girl at the bottom of the cultivation world’s social hierarchy. Three steps and she’s out of breath, five steps and she’s coughing blood—every day feels like her last. To make things worse, both humans and demons despise half-breeds. Humans call her a demonic abomination, demons say she’s a mongrel, and even her own father abandoned her like an unwanted stain in his life. Yu Youyou thought she was destined to struggle between two warring races, make tough choices, and maybe—just maybe—unite the entire cultivation world. Yeah, none of that happened. Instead, she found herself in a world full of weirdos: a genius alchemist who seriously suggested she wrap her tail around her waist like a belt, a divine beast that pretended to be a cat just to scam free meals, and a Demon Emperor who had an uncontrollable urge to groom every young demon he met. Forget unifying the world—Yu Youyou just wanted to survive! But despite the odds, she refused to die. Not only did she thrive, but she became the world’s most sought-after Master of Medicine. Human cultivators begged for her help, whether it was reattaching severed limbs or saving shattered dantian. Demons lined up, asking her to cure infertility, bald tails, and even missing wings. Even the legendary Sword Deity, after failing his ascension and being struck half-dead by divine lightning, had no choice but to seek her aid. His disciples carefully carried him to her sect and whispered, "Master Yu is your only hope now… but she has a bad temper. If you want to live, kneel sincerely and act pitiful." So, for seven days, the proud Sword Deity knelt outside her mountain in the wind and rain, waiting to meet the great healer. And when he finally did, he realized she was the very half-demon daughter he had abandoned.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: Cultivation Begins from Infancy
summary: In chaotic times, seek survival; in prosperous times, seek fame. The Dayu Dynasty, weathered by countless hardships, remains in its era of prosperity. In the northwest, a young man travels nine thousand miles on foot, single-handedly slaying a great demon, striving for lifelong glory. At Dragon Lake, an unparalleled master descends to the mortal world, founding a sect that will be remembered for centuries. In the imperial capital, a sage preaches to thousands, his disciples spread across the provinces, leaving an eternal legacy. And within a martial family estate in Qingzhou City, A child spends his days idly, only playing chess, painting, fishing, and playing the lute. Years later— ... A sword rises, its dragon-like smoke stretches three thousand miles, and with one strike, nine cities are vanquished! Among the myriad laws of the world, only I attain the Dao.

title: Transmigrating into the Male Protagonist’s Stepmother in a Campus Novel
summary: Jiang Jinjin transmigrated into a campus romance novel and became the stepmother of the teenage male protagonist. Throughout the entire story, there had been barely any mention of this stepmother, and a rough estimate put it at fewer than two hundred words. She really had transmigrated for nothing. The male protagonist was sixteen that year, in the middle of his rebellious phase. He was the school's most handsome boy, admired by everyone, and her presence in front of him was practically nonexistent. The male protagonist's father was thirty-nine, a mature and refined man, composed and self-disciplined, with a depth that was hard to fathom. Jiang Jinjin: Neither of them is a person I can handle. I'm out. Fully aware of her own limits, Jiang Jinjin decided to live quietly under the title of Mrs. Zhou and focus all her efforts on making money. Yet to her surprise, while raking in cash, she somehow also managed to win over the father and son pair. Jiang Jinjin was dumbfounded. What's wrong with them? She had only ever treated them as tools! Male Protagonist: There's no way I'll ever see you as my mother. But don't worry, I'll take care of you in your old age. Jiang Jinjin: ? When the male protagonist's father saw the internet calling them 'the sweetest age-gap couple among the wealthy', he fell silent for a long moment. From that day on, those in certain circles came to understand that Zhou Mingfeng had one more taboo— never mention the age difference between him and his wife.

title: Shocking! The Broke Campus Heartthrob Is My Child’s Father
summary: In the novel *Spoiling You Into Marriage*, two supporting characters generated even more discussion than the leads themselves. Jiang Ruoqiao was the male lead's scheming first love — the one who abandoned him before he rose to success. Beneath her pure and harmless appearance lay a personality that despised poverty, worshipped wealth, and craved vanity. Her actions were nothing short of infuriating. Lu Yicheng was the male lead's college roommate and close friend. From a humble background, he was the campus heartthrob and top student of his university days — gentle and reserved, humble and courteous. One day, while working a part-time job, Lu Yicheng unexpectedly came across a five-year-old boy. The child's eyes were bright and clear as he called out to him: "Dad!" Lu Yicheng was at a complete loss. "…" Who could tell him how, at twenty years old, he could possibly have a five-year-old son — especially when he was certain he had never been intimate with anyone? Even more shocking, the little boy pointed at his roommate's girlfriend in a photo and complained with a pout, "Dad, why haven't you taken me to find Mom yet?" * Years later, a legend still circulated at A University—just how beautiful was the campus belle of that graduating class? Beautiful enough that the two most prominent figures in the faculty turned against each other because of her. To this, Jiang Ruoqiao said, "Honestly, at the beginning, I wasn't interested in either of them… Do you believe in a father rising in status thanks to his child?" Lu Yicheng: "?" * Tags: Time Travel · Sweet Romance · Transmigration into a Book · Feel-Good Story * One-sentence Summary: The five-year-old son of the campus belle and heartthrob has traveled through time * Theme: Stay positive and strive forward

title: Transmigrating into the Male Supporting Character’s Ex-wife
summary: Ruan Jiu Jiu transmigrated into a rebirth novel, in which the female lead in her past life had an unattainable love, a white moonlight. In the novel, the white moonlight Cheng Jun was a hollow character with a pretty face but zero accomplishments, and with his cold personality was like a frigid beauty; an empty flower vase. Meanwhile, Ruan Jiu Jiu transmigrated into Cheng Jun’s ex-wife, an evil, stuck-up, female side character. When Ruan Jiu Jiu transmigrated over, a divorce agreement was placed on the table. Cheng Jun, wet from the rain, ate a bowl of unhealthy instant noodles. Seeing that beautiful, emotionless face, Ruan Jiu Jiu suddenly couldn’t take it anymore and said that she’d wait until tomorrow to reconsider the divorce. Later. Ruan Jiu Jiu: Who said that he’s an idiot? Who said that he’s frigid? You’re trolling (╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻

title: President, Madam Is Bartering Knives on Credit Again
summary: Knives as proof, words as evidence. When the prophecy comes true, it’s time to collect payment.** This is the way of the “Knife-Barterer” in the mystical world. Tu Shanjiu, the 283rd generation of knife-barterers, possessed a metaphysical talent far surpassing anyone else in her family. Her divinations were frighteningly accurate, and she could communicate with spirits and deities. Unfortunately, due to a curse the Tu Shan family laid upon themselves a hundred years ago, she wouldn’t live long. Since childhood, she knew she had a fiancé—a destined partner arranged by her grandfather. Only by marrying him could she be truly safe. Before passing away, her grandfather repeatedly reminded her to go down the mountain to the Xie family. It was time to collect the debt owed by her fiancé’s family. — *It was said that the richest family in Nancheng—the Xie family—had a young master named Xie Shiyu, who had been engaged since childhood. His fiancée was said to be some country bumpkin living in a remote mountain village.* No one could understand why old Master Xie had arranged such a mismatched engagement for his eldest grandson. But later, when they met her in person—so gentle and quiet, graceful in speech and behavior, with impeccable manners—everyone realized that rumors could not be trusted. Especially when later on, powerful figures from every industry respectfully addressed her as “Miss Tu Shan,” Everyone was completely shocked. Someone once curiously asked them why they were so respectful toward her. The big shots replied: “Because she’s our creditor!” — Tu Shanjiu had always been forgetful since she was a child. She would often forget to collect debts. After getting married, she simply handed the ledger over to her husband Xie Shiyu and asked him to remind her to collect. Looking at the thick stack of account books left on his desk, Xie Shiyu fell silent on the spot In the world of mysticism, there exists a mysterious job called “賒刀人”—literally “Knife-Barterer.” These people lend services (like fortune-telling, protection, or supernatural help) in exchange for a future debt, which they later come to collect once the prophecy comes true.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural

title: My Mom Is the Protagonist of a Retro Stepmother Novel
summary: As the protagonist of a retro stepmother novel, you must be good at cooking, hardworking and capable, willing to endure hardship without complaint. Not only do you have to serve a vicious mother-in-law, you also have to rack your brains to make those mischievous step-sons and step-daughters acknowledge you. When Su Yang was reading the novel, “What an unlucky female lead.” In the blink of an eye, she became the unlucky female lead’s biological daughter, the so-called burden everyone talked about. It was now the second day since her mom married into the Shen family with her. Five-year-old Su Yang looked at her overbearing stepfather, who seemed like he was about to inherit an empire, and at her stepbrothers and stepsisters, who were still blowing snot bubbles yet holding their noses high in the air. She raised her head and reached out her little hand to tug at her mom. She was just thinking about how to persuade her mom to leave this hellhole. When her mom, with a calm expression, slapped a divorce agreement in front of the stepfather. Su Yang: ! ——— In her previous life, Su Hong spent sixty years as a servant. She washed clothes and cooked, worked day and night, and poured her heart and soul into treating her stepsons and stepdaughters well, so much so that she even neglected her own biological daughter. In the end, all she got in return was a single sentence, “Dad married her just to get a nanny. What right does she have to be buried in our family grave?” Yet everyone kept saying that Su Hong had married a good husband in her life, that her stepsons and stepdaughters were all successful, and that she was truly blessed. Reborn once again, Su Hong gave a cold smile. Whoever envies this so-called blessing can have it. She took her daughter to study, start businesses, and keep up with trends, step by step living into a version that her ex-husband and those stepsons and stepdaughters could never hope to reach again.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: I Have a Cultivation World
summary: After 6,000 years of development by the immortal sect on Planet Earth, all of the leyline spiritual energy was controlled by the country. They only released enough spiritual energy for the cultivators to breathe. If a cultivator wanted to use the spiritual energy to train themselves, they would have to pay the immortal sect for that. Chen Mobai was a senior high school student at the Fifth High School of the Immortal Sect. He was studying for his entrance exam at the colleges of the immortal sect. His biggest dream was to achieve the Foundation Establishment Realm until he was transmigrated to a cultivation world. “There’s no one here despite how dense the spiritual energy is?” “Wait! Isn’t this the legendary spiritual herb? Are these not extinct here?” “Huh? Is this the method to extract one’s Spiritual Root? Also, isn’t this a divine technique?” “What a powerful cultivator! Please accept me as your disciple!” ..As his life in the cultivation world continued, his dream changed.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Harem, Romance, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: A Veteran Player Becomes a Troublemaker
summary: After getting scolded by his boss due to his senior’s mistake, he decides to revisit Meta Pangaea after a long time… “This is driving me crazy.” He ends up playing as Schrantz’s Wild Young Master, known for its infamous extreme difficulty—only to realize it has become his reality?! If real life is hard mode, then the situation he’s in now is hell mode!He must always live fiercely—because that’s the life of Ian von Schrantz. Using all his accumulated gaming knowledge, he must survive as Schrantz’s wild young master!

title: Surrounding Reincarnation ~My Best Friend is a Villainous Lady~
summary: Kushiro Mao had memories of her past life. When she compared those memories, there was something about the world she was born into that made her feel uneasy. But that was a minor detail. She still had adult knowledge from a young age. She was happy that life had become less difficult, and enjoyed life in a wealthy family. In particular, after learning about the existence of magic that was impossible in her previous world, she spent her days engrossed in it. However, this state of happiness did not last long. One day, a certain girl called out to her, and she became aware of this world and her position. This was the world of a manga, and the girl in front of her was the villainess. …

title: You are the Strongest Possessor
summary: Sunan, a mad veteran gamer who suffered from an incurable illness and poured the rest of his life into gaming, ended up becoming the Tutorial Fairy dwelling within a sword in the brutally difficult game Esrana Exodus!
