[You are the Strongest Possessor!]

title: The Beautiful Archery Club Senpai Is Sleeping in My Room with Her Tummy Out
summary: The usually proper and dignified Senpai turns into a useless mess thanks to my healing!? Amemoto Touya is a high school student who loves healing and peace. One night, Touya encounters the captain of the archery club, Watanuki Rino. There was something pitiful about the sight of her buying a massive amount of energy drinks at a convenience store... Learning that Rino was working too hard every day to live up to the expectations of those around her, Touya resolved to help her. As a result of Touya, who is well-versed in "healing," giving it his all— "Nngh... Ehehe." "She's sleeping with a happy face again..." Rino ended up spending all her time in Touya's room!? A reward-style rom-com where a usually dignified, super-strong Senpai becomes completely loose and defenseless in front of me!

title: Help! I’ve Been Controlled By An Evil God Player!
summary: I, Vivian Violet—since that day, it seems I’ve been targeted by an Evil God! It keeps muttering things like “leaderboards,” “PVP,” “pay-to-win,” “loot boxes,” and other words I don’t understand, then takes control of my body and makes me do all sorts of unbelievable things. It granted me the power of an Evil God, allowing me to obtain a profession that ordinary people could only dream of. 【Peace Princess】 It’s a special class that can manually craft something called C4. Supposedly, this C4 can put the Lost into a baby-like sleep. But wait… why does C4 have to be thrown? Shouldn’t it be something like a music box that plays a lullaby? So how exactly does this C4 make the Lost fall into a baby-like sleep? In short, this Evil God is always controlling my body to do all kinds of lawless things—including but not limited to blowing up churches, soloing cultist strongholds, stealing candy from little girls, and, in the end, tossing out a world-ending “nuclear peace” during a war between two nations. “That free, silent nuke has nothing to do with me! It was all the Evil God’s doing!” Facing the gods’ crusade, the pitiful Evil God Vivian said this. …… My name is Jiang Chen, a well-known game reviewer. I just finished testing a game called Eternal Era. But right now, I’m panicking—because just moments ago, a spatial rift appeared in my house, and a blonde, twin-tailed little girl stepped out from it… And then… “Long time no see, Lord God!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, School Life, Supernatural

title: Doomsday Lord: Starting as the Zerg Queen
summary: Here, you'll witness the past and present of the Galactic Swarm, the origins of the warmongering Witch Clan, the rise of the Sea Kin, the birth of colossal beasts... and even... a World Tree cultivation project starting from scratch? On her 18th birthday, Bai Yi suddenly found out her family was actually filthy rich. Just as she was coming to terms with her new reality and getting ready for a new life, another twist hit— The world was destroyed. The apocalypse descended. Humanity got tossed into millions of different worlds after being handed some random "Lord Qualification." The good news? Her cheat code finally arrived—it was something that looked super powerful: gene weaving. The bad news? Everyone else got one too... and theirs looked even stronger. What else could she do? She’d just be a support-type player trying to get by, relying on her cheat to do a bit of farming. But... why are all my units starting to look so weird? I just wanted to grow some crops in peace. They were the ones who barged in and got taken out by bugs/gardeners/crops—how is that my fault?! Zerg Queen? Prime Witch? Slander! It’s all slander! I’m just your average, totally ordinary support-type lord!
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Wishing You Eternal Happiness
summary: The brilliant and young high minister, noble and benevolent in character, was once renowned in the capital. Once the situation at court changed, his identity was questioned, and his name had since been tainted. As such, he left for a faraway place. The pure and innocent pearl of the Zhen family, favored and loved by all, once led a smooth and tranquil life. Overnight, the great mansion completely collapsed. She married a bad husband, and her soul succumbed to eternal rest. One day, she awoke from a great dream. Confronting the junction of fate, she was determined to change the course of events. Their reencounter transformed the trajectory of their lives. With his life-saving grace and meticulous care, Pei You’an brought hope to the helpless her. Staying by his side in happiness and in sorrow, in life and in death, Zhen Jiafu reawakened feelings of concern in the apathetic him. A letter replete with ardent love: traveling a thousand miles to be with the gentleman. Despite the chill of the snowy night, with warmth sustained by love, the two hearts were the most intimate they had ever been. Although the world has its ups and downs, with you keeping me company, this life is enough.

title: The Boyfriends I Picked Up in Horror Games Are Bizarre
summary: Bai Yao became the vicious supporting female character in various horror worlds, a character who possessed beauty but was filled with the stench of money. After the system threw the word “conquer” at her, it lost contact due to poor signal. She had read so many novels and was quite familiar with the trope—wasn’t it just asking her to conquer men with tragic experiences? Whenever she saw someone for the first time, she could sense a dark red glow around them, and she guessed that they must be her target for conquest. So— In a haunted boarding school, she picked up a pure-hearted boy who was bullied. She tutored him, gave him flowers, and they secretly embraced each other in the art room where someone had died. In an abandoned hospital where six people were trying to escape, she rescued a frail young man, abandoned by everyone as a burden. She brought him resources and equipment, and kissed him discreetly in a closet. On a perilous island, she saw a black, tentacled, octopus-like creature and accepted its offer. She hid the black monster in her pocket. It grew larger and larger, finally taking on a human form, and she decided she could teach it how to kiss. The system came back online, and screamed, "How on earth can you fall in love with so many ghost bosses!" Bai Yao: "Didn't you ask me to conquer them?" The system crashed, "I asked you to successfully conquer the game and survive to the end, I didn't ask you to who*e the bosses!" Bai Yao: "Ah, this..." The unspeakable monster tore its body in half, and its tent**les brought all the hidden shells to her, "Yaoyao, kiss me." Bai Yao: My favorability is maxed out, how can I not kiss you?
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: My Mom Sent Me to the Owners’ Group for a Blind Date
summary: My mom posted my photo in our neighborhood's owner group to try and set me up on a blind date. Half an hour later, three men claimed at the same time that I was their girlfriend. The most ridiculous part? I didn't know a single one of them.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Mystery, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Why Are You Begging Me to Come Home After Severing Ties With Me
summary: After the Xiao family went bankrupt, they regretted everything. In tears, they begged Xiao Chen, who had become the richest man, to come home. Xiao Chen’s expression was cold. “We already cut off all ties. Why are you begging me to come back?” In his previous life, his parents favored his twin younger brother, Xiao Ming, and treated Xiao Chen as a jinx. They exiled Xiao Chen to his grandmother’s home in the countryside and ignored him completely. His younger brother inherited the Xiao Group. With Xiao Chen’s help, the Xiao family rose to the top of Jiangcheng. Yet all the glory that should have belonged to Xiao Chen became his brother’s instead. Xiao Ming was hailed as a promising young financial star. Meanwhile, Xiao Chen had to take the blame for his brother’s reckless street racing and hit-and-run incident and was thrown into a detention center. In the end, afraid that Xiao Chen would seize the Xiao family’s assets, his younger brother colluded with kidnappers to abduct him and mu*dered him cruelly. When faced with Xiao Chen’s death, their parents remained indifferent. When Xiao Chen opened his eyes, he had been reborn in his final year of high school. Given a second chance at life, he would live for himself…

title: Every Monster in Every World is Begging for My Hugs
summary: Bai Yao has been cast as the ultimate “villainess” across a series of nightmare realms: a girl with a face like an angel, a heart full of greed, and absolutely zero survival skills. After dropping a single cryptic directive - “Capture” - into her brain, her System lost its signal and went radio silent. But Bai Yao knows the tropes. She’s read the novels. Obviously, “Capture” means she needs to find the most tragic, broken man in the room and make him fall in love with her, right? Whenever she spots someone radiating a deep, crimson glow, she assumes she’s found her target. And so, the “romance” begins: In a haunted boarding school, she “rescues” a shy, bullied boy. She tutors him, brings him flowers, and drags him into the cursed art room for secret, midnight make-out sessions. In a death-trap abandoned hospital, she saves a frail youth who was abandoned as dead weight. She showers him with supplies and top-tier gear, hiding with him in cramped lockers for long, stolen kisses. On a monster-infested island, she finds a writhing, tentacled black mass. Instead of running, she stuffs the little horror into her pocket. As it grows larger and eventually takes on a human shape, she decides it’s finally time to teach it how to use its mouth for something other than eating. When the System finally reboots, it lets out a digital shriek: “How in the name of God did you end up dating all the Horror Bosses?!” Bai Yao: “You told me to ‘capture’ them, didn’t you?” The System has a total meltdown: “I meant a Game Walkthrough! I wanted you to beat the level, not seduce the literal Nightmare Lords!” Bai Yao: “Oh... oops.” Nearby, an unspeakable monster splits its form in half, its tent**les offering up a pile of rare treasures like a devoted puppy. It whispers, “Yao Yao... kiss me.” Bai Yao: Well, his Favorability Meter is already maxed out. It’d be rude to stop now, wouldn’t it?

title: What’s Wrong with My Cute Childhood Friend Being My Girlfriend?
summary: “I have something important to talk about. Can I come to your apartment now?” It all began with a message from my cute childhood friend, Himekawa Hina. When she arrived, she looked straight at me and asked, “What do you think it is? My important, really important talk.” There was no way I could guess. I pretended to think it over, but Hina, who’s known me forever, saw right through me. “Come on, don’t get mad. Then try guessing from these. One, I’m moving away. Two, I’ve fallen for someone. Three, I’m about to confess to you. So, which is it?” A sudden confession. A relationship that changes everything. From childhood friends to something more, this is a sweet, awkward love story about two people taking their first steps into romance together.

title: Small and Soft Girl A and Overbearing President Man O
summary: Ruan Ruan’s body was originally a gummy bear candy. This inevitably caused her outward appearance to be Q and sweet, whereas her innate character to be honest and well-behaved. So when she found out that she transmigrated into an ABO world, her first thought was whether she would be stranded on the street and be bullied by a loser Alpha… Then she met a stranded-on-the-street tall-rich-handsome domineering-president Omega. The other party seemed to have just gone through a fierce battle—his steps unsteady, he was leaning against the wall while desperately panting, and the tails of his eyes were suffused with alluring flush. The alley was saturated with the pungent smell of pheromone-masking medicine. And also, from the domineering president’s body spread a wonderful smell that had not yet been covered by the masking medicine. And then. Ruan Ruan found that under her skirt, there seemed to be… …… It turned out she was the loser Alpha.
genres: Adult, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: I, The Villain, Just Wanted to Be a Nobody, So How Did I Become the Protagonist?
summary: Chen Tianyou transmigrated into a brainless villain. He felt like the sky was falling! Any reader who’s ever read a brainless wish-fulfillment novel knows the typical setup: the brainless villain exists solely as cannon fodder and a stepping stone for the protagonist. In the original plot, the villain constantly courted death, ultimately losing not just his family fortune and fiancée to the protagonist, but also ending up a beggar—only to be bitten to death by a dog in the end. Having reflected deeply on this, Chen Tianyou decided to stay far away from the female leads and live peacefully as a background character. That way, he could safely enjoy his life as a wealthy second-generation heir! But as Chen Tianyou slowly stopped behaving like a villain, the plotline began to veer further and further off course! The female leads, who had initially despised him, began to slowly…
genres: Action, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: After Leaving My Family, I Met a Rich Heiress
summary: "Tell me, who gave you the nerve to push your brother down the stairs?! I never thought you could be so venomous!" As clarity returned to Chu Zhe's eyes, he realized the truth. He reincarnated... sent back to the very day he was framed by his stepbrother, Chu Xuan.

title: Save-Scumming to Survive: I’m Really Not a Big Shot!
summary: After dying from overwork, Xu Xi transmigrates to another world invaded by a survival game. To his shock, he gains a bizarre ability: every time he dies, he can rewind time. Using this death-rewind power, Xu Xi repeatedly escapes danger and clears deadly dungeons— And in the process, he accidentally becomes famous in the real world livestream audience, who mistake him for a mysterious top-tier strategist. “How the hell did he know that would work?!” “What’s Xu Xi planning this time? Can some big-brain explain? I’m lost, man!” “D*mn—such unfathomable depth, meticulous thinking, and flawless execution! He’s a god!” “He may look unremarkable, but he’s clearly pulling the strings from the shadows!” If Xu Xi could hear their praise, he’d probably cry out in utter grievance: “No! You’re overthinking it! I’m not a genius! Not a mastermind! Not a tactician! I just DIED for that knowledge!”
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: I Was Mistaken as a Monstrous Genius Actor
summary: I, Kang Woojin, was quitting my design work and became a jobless person. The next day, my friend took me to auditions and I was forced to perform. As i was given a script, the void space appeared in my mind and forced me to relive the character. I got stabbed. Became a serial killer. Became an Exorcist. As I become an actor, the misunderstandings keeps growing day by day.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Slice of Life

title: The Eighth Princess Without Divine Protection Was a Corporate S*ave in Her Previous Life, so Life in the Royal Palace Seems Like Easy Mode to Her
summary: I used to die a little every day. Not literally-well, eventually literally-but back then, I just called it “work.” Endless overtime at a black company, coffee replacing sleep, and managers who treated us like mindless corporate sheep. And somehow, that was considered “normal life.” Then… I died. From overwork, plain and simple. But instead of some boring afterlife, I woke up six years old-and a princess. Michelle, eighth princess of a huge, fancy kingdom. Except… I had no magic talent, no divine blessings, and everyone deemed me useless. I was confined to a shabby, crumbling palace, far from the main royal halls. And yet-surrounded by silk, chandeliers, and-get this-free food, clothing, and shelter… “Wait… no overtime? No pointless meetings? Is this heaven?!” I whispered, half-expecting someone to yell, “Just kidding! Back to hell!” After a life of endless grind, this felt like winning the lottery. From corporate drone to princess, from overworked to overindulged… and somehow, thriving in a life my old self could never have imagined. This is the story of my new life.

title: Rebirth of the Treacherous Official’s Madam
summary: From the awkward extra luggage of her mother’s first marriage, to the wife of the treacherous minister whose power could overturn the world, Yu Lingxin whose every step was filled with difficulties finally exhausted herself out, closing her eyes with regrets. But, who knew, when opening her eyes once again, she actually returned to her thirteen year old days in the boudoir again. Wait, a certain someone at this time, shouldn’t he be bedridden, how come just this shameless, unable to get rid of?
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance

title: I, The Villain, Defiled My Forbidden Empress Master
summary: Su Changqing transmigrated into a fantasy world. The moment he opened his eyes, his Master had just failed to break through to the Saint Realm. Her cultivation was gone. Her body was gravely wounded. 【Ding! Detected that host has developed improper thoughts toward their Master. Villain System activated.】 【Option 1: Apologize sincerely and grovel for forgiveness. Master’s trust +10.】 【Option 2: She’s just too beautiful to resist. Give in. Reward: Beginner Villain Gift Pack.】 Su Changqing: “f*ck, this is my own Master! Bastard system, you trying to ruin me?!” “I pick two.” He said decisively. Master: “Ahhh!!! You unfilial disciple… I’ll kill you!”

title: The Mage Who Devours Disasters
summary: Earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, tsunamis, fires, and infectious diseases. I can devour all disasters and use them.

title: Hunter Watching a Movie
summary: A world where dungeons threaten humanity, and [Hunters] , awakened individuals divided into 10 levels, exist. Taewoon was once seen as a promising talent but repeatedly found himself stuck as a perpetual trainee, despised for failing to grasp the use of his unique trait, “Universal Theater.” At the brink of giving up everything, he finally uncovers the secret to his trait. By navigating between the space within his unique “Theater” and the real world, he acquires “Cinema Skills” and Artifacts, achieving explosive growth and standing out as a Hunter. But there’s one problem—his strength is becoming absurdly overwhelming.

title: The Rise of a Family: Starting from Daily Intelligence
summary: The southern barbarians invaded, and all the elders of the Fu clan perished in battle. Only four cultivators remained, leaving Fu Changsheng to shoulder the burden as a patriarch. With the aid of the Clan Leader’s Intelligence System, he steadily developed his family’s strength until the Fu clan stood proudly at the pinnacle of the great houses. “Daily Update refreshed.” 【1: Today, Fu Ming was wandering through the marketplace in Southern Sun Town when he unexpectedly bought a Cloud Mulberry Fruit at the Good Again Fruit Shop. After consuming it, he successfully drew spiritual energy into his body.】 【2: In the northern part of your clan’s territory, within the valley of Leimeng Mountain, lies a rich vein of Flame Ridge Stone.】 【3: In ten days, your clan’s territory will be attacked by the southern barbarians.】 【4: In seven days, a herd of Purple-Horned Deer will pass through the western side of your clan’s land while foraging.】 【5: …】 【6: Your Firecloud Rooster is in distress—though it is a male, it somehow has an egg inside that it needs to lay.】 【7: …】 Note: 【Daily Updates】must be exchanged for using 【Clan Contribution Points】. You currently have none. When contribution points reach fifty, you may choose 【Random Draw】 once.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: After Being Reborn as the Villainous Holy Son, I Annihilated My Fiancée for Betraying Me
summary: But unlike others who transmigrated and became protagonists, he became a major villain. In the original novel, this villain’s father was the patriarch of a reclusive divine clan, and his mother was a legendary matchmaker whose brothels were spread across the entire Ancient Immortal Continent. He himself was born with an Immortal Bone, the chief candidate Holy Son of a supreme immortal sect, and his master, True Immortal Shenji, was the Grand Elder of the immortal sect. It could be said that Chu Feng was an ultimate rich second-generation heir, born with a golden spoon in his mouth. However, in the original novel, this villain was a pathetic simp. He fell in love with the female lead Ye Tongyao, and time after time, Ye Tongyao secretly let the protagonist escape behind his back. In the end, he was killed by the protagonist, and his parents and master were also later…
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: I’m an F-Rank “Appraiser,” When I Realized the ‘Rusty Sword’ in the Junkyard Was Actually a Holy Sword and Put It Up on an Online Auction, It Sold for the Price of a Lottery Win ~My Modern Rise-to-the-Top Life Begins from a Run-Down Apartment with My Appraisal Skill~
summary: “Your skill is useless in battle. We don’t need a baggage carrier anymore. You’re fired.” I am an F-rank explorer, Souma Tooru. One day, I was kicked out of my party. My skill is called “True Appraisal.” It only tells me the name of an item and its details. At least, that’s what I thought... It seemed like a plain and useless skill. Feeling depressed, I wandered into the dungeon’s tr*sh area. There, I picked up a “rusty sword” someone had thrown away. Then my skill showed me the truth —[Holy Sword Excalibur (Sealed State): Estimated Value – National Treasure Class] “…What would happen if I put this on an online auction?” Just to test it, I listed it online. But then something unbelievable happened. S-rank adventurers and rich people from all over the world started bidding on it! The price started at just 1 yen, but it quickly rose higher and higher. Soon it passed hundreds of millions―!? From a small room in a run-down apartment, with nothing but a smartphone in my hand, my life begins as I shake the world economy and the dungeon industry with my modern kind of alchemy (resell) unparalleled.

title: Malicious Medical Princess of the Marquis House
summary: When Imperial Grandson Liu Zhao chose his future wife, with a wave of his pen, he circled Gu Jiu’s name. He said resolutely, “I want her!” With a decree, the emperor bestowed marriage. One after another, everyone dropped by to congratulate Gu Jiu. Sure enough, it was her dumb luck to marry the Imperial Grandson. Facing everyone’s blessings, Gu Jiu smiled on the surface, but in her heart, she was cursing fiercely. In her lifetime, the luckiest thing that happened to Gu Jiu was to die of illness but unexpectedly traverse to ancient times and live a second time. And the most unfortunate thing that happened to her was meeting the Imperial Grandson Liu Zhao. It was rumoured that Imperial Grandson Liu Zhao was graceful, elegant, gentle, refined, humble, polite and courteous. Gu Jiu: Hehe! The world was blind. That man was obviously two-faced, cunning, deceitful, treacherous, with the ambition of wild wolves and a great villain. He was like the tyrannical male lead who is written by the screenwriter to die in the finale but fans still feel distressed for him. It was rumoured that the Gu family’s second daughter Gu Jiu was soft, gentle, virtuous, frail and tender. Liu Zhao: What gentle, virtuous, frail and tender—everything is fake. That woman was obviously an aojiao, selfish, bad-tempered, narrow-minded; little foodie with a soft and delicate body that wasn’t easy to push over.

title: The Invincible Female Ghost Is A Bit Of A Hopeless Romantic
summary: Lu Yuan transmigrated to a supernatural world and became a young Daoist priest. Relying on his [Subdue Demons and Eliminate Evil] system, he gained a modest reputation in the region beyond the pass. One day while working a job, he encountered a lone grave. Lu Yuan stepped forward to take a look. "Died at only twenty years old, what a waste. Let me offer you some incense..." From that day forward, Lu Yuan became entangled with a female ghost...
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Horror, Martial Arts, Mature, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural, Tragedy, Xuanhuan

title: Lazy Dungeon Master
summary: “Hey, hurry up and massacre those bandits!” “No way, I don’t want to work…” Spending my daily life in leisure, that was my pastime—until I was summoned into another world and met a blonde loli introducing herself as Dungeon Core No. 695. “Save my dungeon. By the way, if the dungeon core is destroyed, you’ll also go down with me as the dungeon master.” A dungeon with a single room. Moreover, one already controlled by bandits. This is a [Checkmate] no matter how you look at it. Guess there’s nothing to do but somehow get out of this situation so that I can [Not Work]!!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Slice of Life

title: Reborn in 2000: Starting from Pursuing the Pure High School Beauty Desk Mate
summary: Chen Fan, a terminally ill patient, is reborn in the year 2000 and reunites with his high school desk mate and first love, Su Ruochu, the school’s beauty. In his previous life, their love was mutual and respectful, like two dedicated scholars. However, Su Ruochu tragically passed away in a car accident, leaving Chen Fan with lifelong regrets. In this new life, Chen Fan is determined not to let her go and vows to build a magnificent business empire to provide her with the most perfect love and future. “Su Ruochu, in this lifetime, I will hold your hand and witness the splendor of the stars and the grandeur of the world!”
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Financial Freedom Begins When I Return to My Small Hometown
summary: At thirty, Bai Ye had hit rock bottom. Laid off and disillusioned, he finally surrendered to fate and boarded a train back to the tiny county town where he was born. But before he even arrives, a twist of destiny awaits: he’s suddenly bound to the mysterious “Life Assistance System.” [System Online: No need to panic about unemployment! Daily unemployment allowance of 888 yuan, just for you!] [Worried about your health? System-activated physical enhancements incoming!] [Blind date detected. System delivers your Ultimate Starter Pack—house, car, and savings included!] With the system’s unwavering support transforming every corner of his life, Bai Ye can’t help but sigh, “If no one helps me soar to the clouds, I’ll carve my own path up the snowy summit!” “Small town, I’m back!” “This time, I’m going to—”
genres: Adult, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Fantasy Journey? Yeah, Something Like That
summary: "It should be easy to kidnap and confine one of the heroines, then finish the main story written for me...” or so I thought. I was reincarnated as the villain in an obscure game that no one remembers—but with a twist. I became a character who’s insanely popular in this world, and living as the male lead. Naturally, I thought I could just ignore the game’s storyline and enjoy a lazy, carefree life. But the universe had other plans. Now, I’m forced to recreate the events of a game I barely remember, reliving each looping timeline with no choice but to step into the role I never asked for. Can I piece together the forgotten plot and navigate this bizarre new life? Or will the world itself crumble under my improvisation?

title: The Hunter of the Other World Who Is Being Misunderstood
summary: [I am reincarnated as an F-class Hunter. This is a problem because they don’t treat me that F-class way.]

title: Zhui Xu
summary: A relaxing story of a business tycoon who, sick of machinations and struggle, returned to the medieval world and married into a merchant family to become a “Zhui Xu”, a husband that lives in the wife’s home. Even though his intentions were not so, he could not avoid the matters of family, country and world. “There was once a person that stood at the top of the golden pyramid, with innumerable cheap jealousy and envy of people, walking this road, he was escorted by tens of thousands of people, yet he could not escape the long and lonely sleep under the gravestone.”
genres: Action, Drama, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance

title: Reincarnated as the Worst Scumbag, Saving the Heroines
summary: The protagonist is reincarnated as Reo Ryuga, the worst s*umbag who appears in a certain erot*c manga. This manga is depicted in an omnibus format set primarily in a single school, where each heroine, possessing the colorful hair typical of manga, is stolen away and humiliated in various situations… Reo Ryuga was the one who stole away one of them: the pink-haired heroine Noa Momose, who already had a boyfriend. However, the reincarnated protagonist has no interest in stealing a heroine from her boyfriend, so he firmly decides that he will absolutely never do such a thing. But, if things proceed according to the original story, a future of ruin awaits the other heroines. Knowing this, he cannot just leave them be, so in order to destroy the doom flags…

title: How to Live Comfortably as an Abandoned Prince
summary: Radel Silbert Kreti, the weakest and most despised 8th Prince of the Kreti Empire, lies dying on the cold stone floor of his secluded palace, betrayed and abandoned. As his life slips away, memories of a past life flood his mind—memories of a B-rank hunter from Earth who also met a tragic end after obtaining the Heart of the Troll, a mythical item with regenerative powers. Faced with death for the second time, Radel is presented with an impossible choice: inherit the Heart of the Troll once more, enduring its brutal side effects, or perish as the forgotten prince. Driven by a burning rage and desperate to change his fate, he accepts the heart, igniting a painful transformation that revives him but pushes his fragile body to its limits. Reborn with the hunter’s memories and newfound regenerative abilities, Radel must navigate the ruthless politics of the Kreti Empire, where his powerful twin brother, gifted with extraordinary powers, seeks to crush him.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Robbed of All, I Rose First on the Immortal Path
summary: [Level-Up Progression + Strong Heroine + No Romance] Lu Shao Heng was spoiled and willful, living for luxury and pleasure, but she had every reason to be that way. With a privileged birth, top-tier talent, doting loved ones, and a fiancé promised to her, everything came easily. Until a girl barged into her life and forcefully took everything. Lu Shao Heng tried one move after another, yet some twist of fate always made her lose. Old friends turned on her. Her parents treated Lu Shao Heng like something to be traded. The elder brother who built his fame on her poetry and policy essays chose to abandon her, the younger brother she had trained after studying the military classics trampled her with contempt, and her fiancé had long since fallen for someone else... When Lu Shao Heng lay starving and freezing in a ruined temple, a voice spoke. [Life was a play. You were destined to be Jiang Yun Jiang’s backdrop, a clown forever in her shadow. But now you can choose to return to the past and change everything.] [Back at the beginning, you can offer everything to Jiang Yun Jiang and trade it for a decent future. Or you can plan again and face her once more.] Starting over sounded like a miracle. But Shao Heng chose to let go of the past and move forward. She was going to cultivate immortality! “I never regret anything, so why start over?” Letting go of resentment and bitterness, Shao Heng finally saw the truth: power was the foundation of every rule. Ambition woke in her bones, and desire spread like wildfire. Look - mountains would erode into new shapes, rivers could even reverse and change their course, but she would always move forward. ... In cultivation, years meant nothing. When Shao Heng looked back, she had gone from her first step on the immortal path to taking first place on the Phoenix Cry Rankings, soaring straight into the clouds, and cutting down immortals with her sword. Along the way, she had already become the immortal path’s unrivaled leader, someone the whole world had to admire.

title: My Childhood Friend Thought I Was Dead, and Now Her Love Is Way Too Heavy
summary: I'm never letting you go. Not eveeeer. A missed-connection, heavy-love romantic comedy beginning with a reunion with a childhood friend who had the wrong idea! “You’re not a ghost, right? ...You’re really alive! Sei-kun is alive!” Right at the start of high school, I was suddenly hugged by the school's most talked-about beauty, Hiiragi Hinata. Why? How? I just wanted a peaceful school life, but in an instant, I ended up the center of attention. It seemed Hiiragi-san was my childhood friend whom I hadn't seen since we parted in elementary school, and she had apparently mistakenly believed I was dead. As a reaction to that, her love had become even heavier and more intense than before...? “As long as I have you, Sei-kun, that’s all I need.” A missed-connection, heavy-love school rom-com beginning with a reunion with a childhood friend who had the wrong idea!

title: I Lost All Hope, so I Transferred Schools and Disappeared From My Childhood Friend’s Life
summary: Makino Yamato entered a prestigious high school as the top student. By his side were his childhood friend, the girl he secretly liked, and his best friend... Every day was full of joy, and he brimmed with confidence. But those happy days did not last long. His father’s company collapsed under heavy debt. The household finances suddenly fell apart, and Yamato’s dream of going to university was in danger. He rushed to start working part-time, but his studies began to slip. Day by day, his test rankings continued to fall. Meanwhile, his childhood friend, Miyano Aoi, and his best friend, Murase Touru, thrived in their studies and student council work. The gap between them and Yamato grew painfully clear. Burdened by work and school, eaten away by jealousy toward his childhood friend, and crushed by feelings of inferiority... Yamato returned home only to see his father wasting away with alcohol and idleness, and his mother saying nothing at all. Then one day, his exhaustion and stress finally reached their breaking point...

title: Academy’s Genius Extra
summary: I’ve been dragged into the world of Superhuman Chronicles. They’re telling me I have to live as a cadet at the Superhuman Academy starting today. To make matters worse, my main field of study is "Necromancy." The workshop once filled with seekers of the legendary arts… is now nothing but a shadow of its former glory. It’s a declining department that has long since lost its prestige. What’s that? The workshop is abandoned? There’s not even a supervising professor? No problem! I’ve played Superhuman Chronicles enough to memorize the lines! From the dusty workshop of the Necromancy department, I’ll start my strategy.

title: Unbound (Rebirth)
summary: Shao Xun was the eldest daughter of Duke Ying’s household. Her father was a first-class noble, her late mother was a lady of a distinguished family, and Consort Shu in the palace was her aunt. The Third Prince—one of the strongest contenders for the position of Crown Prince—was her cousin. Aside from the early loss of her birth mother and the indifference of her stepmother, she didn’t lack for anything in her life. By all rights, she ought to have passed her days in wealth and honor, her future steady and without disturbance. All of this changed because of a single dream. In that dream, her aunt, seeking to remove a rival for her own son, used Shao Xun’s reputation as a pawn to frame the notoriously degenerate Eldest Prince. Her innocence was destroyed, and amid scorn and humiliation, she was forced into his household as a secondary consort. The Eldest Prince was known for his debauchery, while his principal consort was both jealous and ruthless. When Shao Xun awakened, she was drenched in cold sweat, her heart still gripped by fear. Only then did she realize that the events of the dream had already begun to unfold. With no other choice, she resolved that even at the cost of her life, she would prevent it from becoming a reality. He would rely on her, take care of her, and protect her, but he would not like her like a man likes a woman because Tan Mo did not understand this type of emotion. Perhaps a number of people will understand, but in some cases, people on the higher scale of AS are too paranoid and sometimes overarchingly possessive. With this came a large amount of trouble that came from being too obsessed with one person. Few people could understand or handle such love, which leads to tragedy.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: After the Villain Finished His Role, the System Eloped with the Heavenly Dao
summary: Jiang Chengye, who played the role of a simp villain, finally passed the evaluation on his ninth attempt. He thought he could return to Blue Star and become a proper citizen of his homeland. But unexpectedly, the Heavenly Dao suddenly “ambushed” the system at that very moment, and the system, in a last-ditch effort, forcibly replaced the Heavenly Dao. However, the remaining energy wasn’t enough to send Jiang Chengye back to Blue Star—it could only restart him once more. This time, there was no Heavenly Dao, no preset plot. Yet, the protagonist Ye Chen actually returned with his memories and began following the plotline. Without the favor of the Heavenly Dao, without the plot armor that dulled others’ intelligence, and without Jiang Chengye’s cooperation, Ye Chen turned into a complete clown!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Kumo Desu ga, Nani ka?
summary: The world where the Hero and the Demon King continue to oppose each other. The grand magic from the Hero and the Demon King cross over worlds and exploded in the classroom of a certain high school. The students who died in the explosion will be reincarnated in a different world. The protagonist, who had the lowest reputation in the class, was reincarnated into a spider. Nevertheless, she adapted quickly to the present condition with strong willpower. This is a story of she who has become a spider trying whatever she can to live.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Tragedy

title: The Villain’s Mom Becomes Famous for Fortune-Telling and Gossip
summary: Yu Yuan has been following her master in the mystical sect since childhood, originally destined to live a peaceful life and pass away naturally. That is until one day, she suddenly suffers a heart attack—only to wake up as the mother of the ultimate villain in a classic level-up novel. In the original book, the villain’s mother is just cannon fodder living among villains. Her main role is to create a dark childhood for the villain, and then she dies, allowing the villain to end up in an orphanage. The bound melon-eating system cheerfully announces: [Host, you will die in a week. Hurry up and eat melons!] Facing complete chaos, Yu Yuan: "..." Don't panic. These are all small problems. For the sake of her life, she binds the live melon-eating system, and while telling fortunes and eating melons in the livestream, she waits for people to send her "hush money." The onlookers eagerly compile all the hottest gossip, including but not limited to: "The Phoenix Man CEO’s Ghostly Father-in-Law," "The Dead Son’s Green Hat," and "Just How Many Mistresses Do You Have—Third, Fourth, Fifth, or Even Sixth?!"—a thrilling lineup of this year’s top dramas. At first, when the black fans hear that the unknown Yu Yuan is going to tell fortunes, they almost laugh their heads off: "With her high school education, she's telling fortunes for people? Let me see who gets fooled!" That night, the rich wife @Yu Yuan posts: "Thanks to the Master’s advice, my grandson is indeed not my own." Then she openly bans the daughter-in-law who cheated on her deceased son. The black fans collectively shocked.jpg "Is this made up?" The onlookers: "She’s the godmother of the entertainment industry. How could an unknown celebrity get her to make up a story?" The rich heiress who marries a ‘Phoenix Man,’ the wealthy lady who unknowingly adopts her husband’s biological son, the corporate queen drained dry by her own younger brother, and the unlucky CEO whose ancestral grave gets dug up—all step forward to claim their share of the drama, leaving the black fans utterly speechless. Even bigger entertainment scandals keep surfacing, with major studios anxiously checking in every day: "Hello? Sister Yu? No scandals about our artists today, right...? If there are, please don’t rush to spill! We’re willing to pay—name your price!" The black fan who gets slapped in the face hesitates, pinches the corner of his clothes, and shyly asks: "Well, Master Yu Yuan, can you help me calculate my peach blossom?" ⁕ Yu Liang has a dream—one where he is the son of the real heiress in a cliché ‘Fake vs. Real Daughter’ novel. The problem? His mom is the cannon fodder real daughter… who dies early in the plot. Looking at his mother, who is still livestreaming while living a peaceful life, the frightened Yu Liang pulls the ghost friend he just met to analyze his nightmare. The century-old ghost king, who gets caught as a nanny, looks like he has no desire to live: "..." Little Master, stop messing around! With your mom’s combat power, does she look like someone who would ever suffer a loss? Instead of thinking about all this nonsense, why not focus on something more important—like what’s for dinner? He hasn’t even started cooking yet...

title: Soft and Delicate Wife, Online Snake Rearing
summary: 【Early-stage Road Survival, the Healing Journey of a Miserable Wife and a Dark Snake～】 After Su Su was reborn, she realized she was a cannon fodder character in an apocalyptic novel. She was beautiful, had poor physical strength, and did not awaken any supernatural abilities. Her only purpose was to die in a zombie horde, prompting the powerful male and female leads to lament— "The apocalypse has no place for the weak." · Given a second chance at life, Su Su awakened a "trivial" supernatural ability and picked up a nearly dead little snake. No one could have expected: The "trivial" ability turned out to be the strongest combat power in the apocalypse! The nearly dead little snake was actually a giant python capable of spitting fire and hoarding supplies! When the zombie horde arrived, Su Su, riding the python, ran faster than the male and female leads! · However... raising a python is dangerous. If you're not careful, it might drag you back to its lair. The inherently petty, selfish, and vengeful python would even... "return with interest" the slaps it had once received from humans. Inside the pitch-dark lair, Su Su could only bite her clothes and comfort herself— At least it remembers to retract its fangs, that's... that's considerate, right... PS: The snake possesses human-like intelligence and will transform into a human later.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Mature, Romance, Supernatural

title: I Deliver Takeout Across the Multiverse
summary: ‘To graduate means to become unemployed.’ Yun Tutu was no exception to this iron rule. Should she join the army of delivery riders as well? Yun Tutu picked up her phone and searched for delivery apps. One after another popped up, and her indecisiveness flared again. In the end, she simply shut her eyes, tapped at random a couple of times, then opened her eyes again— *Inter-World Express Delivery* was loading… Yun Tutu: ‘…’ When did this thing appear!? She tried to cancel, but her phone suddenly froze. Bloody hell, had it caught a virus? Remembering that she still had 1,803.73 yuan left in her account, Yun Tutu’s first instinct was to power the phone off. Instead, a message appeared. [Congratulations, Host, on your successful binding with Inter-World Express Delivery. You are now a new employee of our company. Employee ID: 0038…] Yun Tutu: ‘…’ Fine. She’d only been thinking about it anyway. With her soft skin and delicate build, there was no way she could handle delivery work. She tapped to uninstall the app, only to find that the uninstall option didn’t exist. *** You have a delivery order: Refugee Xiaoya requests one plain steamed bun… You have a delivery order: The legitimate daughter of the marquis’ household requests a tube of concealer… You have a delivery order: Online User I Just Want to Lie Flat asks you to deliver a world map to His Majesty the First Emperor… *** The orders grew stranger and stranger. Yun Tutu couldn’t handle this alone. She needed to find herself a powerful backer, fast.

title: Engineer in the Late Ming Dynasty
summary: Industrial designer Li Zhi from the 21st century travels back to the late Ming Dynasty. No money? Create a flying shuttle loom and immediately make a fortune. Unaccustomed to the poor hygiene of the late Ming? Invent soap and toothpaste to refresh the Ming Dynasty! Peasant uprisings? Chaotic times where life is as cheap as dirt? A star fort made of cement and concrete will ensure your safety! The Qing army sweeping south, leaving devastation in their wake? Who dares to say “no” in the face of my rifled guns? Within the range of my cannons—all the land belongs to the Han people!

title: The Real Daughter Just Wants to Pilot Mechas
summary: Jiang Momo spent eighteen years scavenging junk on a desolate planet, until one day she was suddenly informed that she was actually the youngest daughter of the wealthiest family on the Capital Star, mistakenly swapped at birth. That very day, she packed up all her treasured belongings and happily followed the old butler who came to fetch her. However, it was obvious that the wealthy family preferred the graceful and well-mannered fake daughter over the dusty girl carrying a pile of junk like it was treasure. On her first day back, Jiang Momo was sternly warned by the family not to even think about trying to claim the fake daughter’s identity or inheritance. Jiang Momo didn’t care at all. She nodded casually and on the very first day she gained residency on the Capital Star, she enrolled in the prestigious Central Mecha Academy, known for having the highest admission standards. *** On enrollment day at the Central Mecha Academy, Jiang Momo luckily found a sparse registration lane among the overcrowded queues. After submitting her form, she passed through all the exams with ease and was successfully selected as… a mecha manufacturing instructor. Jiang Momo looked at her work badge. “…Wait, I came to learn how to pilot mechas, not teach people how to manufacture them!” *** Rumor had it that a new instructor suddenly emerged at Central Mecha Academy, capable of creating legendary mechas. She even had a stash of long-extinct precious materials. To help their beloved daughter shine at the upcoming semester-end Mecha Competition, the wealthy Jiang family pulled every string they could to get the instructor’s ID and address. Then, at the heavily-paid-for address, they found Jiang Momo buried in familiar-looking junk, deeply engrossed in her research. Without looking up at the unexpected visitors, Jiang Momo said, “A-grade mecha, two million. S-grade, ten million. Legendary, a hundred million.” The wealthy man roared, “We’re your family!” Jiang Momo: “The price’s double for family.”
genres: Drama, Mecha, Romance, School Life, Sci-fi

title: If Dreams Have a Shelf Life
summary: Shi Li won a lottery from the underworld and woke up in the apartment she used to rent, now in ghost form. She didn’t expect that her ex-boyfriend, with whom she had only a so-so relationship, was still living there. This man went out every day looking proper and wearing a suit, but once he got home, he was sloppy and messy, turning a perfectly fine apartment into a doghouse. The smell of smoke almost choked her to death a second time. Shi Li endured it for three days before finally entering his dream. Skipping all pleasantries, she stated the obsession that brought her back from death. “I finally managed to save up a hundred and twenty thousand before I died. The bankbook is hidden in the compartment under the sink. Take it out, exchange the money for ghost currency, and burn it for me, alright?” “If you dare keep it for yourself.” “I won’t let you off even as a ghost.”

title: SSS-Grade Cafe in Front of The Dungeon
summary: I was stuck in a dungeon explosion while working so hard that I actually died. But when I opened my eyes, I was back to the time of 3 years ago! Well, I will live differently in this life. It’s time to say goodbye to the wage s*ave life. I quit immediately and set up a cafe in the store my grandmother left behind. There are no customers because this is right in front of a dungeon, but it doesn’t matter. All I want is to work two days and play five days. But. [Class: I woke up as the cafe owner (F)] [Skill: I have the coffee in my hand (Lv.1)] [Mission: Brew 100 cups of mixed coffee (0/100)] [Item: Mixed Coffee – Increases recovery speed by 100% faster] After leaving my life as a wage s*ave, I became a coffee s*ave. Also, the attractive regular customer who keeps bothering me is somehow unusual. It doesn’t feel great. Isn’t it like the story of the main character of the RPG, who was just trying to run an errand, and ends up fighting the Demon after getting caught up in something annoying? Yes, I will not. I can not. I have no intention of playing more than the role of a novice innkeeper.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Martial Aunt, Blood and Ashes
summary: Nascent Soul True Lord Song Wan Ning dies a cruel death—only to learn she was never the heroine, just the “vicious supporting villain” written to be sacrificed. In her first life, the childhood sweetheart she loved for a hundred years pushed her onto the Devil Path for the sake of his “transmigrated” heroine disciple. The disciple she cherished most—the so-called male lead—personally ground her bones to dust and scattered her ashes. In the end, they even joined forces to wipe out her entire clan. Reborn, Song Wan Ning is told by the Three Lives Mirror that survival means “whitewashing” herself and earning the male and female leads’ favor. She smiles softly… and refuses. A villainess who knows the plot isn’t here to beg for forgiveness—she’s a wolf walking straight into the sheepfold, teeth bared. The Medicine King Sect’s inheritance is meant to go only to the heroine? Song Wan Ning shatters the inheritance divine sense and destroys a thousand spirit tablets in one breath. The divine beast recognizes the male lead but not her? She skins it, tears its tendons, and strips its bloodline—because without bloodline, what is a divine beast worth? The sect shields her childhood sweetheart and the “chosen” leads? Then she’ll erase the entire sect from the Seven Sects and Four Factions. They call her crazy. So what? When she goes crazy, everyone else finally learns to behave.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: A New Life, Yet Still Bound by Her Love
summary: In his previous life, he had been weak—timid, incapable, and burdened by an inferiority complex. One by one, those around him drifted away. And yet, there had been one exception: a beautiful, sweet girlfriend who treated him with gentle affection. After their breakup, that same gentle girlfriend, the one who had showered him with warmth for years, ended his life with a single knife. Then, he was reborn. Granted a second chance, the dreadful contours of the past gradually came into focus. Only then did he realize: his downfall had not been accidental. It had been a carefully laid trap, orchestrated by the woman he once loved. Every misstep, every ounce of despair, had been designed to isolate him—so that in the end, broken and helpless, he would collapse into her arms, his entire life placed under her control. In her eyes, he was only ever meant to love one person—her. In his previous life, she had shielded him, keeping other women away. In this one, he escaped the snare she had so painstakingly woven, only to be confronted by an even greater torment: the suffocating affection of multiple deranged and obsessive women. Now, he faced a cruel question—what should he do? Twisted love pulled him deeper into a quagmire from which there seemed no escape. And in the end, he would fall, utterly, into an even darker abyss.

title: The Little Toddler Sets Up a Stall Selling Incense Rice, Becomes the Police Station’s Beloved
summary: [Cute Baby, Gourmet Food Stall, Metaphysics/Supernatural, Crime Solving, No CP] After wielding a ladle in a Daoist temple for five years, Bai Ningshu, who is only three-and-a-half years old upon her return, descends the immortal mountain with a pacifier in her mouth and a Gourmet System in tow. Good news: She is the lost daughter of the wealthiest man. Bad news: Her wealthy biological father just went bankrupt. Her bankrupt dad has invincible knife skills but suffers from severe social anxiety; he can't cook a single dish in front of people. Her frail mom has an invincible sense of taste and smell, but is extremely delicate and a bit of a crybaby. Tiny Bai Ningshu steps onto a stool, wielding her large ladle so fast it flies: "Without me, this family would fall apart sooner or later!" From then on, a randomly spawning snack cart—and a group of diners desperately searching for it—starts appearing in every corner of the city. The diners track it, create group chats, mobilize all their connections, and even use the latest technology to trace it: "Little Boss~ Where are you~ We're coming to find you!" Bai Ningshu sets up her stall while listening to the "older brothers" and "older sisters"[Ghosts] share gossip. After hearing the gossip, Bai Ningshu casually calls the police station: "Uncle~ I found a wanted criminal!" "Auntie~ I know where the bomb is!" "Brother, the guy on the bounty poster grabbed my chicken leg and didn't pay!" "Sister..." The operator sister cuts in: "Which wanted criminal did you find this time?" Bai Ningshu is shocked: "Huh? Sister even knows how to answer before I speak!" Later, everyone finds it incredibly strange. Why do the locations where the police arrest criminals highly overlap with where the little boss sets up her stall? Why could that be?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I’m Not Going to Be This Cannon Fodder Female Supporting Character Anymore
summary: As cannon fodder female supporting characters in the plot, they always act brainlessly and exit early. But one day, the tool-like supporting female character awakened, and the storyline began to completely collapse. World One: [The Vicious Female Supporting Character in the 1980s] The childhood sweetheart fiancé was suddenly snatched away. Su Qin became the vicious and unreasonable female supporting character. The other party even said he only saw her as a younger sister and only understood what love was after meeting the female lead. Su Qin cheerfully agreed to break off the engagement and wished them a long and lasting relationship, locked in for life. That tr*sh could go to whoever wanted him, she did not. Anyway, the fiancé would end up as cannon fodder later. The real male lead was the future business tycoon. What? Why does the tycoon want to marry her?!!! World Two: [A female Teacher From The 1990s Who Despises The Poor and Loves The Rich] One moment, Fang Yuwei was a laid-off office worker drifting in Beijing, single and at an older age, with a bleak future. When she opened her eyes, not only did she have a husband but also two kids. She was the male lead’s ex-wife who abandoned her husband and children to become a mistress, destined to give way to the female lead. Fang Yuwei looked at the gentle and modest stay-at-home dad in front of her and the two adorable little kids longing for maternal love. The three of them shared the same face, all looking at her pitifully, afraid of being abandoned, carefully trying to please her. So pitiful. No divorce. Absolutely no divorce! By accident, she even became a nationally recognized outstanding teacher. With her husband on one side and kids on the other, she reached the peak of her life. World Three: [The Pitiful Female Supporting Character from a Male-Favoring Family in the 2000s] A hardworking sales assistant at a hardware store × a silent and reserved small business owner In her previous life, Ai Xiaoling was drained by her family and died young. In this life, she only wanted to cut ties with her family and earn some money. As a supporting character, she knew well that she and the male lead were not on the same path. He was only helping her make money out of appreciation for her hard work. The female lead was his true match. Later, the male lead actually wanted to date her? Fine. Dating was okay, but no marriage. He was just a qualified boyfriend. Huh? Why does the male lead want to marry her? Most importantly, she might be pregnant!!! World Four: [The Spoiled and Willful Cannon Fodder Female Supporting Character] A naturally soft-voiced coquettish beauty × a cold and eccentric bookworm As an infatuated female supporting character, Qiao Yiyi devoted her feelings to the wrong person. In this life, she switched targets. What bad intentions could she possibly have? She just wanted to always protect her Song Jing. The top student in the city already liked someone. It was that coquettish girl! World Five: [The Seductive Female Supporting Character in the Entertainment Industry] A glamorous actress supporting character × a shrewd and slick male agent supporting character Shi He realized she was a forgotten supporting character in a sweet romance set in the entertainment industry. She was always causing drama and clinging to the male lead for popularity. Anti-fans cursed her every day, just waiting for her career to collapse completely. After waiting and waiting, Shi He ended up playing the female lead instead. Ask her how? She was the agent’s “only treasure,” willful and proud, demanding to play the female lead in every project. The agent shook his head while investing money, utterly helpless—she insisted on acting. Fans shouted: Don’t love her too much! World Six: [The Cold-Hearted and Ruthless Female Supporting Character] Zhen Qiao returned to her past life and saw her boyfriend selling braised pig trotters on the street, working hard to support her. His family was broken, his life in ruins, and in the end, she would scam him of his money and leave him in deep debt. She no longer wanted to be evil. Thinking about the child in her belly and the loyal boyfriend wagging his tail like a big dog, she gritted her teeth and also started selling braised food. A family must stay together! They would not only sell pig trotter rice and braised dishes, but also drinks and cold dishes... They must grow big and strong! It would be best if they could contract an entire snack street! World Seven: [The “Resurrected” Supporting Character Who Was Supposed to Die] Eighteen-year-old Liu Qingshu had just finished her college entrance exam and spent three steamy days in a small motel with Jin Heng. With one sleep, she time-traveled ten years into the future. Their relationship had dropped to freezing point, and “she” had already fallen for someone else and died in a car accident on her way to find the male lead? Her husband and son had become villainous characters in a melodramatic romance? Liu Qingshu shuddered all over, and eighteen-year-old her was still madly in love with Jin Heng. Jin Heng said: Eighteen-year-old Liu Qingshu and twenty-eight-year-old Jin Heng were a perfect match. He had wished countless times to walk that ten-year path with her all over again. World Eight: [The Cannon Fodder Campus Belle’s Love-Brained Boyfriend] — Love-brained men are the best dowry.

title: My Landlord is an Idol Singer
summary: Gu Zhinan, who transmigrated to a parallel world, became a web novelist. A beautiful landlord… turned out to be a fallen idol singer? One day, the landlord’s guitar was left in the living room… “I don’t write songs, I’m just a novelist. I was just messing around.” Until the landlord stood there, stunned by the song Gu Zhinan had written. “You said you couldn’t write songs?” “Well… I know a little.”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: The Idol Who Returned from Hell
summary: Right after achieving his long-awaited debut, he died meaninglessly in a single moment. When he opened his eyes, he was given two choices: spend the rest of his afterlife happily in heaven, or fall to hell and gain the opportunity for reincarnation. "......I'll go to hell." After 50 years of managing infernal creatures, with his specialty being training the "puppy" Cerberus, this is the story of one idol's second chance at debuting after experiencing the true depths of hell and returning to reclaim his stolen dreams.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Reader #2 Just Wants to be a Fan Girl
summary: I transmigrated into the novel I was fangirling over until my dying breath. As the second transmigrator. Why the second? Because I transmigrated into a transmigration story. In other words, I transmigrated into a novel where a reader transmigrated into a novel featuring a regressor. Setting aside the complexity, the most important fact! This novel only features beautiful men and beautiful women! Regardless of age or gender. Nationality irrelevant. It’s a character feast where everyone gathered has pretty faces AND delicious narratives. Bias #1: The transmigrator. A slit-eyed character who doesn’t discriminate between means and methods, but is dead serious about taking care of his people. Decadent beauty, an eye-smile that enchants people, and intelligence—the holy trinity embodied in my baby #1! Bias #2: The Regressor. An iron wall who broke through a glacier. A lone wolf… my foot. He’s a large dog wearing a wolf’s skin. Must endure the early parts for the sweetness of the latter half. Bias #3: Genius Flame Mage. A tiny pretty boy overflowing with rebellious charm. From the mid-section, he grows 20+ cm and transforms into a magnificent beast. Transformation is always right! Etc., etc. This novel is even an academy story. A happy campus life together with my biases!!! This is the true life of a successful fan! However… There’s one tiny problem. I know how this novel ends. Mastermind, catastrophic incident, massacre, assassination. Zero survivors. Destruction. Just when I died young and was going to enjoy a happy afterlife… Of all things, the novel I was fangirling over has a devastating ending. As a devoted reader, I can’t just stand by and watch! To fangirl, I must prevent destruction! Only I can save my babies! 【Your unique trait has been confirmed.】 【Unique Trait: Devoted Reader】 【Unique Skill has been generated.】 【Unique Skill has been generated.】
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Psychological, School Life, Supernatural

title: Beast Husbands Stolen at the Start, I Conquer the Continent via Cultivation
summary: Xiao Jinyue, a powerhouse cultivator from a mysterious department, is kicked into the world of a “beast world” novel. She finds herself in the body of a “tr*sh” fake socialite female with both abysmal healing powers and a zero fertility rating! Kicked out of the Royal City by her family, even her five handsome, pre-contracted beast husbands have turned their backs on her to curry favor with the “True Socialite” heroine. Penniless and wearing five metaphorical “green hats” (cheated on by five husbands), Xiao Jinyue isn’t panicked at all. The True Socialite has a system to exchange for fertility pills? I can cultivate to ascend step-by-step and purify all corruption! However, as she focuses on her cultivation, why are her five ex-husbands suddenly crawling back with red eyes begging for a second chance? Even the four “sickly” beast husbands the original heroine tossed aside have become obsessed with her… The Golden Eagle shakes his brilliant feathers, offering a rare Spirit Core while nuzzling her fingertips: “The contract mark is still warm; you can’t deny me.” The Sickly Snow Dragon sheds his disguise, his scaled tail wrapping around her ankle: “Master, it was all my fault. Tonight, I am at your disposal.” The Black Mermaid blinks his eyes, transforming into a mini-merman to roll into her arms: “You want to get rid of me? No way—unless I die!” The Noble Qilin lowers his head to rub against her neck, fangs peeking out: “We agreed on healing—you’re regretting it now? Too late.” Even the stray little fox she picked up by the road transforms into a man with eight-pack abs, wagging nine tails aggrievedly: “Sister, you promised to take care of me forever!” Looking at the cave overflowing with out-of-control beast husbands, Xiao Jinyue thinks of the Immortal Brother she left forgotten in the Dream Lord Realm and the Demon Emperor she kicked into the Abyss… and feels like her world is collapsing.

title: I Have a Unique Way to Relieve Stress
summary: Hi, are you there? Look at the abs. 1v1, HE. Urban jungle, mature men and women, love and desire, pleasure above all. Highlight: EAT! LOVE! DESIRE! In bold and all caps. One-sentence summary: How to ease worries? Get intoxicated. Theme: The brave enjoy the world first.

title: I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game
summary: [Tower Defense & Dungeon Attack RPG] I saw the ending to the game no one was able to clear. But, when I came to my senses, I was inside of the game. In fact, I was in the tutorial stage, a place where strategy was impossible. “I’ll clear this bullsh*t game no matter what…!”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Mature, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: It’s Better to be the Empress Dowager
summary: Tang Shishi was the number one beauty in the court. She was arrogant, domineering and aggressive. She accidentally picked up a book and learned that she was just a vicious female second lead in a palace struggle. Later, she would fight for favor with the female lead, and eventually she was ruined and died miserably. Now, they have just entered the fief of Jing Wang, and the first meeting of the male and female leads has not happened yet. There are two paths before Tang Shishi. The first is to hold the heroine’s thighs tightly and join the female lead camp early; the second is to please the male lead and steal the favor of the female lead. Tang Shishi chooses the third way. Tang Shishi knew that the male lead’s adoptive father Jing Wang seemed to be low profile, but in fact he was overly ambitious. In the near future, he will invade the capital and proclaim the emperor before the imperial court, but it is a pity that he passed away before passing the throne to the male lead. This year, Jing Wang is twenty-four years old, still young, and has yet to marry a wife. Anyway, she already in the Forbidden City. Instead of being the concubine of the male lead, it is better to be his adopted mother, the empress dowager in one step. ————– Zhao Chengjun had no intention to get married, so he adopted his subordinate son as his heir. He thought he would be with his army in his whole life. Later, the imperial family sent a team of beauties to Prince Jing, and the leader was named Tang Shishi. His young, adopted son and his subordinates also persuaded: Your Highness, this is a beauty trap. Jing Wang: I know. The so-called beauty trap was merely a bait for those who wish.

title: The White Moonlight Is Quitting!
summary: “You are the noble-born and stunningly beautiful second female lead, the ‘White Moonlight,’ who returned to the country and married the president of a multinational company. But you are hopelessly infatuated with the male lead, your childhood sweetheart, and keep plotting against the delicate female lead. In the end, the male and female leads live happily ever after, while you are abandoned by your husband and family, meeting a tragic end.” Transported into a newly read tragic romance novel as the second female lead with the same name, Mu Ruo decides not to follow the original path. She stays away from the male and female leads and moves back to the home of her arranged marriage partner, establishing herself as a married woman. She only knows that the multinational president is a calm and mature business tycoon, cold and noble in appearance, ruthless and unscrupulous in his actions. He married her solely for the sake of the company, giving her an unlimited black card as long as she didn’t disturb him. To Mu Ruo, this financial backer is more important than anything else, and she fears…

title: Treated Like a Big Shot by Everyone in the Boy Group Survival Show
summary: At the boy group survival show, the system tells Shen Xiu: If he doesn’t debut as the center of the group, he’s done for. title: Hogwarts: I Am Such a Model Wizard
summary: On a sunny afternoon, Kyle finally received the long-awaited acceptance letter to Hogwarts, the prestigious thousand-year-old wizarding school. At Hogwarts, Kyle led a fulfilling life. Besides attending classes, he spent his free time cultivating magical vegetables, tending to enchanting flowers, or venturing into the dark, forgotten chambers of the castle to provide emotional support to a small creature abandoned for centuries. Dumbledore: "Kyle is a courageous, kind, and sincere young wizard." Professor McGonagall: "The Headmaster is absolutely right. Kyle never breaks the school rules." Snape: "Ah, yes… indeed..." Professor Quirrell had thought the same—until one day, he opened a trapdoor and stumbled into a room full of Chomping Cabbages.

title: If I Survive the SSS-Rank Demon Realm with a ‘Useless’ Skill, I’ll Become the World’s Strongest Alchemist: Building a Comfortable Base and Enjoying a Fun Life in Another World with My Companions
summary: "Why Is Someone Like This in the Hero’s Party…?" Sora was suddenly summoned to another world as a Hero. While the other Heroes were granted the most powerful skills, Sora's skill was [Alchemy] —and his stats were utterly average. Branded as a "useless failure" by the king and the Hero's party, he was exiled to the Demon Forest. Thrown into a treacherous forest teeming with the strongest monsters, Sora despaired but resolved to survive by mastering his alchemy skill. As he built a comfortable base and gained abilities by defeating monsters, he realized that his skill was far more versatile than anyone imagined. "So this is a 'useless' skill? It’s surprisingly handy, though." Before long, Sora's prowess surpassed the SS-rank monsters that roamed the deadly forest. Meanwhile, the Hero’s party celebrated their hard-fought victory over an A-rank demon king, unaware that Sora had united the Demon Forest into a kingdom and risen as a king leading an army of extraordinary monsters...!

title: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
summary: Yong Hwarin, debilitated by illness and weakness as the heir to the Tianzhong clan, ultimately gave up the path of martial arts and lived as a merchant after marrying into another family. Carrying his regrets until the time he met his end, he unexpectedly travels back to the past he thought he would never revisit…! Returning to the time of his lowest point, he swears to his shattered heart that his fate will be reborn through his own hands.
genres: Action, Adventure, Harem, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: Regressed to Become an S-Class Hidden Guide
summary: "Please... pick me up! If you take me with you, I'll be useful." Seoyul, who had been exploited his entire life at an illegal guiding trading house before meeting a miserable death. After his regression, to change his future, he recklessly approached an esper with a proposal. The other party was none other than Cha Dowoon, an S-class esper known for being so violent in both personality and energy that no one could guide him. "Why should I trust you?" "I'm a C-class guide... but my guiding has quite broad versatility..." Having successfully caught Dowoon's interest with his talk of versatility, Seoyul is given a matching test. The rank he had believed to be C-class his entire life suddenly changed. "I-I'm S-class, you say?" "Not just S-class, but hidden." "H-hidden...?" Seoyul wants to truly become S-class and stand alongside Dowoon. But figuring out exactly when he transforms into S-class is not easy. 'Pong-pong-pong-' Under what conditions does Seoyul's energy activate?

title: My Whole Family Are Villain
summary: Fourteen-year-old Su Bei almost died when she caught a high fever, got transmigrated into another world, and finally figured out a shocking truth—it turned out that her original world she was just a novel and her whole family were villains. The woman who gave birth to them was the cannon fodder in the novel. She and Su Xiaobao were written like this in the extra chapter: One was a little bastard who tried to bully the male lead’s daughter and eventually got thrown into prison and the other one became an escort who, after having failed to seduce the male lead, was killed by an evil director. They also have a dad whom they never met and was the biggest villain in the book. Back to her original world, the first thing Su Bei did was to take Su Xiaobao and find their father. Su Bei: Su Xiaobao, quick, call him. Su Xiaobao: Call him what? Su Bei: Call him dad. Su Xiaobao: I don’t want to, do it yourself. Su Bei: Dad! Looking at these two dirty children in front of him, Mr. Qin’s eyes showed disgust.

title: After Rebirth, I Only Cherish the Pure Girl, and the Campus Belle Starts to Panic
summary: Bu Yu was a careless, idle teenager who spent his days fooling around and refusing to study. Even worse, he fell in love with the campus belle—Su Muwan. He spent three entire years as her devoted admirer, giving to her unconditionally the whole time. Yet Su Muwan never took it seriously. She even treated Bu Yu’s kindness as something she was naturally entitled to. After graduation, Su Muwan was admitted to her dream university, while Bu Yu failed the entrance exam and had no chance of attending college. From that day on, their lives no longer crossed. Because Bu Yu had wasted his youth and neglected his studies, he could not find a job after graduation. With no source of income and a habit of reckless spending, he soon ended up living on the streets. Only then did Bu Yu finally begin to reflect on himself with deep, piercing regret.

title: The Day I Married the Villain, the Male Lead Was Reborn
summary: On the day I married Pei Que, a man feared by the entire capital, my former flame Xie Linzhou kicked open the doors to the wedding hall. He claimed he had been reborn. He said that in his previous life, I had taken the fall for his crime of forging Military Records, languishing in prison for three years. By the time I was released, I was a broken woman, eventually dying in the snow on New Year's Eve. The entire room waited for me to burst into tears. Instead, I pulled off my bridal veil and looked at his bloodshot eyes. I asked him one question: "You remember how I died, but do you remember where you were at the time?" Xie Linzhou had no answer. I turned back around and asked Pei Que to replace the veil for me.

title: Everyone Was Obsessed With Me After I Became the Youngest Princess Favourite
summary: While performing my duty as a top agent of the Information Guild, a sword pierced through my chest. I definitely thought at that time I died without a hitch… What? 8 years old?! Back to my hellish nursery days?!! “Hi, I’m Diana!” Just then, Diana, the youngest princess of the Duke of Elrad, appeared before me. In order not to repeat the bitter regrets of my past life, I took care of Diana, and I was going to send this lovely daughter to the Duke of Elrad… but wasn’t she too nice to me? “Sister! I monopolised Diana’s affection, but why did everyone become obsessed with me?

title: Transmigrated into a Book as a Capitalist’s Young Lady; She Took Her Child to Join the Army
summary: An Minghua had transmigrated into a novel. The good news: she was now the daughter of a wealthy capitalist family. The bad news: it was the 1960s. She had entered a tragic romance novel set in that era, and not only was she a capitalist heiress, she was also a female supporting villain! Not just any soldier, but a Wehrmacht officer in na*i Germany during the Spanish Civil War. The horrors of war unfolded before him.
