title: Reincarnated as the Legendary Gal Game Protagonist. Supporting the Heroines, My First Loves and Inspirations with “A**lt Experience Point,” Only to Somehow Trigger Their Possessiveness to the Limit.
summary: A man who thought his dull life was over wakes up to find himself inside the world of the legendary gal game he once loved, “Sweet Kiss.” In the mirror, he sees his 17-year-old self. And in front of him are the heroines he had admired from the other side of the screen. Back when he played the game as a kid, they were just beautiful older girls. But in real life, they carried a “raw pain” that wasn’t written in the game’s guidebooks. The student council president, who was perfect at everything, hid her frustrations. The childhood friend who sacrificed herself to support her family. The underclassman who continued to swim even though she knows her talent is fading—. Aizawa Kei, the protagonist, has the mind of a 35-year-old who has experienced life’s ups and downs. He begins to notice that the “choices” and “favorability” floating in his vision don’t feel like a game anymore. “This isn’t a game. They are breathing, living, right here and right now.” He doesn’t need a happy ending from the guidebook. Using a mix of adult experience points, care, and cunning, Kei starts moving the “frozen time” of these girls in the amber-colored Seven Seas City. Even if that ends up turning their love for him into their overwhelming love―.

title: I Was Reincarnated as a Mob Noble, and I Swear I’ll Protect the Villainess Who Got Married Off to Me No Matter What ~To Dodge Our Total Downfall, I Went All Out Training My T*ash Skill [Super Recovery] Through Crazy Hard Work, and Before I Knew It, I Could Totally Wreck the Game Protagonist Who Condemned My Wife Easily
summary: The ultimate power couple completely obliterates the game scenario! “Useless tr*sh… To think the son of the Sword Saint would get stuck with a garbage skill like this!” Zenon Greivan is the eldest son of a border count family that guards the frontier against enemy countries—a total mob noble. On his 15th birthday, he got the skill [Super Recovery] from the gods. Its effect? ‘You can use healing magic. Healing effects get way stronger.’ But in this world, the whole concept of healing magic doesn’t even exist. So his dad, the legendary Sword Saint, labels it a dud skill and treats him like a complete failure. Right then, Zenon realizes—this is the otome game world he grinded like crazy in his past life, and [Super Recovery] is actually a busted, game-breaking OP skill. “Wait, hold up… Isn’t my family the Greivan border count house that gets wiped out by the empire super early in the game!?” He remembers the game plot and figures out—if things keep going like this, he’s doomed. Pretty soon, the villainess rival to the saintess character, Valeria, gets her engagement broken by the crown prince and gets shipped off to marry him. Then almost immediately, imperial forces attack this territory, and both Zenon and Valeria end up getting killed. “No way I’m letting that doomed future happen—I’m changing it!” Zenon teams up with Valeria, the girl everyone calls the worst kind of wicked woman, and swears he’ll use his game knowledge to beat back the incoming enemy army. Later on, he finds out there’s a hidden reason behind why Valeria got branded as an evil woman and condemned in the game—one the original story never explained.

title: Returning to the Modern World, the Demon Sect’s Lair Is Transformed into an Internet-Famous Resort
summary: After serving as the Demon Sect Leader for three years, Miao Yunyou was cornered on the mountaintop by the righteous sects. Just as her entire group was about to be wiped out, she transmigrated back to the modern world. Good news: as compensation, the Heavenly Dao moved her entire mountain over as well—along with that group of disciples who can’t even read simplified Chinese. Bad news: she seems to have been mistaken for an immortal? Even worse news: the righteous heroes seem to have followed her here too... Miao Yunyou: “Let’s put the grudges of the jianghu aside for now. Your top priority is literacy.” Clearly, sitting around and living off the mountain wasn’t going to work—especially when there was nothing on it besides a few buildings. So why not turn it into a resort and make money? **Welcome to Meow Immortal Resort!** Traditional Chinese medicine milk tea, wellness hotpot, mosquito-repelling plush dolls, inner-energy therapy, Five-Element hot spring formations, qinggong weight-loss training... At first, these absurd-sounding services were met with ridicule. But later— The road at the foot of the mountain was jammed into a long, unbroken line, with private cars backed up more than three kilometers away. “Leader Miao! Please! Can you still save one room for me? I’ll pay extra!!!”

title: After I was Exiled, I Became a Noble Minister
summary: Mu Wan Qing was dressed as cannon fodder playing a female supporting role in a book about a reborn female protagonist. The heroine was her amazing and talented cousin. She was reborn on the way to exile, and she devoted all her clan to help her ascend to the backyard of the Emperor. And Mu Wan Qing’s whole family was used as a stepping stone and was destroyed on the road of exile. Mu Wan Qing: I am so tired, let’s destroy it. In the chaos of the house raiding scene, Mu Wan Qing hurriedly grabbed the marriage certificate with a swoosh. During the breaking up of the marriage, Mu Wan Qing exchanged the marriage certificate for a mule cart and twenty taels of silver and started a long journey of exile. In order to survive, she resorted to roasting pig trotters, making fried chicken, farming cotton, and breeding sheep. Engaged in building water power, building cities, building cement roads, and creating a prosperous fortress in the south. Accidentally played a big game, and the plot was really shifted… The Reborn Cousin: Everyone is concentrating on building infrastructure, how can I play the script of the palace fight?! At the palace banquet, the arrogant and arrogant frontier master sat alone while pouring the drink. There was a commotion at the door, and the beautiful and heroic first female assistant, Mu Wan Qing walked in surrounded by everyone. The man put down the wine glass and quickly ran over, with his eyes full of love, he said, “Madam, I can’t eat without you.” There was an uproar at the scene.

title: Amamori Junna is Humid
summary: Clingy at every chance. A seemingly cool heroine who’s actually overflowing with affection makes a gentle entrance. When club activities end early due to rain, Kurimoto Shigure returns to the audiovisual room to retrieve something he forgot—and there, he meets a lone girl named Amamori Junna. Sharing similar tastes in books and music, the two begin to meet secretly on rainy afternoons after school, when their schedules align. “I like the name Shigure.” “I prefer being alone and don’t want to deal with unnecessary people... but if it’s you, Shigure, I don’t mind.” Junna, who only appears on damp, rainy days, is expressionless and dry in demeanor, yet oddly close in proximity and eager for affection. Then, on a sunny day, Shigure discovers Junna’s “secret”—and from that moment, the distance between them shrinks to the point where he can feel her breath. Her overwhelming affection begins to spill out uncontrollably...

title: Can I Apply for a Dungeon House Even if I Disassemble F-Grade Equipment?
summary: In the 21st century, Earth is swarming with hunters of all kinds. To conquer the eight gigantic gates that suddenly appeared, hundreds—no, thousands—of raid teams work tirelessly day and night. Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune… And finally, the most difficult of all—Pluto. Naturally, hunters aiming for the highest ranks go crazy over top-tier gear. That’s why crafting professions have skyrocketed in value, and their status is unmatched. As for me? I’m a so-called “tr*sh-tier” worker—a gear dismantler who picks up discarded equipment, takes them apart, and sells the loot for a profit on the marketplace. My dream? To buy my own home inside the special dungeon called “The Sun”! Right now, I can’t even get into Mercury, and I’m still just a wannabe homeowner! But… why is the world’s only SS-rank twin duo so obsessed with me?

title: They All Want to Become Light Novel Heroines
summary: Absolutely no desire to work! Become a handsome guy at Waseda or Keio, rely on good looks and refined talent to win the favor of wealthy heiresses, and have them willingly support him—this is Narumi Kazuki’s life plan. So this boring, make-believe school life shouldn’t have anything to do with him. At least, that’s how it was supposed to be. But then… In August, in Nagoya, Narumi looks at the girls gathered around him. Their smiling faces are like blooming flowers, their beauty as dazzling as summer fireworks. This is the problematic youth romance story between him… and the girls who “want to become light novel heroines.”

title: After My Husband Became a God
summary: On our wedding day, my husband suddenly ascended to godhood. Just like in my previous life, he offered me a mountain of heavenly treasures out of guilt. Back then, I refused to take them, stubbornly insisting on following him. Later, in the boundless, lonely Immortal Realm, I endured endless suffering. It ended when the goddess who loved him tricked me into jumping off Reincarnation Cliff. As my body perished and my soul flickered out, Xie Yunji didn't even spare me a single glance. When I opened my eyes again, my husband had become a god once more. He still feared I would cling to him, his brow furrowed with impatience. "I carry a divine mandate; I cannot be tethered by the private feelings of one person." "You are a mortal. How could you possibly enter the Immortal Realm?" I stared at him for a long time before finally speaking. "I'm not going to the Immortal Realm anymore. You can go."

title: A Witch Will Never Wag Her Tail and Beg the Enemy Who Killed Her Father

So you’re the Blade Demon’s son?” He looked at the boy who had been struck down, writhing on the ground, with a mocking expression. “The chance to avenge your father isn’t nonexistent. If you’re willing to be of use to me, that is.” Gero…

title: The Obsessive Villain is a Sister-Con
summary: He Mianmian transmigrates into a novel as the adopted sister of He Wenchuan, the story’s biggest villain. He Wenchuan is a possessive sis-con, spoiling his sister to the point that she becomes a reckless drama queen with a tyrannical personality. Mianmian doesn’t want to turn into a drama queen, but if she doesn’t follow the plot and act out, she experiences intense pain. Left with no choice, Mianmian decides to save He Wenchuan, and in turn, save herself. The most effective way? Break the alliance between He Wenchuan and the scheming supporting actress. However, something goes wrong along the way. The original plot had He Wenchuan getting set up and ending up in an unspeakable situation with the villainess. But in the end, it’s Mianmian who falls into the trap herself! O! M! G! — When He Wenchuan was young, he picked up a pet. He carefully nurtured her, treating her as his possession. Until one day, He Wenchuan suddenly realized that this pet was also edible—and tasted exceptionally good. But the pet didn’t want to be eaten. So, what to do? Lock her up, of course!

title: Forced to Marry a Cold-hearted Minister, I Won’t Chase Him Anymore After Being Reborn

Additionally, he was remarkably loyal, showing no interest in other women, even when they were in his arms. However, only Nianxi knew that her husband's heart was never with her. From age fifteen to twenty-eight, Nianxi could no longer endure it and wanted to make way for her husband's true love. Unexpectedly, she was reborn back to when she was fifteen. Unmarried and in her prime, Nianxi decided that in this lifetime, she would find a different man to experience love and fulfill her dream of romance. She chose a young, dashing, and considerate general for herself. However, when the young general excitedly took her to meet his childhood friend, Pei Jian, he coldly stared at their clasped hands! title: Accidentally Going Viral in the Entertainment Industry After My Thoughts Were Read
summary: Jiang Shuwan, a recognized academic star at H University, was widely known as a woman whose heart held no man and whose sword wielded naturally with divine flair. title: Cultivation Is Nothing But Money-Grabbing!
summary: Lian Mu, a modern-day cultivator, failed her tribulation and suffered a backlash. When she woke up, she had been reborn. By some unfortunate coincidence, she was reborn into the body of a little girl with blocked spiritual roots and not a single coin to her name. The girl had been eliminated from the Gui Xian Sect and was now making a living by sweeping the sect’s stairways. Lian Mu, who had already perfected her Dao in her previous life: Starting over from scratch? What’s so hard about that? However, it wasn’t until she re-entered the Gui Xian Sect for the second time that she realized—starting over in this world wasn’t just a matter of experience and skill. What she lacked most was money. As a sword cultivator, she was so poor that she couldn’t even afford a sword. Worse yet, after reconstructing her body with three spiritual roots, her dantian was damaged, and her body was in terrible condition. She needed specialized alchemists and artifact forgers to help her recover—both of which required a massive amount of money. In order to continue cultivating while spending as little as possible, she had no choice but to switch professions in secret. title: Immortality Begins with Comprehending the Dao Scripture
summary: [No tr*sh Protagonist] [No Harem] [Farming & Clan Management] The path to immortality is one of solitude, of loneliness, of chilling heights where few can stand. He and countless sons of the Song family push forward against the current—generation after generation passing on the torch, falling and rising—until the Song Immortal Clan stands tall atop the world! And when he one day looks back from the summit, all the trials and tribulations of the past will be but smoke in the wind.

title: When Clear Days Come
summary: In the twelfth year of Tianhe, deep winter, on a snowy night, eleven-year-old Shaowei swung her blade to sever all blood ties and descended the mountain alone. That night, Prince Liu Qi—who like an unlucky stray dog by the roadside had inexplicably received a beating from her—climbed up from the ground, wiped away his nosebleed, and stood in the heavy snow, watching that blood-soaked figure disappear into the distance.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance, Tragedy

title: Pretending to Be an Overseas Trainee in a Boy Group Survival Show
summary: Before getting tricked and scammed into transmigrating into a parallel world as a contestant on a boy group survival show, Lai Yudong was just a completely untrained college student with zero talent in singing or dancing. But the moment he opened his eyes and found himself on the stage for the initial evaluation, he realized how serious the situation was— “Next trainee, from LYD Entertainment: Miura Yuki.” Lai Yudong: “…” He’s done for—he doesn’t even speak Japanese! title: The Rule Creator Me, a Simp for the Villain?
summary: Ling Yan transmigrated to a future high-martial world where everyone had professions. Here, there were countless star beasts, and dangers lurked in perilous lands! title: After the Drama-Queen Beauty Saw the Bullet Comments [1980s]
summary: Jiang Rao was the well-known drama-queen beauty of Lushui Village, both delicate and capable of making scenes. But on this day, Jiang Rao unexpectedly saw the bullet comments and awakened. Through the bullet comments, she learned that she was actually a cannon-fodder female supporting character in a certain era novel, while the female lead was her half-sister from the same father but different mother. She envied her sister for marrying the town mayor’s driver, while she herself could only marry a rough man. She courted death all the way and ended up miserable, while the rough man would later counterattack and become the richest man. Startled, Jiang Rao covered her little heart: What? Abandon the richest-man husband? Impossible. Is it that the wife-s*ave isn’t obedient enough, or the money isn’t fragrant enough? The villagers discovered that after marriage, Jiang Rao became even more capable of making scenes, pickier than an empress: “What kind of lousy bed is this? It makes my waist hurt. I want to sleep on a Simmons mattress!” “This dish tastes awful. I want to eat mountain chicken soup and braised pig’s trotters!” “This house is both shabby and small. I want to live in a big villa!” The villagers all said that Lu Shen had married an ancestor who eats well and does nothing, and that life like this would sooner or later become impossible! As a result, Lu Shen got up earlier than the chickens and went to bed later than the dogs, working hard without complaint, changing his ways every day to satisfy and pamper Jiang Rao. He was forcibly trained by her into becoming all-round skilled, counterattacked to become the richest man, and upgraded their home from a village house to a town house and finally to a provincial capital mansion. “Without her, there would be no me today.” Lu Shen was clearly a rough man who did not understand romance, yet because of an unintentional word from Jiang Rao, he would run around the entire city and plant a rose garden overnight just to make her happy. —— Jiang Yu was reborn. She knew that in her previous life, Jiang Rao had always caused trouble and ended up miserable. In this life, Jiang Rao was still that dramatic, but the plot went off track: the more Jiang Rao acted up, the more Lu Shen held her at the tip of his heart, pampered her into becoming the richest man’s wife, and until Jiang Yu had endured to the point her hair turned white, she still did not see the two divorce. Warning: Fictional era setting, meticulous fact-checkers, please proceed with caution.

title: Mistaken Era
summary: The master once said that Cui Xiaoxiao, who has the "Ten Injuries" destiny, was actually very lucky. If she had been born two hundred years earlier, with her extremely yin destiny, she would have become the nemesis of the Demon Sect Lord Wei Jie. If that were the case, the novice Xiaoxiao would have been hunted to the ends of the earth, her bones scattered and ashes dispersed... Xiaoxiao secretly exclaimed in relief: Wei Jie was cold and cruel by nature. Fortunately, two hundred years ago, he was killed by his vengeful disciple Qin Lingxiao. This demon is gone from the world! Only his evil reputation remains stinking for eternity. Later, Cui Xiaoxiao accidentally time-traveled back two hundred years and took on a handsome and unrestrained young man as her disciple. Cui Xiaoxiao was very gratified, secretly praying to her master's spirit: Our Lingshan Talisman Sect has finally branched out and spread! I will definitely cultivate my disciple into a talent! After praying, she turned to her tall and mighty disciple, smiling and asking, "Disciple, I forgot to ask earlier, what is your surname?" The disciple looked at his master's bright eyes and slowly said, "My surname is Wei, Wei Jie..." Short introduction: The wrong time, the right person... Female lead: Accidentally took the Demon Lord ancestor as a disciple, leading him down the path of demonic cultivation in her bitter life. Male lead: Accidentally took on an adorable master, living a blessed life receiving her loving smiles every day.

title: My Girlfriend is a Zombie
summary: When disaster struck, Ling Mo knew that the kinds of zombies depicted in doomsday movies would in fact, be totally different from reality… Normally, the most important thing to do during the end of the world is to survive, but when Ling Mo picked up his girlfriend from an abandoned bus, the trajectory of his life had gone completely out of control. title: I Scared the Entire Galaxy in Three Sentences
summary: Shang Jingyan wakes up in the interstellar era and quickly realizes—this world is weird. The arts have flourished, and entertainment comes in all shapes and sizes. But there’s one glaring omission: darkness. No horror, no fear, nothing remotely unsettling. Instead, the entire galaxy is obsessed with love stories, dreamy fantasies, and endless pink bubbles. System: “Your mission is to become a literary icon! Collect ‘Heartbeat Points’ by making audiences swoon!” Former horror director Shang Jingyan: “Got it. No problem.” A few days later, a short film titled Married to an Eldritch God goes live. The opening shot? A cosmic horror’s grotesque visage filling the screen. The middle? Blood, madness, and creeping dread. The ending? Unspeakable. —Statistically, every single unfortunate viewer’s heart rate that night skyrocketed to 180 bpm. System: “Wait… WHAT?! This works too?!” Viewer A: “I only watch romance shows… Wait, horror is actually amazing?!” Gamer B: “I just wanted to romance the NPCs… Ghost, prepare to die!” Casual Viewer C: “I’m not scared of anything—oh hell no, I’m not sleeping tonight.” With sheer creative force, Shang Jingyan ignites a horror frenzy across the galaxy. They say she can terrify an entire civilization with just three sentences: “I’m making a movie.” “I’m developing a game.” “I’m directing a variety show.” And yet, despite the screams and tears, people just. Keep. Watching. Years later, critics would say: “She was the queen of the Second Galactic Era, the one who reintroduced fear and rage to the masses.” “She created countless works, all to deliver a single message—” “I will awaken your nightmares. So scream for me. Let your heart race!”

title: Little Schemes of the Green-Tea Supporting Role
summary: Author’s Note: The alternate timeline epilogue, “What If,” is closely connected to the main story’s awakened heroine. Reading them together provides a complete narrative and is highly recommended. Lin Yao awoke to the realization that she was the vicious, “green tea” best friend of Shi Nian, the female lead of the novel. Her days had been spent scheming to sabotage Shi Nian and steal her love interests. Lin Yao was speechless when she saw the script. Seriously? she thought. Who would waste time on petty female rivalry when their best friend is the female lead? Is my brainstem missing, or is my cerebellum underdeveloped? On her first day of awakening, Lin Yao gathered some snacks and knocked on the door of the Shi siblings next door, who had recently lost their parents. At school, when bullies targeted Shi Nian, Lin Yao was the first to jump to her defense. When a bully from a neighboring school harassed Shi Nian, Lin Yao sweetly grabbed a wooden stick, knocked him unconscious, and rescued her friend. As time passed, Lin Yao became Shi Nian’s closest friend, wanting nothing more than to pluck the stars from the sky for her. Unfortunately, Shi Nian had a younger brother, Shi Yu, a “tea-detecting man” with an uncanny ability to spot green tea behavior. No matter what Lin Yao did, Shi Yu would fix her with his deep, unfathomable dark eyes, severely hindering her interactions with Shi Nian. After some thought, Lin Yao decided to secretly sabotage Shi Yu’s reputation. While moving heavy objects, she sweetly insisted, “It’s alright, I can manage alone.” Feeling sorry for Lin Yao, the female lead summoned Shi Yu to do all the heavy lifting, even scolding him for not working hard enough. At dinner, Lin Yao deliberately burned Shi Yu’s portion and then tearfully wailed, “It’s all my fault for being so clumsy. I can’t even cook properly.” The female lead comforted her, assuring her it wasn’t her fault. Then, she glared at Shi Yu and ordered him to cook for them every day from then on. Shi Yu shot her a cold look, a sardonic smile curling his lips as he clicked his tongue, silently labeling her a “Little Green Tea.” Teary-eyed, Lin Yao clung to the female lead’s arm. “Oh, Sister, look how fierce he is! Unlike me, I only want to take care of you.” That summer, Lin Yao never set foot in the kitchen again. She ate meals cooked entirely by Shi Yu. After the college entrance exam results came out, all three were accepted into Capital City University, a prestigious institution. During a departmental gathering, the campus heartthrob from a neighboring faculty mustered the courage to confess his feelings to Lin Yao. Amidst the cheers and blessings of the crowd, Lin Yao blushed crimson, lowered her head, and prepared to coyly reject him with classic “green tea” tactics. But then, Shi Yu appeared, swept her into his arms in front of everyone, and strode out of the room. In the stairwell, he pressed her tightly against him, burying his face in her neck. His burning breath scorched her skin. “Lin Yao,” he whispered, “when you kissed me last night, you promised to be my wife.” Lin Yao, still hungover from the previous evening: “…………” Shi Nian, rushing in to find her brother embracing her best friend, stood frozen in shock. “What in the world is going on here?!” Everyone said the Shi siblings from Third High School had been handed a reverse-protagonist script: their parents had died in a tragic car accident, but the siblings had miraculously risen to the pinnacle of success, even being welcomed back into their wealthy grandfather’s family. But no one knew the truth. When their parents had just passed away, the siblings were burdened with crushing debt. Relatives abandoned them, and they nearly starved to death in their own home. Then, the pretty little girl next door, clutching a small snack, knocked on the Shi family’s door. She was like a tiny star appearing in the deepest, darkest night, trembling softly as she landed gently on the edge of their hearts.

title: Rebirth in the ’70s: The Capitalist’s Daughter Only Wants a Divorce
summary: Shu Yue was reborn—on the very day her baby was switched. In her previous life, Shu Yue raised the child she believed was her daughter while living with her grandfather’s family. Only at her death did she discover the terrible truth: the girl wasn’t her biological child at all—her in-laws’ eldest sister-in-law had secretly swapped the babies. She had actually given birth to a son. But because that sister-in-law had never managed to bear a boy, she stole Shu Yue’s newborn son and left her with another child. In her grief, the ungrateful “daughter” revealed an even darker secret: the whole family had been drugged, and if Shu Yue wanted to see them again, she’d have to go underground... Shu Yue died unwilling and bitter. She had poured all her love into raising that child—so why did it end with her family destroyed and her life ruined? When she opened her eyes again, she was back on the day her son was born. This time, she would protect him at any cost. No one would take him from her. And as for that man—her so-called husband who never appeared, never sent money, never even looked in on her while she suffered—what use was such a marriage? What could she possibly want from him? Divorce. She would find a way to make it happen, no matter what. (This is a fictional, alternate-history story—do not take it as reality.) Tags: Rebirth • Space ability • Military marriage • Husband’s-regret arc • Arranged marriage turned love story Capitalist heiress × Rough-edged military officer

title: Amari-chan, the Girl I Found Next to the Number-One Girl Everyone Wants as a Girlfriend
summary: Looking anxious, you ask, "Are you sure… about me?" And that’s exactly why I want to stay by your side. Fukusuke, a nice guy but too plain for his own good, falls in love at first sight with the most beautiful girl in class—Yua. But the one rumored to be with Yua isn’t him—it’s his best friend, Yūsei, the ace of the basketball team. Fukusuke sighs, knowing his feelings are hopeless. Then one day, he notices her—the girl hidden in Yua’s shadow, unnoticed by most. A super cute, yet completely overlooked girl—Amari Usuba. "U-um… would you… be my friend?" Shy and reserved, she asks hesitantly. And so, the two of them begin practicing how to be "normal" together. But— "Amari-chan… the person you admire is Yūsei, isn’t it?" "……" "Wait, why is your face turning so red?" A romantic comedy about a hidden beauty only I know—starting from friendship.

title: The Female Supporting Role Is Loved by Thousands of People [Quick Transmigration]
summary: System: "Want to be resurrected? Then come suffer." 21-year-old college student Ming Ming was too busy checking out a hot guy to notice the oncoming car. She got hit and was unexpectedly bound to a Quick Transmigration System. Her mission? To play the role of a tragic cannon-fodder side character, enduring endless pain and heartbreak, all to highlight the heroine’s rise to greatness and the happiness of the main couple. But in the very first world, things already went off script. Ming Ming found herself forced to sign an unfair contract with the cold, domineering CEO male lead. System: “Relax. No matter how much the plot changes, the cannon-fodder ex-girlfriend always gets humiliated in the end.” Ming Ming: “But… he’s not even looking at the heroine.” System: “That’s just the groundwork for a long, painful ‘chasing-his-wife’ arc!” Ming Ming: “The heroine’s already with someone else, though.” System: “You're hogging too much screen time. Hurry up and stir up some drama! Make him dump you!” Ming Ming: “Um… he’s giving me more now…” Then came the Second World. The male lead was a city-educated youth forced to marry the village chief’s domineering daughter—aka Ming Ming. Meanwhile, the heroine was living in the city, his pen pal and emotional soulmate. System: “Perfect. He even sent money and ration coupons in his letters to her. He wants nothing to do with you.” Ming Ming: “So… we’re getting divorced? I was gonna run away with the kinda-handsome village gangster.” System: “Wait, he asked the heroine to send him specialty snacks from the city… because life in the countryside is hard and he wants to get treats for his wife?!” Ming Ming: “Huh? So… we’re not divorcing? Is this world almost over? I’m craving egg yolk mooncakes, ox-tongue pastries, taro rolls… blegh—ugh!” System: “Wait—why are you pregnant?!” Ming Ming (panicking): “When’s the divorce?! I don’t want to have a kid, aaahhh—!” Next was the Third World. Ming Ming entered the palace as the illegitimate daughter, accompanying her sister's marriage to the emperor. She was meant to make her elegant sister shine… but through a twist of fate, she became the emperor’s favored consort. System: “It’s fine. The emperor always builds up a glittering ‘decoy consort’ to draw attention and protect his true love.” Ming Ming: “Oh god, all the shady stuff is being aimed at me… wait—why is he disbanding the harem?! What about the heroine?!” System: “What do you mean, what about the heroine?! She just eloped with someone else!!” Ming Ming: “The emperor’s going after her! He’s going—wait… huh? Something feels off…” System: “The heroine took the phoenix seal with her! The emperor took it back! Who’s he giving it to now?! YOU???” Ming Ming: “I-I-I-I don’t want it!! Honestly, there's this stall outside the palace that sells the most amazing baked flatbreads. I just want to be their apprentice…” Emperor Male Lead, to the imperial guards: “Go. Camp at that flatbread stall and wait for her to show up.” And so it continued, world after world. System (exhausted and confused): “Where’s my heroine?! No wait—how are you still passing the missions?!” Ming Ming (loving it): “Are there more? Let’s go! Start the next round!”

title: Class Survival: I’m the Only Guy on the Bus
summary: Ten billion people around the world have been thrown into the Bus Survival Game. Everyone is sorted into tightly knit groups—classmates, company departments, club teams, scientific research labs, and more. Each group, thirty to fifty members strong, is crammed into a single city bus, forced to survive together in a strange, new world. Gu Pingsheng’s bus, thanks to his college major, stands out from the very start: aside from him, every single passenger is a girl. And that’s not the only odd thing—luck seems to be on their side. Several passengers, Gu Pingsheng included, awaken powerful talents. From day one, Gu Pingsheng draws an S-Rank Talent: Daily Sign-In. For every day he survives, he can pick a reward from a vast prize pool—anything from essential supplies to entirely new abilities. Some of the girls are blessed as well. The class rep, Li Ruoyao, starts with an S-Rank talent: Super Physique—ten times the strength, stamina, and resilience of an ordinary person, with all future boosts multiplied tenfold. The party secretary, Lin Qiunan, awakens S-Rank Divine Insight: she can instantly discern the properties and secrets of any object. The life committee member, Luo Xiaoxue, scores an A-Rank Healing Spell. The arts and sports rep, Zhang Keke, draws a B-Rank Gigantification ability. The science and innovation rep... well, let’s just say everyone’s got a few tricks up their sleeve. With Gu Pingsheng’s S-Rank talent and a bus full of girls, each boasting extraordinary abilities, what should have been a nightmare starts to feel more like a vacation. Together, they blaze a wild new trail through this world—one chaotic bus stop at a time.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Cat A is also an Alpha!
summary: Cat A: “Zhu Yan, do you know how kittens meow?” Mermaid O: “Dear, is it ‘meow meow’? Or ‘mimi’?” Cat A: “I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish I want fish” Mermaid O: “…” * Shu Tang woke up one day to find the world gone mad; humanity was no longer content with just male and female, creating six ABO genders instead. Shu Tang felt she might be one of the common betas, making up 80% of the population—non-aggressive, not too sensitive, quite peace-loving, and without anything extra to her person, just an utterly ordinary beta. Then, on her adulthood test: Supreme Alpha! Shu Tang: ? Shu Tang’s spirit is a cat. Supported by her SSS-tier spirit, she not only interned at the federal secret sanatorium but also got matched with a fragile omega. When visiting her delicate fiancé, she mistook 10 for 01 and entered Restricted Area No. 1. In the Restricted Area lives “Patient No. 1”. An unbeaten legend, the grand leader of the federation, known as the pioneer of human nuclear weapons. This leader is an omega, with a merman as his spirit—no secret there. However, due to his monstrous combat abilities, the discussions usually aren’t about whether he’s omega, but whether he’s human at all. After a psychic outburst, he became a “monster.” Wherever he resided turned into the Restricted Area. Those who trespassed met grim fates. Shu Tang entered the Restricted Area. Reportedly, her fiancé was too frail to fend for himself. She saw her fiancé’s terrifying, silent figure in the dark. Shu Tang noted: He must be shy. She saw her fiancé’s fishtail in the sea, water dripping down, his complexion pale and eyes pitch black. Shu Tang noted: Low blood sugar. She found her fiancé’s voice hoarse, never speaking, only emitting beast-like, raspy threatening sounds from his throat. Shu Tang noted: Quiet by nature, not talkative. Shu Tang managed to get out. An alpha asked: Did you see any terrifying beings? Shu Tang: “Are you talking about the blue rose?” Other alphas: ? Blue rose? Who? Cat, blushing: “He’s nice, just not very healthy.” Other alphas: ? Why would she be blushing? Later, everyone thought Cat A was the one who most relied on the grand leader. But they didn’t know— To him, Cat was the blue rose, his spiritual support, his lifeline, his entire conception of living. She was the one he clung to as he withered. And in her presence, he grew silently.
genres: Completed, Adult, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Hello Vet! How are you?
summary: A quiet neighborhood park. People out for a stroll were leisurely spending their time. At the center of it all, three dogs gathered, conversing with serious expressions. 『Did you hear about that rumor, guys? 『What rumor?』 『If you go that way, there’s a clinic, right?』 『Exactly.』 『I heard the doctor there can understand our language.』 『What are you talking about?』 『It’s like I said, the doctor can understand what we say if we go there.』

title: The Path of an S-Rank Adventurer: The Boy Who Was Expelled from His Party Awakens to His True Power [Weapon Master] and Eventually Becomes the World’s Strongest
summary: In a world where 40% of humanity awakens to unique abilities. Magical beasts and dungeons are everywhere, making the adventurer profession one of the most lucrative paths. Sasha, the leader of the team Sacred, was on the brink of being promoted to S-Rank Adventurer. On the same day, another person was also confirmed to achieve S-Rank—a boy named Haise. Haise was once a member of Sacred, an F-Rank adventurer who had been expelled from the team by Sasha. Possessing an unusual ability, Haise struggled to understand its nature. Misunderstood and abandoned by his childhood friend Sasha, he was cast out of the team under the pretense that “Haise couldn’t keep up”. The true reason behind his expulsion was Sasha’s desire to protect him—she didn’t want Haise to die while adventuring. However, Haise refused to give up. Even on his own, he worked tirelessly to continue his journey as an adventurer. One day, Sasha deceived Haise into venturing into a forest inhabited by a dragon, where he was nearly killed. Betrayed by the trust he had placed in Sasha, Haise vowed never to believe in her again and resolved to grow stronger as an adventurer on his own. At 16, both Haise and Sasha were recognized as S-Rank adventurers. Haise sought to become the strongest adventurer alone, while Sasha aimed to be the best alongside her companions. This is the story of two childhood friends who once walked the same path but diverged onto separate journeys—paths that might one day cross again.

title: I’m Just a Death Warrior, Why Must the Immortal Maidens Die for Me?
summary: Fang Ling has a cold temperament. After dying and transmigrating to become a death warrior, he becomes even more aloof, only wanting to work hard to gain his freedom. What he doesn't understand is that he never actively provoked anyone, yet for some reason many women have set their sights on him... The cold and aloof immortal maiden: "If you dare leave, no matter where you go, I will kill you." The demonic sect's enchantress: "Since you want to cut ties with me completely, then I'll kill you first, then commit su*cide. Two people dying together—isn't that romantic?" The righteous sect's saintess: "We were master and disciple. In this life we may never be able to be together, but you're also not allowed to get close to any other women. Otherwise, I'll kill every single one I see." This is a story of immortal maidens, enchantresses, and saintesses who cannot have what they desire.
genres: Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xianxia

title: Exiled to Hainan: Rising to Fortune from the Sea
summary: Jiang Wan was extremely unlucky to have a car accident, but she was also incredibly lucky in that she and her mother, Yin Huaixi, ended up time-traveling to the same dynasty — and still as mother and daughter. They arrived just as their family was being exiled, forbidden to ever leave the island. What? Their place of exile turned out to be an island just like Hainan! Jiang Wan couldn't help but shed a tear, but she quickly fell back on her old skills of gathering seafood, bringing home all kinds of sea treasures and turning them into profitable sauces and snacks. Her daughter worked hard, and as a mother, she worked even harder. Plagues and pests? A dose of medicine took care of them all, banishing disease and warding off poisonous creatures. From then on, their fish harvests were no longer sold cheap, the mountains were covered in fruit trees, and diseases had cures. The entire community was on its way to prosperity. Through sheer determination, they transformed their desolate exile into a flourishing paradise island!
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Slice of Life

title: I’m Just a Mob Character, but I Picked Up a Villainess — I Don’t Know Anything About the Game’s Story, So I’ll Do Whatever I Want
summary: In a world that feels like a familiar game from a past life, Randolph Victor, known as Randy, has trained himself following his curiosity. One day, due to a certain incident, he realizes that this world is actually the setting of an "otome game." An otome game world—what a surprise. And from his position in this world, no matter how you look at it, Randy is just a nameless mob character. Randy, a true "mob of mobs" with no special knowledge or notable traits, unexpectedly encounters and takes in a villainess who was supposed to be exiled from the country. A reincarnated person with no game knowledge, Randy is a poor mob noble. Together with the exiled noblewoman, Elizabeth, and the ancient great wizard who was supposed to be the final boss, the three join forces. This marks the beginning of a brand new story that never existed in the original game. Standing in their way is the heroine who knows the game inside and out, her ensnared followers, and the powerful figures of the nation who lurk behind them. Against all these opponents, who are far superior to mere mobs, the poor nobleman's son, the exiled noblewoman, and the despised witch begin their dramatic rise and tale of revenge.

title: SS-Class Guide
summary: An Yuan was the only SS-class Guide across the five major districts. After tragically dying in the battle against the Insect Emperor, he is reborn two years later in the body of Rong Xiushe, a D-class Guide currently enrolled in the Sentinel-Guide Academy. He desperately wanted to lie flat and enjoy his new life, but reality refused to let him. Once living a life of luxury, he is now suddenly destitute and forced to experience the hardships of the common world. He earns 50 yuan for a single counseling session with a C-class Sentinel and 80 yuan an hour for tutoring. With fixed part-time jobs on weekends, he must also ensure he maintains a scholarship just to keep his life stable. It is simply too difficult. He even considered whether he should just go back to being a high-level Guide, but once he steps back into that life, he will inevitably have to reconnect with acquaintances from his past life. On second thought, he decided against it. However, after being reborn, even though he felt he had done absolutely nothing and was simply struggling to survive at the pace of a D-class Guide, the "s*umbag" ex-boyfriend he broke up with shortly before his death found him. His childhood friend from his past life found him. The colleague who had given him roses on Qixi Festival in his past life also found him. What gives him the biggest headache is the younger brother he watched grow up. This little brother, who in his memory was the personification of "clingy," actually staged a spontaneous "Berserk State" right in front of him just to force him to admit his true identity. One-sentence Summary: He was reborn with primeval, prehistoric power. Theme: By living well, one can harvest an abundance of love!
genres: Drama, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: The Tyrannical Sister of the Wealthy CEO
summary: Gu Zhaoping transmigrated into the role of the domineering CEO's older sister in a wealthy family romance novel. The System: You know what the older sister of a domineering CEO in a wealthy family should do... Gu Zhaoping had an epiphany and nodded confidently, "I know, I have experience." Having been the eldest daughter of a top-tier wealthy family in her previous life, Gu Zhaoping was well-versed in how to uphold this identity. She quickly laid out a clear plan. The System, reassured, turned to the pampered female lead and said: [In wealthy family romance novels, the domineering CEO always has a vicious older or younger sister who tries to break up the main couple, torment the female lead, and force her own wealthy best friend into an arranged marriage with the CEO.] [Her daily routine consists of dining, shopping at auctions, and causing scenes at parties just to be humiliated by you.] [I’ve already arranged for a character to play the role of the vicious sister. She’ll target you on a reality show according to the plot, and soon you’ll smoothly marry into the wealthy family while she gets written off.] The innocent female lead tearfully agreed. And so, she and the CEO began a secret affair, eloped, threatened to jump into the sea, and declared their undying love—demanding that the CEO leave his engagement party to see her. When the call came through, the CEO crushed his phone in fury and was about to storm out— But from the front row, a woman in an elegant white suit calmly lifted her gaze. "Gu Zhaoye, do you have a death wish?" Bodyguards swiftly restrained the CEO, forcing him to complete the ceremony. The guests were all satisfied, and Gu Zhaoping raised her glass. "My brother is immature. Allow me to apologize on his behalf." The guests: "You’re too kind, President Gu!" The CEO and the female lead were stunned. The internet exploded. As the CEO’s older sister, of course she had to wield even greater power than him. The System: ??? What are you doing??? … At first, the internet assumed: President Gu’s sister? That brainless schemer who bullied Ruan Nian and tried to marry her best friend off to her brother? Then they saw Gu Zhaoping on the reality show. Netizens: ??? Stanford graduate? Double degrees in Business and Law? A cold, brilliant older sister??? While other guests bickered over love triangles and petty drama, Gu Zhaoping’s segment turned the wealthy family reality show into The Apprentice. "Contestant, have you considered working for my company?" No more fighting—why argue when you could cling to the real powerhouse? Gu Zhaoping effortlessly won everyone over. Netizens: She’s the real CEO. As the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, of course she had to secure the family legacy and expand its empire. Gu Zhaoping smoothly took over, earning her parents’ trust in three months and fully inheriting the family business within six, becoming the most outstanding successor of the Gu family’s new generation. She rang the bell at the NASDAQ for the company’s IPO, while her domineering CEO brother was still chasing his white moonlight.

title: I Reincarnated as a Monster in a Game World, and Picked Up the Heroine Who Was My Oshi in My Previous Life
summary: In this world, monsters are humanity's mortal enemies. Said to have been created by an evil god, monsters are monstrous beings whose only instinct is to kill humans. Since I was reincarnated as such a monster, I decided to live a peaceful life, avoiding being found by humans. With that resolve, I have lived quietly until now. But one day, I found a person collapsed near my home. What's more, the person lying there was the heroine I had been rooting for in my previous life. She was extremely exhausted, and I decided that her life would be in danger if she continued like this, so I couldn't just abandon her and decided to take her under my protection. This is the story of the protagonist, who has been reincarnated as a monster, overcoming difficulties together with the original characters.

title: The Harem Is Full of Gossip, Your Majesty, You Are Being Cheated
summary: Jiang Zhimiao bring the gossip system to the Yong Dynasty and becomes the current empress. The new emperor’s harem is in chaos. “What? Chen Shuyi and An Zhaoyi, who are like sisters, are real sisters! General An has a big green hat on his head!” “Concubine De actually likes to smell stinky socks!” “Lady Lin, who is favored by the new emperor, has a white moonlight in her heart!” “The dignified and steady Empress Dowager, she has an old lover in private!” Gossip spread throughout the harem, and the concubines of the new emperor are all excited. The gossip system also comes with a lot of spiritual food. Yue Lin enters the Empress’s palace on the first night, the candlelight is gentle, and the atmosphere is just right. Jiang Zhimiao clicks on the horror movie. The horror movie is broadcasts live simultaneously, and Yue Lin is sweating all over, stiff all over, and instantly lost interest. Jiang Zhimiao comforted: “Don’t be nervous, Your Majesty, I don’t care about these things, it’s good to just chat under the quilt.” Yue Lin grits his teeth. He doesn’t feel good at all! Jiang Zhimiao is gossiping while watching TV series. Dream of the Red Chamber. New Three Kingdoms. Legend of Zhen Huan. Nirvana in Fire. All the concubines are so obsessed with the TV series. Concubine Lin provokes: “Concubine De, I think you should be the master of the harem.” Concubine De is angry: “Get lost!” No one can stop her from watching TV series. Yue Lin wanders into the palace of Concubine An one day. Concubine An: “Your Majesty, please don’t come next time. I’m worried that the Empress will misunderstand.” Yue Lin: “???” Is this my harem, or the Empress’s harem! The entire harem is eating melons and watching TV series, and the salted fish Empress lay all the way and wins in the end.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Reincarnated as the Mastermind of the Story (LN)
summary: 『The Legend of the Seven Heroes』── A game that boasted of its worldwide popularity. Ren, a university student who cleared its sequel while setting a world record, got reincarnated as a baby inside that game. (Could it be that I reincarnated as the protagonist of 『The Legend of the Seven Heroes』?) While indulging in such a thought, hearing his name from his mother’s mouth made him doubt his ears. It was because that name was of a classmate of the heroes who later betrays them halfway into the story and also turns out to be the mysterious and powerful enemy who maneuvered behind the scenes to try and plunge the world into the depths of despair. Wishing to live in peace, Ren decided to continue with his life in a remote region. However, he ends up getting acquainted with the saint whose life was supposed to be taken by him in the game, and is led to an unexpected and unfortunate destiny. It’s the start of a fantasy story filled with dramatic developments and heart-pounding adventures that are impossible to take your eyes off……!

title: After the Gentle Wife Slacked Off, the Aloof Power Broker Pulled Her Close to Pamper Her
summary: Wen Jiayue was reborn. She was reborn back to the day she gave birth to her daughter. As the daughter of a minor household marrying into the Marquis Manor, she had married above her station. Her husband, Shen Fuhan, was exceptionally handsome and talented, with a smooth path ahead in his official career. Although he treated people with distance and coldness, and even she, who shared his bed, was no exception, after four years of marriage, Wen Jiayue believed he at least had some feelings for her. So, even when the Old Madam disliked her for not bearing a grandson, and her husband's younger sister was arrogant and unreasonable, she endured it all, wholeheartedly serving her husband and managing the entire Marquis Manor meticulously. She never imagined that Shen Fuhan was actually involved with the Eldest Princess. She and her daughter were tragically poisoned, meeting a miserable end, unable to rest in peace. Living again, Wen Jiayue stopped serving. She focused wholeheartedly on taking care of her daughter, only wanting to avoid disaster and not repeat her past mistakes. As for men... How could a man compare to her daughter? ——— Shen Fuhan kept feeling that his wife had changed recently. She no longer attended to his daily needs, no longer cared if he was weary, and those smiling almond eyes no longer held any affection for him. Shen Fuhan paid it no mind. His ambitions lay with the imperial court; he absolutely wouldn't be hindered by romantic entanglements. Until, at a flower viewing banquet, he saw Wen Jiayue chatting happily with another man, her gentle face filled with admiration. The talented man and beautiful woman looked like a match made in heaven. Shen Fuhan watched impassively for a long time. Even as thorns pierced his palm, he felt no pain at all.

title: Miss Pendleton
summary: Laura Pendleton, the renowned matchmaker of high society. She believed this latest request, to find a match for Ian Dalton, a prime bachelor and wealthy landowner, would be smooth sailing. At least, until she met the man wrapped in nothing but obstinance. “You must’ve heard. Just how much trouble my sister went through to drag me here.” A straight nose and eyes radiating refined grace. Miss Pendleton thought: With a face like that, he could whisk away any lady in a carriage to his estate. And soon enough, she realized just how accurate her assessment was. “Are you telling me to marry someone else right now?” His handsome face twisted ever so slightly before he spoke again. “Marry me, Miss Pendleton.” A finely cut diamond ring shimmered in the light. Held out to Laura Pendleton, an old maid of twenty-nine.

title: I am the Supporting Female Character in a Restricted Novel
summary: Lin Ting transmigrated into a book—a restricted one at that. She became the female supporting character who secretly loved the male lead but was destined to pine in vain. In the original story, the female supporting character hated the female lead for stealing the male lead’s affection, and by extension, she also despised the female lead’s older brother, Duan Ling. Over time, Lin Ting and him became archenemies. Duan Ling was quite renowned in the capital, with looks as beautiful as a Bodhisattva—a true noble young master. In this book, Duan Ling was the only one who never married in the end and didn’t even get a sip of meat broth, all thanks to Lin Ting’s "efforts." She was a vicious yet foolish female supporting character, using schemes against him that harmed others without benefiting herself, yet she still prided herself on being clever. Lin Ting’s task was to follow the female supporting character’s plotline… and most of those plot points involved Duan Ling. Plot to follow 1: Confess to Duan Ling, disgust him. Plot to follow 2: Hold Duan Ling’s hand, disgust him. Plot to follow 3: Hug Duan Ling, disgust him. Plot to follow 4: Kiss Duan Ling, disgust him. Plot to follow 5: …… Lin Ting: "What kind of logic is this?" The final plot point had nothing to do with Duan Ling—she was so obsessed with obtaining the male lead that she planned to drug him with hehuan yao. That night, Duan Ling somehow found out about this plan. He took the hehuan yao Lin Ting had bought and swallowed it right in front of her. Duan Ling smiled: "Weren’t you going to go to him? Go ahead." Lin Ting couldn’t escape the room. It was only after that night that she learned Duan Ling had an addiction to bedroom affairs—and that he was a madman. He had previously used other methods to suppress it, but now…

title: Dr. Shin Seonhan: The Doctor Who Sees the Future
summary: ‘What if a doctor could see the future?’ 10,000 patients a day, over 6,000 medical staff. Yeonguk University Hospital, the pinnacle of Korea’s medical community. In this place where the lives of countless patients hang in the balance, there’s no room for even a moment’s carelessness. Shin Seonhan, a low-ranking intern who dreams of becoming the best surgeon. One day, he starts seeing the “future”! • A diverse cast of characters and vivid medical scenes, brought to you by a current thoracic surgeon. The freshest medical drama unfolds before your eyes right now.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Psychological, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: A Competent Doctor Can Cure Everything
summary: Seon I-jun, an intern at Korea's top university hospital, put on his father's heirloom glasses. 'Could it be that I'm looking at the contents of a future chart right now...?' One day, he started seeing things that he shouldn't have.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Hide Rankers in Inventory
summary: I obtained an EX-rank inventory skill that can hold absolutely anything. But then— 『Please, just for about a month… hide me inside your inventory, Ms. Seo Aru.』 …along came the suspicious Rank 1, tagging along with it. #Hunter #FemaleProtagonistModernFantasy #ComedyMystery #NoRomance #OneClickOneKill #TheWorldHidesMyHumanRights
genres: Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery

title: I Was Reincarnated As the Leader of a Banishment-Type Villain Party, so I Banished Myself Before I Got What I Deserved. ~The “Steal” Skill-Stealing Ability Is Too Villainous, but It’s Also Too Strong~
summary: “As of today, I’m out of the party – as of today…huh?” I suddenly realized that I had been reincarnated as the leader of a villain party that gets what they deserve in an expulsion anime. If I were to expel Kane, the protagonist of the story, I would get what I deserve like in the anime and enter the death route. To prevent this from happening, Lloyd decided to expel himself. He was happy that he was able to escape from the plot, but he was so unpopular in the guild that no one would want to join his party. This was probably the price Lloyd had paid for using “Steal,” which steals people’s skills, to harass them. …But isn’t this skill a bit too good for a reincarnation? Hmm? By the way, if Kane hadn’t been expelled, what would have happened to the heroines who were supposed to travel with the protagonist? And what about Kane, who wasn’t expelled…eh What would happen if the villain leader didn’t banish the protagonist, but instead recognized his power? This is the story of what if.

title: It Wasn’t Healing, It Was Training Magic
summary: I was reincarnated into a world with reversed gender roles. With only one magic spell learned. I thought I was casting healing magic and used it indiscriminately. But the condition of the people I "healed" seems strange. . . As it turns out, it was actually training/conditioning magic.

title: Falling in Love with a 500-year-old female elder
summary: Ning Chuan travels through the fantasy world and is bound to the storyteller system. As long as the reader’s violent mood swings are triggered, he can get storytelling points. Ning Chuan, who is lazy by nature, started a leisurely life of talking about books and drinking tea. A girl with a red umbrella with half a cultivator face and half a Bodhisattva face turned into a little maid pinching her shoulders and beating her legs. A talented and powerful woman who is proud of the ancient and modern, amazingly talented, and destined to surpass eternity, became the innkeeper’s wife. A so-called six-fingered qin devil, a female devil with excellent qin and colour, has become a talented maid. There is also a peerless and lovely female sword fairy that has not been in love for five hundred years. She plucked up her courage and shouted: “Ning Chuan, I will like you, even more than you like me!” At the same time. Scenes of famous scenes from the major novels in the previous life, along with Ning Chuan’s storytelling, spread to the entire Three Thousand Worlds. “Who is calling invincible? Who dares to say no… Note: This novel and its characters are purely fictitious. Any similarities are purely coincidental and should not be imitated.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: Her Biological Brother Treats Her Like Weeds, The Rich Stepbrother Spoils Her Excessively
summary: In her past life, Qin Bingwu helped her brothers and father achieve fame and success, building her own thriving career. Yet, the moment her younger sister shed a tear, her family betrayed her, took everything she had, and handed it all to her sister. After perishing together in vengeance, both she and her sister were reborn. In this new life, her sister refused to return to the wealthy family as the pampered heiress. Disillusioned, Qin Bingwu declared, "If you won’t go, I will." To her surprise, the supposedly rigid and unyielding Old Madam gifted her a million dollars upon their first meeting. The sister’s so-called "sarcastic fourth brother" shielded her instead, saying, "From now on, if anyone dares to bully you, just drop my name." The sister’s mysterious high-ranking second brother reassured her, "Don’t be afraid. I’ll be your backbone." The sister’s "stingy celebrity third brother" constantly spoiled her, asking, "Little sis, want clothes, shoes, or bags? Third brother will get you custom-made ones." When her biological brothers came to harass her, they stood in her defense, declaring, "You don’t deserve to call yourselves Bingwu’s brothers." Later, when she planned to leave, the domineering eldest brother—the one her sister despised the most—pulled her into his arms, his eyes red-rimmed, and pleaded, "Bingwu, we can be a real family. Marry me, Okay?"

title: On My Last Day, the CEO Confiscated My Sup**essant
summary: On the day I quit my job, my disguise as a Beta finally failed. In front of all the senior executives, Qin Yucheng seized my sup**essant, refusing to let me leave and forbidding anyone else from touching me. It was only later that I realized this near-forced detention was driven by a long-sup**essed affection he had hidden for years.

title: Cultivating Immortality in a World of Chaos
summary: Fang Xi transmigrated, and not just once but twice! In the cultivation realm, I was timid and cautious; in another world, I unleashed my full potential! Never did I imagine that after millennia, I would become a powerhouse even within the cultivation world!

title: Beastmaster King
summary: Lu Ran had long since known that his path in life differed from others when he awakened a special ability one day. Sure enough a mysterious black card appeared, giving him the chance to become a beastmaster. With his loyal husky by his side, he sets out on his path to greatness.

title: A Poem of Eternal Love
summary: A figure strolled along a trail, taking in the beauty of the flowers. Wherever she went, mu*ders seemed to follow in her wake. She sought out a secluded spot under a crooked peach tree, closing her eyes to rest. Out of the blue, a bundle came flying over a towering wall, and landed squarely into her arms. She unwrapped the bundle revealing a freshly severed human head. “Amituofo.” Standing on her tiptoes, she steadily placed the head on the branches of the peach tree. Then she flapped her clothes, and airily departed from the scene.
genres: Action, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance, Wuxia

title: Golem Master ~MAKE MY LADY~ If We’re Going to Fight Together Anyway, Isn’t a Cute Girl Better?
summary: The combat knight-type golem Patton ventures deep into the labyrinth alongside his master, a young magic engineer named Kugutsu. However, they soon encounter the legendary Gigant Minotaurus, a monster so powerful that adventurers fear it as the “Oni-Ox.” Overwhelmed by its immense strength, Patton’s body is destroyed—leaving only his core intact. With no way to repair his body and no money to spare, Kugutsu happens upon a discarded female-type body in a junk heap and, without much thought, installs Patton’s core into it. “Surprisingly cute… well, this’ll do for now, right?” Thinking it’s fine for the moment, Kugutsu brushes it off lightly. Patton, however, is far from pleased with his new feminine form—but as they continue fighting together, he gradually begins to accept it. Thus begins the story of a magic engineer and his golem partner, who enhances her body parts in “fun and cute” ways while aiming to defeat the Gigant Minotaurus—a hack-and-slash golem adventure!

title: The Road Turns White Tonight
summary: Time flew by. Even though their graduation was a long time ago, after countless nights and passing through fleeting time, their story is still circulated around the quiet campus of University G. This story has many different versions, but there is one thing that everyone knows to be true. Back then, that ordinary girl betrayed the genius of the fine arts faculty and yet, his love for her still remained. For her, he nearly died in a fire. For her, he gave up his chance to study abroad. Years later when they meet again, he is successful with a new girlfriend in his arms and she is indifferent with a light and clear smile. However, unknown to anyone, her longing had begun long ago and even now flooded her thoughts…

title: Peppermint Addiction
summary: Can you handle the contract terms?" "The real question is, can you handle my demands?" Actress Park Ha was known for her unyielding spirit, someone who would break before she bent. However, an incident involving her family completely shattered her image, leaving her to barely scr*pe by with part-time jobs. One day, Kang Hyuk, a director at Haesung Group, offers her a sponsorship contract. Desperate for money for her mother's surgery, Park Ha ultimately accepts the offer. "From now on, don't avoid my gaze without permission." The man she expected to immediately demand the fulfillment of the contract simply observes Park Ha instead. "Don't let anyone ignore or defeat you. Only I get to do that." "Haah." Finally, a sigh escaped Park Ha's lips, followed by a wry chuckle. "You're not a pe*vert. Are you saying you're the only one who gets to torment me? Sponsor, by any chance, do you like me?" "No." Kang Hyuk slowly rose from his seat and approached Park Ha. She unconsciously took a step back. "I hate you." "If you hate me so much, why are you entering a sponsorship contract?" "Because I hate you." But contrary to his words, Kang Hyuk gripped Park Ha's chin and kissed her. His breath on her lips was hot.

title: I Have a Penglai Immortal Island
summary: A theme park called [Nevernight] suddenly became famous in China. It features the ‘Penglai Realm’ supported by a seven-level formation; ‘Sea Monster Castle’ rumored to be inhabited by mermaids, complete with a glass tunnel leading to the deep sea; the mysterious and eerie ‘Yellow Springs Path’; and the opulent ‘Divine Capital City’… Visitors who have been there are all left questioning reality, thinking, “Has the world developed this much without me knowing?” The owner must be incredibly wealthy! Just the vast number of marine creatures in the underwater world must cost a fortune! Xiong Zhaozhao: You might not believe it, but all those creatures are just things I happened to collect while fishing…

title: The Omnipurpose Restaurant in Dungeon City
summary: A story about running a restaurant in a dungeon city without going into the dungeons.

title: Reason for Marriage
summary: “To be my wife, you have to keep the three things I said earlier. Can you do it? If you don’t want to, go back now.” What Sang-yeon wanted from Minju was a wife and a ghost bride. A being that exists, but does not exist. “No, this is my home now. I’m not going back.” Minju and Sang-yeon agreed to a secret marriage between the two unbeknownst to the rest of the world. Why didn’t Minju suspect it even once? She should have been suspicious of Park Sang-yeon, a world-renowned conductor representing Korea, when he said he loved her. As to the real reason why he wanted to marry her.

title: Regarding the Game I Made Surpassing 10 Million Downloads. If I Earn 2 Billion, I Think I’ll Get a Cat
summary: Michi Rokuzaka had an accident and was forced to be hospitalized for a long period of time. To pass the time, she created and released a game, which quickly went viral on the internet. On his collarbone, the crimson Chestnut Kite soul-mark flickered with light… Li Yuezhao pulled her hand away, stood tall, and looked down at him. “If you like me, then work hard to make yourself worthy of me.” Suddenly, a massive figure appeared out of nowhere. Ignoring the beastman kneeling on the ground, he wrapped a dominant arm around Li Yuezhao’s slender yet strong waist. “Zhaozhao, I want to marry you.” You once said that a male’s external strength and internal tenderness are his best dowry. We are willing to offer everything we own, just to pray for a single glance from you!

summary: Bai Jinxi is the only daughter of a herbal medicine family, but she misunderstands people and takes a thief as her mother, which leads to the destruction of her family and the extinction of the Bai family! In her previous life, everyone was sorry for her. The only warmth she had came from a little maid she misunderstood and a man with a steady voice who she had only heard one sentence from… After rebirth, she is no longer a weak little white flower, but a revenge queen with deep scheming. Using herbal medicine and medical skills, she takes every step carefully, vowing to destroy the enemy and keep everything! But is the lazy and dandy prince opposite really the mysterious man who gave her dignity in her previous life? With the silent support and protection of King Yi, she will embark on a road of counterattack in a world where power and love are intertwined. Fate reincarnation, hatred and redemption, how will Bai Jinxi achieve phoenix nirvana in the bloody storm?

title: After Joining the Ghostly Beings, Even My Farts Smell Fragrant
summary: Ghostly Resurrection, the apocalypse descends, and everyone struggles for survival. Etiquette collapses, morality declines, and for survival, people betray each other, fully revealing the evil of human nature. In his previous life, Si Ming was betrayed by a villain and died with regret. After being reborn, Si Ming, deeply reflecting on his pain, decided to stop being human! A woman? Why not find a Ghostly Being as a wife, beautiful and useful. A brother? Why not become sworn brothers with a Ghostly Being, loyal and helpful. A foster father? Why not recognize a Ghostly Being as a foster father, the benefits are immense! After joining the Ghostly Being camp, Si Ming was surprised to find that this apocalypse didn't seem so bad. "In my previous life, I was timid and subservient, everyone treated me like a grandson." "In this life, even my farts smell fragrant!" "What did you say? Someone wants to join me? Of course, there can never be too many two-legged sheep." When the Allied Forces fought their way to the most terrifying Demon King in the Ghostly World, people were shocked to discover that sitting on the throne was a human! Looking at those who had betrayed him, Si Ming revealed a ferocious smile. "Welcome to my paradise, have you all written your wills?"

title: Transmigrated as the Only Ordinary Girl in an All-Alpha Military Academy
summary: Due to an accident, Ai Li, an ordinary high school senior, had the misfortune of transmigrating bodily into a bizarre ABO world. To make matters worse, she starts off in an all-Alpha military academy, becoming roommates and classmates with a group of wealthy and influential cadets. Although these high-and-mighty young masters are quite easy on the eyes, they are, unfortunately, a group of arrogant, elitist, and extremely violent lunatics who discriminate against the weak. And Ai Li, stuck in the middle of them, is a “weakling” who takes five minutes to run 800 meters and can’t even lift a chicken. Ai Li: “…” In this world, she has no foundation. To avoid being bullied, expelled, or ending up homeless on the streets, Ai Li bites the bullet and decides to survive in this terrifying military academy. First, she must start by building good relationships with these “Celestial Dragon” young masters— Not only does she play the role of the caring logistics support for the cool guy who ranks first in her dorm (holding his umbrella while he fights and cooking for him while he hunts), striving to be his best combat partner; She also carefully balances her standing amidst the factional wars between the various young masters of the military academy to build trust. Her premise for not becoming a target of bullying is to first become their friend, partner, and “good brother.” One day, she even accidentally rescued the “Omega-pretending-to-be-Alpha” from the next dorm during his heat! After Ai Li’s series of maneuvers, her efforts prove very effective. Everyone’s attitude toward her becomes better and better—aside from the fact that they occasionally stare at her with strange eyes, they clearly treat her as one of their own. …But the invitations to shower and sleep together are unnecessary! And hey, don’t secretly climb onto your “brother’s” bed in the middle of the night! Struggling to hide her identity as a girl, Ai Li shivers amidst the boys’ enthusiasm to be “honest and naked” with her, thinking this is just how Alphas express their brotherhood. Until one night she wakes up to find them all gathered around her bedside— Wait?! Why do my “good brothers” have bloodshot eyes and want to bite the back of my neck??? Reading Guide: A story about a lucky-less, ordinary “sweet girl” surviving in an Alpha military academy, caught in a pincer attack (?) by Alphas and an Omega-pretending-to-be-Alpha. Not much focus on competition/battle plots. This is not a “girl-disguised-as-a-boy” story. In the ABO worldview, it’s a “soft girl” trying to pretend to be a “tough Alpha,” resulting in constant “car crashes” (fails) while mingling with muscle-bound monster young masters. Characterization: Not a “Strong Female Lead.” The FL has specialties that help her survive, but she is essentially a soft girl! title: Crazy Mother and Daughter Make a Comeback in the Era
summary: Tang Lin and her daughter Leng Hui, a mother-daughter pair from the starving, freezing apocalypse, woke up from a deep sleep to find themselves in the 1970s. The story began with their lives on the line, urgently awaiting surgery. A grandmother who was a stingy, money-grubbing miser? A father who was spinelessly and blindly filial? No problem. To save her mother, Leng Hui ripped the money right out of her grandmother's pants to pay for the life-saving procedure. Denied food? They would pick the locks to fill their stomachs. Denied money? Tang Lin told outsiders she was a widow, and told insiders that Leng Hui's father was dead, but her mother was very much alive. Her cousin wanted to steal her prospective blind date. Leng Hui: "A man who can be so easily stolen isn't a good man. It's no loss to let him go." The second branch of the family wanted to seize their inheritance, leaving them with nothing. Tang Lin: "What an ugly way to eat. Aren't you afraid of choking to death?" A man was old-fashioned, feudal, and too stubborn. Tang Lin: "There are thousands of handsome men and millions of wonderful women in this world. Life goes on just fine without any single person." Everyone said the mother and daughter, Tang Lin and Leng Hui, were rebellious, unconventional, and refused to settle down. The pair scoffed: Now that we're in this era, how can men possibly be more appealing than a career? Rely on a mountain, and it will collapse. Rely on a person, and they will run. Only relying on yourself is the most reliable.

"There’s nothing in common between the two of us. We’ve never gone on a date together, never met each other's colleagues or friends, and we don’t even live like a normal married couple." title: The Assassin Girl Who Stayed by My Side in Another World… Somehow Followed Me Back to Modern Japan
summary: At just sixteen, Hiroto was suddenly summoned to another world. He spent eight long years fighting, struggling, and surviving—until he finally made it back home. Naturally, he was anxious about how people would treat him after so long. But to his relief, his body had returned to the same sixteen-year-old state it was in when he’d first disappeared. His parents were gone. The only family he had left was his older sister—and it was for her sake that he made returning home his one and only goal. That determination fueled his journey through the other world, and finally setting foot back in his own world filled him with a wave of relief. …But along with that relief came a heavy, lingering emptiness. Little did Hiroto know, that emptiness wouldn’t last long. Just minutes after his return, the girl he’d practically raised like a daughter suddenly showed up in his world, too. And she had no intention of leaving him behind.

The period is six months. Decide after that whether the engagement will be broken. Objections will not be accepted.” But the king’s order blocks her from ending it quickly. “There is no breaking off this engagement between us. Ever.” The fiancé who always used to run away with an annoyed expression now begs her desperately, saying he will never let her go! “What in the world is going on?” With obstacles appearing everywhere, can Marie really succeed in breaking off the engagement safely?

title: I Was Stranded on a Deserted Island with a Beautiful Classmate

Together with Mana, Tetsu begins a survival adventure, but soon more girls from his class are found, and it eventually turns into a harem. One guy and fifteen girls...Will they end up competing for him!?
