The strongest Devil Fruit user in history! The most powerful man in the world! A man whose flames can evaporate entire oceans! The Emperor of Fire! Supreme Commander of the Flame Emperor Pirate Fleet! One of the Four Emperors! Flame Emperor Portgas D. Ace! Capture or kill—his bounty: 5,369,000,000 Berries!"
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem

title: School Life of the Strongest Mercenary Girl
summary: The strongest mercenary — Ainz Worker. He had a daughter he once took in, named Sierra. Sierra was raised on the battlefield, living and growing amid war. She thought her life would continue that way forever — until one day, Ainz announced his retirement from mercenary work. Through her father’s connections, Sierra transitions from the life of a mercenary to that of a student in the royal capital’s academy. However, having only known the ways of the battlefield, living an ordinary life… might not be so easy for her!?
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Sports

title: Isekai Tanjou Series
summary: “It’s sh*t among shit. First, the genre is bad. At an age like this, a fantasy novel is unlikely to be successful.” In the year 2006, Spring. 6th-grade elementary schooler Shimada Chika was fed up with her mother who kept preparing food for her brother, Takashi, who was run over by a truck last year. Chika was able to stay patient with everything else, but she was annoyed from the bottom of her heart with the new hobby that her mother started. Fumie operated the PC awkwardly, and wrote a light novel using the plot that Takashi left behind. It was a fantasy novel about Takashi being reincarnated in a different world, and used the knowledge of the present world to make weapons and stood against the demon lord. Chika, who wanted her to stop writing, consulted the former driver who hit her brother with a truck, Katayama., but Katayama was fascinated by the novel that Fumie wrote, and proposed a certain plan to Chika—. In some pointless and hollow era, however, it was an intense age. In the chaotic sea of the internet, Love, Sin, and Desire came together, and an “Isekai” raised its birthing cry.
genres: Drama, Mystery, Psychological, School Life, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: My Friend’s Younger Brother’s Secretary
summary: “You said there’s a connection you want to erase? Then erase it with this.”By chance, Haeru acquires a mysterious eraser and uses it to erase her ties with her worst ex-boyfriend. Soon after, new memories begin to fill her mind. Among them are faint recollections of moments that never existed—memories involving Mu-hyeok, her friend’s younger brother.Before she can even adjust to these unfamiliar memories, Yoon Haeru, now working as a secretary, comes face to face with her boss—who turns out to be none other than Chae Mu-hyeok.“It’s been a while, Yoon Haeru.” “…You’re Chae Mu-hyeok?”Looking at Mu-hyeok’s face brings back memories that should never have existed—memories she could never have imagined under normal circumstances.Memories of spending the night with Mu-hyeok…“Yeah. So, look at me for a bit… see how well I’ve grown up.” A sweet romance story between Chae Mu-hyeok, a straightforward younger man who only has eyes for Haeru, and Yoon Haeru, a capable woman going through a phase of denying her growing attraction.

title: [●REC] Horror Streamer’s Survival Broadcast
summary: If you don’t record, you die. If you don’t broadcast, you die. In this merciless and irrational situation, the only thing I had to do to survive was pick up my phone. “This is real. Absolutely not fiction.”

title: It Was You From The Start
summary: “Let’s end it here.” Jinwon and Ina, a campus couple envied by everyone. Their love shattered with one sentence from Jinwon. Ina barely managed to speak, looking like she had been hit on the head. "Is it because I'm pregnant? You want to break up?" Ina shivered with betrayal and heartbreak. Seven years later. Jinwon appeared as Ina's direct superior. Ina was still burning with betrayal, yet this man acted as if nothing had ever happened. “Am I that terrible?” Does that even need to be said? Why is this man acting like this?
genres: Adult, Mature, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors: Alterna
summary: A novelization of the game, Zero Escape: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors, with some slight difference. The story follows Junpei who was abducted and placed aboard an empty, sinking cruise liner along with eight other people. The cruise liner resembles the RMS Titanic, a ship which killed over 1500 in the early 20th century. The nine people were forced to participate in the "Nonary Game", a deadly game which involves numerical bracelets, small bombs in each player's stomach that will detonate and kill them if they disobey, exploring the ship and solving escape-the-room puzzles in order to survive and escape before they drown in 9 hours. The players also attempt to find out why they were kidnapped.

title: The Hand of Redemption
summary: I didn't want to be seatmates with the school bully. But his mother begged me not to switch. She even held up five fingers to me. So, whenever the bully stepped out of line, I gave him a slap. If he dared to throw a tantrum, he got the full Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms. I literally slapped that bully all the way into a top-tier 211 university. Afterward, the bully's mother transferred 500,000 yuan to my account. Me: "?" Wait, holding up her hand didn't mean I was supposed to slap him?

title: The Strongest PK Killer of All Time
summary: Nishiki Hanatsuki, a corporate drone and a disappointment, began playing a VRMMO (Virtual Reality Massively Multiplayer Online) game called “Real Life Online”, or “RL”. However, the class he chose to play as was a “trader”, considered one of the worst classes of all in RL. One day, he undertook one final mission to end things, but chanced upon Player Killers (PK) during it. With it being two against him, it was a hopeless situation that led to awakening the trader’s hidden skill. After killing the PKers, the skill responded to the desires held deep within Nishiki: “I want to fight against even stronger enemies.” After that day, he gladly took on one PKer after another, fighting and making his way to take down the ever-present PKer boss. Now, together with all the traders who’d given up in the past, their actions are creating waves across the entirety of RL.

title: Harem in The Inn
summary: — Listen carefully, Lord Russell. Lord Russell, you have received a marriage proposal from that elf! And having received the proposal, you only took the proposal gift, which was a bow, and then fled!!! — Me, who ran away after receiving a marriage proposal because I didn’t understand Elvish… She’s coming after me. Searching for me… But why? I just wanted to quietly run an inn, that’s all
genres: Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The B-Rank Esper Wants to Make Money
summary: “Water.” “Yes, sir.” “Gloves.” “Right away!” “The air’s stuffy.” “I’ll open the window!” These are the sounds of Haru Lee, a broke B-rank Esper, being bossed around by Shin Dogun, an S-rank Esper. Hang in there, Haru. Big reward money doesn’t come easy! First things first: becoming Dogun’s partner is the top priority. * * * “You’ve done well this week.” “So, about being partners…?” “That means I have no intention of accepting you.” Haru’s patience has run out. At this point, it’s self-defense. “What’s your problem, huh? Sure, maybe I look pathetic to a high-and-mighty S-rank like you. But you can’t just toy with people, work me like a s*ave, and then suddenly say you don’t want me? And you call yourself an S-rank Esper?! Forget it. I quit!” * * * Yeah, Haru definitely went off yesterday like there was no tomorrow. So why is everything suddenly upside down? “I’ll accept you. As my partner.” Dogun’s words made Haru narrow her eyes in suspicion. “But you’ll have to guide me. If you succeed, I’ll pay you five million gold.” “F-Five million?” Haru swallows hard. “And for every successful guiding after that, I’ll add another million gold.” The words are barely out before Haru nods so fast it’s dizzying. Wait. Hold on. Can I even guide someone? I’m an Esper… not a Guide!

title: Princess’s Journey: Qing Qing Zi Zhi
summary: From the moment I was born, my Father Emperor could hear my inner thoughts. [Whoa, so my Father Emperor is actually a brilliant and divine Emperor for the Ages!] [It's a pity he has a few stains on his record.] [First, he'll act on impulse and execute a great hero who served him well, only to cry afterward and curse others for not stopping him.] [Then, he'll execute the Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, brewing a wrongful case that will shock the world for centuries, all while shifting the blame onto his ministers.] [He'll praise the Grand Preceptor as a 'clear mirror' in public, but after the man dies, he'll raid his tomb and whip the corpse.] [And the biggest death wish of all: he clearly loves my Mother Empress so much, yet he insists on making her give birth over and over again. When she eventually dies in childbed, he'll be holding some other beauty while reminiscing about my mother. What a total s*umbag.] My Father Emperor's brow twitched again and again. Finally, he couldn't hold it together anymore. "Quickly! Go and invite the masters from Huguo Temple!"
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: I’m the Only One Who Doesn’t Know That My Sister Is My Step-Sister – The Beautiful Twin Sisters Want to Seduce My Brother Who Knows Nothing
summary: We’re stepsisters, but it’s fine if Onii-chan doesn’t know, right? The protagonist, Yuto Otaru, has two sisters who are the talk of the town: the beautiful twin sisters. The older twin, Yuri Otaru, is an honor student, while the younger twin, Kairi Otaru, is a blonde gal. One night, the stunning sisters, Yuri and Kairi, overhear their parents in the living room discussing the shocking truth: there’s no blood relation between the twins and Yuto. The spark in the eyes of the two, who have loved their brother Yuto since childhood, begins to change…

title: A Swordsman Reincarnated into a Great Lineage
summary: Seo Woo-jin, a secret agent of the Hunter Association, was an unawakened person, but realized the ultimate power of the sword and was called by the codename 'Sword Ghost'. He fell into a trap during a mission and met a miserable end, but when he opened his eyes,he was reincarnated as the youngest child of the Shingeom cheon family, a renowned hunter family with a great bloodline. "Only I can overcome this punishment." Cheon Woo-jin, who escaped the severe punishment with the martial arts he learned in his past life and awakened SS-level abilities, walks the path of a swordsman for revenge.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery

title: The Right Way to Seduce a Villain
summary: 【Lian Sheng was forced to marry General Yi Qiancheng, who was said to be ruthless and merciless.】 This man had been jilted by her family during his time of misfortune. After making a comeback, he was ambitious and domineering. 【Yi Qiancheng exuded an air of wanting to destroy her at any moment.】 To save her life, Lian Sheng braced herself and began showering him with sweet talk. “Your stature is more majestic than the mountains of Daliang, your demeanor broader than the Xiangnao River. From the moment I first saw you, I was utterly captivated by your brilliance.” He squinted. “Oh? Seems like there’s something wrong with your eyes. Shall I dig them out for you?” “…” Yi Qiancheng: A shallow, ignorant fool like Lian Sheng thinks I’d fall for her sugary nonsense? Ha! Lian Sheng: But you clearly enjoy it quite a bit. Yi completely caught off guard Qiancheng: … 【How to survive in the clutches of a vengeful villain】 —Of course, you make him fall in love with you. Fall. In. Love. With. You! A male lead who is arrogant on the surface but soft at heart × A female lead with max-level sweet-talking skills Male lead in the beginning → An unruly wild wolf Male lead later → Puppy mode +

title: Inventory of HSR: Whose Characters Will Break After Seeing the Truth?
summary: The Live Broadcast Room descends upon the Honkai: Star Rail Universe and Teyvat. The broadcast starts immediately with the future plot, the Penacony chapter! Aventu**ne: Three gambling chips are enough, all, or nothing! Firefly: I dreamed of a barren land, a new sprout breaking through the earth... Moths flocking to the flame, born to die! Acheron: May death end your long, drawn-out dream... leading you back to the world of clarity. Mikhail: Having reached the end of the journey of life, I will leave this self-proclaimed precious flame in the deepest part of the dream, hoping to pass it on to the nameless guests of the next generation. Ternan: Some things, even if meaningless, must ultimately be done. Until the very end, Sunday descends! “I shall ascend to the heavens, transforming into the Sun in the sky.” “Multitudes shall flourish eagerly beneath my light, and all evil shall have no place to hide.” “If your paradise can save more people, then cut off my path forward with your own hands.” The First Day granted truth. The Second Day granted the calendar. The Third Day granted language. ... Prepare to witness, the Primal Order is at hand!
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: The Bottom-Tier Adventurer Middle-Aged Guy: Realizing My Unexpected Cheat Abilities in the Territory Management Game for an Effortless Real-Life
summary: After being reincarnated into a fantasy world from an unremarkable life, the protagonist expected his new life to be just as unremarkable. However, He soon realize that the “game” skills he thought were useless are actually incredible. Thus begins the tired old man’s late-blooming, cheat-filled adventure in a new world.

title: Where the Saint’s Gun Is Pointed
summary: She lost everything—her dreams, her hands, and her fame.Due to an explosion at a shooting range, Min Su-ji, once the youngest national representative in shooting, vanished along with the flames. Her fingers, grotesquely fused from burns, could no longer hold a gun.After graduation, she scraped by with part-time jobs—until one day, she was hit by a hit-and-run car. As she closed her eyes, part of her felt relieved.Because maybe, just maybe, this miserable life would finally end. But… what is this?When she opened her eyes, strangers she’d never seen before were surrounding her.Before she could even grasp the situation, a gun—one without even a spent cartridge—was placed in her hands.…A gun, in my hand?Strangely, her hands and face were unscathed, just like before the accident.“Prove that you are the Saintess.”It was instinct that made her aim at the monster attacking the priest and pull the trigger.A white light gathered at the muzzle of the empty gun and pierced the monster right between the eyes. As the creature turned to ash and scattered, everyone nearby fell to their knees in reverence.They said the new Saintess had finally come to save them.And through the crowd, a man with beautifully curved eyes approached her.“So, this is the fine specimen you said you found?” Even as he looked her directly in the eyes, he called her a “specimen.” He smiled kindly—but his gaze was ice-cold.

title: What? I’m a Writer—You’re Telling Me to Become an Idol?!
summary: Choi Seohan—28 years old, unemployed, and a web novel author infamous for producing nothing but flops. His stories barely scraped ten views on average, and it seemed his life as a struggling writer would end in complete poverty. Then one drunken night, he muttered a single line. “I should’ve just become an idol… Writing doesn’t even make money!” …He never imagined that one sentence would become the button that flipped his entire life upside down. [Quest: Then why don’t you try it yourself.] “Where exactly does a life start to go wrong?” Become an idol trainee within the given time limit. Time Remaining: 87 days Failure Penalty: Automatic Upload of Unfinished Manuscripts All the embarrassing, unpublished failures buried deep in your folder will be sent to everyone. Singing? Dancing? The only thing he knew how to do was type on a keyboard. If I’m a writer, couldn’t you at least throw me into one of my own novels? But the genre of this life is now: [Idol] And this time— I swear I’ll reach the ending. 🎤📖
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Heavenly Lord of the Myriad Realms
summary: What are the heavens? Aloof and solitary, none can measure it’s might. It is law. It is commandment. It is merciless. It is unfeeling. Overlooking all existence, controlling the winds and clouds, stripping reward and punishment, leisurely yet capable. For these reasons, the Will of Heaven cannot be measured, the firmament cannot be approximated. Obey it and yield to it even though it may not be to one’s benefit. Oppose it and rebel against it, fortune and disaster however are hard to determine. Heaven, imprisoning the manifold existences like a deep well, the living things of the mortal world as mud. There existed such a very simple, very resolute frog at the bottom of the well, cautiously guarding his mind there were a few, faint rays of light, bearing the meager convictions to absolutely nibble upon swan meat. Step by step from amidst the mire of the mortal world, struggling to leave, step by step to exit the unseeable depths of the sordid, deep well. When he opened his great mouth towards the thoughts of nipping the swan, recklessly taking the firmament and swallowing it down in one bite! Chu Tian said, lacking money, demand even more money; lacking life, demand to pay with one’s life. This is exactly Chu Tian’s determined, most simple and firm principle. This principle is greater than heaven!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Real Mother of the Wealthy Family’s Rebellious Son is Back
summary: Lu Xi dreamt that she would die in a year. After her death, her son grew up to be a notorious rebellious young man due to lack of discipline and died in a racing accident. Out of anger, she fainted and woke up sixteen years later. The wealthy family was still the same, her husband was richer, more handsome, and more caring than before. But what’s the use of earning so much money if he couldn’t even manage their son? Seeing Xie Yizhao, Lu Xi, with a dark face, pushed him against the wall, “The man surnamed Xie, can you manage our son? If you can’t, I will!” Xie Heng, seeing his nearly 1.9-meter-tall father being pinned, irritably pulled them apart, “Take your little lover and go have fun elsewhere, stop bothering me!” Xie Yizhao glared at him, “Shut up, this is your real mom.” Xie Heng: Huh? His dad was out of his mind, bringing a pretty young woman in her twenties not only to be his stepmom but also claiming she was his real mom? To avoid being controlled, Xie Heng deliberately opposed Lu Xi. He skipped classes and stayed out playing until midnight. Lu Xi set a curfew, barring him from entering the house and making him sleep in the garage. When he got into a fight and injured his head, Lu Xi bandaged him up and sarcastically handed him a cup of walnut milk, “Drink this to boost your brain.” When he played with motorcycles, Lu Xi had Xie Yizhao ride one too, with her on the back seat, following Xie Heng wherever he went, turning his rebellious acts into family activities. Xie Heng: How can I enjoy this anymore!!! He surrendered. Was admitting defeat okay? Lu Xi was definitely his real mom! Lu Xi didn’t think much; she just wanted to manage her son and work on her career. As for her husband, she didn’t care much; a superficial marriage was fine with her. Unexpectedly, Xie Yizhao clung to her like a miser, fearing she would disappear again someday! Even more outrageous, the father and son almost blew up the kitchen competing to make breakfast for her! On Xie Heng’s school parent-teacher conference day, his classmates laughed at how obedient he was in front of Lu Xi, joking that he was afraid of his stepmom. Xie Heng blushed angrily, “Shut up, she’s my real mom!”
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Quick Transmigrated:The Woman Disguised herself as a Man and took the Man’s Place
summary: Once she traveled through time, Su Yu became a prince who successfully seized the throne of Great Qi Dynasty but disguised as a man - The head of a noble family who looked down on the world. The gentle and elegant young imperial teacher Tuo Luo, the unruly, brave and resourceful undefeated general, the world’s richest man who was rich enough to make a country strong, he, he, he, he, are all the male protagonists who will rebel against her in the future… The system told Su Yu that she traveled through time and space to a hegemony story with four male protagonists, and she was the king of the country who was rebelled against. If she wanted to survive, she must conquer one of the four male protagonists. System: Host, which male protagonist do you want to conquer? Su Yu thought about it: I want them all. System: shy.jpg, it’s not good for the host to do this… After traveling through time for one day, Su Yu coaxed the powerful male protagonist I to escort her to the capital to succeed to the throne. After traveling through time for three months, Su Yu coaxed the talented male protagonist II to be her full-time butler . After traveling through time for half a year, Su Yu coaxed the wealthy male protagonist III to donate all his belongings to her. After traveling through time for a year, Su Yu pulled the high and mighty male protagonist IV down from the altar… Later, the system looked at the male protagonists kneeling in front of Su Yu with forbearing and fiery eyes, and said with difficulty: Host, you can’t open a harem… Su Yu smiled and agreed: No, a good man has ambitions in all directions, how can he be bound by the harem? Before the system could breathe a sigh of relief, Su Yu said again: I still need them to work hard for me. System: … Su Yu gave an innocent smile. What bad thoughts could a lonely time-traveling woman have? She just wanted to be a real emperor with great power, and the male protagonists were the best knives in her hands.
genres: Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I’m Coming Down to the Hero Comics!
summary: My late aunt came back to life, but in exchange, I have to wear a hero suit every night.

title: Survive As The Hero’s Wife
summary: I possessed the wife of the hero of the novel. Well, so to be precise, as a villainous supporting character and extravagant wife who died at the hands of the hero. But if I treat him nicely from when he was young, wouldn’t he divorce me nicely later? ** “Divorce…?” “His Majesty seems to want you to marry the Duchess of Lancaster, and The Empress….She wants it too…I’m just going to be someone in your path, and I just can’t help myself.” “So if I give you a divorce, you will run to Noah and cajole him?” “What?” “Don’t be ridiculous. I didn’t struggle on the battlefield for my wife and brother to fool around. I’m sure you had fun while I was away.” Why did his brother’s name come up?

title: The Mage Who Reads Patterns
summary: I can see mana patterns..

title: Master Descends the Mountain: My Senior Sister Spoils Me Too Much
summary: [Invincible story, every word is satisfying, the plot moves quickly, no dragging, decisive in action] At my graduation banquet, my parents and brothers were brutally killed, and I was hunted down. By a stroke of luck, I escaped and spent five years training in martial arts on Kunlun Mountain. Now, I return with great strength! "You’re a top heir, do you think I can’t handle you? My master could slap you to death with a single blow!" "You’re the king of traditional Chinese medicine? My master is the descendant of the ghost gate, using thirteen needles to decide the life and death of the world!" "You’re a grandmaster martial artist, above everyone but the emperor? My master is stationed at Kunlun Mountain, with grandmasters from all over the world coming to pay respects!" "You’re the King of Jiangnan, holding immense power? My master was once the emperor’s teacher, your superior’s superior!" "You have billions in assets, controlling the world’s financial system? My master controls the printing press, and your money was issued by him!" Such an invincible master, Ye Beichen has 99 of them.

title: Love Never Ceases
summary: In the third year of my "strategy" mission, I got pregnant. The System, however, told me it had mistaken the female lead. Tears of gratitude streaming down my face, I packed up and ran away overnight. Ten minutes later, my CEO husband, who was supposed to be in England, appeared in the bedroom. His eyes looked wounded, his lips pursed slightly: "In the 'Reason for Divorce' column, you wrote that I used too much force. I can change that. "I’ll be gentle from now on, okay?" Seeing the strange, unnatural color of his pupils, I burst into tears: "I’ve been afraid of snakes since I was little."
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural

title: Humans Shrunk 100 Times
summary: The world has plunged into an apocalypse, and humans have shrunk in size. Houses now resemble towering skyscrapers, tables and chairs seem like massive structures, c*ckroaches are like speedy sports cars, and mice appear as gigantic beasts. Industries have collapsed, and agriculture lies abandoned. The question arises: can civilization endure, and can humanity reclaim its position at the top of the food chain? Survival, exploration, hunting, construction, farming, and the quest for dominance ensue. Chen Mu wakes up in the classroom, picking up a half-broken staple from the ground, gazing at this vast new world...

title: Young Ladies, Please Spare Me
summary: He thought that as long as he completed the missions properly, he’d be able to return. But… Lin Feng: “Weren’t you the one who promised me they wouldn’t fall for me?!” Before him stood several women, each gripping a longsword, pressing him for an answer. “Who exactly will you choose?” The gentle maiden, the cold and aloof fairy, the proud empress—at that moment, Lin Feng bitterly regretted ever believing the nonsense spouted by that damned system.

title: Leaving the Team Is a Death Sentence? But I Have a Demon King Mom!
summary: Klein is at a loss—he’s been kicked out of the hero’s party. The kind of “expelled-from-the-party” storyline he imagined never came; instead, a series of blows hit him one after another. First, his wages were only just enough to settle the Adventurers’ Guild fees. Then, after losing his job and with his credit ruined, he couldn’t stay at inns or rent equipment, which meant he couldn’t complete commissions and had to pay hefty breach penalties. Having spent all his savings, before he could even catch his breath, he accidentally caught a cold—and the doctor is already asking for…
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: God Of Soul System
summary: All Things of this World, Turn to Ashes, Flowing Blade-like Flame! Crossing over to the world of pirates (the One Piece world), eleven years after Gol D. Roger's death, Roja becomes marine hero Garp's nephew and obtains the Sword Soul system, which lets him gain strength without limits and learn various skills. Flowing Blade-like Flame (Ryūjin Jakka), Mirror Flower, Water Moon (Kyoka Suigetsu), Moon Fang Heaven-Piercer (Getsuga Tensho), Thousand Cherry Blossoms (Senbonzakura)…… Roja looked at Akainu in front of him and told him seriously “If this sword descends, you may be roasted to death.”

title: A Swordsman Genius Who Sees the Future
summary: It is a time when the descendants of the Sword King and the Poison King are always fighting. The Sword King’s family, the Granble family, was completely destroyed. But the last survivor opened their eyes to the future — they gained the power to see what’s coming.

title: The Stepmother From A Peasant Family Skillfully Farms
summary: After traveling back in time to an ancient peasant family, the house was empty, her parents-in-law had passed away early, her husband had died, and she was left with four radishes to feed. As the notorious and cruel stepmother who mistreated her children, Su Mulan didn't have time to stare speechlessly at the sky. She calmly rolled up her sleeves, reclaimed wasteland for farming, set up stalls for business, and raised livestock... The stepmother farms, raises children, deals with troublemakers, and works towards a prosperous and comfortable life. This heartwarming story of farming and business involves daily activities of making money and raising children, leading a leisurely life. It includes food, child-rearing methods, struggles and challenges, achievements and laughter. The story mainly focuses on warmth, lightly touches on troublesome characters, and does not involve any system elements.

title: My Senior Sisters Are Super Protective
summary: The eldest senior sister, a palace master, is already invincible in the mortal world; The second senior sister, chairwoman of the top financial conglomerate in Daxia, has a net worth of hundreds of billions; The third senior sister, a legendary military goddess of the northern region, commands an army of 100,000 elite soldiers; The fourth senior sister, an international superstar and master of a deadly assassin organization; The fifth senior sister, a divine doctor capable of miraculous healing. And me? I can only rely on my senior sisters for everything… Life’s sweet like that.

title: My Dad is My Mom’s Mortal Enemy
summary: The Shao and Cheng families have been sworn enemies for generations, though few outsiders know the exact details of their feud. What is known to all is the Shao family’s three cardinal rules: The Shao family must not cooperate with the Chengs, must not intermarry with the Chengs, and must never appear with the Chengs at any public event. One day, an adorable little girl looking like a doll, wearing a puffy pink dress, pink hair clip, and pink backpack, walked into the lobby on the first floor of the Shao Group building. The receptionist thought she was some child who had wandered away from home. But the little girl solemnly said, “I want to see your Shao Group CEO, Shao Chengze.” Seeing the girl’s pink outfit, the receptionist knew she must be from a wealthy and noble family to dare to address their CEO by his full name. She couldn’t be the daughter of some high-ranking Shao Group executive? Smiling warmly, she asked, “Little one, could you tell me your parents’ names?” The girl tilted her head. “My mommy is Cheng Jinlan.” Cheng…Jinlan?! Second Miss Cheng Jinlan of the Cheng family?! She never thought she’d see the day a Cheng would set foot in the Shao Group building. What a miracle! “As for my dad, I’ve come today to get some of Shao Chengze’s hair for a DNA test. Once I have his hair, I’ll know if he’s my dad or not.” The girl’s crisp words rippled outwards from the front desk through the bustling first floor lobby. Everyone who heard froze in shock, jaws dropping. Everyone except Shao Chengze, who had just stepped out of the elevator surrounded by a group. He looked at the girl in pink through narrowed, fox-like eyes. Cheng Liqi recognized Shao Chengze and covered her mouth in an “ah-oh”. title: The Lazy Daily Life of a Little Noblewoman
summary: Shen Yunying had a face like a hibiscus flower, charming and voluptuous—a classic beauty in the making. Although she had a Grand Tutor for a grandfather, her father died young, leaving her and her mother to live like two invisible people in the Taishi Mansion. Fortunately, her mother possessed a generous dowry and had a broad-minded nature. Shen Yunying was raised to live a life of leisure, letting nothing trouble her heart—a true slacker. Her mother, a widow for many years, thought this was for the best. One's own comfort is what matters most. Men? Not worth getting too worked up about. On the eve of Shen Yunying's coming-of-age ceremony, her mother had already set her sights on her own nephew as a potential son-in-law. However, man's plans are no match for heaven's. Yan Peifeng, the capital's most eligible bachelor, was going to take a wife! Yan Peifeng was the Emperor's own nephew, but his marriage had been delayed due to a period of mourning. Now, the Empress was personally hosting a Flower Appreciation Banquet, inviting all the noble ladies of the capital to the palace. Shen Yunying was forced to attend just to make up the numbers. Who would have thought she would be the one muddle-headedly chosen for the marriage? After a brief moment of surprise, Shen Yunying accepted her fate. Marrying Yan Peifeng meant she wouldn't have to serve parents-in-law or elders, nor would she have to deal with concubines and maids. She could still live a good life. Yan Peifeng was gentle and proper, wholly devoted to his political affairs. He would visit the Rear Courtyard punctually on the first and fifteenth of every month. Shen Yunying lived a wonderful life as a little noblewoman of the capital, even returning to the Taishi Mansion from time to time to visit her mother. But one day, the humble and gentlemanly Yan Peifeng suddenly had a change of heart. He began visiting the Main Residence daily, completely exhausting Shen Yunying! After fretting for a long time, a golden opportunity finally fell from the heavens: Yan Peifeng was to leave the capital to take up a post as a provincial official. A clever idea struck Shen Yunying. She seized the chance to announce that she was pregnant and that it was inadvisable for her to travel far. Alas, she was forcibly carried into the carriage. Yan Peifeng patiently coaxed her, "The scenery at West Lake is delightful. Haven't you always wanted to take your mother to see it? I will speak with the Taishi Mansion on your behalf, how about that? And I won't bother you with any of the Rear Courtyard's affairs; I'll handle them for you." Shen Yunying's beautiful eyes widened slightly. That sounded acceptable. The result was that the news of Yan Peifeng's boundless devotion to his wife spread far and wide, becoming the envy of all. —— Yan Peifeng was full of ambition, but because he had been in mourning for five consecutive years, he was long delayed in entering officialdom. The moment the mourning period ended, his uncle, the Emperor, ordered him to marry first. Yan Peifeng looked coldly at the flock of chattering women and casually pointed to the quietest one, Shen Yunying. All he required was for his Rear Courtyard to be quiet, sensible, and free of drama. Shen Yunying was perfectly qualified, except she seemed a bit too infatuated with him. But Yan Peifeng didn't mind. Until one day, he saw his usually sensible and well-behaved wife showing the same solicitous care to a handsome young man, her smile radiant and her eyes full of affection. In the shadows, Yan Peifeng snapped the Wolf Hair Brush in his hand. #TheAloofBeauty'sSelf-InitiatedRomance #TheGentleAndProperManFightsAndCompetes

Back then, Asakawa Kazuki was still a blazing new star of the ACG world; back then, Pinot Noir was still a genius programmer newly recruited by the Organization; back then… he brought Hagiwara and Matsuda back before him. “Why are you wearing such a sorrowful expression, Senior Bourbon?” Asakawa Kazuki patted Gin, signaling him not to be tense. “It’s nothing more than what I wrote on the IF route—the boy didn’t wait for his salvation and simply turned and walked into the darkness.” Why didn’t the Red Team share the plan with “Noah’s Ark” this time? The bad news is, wishes are hard to come by in this world. The good news is, before he starved to death, he opened a passage to another world overflowing with wishes. The bad news is, most of these wishes are already claimed. The good news is, no one understands wishes better than him. At first, Chaoyang only responded to wishes to survive, but as he grew stronger, he turned it into a business. The place where countless wishes can be fulfilled is the [Paradise] .

title: A Tale of Enduring Brilliance, Love, and Wealth Unfolds

Joseph, a jeweler, is in search of a suitable spouse for his beloved daughter, Sophie. Despite turning away 23 individuals driven by greed, hope shines with the arrival of the 24th suitor, Alan, who happens to be the heir to the Duke of Rohan. Although one might assume that being the eldest son of a noble family, Alan would not be interested in money, he surprises everyone by expressing a simple desire, "Please feed me!" His true passion lies in mathematics, and he plans to relinquish his family estate to his younger brother to dedicate himself fully to his studies. Joseph is skeptical but intrigued by this unique approach, wondering if there might be alternative ways for Alan to find a patron to support his research without staying at his parents' house.

To my scheming stepmother and ruthless sister, I will destroy all your backings, pull off your wings, and step on your arrogance! As for grandmother whom speaks kindly but has a snake-like heart, and a father who is hypocritical and exploits advantages; I will tear off your pretense and cut off your hope! Let’s see how you can still scheme against me! Witness her splendid fight against her stepmother, punish s*um men, and create havoc in the imperial court, as she soars with the wind and rises above the water! But as for that man who still stands! How dare he play with my heart?

She excels in both artifact crafting and pill refining, can control beasts, set up formations... She uses her life to demonstrate what it means to be supreme and peerless, utterly domineering! His brows and eyes curved with a smile as he reached out and gently ruffled the top of her messy hair. “Don’t be afraid.” He lowered his head and leaned closer. When Su Wanwan met Xie Yanning again, his features were cold and stern. His gaze lingered on her for only a second before lightly shifting away, calm and unruffled. As if she were a complete stranger. Su Wanwan lowered her eyes. They had only been high school classmates for one year - it was normal for him not to remember her. title: Hidamari Engagement Record — The Adorable Fiancé and the Realist Lady
summary: Among the fiancé candidates chosen by her family, Lady Iris chooses—Roland, a hardworking civil officer whose gentle, fleeting smile is impossibly cute.In social settings, they’re the perfect “ideal beautiful couple.” But when they’re alone, she casually praises him with “You’re so cute,” and he blushes to the tips of his ears—thus begins a sweetly “role-reversed” relationship of pampering.Realist Iris dislikes “uncertainty.” She manages their relationship through practical methods, like three-line daily cards and a ritual of “choosing each other anew every day.” Roland, meanwhile, faces his quiet insecurity: “I wonder if you really love me.”Through humorous and affectionate exchanges, rainy-day closeness, and occasional work-related misunderstandings, they untangle their hearts using “rules that can be lived by.” In the end, the two arrive at a confession that isn’t about proof, but about choice. —A story that tumbles comically yet ends tenderly, wrapping the finale in a sunlit warmth like a day spent in the gentle light. summary: Somewhere in Japan a young boy spent much of his time in the hospital due to illness. Looking out from the hospital window, he always thought: "I want to be a bird a bird, and fly freely across the never ending sky" On that fateful day, he passed.... Only to find himself reborn as a bird?! But he was different from a normal bird. they don't spit fire from their mouths, right? Now that he could finally fly, he set off, only to find the blue sky being blocked out by dark clouds. This is a story about an unusual bird who wants to fly freely under the blue sky, but is met with dark clouds, said to have adverse effects on all the creatures in the unknown kingdom of Nouzen.

Meanwhile, Lu Nian Nian, the fake heiress raised in the Lu family, had already become famous and had millions of fans. Knowing the truth, Lu Sui Sui couldn't help but wonder, is it that hard to build a career or that unhappy to earn money? Although she didn't plan to become good sisters with Lu Nian Nian, she didn't want to be at odds with her either. What she didn't expect was that Lu Nian Nian was also different from what was described in the book. Not only did she not hate herself, but she also secretly gave herself small gifts and cautiously came to her place to freeload on spicy hot pot. Lu Sui Sui: ...? Can't even afford spicy hot pot? Too, too pitiful! Lu Nian Nian: The spicy hot pot that my sister treats is so delicious. After a while, netizens discovered that Lu Sui Sui, who they had been telling to get out of the entertainment circle, not only didn't leave but was even becoming more and more popular. An X cult organization rose up, with the 'Sui Nian' CP carrying the flag. Lu Sui Sui routinely collaborated with movie emperors, shot commercials with top celebrities, and more importantly, it was rumored that Lu Sui Sui's fiancé was that big shot who owned dozens of companies... Pei Zhixing. Haters:? Playing it so big? How are they, the haters, supposed to work?!

title: Kyokou Suiri
summary: A face-less female ghost wearing a mini-skirt is known to roam around at night in this city. Kalin Nanase is the ghost of a celebrity who died an unnatural death. A detective named Saki Yumihara encounters the ghost of Kalin and is saved by a girl named Kotoko Iwanaga. Kotoko was kidnapped by ghosts when she was a little girl and has ever since served as a mediator between people and ghosts. Kotoko also happened to be dating Saki’s ex-boyfriend Kurou Sakuragawa. Kotoko and Saki work together to solve Kalin’s case.

title: Master of the Desert
summary: Hashar, the devil sultan raised by the desert sandstorm. Ilsia, the king who leads the Devaris tribe, the elixir of life. A steamy fantasy romance set in the hot desert!

title: Bringing a Warehouse to the Song Dynasty!

summary: On the first day Yuna became a class teacher, she became well-known in school because of her looks. On the second day of becoming a class teacher, a student secretly took photos of her with his phone and was called to the principal's office with his Guardian. The person who showed up turned out to be Yuna's university crush, Xiao Chen. To Yuna's surprise, Xiao Chen was the elder brother of the very student whose class she manages. She also realized that this rebellious student causes trouble two or three days out of every week, indirectly giving them many chances to meet. ... When they reunite again, Yuna is puzzled. Wasn't Xiao Chen a poor young master in the past? How come he's now driving luxury cars and living in mansions? Xiao Chen is also puzzled. Wasn't Yuna a rich daddy's girl in the past? How come she's now dressing plainly and squeezing onto public transport?? ... In the eyes of her students, Yuna is very beautiful but has always been diligent and thrifty, with little interest in money. However, one day a Rolls Royce showed up outside school, waiting. Upon seeing Yuna, the chauffeur respectfully opened the door for her, "Miss Yuna, please get in." From that day forth, her true identity set off huge discussions in school.

title: The Keeper of Myths
summary: Pei Xueting, born with the Heaven-Opening Eye, had been mingling in both the Yin and Yang realms since childhood, wandering among demons, monsters, and ghosts. She always thought she could pass through a field of flowers without a single leaf clinging to her. Unexpectedly, one day, she found herself entangled by the Sick Beauty she had personally dug out from an ancient tomb. The Sick Beauty would gasp for breath with every step and collapse at a single glare, yet stubbornly clung to Pei Xueting like a pendant on her thigh, fiercely beating up any little dog who tried to get close to Pei Xueting. Pei Xueting: Don’t come any closer. Sick Beauty: Whimper.

title: Bone Blade
summary: The first time I killed someone, the blade was dull. I was fourteen that year. It was winter, and the north wind whipped against my face with a stinging bite. Three bandits had scaled the wall of my grandfather’s courtyard, intent on stealing the last half-sack of millet he had hidden in the cellar. My grandfather was blind. Hearing the commotion, he called out my name: “Shen He, Shen He!” He was using my alias. My real name is Shen Heyi, and I am a girl. But the bandits didn’t know that, and Grandfather pretended not to know either. He just kept calling, his voice urgent and hoarse, sounding like an old crow being strangled by the neck. I fished out that Bone-Cleaver from beneath the stove. Its edge was curled and nicked, so dull it couldn’t even slice through sheepskin cleanly. But a human neck is softer than sheepskin. I didn’t think about that day again for a very long time-not until I met Xie Changgeng.

title: Delusion
summary: In the school’s equipment room, Liang Jin made a bet with Shen Keye. At the time, she thought he was just toying with her. Liang Jin took the initiative and stood before him, saying, “I’m going to pursue you.” But in her heart, she was only thinking of her seriously ill mother. They were truly worlds apart. When the curtain fell on the young girl’s black ballet dress, Shen Keye stood apart from the crowd, applauding. He was the school’s heartthrob, the famous heir from a prestigious family that everyone at the Hong Kong university knew—the kind who could casually sign off 260,000 on a bill. But behind closed doors, in corners unknown to anyone, she was always baiting him. He mocked her, saying, “Liang Jin, be careful, or I’ll actually mess you up.” Liang Jin thought she would never fall in love with Shen Keye. But the day she truly did fall for him, they had already fallen out completely. An airport farewell kiss stretched into eight years. It was she who left without a word. Years later, they met again. Liang Jin was with her fiancé. A brief encounter after the alumni gathering, his mocking words: “Don’t know her.” And that night, her bathroom at home was invaded. Entangled, moist breaths, and in the darkness, Liang Jin saw the possessiveness flooding the man’s gaze. Shen Keye pushed the woman’s slender shoulders, his voice cold: “Liang Jin, we just broke up. That doesn’t mean we’re not getting married.” Young lovers, trapped in an unrelenting obsession.

Not only does she carry the “cannon fodder” aura—making everyone instinctively dislike her—but the script of the world forces her to recite her original villainous lines. To her utter bewilderment, as she recites these toxic second-fiddle lines, the male lead and supporting leads—who were supposed to love the original heroine—all come knocking on her door, crying and professing their love. Boycott her.” Ad Director: “Her character is terrible; I don’t want to work with her.” Movie Director: “Recommending her to me? Her image doesn’t fit.” Later: TV Director: “Goddess, this female lead role is perfect for you! It’s a massive production!” Screenwriter: “Goddess, I’m tailoring the lead role of my next script specifically for you.” Ad Director: “My Muse, please, just give me one look!” Movie Director: “This role belongs to the Goddess Su Yan and no one else!” Mini Theater 2 Initially, entertainment reports interviewed everyone about their impressions of Su Yan: CEO Ling Tiancheng (with a cold snort): “A vain, gold-digging woman.” Megastar Xu Xingchen (with disdain): “A little liar full of nonsense.” Netizens: “Bad acting, loves hype, clings to CEOs, and leeches off superstars. Basically, we’ll hate Su Yan forever!” Later, after Su Yan wins the Oscar for Best Actress, the media interviews them again: Xu Xingchen (blushing): “My future wife.” Ling Tiancheng (deeply affectionate): “The woman I am pursuing.” Netizens (with a straight face): “Back off! Goddess Su Yan belongs to all of us!” Reading Guide Brainless/Over-the-top Charm: This is a “Mary Sue” style power fantasy. Everyone who hates the female lead will eventually fall in love with her. Male Lead: Xu Xingchen. He has no romantic history with the original heroine of the book, either inside or outside the story. Update Schedule: Daily updates. Protagonist: Su Yan Supporting Characters: The CEO, the Movie King, the Superstar.

title: The Beautiful Drama Queen Becomes a Mediator in the 1970s
summary: [Era + Group Favorite + Hilarious + Military Marriage]

title: Memories of M*rder
summary: Retrovision: An ability to delve into the past of others, which is triggered when he harbors animosity towards them. "What were you thinking before you saw 'that'?" "Something bad. I wanted to kill the culprit." "...why?" "They had something I didn't have, and yet they weren't satisfied with it. They killed the people they should've loved." Must justice always stem from good intentions? No, he will protect the innocent through inferiority and anger.

title: The Man Called Demon Lord in Another World Has Returned!
summary: A man who was kidnapped to another world and eventually became known as the Demon Lord has returned to modern Japan and started high school life. He lives freely and does as he pleases, not hesitating to use force to subdue others. This is that kind of story. The protagonist is neither a villain nor a hero.

title: Magnificent Romance of the Three Kingdoms
Overriding the Heaven
summary: Chu Yan's life went through ups and downs. At the age of fourteen, he stepped into the realm of a fourth level martial arts expert. However, he was framed at the celebratory feast of fifteen and charged with attempting to assassinate the emperor and usurping the throne. In the presence of all the witness and material evidence, he was demoted to a civilian on the spot and sentenced to death. Not only was his martial arts destroyed, the poisoned wine at the banquet was also damaging his body at all times. The Emperor, the Prince, and the Princess colluded just to frame him, the Crown Prince. To Chu Yan, the turning point in his life was probably the pair of earrings left behind by his mother. This echo loop could open a time and space cage called Return to the Ruins Tower. Inside Return to the Ruins Tower, one day was equivalent to three days in the mortal world. Different levels in the tower had different surprises. Chu Yan made up his mind, "When I recover my strength, I will take what you guys took from me, and take it back again!"
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mystery, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Martial Uncle, Your Magic Treasure Is Too Unconventional
summary: Having been a Daoist Priest for half his life, Li Hanzhou won the lottery. He thought he could reach the peak of his life, but unexpectedly, he transmigrated to a world where the Daoist Sect had declined. He even became the acting Sect Master of a third-rate Daoist Temple. Li Hanzhou guessed that as long as he ascended, he could return to Earth. However, his own aptitude was too poor, so he could only place his hopes on his disciples. Li Hanzhou: "The Jianghu is dangerous, I will refine some Magic Treasures and Pills for you to help you cultivate." Senior Disciple: "Martial Uncle, the Soul-Snatching Bell should affect people's minds, but why does your Soul-Snatching Bell make the entire Demon Gate lose bladder control?" Second Disciple: "Martial Uncle, the Seven Treasures Gourd should only collect people's weapons, but why does your Seven Treasures Gourd specifically collect people's clothes? The Saintess of the Grand Profound Sacred Land has been seen naked." Third Disciple: "Martial Uncle, your refined Divine Strength Pill is said to allow one to fight against four. It's really precise! It really can only fight against four; one less person and we can't win!" Li Hanzhou: "That's strange, I refined it according to the instructions!" All Disciples: "Martial Uncle, stop refining, we'll take you to ascend, we're too embarrassed to stay in the human world."
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia, Xuanhuan

title: I’ve Been Reincarnated as a Villainous Aristocrat Who Tries To Steal Women From the Protagonist in an Erotic Fantasy Novel, and I’m Trying To Live an Honest Life, but I Steals Every Single Woman From the Protagonist. Why!
summary: One day, I was reborn in the world of the most popular fantasy novel in the world. I was reborn not as the main character, but as Marcoy Draco, a villainous aristocrat who stands in the way of the main character. Born into an elite family of dark wizards, Marcoy is destined to ultimately fall into darkness and ruin. Knowing the ending of the original story, I don’t want to die, so I vow to live as a decent human being. For now, I thought… to stay away from the hero, but I intercepts the hero’s events. And take the heroines one after another. Wait, wait, wait, I don’t want to do that! I found out that my position and the hero’s were reversed… and the hero fell into the darkness! This is a story about me, who was only an intruding character, who (as a result) takes everything away from the hero. Why!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: Uncover the Death of the Villainess
summary: Be careful of Michael. He is not a good man. Letters from my dead friend started arriving. Is my friend Laura truly a villainess as the rumors say, or is her fiancé Michael the demon? As I delved deeper into my friend's affairs, changes began to occur in me as well. In my premonitory dreams that had been helpful for business, I keep seeing myself being killed. Objects falling from the rooftop of a building and strange things mixed into drinks I'm about to consume. "It seems someone is targeting you, boss. Let's spread a rumor that you're marrying me." "Will that reduce the threats?" "At least I can save your life once in exchange for mine." Pretending to give in, I accepted his proposal, and a new situation unfolds. Is my friend Laura really dead?
genres: Adult, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance

title: I Have Become a Death Worm
summary: I have become a giant and dangerous calamity of the desert.

title: Female Partner Became Popular in a Love Show
summary: Ruan Qiu had been struggling in the world of Infinite Flow for nearly ten years, and her biggest dream was to live well. Unexpectedly, after customs clearance, she entered an entertainment circle love novel and became an actress full of black material. According to the plot, she was a low-end sea king. She would be slapped in the face by the straightforward and lovely heroine in a variety show, she would fail miserably in the love Shura field, and then be rejected by all the guests, and finally be forced by the company’s huge liquidated damages and black fan to su*cide by jumping off the building. Ruan Qiu: The Shura Field is really scary, isn’t it good to live a good life as a passerby. “Please fall in love with me” is a love challenge variety show that gathers top movie stars, popular little flowers, actors/actresses with bad reputation, and men from idol groups… The stars needed to fall in love freely in special scenes, and the program also added: The format is novel, there is no script, and the whole process is broadcasted live, which is very exciting. The audience were all waiting for sweet CP and watching Ruan Qiu being a joke. ——But who can tell them why a love variety show has a mu*der case / palace fight / escape room… ah? Audience: Are we really watching a love variety show instead of a survival variety show? And why is Ruan Qiu so cool in saving people?! The other guests looked at her so ambiguously! Their interaction is so sweet, I will eat her CPs first!

title: The Transmigrated Immortal Woman Is Not to Be Messed With
summary: After Yun Yao reincarnated and crossed over into a new world, she found herself in the midst of a storm of meteors and blazing fire. Facing imminent death, she wanted to escape but found it impossible... because she had turned into a baby! Conflicted and unwilling to die, just when all seemed lost, she was saved by an immortal! Yun Yao thought the danger was over, but in reality, a new threat had only just begun. Thrown into the unknown deep mountains through a spatial rift, she realized that she might just be the unluckiest transmigrator ever. Starving and desperate, an old man descended from the sky... and from that moment on, Yun Yao embarked on an unimaginable, invincible path of immortal cultivation.

title: Phone call
summary: Witches soaring through city skylines on broomsticks. Wyverns and griffins sweeping across the skies! “Hyung, I’ve been waiting for you. This is the true dimension.” Just as Lee Si-woo avenges his family, he’s suddenly pulled into an unfamiliar world— and the treasure slumbering within his soul, Barathrum, awakens! [Synchronization complete. Connecting to Soul Treasure: Barathrum.] [This is Barathrum—a world within a smartphone, to put it simply.] In a brutal realm where humans are deemed an inferior race, Lee Si-woo must carve out his survival as a “Phone-Powered Mage.” [Phone-Powered]

title: My Star Teacher
summary: My biggest achievement is not the first person in the entertainment circle, nor the teacher of all people, nor my wealth and status. My proudest achievement is that I live the way I want, not just Live the look that others want – Ye Guang.
genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Greatest Assassin Hides His Presence
summary: ‘Ah, so I have no presence at all.’ He had lived his entire life with a faint presence. He thought he had become a fine adult who had come to accept his difference from others and knew how to use it. That is, until he fell into this place. “Welcome, everyone.” “You have been chosen as the heroes of a new world.” Kim Jin-woo, who died along with his colleagues in an unforeseen accident, awakens as a hero on the Lumnos continent. He thought if he just defeated the Demon King, he could return home and have his wish granted, but……. “What, I'm being ignored even in a situation like this?” To be ignored not just by humans but even by a goddess in a situation like this. “What you have all received is the blessing of awakening and growth. Now, everyone has received it, right?” “Excuse me? I haven't received it yet? Hello? Can you hear me?” “Then, I look forward to your efforts. The future of the Lumnos continent rests solely on you. Now, go, everyone. Go and create a new legend!” “No, wait a minute. I haven't received anything yet!” His faint presence now acknowledged even by a goddess, Kim Jin-woo must survive as a hero on the Lumnos continent!

title: If I Kept Silently Supporting the Lowest-Ranked Idol in the Popularity Rankings, Before I Knew It, I Was in a Shuraba
summary: For some reason, all of the idols Sakurai Akito supported were at the bottom of the popularity rankings, so everyday he would engage in “Oshi activity”. Whenever there was an event for his idols, he would attend and whisper his love (as an oshi) to his idols. Akito is the type of person who makes a clear distinction between his activities and reality. He is not in love with his oshi, but his idols are apparently not like that…
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Abyss Calling ~When a Former Abysmal Gamer Is Summoned to the Worst Social Game World~
summary: --Can you confront the darkness!? I find myself in a world very similar to the social game [Abyss Calling], in which you use randomly summoned [followers] for adventure. The game is balanced by the management's manipulation of probability, the rare greed sensor installed, and the need to pay for the game! The audacity to call itself Abyss! In a world similar to the shitty game which was called the strongest money collecting system and was terminated by the law after hitting millions of users to the bottom, I stand up again as a caller to accomplish what I left unfinished when I was a player. This is the story of brave summoners who challenge the darkness.

title: Immortal Father
summary: “I was transported, and so was my dad.” Li Ping’an had already arranged everything. He established a solid family business for Old Li in the mortal world, arranged connections for himself to enter an immortal sect, and then set his sights on the path of immortality, ready to seize his opportunity to become an immortal. However, little did he know, everything changed on the day he participated in the aptitude test in the mortal world… This is a Xianxia light comedy novel from the author of My Senior Brother is Too Steady.

title: Came For Revenge, But Fell In Love Instead
summary: I, the wife of the emperor, who used my family to ascend to the throne to become the emperor, was falsely accused of treason. Even my trusted friend who used to call me ‘sister’, betrayed me. My trusted friend stole everything from me and even seduced my husband, who never loved me. And my life ended on a guillotine. So, I begged over and over again to have a chance to kill them with my own hands. Hence, I thought I was dead but upon opening my eyes, I found myself at the engagement ceremony with the Crown Prince, my former husband. For reasons I don’t know, I had returned to the past. I was determined to change the fate I had experienced once, so I had the resolve to bring down the imperial family in order to protect my family. However, just as I vowed to never love someone and instead dedicate myself to revenge, a man appeared before me – someone I never met in my past, at that.

title: Sheep and Orchid
summary: My father was a renowned chef in the neighboring villages, and his Roasted Whole Lamb was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, making everyone crave it. The Regent's favored Concubine heard of it and summoned my father to the Royal Mansion to cook, specifically requesting the Roasted Whole Lamb. My father went, but when he was thrown out, his skin and flesh had been burned and ruined by fire. It turned out that the Concubine had a sudden whim and wanted a Roasted Whole Lamb without the taste of lamb. When my mother found out, she did not shed a single tear. But three months later, she set up a large pot at the gate of the Royal Mansion and began selling lamb.

title: Yoiyama Kaleidoscope
summary: During an excursion with an eccentric acquaintance, I am accused of breaking the Gion Festival Ordinance by a burly posse. Seized and taken on a whirlwind tour through Yoiyama, I come face-to-face with a gallery of exotic, grotesque characters. But who's this "Lord Yoiyama" that they all seem to revere? (Yoiyama Goldfish) I wake up, only to find that today is Yoiyama... just like yesterday was, and the day before that. How in the world am I going to find a way to escape this loop? (Yoiyama Maze) A collection of strange and wonderful short stories, weaving in and out through the backdrop of the Gion Festival's Yoiyama. Morimi takes you into a fantastical world where the colors of fantasy and reality blur into each other like a kaleidoscope.

title: My Tumultuous Years
summary: Whose youth isn't a mess? I was an Illegitimate Child, and my Mother died inexplicably in a car with a married Man. Thankfully, Aunt Jun held up the sky for me. For her, I can ignore all kinds of School Flowers, office ladies, Noble Ladies, and elegant young women. But Aunt Jun only said that if I got into a 985 university, she would let me become a real man. This isn't what I want. I want to be with her for the rest of my life, and for this, I will strive to become stronger. But Aunt Jun…

title: Raising a Fox Spirit in My Home
summary: What happens when an ordinary university student runs into a cute, coquettish little fox? What if the little fox is actually a Cultivator? What future awaits the university student after this fateful meeting? Is he heading towards the path of doom? Or is he heading towards ultimate greatness? Read on to find out! Join us and let us embark on an epic journey where we follow the twists and turns of this human-animal... *cough*... human-demon love story.
genres: Action, Comedy, Martial Arts, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: Interstellar Daily Life of Being Tricked by an Omega Senior [Female Alpha, Male Omega]
summary: Unlike many other transmigrators, Huainan quietly focused on studying hard, killing bugs to support herself, and patiently waiting for the academy to start recruiting on a garbage planet after transmigrating. But just before leaving, unexpected events kept happening. First, she ran into an assassin, and later her uncontrolled pheromones inadvertently provoked an omega senior. On the starship, Ansel, who had just finished his heat cycle, had misty blue eyes and flushed cheeks; his naturally enchanting appearance looked even more alluring. He grabbed the alpha’s finger and leaned close, long lashes lowering to cover his cold, calculating gaze. “Please, junior schoolmate, help this poor omega with some comfort.” “I won’t annoy you...” The warm, soft touch made the inexperienced Huainan stiffen, hesitate, and her heart pound like thunder. “...Okay.” After enrollment, to complete missions and survive, Huainan entered the dark net, took commissions, and was extremely busy with her dual S-class talents and engraving skills. After some success, she focused her attention on mechs. She just didn’t expect their feelings to change so fast. “Looks like clothes won’t work, it has to be the person.” “You’re my alpha, so I can’t touch you?” “You mean I should sleep by myself?” Holding the gentle and beautiful omega, Huainan patted her face and said seriously, “I have important things to do!” A talented, upright young female alpha X an omega who seems cold but is actually deep and thoughtful. ABO with custom settings: differentiation at 12 years old, adulthood at 18, and S-level and above have spirit beasts.

title: Quick Transmigration: The Sweet Pet Story of a Cannon Fodder Female Supporting Character’s Blissful Life
summary: [Immersive Quick Transmigration + Female Supporting Character’s Counterattack + Yao Yao is the Most Beautiful + Thrilling Story + Childbirth + Love at First Sight + Non-Fixed Male Lead + 1V1] Yao Yao, the most beautiful maiden of the Fox Clan, wanted to travel to the mortal world. By a twist of fate, she bound with the Female Supporting Character System, embarking on a journey to experience human life. The Female Supporting Character System had only one requirement: the female supporting character must grow old together with the system-designated Virtuous Son, staying by his side for life. The female supporting character and her arranged marriage husband are the control group—a family alliance where they leave each other undisturbed. Yao Yao: “Leaving each other undisturbed is impossible—she still wants kisses!” ❤️ [The Biological Mother of the Villainous Female Supporting Character VS The Biological Father of the Male Lead in a Sweet Story] Not Double Pure The villainous female supporting character regretted on her deathbed—she shouldn’t have opposed the male and female leads, nor should she have driven herself to a dead end for the male lead. But upon waking up, she found herself reborn! Even more unexpectedly, her naive and simple-minded biological mother found her a stepfather, and she became the male lead’s stepsister! ❤️ [The Beautiful Campus Belle Unwilling to Break Up with the Male Lead VS The Male Lead’s Tanned and Muscular Roommate] Double Pure ❤️ [The Male Lead’s Shield Girlfriend VS The Female Lead’s Beloved Boyfriend] Double Pure ❤️ [The Discarded Noble Lady of the Marquis House VS The Original Story’s Background Emperor] Not Double Pure ❤️ [The True Daughter Kicked Out of the Family Enters the Entertainment Industry VS The Capital Tycoon of Hong Kong Circles] Double Pure ❤️ [The Cannon Fodder Concubine of the Imperial Harem VS The Diligent and Gentle Emperor]

title: Tsundere Campus Goddess and Rogue Master
summary: Wang Xiao was compelled to descend from the mountain by his master, with his intrinsic energy cloistered, and a lovely woman erroneously believing him to be her betrothed. In a bid to safeguard his mistakenly assigned fiancée, he resolved to remain in the school teeming with enchanting beauties. With the same intent to defend his intended, he managed to transform the currents of power within the city.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural

title: Reborn to Love You Again
summary: At my lowest point, He Wenjin married me. Everyone said he married me just to spite my younger sister. But after he died in a car accident, he left all his inheritance to me. And a voice recorder. When I gently pressed play, it was his hoarse, deep voice-- He said: "Song Tangyin, could you also like me, even just a little?" After so many years, I finally caught a glimpse of the magnificent and surging love he had hidden beneath the ice. When I opened my eyes again, I was reborn. My adoptive mother was holding my hand, saying: "A yin, can you go to prison in your sister's place?"

title: The Salted Fish Concubine Only Wants to Farm Every Day
summary: Shu Ruohua transmigrated into the role of the Crown Princess married to the powerful heir of the Eastern Palace? No, no, no—she had just been thrown into the Cold Palace and demoted to a discarded consort. Fat and ugly, she became the laughingstock and target of ridicule for the other imperial concubines during tea and idle chatter. But what was going on with His Highness the Crown Prince? Not only did he visit the Cold Palace every day, he often didn’t return to his own quarters at night? One day— The Crown Prince publicly declared, “Shu Ruohua is officially reinstated as the Crown Princess.” Alas, the slacker couldn’t maintain her momentum. She had just been reinstated and was immediately demoted again to a Side Consort. Then one day, a “Fruit & Vegetable Supermarket” suddenly opened in the capital? The produce was so delicious it was unbeatable, with customers crowding in every day. Yet another day, a “Health Restaurant” opened in the capital? The common people praised it: “Affordable prices, and even our chronic illnesses have gotten better!” One year later, the concubines of all the palaces suddenly received word: “Your Ladyship, Shu Ruohua has renovated the Cold Palace. It’s now as grand as the Imperial Palace itself.” Some years later, the Crown Prince ascended the throne. A eunuch proclaimed an imperial edict: “By the Mandate of Heaven, His Majesty decrees: Side Consort Shu, upright and virtuous in conduct… is hereby conferred the title of Noble Consort.” One day— His Majesty the Emperor said, “I’m in need of an Empress. My beloved, are you interested?” The slacker firmly shook her head. “I’m not suitable. I’m only fit to be a slacker.” His Majesty replied, “No matter—slackers, salted fish, even salted pigs—they’re all to my taste!”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Historical, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Divine Exchanged System
summary: Upon waking, Wang Shan finds himself in Room 888, the most luxurious accommodation in Cloud City, typically reserved for the wealthiest. Despite his complaints about the ""subpar"" room, five stunning women are waiting to inform him of his first-place assurance in an upcoming test due to his powerful father's influence. A stranger to this world from the 21st century, Wang Shan learns that martial prowess is paramount, categorized into nine realms. Today, he must take the One-star Cultivator test, despite his supposed lack of innate talent. His father's status as the ruler and a formidable Two-star Expert guarantees his victory, but the arrival of the gifted Zhang Bao poses a deadly challenge. As Wang Shan bathes, he hears a voice in his mind: ""System binding, binding successful."" A powerful trading system allows him to trade anything he touches, enabling him to instantly advance his cultivation. With newfound power, Wang Shan contemplates his next move. Will he overcome the threats and rise to greatness with the help of his mysterious system?

title: The Reincarnated Phantom Demon Wants to Live a Leisurely Life
summary: [The Phantom Demon who dyed the Jianghu red with blood. In this life, I just want to live a leisurely life.] I was betrayed and killed. And in a truly miserable way at that. When I opened my eyes, I had become the lazy youngest son of the Seomun Clan. In this life, I want neither revenge nor power. I simply wanted to live sipping wine and taking naps … ”Why does everyone keep picking fights with me?” Even when I try to stay still, the world refuses to leave me alone. Ill-fated ties from the past, the power of my previous life, and the ‘me’ from before keep shaking my resolve. The Phantom Demon has returned alive. Will I be able to overcome everything and finally live a life of leisure?

title: Starting from the Post-Apocalypse, I Am Invincible
summary: 200 years later, in the post-apocalypse. Lin Xinghai obtains a system, dominating the post-apocalyptic era and crushing all enemies. He continues his journey with overwhelming victories. Ding! You’ve gained Blood Essence + 1. Ding! You’ve gained Genetic Enhancement +1%. Ding! You’ve gained mastery in the Firearm Skill. Genre: Over-powered genre (OP), System, Post-apocalypse PS: The plot emphasizes the protagonist being “Overpowered” throughout the story. It isn’t a dark or grim tale.

title: The Big Boss Loves Her Deeply [Era]
summary: Cheng Ning had grown up with her aunt, the Han family’s stepmother, living in the Han household. Han Dongyuan, with his violent temper and rough personality, had never liked her, dismissing the pale, soft, long‑legged girl. Later, when he was sent down to the countryside, into those endless deep mountains and forests, he thought he would never have to see her again. One snowy day, after finishing errands in town, he trudged back up the mountain through the drifts. Along the way, villagers teased him kindly: “Dongyuan, your sweetheart chased after you to the countryside!” Back at the dormitory, all his bedding and supplies were gone. His roommates said, “We gave them to your sweetheart.” Han Dongyuan: “???” — Everyone worried when Cheng Ning insisted on going to the countryside. Even if Han Dongyuan was there, with his fierce and domineering nature, would he really look after her? Cheng Ning: “…” He was domineering, yes—but domineering enough to kiss her. He wouldn’t “take care” of her; he would only spoil her, indulge her, every single day. She hadn’t known that in her previous life, the aloof, ascetic, untouchable man who seemed inhuman for decades was actually like this.

title: How to Be a Demon King for Dummies
summary: I suddenly hit the jackpot (is it really?) that lands right in front of me. It changes me, Archer Teil, a normal farm boy, into the twelfth demon king of the demon world that governs over hundreds of subjects that has to harass the hero and to endure people’s curses as if it’s an everyday life routine. ... The reason how I came to be the demon king (an occupation that everyone will say ewww) isn’t that I have royal bloodline running in my veins or that I have super badass explosive powers ... No no, I got the job because the late demon king picked my name from the lottery!? Oh, my Goddess!! Someone, please tell me, why do these things have to happen to me?!

title: After I Retire, My Disciples Will Regret It
summary: I was a renowned monster expert in the Empire. I had dedicated my life to the Empire, yet the only thing I received in return was a dismissal and a prison sentence based on a false accusation by my beloved disciple. [Why do we need Gatekeepers? The gates don’t close anymore anyway?] [They must be doing that because there are no taxes or warehouses to manage.] [mol*station? That’s disgusting. lol] My reputation and the people’s respect were shattered by the false accusation. I was branded a criminal overnight and imprisoned for three years. And on the day of my release, gates began to reopen across the Empire.

title: Help, My Newlywed Husband Goes Seven Times a Night
summary: My sister ran away from her wedding. I couldn't understand it. The man she was supposed to marry was Prince Jin! He is a famous handsome man in the capital, favored by the Emperor, and known for being easygoing and always smiling! You couldn't even find someone this handsome at the Southern Wind Hall (male brothel). Why would she run? It wasn't until I took her place and married him that I understood. Prince Jin would always be smiling as he tied me up when I tried to crawl under the bed, going seven times a night! Is he practicing some evil cultivation technique to harvest Yin to replenish Yang? I offered to take concubines for him. He curled his lips and sniffed my neck lightly: "The Princess is delicious; how could this Prince look at those common, vulgar powders?" I couldn't take it anymore, so I ran away too. As I crawled out of the dog hole at the Prince’s residence, he was gazing at me with a smile. Then, his thin lips parted slightly: "The Princess has gone mad. Take her back and lock her up." He whispered in my ear: "Tonight, use the posture you used to crawl through the dog hole."
genres: Adult, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Mature, Romance

title: The Hero Banished Me Saying, “I Don’t Want Incompetents,” but All My Other Friends Followed Me
summary: "I don't want incompetent people. Get out of my party right now!" The protagonist, Kagura, was shouted down by the hero and was told he was fired. The hero's party consisted of Kagura, the hero and three girls. Even though he knew the lowly inner thoughts of the hero, Kagura still accepted the fact he was fired. Kagura was a knight of the church. Because of his position, he could not quit on his own, but it was natural for him to stay in the wild and eat preserved food. He was fed up with the harsh journey of defeating the Demon King and the constant lack of sleep because he was always on guard duty. Fired? That would be great! I'll take this opportunity to quit the church, get my severance pay, and then take over the family business and relax! The three girls who used to be part of the hero's party came to see Kagura, who had been exiled in high spirits. "If Kagura-sama isn't with us, there's no reason for us to be in that hero's party!" ...... Apparently, all of them were in the party for me, not the hero.
