title: The Reincarnated Onmyoji Vows Revenge and Becomes Unrivaled in the Modern World ~ Though Falsely Accused as a Traitor and Declined, They Rise Again With The Strongest Shikigami
summary: Ashiya Michitomo, the legendary onmyoji hailed as the mightiest in the Heian era, is betrayed by his close friend and rival, Abe Seimei, resulting in the tragic massacre of his entire clan. Using a reincarnation spell, Michitomo is reborn in the modern world—a place where yokai (supernatural creatures) run rampant, and exorcists are revered as heroes for purging them. However, the Ashiya clan, once respected, had fallen into disgrace and contempt for betraying the Abe clan and suffering a devastating defeat. While the Abe clan has risen to power in the modern era, the Ashiya clan remains in ruin. Upon learning of his clan's oppression due to his own defeat, Michitomo vows to revive the Ashiya clan and seek revenge against the Abe clan. He has devoted himself to rigorous training since childhood, aiming to awaken as the strongest onmyoji of the modern age. With the mightiest yokai by his side, who pledge unwavering loyalty, Michitomo embarks on a path of unrivaled dominance in the world of exorcists.

title: Dating Game
summary: The Season of high society . Hermeti Kreuz was the only daughter of the Kreuz family—short, chubby, and not considered beautiful in any way. All that her late father, the baron who had wasted his life on gambling and pleasure, left behind was a mountain of debt. However, thanks to Lady Kreuz’s ambition, they moved into a townhouse in London that had been sold at an auction. Hermeti was briefly happy to return to London and reunite with the people she loved—Elijah and Wentworth of the Dunstaneville family. But her happiness didn’t last long. She soon meets Duke Romanes Dane, the king’s cousin and the lord of a blessed southern territory, who had already purchased the Kreuz mansion and returned to London society. Instead of kicking out the Kreuz mother and daughter, he gives them one condition if they want to stay in the house...

title: After Picking up a Wild Man, He Declared Himself as Emperor
summary: Shen Yi is a blind girl who barely makes a living with a little medical knowledge. Her biggest wish is to have a smooth life. She picked up a seriously injured man on a rainy night. He said his name was Qi Yu, and he was chased by his enemies so Shen Yi saved him. He said he wanted to repay her, Shen Yi was a little hesitant, but Qi Yu treated her with deep affection, so they got married naturally. After marriage, the two were in harmony. Shen Yi thought that she and Qi Yu would live a plain and happy life like this. However, she didn’t know that on a stormy night, Qi Yu held a cold blade, his handsome face full of gloom, and killed the person under his feet with a sword. He stirred the wind and clouds in the dark, his hands were stained with blood, but he smiled at her lightly: “It’s windy outside, my lady, be careful not to catch a cold.” … After marriage, Qi Yu found various herbs for her to treat her eyes, but she never thought that she would really see the light again one day. She couldn’t wait to see the person next to her, but when she went back, she saw people kneeling on the ground. Her husband was as handsome as she had imagined, except that his name was not Qi Yu. He was the crown prince, Xiao Yuanqi, who had the power of life and death. Shen Yi was taken back by him and placed in a small courtyard without any name or status. He came very rarely. By chance, she heard him say in a cold voice, “How can a lowly female doctor be worthy of the position of the crown princess?” “Then why did Your Highness bring her back?” The delicate voice leaned beside him. Qi Yu sneered, “My things should not be touched by outsiders even if I don’t like them.” … Shen Yi was disheartened and left quietly, following the merchant ship to the south of the Yangtze River. People said that the one who had just ascended the throne in the capital was crazy, mobilizing the Jinwu Guards and turning the capital upside down, just to find someone. Shen Yi was far away in the south of the Yangtze River, and she just smiled when she heard this. She realized that the past could not be changed, and what he did had nothing to do with her. On this day, the peddler who was always slick was pestering her with toys to give to her. Before Shen Yi could refuse, the peddler suddenly fell down with a scream. She was nailed to the spot, her whole body stiff. Looking at the familiar man, his face was stained with blood and he walked towards her, his handsome face was cold, and the dark color spread in his eyes. He pulled out the sword from the peddler body, stared at her with red eyes, and his voice was hoarse. “Come back with me when you’ve had enough fun.”

title: The Top Efficiency Cultivator
summary: Lin Shuang, is an avid planner and master of time management in the field of science and engineering. She suddenly finds herself transmigrated to a world of cultivation and becomes an outer disciple, considered slow in cultivation progress and lacking talent by her fellow disciples. The stern and dignified senior in charge warns her, "If you don't make progress soon, according to the rules, you'll be expelled from the sect." The genius junior sister, aspiring to be a powerful figure, remarks, "With such weakness, going outside might result in being sacrificed by evil cultivators." The inner disciple, who values money and tops the assassin ranking, sneers, "Hmph, wasting resources! Give me those spirit stones!" The disciples from rival sects all mock and make fun of her. Lin Shuang smiles and says, "Don't worry, it's all part of the plan." "Every breakthrough requires burning incense and bathing, wasting time. I plan to hold it in until the Golden Core stage and break through all at once, saving a hundred tomato timers (25 minutes each)." Everyone: "???" Turning around, they see her accumulate qi for ten years, erupting a hundredfold, and smashing the Golden Core evil cultivator into a pit. Everyone: "??!" Several years later, rumors spread throughout the cultivation world about an abnormal and extraordinary elder who disguises herself as a Qi Condensation female disciple each year. Acting weak, she becomes the champion in the sect's competition, overturns the evil cultivator's base, and takes the Demon King as her dual cultivation partner. Lin Shuang claims, "I'm innocent; I am only at the Qi Condensation stage." She's simply a diligent cultivator, efficiently managing her time. Senior Brother: ... Demon King: ... A hundred years later, the Sect Master comes out of seclusion and asks, "Has Lin Shuang made a breakthrough?" Disciple: No. This time, she plans to wait until the Golden Core stage to ascend. Oh, she plans to do it tonight! Sect Master: ??? Lin Shuang smiles, "From Qi Condensation to Ascension, I've had 1230 breakthroughs, saving at least 6000 steps in total!" All the antagonists who thought she was weak and kept getting beaten are now crying. Even the celestial beings who welcome ascenders shed tears, "Finally, the legend has reached our realm." Later, a book titled "Lin's Fastest Cultivation Methods" spread throughout the cultivation world. It includes minimalistic cultivation steps, mind map-style cultivation, Ebbinghaus memory curve, tomato timers, balancing work and rest, multitasking, and more. Junior disciples: We give up. Nine-Tailed Fox Demon Emperor, Fu Yuan, possesses ancient bloodlines and can help others with their breakthroughs. During his childhood, he had his eight tails forcibly severed. In this life, he hates cultivators the most and only wants to perish together with the enemies who exterminated his clan. But then, a figure in green clothes appears— "As long as I haven't removed you from my tomato timer plan for a day, you won't be able to die." "No one can take you away from me!" Everyone covets his ancient bone bloodline. But she draws a blood-stopping charm on his bleeding hand, and the dan furnace dances as if a flower blooms in the endless glacier.

title: The Legendary Old Man Becomes a Dungeon Streamer: When the World’s Strongest Tried Streaming in His Second Life, He Instantly Went Viral and Gained S-Class Disciples
summary: Relentless Domination × A Second Life in His 40s × Training the Next Generation! A legendary middle-aged man starts streaming and instantly goes viral. Tatsuya Kamiya, a man of extraordinary talent, has secretly protected Japan as the government’s ultimate weapon. But lately, life has become too quiet so Kamiya decides to retire. His battle records and career history were erased by the government, leaving only a handful of people aware of his true achievements. With no way to prove his past, finding a new job seems impossible. So, Kamiya turns to video creation as a substitute résumé. In Chitose's mind, she's poised for greatness, but finds herself at a loss when she continues to only get minor roles. As she clashes with other girls in the agency, including a cunning airhead and a girl with a Kansai accent, Chitose is about to learn that there's more to succeeding in this competitive industry than she imagined.

title: Circumstances of a Villainess from the Outskirts
summary: “A marriage proposal has arrived for you.” Lyra Norris – the troublemaker of the Norris barony. For her, persecution and ostracism were daily companions. Then one day, a ray of hope descended. To build an ordinary family, to love ordinarily. But life had never flowed according to her will. “You needn’t worry about her v*rginity. This child knows nothing of men.” Her stepmother’s praise came with an unfamiliar face, while calculating eyes examined her like merchandise. That day, Lyra discovered why she was being sold as a bride. “I have to… run away.” For the first and last time, Lyra resolved to defy her parents. Then, like salvation, a man appeared. “Do you have somewhere to go?” “…No.” “Then let’s make a deal.” “A deal…?” “Don’t you want to start a new life? I’ll give you that chance.” An irresistible sweet temptation. “What do you say? Why not become a villainess for me?” And so began a fate that seemed like a game.

title: Beyond The Line

My cousin is coming to Korea this weekend.” His cousin was arriving in Korea before his upcoming wedding. An explanation followed that she had met him before, but she couldn’t remember at all. She brushed it off indifferently, but on the day of his arrival… “Ah. You’ve grown so much.” A dark shadow fell over her head, and a woody scent brushed the tip of her nose. summary: "Eh? You want me to take on a request now? There's no way I'd accept, right?" Tatsuya Ono (35) had been in another world for half a year. The first party he joined was a bust. "Old man, go do that." "Old man, you're really useless, huh?" Even after being transported to another world, his days were spent being mocked and treated as an errand boy by the younger party leader. Although the reward money and experience points were supposed to be shared, Tatsuya hardly received any. In such a situation, Tatsuya wondered to himself. (Is this really okay?) Thinking so, Tatsuya decided to leave the party and become a freelancer. "You, being useless as you are, will still be useless no matter where you go. No one would entrust you with jobs, old man." That's what the leader said to him, but once Tatsuya started working alone, he began to grow remarkably. In fact, this unimpressive "old man" (Tatsuya Ono) was a character who, if nurtured, turned out to be surprisingly strong, something you might see in a game. Eventually, Tatsuya started receiving enough job offers to be selective, and he rose to become a world-famous freelance adventurer. When Tatsuya did jobs with "Japanese quality," the bad guys around the clients somehow ended up destroying themselves, and a spiral of gratitude towards Tatsuya began to form. Despite just doing the jobs he wanted in a laid-back manner, Tatsuya somehow started to be treated like a hero. And then, good people began to gather around Tatsuya, and good things started happening to him, while the leader somehow ended up losing everything on his own. "I'm just working in a chill and fun way, you know?"

title: The Happy Days of Being a Factory Owner in London

Time to plant vegetables all over the globe—let's go! After a flurry of operations as fierce as a tiger, she entered the map and fell silent, staring at the starting status on her character panel: 【Dispossessed Farmer】. Farming vegetables? In nineteenth-century London? Me? For real? Clutching the introductory letter provided by the game and her new identity from the expansion, Arna got to work with tears in her eyes. Well, since I'm already here, why not start by becoming a big-shot factory owner? Mrs. Hudson's country relative has come to the city. Soon, they discovered this was an audacious, arrogant, insufferably conceited megalomaniac. …After all, what normal person says nothing upon meeting a neighbour, routinely hops the wall to get into their backyard, digs up dirt on the street to plant vegetables, and silently shoves rubbish at people? title: Tamed the Monster Prince
summary: I married the prince they called a monster. Four women before me had accepted his proposals, only to become bloodied corpses. In short, I was a sacrificial lamb offered to this beast. On our wedding night, I braced myself for death. “Grr…” A guttural growl rumbled from his throat. Then… a miracle. "Good, stay still.” “Yes.” He rested his head on my lap and nudged it back and forth, as if begging for a caress. ‘Does he want me to pet him?’ *** "Ren, please don't go," he pleaded, clutching my sleeve with a desperate look in his eyes. "I can't live without you." A pang of sympathy resonated deep within me. It seemed like I had tamed the monster a little too well.

title: I Alone Have Infinite Lifespan in the Seonhyeop
summary: Abandoned in an unfamiliar world without knowing English, Lee Han’s only solace is the ‘ageless body’ he accidentally acquired. The strange journey of an ordinary (or so-called) man.

title: Scrapped Princess
summary: The story takes place in a fantasy world and revolves around a 15-year-old girl Pacifica Casull who is a girl child born in a set of twins into the royal family of the kingdom Leinwan and then abandoned. The 5111th Grendel Prophecy predicts that she is the "poison that will destroy the world" before the sun sets on her sixteenth birthday. As a consequence, she is dropped off a cliff as an infant. Believed to be dead, no one realizes her continued existence until after Pacifica is already 15 years old.

title: I’m the Main Villain, but the Heroines Are Obsessed With Me
summary: I possessed the older brother of the main character in a yuri game. A villain who obstructs with the main character and is hated by the heroines. I only worked hard to survive. But then, they began to take an interest in me.
genres: Completed, Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, School Life

title: I Started By Forcefully Kissing the Empress!
summary: Transmigrating into a world of cultivation, Ye Lang found himself on the brink of death! His sect was on the verge of annihilation, and the breathtakingly beautiful Empress, was gravely injured and unable to fight! Fortunately, he gained access to a System Chat Group, a group overflowing with countless systems, and Ye Lang started by drawing the most outrageous system of them all! "Mission: Facing imminent death? Don't panic! Stand up and forcefully kiss the most beautiful woman present. Leave this world with no regrets!" With his life on the line, there was no room for hesitation! In the next moment, Ye Lang leaped towards the weakened and stunning Empress, and planted a kiss on her! The whole place was shocked by his brazenness...
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: After Being Linked To The Random Street Vendor System, I Became An Internet Sensation
summary: Unemployed and bankrupt, Lin Wei stood on the rainy street at night, her life at its lowest point, when she was forcibly bound to a "random food stall system". From then on, her life was turned upside down—every day she was randomly assigned locations, tasks and recipes by the system, from jianbing guozi at the alley entrance on a rainy night to heartwarming oden at school in the early morning, from limited-edition bento boxes downstairs in office buildings to creative ice jelly at the entrance of music festivals. She drove her mysterious food truck through the city, healing the stomachs and hearts of countless diners with her delicious food, but this also embroiled her in controversy: she faced suppression from competitors, food safety concerns, and malicious hype from online celebrities... But Lin Wei became more and more courageous in the face of adversity. Relying on the skills rewarded by the system and her own wisdom, she resolved crises time and time again, turning "Weiwei's Food Stall" into a legend that the whole city followed.

title: Long Live The Emperor!
summary: It has been 17 years since Xia Ji transmigrated into the Shang Dynasty as the Seventh Imperial Prince but he has since met with tragedy after another. His mother was mu*dered by a mysterious person and he ended up being under house arrest for three years for consorting with a demon lady. All he had were Buddhist scriptures and his little sister, the Ninth Imperial Princess, by his side as he was abandoned by the entire Imperial family. However, as danger looms the Imperial City, Xia Ji has been secretly accumulating his powers, waiting for the right time to strike with no mercy and no benevolence. Hungry for more power, Xia Ji continues his quest for ultimate conquest and the only person he will give up everything to protect, is his precious little sister, Xia Xiaosu.

title: That Slacker Wants To Ascend To The Heaven
summary: World’s top professor, Shi Ning, had transmigrated and became a slacker. Learning God, Shi Ning expressed that she was going to stay away from her relatives’ fake sincerity, turn over a new leaf and make a fresh start. Anyone who gets in her way can scram! Shi Ning, let’s go fight! Scram! Shi Ning, let’s go play truant! Scram! Shi Ning, let’s drop out! Scram! Powerful and handsome future diplomat, Lu Shi An, when faced with the slacker who used to harass him, the youth who doesn’t understand love, expressed that this girl was so fierce and must be avoided at all costs! Later: Lu Shi An regretted it so much he knelt down and chased after his wife. Lend me strength, good wind, to soar up to the azure sky at last*. Hot-blooded youth, hot-blooded battle, from school uniform to wedding dress, fighting side by side to become legends in the end. She fought for the glory of the country and he fought for the dignity of the country. *好风凭借力 送我上青云: A proverb; meaning to grab onto opportunities to advance forward
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: I Accidentally Revealed the Original Story to the Villain
summary: I reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just any novel, but my favorite one, Square Illusion. In this life, I was the daughter of a powerful duke, born with a golden spoon in my mouth. The darling of my family, showered with love. That was me. The problem? I was Sylvia Langston, fiancée to the crown prince, and the villainess of the story. My fate was a brutal death. Executed the moment I turn twenty, as a punishment for all the sins Sylvia had committed. But how could I accept that? How could I give up this healthy body I’d been granted, the family I’d finally found? Absolutely not! "Then… just live a good life." That advice came from Ray, a background character never even mentioned in the book, and my nanny’s nephew. From that moment, Sylvia’s fate veered off its rails. "Ray, I don’t want to be Crown Princess. His Highness just isn’t my type." "Then who is your type? Black hair and red eyes, as you once mentioned? The title of that book was… Square Illusion, wasn’t it?" "Y-you remember that? But I said it when we were really young!" "I remember everything you like." Without realizing it, I spilled the secrets of the original story to Ray. As for being the crown princess? The heroine could keep that role. Once she appeared and tied up the original plot, I planned to set off with Ray, traveling the world, tasting and savoring life firsthand. ╭══ ≪ •❈• ≫ ══╮ "Are you insane? Do you even know where you’ve come?" Three years later, I met my childhood friend again. But Ray was no longer ordinary. “I’ll come back for you. Wait for me.” The promise he’d made to me seemed thrown away like garbage. By his side now stood none other than the novel’s heroine herself. Betrayal burned in my chest, tears stinging my eyes—but I held them back. "Do you know who I am? Your insolence has no limits. To think you’d dare speak so rudely to the esteemed daughter of Duke Langston!"

title: I Am the Law
summary: If the law isn't upheld, then from now on, I'm the law! What? You want me to follow the law? Don't make me laugh. I am the law. And we are the law.

title: Only I Shall Be Immortal
summary: In the Heavens or on Earth, only I shall be immortal! In the vast Divine Lands, at the western border, upon the recommendation of his best friend, he began walking on a path he had never thought possible. The Cloudlink Sect, as the ‘Final Path’ of the 7 main sects of the Divine Lands, on their sacred disciple acceptance ceremony that happens once every 5 years, took in a single 5th generation disciple who had a beggar-like bearing. With the gates of cultivation opened wide for him, will this bright and mischievous child be able to mature into a powerful Immortal that rules the world?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Xianxia

title: One Piece: Comparison of Two Lufees, This Luffy is Too Competitive!
summary: Comparison of Two Lufees, This Luffy is Too Competitive! At the Great War at Marineford, a comparison live stream suddenly appeared! The person being compared was none other than Monkey D. Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates! One white, one red – dual Luffys on screen! In the original world, Luffy is carefree and reckless, charging into situations without much thought. Though he lives freely, during the Marineford War, he could only watch helplessly as his brother died right before his eyes. In the parallel world, however, Luffy understood the law of the jungle at just three years old, pushing himself to extreme levels from a young age! He mastered Armament Haki at 7, Observation Haki at 9, and Conqueror’s Haki at 14! He set sail at 15 and awakened his Nika form in the same year! Not only does he push himself relentlessly, but he also drives his crewmates to do the same! Zoro: "I can't afford to slack off for even a moment, because if I do, Luffy's swordsmanship will surpass mine!" Nami: "The captain knocks on my door every night without fail, and within three months, he'd already mastered all of my navigation skills!" Buggy: "What did I do to deserve the honor of serving two generations of Pirate Kings...?" At Marineford, Luffy steps on Akainu’s head: "You had your chance, but you blew it!"

title: Spring Will Come When You’re Not Next to Me
summary: I, Yusuke Suzushiro, had three childhood friends. One of them, Yuki Akikawa, was my beloved, and I was so happy to be able to go out with her. Those days were like a dream. If only this time could last forever. That was all I wished for.
genres: Completed, Drama, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: Wudang Sacred Scriptures
summary: "I'll take this child." Sold to the Wudang Sect's outer martial arts training hall for three silver coins at a young age, Kwak Yeon dreams of mastering supreme martial arts. But can he overcome the needle-sized gateway barely permitted to trainee instructors and rise to become a disciple of the main sect? "A true gentleman cannot stand idle in the face of injustice!" Thus begins Kwak Yeon's unyielding journey through the martial world, following the ruthless principle of “Kill Buddha, Kill Ancestors”—destroying all obstacles in his path!

title: Reporting, Let’s Get Married Quickly!
summary: She gets into his car by mistake, and from then on she falls into the lion’s den and never escapes the clutches of the stubborn man again! "I'm engaged.” “Without my permission, it doesn't count.” "But I have a fiancé!" "From now on, I’m your fiancé.” "..." He is the rich and powerful heir of the Bai Group; invincible, handsome, and a dreamboat who drives the women of the city crazy! Yet, she is the only one whom he spoils and pampers infinitely. “Tingting, why are you standing outside the door alone?" "Daddy said I'm too clingy and wants me to face the wall so that I don’t steal Mommy from him..."
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Master Strategist of Dayu
summary: [Strong Female Lead] [s*um ab*se] [Lighthearted] [Mutual Fidelity] [Playing Dumb to Beat the Strong] [Happy Ending] Good news: Her betrothed fiancé won first place, the Jieyuan, in the Xiangshi. Bad news: The fiancé who became the Jieyuan wants to annul the engagement "decently" and has plotted against his fiancée, who comes from a merchant family. Alright, since you want a "decent" annulment and to plot against others, then no one gets to have a good time. The transmigrated Ye Cishu decisively fights back. You like to scheme, don't you? What if every single one of your schemes fails? Will you go mad? Since you love to calculate so much, then Ye Cishu will settle the score with you, one account at a time. Ye Cishu may not know much, but what she knows best is how to use an abacus. With an abacus, she calculates ledgers, the hearts of men, and even the world...

title: The Urban Successor of God of Gluttony
summary: Food critic, Gu Zheng, was chosen by the God of Gluttony to become his urban successor. Having to undergo various trials posed by the Equipment Spirit under the command of the God of Gluttony, he hones his skills to become history’s greatest God of Food. (Gu Zheng，“There’s a rating for ingredients in the heavenly realm too? And… The best ingredients on Earth is only of average standard? Moreover, you want me to use these existing ingredients to make top-notch delicacies? Come out Equipment Spirit, I promise not to hit you!”)
genres: Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Douluo: Peerless Xuanwu Moon God
summary: In the vast and perilous Douluo Continent, where martial souls determine one's destiny, a young man named Xu Tianxi embarks on a journey of vengeance and self-discovery. Haunted by the tragic mu*der of his mother by the Sea God Sect's leader, Xuanzi, and the subsequent humiliation by Shrek Academy's Dean Yan Shaozhe, Xu Tianxi's path is one of retribution. His quest is not driven by a sense of grand justice but by a personal vendetta to avenge his mother's death and restore his family's honor. As Xu Tianxi navigates the complexities of the continent, he encounters formidable foes and allies alike. His journey leads him to confront powerful figures, including Shrek's elite, and to challenge the very institutions that have wronged him. With each battle, he grows stronger, uncovering secrets about his own origins and the true nature of his enemies. Amidst the turmoil, Xu Tianxi's path intertwines with that of Zhang Leixuan, Shrek Academy's current eldest senior sister, who bears her own burdens and regrets. Their meeting sets off a chain of events that will alter the course of their lives and the fate of the continent. In a world where power and politics collide, Xu Tianxi must decide whether to seek redemption, revenge, or something more profound. His journey is one of self-realization, as he grapples with the complexities of justice, loyalty, and the true meaning of strength.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: I Planned My Escape Because I Knew Her Secret
summary: I got engaged to my girlfriend, whom I had been dating since high school, when I was 26. As preparations for the wedding steadily progressed, he noticed her suspicious behavior and, suspecting something was amiss, hired a private investigator to uncover her secrets. After that, his action was to disappear just before the wedding.

title: Turn Your Life Around! Ttanttara
summary: The 19-year-old boy who once dreamed of the stage and of becoming a singer no longer existed. All that remained was a 23-year-old Shin Tae-woo living a bleak, hopeless life. But even that didn’t last long. Through a chance encounter, he regained everything he had lost—no, he gained far more than that. Now, the only thing left is to challenge once again the dream he couldn’t achieve in the past. Right now! It begins!
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: You’re My Love Since The Beginning
summary: He pressed her against the wall, "You want to divorce me for him? He's ten years younger than you. How can you do that?" She smiled with reddened eyes and said, "His sister is so much younger than you. Don't you enjoy it as well?" He gritted his teeth, "You can't divorce me unless I die." She had said the same thing, but she was really going to die soon. In fact, I'll be with you for ten thousand years and the rest of my life. So did he.
genres: Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Musashi Jeongcheon
summary: I was visited by myself from a hundred years in the future. He said that I would become someone who would oversee life and death in the Martial World. I didn’t want to live like that. But fate did not allow it. In the end, I…

title: Become the God’s Knight, Starting from Exile
summary: Lucas, whose hometown was invaded by enemies, was forced to go on the run. By a twist of fate, he was appointed as the God’s Knight by the creator god of this world. “Your task is simple: help me save my world.” “Easy for you to say… you expect me to do all of that alone?” Although he was the creator of this world, he found himself unable to even protect the world he had personally made...

title: Shaman’s Awakening
summary: Able to communicate with spirits and gods and an expert on medicine. Since time immemorial, a Shaman does not distinguish between the two. An accomplished Shaman is questioned neither by the spirits nor the gods. Even disasters and calamities are kept at arms length. However, can an accomplished Shaman cure the heart? Take a look at the awakening of the strongest Shaman~

title: The Autobiography of a Tomb Raider
summary: [Tomb Raiding + Mystery + Antique Appraisal] I am a poor boy from a small northeastern mountain village. At the dawn of the 21st century, in pursuit of a better life, I joined a northern tomb raiding group. From south to north, I’ve seen the myriad faces of society, mingling with people from all walks of life, the good, the bad, and the strange. Over the years, I’ve gone from a reckless youth to a weathered middle-aged man—my drinking capacity has improved, but time has left its marks. I’ve encountered countless extraordinary people and bizarre events during this journey. If you’re interested, grab a small stool and come listen to the tales of a tomb raider’s life and the fascinating stories of the underworld.
genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Mystery, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Steady Cultivation: The Entire Cultivation World Is My Home
summary: Cultivation is no easy feat, and the path to immortality is long and arduous. Shen Lian, who transmigrated into the cultivation world, begins his cautious journey with the aid of a panel that grants him enlightenment. To avoid calamities, he hides when he can, runs when necessary, keeps trump cards secret, masters escape techniques, refines avatars, and operates from the shadows. He aligns himself with the Heavenly Dao above and perfects his avatars below. When there’s trouble, his avatars handle it; when there isn’t, his true self cultivates in peace. Using the names of fellow cultivators, he roams the Immortal Spirit Realm, stepping beyond the Three Realms and escaping the Five Elements. By severing his karmic ties, he attains immortality, settling down in every corner of the world.

title: Casting Cinderella
summary: Seo Sara, South Korea’s Top Star Actress“What do you think has grown the most after ten years of making a living as an actress?”“Hmm… My acting?”“My patience and mental illness.”After surviving ten years in the entertainment industry, she thought she had been through it all.“My name is Yoon Seung-tae.”But a handsome, capable third-generation chaebol heir came to her with an unexpected proposal!“Can we meet again?”“That sounds like a threat. I must be misunderstanding, right?”“I’m merely making an offer. A mutually beneficial one.”A man who wants to cast Sara in his life story.“You really are like Cinderella. You left your earring behind, just like she left her shoe. I’m not a prince, but I am looking for the Cinderella who left this earring.”The genre of the story he’s planning…“That’s a relief. Any dog or cow could wear it as long as they have a pierced ear.”…is it really a romantic comedy?

title: The Chronicle of the Marquis’s Mansion’s Wet Nurse Returning to the Countryside
summary: While fighting floods and providing disaster relief, Zhao Nuan dies unexpectedly. When she opens her eyes again, her soul has transmigrated into the body of an ancient, fictional version of Zhao Nuan. Coincidentally, this ancient Zhao Nuan has also just encountered a flood, leaving her and her daughter as the sole survivors of their family. Having escaped with her life, Zhao Nuan takes the original owner's less-than-a-month-old daughter and follows a group of refugees to the capital. After witnessing fields littered with corpses and refugees vanishing without a trace along the way, she decides to sell herself into servitude as a wet nurse at the Marquis of Wu'an's estate. Just when she thinks she has found a peaceful life, the marquis's household suffers a sudden, catastrophic downfall, and the entire family is sentenced to exile. The Marquis's wife entrusts her youngest son to Zhao Nuan, asking her to raise him as her own. To evade capture, Zhao Nuan relies on her cautious and resourceful nature, taking her daughter and the young master on a journey north. After enduring countless hardships, she arrives at the bitter, cold place of exile even before the rest of the marquis's family. To repay the kindness of being taken in, Zhao Nuan reclaims wasteland, plants crops, raises chickens, and herds sheep before the family arrives. What should have been a grueling life in exile is turned into a real-life sandbox farming game by Zhao Nuan, with the entire marquis household joining in. They sell mountain goods, open eateries, and build workshops, their days bustling with activity. Talented individuals from all over come to join them, and strategists from every corner invite them to join grand schemes. The marquis's household's response: A polite refusal. Then one day, an urgent imperial edict arrives from the capital, summoning the wet nurse Zhao Nuan for an audience with the Emperor. Zhao Nuan: ...A polite refusal. The marquis's household: You can exile us, but you can't take our wet nurse. Aren't you all talented individuals? Aren't you strategists? Come, come, let's discuss how to stage a rebellion.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Younger Puppy and Melting Dolce
summary: 28 year-old Shizuka Horie loves making sweets. One day, she finds out that the friend she’d made online was the famous actor Kento Watase. Hearing how he can’t go buy the sweets he loves so much without breaking his hard public image, Shizuka suggests she make some for him. And so her relationship starts with the man who turns out to act more like a puppy…

title: Naruto System in Jujutsu Kaisen
summary: One day, Natsubi suddenly crossed over. Arriving in this world where only madmen can survive, Natsubi has gained the Shinobi World System from Naruto. How will Natsubi survive? Will he become a madman and go crazy with the cursed spirits, or will he just want to be an ordinary person?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: How to Seduce the Heavenly Demon As a Wudang Disciple
summary: I accidentally spent a night with the Heavenly Demon. But I’m a Taoist of the Wudang Sect. …I'm f*cked.
genres: Action, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Wuxia

title: Master of All Sins
summary: A child born embracing all the curses of the world, Shin Hoe-in. A single talisman, received in place of a declaration of disownment from the family, changes everything. Remember, a curse is to inscribe your name and your enemy's on the same tombstone.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Everlasting Immortal Firmament
summary: The world is like a chessboard. “I do not want to be treated as a chess piece by the players!” Defeat in this chess is tantamount to the destruction of my body and I’ll thoroughly disappear! Victory in this chess and I’ll have a very long life! With the help of an ancient Weiqi piece, Gu Hai arrived at the Divine Province Mainland! Heavenly Dao is eternal, however life is limited, making heaven and earth pieces of a chessboard, then in the end transformed into a loess, vanishing like faded smoke and scattered clouds. Nevertheless people still jump out of the chessboard, and these people are already prepared for their death while playing chess against the heavens, and perhaps win eternal life for themselves? “I’ve come, and I want to live through 10,000 lives without any boundaries!”
genres: Action, Drama, Harem, Mature, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: The Young Master Wields a Hammer
summary: I was a weapon developer and the son of an intangible cultural heritage blacksmith in Korea. Now, I’ve become a character in a martial arts novel. And not just any character—but the youngest son of a martial arts noble family that will be wiped out in a year. "Since I know the future, I must change my fate… and my family’s destiny."

title: Flock Of Pigeons
summary: This book is real hard sci-fi. I’m Fang Cheng, an ordinary sophomore. One day I bumped into a beautiful girl, and then accidentally destroyed the world with her. This is a little bit of hardcore physics student story’s of destroying and saving the world, all of which revolves around scientific facts, so it may not be that easy to read…

title: The Honest Man’s Counterattack 2003
summary: Zhao Feng, the honest man, has been reborn, dreaming back to the eve of his college entrance exams. Though he has returned, he is still just a young boy! That year, a young heart first tasted the stirrings of love, yet he didn’t dare confess to the school beauty he had secretly admired for three years! That year, Legend hadn’t yet entered public beta, brotherhood still burned hot, and the dream of slaying dragons remained unfulfilled! That year, opportunities and fortunes were everywhere, a time when even pigs could soar if caught in the right winds! Drink the strongest liquor, chase the most beautiful girls, walk the fiercest dogs, and flaunt the boldest swagger!
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: Seduction! Entangled Kisses! The Refined Scoundrel Leads Her to Ruin
summary: [Male secretly loves female? Pure couple 1v1? Age gap, Macau-Hong Kong-Beijing elite vs. delicate college girl] Since birth, Chu Zhi has drifted through life until being taken in by the Bo family. To survive in the Bo household, she had no choice but to constantly please the young master. The young master was handsome, but a bit wicked—always bullying her for another girl’s sake. It didn’t matter; she didn’t care. Everyone thought Chu Zhi was infatuated with the Bo family’s young master, Bo Xu, trailing after him for over a decade. No one knew that when night fell and silence enveloped the room, Chu Zhi would always clutch the sleeve of Bo Xu’s uncle, her eyes red from crying, “Brother Yi… I’m scared it’ll hurt. Bo Chi Yi’s breath burned hot as he whispered soothingly, “Don’t be afraid. Bo Chi Yi was ruthless, heartless, and decisive—a man who acknowledged no one. Others called him an utter scoundrel. The only tenderness he possessed was reserved for Chu Zhi alone. He often told her, “Be good, baby. Don’t look at other men—only me. Don’t spend others’ money—only mine. And… you’re only allowed to marry me. When the childhood friend who had followed him for over a decade was about to marry his uncle, Bo Xu couldn’t accept it. On the eve of their engagement, he gripped Chu Zhi’s wrist desperately, on the verge of tears, “You’ve pretended to love me for so many years—can’t you just keep pretending? No sooner had he spoken than someone clung to Chu Zhi like stubborn glue, asserting dominance as he said to Bo Xu, “Where are your manners? Call her Auntie.

title: Dear Not Cunning Witch
summary: An age where science was at the height of its rapid development. The smooth lines of railroad tracks had divided Ingram’s large landmass cardinally by the time people had really noticed, And large airships were being developed in their factories by the day in hopes for future commercial use. The fruits of science were being shared amongst everyone. Yet, there still existed almighty beings who could create fire in their bare hands or summon the rain on demand. It was a supreme talent that no enlightened reasoning could explain and not even the most developed sciences could dare encroach upon. People had revered them and regarded them with fear and awe since long ago. They, who were sometimes called gods and sometimes called demons —the witches. Diana was an unfortunate witch who was born the daughter of a great witch but had inherited none of her mother’s talent. “You must be the most worthless witch in existence." Diana had been taken in by her teacher at the tender age of seven, and the only thing she had wished for ever since Was only to gain her independence as quickly as possible and to live together happily with Hester, her beloved older sister. But dark clouds hang over even the path she took to finally meet her sister after having gained her independence……. “Your trip might be a little long.” The stars had set down an ominous prophecy —what kind of future did they point to?

title: Fal of “Fireball” ~Adventurer who became a hero only with Fireball~
summary: A Story About An Adventurer Who Made a History by only Using Fireball.

title: How a Kitten Raises a Villain
summary: is a showbiz-themed romance novel. In it, the villain, Film Emperor Chi Yan, serves as the foil to the male lead, Fu Shilin. Chi Yan lost his father at a young age; Fu Shilin lost his mother. Chi Yan’s mother despised him, believing he was the jinx who killed her husband. Fu Shilin’s family, on the other hand, became whole again after her arrival. She ignored her own son, yet treated her stepson, who never cared for her, as if he were her own. Chi Yan struggled at the bottom of the entertainment industry for over a decade, before finally clawing his way up to become a celebrated Film Emperor. Fu Shilin, meanwhile, entered the industry just to chase after the heroine, and effortlessly shot up to near top-tier popularity. On a pet variety show— Chi Yan risked his life to save a kitten. People mocked him as s*upid, saying he was just trying to atone for his sins. No one remembered that the kitten had died in the jaws of Fu Shilin’s dog. In the end, Chi Yan, driven by jealousy toward Fu Shilin, made a move against the heroine, Du Qingqing, and paid the price—drowning in the sea. Everyone cheered, thinking justice was served. No one remembered that, at the beginning, Chi Yan had been innocent too. The original novel branded him a paranoid, twisted lunatic in the dark—forgetting that he was also the one who once risked his life to save a stray kitten, leaving a permanent scar on his hand. Then one day, after a car accident, Li Wan transmigrated into the very kitten Chi Yan had been assigned on that pet variety show. She flicked her fluffy tail, her gaze complicated as she watched the man sitting in the dark, head lowered against the wall, drenched in sweat from the pain. She took a deep breath. Two seconds later, she padded silently over, arched her little body, and brushed her soft fur gently across the back of his hand. If possible… she hoped he wouldn’t have to be anyone’s foil. That his future life could be like spring after a long winter, flowers blooming everywhere. *** Chi Yan knew he was a cursed star. Because of him, his family shattered; his mother cast him aside as though he were poison. He thought he lived in hell. Until that stray cat, placed in his care, crept quietly toward him. Its round, bright eyes gazed up at him, and with a soft *meow*, he suddenly felt the light of the human world. *** Fluffy Sweet Kitten × Gentle and Bright on the Surface but Paranoid and Dark Film Emperor

title: I Became the Coach of the Last-Place High School Baseball Team.
summary: Park Hyun-jae was once a rising Major League pitcher— a star who burned bright and vanished just as quickly. It wasn’t just injury that forced him into early retirement. The weight on his shoulders had been heavier than any torn ligament. Freed at last from that crushing pressure, he settled into the life of an ordinary man. Then an unexpected opportunity came knocking. “Hey. Go coach the baseball team.” “I quit baseball years ago. How am I supposed to be a coach?” “Then what do you want us to do? The team’s about to be shut down.” “…What?” He had no grand expectations. No blazing passion left for the sport. But when he heard— “I moved to Seoul because I want to play baseball!” These brats. Fine. If that’s how it is, I’ll throw in all the money and connections I’ve got… and raise them properly.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural

title: Twilight Games
summary: This story, Twilight Games, is a steamy modern romance about the intense push-and-pull between Jiang Xirui, a world-weary "Old Money" heiress, and Zhou Xingzhi, an ambitious "New Money" CEO. Their paths first cross in a snow-swept Swiss town where a drunken kiss ignites an undeniable, raw passion. Despite the scorching heat between them, their initial encounter ends abruptly due to conflicting identities and misunderstandings. Six months later, fate throws them back together in Beijing, this time as adversaries on opposing sides of a high-stakes corporate acquisition. The negotiation table becomes a battleground for their wits and wills, but the lingering desire from their first encounter quickly spills over, leading to intimate encounters in various locations and positions. This is a love game where they're bickering across the negotiation table by day and battling it out in bed by night. World-Weary Feline VS. Practical, Ambitious Lion.

title: Traveling Through Time, I Became a Big Shot with a Daily Check-In System!
summary: Unexpectedly, Shi Liu found herself in the underworld with a blink of an eye, only to discover that her life wasn’t supposed to end yet—her soul had been taken by mistake. Luckily, as a ghost with connections, she managed to intimidate her way into receiving a “check-in” system as compensation from a stern master and the judgment officer, who then swept her into the cycle of reincarnation. Reborn as the adoptive niece of a modern metaphysics mogul in the old Shi family, Shi Liu embarks on her journey of daily check-ins. “Congratulations, Host, for successfully checking in. You’ve obtained a Pearwood Makeup Box 1.” “Successful check-in at the Royal Governess Wang’s Tomb. Congratulations, Host, you’ve received a Royal Etiquette Teaching Course.” “Successful check-in at the Prince’s Tomb. Congratulations, Host, you’ve received twelve superior lake pens.” … Wait a second, why does this handsome guy look so familiar? And why on earth is my past life’s first love here? Ha, thought you could stir his heart and escape? No way! A refreshingly straightforward story with a system-based progression.

title: Martial Arts: Starting With Immortal Cultivation, the Female Warriors Are All Broken
summary: Comprehensive Martial Arts World, Jiuzhou Continent. Jiang Che traveled here and practiced for eighteen years to awaken the sign-in system. "Ding, the host signs in to Snow Moon City, and is rewarded with the inheritance of the Drunken Sword Immortal!" "Ding, the host signs in to Peach Blossom Island, and is rewarded with the Tai Chi Xuanqing Dao!" "Ding, the host signs in to the Yin-Yang Family Residence, and is rewarded with the dual cultivation secret technique Yin-Yang Heavenly Immortal Technique!" With the sign-in system, Jiang Che traveled around the Jiuzhou Continent and stood at the top of the world step by step! Li Hanyi: "Legendary man, look at the sword!" Huang Rong: "Woo woo woo, Brother Che, please let me go..." Wanwan: "My feet are fragrant and soft? My brother-in-law is a pe*vert!" Jiang Che: "It's over, the whole Jiuzhou Continent knows that I am a s*umbag!"
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Wuxia

title: Journey to the Abyss
summary: Tianmen Town: A city that held the secrets of the Immortal Realm and Eternal Life. However, six years ago, an unexplained event left the city in ruins. Everyone died, and it became a place inhabited only by ghosts. So-un (Su Yun) is the sole human survivor of Tianmen Town. Although he lost his eyesight in the accident on “that day,” he grew up healthy and brilliant under the tender care of the villagers. He remained completely unaware that his caretakers were actually ghosts and demons… Then one day, a mysterious master appears, shaking the foundation of So-un’s peaceful life. So-un eventually leaves for the city, accompanied by the fox demons he grew up with like brothers. His goals: To regain his sight, to exact revenge, and to uncover the secrets hidden within his lost memories. “But wait… why is it so incredibly hard just to get an education in this city?!” Raised by ghosts and taught by foxes—this is the chaotic, turbulent coming-of-age story of a remarkable boy.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Tragedy

title: Martial God Sovereign
summary: The Cloud Continent, respected for martial arts, the great world descends and the geniuses gather. This era is a stage for the wicked. Han Yu, who is a demon from the sky that swallows the body, rose after three years of silence, and since then he embarked on the path to hegemony by trampling and killing all kinds of evil spirits. In front of Han Yu, nobody dared to call him against the sky, because the world can be swallowed, much less against the sky.

title: Heavenly Dao Rankings: I Am Exposed As The Sword God
summary: Li Yu transmigrated to a world of the cultivation and martial arts. He became the head disciple of a low-ranking sect. Coinciding with the decline of the righteous Path, demons rampaged across a chaotic world. He planned to train until he was invincible before leaving the mountain. However, when he was 17, the Heavenly Dao Rankings suddenly descended upon the world. Whoever made the rankings would receive the rewards of the Heavenly Dao. This shocked the world. What was even more shocking was that the person who placed first on the Hidden Dragon Rankings was Li Yu from an unknown sect!!! Overnight, Li Yu became famous all over the world. However, this was only the beginning. When the Divine Weapon Rankings, Blood Physique Rankings, Natural Oddities Rankings, Sons of Heaven Rankings, Sect Rankings and many more appeared one after another, the entire world was astonished!

title: Ancient Otherworld: My Beastman Companion is Too Clingy
summary: Here, female beastmen are revered, and she is mistaken for a male beastman by everyone, so she disguises herself as a man. By the way, that clingy dragon clan leader, aren’t you the main villain in the book? Why are you so persistent? Why aren’t you even doing what a villain should do?! And the original male lead, your female lead is right beside you!

title: Path to Heaven
summary: Wei Suo, a low level cultivator from the Spirit Peak City was scammed in a transaction. He ended up purchasing a damaged low level magical treasure. However, this worthless damaged magical treasure had an artifact spirit that already lived for several tens of thousands of years… On top of that, compared to several tens of thousands of years ago, many of the rare and sparse things were abundant now. The first thing Wei Suo discovered was that the materials used to make a Fire Talisman that was worth half a Low Quality Spiritual Stone were extremely abundant now.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Xuanhuan

title: Cute Pet Farmhouse APP User Guide
summary: Heavy pet lover Xu Xiaozhi was forced to spend all her savings to inherit her missing uncle's farmhouse. She originally thought she could then live a carefree life in the mountains, earn a little money, and enjoy life. But who could have told her that this rundown house hidden deep in the mountains was what they called a "farmhouse stay"? Fortunately, when all seemed lost, Xu Xiaozhi activated the Cute Pet Farmhouse APP. As long as she completed the live streaming tasks inside the app, she could exchange points in the mall to get resources to build up the farmhouse. So, she started live streaming in the farmhouse carrying a camera. Unexpectedly, during her streams, she met a "complicated" tabby kitten, a sharp-tongued, thick-skinned colorful parrot, a raccoon family stealing food in the kitchen, beasts from mysterious mountain forests... Her stream's popularity soared. Using the app, she built a creekside camping and fishing platform, a forest cat café, a campfire tent campsite, a cute pet amusement park at the farmhouse, a one-stop RV park, a glass rose greenhouse, an automated fruit and vegetable greenhouse base, a northern mountain hot spring treehouse hotel... The farmhouse became a famous internet celebrity cute pet farmhouse. However, after a while, Xu Xiaozhi noticed strange things: the café's floor-to-ceiling cat climbing frame was suddenly broken in half overnight, weird incidents happened in the mushroom forest, with ghostly cries in the middle of the night... The viewers kept sending messages she couldn't understand. "What do you mean the cat is dangerous?" Xu Xiaozhi picked up the obedient little tabby cat her farmer had spoiled, looked it over, and gave it a kiss on the screen. "Not dangerous at all, Beishan is very cute…" Seeing this, the viewers flooded the chat, "Save our little cutie, that's an ancient ferocious beast!!" Unfortunately, an unknown force blocked all the messages. The culprit was the obedient cat, quietly curled in Xu Xiaozhi's arms, its ears blushing. — From 100,000 light-years away, an alien being: "Let me see what new streams there are today? Oh wow, what's this little Calami!" At first, everyone thought this was just an ordinary stream. Until the war-torn, might-makes-right orcs watched the streamer build a farmhouse from scratch in another world for orcs to relax — even opening an interstellar passage to the other world. Since then, starship tickets have been nearly impossible to get.

title: The Genius Senior Brother Defies Heaven, Shattering the Prodigy’s Resolve
summary: Jiang Xuan transmigrated into a fantasy world, becoming the Ninth Holy Son of the Great Yan Holy Land. As the young master of the Jiang family in the Northern Region, his identity was prestigious, and his talent was terrifying. Along with this new life, a unique system accompanied him. [Option 1: Kill the Daughter of Destiny, plunder her fortune, and rise as an unparalleled villain. Additional reward: Heaven-defying comprehension.] [Option 2: Act as a guide and teacher, embark on the path of a destined senior brother, and achieve eternal enlightenment. Additional reward: Heaven-defying comprehension.] “Senior Brother, please accept me as your disciple. Qing’er promises never to disappoint you!” Jiang Xuan looked at the sincere Daughter of Destiny, her pleading eyes filled with determination. Adding to this, his beautiful master’s subtle encouragement left him pondering his decision. Fine. Becoming the destined senior brother didn’t seem so bad. However, as the system’s rewards unfolded, Jiang Xuan realized that the situation was taking an unexpected turn. “Senior Brother’s comprehension is too terrifying; I must hold on tightly to this opportunity!” “With Senior Brother here, who says a Supreme Bone can’t regrow after being stolen?” “Senior Brother… you’ve already become the Immortal Emperor?!” Years later, when otherworldly invaders struck, his beautiful master…
genres: Adult, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Xianxia

title: Your Talent Is Good; It’s Now Mine
summary: Cracks appear in space a century from now, and spiritual energy is revived. Fierce demonic beasts rage and emerge from the ground. A minority of the human race awaken skills and become martial artists. [You have obtained the C-level skill, Sword Proficiency.] [You have obtained the B-level skill, Frost Element.] [You have obtained the B-level skill, Fire Element.] [You have obtained the B-level skill, Poison Element.] [You have obtained the A-level skill, Divine Blessing.] The skill of Li Jiye’s awakening: [You have obtained the SSS-level skill, Skill Replication.] [Skill Replication - Replicate the skill of the martial artist you touch.] Hence— “Hey, your Wind Wolf King’s contract looks good. Can I touch it?” The prideful girl nods doubtfully. Upon touching it, Li Jiye secretly replicates the two A-level skills of the Wind Wolf King, [Thunder Element] and [Hurricane Element]. “Brother, I've long admired you. Let's be friends.” Li Jiye reaches out to shake hands with the young genius, secretly replicating the S-level skill [Advanced Practice]. He smiles kindly in return. The world’s most talented genius is hence born. “I have to say, your skill is very powerful. But it’ll be mine before you blink.”

title: Explosive! The Black and Red Top Star Gained a Sister
summary: Top-tier star Lu Fei had just finished his concert when a little girl with two tiny pigtails appeared backstage, speaking in a sweet, childish voice: "My name is Lu Youyou, and I'm your little sister." Lu Fei was baffled. "Who are your parents?" The little girl enunciated clearly: "My dad is Lu Yu, and my mom is Shi Ning. Dad's phone number is 18X..." Lu Fei scoffed. "This is hilarious—even your scam is sloppy! My parents divorced ten years ago!" A week later, the hot-tempered star was slapped in the face by a paternity test. Lu Fei’s world crumbled. "Kid… you’re really my sister?!" Lu Yu and Shi Ning had been separated for a decade. When their second son, Lu Fei, pointed at a delicate little girl claiming to be his daughter, Lu Yu was stunned. He had been single for ten years—no drunken accidents, no surprises. But the girl’s nose and eyes… they looked just like his. Wait… she said she was born in 20XX—which was… three years from now?! Despite the absurdity, the family of five was forced to reunite because of this little sister who had traveled back from six years in the future. At first, life was chaotic. Lu Yu and Shi Ning ignored each other, and the atmosphere under one roof was nothing but awkward. The eldest brother was cold, the second brother was explosive, and the third brother was brooding… You You could only hide under her blanket, wiping away tears in secret. She missed her old family so, so much. Until… her brothers gradually revealed their doting sides. When You You had a fever, the eldest brother dropped his urgent work to take care of her. On her birthday, the second brother canceled his schedule just to bake her a cake himself. When she was afraid of the dark, even the third brother—who always prioritized competitions—found a substitute player, gently patting her head and patiently lulling her to sleep. Later, the long-standing misunderstandings between Lu Yu and Shi Ning were finally resolved. Lu Yu tentatively asked, "Master wife… since we already have a daughter, maybe we should… find some time to remarry?" Reading Guide: 1. A heartwarming, family-centric story about a beloved little sister. 2. Features an original, fun-filled dating show and divorce show. If you love variety shows, jump straight to Chapter 17! 3. Set in an alternate universe—purely fictional, don’t take it seriously. Tags: Sweet Story, Transmigration, Wish-Fulfillment Main Characters: You You, Lu Fei Supporting Characters: Morally Upright Dad, Actress Mom, Genius Eldest Brother, Prodigy Third Brother Others: —
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: The Villainess’s Feeding Guide for the Antagonist
summary: I transmigrated as a maid to a Deposed Crown Prince. The System told me he was the villain and that I was responsible for giving him a miserable childhood. However, the little villain was far too good at acting cute. In a moment of weakness, I secretly snuck him out of the palace for a feast. When the System found out, it hurriedly wiped his memory of the meal: [The villain isn't allowed to have such wonderful memories! Delete them all!] My eyes lit up; it was as if I'd discovered a bug. From then on, I frequently took the villain out to gorge himself, only for his memory to be cleared afterward. Five years later. The villain reclaimed his title as Crown Prince and coldly accused me: "You mistreated me every day and refused to feed me. Now, I shall settle every one of those scores!" The accompanying palace attendants looked at the robust villain, who stood a towering 1.9 meters tall. They slowly lapsed into silence.

title: Conquering Another World with Set Theory
summary: Eugene, a fourth-year math student who has always been obsessed with math, is hit by a truck one day and reincarnated into a world where math-based magic is implemented. But the level of mathematics in this world is only medieval...? Eugene's story of conquering this world, trying to change the mathematics of this world, where intuition reigns, into modern mathematics armed with rigor.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The Other Woman in His Phone
summary: On the day of my business trip, I discovered my boyfriend's secret. He has had a Weibo account for a long time, filled with words of love for another girl. He is willing to love her from over a thousand kilometers away, yet he refuses to be in a long-distance relationship with me, even if it's only a hundred kilometers apart. He says he doesn't like traveling far, but for her, he has saved up two hundred and thirteen long-distance train tickets. In this vast world, among thousands, he loves Mumu the most. But I am Zhaozhao.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: I Was Condemned to a Corner Because No One Believed Me
summary: I was accused of stealing a girl’s gym clothes, a crime I had no recollection of committing, and I lost everyone’s trust. I lost the trust of everyone. My classmates were always abusive to me and looked at me with contempt. Furthermore, even my first girlfriend, whom I had trusted, gave up on me. My parents rejected me and my sister treated me like I didn’t exist. ……But then the turning point came. It was revealed that I had been falsely accused. I received apologies one after another from people who had treated me with disdain. They want to get back together with me, but I can’t reconcile with them now.

title: My Plan for Cultural Invasion of Another World
summary: Transmigrating to another world isn't just about fighting and killing; it also involves cultural subversion and destruction! While other transmigrators were still diligently practicing their skills and leveling up, I had already started using Douyin short videos to make the elves addicted and flooding the screen, using "Honor of Kings" to make the orcs addicted to team battles, and using milk tea and desserts to make the dragon princess gain three sizes! Office worker Lin Mo unexpectedly transmigrates to a world of swords and magic, only to find it culturally barren, like a desert. Just as he's wondering how to survive, he's bound to the [Earth Culture Transmission System] —by getting otherworldly creatures to accept Earth culture, he can earn points to exchange for anything! Then, the art style suddenly changed: A group of dragons, carrying small stools, binge-watched "Game of Thrones" day and night, their way of urging the author to update was to tap their tails on his door. The elven druids were moved to tears by "Hachi: A Dog's Tale" and began to protect all canines. A demon lord used his sect's assets as collateral to buy in-game currency for gacha pulls, while a vampire prince shouted "OMG, buy it!" during a live-streaming sales event. Five years later, when the human alliance was preparing to conquer this "corrupted" continent, they discovered: Orc laborers protested their short working hours by holding banners that read "007 is a blessing." The succubus's emotional counseling classes made the nuns blush and their hearts race, yet they eagerly signed up. The entire otherworld's desire for war has been completely dismantled by the three philosophies of "playing it safe," "lying down," and "watching the show."

title: Durarara!! SH
summary: Durarara!! SH is a sequel series of light novels following Durarara!!. Set one and a half years after the end of the original series, SH features the same setting as Durarara!! and much of the previous series’ cast returns alongside several new main characters. The first volume was published in April 2014 under the Dengeki Bunko imprint, and three volumes have been released in total as of January 2015. As with its predecessor, SH is written by Ryohgo Narita and illustrated by Suzuhito Yasuda. One and a half years after the end of the Dollars, Ikebukuro now welcomes a new wind. Yahiro Mizuchi, a cowardly boy with a knack for fighting, moves to Ikebukuro after a childhood of ostracization in his hometown in Akita. Come to the city in hopes of meeting the famed Headless Rider and validating his existence as a “monster," he enrolls in Raira Academy as a freshman where he quickly befriends fellow classmates Kuon Kotonami and Himeka Tatsugami, both of whom possess their own reasons for seeking out the urban legend. Meanwhile, the rider in black has yet to be seen in the city for the past half year, and anyone who has since attempted to seek out Ikebukuro’s resident Dullahan has vanished without a trace. With a new start on life, Yahiro wants nothing more than to live out a quiet, ordinary existence, but the city of Ikebukuro has other plans...
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Mystery, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: Reborn as an Honest Man, I Refuse to Raise Those Ungrateful Siblings Again!
summary: [1970s + Rebirth + Unlimited Space with Supplies + Getting Rich + Face-Slapping Ungrateful Relatives] Honest man Lin Chaoyang suffered his entire life, sacrificing everything to raise his three younger siblings. But when he was on the brink of death, those same siblings joined forces to deceive him and steal the money that could’ve saved his life. Sick and struggling, he dragged out his final days in misery—no one even asked how he was. Then he opened his eyes… and found himself back at eighteen. Faced with the three ungrateful wolves who were still counting on him to provide for them, Lin Chaoyang simply turned his back on them without hesitation.

title: When I Encountered The Stunningly Gorgeous Gloomy Beauty At The Doorstep
summary: During my first year of high school, amidst the rainy season, while enjoying living alone due to my parents' business trip, I, an utterly average guy, encountered my strikingly good-looking neighbor, Sajou-san, on a certain rainy day. In front of my neighboring apartment's entrance, seeing her sitting there, drenched and hugging her knees, I couldn't just leave her be, so I decided to invite her into my room. Everything was fine up to that point, but.. "Do as you please," she said, and began to take off her wet clothes. Her breasts didn't fit into the hoodie I lent her after she took a shower. She seemed defenseless, somewhat reckless, leaving me stunned. Two days later, she unexpectedly appeared at school, presenting me with a homemade bento. Was this some sort of cosplay trespassing? I teased, only for Sajou-san to nod towards the adjacent seat. It had remained empty since the beginning of the term—a spot reserved for the absentee student. "I'm Hitori Sajou. Pleasure to make your acquaintance, neighbor-san," she introduced herself with a hint of mystery lingering in her demeanor.
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: OVERLORD: The Second Supreme Being
summary: Transported to the world of the Overlord, I became the best friend of Ainz Ooal Gown, Peroroncino. With a max-level account, isn’t an isekai world just a playground for doing whatever I want?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: Chronically Relapsing Hunter
summary: “No matter how many times I die—again and again—this shitty world never changes. But… maybe I’ll try just one last time. That damned Hunter.”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Psychological, Sci-fi

title: Train Elementary Level Spell, Magic Arrow to the Absolute Limit ~The Exiled Noble Student Not Giving up, Train to Become the Strongest~
summary: Albert, who had learned the beginner-level spell Magic Arrow at a very young age, was expected to do great things in the future. However, he was unable to learn any other spells. Albert’s father was a noble who heavily valued his dignity, so he banished his good-for-nothing son and granted him a house to stay in. There, Albert would live out more than ten years reading Magic Arrow spellbooks. After day after day of practice, he would unknowingly break the limit of his spell. To a young lady despairing that she would miss her exam, Albert would say: “I’ll take you there with Magic Arrow.” “How are you gonna do that using a spell with a firing range of 50 meters?” This is the story of a man pushing through hardships using his dysfunctional spell and eventually becoming the strongest magician⁠—all while convinced that his Magic Arrow is only slightly stronger than most.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: Conquering the Horror Game Boss
summary: When I entered the horror game, my eyes automatically locked onto two tags: "18+" and "Adult Game." I mistakenly thought it was an otome game. In the prison-themed horror game, the Warden held a whip. His face was pale, his eyes a crimson red, and his voice was sinister as he asked, "Who wants to go first?" My face lit up with excitement as my mind filled with countless unspeakable scenes and scenarios. "Hubby, me! Pick me!" The Warden froze in place. Bullet Comments: [Is this Newbie suicidal? Is she crazy? What a nutcase.] [Even if the Warden is handsome, she shouldn't act like this! Is this the legendary 'to die under a peony flower, a romantic soul even in death'?] [I bet this Newbie is a goner.] Later, as I enjoyed the wide variety of techniques the Warden displayed, they never could have imagined just how happy I was.

title: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam W
summary: In the year After Colony 195, with the start of Operation Meteor, the scientists' plan for revenge against the OZ military organization. The operation involves five young boys who have each been chosen and trained by one of the five rogue scientists, then sent to Earth independently in extremely advanced Mobile Suits, one designed by each of the scientists, known as "Gundams". Their Mobile Suits are called Gundams because they are constructed from a rare and astonishingly durable material known as Gundanium alloy, which can only be created in outer space. The five Gundam Pilots — Heero Yuy (an alias, not to be confused with the assassinated leader), Duo Maxwell (also an alias), Trowa Barton (another alias, he was previously known as Nanashi (No-Name)), Quatre Raberba Winner, and Chang Wufei — originally have no knowledge of each others' existence. On first meeting any of the other five, each pilot believes the others to be enemy pilots in new OZ mobile suit designs. Once the young pilots realize that they have the same objective of destroying OZ (and in some cases the same mission), they band together to help each other complete their goals.

title: The Village Beauty of the 1980s Married the Village Tyrant to Avoid Trouble and Gave Birth to a Cub
summary: Su Yunqi was a well-known delicate beauty in the surrounding area. Unfortunately, the old Su family was too weak to protect her. After a rich gangster took a fancy to her, they had to hastily marry her off to a rough man from the next village—a bigger village tyrant. Although he was five years older than her, they had grown up together as childhood sweethearts. However, on the surface, they never seemed to get along. On their wedding night, Lu Zhao pinched Su Yunqi's chin and sneered coldly. “You squeamish brat, you’ve fallen into my hands now, haven’t you? Didn’t you laugh at me for not being able to find a wife? Who did I marry now? Just wait and see how I ruthlessly destroy this beautiful flower!” “You’re so annoying!” Su Yunqi knew she had no choice now but to marry him. If it had been before, she would’ve cursed him right back. Now, she could only turn her face away, eyes full of grievance as she began to cry. The tall and burly Lu Zhao was stunned. He could only give up on cruelly crushing the flower and gently wiped her tears away. "If you touch me once, I won't hit you." With tear-filled eyes, Su Yunqi reached out and touched him. Then, a certain overexcited someone devoured her completely and spent the rest of the night coaxing his young wife. On the second night, he tasted the sweetness and became addicted. On the third night, that mischievous man used a ghost story to trick his wife into taking the initiative... Later on, the village tyrant willingly gave everything for his delicate little wife! ⋆⁺₊⋆ ━━━━⊱༒︎ • ༒︎⊰━━━━ ⋆⁺₊⋆ A sharp-tongued and doting village tyrant vs. a delicate, sensible, and lovable village flower—it was simply the daily life of an immature and poisonous-tongued brute teasing his wife, getting rich along the way. Who wouldn’t want to tease a soft, tearful, and pampered little wife? Later, they even raised a child and teased the child together!

title: The Reincarnated Princess Wants Territory Rather Than Love, So She Needs a Political Marriage! His Proposition Is Unexpected
summary: — Lead an army to win battles and increase your territory. Fairis reincarnated in the world of the game “Stealing a Kingdom”. Using her knowledge of the game, she becomes the princess of the empire and plays an active role in the war, to the extent that she is called the Warrior Princess. However, when peace comes, her father, the king, gives her a heartless order… “Get married!!” “Well, I didn’t come from another world just to fall in love. Yes, let’s get married for political reasons!” Fairis wants a partner that understands the true nature of their relationship, but for some reason she’s now competing with her sister, the princess to see who gets married first. Candidates are the son of the Prime Minister, the son of the Knights’ Commander, the son of the Great Mage, etc. In addition, the sorcerer Orfed, the last boss of the game, is another candidate for the groom’s post. “What is this? An otome game? Why do I need such glittering men when I just need a business partner!?” Fairis, who wants more territory than finding love or giving her father a son-in-law, wonders who can she marry to control the territory herself. However, Orfed, who was not interested in status, money, or territory, confessed to her. “Love is heavy, but …” Orfed urges Fairis to marry him, while Fairis tries to somehow create a rational, loveless political marriage. This is a story about a reincarnated princess with no love skills and the handsome sorcerer she saved when he was young.

title: The World of Reincarnated Beings
summary: The spectacular second life of a reincarnated person who received a superhuman ability buff.

title: Doomed World, Don’t Fall Apart
summary: Cynthia Astley, the good-for-nothing princess with neither magic nor popularity. Warren Tenneris, the black mage feared and shunned by the entire kingdom. “Your Grace, would you care to dance with me?” “My apologies, but I must respectfully decline.” Two people who thought they would never cross paths again find their fates colliding once more. “Your Grace, have you ever considered curing your obsessive cleanliness?” “If that’s what this is about, I’m not interested.” “… Do I look like some sort of con artist to you?” But this isn’t because Cynthia has fallen for Warren’s looks— It’s because she knows his magic rampage will one day bring the world to ruin! With the knowledge only I possess, I’ll save this world. Will Cynthia truly be able to save this doomed world? “I… would be better off never existing in this world at all.” And will the hand she extends in salvation be able to reach Warren as well? A healing romance fantasy between two misfits of the kingdom.
