Without much effort, he possesses an unimaginable amount of assets and skills from his previous 99 lives. “Senior, your mansion and estates are everywhere. Where did all this money come from?” “Confess, all the ways to make big money are written in the criminal code!” Qi Tongwei smiles faintly, “I earned this enormous amount of money with my abilities. Are you jealous, Hou Liangping?”
genres: Action, Adult, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Douluo Dalu: My System Is Dissastified
summary: How can one survive in this world without a system now?! Awaken the system at the beginning and receive the most bizarre disobedience system! “The system detects that the host envies Tang San for having twin martial spirits. The system expresses disobedience and helps the host awaken three martial spirits!” … “The system detects that the host envies Tang San for obtaining the external spirit bone, Eight Spider Lance. The system expresses disobedience and grants the host the external spirit bone, Dragon Phoenix Ancient Wings!” … “The system detects that the host is being ab*sed by Zhao Wuji. The system expresses disobedience and gives the Spirit Douluo Experience Card.” … Besides envy and disobedience, is there anything else the system can do? Of course! “The system detects that the host prevented Tang San from absorbing the spirit ring of the human-faced demon spider, subverting the original storyline and rewarding 800 attribute points.”
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Douluo Continent: I Am the Lord of Light
summary: Ling Xiao (Mige) died unexpectedly due to an accident and transmigrated to Douluo Continent after death. Witness how Ling Xiao uses his foreknowledge to stand at the pinnacle of Douluo Continent.

title: Chasing the Stars as an Immortal
summary: When ancient China is steeped in the ambiance of martial heroes and immortals, a regular young person discovers they possess mysterious immortal powers. He embarked on an adventurous journey, pursuing mythical stars while facing the threat of dark forces. In the ancient world of martial heroes and immortals, he will uncover the secrets of the universe and shape his own destiny.

title: A Person Wanders in Spirits Performing Spirit Mediumship, Causing the Loss of Zeng and Sun Generals
summary: People in the Min region often say that if the heavens don't agree, Mazu's agreement is enough. Lin Haien, conceived on Qingming Festival and born on Winter Solstice, possesses a naturally yin-yang fate and a spiritual body, carrying an extremely heavy destiny. Solitary souls and wandering ghosts harass him, all wanting to usurp his body, substituting for the real. To seek that sliver of a chance at survival, his grandmother, the midwife, took the newborn Lin Haien to the Mazu temple to cast Sacred Cups. Three Sacred Cups, Mazu's blessing, Lin Haien survived. ......For many years, all was peaceful, until the New Year You Shen. Lin Haien, dressed in Guan Jiang Shou attire, suddenly saw the lurking Great Black Buddha Mother, an evil ghost within the crowd, and his eyes instantly turned vertical. Lifting the sun incense, stepping with the three-step chant, Zeng and Sun Generals, killing only, not saving. Shaking his head, performing spirit mediumship!!!

title: Musket Girls
summary: The world I reincarnated in is a relatively modern era where wars are fought with line infantry. As a Commoner Second Lieutenant, I'm labelled as a 'Death God' and ostracized, and posted to the all women Sixth Special Brigade to serve as a Strategist. The Brigade Commander with hidden intentions, and the clueless Sergeants are all women. Naturally, the troopers are all girls. If this goes on, everyone will die in battle. I need to do something... But what exactly?!

title: Quick Transmigration: Leisure Time
summary: Save the world? Not happening~ Her life motto: eat, slack off, and wait to die! First world: The uneventful daily life of a female hooligan in Chang’an City. Second world: A shameless consort stirring up a messy, reckless palace drama. Third world: A little heartthrob whose path goes off-script, and the male lead becomes a mystery. Fourth world: A delicate clinging vine blamed by a badass apocalyptic heroine. Fifth world: A fiery young widow—inside a retro-era novel, the villain’s precious son breaks his heart over his cheap stepmom. Sixth world: The sect leader’s maid, constantly dealing with the harem-worthy Dragon-AoTian type and his endless stream of flirtatious women.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance, School Life, Xianxia

title: The Farming Life of a Destruction-Level Archmage
summary: [Destruction Point +1] [The end of the world is approaching.] [When your Destruction Points reach 100, the apocalypse begins.] Since being summoned to another world, John Sutton had undertaken countless quests to survive and prevent the world’s destruction. These quests threw him into innumerable battles and warzones. After ten years of relentless fighting, the ‘Retirement’ quest he received felt like a sweet respite. [Retire] [Delays the apocalypse.] [Plant wheat] [Delays the apocalypse.] He no longer wanted to fight, nor did he want to lose anyone. All he wished for was an ordinary life and simple farming. The man who once burned the world to ashes now only wanted to plant wheat. But the world would not leave him in peace: The suspicious villagers The squatting siblings The cow ‘P.D.’ with an oddly strong affinity for mana Secrets beyond the mountain ranges And even a seemingly broken status window John’s peaceful rural life quickly became a second battlefield on which the fate of the world hung in the balance.

title: After Being Reborn and Regaining Her Identity, the True Heiress Is Spoiled in the Seventies
summary: [Time Travel + Online Shopping Mall + Sweet Petting + Sudden Wealth + Strong Female Lead + Abusive s*um Male Lead] An Zhi Xia was born and immediately had her identity swapped out. She was harmed by the fake rich miss and her foster parents until no bones remained. After drifting for a hundred years as a ghost, she watched with her own eyes as the fake rich miss assumed her identity to marry into a prestigious family, achieving success in both career and love. The fake rich miss also angered An Zhi Xia's birth parents to death, and left her four brothers either dead or disabled. Upon returning to the 1970s when she was harmed, the hundred-year-old ghost An Zhi Xia decisively counterattacked. She acknowledged her birth parents, drove away the fake rich miss, and sent her foster parents to prison. Did you think she wanted familial love? No, she only wanted the villains to pay the price. But things often go beyond one's expectations. An Zhi Xia's big brother doted on her, second brother cherished her, third brother loved her, fourth brother protected her. As for her mother, she was always worried about the fake rich miss, but that no longer mattered. Her grandparents still made the decisions at home and could not be swayed. In this life, An Zhi Xia wanted to live for herself, make money, and pursue her career. Yet she was secretly being watched by someone. Pei Jing had a irritable personality but was handsome. After an accident where he was taken advantage of by an ugly woman, he thought he would hate her gritting his teeth. But instead, he unexpectedly fell deeply in love with her, doting on and cherishing her for life.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Lost Winter
summary: During the sentimental retrospective at our wedding, my husband took one look at the screen before his eyes turned bloodshot. He grabbed a chair and began smashing the display in a blind frenzy. Standing on the wedding stage, I laughed until tears streamed down my face. I was the one who played that video. I had been waiting for this moment for a very long time.

title: Thousand Miles of Knowledge
summary: The heroine is blind, but has a special vision; the male protagonist is a turbid person, powerful but mentally unstable. This is a story of a long evolutionary journey of the male protagonist and the female protagonist.

title: Fake Relationship
summary: "I almost misunderstood." "Misunderstanding?" "You were dressed so beautifully, sitting next to me, and kept looking at me. I thought you had another intention." She met him in Venice, the city of water and romance, where she had traveled alone after breaking up with her boyfriend. "What if it wasn't a misunderstanding...?" She must have been possessed by something. By the time she came to her senses, the words had already left her mouth. "Are you sure about this?" Si-heon asked with a chuckle. He had subtly implied, "Do you know what it means for a woman dressed like that to stare at men here?" Yet, she replied it wasn't a misunderstanding, her eyes fluttering. She even clenched her fists, as if making a grand decision; he wanted to tease her more. "Let's go. I don't think there's any need to waste more time." Thump, So-yi's heart pounded fiercely. He actually accepted. Her mind was reeling wildly, but her body moved on its own. She knew what it meant to follow him like this, yet she pretended ignorance and followed him. "Let's date for just one month. A fake one."

title: I Was Dismissed from the Hero’s Party Because They Don’t Need My Training Skills, so I Strengthen My [Fief] Which I Got as a Replacement for My Retirement Money.
summary: 27-year old veteran adventurer Aiga James was once the center of the Hero’s party. However he specialized in the [Training] skill which is no longer necessary now that all his teammates have grown strong. Unable to keep up with his companions, he was forced to quit the party. However, because he had made a great contribution to the party till now, he received a small「Fief」as a retirement bonus. As my heart felt the loneliness of leaving the life of Adventure and I headed to my territory, I had a thought after seeing the seven villages with their 2500-strong population. My thoughts are the following… I wonder if I train these people, won’t my territory become strong enough that we could even defeat the demon lord?

title: Reincarnated as a Villain’s Lackey, I Seriously Consider a “Villain Redemption Plan”
summary: Reborn After Death—As a Villain’s Lackey in a Famous Light Novel. At first, I didn’t even realize it. I was just another background character, enjoying my time in this new world. But then it hit me—I was one of the villain’s lackey. A minor character fated to oppose the protagonist… and die. I don’t want to die. After much deliberation, I made a decision—I’ll reform the main villain before I get dragged into his downfall. There’s no way I’m going down with him! An overpowered protagonist, stunning heroines, and a world filled with mysteries… A light novel fanatic goes all in on a villain redemption fantasy!

title: I Got Reincarnated as a Villainous Noble, and When I Tried to Create an All-Male Academy to Avoid a Bad Ending, for Some Reason the Gender Ratio Reversed?
summary: In an academy with a gender ratio of 1:99, I ended up surrounded by girls with overly intense love... I got reincarnated as the villainous noble in an eroge world. In the original story, I built a harem at the academy, did whatever I wanted, and ended up executed as a result. To avoid that future, I came up with a clever plan. "That's it. I should just create an academy full of guys." If there were no girls at the academy, I couldn't build a harem or get involved with girls. I could avoid the doom flags. To make that happen, I carried out reforms to the fullest extent, but... "This year's enrollees have a gender ratio of 1:99...!?" For some reason, the gender ratio reversed. The academy that was supposed to have only guys ended up filled with girls who were way too determined. Moreover, I, the one responsible for the reforms, somehow started receiving overly heavy affection from those around me. "Why won't you spend the night with me, Lord Ol?" "I will definitely repay you because you saved me. Even if it means offering my body." "Please share your genes with me to save the world. This is necessary as a saintess." They directed emotions that were far too heavy at me. I just wanted to avoid the doom flags. I never intended to build a harem. But everything was already too late. I would end up living in this academy with the reversed gender ratio, surrounded by girls. By the way, where did the original protagonist go?

title: One Hour Before Rejecting the Marriage
summary: My arch-rival and I are both top-tier Alphas. On the engagement stage, we both refused to marry each other at the exact same time. That night, we died together in an explosion at the harbor. When I opened my eyes again, I had returned to one hour before the rejection. Everyone was waiting to see us turn this political marriage into a joke once more. Only I knew that in our previous life, right before we died, Gu Xubai bit into the back of my neck. He used his pheromones to drag me back from the brink of losing control. What was even more absurd was that even though I was clearly an Alpha as well, the moment I caught a whiff of his cedar scent, my legs would go weak and my heart would race, just like an Omega going into heat.

title: My Little Sister Can’t Be My Girlfriend
summary: Sakuraba Fuyu is the cutest sister in the world. Although she is a junior high school girl, she is a beautiful girl who looks like a model, her breasts grow perfectly, and she has a good personality. “Let’s play a game! Today I’m going to mess with my onii-chan!” “Fufufu, how about you? I choose the clothes that my onii-chan seems to like.” “Onii-chan, let’s take a bath together? Sometimes it’s good ♪” However, She’s still a kid at home. For me, She’s a cute little sister forever, and I just enjoy the skinship of a brother and sister. I thought so……. However, one day, the fact of the shock was revealed that we were not real brother and sister! My sister couldn’t be my girlfriend … but this is a different story !? No matter what, in the end, a romantic comedy that is “absolutely” tied to my little sister!
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Ex-Husbands
summary: "Let's get a divorce." That night, after coaxing their son to sleep, Wei Yang said. Tang Wei was a little stunned. Just the day before yesterday, they had still been intimate like a normal married couple. Yesterday, it was just a minor argument. She had only forgotten his birthday—was that really worth a divorce? "Why?" Tang Wei asked. Wei Yang stayed silent. After a moment, he looked up calmly. "Mi Ke is back." Tang Wei sat alone in the study all night. "Fine. Let’s divorce. I only want the children." She said calmly the next morning. I just wanted you to coax me a little.
genres: Mature, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: From Gigolo to Crown Prince: The Secret Life of My Kept Boy
summary: On their wedding night, her husband eloped with his mistress abroad. Did Jiang Ciyou cry? No! She turned around and started supporting a stunningly handsome young man instead. Well, let’s all have a good time together! The young man had broad shoulders, a narrow waist, and a great body, always teasing her in a wild and seductive manner every night. After three carefree years, Jiang Ciyou handed the young man a massive check. “Darling, my husband is back, so let’s end this.” To her surprise, the young man exploded with rage: “Jiang Ciyou, do you know who I am that you want to dump me?” Jiang Ciyou ignored him and left with the check. Before long, she and her husband were invited to the birthday party of the richest man in town, where they met the legendary and fearsome Prince of the Beijing circle. He was exactly the same as the young man she had supported for three years… This is a disaster; it seems she has provoked someone she shouldn’t have.

title: The Comatose Officer Wakes Up to Find His Wife Taken
summary: Transformed into the cannon fodder ex-wife in a period novel, Gu Nanzi, a leading researcher, refused to accept her fate! She cast aside her abusive adoptive parents, the s*umbag who stole her sister, and her lecherous brother – the farther away the better! Forced to flee her marriage and sold to die in the mountains? Sorry, this time she's not running. She's marrying that comatose military officer! The reborn original female lead? This ex-wife is still here, who are you, little shrimp? But, she's just saving people and beating up bad guys, why is the country after her now? Xie Zhenting, carrying countless secrets, originally thought the woman who stripped him naked was a criminal. Later, he realized he had improper thoughts about her! After waking up, Xie Zhenting… "Where's my wife?" "She's..."

title: The Enhancer Wants to Live an Ordinary Life
summary: [Name: Energy Drink (+5)] Auxiliary Power: 1.4 (+0.4) Skill: Vitality Recharge Lv. 6 (+5) Effect: Infuses vitality into an exhausted body. Reduces stamina consumption. Gulp— Vitality surged through my weary body. ‘Good. Another day without trouble.’ That was when it happened. Bang—! “Did you throw out all my underwear?!” “Hmph. Got any proof?” “You little—!!” Haah… What on earth are two women—the world’s most powerful figure and the daughter of the country’s richest conglomerate—doing in my house first thing in the morning? Looks like today won’t pass by peacefully either.

title: All Heavens Ancestor Simulator
summary: Legend has it that the Supreme Saint sought eternal life, opened the heavens and the earth, and created the world and reincarnation. … In a small world, Su Yan woke up thirty years after his death with a cheat - the Ancestor Simulator. Why is it the Ancestor Simulator? Is this the reason why you came so late after I died for thirty years? After complaining, Su Yan began to develop his sect in this world and play various ancestors in the heavens. “Well, the Ancestor Simulator… it’s delicious!” (This is a sect building and disciple cultivation novel, welcome to try it out.)

title: The Abandoned Woman is Powerful and Alluring
summary: Lin Shuwan traveled through time and space and became an abandoned woman. Master Xue San of the Nanyang Marquisate was her ex-husband, and Master Xue Da was her ex-fiancé. She changed her identity and lived a secluded life in the city. Master Xue Da and Master Xue San both had a soft spot for her other identity. Until one day, her true identity was revealed. Her ex-fiancé, Xue Youchen, had a twitching Adam’s apple and red eyes: This marriage was always meant to be mine, and now it’s back to me, why not?

title: He Said I’m Not a Beta
summary: He told me I wasn't a Beta. He pinned me against the wall, the corners of his eyes flushed red, demanding to know how a Beta like me could be carrying an Omega's pheromones. But every medical report I'd ever received stated I was a Beta. It wasn't until he leaned down and bit into my lower abdomen-at the exact spot where a gland shouldn't have existed-that I realized he was never the one who was wrong. The only thing that had been wrong was the lab report that had kept me hidden for over twenty years.

title: Don’t Learn Mandarin Ducks
summary: The Zhuang Lady sent her dog, Yin Huayue, to keep an eye on him and confine him. She is cold-blooded and hypocritical, and always has a fake smile on her face. Helping him get ready, combing his hair, and lighting the lamps. Awake for twelve hours a day, Li Jingyun spends ten hours thinking about how to make her leave. But after that, she actually left. He became anxious. Despite our brief time together, we are not appreciated despite our strength. Rather be alone, instead of withering alongside with another.

title: My Captain
summary: Life is simply too short to have fun. Yan An agreed with this saying and decided to seek some sort of fun during her lonely trip. And now, in the present, inside the cramped airplane cabin, the skydiving instructor is sitting next to her. With an upright face and long and toned legs, the instructor overall has a striking and abstinent impression. Indeed it is an abundantly beautiful spring; spring is now in the human world. “Hey, handsome, my life is now in your hands now, so why don’t you give me your phone number, huh?” * As the first ray of sunlight penetrates the receding darkness of the night, Shan Yi slowly gets up, his rugged and sensual figure laid bare for all to see. But room is so dead and quiet as if there hasn’t been any trace of any living person. Then the phone under the pillow vibrates: There is a sudden emergency, so I’m returning to China first. Thank you for your kindness, and see you in the rivers and lakes soon! Bye-bye, handsome. Shan Yi silently smiled at the message; while morning rays of the sun strangely felt like it didn’t bring any warmth. * In Beitong Airlines, a new batch of trainee pilots has been recently dispatched. Yan An, who was assigned to follow the new captain of the aircraft, heard that he is one of the most competent and punctual captains in the entire civil aviation industry. And around that time, she heard the clacking sound of leather shoes approaching the door, Yan An decided sneakily stretched her neck to take a quick look, where she was left utterly dumbfounded. The man is in a crisp and pristine uniform. He has broad shoulders, narrow waist, and tall, upright body, that is seemingly bursting with testosterone. The gaze of the two collided, and with his black eyes so piercing and deep, Shan Yi raised his thin lips into a smile yet not like a smile, he gently pressed a hundred-euro bill onto the table, and calmly stated, “Returning it to its rightful owner.” The man declared in a cold-clipped tone: “My worth, when compared to this amount of money, is far from close.” Yan Dog: F*ck, you have lost your future by being wild like this!

title: The Innocent School Idol is My Cousin Who Lives with Me and is a Spoiled Brat
summary: "―Hey Kakeru, will you be my boyfriend?" Kakeru is summoned to the rooftop by his school idol, Arisugawa Mirei, who suddenly asks him to become her boyfriend. Naturally, Kakeru is perplexed. However, Mirei wants Kakeru to become a fake boyfriend in order to keep the boys away from her. The only person she can trust is her cousin Kakeru, whom she has been close to for a long time. Although he has his own feelings about it, Kakeru can't ignore the fact that his cousin is in trouble, and chooses to become her lover. ―However, Kakeru had no idea. That this relationship will make them more than just cousins.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Reasoning: Starting from the Floor Plan
summary: I looked it up online. Beef only takes 6 to 8 hours to be dried into beef jerky. I thought, for a person to be dried into a Mummy, it probably takes about the same amount of time.

title: The Demon in Her Womb
summary: Newly in love, I found my girlfriend attractive but unfathomable, for she wouldn't allow me to touch her. When the year-end approached, I accompanied her to her hometown, only to find her crawling into my bed as if a wild wolf at the dead hour of the night… When I woke up in the morning, I unexpectedly found the woman in my arms was…

title: When I Said, “Let’s Break Up” to My Cold Girlfriend Who Was Always Saying, “I’m Breaking Up With You,” She Became Very Cute
summary: The main character, Ikki, had just had his first love come true. He had been dating her for four months, but he gradually becomes unable to stand her cold attitude. She was cold and curt before they started going out, but when he tells her he was breaking up with her, her attitude suddenly changes drastically! It's hard to love her so much now that she's become so cute!

title: Dokbubujongryang
summary: “There’s a saying — even when beating a dog, you should first check who its owner is…” Ruthless, cold-hearted, and vicious — Miss Su Gunang! Born the daughter of a mere dancer, unrecognized by the family registry, she clawed her way up through sheer determination to become the Madam of the Rongguo Mansion. But the Su family, who saw their daughters as nothing more than pawns, offered her no love. In the end, she was betrayed — by the husband she loved, and by her own twin sister. As her life comes to a tragic end, Su Gunang draws her last breath while thinking of one man: “My lord is not a forgiving man… and he cherished me deeply. Surely he will avenge Su Gunang.” Then — she wakes up, reborn into her miserable childhood once more. This time, she swears an oath: To become the loyal hound of the man who was once her cousin, her master in a past life — The Prince of Chu.

title: Going Back to the Modern Times and Live Broadcasting My Daily Life to the Ancients!!
summary: While carrying out the quick-transmigration mission, Ran Shuixian's memory was wiped out by the system. In the last plane, she married the emperor as a concubine and gave birth to two sons. The emperor promised her that they would be together for the rest of their lives, but he still cheated on her. Ran Shuixian regained her memory and traveled back to the modern era with her son. In exchange, Ran Shuixian needed to live broadcast her modern daily life to the ancients. A group of ancient people saw through the sky curtain, delicious food , technology, tall buildings, high-speed trains and airplanes, a prosperous country and strong people... ------- Connecting to the 1959 plane, connecting to the doomsday plane...
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Another World Net Shop Master
summary: This is a story about a coffee shop master who cheats in another world using his skill online store. It is a story about a different world, but there is no fighting. There is magic, but the main character is not good at it. Coke and hamburgers are popular even in the other world. Using the net shop and item box, he and his friends do business in the other world.

title: It Seems That a Former ‘Number One’ Pro Gamer Is Going to Challenge a VRMMO
summary: In the year 21XX, advanced technology has eliminated physical labor for people, and many now find their sense of worth in the Metaverse. Streamers, singers, commentators, avatar designers, programmers... and pro gamers. Once a champion in many games, the pro gamer known as 'good knight,' who held the title of 'world’s number one' or 'zen'ichi' (全一), was undefeated for a long time. However, after a loss in a certain tournament, he distanced himself from victory, eventually losing his sponsorships. With what was essentially his retirement, he disappeared from the public stage and spent most of his days locked in his room, doing nothing but sleeping. But one day, an old friend invited him to play the VRMMORPG 'Idea is You.' This is the story of a former 'zen'ichi' recluse as he fumbles through an unfamiliar genre, coming to terms with his own heart.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: Only My Magic Level Up
summary: Summary: In a world where heroic power is measured by grades, rankings, and academy prestige—Aidan is a walking paradox. No mana aptitude. No swordsmanship. No noble lineage. He’s the bottom of the barrel at the Imperial Hero Academy. Mocked by professors, ignored by peers, and constantly reminded that he’s nothing more than background noise in a world of chosen ones. But here’s the thing: Aidan doesn’t care. Because behind his blank report cards and lazy yawns… He’s hiding something. A secret legacy. A buried past drenched in blood and glory. A war that the world forgot—but he remembers all too well. While the world obsesses over entrance exams and combat practicals, Aidan skips class to nap on rooftops and feed stray cats. But when monsters breach city walls and "star pupils" freeze in terror, the so-called loser raises his hand—and casually rewrites the rules of heroism. “Studying won’t save the world. But I might.” Enemies who once called him worthless now whisper in fear. Teachers who gave up on him now beg for his guidance. And classmates? They're starting to realize— The one who never studied… might just be the strongest hero of them all.

title: Genius Daddy in the City
summary: An ordinary man, Ye Chen traveled to the cultivation world by accident and became a phenomenal immortal of that era. After 3,000 years in the cultivation world, he was betrayed and traveled back to earth through a spatial tear. Five years had passed in the mortal world, but when he came back with his abilities, he found out he now has a daughter!

title: After Online Dating with Unlimited Streaming BOSS
summary: Rong Yi has an online dating boyfriend who is shy, infatuated, cute and reliable, and replies to her in seconds. The only thing that causes dissatisfaction is that, he always refuses to meet. Little Boyfriend: [Little Rabbit covers face.jpg] I, well, I look ugly, and my workplace is also not very good, so I’m afraid to be seen in light… Later, Rong Yi was dragged into an infinite thriller game and her life was hanging by a thread. Unexpectedly, her little boyfriend hacked into the game system and helped her within seconds! Little Boyfriend: [Big White Hugs.jpg] Don’t be afraid, Don’t be afraid. Let me tell you quietly, these bosses are actually very fragile, I strongly recommend that you focus on their hearts. So as soon as Other players enter the game: Develop unnoticeably in the early stages and never run into a BOSS. As soon as Rong Yi enters the game: Where is the boss, let’s talk about ten dollars! She had a long talk with Mr. Ogre and actively solved his troubles about the work meals; She had a drink with a high-risk mental patient, and fights against workplace bullying; She opened the heart of the PUA(pickup artist) demon, ab*sed the s*umbag, and helped the victim return to the happy life of terrorizing the player. … The bosses were grateful and said, “We have identified our sister-in-law!” The young urban beauty Rong Yi: Where does this sister-in-law come from? ! Little Boyfriend: [Little Penguin blushes and scratches his head.jpg] Ah, that, this is my workplace. They called me big brother. ──────────── Rong Yi always thought that her online dating partner was a sweet, innocent and poor little cutie. After all kinds of hardships, the two of them finally met. The big guy with his tall, long legs, and a handsome face still stained with blood, raised her chin with the hand that had just killed a monster, his clear eyes filled with the mu*derous aura that had not yet dissipated, and he called her in a low voice: " Rong Rong." Rong Yi, the rich woman who had been fantasising that she could raise her little cutie, rolled her eyes and passed out.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Romance, Sci-fi

title: The Third-Generation Chaebol Heir’s Journey to Independence
summary: Jin Minjae, a 60-year-old tech executive, wakes up in his 19-year-old body in 1991. Armed with future knowledge, he amasses wealth and influence, and sets out to protect his family’s conglomerate while taking revenge on the relatives who betrayed him.

title: Heartbeat Paradox
summary: My brother has hated me for many years. In the final moments before my death, I made a wish: I hoped he would find happiness and end up with the person he loved. The next second, I sat bolt upright in a coffin, dressed in a wedding gown. My brother was in the middle of sliding a ring onto my finger. A notification chimed in my head: "Wish System activated. Detection complete: Host is currently the person the brother loves most. Task progress: 10%." "Host, please continue to work hard to grant your wish." Me: "?"

title: I’m a Villainous Witch Who Can Only Use Useless Skills, But I’ll Live Strong With the Party-Loving Slimes I Tamed!
summary: In a world where humans become demons, I, having become a demon, was stoned by the villagers and fell off a cliff. That's when I realized: I had reincarnated into the world of an otome game as the most terrifying villainous, alluring witch (in her childhood). Normally, I should be burning with anger and revenge, becoming the enemy of the game's heroine, but what awoke within me was the carefree soul of a Japanese person. I don't care about the game or the heroine; I just want to relax and grow up peacefully... or so I thought. But then a handsome black-haired guy, a slightly scary-looking love interest character from the game, gets involved. Plus, I sometimes turn into an adult. I'll do my best using my cheat skills (though they're a bit clumsy)!

When I unfolded the letter, I couldn’t help but let out a hollow laugh. [Hello, Elena? I’m an alien. I can see the future.] “No matter how eccentric she is, what on earth does that even mean!” A boy said to be the emperor’s bastard son suddenly appearing before me. A mother who spoke as if she knew the future and vanished, leaving only a so-called prophecy book behind. ‘No way… Could this boy really be the emperor’s illegitimate son?’ I don’t want to be an empress!

summary: Ling Chu died. She traveled through time inexplicably and became the eldest daughter of the Shangshu Mansion. However, she was not favored. When she was born, the Taoist priest predicted that she would bring bad luck to her relatives. She was sent to a Taoist temple for foster care since she was a child, and was taken back to the mansion when she reached the age of 15. She thought she could live a happy and beautiful life from then on, but who knew that she would be greeted by an imperial decree to behead everyone in the family. In order to save her life, she risked everything to cooperate with the Jinyiwei to search her house upside down. For this, she was abandoned by her relatives. But she was busy collecting debts everywhere, making money, eating and drinking well, and helping ghosts fulfill their wishes to accumulate merit and prolong her life.

However, Hayato has a strong sense of inferiority to his fiancee and feels suffocated. Then, an older half-Japanese girl named Chiharu Maria moves into Hayato's house as his stepsister. She is a beautiful girl, but she is also devilish and naive. The free-spirited Maria aggressively approaches the younger Hayato, taking baths with him and sleeping in the same bed with him. summary: [A cruel and talkative witch x a scheming, pretentious and acting Black Lotus] It is said that the witch Shen Qingci seized her body and was reborn. With these conditions, she couldn't even lie down, let alone sleep peacefully. There was no other way. Su Mei felt that she was destined to work hard. She rolled up her sleeves and worked hard to lose weight, become beautiful, take the college entrance examination, do business, and fight for a happy life again. As for the original husband, didn't he dislike her? She didn't want to delay him, so she just divorced him. My dream is to enjoy watching which heroine the protagonist chooses, all from the perspective of a classmate! However, due to the moves caused by my knowledge as a fan of the original work, I inadvertently raise romantic flags with the heroines who should have been destined for destruction, turning what should have been disaster flags into love flags.”

Unspeakable, eerie beings crowded around him, baring their claws and fangs… Yet with a casual wave of his hand, all these terrifying entities vanish into thin air. “As everyone knows, there are no such things as ghosts in this world…” Wang Qi declared with absolute conviction to his viewers. He was in a group centered around his childhood friends who are a couple, but he couldn’t stand their condescending behavior towards him, so he left the group. The use of magic and the manifestation of supernatural abilities were only possible within the confines of the dungeon, leaving the real world largely unaffected. Despite this, the lives of many people continued unchanged. In the midst of this, the protagonist, a high school student, awakens to a skill known as "Gate," a teleportation-like ability. With a displayed level in his hands, a new adventure seemed to unfold. On his way home from school, the protagonist decides to test the Gate skill at a normal street corner. In an instant, he finds himself standing in a different dimension, surrounded by unfamiliar landscapes. In this modern fantasy world, the protagonist levels up, learns magic, and hones various skills. summary: After waking up, Tang Fang finds himself transported 253 years into the future, to the era of interstellar travel. He has become a lowly front-line soldier, a mere expendable pawn. To his astonishment, he discovers that he now controls three fully functional bases from the real-time strategy game StarCraft II—each representing one of the iconic factions: Zerg, Terran, and Protoss. Even more thrilling, he realizes that he can summon the units built within these bases into the real world. Zerg: Brood Lords, Ultralisks… Terran: Banshees, Battlecruisers… Protoss: Dark Templars, Carriers… Watch as Tang Fang leads his tri-faction fleet to dominate the stars, shaking the galaxy to its core.

title: Feed Me, Qizhen!
summary: I am the most foolish disciple of the Pleasure Sect, and I must seduce the most outstanding disciple of the Way of Heartlessness. The Eldest Senior Brother is cold and indifferent, as beautiful as a celestial being. He strikes down fox spirits on the left, and slays Seductive Ghosts on the right. Yet when resting, he unknowingly accepts the tea I hand him. Expressionless, he drinks it all in one go. As the effects of the drug set in, we silently stare at each other. He looks at me, and I gaze at him eagerly. The Eldest Senior Brother lowers his eyes and wipes away the powder clinging to the rim of the cup. "Did you put in enough of the drug?" he asks calmly. "If not, you can add more."

title: Transmigrated as the White Moonlight of the World-Destroying Tycoons
summary: Gu Nuan, a top-tier web novelist, is cursed and transmigrated into a disastrous, unfinished novel set in a literal “den of freeloaders.” The original female lead had the looks and the money, but she was a saintly pushover to her core. As a result, she was bled dry by three parasitic men. A year later, after her fortune vanished, the four of them starved to death together in a low-rent apartment, ending the story on a tragic note. Unfortunately, Gu Nuan transmigrated as this doomed heroine, accompanied by a “Curse Reversal System.” On the day she arrived, the resources were depleted, and she was on the verge of death. To make matters worse, the system issued a mandatory requirement: she must redeem Freeloaders A, B, and C within five days. Gu Nuan looked at the three men, who had completely lost their will to live, with a dark, brooding expression. “To hell with this ‘su*cide pact’! Isn’t living better? If you want to die, you’d better wait until I finish this damn task!” To break free from the system’s curse, Gu Nuan had no choice but to roll up her sleeves and personally clean up the wreckage of the phoenix men’s lives. Five days later, once the mission was complete, she staged a stylish “death escape” to save them and vanished. Three Years Later The former freeloaders have climbed to the absolute pinnacle of their respective fields. Standing on the highest award podiums, they confess to the microphones: “The love of my life, her name is Gu Nuan (the evil spirit who possessed her).” Gu Nuan, who has just transmigrated back in her original body to be slapped with a secondary mission by the system, was speechless. Finding yourself at the center of the world’s biggest gossip, isn’t that just wonderful?

title: It’s Okay If There’s No Male Lead

I know society expects people to fall in love, get married, and all that. But right now, I have more important things to do. World Peace. Fighting off monsters, saving lives, and bringing peace to our beautiful empire and this world. I’m too busy working for a greater cause to waste time on silly romance. “Come back with me, Chelsea.” But why does my ex-fiancé, the 7th prince, Keep flirting around me, even though we’ve already broken off the engagement?

title: The Official’s Pursuit of the Demon Consort
summary: In the turbulent wake of a bloody succession, Li Ying secured a decree naming her a consort a desperate gamble just to stay alive. The imperial court was in an uproar; the ministers spat upon her name, loathing her for her perceived lack of shame. None, however, detested her more than Xie Xueming, the Grand Secretary and the elder brother of the new Emperor’s first wife. But Li Ying didn't mind. She delighted in watching them seethe with a hatred that couldn't touch her, finding a twisted joy in their helpless fury. One day, Xie Xueming entered the palace to petition the Emperor for the execution of the "Demon Consort." Suddenly, a screen collapsed with a heavy thud, revealing the jade-like beauty hiding behind it. The so-called "Demon Consort" possessed a delicate, ethereal grace. As her dark, silken hair cascaded over her slender shoulders, she hurriedly pulled her collar tight, retreating fearfully behind the Emperor. Yet, when Xie Xueming looked up, he saw her leaning against the Emperor’s shoulder, casting a glance his way—a glance filled with calculated charm and triumphant cunning. To the man who commanded a hundred thousand soldiers and possessed a mind like a labyrinth, only one thought surfaced: femme fatale. She was foxy, treacherous, and utterly loathsome. Three years after the Demon Consort’s reported death, the Emperor passed away. The Grand Secretary took the reins of power, ruling the empire with an iron fist. No one expected that this paragon of stoicism and tradition would commit an act of such moral depravity. He did not just desecrate the consort’s tomb; he ordered a grand celebration of music, lanterns, and scarlet candles, defying the world to take the "deceased" consort as his own wife. Inside the silken veils of the wedding bed, Li Ying’s insults were drowned out by her own sobbing. A hand brushed away her tears as a powerful arm locked around her waist. His voice was a soft, dangerous rasp: "Tell me. did you love them, or do you love me?" Reader’s Guide Style: Light political intrigue with heavy fictional elements. Tropes: Pure female and male leads (Double C), multiple male side characters with unrequited feelings for the heroine, and a high-stakes "chase-her-back" redemption arc.

title: Eternal Green
summary: Special Condition: Yoo Shin-rok must spend more than one hour each day with Go Han-ra. Yoo Shin-rok felt dizzy as he read the absurd special condition written in the Botanic World land transaction contract, which he thought had been discussed without any issues. He kept telling himself not to get involved, but seeing Han-ra’s attitude, which seemed nothing more than a joke, he decided to refuse and believed that this meeting would be the last. However, Go Han-ra kept intruding into Yoo Shin-rok’s life. As a blind date partner, or at the same gym, and even as the granddaughter of his grandfather’s benefactor, she managed to secure a position as his secretary! “Why are you so obsessed with this one hour?” “If you don’t like it, will you marry me?” If she had fallen in love with me at first sight, I might have understood, but there isn’t a hint of affection in her eyes. “I feel good when I’m with you, Yoo Shin-rok. That’s why I can’t give up.” By the time he came to his senses, he was already immersed in her world, and things he had never imagined began to happen to him!
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural

title: Infinite Fire Record

title: Little Chef
summary: Su Tang found herself transmigrated to an unknown dynasty, with her frail and pitiful younger brother crying by her side. Her parents had passed away, leaving behind a shophouse. With her exceptional cooking skills, Su Tang makes a name for herself in the Capital City’s Master Chef competition and eventually established a foothold in the bustling city. She has a habit of giving away extra food at the end of each day before closing the restaurant. The marquis, who suffers from anorexia, has managed to enjoy countless meals this way. Gradually, Su Tang notices that the number of people coming for free meals seems to be increasing. The young emperor, the empress, and even the young general seems to visit almost every day. Everyone who tastes her food sings its praises! Su Tang only wants to run her small restaurant, bask in the sun, read storybooks, and live her life as a humble chef. But why did the handsome Marquis keep giving her such strange looks? Note: The story involves daily life centered around cooking and eating. In case the broken link: ko-fi.com/soupdumplings

title: Mental Rebirth: The World’s Savior Was Not Me, but My Childhood Friend and Stalker
summary: These feelings, unchanged forever When I realized, I was in an unknown world. A world where common sense no longer applied. The protagonist, Yuusha, wakes up in a completely different world, with his last memory being that of a hospital. Supposedly powerless, he is reluctantly hailed as the savior and sets out to defeat the entity known as the Demon Lord. However, his companions are all slaughtered by the Demon Lord's minions. As he braced for death, the one who saved him was Touko, his childhood friend from the previous world. While her appearance bears some resemblance, her essence has transformed entirely, bestowing her with monstrous strength. Yet her spirit remains unchanged. She directed all her heartfelt goodwill towards me, without a hint of change. Yuusha, elevated as a savior, strives to dispel this misunderstanding and dreams of a slow life in this otherworld

title: The Changing Phases
summary: The phone rang, a ringtone specially designed for him, but Liu Yuxin answered the call without speaking.

title: The Legend of Futian
summary: In a time when the Divine Prefectures of the East Sea were in great disarray, Emperor Ye Qing and Donghuang the Great appeared to save the day. Under their rule, the prefectures united and all nations as well as their kings have been controlled. However, the legend of these two great heroes becomes altered when Emperor Ye Qing's name is wiped from the history books after his sudden death. All statues and images of him were destroyed and his name a taboo. Only the legend of Donghuang the Great shall live on. Fifteen years later, a young man by the name of Ye Futian begins his journey in search for his true identity. The legend of Futian was going to be one for the history books.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: The Underground City
summary: Guan Yue holds on to his faith, betting his life on it. Yan Xiao holds fast to her belief, compromising for him. She doesn’t ask him where he is going or what he’s doing, as she trusts him completely. As long as his heart is still beating, he will not fail her, just as he will not fail any of his missions. Guan Yue touches his forehead to Yan Xiao’s and says, “These past years, sometimes I didn’t know if I was good or bad, but I still don’t regret what we have.” Yan Xiao laughs softly, “Me neither.” She doesn’t regret meeting him. But there is one thing she didn’t say: she hopes he is on the side of justice. Because principles always matter. The vast desert, the wildlands of loess, and the desolate winds of the Northwest have all borne witness to the years they spent together. The one who bore the burden has returned. The peaceful land is the best blessing.

title: Transmigrated as the Male Lead’s Vicious Ex-Girlfriend
summary: Lin Zhizhi suddenly finds herself transmigrated into a romance novel titled “Those Years of Secret Love.” However, instead of becoming the female lead, she shockingly becomes the male lead’s ex-girlfriend — a woman who is beautiful but notoriously vicious. In the novel, this ex-girlfriend initially pretends to be kind and well-mannered. At school, she is admired by everyone — though only by the boys. She makes just two appearances in the story: the first time, she suddenly shows up claiming to be pregnant with the male lead’s child and then leaves the country after giving birth to a son. The second time, she returns, attempting to use their son to rekindle the relationship, but the male lead coldly sends her back abroad. After transmigrating, Lin Zhizhi touches her still-flat belly and looks at the aloof yet heartbreakingly handsome male lead before her. She thinks to herself: “I’m already having his child, so I might as well keep the father too.” Meanwhile, the male lead, who has been trying his best to maintain a cold and distant demeanor while inwardly longing to kiss, hug, and lift his beloved wife high in the air, sighs: “This is just too hard!” On the day Lin Zhizhi gave birth, Lu Yi heard the nurse’s congratulations and stared at the newborn baby boy in disbelief. “Wait… Where is Dad’s little cotton-padded jacket?

title: Primitive Tribe: All My Tribespeople Are Beast Girls
summary: Lin Ye unexpectedly transmigrated to a prehistoric primitive society. He arrived at a tribe filled with beautiful beast-eared girls. To Lin Ye's surprise, he discovered that he was the only man in the entire tribe. At that moment, Lin Ye awakened a system, and from then on, he led the beast girls of the tribe down a completely different path. While other tribes were still struggling daily for a bite to eat, Lin Ye’s tribe was already drinking fresh milk every day. While others were still living in tents made of animal skins, Lin Ye had already led the beast girls to live in large houses built with bricks...
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: All My Masters Are Villainous Witches
summary: After putting on a cute little dress, all of them suddenly want to push me down! And they’re all super strong—what do I do if I can’t beat them?! I’m gonna get bullied! I’m definitely gonna get bullied! But I’m not afraid! Hehe, because I have seven amazing masters! Whoever dares to bully or push me down, I’ll just kick them in the thigh and shout adorably: “Baka! Idiot! No way!” PS: Expect plenty of chaos, teasing, and overly affectionate witches.
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: Reborn as a Chef in a Family of Assassins
summary: “A silly sweet romance: super-strong cute girl vs. overly controlling “ghost-like” boss”. I found a job as a cook in an assassin family. The pay is high, the work is easy, and the employer is even pleasing to the eye. Everything seems perfect—except that this family is a bit… strange. On my first day at work, the boss handed me a maid outfit and said it was my chef uniform. On my second day, the boss gave me a bottle of poison and told me to add it to the daily meals. Me: “0, 0 … Do I put it in everyone’s food?” Boss: “All of it.” On my third day, the boss came again and said the poison wasn’t enough—the family didn’t enjoy their meal properly. Me: “……” I stared at the bottle of poison and started questioning my life. Could it be a seasoning that enhances flavor? Then maybe… I should add more. Everyone knows how terrifying the world’s top assassin family is. But no one knows their real horror. Until one day, people saw a cute maid wearing a maid outfit, swinging a frying pan, and easily taking down a giant beast several times her size—then dragging it back into her kitchen. As expected of an assassin family—even their maid is this powerful! What people don’t know is that this cute little cook is actually the real terror. Her “dark cuisine” is unmatched in the world. Anyone who eats her cooking experiences shock, fear, and a face twisted in pain. Only one long-haired boss, after tasting it, nods in admiration and says: “Your cooking has improved again.” Others: “??!”
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: After Divorce, I Became the Strongest Ghost-Catching Celestial Master
summary: Zhang Buran, a Ghost-Catching Daoist with high Magical Power, was cursed by an Evil Ghost during a ghost-catching mission, preventing him from using his Magical Power for three years. Living as a son-in-law in the Wen Family, he endured the indifference and estrangement of his Wife. Three years later, Zhang Buran regained his Magical Power. He resolutely decided to Divorce his Wife, leave the Wen Family, and embark on a journey to slay Demons and Monsters! Demons and Monsters are afraid! His Ex-Wife regrets it! Little Ghost: "What? Zhang Buran is back! Run, it's that crazy Daoist!" Ex-Wife: "Zhang Buran, give me another chance, I swear I'll treat you twice as well!" Zhang Buran: "I'm sorry, I'm focused on catching ghosts, I don't have time for love." No matter what Demons and Monsters or evil spirits you are, I, Zhang Buran, will slay you with one sword!

title: Dusk, Breeze, Alley
summary: After five years of a secret relationship, I couldn't help but test Jiang Bo'an. "My mom is pushing me to go on blind dates. I told her I already have a boyfriend, but she still..." He leaned against the headboard, a lazy smile playing on his lips. "Yangyang, what I like most about you is how obedient you are." "I've said this before: if you want to leave, our relationship can end at any time." Having said his piece, he considerately buttoned my sleeves and wiped away my tears. He knew that as long as he brought up the end of our relationship, I would do what I always did-compromise, back down, and keep my mouth shut. I didn't tell him that this time was different. I had made a bet with someone on whether or not he would be willing to marry me. And the price of losing that bet was leaving him forever.
genres: Drama, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Married Couple’s Qualifications
summary: Her husband had a woman. From the moment she found out the secret, her perfect family fell apart. In spite of this, she turned a blind eye to it and in return, Rivianna lost her child. She wanted to die, but a cruel fate brought her back to life. And so life began again. Rivianna decided not to get divorced again this time. Instead, she made up her mind. She would sell her husband. "Do you know that there are a surprising number of people who want you to disappear." "What?" “So I sold you.” She sold her husband to the person who gave her the highest price out of all the people who hated her husband. "Aren’t you curious? Who really bought you?"

title: My Boss, A Clear And Perfect Beauty Who’s An Elite Police Bureaucrat, Turns Out To Be My Sweet And Doting Childhood Friend Who Loves Me Dearly At Home.
summary: At 26, detective Harabashi Shinichi had failed in his job hunting and reluctantly became a police officer after giving up on his dreams. One day, during an investigation, a young and stunningly beautiful female career bureaucrat, Akinaga Maho, appears on the scene. "Huh... Shinichi!?" "Maho!?" She has become the supervisor of the Metropolitan Police Department's Criminal Investigation Division at a young age as an elite, and she is also Shinichi's childhood friend. The two had a falling out during high school, and though they felt awkward, they ended up room-sharing due to an unexpected turn of events. Shinichi listens to Maho's worries and, by empathizing with her loneliness, they gradually regain their previous trusting relationship. Moreover, it seemed that Maho had loved Shinichi since they were young...! As they live together, Maho becomes infatuated with Shinichi and stops hiding her feelings. At the police station, the cool elite Maho, at home, begs Shinichi to sleep together and rests her head on his lap... Shinichi and Maho cook together, go on dates, and take care of each other when they catch a cold... Their relationship begins to resemble that of a real married couple. "I can't live without you, Shinichi...!" A beautiful elite turns out to be a cute childhood friend at home! A police romantic comedy about reclaiming lost time!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Became the Sage the Empire Obsesses Over
summary: I, the salutatorian of the Magic Tower, has landed the ultimate cushy job: the Imperial Advisor. What does the job entail? Giving advice. Why did I take it on? To slack off. But then… The Empire started to obsess over me. “God damn it.”
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: I’m a Pitiful Beta
summary: I transmigrated into an ABO novel and became a Beta. The male lead wants to possess me. The villain wants to turn me into a caged Omega canary. The male supporting character sends me selfies in the middle of the night. Even the female lead collapses weakly into my arms. "Sister, I'm so hot..." Me: Hello, police? The ABO world is terrifying!

title: This is My Common Sense
summary: Although it’s troublesome, since it’s common sense, I politely did it. Not good, not good! I’m glad that I didn’t do something that was so lacking in common sense…. This is my common sense.

title: Reincarnated After 200 Years, the Six Elves Who Once Served Me Are Now at the Center of the World
summary: There was elf s*avery in the country where I was born and raised. Their treatment is horrible. I want to change this thinking… Ficelle was a young genius magician who made a fortune by developing a new recovery medicine. One day, he decided to buy some elf s*aves by chance, but after interacting with them, he realised that something was wrong with his country’s society. He became determined to revolutionize it for the sake of the elves’ freedom. However, in the middle of his plans, he collapsed from overwork and, on his deathbed, realised he couldn’t change the world himself and cast an incomplete reincarnation magic, hoping to some day return and see the world changed by his six disciples. He then woke up 200 years after his death, and at the heart of this new world were the six elves who served him long ago who have become great men and women and founded a new country. But even after 200 years, they still yearn for Ficelle. From here begins a slow life that transcends race and status, of Ficelle, who was reborn with no magical talent or sword skill in his second life, and the talented elves who have become the center of the world.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Dragon’s Pet
summary: Dragon spirits have always protected the land of Nanjiang. Chenxi, a quiet girl, accidentally becomes the reincarnated guardian of the dragon spirit Pixie, going from her current lifetime to Nanjiang, where Pixie, having lost its power, is now a piece of jade. A mystical saying leads to a massive brawl over the jade. Chenxi masquerades as the leader of a martial arts clan to protect jade, and meets a man who is a headhunter for jade. During the fighting, secrets are uncovered about Nanjiang. Thieves are not who they pretend to be, and the guardian job is much more complex. When human greed leads to the dragon's anger, inevitable battles loom in Nanjiang.

title: Ballet Beauty in the 1960s Military Compound [Transmigrated]
summary: Chen Siyu, with her graceful figure and mesmerizing poise, was once the principal ballerina. From high-difficulty moves like Italian fouettés, 32 whip turns, to gravity-defying grand jetés—she mastered them all to perfection. But a tragic car accident left her paralyzed, bound to a wheelchair for half her life. One day, she wakes up to find herself in the 1960s, a fresh recruit who just got accepted into a Cultural Troupe. According to the plot of the original novel, she was supposed to be a stepping stone for the reborn female lead—sent off to the countryside, living out her days toiling in the fields. But Chen Siyu... decides to cling to the original host’s childhood engagement, to the cold and strikingly handsome Captain Leng from the Air Force compound. She chooses to stay in the troupe, reclaim her ballet dreams, and return to the stage! Leng Jun is the youngest, most dashing fighter pilot in the Air Force compound. What made the young women secretly grit their teeth was that he had an arranged marriage from childhood. Recently, rumors spread that his fiancée had even moved into his home! Watching his gaze grow colder by the day, the onlookers worried: That childhood fiancée probably doesn't suit Leng Jun’s taste. An arranged marriage, what a cruel twist of fate! Until one day, the Cultural Troupe's belle, Chen Siyu, came to pick up her childhood fiancé after work. The tall, imposing squadron captain, and the alluring, slender-waisted ballerina walked hand in hand… At that moment, all the single officers and young ladies of the Air Force compound collectively experienced heartbreak!

title: The Fox Clan Hides Their True Identity from the Bride
summary: I became the young daughter-in-law of a ducal family that would be annihilated in ten years. In truth, this family harbors a secret—they are ‘fox beastfolk,’ a race of demonic hybrids. Once their identity is exposed, the temple will brand them as heretics and execute them! If the family is doomed, would I, their daughter-in-law, remain unscathed? My head would roll right alongside theirs... “This is unfair! I’m not beastfolk or anything—I’m just an ordinary human!” But running away immediately would be a crazy move. A powerless, penniless little girl escaping alone would only end up as a beggar at best. I need to use my knowledge of the original story to secure a fortune, siphon off money, and prepare my escape. I know their secret, but I have no intention of betraying them—not even a little! Even if my husband transforms into a fox and whimpers, I’ll pretend not to notice. Even if my father-in-law mysteriously disappears at regular intervals, I’ll act as if I’m completely oblivious. *** But then… Are they really demonic hybrids? “Well, we’re family, aren’t we? If this is what my dear daughter-in-law wants, of course we’ll do it.” “Wife… Can I hold your hand while we sleep tonight?” It’s not just blind affection—they all seem genuinely kind and innocent. My husband’s soft, fluffy fox paws linger in my mind. The thought of these people dying rips my heart apart... ‘This won’t do. I’ve grown too attached.’ I can’t bring myself to abandon them and run away alone. ‘…Fine. I don’t care about the original story anymore.’ Why should I care about the plot or the protagonist? I will protect my father-in-law and my husband. Let’s create a future where the so-called ‘heretical demon hybrids’ emerge victorious! *** “Wouldn’t it be better to dress up a little if you want to impress my daughter-in-law? You should get rid of those glasses too.” “Father, you’re saying that because you don’t know Railey’s tastes.” “Her tastes?” “I need to look as pitiful as possible… so she’ll never be able to leave me behind.” He flashed a fierce smile—one that had nothing pitiful about it, but instead carried the aura of a predator. It was the chilling presence of a beast—something he never revealed to his wife.

title: The Daily Life of the Celestial Realm’s Heir as Everyone’s Favorite
summary: The Jade Emperor had a son late in life and doted on him excessively. The sole heir of the Celestial Realm was named Yun Heng. Just three years old, he was as fair as carved jade, intelligent, and elegant. When he walked, he looked like a rolling snowball. The heavenly generals and soldiers had all developed the good habit of watching their step, fearing that an oversight might lead to treading on him... Yun Heng circled around Taishang Laojun's Eight Trigrams Furnace and asked, "What are you doing?" Taishang Laojun replied, "Opening the furnace to retrieve the elixirs." Yun Heng reached out to grab them. Distressed for his tender little hands, Taishang Laojun hurriedly tried to stop him: "Your Highness, be careful, it's hot..." Yun Heng tossed an Immortal Elixir to him, stuffed one into his own mouth, and said in a milky voice, "It's not hot. It smells so good!" Taishang Laojun was shocked: "But that is the Liu Ding Divine Fire..." In the Pan Tao Yuan, Sun Wukong was napping when someone suddenly patted his backside. Looking up, he saw a red-lipped, white-teethed little child smiling at him: "Baby wants to eat the highest and biggest one!" In the Hall of Heaven, the round little "dumpling" stood in front of Sun Wukong: "You are not allowed to bully him! I ate the peaches; he is my little monkey!" Sun Wukong: "..." Looking at his increasingly mischievous youngest son, the Jade Emperor couldn't bring himself to hit or scold him. He had the boy sent to the Zhen Jun Shen Dian to be looked after by the cold-hearted Erlang Shen for a few days. Xiaotian Quan had received a pastry and was sitting in a corner preparing to enjoy it when a small hand suddenly reached over and split it in half: "I want to try it too!" Before the pastry could enter his mouth, Yun Heng was scooped up from behind. A cold voice rang in his ear: "Heng'er, be good. Come inside and take apart the San Jian Liang Ren Dao to play with." The little prince hugged Yang Jian's neck tightly and gave his cold, handsome face a loud "mwah": "Heng'er likes big cousin the best!" Suddenly one day, the Demon Clan and the Monster Clan attacked the Heavenly Court. The little prince charged out on his short legs: "Bold monsters! How dare you covet my throne!" The Jade Emperor's youngest child, the doted little prince, enjoys the affection of all the gods every day. The little prince also has a hidden identity. Note: No CP (romantic pairing). All characters exist to dote on the protagonist! A pure "collective doting/child-rearing" story. Not a history of Chinese mythology, unrelated to religion, lacks logic throughout, and is entirely made up. Regarding the relationship between the Jade Emperor and the Queen Mother: Referring to "Investiture of the Gods," they are a married couple who even had a daughter.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Refining Heaven and Earth
summary: When the heaven and earth first opened, a great divine wind began to refine stones to nourish the heavens, leaving the Heavenly Cauldron in the mortal world. After hundreds of thousands of years, Fang Bai had no intention of obtaining the Heavenly Refining Cauldron. He was ambushed by his fellow brothers, blessed by the Heavenly Refining Cauldron, and reincarnated. In this lifetime, Fang Bai had unraveled the secrets of the Heavenly Refining Cauldron and continued onward, discovering the cruelest secret in the world! And to see how Fang Bai would go against the heavens!

title: It Was Never Just ‘One Night’
summary: A single night born of impulse and curiosity was never supposed to matter. But when Ki Joyoon, the confident heir to the Seozen Group, and Yoon Jiheum, a woman already carrying her own scars, cross paths again, that night refuses to stay in the past. What was supposed to stay physical doesn’t. The heat of that night ran deeper than they’d imagined, the relationship driven by desire slowly slips beyond control, blurring the line between attraction and emotion. For two people who never meant to fall, the question becomes whether this connection will lead them to ruin or somewhere they never dared to hope for.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The SSS+ Rank Hunter Who Farms
summary: Resource Deposits: Unmeasurable Resource Rarity: SSS Map Size: Unmeasurable I had just received my very own infinite resource map.

title: The Divine and Demonic Doctor
summary: The Divine Doctor of the Orthodox Sect. The Demonic Doctor of the Unorthodox Sect. Two legendary physicians got married? The father is a Divine Doctor, and the mother is a Demonic Doctor. An unrivaled martial arts master appears before Dan Ak-seon, who has inherited both of his parents' medical skills. That fateful encounter leads the young Dan Ak-seon into the martial world...
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Martial Arts, Slice of Life, Wuxia

title: Obviously, It’s My Child
summary: She got hit by the reincarnation truck and was reborn as the eldest daughter of a Baron. A harmonious family. A lovely little sister. A modest estate. She planned to live on as an unemployed, freeloading moocher who would never work anymore for the rest of her life. “How on earth did this happen?” “You don’t remember?” “I do. I mean, I just don’t know how exactly it got to this point.” “…Look who’s talking.” But she made a mistake with the Duke, who’s part of the three most prestigious families in the Empire. Well, it’s fine. Things happen. A mistake could just be evened out—there’s nothing to lose. However, her younger sister got caught up in something dangerous that very day. “Everybody will die when it becomes known that I saw it. You have to run away, Sister.” I didn’t run away because of you, got it? * * * “No matter how you look at it, he’s obviously my child. Do you think you can fool me by lying like that?” “Are you saying that I raised my child as my younger sister’s child just to pretend I wasn’t pregnant?” “I didn’t say that! I’m asking you to admit that he’s my child!” Five years have passed since then, so isn’t it about time to just let bygones be bygones? This is madness. “Still, it’s not like my son is without any fault. Child support will be given just as it should. Return to the countryside.” The prospective mother-in-law holds out an envelope. “I was very curious. Who was the one who took my light blue dress from the Duke’s room?” The flower of society is talking nonsense. “A union between Klausener and Aren is too dangerous.” The Empress is hostile. All I ever wished to do was to live quietly while making money. But perhaps I’ll have to kill them all to protect my kid.

title: The Black Cat Grand Duke’s Favorite Maid
summary: The Grand Duke of the North is a kitten…? Melody, a maid in the Grand Duke's household, named a kitten Lucky that she happened to rescue on the street. They spent peaceful days together, sleeping every night. However, one morning, Lucky, who used to sleep with her every day, was nowhere to be found. Instead, she was nestled in the broad arms of Grand Duke Calsius! To make matters more intriguing, he strictly forbade any disclosure of the incident, transformed into Lucky before her eyes, and ran away. ‘A cute kitten like Lucky is the Beast of the Snow.’ For a moment, Melody was bewildered by the dignified Northern Grand Duke's unexpected appearance. Because Melody found out his secret, she was forcibly incorporated into a secret organization, where she took on the role of a fake mistress and a cure for his insomnia... The problem is, later on, she could face execution for treason, and even the workers were destined to share the same fate. If she’s his mistress, she's no different from the main member of the treason plot. "Assist him? Forget that, I'm going to escape!"

title: This Germany needs a Führer
summary: They want to become the best nation even if it means making the world a hell. --- Armin Rosenbaum, a genius with memories of the future, thought he’d have the upper hand. But he soon finds himself entangled with the powerful Junkers and a Kaiser who sees him as a mere pawn. With cutting-edge aircraft designs, Armin shakes up the military game. But as he navigates this brutal world of backroom deals and political traps, he realizes it’s not just about winning—it’s about survival. “I have to fly higher to win... but what will be left when I return to the ground?” Armin’s ready to reshape history, but the question is: can he stay ahead of those who want to bring him down?
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mature, Psychological

title: The Rules of Raising a Succubus
summary: I bought a handsome, aloof Succubus online. But he kept making noises, silently staring at me, and his body temperature was alarmingly hot. Worried that he might be sick, I hurried to contact customer service. After listening to my description, customer service fell silent. [Dear customer, is it possible that the Succubus isn't sick, but just so hungry that he wants to kiss you or do something naughty?]
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Host Wants to Destroy the World [Quick Transmigration]
summary: Sun Duo died, then came back to life. System: Hello, esteemed Host, I am System X. We have selected you to enter various books, break the protagonist's halo, and create worlds. Sun Duo: Hello, dear System. This is your host, Sun Duo. I don't want to do any missions. Can you just let me rest in peace? Zombie novels? The protagonist saves the world? Why not let the zombies rule the world instead? Leveling-up stories? The protagonist goes from zero to hero, becoming all cool and awesome? This cannon fodder has some decent talent. Who says cannon fodder can't be the protagonist? Protagonist's halo? Isn't that meant to be broken? Sun Duo only wants to die. To achieve a clean, swift death, he keeps causing trouble. He never expected to accidentally create a new world. What could he do? He was just as desperate.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Psychological, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Immortal Wife Can’t Be Provoked
summary: She was bored, so the Emperor accompanied her as she played in the three thousand realms and caught a phoenix for her to sit on. When she has cravings, the Emperor crossed through space to gather all kinds of delicacies and immortal fruits for her. Later on, she liked little kids, the Emperor tricked her, saying if she becomes the Empress, she’ll get her own kid. And like that, she became the Empress and got tricked by the Emperor into bed. However, she reincarnated and forgot everything…..

title: The Niece-in-law Remarried Him, and the Scheming Officer Went Crazy with Joy
summary: [Era + Military Marriage + Darkly Critical Father-Criticizing Family + Bright and Dark-Hearted Beauty] A car crash sends Song Yiyi into the world of a novel—straight into the life of a tragic side character doomed to die for obsessing over the stoic military male lead. But Song Yiyi remembers everything, including how the original owner’s love would lead to her downfall. This time, she’s rewriting the script. At the military clinic, she mercilessly exposes the heroine’s two-faced schemes. She tears up her engagement letter without a second thought. And at a formal military mixer, she strides in wearing stilettos and leaves a bold lipstick mark on her ex-fiancé’s uncle—an infamously cold and powerful commander. The entire military district is stunned. The Song family’s prim and proper young lady, who’d pretended to be sweet and obedient for five long years, turns out to be a wild rose with thorns—fearless enough to once tie a commanding officer’s hands with a belt and dare him to break free. “Report! Comrade Song has jumped the wall and escaped again!” Cen Yue slowly traces the old scar on his wrist, his eyes dark and unreadable.
genres: Adult, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Tragedy

title: Transmigrated into an ’80s Child Bride: The Escaping Army Officer Is Captured by Love
summary: [Military Marriage + 1980s + Sweet Romance + Business] Wen Qingtong transmigrated into the body of a child bride. Her brother, unwilling to accept her, joined the army and hadn't returned for ten years. She had just woken up when her mother sent a letter claiming she was paralyzed and wouldn't live much longer, forcing Wen Zhanting to return and marry her. Wen Zhanting returned home to find his mother digging in the vegetable garden. Faced with her pressure to marry Wen Qingtong, he snapped at her, "Stop forcing me! I will never marry her. If you force me, I'll only support her, but I'll never touch her. She'll live a life of widowhood, and I'll be childless. We'll see!" Wen Qingtong, who had originally planned to elope, was immediately tempted by this offer. She hid her belongings, went out, and greeted him with a slight smile, "Hi, brother, are you serious?" This incredible fortune had fallen into my lap! She was determined to pave a smooth path for her Younger Sister, lifting her all the way to the highest heavens. But when she sacrificed herself to save the world in full view of everyone, her Younger Sister went mad. Her friends in the outer sect also lost their minds. The Phoenix Overlord Younger Sister frantically honed her strength, creating the Demon-Slaying Sword Art and nearly purging the six realms of all evil. The little black dragon who’d once chased after her, shouting “Master!” in excitement, became obsessed with alchemy, rising as the first Alchemy Sage among dragonkind. The rebellious young sect heir who’d always clung to her with round, smiling eyes and refused to go home returned to his sect, growing silent and reliable. The honest, dark-skinned body cultivator turned to demonic arts, becoming the ruler of the demon realm. After her death, they all became renowned figures across the six realms, but their joy was forever gone. Countless shadows resembling her appeared throughout the realms, yet none were truly her. She just wanted to ask: What happened to the promise of being rich, carefree, and never coming home? What about our agreement to mind our own business and stay out of each other’s way?
