Their masters in other families place a strong emphasis on tradition and instructor respect. They’re always plotting to take their teacher’s place and undermine their teacher’s efforts in her master’s case. Cheng Shan once made the following hidden calculation in a desperate scenario: “In this critical situation, I should seize any opportunity and latch onto someone influential to find a way out.” Han Luo grumbled, “No turning back; there’s no one in this world who can board my ship and then leave.” An outwardly submissive but inwardly obstinate small puppy female lead contrasts with a dark and distant demon lord male lead. A true 1v1 (one male lead and one female lead) Happily Ever After (HE) tale

title: Seduced the Doomed Villain
summary: In my dying moment, I realized I was an extra in a novel with just one line. Resurrected, I resolved to survive before worrying about the original story. Destined to be the villain's cruel madness, my medicine against it... His blue eyes sparkled fiercely. "Wish to die?" ‘No, I want to live.’ On the brink of collapse, I wrapped my trembling hands around the man's neck. "Haah......." Insanity. His breath felt exhilarating. Is it perverse to find his breath refreshing? Wiping the drool off my lips, I gazed up at him dazedly. His madness overflowing, his handsome appearance belied his impending doom as the villain. Perfect. Just stick around and return home... But life never goes as planned. When did the once ice-cold man start to change, shedding his iron walls to become temptingly wicked? "Shall we get engaged?" He lifted my hand, kissing it deeply. "Why, why are you doing this?" "Where do you think you're going without me?" He tilted his head slightly, flashing a sly smile. My face reddened, and his lips curled mischievously. Aren't you an extra too? Why act like the male lead! I only needed the madness as a cure, but now I'm entangled with the villain, destined to vanish before the original story begins.

title: The Bloody Road to Longevity
summary: The great way is solitary ; the path uncharted involving immense difficulty. The way ahead may be indiscernible ;my experiences illusory. Thrice-born to return home; to rekindle the glory of yesteryears. Relying on the strength of seventy-two skills to duel the entire three realms ! Stepping forward on the bloody road to longevity till all prostrate before my feet. I wander blissfully free and unfettered !!!

title: The Night My Child Was Stolen
summary: I became the spoil of the man who trampled and burned everything I had—the conqueror who killed the only sibling I ever loved in this world. “You'll still have to accept me, Isabel.” Life was hell, but I had to endure. I had to survive until the end. Just as my sister prophesied, I was destined to be captured by the First Emperor, Kailhart, and bear the child who would save the world. It was a time when we were cruel to each other, wounding one another whenever we touched, yet we were destined to become hopelessly entangled nonetheless. ✿──────────✿ “Is it true? That you never wanted our child from the beginning?” The flower’s roots had been cut away and its thorns carefully removed. It was perfectly arranged, so that no one would prick their finger while admiring it. I'd always taken this sight for granted, but suddenly it felt different. “Isabel.” Everything irritated me. I tore at my collar, gasping for breath. At that moment, Kailhart's shadow fell, crushing the flower beneath his feet. “I knew... I always knew we were destined to hurt each other. But still... I never imagined it would come to this...” A bitter laugh escaped me as everything around us began to fade into a pale blur, drained of colour. “No, Isabel!” This is the future I chose. Watch closely. For my family. For my child.

title: Go And Become A Legendary Magician!
summary: "How did you know I was a legendary magician?" Amidst the bewildered faces of bystanders, a red-haired girl shouted with delight. The blonde and blue-haired beauties beside her, along with his close friend, cast disdainful glances at him. The blue-haired beauty punched him in the chest, knocking him back to his original form. Twisting her wrist with a mischievous smile, she said, "Come on, you're already married, and you're still pretending to be a little girl?"

title: A Happy Life in the Empire – The Princess Once Called a “Failure” Becomes the “Most Important Person” as a Hostage in the Empire
summary: Princess Sophia, who was scorned and treated as a “failure” due to her low magical power, is sent as a hostage to the Elysion Empire, the suzerain state. However, her magic actually possesses a special attribute that repels monsters. Noticing this, the empire’s crown prince, Alto, asks Sophia for her help. Sophia agrees, and the two set off on a journey across the empire. She won’t be called a failure anymore! Thus begins the happy imperial life of a once-disregarded princess.
genres: Completed, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: “Let’s Have S*x” My Proposal to My Classmate Just Before She Jumps Off (WN)
summary: One day, I found that the beautiful girl in my class was about to commit su*cide by jumping off a building. She’s the person I like the most and I won’t allow her to do that. So I told her —Let’s have sex!

title: Naruto Escape From Konoha
summary: Everything has to be studied to understand its meaning, Chiba Shiraishi realized that when he had transmigrated to a new world he has no knowledge of, he only knew he was in the village of Konoha. Shiraishi couldn’t sleep, so he took out the book he had picked up “The Will of Fire” and read it carefully in the middle of the night, only to see the words in cracks. The whole book was written with two words – Pyramid Scheme. Shiraishi felt hesitant and fearful for a while, and he decided that sooner or later, he must escape from this brainwashing organization called Konoha.

title: Heavenly Demon of God
summary: Baek Jung-hyuk — once known as one of the three greatest divine doctors in the Central Plains. He dreamed of achieving greatness as a healer, and together with the Tang Clan, he worked to create a groundbreaking technique that had never existed before. After years of hard work, just as their ultimate art was about to be completed, the Tang Clan betrayed him — and he met a tragic end. "Do you seek revenge? Then I shall give you power." After his death, on the border between life and death, Baek Jung-hyuk met the Heavenly Demon — the strongest being in history — and learned the Heavenly Demon Divine Art from him. "Save the world that’s falling into chaos." Granted power strong enough for revenge, Baek Jung-hyuk made a deal with the Heavenly Demon — in return for saving the world, he would be allowed to live again. Reborn as Baek Mu-heun, the notorious fourth young master of the Cheonmu Clan, he now walks a new path. Can Baek Jung-hyuk truly avenge his death… and still save the world?
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Tragedy, Wuxia, Xianxia

title: The Earth Master Girl: Trapped in the Ailao Mountains
summary: A wave of metaphysics has swept through the entertainment industry, leading to the creation of an adventure variety show. The production team invited two Feng Shui masters to oversee the proceedings: one is a Hong Kong Master, and the other is me. Everyone mocks me for being so young. What they don’t know is that I am the sole Earth Master successor.

title: Lethal Impulse
summary: WeChat red packets from strangers are lethal! Do not tap it on impulse! Spooky and lethal things ensue after my classmates all tap a big WeChat red packet from a stranger in the WeChat group. One after another, my classmates die. Perhaps, I’m the very next…

title: My Non-Human Daughters Are Obsessed With Me
summary: I was an ordinary imperial official. I was also an eccentric who raised non-human children, discriminated against and persecuted by humans, as if they were my own daughters. Anyway, while subjugating monsters, I was cursed and sealed away, only to awaken after 15 years had passed. But now, all my daughters had become big shots. ...We can no longer be together. Yes, that's right. Girls, stop being so obsessive!!! I just want to live a normal life...!!!
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: The Reason Why I was Cheated on By My Girlfriend
summary: That day, I, Haruki Ogura, left my notebook at school. Since I have a homework due tomorrow in that notebook, I decided to go back to school at night to get my notebook. However, when I was about to enter my class, I saw a scene that haunts me to this day. “Ahnn…hmphhh…this is the best♡” It was my childhood friend, Niimi Yua, embracing a stranger, half naked… Is that really Yua? What is happening?
genres: Completed, Drama, Ecchi, Mature, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: Barrier Magic Is the Strongest! – I Have Been Blessed With the Protection of the Creator God and Barrier Magic, and I Want to Live a Leisurely and Peaceful Life in a World of Magic –
summary: Dying in an accident, I was reborn as the second son of a viscount with the protection of the Creator God, barrier magic, and life magic. I was sexually harassed by my mother in my previous life, and from that trauma I hated touching or being touched by people, but my trauma gradually healed under the watchful eye of my kind family. I want to live a stress-free life by devising the protection and barrier magic given by the Creator God, but the Creator God, angry at those who tried to harm me, descended and I was able to use the power of God: Kamui. The royal family, high-ranking nobles, and the immortal birds and old dragons who were given the protection of the Creator God also came, and my peaceful life was always disturbed. When will the day come when this young child, who has acquired great powers and drags everyone around him down, can live a carefree and peaceful life?

title: I Kept Saying That Everything Was That Person’s Will, and Now I Can’t Back Down.
summary: It's exactly as the title says. A comedy novel about a man who can't back down, a maid who can't back down, and misguided friends.
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: Creating Urban Legends In Japan
summary: After transmigrating to a parallel world, Kambara Shinji obtained a notebook that was known as “Real Records of Urban Legends”. Any urban legends that were written on the notebook would form and become real in the real world, and in this parallel world, many urban legends from Kambara Shinji’s past life didn’t exist.

title: On the Night of Genocide, I, the Emperor, Was Summoned by Future Generations
summary: One hundred thousand years ago, a foreign realm invaded — the earth turned red for a thousand miles, and all living beings were plunged into misery and ruin! The Great Emperor Lu Xuan, in order to protect all the beings under heaven, entered the Abyss of Heaven alone. Using his own body as a seal, he suppressed the entrance to the alien realm! But unexpectedly, one hundred thousand years later, he suddenly received a bloodline summons from his descendants! “Ancestor, are you still alive?” “If you don’t return soon, the Lu family will… perish completely!” …On that day, the Heaven-Burying Divine Sword, sealed away for one hundred thousand years, reemerged into the world. The heavens wept blood, and ten thousand swords cried in sorrow! “This Emperor has merely grown old — not died!” “A pack of ungrateful wretches — how are you worthy of this Emperor’s protection!” From the depths of the Abyss of Heaven, Lu Xuan’s fury surged to the heavens, his icy voice echoing through all realms: “For the sake of all heavens, I have guarded the Abyss for one hundred thousand years — and you insects dare insult my descendants, sever my legacy!” “If that’s how it is… then I’ll drag all the heavens down to the grave with me!” On that day, the seal of the Abyss was broken — the foreign realm returned, and all heavens fell into ruin once more!

title: The Ruffian Princess Is Too Much!
summary: The troublemaker of the divine realm, Raphaella, the Goddess of Corruption and Revelry. As punishment for shattering the Mirror of the Gods, she ends up possessing the body of an ugly, disgraced imperial princess.To return to the divine realm, she must collect the fragments of the broken mirror and find someone who can die in her place.Trapped in a human body and forced to endure life day by day, Raphaella encounters Duke William, a rigid principlist known as “the Empire’s Final Standard.” “If the world were full of stiff people like you, it would snap instead of bending. You need someone easygoing like me too.” “Your Highness isn’t bending with flexibility—you seem to fly off in completely random directions.” “Why? Want me to send you flying too?” “I’ll pass.” William constantly sighs and rubs his temples at her utterly unprincesslike speech and behavior, while Raphaella treats him without the slightest restraint, despite his stone-like inflexibility.The narrow-minded Duke Klimt and the disaster-prone ruffian princess Raphaella. Two people with completely opposite personalities grow close while bickering as they travel together in search of the mirror fragments.But soon, ominous shadows appear on their path across the continent, and an unknown conspiracy slowly tightens its grip around Raphaella. “Raphaella, have you finally found someone who’ll die for you?” “Shut up unless you’re the one dying in their place.” “You really never change.” Where will the goddess Raphaella’s choice ultimately lead?The Ruffian Princess Is Too Much!

title: Reborn Before the Top Scholar’s Fame
summary: Mu Jiaojiao had a benefactor who saved her life. After her rebirth, she's determined to repay him. She meticulously attends to every detail of her benefactor's family's needs, even more so than a proper daughter-in-law. Everyone assumes she's in love with one of the Zhan family's sons. However, in the 17th year of the Yanjing era, after Zhan Qiyu becomes the top scholar (zhuàngyuán), she leaves a letter and departs, believing her debt repaid. The newly appointed top scholar, dressed in red robes and riding a steed, chases her down the imperial city streets. "Mu Jiaojiao, if you leave today, I will die today." "I will only live if you are here." Mu Jiaojiao thinks Zhan Qiyu is ill. The once aloof and elegant young man has become a sickly weakling, and she can't bear to leave him. Slowly, she discovers his true nature: a powerful and influential minister behind a delicate façade, capable of bringing down even high-ranking officials. Everything is different from what she expected, and she tries to leave. Unexpectedly, the Mu family receives betrothal gifts from two influential men on the same day. A powerful man grabs her chin, "Jiaojiao, do you want to be the Crown Princess? Unfortunately, he might not become the crown prince." Mu Jiaojiao looks at the ribbon on her wrist, sighing, "I have no feelings for him, and I only see you as my benefactor." But Zhan Qiyu can't let go: "Jiaojiao, I told you, without you, I will die." She surrenders. Short Scene: It's common knowledge in the capital that Madam Zhan never attends social gatherings. Therefore, few have seen her, leading to speculation about her appearance or hidden illnesses. Then, someone spots the top minister with a stunningly beautiful woman, and the entire court is abuzz, believing the minister's image of a devoted husband is ruined. The next day, however, Zhan Qiyu requests a first-rank imperial title for his wife in court. Everyone breathes a sigh of relief. It turns out that while he's outwardly charming, he’s deeply devoted at home. The “other woman,” meanwhile, finding out she will become a first-rank noblewoman, collapses onto the bed, crying for help and medicine.

title: The Misanthropic Duke Has Been Doting On Me Since Day One, But I Plan to Leave After The 9 Months.
summary: Just as the marriage between her sister Margaret and the Duke has been arranged, Daisy is shocked to learn that her sister has unexpectedly become pregnant before the betrothal ceremony. To fulfill her sister's wish, Daisy is ordered by her parents to pretend to be her sister and marry into the Duke's family for 9 months until her sister's secret childbirth is over. Daisy is under the impression that she can fool the Duke, who is famous for his good looks and misanthropy, but for some reason, he begins to aggressively approach her from the very first day.......

title: Turning My Life Around Through Dimensional Monopoly
summary: More important than effort is a single room. For me, that single room is a dimension only I can open.

title: My Dead Husband Sent Me a Wedding Invitation
summary: Three years after my husband was buried, I received a scarlet invitation. The groom was listed as my late husband, Xie Shaoqian, and the bride was my best friend, Wen Ningyue, who had stayed by my side throughout my three years of widowhood. Tucked inside the invitation was a photo of a child. On the back, a single sentence was written: "Chen Yingnan, it's time to pay back the second child you owe him."

title: Cheat Skill: Living in Another World That Starts With An Online Shop: Rise To The Top With The Power to Buy Anything
summary: On his thirtieth birthday, the main character, Risei Susumu, got involved in a summoning to another world and is transported to that world. However, he was left behind in the in-between world because he was not the original target of the summoning. The story is that God gave him a cheat skill, and he uses it to rise to the top.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: Transmigrated into a Stepmother Control Group: Bear Love Parenting Goes Viral on the Baby Show
summary: Top-tier young actress Shen Qingqing was chosen as the control group for a variety show about a wealthy stepmother raising a child. The heroine is her illegitimate sister Shen Linyan, who is virtuous and kind, treating her stepson as her own son. In contrast, Shen Qingqing is portrayed as a spoiled and vicious daughter who mistreats her stepson. The two participated in the same parenting variety show. Shen Qingqing became the control group for the heroine, and she was criticized as a vicious stepmother. Her reputation suffered, and she ended up in a mental hospital. System: Do you want to save yourself? If you want to, complete the system task to become an all-powerful mistress of a wealthy family and be more virtuous than the original heroine! It’s difficult to be a perfect goddess, so why compete with the original heroine in virtue? Aren’t hot spring spas and global travels more attractive? Divorce is even more impossible, as the rich old man is generous and doesn’t like to go home! Shen Qingqing decided to give up. It’s better to be carefree than a stepmother. She wanted to relax and be herself! But why are the two men in the family looking at her with more passion? Even her parents-in-law are moved, gifting her a mansion and a yacht. The comments in the variety show are full of praise for Shen Qingqing: "I envy Shen Qingqing," "Shen Qingqing is the king of children," "Shen Qingqing’s successful case of raising children in reverse..." Education experts also praised Shen Qingqing for her advanced educational ideas and ability to befriend children. "Mr. Bear" Shen Qingqing becomes an internet sensation! System: My program is malfunctioning! The housekeeper once warned Zhou Jiayan to be wary of stepmothers bullying their stepsons, and Zhou Jiayan took it to heart, even showing concern on camera. They bought two ice creams, and the stepmother ate one and a half, leaving only the bu*t of the cone for him. She also warned him that children would get stomach aches from eating too much. Later, the stepmother ended up in pain from eating too much. Other mothers in the variety show wake up early to prepare breakfast and care for their children. Zhou Jiayan sighed deeply as he looked at his stepmother, who hadn’t gotten up even after being called three times. He had to move a stool to the kitchen, heat milk and toast, and use the aroma of food to wake her up. When they encountered a fierce white goose during a task, other mothers protected their children, but his stepmother crouched behind him and said, "Yanyan, you are a man, you must protect the girl!" He was laughed at by other children, but his stepmother insisted on restoring his honor! When she turned the kindergarten art presentation into her solo performance, the little girl in the audience had sparkling eyes. Zhou Jiayan wondered, is his stepmother more powerful than he thought? And more importantly, she was willing to spend time with him. He seemed to like his stepmother a little more... After an accidental head impact, Zhou Yexuan suddenly recalled memories from his past life. To avoid his son’s tragic fate, Zhou Yexuan returned home that night. As soon as he entered, he saw Zhou Jiayan covered in paint, his chubby face wrinkled, and his face streaked with tears. Then he noticed the woman who was usually noble and reserved was also covered in paint. Zhou Jiayan cried out, "I’m a child, and you’re already an adult!" Shen Qingqing was momentarily stunned, then cried, "This is my first time being a stepmother too! Why should I give in to you?" Later, Zhou Yexuan saw the two of them, one big and one small, huddled together. He felt a headache but was also satisfied. The heroine lacked a childhood in her previous life, so she let herself go in this life, resembling the original owner. Age difference: 10 years. The stepson is not the male protagonist’s biological son, and the male protagonist is not remarried. The protagonists are not perfect but help each other improve, forming a happy family.

title: Body-Snatched and Made a Concubine, I Stole the System and Staged a Counterattack
summary: [Awakening after Body Snatching, Not a Power Fantasy, Plot-Driven, Minor Ensemble Cast] Lin Ruochu, the legitimate daughter of the General's Manor, was possessed by Body Snatching during her fifteenth birthday ceremony. A time-traveling woman trafficked by the System used every means to "Capture" the Marquis' heir, causing Lin Ruochu to be betrayed by all, her reputation ruined, and confined in the Marquis' manor as a concubine with the status of an unofficial mistress. Once she regained control of her body, Lin Ruochu vowed to restore her derailed life to its rightful course. Unexpectedly, during her struggle against the Body Snatching and the System, she gradually uncovered the truth of this world. Not your typical domestic drama, worldview mystery—all plot holes will be filled later. The female lead relies mainly on her wits; the System's golden finger is not overpowered. [Has a CP, 1v1, male is chaste, female is remarried]
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I’m in Marvel, My Wife Is Scarlet Witch
summary: Li Bufan crossed into the Marvel Universe and accidentally saved the Scarlet Witch. After three years of interaction, the Scarlet Witch finally became his wife, and they lived peacefully and happily. Then, a group of uninvited guests arrived and shattered this peace. Magneto, Professor-X, Avengers, Abomination, Venom, Loki, Ronan the Accuser, Lord of Dark Dimension Dormammu ...... and even the big purple-faced potato! What could Li Bufan do? To protect and maintain his happy life with his wife, he could only rely on the real-world extraction system to extract skills from the other worlds. Extracting, Extracting ...... Magneto: "You are the future of mutants!" Lord of Dark Dimension Dormammu: "Many people say I am a demon. My friend, believe me, this is definitely your illusion. There is someone even more ruthless than me on Earth." Thanos: “Don’t fight! What you say is indeed correct. Can't I just accept it? " …...
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Sci-fi

title: Because It’s Uselessly Pretty
summary: He cherished her more than his own life, loved her as if she were a part of himself.— “…There’s another man. If you truly wish for my happiness, never contact me again.”On their wedding day, Eun-se disappeared. Tae-heon didn’t look for her— because he feared he might see her smiling beside another man. Because he feared he’d rip apart the bastard who stole her away.Then, one day, Han Eun-se—who had vanished without a trace—appeared again. Still beautiful, even in her miserable circumstances.The moment they met again, he realized it. The thing that had been torn to shreds all along— was his own heart.The years and scars that had been violently ripped apart— they belonged to Yoon Tae-heon alone. Eun-se froze. Into her trembling ears, a cold voice cut through. “How could I ever forget? The fiancée who ran away on our wedding day.” “……!” “And not just ran—she fell for another man.” Light flickered in her shaking pupils. The man ground out his words through clenched teeth. “It’s time to take everything back. Every filthy thing you’ve done.” His devastatingly beautiful face twisted in despair.Well, who told you to be uselessly beautiful?Illustration: Michel

title: Give Me Up, Hold Me Tight
summary: This is the novel that shares the same name as the annual fashion romance drama《Stay With Me》, starring Joe Chen, Wang Kai, and Qiao Renliang. There are many different wedding dress designs. Princess-style, fishtail-style, strapless-style...... There are also many different kinds of love. Romantic, heart-pounding, sad...... On this Earth, the most beautiful wedding dress is the one when I marry you. That love that's the best on this Earth that you wear is that which I still tightly hold in my palm after I gave everything up. *** Once she unexpectedly drowned, part of her brain lacked oxygen for a long time, making the famous clothing designer Li Weiwei lose parts of her memory. Thus, her memories stopped at when she was 23 years old. The boyfriend who she was mutually passionately in love with in her memories had unexpectedly become her rival, and a stranger even became her fiancé. Li Weiwei wasn't convinced that she would break up with her ex-boyfriend Chen Yidu, so she tried hard to to investigate previous events. In order to protect Weiwei and get his own fiancée back, her fiancé thwarted Weiwei's investigations by every possible means, keeping watch over her surroundings. Li Weiwei recalled the past and discovered that she and the person beside her had gradually forgotten their first dream while they were busying themselves. The reason that Weiwei and Chen Yidu broke up was also because as the two of them were in the middle of the process of chasing after their occupations, they neglected their love and their bond and walked even farther down the path of grudges and misunderstandings. Chen Yidu misunderstood the relationship between Weiwei and his parent and broke up with her in the end. The 30-year-old Li Weiwei decided to change her current situation, and step by step, she untangled past misunderstandings and forgot her previous differences with her rival, not only retrieving her romance, but also regaining her first heart and her dreams.

title: Both My Parents Are Supremes—Why Should I Fear a Child of Destiny?
summary: Su Ming accidentally transmigrated and became the villain of a dropped cultivation novel—the Devourer Demon Lord. This villain had the strongest background and the most powerful talent, yet in the end, he became nothing more than a stepping stone for the protagonist because of fate. Faced with this predestined ending, Su Ming calmly chose to take matters into his own hands. With an invincible background and unmatched talent, why should he repeat the same tragic path? Just because the other was the so-called Child of Destiny? Then Su Ming would shatter that so-called destiny himself!
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Unknown Coming: I Have Invincible Domain
summary: The end of the world + civilization invasion + invincible domain + all the way to the end + resolutely not harem + humorous and funny] When others are fighting for a piece of bread and trying to improve their strength, Su Xiao only wants to make money as soon as possible! Only in this way can the invincible domain be continuously improved! "50 yuan a bucket of instant noodles" "Tens of thousands of yuan, you can get the enemy's coordinates" "Even if you have enough money, I can directly tell you where the old nest of the [unknown] is!" Is the holy realm very strong? "Is the divine realm very awesome?" As long as it is within my invincible domain...... whoever it is! The unknown is coming: I have invincible domain (Cheng Er Da Fu)
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mystery, Sci-fi, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: They’ll Have a Happy Ending, I Have No Doubt
summary: A story about a young lady whose engagement is broken because she hid her face with a veil.

title: The Kept Man’s Comeback
summary: The Princess stole my husband. To compensate me, she gave me a sickly male concubine she had been keeping. After raising that concubine for three years, he ran away. Later, he became the Regent King, wielding power over the world. The first thing he did after becoming king was to imprison the Princess in the Princess Mansion, tormenting her night after night. And I took advantage of the chaos to take my husband away from the Princess Mansion. During our escape, the carriage was forced to stop outside the city gates. Wu Ju sat astride his warhorse, his eyes as cold and venomous as a snake, staring straight at me. "The night is deep and the dew is heavy-where are you taking your wild man?" "My... Master."

title: Beast-World Matchmaking Bureau: The Snow Leopard Judge Loses Control Every Night
summary: The day I was forced onto the Beast World Marriage Platform, three men who claimed to love me stood below the stage. One wanted to trade me for his family's medicinal lineage, one intended to use me as a stepping stone to rise in rank, and the last one smiled and said he was willing to save me. But the numbers floating above their heads were more honest than a beast in heat. Love Value: 11. Betrayal Rate: 96%. Possessiveness: 89%. Meanwhile, the truly dangerous one, the Snow Leopard Judge, was as cold as ice, yet four words were written above his head. Loses control only for me.

title: Cardboard House Doesn’t Tear
summary: Kim Pyeong-ju, having submitted his master's thesis, woke up in an unfamiliar place after an uneasy blackout. That's when he realized the thesis he'd turned in wasn't the revised version. ...And so, he decided to flip the world upside down.

title: Turning Red
summary: “I’m afraid there will be no one in the world who is as compatible as us. After all, it is difficult for ordinary people to kiss when they are angry.”

title: Thousand-Slayer Alliance
summary: In an era of unprecedented peace, forged through a truce between the forces of righteousness and evil, the leader of the Martial World Alliance, Yi Baek—a pacifist who brought about this era of stability—was granted by Heaven a son: Yi Seon, who bears the Cheonsal Star (Heavenly Killing Star). The Cheonsal Star is a fate that demands constant bloodshed and marks one to stand at the center of a bloody history. No matter how he is raised by a virtuous hand, the question remains: “Is it permissible to kill an evil person?” How can one defy a destiny bestowed by Heaven?

title: Jitsu ha Onaji Shokuba ni Anata wo Sukina Hito ga Imasu Tenkin saki ha Bijo dake no Eigyousho!?
summary: A romantic comedy about a working man who struggles in a workplace with only beautiful women! Rinta Hirabayashi, who works for a recruiting company, is transferred to a sales office where there are only beautiful women! “I will not accept a man if he is not handsome” “This is the first time you’ll find yourself in the middle of the action. “I just don’t like men who only judge women by their looks. Rinta finds himself surrounded by beautiful women: a free-spirited classmate, a strict older manager, and a cool younger colleague. Rinta’s hard work makes him unknowingly more desirable to the beautiful women in his office, who he thought were unassailable, as well as to the beautiful women at his business partners,……. “I still love ……. And there is someone who has secretly had feelings for Rinta since high school! It’s very popular on the web! This is a work love comedy that begins in a workplace full of beautiful women.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: After Escaping Marriage, She Intrudes into the Dominance of the Tycoon
summary: A runaway bride, she disguised herself from the richest young miss in the beautiful seaside city into a vulgar, ugly country bumpkin. However, after an investigation, the military discovered the truth—that she had drugged him herself. Instead, she was arrested and sent to prison, where she died a miserable death. In order to avoid such a tragic ending in the story, Xi Youyou decided to behave herself. Since her little sister-in-law—the female lead—had not yet returned to her family and was still lost outside, she planned to build a good relationship with her in-laws and also with the two children who disliked her. She would take the kids with her to follow the army, and eventually make friends with her sister-in-law, too. That way, she wouldn’t have to worry about meeting a tragic end! Sachi, a second-year office worker at a black company, was rushing home, as usual, working until just before the last train, when suddenly she was enveloped in a dazzling light and lost consciousness. When she woke up, she saw people cheering “The Saint Summoning was a success!” and a high school girl being celebrated as the ‘Saint.’ Huh? As for Qingqing, whose life she had stolen, she would be doomed to repeat the same miserable fate from her previous life. After all, without the Shen family as a stepping stone, Qingqing was just a small orphan. How could she ever come into contact with the people from that world? A life lived in a mouldy, underground room, fighting in the ring as a means of entertainment for gangsters. The naive Yi-kyu roughly pushes Hee-yeon away, but he is unable to stop himself. “f*ck you. It’s something he’s been doing all his life. Hee-yeon hadn’t even taught him how to live normally yet. But his black eyes flickered wildly. “…This is some kind of joke, why are you talking like you’re leaving?” Yi Kyu’s voice trembled, his shoulders shaking roughly. “You said you wouldn’t leave because it was my decision to save you.” There were no excuses; she’d said it, promised it, and now she had the audacity to say she was leaving. “I saved you!” Yi Kyu shouted furiously. She couldn’t bring herself to look up and see his face. Hee-yeon let out a shaky breath and clutched his shoulders tightly, closing her eyes.

She acted sharp and cynical, feigned superficiality, and pretended ignorance—all the while harboring deep and unchanging love for him. In short, she mirrored his disdain towards her in every conceivable manner. Determined to play out the final scene, she clung to his leg, tears welling in her eyes. “Sir, this maiden does not wish to wed. My love for you is unwavering, as clear as day and as evident as the moon and stars. I will marry no one but you in this lifetime!” In Wen Ning’s script, Pei You should have callously walked away without a second glance. Yet, to her astonishment, he remained motionless. Slowly bending down, his warm fingertips brushed away the tears that had yet to fall from her eyes. His gaze and tone shifted from his usual cold and distant demeanor to a beguiling warmth. “If that’s the case, then marry me. What do you say?” Wen Ning: “…???”

Kohhei, nursing a broken heart from being rejected by his childhood friend, slowly starts to regain his former cheerfulness through his interactions with Haruka.

title: Replicator Mage
summary: 'I want that doll.' As if entranced by the dancing doll, I reached out my hand and infused it with my wish...

title: Transmigrated as Cannon Fodder: It’s Hard to Take
summary: Yun Nuannuan, a major foodie, was busy munching on roasted chicken wings when she suddenly transmigrated into a melodramatic novel she had recently read… The most pathetic part? She transmigrated as the cannon fodder female supporting character—the one destined to fail at stealing the male lead from the heroine. Yun Nuannuan, the daughter of the Prime Minister, is a peculiar woman. At home, she refuses to join the family infighting; in the palace, she avoids the concubine power struggles. While every other woman in the world is tearing each other’s hair out over the Evil King and the Regent, she just wants to secretly snack and watch the drama unfold. To her surprise, an imperial decree betroths her to the Evil King. On the day she tries to run away from the wedding, she accidentally provokes the Regent and is forcibly carried back to his manor. Suddenly, she becomes the hottest topic in the gossip magazines… Isn’t this the kind of “main character treatment” only the heroine gets? I’m just a side character! The Regent: “This King shall hand this peaceful era to you; from now on, the world shall know no more war or suffering.” Yun Nuannuan: “Your Highness… please be cautious when usurping the throne!” The Little Emperor Nephew: “What’s ‘usurping’?” Vibe: Old-school lighthearted + Nonsense comedy. P.S. This is a parody/troll-style historical comedy. The characters are “OOC” (out of character) by design. Logic-seekers and serious drama fans, enter at your own risk.

title: The Little Macho Girl
summary: “Macho, won’t anyone buy a macho?” Leading along several machos, a single young girl tossed out some dangerous words to the town residents passing by. The macho seller. On that sudden statement of human trafficking, the townsfolks’ eyes opened wide as they gazed at the girl. “Macho, does anyone need a lively macho? You can boil and bake them, and if it really comes down to it, they can even serve as bodyguards. Does anyone need such a wonderful macho?”

title: My New Family Treats Me So Well
summary: Rescued from childhood domestic ab*se, I found myself with a new family… But my stepmom is a charismatic actress, my older sister is a goddess in the golf world, and my younger sister is a rising idol? This family feels far too perfect for someone like me, and yet they treat me so well. “Son, let me help you unwind today.”

title: The Genius Doctor Decided to Live Quietly
summary: A genius specialist in diagnostic laboratory medicine sets out in search of a more leisurely life. But even that path proves far from easy. “I just want to live quietly!”
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Psychological, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Transmigrated into the 1970s as a Beautiful Mother
summary: Liang Ruolan, a slender and beautiful woman, unexpectedly wakes up to find herself reborn as the mother of a period novel. She originally intended to abandon her children and secretly board a train to Jiangcheng, a role modeled after a husband-and-child abandonment, ultimately facing a tragic end. She initially considered changing the plot and ripping up the script, but the binding system forces her to complete tasks, maintaining her villainous mother persona. She exploits her two children, turning them into villains and causing others to misunderstand her.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Saikyou Mahoushi no Inton Keikaku (WN)
summary: 100 years ago, demons suddenly appeared and attacked humanity. At that time, normal weapons could not even scratch demons which caused the human population to decrease drastically. In order to protect themselves, humanity merged into seven countries. They managed to halt the demon’s invasion by their army implementing and using magic, but even now they battle with the demons to ensure the survival of humanity. On the forefront of the battlefield constantly risking his life, Ars Reigin finished his military duty at the mere age of 16, and requested his retirement. But the country cannot afford to let go of him. This is because among 100,000 mages, Ars stands at the pinnacle of them all as one of the single digit number 【Single Mages】
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: Warm Love Reborn: The Obsessive Master Fu’s Obedient Wife
summary: In her previous life, Qu Wanwan was blind in both heart and eyes. She trusted a s*umbag and her so-called best friend, ran away from Fu Ciyu, and in the end, lost everything—her family shattered, her life ruined, betrayed by everyone she loved. Reborn into a second life, she obediently married the man who held all of Jingdu in the palm of his hand. When it came to punishing the s*umbag, he handed her the knife. When it came to dealing with the fake bestie, he handed her the poison. At night, he pinned her against the bathroom wall, gently licking her earlobe, whispering in her ear: "Baby, you’ve been busy all day. I’m tired now—it’s your turn to help me." "Fu Ciyu, you bastard!" The next morning, Qu Wanwan was cursing under her breath, holding onto the wall for support as she kicked the smirking man with a flushed face.

title: Senior Sister, Shut Up!
summary: “Release faster! Why aren’t today’s chapters out yet?” “… Senior Sister, it’s only six in the morning.” “Then what about yesterday? There was only one chapter!” “… Romance slice-of-life stories rely heavily on the details. Inspiration is needed when writing.” “Then, where does your inspiration come from? You’re clearly single.” “… My imagination.” “In that case, why don’t you date someone? You can get some material too.” “… I need to write. I don’t have time.” “How about I help you?” “… Help me write?” “Of course not! I mean dating!” “… Senior Sister, stop joking around.” *** This is a slice-of-life university love story between a struggling web novel author and a beautiful illustrator, in which they mutually suffer social death. Single female lead, no melodrama, no angst.
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: When I Regressed, I Was a Martial Arts Genius
summary: Lee Jun was despised for his family’s shame and low bloodline. But there was no place for the underdog. On the day of the cataclysmic event, [The Martial Arts Route trait has been unlocked.] the trait has been unlocked. What do you do then? I’m going to die now. But when I opened my eyes again, it was seven years ago, and I was back with my trait open. The life of the underdog is now over. The life of a strong man unfolds like never before. [System] [Hunter] [Growth] [Academy] *The illustrations inserted in the text of the work were done by Sila.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, School Life

title: Rich Second-Generation Forced to Rebuild Their Fortune [The 90s]
summary: In her past life, Jiang Qingning was a second-generation rich kid. Her biggest daily worry was how to spend money. Her only regret was that her parents never had time for her. In this life, she's reborn into an ordinary dual-income family in Beijing. Although the conditions are a bit 'harsh', she finally gets to be with her mom and dad every single day. Sadly,on her birthday during Chinese New Year, a firecracker explosion jolts loose memories that don't belong to her. She realizes she's living inside a period novel, and her family is the foil to the protagonist's family. The female lead is her mother's twin sister. Back then, her mother inherited their grandmother's job and became a worker, while the female lead went to the countryside as an educated youth. Years later, the female lead returns to Beijing via the college entrance exam, having also met the male lead—a descendant of a revolutionary family—in the countryside. Later, the male lead quits his job to start a business and succeeds. The female lead gives birth to brilliant and promising twins, and the family lives happily ever after. Meanwhile, her own family, serving as the foil, sees both parents lose their jobs, forced to take on multiple odd jobs just to scr*pe by. Too busy struggling to survive, they have no time for their daughter, leading to her dropping out of school due to teenage romance. The whole family ends up miserable. Knowing her family's destined ending,Jiang Qingning's fists clench in rage! To avoid the tragic fate from the book, Jiang Qingning has no choice but to reclaim her identity as a second-generation rich kid. Well then, let's start with a street stall... ... Jiang Lifeng and Su Guiying, a couple who always took immense pride in their worker identities, never imagined they would one day face unemployment. The honest, hardworking couple's original fate was to find odd jobs, laboring strenuously to earn physical wages to support their daughter. Unexpectedly, influenced by their daughter, they dive into the speculative 'business' they once looked down upon. Jiang Qingning, who originally planned to coast through life, now embarks on a journey to remotely guide her parents in starting a business, all to change the tragic destiny from the original novel. From setting up a ring-toss stall, to selling soap with raffles for a TV, to buying a truck for the family and starting a company... Unemployed worker Jiang Lifeng transforms into a big boss, and Su Guiying becomes the boss's wife. Jiang Qingning, the mastermind pulling the strings behind it all, happily continues to enjoy the life of a second-generation rich kid.

title: The Master of Metaphysics is The Movie Queen
summary: A metaphysical master Gong Qingyao never dreamed that one day she would be transmigrated into two thousand years later. After transmigration, Gong Qingyao has two goals in life. 1. Make good use of her metaphysical skills. 2. Acting well. But what did this person who has been following her want? Qin Ze: “Me? I’m your third life goal.” During a press conference. Reporter A: “I heard that you can participate in this reality show because of unspoken rules?” Gong Qingyao glanced at the reporter. Her husband and wife palace has collapsed. Her eyebrows were sunken and there was a black air: “Your husband cheated, if you go home now, you can still catch him.” Reporter B: “According to insider, your scene in the middle and late stages of this show has increased because you have a close relationship with the director.” Gong Qingyao glanced at this other reporter. A person’s parents’ house was on the forehead. Looking at this reporter parents’ house, his left forehead was narrow and collapsed, indicating that his father has passed away, while his right forehead was also sinking and darkly stagnant: “Your mother is sick and it is life-threatening. You are recommended to return quickly.” The reporters took a step back in silence. Gong Qingyao: “Are there any more questions?” Reporters: “…” No, no. “Did you find out? Any products with commercials or endorsements by Gong Qingyao will be sold out!” “What’s this! Anyone who has partnered with Gong Qingyao will call her ‘Sister Yao’, even the best actor is no exception!” “Well, Gong Qingyao doesn’t seem to have any anti fans, even if there are, they will turn into fans within a month.”
genres: Completed, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: After Moving to the Countryside, I Received a Flood of Love Calls From Different Creature
summary: I’m just a farmer, and my family keeps growing. Yeah. Since it’s come to this, let’s all just live together!

title: They Dumped Me—Now They’re Reincarnated and Obsessed?
summary: Breaking News! Breaking News! Our school’s resident bad boy, Yan Ze, got into a fight with top student Mei Jian! According to eyewitnesses, the two school heartthrobs—who’ve never interacted before—suddenly started fighting… because of a girl!! • Bystander A: “I heard Mei Jian stole Yan Ze’s girlfriend from Class 10…” • Bystander B: “No way! It was Yan Ze who stole Mei Jian’s girlfriend, right?” • Bystander C: “Weren’t they both famously single? Since when do they have girlfriends?” Xie Tingxue thought: Let the gods clash—it has nothing to do with me. But the next day, both the school tyrant and the academic god appeared in front of her, each grabbing one of her arms. Yan Ze barked, “Mei Jian, let go of her!” Mei Jian smiled gently, “First come, first served. I’m just taking Xiao Xue to tutoring. What’s wrong, superstar Yan? You want lessons too? Makes sense—reading the wrong characters in front of a billion viewers ten years from now would be very embarrassing.” Yan Ze, gritting his teeth: “Vice Professor Mei, why don’t you worry about your mortgage in ten years first?” Xie Tingxue: “Excuse me, you two…” Mei Jian and Yan Ze (in unison): “Yes, honey? What is it?” Xie Tingxue: “???” Yan Ze: “Wife, I came back in time to save you!” Mei Jian: “Same here, thank you very much!!”

title: There’s No Way I’d Throw it Away Now! Everytime I Lose My V*rginity I Get Sent Back to The Past?!
summary: I’m a delinquent student, both by my own admission and that of others. I don’t want to say my name because I don’t like it. Anyway, it seems that I’m cursed. According to Koizumi, my 20-year-old vice homeroom teacher, I am apparently cursed to be forcibly sent back to the past and have my partner’s memory erased every time I lose my v**ginity. But isn’t that an incredibly special skill? “Yes! I can do whatever I want legally!” I was glad for a moment, but for some reason, I kept getting involved in troubles with women…* Author Note: By the way, if you want to read it normally, it’s a good idea to start from ep1. Only those who are really bored should read ep0 because it’s long and doesn’t have any special skill elements. By the way, there is also an uncensored version somewhere.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Mystery, Romance, School Life

title: I Have Descended as the Iron-Blooded All-Master
summary: Possessing boundless potential but destined to become a public enemy of the continent, I found myself inhabiting a character with a grim fate. “I Have Descended as the Iron-Blooded All-Master” [“Your vitality is decreasing due to insufficient ‘Blood Energy’!”] [“Harvest human blood to refine your Blood Energy!”] To make matters worse, even the comrades who were meant to unite and defeat the Demon King have long since perished, leaving behind only their skeletal remains. Now, the only things I can rely on are my experiences as a seasoned player and the legacies left behind by the warriors of the past. [“Achievement unlocked: has been activated!”] [Unlocked Skills: Black Radiance Divine Sword, Silent Incantation, Qi Bullet Creation…] “Whether it’s constellations or the Demon King, I’ll devour them all.” Armed with the iron-blooded powers and overwhelming talent, the ultimate hybrid, Ruth Fried, begins his descent to save the world from the brink of destruction!

title: Ex-level Player With the Greatest Civilization of All Time
summary: After the great upheaval in which the Tower appeared, the player became the object of admiration. One day, Kang Seon-woo also awakens as a player. And not just any player, but as an EX-class A-space user. When asked whether he would like to synchronize his previous usage records, he answered yes—and two years passed. Finally, letting out cries of joy, he faces the Transcendent Civilization inside the A-space where the synchronization has completed. “Hello, successor.” Seon-woo, who has become the successor of the Transcendent Civilization, begins his climb of the Tower.

title: Married To The Male Lead’s Paranoid Uncle
summary: When Shi Yin woke up, she found herself transmigrated inside the book. She had become the weak female lead who was ab*sed by the male lead and later committed su*cide while being pregnant. At the dinner table, when the commercial marriage between her and the male lead was being finalized. Shi Yin pointed to the male lead’s uncle, who was terminally ill, and said, “I want to marry Young Uncle Cheng Yuan!” After marrying the male lead’s young uncle, Shi Yin patiently waited for the day when Zhou Cheng Yuan would die and she became single again. But, why was this man getting better and better day by day? Shi Yin said, “Hurry up and die, I wanted to be a widow quickly!” Zhou Cheng Yuan said, “Either you choose to live with me, or you can choose to die with me.” Shi Yin said, “Let’s live together.” When Shi Yin first met Zhou Cheng Yuan, she thought Cheng Yuan was a cold and abstinent tyrant. But, after spending a long time with him, Shi Yin discovered that this guy was actually black-bellied and paranoid. Every time Shi Yiin looked at other men, he would stick to her and with a dissatisfied voice said, “How can Yin Yin look at others?” Every time Shi Yin was bullied and cried by him at night, he would smile and contentedly said, “Yin Yin is crying, I am very happy.”

title: Culinary World: Starting as Reba’s Food Devil
summary: Ye Chen crossed over to a parallel world where culinary fusion was the norm and became Reba's culinary devil! Just as despair set in, he bound a rebate system! As long as Reba consumed various delicacies, he could earn rebate rewards! "Ding, Reba consumes Kaila Giant Crocodile Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining 100,000 culinary cells!" "Ding, Reba consumes Gemstone Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining a special skill - King's Fist!" "Ding, Reba consumes Ma Wang Hercules Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining Gluttony Blood!" ".................." In no time, while others were still exploring the world of culinary delights, Ye Chen, with Reba in tow, had taken off completely! Reba: As long as my culinary devil is with me, I am invincible!
genres: Action, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Rain In Sunny Days
summary: Lan Yaoyang initially appears as the "inviolable noble son" in the media's eyes—reserved, dominant, and highly intelligent, like a dazzling star everyone pursues. A closer look, however, reveals the honest and interesting "Adorable Lan" to Ni Lan; he lays all his affection bare before her, deep and powerful, with immense strength. Ni Lan, before her memory loss, was seen by others as a beautiful but brainless actress, possessing only looks without talent. After losing her memory, she startles everyone; proficient in firearms and combat, she is like a female 'Rakshasa' who has broken free from her chains, sweeping in from the dark night with a fierce storm. He is her sunny day, like a ray of morning light in a warm winter; she is his rainstorm, stirring up huge waves in his calm life. A car accident leaves police officer Guan Fan severely injured and comatose, while actress Ni Lan suffers amnesia and becomes a major suspect. The "Mountain Forest" case enters a stalemate, shrouded in mystery and involving multiple parties. The dark web, informants, international powers, and a perplexing cold case from years ago... all clues related to the truth seem to be hidden within Ni Lan's memory. When a sunny day meets a rainstorm, we are certain to see the brilliant and magnificent rainbow of "justice" in the future.

title: Princess’s Journey: Easing This Life’s Sorrows
summary: In my previous life, as my Imperial Younger Brother and I were being hacked into mincemeat by a flurry of blades, the Imperial Son-in-Law stood outside the bamboo grove, cold and detached, as if he were a mere bystander. In this life, I looked at the handsome gigolo kneeling before me-the same man who had once died while shielding me from a blade-and I couldn’t help but smile. “You’ll do.”
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Fine Food Broadcaster
summary: A poor, down on his luck kitchen hand, Ye Fei was this close to thinking about sleeping with his landlady to avoid paying rent for his shabby little apartment when he was suddenly electrocuted while trying to turn on the lights. Unexpectedly, he did not die. Instead, a strange voice appeared in his head, "Divine Culinary Broadcasting System has successfully bonded with the host." Excuse me, who are you? Why are you living rent-free in my head?! Wait, where did that new laptop come from? Also, a 24-hour unlimited Internet access? "So long as Host performs your task well, the System shall also provide rewards and care packages from time to time.” The f*ck? Tasks? Are they like missions? Hold on, where did those ingredients come from? Whatever, Ye Fei was too hungry to care. Let's just follow the System's instructions for now and hope for the best!

title: The Man Who Abandoned Me Has Returned
summary: “Miss Elissa Leslie, may I have the honour of this dance?” Elisa’s first love, her first boyfriend—and the bastard who abandoned her four years ago… Ethan had returned. And this time, as a celebrated war hero! Haunted by the hellish memories of their past, Elisa wanted nothing to do with him. “Elisa, you’re going to catch a cold again.” “I don’t need your help. Just go away.” No matter how much she pushed him away and ran, Ethan kept coming back, relentless, and slowly, Elisa found herself unable to ignore him. Even though he never explained why he left and remained a cold, distant man… “You still like me, don’t you, Elisa?” “No, I don’t.” “It’s okay. Because I still love you.” What is he feeling inside?

title: The Story of the Struggle in Another World of the Divine Cat MI-Chan and the Cat Supplies Summoner
summary: Mi-chan, the divine cat, loves ships. I felt so good jumping on a box floating in the river.I took a nap and found myself in the middle of a big river. He cries for help, but it doesn’t reach him… Renta Neji, also known as Nero, a ronin student, finds such a kitten. Showing his manliness, he dives into the river and successfully rescues a kitten! However, this person is allergic to cats. I brought the kitten home even though I was soaking wet, and my allergy to cats started! I fell down the stairs and ended up in the afterlife. I am Mi-chan’s owner, God. Because he saved Mi-chan, he was specially able to be reincarnated in another world. When we arrived in another world, for some reason, a hello appeared in Mi-chan’s bag. But for the time being, I can’t return to God. God panicked and gave Nero the skill to summon cat supplies. (without consent) This is the story of the divine cat Mi-chan and the cat supplies summoner Nero. Even if you aim for a slow life, isn’t it such an easy world? Good luck Nero, aim for a slow life with Mi-chan! Cat owned by God → Divine cat I plan to make it so that even Tsugikuru-sama can read it.

title: Do You Really Know Your Husband?
summary: My husband and I have been sleeping in separate rooms for two years now. We've grown distant, with no passion left between us. But last night, after he'd been drinking, he climbed into my bed and went absolutely wild... I said, "Honey, you were nothing like yourself last night!" Later, I saw a message from an unknown number on his phone: "You slept with my wife, so I'm going to sleep with your wife. Only then are we even!" My husband's latest reply was: "Now we're square, right!"
genres: Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Hello, Nice to Meet You
summary: Mint has been writting letters with her father, who is a soldier on the frontlines, since she was a child. One day, her father picked up a child near the battlefield and suggested to Mint to write letters to him, but he's a stiff person to write to.

title: The First Investigation of Rookie Career Police Officer Akechi
summary: As an extraordinarily handsome young character, rookie police officer Akechi, along with middle-aged Kobayashi and other amusing companions, faces challenging cases. Will Akechi be able to solve these cases successfully?

title: The Fate-Weaver’s Gambit
summary: Before my younger half-sister got married, I served her by washing her feet. "Sis, you've been my foot-washing maid for three years. Tomorrow I'll marry the Crown Prince, and I'm a little reluctant to leave you." I wiped the sweat from my forehead and smiled: "Just come home to visit me more often, little sister." Suddenly, my younger half-sister covered her face and began to cry: "Sis, back then you were kidnapped by villains in order to save me, and disappeared for three years without a trace. Later you managed to run back, but..." My younger half-sister looked up, yet there wasn't a single tear on her face, only a charming smile: "You returned in rags, branded with the Beidi s*ave mark, and your v*rginity Mark was gone. How could the Legitimate daughter of the Chancellor's Mansion be unchaste? From then on, Father let me take your place as the Legitimate daughter Su Yunqi... And you became a lowly servant." She took off her hairpin and handed it to me: "Sis, do you hate me in your heart?"

title: The CEO’s Social Death Diary
summary: The CEO's Social Death Diary I am the CEO's secretary. My daily job consists of cleaning up his messes. When he gets caught pinning a starlet against a wall, I handle the PR. When he totals a Rolls-Royce while street racing, I pay the damages. When he gets rejected after a drunken confession, I write the apology letter. Until one day, he got drunk, his eyes rimmed with red, and asked me, "Do you actually like me or not?" I handed him my resignation letter with a smile. "I don't. Furthermore, every single one of your most embarrassing moments over the last three years? I was the one who personally leaked them to the marketing accounts." "Oh, by the way, the video of your rejected confession from last night is already trending."
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Who Did It with a C*ck like This?! A Strange Tale of Unintentionally NTRing a Harem of True Love
summary: The enchantingly beautiful home tutor, Rena Kurobuchi. The protagonist who had received two years of s*xual ab*se from her, Seiya Kirishima. The outcome, what he got was s*xual techniques and a pen*s that has overdeveloped to an unnecessary degree. “s*x is unproductive. All I wanted was to experience pure love…” Although he who was hurt lamented so, any woman who has tasted him once cannot help but go crazy. A mysterious tale of him unintentionally stealing girls into his “true-love” harem This is a story of love and lust.

title: Secret Love is Poisonous; The Nightmares Never Stop
summary: Humanity's fear of death permeates the very bones. Precisely because of this, I am terrified of dying. To stay alive, I can abandon dignity, face, even my very self, just to cling to a few more days of existence. The initial reason I was constantly enveloped by the fear of death dates back to that summer. I developed a secret crush on a handsome male classmate from the next class. From then on, nightmares became ceaseless...

title: The Dynasty of Cultivating Immortality
summary: In the Croburg Kingdom, leap years mark a critical time when all 16-year-olds undergo a cultivation aptitude test on their birthdays. This tradition offers a second chance, especially for children from impoverished families, to be recognized for their potential as immortal cultivators. The renowned ""Leap Test"" can catapult ordinary individuals into positions of power, as seen with Prime Minister Xue Gui, who rose from poverty due to his exceptional talent. Today, the Ni family anxiously awaits the test, hoping their eligible members will be chosen and restore their family’s prominence. Among them is Ni Huibo, an orphan with a mysterious past and hidden talents. Will he defy the odds and secure a future for his family?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: I’ve Started a Skill Gacha Shop~ Anyone Can Draw My “Skill Gacha Das”! Sell Gacha and Make a Ton of Money! Aim to Be an S-Class Explorer~
summary: 30 years have passed since dungeons appeared in the world. Being a Dungeon Explorer has now become a common profession. Tadano Hitori, an unsuccessful explorer, accidentally acquires an ability called "Skill Gachadas" that can materialize gacha draws. After realizing that not only can he draw gacha himself, but he can also let others draw, Tadano decides to sell the right to draw gacha for 10,000 yen per attempt. The gacha system becomes hugely popular, offering benefits like magic, skills, and status improvements depending on the rarity of the draw. Using the sales revenue from customers' gacha draws, Tadano also draws gacha himself and grows increasingly stronger. Having obtained both money and power, Tadano uses his capital to pursue his dream of becoming an S-rank explorer. This is a success story of a rock-bottom explorer on the brink of 30 who rapidly rises to the top.

title: School Young Maiden
summary: In the new era where the empire rule over the people and create new society, Deng Jiahu begin to take action. As the school director, he began to take advantage of his position to sleep with many beautiful schoolgirl. not willing? then you are the rebels of empire!! In the school where no one could defy him, he was the ruler of all 2000 young girls.

title: He Became Sejong’s Lifelong Follower
summary: If you offer advice to King Sejong, you'll become a prime minister, never to be able to retire. I hate that saying more than anything in the world. Because that's who I am.

title: I Found a Broken Hero
summary: I gave a tearful thumbs-up to the novel with its happy ending, and when I opened my eyes, I had been reincarnated into that very story. But. The protagonist who should have been living happily came to me in a miserable state. Having lost everything, abandoned by everyone. I cannot forgive you all for turning the heroic royal fantasy I loved into a hero-banishment story.

title: Flying Whale’s Wonderful Life – I Who Has Fused With an Invincible Weapon From the Age of Gods Will Build a City on My Back
summary: Adventurer Kaito, in a stroke of misfortune, fell to his death due to the accident in the dungeon causing the crust to split and diverge. However to his luck, the place where he fell was a resting location of a Titanic Ship from the age of gods. Kaito who was left with only a soul, fused with the titanic ship in a form of a whale, gained an immense power strong enough to destroy even a country in instant.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Even if your Sword Pierces my Heart
summary: “I hate Mcthurden.” “Is that all you hate? I bet you’d like to kill me right now…” “Still, Izak.” But even so, Cayden missed Izak. As much as he resented her, he missed her more than he hated her, and sometimes tears would well up in his eyes. When he heard that the marriage to Izak was finalized, he felt a strange sense of relief, even as he hated her madly. When Izak went off to fight in the sudden war, he would start and stop writing letters at night. Both resent her for leaving him behind under the suffocating pressure of the Duke of Macthurden and fearing that she might be harmed. 💫 ‘If the world is split in two, I will protect the Crown Prince.’ ‘Izak must marry me!’ The sweet, glorious memory crumbled to ashes. “I’ll never marry a Macthurden.” “You want to kill me, you want to tear my father to shreds for driving the Empress to her death, then wait. Lie flat on your back and be patient until the time is right.” Izak was terrified of his power-mad father. Fear that even Cayden might die at his hands. So Izak decides to become the Crown Princess. To protect Cayden. 💫 The eyes of Cayden, her husband of six years, were dead. “Izak. summary: On the first day of their marriage, Aenor Lindknecht was sent by her husband, Elliot Lindknecht, to an isolated island that was the Lindknecht family's territory and a penal colony for nobles. His reason for being sent was to live a life of true love with his commoner mistress, Sandy. Aenor was merely a pawn, taken as a bride to maintain appearances for the couple. Ten years later. Elliot had forgotten about Aenor and was living happily with his mistress, when he received a letter of divorce from Aenor and a demand for alimony. The crest indicated that the marriage had been officially accepted by the royal family and the court. To understand the situation, he headed to the penal colony where Aenor was living. The isolated island, far off in the ocean, had become a thriving island. More than ten years ago, it was certainly an empty island, but somehow, a town had formed and a building known as a manor house had been built. When Elliot asked, he saw Aenor, whom he had supposedly banished ten years ago, and Ed, the villainous prince who had incurred the king's wrath by making his fiancée a public spectacle in order to be with the woman he loved, and who was sent to a penal colony, living happily together.

title: Who Says He Can Only Be the Devoted Second Male Lead
summary: Xie Sui and I were a marriage of business convenience. I can't stand a story without spice!] [Don't let his calm expression fool you; his whole world just collapsed the moment he heard 'guest room'!] [Look at your husband! He's had a crush on you for ten years!] [I can't stop laughing thinking about how Xie Sui specifically wore a shirt garter to seduce his wife, only for it to be completely useless!] A shirt garter? title: The Abandoned Warrior Party Came to Me

title: I’m Hated by the Entire School, but After Befriending a Beautiful Girl Cheated on by a Delusional Guy, Everything Started to Change
summary: The Most Hated, Loved by Beautiful Girls. Meanwhile, the Delusional Guy… Due to certain circumstances, Kyogoku Arata has become the school-wide certified “most hated.” One day, while wandering through a love hotel district by accident, he spots Irara Akari, the girl universally considered the cutest in their school… “Explain yourself, Yuya!!!” Akari’s childhood friend and boyfriend, Nakano Yuya, is caught entering a love hotel with a girl from another school—a situation that erupts into complete chaos. What follows is a string of delusional declarations from Yuya himself: “I love you, Akari. I’ve always loved you, and that won’t change. …But I also love Manami-chan. I love her too.” “You can’t control who you fall for, right? You understand, don’t you, Akari? Since you love me.” “I don’t expect you to understand everything. And yeah, I know I hurt you. That’s why… I’ll leave it to you to decide.” In the end, Akari decides to break up with him. However, as she sobs uncontrollably in a park, Arata happens to find her… “A-are you okay?” “Th-thank you…” What begins there is a story with a shocking “secret” hidden between Arata and Akari. Despite being disliked and clumsy, Arata’s genuine kindness slowly begins to change how others see him. Meanwhile, the delusional guy continues his spiral of misguided ideas, falling further and further into disgrace. Surrounding Arata and Akari are their unique and quirky friends. What lies ahead for these two kindhearted individuals as they walk toward their happy youth? An exhilarating and sweet rom-com where Arata, hated by the entire school, wins over Akari from the delusional guy, overturns everyone’s opinion of him, and climbs his way to the top!

title: After the Gloomy, Twisted Tyrant Hears My Inner Voice
summary: [Salty & h**ny Couch Potato X Gloomy, Twisted Tyrant] Su Panyue was a spy sent to seduce the new Emperor of Qi. But no one told her before she arrived that the emperor was a tyrant who avoided women. Rumors said he was vicious and cruel,feasting on blood and flesh daily. Su Panyue found the rumors hard to believe and boldly dared to climb into the imperial bed. Then she died. When she opened her eyes again,she had been reborn, back to the year she first arrived in Great Qi. In this life,she decided to be content with lying low in the palace as a couch potato; staying alive was enough. Unexpectedly,the tyrant she tried so hard to avoid in this life kept approaching her again and again, and the look in his eyes when he watched her grew increasingly strange. She decisively chose to flee,but was quickly caught and brought back. And then she discovered this tyrant had gone even madder. Not only did he build a palace to imprison her,but he also spouted nonsense all day long: "You said you wanted me to be your man.Now I give you myself and this entire kingdom. Are you satisfied?" Su Panyue stretched lazily on the luxurious dragon bed:"Let's talk after I wake up." The lofty,supreme emperor crouched beside her bed, whispering softly: "Whether it's nightmares or...romantic dreams, it's my face in them, right?" Male Lead's POV Xie Lanzhou encountered a maid with astonishing audacity and lust,and he found he could actually hear her inner thoughts: [No one said he was this good-looking! What a waste being emperor, he'd be perfect as my man.] Xie Lanzhou narrowed his eyes slightly. From then on, he gained a lot of entertainment. While he was reviewing memorials: [Wow, a focused man is the hottest. I want to press him down on the desk and do this and that to him.] While he was feigning sleep to rest: [This damned emperor has a pretty nice figure. Show me a little lower...] While he was killing someone in a rage: [Is this 'a fury to overthrow kingdoms for a beauty'? Am I about to become a demon consort who topples the state?] Xie Lanzhou: She's desperately in love with me. I shall grant her wish. But the day after she was made his noble consort,he heard her thoughts: [I didn't say I wanted to be a Noble Consort! What should I do if that old man from Lu State asks me for intelligence?] Xie Lanzhou was silent for a long moment,then picked up his brush and wrote a declaration of war. How could his Noble Consort possibly be a spy?Lu State, you say? Then we'll just destroy it. But then she tried to run. Xie Lanzhou clenched his hands so hard his fingertips turned white,yet a smile touched his lips: "No matter.She probably forgot that every inch of land under heaven belongs to the monarch. I will always find her." Short Scene: Su Panyue,after her spy identity is exposed: Your Majesty, let me explain! Xie Lanzhou:No need to explain. I've heard everything you've been thinking. Su Panyue:What? You can hear my inner voice?? You explain yourself! Reading Guide: 1. 1V1, both pure (double cleanliness), male lead has no harem and is chaste. 2. The male lead can only hear the female lead's inner voice (starting from Chapter 2). 3. In her previous life, the female lead was not killed by the male lead; they hold no grudges against each other. 4. Set in a fictional dynasty; a lighthearted, sweet story.

title: All I Want is Your Company
summary: Song Linan met Jiang Yihe several years ago. On that fateful day, she was distraught after discovering that her parents were divorcing. Jiang Yihe's presence gave her great comfort. But they lost touch after that. Many years later, they meet again and recognize each other. People destined to meet will do so, by chance, and at precisely the right moment.

title: Baron Musou: A Case Where a Young Man Who Hated Nobility Was Reincarnated as a Rural Aristocrat
summary: A young man, who was forced to live an unloved life by parents who considered being part of the former aristocracy to be supreme, is reborn. However, the place he is reborn into is none other than an active noble family. As he trembles in fear of his parents, he reluctantly undergoes training and unexpectedly becomes the first person ever to possess four magic cores. "Huh? Actually, maybe my parents are good people?" Determined to cherish his family and subjects who need him, he makes a decision. This is the tale of a young man who makes a contract with mythical-level monsters and unleashes his unmatched power for the sake of his family and subjects.

title: He Waits for the Spring Snow Another Year

That was the year his family went bankrupt and his parents were driven to jump off a building to their deaths. The rental was damp and dark; Jiang Que had no intention of staying alive. title: After Transmigrating as a Villainous Beauty Even the Crown Prince and Ministers Vied to Please Me
summary: Jiang Li, the rebellious eighteenth daughter of the Duke's mansion, was forced to marry the deposed Crown Prince and was imprisoned with him. It is said that the deposed Crown Prince was of a violent nature, so Jiang Li packed her bags and ran away. Not long after, the deposed Crown Prince ascended the throne, and everyone broke out in a cold sweat for Jiang Li. Wouldn't the Emperor have her torn to pieces? No one knew that the noble monarch of a country held Jiang Li's hand, his eyes reddened, and coaxed her in a low voice, "Be good, I'll welcome you back to the palace as my queen." The youngest (who got the highest score in the imperial exam) of the cabinet stood up and said, "Sister, marry me, let me take care of you."
