title: My Dad, the Demon King, Is a Big Problem
summary: My handsome, overpowered dad, who only ever cared about me, ate something strange and turned into the Demon King. He used to be the sweetest, most doting father, but now he’s the final boss?! Because of this, my dad is fated to be killed by the male lead, and I’m destined to die lonely while mourning him. At that moment, I returned to the past and realized that this world is actually a game! I couldn’t prevent my dad’s descent into darkness, but no matter what, I must turn him back into his original self. If I succeed, I can get my loving dad back, right? For now, I need to get close to the male lead, who’s destined to kill my father…! So, I became a Holy Knight and even managed to be adopted as the ward of the Pluto Ducal House—the male lead’s family. …The problem is, I’ve become way too strong. As long as I get along with the male lead, my dad might avoid being labeled as the Demon King. “But that’s strange.” “…What is?” “Your lips… they’re heart-shaped.” “W-what? Don’t look at my lips!” At that, the male lead tried to avoid my hand and ended up rolling under the bed. “Ahhh!” “…?” He’s supposed to be the strongest person who’ll one day kill my dad, but for now, the male lead is just too cute.

title: Me and My Wife Transmigrated Together!?
summary: In this novel, we follow the journey of a husband and wife who find themselves transported to a new world where the concept of immortal dao reigns supreme. However, they quickly discover that they belong to completely different daos - the husband following the path of the demonic dao, while the wife embodies the principles of immortal dao. Despite being separated by vast and dangerous mountains, the husband and wife long to be reunited and live together in this new world. However, their opposing daos make their journey towards each other fraught with danger and difficulty. The husband, who does not love the demonic dao, feels trapped by it and must confront the consequences of his past choices. The wife, meanwhile, is committed to the teachings of immortal dao and must navigate the challenges of her newfound position of power within this world. As they journey through this new world, they encounter various obstacles, including dangerous beasts, treacherous terrain, and powerful immortals who seek to keep them apart. They each face their own trials and tribulations, as they must make difficult choices and sacrifices to overcome the challenges that stand in the way of their reunion. Throughout their journey, they encounter other beings who have also been transported from their own worlds, each with their own unique dao. Together, they must work to overcome the challenges of this new realm and find a way to unite the husband and wife, while also learning to understand and accept the daos of others. As they make their way towards each other, the husband and wife must confront their own dao and the consequences of their past actions. They must come to terms with their true feelings for each other and make difficult choices to protect each other.

title: Daomu Biji: The Southern Archives
summary: From 1877 to 1878, droughts occurred in nine Chinese provinces, accompanied by thirty-two other disasters. Those affected accounted for half of the country’s population. Ding Wuqihuang started with a drought and ended with a plague that spread from China to all of Southeast Asia, lasting for nearly half a century. Our story takes place in this period. You can even see the welding points, and besides, with that stress, it might not hold up over time.”

title: Butterfly Cemetery
summary: "Butterfly Cemetery" is a fantasy romance film produced by Meiya Great Wall Media, supervised by Wen Jun, directed by Ma Weihao, and starring Zhang Li, Jin Rong, Li Zifeng, and others. The film is based on Cai Jun's novel of the same name. The film was released in mainland China on October 20, 2017. ........................................................................ Legend has it that every city has a mysterious Butterfly Cemetery, a place everyone wants to find because it can fulfill the deepest desires of your heart—if you're willing to pledge your soul. However, all who enter the Butterfly Cemetery must pay the price with their lives... A video and diary left behind by a survivor of a car accident hint at strange events, but the survivor suddenly vanished. Shang Xiaodie, an extraordinarily unattractive college student, sets out on a journey to uncover the truth. She makes a shocking discovery: the "Ghost Beauty," a deadly yin-yang butterfly species thought to be extinct by the scientific community, still exists in a remote corner of the earth... In an abandoned garden near China's S University, an old mu*der case involving the "Ghost Beauty" butterfly quietly resurfaces after decades. .. And the legendary "Half-Butterfly Human" truly exists!

title: Vorpal Bunny and Fortress Uncle
summary: This is the story of Ledge, a man who lives for his hobbies. Diving into the latest VRMMO, our protagonist is dropped on an unexplored planet as a mechanical doll and tasked with its Reclamation. But he had other plans. Namely, doing anything but taking part in this whole Reclamation business. And yet, a skill that was only considered to be a “hobby skill” turned out to be much more… Along his travels, he comes across an anything-can-be-solved-with-enough-brute-force bunny girl, a cool beauty, a shield martial artist young woman, a samurai girl and a ninja boy. Surrounded by his eccentric gang, he sets about conquering the planet one whim at a time!

title: I Became Famous After Binding Two Systems [Through the Book]
summary: After being reborn as the real daughter of a wealthy family in a melodramatic novel about a real and fake daughter, Gu Rongrong accidentally becomes bound to two systems. Only by completing the tasks of both systems can she change her fate. The Super Rich System: One hundred billion, spend it all! The Worker System: Please earn 500 yuan legally today. Gu Rongrong: “...Excuse me???” What if I just transfer the money to myself—cut out the middleman and save us all some trouble? The two systems: “...Pretty face, ugly logic.” Since scheming her way through didn’t work, Gu Rongrong had no choice but to go all in. Maserati, Ferrari, Range Rover, Lamborghini—take them all. London, Paris, New York, Beijing—one mansion in every city. Zhang Daqian’s paintings, Van Gogh’s Sunflowers, Xu Beihong’s horses—forget it, just buy the whole museum. Netizens fell to their knees: Which deity-level tycoon is this? They were just about to call her “Mommy” when a video appeared online. Gu Rongrong, dressed in a custom haute couture outfit worth millions, a Birkin on her arm, emerald earrings worth tens of millions glittering at her ears... handing out flyers on the street. That very day, Weibo’s top trending topic read: “If even billionaires work this hard, what excuse do we have not to hustle?” Meanwhile, her scummy father and his family were certain that after being kicked out, Gu Rongrong would be destitute and miserable. But when they turned on the TV, there she was on the financial news. Reporter: “Miss Gu, with this kind of fortune, why still work so hard?” Gu Rongrong: “Because I want everyone to understand—money is no excuse to stop contributing to society. Oh, by the way, could you bump up the fee for this interview? I just made the Forbes list. My market value has gone up.” Her scummy family: speechless. The next day, they were fired from their jobs simply because their left foot had stepped inside the doors of the company Gu Rongrong had just acquired. ******* One sentence introduction: It’s not easy to make money, but it’s even harder to spend money Concept: Can you be happy if you have money? .
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: In a World Where Death Is Cheap, I’ll Get Back at the Goddess Who Dumped Me—with My “Self-Destruct” Skill
summary: Taiga Origami died in a sudden accident and found himself standing before a goddess. Thanks to her power, he was about to be reincarnated into another world with a special skill. There was just one small problem. The skill he received was the worst of the worst—an absolute dud called “Self-Destruct.” Disappointed by his useless ability, the goddess quickly lost interest and cast him aside. Abandoned and annoyed, Taiga decided that if he was stuck with “Self-Destruct,” he might as well use it to make her life difficult. Thus began his dangerously explosive new life in another world—where revenge came with a bang.

title: Dark Blood Age
summary: A mysterious natural phenomenon caused the Earth to be plunged into darkness. The world turned into endless bloody chaos and mankind is on the brink of extinction… Chu Yun Sheng, an ordinary white-collar worker, discovered his family heirloom, a book, shining a bizarre light by accident. Out of curiosity, he tried to study the book. After long research, he still only understood a few symbols written in the ancient book. However, he was shocked when he figured out what messages the ancient book tried to tell him: the sun will disappear, and humanity is doomed… He tried to spread the message, but no one believed him; his family and friends even tried to take him to see the psychiatrist. Eventually, he gave up telling anyone but prepared for the apocalypse in secret. Until one day — the sun really disappeared…
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Psychological, Sci-fi, Tragedy, Xuanhuan

title: The World Civilization Million Lords

This is a war game between worlds, and even more, a fierce collision between civilizations! Annexing the five continents and sweeping across the three oceans, watch how Luo Ji leads his people to carve out a bloody path to the strongest empire civilization on this civilization battlefield surrounded by powerful enemies and competing heroes!

title: Let Us Not Love Our Enemies
summary: Ashley Gloucester, the Duke, was brought to a field hospital. Agatha was working there under the name Natalie. "From today, I will be taking care of you, Captain, as Natalie," she said. "Natalie, the nurse, nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you," the man responded with a warm smile. But Agatha was someone who knew his true face very well. This was a chance for revenge that would not come again. She had to make sure to inflict terrible and painful suffering, leaving more than just scars. However, during the three days he was unconscious, Agatha hid her complicated feelings and did her best to care for him as a nurse. Finally, the day he was discharged came. She thought she would never have to see him again, but due to Ashley’s request, she accompanied him to the military hospital. While crossing the front line with him, Agatha was shot by an enemy bullet. This injury caused her to lose her memory, and she mistakenly believed Ashley was her lover...

title: Doomsday America
summary: It takes tens of thousands of years for beasts to evolve into humans. And yet—“it only took a single year for humans to degenerate into beasts?” Think about it: once the zombie crisis breaks out and order collapses completely, civilization will drift far away from us. title: When the Delicate Beauty Joined the Army, the Cold General Turned Possessive

Others avoided him like the plague, but when Lin Tingwan saw him, her eyes lit up—broad shoulders, narrow waist, long legs, and a righteous aura… not to mention, a pure-hearted and devoted “little wolfdog”! After their marriage, the neighborhood gossip went wild! “Have you heard? Lu Yunzhen brought home a pretty new wife… but being a stepmother won’t be easy!” Everyone clicked their tongues in pity, just waiting for drama to unfold. title: Treating the Concubine, Eliminating the Wife: Reborn, I Refuse to Marry the Scumbag and Marry the Prince

With her father and brothers fallen in battle, and her family renowned for their loyalty, she bore the stigma and married Jiang Lianzhi. Returning to the year of her father and brothers' deaths, she walked alone, witnessing the devastation of the world along the way. Avenging the unavenged, delivering justice where none was given. When the heavens were unjust, she overturned them; when corruption prevailed, she slew the corrupt officials. Reopening old cases, executing corrupt officials, slaying old enemies... She marched forward relentlessly, with someone always standing tall behind her. Xie Tingzhou said, "Go and do what you want to do. Fear not, I'll accompany you in overturning this world."

title: I Can Copy Everything Without Limit

Awakening in a new body with shattered meridians, his once-promising talent for cultivation now lies dormant, making him a mere shadow in the grand schemes of the Eternal Continent. Everyone laughed at her for having the luck of wealth but not the fate of wealth. ··· Su Luan’er left Beijing and lived in a small town in the mountains. She gave birth to a daughter and raised her alone. She opened a clinic to save the world and her life was prosperous. Unexpectedly, one day, a villager carried a seriously injured and unconscious man and asked her to treat him. Su Luan’er looked at Li Ye, whose body was torn, and her heart was as calm as water. She saved him again with the kindness of a doctor. Although Li Ye’s injury was healed, he forgot everything that happened before. He stayed in the clinic for more than a month. Before leaving, he asked: “I wonder what your name is, young lady? I will come to thank you one day.” Su Luan’er said politely: “It’s just a small favor. We will never meet again.” ··· Li Ye returned to Beijing. His family arranged for him to marry a new wife, but he refused. He was always thinking about the lady in the clinic. One day, he had an absurd idea and rode for three days and three nights with his close followers. He happened to meet her wearing a bridal gown and getting married to someone else. He lifted her veil in public and said, “Come back to Beijing with me.” The attendant looked at Su Luan’er, stunned and stammered, “Prince, she, she is the former prince’s concubine whom you divorced!”

title: I Became an Outer God
summary: Rowan was destined to remain a lowly C-rank Hunter, until the day he lost his eye... and awakened as an Outer God.

title: The T*ash Decided to Become a World Star
summary: Life in the entertainment industry is hell. Having lost everything, Taeyoon falls into the Han River. He returns to his first busking gig, the beginning of his misfortune. "Let's do it again." He'll give it his all, and this time, he'll definitely become a world star.

title: One Day Repeat!
summary: When I confessed my feelings to Koharu Yano, a classmate I dearly yearned for, she answered, “…I’m glad that you feel that way about me. Thank you very much. But I… can’t go out with someone who has a face like a potato. I’m sorry.” I was so shocked that I thought I was going to vomit. I went to sleep with a broken heart, but when I woke up the next day… it turned out to be today again! Apparently, if you don’t capture her heart, tomorrow will never come…! This is the love story of a girl with a fear of men, a girl who cannot recognize faces, and the boy stuck in a time loop who is caught between them.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: Volleyball Boy, the Supreme Main Attacker
summary: "How do you view the player Tsukishima?"... Hyakuzawa Yudai rubbed his head: "Tsukishima, huh? He's the one who introduced me to the world of volleyball and taught me a lot. Without him, maybe I wouldn't be here. Oh, right! Tsukishima, his attacking point is higher than mine." Nekoma's Kuroo Tetsurou pondered for a moment and said, "Tsukishima Kei from Karasuno, right? He is indeed a very talented player, and his talent goes beyond just his own abilities. He's skilled at uniting the entire team, which is rare. He's a formidable ace and a tough opponent." Ittetsu Takeda, with a slightly displeased expression, said, "Huh? Who's that? I haven't heard of him." After a pause, he smiled brightly and continued, "Just kidding. He's a little devil that you either love or hate, and he's definitely one of my favorite (least favorite) opponents, no doubt. By the way, his mental attack on the court is not inferior to his skills (even more formidable)." Tsukishima Kei ran his hand through his deep blue hair and combed it back. "No one starts off at the top, not even you or me, not even gods. But the vacant throne in the sky is about to end. From now on, Karasuno will be led by me and stand at the top of the nation."

title: I Became the Degenerate Son of a Fallen Sword Clan
summary: Born as an orphan in the slums, he rose to become humanity’s strongest warrior—Black Star, Bel Arkan. Yet, after a desperate battle against the Demon King, he met his end and lost his life. But when he opened his eyes again… what? Regression? A degenerate? Reincarnation? “…What kind of nonsense is this?” Returned ten years into the past, he remembers one rule: kindness may fade, but grudges are never forgotten. “Demon King, you bastard! Sharpen your neck and wait for me!!” The tale begins once more, as the former strongest of mankind takes up his sword to overturn the defeat of his past life.

title: Checkmate
summary: After transferring schools, Zhou Shuirong ends up in the same class as Shen Tingwen. One day after school, she sees him being “bullied” on the street. Fueled by her sense of justice, she steps in and saves him. But as they spend more time together, she realizes… He’s not as gentle and helpless as he first appeared. “I’ve checkmated you, sir.” “Just checkmated me?” — Zhou Shuirong is the daughter of Si Wen and Zhou Yan, the main couple from 《风月 (Feng Yue)》 Shen Tingwen is the son of Shen Cheng and Wen Huo, the couple from 《盲灯 (The Invisible Light)》

title: Seeing Chuntang
summary: Mingying knew from a young age that she was just a princess of low status, so she was cautious everywhere and never provoked others. In the banquet where she recognized her ancestors, she was finally able to get rid of her princess status. But she didn’t expect that because of drunkenness, she and her brother Fu Huaiyan had a ridiculous night. Mingying opened her eyes suddenly and saw Fu Huaiyan slowly put his clothes in order, lowered his eyes and said to her: “Imperial sister.” Later, the prince’s selection of concubines was put on the agenda. Fu Huaiyan probably wanted to avoid being seen, so he personally sent Mingying to a temple outside the capital in the name of praying for blessings. Mingying knew that he was about to marry a noblewoman, and she was just a hidden danger. So after weighing the pros and cons, she chose to flee privately. Yuanling is far away from Shengjing. Mingying lived there for several months in the name of being a widow, and finally she felt relieved. Hearing that the new emperor had ascended the throne and was in power, and surrounded by beauties in the future, he must have forgotten the absurd past. … The county magistrate of Yuanling saw that she was powerless and widowed here, and wanted to give her to the governor to plan for her future. When Mingying was packing up, the guards were already waiting outside the door. In the county magistrate’s mansion, she looked up and saw the person sitting on the high seat, playing with the sandalwood beads in his hand casually. He was beautiful and noble. It was not the governor of Wuzhou—but her former brother, the new emperor Fu Huaiyan. Mingying retreated suddenly, but was blocked by him. Fu Huaiyan leaned down and asked slowly: “Where else does the imperial sister want to escape to? Huh?” He has been praised since he was young, and praised as a bright and clear-minded person, but he has never been innocent when it comes to this so-called emperial sister.

title: It’s Hard for me, an Unremarkable Guy, to Believe that someone as Popular as Hirose-san would be Interested in me.
summary: One day after finishing my part-time job, Hirose-san, who’s widely considered the cutest person at work, invited me to walk home together. To be honest, there have been moments when I’ve wondered if Hirose-san might have feelings for me. But I always dismissed it as a sad misunderstanding, a delusion born from my complete lack of romantic experience. And yet... “Please... walk home with me?” Hirose-san looked at me with pleading eyes. That’s why I can’t help but think there must be a reason behind her heartfelt request... but what could it be? A youthful romantic comedy about Hirose-san, who’s so popular that it’s her first time making the first move, and me, a romance novice who can’t believe her approach is real.

title: Daily Life of Striving and Watching Drama in the 90s
summary: Su Ruyi, a landlady, transmigrated into a novel and became the original male lead's ex-wife. A "heroine" who schemed to force the male lead into marrying her, and even cheated on him. A cannon fodder female supporting character who courted disaster at every turn, ultimately leading to her own demise—a particularly tragic one at that. The good news is, she doesn't know the male lead yet. The even better news is, she possesses immense strength—like Lin Daiyu uprooting a willow tree. It feels amazing! The bad news is, she's poor. The male lead is handsome and rich? Marrying him means fifty years less of struggle? Su Ruyi's take: She can earn her own money. With money, what kind of handsome guy can't she get? Why would she be so desperate as to find herself a sugar daddy? Make money, make money, all she wants is to make money! No one can stop her from becoming a landlady. The male and female leads can all step aside. But why is the plot developing differently from the book? It's clearly the original male lead who has impure intentions toward her!
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Magic Genius of the Villainous Family
summary: I became the infamous successor in the notorious game.

title: Vicious Female Character Gets Five Beast Husbands from the Start
summary: [Supernatural Abilities | Post-Apocalyptic World | Beast Husbands | Noble Male Leads | Intense Shura Field] * Due to a system error, Xiao Jinsheng transmigrates into an apocalyptic novel as the vicious female character who has competed with the female lead since childhood. As compensation, the system promises to arrange five handsome and powerful bodyguards for her. A bewitchingly beautiful snake-man with long purple hair. A tsundere, sharp-tongued cat-eared youth. A dashingly handsome black panther youth radiating intense charisma. A gentle, caring sheep "husband" with motherly warmth. And an elegant, noble dragon-phoenix hybrid who can help her soar through the skies. Xiao Jinsheng recognizes them at first glance—these are her destined husbands she has never met before! The system tempts her: 「Press one and receive five gorgeous husbands, allowing you to enjoy a life surrounded by affection and luxury.」 "11111!" Xiao Jinsheng frantically jabs her fingers at the sculpted abs on her husbands' poster. ..Little does she know that systems can lie these days. Where are the promised devoted, gorgeous husbands? Instead, she receives five butchers! The bewitching snake husband, after being tortured and sold to the black market by her, escapes with the sole intention of killing her. The cat-eared youth demands divorce daily. The handsome black panther threatens her with bloodthirsty intent. The noble dragon-phoenix avoids her like the plague. Even the gentlest sheep "husband" turns out to be a wolf in sheep's clothing. Living in constant fear, Xiao Jinsheng leverages this world's mechanism—where beast husbands must accompany their wives in death—preventing these five mu*derous husbands from harming her. As she diligently levels up her abilities and strength, she attracts even more attention: The Demon Lord from the other side of the Misty Continent remains deeply devoted to her. The Merman Prince falls for her at first sight. The Silver Dragon from Cloud Island refuses to leave her doorstep. And just as the five beast husbands were ready to divorce and leave her for good, they suddenly dropped to their knees, swearing they would rather die than let her go.

title: I Became an Obvious Behind-the-Scenes Mastermind in a Wuxia Novel
summary: In a martial arts world in a state of chaos nearing the end of the century. To prevent its destruction, to preserve its peace, there was a man who walked around with squinted eyes, spoke politely, and always appeared at the scene of an incident. "I'm not bad. So, please, won't you trust me now?"
genres: Action, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: I’ve Been Reincarnated as Son of a Villain, so in Order to Avoid Condemnation, I’ve Unleashed the Power of the Magical Eye From the Start, and by Being Nice to People, They Start to Approach Me
summary: Kirt Alkrai. That’s my name in my second life. A villain hated by players of the game Gears of Destiny, a man who from an early age devoted his life to sabotaging the main characters by working as a pawn of the Demon Lord. But I’m different. I love this game and I love the main characters. So I’ll never kill them, and I’ll try to fight off any monster and demon tribe that comes to invite me to join them while building up a relationship with others. It’s good that I’m gradually getting to know people, but why is it that just by being nice to people, all sorts of characters, not just main characters, are coming to me? I’m only being nice to everyone so I don’t get rejected. And I somehow I feel like I’m getting favourable treatment from the girls. ……
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: Born to Warmth
summary: It was the tenth year of my long-term relationship with Gu Yinian. I accidentally answered his call. "Ah Nian, our Zaizai just gave birth to a litter of kittens." It was a gentle female voice. The caller ID: [Little Cat] . "He's in the shower. Call back later." I coldly hung up the phone. That night, Gu Yinian frantically picked up the clothes scattered on the floor, threw them on, and rushed out. And I smashed up our "home," erasing every trace of myself. I boarded a plane flying abroad. Three years later, Gu Yinian stopped me on a vacation island. He stared intently at the Little Bean beside me, whose features resembled his, eyes red as he asked: "Mine?"

title: Poor Rich Boy
summary: Life abroad was hard enough. She was just waiting for someone who had forgotten her, but a customer had made her lose her job. And that was only the beginning. When she was on the roof to clear her head, someone thought she was about to jump. Was he serious? And now he was moving next-door? And he is going to be her tutor? He doesn’t even look like a tutor. He kept calling her Little Yue, Little Yue . . . driving her crazy. She was already under a lot of pressure as a biracial girl studying on a foreign passport. He wanted to date her? She had enough complications with an ex. Did he want to make things worse?

title: Hero! What’s ‘logout’?
summary: What Is a Player from an NPC’s Perspective?

title: She’s Not the King of the Underworld, She’s the Queen
summary: A friend I’ve known for a long time calls himself Hades. No, aren’t you a woman?

title: My Ability: Sow Farm
summary: Something Is Wrong with the Sows(?) Summoned to My Farm.

title: The Night I Saw Him Zero Out
summary: The second my best friend brought her boyfriend over to meet me, I saw a blood-red "000" floating above his head. I turned and bolted. That night, however, he pinned me down in my dreams, his hand gripping my waist. Leaning in close to my ear, he chuckled. "Jiang Xingyao, after faking it for ten years, you're finally willing to let me see you." He said he had come to claim a life. But what he didn't know was that the one I had been waiting for was never among the living.

title: Fox has no Heart
summary: "I'm a fox not a human." "I know, you're a fox." "Then, why do you follow me?" "I like you." "But I won't like you. I don't have a heart." "Then, I will give you my heart."

title: The Tree Beyond the Wall
summary: “I am not a runaway s*ave!” Princess Hwinyeong flees, determined to become a Buddhist nun to annul her marriage to the detested Lim Juyoon. While searching for a hermitage, she is captured by Mok, a s*ave hunter from Chogori Village, a place from which it is said even ghosts cannot escape. She angrily insists to the rough and rude s*ave hunter that she is not a runaway s*ave, but unable to reveal her true identity, Hwinyeong ultimately accepts the deal Mok proposes. “I will keep you safe until the day I master the Thousand Character Classic. To do that, you must become my wife.” Hwinyeong begins to live in Chogori Village as Mok’s wife, ‘Dam’. While teaching Mok the Thousand Character Classic as per their deal, she finds herself drawn into the arduous yet joyful life of a commoner. The more she realizes Mok’s brilliance, the more she laments his low status and finds herself increasingly attracted to him. However, she despairs before the wall of their different social statuses and the fact that she is already a married woman. “Tell them you will not go. Answer that you will stay by my side.” He had promised to escort her to the hermitage without any lingering feelings on the day he mastered the Thousand Character Classic, but it becomes difficult to suppress the growing desire within him. The wall between a noble princess and a lowly s*ave hunter, the revenge he has prepared for his entire life, a childhood promise – he has broken down countless times before the overflowing conflicts within him, but he cannot give up on Hwinyeong now. Even if the Jade Emperor came instead of the King, even if King Yeomra threatened to drag him to the depths of hell, he could not back down now.

title: Ken oni Tensei Kiwameshi Ken wa Majutsu o Kiri Saku
summary: Enchanted by the sword, intoxicated by the sword, and dedicated to the sword. —A swordsman can “never” defeat a magician— In a world where magic reigns supreme, Craze, the second son of the Marquis of Reynothia, is reborn into a body entirely devoid of magical circuits, unable to use any form of magic. However, he realizes that he has been reincarnated into a body with the potential to fully unleash a talent for swordsmanship that he was never blessed with in his previous life. At that moment, he could barely contain the joy welling up within him—the joy of being able to devote his entire being to the sword… After cutting down monsters on the roadside and confronting scheming magicians, Craze hones his extraordinary sword skills, even stirring the heart of Arseria, a beautiful and hollow-eyed genius of magic. The heretical swordsman cuts through magic.

title: I Was Ntr’d by a Handsome Guy in My Class, and He Teased Me About My Girlfriend Cheating on Me, but I Handled It Well and Made My Classmates Laugh. Then, the Most Beautiful Girl in the Class Became Interested in Me
summary: Morita Hanamichi had his girlfriend NTR'd by his classmate Yamaguchi, a cheerful guy. Yamaguchi teases Hanamichi about his girlfriend cheating on him loudly so that his classmates can hear. This may be to make them laugh and to show how big he is. Hanamichi, however, had a talent. He was easily teased and had a talent for responding in a humorous way that made others laugh. He used them to make his classmates laugh using self-deprecation and humor. Because of this, Yamaguchi would get stressed out when things didn't go his way. As these days continue, the most beautiful girl in the class, Mikami Tsumugi, begins to show interest in Hanamichi. Furthermore, things do not go as Yamaguchi wishes.

title: In My Past Life, I Didn’t Marry; In This Rebirth, Why Are You Crying That I Won’t Marry You?
summary: In her past life, everyone knew Luo Nanchu was in love with Fu Hansheng, and it was also common knowledge that his white moonlight was the popular actress Song Feiwan. An accident allowed her to become Mrs. Fu as she wished. Not only did she mistakenly drink a drugged wine, but she also gave Fu Hansheng a glass. After obtaining their marriage certificate, Fu Hansheng, unable to marry his white moonlight, hated her for life and went abroad for two years to avoid her. When they met again, he was holding his white moonlight, covered in blood, bleeding in the obstetrics and gynecology department. She personally performed an abortion on Fu Hansheng’s white moonlight. Reborn back to the night she was drugged with Fu Hansheng, Fu Hansheng believed she had drugged him and was willing to destroy his c*astity to marry her. In the end, Luo Nanchu would rather harm herself than have a relationship with him. —Later , Luo Nanchu was going to meet her blind date. She heard that she and her blind date were getting along very well. Fu Hansheng’s eyes reddened, his voice hoarse: “Please, don’t marry me, okay?” That night, Luo Nanchu prepared to sneak away. In the dim light, the man’s eyes were deep and cold, his eyebrows slightly raised: “Baby, where do you think you’re going?” [SC + Rebirth + Wife-Chasing Hell + Older Man/Younger Woman] The male lead and the female supporting character have a misunderstanding, which will be explained slowly in the main text. The male lead has no one else but the female lead! The male lead will be severely ab*sed!

title: When I Was Nice to a Landmine Girl Who Was Being left Out in a University Seminar, She Started Coming to Sit Next to Me the Next Day
summary: Kazakiri Yuya, the protagonist, wanted to make his university debut with the goal of getting a girlfriend, but he stepped on a landmine. When he was nice to a slightly unusual looking landmine beauty, she took a liking to him……. It was a sweet love comedy in which he was pressed by a landmine named Yanderella on a daily basis, but he doesn’t feel that bad about it?
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: My Childhood Friend, Who’s Totally out of My League, for Some Reason Started Using a Hypnosis App on Me?
summary: Saiki-kun, there’s something I want you to see. Do not have any illusions about his childhood friend. Kazuhiko Saiki had always reminded himself of that. Once, they had been close, but now, that childhood friend of his had become an unobtainable flower. He kept telling himself she would never love him, and never had. If he let himself drown in that fantasy, he’d only end up suffocating in the dullness of reality. Their relationship was only such that he'd keep her in his peripheral vision, careful not to even let her know he was looking. Then, one day, Kazuhiko suddenly received a letter that read like a threat. When he followed its instructions and went up to the rooftop— “” Standing there was his childhood friend, the unreachable beauty herself. And what she showed him, of all things, was the screen of a hypnosis app. When Kazuhiko, in a moment of panic, pretended to fall under hypnosis— she ended up unleashing all of her hidden fetishes on him.

title: I Revived the Demon King Because Insurance Didn’t Sell
summary: The other world is too peaceful, so insurance doesn’t sell. So I revived the Demon King.

title: Flower in the Trap
summary: To escape a marriage forged in malice, Princess Linaelina made a desperate gamble, offering herself to the bed of the hostage prince, Kaellian. She believed it was merely a means of survival, a calculated act to save herself. But she had no way of knowing that this single decision would drag her into an abyss from which there was no escape. Exiled to a foreign palace, Kaellian bore the shame of a fallen homeland, held captive in the enemy territory. Once a pawn in someone else’s scheme, he vowed to take control of the game and become the one who pulled the strings. He would use her innocence, her trust, and her emotions to reclaim everything that had been taken from him. Love and hatred grew tangled, desire and vengeance burned without end, and within the cruel web they wove around one another, they sank deeper with each passing moment.

title: The Gods’ Unattainable Ideal Resurrects, Yet Again
summary: I was The Unattainable Ideal of Gods who died during the Great Tribulation. I watched as four transmigrators resurrected in my body one after another, yet none of them could best that body double. I scoffed inwardly, calling them rubbish. I've seen enough of this farce; it's time for people to die.

title: Ten Thousand Flowers in a Dream
summary: The book features two stories that explore themes of tragic love and revenge. In these tales, MC endure betrayal and heartbreak at the hands of their lovers. Driven by their pain, they return to exact revenge and shatter the lives of those they once cherished.
genres: Completed, Adult, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Tragedy

title: Petty S*ave Merchant, Since Not a Single S*ave Could Be Sold, He Lives a Slow Life with the Unsold Girls on the Frontier ~After Treating Them Kindly Every Day, Before He Knew It, They Started Hunting Monsters on Their Own~
summary: “Do you want to buy a s*ave? Then, you absolutely must provide them with meals. Give them baths. Give them a room. Also, if anything happens, take them to the hospital immediately. I’ve prepared documents outlining other terms too, so please review them carefully.” Sley is a petty s*ave merchant who can’t sell a single s*ave. Circumstances forced him into this unwanted trade, but his deep affection for the children he treats as merchandise drives customers away. Even fellow s*ave merchants mock him, leaving Sley with rock-bottom status. “Sley! You didn’t sell any again?” “Honestly, you’re too soft on the s*aves!” “I-It’s fine. Next time…”

title: Big Shot Little Jiaojiao Breaks Her Character Again
summary: The daughter of the Chi family has been living in the mountains for sixteen years. Suddenly, she returns to the White City. However, it’s soon found out that this missy’s image is a little off. On the first day, the paparazzi catches her having a meal with one of the best actors. The photographs quickly top the hot searches. Best Actor: "Don't jump to conclusions. She's my boss, and I work under her." Netizens: "As if we'd believe you!" The following day, paparazzi catch a financial tycoon tying her shoelaces in the middle of the street, once again igniting online discussions. Some financial tycoon: "Don't jump to conclusions. She's my boss, and I'm her subordinate." Netizens: (⊙…⊙) On the third day, the Chi family's daughter takes the hot searches by storm with pictures of a prominent figure in the medical field accompanying her to school. Big shot in the medical field: "I'm sorry, but she is my boss." Netizens: "Where's the beautiful Jiaojiao we were promised? Her image is falling apart." Just as netizens start getting accustomed to Chi Jiao's unconventional behavior, paparazzi capture her entering the Civil Affairs Bureau alongside Quan Jue, the head of the Quan family. Many describe Quan Jue's strategies as brilliant, sly, and ruthless. He's perceived as an extremely cunning figure. Quan Jue: "Allow me to introduce you all to my wife, Chi Jiao. Jiaojiao has been frail and sickly since childhood. Please, do not mistreat her." Netizens: "Master Quan, I think you may have some misconceptions about your wife." In her previous life, Chi Jiao experienced a violent death, witnessing a man kiss her lifeless body before they both perished. Only then did she realize that the illegitimate son in her household had humbled himself due to his love for her. In her reincarnated life, Chi Jiao's primary mission is to win over Quan Jue and become the cherished "Little Jiajiao" in his heart.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: The Former Mercenary’s Life as a Prosecutor
summary: The Former Mercenary’s Life as a Prosecutor novel follows Lee Jeong-hwan, a man once known as “Khalud” (the Immortal) and leader of the elite Private Military Contractor (PMC) team TEAM ZERO in war-torn regions like Iraq and Syria. After surviving years of combat and violence , Jeong-hwan returns to Korea for his father’s funeral, determined to seek revenge on the powerful forces within the Daesung Group who he believes orchestrated his mother’s death. He reinvents himself, shedding his mercenary past and utilizing his original identity as a former military prosecutor to target his family’s corruption. The moment he returns, he is thrust into action by a major school bullying and s*xual assault case (Seongjin High School Incident). He skillfully manipulates events—allowing himself to be kidnapped and assaulted by the perpetrators’ thugs —to secure irrefutable evidence via a Black Box video. After single-handedly overpowering the thugs and the perpetrators , he leverages his successful S-Corporation (Choi Soo-man) takedown and massive media exposure (via a friendly reporter, Kim Sang-ki ) to force his way into the Seoul Central District Prosecutor’s Office as a prosecutor, despite his step-brother’s attempts to block him. There, he is assigned to work with his former acquaintance, the genius prosecutor Lee Soo-hyeon. He is immediately given a politically-charged “poisoned chalice” case, the Club COCA Incident (a series of unsolved s*xual assault and corruption cases ), which the top brass, led by Vice Chairman Lee Jong-beom and Chief Prosecutor Woo Beom-jin , hope will ruin his career. Jeong-hwan refuses to follow conventional procedure, instead using unconventional, illegal methods like spending his own money on lavish tables and hiring dozens of fake patients to uncover the vast network of “Ghost Surgery” and mu*der by Malignant Hyperthermia at Shining Plastic Surgery. His investigation links the illegal surgeries and the club’s financial backers (Goldmoon Capital’s CEO Baek Sang-tae ) to the crime , which quickly leads to Baek Sang-tae’s mu*der by an unknown assassin. Undeterred, Jeong-hwan uses his special forces training to analyze the mu*der scene and the killer’s profile , launching a multi-agency manhunt. He then forces the Shining Plastic Surgery Hospital Director, the final un-indicted target of the “Ghost Surgery” network, to cooperate by ambushing him and driving him directly to Club COCA, proving his resolve to destroy the system that enabled his enemies.

title: The Crabapple Still Remembers
summary: Three days after our divorce, my ex-husband died. I was in the courtyard airing out my books when the news reached the Old Residence. The messenger boy was sobbing so hard he could barely catch his breath. He told me that Lord Xie had fallen off a cliff, and they hadn't even found all of his remains yet. I stood dazed for a long time. I remembered the day we parted; he had handed me the divorce papers with a calm expression, offering only one parting instruction: "Cut down that Crabapple in the West Wing as soon as possible." At the time, I simply thought he was being spiteful. It wasn't until that night, when I carried a lantern to the West Wing, that things changed. Before my axe could even fall, a crack suddenly split the Fox Immortal Tablet on the offering table. The room became so silent you could hear a pin drop. In the next instant, I heard Xie Huaizhi's voice coming from inside the tablet. It was low, sounding as if he had been enduring something for a very long time: "Lin Yao, if you dare cut it down, my soul will scatter to the winds this very night."

title: Ghost-Catching New Employee
summary: A secret agency that deals with monsters. I was forced to work there.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Mucus Cultivation Game
summary: Leo was subdued by a wicked woman right from the start. He quickly realized he had crossed into a magical world and was to be sacrificed to a sinful goddess by a group of pleasure-seeking Joyful believers. Fortunately, Miss Mucus, who could devour and transform into the form of the wicked woman, answered Leo's call. So, Leo destroyed the hideout of the Joyful Church and transformed all the wicked women inside into the shape of Miss Mucus. Moreover, Leo discovered that through his "intimate moments" with Miss Mucus, his body was evolving towards a higher form of life! From that day on, Leo began his journey to become a god. The queen of the snowy lands, the blood kin waiting for a thousand years, the naive little demon, and the lofty dragon princess... all slowly became his companions. The fading Initial Fire, the endless starry sky, the survivors of the ancient era, and the sea deities... Leo was astonished to find that the path to becoming a god was filled with unimaginable thorns, and even his own existence seemed like a preordained game of fate. title: Playing God in Various Catastrophic Worlds
summary: In the year 2352, Blue Star was in the midst of the Cataclysm Era. The entire planet would be completely destroyed in ten years. Humanity was plunged into despair, and nations exhausted every possible solution—yet nothing worked. At this very moment, Xia Wang’an was reborn. "My ability is [Setting] . As long as enough people believe I’m a cultivator, I can truly become one and alter the world’s system." "But this requires ten billion people to believe in me. Blue Star’s population isn’t enough, so I must travel to other cataclysmic worlds." "However, convincing people in other worlds that I’m a cultivator… might be a bit difficult." The people of Blue Star: !!! Not difficult at all! How could it be difficult?! The entire planet sprang into action. Centered around Xia Wang’an, they crafted cultivator robes, researched cultivation systems, forged flying swords, and even built immortal sects across different worlds. Goal: Rally the entire planet’s strength to create the perfect immortal cultivator persona. Reading Guide: A lighthearted, fast-paced wish-fulfillment story. Includes elements of group transmigration and world-building. All worlds are fictional and unrelated to reality.

title: Tears in Heaven
summary: Everyone bears a love like a tattoo, leaving a permanent mark that cannot be obliterated. Zhenrong is Xiaosu’s tattoo. Xiaosu is Yuzheng’s tattoo. In this lifetime, nobody can replace the tattoo engraved upon one’s heart. In order to seize headlines, willful entertainment reporter Du Xiaosu disguises herself as a nurse to slip into a hospital, where she fatefully encounters neurosurgeon Shao Zhenrong. When she meets Doctor Shao, the epitome of a true gentleman, she embarks on a relentless pursuit of his heart before finally winning his love. Alas, happiness is as volatile as fireworks. It is impossible to fully grasp the feeling with your fingers before it slips away again. Just as they manage to receive everyone’s blessing, the appearance of Shao Zhenrong’s second brother Lei Yuzheng shatters all of Du Xiaosu’s hopes and dreams. “I met her first.” The moment he speaks these words, Lei Yuzheng knows that he has truly fallen in love with Du Xiaosu. Only, they met at the wrong place at the wrong time. Due to the pain of a betrayal in her youth, Du Xiaosu allowed a singular moment of sorrow to get the better of her. Their first encounter was a mistake, as they were both intoxicated. Nevertheless, the sentiment of love has no concept of beginning, running endlessly deep. That senseless moment of passion rendered itself an eternal memory for Lei Yuzheng. As for Du Xiaosu, the only one in her heart is the perfect and tender Shao Zhenrong. Little did she know that a mere moment of indulgence would plunge her into an emotional struggle between two worthy loves. In the end, Du Xiaosu must come to terms with the fallout. After all, you can deceive the world, but you cannot deceive your own heart. Ultimately, this is a story about waiting. Du Xiaosu resolutely waits for Shao Zhenrong. Indeed, she may wait forever without turning back. Therefore, she may never know that behind her is someone who is waiting just as persistently for the moment she finally turns around. The graceful descent of snowflakes silently vanishing against the surface of the sea: these ostensibly myriad flowers are nothing more than passing dreams, just like their love.
genres: Completed, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

summary: 「–Okay. The restrictive spell cast by Habani dissolved, and the fun days with my classmates began. That’s right, it’s not too late. From now on, let’s enjoy school life to the fullest. Then, there’s the girl who sits next to me, Yukishiro Fumi. The impression left by her somewhat big glasses of hers is strong and she has a somewhat different atmosphere from the other students. In my conversations with her, where I realized that I could act naturally unlike with Habani, I gradually began to feel more attracted to herーー

title: Flare
summary: This is a revised edition of the novel, edited for readers aged 15 and above.It felt as if the whole world had joined hands to torment Hyoshin. Her country had fallen, her parents abandoned her, and now she was stuck with the miserable fate of a servant girl, beaten and scolded at every turn. Just the thought of it made flames rise inside her chest.“Do you really think leaving Joseon will free you from being a servant?”The greatest thorn of all was none other than the cold gaze of Yoon Sanyoung, the young master of the household. His eyes held the noble arrogance of someone who believed it was generosity to even glance at someone so lowly. A look that said—How dare you expect my attention.And then, there were his pale, strong hands plucking the strings of the violin. Whenever that sharp and icy violinist swept his bow with force, Hyoshin had to pretend not to feel the burning flames that twisted in her stomach.“What can a servant’s fate become? I’ll just stay here until I die and haunt this house as a ghost.”Would turning her back on this turbulent world finally cool the fire boiling inside her? Would it be easier if she simply died, letting her grief and anger fade away forever? Hyoshin only wished to be erased from this world.“…Do as you please.”But she didn’t realize— the single spark she breathed out had already caught onto him, and was spreading into a blazing fire. A "modernized" cultivation world unfolds: A yellow-haired cultivator rides a flashy sword imbued with lightning and sword energy. "Old Deng, my flying sword is parked outside your house—here’s the report!" A construction cultivator alters the weather with a single punch to meet deadlines. "Why is a broke cultivator like you trying to refine a Ten Thousand Soul Banner?" The Hehuan Sect absorbs energy through online live streams. Please pull over, cooperate with the investigation, and show your sword-riding license!” Xu Xing: "What? Did I transmigrate back to my old world?"

Everything about it is suspicious, but the offer is too sweet for Do-hyun, who’s just fired from his part-time job, to refuse! “Money really pays.” “Keep that in your head!” A relationship between a woman with nothing but money and a man with nothing but money, earning 25,000 won an hour. What does the future hold, for the boy who rushed to the vortex at full speed… A 16-year-old boy who loves otaku subculture goes to a different world.

title: Veil of Pride
summary: All of the capital knew Princess Ming Weiwei to be clever, charming, and hopelessly in love with the brilliant yet distant Grand Tutor Liu Xi. He was the untouchable flower atop the highest peak—elegant, aloof, and cold to her relentless affection. For years, she chased him, only to be met with a frigid rejection: "Your Highness and I are star-crossed by fate—never meant to be." In the twenty-third year of the Great He Dynasty, Princess Weiwei wed—but not to the man she loved. The night before her wedding, she walked barefoot to Liu Xi’s manor, removing her bridal garments one by one before him. "Liu Xi, I'm getting married." He stood frozen at his desk, never once turning to look at her. When the morning drums signaled her departure, the brush in his hand snapped in half.

title: The Remaining Life Has Its Limits
summary: She was an utterly ordinary woman. From a family that favored sons over daughters, to a job with meager pay, and a husband who was taciturn. She thought she would forever remain ordinary until one evening when her husband didn't come to pick her up. Misfortune struck suddenly, and she began to live in darkness, fearing that someone might say she attended a party that night or that someone might mention she wore a dress that night. She feared her husband accusing her of infidelity and her family condemning her as immoral. Until everything became unbearable, her typically silent husband sat on the couch, finished his last cigarette, and looked at her crying in the corner, utterly broken. "What have you done wrong?" he asked. Then he took her hand, called the police, hunted down the culprit, and appealed. Using his remaining life and risking his life, he sought justice for her, sought fairness, and gave love. The road is long, life has cliffs, but there is always an end to this despair. [The story of a heroine who, after being hurt, stands up again with her husband's support, facing her original family, facing herself, learning love and life.] PS: 1. The heroine is not a perfect victim; she starts off weak but gradually grows stronger. 2. Dark beginning, healing ending, complete HE (Happy Ending), overall tone of "though thousands may oppose, I'll go forward," so it won't be overly sweet or cheerful, but the ending won't be stifling. 3. Several hundred thousand words, not your typical romance. Content tags: Inspirational Life One-sentence summary: Boundless remaining years, with you ahead. Theme: Never give up on love for life, brave battle against evil forces.

summary: He was the young emperor. He was good at literature and martial arts. However, he was looked down by his loyal subjects. The court’s dispute forced him to marry. She was the daughter of the influential prime minister. She was talented and good looking but lived in her bedroom where no one knows her. After becoming the empress, she met with a cold response from the emperor. He was the gentle and refined Yu Wang. His behavior and appearance are out of the ordinary. He is famous and well known everywhere for assisting the emperor. A onetime encounter and he cannot prevent himself from falling in love with her. One belated meeting, she becomes his fairy. She was also compatible with him. Since then, the prince only loves her, and unfeeling towards other beautiful women. A sudden confession and she reveals her identity. They become strangers to each other. Since then, their relationship was only sister in law and brother in law. Their love is now dead. The emperor’s harem was filled with many different concubines. Everyone yearning for the empress’s position. Trying their hardest in creating schemes to steal her position. Her trusted aide was gentle, lovely and liked the emperor. She was willing for her to become his concubine. But when the grievous news arrives, she realizes with astonishment that she was already all alone in this world…

title: A Sickness That Turns Into Love
summary: Blue Morphos was a su*cide instigating game that shook the foundations of Japan and claimed the lives of over one-hundred and fifty people. The instigator, it transpired, was Kei Yosuga – a universally loved high-school girl. How did she – a girl who was supposed to good – become such a monster? Miyamine, her childhood friend, begins to recall the very first mu*der that sealed their fates. “If the world doesn’t forgive you, I’ll be on your side.” What is this personal hell, where he sees her changing but cannot stop loving her?

title: Thus Goes The Lost Story

In the universities, many mages are trying to develop new magic and tools under the direction of professors in each field. Auros Elgarden, a 17-year-old boy, is a mage with the lowest level of magical power. Rather than magic itself, he is trying to write a paper to simplify and speed up the process of increasing magic's output. Many mages in the past have given up, but Auros is now doing research that is mocked as a "get rich quick paper." The unwavering conviction of this boy, who has neither talent nor affability, draws his colleagues - each of whom has their own dark side to them - to him, and eventually has a huge impact on the Magic University and even the country itself.

title: The Male Leads I Abandoned
summary: Finding a decent male lead is harder than it looks. Why are they all so obsessed, so possessive, so utterly insane? At first, Eulia had been swayed by their appearances, but in the end, it always came down to personality. Always. [Stop Reading] [Are you sure you want to drop this story?] Let’s go. Fifth story’s a bust too. Next, onto the sixth. Eulia made up her mind and tapped the back of her bookmark twice. It glowed brightly. [The Male Leads I Abandoned] [Start from the beginning?] The bookmark vibrated. It seemed she was entering the story. [Male Lead: Callias Xanderwick] [Male Lead: Hill] [Male Lead: Sihak Winterhell] [Male Lead: Mortert] [Male Lead: Aktion Lahes Khan Egelperium] ‘They’re all the same.’ The names of the male leads she had met flickered before her eyes. Some were fleeting encounters, others long-term relationships, but regardless of the time spent, she remembered them all vividly. ‘How… how did this happen?’ Without a moment to think, Eulia’s vision flashed white. *** Five novels. Five male leads. Having passed through all of their stories, she had arrived at the sixth novel, ‘The Male Leads I Abandoned’. How was she supposed to deal with those five lunatics? ‘What do I do now? Am I trapped?’ Unable to even drop this unknown novel? Everything felt hopeless. But every story has a beginning, middle, and end. And the endings of romance fantasy novels were always the same. The male and female leads unite, the story concludes, the novel ends. ‘If ‘The Male Leads I Abandoned’ reaches its happy ending…’ Wouldn’t the system governing this world also shut down? If so, she had no choice. ‘Fine. I’ll play this little game of love!’

title: My Unrequited Love Is Not You!
summary: Owner of the opulent great theatre, a man with whom anyone may fall in love at first sight. The audience recognized the famous name when they saw Edgar Wharton, the blond, gorgeous man enter the theatre. Even though he makes several females lose sleep over their affection for him, Natalie has a crush on a genuine gentleman rather than this showy socialite. However, Edgar Wharton, famous for winning ladies' hearts with his attractive grin, accidentally revealed her hidden, unrequited love. "I'll help you." The playboy of the social world and the bookworm of the baron's family shared a common goal: to assist each other in finding love. “Natalie, will you be my girlfriend? Leonard will fall in love with you, and we can break up." The curtain was raised on a play called 'Contract Dating,' in which the goal was to avoid falling for the other's act of love. *** "I'm not good at deceiving others." "Then try loving me." The dominant man's smile was so appealing that it appeared seductive. He asked her to cross the border, but he remained in place, commanding love but not loving. Natalie vowed not to love him or allow herself to love him. But... "Do you want to mess up my daily life?" "Is it okay if I mess it up?" Mr. Wharton smiled mischievously as he examined Natalie's lips. "How far will you allow me?" Can they avoid falling in love by the end of the play?

title: The Concubines Can Read My Mind and I Can Speak to Animals
summary: Main Characters: Yu Wanwan, Zhou Jingchuan (Completed) [Silly fun story + mind-reading + animal speech + cross-dressing + chaotic writing] Yu Wanwan has transmigrated into a book! While others transmigrate into an emperor’s consort, Yu Wanwan becomes a fake eunuch disguised as a man! And not just any eunuch—she's a records-keeping eunuch in the Bureau of Internal Affairs, responsible for recording the emperor's activities with his concubines! Good news: She can play with beautiful fair-skinned ladies. Bad news: Her inner thoughts are being overheard by the concubines in the harem! And she’s a spy—her father is planning a rebellion, and her entire family is going to be executed! Yu Wanwan wanders through the palace every day, smiling on the surface: "Congratulations, Lady Xiao, the emperor has chosen you again." But inside, she’s rolling her eyes: [The emperor has athlete’s foot; he better not pass it to my beautiful sister.] So Lady Xiao claims illness and declines the emperor’s summons. When the emperor happily grants a title to Noble Consort Shu, Yu Wanwan thinks: [Sister, run! Sixth Prince has sent a team to harm your unborn child!] Noble Consort Shu refuses the title and moves into the Empress Dowager’s palace. When Imperial Concubine Xian gets caught cheating, Yu Wanwan thinks: [Great job! The emperor’s illness can’t be hidden much longer.] When the newly-arrived Consort Hui isn’t favored and becomes overly anxious, Yu Wanwan thinks: [Men only hold back my sister’s path to wealth! Isn’t making big money in the palace more appealing?] So Consort Hui develops a fragrance that becomes wildly popular in the palace, amassing enough wealth to rival the nation’s treasury. After becoming a rich woman, Consort Hui voluntarily leaves the palace, seeking neither wealth nor power, only wanting to be with the eunuch, Yu Wanwan. The emperor, furious, exclaims, "Am I not better than a eunuch? Drag her out and execute her!" Imperial Concubine Xian: "If you dare execute her, I’ll rebel with my family." Lady Xiao: "I’ll have my father and the civil officials force you to abdicate." Prince Zhan: "Harm my Wanwan, and I’ll slaughter the entire world!" The court officials: "Prince Zhan doesn’t like women because of Eunuch Yu!" Yu Wanwan is dumbfounded. She was supposed to be a minor character, so how did the plot go so off-course?

title: I Shall Not Lose. Political Marriage is a Lady’s Accomplishment
summary: The region of Parsa in the state of Karana is jointly governed by two great houses: the Fullranet family, masters of magical power, and the Romano family, unrivaled in martial might. Each house has a daughter whose breathtaking beauty and extraordinary abilities mark her as the future countess. Annamaria Fullranet, known as “The Black-Magic Lady.” Rosaria Romano, known as “The Silver-Knight Lady.” Though childhood friends, a trivial incident in their youth shattered their bond, turning them into sworn rivals who clash at every turn. Then, Duke Jeremiah arrives in Karana. A royal with prodigious magic, he had served as a general in the capital’s Sorcerous Kingdom Army—only to abruptly resign and relocate to Karana. Rumors swirl: He’s here to find a bride. Marry him, and I’ll rise as duchess, lifting Parsa to new heights! both ladies think. As the two reignite their feud, Jeremiah reveals a secret. “My source of magic—the gem Smeraldo—has been stolen. I can no longer cast spells. Whoever recovers Smeraldo… I will marry.” And so begins the coldly calculating courtship battle between two noble daughters—purely for power, prestige, and Parsa’s future!?

title: The System for Mentoring Villain Bosses
summary: Ever since Su Tian had transmigrated, she received a “Villain Bosses Mentoring System” that could automatically identify villainous bosses IN THE MAKING. As for her missions, they were a little more complicated. For example: Stopping the boy in her class from deviating onto the path of becoming a villain; Turn the boy who was going to create a global financial crisis into Jack Ma of the new world; Talk the strange girl working at the toy shop out of her spending habit, because she will be the cause of hyperinflation! And the boy from the countryside that she ran into, please give up on developing bioweapons! Why don’t you focus on the Nobel Prize instead? Just when Su Tian thought all the little villains were growing straight up into upstanding people under her “education of love”, the small villains brought about a big villain… The young man has slender arms and legs and he cornered her into the restroom. He looked deeply into her eyes said, “I also need …” Su Tian shuddered, “What… what do you need?” “The education of love,” said the young man meaningfully! Ten minute later, Su Tian… was educated. Right after arriving, her little brother was being sold off, and she herself was thrown into the mountains by her wicked grandmother—to be fed to wolves. Su Qingqing was furious. She rescued her brother, moved out of the Su family, and had no mercy dealing with those who wronged her. Their new home was bare and broken? No problem! She had a Gold Ingot System and was blessed with divine strength and supernatural speed. Earning money through farming was a piece of cake. She never expected… her parents weren’t dead and were actually people of great status! The old man who clung to her turned out to be a divine doctor, Her pampered little brother was destined to become the future Grand Chancellor, And the stunning man she picked up on the mountain… was the future Prince Regent, who loved her to death and chased her every day to have babies with her…

title: The Absolute Godspeed of Infinite Worlds
summary: After creating a character profile, Eiji wakes up and finds himself reincarnated into the world of Chivalry of the Failed Knight, where he awakened an ability called 〈Absolute Godspeed〉—a power that ensures he is "absolutely faster than his opponent." While it sounds invincible, it’s not entirely without flaws. From then on, countless opponents couldn’t help but exclaim how fast he was, which only made Eiji beat them even more mercilessly. This novel is a crossover of different anime worlds, not an invincible protagonist type. It involves worlds such as Chivalry of the Failed Knight, Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?, Type-Moon, KonoSuba, Asterisk War, Strike the Blood, and more.

title: Episode 15 of That Drama

summary: How did I end up in the 1980s as a pitiful little girl with the same name as someone else, being bullied by my entire family? A cruel grandmother, a weak father, a heartless mother, and an overbearing younger brother. And then there’s a city fiancé who’s about to break off the engagement. Just as she was preparing to accept the humiliation of being rejected by her fiancé with money, a quick Q&A system suddenly appeared in her mind. One moment, the fiancé was standing with his arms crossed, looking at her with complete disdain. “Are you going to kneel and beg me not to break off the engagement? Or threaten to commit su*cide?” The next moment, he dropped to his knees with a thud. “Who said I’m breaking off the engagement? I came here to build a relationship with my fiancée.” Zhou Yumiao: “……?” No! I was still waiting for you to throw money at me! …Lu Anhe

title: I Confessed and Became a Simp, and Now the Empress Time-Traveled to Kill Me?
summary: 300 years ago, Lin Li transmigrated into a cultivation world and became a weapon spirit. He met a beautiful woman, and together, they climbed to the highest heights. 300 years later, Lin Li’s life force was drained, and the Empress broke through the void and ascended. He thought he was dead, but when he opened his eyes, the girl in front of him looked impatient. Lin Li was stunned to see that it was Jiang Xueer, the goddess from his life before time travel! “I only see you as a friend! Just because you’re kind to me doesn’t mean I’ll like you. Accepting a gift isn’t the same as accepting your confession!” On that day, he had failed to confess his love, and the pain had caused him to faint and cross through time. Unexpectedly, after being reborn, only one second had passed in the span of three hundred years. Facing the goddess from his previous life, he chose to stop chasing after her! He let go without hesitation. But after taking just a few steps, he saw the Empress, whose aura was unmatched, walking down the street. “Lin Li!” The Empress spotted Lin Li as well. Feeling a bit lost in this new world after coming from the shattered void, she immediately found her sense of stability… But when she learned that Lin Li had been Jiang Xueer’s devoted follower… The Empress drew her sword: “If you continue being her follower, I’ll kill you!”
