title: No Matter How Many Times I Go Back In Time, I Fall In Love With You Again
summary: I fall in love again with the 17-year-old you I never knew. He is married to his childhood friend, his work is going well, and his savings are modest. Atsushi Suzuhara, an ordinary businessman, wakes up and finds himself back in his high school days. With his wife. “She looks like a JK, but she’s your wife on the inside! Won’t you give your youth a second chance?” Atsushi and his wife, Chiho, had been on the outs with each other in high school because of his self-consciousness. They immediately enjoy a weekday date in Kyoto in their school uniforms, going to and from school together, flirting at school with Chiho in her volleyball uniform, and enjoying the time between lovers that they couldn’t have before. The true face of the 17-year-old girlfriend that you didn’t know or couldn’t know is adorable. No matter how many times time goes by, I fall in love with you. A joint time-release love comedy in which a husband and wife start over, it’s time to begin!
genres: Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: My Stepmother is Soft and Charming
summary: Du Jingyi, bearing the tough identity, married into the Duke's residence, becoming the sixth daughter-in-law of a prominent family. Her husband, the highly esteemed war god in the current Daxing Dynasty, was Shang Shaoyu, rumored to be notorious for mistreating women. Originally, she thought it to be a match made in heaven. Little did she know, on their wedding night, Shang Shaoyu only managed to lift the bridal veil, leaving with the words "Cezhou is in danger," and was gone for three years. Upon his return, he realized the household had gained a new wife. Believing she had endured hardship, he discovered his secluded wife in the Xi Tang Courtyard was thriving better than anyone else. The Duke's residence lived in a state of turmoil, but she alone lived a life of luxury and privilege... Du Jingyi sought nothing more than a peaceful retirement, yet she was forced to navigate the complexities of the inner palace. From graciously yielding half of her bed to an unexpected presence squeezed into her heart. Just before she succumbed. The stern and cold-hearted Grand General, however, smiled with warmth and charm.

title: The Goddess’s Might Saves the World
summary: As the world teeters on the brink of apocalypse, humanity's last hope is found deep within the sanctuary of the bosom. $$The Holy Bosom Seal: The Twelve Demon Kings$$ $$A Fighting Game-Style Novel$$ Legend has it, this is an "aberrant remnant chapter" of the Hero's myth. The original Divine Chosen Hero, however, utterly degenerated into useless on the battlefield. And so— The multiverse’s most popular, kind-hearted, well-endowed Goddess personally descends. She personally overrides the timeline. She abandons the divine magic, opting instead to use her bosom to pin down and suppress the Twelve Demon Kings, one after the other. The chronicler made a note on the margin: "When the black smog lifts, humanity won't be looking for the Holy Sword, but for the Holy Bosom." The young hero is a weakling, crying in the ashes. The Goddess whispered: "It's large enough here. I'll take over protection duty." She used her bosom to crush the hellhounds, fallen winged demons, tent**les, and dragons. Every single victory was the act of squeezing the darkness into the abyss of the Holy Bosom. For the final movement, the poet only left one short line: "The world wasn't saved by a blade, but found peace in her embrace."

title: Please Treat Us Fairly, Your Majesty
summary: It was said that imperial harems were living hard lives. The emperor had a thousand methods to make a harem die an ignominious death. Besides, she might die due to the countless frame-ups and schemes from other jealous harems. Eight babies in tens were dead before they were delivered. With respect to the lucky two coming to the world, one of them would die before he grew up, and the other one… It was firmly believed by Yun Cang, the emperor, that the other one would grow up to a pillar of the nation. Hua Qingxin asserted in a loud voice, “No! The other one will grow up with a distorted heart!” The emperor: “So is it the reason for you to go to Prince Yun Hai for shelter?” Jieyu Hua: “Yes… I want to share my bed with a man with strong chest muscles!”

title: Seventies: The Doctor Wife Arrives, The Cold-Faced Tough Guy Spoils Her to Heaven
summary: [Aloof and Abstinent Special Forces Team Captain × Beautiful and Dashing Cold Female Military Doctor] [Mutual Flirting Between Two Strong Leads | Pure and Highly Sweet | Intelligent Plot | Time-Space Mystery Case] Military doctor Su Tong, who died in the line of duty in her previous life, opened her eyes to find herself reborn as a village girl in the 1970s, branded as a "jinx who brought death to three families." On one hand, her nasty relatives wanted to sell her off for a bride price; on the other, she was taken hostage during a pursuit. Su Tong handcuffed the wanted criminal to the back seat of the car, stood on her toes, and hooked the cold-faced officer’s collar: “Captain Qin, is this certificate of submission enough to get into your bed... ahem, into your Special Forces Team?” She solved problems even experts couldn’t crack with a scalpel, saved the entire team with a gun, then lazily poked his Adam’s apple with her surgical blade: “Brother Yi, your heartbeat is so fast.” The man crushed the cigarette between his fingers, his voice hoarse as he pinned her against the back seat of the field vehicle: “Say it again, and I’ll give you my life.” When she handed him the blood-stained marriage application, Qin Yi’s eyes reddened: “Su Tong, the fire you lit must be put out over a lifetime.” When the enemy’s gun aimed between her brows, Qin Yi roared in the pouring rain: “If you dare die, I’ll tear apart the underworld to get you back!” When her brother, missing from her previous life, appeared holding champagne, and when she received the jade pendant she wore in her past life, the overlapping gears of past and present suddenly began to turn—
genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Decided to Share a Room With My Childhood Friend
summary: A childhood friend Mayo. She is a beautiful girl in the eyes of the general public. But in his eyes she’s just his younger sister. Both of them decided to go to a university far from home and share a room. Both of their parents are close friends and wants to stick them together. A story about two people that are closer than a couple.

title: Magic is Far, Fist is Near
summary: Yuriel, the lone survivor of that terrible event. He looked at the ruins of his estate and made a decision. If he could kill all those monsters, he would gladly give up his life for this one. However, he couldn't kill the monster that had massacred his clan with magic. The one who killed the king of monsters reached a light that no amount of effort could have otherwise attained. Transformation Master, Lavida von Lutentus. "I wanted to become you." Yuriel chose to die in his place. And then, another chance was given. Amidst a flood of questions, the monster reappeared. Magic could not end it. But this time will be different.

title: Autumn Jade Bamboo Mat
summary: This is an era of frenzy, upheaval, and dramatic change, where lingering sorrows and joys, and beauty-that-topples-nations partings and reunions are played out. For Ye Pingjun, a poor woman, and Yu Changxuan, the son of the Military Commission Chairman, her gentle glance under the moonlight became his unforgettable, lifelong memory. It turns out that some emotions in this world win at the start but lose at the end. When love can no longer return, destiny has long set the pieces on the board... The orioles on the branches listen with tears; new tear stains mark the old. The promise of flying and growing together was made then. Since fate is shallow, why is the affection so deep? In dreams, she is still that captivating trace of jade hairpin fragrance. If you are not by my side, even if I hold supreme power and command an empire spanning ten thousand li, it is nothing more than fleeting, passing glory.

title: Future Pet Shop
summary: I opened a Pet Shop, but on the first day, I received a Panda! What kind of joke is this? Help, I don't want to go to jail!
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Warlord of Chaos
summary: One of the few self-cultivator who exist in this modern world; due to an unfortunate event, completely destroyed his body in an explosion. Using all his effort to save his primordial spirit, he ended up in an strange magical world and had to start all over again. From a fallen aristocrat to the Warlord of Chaos, this can no longer be summarise as legendary; this is the life of the God of War.

title: Lady Aria’s Battle of Sweet Pretenses
summary: A Thieving Noble Lady vs. a Straight-Laced Knight – Let the Sparks Fly in This Fiery Battle of Wits! Aria, the beautiful baron’s daughter known as the “Lily of the Valley” for her pure and modest demeanor, is in truth a cunning girl raised in the downtown slums, and the very jewel thief who’s been causing a stir in the royal capital. After her adoptive father, Baron Jonas, accidentally damages the royal crown a national treasure, the seven deadly sins sealed within its gems are scattered far and wide. To set things right, Aria secretly sets out to retrieve the corrupted gems, aided by the treasure’s guardian spirit, Balt. "Heh, with the skills I honed on the streets and this flawless façade, no one’s catching me." Using her shady back-alley talents to full effect, Aria successfully retrieves gem after gem. But as the commotion grows, the kingdom’s most renowned holy knight, Raul, is dispatched to catch the culprit. Known as the “Holy Knight of the Azure Moon” he’s cold, righteous, and relentless, and he’s quick to see through the thief’s disguise, closing in on Aria fast… Thus begins the high-stakes clash between a noble thief who refuses to be caught, and the uptight knight who never lets his prey escape!
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance

title: The Illegitimate Son of the Shijong Family Is a Great Magician
summary: Just when all hope seemed lost, the very magic that once gave life intervened, and a miracle unfolded. The great wizard, who had witnessed the end of the world, was reborn into his humble beginnings as an illegitimate child, returning to a life of modesty yet carrying the weight of his extraordinary destiny.

title: Our Secret Base
summary: The summer in 14 years old, the hot season—— He is ordinary, she firmly believes in the existence of aliens, and she calls herself a realist. The fate of the boys and girls who met in a seaside town began to be gradually connected with a mysterious and terrifying distant planet… This unknown boyhood adventure is about to overturn the world.

title: Regressing as the Reincarnated Bastard of the Sword Clan
summary: The Great Norther Wall. The Dragon Knights. The Lords of the Winter Mountains. The Descendants of the Primordial Dragon. These are the various titles of the Grand Ducal Clan Ragnar, which boasted a rich, thousand year history. Theo Ragnar resolved himself to aiming for the throne of that very same clan. 'These cursed chains weren't something I could slip out of. They were meant to be broken with strength.’

title: Drifting to an Alien Planet for a Slow Life After a Mutual Kill with the Enemy
summary: Following the destruction of Earth, humanity fled into the cosmos, embarking on a life of exile whilst searching for the next habitable world to call home. Centuries later, a lieutenant of the Federation becomes lost after a battle and is stranded on an unfamiliar world. Unable to return to the Federation, he settles down with his combat weapon. That is the general premise.

title: The Lost Tomb: Mission Progress Bar
summary: A dual-male lead story with an unusual and shippable plot—haha! The Lost Tomb is a famous online tomb-raiding novel that has become a cherished memory for many. "Belief creates existence, and existence is reasonable." This is a phrase widely accepted by netizens, who believe in the existence of another world. In the novel, the sudden death of Wu Xie recorded in the notes was an ending that many readers couldn’t accept. They insisted he was the protagonist—how could the main character die? The overwhelming sadness and anger of the fans led to an unexpected intersection of two timelines. The collective desire to rewrite the ending took form as a living being, entering their world and guiding Wu Xie to find a way to be reborn. However, the journey is full of twists and turns, with unpredictable blessings and misfortunes…

title: My Brother’s Girlfriend
summary: I died of a sudden asthma attack while being bullied. My family sent my bruised and battered body straight to the incinerator; no one went to my school to demand justice for me. Later, my brother started dating the girl who bullied me. He turned her into the blade he would use to avenge me.

title: Feigned Pity
summary: An ‘unwanted child’ appeared at Gu’s household; well-behaved, good-looking, and she looked weak and easy to bully. On the first day of her arrival, the notorious Young Master Gu knocked over the bowl she brought to him, leaving a faint red blemish on her hand. She whimpered with tears in her eyes looking very pitiful as Gu Jing Yuan pretended to be tough and aloof. Gu Jing Yuan skipped classes, missed examinations, and engaged in fights… He became the first person to repeat a grade in Fu Middle School. He was without scruples and no one could control him; except for Tao Yi Xi. Her red blemished slender hand delivered a set of test papers, “Ge-ge, your homework.” “Get lost.” “If you don’t accept it, the teacher will scold me,” she cried. Her tears were like raindrops on a pear blossom, so pitiful. “…” f*ck. His heart inexplicably softened. Later on, as long as Tao Yi Xi cried, he could not help but compromise. The impression of a weak baby chick was deeply engraved into his heart. Until one day, she took on five strong men alone. Covered in bruises and bleeding but she did not shed a single tear. She looked incredibly ferocious. Gu Jing Yuan, “…” Did he get cheated?! The first time they met: She tenderly called, “Ge-ge.” But he sneered, “I don’t have a sister.” Who would have expected that later on, he would trap her in his arms, bite her ear, and mutter, “call me Ge-ge.” Tao Yi Xi: Did she act so well that everything went out of her control?… When Tao Yi Xi just arrived, he chided in disgust: “Don’t touch me!” After that, when Tao Yi Xi wanted to leave, he hugged her tightly and begged her in a low voice, “please don’t go.” When they met again, he had already matured into a business big shot, donned in a western suit. When he saw her, his gaze just lightly swept over her, like the past events never happened. If he did not want to acknowledge her, then so be it! Yet, in the middle of the night, smelling of alcohol, he pressed her against the wall, with red-rimmed eyes. “I like you so much, why must you leave?”
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Chasing You Like a Tenacious Falcon
summary: [Moody Boy x Martial Arts Girl] [HE] [Male Lead is Crazy,] Quan Zhisui didn't understand why Wei Shixu was always getting beaten up by people from other schools, and why she constantly had to rush in to save him from danger. Later she found out that those people were just hired thugs. They were paid by Wei Shixu. "We're through!" She firmly drew the line. Wei Shixu smiled cheekily, "Fine, then don't come to me for tutoring anymore. Fail the exam and repeat the grade, then let your s*umbag dad and stepmom control you." Quan Zhisui had to compromise, "Let's cooperate until the college entrance exam is over, but don't go looking for trouble when there's none." Wei Shixu: "I won't go looking for trouble if you date me." Quan Zhisui: "I don't date in high school." ... After the college entrance exam ended, Quan Zhisui went far away to university. She blocked all forms of contact with everyone, thinking that would make him give up his obsession, since it was decisive enough. But she heard that at the awards ceremony, Wei Shixu tore up his university admission letter. A year later, a certain repeater pursued her to her university.

title: Taking Down the Mother of All Campus Belles in the Apocalypse, Luckily I Have Antibodies
summary: What is it like when the campus belle next to your pillow suddenly turns into a zombie? My name is Zhou Peiyu, an Ordinary Person who went to the hospital to act as a guinea pig in order to make money and was injected with a special antibody called "Mei Li Ting." I didn't expect that the Zombie Virus would break out overnight, and the campus belle who kept vomiting beside me was actually infected with the Zombie Virus? And I became the only Immune in the world.

title: My Gate Connects the Past and Present: The General Reveres Me as a Deity
summary: Yuan Ying transmigrated. Armed with a powerful flashlight, she arrived on an ancient battlefield, scaring away tens of thousands of enemy troops and becoming a god in the Great Qian Dynasty. The border war was critical, but the imperial army's supplies and reinforcements were delayed. Yuan Ying: Leave it to me! Not enough rations? Instant noodles, steamed buns, and dumplings—as many as you want! Not enough military supplies? All kinds of medicine, weapons, armor, winter clothing, and more—plenty! The God of War general was prophesied to be a lone star, destined to become a traitor? Pshaw! Yuan Ying was determined to proclaim the God of War's glorious achievements to the world! But… she was just using her ancient and modern experiences to practice her acting skills, so why did the general embark on a self-conquest journey? After ascending the throne, instead of being a proper emperor, why is he coming to the modern world every day demanding official recognition?!
genres: Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Kiss Him, Play Cute—The Ascetic Prince of Beijing’s Elite Can’t Escape
summary: 【True & Fake Heiress + Entertainment Industry + Reunion After Long Separation + Sweet Romance】 Best Actress Yu Yang once had a romance in her youth that ended without ever bearing fruit. At first, her boyfriend was a cold, aloof, abstinent man straight out of a manhua. After some “training,” she somehow ended up with a textbook twenty-four-filial-piety boyfriend who obeyed her every word. Later on, she dumped him… Later still, that twenty-four-filial-piety ex became her direct superior… Before she could even process this established fact, her ex’s identity changed once again— into her little uncle… Yu Yang spread her hands helplessly: Good heavens, what exactly are you trying to do?! Because of their awkward relationship, Yu Yang decided to go full stealth mode. But she never expected her ex to press closer step by step, tempting her with every word: “Yangyang, do you really want her to become your little aunt?” Yu Yang was also very helpless, but she was a law-abiding, upright citizen after all. ——╥﹏╥… —— After being hurt by a certain heartless s*umbag woman, Pei Yuheng swore that sooner or later, he would make that person regret it deeply. After reuniting following a long separation, before Pei Yuheng could even carry out his revenge plan, he learned that the s*umbag woman who hurt him was actually his elder brother’s biological daughter. ——What kind of absurd, dog-blood drama was this?! At first, Pei Yuheng was unwilling to become a beast. Yet he was tempted by a seductive enchantress and fell straight into the abyss. Someone took the initiative to provoke him and then wanted to walk away— Pei Yuheng’s stance was simple: If I’m going down, then we’re all going down together. Fortunately, the truth of everything was eventually revealed. Everyone: We ship this so hard—turns out what they were playing was pure love!

title: When the Yanderes Whose Affection Reversed Regained Their Memories
summary: As usual, Roa was living an ordinary life. But one day, he noticed that he was receiving hostile glances from the opposite s*x around him. He was especially confused and troubled by the sudden dislike from girls with whom he had previously been on good terms. As days passed, their attitude towards Roa deteriorated more and more, driving him almost to the point of death. And then... the girls, who had been helplessly in love with Roa, had their consciousness return to normal...

title: The Frost Moon
summary: In this lifetime, I have only seen him five times. Our first meeting turned us from enemies into strangers. The second time, we learned each other’s names. I gave him a nickname, and from then on, I called him only that. In this world, I am the only one who calls him that way. And he, without meaning to, added a surname to me. Yet that soft murmur of his, I have never forgotten. Only at the time, I did not know that I would remember that single murmur for a lifetime. The third time was to fulfill the one-year promise we made when we met again a year before, to test the world together. Then I left, to find someone who could help me test the world. The fourth time, heaven aligned, the time was auspicious, the place was favorable, in the capital of the southern kingdom. But the people were not in harmony. It was I who went to steal his wedding, yet in the end, I failed to take him. Only then did I realize that I loved him, loved him so deeply. The fifth time, my arrow grazed his shoulder, and his arrow... So, I only hope that from now on, we will never meet again...

title: Here is Blue Justice!
summary: A man working as an evil organization combatant, Aoi Masayoshi. He suffered from anxiety on his way back home from work. He wonders if he will be all right with the way things are going. In front of the station, a flyer was handed over to him by a girl on a wheelchair. To earn money, aside from being a combatant, he decided to act as a hero who protects the town and exterminate kaijins. In the city full of heroes and villains, sideline hero Aoi is fighting nowadays to earn daily income.

title: He who Protects the Transforming Heroines from the Shadows
summary: Wielding mysterious powers, these girls fight against evil... They are Heroines, and their story is one of tears, romance, and battles. But no, this is not their story. This is the story of the boy who helps them from the shadows. Gifted the same special powers as the magical girls, yet bound by the rule that his true identity must never be revealed, he is the enigmatic ally in the dark. Think of a certain masked man in a tuxedo from a well-known anime, and you'll get the idea.

title: Summer Cicadas
summary: This story depicts Himawari’s ordinary yet not-so-ordinary daily life from Himawari’s point of view. A little of my real-life emotions are in it. lol

title: Bound to the Monster
summary: Ji Yu was a useless beauty in the spiritual-ghost world, weak and sickly, possessing only a beautiful face, completely of no use, and the type that dies the fastest. In order to survive, she made a bold decision. To marry the most terrifying yao-ghost in the world. It is said that when the yao-ghost appears in the world, the living die, the dead appear, all living beings are plunged into misery, and the people avoid him. The days after marriage didn’t seem so frightening. She and the yao-ghost ate at the same table, slept in the same bed, and every day even received flowers and fish sent by the other. By the yao-ghost’s side, Ji Yu rarely enjoyed a period of peace and joy. Until the end of her life, it was the yao-ghost who sent her off on her final journey. * In this world, there are always some sinister and evil beings, who do not enter reincarnation, and cannot have a good end. Every time Ji Yu entered reincarnation, she would have a boyfriend, but the boyfriend each time was not human, and the species were all of every imaginable kind. Yao-ghost, nightmare demon, alien species, blood clan, sea demon, steel beast...

title: Tumbleweed
summary: In 2016, in response to the national policy encouraging second children, Cheng Simin’s middle-aged parents welcomed a new baby into the family during the winter of that year. From then on, at the age of nineteen, Cheng Simin embarked on a seven-year battle against her family to claim her share of personal assets. Working part-time while studying, migrating to Beijing for work, rejecting arranged blind dates, and eventually purchasing an apartment with a single loan—every life decision she made was a deliberate act of defiance against the outdated family system. But when the economy declined and competition became unbearable, Cheng Simin found herself unable to keep up with her mortgage payments. Bankrupt and exhausted, the young woman had no choice but to return to her hometown, cutting her losses and embracing a more passive lifestyle. On the day she moved into public housing in Banshan City, she sneezed as she walked her dog past a jar of pickles emitting a pungent odor in the hallway. Just then, the door across from hers opened slightly. Cheng Simin took a closer look and immediately felt a spark of delight: “Oh! Isn’t that Shi Ying, my childhood rival?” It seemed there was justice in the world after all—even the rich could fall from grace!
genres: Completed, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Found a Man on the Famine Road, Our Pretend Marriage Became Real
summary: [Arranged Marriage Turns to Love + Farming + Food + Beloved by All] Yang Yunxi unexpectedly transmigrates. That alone would be enough, but she immediately falls off a cliff while fleeing during a famine. As if that wasn’t enough, she also ends up “picking up” a man. Not only that, but she also declares herself as the man’s wife. What shocks her the most is that the man she picked up is actually a great general—overnight, she becomes the general’s wife. They travel north, enduring countless hardships, and finally reach the northern frontier. Using her knowledge of space and modern life, Yang Yunxi helps her husband’s army and the locals thrive in the harsh northern lands. She raises chickens, pigs, and rabbits. She grows crops, vegetables, and fruits. She is not only the general’s beloved but also cherished by all the soldiers.
genres: Adventure, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Home of the Unusual Creatures
summary: Dawn inherited the rental house left by his deceased parents, ideally, he wants to be a small homeowner that’s able to enjoy life until his time comes. But why was his tenants a bunch of monsters? A mysterious pendant, a group of supernatural creatures from all sorts of places and times, and he himself a non so ordinary landlord. “I know, from the very moment I promised to let you all stay, my daily routine was destined to be not so ordinary anymore.”

title: The Unattainable Flower Called the Ice Queen of the School Reika Himuro Is My Pet
summary: I did say I wanted a pet, but I’d prefer a dog or a cat…

title: The Transcendent Immortal
summary: Xiao Chen was once an abandoned disciple of an Immortals’ sect after being framed up by people. Thousands of years later, he was reborn, only to seek all that remained, to find his master, and to cultivate again. However, he was involved in a battle of the six realms from the Annihilation Times without knowing it. After his rebirth in the Human World, he was a loser who could not even cultivate. He was mocked and lived a miserable life. When a cultivator happened to pass by his home, he managed to fight against his fate and started his life as a cultivator. He was once banished by the gods, and his soul was sealed. Now, with an invincible Divine Soul, he stirred things up in the world, obtained the great fortune of heaven and earth, and commanded the power of life and death. He dominated the nine realms and the gods held him in awe. How powerful was his Fuxi Zither? Would he ascend to Heaven and become an Immortal? Would he find his master and solve all those mysteries? Let’s take the journey with Xiao Chen and enjoy a wonderful, dangerous adventure!

title: Fragrance Dance – The Final Stage
summary: As the revered elders of eleven major sects reemerge in the martial world and a young prodigy of the Yu clan rises to fame, Sheng Xiang finds himself cast out from his own home—branded a traitor for "harboring a fugitive of the imperial court." Now wandering the Jianghu with Wenren Nuan and Yu Cuiwei, Sheng Xiang is pursued relentlessly by the so-called righteous sects. What's their crime? Yu Cuiwei's daring rescue mission on Mount Daming sparked widespread suspicion and condemnation. To buy them time, Ze Ning risks execution, using the imperial tiger tally to secure a one-month reprieve—giving Sheng Xiang a chance to capture Liu Lingyan and expose the truth to the world. The green ivy and purple wisteria had withered away. Mount Daming remained hot, while Kaifeng had already entered deep autumn. Sheng Xiang sat beneath the wisteria trellis where he often sat, holding the now noticeably thinner Big Fat Rabbit, Little Gray, in his arms. With eyes as clear as glass, he quietly gazed at the withered lotus pond not far away.

title: Master, I Swear I Never Wanted to Be a Traitor!
summary: [Multiple females + Not invincible + Love polygon + Pursuit of a rebellious disciple leading to downfall] "Xu Ruobai, be honest, do you have any thoughts about your Master?" Xu Ruobai looked at his Master and at the three Senior Brothers lying in pools of blood behind her, and said anxiously, "Master, I am loyal, really. It was the Senior Brothers who wanted to be rebellious and it has nothing to do with me. Please don’t kill me, I just want to live." Ye Lingyue’s face turned cold as she said, "Not even a little thought?" "Absolutely not..." Xu Ruobai hadn’t finished speaking when he noticed her expression becoming even colder. What's wrong? Why is she getting angrier after I answered? If this situation continues, I'm afraid I'll end up lying in a pool of blood like my fellow brothers. With a hardened heart, he whispered tentatively: "Maybe... maybe a little bit." As soon as these words were spoken, Ye Lingyue's expression softened instantly. "Ruobai, since you have an idea, do you really need me to teach you how to do it?" Xu Ruobai wanted to cry but had no tears. Wan La, I am not a disciple who rebelled against master, but master is a disciple who rebelled against master!

However, unlike Yernia, who thought about divorcing him after being his guide for a little bit until the female protagonist arrives, Cassian seems to be serious about this marriage for some reason. Even… “I just can’t calm down today.” “You need more. Huh?” Guiding requires more contact. Well, is this what guides must do? It felt strange, but the most bizarre thing to Yena was herself. Why is her heart shaking so much? The childhood friend, who she used to only see as a younger brother, begins to appear as a man.

title: You Said You Would Never Leave Me
summary: Ever since Shen Wang locked me in the basement, he has kept a strange habit: while I pretend to sleep, he gently traces the inside of my wrist and counts my pulse as if he were checking on a treasure he finally recovered. He brings me exquisite meals, warm milk, and roses with every thorn carefully trimmed away. He smiles so softly that I almost believe him when he says he would never hurt me. Then I find dozens of frantic fingernail scratches hidden beneath the peeling wallpaper. When I turn around, the man who has been feeding and guarding me is standing right behind me, watching me with a gaze on the edge of obsession. “You said it yourself,” he whispers. “You’ll never leave me.”

summary: Completed [Spiritual Spring Space + Hoarding Supplies + Strong Female Lead (Not a Saintess) + Farming + Awakening + Fleeing Famine and Natural Disasters] Xie Zhizhi merely fantasized about having a self-restocking space, and it actually came true! Just as she spent all her money and filled her space with goods, she went fishing at sea, only to be swept away by a wave and transmigrated directly into a book! She became the daughter of a general in a novel about fleeing famine and natural disasters, whose family was about to have their home ransacked and property confiscated? Confiscation? No, no, no! She wasn't going to put up with that! Her father and brother had already been framed by the old Emperor and died on the border. Was she supposed to wait to be shackled and exiled instead of emptying the General's Mansion and slipping away early? But they still wanted her life? In that case, she wouldn't leave a thing in the national treasury! Three days into her exile, a massive Hail Disaster would strike the imperial city. The fortunate would awaken Divine Power to resist the natural disasters; the unfortunate would die. From then on, natural disasters would strike one after another. The world would undergo immense changes, the dynasty would be overthrown, and calamities like scorching daylight, extreme cold storms, torrential rains and plagues, frozen rivers, earthquakes, tsunamis, and eternal night would follow. She possessed an Invisible Mobile Space with infinite food and supplies, allowing her to experience a thrilling and brutal apocalypse while ensuring her own safety. Could getting caught in the rain lead to the awakening of Water Element Divine Power? Would being hit by a giant ice spike result in death or the awakening of Ice Spike Divine Power? As natural disasters descended, opportunity and danger coexisted. With her Invisible Mobile Space, Xie Zhizhi single-handedly emptied the national treasury, sending the imperial family into a panic. The Imperial Noble Consort sent assassins to take her life? Then it would be a life for a life. She would build a camp, awaken her Divine Power, and gather forces, becoming a figure feared and revered by all under heaven.

She’ll drag Grandma to matchmaking meetings everywhere, forcing Grandpa to red-eyed desperation as he pins Grandma against the wall whispering gentle pleas. Grandma is gentle but reticent, unsure how to navigate romance? She’ll give Grandma private lessons, transforming into a melodramatic novelist writing stories blending red-eyed literature + wife-chasing crematorium literature + take-my-life-for-you literature + forced-love literature + shotgun-wedding literature – the ultimate CEO blood-pounding saga. Grandma: “The book says to win a man’s heart, you must first win his stomach!” Grandma: “The book also says when a man says ‘no’, he really means ‘yes’.” Grandma: “The book further says men shouldn’t be spoiled – sometimes you need to give them the cold shoulder to deepen the bond.” Wen Sining nodded in satisfaction, thinking she’d mooch off her grandparents forever. However, he was resented by a rival who lost in the struggle for promotion and was fatally stabbed in the abdomen with a knife. For some reason, Zeke was reincarnated as an orphan in another world. Under the guidance of his new mentor, he learned alchemy, and with his intelligence and knowledge from his previous life, he earned the title of National Alchemist at a young age, once again pursuing the path of an elite. However, he was envied by a noble involved in the advancement struggle, who used their power to take his position. title: Failed Awakening, Summoning a Divine Beast, I Take Off On the Spot
summary: Beside the Qinhuai River, the moonlight was like silver. Beneath the peony blossoms, Chu Qiu leaned close to the beauties, vowing to live a life of romance, drunkenly resting his head on a beauty's lap, and laughing at the affairs of the mortal world. But fate is fickle, and in the end, he couldn't withstand King Yama's cold scythe. His soul, like a fallen leaf returning to its roots, was silently drawn into the depths of the Underworld. Entering the Netherworld, he obtained the supreme treasure, the "Book of Life and Death." One day in the Netherworld was equivalent to a thousand years in the world. When he opened his eyes again, he had already boarded a broken ship of transmigration. At the awakening ceremony, he was full of anticipation, but failed midway. In despair, he re-entered the Netherworld, and after a bloody battle, he finally contracted the divine beast Diting. Returning to the human world, he found that the road ahead was not as smooth as he had imagined. Former enemies, harboring resentment, stirred up trouble like venomous snakes in the dark night. Former friends, having succeeded in their awakening, discarded him like worn-out shoes, watching with cold eyes. Fortunately, the mentor showed concern, the city lord concealed for him, and the principal helped him soar. Exotic beasts, Otherworlders, traitors, mortal enemies make the road difficult. Family, friendship, love, cherished thoughts can cross the bridge of life and death. One man, two beasts, three cups of wine. Respect for heaven, respect for earth, respect for beauty. I, Chu Qiu, today open the gate of heaven with beasts! I invite you all to witness!

title: Military Wife in the ’70s: The Delicate Miss Is Super Capable

On his deathbed, he gripped her hand tightly and said, "Ji Zhixiao, I married you out of obligation, not joy. Not once in this life have I felt happiness. If there's a next life, I just want to follow my heart." He left all his inheritance to the son of his white moonlight. It was only then that Ji Zhixiao learned her husband had been secretly supporting that child all along—through his marriage, through fatherhood, the support never stopped. In his will, he wrote: "This is what you owe them." Reborn on the day of their wedding, she watched as her husband abruptly called off the ceremony. She knew then—he had been reborn too. So, Jiang Chen, this time, your paralyzed mother, your parasitic relatives, your bottomless pit of a household, and your lofty pride—leave it all to your white moonlight. At least this time, she won't jump into that fire pit again.

title: Defeated By Gentleness
summary: Si Wa followed He Yanxiao for three years, docile and well-behaved, never once causing a scene. Others mocked her. "A sparrow dreaming of becoming a phoenix. Foolish delusions." Si Wa believed she had found true love and willingly endured the gossip. She only learned later that she had been nothing more than a stand-in for his white moonlight. On her birthday, He Yanxiao received a call from his white moonlight. Si Wa set aside her pride and tried to make him stay. "Can you please not go?" The moment He Yanxiao stepped out the door, Si Wa's heart died. She picked up her suitcase and vanished. Two years later, Si Wa returned. Her eyes were bright and captivating, yet her heart and gaze were filled entirely with another man. Watching her act coy with someone else, He Yanxiao was consumed by jealousy and went mad. He pestered her relentlessly and stood guard outside her door through the night. "Wawa, come home with me." Si Wa left him hanging the entire night. The next morning she dialed the police directly. "I'd like to report someone. There's a person harassing me." --- Si Wa carried her wounded heart to a new city and there she met a gentle and courteous neighbor. The man named Yan Jun was warm and refined. He taught her how to rely on someone and spoiled her until she became a child who knew how to throw a tantrum. No matter when or where, Yan Jun would always tell her, "Don't worry. I'm here." Confession. Proposal. Si Wa finally understood what it meant to feel completely safe. My love for you is not the blazing sun. It is like moonlight, falling gently upon you. — Yan Jun

title: Spring’s Command
summary: Wei Tingchun is a supporting role player in the world of novels. While transmigrating into one story, she took pity on a child kneeling in the snow for days and gave him a cup of hot tea. After her character exited the plot, a decade passed before she transmigrated into the same novel again. By then, the child had grown into a gloomy, pale-faced prince. Coincidentally, he was kidnapped and deliberately imprisoned in a desolate palace, starving and freezing. Unable to resist, Wei Tingchun gave him another cup of hot tea. The first warmth he ever felt was a cup of hot tea from a young eunuch in the snow—only for that eunuch to die moments later. The second warmth came from an old palace maid who gave him tea during a life-or-death crisis—yet she too died swiftly. The third time he relived that bone-deep warmth, the hands bearing scars he’d never forget offered him a steaming cup of poisoned tea. title: Not Crossing
summary: Xie Xuan was wicked in life—and just as unrepentant in death. Denied reincarnation, she was cast into the sea of blood, doomed to fade into nothingness. But before her soul vanished, she was saved by Feng Xun—the ghost king of Fengdu, a celestial being who descended from the upper realm. Pure-hearted and noble, he believed even the darkest souls could be redeemed. He clothed Xie Xuan for the first time in human garments, taught her words, and guided her toward virtue. The first word she ever wrote was his name—Feng Xun. Yet, what he thought was redemption became deception. Xie Xuan learned not purity, but pretense. Behind her gentle smile, she hid the cunning of a serpent. One day, dressed clumsily in rouge and pearls, she tried to trick Feng Xun into setting her free. He looked at her for a long time, eyes soft beneath the ghost mask. “Is that it?” he asked—then kissed her brow and whispered, “I’ve taken the bait.” Xie Xuan never understood what he meant—until much later. Back in the mortal world, she fulfilled her vengeance. She burned kingdoms, spilled royal blood, and drove her dagger into the Crown Prince’s chest—only to see Feng Xun’s face emerge from the dying man’s features. As his lifeless heart bled in her hands, she finally understood the cruelest truth of the gods— A god can only be slain by the one he loves. Years later, Xie Xuan rose again—not as a ghost, but as the ruler of the underworld. She conquered the heavens, captured the God King who bore Feng Xun’s face, and claimed him as her prisoner. In the end, the sinner became the savior, the hunted became the hunter. And love, in its most twisted form, conquered both heaven and hell.

summary: Living deep in the wilderness, a mysterious old Taoist cultivator has nurtured six exceptionally beautiful female disciples who are enough to shake the entire nation. Today, another youngest male disciple, Chu Feng, successfully emerges from seclusion. Chu Feng: "I'm the least talented disciple trained by Lao Bi Deng. I don't have much ability, I just want to enjoy a peaceful life..."
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance

title: Married For Four Years Without Meeting, The Officer Husband Has Returned.
summary: Also Known As: "Before Losing My Purity, I Rewrote the Life of the Cannon Fodder Ex-Wife" (Set in a past era + Military Marriage + Face-slapping + No Cheats + Sweet Romance + Mutual Purity) Xia Qingning accidentally transmigrates into an era novel written by a jealous classmate, becoming the male protagonist's ill-fated ex-wife. In the original story, this character was tricked into losing her purity, gave birth to a mentally disabled child, was divorced by her military officer husband, and ultimately drowned in despair. When she opens her eyes, she's in the very scene of losing her purity! According to the plot, she would soon give birth to the child, face divorce, and watch the female protagonist rise to prominence. To preserve her dignity and avoid the storyline, Xia Qingning decisively chooses to jump into the river to save herself—only to be rescued in the next moment. Huh? This tall, broad-shouldered, narrow-waisted, long-legged man with eight-pack abs and a height of 1.9 meters—isn't he... Her military officer husband, the one who hasn’t returned home in four years? Four years ago, Xia Qingning, a plain and unremarkable rural fiancée arranged by her brother, ended up in the same bed with Lu Jingzhe after he got drunk, forcing him to marry her. Four years later, while returning home on leave, Lu Jingzhe rescues a drowning beauty, only to discover that the beauty is none other than his wife. Lu Jingzhe: How did my wife become so beautiful? So irresistible? After spending a month together, Lu Jingzhe finds himself utterly smitten and takes her with him to live on the military base. Rumors in the Unit: Lu Jingzhe's wife is a plain, unsophisticated rural woman who used underhanded tactics to marry him. When news of her joining the military base spreads, everyone waits to mock her. But who can explain this skilled seamstress, talented artist, and brilliant writer who amazes the world? Which part of her looks like an unsophisticated bumpkin?

title: The Pampered Daughter Stops Pretending and Tackles the Ice Mountain Commander
summary: To climb the social ladder, her half-sister conspired with her s*umbag fiancé to drug Fu Junyao, attempting to ruin her reputation. In this critical moment, Fu Junyao seized the opportunity and slept with the commander she had been longing for. Unexpectedly, this commander acted swiftly and decisively; that very day, he carried a bundle of thorns to apologize, petitioned for a marriage decree, and presented betrothal gifts the whole process was completed with such speed that she was stunned. Fu Junyao secretly pondered that the commander was always upright and must be marrying her out of a sense of responsibility. To warm this “ice block” of a heart, she employed all thirty-six stratagems to win him over, using a variety of methods to seduce him. She dressed up for him, sneaking into his study at night: “Brother Lang, are the official documents as beautiful as I am? Look at me, aren’t I good?” She washed her hands and cooked for him: “Brother Lang, this is lotus seed soup I made myself, isn’t it sweet? Is it as sweet as I am?” Little did she know, he was restraining himself, afraid that he would turn into a wolf and scare her to tears. *The half-sister who finally married up, whose married life was chaotic and whose s*umbag husband was in a mess. With red eyes, he looked at her: “Yaoyao, you should be my wife.” Fu Junyao held the baby and chuckled: “Excuse me, who are you?”

title: Genius Developer Becomes a Tycoon
summary: With my regression, I have become a genius intern. It feels like being a max level character wandering around a beginner’s zone. With this regression, I aspire to become a tycoon.

title: Greed Maiden
summary: During filming, the female lead intentionally shattered my Jadeite Earring, the one that never left my side. My face turned deathly pale as I gasped. My Best Actor boyfriend, however, urged me to be magnanimous. But no one saw the Companion Greed Maiden, sealed for five years, whispering in my ear: “Whose fortune shall we take first?”

title: Villain Becomes Stronger By Doting On His Wife
summary: Transmigrating into a cool novel, he unexpectedly became cannon fodder overnight. His wife was about to be snatched, his legs were about to be crippled. Fortunately, he awakened the villain system! Spoiling his wife makes him stronger. As long as he spoiled her, he would get all sorts of cool skills. [Congratulations to the host for winning a billion cash reward!] [Congratulations to the host for acquiring the Stock God skill!] [Congratulations to the host for obtaining three Life Extension Pills!] … Originally, he just wanted to survive under the protagonist’s strong aura, but accidentally ended up with the beauty in my arms, and even turned his wife into the richest woman. From then on, he trampled upon the mortal domain and shattered the Ancient God Realm with his blade… A generation's Martial God rises. Wherever the blade points, none can stand in his way. Gods in his path? He slays gods! Demons blocking his way? He cuts down demons!
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Psychological, Tragedy, Xuanhuan

title: Outright Favoritism
summary: The engagement of the most adored daughter of the Li Family was broken off. Her furious family members railed against the heartless man and vowed to make him pay the price. * Later on, Li Qiao met her ex-fiancé’s big brother by chance. Some said he was the most mysterious man in Nanyang and his name was Shang Yu, aka Shang Shaoyan. While some others called him the overbearing and obsessive underground Overlord of Nanyang from whom everyone should stay away. Standing in the misty rain, Li Qiao gazed at the ruthless and untamed man with a shallow smile, said, “Hello, I’m Li Qiao.” She would become her ex-fiancé’s sister-in-law, if not wife. * Li Qiao and her ex-fiancé met again on the street several months later when he sneered at her, “Are you following me? Haven’t you given up hope yet?” A harsh voice berated him from behind, “Show some respect to your sister-in-law!” From now on, only one rumor was circulating in Nanyang City – The merciless Overlord of Nanyang had one woman he uncritically doted on. Her name was Li Qiao.

title: After Rebirth, I Became the Villainous Black Moonlight
summary: At the age of twelve, Meng Qianqian married into the Lu family to bring auspicious fortune to the ailing matriarch. On her wedding night, urgent news arrived from the border—her husband was dispatched by imperial decree to the front lines. Half a year later, he tragically fell under the blades of the Northern Liang army. Meng Qianqian became a widow before her marriage was even consummated. Five years later, the husband who was believed to have died in battle returned, accompanied by an ethereal mute girl. Lu Lingxiao said, Wan’er was the descendant of loyal martyrs, unlike a merchant’s daughter like her, steeped in the stench of money—Wan’er was a woman of true integrity and noble character. Lu Lingxiao also said that Wan’er was an eagle soaring in the sky, while she, a delicate flower, could not compare to Wan’er in the slightest. It was only when the nation crumbled and the city walls collapsed, and she charged through thousands of troops with a red-tasseled spear in hand, that Lu Lingxiao realized he had misjudged her. She was no delicate flower confined to the inner chambers—she was the fiercest western wind at the Jade Gate Pass.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance

title: Ore no Imouto to Railgun Collaboration Project!
summary: The Ore no Imouto to Railgun Collaboration Project! is a crossover fiction web series penned by Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai author Fushimi Tsukasa and Toaru Majutsu no Index author Kamachi Kazuma. One day Kirino is offered the job of having a live talk over Niconico Live with Mikoto Misaka a Level 5 esper from Academy City. "Maybe she'll introduce me to her little sisters if we get along.. ehehehe," so saying, she immediately accepts the job and visits the Niconico main office with Kyousuke but...!?

title: Becoming The Food God In This Cultivation World

title: The Palace Maid is Socially Dead Every Day
summary: 【Inner Thoughts + System + Fire Pit + Disguises】 As the cannon fodder bug of this story, Zhou Shengsheng originally thought that as long as she maintained the plot well, she could be reborn perfectly. But these three men are one stranger than the next. When she was a palace maid, they treated her as a plaything. She thought she could use her new disguise to get back at them for the grievances she had suffered. But their attitudes left her completely puzzled. The sick twisted villain said to her: "I am willing to offer the head of my country's emperor as a betrothal gift to marry the princess." The tyrant male lead, his eyes red, bared his chest to her: "This life, I return to you." The scheming male second lead pinned her against the wall: "Kiss me, and I'll give you my life." Zhou Shengsheng: .....Want some Liu Liu Mei (a popular Chinese candy) instead?

title: Desire Fairytales: Starting with Cinderella the Black-Stockinged Maid
summary: Jiang Yu transmigrates into a fairy tale world— But this isn't the wholesome, bedtime-story version you're used to. This is an adult, magical fantasy realm. All the classic fairy tale characters—princesses, maids, elves— They’ve all grown up… And undergone some very unexpected changes. Cinderella’s demon-tainted body has shocking effects. Little Red Riding Hood can now transform—with red eyes and demonic claws! Alice’s Dream Realm is… not the kind of dreamland you'd show kids. In this strange and twisted world, Jiang Yu awakens a Demon-Purging System. Holy Spear in hand, he's ready to shake the very foundations of these fairy tales. Cinderella: “Master… does this make you feel good?” Little Red Riding Hood: “Lord Jiang Yu, will this really drive out the demons?” Alice: “Huh? This isn’t a dream? It feels… way too real!” Snow White: “Jiang Yu… are we doing this outside this time?”
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Romance, Supernatural

title: My Wife Is the Martial Alliance Head
summary: Who says I am a worthless student, the pretty Alliance Leader is within my grasp. Who says I am a single man, a harem of huge numbers waits upon me. Watch how the strongest senior high school student in history, Li Fan, turns over the city upside down, becoming a hero unparalleled under the heavens! genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, School Life, Xuanhuan

title: She Suffered Enough In Her Past Life, This Young Lady Would Rather Die Than Marry Again
summary: Ye Wanshu, the daughter of a merchant from the small county of Tongyang, unexpectedly caught the attention of two brothers from the prestigious Duke Rong’s household. The elder was refined and gentle, the younger dashing and spirited, both godlike in appearance. No matter whom she married, Ye Wanshu felt it would be a blessing from the heavens. But at her coming-of-age banquet, the two brothers, who had once doted on her deeply, suddenly turned on her, publicly fighting over a courtesan instead. Ye Wanshu became the laughingstock of society, endured endless suffering, and ultimately died of heartbreak. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself back on the eve of that fateful banquet. Determined not to repeat her tragic fate, Ye Wanshu resolved to stay far away from the heartless brothers. Yet the two men didn’t take her change seriously, believing she'd come back once she suffered enough. Three years later, when they finally realized Ye Wanshu would never return, the only news they received was—she was about to get married. At the wedding feast, the two uninvited guests faced each other, and in unison, dropped to their knees, begging her to take them back.

title: One Piece – I Am Great Director
summary: In his journey through time, Li Fan unlocked the [Great Director System] , allowing him to earn rewards by bringing the scripts it provided to life. Thus, beginning with the direction of the Holy Grail War, Li Fan ascended in strength step by step. Gradually, he evolved into a peerless individual, a formidable figure in both power and entertainment, within this world of pirates. But when the Celestial Dragons demanded a movie exclusively for them, Li Fan’s response was clear: “Dream on!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Supernatural

title: The Assassin Hunter Stops Time
summary: The Unofficial Strongest Assassin Hunter, Ha Dojin, returns to the past from the claws of death.

title: Oh, I Have Never Abandoned That Tyrant
summary: Possessing a maid was not enough, but even a second possession as a princess! At first, I possessed the evil maid ‘Lari’, destined to die at the hands of the male lead ‘Thierry’. In order to avoid my death, I took great care of the male lead and thought that I had made him a pure child. Until one day, without knowing why, I died. *** “The princess woke up!” But when I opened my eyes, 7 years have passed. I’m even a princess? “This is my last offer. I will treasure the princess.” The bigger problem was that Thierry, who had grown up in the meantime, came in and offered to take me to his own country. No matter what misunderstanding there was, I didn’t want to reveal to Thierry that I was “Lari.” But what’s wrong with him? *** “…Are you afraid of me?” I stared at him with a blank expression on my face. The red eyes facing me shook, and he lowered them as if avoiding my gaze. “I won’t do anything you don’t like. If there’s anything you want, I’ll do it.” He continued his words nervously as if he was wary of me, and I looked at him, stunned even more. “Then…can you look at me?”

title: Rebirth: Refusing to Be a Arse-Kisser, the Campus Belle Is Anxious
summary: "I don't like you... I refuse!" Jiang Che's confession failed, he didn't get into university, his life took a downturn... An accident allowed him to be reborn back to the eve of his high school entrance exam at the age of eighteen. Standing at the crossroads of fate once again. This time, Jiang Che chose not to be a such kiss arse anymore. But after Jiang Che left, Su Rongyin, the school beauty who rejected his confession, chased after him. "Jiang Che, why are you ignoring me?" "Jiang Che, can we still be friends?" "Jiang Che, I was wrong, I actually like you, I accept your confession..."

title: Contract Marriage: The President’s Stand-in Lover
summary: To save her family’s crumbling business, Vivian Lin is forced into a three-year marriage contract with Ethan Gu, a powerful and calculating business magnate. It’s a cold-blooded deal she gets the funds to rescue her father’s company, and he gains the perfect façade to ease his ailing grandfather’s mind. At the start, their boundaries are crystal clear: he’s distant, composed, and never forgets to remind her, “Don’t cross the line.” She, in turn, plays the role of the dutiful wife to perfection polite smiles, poised gestures, and a heart carefully hidden behind restraint. But as they stand hand in hand at countless public events, their rehearsed affection begins to feel dangerously real. A mysterious woman surfaces during their Paris honeymoon. An unexpected encounter with her ex-boyfriend at a charity gala reignites old memories. And beneath their elegant pretenses, something fragile and genuine begins to bloom. Then one night, Vivian stumbles upon a photograph in Ethan’s study a woman who looks eerily like her. In that moment, she realizes she might have only ever been someone’s replacement. Yet what she doesn’t know is that Ethan’s heart has already betrayed the deal somewhere between their practiced smiles and stolen glances, he fell for her. This is a story of a marriage born from transaction, tested by truth, and transformed by love. When the contract expires and the secret of the “substitute” comes to light will they walk away from each other, or finally face the love that was never part of the plan?

title: The Matriarch Reborn to Slack Off: The Hypocritically Aloof Family Panics
summary: Because she could not conceive, Song Yao felt she had failed her husband’s family. She exhausted her dowry, wore her body to the bone, and risked her life for the entire family, single-handedly turning the declining Marquis Manor into a clan of great renown. And what did she receive in the end? The whole family cursed her for being wicked! The three ungrateful children she had adopted were each more "aloof" than the last. The eldest son loathed the imperial examinations and felt no desire for glory, caring only for his flowers and plants. The second son despised his future prospects and refused to manage worldly affairs, wishing only for the company of the martial world. The youngest daughter refused to marry into a high-ranking family, wanting only to find a common farmer, uncaring even if she would have to face the elements and eat meager scraps in the future. The mother-in-law’s title of Lady of Imperial Mandate was earned for her by her daughter-in-law, yet she claimed that Song Yao’s pursuit of fame and profit was ultimately hollow vanity. She complained that as the mistress of the Marquis Manor, Song Yao was always too competitive and aggressive, which she deemed beneath the dignity of her position. The husband ate well and dressed well, yet he had the audacity to say he was born with no love for luxury and that three simple meals a day were enough. He claimed this life of comfort was not what he wanted. Her sister-in-law, Chunlan Xiu, finally revealed a secret to her: "Sister-in-law, your inability to conceive is because Mother fed you Sterility Potion; it wasn't something you were born with!" Overcome with a surge of fury upon learning the truth, Song Yao was literally provoked to death. When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to five years ago—the very day a matchmaker arrived at the door to propose a marriage for the young miss of the Marquis Manor. The adopted daughter doesn't want to marry into a high-status family? Fine, the marriage is off; consider your wish granted! In this life, Song Yao decided to abandon her "savior complex" and respect the fate of these ungrateful wretches. Indifferent to fame and wealth? Uninterested in riches? Viewing money as dirt? Fine, I will fulfill all your wishes! When Song Yao stopped striving for them and instead granted the family’s desires, the entire family was the one to grow anxious...

title: Past Memories of Living with the Goddess: I Think I’ve Seen You Somewhere Before
summary: "Li Huangxuan is a recent college graduate working a tiring 9-to-5 job, yet he remains penniless. Like many young people just starting out, he feels lost and uncertain about the future. He longs for a deep, unforgettable romance and harbors a secret crush on his colleague Xu Wanqing—but his shyness keeps him from getting close. Everything changes one day when his roommate moves out and a stunning 'goddess' named Lin Ximeng moves in next door, turning his life completely upside down..."
genres: Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Moonlit Prisoner of the Gilded Cage
summary: A single act of kindness in a snow-choked capital change everything. Lu Xuejin spots a bloodied youth kneeling through a brutal punishment a disgraced crown prince named Murong Yue, clinging to life under the new emperor’s fragile mercy. Shielding him from the storm with an umbrella and a handkerchief, Lu Xuejin plants the seed of an all-consuming devotion. Murong Yue haunts his every step after that: crimson plums plucked from the hunting grounds at dawn, dew-kissed tea gathered before first light, clandestine letters smuggled through the palace’s labyrinthine gates. But when servants reveal Lu Xuejin as the emperor’s “Lord Consort” the man Murong Yue must call by title while bowing to his blood enemy “foster father” the boy’s fragile world crumbles. A fallen plum blossom marks the end; he lingers at the palace doors one last time and vanishes into shadow. For Murong Yue, love festers into obsession amid relentless torment. He endures daily humiliations at his enemies’ feet, haunted by the consort’s stifled cries from behind gilded doors—sounds that unleash the beast within, shredding Lu Xuejin to pieces in his fevered mind. Lu’s rare smiles become his lifeline through years of pain. At last, iron hoofed cavalry shatters the throne room. Murong Yue claims his vengeance, severing his foster father’s head with his own blade. Then, tenderly, he unlocks the chains around Lu Xuejin’s throat. If the palace dares to cage his beloved, he’ll break every link and offer the empire on bended knee power absolute, for Lu Xuejin alone to wield.

title: Apocalypse Tyrant
summary: How to reign as a king, not just like a king, in a sudden zombie apocalypse.

title: Surviving as a Warrior in a Broken Game
summary: A seasoned player fell into the game. The only thing he can trust is the warrior character he created himself.

title: Thus Began Your Regret
summary: You've made me a sinner, do you realize that? We thought our love was certain. I still love you, but if our marriage is bound by guilt and debt, "Let's part ways." If being together means living in misery, I choose to set you free for a happier ending. "Louisa... let me think about it." Edward is taken aback by the unexpected divorce proposal. During his relentless pursuit to give Louisa a life of brilliance, he realizes she withered away, waiting for him. "I'll give you my research, my company, everything. All I have. Just stay, please." Edward's desperate plea ripples across Louisa's stoic face. "Just sit back and command me. I'll bring the world to your feet." Edward has always lived desperately and now is no different. He must hold onto his wife, for without her, his life has no meaning. Truly, he would give up everything.

title: Farm Space: The Lucky Wife Who Brings Prosperity to Her Family
summary: Rumor has it that Xu Village has produced a "Little Jinx," and a young girl at that. As luck would have it, Xu Jianing—a woman who traveled through time—is that very unlucky soul! At age 3: Her father broke his leg and became lame. At age 6: Her mother fell gravely ill and went blind. At age 9: Her eldest sister’s engagement was called off, and she lost her mind. At age 12: Jianing herself was knocked down and fell unconscious. Everyone was waiting for the punchline, expecting the Xu family to produce yet another "little fool." Little did they know that after a few months out of sight, the Xu family’s Little Jinx had completely changed. With just a casual search on the mountain, she finds thousand-year-old ginseng. With a simple dip in the water, she scoops up hundred-year-old pearls. With a bit of light planting in the fields, she grows ten-year-old trees overnight. ...and so it goes. Xu Jianing’s life is now operating on a "cheat code." Her father is no longer lame, her mother’s sight is restored, her sister has become sharp-witted, and the Little Jinx has transformed into a Little Lucky Girl. Originally, she just wanted to rely on the adorable beast in her magical space to appraise treasures, make some money, buy some farmland, and perhaps open a shop. She even "bought" a cute, puppy-like boy to be her younger brother. Who would have guessed that the "little puppy" would turn out to be a "big wolf" with a mysterious and complex background? Now he’s got his sights set on Xu Jianing, and her simple farming life has turned into a battle of high-society intrigue. To give in, or not to give in? That is the question.

title: After Transmigrating into a Book! I Empty My House and Went to the Countryside as an Educated Youth
summary: In a fictional era, Ye Nan Yi, a modern orphan, unexpectedly obtained a spatial dimension at the age of 12. However, due to the prevalence of surveillance in the future, the space's utility was limited. Since acquiring the dimension, Ye Nan Yi has been plagued by recurring dreams. The girl in her dreams bears a striking resemblance to her, but unlike Ye Nan Yi, despite being an orphan, she has never experienced harm. The dream girl's life took a drastic turn for the worse after losing her father at the age of 5. Her biological mother remarried her first love, and immediately...
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: The Lady’s Secretary
summary: “If Noel kisses me, he can become an adult for a day.” Secretary Noel’s growth period had stopped with having a young boy’s appearance. Only Erina’s kiss can make him an adult. “I am a successor unable to speak to others. Unfortunately I’m not joking.” Erina is the only child of a head merchant, but her voice does not come out in front of people. Since childhood, only Noel could hear her voice. Getting in between them, another being appears, able to hear Erina’s voice. – I thought we were the only ones for each other. Unknown feelings rise within Noel’s heart. However, Erina is an impossible match for Noel as he's a secretary of unknown origin. Erina is on a journey to become the head merchant. At the end of this journey, can the two be the only ones for each other again?

title: Love Glasses ~When I Broke up With My Girlfriend Who Has Zero Liking for Me, the Madonnas at School Started Approaching Me~
summary: I have a secret that I can’t tell anyone. It all started on the first day of school in my second year of high school. Thanks to a mysterious pair of glasses I got by chance, I was able to see the “likability” of the person I was talking to. If it’s just an acquaintance, it’s around 40. If it is a friend, a number of about 60 appears on my forehead. If it is a girlfriend, I would like to say it is more than that, but the likability of my girlfriend, who I am proud of and called one of the three most beautiful women in the world, is... 0 I was in disbelief at the number. I followed her, feeling disbelief at the number. Then, I witnessed her having an affair with another man. I said goodbye to her and tried to go back to being a normal, shady boy, but I noticed that the girls around me were having an abnormally high score. The other two of the three most beautiful girls on campus. The numbers of my friend’s sister were showing 100 at every turn. And for some reason, the number of my ex-girlfriend, whom I was supposed to have broken up with, kept going up. How does the main character end up with such strange glasses and being pushed around by all these pretty girls? …… If you read this book, you will definitely want a pair of glasses, and you will be captivated by them too.
genres: Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Farmer’s Substitute Bride: The Manor Lady’s Rise to Power
summary: To repay a favor, a simple farm girl goes against her heart and marries a wealthy young man from a manor in someone else’s place. Unexpectedly, she finds herself caught in a series of accidents as a hidden conspiracy within the manor begins to unfold. Though she is a defenseless woman, she must shoulder heavy responsibilities. Along the way, she experiences struggles of life and death, love and hate, with the male lead. In the uncertain depths of fate, they gradually learn to understand, love, and protect each other. Together, they use wisdom and kindness to uncover and resolve the conspiracy lurking in the manor, and eventually achieve success on their path of building a new life. But amid love, friendship, and family ties — what heart-stirring stories will unfold?

title: The Wolfdog Always Plots Against His Owner
summary: Сhen Нanshеng has bеen sесretlу in lоve with Shеn Сuo fоr threе wholе yeаrs. Who is Shеn Сuо? Even so, the spirits continued to regard Atrana as their sacred land, serving under the king as they always had. Yet, for some mysterious reason, no one had seen the Fire Spirit since that time.Each of the Spirit Kings became the focus of immense devotion, and Atrana prospered as a spiritual nation, its divine protection so great that even neighboring countries hesitated to attack. I will quit my professorship and go to the Magic Tower!” For some unknown reason, Eugene returns to the past—ten years ago. But somehow, contrary to expectations… quitting the professorship proves to be a difficult task?! And then— “You must have had fun while I was away, Eugene Levin.” “You, you…! The Eldest Princess acquired a forbidden martial arts technique and was banished to the Purgatory. However, no one was powerful enough to restrain her. All the dungeon guards were defeated. Xiao Ran stepped up and declared, “Your Highness, it's better for you to behave yourself on my territory” and effortlessly subdued the Eldest Princess.

title: Tragic Death on the Wedding Night: Reborn in the ’80s to a Family in Ruins
summary: \[Era + Rebirth + Slapping s*umbags + Everyone Pays + Rough Man & Three Babies + Sweet Love] In her previous life, Yan Qingqing’s reputation was ruined, and she died with no body left to bury! By night, he coaxed her softly. Even with three babies in her belly, he’d pitifully beg her, *“Don’t leave me!”* Yan Qingqing didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. summary: Your Highness, why are you here? Liberata Bernadette, possessed as the villain of the novel ‘Leonie in the Blues’. The evil woman’s possession is not enough, so she even returns when she dies. The Cold Saintess? Kill! The Seductive Enchantress? Kill! The Alluring Empress? Kill! Glamorous Demon Queen, Enchanting Beauty, Peerless Female Immortal, Widow of an Ancient Kingdom? One word: Kill! But to his surprise, the heroines he killed have also reincarnated. And now, each heroine is terrified of him, clinging to him for survival. title: The Undead Great Sage Becomes the Elves’ Guardian!
summary: Mozef was once known as the "Great Sage" and was known throughout a certain continent. However, he, too, is unable to conquer old age and lives out his natural life of a hundred years and a few decades, with the frontier lands as his final resting place. Then Mozef found that his body had turned to nothing but bones. Mozef, who had mastered magic, had unexpectedly become a Lich, the highest form of the undead. After becoming a Lich, Mozef had nothing to fear from aging, his body became lighter and he was enjoying all the good things that come with it. However, Mozef, who thought he had reached the end of his natural life, had nothing to do. As he decided to live in a remote area to pass the time, a silver-haired young elf began to appear here and there. Although she was wary at first, she soon warmed to Mozsef's gentle nature. The elf lives alone with her sister in this remote area, and the sister is determined to become an adventurer to give her sister a better life. It was Elysia, an elf girl whom Mozef had once saved. Mozef, who had nothing better to do, becomes their guardian and begins a new life as the Great Sage-turned-Lich. “Ho-ho, though I would already be dead.”
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: Instead of Competing Through Your Child, Compete With Yourself
summary: Xu Huiqing gave up her career after graduating university to take care of her children. She devoted herself to supporting her husband and pushing her kids to excel. Her husband finally achieved great success, and both their son and daughter entered top universities. She thought life had reached perfection, but her daughter was emotionally manipulated, heartbroken, and tragically took her own life. Before Xu Huiqing could recover, she faced a midlife marriage crisis. Even her son, whom she worked hard to raise, echoed his father’s criticism: "You’ve spent your whole life revolving around your husband and children. Look at yourself — do you even live for yourself? What do you have to compare with others?" She believed her family was harmonious, but her life felt like a cruel joke. *** After being reborn, her daughter was just entering kindergarten, her son was newly born, and she had lost her job due to one extra child. Suddenly, Xu Huiqing stopped caring about anything. Life is short; she only wanted to live well for herself once. To hell with hoping her husband, son, or daughter would become great! She only wished to rise with the wind and soar ninety thousand miles high. Instead of pushing the kids, push yourself. Midlife crisis? Switch “puppy dog” boyfriends often—no crisis! Women should quit jobs and stay home? If you want, you do it. The family’s old workhorse woke up—no more sacrifice. Her husband said: "If you don’t want this life, leave!" Xu Huiqing smiled: "Leave!" Divorce wasn’t the sky falling; enduring was the true torment.
