The tsundere and formidable Mikoto Misaka, the Railgun! …The genius magus and Red Devil, Rin Tohsaka! …The progenitor vampire and Dark Evangel, Evangeline! …The ultimate lineage of the Seven Glittering Gems, Reverie! …The heavy cannons of the Blue Flame that incinerate the wicked world, Black Rock Shooter! …The immortal Witch of Fate, C.C.! …The Flaming-Haired Blazing-Eyed Hunter, Shana! …The world’s number one princess, Miku Hatsune! …The supreme commander of the Time-Space Administration, Hayate Yagami! …The Sky Queen who descended from above, Ikaros! …The perfectly elegant maid, Sakuya Izayoi (with the Scarlet Devil Mansion)! …The sinner of eternity and the instantaneous, Kaguya Houraisan (with Eientei)! …The shrine maiden of the Paradise of Paradox, Reimu Hakurei (with Gensokyo)… Of course, this is only the beginning!

title: Emperor of the Galaxy
summary: 1000 years later in the wide galaxy, amongst the four civilizations, the human race is currently in turmoil. In these conflicted times within the many stars, the heroes appear. Will these heroes change the galaxy with their hands? This is a tale about these heroes and the stars around them.

title: The Little Lady of Catalonia
summary: Anastasia, who has lived her entire life as a modest and exemplary princess. On her wedding day, she witnesses the shocking affair between her husband and a maid. Despite this, as a fallen princess, she pushes through with the marriage to support her impoverished family, and ends up living under the same roof with her husband, mother-in-law, and the maid. Just as she forces herself to accept her situation, she suddenly contracts an illness that shrinks her body to the size of a thumb. Struggling with this unpredictable shrinking illness, her married life becomes even more miserable. Then one day, three years later, her first love appears. “Milady really went and married a b*stard, huh.” Once a poor servant, he returns as a tycoon who surpasses even her husband…

title: The Dream’s Ripple in Deep Jade Sandalwood
summary: As the legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister, Ji Wanyuan was the apple of her father's eye. Possessing breathtaking beauty, she had been pampered since childhood, leading a life of indulgence that fostered a wilful and overbearing personality. She became infatuated with Wen Qiyan, the Capital’s most revered young master a man of noble elegance, cool and clear as the moon. She doggedly pursued him for years, even humbling herself simply to gain a favourable glance from him. Alas, he consistently paid her no mind, treating all her advances with utter indifference. That didn't matter to her. What Ji Wanyuan wanted, she always got. If the straightforward path was blocked, she’d take the crooked one; if soft persuasion failed, she’d resort to force. Ji Wanyuan arranged for the acquisition of the most potent aphrodisiac. At last, she got her wish, spending a passionate night with Wen Qiyan. In that moment of frenzied abandon, as her soul felt adrift, Ji Wanyuan bizarrely received knowledge: she was merely the foolish, vicious female supporting character in a published novel. Wen Qiyan’s true purpose in marrying her was to exploit their closeness, serving the Emperor’s order to eliminate the remnants of rebel factions. Her powerful father, the Prime Minister, was the primary target. In less than two years of marriage, the Ji family would collapse, and she herself would die from postpartum haemorrhage. By virtue of handling the Prime Minister’s case, Wen Qiyan would solidify his position before the Emperor, soaring to become a new, powerful political figure. The following year, he would welcome his 'white moonlight', her sworn rival into the household. The two would live harmoniously until old age, while her own son would be marginalised, neglected, and eventually die young! The moment she regained lucidity, Ji Wanyuan broke out in a cold sweat. Looking at the man’s cool, refined profile, her face was deathly pale, and her body felt as if she had been plunged into an ice cellar. “…” Wen Qiyan thoroughly loathed Ji Wanyuan. She was frivolous, ignorant, and utterly s*upid, good for nothing save that pretty face. He had been forced to marry this exceedingly reckless woman only to fulfil the Emperor's decree to gather evidence of the Ji family’s illegal dealings, uproot the Prime Minister’s faction in one move, and, incidentally, cover up the "life" (pregnancy) that resulted from their unfortunate mishap. He had braced himself for a miserable, chaotic, and agonising marriage of deep-seated resentment. Yet, unexpectedly, she completely shed her past hateful arrogance and tyranny. She became kind, understanding, and even restrained herself, avoiding conflict. Perhaps… It’s just another little trick she's playing to distract me, he sneered scornfully. But when his mother suggested bringing his cousin into the household, to take a concubine,e Wen Qiyan had mentally prepared for Ji Wanyuan to cry, rage, and throw a fit, perhaps even trying every dirty trick, as in the past, to stop him from taking a concubine. The one thing he never expected was for her to smile, nod, and agree. She actually… smiled and agreed?! Hearing this, Wen Qiyan was utterly stunned. He abruptly snapped the writing brush in his hand, his brow furrowing as his expression turned cold and dark.

title: The Villainous Noble Lady’s Happiness [ABO]
summary: The top villainess of the interstellar world, Pei Leng, has been infected with the latest cosmic brainwave virus. If she doesn’t obediently complete her so-called “supporting character” missions, she’ll only have three years left to live. Pei Leng blows a smoke ring: “Three years? Whatever. That’s plenty of time for me to splurge.” System: ??? And so, Pei Leng embarks on a daily life of mischief and extravagance. She maxes out her s*umbag dad’s credit card to buy planet after planet; keeps the legendary little heroine as a personal maid to do her laundry and cook; and brainwashes herself by watching channels of handsome alpha and beta women, all in an effort to cultivate her own alpha aura. Eventually, Pei Leng transforms into a soft and sweet omega and decides to spend a fortune on gender reassignment surgery. Just then, a strikingly familiar and beautiful young man shyly approaches, clutching the hem of his shirt. Radiating alpha energy, with a flat chest and undeniable presence, the “little heroine” corners her against the wall and says: “You promised to take care of me for life.”

title: Mai Kitsune Waifu

Because a female immortal sealed a mischievous and sly fox spirit into his right hand, ordinary senior high school student Liu Yi henceforth began his extraordinary journey as a immortal practitioner. title: The Capital’s One-Man Army Golem Master—Unexpectedly Banished!? ~Now That I’m Free, I’ll Create the Ultimate Golem Together With My Beautiful Hero Disciples. I Don’t Care Even if They Beg Me to Come Back~
summary: Once upon a time, a demon lord who tried to invade the world was defeated by the united efforts of a hero community. After surviving this unprecedented crisis, the world's largest empire—Diamante Kingdom—declared all commoners fired. In the office forced to handle torture-level workloads, a young man named Horace was also dismissed. But surprisingly, Horace wasn't upset at all. He was actually the greatest Golem Master in history—and calmly set off in search of rare metals in foreign lands. During his absence, an important ceremony was held... and a shocking truth came to light: Horace had been the *mentor* to the entire hero community. The big fish had escaped. Now, even the once-proud heroes returned to his side, mocking the stubborn kings who banished him. Crushed by debt and countless foolish mistakes, the kingdom began to collapse... while Horas and his allies marched toward happiness. As the kingdom faces its final days—what future awaits Horace and his companions? This is the story of how one underestimated man reclaims everything with power, wit, and his unbeatable golems.

title: Tale of the White Empire
summary: “When all colors are layered together, they become white. What I create is a ‘White Kingdom’ where all races come together.” In the Gr*pe Sea, where different races continue their conflicts, Toto Gattoland, the second prince of the Gattoland Kingdom ruled by the “Meow” tribe with cat ears, encounters Artemisia, a girl sent as a hostage by the antagonistic Black Rose Knights. Initially closed off, Artemisia gradually regains her smile through interactions with Toto and his companions. However, deep-seated discrimination exists between humans and Meow, and a cruel fate awaits Toto and Artemisia, who have started to harbor a faint love. A large army led by knights clad in armor, a fleet of sailboats filling the sea, eight swordsmen with the sacred beads of “Benevolence”, “Righteousness”, “Propriety”, “Wisdom”, “Loyalty”, “Trust”, “Filial Piety”, and “Sibling Harmony”. Mechanical soldiers roaring with the miasma engine, and a flying fleet in the 500-meter limited “Floating Zone” – Inumura Shoroku, the creator of the “A Certain Aeronaut” series and “Propeller Opera”, depicts a battlefield and love story like never seen before with overwhelming artistic prowess. “Whenever, wherever, even if everyone becomes an enemy, I will be your shield to protect you.” The unparalleled classic fantasy chronicle begins.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, Tragedy

title: My Romance Dating Simulator
summary: [Love Triangle + Chasing Husband to Crematorium + Simulator + No ab*se No Flattery] 【Dating Simulator! A blessing for those who struggle with love, a guidebook for dating novices. Quickly match with your dream goddess! Complete walkthroughs earn rewards, and perfect walkthroughs unlock limited achievements!】 Shen Yi, an ordinary office worker, accidentally downloads a mini-game called Dating Simulator. The mini-game is simple: randomly search for dating targets, simulate dates, and receive rewards upon successful confession. Rewards include but are not limited to money, attributes, and skills. The higher the evaluation, the better the rewards, with perfect ratings unlocking mysterious achievements. Shen Yi plans to use this mysterious mini-game to continuously pursue targets and improve himself, making his life better and better. ...... title: Isekai Demon Lord Summoning ~ The Case Where an Old Man Was Summoned as a Demon Lord Instead of a Hero!
summary: “Please, Demon Lord, save us!” In typical isekai summoning stories, it’s often a hero that gets summoned. But this time, the ones around aren’t humans—they’re all demons!? What are they going to do by summoning an old man like me? And to make things worse, the one who being summoned isn’t a demon but just an ordinary human! Once they find out, they start saying things like “Kill him!” or “Use him as a test subject!” as they please. Even an old man gets mad sometimes, you jerks (an old-fashioned expression)! I had no intention of helping the demons at all, but after various circumstances, I end up standing with the demons in a war against the humans…

title: Welcome to the Interdimensional Supermarket

The previous life was ordinary, framed by his fiancee, bullied by his rivals, faced with power, he could only lower his head, kneel in the dust, the mother’s disappearance, he was powerless, the father’s tragic, he was also powerless to change. But now, the immortal emperor has returned, and the pains he has encountered in the past have to be returned to the enemy hundreds of times and thousands of times, to make this world unfair and all to disappear. He wants to stand at the pinnacle of this world, to control the endless stars.

title: Profession, Merchant
summary: When the heroes announced the start of their journey to defeat the Demon Lord, it caused a great commotion. Amidst all this, a merchant tries to take advantage of the opportunity to make a profit. On the way to Andersen, a town where people, goods, and money gather, a female warrior arrives to save the merchant from a gang of thugs. Seeing this as a business opportunity, the merchant immediately begins negotiations with the warrior. He tries to sell her an expensive blue dragon sword. However, the female warrior has no money, and so she proposes to fight a duel with her own body on the line for the blue dragon sword. No way. There is no way that a weak merchant can win against a strong female warrior! However, the female warrior’s body is voluptuous and sensational. The warrior asks again, “Will you accept the duel?” Then the words spill as if it came from the merchant’s loins. “Alright. I’ll do it. Let’s duel!” And so begins the merchant’s journey, full of feminine woes, all to secure huge commissions! This is a full-length adventure fantasy story centered on a traveling merchant, with female warriors, priestesses, sometimes female students, Heroes and even Demon Lords joining the action!

title: God-Slaying Immortal Venerable
summary: Heaven is the father; Earth is the mother. Lang Tianya—a hot-blooded, goofy soul—gallops freely through a cultivation world where humans, demons, gods, ghosts, and devils are locked in eternal strife. Fearless of heaven and earth, he fears only the complexity of “emotion.” Having witnessed the world’s suffering and endured its tribulations, Lang Tianya eventually reaches the Peak Realm, becoming the Great Tree that supports the heavens and shields all living beings. Yet, despite protecting all under heaven, he remains helpless to guard the sliver of tenderness within his own heart. Across the world he wanders, seeking her return; As fate comes and goes, there is no path home.

title: Demon’s Diary

When the island sinks due to “mysterious” events, only a handful of people survive – those survivors are then pursued by the government. On the other hand at another place, two practitioners are worrying about what will happen to them because the young master that they were supposed to protect had died. Their young master just so happens to look nearly like our hero… What will happen? Where will Liu Ming ends up and what will he do?

title: Meddling with Me
summary: “Speak plainly if you want something. Don’t play coy, testing people with that feeble act of yours.” “Even if I told you what I wanted, you wouldn’t care to listen, would you?” Jinha, facing the woman before him, couldn’t help but recall the small, frail child she once was. Her skin was strikingly pale now, and her lips, a vivid red. The girl who once sobbed buckets, swearing she’d never live like her mother, That soft, tender child—she was no longer a child. Scenes he’d never noticed before began to unfold in his mind. The lush roses he’d seen only during summer vacations each year were now preparing to wither, their petals reduced to a scattered few. The scent of the once-humid breeze, the shift of seasons, and the girl from his memories, her face streaked with tears and snot— They had changed. Just as mountains and rivers transform over long years, everything has changed. And one truth, realized far too late, struck him: He, too, had become a fool, manipulated by the woman she had become.

title: Kissing My Student, It’s Over if We’re Caught
summary: I’m in a secret, bad romance with a love dependent student— 「Having a secret meeting with a student one is in charge of at school… Isn’t it exciting?」 The special relationship with Kirihara that no one can know about began when I took up my post at Mori Kawara High School as a teacher. At school, she’s the serious student council president who has earned a lot of trust from other teachers, but when it’s just the two of us, she becomes mischievous, clingy, and jealous. On weekends, I cook meals at her place, play games together, and pamper her as if we were lovers. Unable to reject her because she knows my weakness, and despite knowing it’s wrong, we continue to pile up secrets little by little every day… 「Sensei, my feelings of liking you have grown very strong.」 As Kirihara openly confronts me with her feelings, the emotions I’ve been holding back grow even stronger. Even though it would all be over if it were exposed, that sense of immorality ironically only accelerates things further—

title: Marrying to Support My Husband, For the Sake of Our Child
summary: "She's only been dead for three days, not even carried out of the house yet, and already someone comes to harm the child, thinking about the husband? How outrageous! What's bearable and what's not? I've taken over someone else's body and become someone else's mother, so at the very least, I should stand up for them, protect the child's rights, win back the child's father, witness the rightful wife come back to life, and firmly deal with the seductive mistress. What? I’m not qualified? I was brought into your home by three matchmakers and six betrothals, carried in by a grand procession with eight bearers, and worshipped at the ancestral shrine! Is it true or not? Is it true or not?" -- *Marrying the Husband for the Child*

title: Twilight Evening Star
summary: I transmigrated as the stepmother of the Capital-Circle Fozǐ. When he grows up, he becomes cold and indifferent, violent and wanton. He sends his father to a mental hospital, and sends me, his stepmother, to drink Meng Po Soup. He torments the good girl who loves him, both physically and emotionally. Only after the girl dies does he finally awaken, holding her bones as he leaps into the sea. The good news is, the Capital-Circle Fozǐ is still young, only seven years old. He hasn't yet become bipolar or obsessed with playing with prayer beads. The bad news is, I've been handed the role of the vicious stepmother, and it seems his father really is sick. I pinch the Capital-Circle Fozǐ's little face and say seriously: "Have you finished playing with the prayer beads? Ready to go out? You must finish these beads - I'm waiting to give them away." "In the future we'll be part of the Capital-Circle Fozǐ, so we mustn't smile or joke casually. I'll tell a joke now - you mustn't laugh."

title: The Real Daughter Dominates Everyone, Her Entire Family Regrets and Begs for Forgiveness
summary: [True or Fake Heir + The Female Lead's Outstanding Beauty + A Romance Variety Show's Shura Field + Live Broadcast + Exciting] Wen Lingyue, the true daughter of a wealthy family, has been found. She's spent her entire life fawning over her family, begging for their love. But until her death, her parents and brothers only see her as a beautiful, fragile adopted sister. After her rebirth, Wen Lingyue realizes she doesn't want any more of that bullsh*t family affection! She enters a dance competition, captivating the internet with her single dance. She appears on a romance variety show, captivating guests and driving directors crazy. She stars in a film, winning Best Actress. Just as she's exploding online, reaping the love and accolades, her once-proud family begins to regret their actions. Her s*umbag parents kneel down and cry, "Come back! You're our only daughter." Wen Lingyue: Get out! Belated love, I don't care anymore! * Romance variety show, horror segment. Other guests: terrified, screaming, curling up in a ball. Wen Lingyue expressionless: That's it? ? * Romance variety show, deserted island survival. Other guests: Starving and searching for supplies. Wen Lingyue: ...There's so much food everywhere, do we still need to find it? I don't know when the show's tone started to go off track. The director collapsed: This isn't a dating show, this is Wen Lingyue's solo show!

title: Villainess Brother Reincarnation
summary: What should I do about being reincarnated as a villainess girl's older brother? When I heard about my younger sister’s engagement to the prince, I remembered my previous life’s memories. Isn’t this world the otome game that my previous imouto liked!? Moreover, my current imouto, will be causing the destruction end of my family! This is the brother’s story of trying to prevent destruction flags.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: Go Wild In His Paranoid Mind
summary: That year, there was a disaster in Jiangcheng, and the boy who crawled out of the inferno stood in a dark corner, gazing at the world. He was cold, paranoid, and withdrawn—the most dangerous thing in the night. Time went back, and before that fierce young man could make a big mistake, a girl suddenly appeared in his life. She said she was homeless and wanted to stay by his side. She was very well-behaved and had a sweet smile. That day, when Gu Huaibi returned home, he saw his pants floating by the window and walked into the room with a gloomy expression. "Who allowed you to touch my things? Did you think I wouldn't dare beat you up?" Bianbian was doing her homework and said in a soft voice, "If you change your pants, you need to wash them." Since then, Gu Huaibi's life went from smoking, drinking, and fighting to sending her to school, scratching his ears while tutoring her, and... hiding his trousers. On the day she packed up to leave, Gu Huaibi rushed home under the rain and blocked the door, his eyes cold and gloomy. "You promised to accompany lǎo zi for a lifetime; now you want to run?" "I should go home now," Bianbian said uneasily. Gu Huaibi pressed the girl against the wall, pinched her chin, and looked at her soft lips. "I'm your home."

title: The Villainous Young Master is Focused on Hunting But Always Ends Up In a Chaotic Situation
summary: Who Says a Savior Must Be Upright and Honest? Fairy tales say that a savior should be upright, flawless, and radiant—if that were true, saviors would have all died long ago. … No one expected that the blue-haired father and brown-haired mother would give birth to a boy with black hair and black eyes, and an oriental appearance. The boy didn't practice swordsmanship, martial arts, or fit in; he only liked to look at the stars. The boys didn't like…

title: A Crane Cries in Huating
summary: A youthful beauty in exquisite brocade, Under a man who reigns over tens of thousands. A young man loses his backing, Brothers fight against each other, And a father and son that dread one another; The courtier betrays his ruler. Under such a rule, what branch can one even rely upon? Amidst the sorrow of parting, what feeling can thee even trust? Meeting you was not something I wished for. But now that we met, I plead you to lighten up thy lamp, Let its illuminating light, Light up this beautiful hell for me. Maybe then, I can climb Nanshan hand in hand with you in the late spring. Let us witness the meadow, on which the orioles fly, and hear the cries of cranes, Watching them leap over the lake like broken shards of glass, Flapping their wings Before journeying to the clear open Blue sky. In the autumn of the first year of Jingning, Gu A-Bao, a washermaid of the laundry house in the crown prince’s residence had finally succeeded in getting the attention of Crown Prince Xiao Dingquan after months of planning and patiently waiting. After many struggles, at last, the crown prince opened up to A-Bao. The two promised each other to go to Nanshan in late spring and listen to the cranes together. However, soon, a rather unfathomable, and shrewd, Prince of Zhao suddenly emerged in politics. Using Xu Changping’s past, the Prince of Zhao aims to bring down the crown prince who was plotting to usurp the throne. With the intention to help the crown prince, the Prince of Zhao was reported with a false letter by A-Bao at the very last moment. As the end approaches, the two are yet again confronted with a choice. Will they be together? Or perhaps…

title: Rebirth: The Death God’s Eyes Made My Whole Family Weep
summary: [70s Era + Possessive Tycoon + Villainous Heroine + Revenge + Surrounded by Villains with a Few Good People] Shen Tang was reborn. In her previous life, she was betrayed by her own family—forced to take the place of her delicate, “pure” cousin and sent to the countryside for five long years. When she finally returned, her money was stolen, her job taken, and she was pushed into marrying an abusive man. On her wedding night, her so-called loved one stabbed her through the heart. This time, given another chance at life, she smiles coldly as she cuts ties with her family and changes her fate. She cripples her elder brother and ruins his career, exposes her parents’ scandals, and sends her cousin back to the countryside where she belongs. Piece by piece, she tears them apart—husbands and wives separated, parents and children turned against each other, until in the end the whole family is left destitute: some dead, some insane. Everyone says Shen Tang has gone mad…
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Born as a Soccer Prodigy
summary: A life reborn, now pressed with talent!
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Slice of Life, Sports

title: Shoushimin Series
summary: Kobato-kun and Osanai-san are in their first year of high school. Even though they aren't lovers nor dependent on each other, the two of them have a peculiar, mutually-beneficial relationship. Today, like every other day, they only wish to be modest, upstanding lower-middle class citizens, or as they call it, petit bourgeois. And yet, they constantly find themselves face-to-face with strange mysteries around every corner. Although he doesn't want to stand out like some sort of genius detective, Kobato-kun somehow always ends up finding himself trapped in situations that force him to unravel these mysteries anyways. Will he ever be able to achieve shining, petite bourgeoisie normalcy? The Shoushimin Series (小市民シリーズ), or The Petit Bourgeois Series, is a novel series written by Honobu Yonezawa (米澤穂信), author of Hyouka (Classics Club Series). Each volume is fundamentally a novel-ified compilation of various short stories—a majority of them appearing in the monthly publication Mysteries! (ミステリーズ！)—following the two Shoushimin Series protagonists and their various misadventures. There are currently four volumes. There are also currently two completed manga mini-series covering the first two novels. The first one was written by the same author and illustrated by Anko Manjuuya, and the second one was arranged by Fuua Yamasaki and illustrated by Omiomi. Both were serialized in Square Enix’s monthly GFantasy publication.
genres: Mystery, Psychological, School Life, Slice of Life

title: DOWL Masters
summary: The series takes place in the year 2400, where the world is controlled by the "Solar System Alliance." The reason the Alliance was able to take control is because they wield mobile weapons. Those humanoid weapons use "Cyclonics" electric chips that convert the superpowers and wisdom bequeathed to mankind into interference power. These humanoid weapons which amplify their pilot's psychic powers are called "Titanic DOWLs," or just "DOWLs" (Defender Operated by Wired Linkage). DOWLs do not lose to other weapons, and are part of the Solar System Alliance's unit, "Sophia," who keep the world under the Alliance's thumb. However, this will soon change when two DOWL Masters—Aoi Saotome and Reine Ward Takajou—have a fateful meeting at a high school in an aerial city.

title: Why Am I the Love Interest?!
summary: "Illegitimate-Blood Princess × Scheming Vengeful Prince" Princess Yu Yaoying of Great Yu was once the emperor's favorite—yet she kept dying by his order, each time poisoned under royal decree. After two lifetimes, she finally learns the truth: her mother was accused of disgrace, and Yaoying herself is deemed of impure royal blood. Years of carefree life shattered overnight. Branded as illegitimate, she gives up fighting: “Fine, let this crazy world burn.” But fate has other plans. She reincarnates again. Each time she nears death, a masked man in white appears to save her—but she can’t recall ever knowing him. Who is he? Who framed her and her mother? If heaven won’t let her die, then she’ll uncover the truth herself. One day, she meets the mysterious man: Jiang Lin, the rumored disfigured, unloved illegitimate son of the Marquis of Xunbei. Grabbing his sleeve with tear-filled eyes, she asks, “Do you… know me?” He avoids her gaze. “You... are?” Yaoying rolls her eyes. Seriously? Then why keep saving me? Are you insane?

title: Midsummer
summary: Sheng Xia is a relatively unknown live streamer. Her streams lack specific content; she simply goes live at a fixed time every day using the computer's built-in camera to live stream herself diligently studying. However, she suddenly disappears for more than a month, and the barrage of comments from viewers who used to study along with her every day at the scheduled times increased. "Nothing serious, just went to the hospital for a minor surgery." The computer's built-in camera doesn’t have a beautification function, and the clarity is also average, showing that Sheng Xia looks somewhat thinner. "The doctor?" After reading an online lesson, Sheng Xia put down her pen, "Quite handsome." Indeed, he was really handsome, looking like he walked out of a movie in his white coat. "How is that possible?" The barrages increased, and Sheng Xia laughed, "It’s impossible for doctors and patients to be together." "Once you’re discharged from the hospital, you’re not a patient anymore..." Sheng Xia squinted her eyes as she read the barrages, tilting her head. "True." Sheng Xia nodded, half-jokingly, "How about I try chase him?" Several "hahahaha" barrages scrolled through. Cheng Liang slurped his noodles in the hospital cafeteria and clicked on the report button in Sheng Xia's livestream. The report reason... He squinted at the streamer's introduction: Born in the '90s, postgraduate entrance exam success, life motto: Always keep one’s words. Cheng Liang swallowed the noodles and typed in the reason of the report: False advertising. Not keeping her words.

title: Heavenly Sword’s Grand Saga
summary: There were people who believed they were chosen by heaven and tried to rule the world. Because of them, a long ten-year period of chaos began, and many heroes fought back. In the end, six masters sent one disciple, betting the fate of the martial world on him. “If you are heaven, then I will become the sword that cuts heaven.” With that vow, he arrived… …but no one told him he would show up as a chubby guy! Anyway, since I’m already here, I should save the world… save the world… Damn it. First, I need to lose some weight.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: Super Elation Under the Sun
summary: Li Fuyao, a mysteriously young storyteller, wins over the villagers with his fantastic original tales in a peaceful and secluded town. Actually, born in Luoyang City, he used to be a prestigiously selected child, who should have been cultivating in the holy palace. However, life has treated him otherwise. He was expelled to this remote town, unattended. Notwithstanding, like a hidden leopard, he is always lurking around to get himself back on the road of cultivation and seek revenge when he becomes strong enough. One day, a masterly cultivator and an injured snake demon paid him an unexpected visit, breaking the peace of his life from then on. To his surprise, the snake demon offered him a demonic core for cultivation, which granted him the chance he has been yearning for. Is it really a turning point of his life or will it just put him into inconceivable danger?

title: The Ghost in the Necklace
summary: My ex-boyfriend turned my ashes into a necklace and hung it around his son's neck for eighteen years. For those eighteen years, my soul remained trapped by the boy's side. Then one day, out of the blue, the boy told me something. He said he wanted to marry me.

title: Souryuuden Gengashuu
summary: Four seemingly normal brothers, Hajime, Tsuzuku, Owaru and Amaru, begin to discover that they may not be as normal as they once thought. Though fiercely protective of each other, the entire world seems to be against them.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Heard That the Cool Maid Had Feelings for Someone, so I Fired Her for Her Happiness, and She Came to My House Alone
summary: I had a maid girl whom I grew up with since I was a small child. She always supported me and helped me when I was in trouble. One day, I heard from my maid friend that she was in love with someone else. But she still serves by my side and can't take free time. She has always been by my side and supported me outside of college. So I came up with an idea to make her happy...
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: How Far Can You Go with a Liter of Gasoline? I Refuse to Take Passengers When I Explode Like a Gasoline Explosion!
summary: Lin Yang crossed to a parallel world and found himself participating in a reality show where he randomly drew the job of ride-hailing driver. Female Passenger: "Driver, is it unreasonable for me to seek someone who earns 300,000 yuan per year when I earn 200,000 yuan per year?" Lin Yang: "Hmm! It's not unreasonable!" Female Passenger: "I have a car and a house. Is it unreasonable for me to seek someone who also has a car and a house?" Lin Yang: "Not at all, it's very reasonable." Female Passenger: "My parents have a retirement pension. Is it unreasonable for me to seek someone whose parents also have a retirement pension?" Lin Yang: "No problem at all, it's a good match." Female Passenger: "I'm 35 years old this year. Is it unreasonable for me to seek someone who is 40 years old?" Lin Yang: "Not at all, it's not unreasonable!" Female Passenger: "Driver, if you earn 300,000 yuan per year, have a house and a car, and your parents have a retirement pension, what kind of wife would you seek?" Lin Yang: "I would seek an 18-year-old..." Female Passenger: "Stop the car! I want to get off!! I'm going to file a complaint against you!" Netizen: "Men are more faithful; they always prefer 18-year-old girls!" Reminder: This novel and its characters are purely fictional. Any resemblance is purely coincidental. Do not imitate.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Don’t Fool Yourself into Thinking I’d Love You Forever, Idiot
summary: A story about a woman who believed her boyfriend would love her unconditionally no matter what, and a man who wanted to keep loving her but ultimately ran out of patience.

title: How to Survive With an All-Purpose Stone
summary: Hyun Eun-soo, a tone-deaf, clumsy idol with nothing but his looks, has regressed to his pre-debut self. But… why is his face like this? And… why is he so good at singing?

title: An Ideal World of Loneliness: Cursed To Be Hated By Girls
summary: It was another world, much like our own. The only difference, however, is that the populational ratio was heavily skewed toward women. In such a world where the majority of the population was composed of girls, there was a man hated by the opposite s*x. It was so severe, abusive language was commonplace and he was subjected to heinous violence on a daily basis. For the young man, that daily hell had become the norm. Upon seeing his suffering, the two goddesses of the world muttered, “You, boy, are cursed,” and lifted the malison. From there, his life took a 180-degree turn. “I like you~!” “Hey, hey! Wait a sec! Come play with me~!” “Y, you’re wrong! Until now I… There was mistake! Forgive me!” “I’m sorry… I’m sorry…” This is a story about a slightly nihilistic young man and goddesses who love to crack dirty jokes without a shred of c*astity. Slowly, the world begins to revolve around him.

title: Divorced in the 1970s, Bound to the Fiercest Office
summary: [Alternate 1970s Setting + Mutual First Love + Military Marriage + Regretful Husband + Culinary Delights] Mu Wanwan died tragically in a car accident, only to be reborn on the night of her wedding. In her previous life, she was infatuated with Wen Lin. Out of gratitude, she married into the Wen family—rising from a village girl to the wife of an officer in the military compound. To everyone else, it seemed like she had climbed high. Even though Mu Wanwan knew Wen Lin was cold and never had feelings for her, she firmly believed that with enough effort, she could win his heart, so she spent her days chasing after him. But reality proved her devotion nothing more than a cruel joke. In Wen Lin’s heart, there would always be another woman more important than her. For three years of marriage, time and again, she was cast aside…
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Sixty Days of Gentle Training by the “Strange Being”
Sora ni Usagi ga Noboru Koro
summary: Due to various "reasons" having to leave his parents and living alone, is Kirimura Seiji. With his classmates and a very beautiful bishoujo named Fuyuki Youko (a forceful girl which actually wants the Kirimura Seiji for herself), he barely manages to pass through "normally" each day. Until one day, falling out of the sky, is a girl wearing gothic attire. This cute little girl is called Yuu, and she claims to be a vampire. Her appearance is due to the fact that she is searching for her thousand year old reincarnated lover. Originally he thought that she was raving mad, but never in his farfetched dreams would he have expected to find a Rabbit butler (Sekitoku) and a Steel Maid-en (Koshizu) (a combination android/maid) would appear to retrieve her (Yuu the vampire) home. With these new arrivals, Kirimura Seiji's daily "normal" life is over, and triggers the beginning of his "very abnormal, love life".

title: Rewind, Rewrite, Revenge
summary: Yun Mi is trapped in a xianxia game. To return home, she must "save" a pitiful early-game NPC who later becomes a twisted, beautiful, and terrifying villain. Unfortunately, even the younger version of this future demon lord is already a wolf in sheep's clothing. She spent 400 years clearing his path with kindness and sacrifice-only to be repaid with a blade through her chest as he said, 'You? Unworthy.' Yun Mi: "Oh? That's how it is?" In her final moments, she grabbed his hand and drove the knife in deeper. "Let's see how you handle it when I come back." What she didn't expect... was that he remembers everything too.

title: A Legendary Korean Gamer Stuck in a Japanese Isekai
summary: After 10 years of living as a professional gamer, I moved to Japan to work as a coach. However, I was invited as a special guest to a game show held annually in Tokyo, and ended up playing a certain game… The in-game(?) world I became trapped in, and the Japanese users I’m with… None of them are ordinary!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: Project Delta
summary: In a world where hunters fight space monsters, there was a young man named Jun who wanted to become a hunter—but had absolutely no talent. He worked as a 3D-class spaceship mechanic. One day, while repairing an abandoned ship, he found himself on the verge of becoming a lost space traveler! [Welcome to the Body Correction Program: Delta.] [Would you like to start the tutorial?] “Uhm… excuse me, what did you say my weapon is?” The engineer hunter holding a spanner is going out!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Transmigrated Wife Saves Heirless Lord
summary: Qin Bi is born through transmigration into Great Yan, a realm where fortune, luck, and fate are not ideas - they are powers that can raise or ruin a kingdom. As a powerless concubine-born daughter, Qin Bi is supposed to accept whatever her family arranges. Then He Yan, a brilliant duke's heir cursed to kill his wives and leave no sons, needs her to break his fate while still favoring Qin He, the shining transmigrator everyone protects. Humiliated, trapped, and ordered to endure for her family's future, Qin Bi refuses to become the sacrifice that clears another woman's path. Her escape should leave her discarded, but Rong Jun, another powerful heir under the same childless curse, steps forward and marries her instead. Their alliance shocks both noble houses. Her unexpected pregnancy overturns old prophecies, threatens jealous rivals, and turns one fragile child into the focus of Great Yan's fortune. Qin Bi was meant to be used and forgotten. Now everyone is watching her child grow.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Historical, Martial Arts, Mature, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Won’t Kiss You
I Became a Prison Officer of the First-Class Prisoners
summary: I possessed a prison officer in an R-19 novel. 'Crazy. The prison officer who was killed by the male lead as soon as the novel starts?' The problem is that this woman named Lemony is a public target for prisoners. 'Wha-what, I don't like it either. Damn prison!' I play according to the original and barely try to escape from prison. "Lemony, can you be my prison officer? I like taking orders too.” The villain who flew from the next building suddenly confronted me, "Where are you going, Lemony?" "......?" “You have to keep an eye on me. You are my prison officer.” The male lead who tried to kill me started to obsess over me. Will I be able to escape from prison safely.....? *** “Where are you going, Lemony?” As I was about to leave the cell, I turned my head to the terribly low bass voice that came from behind me, and terrifyingly red eyes filled my field of vision. “You have to take good care of the prisoner as the person in charge.” He slowly approached me with a smile and quietly closed the iron bar I was trying to open and locked me in. So, why would a prisoner imprison a prison officer....?

title: King of Cooking
summary: An ordinary office worker, Shin Woo-joo. One day, from his late mother’s old radio, he hears “King of Cooking FM”! [Do you want food that can fill the hunger of your soul?] [Learn to cook directly with the new cooking app, “King of Cooking”!] What was the secret behind his mother’s cooking? By learning the methods from the gods of cooking, Shin Woo-joo begins his journey to become the King of Cooking!
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Glau Standear Empire Story
summary: Five years ago, seven heroes—known as the "Seven Saints of the Empire" ever since—took action and ended the great war against the neighboring country of Regia. One of the Seven Saints was a young man named Chrom Jarrett, the dual-wielding swordsman and strategist. To fulfill his promise to his liege, Princess Eustina, he returned to the front lines as the Empire's trump card with war looming on the horizon. Featuring a heroic strategist in a spectacular display of his outstanding martial and intellectual prowess to cleverly reverse hopeless battle situations, a fantasy war story officially begins!!

title: Bon’nō no Kazu Dake Koi o Suru 108-tsu no Sainō e Aiwokomete
summary: To dominate all talents, make 108 girls fall in love and serve you! Hatsu Jun-nosuke, a flawless genius capable of anything (albeit with a broken personality), suddenly finds himself reduced to less than ordinary, unable to do anything well. One night, the "God of Heaven" appears in his dream and reveals, "Due to an error, the 108 talents originally granted to you in excess have been redistributed to their rightful owners, leaving you bereft of them." The only talent left to Jun-nosuke is his innate gift: the talent for love. With his secure future shattered and plunged into despair, he learns that the 108 individuals who received his talents are all girls. Determined to reclaim and wield his lost talents as he pleases, Jun-nosuke resolves to use his talent for love to make all 108 girls fall for him—!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: A Pro Wrestler Reincarnates as the Strongest, Invincible Gladiator in Another World!
summary: Matt, who is not only the strongest in the world but also a gladiator beyond all standards. However, his real name is Yamato, and he used to be a professional wrestler from Japan. As Yamato followed the gladiator troupe on their tours, he began to question the gladiators' battles, which were still nothing more than immature death matches. Since spectators were coming to watch, why not entertain them to the fullest? With this thought, Yamato decided to revolutionize the way of the gladiators in this other world. Today, the unconventional gladiator Matt continues to tear through his opponents, tossing them aside one by one. Facing off against a giant troll, he uses professional wrestling moves to bring it down!

title: Murim Megacorp Galaxy Top
summary: The medicine of Sichuan! The sword of Yongcheon! The jade of Kunlun! Everything from the Central Plains is here! A panacea! An alloy divine sword! An artificial Vajra! Even things that don’t exist in the Central Plains are here!

title: Detective Conan: Goddess’s Guardian
summary: Transmigrating into the world of Detective Conan, becoming an expert in criminal psychology and micro-expressions, while simultaneously serving as a highly revered professor at Teitan Academy and an influential superintendent within the Metropolitan Police Department—what kind of legend will he forge? Did you ever lament the tragic and helpless plights of those goddesses in the original story? Now, with the chance to alter their destinies, it's only natural to avert tragedies and mend regrets! An ongoing series of four years, focused solely on its conclusion. Not striving for perfection, but guaranteeing maximum exhilaration!

title: The Exiled Saintess in a Box, Who Finds Happiness and Fulfillment While Raising Children in a Neighboring Country
summary: Apparently, the country that exiled me collapsed immediately afterward. "——Rosemary Lees, you are hereby banished from this country!" The imperial guards of Crown Prince Christoph—Rosemary's fiancé—drag her away without a shred of mercy. The last thing she sees is the face of Duchess Micheline, the woman who framed her with lies, her lips curled into a wide, triumphant smirk. After that, Rosemary is shoved into a cramped wooden crate, and the world goes dark. No matter how hard she pushes or pounds against the lid, the box won't budge. Up until now, she had endured it all. She used her powers as a Saintess to heal the Magic Tree, putting up with constant disdain for her commoner roots. But none of it was rewarded. She had only agreed to become a Saintess because she was promised she could eat her fill—and yet now, extreme hunger is pushing her to her absolute limit. In the depths of her despair, she suddenly realizes the lid of the box is loose. The moment she notices, a surge of rage unlike anything she has ever felt takes control of her emotions. "——You absolute bastards! I’m going to crush every one of you!" ...As it turns out, her "place of exile" was directly in front of King Carnald and Crown Prince Lionel of the neighboring kingdom. (Oh... My life is over.) The color drains from her face like a receding tide. Clutching her growling stomach and drowning in despair from hunger, Rosemary braces herself for a future thrown in a dungeon—but fate has other plans.

title: 7 Killers

To retrieve the antidote, Dragon 5th hires Liu Changjie, a skilled martial artist who loves drinking and women, but has a mysterious past. All is not what it seems in this wuxia heist story.

title: Looking For The Villainess’s Contract Husband

Thanks to recalling the original story, I became aware of the future, but it wasn’t exactly hopeful. My mother, the villainess, would be used by others until her death, and I was destined to die from an incurable illness. Still, there was one good thing. Though there was no way for me to survive, I could save my poor mother. "Mom, you’ll live. Instead of me, live happily." To save my mother, I went to find the duke who was a supporting character in the original story. “So please propose to my mother, Your Grace.” Knowing the original story, I made a deal with him, and in return, the duke rescued my mother and me from the clutches of my cruel maternal grandfather. After successfully completing the contract, I intended to quietly face my death in a place where no one knew me… “Libby, I think I’m feeling a bit unwell. Could you stay by my side?” …Wait, why is this sickly-looking young man holding on to me? But seriously, is he really sick? Something seems off.

title: When My Younger Brother Stole My Girlfriend, I Began Living Together with My Beautiful Childhood Friend Almost as If We Were Married
summary: From being cuckolded to a major turnaround! A sweet and affectionate cohabitation life with a devoted and beautiful childhood friend! On top of that, he is almost completely estranged from his family, who constantly side with his brother. However, in a state of despair, Hayato unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend whom he had a crush on, Reina Iwasaki, at an izakaya where he went for binge drinking! As he is taken to Reina's house, it turns out that they both had feelings for each other in the past, leading them to start dating and living together! He has willingly relinquished his identity, becoming just a shadow without a face—an unknown soul consecrated beneath the mountains and the sea. His noble duty demands utter sacrifice and silence, but her enduring memory is the only truth that anchors him to life.

title: Swimming Pool
summary: “Baeseo-bin. It’s been a long time.” As soon as Seobin recognized him, her vision blurred—just like that day long ago. Her first love, Kim Sahyeok, is someone she’s meeting again after eight years. A man who might have been the one who killed her older sister. I have never forgotten my sister… or any of you. Not even for a moment. “What are you doing?” “You said you wanted an interview.” Seobin, who still can’t let go of the truth from that day and has become a reporter to chase down suspects, now faces Sahyeok—still dazzling enough to draw everyone’s eyes—when he makes a mysterious offer to work together. “I think we’d make a good team. You have a grudge against Sarim too, don’t you?” Even though Seobin is suspicious of Sahyeok, one of the four main suspects, she eventually joins hands with him to uncover the truth behind the Sarim Foundation, the group that covered up her sister’s death. “Forget my offer.” “What do you mean…?” At Sahyeok’s cold stare, Seobin hurriedly grabbed his arm. “Today was a mistake. So please… give me another chance.” “Who risks their life just to make a mistake?” This can’t happen. This might be her last chance to reveal the truth about her sister’s death. Breathing shallowly, Seobin forced out the words. “I’ll do anything. Whatever you want, Director.” “Anything?” Even as her mind faded, Seobin nodded without hesitation. “Then pretend to be my girlfriend. I’ll make sure you’re well rewarded.”

Just as he was ready to relax and secure his place in history, he opened his eyes and found himself reborn as the feeble-minded sixth prince of a later generation. And his cheap “grandson” of a father spent his days refining elixirs and seeking immortality. Fortunately, the divine artifact, the Qin King’s Bone-Reflecting Mirror, was still with him. After pondering for a moment and looking at the Great Qian’s territory, which had expanded from one to two and then to three, Xiao Jingchuan pounded his chest in frustration: “You damn grandson, your ancestor is coming to beat you up!” Given a second chance at life, the divine Bone-Reflecting Mirror had also updated with various convenient features to help save the endangered Great Qian. However… Xiao Jingchuan noticed that among the talent assistance options the mirror had selected for him, the three most prominent SSR-tier talents looked somewhat familiar. Weren’t they his three closest friends from the early Qian period when he was building the empire—the Great Qian’s first-class meritorious officials, the founding three dukes: the Prime Minister, the Grand General, and the State Preceptor?! Xiao Jingchuan: Wait, Bone-Reflecting Mirror, can you explain to me what the [Transmigrator] in parentheses after the Prime Minister’s name means? Bone-Reflecting Mirror: … Xiao Jingchuan: Divine artifact, say something!

Jiang Chen’s playboy father passed away, leaving him alone with a stepmother who had just entered the family. He had heard too many stories about stepmothers abusing their stepsons. He stopped, trembling. “What do you want? I don’t have any money!” The window rolled down, revealing his stepmother’s face. “Chen, it’s dangerous to go cycling so late. Here, let Master Liu and the others accompany you.” That night, passersby witnessed a spectacular sight: ten Ferraris driving at 20 mph behind a single bicycle. Jiang Chen tried to act out and be rebellious so she would kick him out. But no matter what trouble he caused, it wasn’t a problem for her. Coaxed by her calling him “Baby” and “Little Handsome Guy,” Jiang Chen actually felt a warmth he never received from his biological father. When classmates later asked mockingly, “Is your stepmother still torturing you?” Jiang Chen clutched the bear keychain she gave him and defended her for the first time: “She’s a good person. She’s nothing like what you say!” That evening, Jiang Chen went home and dove into Hu Zhenzhen’s arms. After she prodded him for a while, he mumbled, “Mom, why don’t you find me a new dad?” Hu Zhenzhen was startled. Wait, did he find out I’ve been secretly dating that popular young idol?

The legendary cold-faced military general, why was he constantly hovering around her? One moment, he was clutching his hand, demanding she blow on it. That insignificant woman used any means necessary to climb to the top, only to die before their very eyes with the utmost resolution after achieving her goal. Regret... but it was too late. Their only choice was to follow her in death. The road to the underworld is too cold, and they didn't want her to walk it alone. Mini-World Two: In a prestigious academy, she was bullied by the F4 young masters to the point of jumping off a building? All because she dirtied the white moonlight's shoe. Rose: The tables have turned. I'm the real creepy pe*vert! Stalking, sending letters, a wall of photos, collecting habits, chains, a little dark room? Heh, I'm familiar with this script! Mini-World Three: In a unique ABOE world, her cheap older brother, fiancé, sworn enemy, and childhood friend—all top-tier Alphas—have fallen for a straight male Omega who transmigrated into their world. They attempt to use their Pheromones to suppress and force their love on him? Oh, I'm so jealous. What happens if I get overstimulated and accidentally transform from a Beta into an Enigma? If you don't want to become an Omega, then be a good boy and let me do the Marking

title: Ninja Recruitment System
summary: After ending up being Naruto’s older brother and losing both parents at the event of Kyubi’s Rampage, Zhang Miao felt a lot of pressure. Fortunately, he has the Ninja Recruiting System! As long as you collect enough Ninja Fragments, you can recruit the corresponding ninja. Not only could you obtain the chakra reserve of the recruited ninja, but you can also get the recruited ninja’s ninjutsu or Bloodline Limit! So the question is, do you want Uchiha’s blood or the Ramen lover’s blood?

title: Ten Years Beneath Fading Lamps
summary: Their story began with the sweet tenderness of a first love in high school, weathered misunderstandings, separation, and the hardships of single motherhood. Lin Xiaoxia and Jiang Yubai finally reunited and mended their broken relationship, all thanks to their daughter, Lin Zhixia. Just as their new family set sail toward a brighter future, a mysterious crystal ball swept the entire family into a vortex of another world. To return home, they transformed into the "Guardian Alliance"—parents standing shoulder-to-shoulder, siblings united in purpose. In a fantastical world teeming with stars, they embarked on a perilous survival adventure: taming Guardian Beasts, solving the riddles of the Sky Castle, battling the encroachment of the Abyss, and gathering the Star Phantom Stones, each holding a fragment of the key to their homecoming. This intergalactic journey of life and death tempered their familial and romantic bonds, awakening extraordinary powers within their bloodlines. After enduring immense trials to seal the Abyss and returning to Earth, a distress signal from the Interstellar Alliance once again lit up the crystal ball—the Jiang Family's path as Guardians was destined to shine with boundless brilliance.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Sci-fi

title: Zui Wu Dao
summary: Xuan Luo has no recollection of his past. The only thing that can identify him is the jade around his neck. But ever since he had opened the mysterious book from the forest, his strength has multiplied and a current has been running through his body. Strangely enough, the current running through his body resembles the faint current from his jade. Who is he? What is the connection between his jade and the book?

title: Classmates, Stop Chasing! The Freshman Campus Belle is My Girlfriend
summary: "Boys, you must protect yourselves when you're out there!" Lin Senmu embarked on a solo trip, prepared for all sorts of unexpected encounters, but he never imagined that a stranger girl from the upper bunk of the soft sleeper would squeeze into his lower bunk in the middle of the night. "Mmm, my bear!" The girl, talking in her sleep, pulled Lin Senmu's arm to use as a pillow. "Hey, what are you doing?" Lin Senmu was speechless. ... Lin Senmu and Jiang Yuan met under these circumstances. Both had just finished their college entrance exams and decided to take a solo trip. Since their train tickets had the same destination, they rented an RV for a road trip, during which feelings gradually developed between them. But all trips must come to an end. After returning to their respective cities, the thousand-kilometer distance meant they could only find warmth through their phone screens during the summer break. Lin Senmu decided to apply to the university she was going to attend. ... Time flew by, and September arrived. During the military training, classmates were all trying to get the contact information of the most beautiful girl on campus. Lin Senmu turned into a little jealous boyfriend:Classmates, Stop Chasing! The Freshman Campus Belle is My Girlfriend
genres: Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Tycoon: Dumping 101 Girlfriends
summary: Encountering a situation, the protagonist realizes that the identity designated by the system was that of a lackey* before. **With 101 girlfriends, all of whom are essentially spare tires themselves. Determined and resolute, Zhang Fan intends to break up, rejecting you. Protagonist: I'm sorry, but we're not compatible. Let's end this. Girl: Why? Protagonist: I have feelings for your mother. A glass of water splashes onto Zhang Fan's face. Ding: Congratulations to the host, lifespan +10, and receiving a Rolls-Royce. Protagonist: Let's break up; we're not right for each other. Girl: Why? Protagonist: I'm tired of this game and want to try something new. Another glass of water splashes onto Zhang Fan's face. Ding: Congratulations to the host, lifespan +20, and receiving 50 million gold. *Note: "Lick" here refers to someone who is submissive or servile.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Romance, School Life

title: Something’s Off with My Wife
summary: Luo Qingzhou wakes up to find himself reincarnated as a lowly illegitimate son of the Luo family in the Cheng Guo Residence of the Great Yan Empire. To help the second son of the Luo family back out of a marriage, Luo Qingzhou is forced to marry into another family—becoming the husband of a bride rumored to be a mute and a fool who doesn’t laugh. It isn’t until after the wedding ceremony and the bridal chamber that he suddenly realizes: “Something is off about my wife!” In fact, it’s not just his wife—her two maids and even the Qin family members are all acting strange! The senior maid is sweet, playful, and loves to tease, her voice as melodious as a lark. The junior maid is cold as ice and carries a heavy aura of killing intent, her sword striking directly at the throat. His sister-in-law is an immensely talented beauty, delicate and frail like Lin Daiyu. His cousin is proud, fiery, and wields a whip that strikes to kill. His father-in-law looks serious and righteous but secretly spews vulgarities. His mother-in-law is stunningly beautiful but rolls her eyes at everyone. His brother-in-law is obsessed with martial arts, determined to bring glory to the family. As for Luo Qingzhou, he just wants to keep his head down, play the role of a dutiful son-in-law... and secretly rise to become invincible in the world!
genres: Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, Wuxia

title: My Ghost Mom’s Horror Book
summary: An Xin, a young girl whose parents were divorced, had been living with her father since forever. When she was twelve years old, her father had to move to an African country for business. So he sent An Xin to live with her mother who had been living alone. Her mother lived in a remote mountain village. A village far away from the city but very rich. Her old house was large, quiet, elegant, and a little creepy. One day, An Xin went into her mother’s study and found a thick, tattered, and red notebook. Out of curiosity, she flipped it open and soon walked into a world with horrors and mysteries.

title: Exchanged Sisters
summary: When the Zheng Family was banished from Shangjing City, the lady of the house couldn't bear to let her infant daughter endure the hardships of the journey. She bribed a midwife to swap her daughter with the child of the Qin Family, who lived next door and was traveling to Shangjing to take up a post. For the next decade or so, all was peaceful. But in the second year after the Zheng Family returned to Shangjing, the Crown Prince was deposed, and the Qin Family was sentenced to exile. Unwilling to let their biological daughter be sent away to a distant land, the Zheng couple plotted to swap the two girls back. On the day Zheng Xuetong was reunited with her biological parents, I shouldered my pack, ready to find my own parents as they were being escorted out of the capital. My foster mother, unable to remain indifferent after all, called out to me. "Wanqing, if you just lower your head and admit you were wrong, I will convince the Master to take you in as an adopted daughter. You wouldn't have to go to the Northern Desert to suffer." "There is no need, Madam." I declined with a faint smile and walked away without looking back. So what if it was the Northern Desert? I knew it all too well.

title: A Farmer’s Son, but a Superior Person (Keju)
summary: Wang Jingyu traveled to ancient times and became a fifth-class peasant. The peasants worked hard, producing more and more food, but the food was getting worse and worse. A head of a household in Dongxiang, Linnan County, bought the land of the original owner at a low price and said to him: “Never work, but have no worries about food and drink, wear gold and silver, and reap the profits of fishing. This is the best of the best.” Wang Jingyu: ? ? Are you teaching me how to do things? The first step for modern people to refresh the concept of “the best of the best” is to earn cash that his family has not seen for a long time – 50 copper coins, relying on the experience of mushroom cultivation in the next raw material base of the family business in the previous generation . After Wang Jingyu had a full stomach, he started the second step – rolling up his sleeves to study for the imperial examinations. He won three first prizes in a row, was named in the imperial examinations, was in charge of the three departments and two governments, ruled the world, and became a “superior” in the eyes of the world. A hundred years later, the first volume of the “Da Jing Hui Yao” recorded: Taifu Wang Wenzheng, born in a peasant family, has been a master for twenty years, and the world’s civil and military lives are peaceful. The former peasant family is also a noble family, everyone is noble, and there is no “superior” anymore.

title: A Beautiful Duchess with a Dark Heart
summary: In the capital's elite social circles, rumors abound about Wen Yu's ruthlessness. Even the Emperor, upon hearing these tales, has repeatedly nodded in agreement! Wen Yu, upon learning of this, responded with a cold smile: From a young age, her mother was mu*dered, her grandmother showed no affection, and her father offered no love. She was the target of envy and constantly schemed against. After much hardship, she finally secured a good husband, only to find her marital home a chaotic mess! Should she play the innocent fool? If so, would a husband of exceptional talent and beauty, intelligent and considerate children, a devoted mother-in-law, and the title of Duchess simply fall from the sky?! In her past life, the Duchess met a miserable end! Our protagonist first sets her sights on the male lead, unceremoniously claiming him as her own. After marriage, she employs every tactic imaginable: throwing herself into his arms, playing hard to get, alternating between gentle affection and playful dominance, expressing care while subtly tormenting… From then on, the exceptionally handsome, ruthless, yet capable Fifth Young Master Qi, whose emotional intelligence borders on naive innocence, is repeatedly berated by the Emperor, who points a finger at him and scolds, "You spineless fool! What kind of life is this?! Divorce her immediately! Don't be afraid, I will support you!" Fifth Young Master Qi blushes slightly: Actually, this life… isn't so bad… This story portrays a strong female lead who makes every effort to achieve happiness. *** Overlooked and undervalued, Wen Yu, the legitimate daughter of the Wen family, endures a life of quiet suffering. On her fifteenth birthday, tragedy strikes, setting in motion a chain of events that culminates in her agonizing death. Miraculously reborn, Wen Yu returns to the day it all began, armed with the bitter memories of her past life and a steely resolve to change her fate. This time, she won't be a pawn in her family's games. She will reclaim what is rightfully hers, expose the hypocrisy and cruelty of those who wronged her, and forge a new path for herself. But as she navigates the treacherous landscape of family politics and builds her own power, she must confront not only her past enemies but also the unexpected attention of powerful figures who see her as a valuable asset in their own games. Will Wen Yu succumb to her thirst for revenge, or can she find a way to break free from the cycle of pain and create a different future for herself?

title: Natural Born Winner
summary: The newly launched System 9526 from the Time-Space Bureau has been bound to a host with amnesia—who unexpectedly turns out to be a big shot. With a laid-back, Buddhist mindset, the female protagonist traverses various worlds to complete her missions. However, without realizing it, she always ends up becoming the ultimate villain/big boss. Whether in ancient times or interstellar empires, she effortlessly dominates, subverting conventional tropes in this fast-paced transmigration adventure. [Written by 昔我晚矣]
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Martial Arts, Mystery, Slice of Life

title: Dating a Younger Man Is Dangerous
summary: Her ex-boyfriend cheated on her. He was someone she started dating at work and even promised marriage with.Seo Yeon-ha, barely piecing together her shattered heart, threw herself into work. But her daily life is interrupted by the suspicious new employee, Nam Do-hyun.“I’m interested in the team leader.” “Do-hyun, you’re more naive than you look. Just because we slept together once doesn’t mean we’re dating.”It was her first one-night stand. Even though she tried to act strong to avoid being caught, Do-hyun was relentless.“If you don’t want a serious relationship, we can keep it casual.” “Are you saying you want to toy with me, Do-hyun?” “Yes. Drink when you want to drink, call me when you feel lonely.”The warmth she feels from a stranger. The woody scent that lingers on his collar. Everything slowly breaks down Yeon-ha’s boundaries.“Let’s keep it easy. I’ll come running anytime.”She realizes she’s made a mistake. This man is not someone who will just end casually.

title: Doomsday Game: Life Expert
summary: When the Doomsday Game arrives, plants and animals mutate, zombies and ghosts flood into the human world. Fighting monsters, leveling up, and looting gear becomes the new way for humans to survive. Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Life Expert talent. Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Food Appreciation talent. Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Medicine Analysis talent. …Su Ning just wants to say: I think… my life is about to become effortlessly victorious.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-fi

title: Crimson Splendor: Protector of the Realm
summary: Not a “Power Fantasy” (Non-Shuangwen): This is not a “quick-satisfaction” or “overpowered lead” story. It focuses on the struggles and complexities of the era. Beyond Romance: The protagonists’ actions are not just for each other; they are driven primarily by family and responsibility. Political Marriages: The Princess has consorts (husbands), but there are no physical/intimate relations with them. Marriage with Xue: To avoid a political marriage to a foreign land (heqin). Marriage with Wu: To gain a strategic advantage in the struggle for power. These are relationships of mutual exploitation. Historical Creative Liberty: Some plots may not strictly follow the historical timeline. This is a work of fiction; please do not treat it as a historical textbook.

title: I Rose Suddenly in The Alternate World By Overwhelming Gacha With Luck!
summary: It was a gacha experience in a world of swords and magic that the late Jinta Kazama reincarnated in after an accident. But after the reincarnation, a status abnormality was found. His [Luck] stat had a numerical value of [999,999], when its normal maximum was [99], he has become—– The Strongest weapon of mythlogical grade was won in the first gacha! “I won this house with gacha!” “Our pet is a dragon?”

title: A Dragon Girl’s Journey Through A Post-Apocalyptic World
summary: A girl wakes up in a dark room. An abandoned hospital. A deserted post-apocalyptic world. The girl with horns and a tail travels through the ruined world to find out who she is.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Mystery, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Won’t Raise Your Child
summary: Elise, the illegitimate child of a marquis, lived her life in silence. She desired nothing and wished for nothing. The only thing she desperately wished for was one. The simple happiness with the man she loved. But the price of love was betrayal. Even her mother coldly turned away from her, and everyone wanted her dead. Just then, a man approached and asked. She decided. To take revenge on everyone who wanted her dead and erase her existence. The woman who returned decided to seduce the man who abandoned her. Until he falls into ruin, I will become even more wicked. You will regret it, you.

title: The Adopted Heroine Who Stole My Health
summary: I was stolen from by the adopted female lead. "Sister, I'm sorry. Your fiancé confessed to me." This is the fifth time. Once again, my adopted younger sister has taken what was mine. I thought that if I gave up everything and treated her kindly, I could at least avoid a tragic end. "Why are you doing this to your sister when you're the older one?" "Try to be half as good as your sister." Even my parents didn’t love me. Just when I thought I couldn’t endure any more, I discovered a shocking truth. The real daughter was my sister, and I was the 'fake' who was meant to suffer in her place. "I won’t let myself be taken from her so easily anymore." To take my revenge, I decided to claim the one thing my sister had never had. I chose the male lead of this novel, Calix. "Three years? If you want, I can marry you tomorrow and make you a duchess." But for some reason, this man wants me?

title: Silversmith
summary: Summary Seo Han, an orphan raised by the humble wanderer No Geul-gae, has lived his entire life in the shadows. To earn enough money to give his guardian a proper funeral, he joins Samra Jeon, a ruthless organization of assassins. But when he is ordered to kill a young woman who once shared a meal with him in childhood—a tiny act of kindness he never forgot—Seo Han chooses betrayal over blind obedience. Hunted and with nowhere to turn, he encounters Chang Hae-ryu, a notorious master whose very name strikes fear in the martial world. Under his tutelage, Seo Han begins to forge his own path, sharpening both his skills and his convictions. As he wanders, allies and enemies alike are drawn to him, their fates intertwining around the mysterious Yeongrongak, the central sect of the righteous factions. There, Seo Han uncovers a vast conspiracy capable of shaking the entire martial world to its core. With darkness spreading and great evil rising, Seo Han stands at the heart of the turmoil. Together with the companions he gathers along the way, he must rely on every skill, every lesson, and every ounce of will he has honed throughout his life. The final battle is not just for survival—it's for the fate of the entire world of martial arts.

title: Please Permit Me To Love You Forever
summary: She conspires and provokes the most powerful young master in Beijing! They sign a contract and with his every call, she has to go anywhere and do anything his bidding. When their contract ends, she smirks and said, “I’ll take the money and you can leave. We don’t owe each other anything.” He is Young Master Ya who rules Beijing. He controls the business empire during the day, and he is the strongest king at night. He is cold and women are merely playthings to him. With his power, the women he has eyes on have never been willing to leave him, yet she is an exception. She loves money, like all the previous women, but she is never shy of showing her greed. And he never realizes that he will ever grow a heart for such a promiscuous and cheap woman… He points a gun straight at her heart. “Die with me, or accept my love—which one do you choose?” She pouts and turns around, before she pushes an adorable child into his arms. “Here, there’s your answer.”

title: Scandal: Eoudong Lawsuit
summary: I will serve as Jiabi for the rest of my life.” “I will protect you until the end of my life.” Eo Woo-dong’s breath flowed down the nape of Lee Gyeom’s neck. The scent from his mouth wafted into his nose. I couldn’t come to my senses like a drugged person. Lee Gyeom put his hand behind Ou-dong’s neck and gently hugged her. “I may be clumsy, so please don’t imitate me.” As he pulled Eoudong deep into his arms, the faint scent of roses touched him. From the moment they became one, they were passionately conscious of each other as if they were about to melt. The souls of each other began to flow inside their bodies. They thought that an eternally happy future awaited them, but the interruption of Tae Kang-soo’s move forced them to separate forever.

title: Tales of Vesperia – Ryuu Tsukai no Chinmoku
The Sister Who Hated Me, Now Loves Me
summary: With beauty, noble blood, and extraordinary talent, my older sister seemed to have it all. Born as her rival, it was inevitable that I would die at her hands. After escaping once, when half of the empire turned to ashes, I gave up and accepted death. Shh- The moment her cold sword touched my neck, I was reborn at the age of 8. “What’s going on?! Do I have to die again?” This time, I swore I wouldn’t just accept it, clenching my small fists tightly. “Harper, my sister, even if my dreams shatter, I want to protect you.” …Huh? “How dare anyone try to harm you in the Luperne mansion, Harper?” There are so many crazy people in this world. My sister had changed. A lot. “Killian, what do you want to be when you grow up?” “What kind of person do you like? A rich merchant?” “No.” “A Duke?” I shook my head again. “Then the Emperor?” “…What?” “That’s right.” “…” “You want me to become the Emperor.” For a split second, did my inner thoughts show on my face, or was this child more sensitive than I thought? “Then I’ll become the Emperor, Harper. I don’t want anything else.” He grabbed my hand tightly as if there was no more doubt in his mind.

title: The Mad Duke’s Perfect Maid
summary: Female Protagonist: Ella - Born to a noble mother and a commoner father, Ella takes on debt to support her younger siblings after her parents pass away and enters the duke's household as a maid. There, she becomes the maid in charge of Duke Glois, known as the mu*derous and mad duke. Everyone fears and dreads the duke, but to her, the duke is nothing more or less than a master to be served. *Male Protagonist: Luichen Glois - The empire's only duke, nicknamed a warmonger, mu*derous, and mad dog. He has achieved countless merits in war and led the war to victory, but people fear him because of his hysterical and sharp memories of the bloody battlefield. But the moment his eyes meet the bold Ella, a mere commoner maid, the Duke is bewildered by his first feelings. The moment he realizes it's love, there's nothing he won't do to have Ella—even if it means beheading the Emperor. *Read this when: You want to read the special, gentle story of the maid who made the mad Duke, who everyone fears, fall in love. And you want a story without the keyword "Hwibinghwan." *Relatable quote: "If everyone were equal... wouldn't it be truly happy?" Ella's flushed cheeks were so adorable that the Duke smiled involuntarily. At Ella's single word, the Duke finally made up his mind: to destroy this empire. Story Introduction: Ella , sold to the Duke's household as if to pay off her father's gambling debts, becomes the maid in charge of the mad Duke, whom everyone shuns. The Duke looks at the maid standing beside him, feeling a strange sense of alienation. The maid who had prepared the meal, unlike the other servants, did not tremble in her voice, nor did she show any signs of anxiety or cold sweat. She simply stood calmly next to him. “Name.” For the first time since arriving at the mansion, the Duke asked the name of the maid in charge. “Ella.” “Ella… This time, the head maid sent a pretty good maid.” * * * Duke Glois had never expected it. He would fall for an ordinary maid like this… … . However, since there was no turning back now, the Duke resolved for his maid. To destroy this empire.

title: Exiled From the Brave Party, I Save the World as a Rare Occupation “Holy Water Messenger”
summary: This is a nonsensical parody about a kid who is paid to leave his party for no understandable reason, after which he pisses in a bucket and offers it to people to drink before continuing on...his journey?

title: After Being Deeply Hurt, I Chose Divorce, But He Called Me the Bad Woman
summary: At twenty-two, Lu Zhenzhu married Gu Huai. Everyone said she was lucky. But not long after the wedding, she found an old photograph in a drawer... The girl in the photo looked just like her—even the mole at the corner of her eye was identical. On the back of the photo was a complete verse: "Half the river emerald, half the river red; Dew like pearls, the moon like a hook."
