But the handwriting of the two lines differed—one delicate, as if written by a girl, the other bold, unmistakably his style. The signatures at the bottom read "Jiang Sesè" and "Gu Huai." Lu Zhenzhu stared at the photo and understood everything...

title: Do Not Drag the Tree into the Wall
summary: Leaving behind a hometown to which she can never return, Oerta begins a new life in Sol Miraye. However, to her, even a dramatic encounter with Anghie and new relationships are merely connections she must eventually shake off and leave behind. Even Valencian cannot bring himself to trust her will to live—a resolve so fierce she determined to survive even if it meant staining her hands with Rocroe’s blood and breaking her vow to Adel. After everything is over, when she is left as nothing but an empty shell with no heart remaining, what must she rely on to stand and live again? Meanwhile, in Ingre, the capital of Dimnapal, a scandal spreads regarding the mysterious woman whom Duke Miraye has accepted as a guest in his household. The precarious political situation of the three kingdoms begins to tighten the noose around her neck once again…

title: I’ve Never Seen a Lucky Player!
summary: Fan Xiao has a peculiar ability to save his luck by saving money. The more he saves, the more fortunate he will be. For example, if he saves for a month, he could be able to win the lottery. So, what happens if he saves all of his money? Fan Xiao was intrigued, began the limit challenge. The luck kept accumulating. With each passing day. Until one day, he was suddenly caught in a super dangerous game. Congratulations on being qualified for the "Evolution Game". [As a rookie player, you only have one chance to talent development; good talent equals a good start; hopefully, you are fortunate enough] Do you want to develop talent now? "......" Is this just a coincidence?

title: The Coldhearted Chancellor Falls for the Frontier Princess
summary: The young chancellor feared for his ruthlessness, Kairos. Despite being a prince born of a concubine with no backing from his mother, he had climbed to the seat of chancellor through sheer intellect alone. Known for his ever-present smile and the cold, calculated moves he made behind the scenes. Yet, in a kingdom suffering from unrelenting cold, there was one remote territory that continued to yield bountiful harvests. There resided a young noblewoman who transformed her land with creativity and action, Serenade Freudenberg. Beloved by her people as "Milady," she repurposed magical tools into farming implements, promoted commoners to positions of power, and established schools. Though her unorthodox reforms drew criticism from veteran vassals as "reckless," she pressed forward with one goal: "to save the people." At first, Chancellor Kairos took interest for the sake of national gain. But gradually, he began to wield his influence for the sake of the "Frontier Lady." Amidst the swirling conspiracies of the royal capital, the machinations of rival factions, and the looming threat of famine striking the land. Beyond the countless trials they overcame, what the two built was a "new home" and an "unbreakable bond." The meeting of the ruthless chancellor and the frontier lady would change the nation.

title: Virtual Evolution
summary: In the virtual world, power is what you seek. In reality, it's the pursuit of truth. But the game is not actually a game. Evolution!

title: Under The Heng Gate
summary: After her engagement was annulled, Li Qichi, daughter of the royal family, married Fu Ting, a man of humble origins but commanding great military power. For a long time, they lived as nominal husband and wife, he in the north and she in the south, maintaining a peaceful yet distant relationship. One day, Qichi embarked on a thousand-mile journey to reunite with her husband, determined to invest everything she had into this man… “You and I are not meant to be together, now all I can do is spend my money.”

title: After Reuniting with the Troops the Cold Faced Young Officer Came Down with a Case of Jealousy
summary: [1980s + Long-Awaited Reunion + Lovers Reunited + Bittersweet + Devoted Love] After a plane crash, Qiao Sheng transmigrated into the body of a sent-down educated youth, waking up in a mountain ravine with dislocated bones, unable to move. Sheng He appeared just in time not only saving her life but also unsettling her heart. Qiao Sheng was bold and unrestrained, and she quickly won him over, starting a romance. But just as Sheng He grew increasingly clingy and even began planning their future, Qiao Sheng decisively broke up with him, ruthless and firm. When the policy changed, Qiao Sheng returned to the city with the team of returnees. During this time, she encountered Sheng He again he was already in a high-ranking position, a commander feared and respected by everyone. Qiao Sheng had no desire to have anything to do with him…
genres: Action, Adult, Drama, Martial Arts, Romance

title: Senior Sister Dies and Becomes a God, the Entire Sect Cries for Her Funeral
summary: Brief introduction of the work: On the day Ye Li, the second senior sister of the Tianmen Sect, died The entire sect ignored her pleas for help. They were celebrating that Su Ying'er, a mortal woman with no spiritual roots, had finally become their junior sister ... until they saw her corpse. The entire sect went mad. Her fiancé, the eldest senior brother, vomited blood, the junior brothers committed su*cide to accompany him, and the high and mighty master became a demon in a single thought. Ye Li, who had already cultivated her soul into a god, would never give them a second glance. The divine beasts surrounding her pointed at their ragged fellow disciples and said with a grin, "Mother, they look like dogs. ."
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Mystery, Supernatural, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: The King Of Sword
summary: Beng San is a orphan, aside from his name he didnt remember anything else. For years after he lost everything from the great flood, he only want to survive. But fate have different way for him. One fatefull encounter (thanks to his stomach) change everything in his life. Follow beng san as he travel around the world and face his fate.

title: I Became an Extra Who Dies in Place of the Protagonist
summary: I realized too late that this world was inside a novel. I took on the chronic illness of the protagonist’s fiancée and died in her place — only to return to the past, still bearing that same illness.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: I Was Mercilessly Dumped by My First Love, a Gal. While I Was Heartbroken, the Most Beautiful Girl in School Picked Me up and Took Me Home
summary: My name is Shogo Ohsera, and I experienced my first love as a second-year high school student. The girl's name was Anna Shiratsu. She was a beautiful girl and a popular figure in our class with her cheerful personality typical of a "gal." I spent my days just watching her from afar, but then Anna confessed to me and we started dating. I thought this was the beginning of my rosy youth! But then... "I want to break up. I have a new boyfriend." "What!? What do you mean!?" "I was only dating you as a punishment. There's no way I could like a dull loner like you." From then on, it was a storm of verbal ab*se and ridicule. To make matters worse, Anna's current boyfriend and her close friends joined in to insult me. I realized that everything I had seen before was an illusion. My heart was shattered, and I didn't know what to do, so I sat alone in a park, holding my head in my hands. Frustration and resentment consumed me. That's when it happened... "Ohsera-kun...? It's Ohsera-kun, right?" "Takagaki-san?" A Takagaki, rumored to be the most beautiful girl in our grade, was standing there. I ended up confiding in Takagaki-san about what had happened. "If you've been dumped, can I pick you up?" "I'd like to decline if it's as a pet." "No, that's not what I meant! I want to take you home!" After being dumped, I suddenly became close to the most beautiful girl in our grade! To get back at Anna and the others, we started special training (dates). "I know you can do it, Ohsera-kun. Let's show Anna and the others what we're made of!" This is the sweet and revenge-filled youth that we weave together!
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Starting a Camper Van Life in Another World ~My Unique Skill [Vehicle Summoning] Was Quite Useful~
summary: Kirishima Tooru, who works for a black company, at the age of 27 finally obtained his long-desired camper van. Without delay, he goes camping in the camper van, but suddenly, he is summoned to another world, specifically the Kingdom of Othelonia. What the kingdom sought was a hero who could stand against the Demon Lord's army, but since Kirishima was not a hero, he was cast aside. However, Kirishima possessed a unique skill called [Vehicle Summoning] , allowing him to summon his camper van. Without hesitation, Kirishima escapes the kingdom in his camper van. Additionally, it was discovered that the [Shop] function attached to the camper van allowed him to purchase items from his previous world. "Awesome! This camper van is way too convenient!" Thanks to the vehicle add-ons like [Barrier] , [Stealth] , [Vehicle Strengthening] , and [Item Box] , Kirishima's life in the otherworld with his camper van continues to become more and more fulfilling. This is a laid-back camping life in another world, enjoying a cheat-level camper van.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Missing You Deeply
summary: In the business world, legend has it that he's cold-blooded and ruthless. Yet at home, he dotes on his beloved wife to the bones. 'Why am I married to this demon?' After accidentally provoking a certain demon, she becomes his possession. From then on, she is forced into a shameless, wanton life… "Mr. Pei, is there anything that you're dissatisfied with Mrs. Pei about?" a reporter asks. Mr. Pei's dark eyes narrows. 'The only thing I'm not satisfied with…' Mr. Pei answers brazenly, "Lasting for only five minutes after charging for two hours." Mrs. Pei's cheeks instantly turn red and she curses inwardly, 'This darn perv!' The reporter asks again, "What about you, Mrs. Pei?" Gritting her teeth, Mrs Pei replies, "Lasting for two hours after charging for only five minutes!" That night, Mr. Pei smiles wickedly after lasting four hours. "Are you satisfied now?"

title: If I Was the Only One Who Believed in the Prince of My Class Who Was Falsely Accused of Mol*station, the Prince Would Become a Princess
summary: Hanyuu Yuuma loses relationships with his half-sister, childhood friend, and trusted seniors as a result of the existence of a certain male student. However, Yuuma does not resent the boy. Because he was a man of character that even Yuuma himself was fond of, and he was surprisingly good-looking. Despite his mild distrust of women, Yuuma was feeling reasonably content with his new high school life ——until one day, an incident occurred. A male student who should have been a person of character was arrested on suspicion of mol*station. As a result of the incident, the environment surrounding him changes dramatically, and Yuuma’s relationship with him begins to move. No one seems to believe in him, only Yuuma does —what is the future that this relationship will bring?. At that time, what did the three girls who distanced themself from Yuuma think?. And what is the secret hidden by the male student? (Spoilers in the title)

title: The Mythical Craftsman’s Reversal Plan
summary: In a ruined world, he survived solely through the skill of crafting artifacts.But in the end, all that awaited him was betrayal and death.“This time, I’ll be the one holding the artifacts.”To lose nothing, to let go of nothing—The one and only craftsman who has regressed devises his grand plan for reversal.But then—“Wait, I awakened?” If that’s the case… doesn’t that mean he can’t make artifacts anymore?

title: The 9th Class Swordmaster: Blade of Truth
summary: Swordmaster Karyl MacGovern. He returned to the past, wanting to rewrite the future he was unable to change with his sword alone. And this time, he would acquire the power that once eluded him—magic. This time, he would master both sword and magic, and stand on the peak.

title: The Star Lord Chang Sheng of the Palace of Trials
summary: Star Lord Chang Sheng, arrogant, aloof, and heartless, always looking down on others with disdain. But why, upon encountering a little cat spirit from the mortal realm, Did he even become willing to risk his life? The Palace of Trials specifically oversees the trials of deities descending to the mortal realm. Yet the little orange cat, Ju Fang, lost the Record of Love Tribulations. And then... Why was Star Lord Chang Sheng punished to experience a love trial himself? To suffer the torment of unfulfilled love and break this icy, cold facade? But... what if his heart starts to waver? I refuse to stay calm! I’m serious about this!!!!!!

title: My Wife and the Empress Swapped Bodies
summary: Ning Qingtian transmigrated, then was carried off the mountain by a female bandit and became a stay-at-home husband. Faced with a bandit wife whose face was even more righteous than her worldview, Ning Qingtian yielded. He began helping his wife with her grand undertaking of rebellion. But on the night before the uprising, the female bandit and the reigning empress had their souls swapped because of an accident. Completely unaware of this, Ning Qing-tian continued dragging his bandit wife along the road of rebellion...

title: Imperial Zenith: The Twenty-One Regalia
summary: Wind and clouds bid the rising storm, raging seas flood the crimson dust. The four major clans of the capital city, each a titan in their realm. Wandering bards put the names of the four major clans of the Nap-Lan Empire into a simple poem, a poem which spread far and wide amongst the common folk. Here in Heaven’s Martial World, martial artists are the most important figures of all. That is because influence, status and wealth are all dependent on martial power. The four major clans are famous for their numerous powerful martial artists and possessed immense influence because of it as well. Martial artists use their souls as a catalyst to draw in aether and generate soul energy. In combination with their martial soul, they can then unleash devastating martial techniques. These so-called martial souls can take on countless different forms, from swords and knives, to fire and water, beasts and insects and even abstract, formless shapes. The inheritor of the Accident Makers was a young orphan who lost his parents at a young age. Fortunately, he was picked up by his adoptive father, who taught him everything he knew. The boy became proficient at creating accidents, but one day, an accident beyond his control finally occurred. He is now stranded in a foreign world. It is often said that the conclusion of a story is the beginning of a new one. Here in this world of martial arts, where life is worth little more than pennies, fate is as wild as it is unpredictable. The curtains draw and a monumental secret rises above the waters. The path of the gods and the path of the demons, which is real and which is false? Where lies the end of the martial path? Rumours claim that one must gather the twenty-one Imperial Zenith regalias to ascend to the peak of martial might! Justice may rest in the hearts of people, but it is power that decides everything! Everything is now changing because of a young boy’s arrival in Heaven’s Martial World.

title: Wizard’s Tale
summary: A story about a pitiful girl s*aved around and then abandoned by her relatives after robbing her parents' fortune that she was supposed to receive on her eighteenth birthday. On the brink of committing su*cide, she was stopped by a mysterious old man who nagged her about youth and life and then later on gave her a suspicious address claiming it is where she can find job. Eventually, it led her to the residence of a wizard. Then she just found herself under a life contract sealed when the wizard named Brylle Zaffiro kissed her. And the job is for her to be a housekeeper, cook, errand girl, research girl, and maid!

title: All Eyes Are on the Royals’ Adorable Baby Girl
summary: Adorable Baby + Group Pampering + Metaphysics + Five-Year-Old Female Lead Wei Fu had lived on the mountain for five years, but when she returned home, the first thing she saw was her s*umbag father beating someone. Seeing her mother beaten to the brink of death, Wei Fu was furious! She summoned lightning to strike her s*umbag father, went straight to her emperor uncle to report the ab*se, and demanded a divorce for her mother. The emperor, the crown prince, and the princes all backed her up, while the prime minister spoiled her endlessly. Powerful figures from all walks of life stepped forward to protect her. Soon, the capital was home to a little tyrant who strutted around with unmatched confidence. Bullies, playboys, demons, and ghosts all fled in fear of her. Until one day, people saw the little girl being scolded by a handsome young man with jade-like features, tapping her head as he reprimanded her. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief! “At least someone can keep her in check; otherwise, even the Grand Tutor’s beard might fall off from sheer stress!”
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: The Thirteen Beauties of Nanjing
summary: This book draws on novelistic creation methods, incorporates reasonable imagination, and uses poetic language to tell readers about the tortuous and poignant experiences of thirteen ancient courtesans: Su Xiaoxiao, Liu Rushi, Liang Hongyu, Sai Jinhua, Chen Yuanyuan, Du Qiuniang, Ma Xianglan, Gu Hengbo, Dong Xiaowan, Kou Baimen, Li Xiangjun, Bian Yujing, and Du Shiniang. It recounts their births, growth, and the events for which they are remembered by the world, recreating the tumultuous lives of these talented ancient women. Their tortuous lives, emotions, and representative events are precisely why these courtesans receive public attention.

title: Taking on the Fierce Showa Era with Data Baseball
summary: An entire life dedicated to baseball, lost due to a right shoulder injury, quietly began again at the twilight of the Showa era. It was a time when men risked their youth to pursue the dream of a living playing the white-ball sport. On the diamond, sweat flowed freely, shouts roared, and boys ran until the soles of their shoes wore down. "Don't drink water; endure it with grit!". "If you get injured, ignore the pain and keep running!". "Teamwork is learned from your seniors' backs!". The Showa era's blazing fervor tempered both baseball and the boys who played it. Among them was a solitary boy who always carried a notebook with him. He stood out from the others because he was the smallest and quietest, but his eyes, which meticulously observed every action during the game, seemed to predict the future. The trajectory of the hits, the habits of each pitcher, the gaps in the defense... In an era where everyone played baseball with sheer fighting spirit, he was the only one with an infallible method for winning. He had nothing against the traditions of the Showa era, but he had no intention of swallowing them whole. Amid the sweat and dirt of the field, the seeds of "a baseball that thinks" were beginning to sprout. In the scorching Showa era, his intelligence persevered amid the flames.

title: I am a Bastard
summary: I was born in a poor small valley as a bastard, my family is dirt poor, and I am unable to get a girlfriend. One day, my father gave me beautiful wife, but during the wedding night she found my cowardice. She not only did not let me touch her, but also kept calling me out openly, and flirted with other men in front of my face.... My cowardly self could not take it anymore and I finally snapped. I gave the adulterer a serious injury and was imprisoned. I gradually understood in the prison, if you do not want to be bullied, you can't be a coward, you need a big fist!

title: Mrs. Hawn, your disguise was penetrated
summary: At night, it was already midnight when Asher came home from dinner. He knew that Nora would come to The Howe family today. His grandpa Howard had asked Asher to meet Nora, but he refused on the grounds of work. He was not interested in this fiancee at all, and the engagement would be broken sooner or later After returning to the room, Asher took a bath and went to sleep. Probably because he drank a little too much tonight, Asher didn't realize there were other women in the room until he lay down. He was slightly stunned. In the darkness, Asher could not see the woman's face. She turned over and hugged him. The girl murmured, "Good bear, don't make any noise. Just sleep." Asher was frozen. The woman had a very familiar smell, the same as that person... Probably because of the alcohol, Asher didn't move, lying down with Nora and falling asleep.

title: The Cheeky Junior Gal Becomes Too Cute When She Gets Attached to Me
summary: In the autumn of his second year of high school, Tsujidou Masachika had just been appointed as the student council president when he found himself helping a student who was suspected of smoking in school. Her name was Ooba Monaka, a junior gal rumored to be a beautiful girl. He helped her on a whim, with no intention of getting involved. At least, that’s what he thought until… “I’ll do anything to thank you, Senpai~” For some reason, she became extremely attached to him! She would barge into the Student Council room every day, help with event preparations, and even go on dates. Gradually, Masachika and Monaka get closer as she aggressively narrows the distance between them. In the midst of it all, it turned out that the ‘suspected of smoking’ accusation was actually due to malice…? A sweet romantic comedy with a cheeky and cute junior gal begins!

title: I Love Love, Really Love You, so I Want To Tell You How Much I Love Being With You
summary: Eija is a foreign exchange student from Finland. Her school life is solitary, and she is called the Ice Elf. In reality, however, she simply has difficulties communicating with others! Furthermore, her main purpose for studying abroad in Japan is for otaku-related activities! Ouga Aoi, as a member of Eija’s host family and as her classmate, sets out to fulfill Eija’s wishes, but…
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: A Reborn Farmer’s Wife
summary: Female military doctor reborn in ancient times encountered drought and fled, grandfather slag, grandmother poison, to sell her family for food. Gu Jinli said: Small matter, first solve the slag god evil milk, and then find water for food, with the whole family through the disaster. Flee to Dafeng village home, foreigners are not mixed, all kinds of oppression, how to break? Gu Jin ‘an said: It doesn’t matter, brother I am the imperial examination big man, all the way to the branch, the scholar, shining the lintels, looking down the slag. The days are getting a taste of the war, all around, Gu Jinli flip the table, the girl just want to farm, fight what, roll!

title: I Was Reincarnated as an Incompetent Villain Prince, and When I Was in the Dark for an Oshi, the Hero Seems to Have Lost His Temper. Apparently, the Hero Is Also a Reincarnated Person~
summary: I was reincarnated as a villainous prince in the popular game “Sword and Sorcery Fantasy”. Despite being of royal bloodline, I am a lazy first prince who makes no effort to do anything. I’m the target of an assassination attempt by the protagonist in the middle of the game. In order to change such a doomed fate, I master the art of magic and become stronger. Then, when I was playing a role in the dark for the sake of my oshi, the hero got mad at me. “I’m not giving you the heroine and the throne!” “I don’t want the throne you know? I’m in the dark for the sake of my oshi” “You’ve got to be kidding me! You’re ruining the original! I’ll kill you!” “I’m sorry, but I’m already stronger than the hero.”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Why Did You Provoke Her? She Cultivates the K*lling Path!
summary: The peerless prodigy Shen Qingli had her Phoenix Bone forcibly removed by her master and birth mother. This was because her Junior Sister had a cultivation deviation, and her Root Bone was completely ruined, requiring Shen Qingli's Phoenix Bone to reshape her cultivation. But her Junior Sister was merely crippled, while Shen Qingli would die if her Phoenix Bone was forcibly removed, so she refused. As a result, her birth mother slapped her publicly and kicked her out of the hall, ordering her to kneel and reflect. Her favorite Younger brother, whom she doted on the most, splashed her with foul, icy water, saying, "I'll help Eldest Senior Sister sober up." Her most admired Eldest Senior Brother, without even looking at her, changed his cold demeanor and rushed to Pill Peak with Junior Sister. The Sect Master reprimanded her for being heartless, the elders accused her of having no fellow disciple affection, and her junior disciples all stepped forward to accuse her of frequently verbally abusing and beating them. Thus, they forcibly removed her Phoenix Bone and threw her into the Heavenly Thunder Pool. No one expected her to survive. Returning reborn, Shen Qingli felt her lifelong efforts had been fed to dogs. She switched to cultivating the Path of Emotionless Killing, no longer working herself to the bone for the entire sect. They, however, panicked and all knelt, begging for her forgiveness. Her Younger brother, the Demon Lord, whom she had raised through beatings and scolding, now a figure who intimidated the Eight Desolations, shielded her and coldly rebuked, "Scram!" Her father, once aloof and ethereal, now spoke with bone-chilling coldness, "Don't let me see you again!" The ragtag sects she casually joined all proved to be exceptional, crushing the scummy sect until they were begging for mercy. The Jadeite Sect members, their faces ashen, finally understood that the sect could do without anyone, but it could not do without its Eldest Senior Sister. Her master and mother, Zhao Yue, still expected Shen Qingli to understand that she cultivated the Path of Emotion and couldn't selfishly love her daughter; she had to love everyone. Shen Qingli: "Heh." Utterly incapable of understanding!

title: The Great Zhou’s Number One Warrior
summary: Traveling through the Great Zhou Dynasty, Chen Xuan, who was originally the cook and handyman of the General Mansion, woke up from the bed of the Grand Lady of the General Mansion. Looking at this weak and strong-eating, depressed Zhou Dynasty, Chen Xuan decided to change the world for him!

title: The Vicious Dog
summary: Xu Luling had a boyfriend that everyone envied. He was cool and refined, a graduate from a top international school, an investment banking elite, and most importantly, he treated Xu Luling extremely well. Lately, her boyfriend seemed to be stalked by someone. He kept receiving death threats, and strange accidents kept happening one after another: secret surveillance cameras installed in their home, a car that suddenly couldn’t stop on the road, a plaster dummy falling from above… Finally, one day, her boyfriend really disappeared. As she went to report it to the police, the missing man suddenly appeared behind her, drenched, like he’d rushed over without even grabbing an umbrella, looking like a lost puppy she’d forgotten by the roadside: “Lingling, I’m back.” But twenty days later, this man who said he’d returned mysteriously died. There was one thing she never told anyone. She always had a feeling that he had never truly left. He was always there, right by her side. [No one knew that her boyfriend could stay by her side 24/7.]

title: Between the Devil and the Deep Sea
summary: There are many pirates in the world. The hierarchy among pirates is determined by two things: the bounty on their heads, dictated by their notoriety, and their strength. Daphne, a pirate recognized as the strongest in both aspects, one day spends a night with a navy officer. As dawn breaks, the night comes to an end. Even as she leaves behind the sleeping officer, she never once considers the possibility of meeting him again in the future. If they were ever to cross paths again, it would be best not to face him head-on. **** "You’re in no position to be making accusations. If I had known you’d act like this, I should have just killed you." But she never expected to reunite like this. The man standing before her now bore almost no resemblance to the composed yet gentlemanly figure from that night. "So." "......" "You should have just killed me instead." It was only upon hearing those words that Daphne finally admitted it to herself. She had become entangled—completely, inescapably—with the very royal hound she so despised.

title: Save a Failed Idol’s Life
summary: [Will you accept the special quest “Idol – Cheon Ise”?] Lim Hyunsung, “Master of Taste”, who pioneered the myth of the restaurant industry. After being killed in some kind of incident, he possesses an idol according to the guidance of an unidentified system. “This guy… he’s been a failed idol for 5 years?” Will he be able to save this failed idol with his own hands?

title: From the Diary of a Generally Good and Reasonably Competent Rebel Nobleman
summary: The protagonist, a reincarnated thirty-something Japanese man born as the second son of an earl, was trying to act in the usual way when it comes to reincarnation. He used the knowledge from his previous life to liven up the territory, supported his older brother who would inherit the earldom… and spent his days carefree as the second son. It was a perfectly normal and peaceful wish, and nothing special. However, something appeared that got in the way: the royal family, the royal family, and those connected to them. With repeated interference, everything came to a halt, and even his family was taken away, the protagonist reached his limit of patience and began to dream of “killing the royal family”… and in order to one day make that dream come true, he worked hard every day at his government duties as an earl.

title: Fanatic Divine Cultivator
summary: Two years ago, Xu Xuan was the No.1 genius of the Xu Family and was rather famous among the young generation in Cloud City. His mother died of illness when he was a baby and he wanted to be father's pride. That was why he challenged the person with the much higher cultivation in the martial arts competition. Unfortunately, Xu Xuan lost. And his dantian was broken by vicious enemy. But he didn‘t reconciled at all. For the past two years, he had but he had persisted in cultivating every morning in the hope that there would be a miracle. However, there is not until he met the superior of Mysterious God Realm who was escaping. After a fierce struggle, Xu Xuan swallowed unique treasure Nine-Swallowing Divine Jade and obtained a low-grade Heaven rank cultivation technique Five Spiritual Arts. Xu Xuan would never forget the scenes of how the marriage was annulled yesterday, nor the disdainful gazes of others, let alone their smiles after his dantian had been broken. What legendary road will this ordinary boy from the wilderness embark on？

title: Tensei Shite Inaka de Mofumofu to Slowlife wo Okuritai
summary: The protagonist, Inukai Taizou, was run over by a truck because he was trying to save a Shiba Inu. He died saving the dog and met the Inugami, God of Dogs, due to his kindness in saving the dog and sacrificing himself. This is a Light Novel, the spin-off of Tensei Shite Inaka de Slowlife wo Okuritai. The story happened in the same world as Tensei Shite Inaka de Slowlife wo Okuritai.

title: The No. 1 Villain Saves the World?
summary: Su Mo, Su what? Su Mo? Su—what? Su Mu! Bang! Su Mu slammed the door shut, pressing his back against it as he gulped for air. Damn it! Why did he suddenly remember everything that happened last night—right now of all times? Wasn’t that supposed to be a dream? I… Good news: After all these years, I’ve finally awakened a superpower. Bad news: I’m the No. 1 villain.

title: Joseon Needs a Coup
summary: In order for Joseon to survive under imperialism, I must take control of the military.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical

title: Maybe You Are
summary: Shortly after entering high school, the protagonist meets a strange girl in his class. She casually makes hurtful gaffes, can't read the atmosphere, and even at the entrance ceremony, she went somewhere without permission and went exploring inside the school. She soon became isolated and subject to insidious bullying. The main character also shunned her at first, but due to her attendance number and her seat, he had a lot of contact with her, and although he is confused by her, he begins to get closer to her, and eventually tries to protect her. It became like this. But...
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Reborn in a New Era
summary: When I woke up, they told me I was the True Daughter who had been mistakenly swapped in the Qin Family. But the family already had a so-called False Daughter who had been raised for more than ten years. My family waited for me to feel inferior, jealous, to resent the unfairness of fate, and to sink into the abyss of endless grievance. But as I looked at this brand new era-no war, no hunger, no fear of death- To me, this is truly the best of times.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Anti-Cheater Strategies
summary: Ever since an NPC named Shu ChunChun, had been taken advantage of and used carelessly by the world-hoppers, awakened her consciousness, she knew that the only way to drive out the world-hoppers was to make them fall for her, HARD.
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: Best Son-in-Law
summary: Death did not end his consciousness. Instead, it turned him into a ghost—one that witnessed the truth of the afterlife firsthand. Just when he believes his existence has ended, his soul is reborn into the body of a despised live-in son-in-law. Mocked by society, looked down upon by his wife’s family, and treated as worthless, this man’s life was nothing but humiliation. But everything changes when a soul that has crossed life and death awakens within him. Armed with memories beyond the mortal world, hidden abilities, and an unshakable will, he begins to rise from the bottom. The only problem? His wife is devastatingly beautiful—and now that he’s truly alive again, temptation is harder to ignore. From disgrace to dominance, from ridicule to reverence, this is the story of a man who returns from death to claim power, respect, and his rightful place in the world.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: The Female Detective of the Ming Dynasty
summary: In central Beijing’s Qianyu Alley of Chengqing Neighborhood, a widow named Lu Shanrou lived. Having lost two husbands, she carried a reputation as a “husband-killer.” However, her fame for solving cases far outweighed her infamy. Lu Shanrou was known to crack cases ignored by the authorities—such as identifying the true and false daughters of a noble house or locating the will of a wealthy merchant who passed without time to communicate it. She even solved cases that the government couldn’t handle, such as the mu*der of a newly appointed official in the Chenghuang Temple and a eunuch’s family massacre. There were rumors of a romantic connection between the brilliant widow and Wei Cuicheng, a commander of the Jinyiwei. Wei Cuicheng sternly denied it, saying, “That’s absolutely not true!” But secretly, he thought, “It wouldn’t be bad!”

title: Game PD in the House of Magic
summary: "I will raise a family. By creating a 'game'."
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Mystery, Psychological, Slice of Life

title: Blazing Glory of the Nine Heavens
summary: On the continent of the Nine Heavens, the resources needed for all living beings to survive are on the verge of depletion. Faced with this looming catastrophe, where will the countless races of the world go? And who can save them from suffering and despair? It is him — a young man who rose from an insignificant corner of the Nine Heavens Continent, carrying within his heart the determination to become an unparalleled powerhouse. Step by step, he advances toward his goal. For the woman he loves, he wages a bloody battle against the King of Demons. For his master’s final wish, he points his blade toward the vast primordial universe. For all living beings, he sacrifices himself, using his Nine Slashes to bring order to heaven and earth. Among the countless lives beneath the heavens, who shall rule supreme? A true hero stands against fate itself. Hot-blooded warriors — will you fight alongside me across the Nine Heavens?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance

title: The Emperor Descending the Heavens
summary: Hundreds of thousands of years ago, the Heavenly Imperial Palace tore open the void and entered the Wilderness, opening the Cultivation Era. Tens of thousands of years later, the youth entered the void and returned. After cultivating for a thousand years, he established the legend of being an undying. The Heavenly Imperial Palace opened, concealing the secrets of the ancient era, exposing the mysterious veil to the world. The mysterious Heavenly Mystery, Void Flows, Hell's Yellow Springs, Ancient Sea of Stars, Ancient Dao of Stars, Ancient Desolation of Immortals, Ancient Realm of Heavens, Sea of Immortals, Shattered Dao Domain, and Divine Realm of the Nine Heavens were all born. However, in the vast world, all of this was just the tip of the iceberg.

title: The Return of the Demon King
summary: The final Heavenly Demon of the Celestial Demon Sect. The Immoral Heavenly Demon, Cheon Mujin. After death, he returned as an emperor with all ten thousand demons beneath his feet. To the time when he was 20 years old, deployed on the frontlines. There will be no more regrets. Everything he missed in his past life—he will now seize it all and stand above the heavens.

title: The Nemesis Cannot Be Turned into a Loyal Dog
summary: I've always considered Shen Zhizhou my sworn enemy, harboring a secret resentment toward him for a thousand years. He had everything-the affection of our sect, the admiration of our peers, and the favor of the heavens themselves. A paragon of virtue like him... I truly wanted to drag him down and trample him into the mud. But when I finally stood over him, my foot pressed against his body, he... got hard. "Yunqian, I want you to step here, too..." He pointed toward the prominent tent pitched three inches below his navel.
genres: Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Xianxia

title: Boss Fu, Your Wife Has Gone to Set Up a Fortune-Telling Stall Again… Again… and Again
summary: After her master's passing, mystical genius Lin Xi descends the mountain to make a living by setting up a fortune-telling stall—all while searching for her fiancé. Customer: "Master, when will my son's destined true love appear?" Lin Xi: "There’s no true love destined for him—but a true husband, yes." Customer: "Master, I've been dreaming of a ghost lately. Please exorcise it for me!" Lin Xi: "That ghost is your father. You visited the wrong grave, and he wants you to recognize the right one." Customer: "Master, my mother has been missing for over twenty years." Lin Xi: "Your father killed her and buried her in the backyard." ... The head of the Fu Corporation, a man known for being distant and indifferent to women, unexpectedly enters a flash marriage with a young fortune teller. Everyone keeps guessing when Boss Fu will get a divorce. But as they wait... the situation starts to shift in unexpected ways. Top celebrities cry and beg the little fortune teller for help! Influential figures are willing to pay fortunes just to meet her! Even the government reaches out, hoping to collaborate with her. People rush to book a session: "Master, I want a reading too!" One day, Lin Xi sets up her stall as usual. Fu Jingyao corners her against a wall: "Wife, read my fortune." Lin Xi remains expressionless: "Working hours. I only talk business, not emotions." Fu Jingyao pulls out all his bank cards: "All my money is yours." Lin Xi's eyes light up: "What do you want to know?" The man’s dark eyes glimmer with grievance as he murmurs: "Wife, when will we have our wedding night?" Lin Xi: "..." The man tightens his grip around her waist, his voice deep and husky: "Not answering? Then let’s make it tonight." ________________________________________ (Genius Mystic Master × Super Wealthy Wife-Doting CEO. Arranged Marriage Turns to Love. Plot-Focused, with Various Mystical Subplots.)
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Romance

title: The Trush
summary: This is the third and the last part of the story arc collectively known as The Legend of Chu Liuxiang [楚留香傳奇]. Although not absolutely necessary, reading the first two books is recommended, since there are references to these books. Returning from the Great Desert (see Book 2), Chu Liuxiang and Hu Tiehua have a series of encounters with Li Yuhan and his wife, Liu Wumei, a former apprentice of the Stone Avalokiteśvara (Shi Guanyin). Eventually, these encounters led Chu Liuxiang to the final showdown against the Shuimu Yinji, the mistress of the Holy Water Palace, and solved the mystery of the ‘Trush’. The chapter started from chapter 63 as the continuation from The Great Desert which ended at chapter 62.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Mystery, Wuxia

title: Fantasy Galaxy: Why Are There Goblins and Orcs in Space?
summary: In a galactic civilization where goblins and orcs have established empires, I, a middle-aged man, was somehow thrown into this universe. I witnessed a world where goblins and orcs have built interstellar empires. Strangely enough, in this world where spaceships travel back and forth, monsters exist, and there are dragon-slaying hunters and mages who seem like adventurers. I struggled to survive and eventually encountered the Celestial Beings, who are like gods. Will I receive a cheat ability?

title: From Death To Destiny
summary: Parasite. That had been Margarita's nickname for a long time. The last descendant of the Isirian royal family, living as a parasite within the Castor imperial palace. A shameless freeloader engaged to Crown Prince Allen solely due to her inheritance rights, despite having nothing else to her name. Exhausted by the contempt and disregard, Margarita vented her fury on Allen. “Do you think people are kind to you because they like you? It’s only because you’re the Crown Prince!” Margarita prided herself on being the only one who could despise the beloved Allen. That was her sense of self-worth and the driving force of her life. No matter how great you are. No matter how much the nobles look down on me. I’m still the one standing beside you. She was foolish. She should have realized sooner that nothing in this world lasts forever. Branded a traitor and executed, Margarita returns to her childhood. Seeing young Allen’s face made her want to strangle him. She wanted to demand answers: Why? Why did you kill me? “Thank you… for your concern.” Stay calm. If you act as you did before, you’ll be killed again. Remember the people who risked their lives to protect a nobody like you. “I’m sorry. I’ve been so rude to you until now.” Instead of baring her claws and protecting her pride, Margarita lowered her head and apologized. She had to hide the blade in her heart, crawl like a dog, and marry him at any cost. However... “I will marry Margarita. I want to die as her husband. That is my final wish.” Just when she thought she could finally be happy, Allen dies of illness. As Margarita falls into despair, Oberon appears before her. For some reason, he reminds her of Allen...

title: The Alchemists of Intertwined Fingers: The Girl Who Dies if We Let Go, and the Boy Who Can’t Use Alchemy
summary: ​"The only one who can save a life like mine—is you, the 'impotent' mage who cannot even use alchemy." ​Earthfelia Alchemy Academy is a prestigious institution where students of various races gather to become first-class alchemists. Theodore, a boy who enrolled for a specific reason despite having a unique constitution that prevents him from using alchemy, meets Yuyuel, an angelic girl suffering from a strange disease that is slowly turning her body into crystal. ​Currently, there is only one way to stop the crystallization: Theodore must constantly use his unique power—the ability to nullify any alchemy he touches—on Yuyuel. ​In search of clues regarding the shadowy organization that holds the secret to her illness, the two set out to investigate neighboring countries plagued by unnatural troubles. ​This is the story of a "two-in-one" alchemist duo, forced to spend every moment of their day in physical contact, as they yearn for one another and defy a cruel fate.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: The Second Son of The Marquis Runs Away from Home ~ Lacking Talent, He Abandons Everything and Becomes an Adventurer ~
summary: "I can't take it anymore..." Constantly compared to his prodigious elder brother, who is hailed as a genius, Serk strives relentlessly to earn recognition. However, unable to bear it any longer, Serk reaches his breaking point and runs away not only from home but from the country itself. He becomes an adventurer in the land he escapes to, but...
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: I’m a Magical Girl, Is It Reasonable for My Daughter to Be an Evil Witch?
summary: Qin Xin, 37 years old, is the retired strongest magical girl Xing Mang, and also a single parent dad facing a mid-life crisis. For many years, he who lost his wife and fighting spirit has been escaping with his daughter. Exhausting all efforts to avoid everything in the magical world, seeking a peaceful ordinary life. Then... "Senior, you don't want your daughter to become a magical girl, right?" Forced to come out of retirement under threat, Qin Xin with magic...

title: My New Life as an Isekai S**cubus Streamer: Somehow, I Linked Up with Modern Japan and My Otherworld Broadcast Actually Succeeded!
summary: A TS Succubus is starting her streaming career! A former man reincarnated into another world as a S**cubus has decided to start a certain project. That project is... Streaming. Literally sending video footage across various dimensions. Against all odds, her magic pulled off a miracle: she successfully transmitted her broadcast to modern-day Japan. This is the story of a complete idiot—a S**cubus—who managed to pull off the unprecedented feat of streaming from a fantasy world to a modern world where magic doesn’t even exist.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The Obsessive Male Lead Caught Me While I Was Trying To Ditch My Ex-Husband
summary: My husband whispered sweetly to me, “Hurry up and die, Darling.” ‘I, who never lived her life to the fullest let alone loved, am dying like this?’ Maybe. ‘Was it you who plotted the poisoning?’ [ The 23rd Imperial Emperor, Gloria Blake Vierant, died brutally at the hands of her husband. ] It turned out that he mu*dered both my father and my friend. I wanted revenge against the husband who mocked us with that gentle face. “Your Majesty?” “…!” After making that eerie vow, my bloody “ex-husband” stood in front of me again. Regression? Past? It didn’t matter. That damn bastard was in front of me as my fiancé once again! “Marquis Erun Lebossi.” “Yes, Your Majesty.” ‘I’ll return your words to you.’ “Please die, Darling.” Two months before the Imperial marriage. ‘If I don’t do anything, I’ll die at my husband’s hand just like my father.’ Now, I needed to avoid marriage and gain allies. I thought of the perfect one. “I command you.” ‘You always avoided me in the past, and even more after I married.’ “Marry me, Kaien Ludenberg.” ‘I’d rather live a farce with you than marry my husband again.’

title: Starting a Frugal Life with my Neighbor: How About Spending Time in one Room to Save on Electricity Costs?
summary: It’s not like I’m struggling with money, but I could use a bit more extra cash. Yet increasing my income was impossible due to school regulations prohibiting part-time jobs. So, the only option was for me to cut down on expenses. Similarly, my neighbor wasn’t exactly in financial trouble, but she also wanted more money to spend. And thus began the frugal life of mine and hers. For example, we spent time together in the same room to save on electricity costs, tried cooking meals we hadn’t attempted before, and engaged in various activities to economize. This is a story about how the two of us got closer as we did various things together.
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Boy Who Believes in the Demon God and His Shadow
summary: "If only I could smile... thought the bastard holding a gun who had two shadows."

title: The Otherworldly Heroic Tale of the Only One Who Can See Levels
summary: An ordinary young man gains a "Divine Blessing" and sets out on a journey to save another world! Itsuki, who suddenly found himself transported to a different world, is captured by bandits and sold into s*avery. In this world, the lives of s*aves are treated as cheap and expendable. However, mysteriously, he is the only one who can see "Levels" and "HP." Furthermore, it is a game-like world where he feels no pain. Realizing that he can see exactly how far he is from death, he figures out how to grow stronger while prioritizing his safety in this harsh, parallel world. His life in another world begins as a s*ave. First, he decides to break free from his chains and fight to gain true freedom in this world.

title: Barrier Magic Is the Strongest! – I Have Been Blessed With the Protection of the Creator God and Barrier Magic, and I Want to Live a Leisurely and Peaceful Life in a World of Magic –
summary: Dying in an accident, I was reborn as the second son of a viscount with the protection of the Creator God, barrier magic, and life magic. I was sexually harassed by my mother in my previous life, and from that trauma I hated touching or being touched by people, but my trauma gradually healed under the watchful eye of my kind family. I want to live a stress-free life by devising the protection and barrier magic given by the Creator God, but the Creator God, angry at those who tried to harm me, descended and I was able to use the power of God: Kamui. The royal family, high-ranking nobles, and the immortal birds and old dragons who were given the protection of the Creator God also came, and my peaceful life was always disturbed. When will the day come when this young child, who has acquired great powers and drags everyone around him down, can live a carefree and peaceful life?

title: I Kept Saying That Everything Was That Person’s Will, and Now I Can’t Back Down.
summary: It's exactly as the title says. A comedy novel about a man who can't back down, a maid who can't back down, and misguided friends.
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: Creating Urban Legends In Japan
summary: After transmigrating to a parallel world, Kambara Shinji obtained a notebook that was known as “Real Records of Urban Legends”. Any urban legends that were written on the notebook would form and become real in the real world, and in this parallel world, many urban legends from Kambara Shinji’s past life didn’t exist.

title: On the Night of Genocide, I, the Emperor, Was Summoned by Future Generations
summary: One hundred thousand years ago, a foreign realm invaded — the earth turned red for a thousand miles, and all living beings were plunged into misery and ruin! The Great Emperor Lu Xuan, in order to protect all the beings under heaven, entered the Abyss of Heaven alone. Using his own body as a seal, he suppressed the entrance to the alien realm! But unexpectedly, one hundred thousand years later, he suddenly received a bloodline summons from his descendants! “Ancestor, are you still alive?” “If you don’t return soon, the Lu family will… perish completely!” …On that day, the Heaven-Burying Divine Sword, sealed away for one hundred thousand years, reemerged into the world. The heavens wept blood, and ten thousand swords cried in sorrow! “This Emperor has merely grown old — not died!” “A pack of ungrateful wretches — how are you worthy of this Emperor’s protection!” From the depths of the Abyss of Heaven, Lu Xuan’s fury surged to the heavens, his icy voice echoing through all realms: “For the sake of all heavens, I have guarded the Abyss for one hundred thousand years — and you insects dare insult my descendants, sever my legacy!” “If that’s how it is… then I’ll drag all the heavens down to the grave with me!” On that day, the seal of the Abyss was broken — the foreign realm returned, and all heavens fell into ruin once more!

title: The Ruffian Princess Is Too Much!
summary: The troublemaker of the divine realm, Raphaella, the Goddess of Corruption and Revelry. As punishment for shattering the Mirror of the Gods, she ends up possessing the body of an ugly, disgraced imperial princess.To return to the divine realm, she must collect the fragments of the broken mirror and find someone who can die in her place.Trapped in a human body and forced to endure life day by day, Raphaella encounters Duke William, a rigid principlist known as “the Empire’s Final Standard.” “If the world were full of stiff people like you, it would snap instead of bending. You need someone easygoing like me too.” “Your Highness isn’t bending with flexibility—you seem to fly off in completely random directions.” “Why? Want me to send you flying too?” “I’ll pass.” William constantly sighs and rubs his temples at her utterly unprincesslike speech and behavior, while Raphaella treats him without the slightest restraint, despite his stone-like inflexibility.The narrow-minded Duke Klimt and the disaster-prone ruffian princess Raphaella. Two people with completely opposite personalities grow close while bickering as they travel together in search of the mirror fragments.But soon, ominous shadows appear on their path across the continent, and an unknown conspiracy slowly tightens its grip around Raphaella. “Raphaella, have you finally found someone who’ll die for you?” “Shut up unless you’re the one dying in their place.” “You really never change.” Where will the goddess Raphaella’s choice ultimately lead?The Ruffian Princess Is Too Much!

title: Reborn Before the Top Scholar’s Fame
summary: Mu Jiaojiao had a benefactor who saved her life. After her rebirth, she's determined to repay him. She meticulously attends to every detail of her benefactor's family's needs, even more so than a proper daughter-in-law. Everyone assumes she's in love with one of the Zhan family's sons. However, in the 17th year of the Yanjing era, after Zhan Qiyu becomes the top scholar (zhuàngyuán), she leaves a letter and departs, believing her debt repaid. The newly appointed top scholar, dressed in red robes and riding a steed, chases her down the imperial city streets. "Mu Jiaojiao, if you leave today, I will die today." "I will only live if you are here." Mu Jiaojiao thinks Zhan Qiyu is ill. The once aloof and elegant young man has become a sickly weakling, and she can't bear to leave him. Slowly, she discovers his true nature: a powerful and influential minister behind a delicate façade, capable of bringing down even high-ranking officials. Everything is different from what she expected, and she tries to leave. Unexpectedly, the Mu family receives betrothal gifts from two influential men on the same day. A powerful man grabs her chin, "Jiaojiao, do you want to be the Crown Princess? Unfortunately, he might not become the crown prince." Mu Jiaojiao looks at the ribbon on her wrist, sighing, "I have no feelings for him, and I only see you as my benefactor." But Zhan Qiyu can't let go: "Jiaojiao, I told you, without you, I will die." She surrenders. Short Scene: It's common knowledge in the capital that Madam Zhan never attends social gatherings. Therefore, few have seen her, leading to speculation about her appearance or hidden illnesses. Then, someone spots the top minister with a stunningly beautiful woman, and the entire court is abuzz, believing the minister's image of a devoted husband is ruined. The next day, however, Zhan Qiyu requests a first-rank imperial title for his wife in court. Everyone breathes a sigh of relief. It turns out that while he's outwardly charming, he’s deeply devoted at home. The “other woman,” meanwhile, finding out she will become a first-rank noblewoman, collapses onto the bed, crying for help and medicine.

title: The Misanthropic Duke Has Been Doting On Me Since Day One, But I Plan to Leave After The 9 Months.
summary: Just as the marriage between her sister Margaret and the Duke has been arranged, Daisy is shocked to learn that her sister has unexpectedly become pregnant before the betrothal ceremony. To fulfill her sister's wish, Daisy is ordered by her parents to pretend to be her sister and marry into the Duke's family for 9 months until her sister's secret childbirth is over. Daisy is under the impression that she can fool the Duke, who is famous for his good looks and misanthropy, but for some reason, he begins to aggressively approach her from the very first day.......

title: Turning My Life Around Through Dimensional Monopoly
summary: More important than effort is a single room. For me, that single room is a dimension only I can open.

title: My Dead Husband Sent Me a Wedding Invitation
summary: Three years after my husband was buried, I received a scarlet invitation. The groom was listed as my late husband, Xie Shaoqian, and the bride was my best friend, Wen Ningyue, who had stayed by my side throughout my three years of widowhood. Tucked inside the invitation was a photo of a child. On the back, a single sentence was written: "Chen Yingnan, it's time to pay back the second child you owe him."

title: Cheat Skill: Living in Another World That Starts With An Online Shop: Rise To The Top With The Power to Buy Anything
summary: On his thirtieth birthday, the main character, Risei Susumu, got involved in a summoning to another world and is transported to that world. However, he was left behind in the in-between world because he was not the original target of the summoning. The story is that God gave him a cheat skill, and he uses it to rise to the top.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: Transmigrated into a Stepmother Control Group: Bear Love Parenting Goes Viral on the Baby Show
summary: Top-tier young actress Shen Qingqing was chosen as the control group for a variety show about a wealthy stepmother raising a child. The heroine is her illegitimate sister Shen Linyan, who is virtuous and kind, treating her stepson as her own son. In contrast, Shen Qingqing is portrayed as a spoiled and vicious daughter who mistreats her stepson. The two participated in the same parenting variety show. Shen Qingqing became the control group for the heroine, and she was criticized as a vicious stepmother. Her reputation suffered, and she ended up in a mental hospital. System: Do you want to save yourself? If you want to, complete the system task to become an all-powerful mistress of a wealthy family and be more virtuous than the original heroine! It’s difficult to be a perfect goddess, so why compete with the original heroine in virtue? Aren’t hot spring spas and global travels more attractive? Divorce is even more impossible, as the rich old man is generous and doesn’t like to go home! Shen Qingqing decided to give up. It’s better to be carefree than a stepmother. She wanted to relax and be herself! But why are the two men in the family looking at her with more passion? Even her parents-in-law are moved, gifting her a mansion and a yacht. The comments in the variety show are full of praise for Shen Qingqing: "I envy Shen Qingqing," "Shen Qingqing is the king of children," "Shen Qingqing’s successful case of raising children in reverse..." Education experts also praised Shen Qingqing for her advanced educational ideas and ability to befriend children. "Mr. Bear" Shen Qingqing becomes an internet sensation! System: My program is malfunctioning! The housekeeper once warned Zhou Jiayan to be wary of stepmothers bullying their stepsons, and Zhou Jiayan took it to heart, even showing concern on camera. They bought two ice creams, and the stepmother ate one and a half, leaving only the bu*t of the cone for him. She also warned him that children would get stomach aches from eating too much. Later, the stepmother ended up in pain from eating too much. Other mothers in the variety show wake up early to prepare breakfast and care for their children. Zhou Jiayan sighed deeply as he looked at his stepmother, who hadn’t gotten up even after being called three times. He had to move a stool to the kitchen, heat milk and toast, and use the aroma of food to wake her up. When they encountered a fierce white goose during a task, other mothers protected their children, but his stepmother crouched behind him and said, "Yanyan, you are a man, you must protect the girl!" He was laughed at by other children, but his stepmother insisted on restoring his honor! When she turned the kindergarten art presentation into her solo performance, the little girl in the audience had sparkling eyes. Zhou Jiayan wondered, is his stepmother more powerful than he thought? And more importantly, she was willing to spend time with him. He seemed to like his stepmother a little more... After an accidental head impact, Zhou Yexuan suddenly recalled memories from his past life. To avoid his son’s tragic fate, Zhou Yexuan returned home that night. As soon as he entered, he saw Zhou Jiayan covered in paint, his chubby face wrinkled, and his face streaked with tears. Then he noticed the woman who was usually noble and reserved was also covered in paint. Zhou Jiayan cried out, "I’m a child, and you’re already an adult!" Shen Qingqing was momentarily stunned, then cried, "This is my first time being a stepmother too! Why should I give in to you?" Later, Zhou Yexuan saw the two of them, one big and one small, huddled together. He felt a headache but was also satisfied. The heroine lacked a childhood in her previous life, so she let herself go in this life, resembling the original owner. Age difference: 10 years. The stepson is not the male protagonist’s biological son, and the male protagonist is not remarried. The protagonists are not perfect but help each other improve, forming a happy family.

title: Body-Snatched and Made a Concubine, I Stole the System and Staged a Counterattack
summary: [Awakening after Body Snatching, Not a Power Fantasy, Plot-Driven, Minor Ensemble Cast] Lin Ruochu, the legitimate daughter of the General's Manor, was possessed by Body Snatching during her fifteenth birthday ceremony. A time-traveling woman trafficked by the System used every means to "Capture" the Marquis' heir, causing Lin Ruochu to be betrayed by all, her reputation ruined, and confined in the Marquis' manor as a concubine with the status of an unofficial mistress. Once she regained control of her body, Lin Ruochu vowed to restore her derailed life to its rightful course. Unexpectedly, during her struggle against the Body Snatching and the System, she gradually uncovered the truth of this world. Not your typical domestic drama, worldview mystery—all plot holes will be filled later. The female lead relies mainly on her wits; the System's golden finger is not overpowered. [Has a CP, 1v1, male is chaste, female is remarried]
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I’m in Marvel, My Wife Is Scarlet Witch
summary: Li Bufan crossed into the Marvel Universe and accidentally saved the Scarlet Witch. After three years of interaction, the Scarlet Witch finally became his wife, and they lived peacefully and happily. Then, a group of uninvited guests arrived and shattered this peace. Magneto, Professor-X, Avengers, Abomination, Venom, Loki, Ronan the Accuser, Lord of Dark Dimension Dormammu ...... and even the big purple-faced potato! What could Li Bufan do? To protect and maintain his happy life with his wife, he could only rely on the real-world extraction system to extract skills from the other worlds. Extracting, Extracting ...... Magneto: "You are the future of mutants!" Lord of Dark Dimension Dormammu: "Many people say I am a demon. My friend, believe me, this is definitely your illusion. There is someone even more ruthless than me on Earth." Thanos: “Don’t fight! What you say is indeed correct. Can't I just accept it? " …...
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Sci-fi

title: Because It’s Uselessly Pretty
summary: He cherished her more than his own life, loved her as if she were a part of himself.— “…There’s another man. If you truly wish for my happiness, never contact me again.”On their wedding day, Eun-se disappeared. Tae-heon didn’t look for her— because he feared he might see her smiling beside another man. Because he feared he’d rip apart the bastard who stole her away.Then, one day, Han Eun-se—who had vanished without a trace—appeared again. Still beautiful, even in her miserable circumstances.The moment they met again, he realized it. The thing that had been torn to shreds all along— was his own heart.The years and scars that had been violently ripped apart— they belonged to Yoon Tae-heon alone. Eun-se froze. Into her trembling ears, a cold voice cut through. “How could I ever forget? The fiancée who ran away on our wedding day.” “……!” “And not just ran—she fell for another man.” Light flickered in her shaking pupils. The man ground out his words through clenched teeth. “It’s time to take everything back. Every filthy thing you’ve done.” His devastatingly beautiful face twisted in despair.Well, who told you to be uselessly beautiful?Illustration: Michel

title: Give Me Up, Hold Me Tight
summary: This is the novel that shares the same name as the annual fashion romance drama《Stay With Me》, starring Joe Chen, Wang Kai, and Qiao Renliang. There are many different wedding dress designs. Princess-style, fishtail-style, strapless-style...... There are also many different kinds of love. Romantic, heart-pounding, sad...... On this Earth, the most beautiful wedding dress is the one when I marry you. That love that's the best on this Earth that you wear is that which I still tightly hold in my palm after I gave everything up. *** Once she unexpectedly drowned, part of her brain lacked oxygen for a long time, making the famous clothing designer Li Weiwei lose parts of her memory. Thus, her memories stopped at when she was 23 years old. The boyfriend who she was mutually passionately in love with in her memories had unexpectedly become her rival, and a stranger even became her fiancé. Li Weiwei wasn't convinced that she would break up with her ex-boyfriend Chen Yidu, so she tried hard to to investigate previous events. In order to protect Weiwei and get his own fiancée back, her fiancé thwarted Weiwei's investigations by every possible means, keeping watch over her surroundings. Li Weiwei recalled the past and discovered that she and the person beside her had gradually forgotten their first dream while they were busying themselves. The reason that Weiwei and Chen Yidu broke up was also because as the two of them were in the middle of the process of chasing after their occupations, they neglected their love and their bond and walked even farther down the path of grudges and misunderstandings. Chen Yidu misunderstood the relationship between Weiwei and his parent and broke up with her in the end. The 30-year-old Li Weiwei decided to change her current situation, and step by step, she untangled past misunderstandings and forgot her previous differences with her rival, not only retrieving her romance, but also regaining her first heart and her dreams.

title: My Divine Pet System
summary: A young middle school student faces a life-altering choice. Destined for mediocrity and without a War Spiritual Bloodline, he dreams of transcending his ordinary existence and becoming a high-status War Spiritualist. His world is transformed when he becomes bound to the ""Godly Pet Evolution System,"" enabling him to activate his War Spiritual Bloodline and cultivate divine pets, even from the most unlikely sources. Armed with this system, he defies expectations by nurturing underdog spirits into formidable allies. The seemingly weak flower spirit evolves under his care, as does his Lord White Dragon, challenging the mightiest thunder-attribute battle spirits. Even when presented with a Diamond Demonic Spirit Card, he counters with three Epic-Demon Spirit Cards of his own. His journey takes an unexpected turn as powerful entities, including the Six-Tailed Demon Fox, the Phoenix Holy Maiden, and the Queen of the Seas, vie to become his second battle spirit. Faced with a wealth of choices, he refuses to settle for just one and ambitiously aims to harness them all.
genres: Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Mystery, Xuanhuan

title: The Master Asks the Spring Breeze with a Sword
summary: I transmigrated as the ‘Black Moonlight’ Master of a yandere villain. The system told me: “You have to bully him relentlessly! Make him blacken!” I gave the little bun’s cheeks a firm squeeze. This kid had a split personality.

title: Survive as the Villain’s Pet Weasel
summary: I possessed a weasel prisoner in a world where prisoners are persecuted. You need to eat gems to maintain your human form. Every day too! By the way, did you rob the safe? “Let’s steal.” In order to survive, he decided to steal the legendary jewel ‘Kleia’s Tears’ in the imperial palace. * * * Polished hard shoes touched the white fur strewn across the flower bed. “It’s a weasel.” The gleaming golden hair flowed down his tilted head, his eyes wide open. “It’s white… … , small.” When I woke up after fainting, I became the prince’s pet weasel? “Beep?” * * * The double life of a pet weasel and a maid that started out of nowhere! But why can’t I see the jewel I’m looking for, and I keep running into only the beasts with their own stories? ‘We have to leave here before the original story begins.’ My only goal is to survive with the weakest body! Will I be able to survive?

title: Golden Haired Summoner
summary: I thought I was dead, but when I woke up, I was reincarnated as a nobleman's daughter?! The only thing I did in the seventeen years of my first life was studying. Now that I'm alive again, I won't live just to study! The second life of an ordinary middle school girl with a slightly strange personality, Geenie, begins an unstoppable journey on this continent!​

title: I’ll Live as a Villain Obsessed Over by a Magical Girl
summary: There’s only one way to avoid the bad ending. That is to live as a villain.
genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural

title: In a World Without God
summary: A battle-hardened mercenary captain, allying with a princess and a goddess incarnate, falls in the throes of war, only to awaken 80 years later in the body of a child. Believing his allies had triumphed, he is stunned to find their history veiled in shadows and deceit. Embark on an epic quest with our hero as he unravels the twisted webs of lies and reclaims the truth that imprisoned his world

title: A Dragon Lives in My Inventory
summary: I started raising a dragon in my inventory… and became a powerhouse that the entire world is after.

title: I Got Married That Day, The Fox King and Snake Lord Forced Me to Marry
summary: When I was fifteen, I went to the river to bathe and encountered a large White Snake. As a result, that night I developed a strange illness with a high fever that wouldn't subside. My whole body became paralyzed, and my stomach swelled up as if I were ten months pregnant. Paralyzed for three years, I became a cripple that everyone disliked. While my parents worried daily about me not being able to get married, a man as beautiful as a celestial being volunteered to come to our door. Not only was he willing to marry me, but he was also happy to take care of me, paralyzed in bed? Where in the world is there such a good thing as a meat pie falling from the sky? When I was alone with him, I saw a section of a fox tail accidentally slip out from behind his buttocks. This man was actually a fox in disguise. The night the fox came to the door as a son-in-law, my whole family was tragically mu*dered, leaving only me out of seven people. Was the mu*derer the Fox Spirit willing to take care of my bodily functions, or the mysterious and aloof Snake Demon, or the free Taoist Priest of unknown origin, or someone else entirely? On the night of the souls' return, my deceased Older Sister came back to seek my life. She repeatedly said that the mu*derer who killed the whole family was me! How could the mu*derer be me?!

title: Palace of Flickering Memories
summary: When the Crown Prince cherished his Bright Moonlight as the center of his world, I voluntarily relinquished my position as Principal Consort. All of Chang'an mocked the Kong Clan, a lineage of a hundred years, for producing a daughter from a branch family so willing to debase herself. They did not understand that in the high-stakes chess game of the inner palace, the most brilliant players are often those who remain outside the board. I withdrew at the height of the fervor. For two years, I focused on only three things: studying history, gathering intelligence, and cultivating my inner self. When the Eastern Palace was once again left in a shambles due to the Crown Princess's "innocence and whimsy," I happened to be holding an umbrella, passing the Bamboo Pavilion where the Crown Prince and I once sat together to listen to the falling snow. He stood in the snow, his eyes heavy with exhaustion. When he looked up, he saw half of my face veiled by the swirling snow, my features as serene and composed as a painting. He froze. In that moment, the game was won. I never fought for that position; I simply waited. I waited for him to treat a fish-eye like a precious pearl, and for his love to devolve into an endless, suffocating obsession. In the end, all that remained was my impeccable presence-a face that would forever uphold the dignity and decorum of the imperial family.

title: Decoding the Ghost Stories in Fantasy
summary: One of them is me.

title: What’s Under Kamiyama-san’s Paper Bag?
summary: On his very first day of starting high school, Namito Kominato's homeroom teacher has him sit behind a strange girl who wears a paper bag over her head and is always soaking wet with sweat. Her name is Samidare Kamiyama, a extremely shy girl with severe social anxiety. Ultimately, she meets Hinata Arai (the student council president who's kind and helpful, but alarmingly obsessed with her uniform) and Harusame Amano (a girl who only speaks at the magical girl panels at anime conventions). These three unfortunate, but beautiful girls form a "conversation club", opening the curtain on this somewhat pitiful and comedic tale of adolescent romance!

title: The Legend Of WuKong
summary: "Five hundred years is a long time, isn't it? Nothing is eternal, so just forget it." This story does not follow the single narrative mode in "Journey to the West", but is narrated in three clues: the first is the inseparable love between Zhu Bajie and Yue, the second is the passionate but repressed relationship between Sun Wukong and Zi Xia, The third is the sad affection between Tang Sanzang and Little White Dragon.

title: Burning Vengeance
summary: With tears continuously flowing. Her heart was sliced seeing her helpless child who was forced to witness the horror that had just occurred. In her soft whisper, she tried to calm Cin Han, even though she herself felt shattered and powerless. Outside, the wind blew softly, as if the world around them was unaware of the tragedy that had just taken place inside the small house. Phang Lok continued his work as if nothing had happened, but in his heart, guilt and fear began to gnaw away. Cin Han, although his small body was filled with pain, held a determination in his still innocent heart. A determination to protect his mother and find justice for the suffering they endured. He realized that his life had just changed forever, and even though he was just a small child, a fire began to ignite within him—a fire of courage and justice. On the other hand, Lui Kim Eng, who witnessed part of the incident from afar, felt a mixture of fear and anger. She knew that something terrible had happened, and in her heart, a sense of sympathy and a desire to help Cin Han and his mother grew. However, as the daughter of an official, she knew that her actions were limited by the rules and status of her family. This story has just begun, and amidst the suffering they endured, the friendship between Cin Han and Lui Kim Eng might become the key to uncovering the mystery and crime veiled behind the magnificent walls of the Lui family home. A long journey awaits them, filled with challenges, battles, and the revelation of truth that will change their lives forever. Against the backdrop of a world full of intrigue and power, "Shadows Behind the Garden" (Bayang-Bayang di Balik Taman) becomes a silent witness to the determination of a small child who wants to defend justice, as well as the seed of friendship that might become hope amidst the darkness.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Historical, Martial Arts, Wuxia, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: All Hail My Wife
summary: After transmigrating, I ended up with a husband for free. He was handsome, but his brain didn't quite work right. Perfect. That just meant I could brainwash him every day. I sat up straight and asked in a low, serious voice, "What is the first thing you do every morning when you wake up?" A Shou kept a straight face and answered earnestly, "Find my wife." Without changing my expression, I continued, "And besides your wife..." A Shou answered fluently, "Everyone else is a liar." Me: "If you don't listen to your wife today..." A Shou: "You'll only have bitter melon to eat from now on." Me: "Eating bitter melon every day..." A Shou: "Makes life a bitter fray." "Summary." "Love my wife-in this life, the next life, and the life after that." "Let's eat." He closed his eyes devoutly and pressed his palms together. "All Hail My Wife." The pre-meal ritual was complete.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Was Naked When I Reached the Other World
summary: 「I was just enjoying my time at the pub, and then—..!」 Yoshida Shuta is just your average 32-year old dropout. Well, that is other than his numerous amount of part-time jobs! From convenience stores to construction and even civil engineering! Yoshida Shuta has accomplished much in his modest thirty-two years. 「Money makes the world go around. I’ll do anything to make it, even if that means taking up every profession in the world!」 Enjoying his night after leaving the pub, he finds himself suddenly transported to a fantasy world…with no clothes!
