Thought of as suspicious, he’s immediately taken prisoner and forced to work to sustain the lives of a small village. 「Seriously, why am I naked?!」 The story of a single bachelor who climbs his way up the social ladder, starts a harem, and fights monsters—all without clothes!
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: The Dream the Beast Saw
summary: A man who had lost everything found himself reincarnated as a dying child… In a world of sword and magic, torn by war and plagued by man-eating beasts. And there, the man encounters a girl called Ise. Through repeated encounters and by overcoming danger, the man grows stronger bit by bit. But an unavoidable, devastating battle draws near. In the midst of a life-or-death struggle, what he sees... could it be something called love, or perhaps salvation…?
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Genius Hitter’s Baseball Game Survival Guide
summary: A genius batter gets s**ked into a baseball game! Jun Seunghoo, a genius hitter who dominates the league both in skill and arrogance—so much so that even his fans jokingly call him “the God of Baseball, the Jerk of a Person”—suddenly finds himself pulled into a baseball video game. Trapped in the game and fully inhabiting his character, Seunghoo must rely on his unparalleled talent and wits to survive. Thus begins the fierce survival saga of the genius batter… in a world where every match is life or death!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Psychological, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: First Love Code
summary: At the age of 18, Yu Chi worked part-time on a film set while studying. During that time, he got involved with Sheng Li, a rising young starlet. Two months later, after filming wrapped up, Sheng Li patted his face and smiled, saying, “Let me introduce you to a manager. With your looks, you’re bound to become famous.” Yu Chi thought for a moment, then obediently nodded. “Okay.” Little did he know, this was Sheng Li’s way of giving him a breakup settlement. Later, Yu Chi finally rose to fame but carried a public secret with him: “I’ve been in a relationship before—when I was 18. It lasted two months. It was my first love, and I was the one who got dumped. If I ever get the chance, I want to win her back.” Fans: “Who is this mysterious first love? Who on earth had the audacity to dump him??” Rivals: “He’s really pulling out all the stops for fame, huh? What kind of ‘first love’ act is this? Let’s see when he trips up.” The short-sighted Sheng Li: “….” She watched as Yu Chi, now exuding icy aloofness, walked past her. Is this really how you pursue someone??? ________________________________________ Due to a movie project, the two were cast in the same production again. This time, Sheng Li was the female lead, and Yu Chi was the male lead. During their kissing scene, they went through over ten NGs, leaving Sheng Li flushed. Yu Chi sincerely apologized to the director: “Sorry, Director. I’ll make sure it passes next time.” Later, just before Sheng Li was about to film a kissing scene with the second male lead, Yu Chi passed by and leaned down to whisper in her ear: “Sister, if you NG more than three times, I’m coming to settle accounts with you tonight. The code is the same as back then, and you better not lock the door.” Sheng Li: “….” #Such a reckless code, yet unforgettable# From an extra to a top-tier actor, the darkened little wolf dog VS. the naturally seductive older sister celebrity.

title: Rational Dungeon Conquest of the Introverted Archer ~What? Just Unleashing Arrows from Outside the Dungeon and Dominating?~
summary: Kageyama Eimu, a first-year high school student attending Leonis Adventure Academy, possesses a unique innate ability known as a blessing. Unfortunately, his blessing, called [Sure Hit] , is perceived as a dud since it merely guarantees hitting enemies within his visible range—a skill aptly named [Sure Hit] . Choosing the Archer job to make the most of his blessing, Eimu diligently engages in dungeon conquests to become stronger. However, his level progress is sluggish, compounded by the Archer job’s lackluster reputation, leading to constant harassment from his classmates. One fateful day, Eimu makes a startling realization. The effect of Eimu’s [Sure Hit] extends not only to visible enemies but also to those he senses through the Archer’s detection skill. Realizing that he can hit enemies at a considerable distance, even those invisible to the naked eye, Eimu expands this range further. Soon, he gains the ability to unilaterally attack monsters from the upper layers of the dungeon and even from outside. Through this seemingly cunning yet rational leveling strategy, Eimu starts effortlessly overwhelming formidable adversaries.

title: I Regressed and Ended Up with a Demon & Harem
summary: After killing the Demon King and returning to the past, the demons who couldn't wait to torment me had turned into beautiful girls. ...Should I really be happy about this when it's just a different shell?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: After Transmigrating, My Younger Brother Always Tries to Seduce Me
summary: Zhu Zhenzhen transmigrated to the day the Song Manor was annihilated. In her original world, she had been the top operative of a notorious thieving organization, a solitary reed adrift in the wind. After transmigrating, she suddenly gained a docile and adorable younger brother, no longer alone. She initially believed her mission was simply to clear the Song Family’s name. But to her utter shock, she found herself having to manage her brother’s romantic feelings—the kind that could lead to that kind of intimacy! Zhu Zhenzhen wrestled with her dilemma for a long time, her inner balance wavering. Just as she was about to give in, a drunken confession revealed the truth she was merely a substitute for the white moonlight in his heart. The words froze on her lips as she snapped back to reality, deliberately distancing herself from Song Heng from that moment on. Song Heng was still reeling when the Emperor suddenly issued a marriage decree. The imperial edict, emblazoned in bright yellow, pierced his eyes like a dagger. He resisted with every fiber of his being, questioning the decree a thousand times. Her calm eyes reflected Song Heng’s bewildered face. Her crimson lips parted slightly, but her words struck his heart like a heavy blow. It was merely a case of mutual affection. A complete madness filled Song Heng’s eyes. Zhu Zhenzhen looked at him as if she didn’t recognize him. He gritted his teeth and snarled, Red sleeves adding fragrance, never leaving my side, night after night—you promised me that yourself! Zhu Zhenzhen’s initial reaction was Are you alright? Later, when she recalled her past life, she realized that she had been his white moonlight all along. The man before her, his eyes rimmed with red, tears glistening on his lashes, prompted her to reach out and wipe them away. After a moment’s hesitation, she finally spoke …I did promise you that, but it was only because I was working. Song Heng closed his eyes, tears streaming down his cheeks as he murmured, It doesn’t matter… You won’t be able to shake me off in this lifetime. He had once despised her, hated her, yet now he still loved her.

title: Aqua Tofana
summary: Poisoning. The power to kill without leaving a trace. *** “That damned pittance.” Lauren ground his teeth. The Special Forces paid stipends strictly based on performance. It was a pitiful arrangement, considering the immense suffering the work entailed. *** The third son of the Montefille Barony—a renowned family of swordsmen—had been all but forced into the Special Forces due to a connection he made while running away from home. Currently, he was working as a teaching assistant in Herbology at the Imperial Academy, a role that served as both cover and a side job. The reason for working two jobs was simple... both paid a pittance. Nevertheless, his primary occupation was as Lauren, the sole operative of the Imperial Palace Special Forces’ Poison Surveillance Unit. Whenever a poisoning incident occurs, the investigation of the agent codenamed “Aqua Tofana” begins…

title: Former Demon King Becomes Savior
summary: After being defeated by the Hero from another world, the Demon King went to sleep, declaring that he would resurrect in a hundred years. —And after a hundred years… As he had declared, the Demon King has resurrected. However, the world has changed in the hundred years since then. ”Wh-What…!” ”So, the demon tribe and humans have made peace with each other and are living peacefully together now.” The Demon King is unexpectedly dismissed from his position. The former Demon King, now a mere demon, decides to become an alchemist in order to survive. To survive, I need food. To buy food, I need money. If I don’t work, I can’t survive! Thus, the former Demon King, who has the strongest power and the best alchemy skill in the world, shows his original unreliable nature to save the world!
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Sword and Magic and Nanomachines: The Fantasy Wandering Tale of the Strongest SF Cheat Girl
summary: "In a world advanced with super-scientific technology, where spaceships soar through the sky and people coexist with cyberspace, a girl named Lala, born and raised in such a world, accidentally stumbles into a fantasy realm of swords and magic. Scratching her head at the existence of mysterious magic, she, with the power of nanomachines, overcomes approaching ferocious magical beasts and decides to temporarily explore this unfamiliar world. Alongside a skilled female mercenary and a pure-hearted priestess girl, Lala embarks on a journey in a fantasy world brimming with unknowns and romance."
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Ghost Amusement Park [Infinite]
summary: On an ordinary afternoon, a higher-dimensional supernatural system named [Ghost] invaded human society. After that day, ghost sightings became frequent across the world, and the rate of accidental deaths soared. Just as humanity was at a loss, the [Ghost] system launched a global livestream: — Ding! Congratulations, you’ve been chosen to participate in “Horror Variety Show”~ — Because you’re a beloved celebrity with enough attention, you were selected. Use your popularity to survive in the instance~ You’re the brightest star! — The celebrity with the lowest popularity after clearing the instance will be eliminated and become the ghosts’ dinner, so do your best. — Either get famous or die, tee-hee~ Li Zhi, a small-time actress who had been doing background roles in countless TV dramas with no fame at all, looked to the left at the top idol and then to the right at the nation’s first love. With a resolute smile, she said: — From an unknown small actress to the top star player in the instance. — From nothing to something. — From something to destruction. 【Even when this world has become a playground for ghosts, I won’t forget that I am human.】
genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural

title: Ban Yue
summary: In the city where I live, there is an industry called "Ban Jie." What is "Ban Jie"? Let me explain slowly. In this city, when someone dies, there is no memorial service. Instead, they set up a makeshift funeral hall on the sidewalk. Steel pipes are used to create a frame, and then a layer of woven fabric is draped over the pipes—this becomes the "spiritual hall." The cold body of the deceased is placed in an ice coffin, which is placed at the very back of the hall. The ice coffin...

title: The Maid’s Temptation
summary: Ipho Bell, a maid of the Asta Marquisate. That was my name. And I was secretly in love with the master of the house, Arwin Asta. “Arwin Asta.” I softly called out his name. It occurred to me that I must be the first maid to ever address her master by his full name. “Will you sleep with me?” Since I was going to die anyway, I wanted to have him, even if just for a single night. Because I was destined to die in three months.

title: After Transmigrating into a Book, I Raised Four Big Bosses
summary: Fu Yuling was doing experiments in the lab one second, and in the next second, she found herself in the small mountain village in a historical novel, becoming the blackened female supporting character that everyone wanted to beat up. She became the vicious female supporting character in the book who not only forced the male lead to marry her, but also gave birth to four children. According to the plot of the book, the male lead will eventually die outside because of a mission and never return to the village. And the few children she gave birth to will become big bosses in the future, destined to become stepping stones in the female lead's struggle. Naturally, their endings were more miserable than the other. In order to change the ending of the book and also to continue to return to real life, Fu Yuling slowly began a life of raising the children. She also took the opportunity to change the fate of everyone in the book during her leisure time. And these few children, the more Fu Yuling spends time with them, the more she likes them...
genres: Drama, Historical, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Falling Leaves Without Trace
summary: The leaves have fallen and I know spring will return again soon. Then, it will no longer be my season. The array of the setting sun filters through the window bravely, Rosy clouds coalesce to form an extraordinary orbit — They say, after a person dies, their spirit would pass by, And have a final glimpse of the world they’ve left behind… --- On the 5th of March 2002, he wore a white shirt with tattered sleeves and a pair of old, ash grey trousers as he came running into my home. It was evening and rays from the setting sun filtered through the window at an oblique angle, casting dark shadows on his left cheek. He stood ferociously before my family’s dining table. My father and I were in the middle of eating when he suddenly bellowed, “Let’s get married!” That day, he received a stern beating from my father. He didn’t retaliate and was beaten black and blue, his face all swollen. That year, I was 21, and without any hesitation, I married him. Because when he looked at me, nothing else mattered. It was as though he was drowning, and only I could save him.

title: I Became a Tyrant-Class Monster in the Hunter World
summary: When I was young, I admired heroes. So when Hunters and monsters appeared in the world, honestly, I was thrilled. I thought my chance to finally become a hero had come. But…. “What the h*ll!” I had become a monster.

title: The Daily Life of a Troublemaker Raising a Child
summary: Lu Shiqiu was a notorious thug in the area, known far and wide, and at twenty-five, he still spent his days idly, living a life of sloth, waiting for death. One day, unexpectedly, he bound himself to a "Child-Rearing System"! [Once you bind with the system, you'll have a biological child!] Lu Shiqiu was overjoyed, because ever since that winter night when he soaked in the sea at fifteen, he had believed he would never have children. He was cautious though, knowing that nothing good comes for free, and asked warily: "What do you want me to do?" [Buy one, get three! You just need to raise three more daughters!] Lu Shiqiu: !!!!!!!! This is the story of a thug who, in an attempt to raise a successor, exhausts all means to do so, only to end up being healed in the process. Little Scene: His daughter was four years old and still loved to play in the mud. Lu Shiqiu tried to reason with her, but his daughter refused to listen. He grabbed her little arm: "Nannan, I’m your father, you need to listen to me." The daughter, standing her ground, said, "But you didn’t listen to Grandpa!" Lu Shiqiu: "......"

title: Turns Out, It’s the 3rd Generation of the Chaebol
summary: It turns out I wasn’t actually a dirt spoon. [Dirt spoons never even try, they just blame the spoon all the time.] That was what I always heard from the gold spoons while growing up. I used to think it was nonsense…
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Martial Arts are Too Easy
summary: Zhang Xian, once a Hunter in modern Korea, dies and is reborn in Ming-era Hangzhou. Orphaned young, he survives by joining the mercenary-like Jinli Sect, living quietly as a third-rate warrior. But on his twenty-first year, a message from his past life suddenly appears— “You have Awakened.” Now, with both cultivation and the system in his grasp, Zhang Xian realizes one thing— for him, martial arts are far too easy.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: I Was a Good-for-Nothing, but I Became the Northern Grand Duke
summary: I was born as the fifth son of the Northern Grand Duke’s family. So I lived it up without a care in the world. Unless the whole clan got wiped out, there was no way I’d ever inherit the family—no matter what. “…Young master. Please listen without being alarmed. The head of the family and the other young masters have been attacked by a dragon.” And that’s how I became the Northern Grand Duke.

title: One Piece Shura
summary: The world of Pirates, where the strong are standing. The four emperors, Shichibukai dominate one side, and the admiral dominates. One day, when Raavan, carrying the infinite awakening system, travels through the world of Pirates, and seeing the fruits of others can only be awakened once, but his fruits can be awakened infinitely, how can the pattern of the world of Pirates change? Anyway, Vice Admiral Garp, known as a naval hero, only knew that when he got news of the battle between Raavan and the Four Emperor Kaido, his only thought was… “That guy Kaido is known as the strongest creature in the world, but can he withstand Raavan’s punch?”
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: Secretly Raising a Little Golden Crow
summary: Du Yu unexpectedly transmigrates into a world of beast taming. Looking at the paper crane fluttering its wings in his palm, he can’t help but fall into deep thought. Did it just say… it’s an ancient Golden Crow? Ps: A lighthearted and heartwarming urban beast-taming story.

title: Farmer’s Group Favourite: The Female Supporting Character is a Full-level Bigshot
summary: Su Wan transmigrated into the abandoned daughter of a marquis family, marrying a poor scholar in place of her younger step-sister, becoming the subject of ridicule by everyone. Little did she know that her younger brother was the empress’s legitimate son. After acknowledging his roots, he said, “Sister-in-law, whatever you desire, I will bring it to you.” The man she casually saved turned out to be a grand general, said, “Sister Su, whoever bullies you, I will crush them into pieces with my elite troops.” Even the top-notch mother-in-law said, “Wan Wan, men just need a good beating when they misbehave, don’t spoil them.” Her sickly husband, who would hold great power in the future, was domineering and forceful, said, “Ah Wan, you are mine. Everything of yours, I will provide.” Su Wan was favored by various powerful figures, never expecting that her true identity was even more astonishing.

title: Becoming the Dead Mother of a Beautiful and Strong Male Lead
summary: Yu Wei was originally a delicate and lazy little cat demon but by a twist of fate she became an outer disciple of the foremost immortal sect. She had no ambitions and spent her days basking in the sun and g*ooming her fur, occasionally teasing the disciples who looked down on her for being a hybrid. Her life was carefree and pleasant. One day a handsome and aloof newcomer of the sect appeared. He forbade her from catching birds and staying up late reading manuals and sharply reduced her g*ooming and loafing time. Wherever she went he followed and would not leave. Unlike everyone else Ling Xiao, who was cold and distant to others, was endlessly patient and gentle with her no matter how she threw tantrums. Other disciples could not understand why he cared so much for Yu Wei while treating even his own mother with less attention. Looking closely, it was clear their features resembled each other. Yu Chengyan was the only son of Celestial Lord Zheqing and the tragic yet beautiful male lead of a xianxia tale. At sixteen his mother Yu Wei was killed in front of him, leaving him with indelible trauma. He changed drastically and broke ties with his father. By chance he returned to the past with two goals. First, to personally teach and guide Yu Wei and make her strong enough that no one could harm her. Second, to prevent Yu Wei from falling in love with his father. When Celestial Lord Zheqing returned to the First Immortal Sect he had once founded he saw a young cultivator with a similar aura staring at him expressionlessly, with a girl with white cat ears hiding behind him. Xie Jianbai wondered why he was looking at him with such mu*derous intent.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: My Skills Are Too Strong to Be a Heroine
summary: Aria Amamiya, an ordinary high school girl, happens to run into her one-sided love, Takato-kun, when he is being summoned to another world. So, as an extra, she is summoned along with him. God gave her a skill, after describing her as a child so slow that is surely going to die soon, the skill of “doing whatever humanity can do”. Thus, she can run 100 meters in 9 seconds, shoot a hundred arrows with a bow, and crawl up on her own even if she falls off a cliff… Being strong is good, but isn’t this totally… no cute at all?! It’s an otherworldly love adventure story in which you try your best to save the world.

title: The Guide
summary: Cha Ji-won, the director of Gallery Hwadam. A man seemingly perfect with exceptional talent and handsome features, he harbors a hidden ability: he can see and eliminate ghosts by drawing their portraits. One day, after dealing with a troublesome spirit as usual, Ji-won is summoned to "Jungcheon" for sending a deceased without proper procedure. There, in Jungcheon, the place where the dead are judged, he meets Ga-on, the master of Jungcheon. At first, it was competitiveness. He thought it was curiosity about a transcendental being who didn't even spare him a glance. It was a more complex emotion than simple fighting spirit, but he couldn't explain it any other way. Yes, that's how it was at first… but why does she look beautiful now? A story of the living, who love, and who live in the world of the dead.

title: We Are Looking For A Guardian For Our Wicked Lady
summary: I became a maid who gets killed by a young villainess. She was supposed to be the one who would kill me, but when I actually met her, she was so small and pretty. On top of that, she was just a child who had been neglected and abandoned by her family. “Young lady, shall we try rebelling a little?” The moment I found out that a huge inheritance would go to the villainess, I decided to find a guardian for her. * Among the guardian candidates, I saved the villainess Lilith from the Duke’s house of Heriot, which was the original heroine’s family. Thankfully, the Duke’s family liked the villainess. “Lilith, who do you like the most?” “Chloe.” When the little girl replied with her tiny mouth, everyone else felt gloomy for not being chosen. * Lilith grew up well, and I also became an adult. So, I told them I would leave the Duke’s house. “If Chloe leaves, I’ll leave too.” That one sentence from Lilith shook the whole mansion. The Duke’s family tried to stop me from leaving. “But I don’t have any reason to stay here anymore…” “Then marry me.” “…What?” I looked at Johann, the heroine’s older brother, who had always looked at me coldly. “What… did you just say?” I couldn’t believe those words came from his mouth. “Your reason to stay here…” “Isn’t marrying me enough?” “I don’t want you to leave, Chloe.” Johann grabbed my shoulder tightly. His quiet voice now carried emotions.

title: Kyokou Suiri
summary: A face-less female ghost wearing a mini-skirt is known to roam around at night in this city. Kalin Nanase is the ghost of a celebrity who died an unnatural death. A detective named Saki Yumihara encounters the ghost of Kalin and is saved by a girl named Kotoko Iwanaga. Kotoko was kidnapped by ghosts when she was a little girl and has ever since served as a mediator between people and ghosts. Kotoko also happened to be dating Saki’s ex-boyfriend Kurou Sakuragawa. Kotoko and Saki work together to solve Kalin’s case.

title: The Lady Only Deals With the Real Ones

title: After Becoming a Widow She Married the Emperor

When she was found by her relatives, she had just lost her husband and was left alone with her young daughter. When she returned to the Marquis’ Mansion, her biological mother had passed away, her father was not happy with her, and her stepmother wanted to arrange another marriage for her and marry her off as soon as possible. But Wen Mian didn’t want to marry again, so she took her daughter to the palace to ask for help from her aunt, the Concubine Tai. Unexpectedly, she happened to see the emperor’s unique selection of concubines, and a golden arrow blew her hair apart. The way they came to arrest him… no, to "invite" him, was downright absurd. Escorted by several vehicles, Ji Ting carefully reviewed his short first half of life and came to a conclusion: no matter what mistakes he had made, none of them were serious enough to justify this kind of arrest. "What exactly did I do?" "The novels you wrote fused with reality." "Huh?" Ji Ting froze on the spot, suspecting they had the wrong person. "The novels I wrote?" Those half-baked things that weren’t even good enough to be put on X-point, the ones that didn’t even meet the requirements to enter V on X-Jiang—those were being called novels now? "Be honest. How many books have you actually written?" "But I didn’t even know my novels had become real. How did you find out?" "The protagonist of your novel contacted us directly and turned you in." Upon hearing the news that Cao Cao's fierce general Xiahou Yuan was approaching, the startled Song Jian performs a ritual to ward off misfortune and... Leah, who had died a miserable death, opened her eyes as Grace Visac. She had become the fiancée of Taran Courtios, the absolute ruler of the Rubec Empire. "Grace, you seem to have changed a lot." Meanwhile, Taran, Grace's fiancé, suspects her changed behavior. Leah tries not to reveal her secret. "I have to live as Grace now." As Grace, Leah dreams only of revenge against Allen. "Don't cry, Grace,’’ Taran begins to fall for her bold and daring nature, promising to help her no matter what Grace does, but he sets a condition. "Love me. You must keep me in your heart alone." His blind obsession and possessiveness entangle Leah, but she cannot easily shake him off. "No matter who you are, you can't escape from me."

It's difficult to have a child in that world, and amongst them, they only have a boy at a 1 to 5 ratio. And 'you were born as the heir to a family of Gods'. He ends up accepting it despite being perplexed at being given such a request. Without knowing whether Mai has reincarnated into this world with himself, Aoi, who has lost his reason to live, sealed off that sadness and took on the challenge of not just the birth rate problem, but the unravelling of this world's mysteries as well.

The turbulent life story of Biryong, who dreams of becoming the Emperor of the Martial World while striving to escape that trap.

Seriously—who has time to worry about a missing girl, when everyone’s too busy drowning in their own troubles and miseries? Facing all sorts of hostility, they begin to doubt themselves… As the hours tick by, Goldfish’s missing persons case remains unsolved. And amidst this mystery, seven souls who live utterly unrelated lives seem to be interconnected in curious ways. A glimpse into their ordinary and complex lives presents a blurring line between good and evil, and perhaps, despite everything, a tinge of hope. "Everyone glows a different color, and when these colors come together, feebly as each one may glow, they form a beautiful, blazing rainbow." Trigger Warnings (as suggested by translator): mentions of emotional ab*se and childhood trauma T/N regarding translated title: A literal translation of the Chinese title would be “We brush past each other in the rainbow light”, but the current translator chose not to use that.
