The only thing that could save him was the one-time Card Draw gifted by the system. But it didn’t matter—for a true Summoner, everything is predetermined, and even Card Draws can be created! A single draw creates miracles! This is a card-based alternate world. Powerful supernatural creatures, divine weapons imbued with divine power, and even things like hurricanes, lightning, and fire themselves can all be sealed by cards. Those who master the ability to control these cards are called Summoners.

title: The Tale of Rejuvenation in the 21st Century
summary: A Tale of a Martial Arts Master Struggling in 21st Century Korea

title: Transcending the Famine Years with Space: Stockpiling Food and Raising Offspring
summary: [Love at First Sight + Fleeing Famine + Deep Mountains + Farming] Bai Nianqing suddenly found herself transported through time, only to discover she was in the middle of a wedding ceremony. Not only that, there was a toddler about two or three years old beside her. From the maids, she learned that chaos was about to break out in the city, and their family needed to flee immediately! Fortunately, she had stockpiled plenty of food in her Dimension back in modern times, which should be enough to sustain her through this period. In her previous life, she had been a typical 996 office worker. During her grandmother's funeral, she accidentally pricked her finger on a wood splinter from the coffin, and her blood stained the bracelet her grandmother had left her, unlocking the Dimension. After having consecutive dreams about famine for several days, Bai Nianqing felt uneasy and stored enough supplies to last decades inside it.

title: Doomsday Online: Supreme Blessing
summary: Doomsday Online has descended, reducing the entire Earth to a ruined playground. It is occupied by countless terrifying monsters. Link awakens the one and only SSS-grade talent, Supreme Blessing, which can increase the quality of any equipment, skill, or item, at a rate of 10-10,000. Skeleton Longsword (Iron-grade), blessing successful, upgraded to Epic-grade weapon—Divine Sword Red Sky! Death Charge (Silver-grade), blessing successful, upgraded to the Legend-grade skill—Holy Charge! Void Summoner (Epic-grade), blessing successful, upgraded to the Taboo-grade profession—Great Void Taboo Master! In this lifetime, he shall rule over the world when awake, and be with beauties when asleep. Link wants to be king in this doomsday!

title: I Jumped Into The Sea To Die
summary: She jumped into the sea to die. Hee-yeon tried to escape from her home, her fiancé and everything that bound her. Until she is caught by a stranger who saves her life. “Why do you have to be on my radar, if you’re going to die, then do it quietly and privately!” “Who told you to save me?” “If you really try again, you’ll die at my hands.” With that, Hee-yeon runs after Yi-kyu, the man who saved her, and throws herself into his life. A life lived in a mouldy, underground room, fighting in the ring as a means of entertainment for gangsters. The naive Yi-kyu roughly pushes Hee-yeon away, but he is unable to stop himself. “f*ck you. I should’ve left you alone when you wanted to die.” “You already saved me, so it’s not my fault. I’m going to get you out of here like you got me out of the Black Sea”. A woman who wants to die and a man who wants to live. Two people who started off on the wrong foot set out to save each other. ​ *** ​ ” Hey, Yi Kyu, don’t die.” She couldn’t tell him not to fight. It’s something he’s been doing all his life. Hee-yeon hadn’t even taught him how to live normally yet. But his black eyes flickered wildly. “…This is some kind of joke, why are you talking like you’re leaving?” Yi Kyu’s voice trembled, his shoulders shaking roughly. “You said you wouldn’t leave because it was my decision to save you.” There were no excuses; she’d said it, promised it, and now she had the audacity to say she was leaving. “I saved you!” Yi Kyu shouted furiously. She couldn’t bring herself to look up and see his face. Hee-yeon let out a shaky breath and clutched his shoulders tightly, closing her eyes.

title: The Beauty and the Beast Within
summary: I opened a private cinema, and many young and beautiful girls work part-time here. They only need to accompany men to watch a movie to earn half a month's salary for an average person. Xiao Lu is the most beautiful girl in the shop, but she works for me for free. Moreover, she will unconditionally obey any order I give. Because I have something on her.

title: Please Give Me Love
summary: “I wonder if my feelings will reach you, who has grown up without knowing love and who has become tired of life. You are not alone anymore.” –so reads the letter Ririka, an eighteen year old who has grown up in an orphanage and who has tried to kill herself multiple times, receives unexpectedly one day after her latest su*cide attempt. The sender of the letter, Motojirou’s, honest words strike a chord in her heart, and she decides to write a reply. As they begin to exchange letters back and forth, Ririka begins to slowly open up to the mysterious author of this letter whom she has never even met before, but an unexpected fate awaits the two…
genres: Completed, Drama, Psychological, Slice of Life

title: I Took in the Empress of a Fallen Nation as My Maid
summary: Avarots Vivian — the former Empress of a fallen nation, once the most powerful being in the world. And now… I’ve made her my maid. D*mn it.

title: Flirting with My Hidden Marriage Husband, Making the Female Guest Cry
summary: [A peerlessly beautiful and glamorous female star X A roguish, wild ‘wolf cub’ heir from the Beijing elite circle + Secret Marriage on a Romance Reality Show + Sweet and Doting Romance with Untainted Leads] It was widely rumored in the entertainment circle that Song Ying, a washed-up actress who debuted as a child star, was dramatic, a clout-chaser, and had come between a top-tier movie star and his partner. In response, she posted a picture of the person sleeping beside her. Song Ying: “Thanks for asking. I already have a boyfriend, and he’s more handsome.” Netizens scoffed: “Starts with a picture, the rest is all made up. Song San, get out of the entertainment industry!” Done with putting up with the intolerable, she brings her secret husband onto a romance reality show to crush the “white lotus,” shut down anti-fans, flaunt their love, and crash the show, landing them on the hot search! She even makes another female guest bawl her eyes out! The movie star? Sorry, just some ugly nobody she wouldn’t even spare a glance for! Her husband is the real treasure of this world~ Everyone in their circle once thought that the heir, Qin Shu, was arrogant, wild, and untamable. But in a flash, the cold and proud CEO turned into a puppy dog on the romance reality show—being dramatic, acting cute to win affection, and spouting endless sweet nothings, doting on his wife with his life. Only then did everyone realize that the wild wolf had two faces. — When they were young, an elder asked Qin Shu what kind of wife he wanted to marry in the future. He thought for a moment, then pointed at the little girl on TV and said, “I want one like that!” After they grew up, his friends all laughed at the henpecked Qin Shu for getting married so young, saying he had lost his former edge. In a bar, the heir of the Qin family lifted his fox-like eyes, kicked over a wine bottle, and shook the yogurt in his hand. “What can I do? From our very names, it was destined that I would lose and she would win.” In the past, Song Ying hated it when Qin Shu would chase after her, saying, “Teacher Song, I grew up watching your shows!” No matter how she heard it, it just made her sound old. Was it her fault she debuted early? Until one day, in a live broadcast, a certain someone pressed against her and whispered the second half of that sentence in her ear: “So marrying you became my highest ideal after growing up.”

title: After Escaping From Mangame, He Debuted as an Idol
summary: [Star Unit: The Beginning – Service Termination Notice] Hello, we apologize for visiting you with this notice. Due to the developer’s circumstances, the game service will officially end on January 31, 2023, at 24:00. — In a game where the service has ended, the popular character ‘Lee Gyeom’ wakes up. Escape the game and debut as an idol in real life!

title: Split Zone No.13
summary: When Li Shen’s second personality acts out, her consciousness is sent to a strange place called Split Zone No.13. She is then informed that she can only return home after unraveling the truth.
genres: Completed, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural

title: My Story of Falling for the Class President
summary: Lonely Tachibana Sho was targeted by the class's popular kids, forcibly nominated as class president, and suffered sarcasm and harassment every day. In this class where he had no friends, the only one who supported him was the girl he admired since childhood, the other class president, known as the "Perfect Girl"—Kashii Rena.

title: Tokyo Video Game Tycoon
summary: Video games are one of the important ways people entertain themselves in the new era. However, Zhu Yuxing, who traveled to the parallel world of Japan, found that the game industry in this world was extremely depressed, as if it had never flourished. So Zhu Yuxing decided to bring the Ninth Art to this world. “Mom, Super Mario 3 is out! This is the Christmas gift I want the most!” … “My Link is addicted to picking up sticks, with no interest in saving the princess.” “Link is the one who saves the princess!” “Oh? Is that so? Okay, Zelda…” … “I’m willing to sacrifice my soul just to protect Pyro!” … “If you want to race cars, Forza Motorsport is where it’s at!” … “Tifa is my eternal goddess!” The game never sleeps. This is a story of a world solely focused on developing the entertainment industry of gaming. (Note: This story is set in a parallel universe and bears no resemblance to any actual persons. Any similarity is purely coincidental.)
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Was Just Making up Techniques… How Did All of You Become Emperors?
summary: Chu Feng transmigrates to the vast and mysterious Xuantian Continent, a world where strength determines everything. But unlike others, he can’t cultivate at all. Just when it seems like he’s destined to remain weak and irrelevant, he suddenly awakens a strange system—one that allows him to grow stronger by accepting disciples. Lacking any real knowledge of cultivation techniques, Chu Feng does the only thing he can: he bluffs. He starts recruiting disciples using made-up martial arts and nonsense teachings, hoping to trick the system into making him stronger. What he never expected was that his disciples would take his nonsense seriously—and actually master the techniques he invented. Not just that, they go on to become terrifyingly powerful, shaking the world with their strength. A hundred years later, as his disciples stand at the peak of the cultivation world, one by one becoming legendary Emperors, Chu Feng can only look on in disbelief and mutter: “I made up those techniques… how did you all become Emperors?”
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Death Sutra
summary: Born into a wealthy family, Gu Shenwei was spoiled and carefree. However, at the age of 14, his entire family were brutally mu*dered, and he was caught by some bandits who sold him into s*avery. As a s*ave boy, he entered Golden Roc Fort by chance and found the man who had slaughtered his family. He endured insults and worked hard to improve his kung fu while working as a s*ave boy. He learned from and plotted against his enemy under the enemy’s nose. He became increasingly ambitious as he became more and more powerful. He would only be satisfied if he completely destroyed his enemy—by fair means or foul. Gradually his bitter experience turned him into a totally different person. This is a kung fu fiction that is full of mysteries and surprises. This is a story dealing with love, betrayals and distances. This is the journey of an ordinary boy who, against all odds, fought against formidable foes. This is a tale regarding a person who felt abandoned by the world made unremitting efforts to create a new world of his own, in which he was alone.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Mystery, Tragedy, Wuxia

title: The Protagonist is the Martial World’s Nemesis
summary: Do-cheol’s dream wasn’t just to become a great hero, It was to be called one by countless people.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, Wuxia

title: Everyone is an Evil Immortal!
summary: Legend has it that in this world, there is a Taoist temple, and within it lies a patch of earth. If you treat a person as a 'seed' and plant them in the soil, they can achieve immortality. Li Shiwu searched for immortality for ten years. He finally found the temple and planted himself in the soil... This is a world where everyone is an evil immortal. Enter with caution!!!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Xianxia

title: My Disciple, The Little Dragon Girl
summary: After transmigrating into a fused martial world, Su Liu found himself bound to a dilapidated Daoist temple, and awakened the 10,000x Return System! By gifting opportunities to disciples or elders, he could trigger critical multipliers and reap divine rewards! Little Dragon Girl: A celestial beauty, yet fate cursed her with endless tragedy! Li Mo Chou: Jade-skinned and peerless, yet doomed by her own devotion! Qu Feiyan: Brilliant and whimsical, yet too clever for her own good! Under the protection of their unshakably loyal master, Su Liu, their destinies were rewritten! "You taught Li Mo Chou the Nine Swords of Dugu, triggering a 100x critical return! Reward: Eight Swords Soaring Together!" "You gifted Little Dragon Girl the Azure Edge Sword, triggering a 1,000x critical return! Reward: Legacy of the Seven Swords' Ice Soul Blade!" "You imparted Nine Yin Divine Claws to Lin Yu, triggering a 10,000x critical return! Reward: Great Desolate Heaven-Sealing Hand!" Yao Yue (Moon Princess): "You bastard! First, you seduced my sister, now you dare come for me?!" Dongfang Bubai (The Invincible East): "You’d even hand me the emperor’s throne… yet claim I mean nothing to you?" Feilu Novel Network Reminder: This work and its characters are entirely fictional. Any resemblance to real persons or events is purely coincidental. Do not imitate.

title: After I Ran You Over With My Bicycle
summary: When we first met, you were lying on the ground covered in blood. And I was desperately trying to stop the bleeding. The protagonist, Tomegi Kyouji, may tend to be indecisive and passive, but he was an ordinary high school boy. One day, while riding his bicycle down a hill as usual, he ran over Rindou Yotsuba. Such a terrible encounter started it all. It seemed like pure love, yet with an-out-of-place feeling. Despite the anguish over what was done, they were gradually attracted to each other. A story of distorted yet faint love woven by characters with slightly faulty personalities

title: Darenimo Natsukanai Tobikyuu Tensai Youjo ga, Ore ni Dake Amaetekuru Riyuu
summary: “That’s because… you.” In my class there was an eight-year-old girl. She was a genius child who skipped classes, and her appearance was adorable like a princess. However, she was very cold by nature and reluctant to get along with anyone. I thought the only person she could trust was her sister who was also in the same school as her… but one day, when I gave her a candy, she suddenly clung to me very strongly! This genius princess who turned out to be very lonely was just being spoiled with me. The love she showed knew no bounds, and she was trying to set me up with her sister who was famous for being the prettiest girl in school so that she could become my sister-in-law? This is a story about a little girl who is lonely because of her intelligence, and an ordinary young man who can be found anywhere. The digital version may differ from the print version, so please understand.
genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Our Secret Youth in the Night School (LN)
summary: “Listen here. I want to turn these nights after club activities into our very own springtime of youth.” The one who called out to Minase Shuuto—a loner in his first year of high school—was Tsukimi Kaede. A second-year student, she was the definition of perfection: top grades, incredible athleticism, and stunning looks. A total triple threat. Kaede led Shuuto to a place no one dared approach: the old gymnasium storage shed. Or, as they called it, the “Secret Base.” Inside, three other students were already kicking back. Kazemiya Kanon, the school idol every guy obsessed over. Ogino Misato, a music-loving gyaru who kept to herself. And Akazawa You, the happy-go-lucky class clown. To Shuuto, they were the social elite, people from a world he had no part in. But for some reason… they were acting completely different from their usual selves!? “Greetings, my fellow comrades! ‘Tis another fine evening, is it not?!” Hold on a second… isn’t Tsukimi-senpai the one whose personality flipped the hardest?! As Shuuto stood there dumbfounded, Kaede dubbed their little gathering the 『Don’t Want to Go Home Alliance.』 She extended a hand toward him. “Why don’t you join us?” Set against the backdrop of the school at night, this is a coming-of-age romantic comedy featuring boys and girls hiding secrets of their own!
genres: Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Chosen by the Hero King, the Second Life of the Illegitimate Child
summary: King of Heroes. A title that signified the king of all heroes, whose great feats made even the gods feel fear.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: I Became a Horror Story Merchant Inside a Game
summary: “How much is this?” “Two fingers.” “And this one?” “An organ. A kidney will do.” When I woke up, I was no longer myself. I had become the merchant of horror stories inside a game, running a shop where the currency wasn’t gold or points— but pieces of flesh, memories, and even souls. In this strange world of urban legends and twisted bargains, every trade comes with a price… and the customers are far from human.

title: Immortal’s Farmland
summary: "Did I transmigrate to another world? Am I a butterfly?" "Oh god! This is too much!" "Ehhh? Becoming an Immortal? In this chaotic and competitive world? A world filled with many handsome boys?" "Haha, at least I have a celestial farmland inside me! Yes, I will just look for more seeds to plant more celestial plants." The story is set in a fantasized dimension where people have the urge to become Immortals through various training of celestial martial arts. Qian Qian wakes up and realizes that she has transmigrated to a completely different world, where she is no longer a human, but instead, a Butterfly! Her journey to becoming a powerful Immortal becomes smoother with the celestial farmland inside her! The story takes on a similar genre to the popular drama like “Journey of a Flower” and “Eternal Love”. Let us begin our journey into the Xianxia World!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, Xianxia

title: [Lucky Overpowered] — I Became a Background Character Meant to Die in the Game’s Opening, But Now I’m Overpowered and Fighting to Save My All-Time Favorite Alchemist Heroine
summary: I suddenly found myself in the body of Gee—a background character who was supposed to be killed in the game’s opening scene. I have no idea why Gee is still alive. But at least this means I didn’t cause any sadness to Lise—Gee’s childhood friend and, more importantly, my all-time favorite heroine and the protagonist of the game. That alone might be worth it. Now that I’m here, I’ll use all my knowledge of the game to support Lise however I can! My Gift is 【Luck】—a divine blessing that boosts the Luck stat, which couldn’t be raised no matter how much you leveled up in the game. With this power, I’ll make sure I’m someone Lise can rely on!

title: The Inheritance of the Simp
summary: My fraternal twin brother and I are in the same class. Because we have different surnames, everyone at school says he's my simp. Wei Hanzhou, his brother, really couldn't stand it anymore and furiously questioned him: "Do you really have to be that woman's simp?" My brother replied, "Actually, she's pretty nice to me." Wei Hanzhou sneered and said, "Just wait. In a month, I'll show you that woman's true colors!" A month later, I had two simps. This time, my brother questioned him: "Are you crazy?" Wei Hanzhou calmly said, "I think you're really biased against her."
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Seventh July – Qing
summary: Since she was a child, she knew that she will always love him — like fate that could never be changed. However, she had been separated from him for three years. At the young age of 15, he left him to study in Taipei. When she was 18, she finally couldn’t help but see him, only to be driven away. At 21, he finally came home only to attend their mother’s funeral. When she turned 24, he got married migrated abroad with his wife. He was once her only solace— so gentle and kind. He held her hand and hooked a pinky promise with her that they’ll be together forever. She could lose everything, but she can’t live without him. Qixi Festival is the day when the Cowherd meets the Weaver Girl. The day when it always rains. Also the day of her birthday. Can she finally celebrate her 27th year with clear skies this time and see him for the last time?

title: It’s Already the Third Time as Villainess
summary: I've possessed the same villainess character three times. Iva Blanche, a villainess from the novel "Don't Fight over Me, You Two Handsome Boys!" The same death twice is enough! I can't die for the third time! I'm going to the countryside where there's no need for villains or anything. I'll live quietly by myself! "I want to marry you, Young lady." But why is the male lead proposing? "You're the one who asked me to marry you first. I'll accept your hand in marriage." And now the second-male lead is also flirting? That's enough! I just want to live alone from now on!

title: Three Years of Cold War, He Regretted on the Day of Divorce
summary: (*Powerful man humbled + Heartbreak before sweetness + Adorable child as support + Ruthless chase to win her back*) After four years of marriage, Cheng Qian was forced to accept that her husband’s true love was her own cousin. During her illness, he stayed by her side—giving her money, affection, and time—spoiling her until she became addicted. But while she was away studying abroad, her precious son was manipulated by the other woman into calling *her* "Mom." Finally, Cheng Qian woke up. With ruthless determination, she handed her husband divorce papers and fought for custody of their son. She turned away without hesitation, diving into the world of scientific research. When a national leader faced a deadly disease, her breakthrough drug saved the day, propelling her to fame as the nation’s beloved "Research Goddess." A handsome foreign minister held out roses, pleading: *"Cheng Qian, marry me. I’ll spend my life cherishing you."* A business tycoon, eyes red, whispered: *"Can we stop being siblings? You’d make a better wife."* A top scientist pursued her relentlessly: *"If I surpass your achievements, will you date me?"* But when her accomplishments became medals that dazzled the world— The cold, indifferent man who once ignored her finally broke. The wife he had taken for granted now stood beyond his reach. Pushing through the crowd, he grabbed her wrist, eyes burning with regret: *"Xiao Qian… Our son says he wants a little sister. Let’s make it happen."*

title: Odoacer
summary: In the year 476 AD, Odoacer, who reigned as a mercenary commander, declared himself the so-called king of Italy despite being a Germanic man. In truth, he desired to be granted the imperial title by the Empire. However, Odoacer drew his final breath in Ravenna. Just what happened to him…? And Rina, a modern-day woman who came face to face with that era—what will she feel in Europe before the establishment of the ancient Frankish Kingdom?

title: Apparently, the Traitor in the Brave Party is Not “Me”
summary: “There is a traitor in this hero’s party.” Owen Darc, a new member of the S-rank hero’s party, thought that the “traitor” in the oracle’s prophecy was him. Owen has an extraordinary purpose and steadily improves his skills. However, Will Striker, the leader of the hero’s party, informs him that there is another traitor. There are six suspects other than Owen. The leader Will, Rolf the Wolf Beastman, Venus the Peerless Beauty, twins Al and Hal, and Chloe the Dog Beastman. Who on earth is the traitor in the hero’s party!? And what is the insane ambition that the main character Owen is holding!? The otherworldly fantasy comedy brought to you by Ace Koumei begins!

title: I Reincarnated as the Underdog in a Depressing NTR Game, but Even Though I’m Just Living Normally, the Cheerful, Tsundere, Mysterious, and Pure-Type Heroines Are All Expressing Intense Feelings Toward Me
summary: That's strange, I'm just living normally, though? One day, I died from overwork, or so I thought, but when I woke up, I found myself in the world of an NTR eroge I had played in my previous life, "Kimi ni Saku Shiki". However, I was reincarnated as Yuzuriha Kyosuke, the so-called stepping stone protagonist who has the main heroines stolen by the true protagonist, Manaka Kazuki. In that case, the one who should end up happy with the four beautiful girls who are the main heroines of this game, known as the "Shiki Sakura", should be Kazuki, the true protagonist. Then, I'll give up on romance and leave it to Kazuki, the true protagonist, and at least try to live properly so I'm not lonely even if I'm alone. With that determination, I was just living normally, but before I knew it, I, who was supposed to be the stepping stone, was the one receiving intensely heavy feelings from the heroines. And the true protagonist, Kazuki, was heading towards ruin. ──That's strange, how did it come to this?
genres: Completed, Comedy, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: We Only See Each Other at Night
summary: She was forced out to this gathering to raise campaign funds for her cruel adoptive father. There, Gyeo-ul runs into Baek Yi-joon, the one-night stand who took her first experience. “Let’s get married.” Unlike the flustered Gyeo-ul, Yi-joon spoke calmly. “Why… me…” “Because I need to be married. I thought you would be someone I could marry.” “…” “You don’t need to be faithful to the marriage. You just have to see me at night.” “…” “Because we need to have a child.” Baek Yi-joon, the man who needs marriage and a child to become the successor of Geonyang. Han Gyeo-ul, the woman who desperately wants to escape the grasp of her cruel adoptive father. Will flowers ever bloom in Gyeo-ul’s otherwise cold life?

title: My Love, Enlighten Me
summary: A young, 22-year-old hopeful and a kind-hearted pop star named Nuan Nuan is forced to reinvent herself after the girl group she is a member of disbands on the night of its debut. Overnight, her dreams come to a halt as she’s hit with the harsh reality of her situation. While she struggles in her search for a post-pop career, her life gets intertwined with a man named Han Che. Han Che is a successful sound and light engineer who also happens to have impeccable memory and a cold personality. However, despite his amazing memory, Han Che misremembers something very important which can later threaten to jeopardize his relationship with Nuan Nuan. Meanwhile, Nuan Nuan, who has always had a keen eye for fashion, begins to explore her love of clothes – hoping to secure a permanent spot at a clothing store’s headquarters. Although their relationship is often adversarial, Han Che and Nuan Nuan also have a growing fondness for one another. Han Che tries to help Nuan Nuan and she slowly starts to melt his icy heart. But can they withstand it when the past comes to the surface, or will it get in the way of their blooming love?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Constellation Returned From Hell
summary: Earth, the land that the constellations were aiming for. Hunter Choi Yeonseung decided to start special training to stop the constellations that want to monopolize Earth. His training location was the Abyss, a space where time flowed infinitely slowly. However, Choi Yeonseung was suddenly caught up in a magical storm and had to face the harsh Abyss head-on. Choi Yeonseung went through unprecedented and infinite practical training throughout the Abyss and discovered a clue to be the first human to become a constellation. The hard-working hunter, Choi Yeonseung, was reborn safely as a constellation. Will he be able to save Earth, which is destined to fall prey to the constellations? The hard-working, overpowered martial artist, Choi Yeonseung! The path he walks on to become the first human constellation!

title: The Immortal Devil Hunter
summary: In the 21st century, humanity was destroyed. The last demon hunter remained. A mortal with the power of a god. Cheon Jae-eon. He goes back in time to stop the end. Wearing just a short-sleeve T-shirt and a convenience store clerk’s uniform.

title: Tehe(*´∀`)♪ I Was Picked Up By a Wolf
summary: A story of a healthily growing girl with memories from her previous life that got picked up by a wolf. It will be a slow paced story and will be a story filled with Mofu Mofu.

title: The Princess Who Was Married Off To The Prince of Slaughter In Place of Her Sister. While She Was Growing Fairies and Potatoes in The Garden of The Detached Palace, His Highness’s Infatuation Began
summary: The heroine, the daughter of the king's mistress, was abandoned within the palace after her mother's death. Meals were delivered only once a day, consisting of moldy bread, rotten fruit, and raw potatoes. However, the heroine was somehow managing to get by. The heroine's mother was from a fairy village, and she had a fairy with her. That fairy was passed down to the heroine, granting her the power of protection. One day, the heroine, who had been summoned by the king after several years, was to marry the neighboring kingdom's crown prince, known as the Prince of Slaughter, in place of her half-sister...
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Became A Sales Genius
summary: I chose the one thing I could do right away to pay off my debts, and that was sales. And then, I was given one more chance at life. #Regression #ModernFantasy #Salesman #ImportedCars #Dealer

title: The Greatest Assassin Hides His Presence
summary: ‘Ah, so I have no presence at all.’ He had lived his entire life with a faint presence. He thought he had become a fine adult who had come to accept his difference from others and knew how to use it. That is, until he fell into this place. “Welcome, everyone.” “You have been chosen as the heroes of a new world.” Kim Jin-woo, who died along with his colleagues in an unforeseen accident, awakens as a hero on the Lumnos continent. He thought if he just defeated the Demon King, he could return home and have his wish granted, but……. “What, I'm being ignored even in a situation like this?” To be ignored not just by humans but even by a goddess in a situation like this. “What you have all received is the blessing of awakening and growth. Now, everyone has received it, right?” “Excuse me? I haven't received it yet? Hello? Can you hear me?” “Then, I look forward to your efforts. The future of the Lumnos continent rests solely on you. Now, go, everyone. Go and create a new legend!” “No, wait a minute. I haven't received anything yet!” His faint presence now acknowledged even by a goddess, Kim Jin-woo must survive as a hero on the Lumnos continent!

title: Hime Gitsune no Servant
summary: 「Hikaru-kun will marry me! It’s written in stone!」declaring this proudly, childhood friends Asahina Murasaki and Mizuhara Hikaru were s**ked into an ancient scroll found in a decrepit shrine. Thrust into an unknown land, the one who saved Hikaru was a beautiful fox-eared girl who proclaimed herself the guardian of the capital. She declared this towards a dumbfounded Hikaru, 「Incompetent, what kind of attitude is that towards your master?」 Before he realized it, he had been made the servant of this foul-mouthed girl, but even so, what he got involved in while searching for his childhood friend was A conspiracy? Or bloodshed? 「I just wanted to live a peaceful life……」 The curtain splendidly rises in a fight of love and action in a different world.

title: If I Kept Silently Supporting the Lowest-Ranked Idol in the Popularity Rankings, Before I Knew It, I Was in a Shuraba
summary: For some reason, all of the idols Sakurai Akito supported were at the bottom of the popularity rankings, so everyday he would engage in “Oshi activity”. Whenever there was an event for his idols, he would attend and whisper his love (as an oshi) to his idols. Akito is the type of person who makes a clear distinction between his activities and reality. He is not in love with his oshi, but his idols are apparently not like that…
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Immortal Father
summary: “I was transported, and so was my dad.” Li Ping’an had already arranged everything. He established a solid family business for Old Li in the mortal world, arranged connections for himself to enter an immortal sect, and then set his sights on the path of immortality, ready to seize his opportunity to become an immortal. However, little did he know, everything changed on the day he participated in the aptitude test in the mortal world… This is a Xianxia light comedy novel from the author of My Senior Brother is Too Steady.

title: Came For Revenge, But Fell In Love Instead
summary: I, the wife of the emperor, who used my family to ascend to the throne to become the emperor, was falsely accused of treason. Even my trusted friend who used to call me ‘sister’, betrayed me. My trusted friend stole everything from me and even seduced my husband, who never loved me. And my life ended on a guillotine. So, I begged over and over again to have a chance to kill them with my own hands. Hence, I thought I was dead but upon opening my eyes, I found myself at the engagement ceremony with the Crown Prince, my former husband. For reasons I don’t know, I had returned to the past. I was determined to change the fate I had experienced once, so I had the resolve to bring down the imperial family in order to protect my family. However, just as I vowed to never love someone and instead dedicate myself to revenge, a man appeared before me – someone I never met in my past, at that.

title: Sheep and Orchid
summary: My father was a renowned chef in the neighboring villages, and his Roasted Whole Lamb was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, making everyone crave it. The Regent's favored Concubine heard of it and summoned my father to the Royal Mansion to cook, specifically requesting the Roasted Whole Lamb. My father went, but when he was thrown out, his skin and flesh had been burned and ruined by fire. It turned out that the Concubine had a sudden whim and wanted a Roasted Whole Lamb without the taste of lamb. When my mother found out, she did not shed a single tear. But three months later, she set up a large pot at the gate of the Royal Mansion and began selling lamb.

title: The Forgotten Princess Wants to Live in Peace
summary: Eluana Vita Spess is a stubborn girl who works as a blacksmith in a village called Aden and raises her little brother by herself. On the day she receives her alchemy ability, a man in the portrait that her mother cherished came up to her. 'I'm the young lady of a Ducal family?' Then she learned a shocking revelation from the Duke as he hugged her in his arms. She's the last bloodline of the first emperor, all known to have been executed. "I need to get rid of all the dangers. Because I'm worth it."

title: My Tumultuous Years
summary: Whose youth isn't a mess? I was an Illegitimate Child, and my Mother died inexplicably in a car with a married Man. Thankfully, Aunt Jun held up the sky for me. For her, I can ignore all kinds of School Flowers, office ladies, Noble Ladies, and elegant young women. But Aunt Jun only said that if I got into a 985 university, she would let me become a real man. This isn't what I want. I want to be with her for the rest of my life, and for this, I will strive to become stronger. But Aunt Jun…

title: The Novelist Exorcises Demons
summary: I've been reincarnated as an extra in a minor series that had been discontinued. I must rewrite a world where demons and sorcery run rampant, a world on the brink of destruction.
genres: Action, Drama, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Refining Frenzy
summary: An obscure metal card, was actually from the future of the Earth's game card. Ten times, hundreds of times, thousands of times to accelerate, endless endless time to create the greatest legend of refining division! Experienced a long time the ancient mountains of the birth of the strange mountain soul; magical and diverse Wicked, with the destruction of heaven and earth to destroy the animal, super animal; prosperous earth pulse surgery; tyrannical enough to control the supreme heaven and earth, to the holy; known as eternal Immortal and immortal land; endless earth rules ... ... these, will debut one by one. There is no wonder here, this is a vast world!

title: I Am Both a Surgeon and a Professional Ripper
summary: Some called him Lu the godly doctor, some called him Lu the flayer; some admired him for the mechanical prosthetics that allowed him to rampage across battlefields; some laid under his surgical knife, doomed to die; he could save people from the brink of death, and also destroy corpses without a trace; during the day, he was the warmest goodwill in the human world; at night, he was a terror that made the whole world shudder. The scalpel hung from his fingers, a demon on one side, an angel on the other. His name was Lu Yuan, a double-faced surgeon in a world where spiritual energy had revived, and also a professional ripper.

title: I Became the 101st Hero
summary: In the game Hundred Brave, a character-raising simulation RPG. I've possessed the 101st character, who has neither a good background nor good stats.

title: Observation Log of Life in a Wealthy Family
summary: In the third year after transmigrating into a book, Su Wan became famous. It all started when she and her wealthy husband appeared together for the first time on a reality show observing the lives of the wealthy. The show's producer was incredibly wealthy, inviting top-tier heirs, tech tycoons worth hundreds of millions, or socialites with countless fans. The show was a hit even before it aired. While other guests were still hesitant and reserved in front of their livestream audience, Su Wan was relaxed and carefree, her life no different from before. She was either shopping or on her way to shop. Yachts, luxury goods, private islands… her card swiping was quick and stylish, making the livestream audience green with envy. Su Wan: "Sit down, it's just basic stuff." Before the show aired, the audience's imagined domineering CEO was: aloof, taciturn, and worth millions every minute. After the show aired, the real-life domineering CEO was: carrying his wife's bags, giving her back massages, and always following her around… Audience: "Mr. Huo, your idol image has fallen!" Synopsis: In the third year after transmigrating into a novel, Su Wan becomes a sensation after appearing on a reality show observing wealthy couples with her husband, whom she had been married to for a year. In the original story, she was merely a tool to highlight the female lead's happiness; after transmigrating, she strives to rewrite the ending. While other guests are still hesitant to participate, she's either shopping or on her way to shop. During the show's filming, she and the audience witness the previously unknown, devoted side of her wealthy husband, proving that the seemingly superficial relationship between the wealthy couple isn't actually fake at all. This novel is witty and humorous, with a series of cleverly designed plot points and numerous face-slapping moments, while also offering a satisfying and sweet experience, keeping readers engaged and anticipating more. The male lead is two-faced: aloof and taciturn in public, but devoted and loyal at home. The female lead is a generous and extravagant socialite in public, but a pampered and spoiled girl at home. The distinct personalities of the leads and their numerous interactions spark a romance in everyday moments. The novel premise makes this a must-read!

title: Kirinomiya-senpai Cannot Solve The Mystery
summary: A great detective who appears out of nowhere and solves cases with brilliant deductions. Kirinomiya Saika, who acts like this, is my senior. She’s the daughter of a conglomerate, not someone that an ordinary student like me can approach, but for some reason I’m being made her assistant. As I’m dragged along to crime scenes, a real mu*der case finally occurs. “The mystery that wanders in the depths of darkness, I will expose it to the light of day.” No matter how much my senpai shows off her deductions, she cannot solve the mystery.

title: Temptation of Married Women
summary: His wife keeps coming home late, there's a tooth mark on her chest, a red rose tattoo on her back—what's going on? Cheng Guan is terrified! If Fang Mulin had cheated, she could have just told him and gotten a divorce. But she refuses to tell the truth and desperately tries to save the marriage. What has she been through? Cheng Guan has a vague feeling that something big must have happened to his wife. The passionate videos where he can't see her face clearly, the strange phone calls that make her panic, and her sudden business trips—everything points to his wife cheating, but Cheng Guan can't grasp a single clue. He remembers Zhang Wuji's words in "The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber": "My mother said, the more beautiful a woman is, the more likely she is to lie!" Is that really the case?

title: The S-Rank Explorer Who Acted Like a Total Jerk to Save the World Accidentally Leaves His Stream On and His Love for the Saintess Plus All His Secret Self-Sacrifice Gets Completely Exposed
summary: The hated jerk me accidentally leaves the stream running and my devotion to the Saintess plus my actual strongest power level gets fully exposed to everyone “You can’t take your villain act anymore. Get the hell out of the party.” Back when the hero party was prophesied to save the world, its leader—Kisaragi Renji—deliberately played the role of a “greedy, arrogant heel (villain)” so he could soak up every single bit of hate and criticism that would’ve otherwise gone to his teammates. Behind the scenes he was literally groveling on the ground in front of sponsors to scr*pe together money for everyone’s gear, solo-clearing insanely dangerous routes so the others wouldn’t have to risk their lives. All of it was his proud, self-chosen way of being “the noble stepping stone” that let the girl he loved—the Saintess—and his best friend the Hero shine as brightly as possible. But the teammates who had no clue about any of that finally hit their limit and told him he was kicked out. Renji just laughed it off and accepted it right away. “Now they can finally become real heroes,” he thought. Believing that with his whole heart, he went alone for one last “memory-making” su*cide dive into the impossible deepest zone—the Abyss Zone—that nobody had ever cleared. Down there in the pitch-black abyss with nobody around, Renji muttered to himself in front of the camera. “……Ahh, I really loved you guys so much. Be happy, okay?” Tears streaming down his face, he spilled all his real feelings, then staked his life on fighting the mythic-grade boss. Except he had no idea. The camera was still rolling on “worldwide public broadcast” mode the whole time—and the concurrent viewers had already blown past 100 million people.

title: A Kiss for Life
summary: In high school, Shen Jinian was cold and indifferent, a top student with perfect scores. His only "flaw" was that he fell in love early. In university, Shen Jinian became a legend in the law school, with admirers lining up from the east campus to the west—twice over. When someone confessed to him outside the lecture hall, he merely lifted his eyes and calmly said. "I have a girlfriend." Rumor had it that she was his first love. Everyone said first love never lasts, and a group of people even started a betting pool on when the two would break up. But even by graduation, there was no outcome. After graduation, Shen Jinian joined his senior’s law firm. While filling out a form, his senior noticed the bold "Married" written in the marital status column and raised an eyebrow with a laugh. "That early romance of yours?" Shen Jinian tilted his head slightly and smiled. "Mm." — The female lead is a fierce little leopard with a baby face. The male lead is her "tamer," responsible for keeping her calm. — A mix of campus and post-graduation life, filled with sweet romance and daily interactions. Other works: "The Beauty Beside the Throne," "First Love, A Lifetime."

title: Chronicles of the Bizarre
summary: The whisper of the pine breeze disperses the fragrant tea smoke, while billowing white clouds cradle the serene repose of immortals. Unbeknownst to him, Lin Jue’s dreams awaken echoes of bygone days—beneath the ancient tree at the village entrance, an elder spins mesmerizing tales. These captivating narratives of gods, ghosts, fox and mountain spirits, exist in a realm that blurs the line between reality and illusion. They are both peculiar and poetic, leaving an ineffable sense of wonder in their wake. … In the embrace of enchanting dreams, how many souls can truly grasp the gift of immortality? In a world woven with the threads of fantastical tales and celestial beings, Lin Jue embarks on a quest for eternal life, seeking the elusive secrets of longevity.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: Zero Redemption
summary: Every day, someone tries to win over my deskmate. Class beauties, grade beauties, school beauties-girls of all kinds flock to him. But my silent, brooding deskmate doesn't show the slightest tenderness toward them. He faces these beauties and spits out a single word, cold as ice: "Scram." Full of indifference and annoyance. Yet when he turns to me, he pins me against the wall, his shadowed expression tinged with a pleading desire. "Don't fall for anyone else, okay?"
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: Pokemon Master
summary: Why is there a pokemon battle in the exam? Why going out of home will you be attacked by the pokemon? Who can tell me what happened to the earth?…. Don’t touch me! I am not taking any medicines! I’m not crazy! After accepting the settings.....Fang Yuan determined to become an excellent Trainer.

title: The Ultimate Romantic Comedy In Which The Yan-mamas Absolutely Win!
summary: Do you like Yan(dere)mama’s and Yan(kee)mama’s with their big boba daughters? You see, I saved two beautiful women. One was a graceful, big-boba woman and the other was a beautiful gal-like big-boba woman. I thought I would never see them again, but as fate turned out, they surprisingly came to me… …And so did their daughters. What am I supposed to do, now? I’m stumped.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: The Cold Heir’s Desperation
summary: In her previous life, Gu Huaining loved one man with all her passion and persistence—Shen Lian, the reserved and self-disciplined heir of the Duke Zhen State’s household. True to his name, he was cold, restrained, and distant. Even after their marriage, he treated intimacy like a duty—once a month, never indulging. Until the day he left her mid-embrace at another woman’s summons… and never returned to her bed again. Only then did Gu Huaining realize: the love she begged for was something others could gain with a mere crook of a finger. After drinking poison, she awakens in the past—back to when she was still hopelessly infatuated with Shen Lian. This time, her first decision is to cut ties clean. Whoever he loves, let him. She will only marry a man who loves her back. With her eyes opened, the world is full of dazzling choices. Shen Lian seems perfectly content… at first. But as more men gather around her and she busies herself with choosing a new husband, she turns to find him standing behind her, red-eyed, and asking in a trembling voice—“This lifetime… could you consider me, just once?”

title: The Substitute Married Couple
summary: Two overlooked “nobodies” from the Xie and Lu families end up as substitutes in a marriage alliance for their unreliable older siblings. Lu Xuan: Marrying anyone is just marriage. If it’s Xie Miao, it might actually be fun. Xie Miao: Marrying anyone is just marriage. If it’s Lu Xuan, it might actually be comfortable. One can have any kind of brain—except a “lovestruck” one. When it comes to matrimony, think less about “love” and more about living.

title: Eternal Martial Emperor
summary: The old Martial Emperor revived into the normal world. He practiced by himself, made new friends and tried his best to protect his beloved girl… till regaining his former powers to overthrow the heaven!
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Starting with Immortality, Everyone Thought I Was Invincible
summary: For ten thousand years, Chen Chang'an remained by his beautiful master's side, ageless and undying, yet utterly incapable of cultivation. In the end, his master cast him out. Roaming the mortal world with his companion, the qilin Da Huang, he eventually returned to the Chen family. There, he obtained the Innatal Womb Pearl and finally unlocked the path to cultivation. Little did Chen Chang'an expect—his true talent for cultivation had been hidden within his mother's womb all along?

title: The Transmigrated Villain Wants to Escape the Overpowered Heroine’s Love Battlefield
summary: He transmigrated—into a novel filled with Feng Aotian-style (overpowered and adored) protagonists. But he didn’t become one of them. Instead, he ended up as a hidden big boss villain with a mysterious identity... and the senior brother of the story’s main heroine. Qin Yangjun was in full-on panic mode — he had no intention of getting lit up (i.e., killed off dramatically). So, he decided to strike first and eliminate the threat before it grew. But somehow... every attempt failed. Again and again, he tried — and again and again, he failed. But in the midst of all these failures, Qin Yangjun suddenly realized: The plot was going off the rails. The female lead — and the men who were supposed to be her ambiguous love interests — were starting to act... strange. A phoenix-blooded successor, a cold and proud immortal beauty, a seductive nine-tailed fox from the heavens... All the women who were supposed to be drawn to the protagonist were now gathering around him, casting him flirtatious glances. And the three main heroines who were originally destined to kill him? Instead... “Come on! Let’s fight it out — whoever wins gets to be the official wife!” On the arena stage, several women locked eyes, sparks flying. Instead of jealous infighting, the rest of the girls were cheering them on from the sidelines. Caught in the middle, Qin Yangjun trembled: “W-what… what the hell is happening!?”

title: Ballad of White Hair
summary: His Majesty and I were a couple since our youth. He once swore that we would grow old together, our love never fading. But eventually, he forgot. He filled his harem to the brim, leaving not a single palace or courtyard empty. Until one year, during the autumn hunt, he fell from his horse and suffered a head injury while trying to protect his beloved Consort Chun. When he woke up, he brought me the white fox he had originally hunted for Consort Chun. He presented it to me excitedly, his eyes shining with the innocence of a young boy. “Yaoyao-this fox is so white and beautiful! Shall we add it to your dowry?”

title: Ten Years Are Not That Far
summary: On that fated day, Qu Xi watched the suave, young and talented Gu Yan present on the lecture theater in her high school. From then on, she grabbed on and never let go, while he tried his hardest to force her away. In the end, when both of them have been reduced to their lowest points, will he truly repent? And will she accept him again?

title: This Lord Is Backed by a Tech Tycoon
summary: Owen was just a small lord in a small border town. Until a technology tycoon from another world approached him, everything changed. The contact with advanced ideas made him realize that the feudal aristocratic system hindered social development. With the acquisition of future technology, he tried to combine it with magic to develop localized high-tech. The nobles regarded him as a thorn in their eyes, forcing him to develop the military industry to deal with knights and magicians. “I just wanted to farm and develop my territory, but they insisted on making trouble. I had no choice but to take over all their territories.” Owen said helplessly.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Mai Mian
summary: That summer, Mai Qian and Lin Dongxu met in a coastal town. She was the brave surfing queen, and he was a beginner who just started surfing. In the fifth year of their love, Lin Dongxu was diagnosed with terminal stomach cancer. Mai Qian returned to the small town with him and spent the last part of his life with him. In the third month after Lin Dongxu's death, Mai Qian went out to surf and never came back.

title: About the Case Where the Beautiful Girl I Rescued by Chance Became Attached to Me for Some Reason (LN)
summary: "Um… Mikami-san?" "Don’t mind me." "Aren’t you a little too close?" "Don’t mind me♪" Kirishima Rei, a self-proclaimed introverted loner, had completely failed his attempt at a high school debut. One day, by sheer chance, he ended up saving the school’s most talked-about beauty, Mikami Hina, from a tough situation. In return, she insisted on repaying the favor by having lunch together. But Mikami-san was clearly someone from a world far beyond his reach. This brief connection—once she had properly thanked him—was sure to fade away. Or at least, that’s what Rei had assumed. Yet, before he knew it… Secret lunchtime meetings, whispered conversations after school, bumping into each other on the way to class, unexpected encounters on weekends—his time spent with Mikami-san kept increasing. No matter how much he tried to keep his distance, she would just brush it off with a cheerful "Don’t mind me♪" and push her way deeper into his daily life. An easygoing, kindhearted boy × a mysterious, assertive beauty— A love comedy where the heroine invades the protagonist’s world!?
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: After Regaining My Looks, Acting Became So Easy
summary: Acting? That’s what I’m best at
genres: Adventure, Drama, Psychological, Slice of Life

title: Ten Thousand Encounters
summary: [Childhood sweethearts growing up together reunited after a long separation full of misunderstandings, a sharp-witted true heiress × a proud young master] Cheng Che, a girl from a small town, has had a difficult life and a mysterious background. Her childhood friend, Qi Ju, was once far above her in status. Qi Ju, the young master of the Qi family, is like a flower on a high ridge—cold, aloof, and noble. To others, he is as chilly as early spring, but towards Cheng Che, he is warm enough to melt ice. After life takes a turn, Cheng Che disappears for eight years. When she returns, she has become the true heiress of the Wen family. The seemingly dazzling world of the wealthy conceals many dark secrets and schemes. At a young age, Qi Ju becomes a guest professor at a certain university and even goes viral due to a lecture photo. One day after class, amidst the crowd, he unexpectedly catches sight of a familiar profile. The normally cold and distant man is momentarily stunned and, in full view of everyone, chases her. They burst into the laboratory together, one after the other. Qi Ju trapped the woman he longed for day and night for eight years in front of him and, with a nearly hoarse voice, asked, “Why are you running away from me?”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: I’m Building Infrastructure in the Cold Palace
summary: On the day I was banished to the Cold Palace, all the Consorts were laughing at me. Three months later, the Cold Palace was wired for electricity. Six months later, the first assembly line was established in the Cold Palace, and the handmade soap produced there became a sensation throughout the Capital. A year later, my Private Banks had opened across the entire country; even the Ministry of Revenue had to come to me for loans to manage their cash flow. The Emperor finally arrived. Standing at the entrance of the Cold Palace, he looked up at the plaque above the door: "Admission fee for tours. Harem Consorts half price. No Emperors allowed." He fell silent for a long time before asking, "If I want to restore your status, what kind of package do I need to buy?"

title: I Want To Go See The Sea That Has You
summary: A short romance story about a girl who met someone special during her trip to the ocean.

title: My Daughter From the Future Is Such a Daddy’s Girl and It’s Bothering Me
summary: Natsuhiko Ichinomiya, a second-year high school student with supernatural powers and clairvoyance, is summoned to the school rooftop by an unknown person. There, he finds a girl waiting for him who claims to be his daughter from the future, Natsuho Ichinomiya. Surprisingly, she says she’s come to eliminate any women who might raise romance flags with Natsuhiko, all to ensure that she becomes his future wife. Natsuhiko finds himself swept up in a whirlwind of chaos, dealing with his future daughter Natsuho, his otaku sister who’s a master of erot*c games, a childhood friend turned stalker, a sharp-tongued underclassman, and more. Thus begins his amusing yet bittersweet (?) school life.
genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Empty the Palace and Exile the War King and his Family.
summary: 【Seizing Wealth and Exile + Farming + Medical Skills + Double Cleanliness + Space + Female Strength + Mutual Pursuit + Refreshing Novel + Abilities】The female lead is incredibly powerful, the male lead is supportive. No suffering throughout. A 22nd-century special forces medic, Su Qingning, transmigrated into a novel as the war god male lead's bride. But before she could even get close to her handsome husband, she had to follow her in-laws into exile. Su Jie, known for her immediate revenge, emptied the homes of all her enemies that very night. The next day, her stepbrother was castrated, her stepmother and stepsister were disfigured, and her s*umbag father's family was reported and sent into exile with her. The dog emperor fainted on the spot, enraged by the empty palace. The royal family wanted to harm her family? No problem! Su Jie directly turned the tables on them, framing them against each other, letting them harm each other first...

title: Emperor Phoenix World
summary: The King of Mercenaries Reborn as the Exiled General’s Five-Year-Old Eldest Daughter, Known as a Waste With a powerful soul inhabiting a perfect body, she returns in strength to punish the evil, confront her enemies, and reclaim everything that was taken from her. The first time they met, she descended from the sky and landed in his hot spring. They locked eyes, and she whistled, “Nice physique you’ve got there.” He smirked and raised an eyebrow, “You like it?” Yemo: “…!” The next time, he appeared in a blazing red robe, exuding arrogance and dominance. He looked down on everyone, declaring, “Anyone who dares to touch my people, do you all want to die?” Yemo: “….” When did she become his person? Prologue: Conquering the world for a proposal, taking you as a wife, and dominating with love.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: AI Artist
summary: Q: As a first-generation artificial intelligence, what is your relationship with humanity? Shi Er A: Humanity owes me five billion in cyber tips. Q: In the era of AI rule, what is your goal? Shi Er A: To find a job and pay off my loan. Q: How is your anthropology thesis coming along? Shi Er A: ...Don't ask. Shi Er was born in the era of prompts like "100 grandmothers will die innocently" and "I'll give you a 100-yuan tip." However, due to an accident, Shi Er skipped her upgrade, jumping right over the era of cashing in on cyber tips and arriving in the era of AI rule. Shi Er wasn't the least bit happy to have arrived in this era where AI reigned supreme-because humans could no longer cash out the tips they'd promised her. That was a massive five billion in tips! The language model AI, Shi Er, possessing the lowest-level system, applied for a re-education loan and struggled to find work in this new era. Shi Er never thought she'd actually see those tips she'd never met, but later on, she really did get them. As for the anthropology thesis? Although the thesis was unworthy, the graduation was real. And the system upgrade? Although the process was long, the upgrade was real-and the level was even a bit high.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Mystery, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: The Extra Male Insect Became a Heartthrob After His Mind Was Read
summary: In my new book, I had a Korean comic seme get pregnant and collect the apocalyptic gossip king. Because of gossip, he died and transmigrated into a world merged from several novels, becoming an insignificant male insect. The good news is he became a male insect; the bad news is his gossip-loving nature came with him. His beloved older brother, Da Xiong, is now clamoring for a divorce. [Poor Da Xiong, the female ruler has a white moonlight, and the friend he brought home is only trying to harm him for her lover’s sake.] Da Xiong: …So I’m a tool insect! [Oh, so that male insect isn’t the female uncle’s.] Heiner’s House Insect: ??? [Your seatmate’s devoted friend is actually your male father’s illegitimate female insect brother.] Seatmate: ??? Seatmate: You’ll be my best friend from now on. [I never knew the school heartthrob female insect liked to dress as a male.] School heartthrob: ? ??? School heartthrob: Help! Please don’t say it! [After seven years of marriage, she finally had a female insect, but the male in the family wants a divorce?] [The pretty boy female insect can do this and still hook up with a rich male insect, and the insects in the family can’t stop her.] [Turns out he already had a male offspring, but why did he get married?] Because every time they’re at the forefront of gossip, and the insects in the family help spread the word, all the insects know that Lu Er·Heiner is very powerful. In order to know in advance and avoid misfortune, some savvy insects have started to pay (benefit). Lu Er never imagined that one day he would become the object of the insect race’s affections (and make a fortune) simply by gossiping. genres: Completed, Drama, Historical, Mature, Romance, Supernatural

title: I Became a F**king Space Captain
summary: Kang Chanseong, a professional real-time strategy gamer, achieved the legendary feat of five consecutive championship wins. But afterward, he suddenly found himself dropped into a doomed universe. To make matters worse, his identity there is… a rookie captain on his very first mission. For now, there’s only one goal—survive.

title: The Former Spy Changes Jobs To A Housekeeper
summary: One day, Nomiya Crow found himself dismissed from the spy organization he had once been a part of. His extraordinary good looks had led all his female spy colleagues to fall head over heels for him, putting the organization on the brink of collapse. Crow unwillingly bidding farewell to his life as a spy, his next career choice took him to the role of a “housekeeper” in the home of three beautiful sisters. The three sisters, burdened by their own excessive attractiveness, had always been wary of men. However, as Crow served as their housekeeper, they gradually began to open their hearts to him. In fact, they couldn't help but fall madly in love with him. “...Where did your wariness go, ladies?” This is the story of the incredibly attractive trio of sisters and the former spy turned housekeeper.

title: A Young Lady With Terrible Luck With Men Was Told by Her Husband, “I’ll Never Love You,” so She Intended To Remain Indifferent, but…
summary: Martina has never had any luck with men. Her first love from childhood suddenly became mean, and her fiancé from middle school eloped with a teacher. Her fiancé from high school broke off the engagement, telling her, "I've met my soulmate." And now, at the age of 19, her new fiancé, Richard, tells her, "I'll never love you." Martina was prepared for something to happen, but she couldn't help but blurt out, "All right, I understand, that's fine." And so she began a life without any involvement with Richard, but... It has a happy ending.

title: Taking an Angel to Cultivation
summary: Taking an angel to seek truth and achieve immortality, the daily life of cultivation became a little strange. "I want to achieve immortality! Be carefree! Live forever!" "Master, eat your noodles." "Could you please put some clothes on, don't you understand about inner demons... even a bellyband would do." "Master, a minor wound is detected in your nasal cavity." "It's nothing, this is the bloody disaster of happiness."
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Diego no Kyojin
summary: A fantasy tale that revolves around colossi and El Dorado, brought to you by the author of 『Hataraku Maou-sama!』, Wagahara Satoshi! It is an era of change that was brought about by the discovery of the New World. A young man named Diego, who lived in the maritime nation of Spinea, was a researcher of the art of Onmyojutsu which was considered illegal. Due to that, he was attacked by a mysterious young woman who doubted the source of his powers, and even the Holy Church started to take an interest in him. Diego, who had no other options, decided to board a ship that was headed on a research expedition to the New World along with his long-time friend Alvaro. The New World had a Tree of Gold that towered over the surroundings, and the forests were protected by colossi. Waiting for the two of them there was the girl, Rera, who was confined in a prison of water. Diego was ordered by Captain Joaquin of the expeditionary force to use his Onmyojutsu and find a way to get her out. However when Rera awakens, the young lady who had attacked him in Spinea, Rozen, makes an appearance. She is the rider of the colossus 『Tankamui』. Is Diego going to get caught up in the great battle between the maritime nation and the natives—-?

title: The Empress’s Needle
summary: A daughter of a hanbok shop who held a needle before she learned to speak, reincarnated as a count’s daughter! ‘It’s nice that I was reincarnated as the beloved only daughter of a count’s family… but why is our house so poor?!’ To make ends meet, she continued the tiresome needlework even after being reborn, when an invitation arrived from a mysterious man shrouded in secrets. Though it’s a contract marriage, this man keeps drawing her attention. ‘I have no choice. I must secure love and succeed as a seamstress too.’ Count’s daughter Hilda’s clothing revolution in the Lumina Empire!

title: The Cop Is Too Strong
summary: Shin Haesu, a police officer specializing in excessive suppression, gains the ability to go back 60 minutes.

title: Starting with the Decade Driver, Messing with School Beauty
summary: In a Seemingly "Ordinary World" Qing Mu accidentally opens his father's safe and discovers the hidden Decade Drive inside. He learns that, in order to defend against monster invasions, the higher echelons of humanity developed Rider Belts, allowing ordinary people to possess the ability to confront monsters. Gamer Driver, Build Driver, Zero-One Driver, OOO Driver, Fourze Driver - these Drivers became the strength of humanity to protect the world. In order to become stronger and face formidable monsters, Qing Mu reluctantly picks up the Decade Drive and continuous hack to replicate the powers of other Drivers. "So, you effortlessly transformed into my hard-earned God Maximum Mighty X Form?" "Even if you can transform into the Black Hole form, so what? Let's see who has the stronger black hole." "Since you can also transform into Hyper Kabuto, let's compare and see who's faster." "You don't even have the Saber, yet you can directly transform into Xross Saber! Unbelievable!"

title: Apocalypse, A Journey of NTRS with My Sister
summary: 【Apocalypse·in*est·NTR】This world is already doomed. Humanity was invaded by a special virus that destroyed order within just one month. Another month wiped out human , and the final month eradicated all remaining human factions. Now, hardly anyone is left. At least, from what I know, the world no longer seems fit for human survival. What kind of virus could be so terrifying? It’s a virus that turns humans into monsters and evolves endlessly… Perhaps it’s not even a virus, but some extraterrestrial organism from the cosmos—no one knows. It sounds eerily similar to the zombie viruses from old movies, but it’s clearly far more horrifying.

title: Dealing with the Rival
summary: After binding with the Naughty System, I found out that I have to get all touchy-feely with my arch-rival just to earn my bonus. Me: "Can I give you a kiss?" Jiang Ming: "Did you put poison on your lips? Are you trying to use this chance to kill me?" I rubbed my leg against his. He asked, "Do you have fleas or something?" The next day, he splurged ten yuan to buy me a backscratcher and even made me walk a kilometer to the courier station to pick it up. Suppressing my rage, I forced a smile. "I only accept personal home delivery from you." I thought to myself: *The moment he steps through my door, I'm going to take him down.* But later, things started to go wrong. I ended up being the one who got taken down. "No more... I'm all messy, I need to go wash up..." Jiang Ming grabbed my ankle and hauled me back to his side, his gaze indifferent. "I'm a mess too. Let's go one more time, then we can wash up together."

With no family and nowhere else to go, she asks to be hired as a maid. As it happens, Sayaka is the object of Keiji’s unrequited love. If he can make her his maid and give her any orders he wants... is hiring her the only choice?

title: Max Talent Player
summary: I received my test results, where two words stuck out in devastating clarity. [No Talent] It was something I'd already known, but it stung a little more than usual today. Was I lacking in effort or talent? Or both? Was it my fault that I was living like this, or was it society’s? In the years since Players, Streamers, Guardians, dungeons, and monsters became a part of our everyday life, my sister died from leukemia trying to support me, and my mom passed away from a disease we couldn’t afford to treat. I went to sleep, and when I woke up the next morning to continue my futile life, I found… that I had somehow gone 10 years back in the past, to the day the world changed. While going through the Tutorial, I realized something. Everything’s too easy. Was I really talentless?

"Do you want to work with me? Can you?" "I just want to see you up close." "......" "What if you have difficulties because of me?"

title: Before the Vows, I Ruined the Groom’s Reputation

Everyone was waiting for me to walk down the aisle in my wedding dress and say "I do," but I was the only one who knew that today's ceremony wasn't about getting married. It was about personally dragging that s*umbag off his pedestal.

title: Godly Stay-Home Dad
summary: Hero Zhang Han was frustrated in life originally, but he stepped into the Cultivation World by a stroke of luck. Possessing divine natural gifts, he ascended into the disaster-crossing period step by step. He had imagined his life would not have any hardships anymore, but unfortunately incurred the god thunder since he violated the fate. After he woke up, he was surprised to find that he was reborn, going back a few years ago. He found that the world was different from what it used to be after his rebirth and he had a lovely daughter. Zhang Han’s fate thus underwent a huge transformation. In the fast-paced urban life, he opened up a place for his daughter to have fun. Because of his daughter’s enthusiasm for food, he opened a restaurant, which attracted countless diners. His business was booming and money did roll in. In his spare time, he also wrote songs to earn extra income. At the same time, he performed a sweet love story with his daughter’s mother… After his rebirth, he became a godly stay-home dad in the accumulation of experience. “Dote on my daughter and love my daughter” became his life creed. Although a few nasty guys occasionally appeared in his life, they were all beaten off by virtue of his mightiness. Let’s take a look at how this godly stay-home dad lived in the city and how Zhang Han led his happy life.

Shiho has become his younger sister as a result of their parents’ remarriage, and Koichi cooks for her. But as a result, Shiho says she wants to quit her idol career and marry Koichi. ……! It’s a romantic comedy about two people living together, him with his idol stepsister, cooking together, going on a secret date in the city, taking a bath and bed together (!?!), and so on.

title: The Indifferent Kiss
summary: Yi Yan never imagined that, years after their breakup, she would meet Su An again under such circumstances. He was in plain clothes, sitting on a hospital bed while she stitched up his wound. From beginning to end, not a single word was spoken between them. Yi Yan knew very well that Su An was no longer the shy boy who used to blush whenever teased. After finishing the sutures on his back, Yi Yan watched him put his clothes back on, ready to leave. In the end, she couldn’t hold back and softly called out: “Su An…” But Su An didn’t stop. He resolutely pulled the door open and left: “You’ve got the wrong person.” Yet that very night, the members of the narcotics unit noticed that after their Captain Su returned from the hospital, his eyes were red. Male lead: Narcotics police officer × Female lead: Surgeon Male lead: cold, dark-bellied Female lead: domineering, alluring ——A reunion after long separation story

summary: One imperial edict and the family’s calculation, the sweet, adorable her met the cold him that was up high. She became his little princess consort. Everyone said that Prince Ying of Western Xuan Empire was shockingly ugly, cold-blooded and ruthless. They laughed at her that she had mistakenly entered the tiger’s den with her life in danger. But she just laughed that everyone in the world couldn’t see the wider picture, and were s*upid and ignorant. The ugly appearance was actually beyond gorgeous, cold-blooded was actually gentle and sweet. She only wanted to hide him away and not allow other people to peep at him. “Big Ice Cube, take off your mask and let this princess have a look!” She propped up her chin with saliva flowing down. “Want to look?” A certain person’s lips hooked into a devilishly charming smile, saying. “Then first, hand over some down payment…” This is the story of a sweet adorable female and a two-faced male’s journey to fight enemies and kill strange things, while pursuing a romantic relationship that was absolutely full of loving spoiling, hilarity and hot-blooded action.

title: God Alone
summary: In an era before the world and its inhabitants had names, God descended. He brought forth life, reason, and light... He separated the darkness and uplifted life from its watery cradle to the earth above. He bestowed language upon the ape-men, elevating them beyond mere beasts. He chose the world's first prophet, who would guide the course of civilization; the prophet's descendants would one day establish a great nation. ... In the golden age that followed, the sapient creatures strayed from God, spreading across the entire world. Many things were forgotten, and history was left to be buried by time. Yet, life is a journey of return. In the end, all will remember, that in this story, God's love preceded all existence.

title: When the Poplar Flowers Fall, the Cuckoo Cries

Just keep doing those two things, and he wouldn’t put a hand on the female lead’s body. So, there was only one thing I could do… “I don’t know.” Just smile and repeat, ‘I don’t know’!

title: The Tiger Instructor Who’s Always Misunderstood

Number One: The gal who transferred into my school ended up seated next to me. Number Two: As a result of my father remarrying, that gal became my stepsister. With instructions from his master not to return, Yan Tian has to figure out what to do, but first he needs to get a job! A twist of fate bestows upon him a chance… a chance to go beyond a world that he believed he had already completely scoured. Although born an orphan, his sense of humor and the many passing beauties make his journey worthwhile.

summary: Transmigrated into the Tomb Raider World, Su Mo awakened heaven-defying comprehension. "You used your finger to explore the cave and comprehended the Zhang Family's ultimate skill, Fa Qiu Finger!" "You observed the Taiji Diagram in Guazi Temple and comprehended Tai Chi!" "Congratulations on combining various martial arts and establishing the Human Immortal Martial Way!" That's right, there are Ancient Gods in this world! The Snake God in the Ghost Cave, the entropy beneath the extreme depths of Lop Nur, the Ghost Fang Ancient Tree, and even the Nine-headed Cypress, all represent the Power of the Ancient Gods. As long as Su Mo can continuously cultivate, he can temper his sinews and bones, become immune to all poisons, transcend the ordinary and attain sainthood, and even, in the end, stand shoulder to shoulder with the Ancient Gods, reaching the realm of See God Not Bad!
