The first thing this overwhelmingly powerful Geom-ryeong does upon entering the Central Plains is… Become a courier?! Delivering items faster and more accurately than anyone else?!"

title: Harry Potter and the Master of Magic
summary: In the 1980s, Zhang Hao had amassed unparalleled name, fame and wealth thanks to his unique cheat skill. Just as he was about to become the richest man in the world, a mysterious letter opened the door of a new world for him. “Uh! What? Are you telling me now that I have crossed into the world of Harry Potter? God, are you kidding me?!” With great expectations, Zhang Hao finally walked into Hogwarts. And as a result, a lot of common sense in the magic world was broken… Professor McGonagall, “Oh! Mr. Zhang, what have you become? Why have I never seen such a creature?” Professor Flitwick, “It’s amazing! Is this Lumos Maxima improved from the Lumos Spell? Mr. Zhang, you are such a genius!” Professor Snape, “Harry Potter! I think you should learn more from Zhang Hao. You can never match his talent and resolve!” Professor Dumbledore, “Child! Your light is so dazzling. I think you can keep a low profile. How about giving Harry a chance?” Zhang Hao said with an innocent look, “I also want to keep a low profile, but my strength doesn’t allow it!”

title: Shocking! My Brother Can Reload Save Files
summary: Shen Youwei has a secret—she knows she’s died once. Guan Shanyan also has a secret— Fifteen years ago, when they were climbing Mount Qingjing together, Shen Youwei clearly slipped and fell off a cliff to her death. But when he blinked, he was suddenly holding her hand tightly. He had pulled her back with all his strength. --- Shen Youwei and Guan Shanyan grew up together—first as neighbors, later under the same roof. Guan Shanyan always saw himself as her older brother. Shen Youwei could see the love in his eyes, but he kept his distance. After confessing to him and being rejected, their relationship hit rock bottom. Shen Youwei made a secret account on Weibo and started badmouthing him for fun. After three years of effort, her little account became a “heart-to-heart” friend with Guan Shanyan. On the day she moved back into the Guan family, the two acted like strangers despite sharing a room. But later, in her room, Shen Youwei saw a message sent from Guan Shanyan to her secret account: "How can I make things right with my little sister?" Shen Youwei: ...Heh. --- Fifteen years ago, Shen Youwei and Guan Shanyan watched a meteor shower on Mount Qingjing. The very next night, Guan Shanyan came down with a raging fever. Even after recovering, his health never seemed good. It wasn’t until Shen Youwei saw him kill a wild boar barehanded that she realized— He wasn’t weak. He was way too strong.

title: Living Our Lives Well is More Important Than Anything
summary: Li Chunzhou suspected that she was an NPC in a horror game. Every year in the capital city, there is an Oiran Contest; she has been selected 120 times. The emperor brings back three illegitimate children from the commoners every month, more fertile than pigs. Whenever the last outsider in the capital dies, she goes back a month, along with exactly thirty new outsiders. They dress differently, speak differently from the locals, and even the word "NPC" is overheard by Li Chunzhou from their conversations. Their eyes gazed at Li Chunzhou, greedy yet apprehensive. These people would disappear quietly after thirty days. Li Chunzhou absentmindedly picked at the small scar on her wrist. After several years, it never truly disappeared. And all of this - Li Chunzhou looked at the little monster with dark hair and eyes beside her - started when she picked up this "thing." The tall boy, who was a whole head taller than her, gave Li Chunzhou a strange smile that seemed practiced a thousand times. ... Li Chunzhou was certain that this guy was definitely not "human". summary: One day, high school student Ryou Aomi loses his childhood friend and first love, Mia Morisaki, to illness, and is suddenly summoned by a hero and transferred to another world. A few weeks later. He begins to think that there is a possibility that Mia has been reincarnated in this world, but his life is taken away as a person who brings disaster. However, just before his soul is about to be extinguished, he activates his only gift, "Ikiru Ryuten," and is revived as the strongest being in the world. 『If you are reborn in another world, please meet me again...... and love me again.........』 After changing his name to Siryu and becoming an adventurer, Siryu sets off on a journey to another world where danger and adventure await him, in order to fulfill the promise he made to Mia. Is the girl he meets there the reincarnation of Mia?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance

title: A Master Who Can’t Even Handle a Single S*ave Properly
summary: He took in the rabbit Suin, who was involved in the incident, as a s*ave and treated her kindly. She seemed to repay him with trust and kindness. However, the degree of this became increasingly strange.

title: Paranormal World (The Semi-Physical World)
summary: There are many things in this world that we have yet to discover. However, what we never encounter doesn’t mean it never existed. Most of the time, legends are not just mere legends, and traditions that lasted for generations has its untold cause.

title: Ultimate Firepower
summary: This world is not just as ordinary people know it; there is also an underground world that common people won't come into contact with. Government agents handle trouble in the shadows, and hitmen hired by tycoons solve problems in secret. There are assassins, mercenaries, arms dealers, and agents. There is the dark web that connects this world, and there are tycoons who attempt to control everything with money. Gao Yi broke into the underground world. Invincible in close combat, he carved out his own domain. But in this world, there are guns. Beyond seven steps, the gun is faster. Within seven steps, the gun is both accurate and fast. Within three steps are Gao Yi’s fast fists. If you can't beat them, join them. Gao Yi chose to have it all. To have it all, he became the king of assassins in the mercenary circle, the king of agents in the eyes of assassins, and the king of assassins in the eyes of agents. He became the king of intelligence in the eyes of arms dealers. Until he was crowned king of the entire underground world, Gao Yi became the ultimate firepower.

title: After Conceiving the Heir, She Became Arrogant with Her Child
summary: [The heroine returns with her baby + the hero is strong and doting + the couple ab*ses the s*um + double cleanliness + perfect ending] It is rumored that Miss Lin was pregnant with the child of a beggar in the bridge hole seven years ago, and was despised by thousands of people. Zhan Shao stood at the forefront of the melon-eating and ridiculed him, but he didn't know that he was the broken beggar in the mouth of others. Seven years later, two miniature genius heirs took the initiative to come to the door to recognize their father. One is a hacker master, and the other is proficient in medicine. They are smart and soft, and everyone wants to steal them. "Mommy, you got pregnant with both of us in a muddle, and you have worked hard for six years. It's time to let this man share some of the burden." It is rumored that Mr. Zhan is a flesh-and-blood, abstinence male god. Unexpectedly, the moment he saw Miss Lin, he broke all the principles. Finally, he began to admit-"No one is special to me, except her." From then on, Mr. Zhan became more and more shameless on the road to chasing his wife.

title: Unbuttoning Spring
summary: HE×Double Purity×Sweet Doting×Healing The first time Dai Ying met Lu Mingzhang, the Old Madam said, "He's a generation older than you. You should call him 'Uncle'." Lu Mingzhang casually replied, "No need for formalities. Treat this place as your own home. Just follow the Old Madam's suggestion and call me 'Uncle'." Later, when she came to him with earnest pleas, her words were both sincere and heartrending. Yet he remained unmoved. She rubbed her eyes, wiping away tears that held no warmth. "Uncle, why won't you show some kindness to your junior?" Lu Mingzhang's eyebrow twitched, his expression unreadable. Then his voice lowered, "Very well." She asked him to show her kindness, and he truly did... in the most intimate way, cherishing her to the very core of his being. After that, Dai Ying only trembled out the word "Uncle" during the most "urgent" moments. She never imagined that one day, this man would whisper in her ear with a low sigh, "My wife, there's no need to stand on tiptoe. Your husband will lower his head." Later, she sat regally in the main hall, her enemies bowing their heads, offering tea, and addressing her as "Mother".

title: Live Fortune-Telling Nails It Poor Girl Goes Viral
summary: [Mysticism + Fortune-Telling + Live Streaming + Ghost Hunting + Feel-Good Story + CEO + Dual Strong Leads] After dying unexpectedly, the mystical expert Ye Zhishu transmigrates into a book! She finds herself as the useless, kind-hearted older half-sister in a sweet romance novel—rejected by her family and living in poverty. To make matters stranger, she gets bumped by a Mountain God Seal and becomes the Mountain God of Qingming Mountain. Mountain God Seal: “Since you’ve already… ahem, become the Mountain God, to revive Qingming Mountain, you must collect believers’ faith. Otherwise, both you and Qingming Mountain will be annihilated!” Looking around at her empty home, Ye Zhishu thinks: “Might as well just die again.” But life goes on, and she decides to survive in style. Ye Zhishu sets up an online stall, offering ghost hunting, fortune-telling, and protective charms—as long as the money comes, everything is negotiable! Soon, clients start pouring in: A popular streamer: “Master, master, can you tell me if I’ll survive my ghost house adventure this time?” A rich second-generation heir: “Master, will my girlfriend finally be human this time?” A wealthy CEO: “Master, my aunt has gone missing!”
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I’m a Second Male Lead in a Romance Fantasy, but I Don’t Like the Female Lead
summary: I fell into a romance fantasy world that I’ve never read before in my life. From what I can tell, I’m the Northern Duke who’s fighting with the Crown Prince over a woman, basically in the second male lead position… “But my fiancée is prettier?” The female lead is really not my type. Can’t you just take that woman, and I’ll live happily with my fiancée instead?

title: LV99 Demon King’s Servant. I Was Reincarnated in the Game World That I Used to Play in My Previous Life, so I Will Do My Best to Guide My Favorite Demon King to a Happy Ending
summary: The protagonist is a reincarnated villainous aristocrat. His name is “Varian Klovrulm.” One day, Varian realizes that he is a reincarnated person and that the world is the world of the game “Fielder Resonance,” which he played in his previous life. In that game, he has “favorite character”. The Demon King Irina. She is the last boss of the game, and regardless of what route is taken, she is the one who will be killed by protagonist at the end of the game. “—— Never I will accept it.” He can’t stand the fact that the Demon King, who is his favorite character, has to meet such an end! Varian, who has gained memories of his previous life, becomes extremely determined to engage in the training that he had hated. Everything he does is to lead his favorite Demon King to a happy ending who is about to die an unhappy death. In order to save the Demon King, he begins his training. He then becomes a servant of the Demon King, and goes on a rampage to save the Demon King from all kinds of disastrous situations!

title: King of Hollywood
summary: In the ‘90s era, Adrian Cowell was just a rich young man living it up in Los Angeles who had spent years in indulgence and often caused trouble. Unable to allow his behavior to continue, his parents changed their will before their passing and he was no longer able to live as extravagantly as he did before. However, Adrian’s fate took a turn one night while trying to fix his bedside lamp which led to Zhang Haoxuan, a man from the future who had time-traveled after being intoxicated, to possess his body. Assuming his new identity as ‘Adrian’, he utilizes his absurd memory for films in his former life as Zhang Haoxuan, as well as Adrian’s wealth and connections, to replicate films that have been produced in the future — determined to dominate the Hollywood scene. Watch Adrian as he rises to be the king of Hollywood, a figure who will be envied by many!

title: The Case of an Idol’s Disappearance
summary: It's a story of an older brother, a former failed idol, who returns five years ago and discovers the disappearance and death of a popular idol, his younger brother.

title: The Proper Way for a Little Crow to Repay Its Kindness
summary: An enchanted crow is struck by lightning during its tribulation, leaving it charred to a crisp. A kind human finds it and takes it home to nurse back to health. Decades later, the crow awakens to find itself reincarnated as Wu Xiaoya, the daughter of City A's richest man. All the students at school envy Wu Xiaoya. She's not only gorgeous, like an anime protagonist, but also incredibly wealthy. Her backpack costs hundreds of thousands, her pens are specially custom-made, and the water she drinks is transported from a snowy mountain thousands of miles away. However, one day, they notice Wu Xiaoya acting a little strange. When they ask her a question, she answers it perfectly. Yet, on her own exams, she gets every single question wrong. Everyone is stunned: A true genius can fill out an entire exam and still score zero. Then one day, the real genius of the school accidentally gets a hold of one of her exams. Every single answer is well-reasoned and clear, yet each one perfectly avoids the correct answer. "Interesting." He takes a look at the name. "Hmm? Isn't this the nickname of my family's crow?" Notes: Protagonist: The female lead is a crow spirit. Story: The entire story is whimsical and imaginative. Genre: A fantastical, slice-of-life romance. Tags: In love with one person, close proximity romance, sweet story, ancient fantasy. Keywords: Main character: Wu Xiaoya; Supporting character: [Empty] ; Others: [Empty] One-sentence summary: A sexy crow online shows what it means to poison herself. Moral: One hundred years of kindness should be repaid with one's own body.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Got Pregnant with Triplets After One Night with a Soldier: I Lay Low and Won Big in the 1980s
summary: Modern-day food blogger Jiang Yue had transmigrated into a novel. She became a vicious supporting female character in an era novel, one who was beautiful but good for nothing! She had just gotten married and immediately put a green hat on her old husband! She even ab*sed the little bun that the old man had adopted! After discovering that she was the real daughter of a wealthy family, she left behind a divorce letter and ran off to acknowledge her biological parents, only to be thrown out by them when they declared that they only loved the fake daughter. What was even worse, because of her special physique, she had actually been sold off to give birth to children for an idiot. Jiang Yue: What kind of joke is this! She absolutely refused to live such a rotten life! Just watch her stomp on the scum, ab*se the tr*sh, and turn the tides to make a dazzling life for herself in the 1980s. But wait—wasn’t it said that her husband was old and ugly? Then who was this broad-shouldered, long-legged, strikingly handsome man with an air of asceticism (and repressed desire) all over him? "Come here!" The man's voice was hoarse. His shirt was half open, and from time to time he pinned her against the wall and stole kisses. Jiang Yue: "……" This plot progression didn’t quite match what was written in the original novel. Wasn’t it said that the male lead loathed this female supporting character, and that a month after the supporting character’s exit, he would marry the female lead? Then who was this man, whose eyes turned dark the moment he saw her, who used his beauty to tempt her, who kept touching her here and there and everywhere, and went around declaring to everyone that she was his wife?

title: The Boy Who Gave Up on Romantic Feelings ~I’m Done Because I Was Betrayed by The Girlfriends I Used to Date~
summary: I don’t want to get hurt anymore. The main character, Shintani Maeshima, got betrayed twice by his ex-girlfriends. Moreover, it happened in the same situation. —what happens twice will happen thrice. Maejima no longer wants to fall in love. He doesn’t want to be betrayed in such a way again.
genres: Drama, Ecchi, Mature, Romance, School Life

title: That Turtle, The Strongest On Earth
summary: When Bruno was eight years old, he got a turtle from a stall at a festival. That turtle, Ivy, continued to grow rapidly... and eventually became larger than a house. To prevent Ivy from being hunted, Bruno registered himself as a tamer and decided to start an adventurer's life with Ivy. Wanting to sit on Bruno's shoulder again like in the old days, Ivy gained the ability to adjust her size... and as it turns out, she was actually the strongest.

title: Play Baseball Instead of Infinite Regressor
summary: The hero who carried the perpetually struggling Busan Waves to the Korean Series. “Baseball… do you want to play?” “Yes!” I jumped at the opportunity he offered. [Regression.] No… but you never said anything like that!

title: I Had To Take A Day Off From Work Because I Was Suspected Of Being In Love With Someone
summary: Goro Araki, 32 years old and single, is in his 10th year of working. He was a big fan of Momoka Aimi, a member of the five-member idol group “Sakura Romance”. One day, her “alleged infatuation” was reported. Araki broke down the moment he saw the online news and decided to take a day off from work in shock. The weekly magazine showed a picture of her seemingly shaking hands with the other man, which was covered with mosaic. Araki came to one inference. “Hey, isn’t that … me?” He becomes a party to the allegations and gets caught up in his daily life with Momoka Aimi. Even adults can have sweet and sour youth forever.

title: Last Bus of Route 13 Ⅱ
summary: Have you ever lived next to a dead person? Have you ever read a story that kept you in suspense? Are you scared? Click on it, read on, for suspense upon suspense!
genres: Adventure, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: Sis, You’re Pretty Broke, Huh?
summary: Synopsis: Northeastern-flavored, wealthy domineering CEO × Broke girl with big dreams After graduation, Shi Zhen joined the vast ranks of the “graduated and unemployed.” Having been obedient her whole life, she suddenly wanted to rebel for once. So, without telling her family, she secretly rented a small place, claiming she was working while preparing for the civil service exam. In reality, she stayed in her rental every day writing scripts. A month later, after facing more than a dozen rejections for her scripts and being so broke that she only had 100 yuan left, Shi Zhen made a post online documenting her broke life. The post barely got any views. A few days later, it finally received its first comment: Xie-ge: Sis, what part of the Northeast are you from? A few days later: Xie-ge: Sis, mind adding me on WeChat? And a few days after that: Xie-ge: Sis, how can you live on just 100 yuan? Let me order you some takeout. And then yet again, a few days later: Xie-ge: Sis, I’m seriously rich. Want me to transfer you 10,000 first to show my sincerity? Shi Zhen: ……… Xie Qian — the one and only heir of the Xie family in Shulin. After nearly thirty years of life, Young Master Xie entered a bout of existential crisis and suddenly began to miss his childhood in the Northeast. Shulin has everything: gold on every corner — but not a shred of human warmth. Xie Qian carries himself with integrity, but his father nags him constantly: “Righteousness has no place in business, and kindness doesn’t lead armies.” He’s been saying this for over ten years — Xie Qian’s ears practically have calluses. Outsiders say the Xie family’s heir stayed in the Northeast for a few years, and that thick Northeastern accent of his still hasn’t gone away. Only those who know him well understand — hasn’t gone away? He never intended to change it! It’s not just the accent he doesn’t want to change. It’s also the fire in his heart that’s never burned out — despite all his years in the business world. On his 29th birthday, Xie Qian had a subtle, uneasy feeling that that fire might finally be going out. Then suddenly, he stumbled upon a post: A girl determined to chase her dream — surviving an entire month on just 100 yuan. To Xie Qian, 100 yuan disappears in the blink of an eye. And so, he began spending money on that girl like his life depended on it. In saving her, he was also saving himself. Later on, Shi Zhen entered Xie Qian’s world. Like a fawn who accidentally wandered into a dangerous forest, all she wanted was to escape. But Xie Qian was like a wolf. A wolf pushing the little deer forward — not to devour her, but to bring her into his den, to protect her properly.

title: The Reincarnated Mid-Boss Welcomes the Protagonist With a Level of 999 ~ It Seems the Hero Is Mistaken About Having a Max Level of 99 ~
summary: Let’s snatch the items from the jar beforehand. Oh, and also the heroine candidates, right? The protagonist, Tsunaka Hajime, was reincarnated as the son of the demon duke, Zaus Jarmel. It seems his memories from his previous life have awakened. In his past life, he was a corporate s*ave, worked to death from overwork. He was reincarnated as the mid-boss that appears in the Brave Sword Quest, commonly known as Breque. In the beginning, his father, the demon duke, is killed by the hero, and he seeks revenge against the hero. And thus, it’s a scenario where he gets killed by the hero. Moreover, Zaus’s position is strictly that of a mid-boss. He’s just a checkpoint, not the main boss or anything. In terms of the game, it’s like a tutorial. While it makes you think the max level is 99, the scenario actually has a max level of 999. The mid-boss demon duke Zaus, who is defeated within that level 99 range, is the one. Isn’t it kind of pathetic for the mid-boss to be defeated by the hero protagonist? And what’s up with being fated to be defeated! My previous life wasn’t great as a corporate s*ave, and it was a terrible life! Zaus is currently 15 years old. He will be defeated by the hero at the age of 20. Only 5 years left. He made the choice to avoid the bad ending. He will strengthen his own army and weaken the protagonist using his knowledge of the game. He stopped hitting his subordinates. The monsters are valuable assets. Training them is more important than hitting them. They will be provided with ample food, and medical care will be thorough. It’s to create the strongest army to defeat the hero. “Master seems to have changed… He might have become kind of gentle…” Not hitting the subordinates is inefficient. Injuries to valuable assets will result in a decrease in combat effectiveness. Everything must be done efficiently! Efficiency is paramount! That’s right, let’s snatch the contents of the dungeon’s treasure chest beforehand too. The protagonist’s scheming begins. What will happen in 5 years? Will Zaus be able to defeat the hero? The curtain rises on a thrilling fantasy of avoiding the bad ending.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: There’s No Way My Dad Is A Legendary Cultivator
summary: Jiang Ping transmigrated to a world of the cultivation with a sign in system and became the chief of a deteriorating cultivation family. Most importantly, he had three cute and playful daughters. Because the world of cultivation out there is too dangerous and his daughters are too young, Jiang ping chose to hide their identities and live in a small town of ordinary people. He kept warning his daughters that the world out there is too dangerous, so don’t make any trouble. “Daughters, you must remember that there are tons of bad people out there! Their favorite thing to do is to kidnap little girls like you and use you for evil cultivation methods.” “In this world of cultivation, the most important moral to follow is to stay low-key and hide. As long as we don’t cause any trouble, we’ll never be in any danger. Until one day, when a supreme divine cultivator came to seek revenge, Jiang Ping smacked him down on the ground and completely crushed him over and over again… His daughters asked, “Daddy, was that person you just beat up a Divine Cultivator?” Jiang Ping said, “Nop, that was just a bad person who was trying to disturb our happy life. Daughters, the world outside is too scary, we didn’t even go out and danger came knocking on our door!” His daughters asked, “Daddy, do you think that we’re all idiots?” The servants he hired all said, “So the family chief is the real supreme cultivator?”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: The Hero Who Was Reincarnated as a Facial Genius
summary: The strongest hero of mankind, Rodri the Black-Helmed Hero, has saved the world from countless crises. Yet, he carries a secret he’s never told anyone. One day, he succeeds in summoning the Goddess of Beauty and makes the wish of his lifetime: “I wish… to be handsome!” Moved by his plea, the Goddess Ashtar grants his wish — but in her own way. “Be born again.” Thus, the hero is reincarnated as Roin, the youngest son of Baron Raiden’s family! Now begins the tearful (and dazzling) beauty struggle of an absolute being discovering the thrilling, ever-new joy of being handsome!

title: Adorable Baby at the Door: Mommy, Please Sign
summary: In order to save her mother five years ago, Jiang Sese went to him and chose to never see her child again after giving birth to them. Five years later, an adorable child started pestering her for kisses, hugs, and asked to sleep together with her. Jiang Sese happily gave in to the child’s every request.

title: SPEEDBOY!
summary: A tale of solitude by Maijo Otaro following Naruo, a boy with a mane on his back, in his constant search for speed.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Romance, Sports, Supernatural

title: To You, Dear Beyond the Fireplace
summary: Helen Atwell, a skilled pilot. Her job is to drop bombs over enemy bases and shoot down enemy aircraft. To uphold the hated Empire’s prestige—and to protect the very people of the Empire who had oppressed her. It had already been months of throwing herself headlong into death. Then, like a miracle, she received a wizard’s letter through the fireplace. To the dearly missed Miss Helen. I practiced my handwriting a great deal to make a good impression on you. I simply couldn’t bring myself to send you a letter in ugly script. I hope the magic I send this time will please you. As she gradually grows fond of the gentle, secretive wizard Enoch, Helen is also assigned to the squadron under the cold, taciturn Major Alek Morton— whose origins and attitude cause them to clash endlessly… “You should have just gone back.” “You dying is not an option. So stop saying things like that.” Helen had never imagined that a single letter, flying into a winter battlefield, would change her life forever.

title: Crying in the Paranoid Brother’s Arms After Rebirth
summary: [Rebirth + Obsession + Seduction + Goofball] In a car accident, Shu Qianzhi saved Ji Zechen's life, and in return, Ji Zechen "accidentally" picked up a "little sister." She was a crybaby who would throw a tantrum if she couldn't see him for even a second. She was impolite, demanding he feed her and coax her to sleep. To everyone's astonishment, the renowned Master Ji of the capital was utterly devoted to a woman, fulfilling her every wish and spoiling her to the heavens. Only later did they discover that this person who had suddenly barged into his life was reborn to make up for the regret of their previous life, where they were mutually in love but could not be together. Theirs was a love that was a full two lifetimes late.

title: I’m Alone at the Gate
summary: The story begins when the living room of my room is connected to the basement of the royal palace of the Kingdom of Raymond on the continent of Pangamonia.

title: The Silver Sword Grudge
summary: The series follows Shen Shengyi as he changes from a ruthless professional killer to a chivalrous xia. In this story, old grudges surface and Shen Shengyi’s friend hires him for one last hit. But the target is someone Shen Shengyi knows intimately…

title: I’m a Freed S*ve, But My Master Is Obsessed With Me
summary: “Rion is free now! I can live however I want!” “I’ll give you everything. Please… stay as my s*ave.” …but my former masters are obsessed with me.

title: Peerless Demon Immortal
summary: He is a monkey, but a clever one. He received the inheritance from the old demon and embarked on the path of demon cultivation. Since he is cultivating as a demon, he aims to become a demon immortal. What? A cultivator wants to kill me? They should first ask the cudgel in my hand!

title: Ties of Shooting Stars
summary: “When we grow up, the three of us will find the killer and take revenge.” Fourteen years later, the three siblings of Ariake, a western-style restaurant whose parents were killed when they were young, are now adults and living off marriage fraud. Their biggest target is the son of the owner of the restaurant “Togami Restaurant”. However, the specialty of the restaurant tasted just like the nostalgic “Ariake.” “This is our father’s hashed beef rice–” Fourteen years later, the three siblings, who believe only in each other and live in hostility toward the world, have their first and last chance to find out who killed their parents. The three of them had planned their revenge to perfection, but their biggest miscalculation is that they have lost sight of their sister who fell in love with him. The shocking truth that will bring tears to your eyes.

title: Doomsday Calamity
summary: The end is coming! The old way of life no longer exists. The sacred item is once more among us! I want to dominate all under the heavens!

title: He Chose Her Kid Over Ours—So I Chose to Burn His World Down
summary: She lost her son. He chose another woman. Now, the hidden heiress will make him pay. When a stadium collapse traps her only child, Chloe’s world shatters—not by tragedy, but by betrayal. Her husband Lucas saves another woman’s son, while theirs is left to die. Broken but not defeated, Chloe unveils a power she long kept hidden: she is the sole heir to a fortune beyond imagination. No more quiet wife. No more compromises. With cold precision, she targets his life—piece by piece, lie by lie. Some choose mercy. She chooses revenge. And no one—no one—steals her future and walks away.
genres: Completed, Adult, Drama, Slice of Life

title: Who Says I’d Take Her In Just Because Her Dao Partner Passed Away?
summary: Once, Qi Xiu was a dazzling “Favored Son of Heaven,” basking in boundless glory. But after a tragic accident took his beloved wife, he spiraled into a decade of dazed, decadent, and derelict living. Now, he has become a classic wastrel—a playboy who spends his days dallying with women and drowning in pleasures. Relying on the fact that his most doting Junior Sister has become the Sect Master, he acts with utter lawlessness. Yet, beyond his Junior Sister, there is also the “Ice-Cold Sword Immortal,” the boy-crazy heiress of a great Immortal clan, and even the female apprentice he picked up…

title: Dominating Sword Immortal
summary: On this land of real souls, with millions of different martial art institutions, there’re so many strong fighters just like the trees in the forests. Among all, a mediocre apprentice from one of the mediocre institutions suddenly became a martial art genius after a mysterious incident. Not only did he acquire a photographic memory and keen perception, but he had also come to discover that his ability to comprehend martial arts is astronomically good, which eventually made him an almost godly existence. From the hot-blooded intense battles to the clashes between the top geniuses, Martial Arts is no longer limited to the mortal world, it reaches to a level that can do everything from controlling the oceans to flying up the sky and diving under the ground.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: The Mystic Dragon Saber
summary: In the quiet and beautiful Liong-san Mountains, which are lush in the springtime, four mighty figures from major factions gathered with a noble purpose. They were Thian Seng Cu of the Hoa-san-pai, Tek Hwat Hwesio of the Siauw-lim-pai, Kiang Cun of the Butong-pai, and Ciong Tosu of the Kun-lun-pai. These four figures, usually guardians of peace and justice, now faced a major crisis: the disappearance of the Mestika Golok from the palace's treasure storage. Tension filled the air as they confronted each other, each deflecting accusations that one of them or their disciples may have been the perpetrators of the theft and the mu*der of the guards using techniques distinctive to each sect. The pressure grew when Ciong Tosu proposed that they all investigate and spread news that the missing golok was a fake, as a bait to catch the thief. However, in the midst of their serious discussion, resounding laughter echoed, piercing the morning tranquility. A black-faced giant appeared, claiming to have mastered techniques from all the present sects. Arrogantly, he demonstrated his skill with the Butong-pai's Touw-kut-teng, as well as deadly techniques from the other three sects. The mysterious arrival of this giant added a new layer of intrigue. Who really was he? What was his purpose in disrupting these four major sects? With his terrifying face and booming laughter, he challenged the four great figures, opening the curtain of an adventure that will test the limits of their abilities and unity. In the midst of the mist and the cool wind of Liong-san, the warriors must unite against this new threat, uncover the truth behind the disappearance of the Mestika Golok, and face an enemy possibly stronger than they ever imagined. Will they succeed in uncovering the mastermind behind all this and restore the honor of their sects? Only time can answer that.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance, Wuxia

title: The Arrogant Ex-Boyfriend Wants Me to Beg for Reconciliation
summary: Jiang Caifu didn’t have many ways to spice up her dreary life as a disheartened corporate drone, but one of her favorite rituals was buying a ton of groceries and snacks after work on Fridays to vent her frustration. Today happened to be a big sale at the supermarket, and she indulged in a shopping spree. Everything went smoothly—until her overstuffed cart accidentally bumped into a passerby. The man looked up, his initially annoyed expression freezing for a moment before twisting into a smirk. "It's you? Long time no see." Jiang Caifu groaned inwardly. What bad luck to run into her ex-boyfriend from two years ago! With a blank expression, she casually replied, "Who are you?" Her nonchalant response shattered the calm façade her ex had been trying to maintain. "Jiang Caifu! You’d better not really have forgotten who I am!" The man, clearly provoked: It was game on. What’s harder: rebuilding a fortune after going bankrupt or winning back your ex-girlfriend? Qiao Yu privately believed it was the latter. After carefully orchestrating their "chance meeting," dropping hints about getting back together, and practically parading his peacock-like charm in front of her, she... ignored him completely! The only way to get her to react was to pester her as shamelessly as he used to. Sure, most of her reactions were eye-rolls and cutting comebacks, but at least they weren’t indifference. This wasn’t how he’d envisioned their reconciliation! Damn it—wasn’t their breakup two years ago because of his bankruptcy? Now that he was wealthy again, why wouldn’t she take him back? ...Was he really going to have to pull out the old tricks—cry, pout, and beg like a spoiled child?

title: Villainous Minister’s Redemption Plan
summary: 【Younger, Unhinged Crybaby Loyal Dog × Gentle, Resilient Entrepreneur Embroiderer】 【Older Woman-Younger Man / Intangible Cultural Heritage Suzhou Embroidery / Transmigration + Rebirth】 Everyone says the powerful minister Wen Shiqin is as cunning as a fox and as vicious as a scorpion in his dealings, with those who suffer under his schemes lamenting incessantly. Yet, in front of a mere embroiderer, he can shed all his sharp edges, pretending to be pitiful and deeply devoted, putting on a performance that captivates everyone. Thus, while working at the embroidery workshop, Su Jinxiu often receives complaints and pleas, hoping she can rein in that unruly troublemaker who "only listens to his sister." The moment she hears them, she knows the younger brother she raised has been causing trouble again. And her mission, as someone who transmigrated into this book, is to whitewash all his misdeeds. Su Jinxiu has always guided her younger brother with patience and persuasion, explaining the consequences of his actions. She teaches him to be humble and polite to colleagues, respectful to superiors, and especially to those who propose to her... he must never draw his sword at them again. No matter how stern her words are initially, she always ends up adding helplessly, "Don't cry!" But this influential minister, who is decisive and formidable outside, relies entirely on his irresistible good looks—which she can't resist—burying his face in her chest with reddened eyes and sobbing: "Does A-Jie not want me again?" "A-Jie, I really didn’t mean it... They provoked me first..." A-Jie is kind-hearted and softens at the sight of tears, forgiving him every time. But he is as vile as a rabid dog, intent on devouring her kindness, compelling her to offer herself to nurture him.

title: Sunflower Field
summary: Me and my older brother went to play at my grandpa's house during the summer vacation. When I was playing hide-and-seek in the sunflower field, my brother became strange.

title: A Story About Becoming Friends With a Romance Villainess
summary: I stumbled upon "Arone's Diary" while on a trip to refresh my weary life. At first, I cursed it, wondering what kind of person this was. But the more I read, the more I sympathized with the villainess Arone. But that doesn't mean I wanted this to happen. "Who are you?" "I'm the Arone nymph. Who are you?" How did this happen? She's practically pen pals with the character in the book, and now she's even dimensionally traveling? It's already crazy enough being dropped into another world, but now I'm getting entangled in a crown prince, the next magic tower lord, the villainess's older brother, and her mysterious rival. Isn't this just too much? [Crazy female lead/Survival skills that could survive even on a deserted island/Hell's jaw/Female lead with a steely mentality/Friendship-focused/Big-dog male lead/Female lead's s**tty male lead]

title: Phoenix Pendant, Winter Heart
summary: It was the fifth year of our engagement, and Meng Cijun still refused to marry me. The first time he turned me down, he said the King was placing great importance on him, so how could he indulge in the trivialities of love? That made sense, so I nodded and waited another two years. The second time he turned me down, he said that since the King had yet to choose a Queen, how could a mere subject like him marry first? That made me angry. I felt the King was being completely unreasonable-I had waited so long that I was practically an old maid, yet he still wouldn't allow Meng Cijun to marry me? Meng Cijun and I had a fight. In a fit of pique, I left home, only to rescue a palace official who was trying to end his life by the river. One of the girls selected for the draft had run away, and Wang Shiguan was so distressed he was ready to jump into the water. "If I enter the palace, will I be able to see the King?" Wang Shiguan looked at my hair, which was not yet pinned up in the style of a married woman, and my youthful face. He nodded with delight. "Of course! If you find favor, you'll see the King every single night!" "Alright then," I said, nodding as I gathered my skirts and stepped into the carriage. Once I saw that King, I intended to ask him exactly why he wouldn't let Meng Cijun marry me. "Miss, if you leave, how am I supposed to explain this to Master Meng?" Xiao Tao asked, panicked. I thought about it for a moment, then pulled back the curtain and waved a hand. "Just tell Meng Cijun that Ah Wu is still mad at him and won't be coming home for dinner tonight!"
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Skill Up with Login Bonus
summary: The more I sleep the stronger I get. My grimoire give me new skills and magic as I wake up every day! Everyone else tries hard to memorise and understand their grimoires and gain new magic or skills, but for me, I get them automatically. What I get all depends on my luck, but I can easily acquire the highest tier magic. While holding onto the grimoire like this, I enjoy my time in another world with my wife and friends that I've made here.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Have Infinite Attributes
summary: Zhou Jibo's world shatters when betrayal strikes from the least expected quarter—his fiancée, Zheng Xunqin. Drugged and robbed of his cultivation ability by Zheng, a member of the allied Zheng family, Zhou finds himself crippled in a realm where martial prowess rules all. Reborn in a mysterious new world after a tragic end in modern times, he discovers he's not just any youth, but one blessed with an Earth Spirit bone root, a marker of potential greatness now tragically marred. As he silently endures the agonizing theft of his bone root, a sudden twist of fate awakens the ""Universal Attribute Point System"" within him, presenting a Newbie Gift Bag that promises unimaginable power.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Supernatural

title: If Only Spring Would Come.
summary: Cha Jun-young. That guy showed up. “It’s been a while, Choi Bom.” It’s been a year since I ended our long eight-year relationship. A year since I walked away from the wounds he left behind. Today was supposed to mark a new beginning—a day I finally decided to embrace a fresh start and open my heart to a new love. But of all days, why today? And of all places, why here? He appeared as a student at the art academy where I work, throwing my newfound resolve into disarray. “You… Why are you here?” There’s no way he’s here to learn art. He must have another motive. His enigmatic gaze held mine for a moment, and then he said something completely unexpected: “To save you.”

title: Phantom of the Mirror and Water
summary: When I was kidnapped, Ji Chenyu was with his new lover watching the sunrise; he carelessly said to the kidnappers: "Keep her tied up, there's no rush to save her." "Let her learn her lesson and stop bothering me. This is good." To survive, I had no choice but to strip and cling to the kidnapper leader. My voice trembled as I begged him, "I'll be good-please don't kill me." Later, Ji Chenyu finally decided to come save me. The kidnapper leader even laughed and looked down at me, sleeping in his arms: "She's exhausted. She might not even have the strength to go with you."

title: I Have 10 Training Avatars
summary: Lin Xuan transmigrated into a world where demon beasts rampaged. He became one of the lowest ranking wasteland reclaimers in the Germinal Organization to explore the mystic realms. The Zero Realm mystic realm was the Giant Rock Cave. The First Realm mystic realm was the Demon Ant Nest. The Second Realm mystic realm was the Tree King Sea. [Congratulations on seizing a Gold Swallowing Lizard as one of your avatars for gaining more experience. Do you want it to begin its training?] [Your current location is first floor of the Giant Rock Cave. (1 coin per minute. 5 exp points per minute)] [Gold Swallowing Lizard has been training for 4 hours. Do you wish to collect its experience?] Lin Xuan’s eyes were wide open. He was well-versed in how this worked. This was similar to the AFK games that he played in his previous world. As such, he began his comfortable journey of becoming the strongest. Up until one point, the Germinal Organization discovered that he was abnormal and decided to deal with him. It only then did Lin Xuan realize that even Seventh Realm fighters and the managers of the organization were inferior to him.

title: In A World Full of Silence, My Heart Will Find Its Way To You
summary: “You will never escape from me.” I will find you no matter what. So give up. Aria, the neglected mute maid of the Bailey Count family. In Aria’s life, who lived as Edward’s dedicated maid in unrequited love, one day, Eric, the illegitimate child of the Bailey family who had disappeared, returned with a blade of vengeance. “Please assign me a maid as well. A quiet maid who won’t complain if possible.” The man who suddenly appears and shakes up her life, Eric Bailey. To him, Aria is helplessly swept away. “Why are you trying to run away from me?” “I told you last time too.” ”I won’t just stand by either.” For a moment, she was consumed by his uncontrollable obsession with her. Aria left the Bailey house as if fleeing to escape. However, Eric finally found her again. “Remember. Your master is me.” Your breath doesn’t let me drift away again. I have to remain stagnant in his embrace like this. In the end, Aria had to accept all the emotions he poured out.

title: Black Myth: Starting from a Dream-weaving Puppet Monkey, I conquer the Three Realms
summary: (Heroine Included) Lin Chen transmigrated into the world of Black Myth: Wukong. Becoming a mere Macaque. Me? Tasked with searching for the Great Sage’s Six Senses? A one-life challenge to re-walk the Journey to the West? As a Hardcore Veteran, Lin Chen knew exactly how brutal this world was. Humans are just consumables; Demons are mere herbal ingredients. If even the powerful are helpless, what hope did a tiny macaque like him have? Re-walk the Journey to the West? To hell with that! I wouldn’t do it even if you paid me! [Ding! Strongest Roleplayer System bound successfully!] [Character Bound: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King from “Legend of Zelda”!] Let’s go! I am walking the Journey to the West! They won’t do it? I will!

title: Chronicles of Gu Hai
summary: Forty years ago, Gu Hai, transmigrated to a brand new world where the cultivation was no longer fiction but a reality. These are the tales of Gu Hai’s life since his arrival at the Chen Kingdom as he becomes the biggest merchant of six kingdoms.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Return of the Dragon Girlfriend
summary: “Oppa, I spent two thousand years holed up in a dragon’s lair studying dimensional magic just to see you again. I did good, right?” My girlfriend, who I thought died a year ago, has returned—as a dragon. “But oppa… you didn’t get yourself a new girl while I was gone, did you?”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: After Rebirth, He Married his Childhood Sweetheart
summary: It was not until the moment when he was dying in a pool of blood when he was in a car accident and looked at Xia Yuchan who was crying hysterically in front of him, and the memories in his mind flashed like a revolving lantern, did Ye Fei realize that someone who loved him deeply and was worthy of cherishing was near. Within easy reach. At the last moment when his life disappeared, he suddenly remembered the classic line of Zhi Zun Bao. If God can give me a chance to do it again, I will definitely… Then, God really gave a chance, and Ye Fei became a glorious primary school student again.
genres: Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Lover
summary: “Zhuang Jie, let me be your lover.” “What?” “I, Chen Maidong, am willing to be your lover.” This is a story about the love between a man and a woman. About an “I will love you for sixty years” friendship. It’s about a family where misfortunes always come in pairs; mutual support, understanding, tolerance, and love among family members.

title: Unsettling First Love
summary: From the very first moment to the very last day, you always carried the sweet scent of peaches. After losing everything in an instant, I went down to Yongsoo Village to live with my grandmother. There, I met Jung Yoon-jae, known as the rich family’s young master—a fateful encounter that would change everything. He was a boy so utterly different from me. Time passed, and the twelve-year-old Jung Yoon-jae had grown into a thirty-year-old man—intensely passionate, cold at times, but deeply tender. “Am I your first?” “I’m not the one you’re looking for.” He spoke as if he were someone else, yet I could recognize him in an instant. Because at the end of every memory, it was always you. “Never again. I’ll never let you go again.” For the sake of my grandmother’s dying wish, for the sake of revenge, I must push this man away… And yet, the more I try, the more I find myself drawn to Jung Yoon-jae—body and soul. “It’s useless to run. Just as you once saved me, now it’s my turn to save you.” The man who insists on having me, Jung Yoon-jae. The woman who tries to resist him, Chae Soo-yeon. My dangerous first love, Jung Yoon-jae. Can I truly protect myself from him?

title: Path to the Celestial Peak
summary: Su Shier, a mediocre village boy, is forced onto an endless path of cultivation to avenge a blood feud. It is a world of deception, where the weak are prey to the strong, filled with schemes and hardships… The road ahead is long and arduous, but even as a mere mortal, he vows to hack through the thorns and forge his own path to immortality.

title: Apocalypse: A Godly Sanctuary I Have
summary: Zhou Heng thought the news of an impending solar flare and natural disasters was absurd—until he died in the apocalyptic chaos that followed. Reborn ten days before the end begins, Zhou Heng now knows the truth: earthquakes, tsunamis, plagues, and even zombies will devastate the Earth. Armed with the Doomsday Sanctuary System, he has a chance to rewrite his fate, but there's a catch—it requires a shelter to activate. With only ten days left, can Zhou Heng gather the resources, fortify his sanctuary, and prepare for the storm of humanity's collapse?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural

title: I Raised a Nine Tailed Fox Wrongly
summary: Scyllia is a noble Paladin of the Western Continent. While subjugating the smuggled monsters, she felt the unusual energy of a monster fox , so she found a priestess of the Eastern continent to ask about it. “It’s a terrifying nine-tailed-fox. If you don’t want to see it become a demon of hell raise it yourself and bring it to the East Continent.” So she raised and taught the fox with effort… “I am of a race greater than that of a beast. Scyllia knows that, right?” “……” “Don’t worry. You taught me well. I don’t do anything dangerous.” “……” “But you can’t run away.” Power entered his thick and tense forearms that tightened her. “Keep helping me to be a nice person, Scyllia. By my side.” Forever. A nine-tailed-fox that is naturally bewitching and eats people. The boy who grew up to be huge, refused to become independent.. With a face that was so le*d that the discipline she had been teaching in the past would be in vain.

title: Zenith
summary: In her past life, Janice was betrayed by her comrades and her organization, and died. In this life, unlike her unfortunate past, she was born into a powerful count’s family that dominates the North— but she’s so steeped in distrust of people that she views even this fortune with cynicism. However, when her childhood friend Flora falls in love for the first time, even Janice, who had always chosen to remain a bystander, begins to change. Sigh… love—what’s so great about it that it makes you cry like that? “If you want it, I’ll make it yours. So do something about those dull, vacant eyes.” While scheming every possible plot to help her friend’s love come true, she begins to encounter a series of increasingly mysterious incidents… “It’s your fault. Why were you standing in my friend’s way? You should’ve known to get out of the way yourself.” She has no desire to meddle in other people’s affairs— but once she steps in, she has to see it through to the end. The story of Janice Lintbell—talented, strong-willed, and impossible to ignore!

title: Live Fortune-Telling Nails It Poor Girl Goes Viral
summary: [Mysticism + Fortune-Telling + Live Streaming + Ghost Hunting + Feel-Good Story + CEO + Dual Strong Leads] After dying unexpectedly, the mystical expert Ye Zhishu transmigrates into a book! She finds herself as the useless, kind-hearted older half-sister in a sweet romance novel—rejected by her family and living in poverty. To make matters stranger, she gets bumped by a Mountain God Seal and becomes the Mountain God of Qingming Mountain. Mountain God Seal: “Since you’ve already… ahem, become the Mountain God, to revive Qingming Mountain, you must collect believers’ faith. Otherwise, both you and Qingming Mountain will be annihilated!” Looking around at her empty home, Ye Zhishu thinks: “Might as well just die again.” But life goes on, and she decides to survive in style. Ye Zhishu sets up an online stall, offering ghost hunting, fortune-telling, and protective charms—as long as the money comes, everything is negotiable! Soon, clients start pouring in: A popular streamer: “Master, master, can you tell me if I’ll survive my ghost house adventure this time?” A rich second-generation heir: “Master, will my girlfriend finally be human this time?” A wealthy CEO: “Master, my aunt has gone missing!”
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Digimon Adventure
summary: These novels are an official publication, not fan-made. They were written by the show’s director, Hiroyuki Kakudou, and one of the screenwriters, Hiro Masaki. Therefore, information revealed in them can be considered canon. Notice the use of verb “can” here, meaning that it is not an absolute. You’ll discover as you read on that not everything is exactly as portrayed in the television series.

title: I’m a Second Male Lead in a Romance Fantasy, but I Don’t Like the Female Lead
summary: I fell into a romance fantasy world that I’ve never read before in my life. From what I can tell, I’m the Northern Duke who’s fighting with the Crown Prince over a woman, basically in the second male lead position… “But my fiancée is prettier?” The female lead is really not my type. Can’t you just take that woman, and I’ll live happily with my fiancée instead?

title: LV99 Demon King’s Servant. I Was Reincarnated in the Game World That I Used to Play in My Previous Life, so I Will Do My Best to Guide My Favorite Demon King to a Happy Ending
summary: The protagonist is a reincarnated villainous aristocrat. His name is “Varian Klovrulm.” One day, Varian realizes that he is a reincarnated person and that the world is the world of the game “Fielder Resonance,” which he played in his previous life. In that game, he has “favorite character”. The Demon King Irina. She is the last boss of the game, and regardless of what route is taken, she is the one who will be killed by protagonist at the end of the game. “—— Never I will accept it.” He can’t stand the fact that the Demon King, who is his favorite character, has to meet such an end! Varian, who has gained memories of his previous life, becomes extremely determined to engage in the training that he had hated. Everything he does is to lead his favorite Demon King to a happy ending who is about to die an unhappy death. In order to save the Demon King, he begins his training. He then becomes a servant of the Demon King, and goes on a rampage to save the Demon King from all kinds of disastrous situations!

title: Super Elation Under the Sun
summary: Li Fuyao, a mysteriously young storyteller, wins over the villagers with his fantastic original tales in a peaceful and secluded town. Actually, born in Luoyang City, he used to be a prestigiously selected child, who should have been cultivating in the holy palace. However, life has treated him otherwise. He was expelled to this remote town, unattended. Notwithstanding, like a hidden leopard, he is always lurking around to get himself back on the road of cultivation and seek revenge when he becomes strong enough. One day, a masterly cultivator and an injured snake demon paid him an unexpected visit, breaking the peace of his life from then on. To his surprise, the snake demon offered him a demonic core for cultivation, which granted him the chance he has been yearning for. Is it really a turning point of his life or will it just put him into inconceivable danger?

title: The Case of an Idol’s Disappearance
summary: It's a story of an older brother, a former failed idol, who returns five years ago and discovers the disappearance and death of a popular idol, his younger brother.

title: The Proper Way for a Little Crow to Repay Its Kindness
summary: An enchanted crow is struck by lightning during its tribulation, leaving it charred to a crisp. A kind human finds it and takes it home to nurse back to health. Decades later, the crow awakens to find itself reincarnated as Wu Xiaoya, the daughter of City A's richest man. All the students at school envy Wu Xiaoya. She's not only gorgeous, like an anime protagonist, but also incredibly wealthy. Her backpack costs hundreds of thousands, her pens are specially custom-made, and the water she drinks is transported from a snowy mountain thousands of miles away. However, one day, they notice Wu Xiaoya acting a little strange. When they ask her a question, she answers it perfectly. Yet, on her own exams, she gets every single question wrong. Everyone is stunned: A true genius can fill out an entire exam and still score zero. Then one day, the real genius of the school accidentally gets a hold of one of her exams. Every single answer is well-reasoned and clear, yet each one perfectly avoids the correct answer. "Interesting." He takes a look at the name. "Hmm? Isn't this the nickname of my family's crow?" Notes: Protagonist: The female lead is a crow spirit. Story: The entire story is whimsical and imaginative. Genre: A fantastical, slice-of-life romance. Tags: In love with one person, close proximity romance, sweet story, ancient fantasy. Keywords: Main character: Wu Xiaoya; Supporting character: [Empty] ; Others: [Empty] One-sentence summary: A sexy crow online shows what it means to poison herself. Moral: One hundred years of kindness should be repaid with one's own body.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Mitou Shoukan://Blood-Sign
summary: Summoning ceremonies can freely call forth even "those which lurk in the depths beyond the gods". One boy has top-level abilities even among the cutting-edge summoners who can use those ceremonies. He is Alice (with) Rabbit aka Shiroyama Kyousuke. But this strongest boy summoner has a single fatal weakness. Certain "cursed words" spoken by girls: "Help me." When Kyousuke hears those words from Meinokawa Higan, a girl brought to the verge of death, he throws himself into a city where three great summoner forces clash!
genres: Completed, Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural

title: Got Pregnant with Triplets After One Night with a Soldier: I Lay Low and Won Big in the 1980s
summary: Modern-day food blogger Jiang Yue had transmigrated into a novel. She became a vicious supporting female character in an era novel, one who was beautiful but good for nothing! She had just gotten married and immediately put a green hat on her old husband! She even ab*sed the little bun that the old man had adopted! After discovering that she was the real daughter of a wealthy family, she left behind a divorce letter and ran off to acknowledge her biological parents, only to be thrown out by them when they declared that they only loved the fake daughter. What was even worse, because of her special physique, she had actually been sold off to give birth to children for an idiot. Jiang Yue: What kind of joke is this! She absolutely refused to live such a rotten life! Just watch her stomp on the scum, ab*se the tr*sh, and turn the tides to make a dazzling life for herself in the 1980s. But wait—wasn’t it said that her husband was old and ugly? Then who was this broad-shouldered, long-legged, strikingly handsome man with an air of asceticism (and repressed desire) all over him? "Come here!" The man's voice was hoarse. His shirt was half open, and from time to time he pinned her against the wall and stole kisses. Jiang Yue: "……" This plot progression didn’t quite match what was written in the original novel. Wasn’t it said that the male lead loathed this female supporting character, and that a month after the supporting character’s exit, he would marry the female lead? Then who was this man, whose eyes turned dark the moment he saw her, who used his beauty to tempt her, who kept touching her here and there and everywhere, and went around declaring to everyone that she was his wife?

title: The Boy Who Gave Up on Romantic Feelings ~I’m Done Because I Was Betrayed by The Girlfriends I Used to Date~
summary: I don’t want to get hurt anymore. The main character, Shintani Maeshima, got betrayed twice by his ex-girlfriends. Moreover, it happened in the same situation. —what happens twice will happen thrice. Maejima no longer wants to fall in love. He doesn’t want to be betrayed in such a way again.
genres: Drama, Ecchi, Mature, Romance, School Life

title: That Turtle, The Strongest On Earth
summary: When Bruno was eight years old, he got a turtle from a stall at a festival. That turtle, Ivy, continued to grow rapidly... and eventually became larger than a house. To prevent Ivy from being hunted, Bruno registered himself as a tamer and decided to start an adventurer's life with Ivy. Wanting to sit on Bruno's shoulder again like in the old days, Ivy gained the ability to adjust her size... and as it turns out, she was actually the strongest.

title: Play Baseball Instead of Infinite Regressor
summary: The hero who carried the perpetually struggling Busan Waves to the Korean Series. “Baseball… do you want to play?” “Yes!” I jumped at the opportunity he offered. [Regression.] No… but you never said anything like that!

title: I Had To Take A Day Off From Work Because I Was Suspected Of Being In Love With Someone
summary: Goro Araki, 32 years old and single, is in his 10th year of working. He was a big fan of Momoka Aimi, a member of the five-member idol group “Sakura Romance”. One day, her “alleged infatuation” was reported. Araki broke down the moment he saw the online news and decided to take a day off from work in shock. The weekly magazine showed a picture of her seemingly shaking hands with the other man, which was covered with mosaic. Araki came to one inference. “Hey, isn’t that … me?” He becomes a party to the allegations and gets caught up in his daily life with Momoka Aimi. Even adults can have sweet and sour youth forever.

title: Last Bus of Route 13 Ⅱ
summary: Have you ever lived next to a dead person? Have you ever read a story that kept you in suspense? Are you scared? Click on it, read on, for suspense upon suspense!
genres: Adventure, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: Toaru Majutsu no Index: Road to Endymion
summary: This is a prequel to the anime movie . Just before the completion of the Academy City space elevator "Endymion", the main characters Kamijou Touma and Index encounter a level 0 girl named Arisa. The Magicians are after Arisa, and they attack Academy City. A female leader named Shattoaura leads a unit from Academy City against the attack. Kamijou and Index learn from Stiyl that Arisa is key to a brewing war between the sides of Magic and Science. When science and magic cross paths, the story begins with Endymion as its stage!
genres: Completed, Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Sis, You’re Pretty Broke, Huh?
summary: Synopsis: Northeastern-flavored, wealthy domineering CEO × Broke girl with big dreams After graduation, Shi Zhen joined the vast ranks of the “graduated and unemployed.” Having been obedient her whole life, she suddenly wanted to rebel for once. So, without telling her family, she secretly rented a small place, claiming she was working while preparing for the civil service exam. In reality, she stayed in her rental every day writing scripts. A month later, after facing more than a dozen rejections for her scripts and being so broke that she only had 100 yuan left, Shi Zhen made a post online documenting her broke life. The post barely got any views. A few days later, it finally received its first comment: Xie-ge: Sis, what part of the Northeast are you from? A few days later: Xie-ge: Sis, mind adding me on WeChat? And a few days after that: Xie-ge: Sis, how can you live on just 100 yuan? Let me order you some takeout. And then yet again, a few days later: Xie-ge: Sis, I’m seriously rich. Want me to transfer you 10,000 first to show my sincerity? Shi Zhen: ……… Xie Qian — the one and only heir of the Xie family in Shulin. After nearly thirty years of life, Young Master Xie entered a bout of existential crisis and suddenly began to miss his childhood in the Northeast. Shulin has everything: gold on every corner — but not a shred of human warmth. Xie Qian carries himself with integrity, but his father nags him constantly: “Righteousness has no place in business, and kindness doesn’t lead armies.” He’s been saying this for over ten years — Xie Qian’s ears practically have calluses. Outsiders say the Xie family’s heir stayed in the Northeast for a few years, and that thick Northeastern accent of his still hasn’t gone away. Only those who know him well understand — hasn’t gone away? He never intended to change it! It’s not just the accent he doesn’t want to change. It’s also the fire in his heart that’s never burned out — despite all his years in the business world. On his 29th birthday, Xie Qian had a subtle, uneasy feeling that that fire might finally be going out. Then suddenly, he stumbled upon a post: A girl determined to chase her dream — surviving an entire month on just 100 yuan. To Xie Qian, 100 yuan disappears in the blink of an eye. And so, he began spending money on that girl like his life depended on it. In saving her, he was also saving himself. Later on, Shi Zhen entered Xie Qian’s world. Like a fawn who accidentally wandered into a dangerous forest, all she wanted was to escape. But Xie Qian was like a wolf. A wolf pushing the little deer forward — not to devour her, but to bring her into his den, to protect her properly.

title: The Reincarnated Mid-Boss Welcomes the Protagonist With a Level of 999 ~ It Seems the Hero Is Mistaken About Having a Max Level of 99 ~
summary: Let’s snatch the items from the jar beforehand. Oh, and also the heroine candidates, right? The protagonist, Tsunaka Hajime, was reincarnated as the son of the demon duke, Zaus Jarmel. It seems his memories from his previous life have awakened. In his past life, he was a corporate s*ave, worked to death from overwork. He was reincarnated as the mid-boss that appears in the Brave Sword Quest, commonly known as Breque. In the beginning, his father, the demon duke, is killed by the hero, and he seeks revenge against the hero. And thus, it’s a scenario where he gets killed by the hero. Moreover, Zaus’s position is strictly that of a mid-boss. He’s just a checkpoint, not the main boss or anything. In terms of the game, it’s like a tutorial. While it makes you think the max level is 99, the scenario actually has a max level of 999. The mid-boss demon duke Zaus, who is defeated within that level 99 range, is the one. Isn’t it kind of pathetic for the mid-boss to be defeated by the hero protagonist? And what’s up with being fated to be defeated! My previous life wasn’t great as a corporate s*ave, and it was a terrible life! Zaus is currently 15 years old. He will be defeated by the hero at the age of 20. Only 5 years left. He made the choice to avoid the bad ending. He will strengthen his own army and weaken the protagonist using his knowledge of the game. He stopped hitting his subordinates. The monsters are valuable assets. Training them is more important than hitting them. They will be provided with ample food, and medical care will be thorough. It’s to create the strongest army to defeat the hero. “Master seems to have changed… He might have become kind of gentle…” Not hitting the subordinates is inefficient. Injuries to valuable assets will result in a decrease in combat effectiveness. Everything must be done efficiently! Efficiency is paramount! That’s right, let’s snatch the contents of the dungeon’s treasure chest beforehand too. The protagonist’s scheming begins. What will happen in 5 years? Will Zaus be able to defeat the hero? The curtain rises on a thrilling fantasy of avoiding the bad ending.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: There’s No Way My Dad Is A Legendary Cultivator
summary: Jiang Ping transmigrated to a world of the cultivation with a sign in system and became the chief of a deteriorating cultivation family. Most importantly, he had three cute and playful daughters. Because the world of cultivation out there is too dangerous and his daughters are too young, Jiang ping chose to hide their identities and live in a small town of ordinary people. He kept warning his daughters that the world out there is too dangerous, so don’t make any trouble. “Daughters, you must remember that there are tons of bad people out there! Their favorite thing to do is to kidnap little girls like you and use you for evil cultivation methods.” “In this world of cultivation, the most important moral to follow is to stay low-key and hide. As long as we don’t cause any trouble, we’ll never be in any danger. Until one day, when a supreme divine cultivator came to seek revenge, Jiang Ping smacked him down on the ground and completely crushed him over and over again… His daughters asked, “Daddy, was that person you just beat up a Divine Cultivator?” Jiang Ping said, “Nop, that was just a bad person who was trying to disturb our happy life. Daughters, the world outside is too scary, we didn’t even go out and danger came knocking on our door!” His daughters asked, “Daddy, do you think that we’re all idiots?” The servants he hired all said, “So the family chief is the real supreme cultivator?”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: The Hero Who Was Reincarnated as a Facial Genius
summary: The strongest hero of mankind, Rodri the Black-Helmed Hero, has saved the world from countless crises. Yet, he carries a secret he’s never told anyone. One day, he succeeds in summoning the Goddess of Beauty and makes the wish of his lifetime: “I wish… to be handsome!” Moved by his plea, the Goddess Ashtar grants his wish — but in her own way. “Be born again.” Thus, the hero is reincarnated as Roin, the youngest son of Baron Raiden’s family! Now begins the tearful (and dazzling) beauty struggle of an absolute being discovering the thrilling, ever-new joy of being handsome!

title: I Like You
summary: Lin Wei: I want to attend Tsinghua Univeristy Jiang Su: Then I am a little different than you,…, Other than Tsinghua, I still want you. … Someone like me isn’t deserving of your interest. Me liking you isn’t up to you to say. {no many how many years have passed. Both Lin Wei and Jiang She won’t forget that day. The day which they’ve first met}

title: SPEEDBOY!
summary: A tale of solitude by Maijo Otaro following Naruo, a boy with a mane on his back, in his constant search for speed.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Romance, Sports, Supernatural

title: To You, Dear Beyond the Fireplace
summary: Helen Atwell, a skilled pilot. Her job is to drop bombs over enemy bases and shoot down enemy aircraft. To uphold the hated Empire’s prestige—and to protect the very people of the Empire who had oppressed her. It had already been months of throwing herself headlong into death. Then, like a miracle, she received a wizard’s letter through the fireplace. To the dearly missed Miss Helen. I practiced my handwriting a great deal to make a good impression on you. I simply couldn’t bring myself to send you a letter in ugly script. I hope the magic I send this time will please you. As she gradually grows fond of the gentle, secretive wizard Enoch, Helen is also assigned to the squadron under the cold, taciturn Major Alek Morton— whose origins and attitude cause them to clash endlessly… “You should have just gone back.” “You dying is not an option. So stop saying things like that.” Helen had never imagined that a single letter, flying into a winter battlefield, would change her life forever.

title: Crying in the Paranoid Brother’s Arms After Rebirth
summary: [Rebirth + Obsession + Seduction + Goofball] In a car accident, Shu Qianzhi saved Ji Zechen's life, and in return, Ji Zechen "accidentally" picked up a "little sister." She was a crybaby who would throw a tantrum if she couldn't see him for even a second. She was impolite, demanding he feed her and coax her to sleep. To everyone's astonishment, the renowned Master Ji of the capital was utterly devoted to a woman, fulfilling her every wish and spoiling her to the heavens. Only later did they discover that this person who had suddenly barged into his life was reborn to make up for the regret of their previous life, where they were mutually in love but could not be together. Theirs was a love that was a full two lifetimes late.

title: I’m Alone at the Gate
summary: The story begins when the living room of my room is connected to the basement of the royal palace of the Kingdom of Raymond on the continent of Pangamonia.

title: The Northern Black-Haired Grand Duke is the Male Lead
summary: “Once upon a time, there lived the Northern Black-Haired Grand Duke. He only bathed in cold water, never wore a coat no matter how cold it was, and only drank water during tea time.” “Minelli, what is a Northern Black-Haired Grand Duke?” “What is a Northern Black-Haired Grand Duke?” What else? It’s what you’ll grow up to be in the future. * * * I thought I had died in a car accident, but I was born again as the playmate of the Northern Grand Prince. But this Grand Prince was sickly to his bones and destined to lose his Princess to another man. ‘In that case, I’ll make him the perfect Northern Black-haired Grand Prince and help him find love!’ That’s what I planned, but…. Why is our Setz so cute and sweet? Can I really succeed? * * * “I am only sweet to you.” #WesternAmbience #ObsessiveML #Misunderstandings #Transmigration #Two-WayShoveling #ChildhoodFriends #SchemingML #CharismaticML #BigPuppyML *Two-Way Shoveling – two people misunderstanding or misinterpreting each other’s intentions or feelings
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Yayoi Can’t Hide Her Secrets
summary: That feeling you can’t hide – I love you. “Satsuki-kun, you’re so cool ……” I heard such a voice in my mind. Yayoi has a reputation on campus for being beautiful, but she is always alone and unsociable. I, Satsuki Fukase, who has psychometry ability, heard Yayoi’s voice in my mind one day. However, despite my confusion, Yayoi had an even bigger secret. Yayoi is an agent who lives in the underworld. Yayoi is full of secrets and I, Satsuki knows her secret. Can their hearts, which are so close and yet so far apart, overcome the barriers that psychometry alone cannot cross and come closer together? A love comedy between Satsuki, who can hear the voice of the mind, and Yayoi, who hides her feelings from the world!
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: My Space Is An RV
summary: In the dreams, an overwhelming fiery red bird descended from the sky, its burning wings igniting the familiar world around her. Stiff and terrifying walking corpses surged from the ruins of buildings. Yellow sandstorms filled the entire sky. Heavy rain melted towering buildings, turning the cities into wastelands. The fleeing people collapsed, coughing blood, on the red barren land… … Startled awake by another nightmare, Ji Ningxin woke up drenched in cold sweat and drove to the supermarket. She realized their supplies at home weren’t sufficient. She didn’t want her older brother to be severely beaten for a bottle of clean water, nor did she want her father harmed because of a trap set around a box of medicine… Whether the scenes in her dreams were real or not, she hoped to protect her family. … Fortunately, along with the apocalyptic dreams, there was also a pitch-black space. Initially, she thought it was just a storage space. However, when she accidentally entered it, she discovered that this space was connected to her RV!? [Passenger List], [Basic Defense], [Purified Water], [Automatic Blackwater Treatment], [Robust Structure], [360-Degree View], [Disinfection Zone]… As she stocked the space with more items, the performance of the RV became increasingly enhanced… Collecting; metals (3/10 types), ore minerals (1/5 types), seeds (10/10 types)… it’s upgradable. Ji Ningxin started dismantling her home: tinfoil containing aluminum, ceramic tiles made of marble, cement in the walls containing lime and gypsum, glass containing quartz sand and borax, jewelry made of gold and silver, compasses with magnets, pencil leads containing graphite… ★★Reading Guide★★ 1. The female protagonist’s golden finger is a motorhome that upgrades, only able to protect her own family, not a savior of the world. 2. There is a male lead, introduced later, no spoilers, the main story focuses on the female lead’s survival, with minimal romantic development. 3. Alternate reality! Don’t connect it to reality. Starts in a peaceful era, early stages involve hoarding a large number of goods, within a single world without time travel, and disasters occur in a specific sequence. 4. Not a rebirth, more like precognitive dreams. 5. The female lead is intelligent, and plans ahead, not like a virg*n Mary but not heartless either. 6. This is an apocalyptic hoarding-themed story, hoarding isn’t about padding the word count (hoarding involves checking information, making it more challenging to write than regular plotlines).

title: Dream Controller
summary: I am the last Dream Controller in the world. A Dream Controller can not only lead others into dreams, but also enter the dreams of others. Ten years ago, my Junior Sister entered the Emperor's dream, falsely claiming to be a Goddess, and engaged in the affairs of clouds and rain at Mount Wu, becoming the Imperial Concubine most favored in the Imperial Harem. Once she attained such high status, fearing the Dream Control Art would be exposed, she sent people to slaughter the Master's Sect, leaving rivers of blood.
