Even the Senior Sister, who had been expelled, was killed by an arrow through the heart. Ten years later, the Emperor dreams of the Goddess again, unable to awaken from his obsession. The Imperial Concubine grows restless and enters the dream herself. But she does not know that I have long since set up a Dream Prison, waiting for her arrival. "Junior Sister, it's time to pay for your crimes."

title: I Would Like to Become a Fox You Like
summary: The first life, she was Fairy Peony and secretly loved Emperor of Donghua in the Gods’ world, but he even didn’t remember her name… The second life, he was an emperor in the mortal world, while she was mistaken as a demon and burned to death… Finally, she gave up and chose to jump into the gateway of Tiryagyoni… So, the third life, she became a white fox, which was born in Green Mound, but inadvertently she met him again. He said that he would bring her to immortality and then she would get rid of suffering forever…

title: May I Go on a Date with You?
summary: “Can I go on a date with you?” Shidou makes an invitation to Issa. “You’re a good person.” Good Person Card +1. He tries a second time. “Will you go on a date with me?” “You’re a really, really good person.” Good Person Card +1 again. The third time. “Can I go out with you?” Issa grips Shidou’s hand, her eyes burning as she looks at him. “Let’s get married.” Welcome to a story woven from the salvation and swan song of boys and girls…

title: The Retired Top Ranker Was Abducted to Another World
summary: I Retired but Got Kidnapped to Another World. [The Hero’s Fate Has Been Taken!] Huh? I got kidnapped, but my fate was taken instead? Even better! The Isekai Life of a Retired Top Ranker.

title: To the One Who Doesn’t Love Me
summary: The important thing was that no one died. [Finally, it's over. Congratulations.] "......" Through a contract with Creon, the Time Demon, Rachel saved Tervan's life that she had desperately wished for. But strangely, she didn't feel particularly happy. Twenty-seven times she regressed, enduring death's pain each time. Her emotions, worn and eroded from exhaustion. She believed everyone except herself had returned to their places... "I'm interested in you, my lady." "Excuse me, Your Highness, but I don't think it's me." "I've been too selfish all this time." "You don't need to apologize, Tervan." "Rachel, may I escort you?" "Edward?" Attention that should have flowed elsewhere now poured toward Rachel. Something had begun to change.

title: Heroes of the Permafrost
summary: A young man walks alone through frozen land covered in snow and ice as far as the eye can see. Not for himself, not because he cares about his hometown, but in order to return to the only woman he loves - a fragile human fighting against a harsh environment. The extreme north of physical expression.

title: Job Transfer for All: I Can Add Unlimited Mana
summary: Global changes have occurred, the world has turned into a game, and strange monsters are raging all over the world. To become stronger and to resist disasters. Everyone is changing classes and moving up their ranks like crazy. Some people become wizards in their first transformation, while others become professional thunder warriors in their second transformation. But Ling Zhan did the opposite. First, he chose a non-professional class and added the blue bar to all attribute points. “It's crazy. I don't have a class. All I have are low-level skills before I change classes. How can I fight in the later stages? What's the use of the blue bars? It can't increase combat effectiveness. It's really funny...” However, when the battle occurs, Level 3 Thunder Warrior: “I'm shocked, non-professionals are so strong?” A certain third-level Elf Queen: “Infinite blue bars, invincible in one-on-one combat, No. 1 in team battles, how can we fight like this?”

title: The Hellborn Heiress​
summary: [Omnipotent Female Lead + Hidden Identities + Metaphysics Ghost Hunting + Face-Slapping + Prefers Action Over Words + Scheming Little Wolfdog] In her previous life, she commanded the winds and clouds, stood above millions, and single-handedly severed the nation's fate, falling into Hell for eternity. Now, she borrows a corpse to return from Hell, becoming the true heiress whom her father doesn't care for, her mother doesn't love, bullied by everyone, forced to sleep in a doghouse and even at risk of being killed? Jiang Ci calmly pinches her fingers to divine: You've committed countless evils, prepare your coffins-your entire family's household registration will be wiped out. Not recognized by the top elite families? Jiang Ci smiles: Don't compare your entire fortune to my pocket money. I'd be embarrassed for you. Everyone on the street says she's an idiot, but only he treasures her, sticking to her like glue, impossible to shake off. Until one day, all of Jiang Ci's awe-inspiring hidden identities are revealed to the world. The world is shocked! So she is the true boss who dominates both Yin-Yang worlds!

title: The Palace Only Buys Frozen Dreams
summary: The night I was sent into the Royal Palace, snow was falling from the heavens. One hundred and twenty silver lamps lined the steps, but their wicks were not made of cotton; they were segments of little finger bones coated in white wax. Everyone said that as long as I sold my last box of matches to the Crown Prince, Baili City would survive this winter. Only I knew that the flames capable of conjuring the scent of bread, the crackle of a hearth, and the warmth of a grandmother's smile were not blessings from God. They were the final dreams of children who had frozen to death in the streets. Tonight, the Royal Palace was coming for mine.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: There Is No Way a Support-type Character Will Have a Girlfriend
summary: I have to protect Shōgawa-san’s secret…! My classmate Shōgawa-san has a secret that no one must uncover── That’s right, she is actually a Radiant Magical Girl that protect this city! (And she’s super cute～!) I found out this secret by accident, and to avoid her identity from being exposed, I vow to cover up for her, but she is a really clumsy ditz! In order to better support her, I must be mentally prepared to stay by her side at all times… 「Shōgawa-san! Please stay with me (Physically)!」「Oh, Okay.」 Great! Now we can have lunch together, go home after school together, visit the amusement park together── As a support type character, my support will be flawless! …Hmm? A couple? No no no, There Is No Way a Support Type Character Will Have a Girlfriend. A love comedy of misunderstandings and lack of self awareness, is now screening!
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: My Father Who Has Been Widowed for 18 Years Is in Love
summary: My widowed father, who has been alone for eighteen years, is in love again. I don't actually object to him remarrying; in fact, I hope he finds a wife who will care for and cherish him. After all, my mother died from postpartum complications shortly after I was born. For eighteen years, my father remained single, rejecting the advances of countless women. For an extremely wealthy and well-maintained middle-aged man, this is truly remarkable. I've always been moved by the unwavering love he and my mother shared. But he's in love, and his new partner seems to be around my age. Tao Xin and her boyfriend were caught in a mudslide while traveling. They should have died, but instead, they were transported eighteen years into the future. Eighteen years later, her once shy and reserved boyfriend has become a successful and powerful CEO, with a lively and energetic grown son. This is tough. She's only in her early twenties. How is she supposed to be a stepmother? One day, Tao Xin was watching a drama in bed when a WeChat message popped up on her iPad. Only after clicking on it did she realize she was logged into Zhou Tingzhi's WeChat account. Inevitably, she saw a photo of herself touching a male model's abs at a bar. The reporter was Mr. Chen, a righteous man who was indignant, saying, "Do you know your little lover is playing around like this behind your back?" Tao Xin was mortified. Just as she was thinking about how to explain it, the outspoken Mr. Chen received a reply. Zhou Tingzhi: She's young, it's only natural she's playful. She'll settle down after we get married.
genres: Adult, Drama, Historical, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: The Throne Of Power: Reborn As A County Seat Civil Servant
summary: The Great Leader: This kid Chen Donglai is good, let him be the Director! Organization Department: Chen Donglai, the Great Leader has decided to appoint you as Director. Do you think you can accept the position of Police Station Director? Chen Donglai: My combat power is too low, I'm afraid I can't control criminals. I don't accept. Organization Department: Can you be the Director of a research institute? Develop lithography machines and nanochips to bring glory to the country? Chen Donglai: I have a bachelor's degree, I can't do high-tech research, I don't accept. Organization Department: Can you be the Director of a township judicial office? The same starting point as Qi Tongwei? Chen Donglai: That sounds like a script for suffering in a mountain village for thirty years. I decline. Organization Department: "Nothing is good enough for you! Fine—make him the Director of the Public Toilets!" Chen Donglai: "Wait, no! I’ll take the Police Station Director!" Organization Department: "Too late! There is only one position left. Director of the Government Guesthouse. Do a bad job, and you’re off to scrub those toilets!
genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Slice of Life

title: The Monstrous Narrow-Eyed Villain Actor Takes Over the Entertainment Industry
summary: I took on a minor villain role as a same-day stand-in. But then… “How can the acting of a mere supporting role pierce through the screen like that?” “Ugh! We need to rewrite! This script doesn’t do justice to the performance!” “How did you manage to act like that?” “Bring that guy here. Looks like we’ve unearthed a monstrous talent after a long time.” The entire entertainment industry has its eyes on this. How on earth did this happen?

title: Juliet’s Survival
summary: I was living my life as an ordinary Korean citizen, but one day I suddenly became Juliet Capulet. For a moment, I was terrified that I had become the Juliet who had met a tragic end. But then I realized that this was a subtly different world from the original story. I decided to live a peaceful life without Romeo. However, a presence that disrupts my peace emerges... "I'm writing a play based on Miss Juliet." - - - After the appearance of William Shakespeare, the author of "Romeo and Juliet”, every situation around conforms to the script he writes. To Juliet, who only thinks of survival, her tragic lover Romeo, no... The culprit behind all this, William, approaches her?! 'If Shakespeare falls completely for me, can he complete such a story?' William, intending to finish the story as per the original, without knowing anything. And Juliet trying to survive by twisting the planned tragedy. What will be the conclusion of the new masterpiece they create?!

title: Before A Vampire Bites Me
summary: Masato Tanaka, an ordinary man living a normal life in human society. The morning after graduating from high school, his family mysteriously disappears, leaving only ashes on their beds as a clue. The police investigation reaches its limits, and the search is called off. One night, while returning from his night walk—a habit he had developed to search for his family during his free time before bed—he finds a girl collapsed in front of his house. Unaware that she is a vampire, Masato Tanaka is injured in the arm by a pursuer he mistakes for the girl’s guardian. He grabs the girl’s hand with his bloodied arm and flees the scene, but as he believes he has been caught and killed, he wakes up in a hospital room. This is the story of Masato Tanaka, who knows nothing about vampire society, becoming the kin of a vampire girl who is in protective confinement by humans, and how the two end up living together.

title: Can’t Not Ship This Couple Pairing
summary: The Top Actor was doing a Live Stream playing Honor of Kings, and got insulted with foul language by his opponent. As his teammate, I fired back so hard the other side was left speechless: "Keep barking, keep barking. When your mom gave birth to you, she only gave you vocal cords, not a brain?" "If they put your picture up at the crematorium for New Year's, even the dead would feel unlucky, and yet you think you're hot stuff." Then, unexpectedly, I went viral. The whole internet started shipping me and him as a CP: "Fiery Sister and Helpless Puppy, this is such a good ship! Who can resist?!" Afraid his fans would cyberbully me, I quickly clarified: "I don't know him, never met him, we're just game teammates, no further contact." But the Top Actor replied with his main account: "I get it. It's a good ship."
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Became a Gunslinger in Wild West
summary: Every shot lands. A dull, monotonous life—just another cog in the machine. Seeking excitement, an ordinary Korean civil servant, Kim Jaei, dives into a wildly popular Wild West game. But it’s brutally difficult. In the end, he switches on auto-aim assist… only to find himself transported into that very world with it enabled. In an era of schemes and lawlessness, the weak don’t survive. Armed with nothing but perfect aim, a rookie gunslinger begins his desperate fight to stay alive.

title: Dragon Ball- Vegata Future Rewritten By Inner Voice
summary: The system’s function currently only applies to Vegeta, who gains the ability to hear Trunks’ inner thoughts. His soul transmigrates into Future Trunks. At first, he believes he’s in the main timeline, only to realize it’s the desperate future timeline. Though he wants to save this bleak world, he’s just a child—powerless to change anything. But then, something unexpected happens. Trunks: “Dad… seems a little different?” By eavesdropping on Trunks’ inner voice, Vegeta learns of the tragedies that will soon befall this future world. This knowledge sparks a profound change in his heart. After Goku’s death, Vegeta shoulders the responsibility of saving Earth, gradually turning the tide of despair—all while secretly listening to Trunks’ thoughts. This isn’t just a story about Vegeta and Trunks shining—every character has their moment. In my heart, Dragon Ball has never been about just one person’s strength. PS: Dual protagonists—Vegeta and Trunks. The early stages focus mainly on Vegeta, while Trunks plays a supporting role.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Earth Protection Zone
summary: It has been 444 days since I was trapped in a zombie game. Exhausted from loneliness, I finally managed to meet another survivor, but then—[Sudden Quest] Reduce Caliph Roxburg’s mutation rate to below 90% within the time limit (00:29:59) ▶ Failure Penalty: Game clear failed To clear the game, she must have physical contact with a man! Thus, she begins to carry out secret quests…“Don’t provoke me. I’m barely holding myself together as it is.” The stoic but unusually kind Caliph “…I want to stay by Earth’s side.” The pure-hearted and handsome Damian “Once I start, I can’t stop. No, I won’t stop.” The uncontrollable troublemaker Chase She only completed the quest, yet the three sentinels begin to obsess over her.[Game Clear Quest] Find the vaccine (0/1) and deliver it to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention And on top of that, the fate of the world rests on Earth. Will Earth be able to resolve the zombie outbreak and return to her original world?

title: The Story is Told by the Protagonist
summary: The novel I wrote has become reality. The destruction of Earth has begun. But me telling the future about the protagonist ended up being broadcast live to the whole world. ‘We’re screwed.’ Everyone is looking for me to survive the apocalypse.”

title: Roughly an Isekai Hypnosis Story
summary: "From now on, I am your god." With overwhelming hypnosis skills, he transfers to another world!
genres: Action, Adult, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Romance

title: False Sage’s Heroic Tale
summary: A young Hero, said to be the strongest in history, and his best friend, a Sage, is the weakest, but possesses exceptional wisdom. Together, they defeat the Demon King, but on their way back home, the news that the Hero was attacked by the remnants of the Demons and lost his life sends the country into an uproar. The only one who returned was the Sage. He was accused of aiding the demons and sent to the remote region for a crime he did not commit. A plot to assassinate the Hero was cleverly hatched. When he learns of this, he secretly recovers his best friend's inheritance and increases his power, finally becoming more powerful than the strongest man in history. He is determined to take down the people who set him up. And for the sake of his deceased friend, he will deceive the "world" and create a new legend. All the while keeping his true identity hidden----

title: The Traces We Walked Together ~Miracle~
summary: After losing the woman he loves, Kazuki Kimura loses the will to live. In that state, Kazuki gradually remembers the traces he and the woman he loved built together. Will Kazuki be able to recover… a moving love story!

title: The Strongest Bride in Another World, But It Seems I’m Stronger in Night Battles ~A Harem Chronicle of Rising to Power Using Strategy~
summary: In a tale set in another world, a man who sought a peaceful and comfortable life found himself reincarnated as the husband of a muscular clan’s chieftain. While living with his wife and his lover in a harmonious harem, he also serves as a military strategist under the formidable Demon Lord, working tirelessly for the prosperity of their household.

title: The Supporting Role Protagonist Correctioner ~The Man Who Manipulates the World from the Shadows~
summary: Yuma Sato—an ordinary young man with memories of a past life—was living a quiet life as a mere “supporting character” in another world. Yet, for some reason, incidents, romance, and conspiracies kept unfolding all around his everyday life. Yuma intended not to interfere, watching only from the shadows—However, small coincidences and his unconscious actions gradually began to alter the fates of those around him. The glory of heroes, the course of love, and the schemes of nations—all of it played out before Yuma’s eyes.A mundane daily life as a bystander. But without realizing it, Yuma himself was the one throwing the gears of the story off balance— A quiet, slightly ironic otherworld fantasy where an ordinary supporting role peers into the world through the cracks of fate.

title: The Little Macho Girl
summary: “Macho, won’t anyone buy a macho?” Leading along several machos, a single young girl tossed out some dangerous words to the town residents passing by. The macho seller. On that sudden statement of human trafficking, the townsfolks’ eyes opened wide as they gazed at the girl. “Macho, does anyone need a lively macho? You can boil and bake them, and if it really comes down to it, they can even serve as bodyguards. Does anyone need such a wonderful macho?”

title: Men’s Welfare Starts with Exorcising Evil Spirits
summary: A quirky, action-packed office exorcism comedy featuring a tiger-born rookie and a rabbit-born manager—plus a whole lot of ghosts! When ‘Dokgab Mulsan,’ a massive corporation built on a goblin site, starts experiencing bizarre hauntings, it's clear something’s gone wrong. With the original guardian goblin gone, supernatural chaos begins to affect the employees. Enter *Kang Hae-young*, a fearless, tiger-born new hire in the Employee Satisfaction Center (a department of one), and *Go Jeong-seok*, a timid, rabbit-born manager (and also the chairman’s grandson). Together, this unlikely duo tackles ghostly encounters, soothes stressed-out office workers, and keeps the company in one piece. But the spooky events aren’t random—there’s a dark force working behind the scenes, using evil spirits to try and take over the company. I am the only one who will never abandon you," her father declared. Her beautiful and omnipotent father. Her great and magnificent creator. Her sin was that she served two masters. "Stab your father's heart and crawl back to me," Remington commanded. Remington, who wished to kill her yet could not, was sad. "And then tell me you love me, cry, beg, and plead. It felt good when you looked at me with such longing," he continued. "...You're insane," Dani retorted. "Is that still too difficult a command?" he asked. If Dani ever decided to end her life, Remington would hang himself first. Did he know? That contradiction was her only lifeline. "I want you to look at me the way you are right now," he said. "...Don't be mistaken. I despise you at this moment," Dani replied. "Yes. That's exactly what I want." "......" "Continue to despise me. By my side." Then one day, a troop of iron-clad riders halted before her humble restaurant. “Come back to the capital with me,” the man on horseback commanded, his armor gleaming cold in the sunlight. After all, my ability—and the codename I go by in the industry, “Jet-Black Wings”—is just too cringeworthy. I don’t want to be tied to that identity forever. Then one day, I found out someone had hired the Top 1 to take me out. After thinking it over again and again, I decided to strike first… and ended up getting counter-killed instead. But that redhead didn’t finish me off. Instead, he said he wanted to start writing novels and was planning to quit killing altogether—to wash his hands of it—and asked if I wanted to join him. My gaze sharpened instantly—what a terrible excuse! That was obviously a threat, right?! Knowing better than to resist, I tearfully agreed and followed him along in trembling fear. He even said that since he was “keeping” me, we should get proper jobs and earn money honestly. So, sniffling all the way, I went from working as a convenience store clerk with him to selling bubble tea. After living together for a few years and even expanding our milk tea shop, it suddenly hit me— Wait a second… you were actually telling the truth back then?!

title: Dragon Talisman
summary: Skyseal Emperor Gu Taxian is perhaps the greatest Emperor in all of history. He crushed the Hundred Empires and brought them to heel, built the vast Great Stone Wall to keep out the deadly wilders, relocated mountains and rivers to promote commerce, set up roads and highways, and even promoted free academies of learning for the common man in an attempt to uplift them. But the Skyseal Emperor's ambitions involve more than just this - he is preparing to launch a great campaign to stamp out all pagan religions, wishing to allow all men to become like gods instead of merely worshiping them. Deities, demons, and immortals alike tremble and rage at the Skyseal Emperor's ambitions. Gu Chensha is the nineteenth son of the Skyseal Emperor. His mother had been of the royal Chen clan of the Xian Dynasty, one of the Hundred Empires, which had betrothed her to the Skyseal Emperor in an effort to strengthen ties between them. When they refused to submit once the Skyseal Emperor began his grand campaign, he crushed them along with the rest of the Hundred Empires. Chensha's mother then committed su*cide, leaving him alone and friendless at court. For years, Chensha played the part of a fool to avoid being targeted by the other princes... but by accident or design, he one day discovers the long-lost scroll containing the ancient technique only meant for the Sons of Heaven, the 'Son of Heaven's Consecration'. This technique supposedly gave the ancient Sons of Heaven the power to make mortals into gods... or strip the gods of their godhood. Finally, Chensha had the power to change his destiny, but he still needed to be careful - his imperial siblings have spent years building up their powerbases, and neither they nor the maternal clans supporting them will take kindly to Chensha pushing his way into their ranks. Moreover, if anyone discovered that he held onto the Rites of Celestial Sacrifice instead of offering them to his imperial father, the punishment would undoubtedly be death! Only time will tell if he can make use of this opportunity to rise up to become a dragon amongst men, or just become a footnote to the grand history of the Aeternal Imperium.

summary: A young general, Xie Yunshuo, renowned for his military achievements and a leader among the nobles of the capital, is forced to marry his old enemy, Jiang Si. Not only is Jiang Si devoid of virtue, she is also shrewd and arbitrary, prioritizing anyone above all else. Unfortunately, the Xie family is entrusted with the important task of quelling a foreign rebellion on the border, and less than two months after their wedding, Xie Yunshuo is dispatched to join the army. Outside, he could tolerate her coquettishness, hinder him in every way, and ride on his head without shedding a tear. But in this Luan tent, she wanted to return all of this to him. Unfortunately, Jiang Si was soft and not hard. In the tent, the spring scenery was voluptuous, her slender waist softened like water, her cheeks were red, tears were streaming, but she still had to be tough. “Xie Yunshuo, practice martial arts well and strengthen your waist.” Xie Yunshuo: “…” He had no rival in this life, only this little ancestor.

At that time, Chen Youliang led an army of 600,000 to attack Nanjing, declaring that the first battle would be the decisive one and the outcome would be decided in a single battle. Zhu Chong volunteered to guard the strategically important city of Hongdu to buy time for his father, Zhu Yuanzhang. A Pangu axe! A Qilin stepping on a Pegasus horse! Zhu Chong was invincible in the midst of thousands of troops, and he was unstoppable. He frightened Chen Youliang's 600,000 troops and made them lose their souls! This battle earned Zhu Chong the name "Man-Slayer," and he was called the reincarnation of the God of Death! Zhu Yuanzhang: "My son Zhu Chong is invincible in the world!" Chang Yuchun: "People call me Chang Shiwan, but the Second Prince only needs one person to be invincible!" Wang Baobao: "In the face of absolute power, all strategies are useless! The Yuan Dynasty... is dead!" Zhang Sanfeng: "Alas! After practicing Taoism for over a hundred years, I can't even withstand a punch from Zhu Chong!" Xu Miaoyun: "Brother Zhu Chong is the best, I want to marry him!"

title: An Encore for This Love
summary: “I want to get married.” With that single sentence—spoken without even consulting her—their four-year relationship came to an end. Thinking she might as well devote herself entirely to her studies, Ina left for the United States. But soon, she was met with shocking news… “You’re pregnant.” During the six years she spent in America, Ina worked tirelessly—raising her child while continuing her studies. Using her original major, she eventually debuted as a musical director in the U.S., achieving remarkable success before finally returning to Korea. Just as the dazzling second act of her life was about to begin… She ran into her ex-boyfriend, Dohyun—the father of her child—who had been cast as the male lead in the very musical she was directing. Desperately hiding her lingering feelings for him, Ina struggles even harder to keep the existence of her son, Chan, a secret. “Who’s the father?” “…He’s dead.” “Seo Ina, don’t lie. He looks exactly like me—and you’re saying I’m not his father?” Their relationship, which once ended unfinished, begins again—this time on the stage. Ina pushes Dohyun away, unwilling to be hurt again. But Dohyun keeps pulling her back toward him. “So… try it with me one more time.” “Dating.” Will the two of them be able to bring this dazzling stage to a perfect close?
genres: Adventure, Drama, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Reborn in the 1960s: The Pitiful Little Girl’s Real Mother
summary: He Jingshu kept having the same dream from time to time, and it left her utterly puzzled—what could it mean? It wasn’t until an earthquake struck that she was reborn into the 1960s. The pitiful little girl from her dream had now become her own biological daughter. Looking at the skinny, frail child, He Jingshu was suddenly overwhelmed by a rush of maternal love. As the little girl became more lively day by day, He Jingshu felt deeply fulfilled. But then, the so-called “husband” who hadn’t returned home for years suddenly showed up—and now he wanted her to take the child and leave with him...?

title: The Person Who Gave Me An Extraordinary Life Was You, A Beautiful Executive Secretary
summary: “I came.” It’s been three years since I was assigned to the technical department of my current company. Going back and forth between the company and my room is my usual unchanging daily routine. One day, I found out that an old movie I had seen before was being revived and screened. I reserved a seat online and headed to the movie theater that night, which was reserved for private viewing. Enjoying my leisurely time alone, a woman came and sat right next to me. At that time, I had no idea that she lived in the same apartment building as me, or that we actually worked for the same company. This is a story about me, who is ordinary except for being good at shogi, and the girl who has been hurt in her heart, spending everyday life together with everyone around.

title: Madman!
summary: My name is Chen Wujun, and I have made outstanding contributions to the public security of East District 9. However, the Federation does not recognize this. I feel that the Federation is biased against me. So many people in East District 9 have no opinion, why should they have an opinion? ...... "Since your Federation has so many opinions, then let's create a new Federation!"

title: This Earth Is A Bit Fearsome
summary: In his past incarnation, Lu Xuan was the youngest Celestial Lord that the universe has ever seen! An accidental rebirth brought him back to a thousand years before, where the Earth had just begun its spiritual reawakening. When he stepped onto the way of cultivation for a second time, he swore to rewrite all injustices suffered in his past life and defeat all enemies that dare stand in his way! Let invincibility be his cultivation and the path he treads. In this life, it is his destiny to be invincible!

title: The Terminally ill Genius Actor Wants to Live
summary: Kang Jun, an actor notorious for his rude attitude. After an accident, he began to see his remaining lifespan. [D-1] [You will die after this time.] [You can gain more time through acting.] To survive, he must act.

title: Final Days of Summer
summary: A man, burnt out from excessive overwork, returns to his hometown to get away from it all. He soon grows bored and decides to visit a beach he used to play at as a child. There he stumbles upon a man on the sand wearing strange clothes who speaks of even stranger things: he is at the beach to see the upcoming meteor shower, even though it is supposed to occur almost a week later. But he finds a strange comfort in watching the sky at the mysterious man’s side and decides to return the next day to ‘wait for the stars’ with him. This is just the beginning of a series of interconnected tales that span across time and space, and share a feeling of quiet peacefulness, like what you feel when gazing up into the starlit night sky. While reading these you may begin to feel there is more out there–and more inside yourself–than you ever imagined.

title: Giving the Escape Game Boss a Women’s Costume
summary: By chance, Jiang Xiu Xiu participates in the escape game rumored to have the highest death rate. Among a group of extraordinarily talented players, the special ability she acquires is... the art of disguise (?!). Even more terrifying, her task to clear the game is to dress the BOSS in specified outfits! Including but not limited to cat ears, bunny ears, or maid outfits??? She understands the logic, but why are all the BOSSES men?! In the first level, looking at the boy on the high platform with clean eyebrows, gentle and harmless, Jiang Xiu Xiu thought hopefully that maybe clearing the game wouldn't be so difficult? Then, the next second, the BOSS smiled and twisted someone's neck. In the Nth level, looking at the still innocent and pure BOSS, Jiang Xiu Xiu, with a numb expression and a weathered demeanor, lit a cigarette: "Today is another day of striving to make the BOSS cross-dress."

title: A Gate Opened On My First Day As A Politician
summary: Han Seung-Moon thought he was the luckiest man alive when he unexpectedly won his election and took his oath as an Assemblyman. But his first day in office becomes a nightmare when monstrous creatures crash through the National Assembly roof, marking the start of an invasion through mysterious gates. Now, alongside a fierce group of survivors—some of whom begin to exhibit strange new powers—Seung-Moon must navigate both deadly monsters and political intrigue in a brutal new world where survival demands every ounce of wit and courage he has.

title: Idol Born as a Devil
summary: To restore magical power, they needed human attention and worship. To do that, they had to first become famous. Idol. The very meaning of the word itself is idol. Could there be a more fitting definition?

title: The Father of American Comics Superheroes
summary: That night, when a Kryptonian ship with a baby crashed on Mike Kent’s family farm, and when he decided to adopt that child the golden finger of crossover was thus activated, he understood that his life was about to change. Superman Clark Kent, Professor X Charles Kent, Magneto, Eric Kent.. When he became the father of these men, the strongest family was born!
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Beware the Mixing of Genres
summary: It’s been three years since I signed up as a tester for my employer’s detective action game and got stuck. On the verge of becoming stagnant, rotten water, I was transferred to a dating simulation game. Just as I was about to celebrate the end of a life chasing after the tails of criminals and screaming at the top of my lungs, a torn and shattered crimson system window appeared in my mind. [system: The player’s passive skill ‘Quality of a Detective’ has been activated. Crime rate within a radius of 1km increased by 5%.] What should I do with this? It feels like I’ve brought disaster to the peaceful world of dating simulation. * “Let me ask you one thing. Why do you dislike me so much?” “I don’t dislike you.” [♥SYSTEM: Evan Sylvester’s favorability rating is -10 ♥] “Ah, yes~! the noble one is putting up with me, so I should just disappear.” Now, I must never see this person again. As I made up my mind and grasped the doorknob, it happened. ‘Ding.’ [♥Affection Event: ‘Hope to Get Closer’ Event Triggered! ((っ´ω`)♥(´ω`⊂ )) Heart pounding! Spend time with him in the secret room and increase your affection! Increased likability opens the chamber exit!] Crazy, what is this, let me out, what did I do wrong!!!

title: A Story Only I Don’t Know
summary: ― Why on earth is her fiancé acting like this? Is she the only one who doesn’t know? One day, Elia’s fiancé appeared before her. He wore an unfamiliar, exceedingly gentle expression. “Elly. I missed you. So much.” He called her by a pet name, then suddenly claimed he missed her. It seemed that overnight, Edmund had gone mad. * ― A second chance given by death. And once more, he fell in love. One day, parting came to Edmund. With his wife Elia’s notice of divorce, and with death. However, when he woke up again… the man’s time had returned to ten years ago. “Elly. I missed you. So much.” This time, he approached, pretending to be a gentle man, calling her by a pet name. For the love he once lost, he was willing to do anything. Preview: “Elia, Elly.” “…What?” Elia thought she must have misheard. She never imagined that Edmund, who she expected to bluntly state his business and leave, would call her by her pet name. Moreover, the voice calling her name sounded nothing like usual. ‘Gentle…? That can’t be.’ It was only natural for her to be wary of Edmund’s strange behavior, now that he was suddenly showing interest in her. “I missed you. So much.” She couldn’t tell if her breathlessness and pounding heart were from fear, or from the man’s desperate voice and gaze… She felt as though she might faint from the overwhelming emotions Edmund was pouring out at her.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Academy’s Stationery Warrior
summary: An institution that trains Nox who have contracted with weapons, 'Scionia Academy.' I possessed a character in a game set in that very place. ...In a body that can only use school supplies.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, School Life

summary: Coming Soon

title: [Blue Archive] I am the Trinity Checkpoint Chief
summary: It's not like it's a story about beating Gehenna with bagpipes... but is being the chief of the checkpoint an easy job?

title: Grave Robber
summary: Haunted by his dreams, Xiao Bei, a man who has lived his entire life as something that could be expressed by the word, “Meaningless”, has begun to walk a new path. One of a Tomb Raider. Trying to help him, his friend had introduced him into a new world, one filled with monsters, deadly poisons, traps, curses, and various creatures of the supernatural. And for what, you may ask? Money! Lots of it. But Xiao Bei was not enticed by the possible fame and fortune. He begins to venture this path only to find out the mysteries behind the very thing that has haunted him for the past twenty years. Welcome to a world of thrills, adventure, and the supernatural.

title: Villain: I Possess The Dragon Yang Dao Physique, All Saintesses Turns Into Villainesses
summary: Lin Qi’an safely crossed into a fantasy realm, becoming the Crown Prince of Beiyang of an Immortal Dynasty. His father, the current strongest Sword Emperor, enjoys an exalted status! His fiancée is also the unparalleled beauty ranked first on the Fairy List. However, Lin Qian discovers that he has an overwhelming number of enemies, all of whom are emerging protagonists destined for greatness! Those born with a sacred body! Reincarnation of a Great Emperor! Holder of immortal treasures! Fortunately, Lin Qian awakens a villain system, which rewards him for defeating these protagonists. “Ding! Opening beginner’s gift pack, obtained ‘Dragon Yang Dao Physique’.” “Ding! Subdued the daughter of golden luck, rewarded with the divine skill ‘Thousands of Swords to Court’.” “Ding! Slayed the ancient clan’s holy son, rewarded with ‘Ice Qillin Essence Blood’.” Lin Qian could never have imagined that these so-called daughters of luck could see through his special constitution! The icy pure and aloof holy saintesses, one after another, turned into villainesses. What broken protagonists? Isn’t the Dragon Yang Dao Physique more fragrant?
genres: Action, Adult, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Xianxia

title: The Farming Family’s Precious Darling: A Sweet Little Lucky Charm at Home
summary: The Tan family endured hardship for most of their lives until they adopted the little girl abandoned by the county magistrate's family. Their fortunes dramatically changed. The unproductive hen that had never laid an egg suddenly filled the courtyard with them. The barren land, once incapable of growth, now flourished with abundant harvests. The eldest son became more ambitious, the second son shed his foolishness. The third son recovered from his illness, and the fourth and fifth sons became more attentive and caring. The sixth son achieved great success, passing the imperial examination. Those who had bullied them faced the consequences of their actions. Their lives improved with each passing day, but this newfound prosperity brought with it a new worry. A hidden prince had taken a liking to their daughter. What were they to do?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Build a Magic School in a Disaster World
summary: Ning Zhao tragically sacrificed her life saving her students, but was fortunately chosen by the management of the “All-Star Magic Academy” to become the rookie principal, poised to make a name for herself in another world and build a legendary magic academy. However, something went wrong during her journey— she accidentally stumbled into a book. A previously unfinished, dark, apocalyptic novel, reviled by readers for its incomprehensible, unfinished nature. The world of this novel will emerge with the eerie rusty sunrise in the sky, ushering in five different disasters: extreme cold as low as -150 degrees Celsius combined with blizzards, tidal waves powerful enough to swallow cities, scorching heat and volcanic eruptions that evaporate all rivers, devastating earthquakes accompanied by terrifying meteor showers, and hurricanes wrapped in acid rain that devour everything… And, all of this will restart again and again with the death of the heroine. Ning Zhao: This world is hopeless. Ning Zhao: …If you want to live, you’d better save it.

title: Second Life: This Time I Choose the Right Man
summary: In the first half of her life, Cui Yaoning was the envy of everyone. She was the legitimate daughter of the prestigious Cui clan of Qinghe. Spoiled and willful since childhood, she later married Pei Yu, the top scholar from an equally eminent aristocratic family, and was cherished beyond measure. Pei Yu had grown up with her as childhood sweethearts. They were deeply in love. On their wedding day, he promised her that he would never take concubines and would never have children by another woman in his lifetime. She believed he truly loved her. But when her father and brothers were falsely accused of treason, the very first thing he did was bring his mistress into their household. He said, "Ruiniang has a gentle temperament. She won’t compete with you. Even if she bears a child, the child will be raised under your name. No one will ever surpass you." Later, he said, “You can’t even tolerate one child? You truly disappoint me.” When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to the year she was fourteen. This time, at the Spring Banquet, as she looked at the many outstanding young men present, Cui Yaoning’s gaze passed directly over Pei Yu, who was looking at her full of expectation and was settled on that quiet and refined young man instead. Her voice was sweet yet domineering as she declared, "I choose him." He was the son of the Princess Royal of Jinyang. And also… Pei Yu’s legitimate elder cousin. Pei Yanshu was a young lord raised in a noble household. Elegant and aloof, as graceful as orchids and jade trees, he had engraved rules and discipline into his very bones since childhood. Throughout the capital, he was known as the model gentleman. Yet no one knew that from the moment he first saw his cousin’s fiancée, he had harbored secret desires for her. He never expected that one day, the bright moon in his heart would descend from the heavens and run toward him.

title: The Nine Cauldrons
summary: Emperor Zi Yu used 5 strikes of his axe to split mountains and unify everyone underneath the heavens. He partitioned the land into 9 areas, thus establishing the Nine Cauldrons which eventually became known as the 9 prefectures. When Emperor Zi Yu died, disputes unceasingly arose One thousand years later, a once in a generation genius, Heavenly Emperor of Qin Mountains was born. Able to split a one hundred meter river, equipped with his peerless martial prowess, he finally united the land under the heavens. However, when Heavenly Emperor of Qin Mountains died, chaos once again shrouded the land. Another one thousand years passed and no one was able to consolidate the nation. From contemporary society, great Chinese Martial Artist Teng Qingshan, unexpectedly arrived into this world.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Twelve Witches
summary: In the chaos of Yongqing, Su Lingxi orchestrated thrones and rebellions—a ruthless architect of power, branded a traitor by heaven. Exiled from Fu Yu, her memories faded over thirteen years, leaving only whispers of a life she once knew. When heaven’s pillar cracks, unleashing demons, she returns with mankind’s plea—and confronts the icy commander Ye Zhuxu. Their clashing silver bells ring with buried history; his storm-dark gaze hides a past she can’t recall. Now, as monsters hunt and her fractured truths resurface, Su Lingxi must choose: reclaim her ghostly legacy… or let both realms burn.

title: William In The Closet
summary: William In The Closet/To My Juliet Boy Julia Green was a teenage girl who lived in California. One day, an unknown but gorgeous boy emerged from her old closet. On a birthday spent alone, On a night without a dancing partner, Whenever the dawn cried, William would emerge from that same door and remain by Julia’s side, always and forever present in her time of need. It was only natural for Julia to fall in love with him. “When I am with you, everything becomes special. The time, the distance, the scenery… Even myself.”
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Killed the Game’s Heroine
summary: I was reincarnated in a game and killed one of the main heroines. Then, troublesome things kept getting involved.

title: Music Genius of the Arts High School
summary: The messenger god Hermes has descended into this world. Above heaven and earth, he stands alone. A fun story of a former god of music conquering an arts high school! “I’m going to become the greatest star.” A top star is born—aiming for a position even higher than the gods!

title: Shut Up – This Is a Serious Game
summary: As a serious game to save the world, why aren’t my players taking it seriously? You were brought here to farm, mine, build infrastructure, and research technology, yet all you do is look for glitches or try to skip class? Can’t grow crops in cold weather? That must be a bug in the weather system, but the high-power microwave radar from the research institute can come in handy! Mining is too tiresome? A nuclear bomb to blow off the top and turn it into an open-pit mine! Not enough people in the settlement? Well… After crossing into the post-apocalyptic world, Chen Jiu unlocked the Particle Reconstruction System, which could summon players from the real world. He wanted these players to obediently work for him and help rebuild the ruins of civilization brick by brick, but these players seemed to have no sense of being a worker. Work? There’s no time for work, the only way to rebuild civilization is to take shortcuts without hesitation. Years later, when food was available, technology was upgraded, and population had grown, Chen Jiu couldn’t help but ask himself: Is this a bug? No, this is game mechanics!
genres: Sci-fi, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: All the Girls in the Cultivation World Are Imagining Things About Me — What Should I Do?
summary: Mingming is a useless person who can’t cultivate, yet all the great figures of the cultivation world revere him as the supreme. Even though Mingming hasn’t done anything bad, he’s constantly slandered as a s*umbag who ruins countless saintesses, noble ladies, and outstanding men. From time to time, a few blackened beautiful girls will even appear, clutching knives and firewood, insisting on sharing their love-hate entanglement with him. Lin Huai’an really doesn’t understand what kind of illness these cultivators have. Mingming himself, as this cannon-fodder villain, has from start to finish only…

title: Twin Brothers Want to Swap Wives? I’ll Secure My Position as the Marchioness
summary: My cousin and I married the twin sons of a marquis's household, a story celebrated as a beautiful tale in the capital. Two months later, the devastating news of my husband's death in battle arrived. Before he died, he supposedly entrusted his twin brother with inheriting both family lines to take care of me and father a child with me. Even my mother-in-law urged me to agree. When my sister-in-law found out, she slapped me on the spot and accused me of being unchaste. I sternly refused this arrangement, but I accidentally overheard an argument between my mother-in-law and my younger brother-in-law: "It was clearly your younger brother who died. Why do you insist it was you?" "Mother, Xi Yue and I were already in love. On the wedding day, my brother and I swapped places for the ceremony. I originally planned to reveal the swap the next day, but I was unexpectedly sent straight to the battlefield." "Then what about Qing Wan? She was devastated to hear of your 'death' and is now forcing herself to manage the entire marquis's household!" "Qing Wan has always been sensible and strong. I might as well just inherit both family lines and give her a child as well. That would be a way to honor our bond." "Now that your brother is dead, let's just go along with this mistake. Don't tell Qing Wan the truth..." I had intended to seek a divorce, but at that very moment, I discovered I was pregnant. Even more unexpectedly, my husband, who had supposedly died in battle, returned with military honors...
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Fuyuu Gakuen no Alice and Shirley
summary: One day, people awoke to find themselves with the superhuman ability called Dialecte. They gathered in the academy city "Canaan" that was isolated from the general public - a futuristic town floating in the sky. Masaki was a high school student who had a peaceful hobby of making pastries and yet he was judged to have the peerless ability "Glow Verbaliser" so he changed schools. He meets up with his childhood friend Shirley along with the quiet and mysterious Alice. The two of them are the strongest "Breaker" pair who supervise the rule-breakers of the school regulations regarding the misuse of illusions...but they break up over a trivial argument. Furthermore, since Masaki has the power that's called peerless, Alice chooses him as her new partner. The strongest! The unluckiest? Let's raise the curtain on the maximum level tea and sweets superpower school battle!!
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Who Asked Him to Play Yu-Gi-Oh!
summary: "Mr. You Xuan, many people believe that the current state of the dueling world has become increasingly unhealthy, with heavy trap decks and overly defensive strategies dominating the mainstream. As the new King of Duelists, how do you respond to claims that this negative trend was sparked by you?" a journalist asked during an interview. "Slander! Pure slander!" You Xuan angrily responded to the accusation. "How can they say I’m the one who led this trend astray? Dueling has always been like this!"
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Slice of Life, Sports

title: I’m A Super Rich Man, So It’s Reasonable For Me To Be A Scumbag
summary: Jiang Cheng woke up and was reborn! He was also bound to the Godly Rich System. Every second the world runs, he can get money! As the system continues to upgrade, Jiang Cheng's wealth has skyrocketed. All the cool school beauties and queen bosses are around him. Jiang Cheng laughed up to the sky. In his previous life, he was trapped by the things that he couldn't get when he was young for so long. Now that he is reborn, who cares about those broken rules! Let's drink and enjoy it first.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I’m the MC, Why Do I Suck at Cultivation
summary: Lu Changsheng is depressed. In this world full of cultivators and immortals, because of his face and irresistible fine bearing as a protagonist, women fall in love with him within three seconds. Unusual heavenly phenomena occur to celebrate his breakthroughs. His literary talent can easily shock all scholars and his random citations are eulogized by the heaven and earth. Legendary beasts offer themselves as mounts, celestial treasures throw themselves into his pockets. However, there is one thing he does not understand. He’s the main character, the protagonist, the MC! Why does his cultivation suck? Also known as “Super Ultra Ordinary and Average Eldest Senior Brother,” “Why Am I Still the MC Even When I Suck at Cultivation,” “My Good-looking Face But Hopeless Cultivation.”

title: I Will Eventually Become the Hero of Justice
summary: As a six-year-old, Shirou Emiya has not yet experienced the Fourth Holy Grail War, and his parents are still alive. In order to live a fulfilling life, he decides to avoid the war and the responsibility of being a hero of justice. Instead, he uses his knowledge of the future to amass great wealth and reach the pinnacle of life! But… Eliminating All the World’s Evil… Prevent the eradication of mankind… Crushing the conspiracy of the Demon God King… Saving the Pan-Human History… My path seems to be getting more and more off track…
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Romance

title: Green Tea Stepdaughter: Daily Survival in the Mansion
summary: Chu Yufu accidentally transmigrated into a novel, becoming a cannon-fodder concubine daughter who wouldn’t survive past chapter sixty. In the original story, her legitimate sister and cousin were fighting over the heir of a noble family, while she was about to be married off to a s*umbag by her stepmother to serve as a stepping stone for her brother. Before the meeting with the s*umbag, her stepmother specifically instructed, "Dress brightly to catch Young Master Li’s eye." The next day, at the chrysanthemum banquet, she appeared in a full pink outfit, making a grand entrance and smiling with a hint of sly sweetness, "Mother, is this bright enough?" After finally shaking off the s*umbag, her stepmother immediately betrothed her to a minor military officer whom her legitimate sister had rejected. Seeing the officer’s name, she didn’t make a fuss this time— The future Great General of the Northern Frontier, unwanted by others? Then I’ll take him. Unexpectedly, on the day their birth charts were to be matched, news of a military victory at the border reached the capital. The minor officer had become a great general. Her stepmother snatched away the marriage proposal, declaring, "Our Yufu’s fate is ill-omened and incompatible with his." She then handed the betrothal to her own daughter. .... Pei Yue first met Chu Yufu at the Li family’s chrysanthemum banquet. Adorned with jewels and wearing a pink dress, she stood out starkly among the elegantly dressed noble ladies. She appeared foolish and garish. The next time he saw Chu Yufu was in a pharmacy during the Lantern Festival. With a calm expression, she eloquently debated medical principles with the shop’s physician: "If you’re so knowledgeable, how come you don’t know that in such cases, it’s necessary to first promote yang and induce sweating? Only then will Ephedra Decoction be effective." Standing on the second floor of the pharmacy, Pei Yue gazed at the fair, delicate face downstairs. He was momentarily stunned, then raised an eyebrow slightly, tapping his slender fingers lightly on the table. Who would have thought that Miss Chu had two faces? He had originally intended to reject the marriage arranged by his uncle, but now he suddenly felt it might not be such a bad idea. Two months later, after a great military victory, Pei Yue returned home only to learn that his fiancée was about to be swapped. He smirked. What was the Chu family thinking? Did they really believe he would accept just anyone?

title: The General Won’t Live Past Three Months, But After the Bridal Swap, I’ll Bring Him a Hundred Years of Prosperity
summary: Reading Guide: [Bridal Swap + Sweet Pampering & Devoted Couple + Marriage Before Love + Satisfying Household Drama & s*um Slapping] On her wedding day, Jiang Lingzhi's bridal sedan was forced to make way for a coffin. After finally entering the Guogong Fu's gates, her new husband was caught in a tryst with her stepsister on their marriage bed. How could she tolerate this? Jiang Lingzhi decisively picked up the memorial tablet of the s*umbag's younger uncle, Xiao Jingyi, and completed the wedding bows in the mourning hall. "Today, the Xiao General's coffin welcomed me. I am now his wife!" So what if he's a dead man? He's still better than a s*umbag! But to her utter surprise, Xiao Da Jiangjun suddenly "came back from the dead," only to become a comatose man who wouldn't live past three months. The Guogong Fu offered a hefty reward for her to continue the family line, and she also wanted a child to secure her future. Thus, she studied little manuals by day and clung to him insatiably by night. After regaining consciousness, Xiao Jingyi was initially resistant: "Insolent! What country bumpkin dares to be so disrespectful to this general?" Later, he was so smitten his smile reached his ears: "My lady, after you have our child, you'll still want me, right?" Later still, the s*umbag was green with regret and sought out Jiang Lingzhi, insisting on eloping with her: "My little uncle is dying. I'll take you far away!" Xiao Da Jiangjun leaped up in a panic: "You scoundrel, unhand your little aunt!"
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: All You Need Is Kill
summary: When the alien Mimics invade, Keiji Kiriya is just one of many recruits shoved into a suit of battle armor called a Jacket and sent out to kill. Keiji dies on the battlefield, only to be reborn each morning to fight and die again and again. On his 158th iteration, he gets a message from a mysterious ally--the female soldier known as the Full Metal b*tch. Is she the key to Keiji's escape or his final death?
genres: Action, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-fi, Tragedy

title: The Ex-Inquisitor’s Exorcism Broadcast
summary: The Apostle Theo, respected by all, has died. And then, he resurrected. “I can tear apart ghosts.” With the abilities from his previous life.

title: Douluo: Let the Body Sect Become Great in Advance
summary: A Douluo Dalu fanfiction, not for fans of the original novel. She wanted to be an ordinary little salted fish all her life, but she was forced by her grandfather to get married to a poor boy in the countryside. She is a little poor, but she is handsome! Hey! Xia Nanxi suddenly discovered that the president of the top ten company in the world where she interned had the same name as her poor husband, and they looked exactly the same! Could it be that her poor husband is actually a big boss worth trillions? But what she couldn't figure out after thinking for three days and three nights was, how could she not be the biological daughter of the Xia family, and her top wealthy parents actually brought seven handsome brothers to find her!

title: Fire
summary: A passionate romance between a witch who blooms from flowers into fire and a puppet master with a secret. Hwaya (火惹) Born a flower into a noble family in the land of Muyeon, Moon So-hwa was raised as a flower. She always carried a fire in her heart, but she never thought the day would come when she could ignite it. After all, a woman’s life was always like that. But the Taoist priests rebelled, and her life was turned upside down in an instant. Her father, her brother, her fiancé—none of the men who had promised her a life as a flower could protect her, and she fell into the abyss. But she didn’t despair. In this new world, there was a chance to rise again. With Taoist magic, a woman could become equal to a man. “Jump into the fire. Prove yourself a true witch.” Thus, she abandoned her delicate name, Sohwa (小花), and became Sohwa (小火), the seed of a fire that would consume everything, embarking on the path of a witch. “Means, impulse? Me to you.” But did she have masochistic tendencies? The tyrannical Taoist priest, Do Jae-ah, kept catching her eye. He’s a black carp from his prenatal dream, a man of water who is said to have died and been resurrected from the water. He’s the polar opposite of Sohwa, the woman of fire. Furthermore, Do Jae-ah hides a terrifying and sinister secret… Will this love ever come to fruition?

He spoke passionately, “Before the United Kingdom does, let’s make mankind reach space!” Behind the scenes, at the end of the snowy fields of the republic, at the secret town , the “Nosferatu Project” that used vampires as a substitutes for humans for rocket flight experiments was moving forward. Taking advantage of a certain incident, First Lieutenant Liev Lepus was promoted from Cosmonaut Cadet. He was ordered to supervise the vampire girl, Irina Luminesque, who was chosen by chance to be a guinea pig. Strict training. Continuous failed experiments. Can mankind actually reach space? The team was enveloped by such an atmosphere. “Before anyone else, I will travel to space. I want to take a look at the moon from outer space, where no one has gone before.” Irina had those exact feelings. In their chests was a pure longing for space. Despite being made fun of by the egoist top-brass and the whims of the times, they were here, putting everything they have into aiming for distant space. title: Male Inferiorly and Female Supremacy in the World of Immortal Cultivation
summary: Fang Zhou transmigrated into the immortal cultivation world, and the first thing he did was personally cancel his engagement. As a straightforward and macho man, he decided to cancel the engagement to a beautiful girl with a great figure. In this world where men were inferior and women were esteemed, the righteous were women, the villains were women, the cultivators were women, and even the gods who created the heavens and earth were women. Female warriors robbed the rich to help the poor and explored the world with their swords. Men, on the other hand, had to be cautious when going out so that they could protect themselves, lest they be robbed of their wealth and dignity, leaving them with nothing. Transmigrating into such a world, Fang Zhou, a handsome man who was desired wherever he went, felt immense pressure. Girls wanted to play with him and even tried to capture him and take him home. For the sake of his own life, Fang Zhou had no choice but to fight against women to the end. "Get lost, you annoying woman! Don't disturb my cultivation!"

Entertainment world—your emperor has returned!

title: The Return of the Noble Abandoned Consort
summary: When she woke up, she had already jumped through time and space. Qiao Wei fell silent. How could she be so unlucky? Sleeping can also cause time travel? Not just simple time travel, but becoming the mother of the two small buns. But looking at the small buns' sparkling little eyes, Qiao Wei could not say a word of complaint. Bad! How could she handle such a situation? She had never been a mother! Could anything be worse than this? Well then, time to make a plan. Raise the buns, get a fortune, and become prosperous. If someone is not being evil, I will leave them untouched. If people respect me, I will also respect them, but if people make trouble for me, I will punish them, no matter what. Xinglin spring, even if she was an abandoned woman, she could make a beautiful life too. “Nān Nān, finally aunt found you! How could you leave that year? Aunt was looking for you like crazy! You still being alive is really good, let’s go home with aunt! A woman earning so much money is very unsafe outside!” Said a beautiful woman with a veil. “You do not care about my children but want to touch my money. You know what, Aunt, it really hurts me!" Qiao Wei looked cold. The little buns looked back and forth between their mother and a cold-looking man: “Mother, Uncle said he is my father.” Qiao Wei smiled: “Good son, tell your father to prove his identity. What should be done? Small buns opened a gold booklet and started reading one by one: “101 Qiao Family Rules”, insulting an underage girl, will be given palace punishment. “Uncle, if you are really our father … …” After winning over the little buns, the man grabbed Qiao Wei’s chin with a long finger, showing a touch of a cold and dangerous smile: “If this Lord remembers right, it seems that night you were the one being hard on this Lord!”

title: [The World’s Strongest Fire Wizard] ~I Was Reincarnated as a Fat Mobster Who Lost Everything After Being Defeated by the Hero Many Times, but I Will Become Invincible To Save the Heroine I Love So Dearly~
summary: Even among the villain mob characters, there are some that are strangely cool, right? The ones that appear dashingly when the protagonist is in trouble and then die. That’s me… In the game “The Kingdom of Spirits,” Leonhart is a villainous noble mob character who confronts the protagonist many times and loses everything. He is removed from the position of the heir of the marquis family, becomes the laughing stock of the school after losing to the commoner game protagonist, and even his beloved Celestine becomes the sub-heroine of the game protagonist. And at the end of the story, Leonhart even uses his life for Celestine. I refuse to accept such a sad future! I will definitely be happy with Celestine! She is definitely not a sub-heroine who will become a part of the harem! This is the story of a villain mob character who rebels against the game’s scenario.

summary: "Wait, you've returned from death seven times? A reincarnator obsessed with your past life? …How is that my problem?!" A prodigy so brilliant that even the gods pale in comparison. The greatest genius in his territory’s history. Patrick, the eldest son of a poor baron’s family with five siblings, was showered with praise in his rural homeland. Now, he has entered the prestigious royal academy, a place reserved for the most elite students. However, what awaits him there is a group of eccentric geniuses unlike any he has ever encountered… "What? You’ve died and come back seven times?" "Huh? You’re a reincarnator obsessed with your past life??" People keep telling him things like, “You weren’t in any of my past lives” or “You’re not supposed to exist in this world”, but—he's just trying to live a normal life! Will Patrick manage to graduate safely and return home in triumph…? "…Wait. You… can see me?" Stop adding even more complicated plot twists—!!

title: Fated Deception: How I Accidentally Married a Nine-Tailed Fox
summary: When Lu Yuan found himself thrust into an ancient era resembling the austere 1970s and 80s, he was struck speechless. This was a world where simple white flour buns were luxuries reserved for the wealthy. But Lu Yuan had an advantage—a peculiar system that came with his time travel. Each time he spent fifty-two cents on a meal and the store rounded off the difference, it triggered a tenfold multiplication, rewarding him with twenty cents! A modest benefit, perhaps, but in this world, careful planning could transform such small gains into significant success. Just as Lu Yuan was reconciling himself to this strange new life, a figure appeared in the distance. Above the approaching stranger’s head, six characters glowed with supernatural brightness: [Supreme Class Great Bargain] . Lu Yuan drew in a sharp breath. “Hiss~~”

title: I’d Like to Take Advantage of My Female Friend’s Naivety and Get Her to Be My Wife

title: An Adventurer Mom, Who Awakened [Housewife] Skill Through a Login Bonus, Is Making the Most of Her Adventurer Life With the Weekly Flyers She Gets!

The job is popular among young people and housewives in the labyrinth city of Loa because it’s relatively safe and easy. Her dream is to save up 1 million gold. With that much, she and her children could go visit their father, who’s stationed at the border on guard duty. One day, Kachua received her 100th login bonus from a statue of a goddess in the dungeon: a stylish coin purse, a loyalty card, and… a flyer? “Triple Monster Points Day? What’s that?” “Herb Day on dates that end in 4?” “There’s a Meat Day and a Fish Day too?” This is the story of Kachua, the weakest adventurer mom, who was granted the skill [Housewife/Househusband] by the gods and is doing her best to juggle solo parenting and the adventurer life.

title: Princess’s Journey: What Matters Not Knowing Autumn

My mother told the Princess Consort to take us and flee first, while she stayed behind, sword in hand, to hold back the enemy. With a single blade, she cut down countless foes, but in the end, she was simply outnumbered. After her capture, she sought only the release of death. Instead, they dislocated her arms and tore at her clothes, exposing her snow-white skin... The Princess Consort and I were saved. However, the Princess Consort broke her word. She did not treat me like her own daughter. Instead, she loathed my mother, claiming she had been rendered filthy and defiled by the barbarians. Because of this, she made me her daughter's personal maid.

title: 100 Things I Don’t Know About My Senior

Despite not having any contact previously except for using the same train station to get to school, senpai unwillingly agreed to a promise: from that day on, they would have to answer one question every day no matter what it was without telling any lie. The disinterested senpai who doesn’t want to give up on his peaceful commuting time, and the passionate kouhai-chan who doesn’t want to give up on the only student taking the same train as her. This is the story of how their relationship will progress with just one question a day.

title: I Am God’s Proxy (Self-Proclaimed) Kept Saying ‘Everything Is According to the One’s Will’ and Now I Can’t Back Down
summary: That boy— Is he the savior of the world, or just a hopeless chuunibyou? A noble’s son named Zero, reincarnated from Japan. When he realized his new world was one of swords and magic, his former otaku blood boiled with excitement— He just couldn’t help himself: he wanted to do something totally chuunibyou! One day, while rummaging through the study, he found his father’s embarrassing old journal titled “The Notebook of the World’s Truths”. He decided to become the God’s Proxy, a messenger of the true holy god’s will, and began role-playing as the one who rebels against the false gods ruling the world! title: After the Immortal Lord’s White Moonlight is Reborn [Female-Centric World]
summary: The world knows that Immortal Lord Yun Heng, with her clear and moonlight-like elegance, possesses a cultivation level nearing the divine realm. She harbors compassion for all living beings but feels no private affection; she is the coldest drift of snow atop Misty Mountain. As Yun Heng’s only junior sister, Wen Qiwu harbored a secret hidden in the depths of her heart since youth—she loved her Senior Sister. However, this love was destined to never see the light of day. She thought she could guard this secret for a lifetime, but she overestimated herself. A single jar of immortal wine, not even particularly intoxicating, caused years of endurance to crumble in an instant. The moment she was imprisoned at the Cliff of Reflection, Wen Qiwu felt regret, but more so, a sense of relief. She suffered from an innate, incurable illness and was destined to die young; she felt it was better to leave no regrets before the end. Years later, the war between Immortals and Demons broke out. Perhaps her Senior Sister felt that Qiwu had finally let go of that forbidden affection, for before leaving, she left a voice transmission: “Stay safely within the sect. When I return, I will make your favorite chestnut cakes.” Her Senior Sister ultimately couldn’t bear to lock her up forever. Unfortunately, Wen Qiwu never got to eat those chestnut cakes, nor did she ever see her Senior Sister again. Instead, she encountered the Demon Army making a sneak attack on the sect’s rear. To protect the sect, she perished along with the enemy leader. Perhaps by the grace of Heaven, her soul—which should have dissipated—was reborn within a spirit beast egg on the borderlands. Even though she was far from the sect, she intentionally avoided any news related to her past. Yet, years later, whispers of her Senior Sister’s current state still reached her ears. She heard storytellers say that Immortal Lord Yun Heng was gravely injured in that great war; she heard others gossip that the Immortal Lord wasn’t truly injured, but had developed an “Inner Demon” because she couldn’t obtain the “Moonlight” in her heart. Hearing such “absurd” claims, Wen Qiwu endured it as long as she could. Finally, unable to hold back, she transformed into a white bird, intending to teach those gossips a lesson for speaking nonsense. In a twist of fate, she was accidentally caught by a disciple of Misty Mountain and sent to the Immortal Lord as a pet to relieve her boredom. Seeing her Senior Sister again after many years, Wen Qiwu realized that the rumors of the “grave injury” were true, and the “Inner Demon” seemed real as well. The once-reticent Senior Sister now locked herself in her room every day, clutching the birdcage and murmuring incoherent, illogical words. Beside her always sat a plate of chestnut cakes that no one ever ate. Wen Qiwu could not escape; she could only remain as her Senior Sister’s sole daily listener. Later, Wen Qiwu discovered that every word her Senior Sister spoke was a sentence of love that had failed to be delivered in the past.

Shen Bingyue, the youngest three-time film award winner, national goddess, and unstoppable star in the entertainment world, was forced to marry a terrifying, tyrannical man with a powerful background. But halfway through the show’s filming, she began to notice something different about her overbearing and violent villain husband…

title: Love Beyond The Dream
summary: “Did you know? When a cosmic magnetic storm occurs, people’s fates might be rewritten.” “For example?” “Someone who was originally destined to die could have their fate forcibly altered, living happily ever after.” “I don’t believe it. That’s too far-fetched. I know I’m nicknamed ‘Sweeping Star’ and have a fragile constitution, but I’ve worked hard to build strong muscles and put my all into work. Something like that won’t happen to me—I’m not going to die anytime soon.” By this point, Jiang Huan is already half-skeptical about the legend. “Are there other possibilities?... I mean, I’m already so unlucky. Shouldn’t I get some kind of benefit?” “The wafer-thin paper characters you only see in your dreams might come into the real world. But they can’t let you find out about it. Your tin-foil-acrylic-PVC boyfriend might already be trying to seduce you.” “Huh?” The male leads of otome games always love their one-and-only partner. Using an otome game approach to enter the novel, find the male lead waiting to conquer your heart!

title: The Wildest Savior Squad: Elbow-Striking the World Online
summary: [No Romance + Ensemble Cast + Apocalyptic Disasters + Urban Sci-fi Brainstorms] Main Quest: Save the world Hidden Achievement: Elbow-strike the world Team Code of Conduct: As long as our elbows move fast enough, disaster will always be one step behind! People of the world: Thanks to the Daxia Squad for the elbow-strike care package, but we’re sending it right back, no thanks! Borderland Calamities: Could the Daxia Squad try acting more human? Stop dragging us down with you! On the first day after graduating high school, Ye Buyu accepted her fate and went out to find a job. The next day, the company exploded, and the apocalypse progress bar ticked up by one. Ye Buyu: How is that my fault!? The Daxia higher-ups stared at the assembled squad members in deep thought. A bright, cheerful guy on the surface, but secretly a drama-hungry chaos gremlin. A sugar-loving, poison-mouthed tsundere girl who could kill herself with a single comeback. A tech hacker whose claim to fame is sheer misfortune and constant bad luck. And Ye Buyu—cowardly, snarky, only plays top-tier games. Together, this squad lives by one motto: “Worst case scenario? We blow everything up together.” And with that mindset, they’re online elbow-striking the world— Wait, no—saving the world. Definitely saving it.

title: The Earth Master Girl: The Snake Pit of Devil City

These are just ordinary Sand Snakes.” The next second, the ground beneath us gave way, and the entire Program Team plummeted into a pit of snakes.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: President Daddy’s Infinite Pampering
summary: On the night of her coming-of-age ceremony, Nan Zhi is lured into a trap by the people closest to her and falls pregnant. Four years later, she returns with her son. A respected and domineering man suddenly barges into her world. "Speak! Who is the child's father?" An adorable child holding a water gun appears out of nowhere, shouting, "Who is this wild man? How dare he snatch Brother Jie's goddess?!" From then on, two small domineering brats and a manchild are added to her world. In the middle of the night, he sneaks into her room, pressing a heated kiss onto her lips. "Woman, do you know what's the result of stealing my seed?" "What?" "From now on, you have to let me kiss and pamper you everyday." Erm… How was her inability to walk the next day, the result of his pampering?

title: Can’t You Get Divorce?

title: Even If the Stars Perish, You Shall Resound

Formerly a nationally beloved actress, Hoshimiya Miyuki. Her true face is assertive and sometimes a bit deceptive… and she’s a girl who can see the future. Thus began our strange cohabitation, all to prevent my su*cide. In these days that gently painted over the scars of my past, pleasant melodies began to play— But I didn’t know anything. Not the meaning of her relentless pursuit, nor the reason she had to stop, nor even the single prank she hid in the future. This is a bittersweet coming-of-age story of farewell, overcoming the past and future, and a tale of love that continues to resonate through eternity.

title: I Love Small And Cute Senpai, I Want To Make Her Blush Three Times A Day
summary: The head of the broadcasting department, Hanabi-senpai, has a beautiful and crystal-clear water like voice flowing in the forest. The voice, which reminds people of a pretty big sister, captures the hearts of the boys in the school in the daily broadcasts ...... But, as the only member of the broadcasting department, I know. title: Danger! The Beloved Spy Agent Has Been Exposed
summary: The powerful top Alphas were actually defeated by a spy what a massive disgrace! So, when they were reborn, their first thought was to capture that spy and exact a ruthless revenge. They wanted to peel her skin, shave her bones, and devour her flesh and blood just to slightly lessen the hatred in their hearts. But before that, they wanted to see her groveling at their feet... First day of captivity - Chu Wan, covered in blood and barely breathing, wore a smile that was dangerously alluring as she flipped the bird at her captor, utterly provocative. s*umbag No. 1 laughed back in fury: "Do you think I'd be reluctant to kill you?" Chu Wan smiled even more brightly as she was grabbed by the collar, but she thought: 【Might as well die, end it all】I give up Suddenly hearing Chu Wan's utterly lifeless inner thoughts, the man's hand went soft for a second. He then stared intensely at her beautiful face, "Without my permission, you can't end any of this!"
