They turned on each other and began fighting fiercely. After all, who wouldn't want to possess an Omega exclusively? Sentence Summary: Male A, Female O, Top Alphas go mad for love. Message : Everyone is equal in the face of love.

title: The Nineteenth Letter Before the Wedding
summary: On the night of the wedding rehearsal, I found The Nineteenth Letter tucked inside the old wool coat my mother had left behind. She had been dead for three years, yet the paper was as crisp as if it had just been written. There were only three lines on it: Don't marry into the Lu Family. Your father didn't die of an illness. If you still intend to put on that wedding dress tomorrow, go to the third locker by the back wall of the funeral home.

title: Sakurako-san no Ashimoto ni wa Shitai ga Umatteiru
summary: Sakurako Kujō is a genius beauty in her mid-twenties whose life is centered around one thing and one thing only: bones. With little tolerance for others, she would be completely isolated in her study full of skeletons if it weren’t for high school boy Shotaro—her new assistant and constant companion. Why exactly she has taken a shine to him remains a mystery, but one thing is clear: Whenever the two go out together, the chances are high that they will come across a human corpse.

title: Divine Reincarnation
summary: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I Alone Am The Honored One The unparalleled prodigy of the dark faction (邪派), Cheon Mu Shin Gui (天武神鬼) Sa U-Myeong. Was it because of his exceptional talent? Betrayed and eliminated by the Demonic Cult (魔教) and his master, he is reincarnated as Cheon Woo-ha, the eldest son of the Yongmyeong Merchant Guild (容名商街). "This life, I wish to live quietly." title: Tianhai Xiantu

title: High Martial Era: Awakening the Lord of Ten Thousand Weapons at the Start
summary: The fall of nine meteorites caused all living creatures on the Blue Star to mutate, becoming Exotic Beasts. The meteorite impact tore through space, and Exotic Races appearing from the spacetime rifts also began to invade the Blue Star. Humanity lost its dominant status and suffered brutal massacres. All thermal weapons lost their deterrence. Influenced by the meteorites, humans could also begin to cultivate, and powerful martial artists could now contend with the Exotic Beasts. After decades and countless sacrifices of blood and tears, humanity finally received a moment of respite. The young man, Ye Tian, awakened the Supreme-grade Talent, Lord of Ten Thousand Weapons, at his high school graduation ceremony. He then rejected all academy invitations and resolutely enlisted in the military. After entering the army, he met many comrades and grew step-by-step, accumulating military achievements. He gradually matured and awakened through countless trials of life and death. Years later, when the Exotic Beast Emperor launched its final offensive, a figure surrounded by myriad divine weapons appeared before it.

title: There Are Too Many Truck Reincarnations! 〜The Truck Drivers Are Crying〜
summary: Buntarou Sugawara, a truck driver from Hokkaido, was tasked with the job of carrying wood to Kumamoto by his boss. However, this was also a battle with the reincarnation applicants who dreamed of getting transported to another world. They threw themselves onto the truck’s path; if he ran them over, Buntarou would lose his license and job, and it would mean the end of his life too. Still, Buntarou will drive his truck. To protect his livelihood, to protect the company he works for, with his heart and soul, he will drive the truck to Kumamoto!

title: Guide to Failing as a Full-Level Green Tea
summary: Shen Roujia, a completely despicable top-level “green tea,” suddenly found herself inside a book on the very day she secured her inheritance rights. However, karma caught up with her. Not only did she have to start over, but she also didn’t become a stunningly beautiful female lead or a charming second female lead. Instead, she became a short-lived, pitiful memory in the male lead’s past, with only one line left in her story! Determined to return to her original life as soon as possible, Shen Roujia pretended to be pitiful and started her long wait for death. But… was her progress bar stuck? Why wasn’t she dying already?! Moreover, what was wrong with this male lead? Instead of focusing on his career, why was he always hanging around her? Male Lead: “To repay your life-saving grace, I will marry you!” Antagonist: “Woman, you have successfully caught my attention.” Prime Minister: “Jiaojiao, have you forgotten our promise?” Shen Roujia was speechless: “…” “You mediocre people better not hinder my grand plan to return home!!” Until one day, the Crown Prince stood by the lake for the Nth time, holding a su*cide note, his eyes naturally reddening as he looked up. “I don’t want to delay you.” Shen Roujia immediately dropped everything she was doing and rushed over in a panic, “No… if you die, at least give me the divorce papers first!”

title: A Modern Man Reincarnated Into Tang Dynasty And Become A County Magistrate
summary: Fang Yuan transmigrates to the Tang Dynasty and becomes the county magistrate of Wuling County. After five years of governance, Wuling County now boasts cement roads, hotels, clubs, factories, tea houses, and more. The economy thrives, agriculture flourishes... In the second year of Zhenguan, a severe drought strikes the land, followed by a locust plague. Rumors spread among the people that the emperor's loss of virtue caused these calamities. Officials pressure Li Shimin (The Emperor) to issue a public confession of his faults. Helpless and desperate, Li Shimin suddenly got a vision about a wise minister in the south who could solve his crisis. Disguised as a commoner, he embarks on a secret journey southward, eventually arriving in Wuling County...
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance, Slice of Life, Wuxia

A mystery filled with pure love, where tears never stop.

title: The Demon King Has Returned as the Savior
summary: Oppression, discrimination, suffering and an incurable disease. Amidst all those things, a horned demon and a human chased after hope, yet they failed to save the world and finally breathed their last. But even in such a bitter end, hope remained. The Savior’s magic turned the demon’s time back to the past. The time left until she appeared again was three years. In this life, I will make proper use of the time left so that I can survive no matter what. To save the world. The demon works diligently once again today.

title: My Mother is Not a Wicked Stepmother
summary: Synopsis: The soldiers of the Yong Kingdom were valiant and skilled in battle, their iron cavalry wreaking havoc on the surrounding nations. Among these, the conquest of the small border nation of Southern Qi was the most dramatic. Southern Qi's Fourth Prince colluded with the great Yong to commit patricide and usurp the throne. After being emperor for just three days, he was eliminated by Yong. The nation was annexed without a single soldier lost, a painless takeover. Under the System's arrangement, Zhao Tingyan transmigrated to become the empress of Southern Qi. But the Yong Kingdom wanted to discard her now that her purpose was served, ordering the Fourth Prince to kill her. "Did you think your wicked stepmother was some kind of good person? Everything she did was just to make you kill your father and usurp the throne! You don't have a mother, she's just a vicious—" Before the words were finished, the Fourth Prince slit his throat. "You're the one without a mother. Your whole family has no mother." "I never wanted to be the emperor. I just want to be a mama's boy." title: Fantasy World Transmigration
summary: When fantasy becomes reality, will the heaven-blessed youth be able to make his way to the end of the deity’s road? Chen An, who has the ability to transmigrate, found himself in a fantasy world. In the “Never Ending” world, he obtained the wisdom of a superhero. In the “Super Body” world, he glimpsed into the mysteries of godhood. From the world of ‘’Proud Jianghu” onwards, he practiced internal strength, evolving his body. Through the “Calamity of Python Madness”, he obtained the key to longevity. Superhero serum, impasse drug, factor X, spider gene, and the lizard drug. After facing the difficulties and danger to spy on God’s forbidden region, he doesn’t have any regret doing so!

title: I Become A Burdensome Child After Transmigrating

When Xiao Mengwa grew up, she became the vicious female partner in the book. This is not enough. How can she break her father’s uselessness? Don’t you want to find me a stepmother?” “Dad, I’m going to give you an award, so hurry up and think about the words to speak on stage!” With her rescue, Dad has gone from being a black and eighteenth-line star who strayed out of the sky to become a top-tier one-line celebrity, making countless money. As the sole heir, Su Jiu has billions of assets, and life is beautiful, and he can eat and die at ease. but– Wait a minute, for this dark, paranoid, cruel villain in Mao Shu, who does not haunt the heroine but haunts her? The dad, who is a beloved girl, finally realized that a wolf is eyeing the girl, and frightened her to spread all kinds of safety knowledge. Cherish life and stay away from big bosses. The big villain sneered, “Little Jiu, marry me, I will give you everything and my life will be yours. Otherwise, I will block your dad, and let him stand as high as you can, and you will fall badly!” Su Jiu, “……???”

title: Half-Demon Allure
summary: In Shanghai during the Republic of China, Nie’s father was a guard of the former Qing Dynasty. Due to his family’s decline, his daughter Nie Qingcheng became a dancer to support the family. By chance, she met Ming Xia, a rich man and the Chief Superintendent of Shanghai, and the two secretly fell in love with each other, and their love gradually grew. At the same time, many mu*der cases occurred in the concession. During Ming Xia’s investigation, he discovered the whereabouts of the mysterious man Youtong. It turns out that Youtong is not an ordinary human being, he is an existential demon unknown to the world. As Youtong got acquainted with Qingcheng, she gradually understood love. Jiang Xuewu, who returned from studying medicine abroad, was also involved in this love triangle, where love gave birth to hatred. The identity of the protagonist Nie Qingcheng was also revealed by her. It turns out that Qingcheng is a half-demon. What secrets does her identity hide? What will be the fate of four young men and women? In Shanghai, where the old and the new are alternating, the torrent of the times will also sweep across a mystery of their life experience, which will lead to another story of love, hate and hatred from the last century.

title: My Villain Husband
summary: She was once a poor woman who died at the hands of a villain, her husband. Now, having read the story in the novel before being reborn, she knew. She knew that this woman was the real villain, not the husband. She became that wicked woman. Not wishing to die in her husband’s own hands, she becomes the villain. She has only one goal: to change the tragic ending where they both meet their death- an end where they die at each other’s hands. She will make known to everyone the righteousness of her husband and dissolve the misconception that people already have of him. “These are a lot of boxes!” “Ah, yes. I know your birthday has passed, but I wanted to celebrate it today anyway… And all your birthdays so far.” “All of it? All of my birthdays so far?” “Yes.” “Twenty-two! That sounds like a lot of money.” “For you, nothing is a lot of money.” What is she to do with him? She constantly feels warmth from him. She knew she could never find a husband so kind and gentle anywhere. He is so handsome. He seems shy too. His cheeks are slightly red when he smiles at her with his eyelids folded at the corners of his eyes. He is an angel on earth. Mr. Author, why did you make my husband into such a villain?

title: Cultivating Immortals, I Can Extract Experience
summary: Li Chengdan was a lowly servant in the Jindan Immortal Sect, of average talent, and had been stuck at the second level of Qi Refining for many years. After awakening a system, Li Chengdan gained the ability to absorb the cultivation experience of others, and from that moment, his path of cultivation officially began. Immortality, it seemed, was not that difficult—one only needed to stand on the shoulders of giants! Many years later, Li Chengdan looked back at the land, moved by his thoughts and feelings.

title: Curator of the Deep Blue Waves

Hou Wenling, a writer who came from Shaanxi Province in China to punish his older brother, who is a traitor to his family. Choi Yunseol, a curator of Jeju Island who holds a slightly unusual secret. Later, Lu Jianshen proved with practical actions that he liked her and she liked him, and they were in love with each other, and after marriage he spoiled her to the sky!

title: Bridal Academy Dedicated to the Last Hero: The Time-Traveling Mage Forms Bonds with the Next Generation’s Princess and Builds a Harem

title: The Happy Family of Zhang Qinghe

summary: [Job Recruitment Online] aka [JRO] Find and master your own job from over 1,000 jobs! That’s the catchphrase of the game. No one would ever discover her romantic affair with the prince of another race. However, one day, a citizen journalist on the street unexpectedly spotted a breathtakingly handsome, long-haired man in white, holding two human toddlers in his arms. The man, as handsome as a deity, spoke with an indifferent tone: "I'm looking for Su Yanyan." "She abandoned me and the children."
