title: Yan Yan
summary: Su Yan adored Xie Yu for many years and finally got what she wanted, but Xie Yu ran away on the wedding day, making her a laughing stock. At that time, Bai Xingfan appeared in front of her. He held a black umbrella in his skeletal hand to shield her from the heavy rain, and the other hand stretched out in front of her with a gentle and determined voice: "Don't be afraid, still With me." Su Yan was stunned with tears in her eyes for a long time, and finally, she reached out to Bai Xingfan.

title: Love Brain Rescue Diary
summary: After reading a brainless heroine who ab*ses men , Lin Suisui was ready to go to bed. She didn’t want to open her eyes again and find herself traveling back to the book. She also became a cannon fodder female supporting role who was offline after only a few episodes. Lin Suisui: Such a familiar plot of traveling through a book . Tell me, who do you want me to capture? System: Sorry, your task is to change the ending of the hero in the original book and prevent him from falling into a dead end. Lin Sui Sui couldn’t believe it: You mean, you want me to save the love-brained male protagonist who was ab*sed and died under the sword of the female protagonist in the end? In order to return home safely, she began to do her tasks conscientiously, and her eyes followed the male protagonist all the time, fearing that he would die quietly if she was not careful. But the other party seemed to only want to die… Lin Suisui thought he was an ungrateful person, until that day when they both entered the illusion. It is said that what happens in the fantasy world is what I want to do most. The thing a love-brained person wants to do most is…get married? Lin Suisui was so angry that she was speechless. She had been trying to persuade him for a long time, but this man was still only thinking about the heroine. Little did he know that the young man lowered his eyes to look at her profile, wishing he could drown in the illusion. But he still thinks that she is more lovely in reality * Pei Zhiheng didn’t know why, but he would always get closer to someone involuntarily, as if it was an order that he couldn’t disobey. But since she appeared, this strange feeling no longer exists. Small Theater Lin Suisui, wearing a red veil, sits quietly in a room covered with wedding characters. ”Hasn’t he been married once?” The boy leaned over and kissed the back of her hand ”You and I truly love each other, so what’s wrong with doing it again?” Lin Suisui rudely pushed him away: “True love? But why do I remember that His Highness Pei always wanted to kill me before?” The boy immediately changed his expression to one of grievance, but his words were completely different. ”If Sui Sui doesn’t want to, then I’ll have to use the same trick I used last time to keep you by my side, so you can’t go anywhere.”
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Cinderella in the T*ash Can
summary: Next to the study building in the academy lies a small tr*sh heap, which Xia Fu passes by every evening after her night study sessions. On Valentine’s Day, she picked up a bouquet of discarded roses from it. Little did she know, the man who threw away the flowers was nearby. Sitting on an abandoned leather sofa, the man smiled and asked her, “Do you like them?” … The goddess of the Literature Department had tossed away the flowers given to her by Fang Jingcheng. With nothing better to do, he decided to take the starving Cinderella to the restaurant they had previously agreed upon. Xia Fu was already accustomed to being ignored and looked down upon. At this point, if embarrassing herself could make her life a little better, then it was no big deal.

title: My Boyfriend is Super Rich
summary: My Boyfriend gives me two hundred thousand yuan every month. Every day, I "strictly observe the virtues of a woman": I never look at his phone, never ask about his whereabouts. If I happen to bump into him shopping with another girl, I get even more nervous than he does, burying my head and running away as fast as I can, afraid of ruining his good thing. One day, half a year into our relationship, we were casting a movie from his phone onto the TV when a WeChat message suddenly popped up: "I'm pregnant." We exchanged an awkward glance. After a moment's hesitation, I spoke up: "How about... I go take care of my sister during her Postpartum Confinement?"

title: The Kids Have Changed
summary: Nara Lee, an ambitious and diligent 35 year old, has finally achieved her dream: buying a rooftop apartment! Little did she know she wouldn’t have time to enjoy it, as she ends up reincarnated as the 8-year-old Sharon Atrina, a side character in her favorite webnovel, “The Queen’s Extravagant Outing.” As Sharon, a wealthy and beautiful noblewoman, she has everything she could possibly want, but she’s destined to die a pitiful death at the age of 20 after being betrayed by her best friend, Carol — the villainess! Rather than waiting for death, she takes it upon herself to raise Carol — whose terrible personality resulted from bad parenting — into a better person, and save both of their lives to change their future!

title: The Villain Reincarnated Is a Free Man ~I Want to Act While Ignoring the Scenario of the Original Game~
summary: Before I knew it, I found myself reincarnated as the villain of a video game. His name is Ares Soelartaut. Hated by the game’s characters and ridiculed by the players, he is the second son of a Marquis family headed for ruin. But I don’t want that kind of future. I won’t go along with the game’s scenario. I am aware of Ares’ unrivaled potential, so all that’s left is for me to train him to be one of the best. But first, I need to lose weight! The adventurous tale of Fat Ares’ diet begins now.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: Daoist Nun Little Princess Consort
summary: Yun Ran was a young Taoist nun who spent her days growing vegetables, copying scriptures, and drawing talismans. Her life was peaceful and carefree. One day, dozens of carriages with ornate canopies stopped in front of her rundown little temple. Yun Ran thought, 'Wow! Big customers!' She gave the richly dressed woman in the lead a sweet, businesslike smile. "Madam, would you like to buy some talismans? They're very effective for keeping your family safe and protecting your home. Buy three and I'll even throw in a free longevity thread!" The woman’s eyes filled with tears. "My poor child… you’ve suffered so much." *** The lost daughter of the Marquis of Changxin’s household had finally been found! The little girl was as delicate and lovely as carved jade, and her sweet words made her the cherished treasure of the entire Marquis household. At a palace banquet, she even caught the eye of the Empress Dowager, who wanted to make her a daughter-in-law and marry her to Prince Jing. Prince Jing—whose fate was said to be cursed, who had already caused the death of three fiancées? The Marchioness of Changxin rolled her eyes and fainted on the spot. *** When Sima Jing heard his mother had arranged another engagement for him, he refused outright. He never imagined that the little marquis’s daughter would actually live long enough to marry him. On their wedding night, Sima Jing pushed open the door—only to have a talisman slapped right onto his face. A small hand reached up to touch his cheek. The young girl’s bright eyes sparkled as she gave him an awkward but ingratiating smile. "Sorry about that. I forgot to close the window. The wind was strong… let me take it off for you…" Sima Jing: "…?" *** Sima Jing thought the world was rotten to the core. But his little princess told him the world was beautiful. From then on, spring blossoms, autumn moons, summer cicadas, and winter snow—all were shared with her.

title: The Immortal Queen Cannot Escape the Lies and Obsession of the Demon — Not That She Wants To
summary: In the kingdom of Fenizard, where the hero had slain the demon king and peace and prosperity were assured. Ariana, a member of the royal family, was forced to become queen at the tender age of fourteen, only to be killed at her coronation. However, she was revived by the power of Rai, a demon boy who was humanity's natural enemy. To remain queen and obtain an immortal body, Ariana made a contract with Rai. "Please give me a body that will never die! I'll give you anything!" "You said it, right? It'll be too late for regrets." A human girl and a demon boy. Two who should never have crossed paths strive for a 'someday' when they can join hands.

title: The Demon King of the Frontier Life, Reincarnated to Become the Strongest Mage ~The Former Demon King Who Grows Up While Being Loved, Wants to Know Humans~ (WN)
summary: There was a mage called ‘The Lone Demon King’ at the frontier. He was just a creature that never grew old, but he was loved by the villagers as something of a guardian deity. However, he was destroyed by a magic organization that sees his existence as dangerous. 200 years later, he is reincarnated as the second son of an aristocrat and obtains the strongest magic power. “Let’s pretend to be a human this time” However, being a human lover, he didn’t particularly think of revenge and has decided to pretend to be human in this life. In his past life, he was the guardian deity of a region, and in this life, he’s a local aristocrat, but he does not know common sense. He doesn’t know how to take it easy. As the second son of an aristocrat, he is loved by his family and friends, and while he is regarded as a master of magic in the magic guild, he becomes an ‘Immortal Mage’ behind the scenes.

title: The Mad Crown Prince’s Road to Regret
summary: In the eyes of the court, the Third Prince Gu Zhou was a dangerous, vindictive man, unfit for kindness. Yet when Su Qingwan saw him in the Cold Palace, battered and bloodied from a public whipping, compassion overrode her parents’ objections. She nursed him back to health, enduring humiliation and illness for his sake, believing he would one day repay her devotion. Three years later, when the Su family faced ruin, she went to the newly-crowned Crown Prince Gu Zhou with hope in her heart—only to be met with icy hatred. Accusing her of betrayal and already flaunting a new favorite, he nearly strangled her under the withered tree of the Cold Palace, stopping only to banish her forever. Su Qingwan left without a backward glance, determined never to cross paths again. But in the twenty-second year of Yonghe, Gu Zhou rose in rebellion. At the docks, as she prepared to flee, he cornered her—blood-stained sword lifting her chin, eyes cold. “Our debts aren’t settled, Su Qingwan. Where do you think you’re going?”

title: Our Company is Safe
summary: "How do I follow rule number 3 when there isn't one?" "That’s the trick."

title: Human Level
summary: One day, a god suddenly appeared and announced the “Human Level” system to the world. Good deeds would earn points, and bad deeds would reduce them. With this simple system in place, the world began to overflow with acts of “kindness.” However, these “good deeds” weren’t really for others; they were hypocritical acts done solely to save oneself. A young man named Hirano Yuichi looked down on these hypocrites, feeling a deep sense of anger toward the current state of the world. But after meeting a gentle-hearted young girl, his understanding of what it means to be good gradually began to change. What is true goodness? What is hypocrisy? Yuichi tries to find answers to these questions, but…

title: Refusing the Marriage Alliance, I Founded a Dynasty
summary: On the day of my Coming-of-Age Ceremony, the snow was heavy, and he said he wanted to break off the engagement. I asked him if he had thought it through. He did not answer, his gaze shifting to the space behind me. My Concubine Sister's face turned pale under his gaze. And he, his eyes and brows were filled with lingering affection.

title: Love is Sweet
summary: You should believe that there is always a feeling in this world which will make you remember to the end of life even if you should go through the hidden love of eighty-one difficulties. She is a queen in workplace, a tsundere woman in life, a domineering mature woman in appearance and a Transformer in mentality. He is a conqueror in workplace, a man with poisonous words in life, an unruly man in appearance and an invincible superman in mentality. They were “Childhood Friends”. However, she fell in love with another guy. As an unknown secret admirer, he cannot express the pains in heart and dared not show the affection to her. He devised a plan and tried to break them up and get her back. Did his trick succeed? When she knew that he did such a thing, whether she would forgive him? Alienation is sometimes because you are afraid of falling in love with that person uncontrollably rather than hate. She deliberately stayed away, however he pressed on step by step. She was his rib. After so many experiences and struggles, will the love come in time? Love is half sugar and half injury
genres: Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Villainess’ Kindergarten
summary: I possessed a wicked woman who bullied the children of a childcare novel. She eventually had her engagement broken off and was killed, so I tried to keep my wits about me and not get involved with the children. ...But why are they so cute? Duke, I'll agree to break off the engagement, so will you hire me as a tutor?

title: Assassin Landlord & Beauty Tenants
summary: The name Zhao Tie Zhu (lit. Zhao Steel Pillar) sounded pretty unrefined. But, when it came to his nickname, Phantom, it could be said that everyone in the assassin societies around the world know it. Nowadays, the world was too peaceful, and because of that, the assassination business wasn’t going well. Hearing real estate could earn you good money, Zhao Tie Zhu bought a huge villa, and became the legendary landlord. He only rented his villa to single women. Zhao Tie Zhu posted renting advertisements on a well-known social website, and with that, women all came one after the other to his villa. The prettiest in schools, the prettiest in police teams, and all sorts of beauties came into his surroundings. Proclaiming himself as hegemon of campuses, unifying the underworld. All so that the tenants would live in even more content. I am a very responsible landlord — Said the Zhao Tie Zhu who was stepping on countless skeletons of the enemy.
genres: Action, Comedy, Harem, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: Trial of the Heart
summary: Before the age of sixteen, Xiao Ling was the most radiant and beloved Lady of Rongle in the city of Lian’an. Then tragedy struck. Her entire family-the powerful Xiao clan-was annihilated overnight. The Jingkang Army, loyal border defenders, perished under the emperor’s suspicion. She survived by chance, but was left poisoned and broken. With the injustice unresolved, how could her soul rest? Years later, she returns-no longer the gentle noble lady, but a domineering princess sent on a political marriage. Hiding her true identity, she joins forces with her childhood sweetheart, stirring chaos, manipulating hearts, and vowing to clear the name of the Xiao clan and the Jingkang Army. Everyone who betrayed her must pay. If those in power stand in her way, she’ll see them ruined. If anyone dares block her path, she’ll leave no one alive. But just as justice is served and enemies lie dead, she uncovers a terrifying truth-the true mastermind was someone else all along. Even the ones moving the pieces were only pawns in a greater game. They were all players on a board far more dangerous than they knew.

title: The Two Heroes of the Heretic Path
summary: "The family head is quite a foolish man." A servant in the Seol family of Gansu, Ja Woon-yeop, thought this. The foolish family head, manipulated by the new mistress Chu San-mi, contrasts with the upright eldest son, Seol Soo-beom. "The first young master Seol Soo-beom is the most terrifying person I know!" Despite being caught stealing and facing severe scolding and humiliation, Ja Woon-yeop ultimately decides to help Seol Soo-beom thwart Chu San-mi's schemes. "I am the eldest son of the greatest family of Gansu, I cannot just watch this happen." "I will grow stronger than now and deal with them all." Seol Soo-beom resolves to leave and gain strength, seeking revenge against Chu San-mi, and Ja Woon-yeop also decides to leave the Seol family and walk his own path. "In this one life, I refuse to be just an orphan or a servant; I will rise as a superhuman." "Freely and with pride, I will roam this vast world." Ja Woon-yeop, who became a master through training his own martial arts from a mysterious secret manual, begins to get closer to the scheme that loomed over the Seol family of Gansu as he meets various comrades... Then one day, Ja Woon-yeop and Seol Soo-beom meet again. Ja Woon-yeop is surprised by Seol Soo-beom's martial arts. "To think you, the eldest son of an orthodox family, would use such a sword technique!" The very man who condemned him as wicked was now treading a heretic's path, just like himself!
genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: The Duke, Please Just Leave Your Wicked Wife Alone Now
summary: "You're going to keep me company until morning again today, aren't you, my wife?" I reincarnated as the Wicked Wife—so why is the Duke looking at me with such intensely loving eyes?! I got the absolute worst luck: I woke up as Ilze, the novel's notorious wicked wife character. The original Ilze was a shameless pe*vert, utterly obsessed with her own husband, Gilbert, and was constantly throwing herself at him. "If you don't have a reason, don't speak to me." Naturally, Gilbert despised the original Ilze and refused to give her the time of day. Desperate to avoid the horrible fate of being sent to a brothel, the new Ilze decides her goal is a peaceful divorce. She just needs to stay clear of the inevitable heroine and dodge her tragic ending to finally enjoy this new world! But just as she hatches her plan... Gilbert suddenly appears in her bedroom! "That crying face isn't bad." "Just keep pretending you hate it while you're at it." Tormented by his advances and cruel attention, will the ill-fated Ilze ever manage to secure a divorce from the cold, sadistic Duke? This explosive tale is a Romantic Comedy set in another world!

title: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
summary: The story of the Heavenly Demon who wants to live his newly granted life quietly and peacefully.

title: Shadow Rogue
summary: As a promise, he went out into the world as an assassin. 3 years later, after becoming the Supreme Assassin, he gave up on everything he had and returned to the ranks of ordinary people. But one day, Kismet, a mystical game created by the National Research and Development had appeared. Enigmatic hands, spectral frame, and one cunning strike just like the swing of the Grim Reaper. The Supreme Assassin takes on the mystical world, and how his legendary tales sets off, progressively ascending the altar to becoming the best.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Sci-fi

title: Hard to Coax: The Unruly Young Master Is About to Cry
summary: 【Elite Families × Forceful Love × Groveling for Wife × HE】 【Soft Girl × Wild Young Master × 1V1】 The first time Xu Zhiqiao met Zhou Cong was in the Courtyard of her new home. The man was lounging lazily in a rattan chair, legs crossed, drawling, “Such a cute little darling—call me Big Brother, let me hear it.” Glimpsing the gleaming metal cuff on his ear, Xu Zhiqiao instinctively backed away, utterly terrified of this devilish man who stirred up chaos yet seemed capable of controlling everything. That day, in the warmth of winter, she opened her door—and there he was, impossibly handsome, flashing a roguish grin: “I lost my ID. Let me crash here for the night?” She let him stay, and just like that, Xu Zhiqiao had herself a boyfriend. Until one day, hiding behind a row of potted plants, she overheard Zhou Cong’s amused voice: “It was just a fling. Honestly, I’d rather not have met her.” — Everyone knew the Zhou family’s Young Master was raising a delicate flower. He gave her money, power, time—treating her like a rare gem, not letting a single outsider lay eyes on her. Then one day, that delicate flower disappeared. And the Young Master of the Zhou family lost his mind. Later, at a grand banquet, with all eyes watching, Zhou Cong dropped to one knee. He used his sleeve to gently wipe the dirt off the girl’s crystal shoe, his voice trembling as he pleaded, “Come back to me.” The girl coldly turned away, her dainty shoe kicking his hand aside. Zhou Cong grabbed her wrist and pressed it to his chest, his voice hoarse, “If you want payback, shoot me in the heart—just don’t ignore me.” Years later, their child bragged proudly to playmates, “My mommy hunted my daddy down like prey!” Zhou Cong scowled, “Nonsense. It was Daddy pestering Mommy to death that finally won her over.”

title: Above the Seven Towers
summary: Beyond countless towers, seven stand tall. Above these seven, lies the divine realm. Xiao Chen and his university found themselves plunged into a strange new world, only to discover it was a prison for science but a paradise for magic. To survive, he took his first step on the stairs of the Magic Tower

title: The Fastest Sword Under Heaven
summary: The greatest swordsman in the history of the Diancang Sect. The World's Fastest Sword has returned to the Murim!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: I Do Not Want to Inherit the Family Fortune
summary: “No, if you don’t work hard, you will have to go back and inherit trillions of possessions.” Chen Ping, as the heir to the top giants, was very troubled.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Government Sends Wives: Too Many Beauties, I Can’t Handle It
summary: Chu Zhongtian’s soul transmigrates into the Kingdom of Kun, only to find six peerless beauties kneeling at his bedside. A pure little fairy, a stunning peach-like beauty, a sweet and lively maiden, a kawaii cutie… The government is giving out wives for free! Other people are opening blind boxes, but why am I being treated with such special favor? Wait—there’s a conspiracy? Fine then, don’t blame me for being impolite! …With lovely wives and concubines at home, he only wants to earn a little money and enjoy a simple, peaceful, and happy life. But why are things turning out like this… I can’t take it anymore, please let me off!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Killer Couple
summary: I am an assassin. My gentle, kindhearted husband, however, hasn't the slightest clue. After all, he's the type of man who wouldn't dare kill a chicken, and he even needs my help just to open a can of food. That was until I was on a mission at the largest casino in L City and crossed paths with the legendary top-tier assassin, Orbit. The gaze behind his mask was ice-cold, and the Glock in his hand was pointed directly at my forehead. But why was Orbit wearing the wedding ring I gave my husband around his neck?!

title: Emperor of Taikoo
summary: Distinguished the heroes, overlooking the living beings and becoming a generation of emperor. A young man named Lu Feng, who traveled through other worlds and had a mediocre talent, but with the help of the gods and spirits, embarked on a martial art journey, devouring the god soldiers, powerful himself, killing enemies, seeking martial arts, and famed the world. A magnificent and magical world, where people, gods and demons coexist. And look at a generation of arrogance, the rise of abruptness, conquer all realms, based on the magic soldiers, and ask the emperor.
genres: Action, Adventure, Harem, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: I Just Wanted to Live, but I Somehow Became Better Than the Main Character
summary: My name is Ye Yong, and I’m panicking right now. I was just reading a novel and accidentally got hit by my phone and I transmigrated and became a villain. Right now, every day, my thoughts are occupied with how to avoid the male lead and how to make the female protagonists fall for me. I think and plan my actions carefully, and I make every move according to plan. However, the development seems to have gotten off track. The most obvious changes are the female protagonists, who became different than how they were in the novel. They- Crap, I gotta run, talk to you later.

title: More Than Just Summer
summary: That summer, Xia Yu heard from her childhood crush about another girl. He said she was bright and lively, loved sports, and looked especially attractive when surfing. Surfing? Attractive? Then she could learn too. So she plunged into the seaside city, swallowing plenty of seawater and falling plenty of times... but unexpectedly ended up "catching" the legendary top surfing prodigy. Xu Baiyan was the hardest person Xia Yu met in the seaside city. He was distant and cold, carefree but sharp-tongued... yet, he was a surfing expert. She thought their relationship would only be a "pure" master-apprentice one, but later, it turned into something "not so pure." *** The sea breeze blew gently. That night, Xia Yu ran into her childhood crush who had come to the seaside city surfing with his friends. One friend teasingly exclaimed, "I told you she likes you! She followed you all the way here!" Xia Yu clenched the hem of her shirt, embarrassed beyond words. Then, unexpectedly, someone wrapped an arm around her shoulder from behind, speaking lazily, "Like who? Aren't you the one chasing me?"

title: The Munchkin Magic Genius is Laughing
summary: All those people who stole my accomplishments— I was unjustly fired from the magic tower. “You’re just garbage without any ability” At the words of those s*upid people who didn’t know how amazing my abilities were, I removed my abilities that had been applied to the magic tower. [There is a problem with the magic tower’s floating facility.] [The magic tower’s sewage treatment facility has malfunctioned.] [Permanent damage has occurred to the magic tower’s data storage institution.] [The magic tower is gradually collapsing.] . . . As I stopped performing maintenance, various problems began to emerge in the magic tower. But people’s mockery continued. “We don’t need someone like you anyway? We can solve problems of this level easily.” At her confident attitude, I could only laugh. Idiot. That’s something only I can fix.

title: Ultima Online: The Former PK Clan Leader Wishes for a Quiet Retirement Life
summary: There was a game called "Chronos Online." Among the multitude of games created due to the growth of VR, it was one of the few MMORPGs. It offered extensive character customization and a second reality that closely resembled the real world. In that virtual realm existed the infamous PK clan known as the "Crazy Killer Crown." Despite being a small group, they continued to slaughter numerous players. This is the story that begins with their demise. The tale is narrated by a man known as the "Headhunting Clown," a jester who was a leader and performer in this notorious PK clan. It's a fairy tale set in the VR world, offering a glimpse into the revamped Chronos Online... no, Ultima Online, and the actions they take in this new setting.

title: In This Life, I Will No Longer Be a Scumbag to My Childhood Sweetheart
summary: Su Zelin regretted cheating on the girl next door, but luckily an accident made him come back to the eve of the college entrance examination, giving him a chance to make up for his regrets. In this life, I will never cheat on my childhood sweetheart again! What should I do if I can't help but flirt with Qin Shiqing again since I can't change my s*umbag nature? Then stay away from her! Qin Shiqing hasn't fallen in love with me at this time. I'll reveal some college entrance examination questions so that she can get into Peking University or Tsinghua University, and I'll go to Lin'an, and we'll live our own lives from now on! The plan was perfect, but two months later, Su Zelin was stunned when he saw the eye-catching words "Zhejiang University" on his childhood sweetheart's admission letter. "Qin Shiqing, are you a pig? You can't even get into Peking University or Tsinghua University!" The s*umbag's mentality exploded. "Sorry, I guessed the wrong score!" The girl chuckled in the bright sunshine, and her rosy lips raised a playful arc. "..."
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Wizard of Infinite Regression Sees Good
summary: Mana gathered and formed hundreds of lines, hundreds of lines tangled together and became magic. I flicked a line, and the mage coughed up blood and collapsed.

title: Cold-blooded Undercover Master
summary: In the year 2220, a radiation source in the Pacific Ocean, tens of thousands of times stronger than a nuclear bomb has begun mutating exposed creatures into horrific monsters thousands of meters long. Mankind’s only hope was nuclear weapons, which only made matters worse. The combination of the natural radiation and nuclear radiation released an incurable and highly infectious virus, turning the 90% of the world’s population into violent zombies in mere weeks. 40 years later, the survivors of this tragedy invented RoboArmor, finally allowing the remnants of humanity to fight back against the mutants who have taken over the world. When Kong Yuan, a mere garbage collector, stumbles upon a mysterious blue liquid, he becomes a superhuman, with the ability to absorb and generate metal, including weapons! Will his new skills help mankind survive?

title: Otherworldly Sandbox Game
summary: Banished to exile? Unlocked hell mode at the beginning? Luckily he's got OP cheats from the Sandbox game system! Grinding? Farming? Aren't those all basic skills?

title: My Mentor Is a Calamity Witch, So Can I Still Be a Good Person?
summary: Dragons are incredibly powerful—but don’t be afraid if you run into one, because getting eaten won’t kill you. What? How do I know? Lance glances at his pale, skeletal hand and writes as if it’s nothing unusual: Because I’m all bones now! Damn that Adventurers’ Guild—weren’t they saying the upper layers of the dungeon only had low-level monsters? What’s with this legendary dragon nonsense?! I’m such an idiot. Truly. I really am. I transmigrated into this world as the legitimate eldest son of a great noble family, with an absurdly blessed start, and yet somehow still ended up like this…

title: Master, the Metaphysics Expert Running a Stall on the Pedestrian Bridge Is the Madam!
summary: At eighteen, Yan Qiao was brought back home from the Taoist temple by her family. The whole world said that the young lady of the Yan family had been raised to pretend to be mysterious, engaging in trickery and deception like a swindler from the streets. All of Jiang City was waiting for the day she would be exposed, fall from grace, and become a laughingstock. But even after waiting until their necks grew long, not only did they not see her make a fool of herself, powerful figures were instead breaking down the Yan family’s door just to cling to her for support! Every day, there were long queues at the Yan family’s entrance, people holding money in hand! "Master Yan, please save my life!" "Master Yan, please rid me of my bad luck!" Everyone was dumbfounded! Wait a minute—why does that figure look so familiar? Wasn't that Lord Xiao, the infamous "Living King of Hell" from the elite circles of the capital, also standing in line? And... why was he holding flowers and a ring? In front of the Yan family home, Father Yan, Mother Yan, and the three Yan brothers stood side by side, eyes full of hostility as they looked at Li Xiao: "If you want to take away the treasure of our Yan family, you’ll have to get past us first!" Li Xiao gave a devilish smile: "Let’s see if you can stop me."
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural

title: The Return Empress Tames The Hunting Dog
summary: “I just want you to die, Velia.” Her family, country, and even herself were taken away by the one she loved, and she was killed in solitude. The moment I closed my eyes, cursing that I would never forgive him even after death. I went back to the moment when the Emperor courted me. “Marry me.” So, this time, I chose his younger brother, the 2nd Prince . “If you hold my hand, I will restore everything Your Highness lost.” At first it was just a contract. But why... Khalid rested his cheek on Velia's hand. His voice scratched his neck and became sharp. "Don't even think about leaving me, Velia." His blue eyes grew darker and darker with obsession. The second prince who is crazy about me, who is only in a contractual relationship, begins to crave affection. Clearly there was no sincerity in our contract. ...

title: Barbarian’s Dark Fantasy Strategy Guide
summary: Khalid, a barbarian warrior from beyond the Forbidden Mountains, seeks vengeance for the annihilation of his tribe. Driven by a burning rage, he enters the empire, a world foreign to him, where humans live behind fences and value gold above all else. But fate has other plans for Khalid.

title: Hate You, Save You
summary: Zhou Ci and I were also a pair of resentful lovers, exchanging harsh words and blows, finally threatening, "Whoever doesn't get divorced is a dog." On the way to the divorce, we cursed each other with the most venomous words we could muster. But when the oil tanker crashed towards us, he jerked the steering wheel, using his side to take the impact. He let me live 0.01 seconds longer. When I opened my eyes again, I was back in the summer at the end of my second year of high school. Zhou Ciye was holding a bouquet of flowers, asking if I would accept it. The next second, his listless face lifted, full of gloom. The moment our eyes met, I knew he had come back too.

title: Here Lies The Wicked
summary: Missing people… Cars mysteriously falling off the Tongjiang Bridge… The world is going mad and it is up to Fang Zheng to prepare himself for it. What will he get himself into? What horrors will he face? Are YOU ready to join Fang Zheng on his journey to hunt the wicked? Ps. Save this one for a lonely midnight.
genres: Action, Fantasy, Horror, Martial Arts, Mystery, Supernatural

title: Flash Marriage with My Ex-Boyfriend’s Nemesis
summary: Ning Qingqing and Shen Zhiqian have dated for 9 years from high school to university, including 2 years after joining the workforce. Their relationship was stable and they were financially stable. Everything seemed to be a matter of course; however, even after hinting at marriage multiple times, Shen Zhiqian never gave any response. Finally, on Ning Qingqing’s 25th birthday, after giving her last hint to no avail, she resolutely turned around and flash married Shen Zhiqian’s nemesis. On the day of the wedding, Shen Zhiqian attended the ceremony, eyes red. It was also at this moment that he finally realized what he had lost. This is my wedding invitation, it’s the day after tomorrow I arrived in style, just to miss you I chased my wife all the way, yet I’ll never catch her again More often than not, there are only two outcomes during a slow marathon of love – either to get married or to break up. Unfortunately, her’s was the latter, yet she was also very fortunate to have met someone even better ~
genres: Comedy, Drama, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: General Xuanping
summary: In the capital, everyone knows the story of the “power couple” who love as fiercely as they fight. Miss Sang Lan of the Prince Duan’s household has no talent for poetry or embroidery, but carries the air of the martial world, her unmatched archery famous across the city. Young Marquis Wei Anyan of the Zhenyuan Marquisate grew up on the frontier with his father, capturing the northern prince of Mobei and earning great military merit. By all accounts, these two dazzling young talents should admire each other. Instead, after serving in the same court, they cross swords in the hall and trade blows outside it—unyielding and relentless. Sang Lan: “If General Wei insists on opposing me, my arrows show no mercy. Yield early, and you may yet keep your life.” Wei Anyan: “General Sang, my sword has tasted much blood. How do you know the one to fall today won’t be you?” …Yet few know the truth, Wei Anyan’s life belongs to Sang Lan. Behind closed doors, they are secretly husband and wife. Beneath the jingle of tent bells, love and hate tangle into something neither can escape.

title: Reborn as a Villainess, I Spend Every Day Redeeming Myself
summary: She transmigrates into a love-brained girl. The moment she wakes up, she’s caught in a “climbing into someone’s bed” situation. Tang Zhuojun turns around and bolts— Forget climbing into beds! Seriously—her father is the top imperial scholar, her brother is the top imperial scholar, and even her son is a top imperial scholar. With that kind of backing, she can walk all over the place. Why would she need a man? As a divine doctor, she focuses on her career, saving lives and healing the injured. Men, please keep your distance! Prince Jin, wearing a wounded, aggrieved expression: “You said you were going to climb into my bed… I waited for nothing.”
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: A Hundred of Beautiful Lives
summary: Princess Anle's imperial father is a cuckolded king. Her imperial mother is the infamous Su Daji. Princess Anle is an ardent admirer of the imperial consort. Her prince consort, however, is her uncle. "My lord, an envoy from Central Plains has arrived, bearing an imperial edict from the Emperor." Yu Da stood respectfully at a distance of ten feet. After speaking, he lowered his gaze and fell silent. In the early spring breeze, laced with the delicate fragrance of pear blossoms, the only sounds were the chirping of birds and the crisp clack of Go stones landing on the board. A clear stream circled the humble thatched cottage. Beneath a pear tree full of jade-hued blossoms in front of the cottage, an elder and a young man were deeply absorbed in their game of wits. “Settle the envoy first,” Shen Du said calmly after placing his stone with measured grace. Yu Da bowed and withdrew in silence.

title: Senior Sisters, I don’t Want to Work Hard Anymore!
summary: Qin Muling, who was reborn by chance, joined the Yunmeng Heavenly Palace, which was full of beautiful women, and became the closed-door disciple of the supreme leader. He thought he could step onto the pinnacle of life from then on, but little did he know that he would be suppressed by the senior sisters who were both stunning and powerful, to the point where he couldn’t even lift his head. He fought hard for his dignity, but was repeatedly defeated and suppressed by the senior sisters without any mercy. He never had a chance to turn the tables, and in the end, he had no choice but to give up: “Senior sisters, I don’t want to strive anymore!” The senior sisters smiled and threw out a life-or-death question: “Very well, choose one of us!” Qin Muling: “…”

title: Became a Kindergarten teacher at the Demon King’s Castle
summary: Jung Dawoon, once the director of a failed kindergarten, now struggles to pick up the pieces of his shattered dreams. Despite his fierce appearance and intimidating reputation, he remains passionate about nurturing children. However, his imposing looks have driven parents and students away, leaving his kindergarten empty and his spirit broken. Just when Dawoon believes he's reached rock bottom, he encounters a mysterious child with a deer’s head. Compelled by compassion and a lingering sense of duty, he follows the child to a strange, otherworldly place filled with abandoned children—each harboring untapped potential as future demon lords. Determined to prove that he can be a good teacher despite the odds, Dawoon takes on the daunting task of raising and guiding these young candidates into becoming the next generation of Dark Lords. But with children more rebellious than he could ever imagine and supernatural obstacles at every turn, will he manage to transform these misfit students into the rulers of darkness? Or will he end up failing again, this time in an entirely different world?
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: The Secret Contract on the Eighteenth Floor of the Flesh Article
summary: The 18th floor of the Yin Feng Group’s headquarters belongs exclusively to the company’s two most powerful men and their personal assistants. To pay off the crushing debt left behind by her parents, Qu Huan is forced to sign a contract, becoming the forbidden possession of these men.

title: Tattooed Whales
summary: Chi Jian used a total of eight years to finish a tattoo. A story between a tattoo artist and a high school student.

title: The AFK Farming Software: I Became Invincible Without Knowing It
summary: Qi Ming woke up to find that he had transmigrated. He had become a disciple of the Green Cloud Peak, one of the twelve peaks of the Heaven Enlightenment Sect. Fortunately, the "AFK Farming Software" was activated and changed his life. "Ding!" "You had been AFK Farming for seven days in the game dungeon 'Shu Mountain Ancient Path'. You have cleared the game dungeon seven times. You have obtained: 1 Seven Star Sword, 1 Sword Kinesis Technique, 1 Top-Grade Foundation Establishment Pill, and 630 Low-Grade Spirit Stones." ... "Ding!" "The Green Cloud Qi Refinement Art has been cultivated for a day. Your cultivation progress has increased. You will break through to the next level after 10 days of AFK Farming." ... Qi Ming was tired of cultivating. It was too dangerous out there, so he could only cultivate through the AFK Farming Software every day in the sect. Eventually, Qi Ming reached Foundation Establishment, followed by Golden Core, and subsequently Nascent Soul. He... became invincible?

title: Red Bride of the Seventies: The Iron-Willed Officer’s Fortunate Little Wife
summary: [Military Marriage Era + Sweet Everyday Romance + Strong Couple + Space Ability + Multiples + Alternate History] Jiang Ning, a modern-day international mercenary and military doctor, is injured in a car accident during a mission. When she wakes up, she finds her soul has traveled to an alternate world, into the body of a pitiful girl in a remote mountain village—forced by her uncle and aunt to marry a gravely ill, rough man in a “marriage of fortune.” The original girl’s parents had died early, and her greedy relatives, seeing her as a burden, sold her off for a bride price of just thirty yuan and five catties of rice to marry Ji Yanli, the eldest son of the Ji family. Ji Yanli, a battle-hardened soldier, had suffered a head injury from a gunshot and lay unconscious ever since returning from the battlefield. Using her exceptional medical skills, Jiang Ning cures her new husband, and as they live together, affection quietly blooms between them. Ji Yanli: “Jiang Ning, I know…”
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Incense Ash Falls on His Suit
summary: What is the most shameless thing you've ever seen an ex do? The year my mother died, I took over the nearly bankrupt Jianshan Fragrance Studio. It took three years of grueling work before I finally managed to recreate the final fragrance she had left behind. Then he stole the formula. At his brand's new product launch, he had the audacity to promote it as his flagship product. The entire audience waited for me, the owner of a small fragrance workshop, to admit defeat. That was when Zhou Xuchuan walked over, his suit stained with incense ash. "One dollar," he said. "I'll take the case.
genres: Drama, Mystery, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Quick Transmigration: Snatching Golden Fingers
summary: What is a Protagonist? After transmigrating, the wind will blow and the water will rise! After rebirth, begin the slaughter in all four directions! Bring a system to win at life! Carry a dimension to soar above the masses! Enter a red packet group and walk to the peak! … … How could a life without a cheat be called a Protagonist? However—— Behind every successful Protagonist lies innumerable cannon fodder, they are unresigned to be the Protagonist’s stepping stone, they want to be the main characters of their own lives, it doesn't have to be dazzling but it must be a unique and unmatched life. Wen Qing’s job is to complete the wishes of these cannon fodder, settle their obsessions, and allow them to successfully reincarnate. Regarding the reward for completing the missions ——she can snatch the Protagonist’s golden finger.

title: The Story of How I, Who Became the Beloved Child of Winter Fenrir, Was Healed From Despair
summary: I got fired from my company. Despair… I can’t do it…! I collapsed onto the sofa crying from frustration and pity, and somehow I was transported to another world. I don’t understand. But I saw a beautiful white fur in front of me, so I buried myself in it. “Shut up. Be my bed.”… I complained in my sleep, but it was the winter demon wolf Fenrir! ? But it seems he liked me. Why? With his protection, I became a super beautiful silver-haired girl. What is this? He calls me that and spoils me. …I decided to bring a healing winter to this world as a thank you. Such is the story of another world .
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: After Transmigrating as the Villainous Fake Young Miss, My Whole Family Can Read My Mind
summary: [Transmigration into a Novel + System + Mind Reading + Beloved by All + True and Fake Young Miss + Entertainment Industry] [Unconventional Female Lead x Disguised Wastrel Male Lead, Male Lead Has a Sharp Tongue, Annoying at First but Sweet Later] One day, Lu Xiaoxiao unexpectedly transmigrated into a novel, becoming the fake young miss with a tragic ending in a Beloved-by-All Novel. With no way out, she decided to embrace her doomed life, playing the role of the Villainous Female Supporting Character on the surface while internally roasting the entire world. Little did she know, her entire family could hear her inner thoughts. To the innocent and sweet true young miss, Lu Xiaoxiao's inner thoughts were like: ["Darling, you shouldn't be so gentle! I'm this bad—you should slap me dead!"] To her parents in a Commercial Marriage, Lu Xiaoxiao's inner thoughts were like: ["Mom and Dad, when are you going to speak up! Love should be said out loud!"] To her Love-Obsessed, straightforward older brother, Lu Xiaoxiao's inner thoughts were like: ["Bro, that girl is really bad for you. Later, she'll steal your Confidential Documents and bankrupt the Lu Family!"] To her rebellious high school younger brother, Lu Xiaoxiao's inner thoughts were like: ["Go ahead and act out. Anyway, you'll be the first to die off later. You'll behave once you almost lose your life."] The Lu Family: ???!! Gradually, Lu Xiaoxiao noticed the plot was veering further off course. Not only was she not hated by everyone, but she inexplicably became the Beloved by All. On top of that, she was also being pestered by the original novel's second male lead! Later on, the media caught the only son of the Ji Family from the Imperial Capital and the Lu Family's eldest young miss behaving intimately, sparking a frenzy of fans shipping them online. Lu Xiaoxiao: Don't @ me, don't spread rumors! Just ordinary friends, purely platonic! Ji Yunhuai: Indeed, because I'm still chasing her. "Amidst the bustling crowd, only you can unveil my mask."
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: High Energy Ahead
summary: Here, there are the most dangerous missions, and there are the most generous rewards. The next moment could be the end of life, a point of no return into the abyss, or perhaps the ultimate ascent to divinity, standing at the pinnacle of all beings!
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Supernatural

title: My Husband Has Two Faces
summary: Lu Mengnian was the Child Bridegroom for Auspiciousness that Dad bought for me. He was handsome, and since childhood, I loved to cling to him. Relying on my status, I did whatever I pleased to him. Until one day, I suddenly saw countless words floating in the air: [Can this Villainess Female Supporting Character have some dignity and stop pestering the Male Lead! Can't she see the Male Lead is always cold and disgusted whenever he sees her!] [She even humiliates the Male Lead and Female Lead so much! No wonder that after the Male Lead returns to the Capital and regains his identity as the Crown Prince, he can't wait to cut all ties with the Xie Family!] I was slow-witted and couldn't understand. I wanted to ask Lu Mengnian. But I accidentally overheard his conversation with a subordinate: "Does Your Highness wish to reveal your identity to the Xie Family before returning to the Capital?" "No need." Lu Mengnian lowered his eyes, his expression indifferent: "Bestow ten thousand taels of gold, and I will have nothing more to do with the Xie Family." Only then did I realize- Lu Mengnian was the Male Lead. And I was the Villainess Female Supporting Character, the one hated by the Male Lead and destined to have my whole family wiped out.

title: God Blood Warrior
summary: Swallows the blood of a blood beast and uses the blood beast as the blueprint to gain powers, but not limited to powers.
genres: Action, Adventure, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Flash Marriage for Three Years Now with Two Kids the Powerful Military Officer is Madly In Love
summary: [Cold-faced military officer + delicate beauty] (Multi-person transmigration + military family life + marriage before love + raising kids & pregnancy + mutual purity) [Woke up, flash marriage, already have a child.] As soon as she opened her eyes, Jiang Nian found herself inside a 1970s-era novel written by her roommate. She had become a pitiful side character a busty but brainless woman with an adorable daughter included as a bonus. After yet another failed escape attempt and being brought back, standing beside her was her cold, expressionless military officer husband who turned out to be the aloof school heartthrob from the military academy next door in her past life! Dressed in a crisp uniform, broad-shouldered, narrow-waisted, and incredibly handsome, the man held a baby in his arms and said coldly: “Jiang Nian, you’re pregnant. It’s already been two months.” “Divorce is out of the question. Let’s talk about it after the baby is born.” “The little one is hungry.”

title: The Fallen Girlfriend ~ The Aftermath of My Breakup with My Childhood Friend and My Sister ~
summary: Can the Defeated Heroine of a Childhood Friend Make a Comeback? A single moment at a park during twilight changed everything between me and her. What should have been just our problem began to involve those around us, unfolding into a story that starts after the breakup.
genres: Completed, Adult, Drama, Mature, School Life, Tragedy

title: The Return of the Wudang Sect’s Axe Ghost
summary: Hyunseong, the survivor of the fallen Murim—Wudang Ghost Axe He regresses across time to his childhood, back to the days when his senior brothers oppressed and persecuted him.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: The Unexpected Rise Before My Exit from the Entertainment Industry
summary: [Double Female Leads + Lighthearted Funny + Daily Life + Entertainment Industry] On the verge of her debut, she unexpectedly died. When she woke up, she had transmigrated into a first-tier female celebrity! With plenty of scandals and poor public opinion, her career was beyond saving. She thought the original owner was rich, so she might as well enjoy a lifetime of luxury. But it turned out there were only five digits left in her account... Having endured the cruelty of society in her previous life, she hadn't caught a break in this one either. Not wanting to put in effort anymore, she took a laissez-faire approach on shows, never fighting for attention. But unexpectedly, she became hugely popular!? This is purely fictional. No implications or connections are intended. Please do not overanalyze or gossip. Thank you all.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: I Became The Wife Of A Martial Arts Master
summary: Sojin, the youngest daughter of a moderately wealthy family, has a secret. That secret is—she remembers her previous life completely! Because she wasn’t loved in her past life, Sojin now does everything she can to help and repay the warm and caring family she was born into this time. However, her passion often goes overboard, and her family, worried about her, ends up issuing a “No More Effort” order! So, Sojin sets a new goal for herself— to revive her family through marriage! “Please marry me.” “Yes, let’s do it.” “Of course, since we’ve only just met, I thought you’d need time to—wait, what?” “Let’s get married.” Though his family background isn’t impressive, Baek Muwol—known as one of the greatest prodigies of his generation and a strong candidate for the title of “the best under heaven”—proposes to her. To Sojin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! This marriage—she’ll accept it without hesitation! A story of love after marriage! A heartwarming romance between a couple who marry for practical reasons and slowly fall in love for real!

title: Spring Banquet Unveils the Immortality Scheme
summary: At the Spring Banquet, Princess Zhaoyang had a woman's corpse brought before the assembled court and demanded that I dissect the bones on the spot. Everyone said I was mad, but I knew that if my blade did not fall, the girls who had been turned into ingredients for longevity pills would leave this world without even their names behind.

title: My Castle, My Castellan
summary: He was just an ordinary guy who stayed at home and played online games every day. One day, during his nap, he experienced time travel and found himself in an ancient city that was about to shatter. He became a castellan and was served by an old man called Garcia. His city was about to be torn apart by someone called Tucker. With no skills in fighting, no financial resources and thousands of suffering people waiting for him to take the lead…what would be his next move?

title: The Runaway War Hero Is Obsessed Over by His Arch-Nemesis
summary: "‘You’re terrible at this.’ Running away after pinning him down was a mistake."

title: It’s Satan, Not Santa
summary: On Christmas Eve, when making my wish, I accidentally wrote 'Satan' instead of 'Santa.' The next day, a devilishly handsome man with crimson eyes knocked on my door. He lounged lazily against the doorframe, my wishlist pinched between his long, elegant fingers. "What kind of ridiculous wish is this?" "What do you mean by, 'Humble devotee wishes for a life of endless feasts and riches, and just wants a Male Mom who's big in every way. Also, give me a million bucks. Thanks.'"

title: Greatest Swordsmaster’s Game Streaming
summary: A swordsmanship legend with an undefeated record. The player who was once called the best sword in Korea has returned. Now, into a virtual reality where swordsmanship, no longer seen in reality, exists.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: The Sister Of The Heartless Lady Wants To Live
summary: One day, Catherine realized that she was not the 'main character'. The main character here was someone else. It was none other than her older sister on paper, 'Eleanor Valentine'. Catherine's role was simply a villain and a bad younger sister who was dealt with by the heroine who returned indifferently. But the moment she realized that fact was right after she had been terribly tormented! "I'm here, Sister-." No matter how much she struggled to become close . " Haa. Don't block the door and get out of the way." "Huh? Ugh. Sorry... ... ." All she got in return was a cold, indifferent attitude and ignorance! What was the end of a bad villain? 'Death'. The younger sister of the indifferent heroine wanted to live. Very, desperately. 'Sister, can you spare me... ... ?' Will Catherine be able to survive in a world that only exists for Eleanor?

title: Endless
summary: Every year, my husband visits his first love's grave. I have always been very understanding. That is, until three years later, when his first love returned to the country-alive. She clung to him, acting as coy as a kitten. "Don't be mad anymore," she cooed. "I still love you." I remained understanding. Seeing how conflicted my husband looked, I took the initiative. "Let's get a divorce." Instead, he pointed at the clay sculpture on my workbench, which bore a seventy-percent resemblance to him. "Let me stay and keep you company in his place, okay?"

title: Deep Kiss
summary: At the dinner party, He Shuyu’s Haute Couture evening dress was spilled with red wine. The culprit was a part-time student from Jiang University. He had pale cool-toned skin, a red mole at the end of his eye, and a tie tied around his shirt, both cold and desirable. He bent over with his head down and was scolded by the manager, telling him to apologize, but his fingers were taut and straight as he clasped his tray. He Shuyu stroked her ring slowly and thought to herself – young people nowadays are quite stubborn. He Shuyu helped him up by putting her hands on his shoulders, pushing a business card into his suit pocket and whispered into his ear in full view of everyone. “Here’s my contact information.” As she hoped, she saw his lips tighten. He Shuyu smiled lightly and tapped the mole at the end of his eye, whispering, “I’ll wait for you.”

title: Iron-Blood Marine Lady
summary: "Listen up! From now on, I'm going to transform you from a helpless and disgraceful duke's daughter into a ruthless killing machine, ready to mercilessly take down our enemies!" It all started on that summer day. Alicia, the daughter of a duke, had her engagement suddenly broken by the second prince, leaving her in a dire situation that could lead to her family's downfall. During these tough times, Alicia's servant, Abel, suddenly awakens with the memories of being a U.S. Marine Corps member. To change the impending future of destruction, Abel takes Alicia and executes a strategic retreat from their school. He's determined to transform Alicia, who's feeling down, into a full-fledged Marine! "Put your hair in a bun, and add 'sir' at the beginning and end of your sentences!" "What do you mean, sir!?" After going through basic training, Alicia, who still looks like a noble lady, has become a Marine at heart. But now, her transformation leads her down an unexpected path. In her journey, she encounters something she must protect and faces unforeseen challenges, all in pursuit of seizing her own future. What lies ahead for Alicia and the U.S. Marine Corps summoned to this different world? To the otherworld, this is the United States Marine Corps.

title: Forbidden to Love Me
summary: My brother never allowed me to fall in love. One night, I heard soft panting coming from his room. Thinking he was unwell, I hurried over and turned on the light. But what I saw was his face flushed, his eyes swirling with dark emotion as he looked at me. A stack of photos slipped from the corner of his bed. Every single one was of me: Wearing a camisole and short skirt while playing pool with him, in a sultry swimsuit swimming at home, wrapped in an ice-silk robe with one strap slipping off my shoulder, dressed in a high-slit cheongsam, and even in black stockings and high heels... My earlobes burned red with embarrassment as I reached to pick them up. But he stopped me in a hoarse voice, pressing me beneath him: "Little Darling, don't move."
genres: Adult, Drama, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: There Is No Grandma in the Forest
summary: The night Grandma draped the red cloak over my shoulders, there was still unwashed blood tucked beneath her fingernails. She told me to take a cake to the Cabin in the Woods to visit “sick Grandma,” yet I had seen her with my own eyes returning from that very cabin only last night.

title: Momaseteyo Ore no Seigi
summary: Yoh Nigorikawa’s life was positioned at the lowest depth of the society. At the academy he was an attendant of a special-student. At the evil organization Demonia PPO he was an underling who had to do chores every day. He was surrounded by the huge breasts of the dark knights. However, he could only observe them from a distance which left him with a bitter taste. The sudden battle test was a chance for Yoh to grope the breast he had been dreaming about all this time! The success story of Yoh where he would grasp hold of the glories and the breasts had now begun…
genres: Action, Adult, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery

title: Self-Awareness
summary: I took a flight to visit my long-distance boyfriend, but the plane hit severe turbulence along the way. I was a total mess, throwing up everywhere. I had even written out my final will. After landing safely, I recounted the whole ordeal to my boyfriend, gesturing wildly with lingering excitement. He listened for a moment before asking calmly, "Are you finished?" "If you're done, I'm going to go read some research papers." The words "Let's get married as soon as possible" died in my throat. Later, he frowned and asked me, "Why are we breaking up? Just because I didn't stay to chat with you?" I replied, "That's right. Actually, I should thank you." "If I hadn't left you, I never would have known..." "That some people will take every single word I say and carve it into their heart."

title: The Villain Quits
summary: My brother and I are the villainous siblings in a novel. To save us from our fate as cannon fodder, my brother constantly provokes the male lead, while I scramble behind him, desperately trying to smooth things over. When my brother snatched the rank of first in the grade away from the male lead, I apologized like a coward. "I'm so sorry, really! My brother actually cheated. I'll give him a good talking-to when I get home." When my brother took the love letter the female lead had sent, I blubbered with tears and snot running down my face. "My brother is illiterate! He thought it was a challenge to a fight. Oh gosh, look at the mess he's made!" And when my brother decided to throw a sack over the male lead's head and beat him up for no reason at all, the world went dark before my eyes. I gritted my teeth and blurted out: "Um, it's because... because my brother found out that I like you, so he..." The habitually cold male lead suddenly lifted his eyelids and shot a glance my way. "Really?"
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: I Really Want To Go Against The Sky
summary: You boiled two eggs, culinary skills +1. You chewed a mouthful of cereal, your jaw is strengthened. You are riding a bicycle, driving ability +1. You gazed at the beauty, your mood is very pleasant, your kidney function has been strengthened, appraisal ability +1. You see elderly women dancing in the public square, you can’t help but want to swing to their rhythm, dance skills +1. You glanced at the newspaper, your reading ability is strengthened, knowledge experience +1. You sneezed, your disease resistance has improved. You took cold medicine, toxin resistance is improved, medicine proficiency +1. You observe a nurse use an injection, your basic medical skills are strengthened, medical skills +1. …… I don’t know what’s going on, my strength is improving even if I’m drinking cold water. I don’t want to stop, but I’m so worried…

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Trials: Starting with a Full Cyber Dragon Deck
summary: One misstep—and Kai found himself transported to a world where Dueling reigns supreme. In this world, bizarre card-based Trials appear! Conquering these Trials earns rare and powerful cards. Armed with the Deck he brought through transmigration and his deep knowledge of Dueling, Kai cleared Trial after Trial, claiming each unique card for himself. Clearing the Blue-Eyes Trial, he obtained \[Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon] and the complete Blue-Eyes family pack! Clearing the Red-Eyes Trial, he received the entire Red-Eyes lineup plus \[Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon] ! Clearing the Stardust Dragon Trial, he earned Shooting Star, Cosmic Blazar, and a full set of Junk cards! Someone once asked Kai, "Are there any Trials even you find difficult?" "If it’s Tearlaments," he said, "then maybe a little." "Would you lose, then?" Kai looked at the Deck in his hand—a full Maliss-Tearlaments deck and answered with confidence, "I’d win, of course."

title: The Villain Writes a Diary, and the Heroine Is Completely Broken
summary: Lu Yun transmigrated into a cultivation novel as the villain. By writing in a diary, he grows stronger. Originally, he thought if he quickly finished the plot, he could return home and live as an ancestor. But how did the plot go off the rails from the very beginning? The master locked him in her bedchamber, forbidding him to leave for less than three days? The second senior sister, who was supposed to poison him, only gave him spiritual pills to eat? The fourth senior sister, who was supposed to stab him to death, offered to temper his body instead? Master: "You dare to say I'm some brainless member of a harem? Fine, I'll be your brainless harem member!" First Senior Sister: "Didn't you say this thing I'm wearing called 'high heels' is super exciting?" Third Senior Sister: "Junior brother, don’t be afraid! I’ve learned a new move for you! It's called the 'Ah Wei 18-Style,' or something like that?" Fifth Senior Sister: "It’s fine if it’s anyone else! But why did you say Seventh Junior Sister is more exciting than me? Where do I fall short? Say it to my face!" Master, wait a minute! Hey! Senior sisters, you all wait too! No! Wait! I'm the villain! Stick to the plot! I... mmm...

However, by the time he became strong, he had lost everything he wished to protect. His one and only life was spent entirely on the pursuit of power. But then, Chrom made a decision. He would use time magic, and rewrite his life. And thus, he went back to a time in his life when he was known as a failure, with his powers intact. All to defeat the enemies he was unable to beat, and save the people he once lost. The fated deaths of his childhood friends, the attacks of powerful monsters, enemy conspiracies... He would have to settle everything from the shadows using his knowledge of the future. While being lauded by the townspeople as a mysterious hero, Chrom enjoyed his opportunity to live his life again, with the people he saved.

Meanwhile, I became despised by everyone, forever banished to the cold palace, never allowed to step beyond the palace gates for the rest of my life. It was only after my death that I realized she came from another world, with the sole purpose of capturing. The more miserable I became, the luckier she grew. In this new life, I exchanged a lifetime of love for a single wish. The Bodhisattva asked me, "What do you want?" In a soft voice, I replied, "I want everyone she captures to know that she came to capture them." And so, they all heard the notification sound of her system.

Five years later, I was living a surprisingly happy life with the twins when my husband returned. title: Preserved
summary: *The shamanism, characters, and organizations in this story are fictional and have no relation to reality. “I, Lee Myo-jin, was born to be the family’s curse-bearer for Congressman Tae Jung-hwan’s family.” Tae Jung-hwan, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport, brought a curse upon himself by digging up a family’s ancestral burial ground. She tells them that if they take a girl born five years later and use her as a “curse-bearer,” a president will finally rise from this family. Twenty-three years later, Myo-jin lives trapped in Sayundang—Shaman Yu-jeong’s house—serving as Yu-gang’s spiritual shield. Her entire existence is devoted to protecting him during the four nights each year he stays at the house. One day, Myo-jin leaves Sayundang on the Shaman’s orders and encounters a man at a hunting ground who reminds her of a tiger. He points a gun at her head, but eventually lets her go. He is the very person she has been waiting for: Yu-gang. “Caught you.” Her beautiful hell had finally begun. *** The Shaman was wrong. She isn’t cold water that cools down the burning sun. She is a vast ocean. A deep, cold sea that makes your throat burn the more you drink from it. His dark eyelashes flickered as they slowly covered his eyes. He pressed down on her neck as she gasped for air. “Whether you like it or not, I’m getting you out of this hell.” His knuckles trembled as he gripped her throat, tight enough to break it. His bloodshot eyes, filled with thirst, traced her closed eyelids. “Just wait and see what kind of world I’ll put in your hands.” To Yu-gang, she was a wicked fate—one he wanted to keep by his side, even if he had to preserve her like a trophy.

title: From Chubby Wife to Fiery Beauty: Rough Husband Spoils Her Endlessly!
summary: “[Era + Military Marriage + Marriage Before Love + Sweet Romance + Empowering Transformation + 1970s] ” Due to an unexpected accident, Ruan Suhe’s soul transmigrates into the 1970s. She finds herself in the body of a nearly 200-pound married woman—who also happens to be the most notorious mother in the village for mistreating her own children. She beats and scolds her two little ones whenever she’s in a bad mood, earning the disdain of everyone around her. Ruan Suhe, however, isn’t fazed. A minor challenge! All she needs to do is win over the husband she “got for free” and take care of the two little kids—she’s got a hundred strategies ready to go! They say she ab*ses her children? She sets up a stall, earns money, grows fruits and vegetables, raises livestock, and experiments with recipes—fattening up her little ones with all kinds of delicious food! They say she’s uneducated and not smart? She takes the college entrance exam, builds a factory, and dominates both academia and business—outpacing everyone without breaking a sweat! They say her husband has no future? Well, her rugged military man reveals his true identity—one that even the elites of the capital have to respect! Onlookers warn, “Lu Zhengxiang, you spoil your wife too much. One day, she might not even want you anymore and run off with someone else!” Lu Zhengxiang replies calmly, “If she doesn’t want me, then that’s on me. I’ll do everything to make sure she does—this life, the next life, and every life after that. She’s mine, forever!”

As she sets sail, she gets captured by notorious pirate Qin Shang Cheng and finds herself becoming a bride against her will. After much trouble, Hua Rong successfully escapes the island. Meanwhile, she crosses paths with the young prince Jin Yiwen who falls for her at first sight. However, Qin Shang Cheng who has also fallen for her starts on a journey to chase after his wife.

Secretly, Bunta calls her the "Saint," and her graceful presence soothes his heart. However, the one who starts talking to him isn't the Saint, but a gal who looks the complete opposite!? The gal who introduces herself as "Urakawa" is supposedly the Saint's best friend—or so she says, but in reality, she's Yui herself in disguise! Completely unaware of this, Bunta is given "100% accurate advice" directly from the person herself, all while being playfully teased. Will this advice help Bunta get closer to the Saint? "Hehe, listen to my (the back's) advice and make sure you properly conquer me (the front), okay?" A romantic comedy where Bunta is tossed around by two personas of the same girl, each with a completely different personality!

These little sparks of anger have finally become an uncontrollable fury for Xu Yi, compelling him to seek revenge. In this immortal world, where power is everything, our protagonist will have no one to count on but himself! Will he overcome all the hardships in front of him, or will this turn out to be an impossible challenge? Follow the tale of Xu Yi, as he overcomes the misfortune that his family is caught up in, and fights his way up to become a legendary warrior.

title: I Got Too Strong Just From Cooking

Items from Earth can’t be taken into the Field, and monster meat tastes so awful it makes people gag—leaving most hunters deeply dissatisfied with their food. Meanwhile, an ordinary man named Lee Seojin has no interest in the Field whatsoever. He only wants to pursue the path of cooking. But after being scammed, he ends up buried in debt, and an injury to his right hand pushes his dream even further out of reach. Then one day, he awakens—and gains a unique skill: “Hand Taste” Everything his hands touch becomes delicious. Even monster meat.

title: The Azure Longsword

Seventeen-year-old Princess Theodora ascends to the throne, inheriting a realm teetering on the brink of collapse. Rome is about to fall. ... The gears of fate spin wildly as a transmigrator materializes on the rain-slicked streets of Constantinople. "According to the original plot, Constantinople is doomed to fall," he muses. title: After Raising The Daughter Of My Sworn Enemy

Amidst the fierce literary-military debate that had thrown the court into chaos, both the Prime Minister's Mansion and the General's Mansion welcomed back their long-lost eldest daughters. The Prime Minister's Mansion was ablaze with celebration, hosting lavish banquets for three days straight. To outdo them, the General's Mansion held theirs for five days. The usually stern Prime Minister Wen boasted to everyone about his daughter, a capital-renowned scholar, beautiful and intelligent, possessing both grace and intellect! The next day, the General's Mansion announced their eldest daughter possessed extraordinary strength, a remarkable physique, and could single-handedly defeat a hundred foes... It wasn't until both families had each found a distinguished son-in-law that they realized, they had exchanged the daughters! After retrieving their daughter. The Prime Minister, unable to catch his breath, fell ill for three days, bedridden. Three days later, the Prime Minister slowly regained consciousness. His eyes opened to behold the Young Marquis of Ningyuan, triumphant from battle. Crowned with crimson plumes and spear in hand, he stood as imposing as a war god, then casually thrust his spear through the cherished sandalwood floorboards! "Father-in-law, your son-in-law is late!" "I..." The Prime Minister's eyes rolled back, and he fainted once more.

summary: Xu Wuyou is the legitimate daughter of the Duke's Mansion. She grew up in the countryside since she was a child. After entering the Royal Academy, she offended several young men of the royal family one after another. When she reached the age of marriage, the beautiful girl grew up to be a stunning beauty. Seeing her best friends marrying up, Xu Wuyou's marriage was still uncertain! Her former enemies were so powerful that they almost controlled half of the country. The girl hesitated, and the man lost his patience and took the initiative to cover her lips. But Xu Wuyou was ignorant and pushed the man away to the limit, staring at him with wet eyes. The man taunted: "Xu Wuyou, if you can't even stand this, why should I save you?"

title: The Shape of Happiness: A Family Crumbling Due to the Mother’s Infidelity, a Wounded Middle School Daughter, and a Struggling Father Finding a New Form of Happiness
summary: In a quiet suburban town, a family that once seemed perfect is falling apart. The mother’s secret affair shakes the foundation of their home, leaving everyone hurt and confused. The middle school daughter, burdened by her own struggles, feels the weight of her mother’s betrayal. The father, heartbroken yet determined, tries to pick up the pieces. As their world crumbles, each of them searches for meaning, hope, and a new way to move forward. Amid the pain, they slowly begin to discover that happiness can take on a different shape—a form they never expected.

title: Bukhansan Iron Wall
summary: Martial arts and inner energy—both are absolutely indispensable. Martial arts without inner energy are nothing more than a dance, and inner energy alone can achieve nothing. Over hundreds of years, it became common sense in the martial world that without both martial arts and inner power, one can never become a supreme master. But the protagonist shatters this fixed belief of the Murim world and stubbornly walks his own path. No matter who blocks his way, through fierce determination and the close-combat techniques he has learned, he finds his opponent’s weaknesses, exploits them, and overturns battles. Other than surviving, there’s not much she can do. One by one, they began to subjugate rival factions, gradually constructing a vast nation in what was once an inhospitable territory. title: Going Back to the Modern Times and Live Broadcasting My Daily Life to the Ancients!!

title: Soul-Whip 5: The Daughter’s Sedan Chair
summary: At midnight, I woke up in a strange place. Someone knocked on my truck window and said they were holding a celebration tonight, and asked me to join them. Still groggy, I got out of the truck. The village before me was decked out in lanterns and colored streamers. "Is it a wedding?" I asked the villager. The villager didn't answer. Instead, a hazy thought came to me: I seemed to have come here to escort the bride. I turned back to look at the heavy truck I'd driven here. It was empty. But why did I remember it being packed full of things when I arrived? What had I been carrying? For a moment, I couldn't recall. When I turned back again, the villager who had come to call me was gone.

title: I Want to be Your Tears
summary: This was a story that began and ended with tears. Yakumo Saegusa, a boy who lost his mother to a strange disease, the “Chloride Blight,” in which the whole body slowly turns into salt and crumbles, met a girl in the music room. She was a beautiful and gifted piano player named Yuzuki Igarashi. Her delicate fingers were capable of both piano and wring bullies. She struggled to live up to her mother’s excessive expectations in the dark while presenting a strong front. Yakumo, who had seen Yuzuki in all her various forms from a distance closer than anyone else, was unknowingly drawn to her. Graduating from elementary school, Yuzuki grew more beautiful and charming, and by then, became the object of people’s love and admiration. By the time she entered high school, Yuzuki, already a professional pianist, left for Italy to learn her craft.
