A confession from the infamous sorceress senpai. A confession cursed, demanding the precondition of marrying into her clan. There was no way a high school boy could dedicate his life to such a fate. Summoning all his courage, he rejected the maiden’s confession. With an almost resigned tone, the senpai asked: “Do you want to be popular?” “Huh? Well, yeah, I guess…” “Got it.” As you might have guessed, she cursed me with popularity. Thanks to that, my shallow wish to be popular came true. But because of it, my sincere wish to be popular with normal women was utterly crushed. Life isn’t so sweet. You’d be hard-pressed to find something this bitter.
genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Love You as Much as You Do
summary: 1. A friend asked Chen Yao, “When did you like Jinxiu?” Chen Yao looked at Jinxiu’s back and smiled knowingly, “Because of a bowl of dumplings.” The friend suddenly realized, “It turns out that you found a potential wife!” Chen Yao lowered his head, his dark eyes warmed a bit. Because in his hunger and despair, Jinxiu brought him a ray of sunshine, warm and full of energy. 2. Jinxiu’s best friend asked her, “When did you like Chen Yao?” Jinxiu smiled slightly, revealing the deep dimples at the corners of her mouth, “Because when everyone is standing opposite me, only he puts me behind him.” Jinxiu would never forget the man holding a shovel in front of her while glaring at everyone, he guarded her behind him and said to her gently, “Don’t be afraid, I am here.”

title: Age of Empires From Scratch
summary: David became a pioneer in the Tiran Kingdom and acquired his own territory, becoming a village chief under the kingdom’s rule. Although his land was located in a somewhat remote and harsh environment where crops were difficult to grow, and the village was only inhabited by him, David believed these difficulties could be overcome. David declared, “My territory is open to all realms and dimensions. I won’t go looking for you; you come to me!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: The Noble Girl Is Beautiful
summary: Shen Yourong, as the eldest daughter of the Duke’s household, engraved the word “propriety” into her bones. Her words and actions never faltered. She neither harbored secret affections at a young age, nor engaged in the childhood antics of love-hate relationships. Moreover, she never encountered any strange encounters while traveling, smoothly embodying the epitome of a noblewoman. The only hiccup in her otherwise flawless life was her marriage, which didn’t go smoothly. Despite discussing marriage with her nephew, she ended up marrying her uncle, which was quite embarrassing. The Emperor, advancing in age, favored the fourth prince, Ji Chengyao, for the heir position. The fourth prince’s foster mother, Lady Shu Fei, hinted at a marriage alliance between Shen Yourong’s maternal family, the Duke of Qi’s household, and the fourth prince. Both overtly and covertly, they suggested that Shen Yourong should befriend the fourth prince. Ji Zhuo always felt that Shen Yourong, this so-called model noblewoman, was not as genuine as she appeared. A noblewoman who seemed diligent and earnest shouldn’t be casually snacking on melon seeds while watching the fourth prince flirt with other girls, as her family tried to curry favor with him.
genres: Completed, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Now, Everyone Will Say Their Goodbyes
summary: I asked the doctor. "How much time do I have left? The time given to me." "...About three months. But since there is still a good chance, you should consider having the surgery..." I gave a hollow laugh at the word "chance." Chance always holds people back. Everyone either despairs or holds onto hope with that word. It's the kind of hope that prays to be alive, no matter what. However, that small chance, wrapped in a pleasant-sounding hope, was just empty comfort to me. "That's enough. How should I put it... I'm tired." With that, I decide to cut ties and leave.

title: A Chan
summary: Zhang Jingchan, from a once-wealthy family, is a handsome, single, and rising star in the city's business world. His father went bankrupt years ago, owing 1 billion yuan, and he insists on taking on that debt, a situation that has trapped him like a dragon in a quagmire. One day, Li Weiyi, a heartbroken and unemployed office worker, wakes up to find herself transformed into Zhang Jingchan, who was a wealthy young master eight years ago. Zhang Jingchan: "If you can help me get this 1 billion yuan back, I'm willing..." Li Weiyi looked at his face and figure and swallowed hard. Zhang Jingchan: "I'll give you 100 million." Li Weiyi: "!!!!" ———— At first, I thought that time travel was just like any other, a fleeting moment. Later I learned that he had waited for a full eight years. Time loop + gender swapping.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: Monster Eater
summary: E-rank adventurer Lude was born with a unique skill. However, it was a questionable ability called [Nullify Status Abnormality]. To overcome his current situation, he dives into a new labyrinth but encounters a B-rank Minotaur. Abandoned by his teammates, he falls into the abyss. He was injured, his supplies were depleted, and the only thing he could eat was the Minotaur in front of him. However, in this world, eating monsters was taboo, and eating them causes physical abnormalities, eventually turning the perpetrator into a monster. While there was a large risk, Lude believed in his unique skill and ate the monster to survive. Then, Lude’s unique skill was activated, and the monsterification was effectively nullified. He was even able to acquire monster skills. Lude, who understood the true use of [Nullify Status Abnormality], earned skills by earnestly consuming monsters. This is the upstart adventure story of Lude, who dreams of becoming an S-rank adventurer.

title: Director Zhou Won’t Work Overtime Tonight
summary: A long-planned scheme / Age gap / Pure love / High-ranking official / Dual civil servants *Gentle and obedient younger sister vs. authoritative and paternal husband with bureaucratic charm *Culture and Tourism Bureau guide & Beijing elite with impeccable political background / Director within the system At 21, Shi Ye graduated from university. Without grand ambitions, she only wished for an ordinary, stable life. But a marriage contract with Zhou Junheng—given his position—shattered her hope of remaining an ordinary, unnoticed figure. "Director Zhou, do you consent to this marriage arrangement? If not—" "I do." He gave her a promise: "As my wife, I will protect you and ensure you receive dignity and respect." — After marriage, he kept his word. Providing her with unwavering stability; Offering her the most attentive care and guidance; And even more… Pinning her against his desk, kissing her breathless. "Shi Ye, I love you. Could you love me a little more?" He also said, "Our marriage is based solely on love, nothing else." — When she first joined the bureau, a colleague tried to set her up. She mentioned she was already married. The colleague was shocked—during the background check, she had been single. Was civil service now embracing whirlwind marriages? Later, at the office, she rarely spoke of her husband, sparking curiosity. When asked about his job, she didn’t want to deal with the prying. "He’s also in the system. His work keeps him busy, so he can’t pick me up." Everyone assumed it was a half-truth, an excuse to hide an unimpressive spouse. Then, when a colleague asked her to pull strings for a small favor, she replied, "His position can’t handle this." Only later did they realize how wrong they were. So this was what she meant by "also in the system"—including the position of Director.

title: Little Dog Friend
summary: My boyfriend is a total hopeless romantic. The most extreme thing he's ever done to me was cry a little too loudly. That was until one day, when bullet comments suddenly started flickering in midair. Only then did I discover the depraved thoughts he was hiding behind my back. Later, I followed him and saw the cage he had prepared for me. I was furious. "You should have said something sooner! Then I wouldn't have bothered going to work." "When exactly were you planning on locking me away?" "Are there snacks at home? I'm planning on moving in tonight."

title: Heart of Empire
summary: The curtains to an epic of a continental power struggle are pulled open. There’s an entire empire in Dane’s heart! Churches, tribes, prisons, forests, castles, graveyards, abysses . . . He controls the bases of all seven races in the fantasy epic war game, [Heart of Dynasty]; right before his eyes is the throne of a monarch! Elf rangers pull your bows, the heavy-armoured knights are charging! The Caesar Empire has collapsed. An era of war for the new ruler arises. The Kingdom sends endless expeditions; the Northern Alliance is unwilling to be excluded; the abyss and death begin to stir as they gaze upon the continent. Plots, tricks, religious wars. . . amidst these battles, only the victor can be called powerful! Dane, holding a blade dripping with blood, says with bared teeth, “f*ck! Let me use my ass to see whether that seat at the top is comfortable or not!”

title: My Childhood Sweetheart Gradually Puffed Up
summary: Before his reincarnation, Wen Yu always thought that his childhood sweetheart, Fu Chengque, was like the snow on the high mountain, unattainable. But later, he realized that she was not ice and snow at all. She was clearly a penguin standing on ice. With one slip of her foot, she tumbled down the mountain… —————— Next door. Fu Chengque looked at her golden finger and felt extremely puffed up! She wrote hastily: “I, the future empress, the superhuman, the destined deity Fu Chengque, am recruiting talents! Help friends regardless of reason, sign up quickly!” But her tasks were not only related to her childhood sweetheart Wen Yu, but each one was super difficult! 【Make Wen Yu say “But I like it.”】 【Have a candlelight dinner with Wen Yu.】 【Whisper to Wen Yu for ten minutes.】 … She’s just a girl, not a lover. How could she possibly complete them! What’s absurd is that, although things didn’t go as expected, she still completed them all! [Highly recommended for people who enjoy both male protagonists and/or female protagonists]
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Sniping
summary: [This isn’t a place you can just walk into.] […] The rooftop of a building about to be remodeled. Kwon Hyunse came to a halt when he spotted someone he hadn’t seen before, hidden by the structure near the edge. Someone leaning over the railing, looking at something. A small frame. A woman? [Your laces came undone. You should tie them properly when running.] Facing a small face filled with confusion and panic, Kwon Hyunse tucked the cigarette between his lips and stood in front of her, blocking her path. “…Are you going to report me?” “Kitty, is that what you were worried about?” As her eyes blinked blankly like an overloaded computer, Kwon Hyunse called to her in a low voice, as if trying to bring her back to her senses. “Kitty, I’m not the police, so I’m not here to arrest you. I need you.” “…W-what do you mean?” Watching her face change from moment to moment, the corner of Kwon Hyunse’s lips tilted into a crooked smile. “I need a sniper.” “There are plenty of snipers out there.” “Not just any sniper. The best sniper. Like you, Kitty.”

title: Misunderstood Lousy Cop: Getting Promoted for Running Criminals Over
summary: Shiraki Touya is a 29-year-old cop. He’s a total klutz that runs people over and accidentally shoots someone every few months. Luckily, everyone he has injured turned out to be merciless criminals! So, thanks to his intelligent looks coupled with his white hair and glasses, he began to be revered as ‘The White Enforcer’. You can’t hear it, but today, just like every other day, he’s screaming inside, saying, “Please don’t respect someone like me!!”

title: Don’t Tame the Tomboy
summary: “I’d rather not marry than lower my eyes!” Katya, the notorious villainess from the southern region, declares her opposition to marriage! The Duke sets up an intense showdown with his daughter, who rejects every suitor that comes her way. Caught in a crisis of being forced into marriage with the scoundrel Petrozsky, Katya decides to make her escape. During her escape, she ends up spending an unexpected night with a man she encounters… He turns out to be the tyrant Grand Duke Nikolai de Vasily. “At the moment you stood in my way, I couldn’t breathe.” “Well, then why don’t you visit the asylum, sir?” “For someone like me, a madman, you need to be at least as crazy to control me.” “Are you looking for… a bride or a caretaker?” “With you, I think both are possible.” In her attempt to avoid one madman, she becomes entangled with an even crazier one! Is this a choice based on reality? “If I ask for a divorce, you’ll kill me.” “What do I have to gain by doing that?” “I don’t know… A sense of conquest?” “I’d like you to conquer me a little.” “Obedient wife, doting mother, that sort of thing, I’ve had enough of that in this life.” “I like you just the way you are. Does that answer your question?” Don’t tame the tomboy. She’s pretty enough the way she is.

title: Soft and Delicate Girl from the ’80s Marries a Military Officer
summary: Lin Yiqing grew up in an orphanage. After finally graduating from college and landing an internship, she never expected her life to end so suddenly—an unforeseen death cut everything short. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself in the body of a poor, timid orphan girl in the 1980s. As if that weren’t enough, she even carried an arranged marriage contract on her shoulders…

title: His Xiao Qingmei is Super Fierce
summary: "Young Master, Miss Yi has arrived." "Unleash the dogs," Tan Mobai said nonchalantly. "Bastard, do you want to fight again?" Yi Qianqian rolled up her sleeves, looking aggressive. "One-on-one." Childhood sweethearts, innocently inseparable, yet they couldn't stand each other but were engaged. One day, Yi Qianqian woke up and found herself in a certain man's embrace, crying, "Shameless!" Tan Mobai lazily opened his eyes, "Last night, you were drunk, mm... you should take responsibility for me."

title: This is How I Became a Chaebol
summary: I regressed to the era of romance. It was a time also known as the age of success, the age of ambition. I would seize control of everything from textiles, petroleum, machinery, shipbuilding, to automobiles. I would become not just a chaebol, but a legend...
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Slice of Life

title: On the Day When the Tagger Goes Blind
The God of Baseball Who Makes the Losing Team Win
summary: Yang Min-soo, a major leaguer considered the greatest Korean catcher of all time, was unable to win the championship alone. Frustrated, the god of baseball appeared before him. He accepted an old baseball and a system window appeared... [Quest: The Path to Becoming a Baseball God] [Will you accept? Y/N] Yang Min-soo became a manager with the system. The story of leading a failing team to victory begins!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Sports

title: The Unique Legend 2 – Ancient Night
summary: If the heart speaks, its words must be a curse. After Senior is away for 11 months, Yangyang becomes a year 2 student. In one of the Guild’s missions, he encountered a legendary magic beast, Yangyang initially thought the magic beast was pure and innocent, but it not only turns out otherwise, But has also even conveniently integrated into his life… The medical base has been attacked, forcing the deep-sleeping Senior to be immediately sent home. And yet, the emergency escort team formed is claimed to be the worst! Comprising the purple robe and black robe who are perpetually on cold war, the Unicorn full of smutty interests, and Devil Master and Assassin who are widely frowned upon! Goodness! The journey has only just started and the situation is already in a mess!?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, School Life

title: I Reincarnated and Became Level 1, But I’m the Strongest Because I Inherited Skills and Equipment ~Become a Different World Adventurer with Knowledge No One Knows~
summary: One day, when I woke up, I was in a strange place. I learned that it was the world of VRMMO that I used to play so often. It's nice to be reincarnated in the game world, but it started in an orphanage. I couldn't even eat a satisfying meal, and I started from a poor life. However, by making full use of the knowledge and skills acquired in the game, he decides to rise from such a bottom state. At first, he thought, "Let's try to hunt 1,000 orcs." ""A thousand orcs?"" Afterward, sisters from an orphanage and a big-breasted subhuman join him and he grows up. Such is the story of the strongest adventurer.

title: Crossing the Line Senior
summary: Seo Hae-joo, a freshman at a Korean university. Known as the icon of bad luck, she has only one goal: to live safely, quietly, and steadily.But then appears Jung Tae-heon, “the biggest risk” of the business school. Assaults, gaming addiction, womanizer… He carries every bad reputation imaginable.Red warning lights flash as Hae-joo senses danger, and she erects an impenetrable wall against Tae-heon.“You can go ahead and draw that line all you want, even if our lips are just a step apart.”But Tae-heon doesn’t stop at climbing over her wall.“Am I getting scammed by you right now, junior?” Looking down at her from the top, he smiles.“I’m not planning to be partners with you, so whether you date me or not, you’ll have to try it a few times and then decide.”Before she can react, he crashes through her wall like a bulldozer.“I’ll specially be your pushover, just for you, junior.”Will Hae-joo be able to avoid this massive risk until the end? A filthy, long modern romance novel: Crossing the Line, Senior

title: Traveling as Ning Caichen
summary: Ning Fei had a dream. In the dream, he was inside the Orchid Temple. There was a female ghost named Nie Xiaoqian. There was a bearded man named Yan Chixia. There was also a thousand-year-old Tree Demon... Then, Ning Fei woke up. But he found he had become Ning Caichen. He wore white clothes with long sleeves, dressed just like an ancient scholar!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Historical, Horror, Martial Arts, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural, Tragedy, Wuxia, Xuanhuan

title: Duke, Please Fail!
summary: While toiling away at Altwood Duchy, I worked myself to death and actually died. When I opened my eyes, I found myself in the past, and I was determined to seek revenge for my overworked demise. During my time as the steward, I swore to ruin the arrogant Duke’s territory and make him pay for his misdeeds! Wasting the budget in all the wrong places and entrusting the fields to an infamous layabout, attempting to sabotage the crops… “Isn’t this an enormous harvest like never before?” “Thank you. The steward saved us!” Strangely, everything seems to be going well! I even managed to get back at the Duke himself this time. “You’ve laid a hand on me, so you must take responsibility. I need you, Nelly.” Such an unexpected twist? No, I still need to seek revenge. Duke, please just go down without a fuss!

title: I Was Transmigrated Into a Dark Fantasy After Regressing 999 Times
summary: I was transmigrated into a dark fantasy I had regressed in 999 times. To survive, I have no choice but to become a corrupt lord. But then, the heroines started to remember the regressions.

title: Superhero Comic – Overlord’s Path
summary: In the dark mist of chaotic gotham, he's the crimson devil bring the blood,he is sin! For lost mutants, his new force rise, he is stubborn! In the conflict of shield and hydra, he is the sword cut in the war, he is firm! Admired, detested, praised, cursed, some love him, other hate him. His heart is just like trenchant blade he held, never hesitate, never vacillate, never fluctuate, who can defeat a men like this? Welcome to, the story of the overlord.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: After Being Pampered by Her Cold Cousin
summary: Yun Dai has good looks but a humble status, and lives carefully in the Duke's mansion. It wasn’t until the crown prince Xie Jinlan returned home after being devolved for three years that Yun Dai saw his power and decided to please him. However, she was surprised to find that all her awkward efforts to impress him were noticed by Xie Jinlan. Xie Jinlan always knew what Yun Dai wanted. She intentionally went up to him as she desired to establish a stable and secure life. He was confident that he could control everything, so he let her get close, kept her by his side, and gave her everything she wanted. Until that day, he accidentally heard the drunken Yun Dai murmuring her affection for him, and his usually calm heart suddenly became a little confused. ... Xie Jinlan was aware that he could only marry a woman from a prestigious family as his first wife, not a relative of lower standing, so he never went out of his way towards Yun Dai. However, his feelings changed dramatically when rumors about Yun Dai's possible suitors began to circulate. He looked at the girl who stumbled into his inner courtyard, and the cup in his palm was almost crushed by him. He suppressed the discomfort in his heart and said: "If you ever face mistreatment after marriage, you can seek me out at the Duke's Mansion for help." The light in Yun Dai's eyes dimmed and she replied, "Yun Dai appreciates my cousin for looking after me, and I also wish for my cousin to find a lovely partner." Since that day, nobody referred to him as cousin and no one looked at his eyes lovingly. One dat he accidentally saw a scholar kissing Yun Dai on the corner of hee mouth. Xie Jinlan's pupils narrowed, and he later realized the taste of regret and jealousy. ... Later one night, the always kind man firmly directed Yun Dai's gaze towards him, compelling her to repeatedly confess, "Dai Dai, tell me you have feelings for me and no one else."

title: Fantasy: I Possess a Max-Level Immortal Emperor Account
summary: Lin Xuan transmigrated into his favorite game, bringing along his god-tier main account—divine artifacts, divine equipment, divine skills… everything one could imagine! On the Tianxuan Continent, demons and monsters run rampant while the human race stands on the brink. Lin Xuan crossed over to the Nine Heavens Holy Land, where he commands the holy land, sweeps across the Eight Desolations and Six Directions, and rules over all races. Wherever his gaze falls, every clan bows in submission! Those who dare offend the human race—whether in the heavens or on earth—shall be annihilated!
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Xuanhuan

title: Pika Pika No Mi In Marvel
summary: What should one do when he inexplicably become a mutant student in the Xavier’s School for Gifted Youngsters of the Marvel world? Waiting online, quite urgent! Huh? Wait a moment, why does this world have a golden fruit that resembles the Glint Glint fruit from the One Piece world? Countless years later… When Dormammu, Ego, and many cosmic bosses were kicked at the speed of Light, Yu Feng stood on top of Vormir star mountain Holding the Soul Stone in his hands while his hands was on Death’s cheeks as he said: “Death, if you Don’t want to experience what you preach, then you will be my maid for eternity.”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Managing a B&B First Guest Wu Song
summary: "Excuse me, I am Wu Song. May I ask if wine is sold here?" When a stout man in ancient attire, carrying a staff, appeared at the doorstep of the guesthouse, Li Yu, who had been worrying about his poor business, had no idea that his life was about to undergo a magnificent transformation... (With a four-million-word acclaimed culinary novel No More Pretending, I’m the Chef God, I Admit It as proof of quality, please enjoy with confidence.)
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: After the Marriage Exchange, I Married the Young General’s Tablet
summary: [Rebirth + Harem Intrigue + Female Lead with Yin-Yang Eyes + Male Lead Died in Battle + Bride Swap] Zhu Changsheng died on the third day of being named Noble Consort, falling victim to a conspiracy meticulously planned for her by Prince Jing. In her previous life, her Fate Pattern was altered by an evil path. Her healthy body wasted away overnight, while the originally sickly Princess Consort Jing was miraculously rejuvenated. The following year, Princess Consort Jing gave birth to fraternal twins for Prince Jing, helping him become the crown prince. As for her, the Concubine of Prince Jing, she became a frail and sickly invalid, cast aside into a dilapidated courtyard by Prince Jing. When Prince Jing ascended the throne, she was named Noble Consort, and on the third day, she was given poisoned wine, ending her miserable and destitute life. After her rebirth, Zhu Changsheng returned to her old trade. She roamed battlefields, public morgues, and execution grounds. Wherever there were dead, a woman named "Zhu You" would appear. Corpse stitching, skin painting, a bell doctor... Zhu Changsheng's master told her that her Fate Pattern was suited for the business of the dead—her fate was hard, she would afflict her six relatives, and she was destined to never marry. Later, her legitimate younger sister, Zhu Yuanshu, did not want to be a widow and pushed her deceased fiancé onto her, demanding that she marry in her place with his spirit tablet. Zhu Changsheng married the young general of the Great Jin Kingdom, Wei Yuan, holding his spirit tablet. No one knew that she could see Wei Yuan's soul. Her legitimate younger sister, Zhu Yuanshu, was also reborn. To become the Noble Consort, she used every trick in the book and successfully married into Prince Jing's Mansion. Years later, Zhu Changsheng, while wiping her husband's spirit tablet, had become the revered matriarch of the Wei Family. Her legitimate younger sister, Zhu Yuanshu, did not live to see the day she was named Noble Consort and "died of illness" in the back courtyard of the prince's mansion. Years later, Zhu Changsheng looked at her deceased husband's soul and asked, "Why haven't you gone for reincarnation yet?" Her deceased husband gazed at Zhu Changsheng's silver-white hair. "You collected my body for burial. I will wait until your life comes to its natural end to come and get you."

title: The Holy Sword I Found Came With A Husband
summary: The cursed Lady, Evelyn Berrett. Flowers withered at her touch, and her closest friend died. Even her brother, the family’s heir, fell into a coma.

title: Master of Ninja World
summary: A boy from 21st century Earth, met an accident and later was reborn in Naruto's Ninja World. He is born in Uchiha Family and becomes the useless brother of Itachi Uchiha and Sasuke Uchiha…. Let’s see how he changed the Naruto world.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: My Cool Classmate Yukino Is Secretly Sick Today as Well
summary: No way. Kamiyama-kun’s first time has to be with me! Kamiyama Yuuta is interested in his classmate Fuyusaki Yukino. By chance, they end up going to school together, but he has no idea what Fuyusaki is thinking. On the other hand, Fuyusaki also likes Kamiyama Yuuta. But deep down, she’s just a yandere, and her delusions are always running wild, preventing their relationship from progressing. A romantic comedy about an oblivious guy, a yandere, and unrequited love.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Mature, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: My Dear Husband, Let’s Keep It Business-Like! ~Countess Anastasia, Raised in The Downtown, Won’t Give Up Her Way~
summary: "This is a political marriage. I have no intention of loving you." Thus, began a marriage life with a line that sounded like it was straight out of some popular entertainment novel, lacking any originality. Anastasia didn't look down in hurt... "Well, it's pretty much exactly as I imagined." A mismatched story begins with a young head of a wealthy count family, Eugene, and Anastasia, the adopted daughter of a duke family raised in the lower town, starting with a politically motivated marriage. The two, who were raised differently and have different values, gradually start to form a bond... or do they!? I won't back down, I won't flatter, and I won't show mercy! Countess Anastasia, the Weed Spirit, here I come!!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Hogwarts: This Professor is Too Muggle
summary: In the new school year, Hermione Granger, returning from summer vacation, eagerly anticipates her Muggle Studies class. The enlightened Professor Levent shows a movie in class, but these movies... seem a bit off. "Prisoner of Azkaban" Sirius Black: You know, some dogs are destined not to be caged, their every hair shines with the radiance of freedom. "Infernal Affairs" Wormtail: You undercover agents are interesting, always meeting in graveyards. Severus Snape: Unlike you, I am open and honest. Wormtail: Give me a chance. Severus Snape: How will I give you a chance? Wormtail: I had no choice before, now I want to be a good person. Severus Snape: Alright, tell Mad-Eye and see if he'll let you be a good person. Wormtail: That means I have to die. Severus Snape: I'm sorry, I'm with the Order of the Phoenix. Wormtail: Who would believe that? "Memento" Bertha Jorkins: Someone tampered with my memories. At first, I just forgot that afternoon, then I started to forget the dates, couldn't remember what I ate for breakfast... Before I completely forget all my memories, I want to visit my aunt in Albania. Mr. Crouch approved my holiday, he is so considerate. Crouch? I seem to recall some things, a tremendous secret. Danger is approaching. Now, Who am I? Where am I?
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, School Life

title: Mother of Dragons
summary: As the Mother of Dragons, I judge that breathing fire at a low altitude is too dangerous. It's better to switch careers and become a bomber! Napalm bombs, wildfire bombs -- how about an orbital weapon? I wonder if a one-ton iron javelin, dropped from a height of fifty thousand meters, can kill the Night King? (The protagonist travels to the world of "A Song of Ice and Fire" as the Mother of Dragons, and she's also watched "Game of Thrones,"...)
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mature, Supernatural

title: Warm Monsoon
summary: “Jifeng, I don’t want to be in a relationship right now.” Jifeng, who had been ruthlessly rejected, spent 10 years pining for Gu Xueting—from campus days to her wedding day, except she married someone else. After giving everything and ending up with nothing, he even raised a glass to toast, “I wish you happiness!” Even the most desperate would hand him a cigarette in sympathy. After being reborn, Jifeng decided to stop being a simp, but his once-unattainable “white moonlight” suddenly grew anxious. Gu Xueting: “Jifeng, if you keep acting like this, I’ll ignore you.” “Jifeng, you weren’t like this before.” “Jifeng, why are you treating me like this?” “Jifeng, let’s go back to how things were before.” Gu Xueting: “Jifeng, I want to buy sleeping pills.” Jifeng: “Oh, can’t sleep? You can’t just buy those casually.” Gu Xueting: “I want to kill myself, kill myself… Are you still there, Jifeng?” Jifeng, panicking: “Wait, just wait, I’ll come over right away. Three bottles—will three bottles be enough?” … After being reborn, Jifeng returned to his younger days as a simp and a troublemaker. But when he sees her again—the girl from his memory with glass eyes and a smile sharp enough to cut—he chooses to fall deeper. What begins as a mission to burn their world to the ground becomes a dangerous game of lies and reflections. Each trial shatters another mask. Each choice drags him closer to a cracked Wonderland where even his own face might betray him. A dark psychological fantasy about identity, obedience, and the lies we tell ourselves. summary: Kageyama Eimu, a first-year high school student attending Leonis Adventure Academy, possesses a unique innate ability known as a blessing. Unfortunately, his blessing, called [Sure Hit] , is perceived as a dud since it merely guarantees hitting enemies within his visible range—a skill aptly named [Sure Hit] . Choosing the Archer job to make the most of his blessing, Eimu diligently engages in dungeon conquests to become stronger. However, his level progress is sluggish, compounded by the Archer job’s lackluster reputation, leading to constant harassment from his classmates. One fateful day, Eimu makes a startling realization. The effect of Eimu’s [Sure Hit] extends not only to visible enemies but also to those he senses through the Archer’s detection skill. title: After Transmigrating, My Younger Brother Always Tries to Seduce Me
summary: Zhu Zhenzhen transmigrated to the day the Song Manor was annihilated. In her original world, she had been the top operative of a notorious thieving organization, a solitary reed adrift in the wind. After transmigrating, she suddenly gained a docile and adorable younger brother, no longer alone. She initially believed her mission was simply to clear the Song Family’s name. But to her utter shock, she found herself having to manage her brother’s romantic feelings—the kind that could lead to that kind of intimacy! Zhu Zhenzhen wrestled with her dilemma for a long time, her inner balance wavering. Just as she was about to give in, a drunken confession revealed the truth she was merely a substitute for the white moonlight in his heart. The words froze on her lips as she snapped back to reality, deliberately distancing herself from Song Heng from that moment on. Song Heng was still reeling when the Emperor suddenly issued a marriage decree. The imperial edict, emblazoned in bright yellow, pierced his eyes like a dagger. He resisted with every fiber of his being, questioning the decree a thousand times. Her calm eyes reflected Song Heng’s bewildered face. Her crimson lips parted slightly, but her words struck his heart like a heavy blow. It was merely a case of mutual affection. A complete madness filled Song Heng’s eyes. Zhu Zhenzhen looked at him as if she didn’t recognize him. He gritted his teeth and snarled, Red sleeves adding fragrance, never leaving my side, night after night—you promised me that yourself! Zhu Zhenzhen’s initial reaction was Are you alright? Later, when she recalled her past life, she realized that she had been his white moonlight all along. The man before her, his eyes rimmed with red, tears glistening on his lashes, prompted her to reach out and wipe them away. After a moment’s hesitation, she finally spoke …I did promise you that, but it was only because I was working. Song Heng closed his eyes, tears streaming down his cheeks as he murmured, It doesn’t matter… You won’t be able to shake me off in this lifetime. He had once despised her, hated her, yet now he still loved her.

While not knowing the reason he went and returned from the journey, Tiese was thinking of parting from her anxious childhood friend, but……Before the job she was about to take just next, she, got involved with a kind Demon King with love troubles, and his not so kind Prime Minister.

title: Aqua Tofana
summary: Poisoning. The power to kill without leaving a trace. *** “That damned pittance.” Lauren ground his teeth. The Special Forces paid stipends strictly based on performance. Currently, he was working as a teaching assistant in Herbology at the Imperial Academy, a role that served as both cover and a side job. The reason for working two jobs was simple... both paid a pittance. Nevertheless, his primary occupation was as Lauren, the sole operative of the Imperial Palace Special Forces’ Poison Surveillance Unit. Whenever a poisoning incident occurs, the investigation of the agent codenamed “Aqua Tofana” begins…

She wishes for the happiness of the person she loves, and searches for a way to die for him every day. Will Meg ever be happy?

Alongside a skilled female mercenary and a pure-hearted priestess girl, Lala embarks on a journey in a fantasy world brimming with unknowns and romance."

However, just as she decides she’ll need to live quietly to avoid her death flags, the original heroine of the story, Aria, gets bullied right in front of her. title: The Dignity of the Shop Window
summary: 6:30 a.m., wake up. A light shower. Leaving for work at the exact same time. For four years, not a single part of her daily routine had changed. They were small actions, but when it came to self-management, she lived with absolute discipline. At least… until today, before she met this man.‘What on earth is happening to me…?’Her hands were pulled behind the chair, tied with something that felt like a necktie, and in front of her stood a stranger. His overwhelming presence made Seo-ah’s words stick in her throat. Despairing, she begged as if pleading for her life.“Why are you doing this? Really! I just came in and slept here, that’s all. This is my friend Jihyun’s house.” “Right. Min Jihyun. Min Jihyun is my sister.” “…What?” “And this is my house.”Unable to make sense of the situation, Seo-ah could only blink.“You dared to run a business in my house without my permission?”But… I’m just a tenant.

title: Seventies Space: My Arch-Enemy Wants a Military Marriage With Me
summary: Mu Zhaoye transmigrated into a book as the nemesis of the Minister’s household. Using underhanded, disgraceful means, she snatched her younger sister’s marriage contract and wed the God of War, Pei Shenxiu—only to have her family raided and exiled the very next day. Everything unfolded far too smoothly. Behind it all were her father and that dog of an emperor pulling the strings. As the only poison doctor from the dark organization who survived to the end, how could she allow herself to be manipulated? With her spatial ability in hand, she emptied the Pei residence, and her father’s storerooms couldn’t be spared either. While cleaning out the national treasury, she conveniently left behind her father’s embezzlement ledgers for the dog emperor. The scummy father’s entire household ended up with nothing, and in the end, because of corruption, they were raided and exiled, suffering bitterly. With space at her disposal, medical skills in her grasp, and gold and silver aplenty, Mu Zhaoye faced exile without worrying about food or drink. A minor plague? Nothing to fear. Assassins from the court? None would return alive. … Once they reached the wilderness, the gravely injured man looked at her with affectionate eyes every day. But Mu Zhaoye, who longed only for the freedom of separation, gradually developed the barren lands into wealth and prosperity—until the people in the capital could no longer sit still. “Wife, someone wants to seize your land, and also your business.” Mu Zhaoye slammed her palm onto the table, secretly thinking: they could try to take her husband, but her business was absolutely off-limits. “Pei Shenxiu, what are you waiting for? Raise your troops… and march back to the capital…”

title: This Summoner is Ridiculous

A single draw creates miracles! This is a card-based alternate world. Powerful supernatural creatures, divine weapons imbued with divine power, and even things like hurricanes, lightning, and fire themselves can all be sealed by cards. She pushed open the bedroom door and saw a man and a woman “entangled” together, doing something that could only be understood, not explained. The man was her fiancé. Qin Nian rushed over and tore at her fiancé, but at the same time, her cong**ital heart disease flared up — she died of shock. When she opened her eyes again, she saw the same man and woman “entangled” together, doing that same indescribable thing. Emma, what’s going on? Soon, Qin Nian understood what was happening — she had transmigrated and been reborn into ancient times. It was still a barren year, with food shortages and scant clothing. Besides her grandmother, who was as thin as a fishbone, there was nothing else at home. But how could this possibly defeat her?

title: Shengzhuang Mountain and River
summary: In her previous life, she was obsessed with King Rui and let the wolf into the house, causing the men of the Yun family to die without a burial place and the family to be destroyed. In her new life, she is willing to turn into ashes and spread across the mountains and rivers, and swear to defend the Yun family's century-old mansion to the death. When she puts on armor, she has a heroic dream of mountains and rivers, and a woman's red makeup can also embellish the magnificent mountains and rivers... - She freezes her love and only wants to protect her loved ones. He sits in the half-bright shadow, his eyes full of scarlet: "Aluan, this king will give you everything, but your loved ones?"

title: Nine Evolutions of the True Spirit
summary: This is a world filled with mysteries from a conspiracy that has lasted tens of thousands of years; This is a story about an ordinary cultivator's passion and perseverance in his cultivation path; The rise of a sect foreshadows tactics and trickeries; The confrontation between two races reveals alliances and betrayals; Countless deaths and secrets were buried in a catastrophe. As the secrets were slowly exposed, so too unfolded the mysteries of this world. Combined with various magical effects, it creates a variety of monsters with magical powers. This magic is known as “Summoning Cards”.

summary: If one day, my favorite game character crossed into the real world... “I’m Keqing, one of the Liyue Qixing, 'Yuheng'.” “Excuse me, are you the Traveler?” James Ford stared at the Keqing who suddenly appeared in his home, looking exactly like the one in Genshin Impact. He thought he might be hallucinating. Until he saw Keqing swing her electrified longsword, splitting his table in half. “Keqing, you’re really going for it!” “I’m trying to get back to Liyue.” “You might not be able to go back.” “Why?” Because it's far, so far, from nothing to something. … From then on, James Ford lived together with Keqing, the "cupping therapist" of his house. “Wife! Genshin Impact released a new character!” “Klee is so cute!” Keqing looked at James Ford, deeply engrossed in the game, leaving her ignored, and said pitifully, “What? Is marrying me, Keqing, making you feel wronged?” “Like the sword light, I cut through the chaos!”
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Flirting with My Hidden Marriage Husband, Making the Female Guest Cry
summary: [A peerlessly beautiful and glamorous female star X A roguish, wild ‘wolf cub’ heir from the Beijing elite circle + Secret Marriage on a Romance Reality Show + Sweet and Doting Romance with Untainted Leads] It was widely rumored in the entertainment circle that Song Ying, a washed-up actress who debuted as a child star, was dramatic, a clout-chaser, and had come between a top-tier movie star and his partner. In response, she posted a picture of the person sleeping beside her. Song Ying: “Thanks for asking. I already have a boyfriend, and he’s more handsome.” Netizens scoffed: “Starts with a picture, the rest is all made up. Song San, get out of the entertainment industry!” Done with putting up with the intolerable, she brings her secret husband onto a romance reality show to crush the “white lotus,” shut down anti-fans, flaunt their love, and crash the show, landing them on the hot search! She even makes another female guest bawl her eyes out! The movie star? Sorry, just some ugly nobody she wouldn’t even spare a glance for! Her husband is the real treasure of this world~ Everyone in their circle once thought that the heir, Qin Shu, was arrogant, wild, and untamable. But in a flash, the cold and proud CEO turned into a puppy dog on the romance reality show—being dramatic, acting cute to win affection, and spouting endless sweet nothings, doting on his wife with his life. Only then did everyone realize that the wild wolf had two faces. — When they were young, an elder asked Qin Shu what kind of wife he wanted to marry in the future. He thought for a moment, then pointed at the little girl on TV and said, “I want one like that!” After they grew up, his friends all laughed at the henpecked Qin Shu for getting married so young, saying he had lost his former edge. In a bar, the heir of the Qin family lifted his fox-like eyes, kicked over a wine bottle, and shook the yogurt in his hand. “What can I do? From our very names, it was destined that I would lose and she would win.” In the past, Song Ying hated it when Qin Shu would chase after her, saying, “Teacher Song, I grew up watching your shows!” No matter how she heard it, it just made her sound old. For the sake of her family, she began her life as a pro gamer. But this time, she was no longer the Human Sorceress that she was familiar with. She was an Elven Huntress. Could she still acquire the power to be the Right Hand of God?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Eternal Love Within A Smile
summary: How fortunate yet unfortunate I am to attend my own grand funeral, contentedly watching the members of the Dao Alliance sing praises of my glorious life, feeling that I have died a worthy death. As the only female Dao Venerable in the history of the Dao Alliance, I adhered to the teachings of my master, living a life of warmth and kindness, maintaining purity and integrity, showing great compassion, rescuing those in distress, and fighting valiantly against the evil Blood Sect, dying in battle, and earning the reverence of the masses. However, I never expected that after my death, my reputation would be tarnished. During the funeral, several men jumped out, claiming to be my Dao companions from my lifetime, accusing me of being unfaithful and abandoning them. Master in heaven, heavens can attest, I really do not know them well. If anyone falsely accuses me, then I will definitely—make the charges stick!

title: Imprisoned for Writing Fantasy Novel

"Immediately escort the author to the guest quarters of the imperial palace with utmost courtesy!" In the end, I was imprisoned. With a pen and some paper.

title: When He Smiles
summary: When she was much younger, Meng Sheng Nan had a crush. But she never knew if she was his type, and so she suppressed her love for him. Many years later, she met him again in her hometown. He was no longer the unruly and carefree youth and now often shuttles about the old streets of JiangCheng in his flip-flops. He stood before her dirty and unshaved, with a history of hardships behind his eyes. Her heart raced, as he chased after her. For her, he had renewed his efforts and started from scratch to redeem himself. It was as though he responded to the line she wrote in a book she sent him many years ago: “I want him to amend his ways and not waste his youth.”

title: Godzilla Earth: Origin
summary: When Godzilla awakened from its two-hundred-year slumber once again, it found a strange voice suddenly appeared in its mind. “Name: Godzilla” “Height: 218 meters” “Weight: 500,000 tons” “Main objective: Make humans leave this universe.” “Reward: …” Godzilla, who had just awakened from his sleep, fell into confusion.

title: Just Became a Special Forces’ Soldier, and You Say Steel Seventh Company is Disbanding?
summary: Ye Yun, who crossed over into the world as a soldier of Steel Seventh Company, coincidentally encountered military reforms that led to the disbanding of Steel Seventh Company. The soldiers were discharged and returned to civilian life, and Ye Yun was among them. But old soldiers never die, they just fade away! Returning to everyday life, Ye Yun missed his days on the battlefield and could not help but feel melancholy. "Mercenary System Activated!" The system awakened just in time, but to unlock all its functions, he needed to form a mercenary squad. "Veterans, grow bigger and stronger, and create glory once again!" After some persuasion from Ye Yun, discharged veterans Wu Liu Yi and Shi Jin were the first to join the squad! Under Ye Yun's leadership, a mercenary squad composed of discharged veterans gradually grew stronger and became active all over the world! "Bai Tiejun, where the hell is your rocket launcher?" "Squad Leader Lao Ma, cover us with smoke grenades!" "Leng Feng, stay with us! We will help you find your wife!"

title: The Story Of How I, A Gloomy Guy, Ended Up Surrounded By the Top-Tier Beautiful Girls In Class After A Seat Change
summary: The Story of How I Ended Up Surrounded by the Top-Tier Beautiful Girls in Class After a Seat Change.

title: My Master is the Real Boss
summary: Having transmigrated and become a Little Taoist Priest of Ping'an Temple, Xiang Jiannan feels that his life is quite tragic. Since transmigrating, all sorts of things that don't align with his original worldview have come his way, especially that Master in the Taoist temple, who is definitely clueless about how much he's screwing people over. Let's see how a Little Taoist Priest strives to grow while shedding tears of frustration. *** Xiang Jiannan, a modern soul mysteriously transmigrated into the body of a young Taoist priest in the remote town of Ping'an, just wants a quiet life. He's stuck with a master who's more interested in making a quick buck than imparting wisdom, and the local temple, Ping'an Temple, is more dilapidated than divine. But peace is short-lived. When a local family claims their "Peace Talismans" are useless against a haunting, Xiang Jiannan is reluctantly drawn into a series of increasingly bizarre events. As he investigates, Xiang Jiannan discovers that Ping'an Town is a hotbed of strange occurrences, from restless spirits to a pig demon with a penchant for collecting debts. With his master's help (or hindrance), and his own surprisingly potent, though often unpredictable, abilities, Xiang Jiannan must navigate this supernatural chaos. He finds himself forming an uneasy alliance with a mysterious agent from the Fu Mo Si, a government agency dedicated to suppressing the paranormal, and facing off against a variety of colorful characters, both human and otherwise. Along the way, Xiang Jiannan grapples with the meaning of cultivation, the effectiveness of his master's questionable methods, and the very nature of good and evil. His journey is a blend of comedic mishaps, genuine moments of terror, and a deep dive into a world where the line between the mundane and the magical is constantly blurred. He'll be forced to question everything he thought he knew about Taoism, about his master, and even about himself. And through it all, he must learn to trust his instincts, even if they lead him down the most unexpected, and often hilarious, paths.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Greece: I am Zeus!
summary: Zeus is the beginning, the end, the God Lord of the Sky Dome. He is the Creator of all things, breeding all spirits. He is the Great Supreme Heavenly Father, and also the eternally pure bride-to-be. All existing things, from now on become the sole. The Lord of all existence, will forever be so. The Supreme Father, Absolute Lord, self-existent, all-knowing and all-powerful. Zeus—this is everything, the one above all.

Mr. Xu, who has proven that he is still extremely strong for his age, is now walking around with his head held high! As for the three daughters-in-law, they are now shivering in fear. It doesn't matter if it's a son or a daughter because they would now have another person to serve. Oh god, how would they be able to live their lives now? After ten long months, Mrs. Xu finally gave birth to a cute little girl — Fu Bao. Her arrival entirely changed the Xu family. Fu Bao: "Mother, I caught a rabbit!" Fu Bao: "Father, is this gold?" Eldest Xu: "Little sister, could you take a look at me and see if today is a good day to go into the woods?" Second Xu: "Fu Bao~ Am I the brother that treats you the best?" Third Xu: "Bao~ You have to wish me best of luck so that I'll pass my exam. I'll buy you beautiful clothes on your way home!" All her sisters-in-law: "Oh dear, just leave it. We will do it instead!"

summary: King Cohen Colion of Aifein awakens memories of his past life—his current life astonishingly aligns with the trajectory of a game from his previous world, and that game has now become reality! According to the plot’s progression, his queen, renowned as the most beautiful woman on the continent, will, in one year’s time, unleash a bloody purge of the royal family, ascending to divinity as a mortal and claiming a god’s throne. Meanwhile, he is merely a tragic “tool” on her path to godhood. Faced with his queen’s regicidal conspiracy, Cohen steadies his resolve. A flood of intelligence and strategies from his past life surges into his mind: The noble daughter of the Gold Wing Family, whose wealth dominates the continent, is about to face a life-or-death crisis! The divine treasures of the Arcane Empire, destroyed a thousand years ago, still lie buried deep beneath the earth! Arnold, the god of war who commands unparalleled influence, is currently just an unremarkable adventurer! The peerless Silver Dragon Countess, who leads a dragon legion to sweep across the continent, is now merely a squire knight yet to awaken her extraordinary powers! Armed with this foreknowledge and strategic intelligence, Cohen moves with foresight—rescuing the Gold Wing heiress, unearthing ancient ruins, assembling a beastman army, and recruiting the Silver Dragon Countess, embarking on his own path to divinity!

title: My Perfect Apocalyptic Life
summary: Meng Xu woke up to discover he had activated the Perfect Life System—a system that promised promotions, raises, and a climb to the peak of his life. But when he drew back the curtains, he was dumbfounded. The apocalypse had arrived, and zombies were everywhere! Blood and fire littered the streets, with darkness having fallen upon the world. The apocalypse is here, and the Perfect Life System chooses now to show up? 【A perfect day starts with a conversation. See that beautiful lady not far away? Go chat her up, and you’ll have a perfect encounter.】 【Task Issued: Flirt with the Beauty】 【Task Rewards: Allocatable Attribute Point +1 and gain a close female acquaintance.】 Staring at the beautiful female zombie missing half her face, Meng Xu swallowed hard. “System, are you serious?” … So, in this perilous apocalyptic world, every morning, you could see a lightning-fast figure weaving through the streets and alleys, stirring up zombie hordes. “What mental illness? I have no illness! Wait, I’ll argue with you later; a customer is here… Excuse me, Mr. Zombie, are you interested in swimming and fitness?” Join Meng Xu on his extraordinary journey navigating a world filled with zombies, empowered by a system that promises a perfect life.

title: The Obsessive Regressor of The Academy
summary: The day after enrolling in the academy as the disciple of an Archmage. "I, I'm actually a regressor! We were married before my regression!" A crazy woman clung to me.

title: You’re Asked to Create a Copy, and You’re Supposed to Build the Tang Dynasty?
summary: Lu Chen transmigrated to Earth and found a world strikingly similar to his previous life— except for two things: A profession called “Instance Builder” A mysterious place known as the “Secret Realm,” inhabited by Heavenly Demons At eighteen, everyone could create their own instance based on a historical dynasty to battle these demons. This was the core duty of an Instance Builder. But Lu Chen soon noticed something strange: In this world’s Great Xia Dynasty, no one chose a Chinese historical dynasty as their instance. At that exact moment, he obtained the Chinese Instance Quest System. Completing quests granted him every resource needed to construct new instances. And so, one after another, Chinese historical instances were born from his hands: The Prosperous Tang Dynasty Group The Great Qin Heavy Industry The Powerful Han Industry …and many more Years later, while various countries fell to the Heavenly Demons of the Secret Realm, China alone remained untouched. Desperate, nations around the world begged China for help in exorcising the demons. Naturally, Lu Chen agreed. Earth’s countries: The Heavenly Demons are gone now, Mr. Lu… shouldn’t you leave too? Lu Chen: What are you talking about? Isn’t this my home? Please leave. Earth’s countries: …

summary: She always dreamed of becoming a singer. After a year of becoming a singer, She lost her voice due to laryngeal cancer. And then a faint voice could be heard from her. 「......I can sing again.」 In a world filled with only the desire to sing again, she faces a new destiny.....!

summary: When he walked out of prison, the whole world would tremble! He harbored blood-deep vengeance and would stir up a storm of bloodshed and violence! Those who deceived me, betrayed me, hurt me – are you afraid? Don’t be afraid… I will not let any of you off easy!!!

That's the conclusion I've come to after much thought. I'm screwed." Realizing that his life was an NTR game, he begins to twist his body to escape the bad ending.

summary: I was the first human created by God. Blessed with a paradise and companionship, I took love for granted, never bestowing it upon others. Abruptly, God posed me a challenge and expelled me from Eden, decreeing I couldn't die until I found the answer. Once again, I'm reborn. But this time... "Baaah!" Disaster strikes!

summary: Marriage is like a besieged city. People who are outside the city wish to enter while people who are inside the city wish to leave. Ji Xuan racked her brains just to divorce Sheng Zeyan, the male god who has captured the hearts of thousands of women. Who would have thought that no matter what she did, Sheng Zeyan remained unswayed, always indulging and pampering her. He was perfect, except that he did not personally pick and send her when she had a friendly meet up with her first love. However, once she lost her life in the besieged city and threw away her feelings, a divorce agreement was placed in front of her. Her perfect* husband became a familiar stranger. “Didn’t you always want your freedom? Now I’m giving it to you.” 「But you do not know, that since the day I fell in love with you, freedom no longer has any meaning. 」 *二十四孝 – The Twenty-four Filial Exemplars. title: Forcibly Marrying the Saint

title: Fanlu Manor
summary: After leaving London, Zhen Ning never expected that she would encounter Du Boqin again in a foreign land. Even less did she expect that the once low-key and aloof male classmate was actually the noble Prince Boqin of Moselan. She thought forgiving him for his abrupt departure years ago marked the end of that youthful romance, but little did she know it was only the beginning of a lifelong entanglement. Between them lay family feuds, generational grudges, and blood debts—destined to meet a tragic end. She returned his engagement ring, left Fanlu Manor, and disappeared from his world. But he refused to let her go, even threatening with his life. “Your Highness, we have no future.” “Then shoot me. Otherwise, you’ll never be able to leave me for the rest of your life.”

title: Divorce, My Lord. The Cultivating Princess Is Beyond Your Reach
summary: On her wedding night, Lin Qingyue was strangled to death by her deranged sister-in-law while her husband was romancing her own stepsister under the moonlight. Upon her death, the soul of Lin Qingyue, the Demon Lord, awakened within her: “Your vengeance shall be mine to exact!” Her fake-sister spoke with feigned innocence: “So what if I stole your identity and credit? The world would rather believe a single tear of mine than a thousand truths from you!” She smirked: “Keep lying, and karma will curse your tongue with sores.” A haughty princess lashed out with a whip: “A lowborn wretch like you is unworthy of my brother!” With a single move—Dream Tracing Shadow Return—she unraveled layers of deception: “A phoenix with the blood of commoners dares to question my nobility?” The cold-faced prince embraced the green-tea stepsister, declaring passionately: “I will never forget your life-saving grace.” She tore apart the impostor’s disguise with her bare hands: “Blind fool, you mistook your savior. Your life is now mine to reclaim!” When the truth came to light, the once-arrogant man begged with red-rimmed eyes: “I was wrong. Let us start over.” She tossed him the divorce papers and turned away: “I have cultivated for a millennium. You are beneath me.”

title: Half-Demon Si Teng
summary: Si Teng, a spirit transformed from a white vine (commonly known as a “ghost vine”) in Southwest China in 1910, was poisonous, cunning, and ruthless, even killing its own kind. She was also known as the “Demon Slayer,” unrivaled in power, never losing a battle. The demon world feared her, and the Taoist community trembled before her. In 1946, Taoist master Qiu Shan killed the female demon Si Teng in Shanghai. Before her death, a strange, relieved smile appeared on Si Teng’s face. In 2013, Qin Fang and his fiancée traveled to Nanquan in the west to find a benefactor of his ancestor. Their car crashed off a cliff; a spike pierced Qin Fang’s heart, and the dripping blood revived the long buried female demon. She claimed to be Si Teng, who had died before, and forced Qin Fang to obey her, plotting a revenge scheme. Qin Fang tried desperately to escape Si Teng’s control, but as he uncovered the truth, he gradually discovered that his fate had been predetermined more than seventy years ago…

title: Wife’s Color is Addicting
summary: She was the most dazzling actress in the entertainment industry, but she was sadly framed by her s*um boyfriend and killed in an explosion. Opening her eyes again, she became an 18-year-old wallflower student in a media college. More importantly, she surprisingly discovers there’s an ugly human skin mask on her face hiding her true features. She kept wearing the human mask and endured the vicious remarks and bullying of all sides. But once she made her mind, she removed the disguise amidst a wave of surprise, stepped on her enemies with 10cm heels and became an untouchable gem dazzling the world, loved by men and hated by women. When her unyielding soul took over that small and frail body, she vowed to stand on the Oscar podium and become a superstar in the film industry! After three years of disguise in the industry, she removed her silver mask at a concert and shocked the world with her unmatched beauty. … Once she got back into the entertainment circle, she started investigating the cause of her death in her previous body, while enduring the stalking of a very persistent yet caring fellow. When a scandal involving her broke out, he blocked the bad gossip for her. When she was framed, he domineeringly declared “She’s my woman, let’s see who has the courage to touch her!” When she went abroad to film, he left his business to follow after her and decided to be the leading actor. title: Survival Log of a C-Class Guide
summary: One day, C-class guide Roen accidentally guides Calix, the head of the country's top private mercenary group Eclipse . But this man is somehow suspicious. "I'm a C-class and I have my flaws as a guide, so why do you want to take me with you?" "I told you. I like you. I need you." Unlike the arrogant gaze of the top predator in the food chain, he spoke in a sweet and seductive voice. "Come with me." Let’s go to Eclipse together. And… … “It’s not enough.” He bit my lips like a hungry beast and dug into me. Our bodies pressed closer and humid air filled the surroundings. Was this what it felt like to be eaten? “Ha… This is so damn good. What the hell are you?” ▶A quick taste I guess my hair wasn’t completely dry, so water droplets fell on my knuckles. The faint scent of shampoo lingered at the tip of my nose, making my head dizzy. Even his eyes were wet and moist. Calix looked like a spy using a charm in a spy movie. “How about sleeping next to me?” “Yes?” “You sleep so well without even dreaming when you sleep with me.” “Don’t be ridiculous.” Calix’s face hardened when the charm didn’t work. “That’s the only way.” He unfastened the cuffs on my wrist and rolled up my sleeves to my forearms. Even in my dark room with only a few candles lit, my eyes were drawn to her pale, shiny skin. “Wait, Calix. What are you doing?” “Faint.” Did he misunderstand the definition of fainting? His gaze did not seem to lie. As if to prove it, he leaned toward me, placing one hand on the bed. I thought, “No way,” and backed away as far as he could. Her jet-black hair was tied back with nothing but a red silk ribbon, dancing wildly in the wind—vibrant, almost painfully so. Rumors spoke of her unparalleled wit and beauty, how she had once defended a small city in Dayan alone against a hundred foes, a single spear securing her fame. From afar, he caught just one glimpse—a soul-stirring glance—and he could never forget her, though he told himself it was dislike. Only later did he realize it was an affliction of the heart. He wanted to hide her away, let no one else see her. When she visited the Shen residence daily, he secretly anticipated it. Then one day, she stopped coming. Later, defying all opposition, he carried Lin Sangwan’s “lifeless body” back to his courtyard and buried her beneath the pine tree. The tombstone read: “My Beloved Wife, Sangwan.” He raised a white jade cup toward the grave, his usually indifferent eyes brimming with desolation and grief. “After your departure, this world is left with nothing but endless snow and wind.” He had studied the way of the noble scholar, vowed to remain a pure servant of the state. But after her family’s ruin, he decided there was no harm in becoming a man of power instead. It was a time when the landscape of game development was still in its infancy, with early pioneers laying the groundwork for the future of the industry. title: Young Leader of the Golden Scale Trading Group
summary: As if waking up in a martial arts novel wasn’t bad enough, I expected to be born with a silver spoon according to the original setting, but my situation seems off—more like a gold-plated spoon. “What kind of family treats their direct descendants worse than servants? Does that even make sense?” At least I inherited some wealth from my late parents. So, I thought I’d escape my terrible household, avoid the harassment from my uncles, and live a quiet, long life. “If anyone messes with my people, the story changes.” An eye for an eye, as they say. They tried to keep me down because of the position of young leader of the Golden Scale Trading Group, huh? “Guess I’ll have to take that position myself.” To get back at my uncles who wronged me, I aimed to become the heir of the trading group. Using the knowledge from the original story, I made my move. But then… “This job really suits me too well.” I easily dealt with the Eighteen River Pirates and the Green Forest bandits by using the power of negotiation. “Oh, you little rat! You scoundrel! Are you trying to starve us all to death?” Clearing out those outlaws also allowed me to tidy up the black market and gather useful items and information. “The royal house is requesting an additional deal. And I’ve received letters from sects beyond the borders. What on earth did you do?” As I successfully closed more deals, I even caught the annoying attention of my grandfather, who had previously ignored me. “If you’re curious, pay up. Nothing in this world is free.” People started calling me more of a money-grubber than my grandfather ever was. “I’ve got too much to protect now; I can’t afford to slack.” No matter how much I gathered, it was never enough, especially considering the bloody storms that would come in the original plot. Amidst all this… “You’ve taken me in, so now you have to take responsibility.” The person I raised and set free returned, trailing after me. You weren’t this obedient and tame before. “Oh, forget it.” First, I’ll deal with this damned original story. Then I’ll figure out the rest.

A clandestine relationship, hidden from the light, was destined to end. Lin Zaoyi resolved to sever the ties herself and agreed to a blind date arranged by her mother. That very evening, Tan Zhaojing appeared at the restaurant, his usual composure gone, his every step closing in on her. She swallowed hard. “You promised to let me go…” His voice, cold and deep, brushed against her ear. “I let you go because I couldn’t bear to see you cry, not so you could sever ties and turn to someone else.” The day their relationship was exposed, Tan Zhaojing stood in a dark suit, his features pale and composed, but his words were like a bowl of water poured into a boiling oil pan. Stripping away the “obedient” and “sweet” attributes of the little puppy, she met the real Xie Bo— Possessive, extremely scheming, and extremely wealthy. The pretending-to-be-well-behaved and decadent girl versus the pretending-to-be-well-behaved and scheming prince.

summary: I became a maid who gets killed by a young villainess. She was supposed to be the one who would kill me, but when I actually met her, she was so small and pretty. On top of that, she was just a child who had been neglected and abandoned by her family. “Young lady, shall we try rebelling a little?” The moment I found out that a huge inheritance would go to the villainess, I decided to find a guardian for her. * Among the guardian candidates, I saved the villainess Lilith from the Duke’s house of Heriot, which was the original heroine’s family. Thankfully, the Duke’s family liked the villainess. “Lilith, who do you like the most?” “Chloe.” When the little girl replied with her tiny mouth, everyone else felt gloomy for not being chosen. * Lilith grew up well, and I also became an adult. So, I told them I would leave the Duke’s house. “If Chloe leaves, I’ll leave too.” That one sentence from Lilith shook the whole mansion. The Duke’s family tried to stop me from leaving. “But I don’t have any reason to stay here anymore…” “Then marry me.” “…What?” I looked at Johann, the heroine’s older brother, who had always looked at me coldly. “What… did you just say?” I couldn’t believe those words came from his mouth. “Your reason to stay here…” “Isn’t marrying me enough?” “I don’t want you to leave, Chloe.” Johann grabbed my shoulder tightly. His quiet voice now carried emotions.

title: The Lady Only Deals With the Real Ones
summary: "My granddaughter, Elisha. Promise me you’ll take care of the pawnshop..." I failed to keep my grandfather’s dying wish and closed my eyes for the last time. But when I opened them again, I was back to the past—before I lost everything and met my end! "This time, I won’t let anyone steal my family or the pawnshop from me." I claimed my inheritance early to protect it. But why are all the customers who come to this pawnshop so... peculiar? *** "Does this pawnshop deal in people too?" "What?" "Nothing much. I was just wondering if you could buy me." "Uh... that’s definitely not nothing." An oddball, possibly a criminal, confidently requesting to sell himself. "Are you the owner here?" "Yes, that’s correct." "I see. And who gave you permission to run a business here?" A suspicious figure, possibly a gangster, politely delivering thug-like lines. "...Where did you even get this?" "Why? Is it worthless? Did I bring something too small?" "No, sir, this is a holy relic." "...." "Where on earth did you steal this?!" And another weirdo, possibly a thief, casually bringing in a stolen sacred artifact to pawn. "Grandpa, there are just way too many troublesome people here..." Can I really make this work?

title: The Black Swan Trap
summary: The top-tier green tea girl does not seek redemption. Process: 1VN, Ending: 1V1. Male rivalry | Battle royale. Eighteen years of miserable life have transformed Wen Ning into a perfectly poisoned black swan. She has only one goal: to drag the Wen Family down to hell with her. With neither power nor influence, Wen Ning has only one way to achieve her aim: to hunt and use the elite of society for her own ends. A top-tier hunter not only appears as prey, but can even make the prey willingly offer themselves. In the end, countless people desire Wen Ning, this black swan, but only Shen Du succeeds. Because Shen Du says to her: "I am willing to fall into hell with you."

She thinks his offer to help is just a polite gesture, but the man shows up the next day as promised. However, he is unmistakably the Duke, who is known to dislike women — a misogynist.

title: Back in the ’70s: My Military Husband Is Confused

Along with her second chance, she gains a golden ability: the house and car she owned in her previous life. Determined to rewrite her destiny, Chen Xi first cleans house—targeting her uncle’s family and her grandparents’ household—then teaches her scheming cousin, who tried to steal her marriage, and her triplet brothers, who pressured her to go to the countryside, a lesson they won’t forget. With a casual wave, she chooses a new location to be sent to, only to accidentally nearly “convert” her idol from her past life into liking her… despite him being a man. Male lead: “What the hell? I… I’m actually falling for a short, effeminate woman!”

A warrior absorbing the stars energy to strengthen the body, astonishing the heavens, smashing the starry skies, stepping on the universe! Sword qi weaving in the nine heavens, the blade ripping apart the blue skies, precious weapon piercing, star collapsing and breaking to ruins, the Arrow God arises, severing the soul! An enchanting star descends on the earth encompassing the whole sky. The Arrow God must not be provoked, wherever you hide, no matter if separated by countless sky, the massive lands, the Arrow God sees and can do his bidding. Pure genuine immortal, the sword going against the heavens, immeasurable true immortal, the Arrow God is born.

title: A Reincarnated Villainous Aristocrat, Who Becomes the Greatest Adventurer to Saves His Favorite Character
summary: A boy from a villainous noble family learns of a future in which his favourite character is killed as the last boss, and after that day, he begins to learn magic with bloody hard work. One year later, he is convinced that his doomed future has been averted for now, but he is shocked to discover that it all happened according to the game storyline. The game scenario’s compelling force, which could be called a curse,—- but on the flip side, it meant that no matter how reckless he was, he would not die until he was doomed. The boy who became an adventurer learns not only magic but also swords and faces monsters. In order to save the girl of his dreams and the precious people he encounters, his efforts are accelerated to the point of sickness. And the boy pushes forward on the death line without a care in the world. Will the crazy boy be able to destroy the storyline and save his favorite character? —-

title: On the Wedding Day, the Substitute Foolish Bride Wants a Divorce
summary: Transmigrated into the body of a fool, she was bullied by the servants—until she fought back with a whip and trampled them underfoot. The short-lived prince tried to protect her, but she demanded a divorce right on the spot. Thrown into the back mountain to be fed to a python, she turned the python into roasted meat instead. To rescue her exiled family, she reached a cooperation agreement with the short-lived prince. When everything was settled, she clapped her hands and left without hesitation. The prince could no longer stay calm—he’d rather give up the world than lose his beauty.

title: Beauty and the Snake God
summary: Mu Rongxue is a wandering swordswoman of the jianghu—cool, composed, and always seen with a flute in hand and a snake by her side. For years, the two have traveled together in quiet companionship. But one day, everything changes. The snake transforms into a stunning woman. Calling Mu Rongxue “Master” in a soft, husky voice, she clings to her with an almost instinctive devotion—seeking warmth, attention, and something more she doesn’t quite understand. What begins as curiosity and dependence soon turns into desire. Under the moonlight, boundaries blur. Mu Rongxue, who once treated her as nothing more than a companion, finds herself unable to resist the allure of the woman before her—bold, affectionate, and utterly captivating. And the “pet” she once kept close reveals a side that is far more dangerous… and irresistible. As they continue their journey through the jianghu, their relationship deepens from master and companion into something far more intimate—a love that is tender, passionate, and impossible to deny. A lighthearted and sweet tale of a swordswoman and her shape-shifting companion, filled with warmth, playful seduction, and a love that only grows stronger.

title: Below the Great Emperor, I am at the Emperor Realm; Above the Great Emperor, I Cheat
