To avoid exposing the fact that he's a novice, he maintains a stern face and pretends to be a master for a full hundred years. Finally, one day, he awakens a system that can instantly kill Great Emperors: 'Great Emperor Killer': It can only kill Great Emperors specifically - this ability can't defeat anyone except Great Emperors. So Lin Xuanqing decides to become a Great Emperor harvesting machine, cutting down all Great Emperors before him. This way, no one will dare question my identity as a powerful cultivator, right? All the Great Emperors cry out: Purple Empyrean Ancestor, please don't come near us!"

title: Hell’s Handbook
summary: Su Jin, an ordinary poor young man from the countryside working overtime every day to make ends meet in the city to support his family, finds himself in the possession of a book only known as Hell’s Handbook. The Handbook universe initially seems like a video game as it proceeds to throw him into a different world every month, each world filled with supernatural beings, mythical creatures and deities, and even includes a complete point system along with weapons and special skills. Surviving these challenges is not easy, but it comes with great rewards. But he soon realizes that all of this is real. The monetary rewards and magical items he receives from Hell’s Handbook can be used in the real world, but in the same way, every person who dies during a challenge dies in the real world too. As Su Jin desperately tries to survive each challenge he is thrown into, he slowly starts to uncover the truth behind Hell’s Handbook. Who is behind Hell’s Handbook and its horror filled challenges? Each challenge reveals a new truth about the world Su Jin lives in, bringing new people into his life even as the world around him becomes harder and harder to trust, and perhaps, even a greater mission in life…

title: Koibito, Hajimemashita
summary: In Kamitou Akito’s class, there is a female student named Aoyama Hiori. Hiori is a woman gifted with both intelligence and beauty and receives many confessions, mainly from boys, but she refuses them all. Because she is cool and never smiles and that she has silver hair. Some people call her [Absolute Zero Lady] from her name, [Hiori]. About six months ago, Akito fell in love at first sight with Hiori, ever since then, he keeps holding those feelings of love inside his chest. However, afraid that he might be dumped, he was unable to confess his feelings. One spring day after school. Akito finds Hiori accidentally scattering tr*sh and helps her. At that time, Akito musters up his courage and confesses to Hiori. “Unlike previous confessions, I felt a slight warmth in my heart. I don’t know if this is affection, but I can’t bring myself to refuse.” “…Then, how about we start dating on a trial basis?” Hiori accepted such a suggestion from Akito, and a trial lovers’ relationship between the two began. They eat lunch together, go on dates after school, Hiori comes to Akito’s part-time job, and they go to each other’s houses. As these days go by, the distance between them becomes shorter, and Hiori’s expression gradually becomes richer. A sweet and refreshing school youth love comedy that begins with a confession and a trial lovers relationship!
genres: Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Devouring Earth
summary: Reborn and returned in a brilliant counterattack. Others' tr*sh becomes my treasure! The powerful fighters on Earth said, "That's just a pile of clay." Jiang Xincheng said, "No, that's not clay. That's a first-grade Yuan Stone Yellow Clay Yuan Stone Mine. After I absorb it, my strength will rise by a major realm." The powerful fighters on Earth said, "That's just a sweet osmanthus tree." Jiang Xincheng said, "No, that's not a sweet osmanthus tree. That's a Natural Treasure Sweet Osmanthus Spirit Tree. It can be refined into a Moon Spirit Divine Pill. After I consume it, my Spiritual Sense will surge multiple times." The powerful fighters on Earth said, "That's disgusting! There's a pile of dog poop over there." Jiang Xincheng's eyes glowed green, and he lunged forward, saying, "Get away quickly! That dog poop is mine. It's actually Divine Grade medicinal mineral True God Stone. After eating it, my foundation will soar, my spirit will surge, and my Primordial Force will improve rapidly. I want to eat it…" A broken-down old man jumped into a deep-sea whirlpool to protect a divine codex. To his surprise, he died and was reborn. He returned from the Golden Age of Primordial Force cultivation on Earth to the Enlightenment Era of Primordial Force cultivation on Earth. He started to fix all the regrets and mistakes from his past life.

title: Plotting Game
summary: Contrary to his enthusiasm, Frontier—the publishing company already in a state of flux—offered a collaboration with AZ Group’s successor, Gong Ju‑heon, effectively letting go of Seo Won‑young’s lifeline. “How do you feel about working again?” “It’s… oh, it feels good.” “It’s written all over his face, but I’ll trust him since he says it’s good.” Three months passed after Won‑young decided to work with him on the publication of AZ Group’s memoirs. Nothing was as terrifying as Gong Ju‑heon holding a red pen. “And what about the last one? The beak of fear. What about Heon?” “Huh, I’ll devote myself to it.” Ju‑heon shot him a look that felt like a provocation. “I know more about Seo Won‑young than you think,” he said, his meddling interest impossible to ignore. “Well, I’m not sure. It’s true that I want to look good, after all.” The man’s innocence—speaking so plainly of wanting to be liked—finally began to stir something in Won‑young. “We shouldn’t be like this… You know that, right?” As Won‑young squeezed his eyes shut, trying to swallow down the rising tension, the hand that had been brushing his lips drifted down to the buttons of his shirt. “Is this okay?” A button slipped free beneath his fingertips. The modern romance novel The Plotting Game was released.

Gluttony: When you digest food, you can digest it faster and better. You will also get hungry faster. Strength: When you are not fighting, you will slowly regain 1% of your health. Blade-Sharpening Rock: You will gain 1 point every time you fight. Age Gracefully: Every year you live, you gain Defense +1. Armor: You will have an armor of a certain ratio every time you attack. Dao Seeds: Increase of 1% to your familiarity with cultivating the Dao. … “All sorts of passive skills are vested within me. I cultivate passively!” “As long as I can live until the end, then I will become the strongest!”

title: Immortal of the Ages
summary: As Yun Xiao’s soul soared into the heavens after his death, he made a startling discovery—the vast world in which he had lived for sixteen years astonishingly resembled a colossal tomb! Beneath it lay an ancient bronze coffin, vast as the boundless seas, radiating an overwhelming miasma. Every piece of land was but a handful of dirt atop this enormous coffin. The billions of living souls unknowingly thrived and multiplied within this graveyard soil. Inside the massive casket rested the body of an Immortal. His eyes were as deep as the underworld, his mouth reminiscent of the Yellow Springs, his hair flowed like a majestic dragon, and his body spanned across a million mountain ranges. Which celestial deity from ancient times could be resting here for eternity? Refusing to let himself fade away, Yun Xiao’s soul entered the body of the Immortal. With the world’s Divine Pillar as his sword and the vast continents as his seals, he and the coffin embark on a journey through the Immortal path, seeking enlightenment and challenging the heavens!
genres: Action, Comedy, Harem, Mature, Romance, Xianxia

title: There Are Too Many Bad Women… How Am I Supposed to Cultivate (Or Train) Like This?
summary: One morning, Li Muqun woke up to find himself reincarnated in a world of mystical cultivation. He worked diligently, cultivated earnestly, and lived an honest life. Eventually, he was accepted into an immortal sect and became an inner disciple. But little did he expect—the cultivators around him were all strange. His misandrist master insulted him, his tsundere junior sister scolded him, the scheming sect leader avoided him, the Sword Sect’s saintess ignored him, the fox maiden from Qingqiu wanted to eat him, and even the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Sect wanted to kill him…

title: City Lady-Killer
summary: Lin Tianlong, 19 years old, a polytechnic school graduate. With mastery and control over electrical energy, he displays his unparalleled sagely medical skills, accepting the hearts of beauties on the side. Starting by helping his sister-in-law's small clinic which was on the brink of closing down rise from the dead, he then proceeds to bring prosperity to a private hospital previously in a business slump. Socializing among the officials from the sectors of politics, commerce, law, literature, education, and health in Flame City, he's drawn into the power struggle between the officials. Businesswomen, doctors, and nurses, attractive policewomen, teachers, pretty loli girls, charming married women, mature beauties - all of them fall to his clutches as he establishes his business empire and a harem of beautiful women.

title: Sword and Return
summary: The Sword Demon , Yoo Baek-ryang, who had gone mad with revenge. After being branded a public enemy of Murim, he meets his final end. At the very last moment of his life, a miracle comes to him. 《Very well. I will entrust my final remaining chance to you.》 A mysterious man sends him back to the day his clan was annihilated. ‘What a perfect day to return.’ In this life, he will have no regrets. He will protect what he once lost and punish the evil that has spread across the world. As the Sword Demon takes action to set Murim right once more— a world where chivalry and righteousness have vanished— the entire world trembles.

title: Social Anxiety Has No Interest In Romance
summary: Having lived a relatively unsuccessful life due to social anxiety, Su Chengyi’s journey of self-redemption begins after his rebirth, starting with a speech at the Hundred Days Pledge Ceremony before the college entrance exams. “Don’t squander your golden age.” From that moment, the gears of fate start turning. Intersecting timelines converge, and stories of redemption and reunion unfold one after another. The tsundere childhood friend says, “I like this world because I like you.” The gentle and alluring newcomer says, “To all the Irises in the world, I am your Jin Zhi.” Unable to choose, Su Chengyi decides to face everything head-on, embracing the challenges before him. “In a century of life, all I seek is fulfillment.”
genres: Adventure, Drama, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Only The Princess Of The School Notices Me, Who Almost Does Not Exist
summary: I, Ebato Ren, am an almost invisible first year high schooler. My presence is hopelessly small, and my name is practically unknown. One day, after going back home from school, I found the “princess” of the school standing in the pouring rain, completely drenched, without an umbrella. She wouldn’t notice even when I called out to her, but luckily I was wearing a raincoat, so, I pushed my umbrella into her hands and ran. Well, no one is really aware of my existence anyway. I’ll think as if the umbrella is lost, and put it out of my mind. …or so I had thought.

title: Alien In The Field
summary: “…How is he so good at it? He’s young, and he’s not particularly good physically. Does that make sense?” The man’s question was valid. However, that question was only asked when people did not know the newly appeared Shin Seong, Yoo Ji-woo. “You don’t know Yujiu? You don’t even know his nickname?” “…What, what’s your nickname?” “The next Maradona, the future of Korean soccer, fraudulent characters, and-” The last answer was drowned out by the cheers of the audience. However, the answer was just as I heard. Because everyone was shouting that nickname in unison. “Aliens in the field!”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural

title: I am a Super Sorcerer
summary: Wu Lai was an ordinary high school student. One day he was struck by a flash of lightning from a different world, and suddenly entered a fantastic world full of magic and swords. Since then, he started a totally new life. In this supernatural world, he had his ups and downs, experienced numerous battles, subdued powerful evil beasts, and fell in love with a belle. His nickname “Demon King” was remembered throughout the ages there. Stay or return was a question. In the face of this choice, Wu Lai, with the nostalgia and gratefulness for the original world, finally chose to stay… Here was the legend of “Demon King”…
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Supernatural

title: One Thousand and Three Nights
summary: My v*rginity was sold by my family to a seventy-year-old tycoon for the steep price of one million yuan. The price was fair, all things considered. After all, I wasn't just selling my virtue; I was selling my life. On our wedding night, the old man squeezed my throat and asked, "Do you have any final wishes?" To stay alive, I told him three stories. And then, I made a prophecy. "You will die within my third story."

title: Fake It Till You Make It (and Find Your Real Family)
summary: – (True and False Daughter + Mystical Cultivation Novel + Double Strong) Su Xiwan was originally the fake daughter mistakenly taken in by the Su family. After the real daughter of the Su family was found, Su Xiwan was kicked out of the Su family. After leaving the Su family, Su Xiwan was accidentally seen by the Mu family and discovered that Su Xiwan was the missing real daughter of one of the four major families in the capital city, the Mu family. Returning to the prestigious Mu family, Mu Xiwan received the true love and favor of her parents and brother. Initially, her cousins were cold towards her, but after witnessing her continuous use of mystical and medical skills to save people, they gradually changed their attitudes towards her, making Mu Xiwan a true favorite of the family. After returning to the prestigious family, Mu Xiwan was a little busy, busy drawing talismans and busy saving people, but all the spiritual power she worked hard to earn was not as much as she got from staying with her fiancé Ye Moyan. Since then, everyone can't believe that there is a woman beside Ye Moyan, who has always been cold and aloof... Avoid pits:①: The heroine knows the mysterious arts, and the mysterious arts also run through the whole story with the heroine, but the point is not that the heroine knows the mysterious arts, but that the heroine was kicked out of the house by her adoptive parents, and after returning to her biological parents' home, she used the mysterious arts to slap everyone in the face. 2: The heroine did not receive family affection in her adoptive parents' home, so after returning to the wealthy family, she paid more attention to family affection. But the heroine only cares about family affection and will not let others bully her.

title: I’m a Broken Man Pretending To Be a Real Person, and I’m Willing To Stay Broken. My Childhood Friend Made Fun of My Classmate Who Is Writing My Favorite Novel. I Don’t Care About My Childhood Friend Anymore
summary: “He’s sick.” Mom cried when she heard the doctor’s words. I didn’t understand why she was crying. In order to keep her from crying, I pretended to be normal and recovered from my illness. I became friends with my classmates, and when we went to karaoke, they disappeared, leaving me and girl behind. I saw the girl being made fun of in the classroom, and for the first time, I took an interest in people. I tried to get involved with the girl myself. My childhood friend, who had been making fun of me behind my back, stopped me. “Hey, don’t turn into what you used to be!” “—-I’m a convenient childhood friend who pays the bills. You said you didn’t like me because I was annoying. Then stay the hell away from me.” A coming-of-age love story about a sober girl who’s a hidden novelist, and a guy who loves nothing more than drawing pictures, both of whom are trying to become manga artists!

title: Otherworldly Bar
summary: When Leon was job hunting, he applied for a position as a bartender at a rather unique bar. The customers here, however, seemed quite unusual. There was a female warrior who wore minimal armor, and it made you wonder what exactly it was protecting. Then there was an unfortunate catastrophe mage with a luck score that was negative 100 – how had she managed to get by? A melancholic and solitary Skeleton King – a skeleton? Enjoying a drink? Please, let’s not waste it! And finally, there was a Demon King who had a soft spot for a hero – but hey, if you’re a Demon King, could you at least focus on your day job? OK? This bar had an intriguing mix of patrons, to say the least.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: A Marriage Swap: My Flash Wedding with the Rough Army Officer My Stepsister Rejected
summary: Su Li, an overworked corporate drudge from the 21st century, dies suddenly after yet another late-night shift—only to wake up in the 1970s. She quickly discovers that her scheming stepsister, reborn with memories of a past life, refuses this time to marry a rough military officer. Instead, the stepsister sets her sights on a “phoenix man”—a fallen intellectual with an urban household registration. Su Li wastes no time. She seizes the chance to meet the military officer her stepsister abandoned, and sparks fly instantly. With quick wit and determination, Su Li reclaims her late mother’s keepsakes, uncovers a mysterious space blessed with a spiritual spring, and fights back against her s*umbag father and stepmother. Happily marrying the strongest and most rugged soldier in the village, Su Li faces new challenges: rumors that her husband is doomed to die young. But with her skills and newfound powers, she effortlessly turns the tide. As secrets unravel, Su Li learns she’s actually the true daughter of a wealthy family. Meanwhile, her once-rushed marriage blossoms into a sweet romance, with her “rough” soldier husband spoiling and protecting her at every turn.
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: After Receiving A Reply From My Crush, I Started Using Our Chat As A Memo
summary: Cen Yao was a fan of the world-class international racing driver Xie Yixiu. She had always treated his Weibo private messages as a memo. After all, his account had tens of millions of followers. Countless private messages flooded in every day, and he himself was notoriously aloof, so there was no need to worry that he would ever see them. After being hurt by her ex-boyfriend, she began recklessly venting in the “memo” of her male idol’s DMs: “I got dumped QAQ.” “But it’s okay. After all, I still have you as my husband, right?” “(No one will see this) (plants a big kiss) (runs away)” One second later, two replies appeared on the screen. “Who are you calling husband?” Cen Yao: !!! Cen Yao: “Is it you? Is my husband you? Is it you?!” There was no further reply. Thrilled, Cen Yao took a screenshot and sent it to her best friend, whose words instantly brought her back to reality: “It must be a staff member. How could Xie Yixiu possibly manage his own account?”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Sports

title: Emperor of the North
summary: After an ancient devilish war, when Heaven and Earth were left hanging at the brink of destruction, the aura-based cultivation system became a history and the ability to soar through the heavens became a legend forever. summary: “Don’t act like we’re close after rubbing against me all night.” Cheong-ah, who works as a counselor in the education team at Taehwa Group, keeps up her life by doing delivery work before going to the office to afford a comfortable life with her younger sibling, Myeong-ha. She had always endured any customer rudeness as long as they paid properly. But then she meets Jae-kyung, a suspicious intern who becomes obsessed with her voice. After their awful first meeting, she accidentally rear-ends his car… The deal Jae-kyung demanded instead of a settlement was an absolutely absurd proposal.

title: A Story About A Dull Otaku Trying To Commit Sui**de With A Popular Idol
summary: A dull otaku, Chiaki Haigareki, attends a su*cide party offline and meets a popular idol, Natsuki Seizabashi. She has a perfect face that shines as the number one celebrity that every girl wants to be. Her beautiful body is said to have sold hundreds of thousands of copies just by displaying her swimsuit on the front page of a popular shōnen manga magazine. At first glance, she has a special aura that makes it clear that she is a celebrity. The story is about Natsuki Seizabashi, a beautiful national treasure class-level idol, and Chiaki Haigareki, a dull high school boy, trying to commit su*cide.

title: A Lie Without a Single Trace of Truth
summary: Her name was Im Ryujin. However, Ryujin was rarely called by that name—more often by something else entirely. The names varied, but they all carried the same venom: insults laced with the speaker’s curse. It was the price that the “designated bad b*tch” errand runner at the errand center had to pay. Still, since a fitting amount of money was steadily piling up in her bank account, she was willing to endure it. But then the errand center she worked for got caught up in a lawsuit, and suddenly, Ryujin was facing compensation demands far greater than everything she had saved so far. “There’s only one thing you need to do from now on.” Just as she was seriously considering disappearing without a trace, a new client walked into the errand service, which had been collecting dust with no work. The man radiated overwhelming wealth. He was Ji Geonmu, Vice Chairman of Cheonhwa Group. “Make Wootae fall for you the same way all those other guys you’ve toyed with fell for you.” His demand was simple. She was to approach him pretending to be Vice Chairman Ji’s mistress and drag his second son, Ji Wootae’s, reputation straight into the gutter. “Wouldn’t it be entertaining to watch a guy who despises his father’s affair fooling around with that very mistress?” The payment: 500 million won. Another 500 million if she succeeded. But there was one condition. ‘Do not fall in love.’ If she violated the condition, she would have to pay a penalty five times the reward amount. After hearing all that, Ryujin thought to herself: This was practically a once-in-a-lifetime jackpot.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance

title: Sky Traversing Sword Master
summary: One sword flies through the sky, its master rises and falls. The youngster Jiang Chen fortuitously obtained a part of the Void Sword Body secret technique’s foundation, after this, his talent was no longer low, since then he walked on the legendary endless path of the martial Dao. Unrivalled fierce beasts, otherworldly mysterious creatures, legendary devilish spirits, this is merely the beginning…

title: Douluo: Manifesting the Black Abyss and White Flower at the Start
summary: Reborn in Douluo Continent with real authority in hand, Lu Jingming discovers that he can actually manifest characters from the game in his previous life. When the holy spears of black and white pierce through the iron laws of the soul master world… Let this moonlight illuminate all rivers and mountains! — Jingliu. I will ignite the sea of stars! — Firefly. female, beautiful, cute. — The Herta. Who is truly the caged bird? — Changli. The hour of midnight has arrived! — Ji Yingying. Main World: Soul Land Summoned Characters from the Games: Honkai Star Rail Genshin Wuthering Waves Etc.
genres: Action, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: Mech Battle: Full Metal Storm
summary: [Apocalypse + Giant Beasts + Mecha] Giant beasts invade, the apocalypse is upon us! Surface survivor Luo Yan awakens the mysterious Eye Technique, pilots a mecha, and confronts the giant beasts. This is a clash of metal! This is humanity’s final roar! This is a legend of heroes…
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mecha, School Life, Sci-fi, Xuanhuan

title: Two Birds with One Stone! Since I Reincarnated as a Mob in an Otome Game, I Decided to Crash the Engagement-Breaking Scene!
summary: The protagonist is reincarnated into an otome game that his friend once recommended to him. However, instead of becoming a capture target or a major character, he ends up as the third son of a minor baron—a background mob among mobs. At the academy’s graduation party, he suddenly finds himself witnessing the infamous Judgement Time event: the crown prince and the heroine condemning the so-called villainess. On instinct—and partly out of stubbornness—he steps forward, placing himself between the prince and the accused young lady, disrupting the scene that should have unfolded according to the game’s script.

title: I Can Track Everything
summary: Traveling through the Xianxia world, Chen Chen got the strongest tracking system and was able to track everything ever since. Chen Chen, "System, I am short of money." "Two meters away, your father has hidden some money under the bed. Five meters away, there is a rusty copper coin buried half a meter underground." "There is a piece of silver in the grass ahead." Chen Chen, "System, I need some luck." "The sh*t in front of the pigsty is actually not ordinary." "Go to Black Peak cliff twenty miles away to jump off the cliff." "Somewhere hidden there is a fairy cave mansion. Please explore by yourself."

title: Refusing to Please, She Becomes a Money-Spending Sensation
summary: Cheng Zhaozhao found herself transmigrated into a supporting role in a novel set in the entertainment industry. According to the plot, she would lose a 100 billion inheritance and face the disdain of the male god, becoming the target of mockery across the internet. The Licking Dog System reassured her, saying, "Don't worry, as long as you're willing to be a lickspittle, showering the audience and the male god with flattery, increasing your popularity and the male god's favor, you can avoid this outcome." And so... She participated in a romantic reality show with the male god, but none of the male contestants were willing to cook for Cheng Zhaozhao. The system advised her, "The male god likes innocent and helpless types. Show your pitiful side, host!" Unexpectedly, Cheng Zhaozhao waved her hand and hired several handsome waiters at a rate of 10,000 per hour. These waiters were well-versed in various international cuisines and treated Cheng Zhaozhao like a princess. Rather than waiting to lose her inheritance, she decided to spend it all. She enjoyed the juice served by the handsome waiters and savored the delicious meals they prepared, smirking at the camera. "Men? Ha." The male god's reaction: ??? The netizens, who had been eagerly waiting to ridicule her, exclaimed, "With such wealth, who needs a man!" She appeared on a lifestyle variety show. The system advised her, "The audience loves girls who face difficulties with optimism and a positive attitude. Quickly create a story to shape your character, host!" While other contestants tearfully shared their hardships on camera, Cheng Zhaozhao spent six million to decorate her room, maintained a disciplined sleep schedule, and led a refined and peaceful life. Haters criticized Cheng Zhaozhao, saying she was wasting so much money. In response, Cheng Zhaozhao released a video sharing her furniture collection, sparking a trend for a refined lifestyle across the internet. One hater asked, "Is there a cheaper alternative for this multifunctional ergonomic chair that Cheng Zhaozhao recommended?" The Licking Dog System sighed, saying, "I wish I could experience it too." She visited impoverished children in the mountains, and the system required Cheng Zhaozhao to display her sunny and kind side. However, she first complained about the dilapidated classrooms in the area and then donated ten million yuan. Cheng Zhaozhao repeatedly disregarded the system's instructions, leaving the system feeling helpless, "There's no chance for that achievement anymore." Later, as the system observed Cheng Zhaozhao's skyrocketing popularity and the male god's overwhelming favor, it fell into silence. One fan exclaimed, "Cheng Zhaozhao made me realize that money is more important than men. So, I dumped my s*umbag boyfriend and started my own business. Now I'm thriving in my career." Another fan shared, "Since I started shopping with Cheng Zhaozhao, I choose affordable alternatives when I can't afford something. Now, my mom and aunt praise me every day for my smart shopping decisions." Yet another fan said, "After seeing Cheng Zhaozhao's donations, I started supporting a poor student myself. I just received a call informing me that he got accepted into a prestigious university. His dream is to become a teacher, and it brought tears to my eyes, even as a grown man." ... Millions of netizens marveled, "Who is this treasure of a girl, Cheng Zhaozhao? She's an idol of positive energy!" ** In the upper-class circles of Beicheng, everyone knew that Lord Jiang disliked women who acted coquettishly, especially when they begged for his attention. Once, there was a prominent socialite who had been rejected by him. However, she showed extraordinary determination by tracking down his address and delivering breakfast to him, creating a coincidental encounter. At a later social gathering, that socialite appeared and shyly asked him to open a bottle for her. Unable to tolerate the harassment, he lost his temper in front of everyone for the first time, saying, "Don't you have hands? I can't stand women who act helpless." From then on, that socialite became a laughing stock in the circle. At another event in the future... As the gathering was about to end, Cheng Zhaozhao walked up to him in front of everyone and said, "Jiang Ting, I can't carry my bag." People stifled their laughter, anticipating Cheng Zhaozhao's embarrassment. To everyone's surprise, Jiang Ting responded readily, "Give me the bag. Are you tired from wearing high heels? Should I carry you out later?" Others: ??? The Small Trickster X The Hypocrite's Double Standards

title: Full-Time Mage: The Zhou Family’s Young Master Forcefully Marries Mu Ningxue
summary: In a twist of fate, Zhou Haoyu awakens in the world of Full-Time Mage, finding himself reborn as the heir of the prestigious Zhou family in the Imperial Capital. Even more shocking—he is the very young master bound by engagement to the icy goddess, Mu Ningxue. Everyone believes he is destined to be nothing more than a stepping stone in her dazzling path, a pawn fated for humiliation. But destiny has other plans. Hidden from the eyes of others, Zhou Haoyu begins to uncover mysterious, shimmering treasure chests—each one containing powers and legacies beyond imagination. His very first chest grants him psychic powers of spiritual telekinesis, followed by an unprecedented second awakening in the Space element. Soon, every encounter reveals a new chest… and a new fate. When he meets Mu Ningxue, a radiant golden chest appears before him, its condition shining clear, Unlock Requirement: Engagement! From there, a new legend begins— Unlocking Jiang Yu’s chest, he gains a massive boost in Summoning magic. Unlocking Mu Ningxue’s chest, he inherits a devouring Thunder Seed. Unlocking Lingling’s chest, he obtains a colossal Mind Stone. Unlocking the Ancient King’s chest, he seizes 30% of the Underworld Monarch’s authority. Step by step, chest by chest, Zhou Haoyu carves a bloody path through destiny. During the Ancient Capital Calamity, he stands alone against millions of undead, daring to plunge into the Abyss itself to seize the Ancient King’s relics. On the Tyrant Mountain Range, he crushes Su Lu beneath his fist and forcibly contracts the Black Dragon Emperor. In the Shanghai Defense War, he faces three elemental emperors at once—unbroken, unyielding, undefeated. The boy once dismissed as a tool of fate rises as a sovereign who bends fate to his will. With blades of thunder and the will of space, with black dragons roaring at his side, Zhou Haoyu steps into a legend written by his own hands. This is not the story of a pawn. This is the rise of the Zhou Family’s Young Master—the man who will shake the world of magic itself.

title: The Fox Spirit Turns Out to Be a Wolf Friend
summary: During an interview, the heroine says she likes fox spirits. Before she can finish, her husband carries her away. Later she returns and says her favorite is a wolf demon.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Became the Villainous Goalkeeper in a Novel
summary: To Kim Chan-ki, the player Hello there! It’s the goddess of soccer here (＾▽＾) Surprised, right? I was too! I can’t believe that the player Kim Chan-ki is reading the novel I’m writing~ I just wanted to turn the unlucky villain who couldn’t even see Jung Tae-woo’s face into a side character in the novel, freeze him for a moment, and make it feel like a dream... But the one freezing him turns out to be none other than Kim Chan-ki! You're so famous and incredibly impressive that I ended up using all of my precious divine points just to create you. Heh! (≧◡≦) Please don’t feel too pressured~ Even so, I only made you freeze him as an extra, but you ended up freezing Jung Tae-woo himself. Once Jung Tae-woo starts piling up achievements, my points will go up again, and I’ll be back soon. Maybe… (´・ω・｀)? *Recommended: This letter will make your heart flutter ٩(๑❛ᴗ❛๑)۶

title: God Alone
summary: In an era before the world and its inhabitants had names, God descended. He brought forth life, reason, and light... He separated the darkness and uplifted life from its watery cradle to the earth above. He bestowed language upon the ape-men, elevating them beyond mere beasts. He chose the world's first prophet, who would guide the course of civilization; the prophet's descendants would one day establish a great nation. ... In the golden age that followed, the sapient creatures strayed from God, spreading across the entire world. Many things were forgotten, and history was left to be buried by time. Yet, life is a journey of return. In the end, all will remember, that in this story, God's love preceded all existence.

title: When the Poplar Flowers Fall, the Cuckoo Cries
summary: "My surname is Yang. From today onward, I am Yang Zigui."
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Genshin Impact: Supreme Justice of Teyvat
summary: In the mystical land of Teyvat, where elemental forces collide and secrets of ancient gods remain buried, an ordinary traveler awakens to an extraordinary destiny. Armed with unparalleled ambition and a mysterious system, they embark on a quest to become the Supreme Arbiter—the ultimate authority over all creation. The world of Teyvat is no stranger to conflict, but its hidden truths are more treacherous than any battle. Beneath the veneer of harmony lies a struggle for dominance among divine beings, and the enigmatic Heavenly Principles rule from the shadows. Yet, this traveler defies fate itself, determined to shatter the chains of divine control and reshape the world. Guided by a unique power to harness and manipulate the essence of Teyvat’s elements, the protagonist builds alliances with heroes from every nation—Mondstadt’s free-spirited knights, Liyue’s calculative sages, and Inazuma’s thunderous warriors. However, their journey is far from peaceful. Ancient enemies, forbidden truths, and the ever-present gaze of Celestia test their resolve at every turn. As they ascend in power, unraveling secrets that defy the understanding of gods and mortals alike, one question looms: What does it mean to be the ultimate authority? Will they bring salvation to Teyvat, or become its greatest threat? The skies tremble, the earth stirs, and destiny itself bows before the rise of the Supreme Arbiter.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Xuanhuan

title: The Alchemist on the Sand
summary: I was selected for the beta test of the sequel to a game I enjoyed. “If it goes wrong, I can just delete it~” With a light mindset, I created my character, and now all that was left was to enjoy the game. [Tip. We wish you good luck.] A blazing sun so bright it was hard to open my eyes, and golden sand stretching beyond the horizon. Even the thick, scorching air made it hard to breathe. “Where is this place?” The moment I finished creating my character, I was dropped straight into a desolate desert. “How am I supposed to survive here?” With nothing at all, and an unfamiliar production-type job, can I really survive in this world?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Dragon Delivery
summary: Zolto Eshan, a young man from the countryside, has always hoped for a simple life. He wanted nothing more than to tend to his crops, work the fields, and care for his numerous Jamis (Jami are fluffy and hooved, ruminant creatures used for plowing fields and are known for their hearty appetites). But then, on a fateful day, out of the blue, he was presented with an inheritance from a relative he had never met before. It turned out to be a dragon delivery service business. Yes, you read that right—a business that used dragons as a means of transportation to swiftly deliver goods. Zolto, who Despised animals without fur and, Having never run a business in his life, he suddenly found himself compelled to venture into the bustling city. With no prior experience in this line of work and no previous knowledge of caring for such creatures, Zolto needed help with how to handle the situation. And then there was the matter of the massive debt that came with it. This is a heartwarming slice-of-life fantasy that follows the journey of a young countryside man as he tries to rescue and revive his dragon delivery business.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Crying Red Bean Cake
summary: Four years ago, a young girl vanished under mysterious circumstances after school. At the time, I had just lost my job and was running a snack stall outside the kindergarten gates. Word was that her parents had been waiting right outside the whole time, yet they never saw her come out. In the aftermath, the family’s grief-stricken protests and a massive compensation settlement forced the kindergarten to shut down. Four years later, I’ve changed careers and come across the case files from that day. Certain things I experienced while running that stall have started to crystallize in my mind. And those details are enough to completely overturn the entire case.

title: My Fleet Girl
summary: A Kancolle fanfic

title: Life in Another World Is Full of Twists and Turns
summary: Office worker Tsutomu Kawabata dies in a traffic accident and is offered a chance to travel to another world by a supernatural entity. Equipped with a seemingly non-cheat skill called "Magic Talent," Tsutomu is reborn as his 15-year-old self and sets out to build a harem of older women in this new world. The story follows his adventures as a rookie adventurer, battling monsters and engaging in fierce PvP fights!

title: Although All the People I Care About Have Been Taken from Me
summary: A memory from a distant past, a promise made with childhood friends. — "If you win an award, will you marry me?" Several years later, I, Hajime Aizawa, a second-year high school student, called out to my childhood friend, Miyabi, in the quiet classroom after school, intending to fulfill that promise. However, when I tried to confess my feelings, the words she returned to me were shockingly cruel. "—Senpai. I've decided to date him." "Do you... like him?" I asked, clinging to my last hope. Miyabi paused for a moment before quietly answering. "...More than you, I guess." This is my story, one where I decided not to look back at the past but to move forward, alone.

title: Male Leads, Please Love Each Other
summary: At her debutante ball after being reincarnated as a count’s daughter, she witnesses a strangely familiar scene—and suddenly remembers. This is the world of a novel she read in her previous life.The problem is that the novel is a BL story where a duke who controls the empire’s political stage, the crown prince who is every young lady’s dream, and the knight commander revered as the empire’s guardian deity all get romantically entangled with one kind, pure-hearted man…So she gives up. They’re men who were never meant to be hers anyway! Fine—go ahead, the lot of you. Fight, flirt, have your little “some,” and fall in love with each other.But then… why—?“Rosemary, I hope I’ve caught your fancy.” “My lady, please forgive my rudeness. I simply couldn’t tear my eyes away from you.” “Can I call you Rose? Please, say yes.” “Lady Rosemary… do you dislike me?” No, but seriously—why does it feel like you’re suddenly hitting on me? Don’t make things confusing. Stop it—and just love each other!

title: The Maid Dreams Of The Sunset
summary: A lowly maid and an illegitimate young master from a household. Dahlia and Isaac felt such strong attraction to each other, almost like it was fated. Isaac broke out of the cage he had been locked up in to withhold Dahlia’s happiness, after sharing their feelings and suffering. Just so that he could get her to a better position, he attempted to sought out glory. “Now onwards, I’m Duke Eufgenschult.” Isaac announced his position in front of his father’s body with a bitter smile. Now that he was the Duke, he was no longer the young master Dahlia knew. Isaac rolled his eyes at Dahlia, who was begging him to let go of her. ‘You were the one who taught me how to live. If you had to leave me, then you should have taught me how to die before doing so.’

title: I Used To Be A Porter, And Now I Have Infinite Mana?
summary: [Mana: ∞] Maybe I hit the jackpot…?

title: Rough Military Young Master Faces Extinction? She Miraculously Bears Triplets!
summary: Set in the 1970s, this story features themes of mistaken identity, rebirth, a clever little wife (playing dumb to outsmart), military life, and a magical space element. In her previous life, Zhang Yaoyao was betrayed and ruined by her childhood friend and her childhood crush! Confused and naïve, she ended up having a child with Lu Jin’an, a man rumored to have a hidden illness. Their relationship deteriorated after manipulations, leaving her alone in an empty house, on the brink of madness, while he, thinking he had been deceived, refused to return to her in the army. Things got worse: when she tried to break free from her adoptive parents’ exploitation, she discovered she had been switched at birth and was actually the real heiress of Beicheng! The life of wealth and privilege that should have been hers had been stolen by her adoptive mother and her daughter. She was so shocked that she fell down the stairs, losing her pregnancy, and was even imprisoned and tortured in a hospital. But fate gives her a second chance, and this time, she will turn the tables, raise her children, and reclaim her rightful life—giving birth to three precious children in a single pregnancy.

title: Don’t Look, Don’t Turn Back, Don’t Fall in Love with Him
summary: The first lifeline that world of strange tales gave me was simple: don't make eye contact. Its first act of malice was assigning me a partner who was far too gentle to be human. Again and again, I broke the Rules, and again and again, he bled for me, broke for me, and tore thorns from his own mouth for me. It wasn't until the final stage, when the last Rule surfaced on the wall, that I realized the one thing I truly should never have touched was never the Rules themselves. It was him.

title: Reincarnated and—Wait, I Already Have a Wife in Another World?!
summary: When it comes to another world, a harem is a given… or so I once believed. Oda Juzo, who met his end in Japan under questionable circumstances, was reincarnated with his past memories intact as Judeau Vodan, a penniless noble. Having been granted a second life, he vows to enjoy it to the fullest! And what better way to do that than by chasing the dream he never achieved in his previous life—a grand harem! …Or so he thought.
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Cat Master Is Quite Cute
summary: After her café collapsed— taking all her savings with it— she chose not to give up. Starting over as a servant, she enters a rich household that feels like a dream: blooming flowers, fluttering butterflies, and the promise of a new life. That’s when she meets him. A chubby, adorable cat— big, soft, and round like a royal dumpling. She pours all her affection into him, believing that for the first time, everything is finally going right. But the youngest master of the house is nothing like the cat. Cold. Prickly. Always pushing her away. Never letting her get close. Until one night— tears fall from his eyes, and he confesses the truth. He was the cat she held. The cat she petted. The warmth she gave him became feelings he could no longer deny. And in that moment, she realizes— the man standing before her is the very “fat cat” she loved all along. In a mansion filled with magic, a healing romance blooms— between a broken girl and a boy who learned how to love because she once held him in her arms.
genres: Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Supernatural

title: The Younger Brother Next Door is a School Grass
summary: The heavily indebted Zhou Sisi died tragically on a wine table while working. Returning to the age of seventeen, Zhou Sisi, a teenage girl with delicate features and an attractive physique, knocked on the neighbor’s door. Behind the door lived a man named Lu Xi, who was willing to spend his money to pay off her debts. Zhou Sisi would never forget the scene where Lu Xi rushed over and held her corpse in tears and kept others from approaching. Now Lu Xi was fifteen years old, with terrible achievements and stubborn cruelty. Lu Xi’s parents had a headache for their son, who didn’t like to study and work hard, so they casually asked the young girl who was good at both literature and art if she would be willing to help her son make up for the class. The little girl readily agreed without hesitation.
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Retired Hero and His Hotel Maids
summary: The retired hero Chen Ai, at the border of the empire, opened a small hotel. He thought he would spend his life peacefully. Little did he know that as soon as the hotel opened, he would encounter a formidable adversary in life! “Daring to open a hotel right across from mine, how long do you think your place will survive?” Standing before the hero was an exquisitely beautiful elven girl, along with her invincible five-star hotel. A rookie in the service industry faces off against the devil. Could opening a shop really lead to bankruptcy?! Fear not! In the name of a hero, I swear that in the end, I will turn you into my maid! A yuri elf, a former lover, an ice-cold imperial princess, and a loli with animal ears.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: My Eldest Brother Died
summary: After eight years on the run following the fall of her family, Berenice threw herself off a cliff.“Where did it all go wrong?”She had struggled desperately to clear her family’s name, but her revenge had failed, and the honor of her house remained buried in the mud.“Yes… It all began with Brother Bleddin’s death.”And when she opened her eyes again, she found herself back on the day of her eldest brother’s funeral— the very day the downfall of House Wiltierra began. “I’ll protect my brother’s honor. I won’t let anyone harm our family ever again.” Whether it was a miracle of God or a whim of fate didn’t matter. This time, she would never let the mansion burn. During her years as a fugitive, Berenice had worn countless faces to survive. She had been a merchant, a thief, and at times, an actress. So she thought her second life would be far easier than the first…But then, an unforeseen variable appeared. “The esteemed daughter of House Wiltierra is nothing like the rumors suggested.” “Why are you helping me?” “Because it seems… entertaining.” Kaiden Manus. The Second Prince of the Aegonid Empire— the very man who had hunted Berenice to the end in her previous life. Now, under the name of “ally,” he began to involve himself in her new one.

title: Wait for Me to Rise from the Coffin
summary: I guarded that coffin by the edge of the abyss for three years. Everyone said that once the Demon Lord inside emerged, I would be the first to die. But on the day the seal cracked, he crawled out of the black coffin dragging a mass of chains, only to kneel before me. He pressed my hand-covered in paper ash-against his throat and pleaded in a raspy voice, "Ji Jianqing, choose me. Don't choose my death."

title: Cool Goddess Special Agent
summary: What will happen when a wild, arrogant, and cold secret agent transmigrates into the body of a weak and timid young miss of an aristocratic family? She, Chu Ye, is the CIA agent who grabbed the outstanding title of “Agent 007” after the death of Qian Xie. However, she fell in love with the enemy during an assassination mission and died for love. She, Boling Yili, is the seventh young miss of the Boling clan, the greatest aristocratic clan of the Eastern Nation, but because of her natural timidity and cowardice and her inability to become a wizard, she was regarded by the family as a disgrace and was exiled to a small remote town, where she supposedly drowned in a pond due to su*cide. When matters are left unsettled, the heart and body will almost thirst for blood, longing for the wildness and madness and even undergoing change to the point of blurring the fine line between life and death. From the moment Chu Ye transmigrated, the Autonomous Wizard Continent better wait for they will witness what it means for the sky and the earth to turn upside down!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: Blind Sword Saint: Invincible Upon Opening His Eyes
summary: Meng Qingzhou traversed into a book and unexpectedly awakened the Blind Sword Saint System, becoming a blind sword saint. Fully aware of the book's plot, Meng Qingzhou didn't want to be a mere tool for the protagonist's face-slapping moments. So, he decided to slack off and enjoy life, spending his days gardening, walking the dog, teasing the maidservant in his leisure time, and accompanying his virtuous wife. However, little did he know: He lived in a grand palace, the coquettish maidservant was a cold and beautiful sword fairy, the flowers he tended were millennium-old divine herbs, the dog he walked was a national guardian beast, and his virtuous wife was the current Empress! The Empress went to great lengths to have everyone act in front of Meng Qingzhou, portraying an ordinary family, just so she could have a place of peace during her spare time. But unexpectedly, not only did she hide her identity, Meng Qingzhou also concealed his sword saint prowess! Rebellious vassal kings: "Dongfang Liuli, you are infatuated with Meng Qingzhou's charm, neglecting state affairs, you should be punished!" Meng Qingzhou: "Nonsense, being infatuated with my charm is my wife's official business!" Enemy envoys: "Either cede land and pay reparations, or face the destruction of your country and family!" Meng Qingzhou: "I only have a small plot of land, and you still want to take it? Sword, come forth!" When the allied nations conspired to hinder the Empress's path to unification, Meng Qingzhou rushed to the border alone, unsealing his eyes. At the moment he opened his eyes, the sword saint emerged spectacularly! Meng Qingzhou: "Is the small plot of land in front of my house really that attractive? Why do all the gods and demons come to fight over it?"

title: I Killed the Tutorial Monster One Million Times

The imperial envoy, who was on duty on behalf of the Emperor, suddenly died at Lin Fan's station. What should one do in such a situation? Lin Fan said that the imperial envoy died in his residence, and His Majesty would definitely blame him. He could not just sit there and wait for death, so he had no choice but to charge into the capital and explain things to the tyrant.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Reincarnated as an Elf Magic Swordsman: Paving a Path to His Peerless Harem
summary: Being the strongest when it comes to magic swords, being handsome and youthful, being peerless in bed, being the luckiest when it comes to women, and being from the race of the long-lived elves. Lian is reincarnated into another world with these five cheat-like traits, gifted to him by the goddess of the otherworld after his death. Using these unparalleled skills, as well as his good looks and abilities, he completed various difficult quests as an adventurer, all while seducing the beautiful female adventurers he meets along the way. In time, this quickly made him rise to the highest ranks, and he was able to build the harem of his dreams. However, the path to greatness is always a rough one, much more in another world, where everyone is never safe. After a while, Lian finds out the existence of the powerful and tyrannical dark elf, Redoni, who possesses an ancient magic weapon and has used them to destroy many countries in his wake. As the strongest magic swordsman, Lian vowed to defeat Redoni and restore the peace of this world. He gathered all his party consisting of beautiful women, whom all he has formed naughty bonds with, and together with the goddess’ powerful blessing, they began to challenge the dark elf to the biggest battle that they could ever imagine. Will Lian be able to destroy the enemy’s ancient magic weapon and save the world? Or will he fail and lose everything to his adversary? The path to an unparalleled harem of the elf magic swordsman awaits!

title: Pretty Boy
summary: “He’s my boyfriend.” One drunken night, I blurted out a lie without the slightest hesitation. The kiss I stole without permission carried the feelings I had hidden— a pitiful act of self-defense to protect a love that had ended before it even began. After that, with a hollow emptiness left in my heart, I endured my monotonous days as always. Until one day— “Hello, I’m here to share some rice cakes.” On the quiet outskirts of Seoul, in Heonin Village, the arrival of a flower shop man, more beautiful than flowers themselves, brings an unexpected change to Yeon-shi’s ordinary life. “Should we go around spreading rumors that we’re dating?” A temptation sweeter than their first kiss. A strange thrill seeps into her broken heart, knocking again and again at her chest— as if telling her, “It’s okay to fall in love once more.”

title: The Power of Women
summary: Cui Hezhou had been reborn twice, yet he still couldn't escape the fate of marrying me. By the third time, he finally resigned himself to it. He no longer abandoned me in the desolate wilderness just to save my sister first. Nor did he despise the birthmark at the corner of my eye anymore; instead, he claimed it was a mark from the heavens to help him recognize me. His resolve was as steadfast as ever. He crawled out of the slums, covered in frost and snow, and collapsed before me, waiting for me to help him up and take him home, just as I had in our previous two lives. But this time, the heavens showed mercy. It was my sister who helped him up. I, instead, picked up another little beggar-one even more wretched than he-and said with a smile that I would raise this one. Cui Hezhou stared blankly as I bypassed his outstretched hand. He must have been overjoyed-so overjoyed that he looked like he was about to cry.

title: After a Flash Marriage, The Domineering Mr. Sheng Becomes Humble and Seeks Favor
summary: Sheng Qing, as the heir of the Sheng family, at the age of twenty-eight, never touched a woman. To escape the pressure of marriage from his elders, he directly fled abroad. The only time he returned to the country, he was tricked by the two troublemakers in his family and lost his v*rginity to Miss Luo, who had just returned from the countryside. From then on, he developed a taste for it, directly moving the company headquarters back to the country and seeking favor from Miss Luo every day.

title: The Little Gluttonous Child Needs to Eat
summary: Yao Yao was born as a little glutton, her appetite rivaling half a mountain. One day, the old Taoist who adopted her passed away in meditation. At just three and a half years old, Yao Yao had no choice but to pack her small bag and head down the mountain to find her senior master. By chance, she ended up saving a wealthy tycoon from a car accident and became the adopted daughter of the prestigious Gu family. At first, everyone in the Gu family opposed the idea. The Gu family matriarch tapped her cane and said, “Raising someone else’s child? Careful not to end up with an ingrate!” The Gu family head, Gu Xuesong, said indifferently, “Picked up halfway? Who knows what kind of trouble she might bring.” From the eldest to the seventh brother, their response was unanimous: “We don’t want a sister!” But this little girl, rejected by the entire family, proved herself after joining the Gu household. She resolved the business partner issues that even Gu Xuesong couldn’t handle, bringing in so many contracts that they couldn’t sign them all. She cured the Gu matriarch’s chronic leg pain, to the point where the old lady was now striding around effortlessly… Even the seven Gu brothers, one after another, benefited greatly from her presence. It was only then that the Gu family realized they had brought home a treasure. From then on, the Gu family’s attitude completely changed. The Gu matriarch: “Yao Yao, do you want some cream puffs? Grandma will buy them for you.” Gu Xuesong: “Yao Yao, do you want a private jet? Daddy will have one sent over to take you for a ride.” The Gu brothers: “Yao Yao, do you want…” And so, Yao Yao secured herself a meal ticket—one of the highest quality!

title: Not Letting Youth Down
summary: Mom remarried and took me with her. My stepfather's family had a reckless older brother. He said to me with a sinister tone, "Welcome to hell." That very night, he threw two live mice into my room. I kept quiet and didn't tell anyone. The next day, I slipped a snake into his backpack. He ended up in the hospital. KO! From then on, we started an open and secret rivalry. But one day, he said to me, "Alright, I give up. I like you!" ? You little brat, can't you handle your own game!

title: Game’s Dogma
summary: Right when Drako Yau, the chairman and game designer of a game company, is about to release the open beta of the game which he has been developing for years, things go awry. Another company suddenly launches a game which can be played using the brainwave technology, Real World. The map, background, game mechanics, and many more; everything is almost identical to the game he has designed. Out of curiosity and bitterness, he enters the game, only to find that he cannot log out of it. He has to struggle in what seems to be a game, with his life on the line.

title: Overpowered Archmage Doesn’t Hide His Talent
summary: Archmage Kaplan possessed the body of a boy who was betrayed by his childhood friend. In the boy’s diary, he found by chance that he wanted to become a great magician. “Shall we try one more time, then?” ‘Let’s do it.’ In the end, those who are good at magic should use it well.

title: Transmigrated as a Little Chef: My Refrigerator Can Refresh Infinitely
summary: [Farming + Slow-paced + Family Life + Business + Food] Lin Yue transmigrated into an ancient era where clothing and food were scarce, and the world was in turmoil. Hellish start! Her husband had supposedly died in battle, and a ruffian barged into her home. After dealing with the thug, she fled with her two scrawny younger siblings to her husband’s family home—only to be given a drafty thatched hut. No money, no land. Fortunately, she had a golden cheat: the modern refrigerator had transmigrated with her! Steamed buns, eggs, jelly noodles, pork legs, steaks, potatoes, sweet potatoes, liquor, cola… Starting from a humble food stall, she began to make her mark in ancient times! What Lin Yue never expected was that her husband hadn’t died at all—instead, he had carved out territory for himself, ruling a region. And he was hiding a huge secret.

title: I Opened a Restaurant in a Natural Disaster Game
summary: [Management + Base Building + Farming + Food + Apocalypse] He Lingyu, a laid back introvert, had been transported into a small simulation game set in an apocalyptic world, one that focused on farming, construction, and business management. Bad news: She had no superpowers at all, and once she stepped outside the restaurant, she would become food for zombies. Good news: The restaurant could still operate, and completing game missions allowed it to level up. ** One day, a squad of ability users passed by. “Captain, why is there a restaurant out here in the wasteland?” “What kind of dream are you having? Are you so desperate for food you are hallucinating?” They turned their heads, and a huge signboard on the restaurant was flashing with dazzling light. … When the restaurant was Level 1, He Lingyu ate buns every day and wondered when she would finally get to eat meat. When the restaurant was Level 3, she stared at the roast duck in front of her and thought how nice it would be if she had hot pot. When the restaurant reached Level 5, she ate hot pot and drank milk tea, wondering when she would ever get to enjoy a full Manchu Han Imperial Feast. In the end, the restaurant successfully upgraded into the largest base in the apocalypse. Countless people wanted to join, crying and begging to work for her. He Lingyu replied, “Thanks for the interest, but all positions are filled. Why not buy a house here instead?” ** Among the nation’s bases, a legend about a restaurant began to spread. “I heard you can eat your fill there for just one crystal core?” “Not only that, I heard that if you live there, you do not have to worry about zombie attacks at all!” “You are all behind the times. They are recruiting staff now. My third aunt’s cousin’s nephew already got hired to raise pigs there!” “You are the ones who are late. I just got back. They are not hiring anymore, but they are selling housing. I finally saved enough money. If you go too late, they will all be gone!” ** When acid rain arrived, Other people: “Quick, find shelter and reinforce the defenses!” The people living in the restaurant: “It is raining today, perfect weather to stay inside, draw the curtains, and sleep.” ** When a blizzard arrived, Other people: “Quick, gather firewood and start a fire!” The people living in the restaurant: “Snowy days go best with hot pot. Let’s get another cup of milk tea too.”

title: Heaven’s Intention
summary: Living for the forest, I’m happy when glory approaches. Living for precious herbs, I’m lavish when brandishing greens. Even if I’m a root of a small herb, I do not need to be envious of the big imposing tree, towering to the sky. I can still grow vibrant. A Druid’s mind, that is my nature.

title: The General’s Love: Embracing You Through Time
summary: A lifetime is long — and regrets are inevitable. Si Cheng’s world was gray, her heart numb with disappointment. Just when she had given up on warmth and love, she reunited with her first love and childhood sweetheart, Zong Xuze. His gentle affection rekindled the warmth in her guarded heart. But right before their wedding, Si Cheng was in a car accident — and woke up back in her middle school years. At this point in time, her parents hadn’t divorced yet, and her dysfunctional family hadn’t completely crushed her fragile self-esteem. All she wanted now was to study hard and escape the clutches of her toxic mother. The deepest pain often comes from the ones closest to you. Though they were mother and daughter in this life, they seemed more like bitter enemies. Trapped in a cage of pain, Si Cheng was fortunate to once again have the powerful yet gentle Zong Xuze by her side — helping her through it all.
genres: Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Divine Doctor Descends the Mountain, I Have Five Enchanting and Exceptional Female Masters

title: A Nobody on the Path of Immortal Cultivation? No! A Little Genius at Farming
summary: The Li family of Peach Blossom Village is a great farming clan. Li Xi has finally turned ten years old and received her first spirit field in life. In the first year, she practices simple tasks like planting spirit rice and raising spirit fish. Doing anything with family is always joyful! 1: When the village’s spirit wheat fields are troubled by pests, Li Xi’s family already has small spirit chickens at work in their field. All the insects become food reserves for the spirit chickens. Watching the brave little spirit chickens, Li Xi has a sudden idea: “Second sister-in-law, let’s send these spirit chickens to work in the village and earn insects!” 2: At night, while Li Xi is cultivating, unexpectedly, her cultivation progress has its own ideas. Her cultivation level increases on its own and breaks through to the next level. Li Xi thinks: “Being the beloved daughter of the Heavenly Dao is terrifyingly amazing for a limited time experience!”

title: My Husband has Five Personalities
summary: Tang Mingyue transmigrated into a book as the wife of an overbearing president. She went bankrupt as soon as she transmigrated. The former handsome and powerful businessman was stimulated by the bankruptcy, and his mental state becomes…defect. Tang Mingyue originally wanted to divorce him, but she couldn’t bear to abandon him alone because of his situation. Forget it. Let’s wait until his “madness” gets better. So, she tried to use various methods to earn money in order to treat his disease. One day, she accidentally had a relationship with one of Xiao Zifeng’s personalities. D*mn it! So, she will have to have a relationship with each of his personalities to cover up her possible pregnancy? She doesn’t want ah! title: Japanese-style Sengoku Survival ~ Survive the Sengoku Fantasy ~
summary: One day, the Earth's axis tilted slightly, causing drastic climate changes that resulted in the submergence of continents and islands while new land emerged. The surviving Japanese people settled on the newly formed islands created by undersea uplifts, where powerful feudal lords vied for supremacy in a manner reminiscent of the Sengoku (warring states) period. The protagonist, Minazuki, was born as the son of a feudal lord and began his journey to become the supreme ruler.

title: After Becoming a Mother Painlessly, I Discovered that my Children are Villains
summary: Su Sanxian, a humorous woman in the online world who was skilled both in writing and martial arts, suddenly died from overwork after many nights of live-streaming and woke up inside a novel. She became a mother without pain—a crazy mother of three little villain children. The truly crazy kind. She didn’t drool, but she did hit people. Su single since birth Sanxian, who had been raising more than ten kids virtually: “Thanks.” But the three kids were pure and adorable. Su Sanxian fell for them at first sight. What could she do? Of course, she happily raised them. Lin Shen had taken care of the insane Su Sanxian for four years. Just when he was prepared to look after her for the rest of his life, Su Sanxian got better. Lin Shen said, “Wife~ snuggle~” The eldest son: “…” The second son: “…” The third son: “…”

title: Synthesis Wizard
summary: After crossing over into the game world he had played before, Su Nan finds himself as a nobleman who has lost his title. At this time, the continent is still a barren wasteland of elements; powerful wizards abandoned this world a thousand years ago to explore the multiverse, becoming little more than elusive legends. Only Su Nan knows that, a thousand years later, the elements will revive, the wizards will return, and the continent is about to enter a prosperous era of magic. So, his task is quite simple: work hard to cultivate and become a wizard, surviving until the age of wizards arrives! “Resource-poor?” “There’s nothing for it; I’ll just have to synthesize everything myself.” Su Nan opens the synthesis cube. This is the story of a traveler with a player panel and a synthesis cube, leveraging a slight advantage of foresight to make a name for himself in a foreign world.

title: Outlier Skill [Storage], Proficiency Level 9999 – The Strongest Cheat Awakened After 60 Years of Hard Work
summary: In a world where skills manifest at the age of 15. Ash, who wants to become an adventurer, and Martina, a childhood friend, are baptized. But his skill is [Storage], which is considered a great disappointment. Martina, on the other hand, has the S-rank skill [Holy Warrior]. They go on adventures together, but the distance between them is growing. Finally, Ash promised to catch up with Martina and they parted ways. After that, Ash's situation remained unchanged, and Martina rose to become the queen of the nation. Time has passed and 60 years later—Ash's [Storage] skill, which has reached proficiency 9999, awakens.

title: I Didn’t Want to Become the Emperor of This World
summary: At first, I just wanted to survive. To do that, I had to seize power. So I seized it. I had no choice but to abandon some conscience and morality. The power I had grasped came with responsibility. And to survive, I had to fulfill that responsibility. The crown upon my head was heavy, and the path before me was a th**ny road. But once I could bear the weight of the crown, and once calluses formed on the soles of my feet so that walking the th**ny road no longer hurt—I became the emperor of another world. No, I became the emperor of this world.

title: Hands Off My Doctor
summary: After Song Jinhe's childhood friend climbed into his passenger seat yet again, I didn't make a scene or start a fight. I just quietly went to the back and sat down next to his best friend, Chen Jingchuan. As the car jolted over a bump, my knee grazed the man's firm, taut thigh. I deliberately didn't pull my leg away. He didn't shift, either. We stopped at a service station partway through the trip. The childhood friend clung to Song Jinhe, insisting he go with her to the restroom. The instant the car door shut, Chen Jingchuan caught the back of my neck and kissed me. Dazed and undone, I couldn't help but think. Question them. Understand them. Become like them-turns out that really is the truth.

title: After Divorce, Bewitching Female CEO Pursues Me

He originally intended to accompany her through thick and thin, but four years later, Su Wanyun, now a CEO with her company going public, finds him lacking ambition, leading to their divorce. Shortly after the divorce, he attracts the pursuit of the first lady CEO of a wealthy family.

title: Brother’s Silly Girl
summary: "Brother, when I grow up, will you marry me?" "No way!" "Why?" "Because you're too silly, and you're as chubby as a Russian doll..." The words of her neighbor, Zheng Yuanxi, echoed in her ears, making it hard for Jian Shuning to forget. He was smart and outstanding, starting his own business from scratch and becoming the CEO of a company at a young age. In contrast, she hadn't changed much since she was a girl, still plump, and now she was unemployed... She had admired him since she was little, but he often didn't give her a pleasant look and spoke harshly. But she knew he was tough on the outside but soft on the inside, otherwise, he wouldn't have taken her in when she sought refuge at his place. However, living under the same roof, he didn't seem to spark any romance with her. Sadly, the beautiful neighbor and colleague seemed to be a better match for him. Sigh... Was she destined to be a wallflower in someone else's love story? Unexpectedly, it seemed like fate was giving her a chance. On that eerie stormy night, because of that cup of sake said to make wishes come true, she actually swapped bodies with the beauty?!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Master is an Extreme Job
summary: In front of him floated a glowing blue orb—and a boy who looked about ten years old. He reached out his hand toward the child. “You…?” Then it happened. A sharp pain, as if his heart were being torn apart, struck him all at once. At the same time, a voice echoed in his head: [My name is Yuta, Master.] “It was… a dream? But it felt so real… every detail was alive…” Taegang took deep breaths, trying to calm himself, but suddenly his face turned pale. “W-What’s going on? Am I still dreaming? Or have I completely lost it?” Something strange was floating above Instructor Kim Ki-cheol’s head. [Kim Ki-cheol, 42 years old.] It looked just like a transparent pop-up window from the internet—clearly showing the instructor’s name and age inside.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mature, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: I Am the Light of Science and Technology
summary: Everyone thought that the most powerful scientist they had ever seen was a national treasure-level scientist until they saw Baizhi- The light of technology, a cosmic scientist. [Congratulations to the host Bai Zhi for completing the task perfectly and winning the titles of “New King”, “Big Devil”, “Task Killer”, “Nightmare on Earth”, “Super Species” and so on!] After her death, scientific researcher Bai Zhi, in order to explore higher-dimensional technology, bound the most rubbish Wish system from the system world, and traveled through different worlds to fulfill the wish of the original owner. Three thousand worlds are different. In each world, she is keen on scientific research. This is a story of a scientific researcher who concentrates on scientific research, explores high-dimensional science in various worlds, and refuses to admit defeat and fate.

title: I’m The Masked Knight
summary: ~He's a transforming hero mixed in with the magical girls~ Ten years have passed since the birth of magical girls, and the world has been captivated by the battles they've been posting on "Maji Maji," a video site specializing in magical girls! Meanwhile, a young man becomes a transforming hero through a series of unexpected events, and ends up joining the magical girls on their battlefield!
