title: She’s Not A Saint, But A Fairy
summary: 'Seonnyeo-ya. You resemble me, so you must help people.' Faced with Mom's teaching, I always resolved. That I wouldn't live as a shaman like Mom. The place I arrived after ultimately dying trying to escape the gods, Was a Western romance fantasy world where such resolutions were unnecessary! But... [Can you hear my voice? From now on, you are the Saintess appointed by us!] No, why are the gods here calling me Seonnyeo (Fairy/Saintess) again! [His deceased grandmother is hovering around that man.] "Our James, have you been well?" "G-grandmother...?!" Showing off a flamboyant wrist snap, I swung the bells. "That woman you plan to marry... Absolutely not!" In my past life, I rejected this kind of life, even dying because of it. Why on earth am I doing this...? Besides, I went to meet the Emperor as the gods instructed, and the killing intent he exudes is no joke. "Claiming to be the Saintess, who appears only in ancient legends. It's not even child's play." ...To prevent the world's destruction, I have to persuade this man? Why, of all people, someone who detests religion!

title: Reborn During the College Entrance Examination: Take a Rough Man to Become Rich
summary: In her previous life, Yu Zhi was resentful when her best friend set her up to marry a rough man from the countryside. Failing the college entrance examination and losing hope of returning to the city caused a lot of trouble in the family. She was happy to get a divorce and return to the city, only to be greeted by one disaster after another. The sinister faces of her kind-hearted uncle and cousin were finally revealed. The rough man she had resented for ten years was burned beyond recognition to save her. In the end, she died tragically after failing to get her revenge. But she came back. She was reborn during the college entrance examination, so it was not too late. Her unfinished revenge from the previous life would continue in this life. The people she could not have the chance to love and cherish in her previous life, she would love them wholeheartedly in this life. But she just did not expect that… Her deceased father would return with honor. Her missing mother would also return in a high-profile manner. Her father-in-law and his father, who had disappeared without a trace and had been gone for over twenty years, were both alive and powerful. Her husband was a great talent, her son was a genius, her daughter was a military talent, and she would become the darling of the whole family.

title: When You Pick Up a Suspicious Push-Over
summary: Q. What would you do if you picked up a suspicious pushover? A. I’d observe him for a bit, and if he seems fine, I’d train him to be husband material.Q. What if he’s dangerous? A. It’s okay. I’m stronger.I picked up a suspicious man in my backyard — dangerous-looking, yet radiating that unmistakable “pushover” vibe. He was completely clueless about the world and lacked common sense, but he did have an impressive face.I tamed this beastly man, coaxing and teaching him to act human. Then I went a step further — trained him exactly to my taste, shaping him into the perfect future husband.But not long after, some men came looking for him… and they looked important. “We’ve come to escort you, sir.” Apparently, my “pushover” wasn’t so ordinary after all. It was obvious things would get complicated if I got involved any further…So, as much as it pained me— I’d have to let this man go. When he saw the empty house, Jayden realized instantly. Elaina was gone. [Jayden, please live well there. I can’t accept you as my lover.] The words in her letter—words he didn’t want to believe—had become reality.The moment he understood that she had abandoned him, his heart pounded violently. He hurriedly pulled the blanket draped over the sofa around his shoulders.It was the same blanket Elaina always covered him with whenever he felt cold. But it wasn’t as warm as before—only the chill grew stronger.The world without Elaina was unbearably cold. “Why… did she abandon me?” No, there was no need to think about it.Wherever she was, whatever her reasons were— They couldn’t be apart.Because by her side was where he belonged. If she abandoned him, he’d just chase after her… and never let her go again.

title: 70s Military Marriage: Rejecting the Abstinent Rough Man 99 Times
summary: Ye Xuanhan, who had survived for ten years in the apocalypse, traveled to the 1970s when supplies were scarce. Along with her came the Lingquan Space filled with billions of supplies. The original body was a poor girl. After her parents passed away, she was not only bullied by her relatives, but also framed by her childhood sweetheart. As a trouble-making little green tea girl, Ye Xuanhan does not allow anyone to take advantage of her. If anyone dares to provoke her, she will take her space to that person's house and sweep it out, emptying their belongings. Who made them not behave like human beings? Ye Han will take revenge on all those who like to make trouble. Only by learning to take the initiative can you live freely. But who could tell her why the original owner had a fiancé who was a battalion commander? Just kidding, she still has to work hard.

title: For You Who Hate Autumn
summary: ―"Hey, do you really understand what you're saying?" "For You Who Hate Autumn" / Miraiya Tamaki “I really hate autumn (Aki),” The person walking beside me—Fuyushima-san—said that out of nowhere. By the way, my name is written as "亜季" and read as "Aki," which also means "autumn." Of course, I don’t think there was any deep meaning behind what he said, but it wasn’t exactly pleasant either.
genres: Completed, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: After I Let Go, My Tormentor Dug Her Own Grave
summary: My roommate, Whitney, was determined to make a documentary about a mentally ill patient with a history of homicide. To get a deeper look into his world, she was even planning to visit his home—alone. I warned her it was too dangerous. A patient with intermittent psychotic episodes was unpredictable; he could snap at any moment. She listened to me, for once, and dropped the project. But then her campus rival found the same patient, made a nearly identical film, and won a major international award. Whitney blamed me for robbing her of that success. During a trip to a beach resort, she held my head underwater while we were swimming. “It’s your fault, Kylie! That award should have been mine!” she screamed. She had no idea, of course, that the patient later had another breakdown and killed the very person who interviewed him. When I opened my eyes again, I was back in our dorm room. Whitney was shoving a printed proposal under my nose, her eyes blazing with excitement. “Kylie, tell me this isn’t absolutely brilliant? This is my ticket to winning that award, right?”

title: Mamatomo ke Sodateru Rabukome
summary: Raising kids with Joshikosei is a busy but rewarding everyday life! Kuremoto Kyota is a high school student who loves his 3 year old sister. His parents worked together to do housework and take care of the children. Akiyama Sumi is a lonely girl with beauty and a clear mind. She distanced herself from everyone because of her aura. One day, Kyota, who was attending the park’s acceptance ceremony sister’s kindergarten, surprised to find Sumi taking pictures of her sister like a cameraman. “Iku, how cute…” Turns out she’s a brocon too! Knowing that they take care of each other’s younger siblings, they gradually begin to deepen their relationship. Cooking, picking up sister at kindergarten, weekend dates. Yes, the relationship between the two is exactly like “Mamatomo”. Romcom child rearing has begin!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Zenith
summary: In her past life, Janice was betrayed by her comrades and her organization, and died. In this life, unlike her unfortunate past, she was born into a powerful count’s family that dominates the North— but she’s so steeped in distrust of people that she views even this fortune with cynicism. However, when her childhood friend Flora falls in love for the first time, even Janice, who had always chosen to remain a bystander, begins to change. Sigh… love—what’s so great about it that it makes you cry like that? “If you want it, I’ll make it yours. So do something about those dull, vacant eyes.” While scheming every possible plot to help her friend’s love come true, she begins to encounter a series of increasingly mysterious incidents… “It’s your fault. Why were you standing in my friend’s way? You should’ve known to get out of the way yourself.” She has no desire to meddle in other people’s affairs— but once she steps in, she has to see it through to the end. The story of Janice Lintbell—talented, strong-willed, and impossible to ignore!

Otherwise, both you and Qingming Mountain will be annihilated!” Looking around at her empty home, Ye Zhishu thinks: “Might as well just die again.” But life goes on, and she decides to survive in style. Ye Zhishu sets up an online stall, offering ghost hunting, fortune-telling, and protective charms—as long as the money comes, everything is negotiable! Soon, clients start pouring in: A popular streamer: “Master, master, can you tell me if I’ll survive my ghost house adventure this time?” A rich second-generation heir: “Master, will my girlfriend finally be human this time?” A wealthy CEO: “Master, my aunt has gone missing!”

While others struggled to survive in dire circumstances, she and her monster dad busily planted melons and beans in their own territory, eating until their bellies were round. While others fought desperately against mutated flora and fauna, she and her monster dad amused themselves with monkeys and chased chickens in their self-cultivated farm, relaxing as if on vacation. As for mutated man-eating monsters? The three-year-old child raised her fists and violently pummeled them into submission! Then, somehow, they ended up establishing a chaotic neutral safe zone (more like a small shop for agricultural by-products). (This is a slice-of-life farming story about an ordinary human child and her eldritch elder dad striving to live well in a post-apocalyptic wasteland world. The female lead has no romantic pairing.)
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Return To 1990
summary: Self-made billionaire Lu Feng, 35 and single, is transported into the body of someone who has the same name but is living in 1990! He is confused when he looks at his daughter and his beautiful wife in a grim apartment which was miserable as per his standards. The person whose body he has gotten into is a useless, unemployed s*um who used to commit domestic violence on a regular basis! What is going on here? Is this a dream? What happened that night? Did I drink myself to death? Rebirth? Now, Lu Feng is enthusiastic to get his new family out of this rut by helping his previous life mentor, and also reach the paramount of wealth. This is the story of Lu Feng and his return to the year 1990 with his memories of a 2020’s billionaire!

title: My Villainess Older Sister Is Obsessed With Me
summary: A villainess fated to fall—Ophelienne. And I became her little brother.

title: Doctor Goes Back to Joseon
summary: The undisputed greatest doctor in Korea, Baek Gang Hyuk. He falls back in time to Joseon after touching a strange painting

title: God of Medicine
summary: A fateful encounter between ordinary surgeon Yoon Tae-sik and the visionary Blue Envelope Book of the medical immortal Hwa-tao. "With this, I can save more people!" With his insight into every patient, there's no illness he can't cure. With a divine scalpel in one hand and a divine needle in the other, the harmony of Eastern and Western medicine begins with him!

title: The Frenzy Of Evolution
summary: After an unprecedented virus storm hit the world, the world became a wasteland. When desire loses its shackles, the only rule is the strong eating of the weak. When life loses weight, only evolution is the only way back. On December 21, 2012, the surviving humans opened their eyes and found that the world was in ruins, like hell. However, the moment Duan Fei opened his eyes, he found himself in heaven!

title: My Fiancé Cheated On Me, So I Had No Choice But To Break Off The Engagement
summary: At a night gala held for young aristocrats, my eyes chased one young girl surrounded by heaps of single men. Her name was Lulu Camell, and she was the second daughter of the Count of Camell, boasting radiant golden hair and emeralds for eyes. She was also Ruben Berner’s fiancée—my fiancée, two years younger than myself. An engagement is also a contract between two families, and the weight of breaking off a marriage instead of dissolving it is much heavier. For my part, I wanted to dissolve in the most peaceful way possible, but… I had no choice but to make up my mind.

title: My Wife Is Too Wild, the Rebellious Young Master Begs for Cuddles in Tears
summary: [Marriage first, love later + sweet love story + heroine trains her husband] [Fair-skinned and beautiful queen x rebellious self-strategy to win over the prince] To reclaim her company, Shen Qingci swiftly married Xi Xingye, the notorious heir of the Xi family. A three-year-old in Beijing could recount Xi Xingye's misdeeds. It's said that he once lost all eighteen of the Xi family's companies overnight and mortgaged over one hundred of his biological father's properties. He sent wreaths to his stepmother and tablets to his father, and kept fifteen dogs named after his enemies, whom he bossed around the house. So, on their first day, Xi Xingye naturally sneered at Shen Qingci and laid out eight rules for her. First, no physical contact. Second, no interference in his private life. ... And eighth, divorce after one year, leaving her empty-handed. Shen Qingci readily agreed. However, a year later, outside the Civil Affairs Bureau—the dandy young man had put away his flashy pink luxury car, donned Shen Qingci's favorite suit jacket, and rubbed his arms against her thighs. "Wife, I want to be intimate, just for a minute." "Wife, other people's wives care about their drinking, why don't you care about mine!" "Wife, you can beat me if I'm so excessive!" "Wife, I was wrong, I'll give you all my property, but don't divorce me, okay?"

title: Novoland: YuChuanShuo
summary: In the ancient and magical land of Novoland, there exists such a group of magical beings : they are light in body, and they can retract their wings and fly high on the night of the full moon. They are called the Winged People. This is a story of the rise and fall of the Winged Dynasty. The Yi clan, descendants of the second dynasty of the Winged clan, and the Feng clan, descendantspowe of the first dynasty, conspired to overthrow the rule of the third dynasty and restore their kingship. However, due to the implementation of the unpopular "Jian Kong Decree", the Yi clan divided the Winged People into nine classes, which caused the resentment of the lower Winged People, eventually leading to riots and the establishment of a new dynasty. However, the new Winged King was weak and conservative, and the Winged clan gradually declined under his leadership. At this time, the Ye Chen Legion of the Human Race annihilated the elite of the Winged Race, the Hexue Tuan, wiping them at once by taking advantage of the "Changing Time of The Moon" event that only happens once in a thousand years. Now, the Hexue clan has become ancient history, and the technique of Hexue Yongxiang became an ancient myth. Xiang Yi Zhi and Feng Ling Xue met in such a troubled world. One of them is a descendant of the Dark Moon, born with black wings, and his flight will always announce the coming of disaster, hatred, and war. Facing the various coups and wars, is it love or conspiracy? Is it justice or selfishness? At the beginning, the lovers who walked through the wind and snow together will finally be able to enter the spring together...

title: I Transferred to a New School and Ended up in the Same Class as Three of My Ex-girlfriends
summary: Rukawa Aoto has had former girlfriends. In kindergarten, a promise with Kisaragi Noa, “When we grow up, let’s get married, okay?” In elementary school, a promise with Yozakura Koharu, “Will you be my husband in the future?” In junior high school, a promised to Onodera Himari, “Hey, can I always be next to Aoto?” In each of those times, he dated each of them, but they all ended in “natural extinction.” Aoto now has no girlfriends, and when he has to change schools for his parents’ reasons, he ends up with no friends. “My name is Rukawa Aoto. Nice to meet you.” This is the first time I introduce myself, the first time I meet my classmates. Nothing but nervousness, but first impressions are important. When I look up, my peaceful, peaceful school life begins. First, making friends — wait, Eh!!?? All three of my ex-girlfriends are in the same class! And they all seem to still “like” me! And what’s more, they were the top 3 cutest girls in the grade! “Because he’s my Aoto.” “He is my Aoto-kun.” “He’s my Aoto, after all.” From that day on, the three ex-girlfriends, who had ended up disappearing spontaneously, started a big love war to compete for Aoto–?!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: [The King’s Avatar] as a Game Planner, I Guide the Players
summary: Premise Ye Xiu is widely recognized as the “Glory Textbook,” one of the greatest players in the game’s history. However, at the start of the story, he is forced to retire from his professional team, Excellent Era, due to internal politics and commercial considerations. Left with nothing—no team, no account, and no place to stay—he takes a job at an internet café. A New Beginning At the internet café, using a newly created, unspecialized character named Lord Grim (with the weapon Myriad Manifestation Umbrella), Ye Xiu begins his climb from scratch on the new 10th Glory server. His deep understanding of game mechanics allows him to quickly dominate the leaderboards, attracting attention throughout the Glory community

title: My Beast Can’t Be a Demon God
summary: Beastmaster, but the spirit pet is a weed. [Ding! Congratulations to the host for awakening the world-saving system.] [Our ultimate goal is to kill the beastmaster named Zhou Lu in his cradle and save the entire world.] Zhou Lu: "???" [The spirit beast he trains will become a world-destroying demon god. All living things will wail beneath its vines. Please use all means to stop him.] Zhou Lu looked at the blade of grass fighting a bee. Weak, pitiful, and helpless. You call this a demon god?

title: What if the the Ugly Duckling Wasn’t a Swan But a Dragon?
summary: The story of a dragon raised as a duck. As the title says, it’s the story of the fairytale「The Ugly Duckling」with the protagonist as a dragon instead of a swan.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Unbridled Etiquette
summary: As the little princess of the Qinghe Group, Jiang Zhili grew up spoiled and doted on by her parents and two older brothers, molded into a bold and unrestrained character. Yet after hiding the Jiang family’s prestige to carve her own path in the entertainment industry, she had to temper her sharp edges, relying solely on her deceptively innocent and sweet face to win favor. Miraculously, she managed to thrive, achieving her desires and rising to prominence. However, when the boyfriend the public perceived as her pillar of support suddenly cheated, a torrent of misfortunes followed. This drove her to set her sights on Xiao Yannan—the decisive and formidable heir to the Desheng Group, who had recently returned to the country with formidable capital and a reputation no one dared challenge.

title: Attending Court for My Husband, Listening to My Thoughts, Eating Melons, and Laughing Heartily
summary: [Mind-Reading + Gossip + Sweet and Lighthearted + Romantic Pairing] Shen Mingzhu accidentally fell into the water, transmigrated, and bound herself to a Gossip system. Before she could enjoy any gossip, she first learned that she had transmigrated into a book! In the book, she is a villainous side character, and even her mother and brothers are destined to be cannon fodder. How can this be! Gua Gua: Host, the emperor's true love is the empress, and his precious treasure is the Crown Prince. You've been betrothed as the Crown Princess! Shen Mingzhu: What? The beautiful, strong, and tragic character is my fiancé? Watch me turn him into a heartthrob! Gua Gua: Host, your maternal grandfather and two older brothers are about to be sacrificed! Shen Mingzhu: No! Watch me expose the traitor and sweep through the enemy army! Gua Gua: Oh, Host, Chaoyang Princess's Imperial Son-in-Law is having an affair with a maid, and they've pulled a 'civet cat swapping the princess' scheme. Shen Mingzhu: Poor Chaoyang Princess! Should I tell her so she can thrash the s*umbag couple?! Crown Prince Yan Beichen woke up one day to find himself with a little Crown Princess. Wherever she went, she was eating melons, immersed in the joy of gossip every day. Hey, hey, hey! Crown Princess, I'm the Crown Prince! Could you please pay some attention to me! Unwittingly, the entire Great Yan Dynasty began to treat Shen Mingzhu with the utmost courtesy. Shen Mingzhu: Gua Gua, I accidentally became a heartthrob! Hehe~~~ Yan Beichen: My Crown Princess is a heartthrob! I'll wave the banner for my Crown Princess! Gua Gua: ...Host, you're amazing
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Wind Heard Her Confession
summary: Synopsis: Lin Yuran never would have thought that the client sitting across from her, forcing them both to work together, was the high school classmate she had rejected long ago, Chi Ye. The two maintained a distant yet courteous relationship, keeping their distance as they worked together. However, Lin Yuran gradually felt something wasn't quite right. For example, why did this man insist on her working at his company instead of her own studio? And moreover, how come her office just so happened to be directly opposite his? Another instance, when Lin Yuran accepted a ride in another man's Rolls-Royce Phantom, Chi Ye only sighed, "I thought I'd never get to ride a luxury car like this in my life." The very next day, Chi Ye's car changed to a Bentley, then Bugatti, followed by Koenigsegg... Another time, Lin Yuran accidentally stumbled upon Chi Ye's Baidu profile and discovered that her favorite lollipop factory was registered under his name. But rumor had it that the factory closed five years ago, and that some mysterious big shot loved eating these lollipops, so he bought the factory and continued production regardless of profit or loss, no matter what the situation. Numerous clues led Lin Yuran to suspect— Chi Ye still liked her? Little did she know, even their second encounter was part of his plan. Yet Chi Ye remained unaware that on that sweltering afternoon six years ago, Lin Yuran had quietly watched his lonely figure from afar and murmured softly, "If we meet again someday, I hope I can respond to you." That year, only the wind heard her confession.

title: Sister’s Revenge
summary: I am the Concubine-born Daughter of the Prime Minister's Mansion. When the nation was in peril, as I fled for my life, I shared my rations with a beggar by the roadside, while my legitimate elder sister led our family to seek refuge with the general. Later, the beggar led an uprising and seized power, and I was made empress, honored as the mother of the nation. But my legitimate elder sister was reduced to a camp prostitute, forced to receive hundreds of men each day, living a fate worse than death. Living my life over again, my legitimate elder sister slapped the sesame cake from my hand and handed her exquisite pastries to the beggar: "Eat. If it's not enough, there's more here."

title: I am Wizard
summary: Ban Tae-soo, who lost his memories before the age of 17, became a wizard. While running a cafe and leading a peaceful life devoted to magic research, he arrives at a parallel world. As he goes back and forth between the earth and the parallel world, he goes through various events and approaches the secrets of the world little by little…
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Silent World
summary: Hadori Kento is a normal high school student whom can be found anywhere in the world, but "he" actually is not so normal. Kento holds a certain secret—he has the ability to accelerate himself to extraordinary speeds. Why he has this ability and for what he should use it, he himself does not know yet. Without finding the answer, he spends his life very peacefully... that is until he meets a person with the same ability. The person he meets is a serial slasher called "Silent Killer."

title: Manual for Using a Chaebol Lover
summary: “Let’s get married.” “You can’t mean… marriage as payment for saving your son?” “That’s about right.” Han Yeong-seo—born the black sheep of the Han family, forever branded the unwanted child. Despite her remarkable talent, endless obstacles and sabotage kept her from the spotlight, leaving her to scr*pe by as an unknown actress, doing odd jobs just to survive… Until one day, trapped in a hotel storage room, she saves a handsome little boy. Who would have guessed that this child’s father is none other than Yoo Si-hyuk—the illegitimate son of Korea’s top conglomerate, a man as famous for his chiseled, sculptural looks as for his icy demeanor! And with those cold eyes, he suddenly demands: Marry me, in exchange for saving my son. What kind of outrageous deal is that? Perfect from head to toe, yet hopeless when it comes to human relationships, Yoo Si-hyuk barges into her life. And from the moment Yeong-seo meets this complicated father-and-son pair, her world begins to change, little by little…

title: Beyond the Bullet Screen
summary: Yet another cold war with Zhou Xiao had begun. I was just about to send him a long, emotional essay to make amends when a stream of bullet comments suddenly flashed across my vision: [Here we go, here we go. The male lead's buddies egged him on to give the female lead the cold shoulder again. He's so s*upid.] [The male lead steps out from under his friends' "umbrella" only to realize it isn't even raining. LMAO.] [Keep playing games. Once he actually breaks up with the female lead, his friends will be tripping over themselves to get in line for her.] [Female lead, look at the male lead's childhood best friend-the one who supposedly hates you the most. If you so much as smile at him, he'd give you his life.] I froze. Skeptical but curious, I deleted my draft and sent a different message instead: "Happy breakup." A second later, my Moments feed exploded with likes.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: My Inseparable House Guests
summary: Yo, Hi! I’m Frank, I made a deal with a demon to pay me some money for receiving a guest for a few days every week. I had no idea about what I have done. On May 1st, Conan ‘the God of Death’ came to my house. I was forced to let him in and we get involved in a criminal case. On May 8th, Bruce Wayne ‘Batman’ came to me. I was forced to follow him to fight crime. On May 16th, Hannibal Lecter, The Silence of the Lambs, came to my home. I can only say that I really can’t stand my guests.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Romance, School Life, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: The Relaxed Journey of the Bag Hero in Another World ~ Exiled from the Royal Castle as a Failed Hero and Dropped into the Abyss. But in reality, the bag can absorb anything and was a cheat weapon that could order anything from Japan. There’s no intention to go back even if they beg for forgiveness now.
summary: One day I, Keisuke Sakudaira, a high school student, was summoned to another world as the “Bag Hero”. However, I was expelled by the queen who summoned me because she said a bag wouldn’t be useful. Later, I was thrown into the most difficult dungeon where I thought I would die. But… “Huh, this bag can store both attacks and monsters!?” “Huh!? I can summon food and drinks as much as I want!?” Surprisingly, this bag… was a cheat. Freed from the task of defeating the Demon King, I embarked on a leisurely journey through this different world with this cheat bag in hand.

title: For Those Returning Bastards a Beating Is the Best Remedy
summary: "Those returnee bastards need a good beating. The higher-ups just don't get it." The absolute supreme ruler who commanded the world, the hero who saved it, the witch who schemed in the city's shadows. All those returnee bastards are ticking time bombs, but there's one key difference. Unlike bombs, they quiet down in the face of violence.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Tragedy

title: The Land of Shadows and Fire
summary: The Land of Shadows and Fire follows Im An, a courageous woman betrayed by her closest friend and thrust into a mysterious, magical realm. In this new world filled with danger, ancient powers, and dark secrets, she meets Jin, a skilled warrior with a painful past. Together, they battle the Shadow Army led by her betrayer, uncover hidden truths about their destinies, and fight to restore balance to the realm. Along the way, Im An learns the meaning of strength, forgiveness, and love, transforming from a victim of betrayal into a powerful force of hope and fire.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural

title: Undying God of the Underworld
summary: He was an illegitimate child, prophesied to be a once-in-a-century genius Mage in his family. When he was born, there were strange signs in the sky, and a meteor streaked across. He had black hair and black eyes like no one else in the world. The priest who baptized him couldn't help but marvel at his extraordinary Spiritual Power. In his childhood, he received all kinds of care and endless affection. People affectionately called him the Child of the Sky, the Star of Tomorrow. But when the world discovered that his body was unsuitable for cultivating any elemental Magic, making him a once-in-a-century useless genius, everything, everything drifted away from him. The rolling wheel of fate mercilessly crushed him beneath its wheels. His despairing father refused to look at him again, while his mother shed all her sorrowful tears for him. The world calling him 'genius' became his most painful, most unbearable mockery! The Temple of the God of Light even considered his blood impure and blasphemous. When nightmares loomed over his head, what path would Rody take?
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Supernatural, Tragedy, Xuanhuan

title: The Fox Concubine
summary: A royal fairy princess traveled to the human world with her pet fox, where the Heavenly Emperor befriended them at first before killing the princess for her royal blood. Before dying, the princess sent away part of the spirit belonging to Hua Mei’er, the fox’s baby. When the Heavenly Emperor realized having royal blood didn’t make him royal, he blocked Mei’er's memory, and had his illegitimate son, Hu Xiaoyu, take care of the fox baby. After 1,000 years, the grown-up Mei’er lost her memory upon waking, and was told she was a fox spirit by the Fox Spirit Miaoli and that she ruled the mountain she inhabited. Mei’er soon suffered an ordeal where Xiaoyu came to her rescue. Xiaoyu said Mei’er was his wife, which Mei’er couldn’t accept, and she decided to escape with Miaoli. While the two of them were in the city, Mei’er inadvertently became an assassin and was ordered to kill the Lord of Xiaoyao, who was trying to rebel against the royals, and who actually turned out to be Xiaoyu, the man she has been avoiding. Mei’er became close to Xiaoyu after some time together, but after discovering his wandering eye, she left again, and was captured by Xiaoyu.

title: The One Who Saved Me When I Was Depressed After My Girlfriend Was Stolen From Me Was a Beautiful Transfer Student
summary: Kuramoto Kazuki started dating Mihashi Eri after she confessed her feelings to him in their second year of middle school. Ever since they first became intimate during the summer of their third year, their bond deepened significantly. Their relationship is even officially recognized by both of their parents. For high school, the three of them, Kazuki, his good friend Komine Isao, and Eri, enrolled in Tokyo Metropolitan Ohashi High School. It’s a college-preparatory school, for what it’s worth. About half a year later, a strange rumor started to spread. A rumor that Eri is dating the ace of the basketball team. Although it’s true that Eri has been distant lately, he thought there was no way the rumor could be true, so when he asked her about it in person, she told him it was just something spread by someone jealous of our relationship. But after she stood him up on their planned date, as he was walking through town anyway, he saw Eri walking with a guy he didn’t know. He took a video as proof, but the next morning, Eri approached him as if nothing was wrong. Unable to bring himself to ask about yesterday, over the course of a few weeks, he began to convince himself that it must have just been a woman who looked like Eri. But the rumors about Eri began to spread, and as he grew more and more confused about her, Komine told him that it’s true and when he asked Eri, she tearfully insisted that she hasn’t done anything like that and that it’s a lie. Still not knowing who was telling the truth, he once again saw a girl who looked like Eri walking happily in town, holding hands with the basketball ace, and he worked up the courage to call out to them.

title: Regression Episode 101: The Salvation Diary of an Incompetent Person
summary: [Save humanity from dimensional invasion.] I thought of myself as a sword. A sword that would one day grow sharp if honed and tempered. But my talent was so meager that I couldn’t even kill a goblin. Before long, I realized it was worse than a pebble rolling by the roadside. That didn’t mean I could give up. A hundred regressions lived through that way. And the final chance that was given. The Salvation Diary of an Incompetent on His 101st Regression, its final chapter. I begin once more to sing a hymn dedicated to my pitiful soul. For the salvation of the world is the salvation of my soul.

title: My Gun Can Pierce Through Hunter Story Clichés!
summary: In a world with Gates and monsters but no Hunters, I survived for 32 years using only technology. Extinction, then regression. 32 years into the past. The human survival system, Savior. Reality finally changed to resemble a game, just like typical Hunter stories. “T-that’s a gun…?! Don’t you know the basic fact that guns don’t work on monsters because of their magic barriers?!” No, that’s wrong. My gun penetrates both magic and barriers. This is why I can’t stand today’s youth, tsk. They think everything in the world is like a game?

title: A Merchant With Zero Combat Power Who Was A Baggage Handler In A Hero Party (Me), Was Finally Banished And Wants To Be A Steady Merchant.
summary: With the mundane ordinary skill “Warehouse”, I spent 15 years as a baggage handler in a party that happened to pick me up. That party grew into the strongest party, led by Ryan, a Hero with the strongest skills. Ryan and his team finally succeed in defeating the Demon King. “Sorry. You’re fired.” They said I don’t deserve to be in their party, and I’m sentenced to be fired. But there’s a part of me that thinks it’s the right thing to do. And that’s because… I’m weak. I’m so weak. I could just barely win a single combat with a goblin if it was unarmed and I had a weapon. To be honest, I wasn’t able to contribute at all to the fight against the monsters of the Demon King’s army. At the age of 30, I was expelled from my old hero’s party. I have no choice but to start looking for something new. For now, I aim to become a great merchant, while working steadily in business, I will try to find a wife. In addition, in this world, polygamy seems to be allowed.

title: Fleeing to the Grassland
summary: Mi Niang was swept along with the flood of refugees in a daze, fleeing to a place beyond the borders. She thought she would be a lonely soul, destined to die as a stranger in a foreign land. No one to care, no one to love. When she fell ill, her death would be marked by a simple straw mat thrown to feed the wild wolves. Until the day a taciturn shepherd boy appeared. He helped heal a sick lamb for her and chased a major flood that swept away her hometown, causing her family's ruin and the loss of lives. As the sun set, she suddenly noticed the unusually tall figure of this silent and reserved young man. The bruise on his face stirred her once lifeless heart. From the perspective of the male protagonist: Bahu was someone who avoided trouble at all costs. To escape the chaos of his family, he separated from them with his servants and livestock before reaching adulthood. He was especially cautious about getting married. One day, while grazing his animals, he encountered a cart carrying refugees. A silent girl walking with a dog caught his attention. She moved mechanically, and the dog was vigilant. His heart skipped a beat, and as fate would have it, he found someone with a similar disposition. But Bahu never imagined that he had misjudged the situation. The dog was the one who liked to meddle in affairs, and the girl was not someone who enjoyed tranquility. However, this time, misjudgment turned out to be the stroke of luck in his life.
genres: Completed, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I’ll Show You My Cold Wife! ~You Forgot Our Anniversary, So I’ll Have No Mercy on You!~
summary: My wife has been cold to me lately. Well, I’ll show her! “Don’t touch me, it’s annoying,” she says. We dated for many years before getting married. When we were newlyweds, we were always together, and we never missed a chance to be physically affectionate or to contact each other. But from some point, we started having s*x less and less, and eventually, she even forgot our anniversary. I no longer felt any love from my wife, and my feelings for her began to fade as well. A revenge romance story that starts with divorce!
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Mature, Romance

title: Former Dictator, Now a Noble Daughter
summary: At twenty years old, she was betrayed—and regressed back in time. All she ever did was faithfully make poison, just like she was told!When Marguerite opens her eyes again as a six-year-old, she makes a firm decision. Run away! If she doesn’t, she might end up spending her whole life making poison again.But then… “You… Are you my daughter?” Huh? What is this Duke even talking about? She managed to escape from Leviathan, the ruler of the underworld, and ran straight into the arms of his natural enemy—the Duke of Vertier. That part went great… except— “For saving my life, I intend to repay you with the most precious thing in this world. Become my daughter.” Now the Duchess wants her to be their daughter too, and— “You should call me father. Have you forgotten already?” “I call you my sweetheart because you’re just too cute—what’s wrong with that?” “Wait right there. I’ll win you seventy-four dolls.” Even the Duke and his sons are acting weirdly affectionate…? “Don’t you ever leave me.” And on top of that, even the son of Leviathan—whom she only cooperated with to survive— seems to have grown too attached to her. Did she really run away… the right way?

title: Valentine’s Day Breakup, I Woke Up a Madwoman
summary: My girlfriend was the queen of the Shangjing business world. I was a wage-earner mingling among ordinary people. No one was optimistic about our relationship with such a disparity in status. On Valentine’s Day, Liu Ruyue got into a car accident and lost her memory. After waking up, she forgot everything about me, crying out for her first love: “Where is my Brother Fu?” The Liu family was overjoyed. They immediately severed our relationship and promoted Fu Shenxing to take my place. I said nothing, silently packed my things, and left. They didn’t know that I had been waiting for this day for a long time. Liu Ruyue wasn’t a docile little lamb. She was a madwoman with an extremely twisted personality. Liu Ruyue got into a car accident. On Valentine’s Day, she was hit by a truck from the side.

title: Aren’t We Supposed to Be Sworn Enemies?
summary: Chu Tianqing wasn't even an adult yet, but her life was already a complete mess. Anxiety disorder, obsessive compulsive disorder, bipolar disorder, she had them all. She took two years off school, and both her parents lost their jobs. To make ends meet, the whole family relocated, starting over in a cramped rental unit. She scrimped and saved, and would even help her mother collect scrap. But she always believed that one day, everything would get better. Sure enough, after transferring to Provincial First High School, she easily tested into first place in her grade. Any opportunity to earn scholarship money, she absolutely would not let slip by. The original top student, Ji Mingchuan, had his defenses broken for the first time in his life. He stayed calm, faced it composedly, plotted cleverly, crawled through the darkness, and regarded Chu Tianqing as his lifelong enemy. However, his relationship with Chu Tianqing gradually developed in an unexpected direction. Weren't they sworn enemies? Why, why... mm, they couldn't keep kissing like this, what happened to being sworn enemies... Eccentric Genius (Female) X Handsome Overachiever (Male) Notes: - Female lead is a bit greedy, "Baby sees it, baby wants it, baby gets it" - Male lead has a stubborn mouth and lots of schemes

title: How to Be Mistaken for a Villain in a Zombie Apocalypse
summary: I was transported into a hardcore zombie apocalypse game that I played for over 1,000 hours. But the world is much more intact than I remember. For now.

title: Otherworld Constellation Gallery
summary: I grant you access to the “Constellation Gallery”, you ignorant fool.

title: Rebirth: Opening Confessions With My Table Mate Who Is a Little Stupid
summary: Successfully starting a business, Lin Xinyu, who had been quietly supported by someone struggling with severe social anxiety, deeply regretted why he hadn't paid better attention to the other person's emotions before. Fortunately, an unexpected incident gave him a chance to make amends. At this moment, the once withdrawn person was now just shy but could still speak. So, why hesitate? Take the initiative! "Bai Shihan, I have something to tell you." "D-don't bully me, I-I don't have any food left..." "I'm not talking about food. From today, you're going to be my wife, got it?" Bai Shihan widened her eyes, a bit incredulous. Not giving food but wanting her to be his wife? Sob, sob, sob... He's a big villain!
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: I Reincarnated as the Captain of a Battleship in a Robot Anime, but at This Rate, I’m Going to Be Assassinated
summary: Shougo Hamagishi, an ordinary Japanese office worker, finds himself unexpectedly thrust into the world of the canceled robot anime “Trismegistus: New Order,” becoming the incompetent Lieutenant Colonel Jowain Date. With only twelve hours until the start of the anime’s first episode, he faces a dire situation: Jowain is destined to die, betrayed by his own subordinate after committing a planetary massacre. Desperate to survive, Shougo decides to alter the original story. He manipulates events, exposes the corruption within New Balance, and eventually defects to the Rebel Army, dragging most of his crew with him. He even recruits the anime’s protagonist, Yuuki, to pilot the powerful Trismegistus, but the story quickly spirals out of control.
genres: Completed, Action, Drama, Mecha, Mystery, Sci-fi

title: My Competent Junior Living Across From Me Just Wants to Be Spoiled on the Veranda (WN)
summary: Exhausting days… But when I come home, you're always there—unguarded, just waiting for me. My only hobby is enjoying a quiet drink alone on my balcony. Living across from me? The most popular junior at our company—Shiraho Yo, flawless at work and adorable beyond reason. “Just being beside you in silence makes me happy, senpai.” For some reason, this perfect girl only ever lets her guard down around me—and starts getting all clingy!?
genres: Completed, Comedy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: A Floating World in the Boudoir
summary: The world says I have been blessed with a charmed life. My father is a first-rank official, and my mother hails from a prestigious, noble clan. Both of my elder brothers serve in the imperial court, and all three of my elder sisters have married into high-ranking families. Since childhood, I have been draped in the finest silks and fed the rarest delicacies from jade platters. Even the trifles I play with on a whim are worth enough to sustain an ordinary family for half a lifetime. Yet, outsiders see only the surface of my tapestry-like life. They do not understand that greatness brings its own burdens. Within these embroidered curtains and silken screens, schemes lie hidden at every turn. Between the golden chalices and jade chopsticks, mu*derous intent flashes when least expected. A single misstep is all it takes to fall into the bottomless abyss.

title: Something Like Hypnosis Doesn’t Work on Me
Love, Unplanned
summary: After I failed to win over the School Heartthrob, the System told me to switch targets to the School Bully. Unexpectedly, I was caught red-handed before I could even finish writing the love letter. The School Heartthrob looked down at my chicken-scratch handwriting, a brow arched in amusement. "Is that little System in your head the one who taught you to give up halfway?"

title: Once Young
summary: Between people, it is a meeting and a parting. Some people only meet and part for a moment. Some people meet and leave for as long as a lifetime. It seems that Xie Qiao and Qin Chuan met too early. Before they were born, they started fighting across the belly. The memories of the two people are intertwined, making it difficult to tell which is his and which is hers. That year, they played the “three-word” chase game. Seeing that they were about to be caught by him, in a panic, she shouted: “I love you!” That year, when the locust tree rustled, she looked at him eagerly, he paused for a few seconds, and said lightly, “It’s the most important friend.” That year, there was another him by her side, and another her by his side. They are obviously in the same world, but they seem to be separated by a parallel universe. That year, he said, if no one married you at the age of 30, I would marry you. They accompany and wait carefully, daring not to get too close, but also unwilling to go too far. They buried their heads deep in the sand called friendship that had accumulated over the years. It seems that that feeling, as long as it is not spoken, does not exist. However time will grow old, and love will have a voice of its own.

title: Only I Have Daily Dungeon Missions Life
summary: As the graduation from university approached, Hideo Akagi found himself burdened with a massive debt due to his delinquent older brother misusing his scholarship. Unable to envision a future after graduation, he was stuck in a bleak situation. In the midst of this, an envelope arrived from the Dungeon Foundation, revealing that he was a chosen "Explorer" eligible to challenge dungeons. His only skill, finger snapping, transformed into the skill "Finger Snap," and with the acquisition of the ordinary skill, he ventured into the dungeon aiming for a windfall. Despite putting effort into utilizing his seemingly ordinary ability that anyone with finger snapping could use, everything ended up in vain. The only thing it excelled at was high accuracy, proving almost useless in combat. At the point of giving up, a window appeared before the hero – the Daily Mission.

title: Divorced Heavenly Demon
summary: The Heavenly Demon, Hyuk Moolin, who passed away in solitude, suddenly finds himself back in the past. With a second chance at life, the first thing he decides to do is: “Let’s get a divorce.” That declaration stirs up a storm within the once-quiet Heavenly Demon Cult. **1.3 Million Views in 2 days on Kakaopage

title: Mask
summary: "Gwimyeon" (鬼面) means "ghost face" or "a mask made imaginary to resemble a ghost's face." However, the martial arts world interprets the name differently. A bloodthirsty tyrant. Or a serial killer who craves blood. The swordsman "Biho" from beyond the mountains begins to track down "Gwimyeon" after many twists and turns. However, as if wandering through a thick fog, he is gradually s**ked into the vortex of fate. Now, the "cloud-blazing dragon and wind-running tiger" (雲龍風虎)" berate the martial arts world and bring about "wind and cloud creation."

title: Huai’an
summary: I am the Imperial Tutor, and also the most powerful minister in the dynasty. I have committed every treacherous act imaginable: embezzlement, power plays, and the persecution of loyal officials. I even climbed into the Emperor's bed in a man's body. I taught the Emperor well. His heart belongs to the people, and he can tell loyalty from treachery at a glance. That is why he hates me with all his heart.

title: He Gave His Life to the Dao, Leaving the Immortals in Sorrow
summary: Only through Ye Di’s death could the Demonic Path be eradicated and the countless lives of the world be saved. This was something the white-haired senior sister—cold and distant like an exiled immortal, yet bearing the fate of the world in her heart—had known all along. And so, she asked him to die… for the sake of all living beings. Only through Ye Di’s death, offering his body to the sword, could the legendary blade [Tangxi] be forged and gifted to the one he loved. This, too, was known long ago by the sword-obsessed girl, her passion blazing like fire. And so, she asked him to die… to create a peerless sword. After Ye Di’s death—

title: Prince or Pirate
summary: The prince who was brought up by the enemy will eventually return with vengeful anger. The son of a rich family who was in decline finally betrayed his own class and embarked on the road of resistance.

title: Those Years When I Was an Exorcist
summary: Mass graves... abandoned crematoriums... deserted villages where everyone vanished overnight... haunted houses where restless spirits and malevolent entities lingered... wherever dread and terror reigned, wherever people fled in fear, there I stood, a new-generation Exorcist. An Exorcist's duty is to banish malevolent spirits, break the curses binding the dead, uncover hidden truths of the past, dispel the lingering resentment of vengeful spirits, seek justice for wronged souls, and purge the world of evil. I make the living confront the questions of the dead, guiding lingering spirits to release their earthly attachments and return to the cycle of Reincarnation. I do all this for no other reason than to comfort the dead, bring peace to the living, dispel the darkness, and restore harmony and light to the world.
genres: Action, Adventure, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: I Only Know How to Bully Noobs
summary: That night, in prison, when a prisoner spoke rudely, Chen Ming beat him up — and suddenly, a door to a new world opened before him. 【You’ve defeated an LV0 enemy. Gained 1 EXP.】 From then on, a martial artist with zero honor and a passion for farming weaklings rose to prominence. An offbeat stat-boosting cultivation story, where power comes not from glory... but from relentless noob-stomping.

title: I’m Not Your Dad, I’m a Villain
summary: Until the day the promised time comes. I will play the role of her father.

title: Survival in the Ruins: I Can Make Everything Evolve Infinitely
summary: In a world ravaged by ruin, where the land is lifeless, skies are smothered by dust, and sunlight no longer graces the earth, survival is a battle against insurmountable odds. Water is tainted, food is scarce, and mutated creatures lurk at every turn. The remaining humans are caught in the grip of a merciless, dying world. Amidst this desolation, Mu Liang awakens a unique and extraordinary gift: the power to absorb energy and evolve. This ability allows him to transcend the limits of nature, unlocking endless possibilities for the world around him to evolve. A humble sapling, infused with the power of evolution, grows into a towering World Tree that blots out the sky. A small land turtle undergoes an unimaginable transformation, evolving into a mighty, world-bearing creature. A tiny spider? It evolves into a malevolent being, capable of manipulating the threads of fate. With the immense strength of a continent-sized tortoise and the power to command the weather through the World Tree, Mu Liang stands poised to create his own kingdom—a world of limitless evolution, where nothing is beyond his reach. This is the story of a man who, in a shattered world, harnesses the power to rewrite fate itself.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Xuanhuan

title: The Strongest Sect Across All Realms
summary: In the True Immortal Continent, strength reigns supreme. Martial artists stand above all. Qin Ye is unexpectedly transported to another world, where he becomes the sect leader of a small sect that is on the brink of collapse. Just as all hope seems lost, he awakens the Strongest System. Starting with the recruitment of his very first disciple, Qin Ye embarks on a relentless rise—step by step forging his sect into the strongest sect across all heavens and myriad realms.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Ore to Imouto no Chi Tsunagatteimasen
summary: "Does it matter what we're doing now? Whatever the reason, we're still siblings in the family." My little sister, Kururi, is a brocon to the extreme. Whenever our eyes meet, she's so attached to me, always crying to sit on my lap or hold hands with me. "Hehe. Onii-chan, I love you!" Kururi smiled mischievously, at night, she entered the same room as me. During dinner, our parents revealed a shocking truth to me, which even Kururi herself didn't know. "Kōsetsu-kun and Kururi-chan are not related by blood." Wait, Kururi and I are stepsisters!? That would be a bad thing... "If we weren't siblings, that way, I could marry Onii-chan!" My little sister was always the type to say things like that! The relationship between a serious older brother and a half little sister who is affectionate as a family begins to change with this hidden secret!
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Ordered My Campus Crush Online
summary: Lu Yu is the aloof and indifferent, impoverished campus heartthrob. But I never expected that he was so poor he put himself up for sale online. Priced at five hundred a night, satisfaction guaranteed or your money back. Well, well. I hurriedly transferred a huge sum over. He replied instantly. [Are we doing it tonight?] Uh... He really is dedicated to his work. My sympathy overflowed, so I booked Lu Yu for a whole month. Until one day, I saw the balance on his bank card, longer than my own lifespan. I laughed. Turns out, the clown was me all along.

title: Seductive Kiss of the Wild Rose, the Yandere Boss is Addicted to Me
summary: [The Unhinged and Seductive Young Master VS The Aloof and Wild-hearted Eldest Miss] Zhou Jinyue will forever be behind Qiao Ling—a blade in the shadows, a ghost in the sunlight. He would go mad for her; he would be docile for her. His entire life exists for only two words—Qiao Ling. Between adults, there is no need for the undercurrents of ambiguity, only the surging tides of passion and desire.

title: Red Packet Server
summary: Ye Zichen was just a normal university student. Or so he thought. Upon a 'chanced' invitation into a deities' chat group filled with deities from the Heavenly Court, Ye Zichen found out that there was much more to the world than what meets the eye. The Heavenly Court, the Underworld, and immortal cultivators which only exists in Chinese mythology... They are all real. As Ye Zichen becomes more and more involved in that world filled with unworldly beings, the wheels of destiny began to turn. What sort of destiny awaits him? Will he be able to prevent the tragedies that are to unfold? Will he be able to forge a new path; or will he succumb to wills of the greater beings that guide his life?

title: The Emperor is on Strike as an Aide
summary: I Became the Tyrant’s Assistant. You know how tyrants in romance fantasy stories usually get their hands bloody, have scary nicknames, and threaten nobles with charisma? Well, our emperor is… a bit different. “Do you even know what His Majesty looks like? I don’t. Actually, I’ve never even seen him!” Have you ever seen a tyrant who shuts down the country by not doing any work? Here he is. Ta-da. Because the emperor’s basically on strike, us poor assistants are drowning in work 24/7, 365 days a year. The only person I can trust here is my boss, Mr. John Smith, who’s like a unicorn. But one day, Mr. Smith starts asking me weird questions. “Miss Foy, what do you think it would be like if you became the empress?” “Let’s just put curtains around the throne.” “And what good would that do?” “Until the curtains are opened, no one can say the emperor isn’t there. No one will know if he’s really inside or not.” This is… an actual meeting topic? And everyone’s serious? “…Hey. That sounds crazy but also kind of smart, right?” “I agree. Let’s do it right away.” Uh, hello? Is there still a spot open to quit this job?

title: He Said He’s Pregnant, and It’s My Child
summary: Something seems a bit off about this world. Wang Zhao thought as she watched a pregnant man walking towards her. P/S: Yandere male lead, Female-dominant World

title: The Butler of the Villainess Has Returned
summary: This is the last chance to save the young lady.

title: Novoland: Mrs. Pearl Bead
summary: The daughter of a pearl fisherman, Haishi, met a mermaid when she was a child, who left her the two words Lang Huan on her palm. And the pearls created by the mercreature’s tears resulted in her meeting the officials. The once handsome and young six-winged general, Qinghai Prince, only hides behind the emperor now, manipulating the black-feathered forest army. The entangled fate between him and Di Xu gradually disappeared on the specious smile his lips formed. In the big Zheng Dynasty, there was another big empire on the Nine Continents. The previous civil strife took away everything the young emperor Chu Zhongxu wanted to protect. The so-called civilians and nation were nothing but tools for him to demand liberation. Whether it was to be hated by others to be betrayed by his brother, nothing was important anymore. The peaceful and prosperous world he had created himself must be destroyed by himself. Thousands of horses are running, and the flags are changing. The world is magnificent, and this will become the legend of the nation. And the shiny and round merfolk pearls scattered everywhere on the ground reflect everyone’s swirling destiny.

title: A Monopoly on Chance
summary: "It's a perfect day to die." Lying down, looking up at the sky, it felt as if all the world's snow was falling on me. Covered by the accumulating snow, I awaited death... "Huh?" I opened my eyes to a new life. The underworld I'd lived in for 42 years was over. In this life, I would live the most splendid life, with the greatest power, in the highest reaches of the night.

title: I Built a Small Town in the Apocalypse
summary: What was life like in the apocalypse? Answer: Thanks for the question. I woke up naturally every day, never missed a single meal, exercised, took walks, teased cats, chased dogs, wandered around the supermarket, and watched movies. Oh right, our mayor even built a zoo recently, so on weekends I could take the kids there for fun. Other than collecting rent, who would want to go out? You’re asking about neighbor disputes? Impossible. Absolutely impossible in this lifetime. Anyway, I have to go pick up my kid from school later, and tonight I’m taking the train to visit my second granduncle, and bring him over to stay for a few days while I’m at it. … In the fifth year of the apocalypse, a mysterious small town appeared out of thin air in H City. The town had warm rooms, abundant food, clean drinking water, electric lights that could stay on all night, and absolute security. As the town developed, the number of residents kept increasing, and its facilities became more and more comprehensive. Agriculture, industry, leisure, and education, none of it was neglected. In the end, they had even built a train. … Miao Suisui had been killed by a falling object from a great height, and was unexpectedly pulled into the apocalypse, where she was bound to a town system. She recruited residents, upgraded the town, and earned special rewards for completing achievements. As someone who loved management simulation games, Miao Suisui found herself thoroughly enjoying it. Before she even realized it, the town’s population had reached tens of thousands, and people began to call her a savior. Miao Suisui: If I said I only wanted to play a management game at the start, would you believe me? Note: This was mainly a town building and upgrading slice of life story, with relatively little focus on apocalyptic survival. If that bothers you, proceed with caution~ Content tags: Apocalypse, System, Futuristic Setting
genres: Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Immortal Ape King
summary: He was only an ordinary Chinese youth. Because of the strong refusal of his soul, he unexpectedly arrived in this strange world. He ardently loved peace; yet, he had no choice but to become a Demon God. If cultivating to the peak could lose person's human nature, then all living creatures will weep with grief, waiting to be slaughtered. Can he still remain calm after this? In the vast wilderness, a handsome youth carrying the wisdom of "Daodejing", step by step would rise to prominence in this world. Condensing and cultivating his bloodline to the supreme. Controlling and commanding the rivers. Swallowing and spitting the sun... Tl: 1.Daodejing also mean as "The classic of the virtue of the tao" was a book of dao by Lao tzu, a sacred text of Daoism.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Raising Orphans, Not Assassins
summary: Chen Ye transmigrates to the Great Wu Dynasty and binds himself to an orphan cultivation system. As long as he nurtures orphans, he earns points, which can be used to draw skills to bestow upon the orphans. But... Chen Ye always feels that these traits are a bit strange. [Strong Physique: Increases strength growth rate; but can only use heavy weapons] [Dexterous Hands: Enhances talents in cooking, sewing, and other life skills; greatly enhances talent in mechanisms and manual techniques] [Perseverance: As long as there is determination, nothing is impossible; but thoughts must be clear and unobstructed] [Draw Lots: The things drawn will accompany for a lifetime; but...]

title: Professor Holmes Is Not a Villain
summary: Is that a lie? It would be the detective's job to figure that out. I took the girl Sherlock Holmes as my apprentice. She obsessively insists that I am a criminal.

title: They Call Off the Engagement, So Why Is Everyone Chasing Me After Rebirth?!
summary: Lynn transmigrates. He wakes up inside “Sword of the Rose,” a female–overpowered–protagonist RPG he was playing on a New Game+ run in his previous life. The good news: he’s now inhabiting the body of Lynn, a rich young noble who shares his name—and he’s even engaged to an adorable witch. The bad news: the moment he marries that witch, he is guaranteed to die. Fortunately, Lynn awakens a death-rewind ability… western fantasy / rebirth / action / girls-chasing-boy / chasing-the-husband
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: I Spoiled “Quderella” Next Door and I’m Going To Give Her a Key to My House
summary: A sweet, cross-cultural love comedy about a cool foreign exchange student and a housewife boy! Katagiri Natsuomi, a high school student living alone for two years, has a beautiful black-haired, blue-eyed girl move into the next room. The girl, Yui, seems to be a real noblewoman, and her nickname is “Kuudere-lla” because of her indifferent reaction at school. When Natsuomi finds out that Yui doesn’t want to rely on others, but is actually quite naive, he decides to help her out. “What’s for dinner tonight, …… chicken karaage? “Chicken was cheap.” “I love your fried chicken, so I’m really looking forward to it.” This is the beginning of a sweet and tantalizing relationship between two neighbors.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: My Childhood Friend, who became a National Idol, moved next door to my Run-down Apartment
summary: My childhood friend, Mitsuki Toujou, is now a nationally renowned idol representing Japan. As Mitsuki became busier, we gradually grew apart. There was a time when I was always cheering for my childhood friend, who always exuded an overwhelming and unrivaled charisma. From behind the TV screen, she looked dignified and cool, as if keeping everyone at a distance. It was during such times that something unexpected happened. "Oh, it's Kazu-kun! We're neighbors again, just like in the old days. Take care of me~" Out of nowhere, the top idol of Japan appeared in front of me as she popped out of the TV and it looks like she had suddenly moved into the shabby apartment next to mine. Moreover, during the neighborly greeting, she welcomed me in her most relaxed expression and in her sleepwear! Could it be that the childhood friend who had become distant is now seeking comfort with all her might due to the busy life of being an idol...?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Confessions of the Past
summary: I was such an idiot to download that chat app. If I could do it all over again, I swear I’d never want to know her. I was a complete mess during that time—a total disaster. I single-handedly destroyed a relationship that I’d built for years and was about to lead to marriage, turning my entire life upside down.​

title: Monster Hunter
summary: It is an age when giant monsters rule the world of nature, freely roaming the land and soaring through the sky. In order to survive, humanity relies on the hunters, powerful warriors with the strength and intellect to fell such beasts. Zeeg Grandest is one such hunter, albeit still a rookie. Through his meetings with numerous comrades and battles against powerful wyverns, the boy will learn what it truly means to be a Monster Hunter. Based on Capcom's PS2 video games Monster Hunter and Monster Hunter G. The series won Kadokawa Shoten’s 2007 light novel award for light novels under the novelization category.

title: The Guests of the Mansion Are Not Alive
summary: In the Empire of Ista, exorcists who eliminate evil spirits are held in high regard. Luna, a support-type exorcist, lives with festering wounds from constant neglect and ab**e by others. One day, she narrowly survives an exorcism mission at a mansion.When she regains consciousness, what appears before her is… “We’re the spirits wandering this mansion. ”None other than the souls hiding within the mansion! Caught in confusion and panic, Luna finds herself unsure of what to do—“My lady, would you consider making a deal with me?”—when she comes face to face with Lucian, a renowned exorcist recognized by the Empire.— “You’re an exorcist officially recognized by the nation. So, I hope you don’t belittle yourself like that.”Luna’s life, which had been filled with disregard, begins to change completely after meeting Lucian. She is deeply grateful to him for treating her as an equal partner. She thought that would be enough to satisfy her…“Please allow me to call your name.”…but she starts to desire something more—to grow even closer to Lucian.

title: Twelfth Floor Mystery
summary: The protagonist and her family moved to a picturesque resort city to live. Upon the invitation of their friendly female neighbor, they joined a "big family" composed entirely of people from outside the city. Although the members of this big family were not related by blood, their bond was stronger than that of family, and their relationships were harmonious, giving the protagonist's family a sense of warmth and belonging. However, the good times didn't last. After some time, the protagonist learned that the gathering place where they often held their parties was actually a mu*der house. Two years ago, a bizarre homicide had occurred in that house. The female neighbor had been organizing gatherings at her place out of fear. This revelation cast a psychological shadow over the protagonist, but she didn't anticipate that even more terrifying things would follow. After they moved there, one member after another of the big family started getting killed. The police investigation confirmed that the culprit was someone familiar to them. The protagonist couldn't understand why such things were happening. Who was the killer, and what was their motive for the mu*ders? As the investigation progressed, an unexpected truth gradually emerged.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: Walking Alone With a Sword, Slaying Ghosts and Gods
summary: If people are not burdened by their physical form, the Daluo Heaven will be right before their eyes! Blood God True Lord Lu Cheng, the strongest magic player in the Nine Heavens World, relies on his unparalleled Blood God Dharma. His Heavenly Demon Blood Sword and Human Emperor Flag are fierce and unparalleled. He single-handedly defeated many top masters of the time and won the supreme artifact Jiuli Ding. However, because of this, he traveled to the real immortal world, to this era where evils arose, the human race was in decline, and the true cultivators of the Tao could only hide in the mountains and practice hard. The sword swept the world, sweeping across the world and being invincible.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Flowers Bloom Even in Shadows of April
summary: Nakryeong, a leopard spirit confined to Mount Jaha as punishment for killing a god, lives stained with twisted possessiveness and obsession. Before him appears Yoo Sawol, a young sorceress fleeing from the gods. Nakryeong offers to hide Sawol from the gods in exchange for one condition: ‘Never leave Mount Jaha again.’ However, Sawol secretly grows her power and plans her escape to avenge her family, who were massacred by the gods… “Don’t forget, you belong to me. Every breath that enters and leaves your body, even every shadow you cast, belongs to me.” Love blooms amid deception and pursuit, escape and chase. Will love’s end be destruction or salvation?

title: Rebirth: Catching the Aloof School Belle Shoplifting at the Supermarket
summary: Reborn in his school days, Lu Yuanqiu was managing his family’s supermarket when he noticed, via surveillance footage, a beautiful girl secretly taking items from the shelves. After gathering evidence, Lu Yuanqiu brought her into the storeroom. “How much did you take?” The girl leaned against the wall, silent and reserved. “No more, just this.” Lu Yuanqiu recognized her. Her name was Bai Qingxia, a fellow student. Aloof, unapproachable, and known as the cold-faced school belle—these were all labels synonymous with her. Yet today, the untouchable “White Moonlight” in everyone’s eyes had been cornered against the wall by him under such circumstances. Lu Yuanqiu silently reminded himself that no matter what, he couldn’t let her go today. In his previous life, Bai Qingxia had done the same thing at the supermarket. At the time, Lu Yuanqiu, mindful of her dignity, chose to turn a blind eye. But after leaving the store, Bai Qingxia was involved in a car accident. That incident became a thorn in Lu Yuanqiu’s heart. If he had been firm and stopped Bai Qingxia that day, the subsequent tragedy could have been avoided. This time, he was determined to delay her departure and give the school belle a strict lecture! Staring at the humiliated school belle, whose eyes were turning red, Lu Yuanqiu continued to question: “Are you sure it’s just these?” “Your school uniform looks suspiciously bulky—are you hiding something in there too?!”

title: Daomu Biji: A Thousand Faces
summary: There is an amazing industry around me that focuses on masks. I have long been interested in this mask industry, so I will do in-depth data collection and gather a thousand stories associated with masks. Some will relate to human skin masks and some will relate to dirty faces. I’ll collectively call them — A Thousand Faces.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Supernatural

title: I Have A Divination System
summary: Lin Xuan stumbled upon a divination system by chance. The accuracy rate of the divinations was 100%, capable of bringing good fortune and averting disasters, saving people from perilous situations. Such a divine tool, however, had a fatal weakness: each divination came with a price tag of ten dollars. Her delusion of becoming wealthy and reaching the pinnacle of life was shattered right at the beginning. Lin Xuan diligently went about her work, occasionally earning some pocket money through divinations and occasionally drawing strange and useless items from the system’s store. [Sadako’s Long Hair: Can crawl out of the television when lost. Since Sadako likes handsome guys, there is a chance of encountering one when crawling out.] [Confucius’ Ruler: When held, you can ask the other person a question. If they answer incorrectly, you can give them ten slaps on the palm.] [Old Man Sticker: Stick it on, and you become the grandfather of the Calabash Brothers.] … “What a mess! Not a single useful item!” One day, Lin Xuan got lost and, with no other options, she had to put on Sadako's Long Hair and crawl out of the television. Chen Chu looked at the woman with her half-body still stuck in his own television, and asked, “Can you explain this?” Lin Xuan replied, “It seems that Sadako really likes handsome guys.” A clueless female protagonist versus a powerful male lead.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural

title: My Fiancé Got Used to Saying, “Let’s Break Off the Engagement,” so I Decided To Give Him What He Wanted.
summary: Just as the title says. After being used as an excuse for breaking off the engagement so many times, the protagonist decides to accept it for real. There's no ex-husband, the engagement is not broken off but is simply nullified, but she takes what she can get, and it's a convenient happy ending; there's no "serves you right" but she does regret it a little.

title: Do Whatever You Want
summary: Su Qiuzi lost her mother at a young age, and her father remarried. Unloved and neglected by both parents, she lived to her early twenties only to be proposed to by the man her stepsister desperately wanted to marry at her stepsister's birthday party. This man was handsome, wealthy, and refined, known as the aristocratic young master of Xia City. However, after marrying him, she discovered the deep desires hidden beneath his gentle exterior. Su Qiuzi believed that in this unequal marriage, He Yu could do whatever he wanted with her. But in reality, it was she who could do whatever she wanted with his heart. "I will protect you with my world, and I also want your world. Only I can shatter the radiance in your eyes." A Cinderella story of marriage of convenience that blossoms into love, sweet and flirtatious.

title: Rebirth 09: Synthetic God
summary: Zhou Rui was reborn on the eve of the college entrance examination in 2009. He returned to his childhood sweetheart, the "last queen," and awakened the "Life Entry Synthesis System." By creating entry tasks and performing the corresponding behaviors, Zhou Rui could gain experience points. Most importantly, entries could be synthesized! - "Student" + "Self-Disciplined" = [Academic Hegemon] - "Academic Hegemon" + "Inspiration" = [Academic God] - "Martial Arts Enthusiast" + "Inheritor of Intangible Cultural Heritage" + "Strong and Strong" = [Ancient Martial Arts Successor] - "Proficient in Zoology" + "Mastering Multiple Languages" = [Animal Speaker] As Zhou Rui gained more and more entries, his life became increasingly exciting! Starting from a small-town high school, he ventured into the entertainment industry and fought against capital. Well... the best way to fight the enemy is to infiltrate the enemy, isn’t it?
genres: Action, Comedy, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: Top Idol Band – Would You Like to Subscribe?
summary: Kim Dae-hyun, a 29-year-old civil service exam student. Because of his habit of trembling hands whenever he gets nervous, he ended up failing the exam again this year. “If only my hands were normal…” While despairing and watching W-Tube to prepare himself for reentering society after years of studying, a sudden message popped up in front of his eyes. [Would you like to subscribe to W-TubeLife?] The moment he subscribed and opened his eyes, he found himself back ten years in the past— the moment he had been street-cast as a trainee! But what? He has to gather 100 million fans? How is that even possible? “…But actually, I like this.” He had always been waiting for a chance like this! The survival story of washed-up idol-to-be drummer Kim Dae-hyun begins— a man who will die if he fails to gather 100 million fans!

title: I, Who Still Had 1.8 Billion Seconds To Live, Made A Promise With The Shinigami
summary: Unfortunately, you only 1.8 billion seconds left to live. Please live a meaningful life. According to the Shinigami, I have 1.8 billion seconds left to live, and my childhood friend is going to die today. “The time we have spent together, it is all going to waste.” To lose the meaning of life, to lose all that I love, and to lose her smile, and so, my naive and boring way of life has come to an end. I will never accept such an ending for her. We have boarded the train departing from the other world, and now is our destination the intersection of destiny? Or is it―

title: The Best Building Owner in the World
summary: After escaping the Blood Cult, So-ryong, the dragon hatchling, wandered the martial arts world for many years. His only wish was this: "I want my own land." Then one day, he obtains a mysterious land deed from an old man who stops by his inn. "Welcome. This is Cheonhagak. You are... ...a new challenger." The story of So-ryong, the owner of Cheonhagak, who encounters new relationships, grows, and even causes turmoil in the martial arts world.

title: You Already Have the Way to Death
summary: When I transmigrated, an assassination attempt was already underway. To protect the Second Female Lead, my guard shoved me right into the path of the blades. I was stabbed, narrowly escaping with my life. The System explained: "He is the Third Male Lead. You must win him over. A little mistreatment in the early stages is nothing; later on, he will give up the Second Female Lead and fall in love with you!" The guard knelt on the ground, looking at me with pure loathing.
