"Everything was my fault," he said stubbornly. "It had nothing to do with Miss Shen." Ignoring the System's frantic screams, I calmly waved my hand. "Wei Ping failed in his duty to protect his master. Men, drag him away." "Beat him to death."

title: Against the Fate
summary: Haggling, Gambling, Bravery or Outsmarting? How to distinguish which is good and which is evil? Who is the true ruler? On the Eternal Planet, the truth only lies within the hands of the most powerful ones! But the Great Swindling Master will give them a magic show!

title: I Became The Leader Of A Revolution In A Romance Fantasy
summary: I found myself possessing the body of the male lead in a romance fantasy novel, right in the midst of a revolution. If I didn’t want to live the original male protagonist’s miserable life, I had to surrender quietly. “Can you hear it? The song of the angry people! The cries that they will no longer live like s*aves!” “It’s not about what you can do for the country, but what the country can do for you!” ……I should have just surrendered. I guess I overplayed my hand. Somehow, I ended up as a major figure in the revolutionary faction. My greatest achievement in my political career was none other than... “How could you…” The destruction of the royal family—the family of the woman I once loved.

title: The Fate of A Rose
summary: "If I had known you were a woman, this tedious chase wouldn't have even started in the first place!" Dantes Velkin, the Crown Prince, infiltrates the Imperial Apprentice Knights to find a true companion who can stay by his side. There, he meets Robert Vrida and develops feelings for him that go beyond friendship. Confused by his emotions for a moment, Dantes confesses his true feelings to Roberto. However, Roselina, who had been disguised as a man, flees in fear of her identity being revealed. Six years later, they reunite. Now the Emperor, Dantes finally catches Roselina after a relentless pursuit. However, upon discovering she is a woman, he feels an overwhelming sense of betrayal. Unable to kill her but also unwilling to let her go, Dantes demotes Roselina to a maid. Despite his vow to torment her for the rest of her life, his feelings for her only grow stronger....
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Lady Who Has Gone Back in Time, Will Not Grant You Forgiveness!
summary: A noble lady seek revenge After she was killed by her fiance.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Psychological, Romance

title: Our Final Goodbye
summary: I followed Jiang Muzhou for three years. Later, when he was about to get engaged, he gave me fifty million and told me to leave. Back then, I was proud, valuing my dignity too much. I didn't take it. Two years passed, and my life was really tough. Just then, a rich second-generation started pursuing me. I agreed. On the day we got together, he took me shopping. I didn't hold back and picked out things worth seven figures. When it was time to pay, his card was declined. The man was extremely embarrassed and hurriedly brought up his cousin, who was said to be quite influential in North City. "My cousin seems to be nearby. I'll just have him come over." I said okay. The next moment, when I saw the man who appeared before me, I was stunned.

title: Hourou Yuusha wa Kinka to Odoru
summary: After the hero defeated the demon king, the world became peaceful–but it hadn’t ended. After humanity’s ‘enemy’ disappeared, from the era of ‘violence’ came the era of ‘money’. At the nook of trade city Faltram, the wandering hero who had hidden his identity came across the demi-human Yunis, and the female knight, Rachel with whom she was discussing with. Without much of a choice, the hero decided to help them out and indifferently declared “If they don’t have principles, sword nor power, wouldn’t it be alright if we deceived the villains that deceived” For the hero who defeated the demon lord, his new enemy are those humans obsessed with money! And furthermore, he challenges the swindlers who overrun the town..!?

title: It Seems My Job Aptitude Didn’t Come with Human Rights
summary: Even six years after its release, the legendary MMORPG Lord of Grandeur (LOG) remained wildly popular. One of its most devoted hardcore players, Hayato Yuma, was eagerly looking forward to the new update featuring the reincarnation system. Within LOG’s vast world of seemingly infinite class and skill combinations, he had been searching for the ultimate build—but now, with the newly introduced reincarnation system allowing players to carry over skill points and start again from level one, he saw new possibilities. As soon as he got home, Hayato prepared immediately and executed the update the moment it went live. Using his max-level character, he initiated reincarnation through the new system. In that instant, the world turned upside down—and when the visuals settled, he found himself somewhere completely unfamiliar. As he sat up on an opulent bed he’d never seen before, tended by an unknown woman in a maid outfit, the truth hit him: he had actually reincarnated. Reincarnated as a young child, Hayato began learning about the world and soon discovered that this new place had the same kind of job aptitude system as LOG. Although the country’s name and details were different, it just might be a world connected to LOG. With that thought, Hayato realized—maybe he could now test the ultimate build on himself. However, despite being born as the eldest son of the prestigious Count Fallentail family, his job aptitude turned out to be far from what was expected. As a result, he was promptly cast out. This is the story of a protagonist who reincarnates into another world, uses his game knowledge to survive exile, and rises to become the strongest.

title: Perfectly Sweet
summary: The stage rehearsal for the New Year’s Eve event had just finished, and the lights dimmed, leaving the seating area in darkness. As Bian Li was walking with her team, she accidentally tripped near other artists' seats and ended up sitting on someone’s lap. She looked up and met a pair of slightly amused dark eyes. The owner of those warm legs propped his head up with one hand and said in a lazy tone, “Throwing yourself at me, huh? Do you like me?” That evening, Bian Li’s name trended on the internet due to an insider’s leak. —--------- Young and famous, arrogant and unruly, as the top figure in the industry, He Yunxing has never taken anyone seriously. After clarifying the rumors, fans insisted the two were not related with each other at all and could never spark a relationship. Later, on a variety show where idol groups send their members to participate, the director’s team did a live broadcast surprise check, knocking on Bian Li’s door. To their surprise, it was He Yunxing, shirtless and sleepy, who opened it. His half-closed eyes showed a hint of irritation, “What is it?” At that moment, a soft, sweet female voice came from inside, “Xingxing, are you done? Come back and keep me company.” The director’s team was shocked. The live broadcast room exploded.

title: Reborn as a Delicate Young Man, the Evil Sorcerer Finds Love
summary: “Rhine Green. Star-Ring Archmage. wielder of the Authority of ‘World.’ One of the founding pillars of modern magic. Founder of Green Magic Academy… and a mage feared across all borders.” Even now, history cannot agree on how to judge him. The Church brands him a ruthless demon king, a mu*derer who never blinked. Historians call him a genius whose morality was buried beneath ambition. His disciples remember him as a complicated mentor—dangerous, yes, but also brilliant beyond measure. Yet none of those labels matter now. After his death, the infamous archmage Rhine Green awakens in a different world… as a delicate, beautiful young man. And the first person he encounters is a Duke’s daughter— noble, proud, dazzling… and far too interested in him. In a world of swords, sorcery, and political intrigue, the once-feared dark mage must navigate romance, identity, and feelings he never allowed himself to have in his former life. This time, instead of conquering the world— he may lose his heart instead.

title: Manadeshi ni Uragirarete Shinda Ossan Yūsha, Shijō Saikyō no Maō toshite Ikikaeru
summary: Freed, a middle aged hero, defeated the Demon King after a deadly battle. However he is killed by his beloved disciple who tried to monopolized all the credit. Immediately after that, Freed somehow came back to life as the new Demon King. The Demon King’s castle is on the verge of being overrun by the oncoming heroes. His second-in-command, a beautiful girl from the demon tribe, and his subordinates try valiantly to protect him. In order to save them, Freed unintentionally ends up fighting against the heroes. The former hero becomes the most powerful Demon King in history, and a great counterattack to save the demon world on the verge of destruction begins…
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Supernatural

title: Levelling Up the Fallen God
summary: The moment he finished the first test play of the mobile game Sky Islands, which his older sister had helped develop, Earth was destroyed. When Hyesung opened his eyes, the world of Sky Islands unfolded before him. He was no longer Hyesung—he was now Phinen Bladian. A man devoid of even a sliver of emotion. As Phinen, destined to be a lord, he must ascend the Sky Islands. If only to uncover the secrets hidden within himself and the world.

title: Return as an Idol
summary: He was the CEO of an entertainment company. There was always a small status window floating in the corner of his vision. It didn’t show much detail, but when he clicked on a trainee’s name, he could see their stats. Based on those stats, he could even predict their chances of success. This strange ability appeared like magic when he started working in music. Everything was going well for him—until one day, he suddenly felt dizzy and saw a new message: [Do you want to reset your life?] He laughed it off, thinking it was a joke. But then the status window went completely blank with static noise. What happened next changed everything. All the members of the group he had been training died in a tragic car accident. A few days later, amidst the static, another message appeared in the status window: [Do you want to reset your life?] This time, it felt like salvation. When he said “Yes,” a new question came: [What kind of life do you want to live?] — “With the people I love.” — “Without heavy burdens.” — “I want to live life like a game.” [The contract has been made. One last time—do you agree?] And just like that, he went back to the past— and his new life as an idol began. Illustration: 인사삼 Title Design: 김소낙 (@Kim_Sonak)

title: The Mad Dog General’s Little Princess
summary: A wild, tough-as-nails general vs. a coquettish, scheming little princess. Both main characters are each other's firsts, in a genuinely sweet and fluffy story. The great desert, yellow sands, a large tent burning with Aloeswood incense. The scent of a strange man was pervasive—cold, hard, and violent, utterly repulsive. The fallen little princess trembled, her charming and beautiful face earning not a shred of pity from him. The man's gaze as he sized her up was like that of someone looking at the corpse of a white hawk shot down from the sky. The days and nights stranded in the great desert were the most humiliating time of Li Youqing's life. Her skin, whiter than frost and snow and never before touched by a man, was caressed by his coarse, large hands. Her proud head, which had never bowed to anyone, was forced into humble submission before him. It was rumored that General Xuan Rui was cold, ruthless, and cruel, and that no woman had ever survived by his side. The only one who was carried out alive after the first night was the noble lady he had captured on Lu Ming Mountain... and though she kept her life, she was covered in wounds, a tragic sight to behold. Barely surviving by that man's side night after night, she was finally able to leave that hellish desert when her Father Emperor sent men to rescue her, and he at last let down his guard. A year later, with the rebel king's head hanging from the city walls and the rebel army completely annihilated, Youqing thought she would never see that devil-like man again. She could finally live a life of ease, enjoying music and song on the Golden Scale Platform. But she never imagined that at a banquet in the Crown Prince's residence, through layers of curtains, she would once again meet those hawk-like, ruthless eyes. He was the ultimate nightmare she could neither escape nor forget. She was the faint glimmer of a firefly in his endless nightmares. "Xuan Rui, you are only twenty-three this year. Free from the rebel king's control, you can have a better life," the young woman said, resorting to her old tricks and trying to coax him. Ignoring the small, feminine dagger plunged into his left chest, the man continued to advance, his eyes filled with their usual wildness. "Qingqing, as long as you behave, I won't go mad!" PS: I hope this novel will transport you to a different kind of world.
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Kumo no Mukou, Yakusoku no Basho
summary: In an alternate history of the aftermath of World War II, Japan has been cleaved in half, with the south—Honshu and the other islands—allied with the United States and the northern island Hokkaido annexed by the enigmatic Union. It was on Hokkaido that a mysterious tower had been built, a strand of metal reaching up out of the atmosphere, visible from the northern tip of Honshu. In 1996, three teenagers, Hiroki, Takuya and Sayuri, make a pact—they will build an experimental aircraft, almost invisible to surveillance, cross over to Hokkaido and unlock the secrets of the tower. Their dream was never realized, because Sayuri was sent to Tokyo for treatment after she fell into a coma. It is now three years later. The rosy illusions of youth have fallen away, but not the unbreakable strength of the trio’s promise. The truth of the tower will be uncovered, and with it, the link between it and Sayuri’s mysterious, carefully tended condition.

title: Pet God
summary: Chen Guan awakened a support-type innate talent, initially thinking he’d just buff his pets and coast through life. But who knew this talent could do more than just apply buffs? It could upgrade pet quality. Not only that—it could unlock the potential of human cultivators… and even steal insights from geniuses for his own use. "Brother Guan… the enemy’s too strong… I can’t go on…" Duan Shulin staggered back, battered and broken. "Yes, you can." ...

title: To My Beloved Misfortune
summary: Marriage with him? I'd rather live in seclusion for the rest of my life." Milord Eckhart, Selena's rival and an unfortunate man who can't get anything right from one to ten. What's all this about 'everyone's first love'? Even if it was a request from the king himself, marrying him was an absurd idea. ...That must have been the case. "You ungrateful wretch! I fed and clothed you, and you don't even appreciate it! Do you not know who's keeping your sister alive?" Selena realized her situation. If only she could escape this life, which was no different from being a s*ave. 'I will become Selena Eckhart, not Selena Steward.' Selena decided to use the arrogant man, Milord. * * * "Let's get married." His lips, which had been close, slowly moved away. Milord looked at her wet lips, then shook himself and pushed her away. "Selena, what are you doing now?" Selena put her knee between Milord's legs. "Once is difficult, twice is easy, Milord."

title: Mr. Ye’s Secret Lover
summary: He was some girl's husband-to-be, and she was in love with someone else. The two of them didn't love each other but coincidentally got together. In the night, she was his booty call, while in the day, she was just a nameless actress working for peanuts. She didn't mean to shoot to fame but endured all torment to get back everything belonging to her. He stood by and watched her going through vicissitudes of life. Every time she racked her brain to approach the goal, he resorted to all kinds of means to undermine her. He wove the illusion that he had fallen for her. However, when she finally sunk into his net, he sent her a wedding invitation. Looking at her helpless eyes, he flung a cold sentence, "Girl, the game is over."

title: Super Powered Teacher
summary: If before you say something, you had to think it through in your mind first. If every step you take, is carefully tread. If every decision you make, you’re afraid that you will regret it. Then, what do you need youth for? I am not an intense teacher, and not a super teacher. Being here, I do not want to change the education system, and do not want to reform all the students, all I’m doing is working for a meal. Xia Yu, the moment he was stamped with the label of a teacher, his legend also began…

title: The Timid Noble Daughter and the Rebellious General
summary: Meng Xiaotang, a corporate drone, one day transmigrates into the body of Yue Moyuan, the daughter of a noble family abandoned by her relatives in the deep mountains. Bearing a black birthmark, Yue Moyuan returns alone to the Capital City, determined to make something of her life. Meanwhile, the rebellious Great General Chang Yunshang, renowned for his military achievements—why does he insist on marrying only her? Is this truly deep affection, or is there another motive?

title: The Game Became Reality, I Built the Immortal Clan of the Ages
summary: Li Wei unexpectedly came across a cultivation family simulator. He discovered that the descendants in the game would present him with all sorts of peculiar offerings. “Thank you, Ancestor, for your blessings. Our family has become the number one household!” “Quick, offer a tribute to the Ancestor. Please accept this immortal artifact!” “Ancestor, we have already dominated the immortal realm!” “……” Until one day. The descendants of the Li family appeared on Earth in a grand procession aboard a flying ship. Under the stunned gaze of the entire world, those Li family descendants who once existed only in the game marched grandly toward Li Wei to worship him. “Welcome home, Ancestor!”
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: The Demon Lord Who Should Destroy Humanity… Is Currently Busy Dating
summary: In an accident, the girl who should have died was reincarnated as a demon lord in another world. Yet the moment she saw her natural enemy—the hero—she fell hopelessly in love. Just like in the stories, being killed by the hero is the destined end of every demon lord. Thus, after “cutting through thorns and brambles” on his journey, the hero finally pointed his sword at her as she sat upon the throne. “I will definitely kill you, Demon Lord!” But before he could even finish delivering that cool line…

title: My Ex-Husband Became The Male Lead
summary: Renna, who lost her life, was reincarnated into a novel she used to read in her previous life. Thankful for getting another chance, she lived her life peacefully until one day, the Male lead appeared in front of her out of nowhere and made a request. "....I need you to make me a potion that can make my desire disappear." "What....kind of desire?" "....sexual.....desire.....". The problem here.....is that the man asking for the potion to be made is Renna's ex-husband who lost his life on the same day as she did. Her stoical monk of an ex-husband. Her ex-husband, who throughout their marriage, was the literal meaning of the word ice. He had possessed the famous Male Lead and appeared in front of her!

title: Rebirth of a Little Cannon Fodder in the ’70s
summary: Ye Mi went to the countryside for five years, and finally died of illness before the college entrance examination resumed. Before she died, she realized that she was actually just a vicious cannon fodder in a book. The only function of her life was to frame the heroine to go to the countryside and create opportunities for the hero and heroine to meet each other. Waking up again, she found herself reborn two years ago. Looking back on the miserable days of not having a full meal for five consecutive years in her previous life, Ye Mi immediately packed herself up and found an honest man to marry, forgetting what her mother told her not to marry before she went to the countryside. As long as she can have enough to eat, she will obediently be someone’s wife. But life after marriage seems to be different from what she imagined? The big chicken leg was dangling in front of his eyes, exuding a tempting aroma, Ye Mi salivated and s**ked his saliva. “Want to eat?” “Want to!” “Memorize five texts before dinner.” The s*umbag Ye Mi reluctantly closed her eyes: “…deal!” He intends to take responsibility for the girl’s reputation, so he will raise another younger sister. Unexpectedly, this little wife has a bad temper, is incapable of learning, and loves to study. This makes Jing Ziheng, who is a teacher in the village primary school, especially look down on her. There is no way, my wife teaches by herself, and the wife is still young, so she can always get it back after a break.
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: LV999 Villager (LN)
summary: Fantasy World: Earth Clear In this world, every individual is born with a role that defines their way of life: Royalty, Hero, Sage, Warrior, Fighter, Monk, Mage... and the weakest role of all, existing solely to enrich and develop the world—the Villager. Devoid of combat prowess, Villagers are mere existences to be protected in a world overrun by monsters. However, one day, an ordinary Villager with an average level of 10 reaches the unimaginable pinnacle of Level 999. Having attained the ultimate limit and finding no value beyond accumulating wealth, the Villager named Koji encounters Alice, a demon girl deemed an enemy of humanity. This fateful meeting sparks a new sense of purpose in Koji, setting him on a perilous path to defy the fate of the world. Thus begins the epic saga of the weakest Villager's heroic journey!

title: The Tale of the Hunter in the Dark
summary: “I want to experience a love that will go down in history!”A hunter who exterminates Eodukseoni and the monsters they create. They are known as Eodukseoni Hunters.Yoon Siha is no ordinary leave-of-absence college student—he is an Eodukseoni Hunter. One day, he happens to pick up a handsome Neosu who has fallen from the Heavenly Realm.Introducing himself as Cheonyul, a demigod, the Neosu claims that in order to become a perfect god, he must awaken the emotion called love…“Can’t I just try it with you first?” “……Try what?” “Love.”Siha lets out a deep sigh. Is this guy seriously insane?However, since Siha happened to be without a partner at the time, he ends up dragging Cheonyul along on his Eodukseoni-hunting missions.A full-scale exorcism (physical) action fantasy featuring a human and a demigod duo!

title: Hidden Flame
summary: Song Chaohuan always knew why Yan Xun married her: 1. Her family was weak and easy to control. 2. She was unloved at home—no one would back her. With her, the rebellious young master could marry without restraint and still indulge in his decadent lifestyle. Everyone said she was lucky to marry up. What couldn’t Yan Xun give her—except love? Obediently, she became his wife. She watched from the sidelines as flirtatious women lit his cigarettes. Listened in silence as he answered midnight calls and never came home. She was quiet and well-behaved. No one knew—it all began with a single moment of kindness from him in their youth, which she cherished for years. But youthful infatuation doesn’t last forever. After seven years, her love burned out. She realized some hearts could never be warmed. So, she decided to leave. Yan Xun sneered, “Do as you please.” Everyone praised him for being cold and carefree. Even after his lawful wife left, he lived freely and unbothered. Until one night at a high-society gala—Song Chaohuan appeared as the guest designer, handpicked by the hostess. Outside the hotel, dressed in an elegant qipao, she greeted him with polite distance: “Mr. Yan, please step aside.” She passed by without pause, leaving him standing in the rain, eyes rimmed red.

title: After Transferring to a Correspondence High School, a Harem High School Life With Beautiful Girls for Some Reason Began.
summary: Minazuki Makito, a student at a private high school in Tokyo, gets into a violent incident with a student from another school when he tries to save a beautiful blonde girl from a delinquent on a night street. Although it is not Makito’s fault, he is suspended from high school. Makito, who has always been an honor student, becomes afraid of how he will be viewed by others because of the violence and decides to transfer to a correspondence high school at the recommendation of his parents. On his first day of school after transferring to a correspondence school, he goes to the building where the high school is located. When he arrives at the building where the high school is located, he finds that his classmates include a beautiful girl who is a famous idol, a famous athlete, and even a popular internet streamer. All of them are beautiful girls, and Makito is now living in a harem high school with famous girls from different circles, but in fact, each of them has their own reasons ……?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Assassin Who Transcends Myths
summary: No. 1, who spent his entire life as the hunting dog of a grand duke’s family. “It’s an order. Kill yourself.” Betrayed and discarded by his master. But the end became a new beginning. “I’m the second son now?” Reborn as the younger brother of the first son who abandoned him. “This time, I’ll live the life I desire!” The legend of Sigmund, an assassin wielding the most powerful bloodline, begins!

title: Miracle All-rounder
summary: Han Jin-hyuk, once hailed as a genius, suffered a shoulder injury from overwork in high school, forcing him to give up his playing career. Unable to let go of his passion for baseball, he hovered on the brink of professional baseball. One day, a miracle struck. But the miracle didn't end there. Jin-hyuk, empowered by an unknown force, transformed from a pitcher to an all-rounder... The story of Han Jin-hyuk, the great all-rounder who conquered both Korean and American baseball. Written by Yesung. Illustrated by Jo Min-jae.

title: A River of Spring Mist
summary: The moment the Succubus within me awakened, my boyfriend, Chen Yan, broke up with me. I crouched by the side of the road and sobbed-not because of the breakup, but because... I felt miserable. Chen Yan looked a bit annoyed. He pulled his roommate over and said, "Help me deal with this. I have a date." Jiang Chiye hummed in response and nodded. He walked over and asked me, "Li Wu, what will it take to make you stop crying?" I cautiously smoothed down my skirt, terrified he would see my rabbit tail. But things were going south fast; my ears were about to pop out, too. I could only bite my lip and plead, "I need a kiss." Jiang Chiye arched an eyebrow. "What kind of kiss?" I reached up to press down on my twitching ears and whispered, "The kind that doesn't stop until I'm satisfied."

title: Unparalleled Heavenly Lord
summary: Zheng Shiyi was born with a matchless supreme soul but had his soul taken away from him by the ancestral land. This is the story of him trying to attain justice, get his soul back and create the legend that was meant to be his.

title: Descendants of the False Gods
summary: This isn’t your typical tale of romance or destiny. No reincarnation. No systems. No finger-snapping god powers. Just raw, unfiltered struggle. Two young men. Two burning souls. Thrown into a brutal world on a distant planet where magic clashes with machines, fists meet fangs, and the line between science and divinity is razor-thin. Here, the beastfolk wield mysterious arts. Humans fight with bare knuckles and sheer will. Dwarves build empires with steam and steel. Elves bend the elements with ancient spells. And above them all, in the shadows, loom the False Gods—wielding twisted science that borders on divine. This is a brotherhood-forged-in-battle story. The heroes don’t seek glory. They just want to survive. But survival in this world means shedding blood, facing fire, and standing tall when everything tries to drag you down. They still laugh. They still bleed. They still love. But make no mistake—this is a story about the cost of staying alive when the world is designed to break you. “Descendants of the False Gods” — If you're tired of overpowered protagonists and cheat codes, dive into a world where every victory is earned with sweat, pain, and defiance. Want a story that punches harder with every chapter? Curious about a universe where magic and steampunk go to war? Open this book—meet the brothers, face the storm—and find out what it really means to fight like hell when gods aren't on your side.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mecha, Mystery, Sci-fi

title: Senior Sister, Don’t Be Afraid, I’ll Protect You
summary: Luo Ye had a crush on a girl in high school for three years and even got into the same university as her. They had agreed that if they both got into the same university, they would be together, but the girl reneged on their agreement. Heartbroken, Luo Ye transformed into a romance novel author, and unexpectedly, before university even started, his novel hit the top of the platform rankings and he became famous. After starting university, Luo Ye thought he would never fall in love again, but then he met a cool and aloof senior female student. Luo Ye decided to secretly date the senior and then stun everyone. "Sorry, Junior Brother is now mine," Su Bai Zhou said assertively. *** "What happened later? Mr. Luo Ye, how did you fall in love with the famous comic artist Su Bai Zhou?" Hearing this, Luo Ye touched his head, looked at that stunning figure, and said with a soft smile, "She secretly adapted my book into a comic..."

She emptied them all! She tricked her stepsister and her stepsister/not-biological brother into going to the most remote and harsh rural area of Xinshi. I’ll be your knight.” When did I say that, crazy brother? So, I became the emperor thanks to my crazy little brother. I’m doing well because it seems to suit my aptitude. “Sister! I need to find a good worker, no, a husband. “Eddy, I’m thinking of getting married now.” “I’ll find the best brother-in-law in the world.” “No need to be the best in the world, just work well and listen well…” “I can’t accept a man who’s weaker than me to be sister’s partner. The story begins during the post-graduation trip of our protagonist, where he discovers some ancient ruins and witnesses “the great change”, an upheaval that changed everything. The changing earth not only brought about new, unexplored landscape but also sparked the evolution of all organisms. Plants and animals started gaining sentience and some humans obtained unimaginable powers. The legends, myths, and tales of old seemed to have suddenly come to life as the earth entered a new era where beasts and men formed factions, explored new lands and ultimately struggled for supremacy.

She wasn’t sure if it was because she rescued him from a gang of bullies, or because she helped him reclaim something he loved— but from that day on, he listened only to her. The gap between their worlds, along with the shadows of his past, made her decide to keep her distance. Yet no matter how coldly or firmly she rejected him, he never backed down. Because of her, he kept showing up in places he didn’t belong. Eventually, she was moved by his persistence. During an unexpected incident, she was ordered to provide guidance to an S-Class Sentinel on the verge of losing control. The Commander’s only request was to "buy as much time as possible." But what happened next exceeded everyone’s expectations. When Shen Xizhen entered the Sealed Ward, unlike others, she wasn’t subjected to indiscriminate attacks. Once the guidance began, the ferociously snarling Spirit Entity even retracted its claws, its fluffy tail curling around her wrist. The Commanders in the monitoring room began to doubt their eyes. Then that night, Minato met the sisters again at a meeting with his father’s remarriage partner. This is a story not only about the coincidence of the remarriage, but also about the fate that was set in motion by saving the sisters. Why are all the supernatural entities fawning over Chen Feng?" ...Years later, people ask Chen Feng. "How did you master the supernatural realm world?"

title: Yuanxi
summary: The following tale is entirely fictional and any similarities to real-life events or people are purely coincidental. After a decade of heartache, Lin Nuan decided to take her own life by jumping into the river. However, instead of death, her soul traveled to a new body - that of Yuan Xi in Yebei. From a tender age, Yuan Xi's father had been nurturing her, hoping that she would become one of the most prominent women in the land. When the emperor's three-year mourning period finally came to an end, a grand ceremony was held to select new members for his harem. The proud father had anticipated that his daughter would be among the chosen, but to his dismay, she was eliminated from the competition. Read on to discover how Yuan Xi was able to regain entry to the Chinese palace, how she dealt with the hidden threats lurking around every corner, and how she fought to thrive in the complex and ancient system that demanded the "Appointment of Crown Prince and then Matricide."

title: After Clearing the Game, the Defeated Darkened Girls All Came to Kill Me!
summary: On the way to school on the first day of the new term, Zhu Hanqi ran into incredible luck. He thought he was about to leave his mundane life behind and embark on a thrilling new chapter. The first half of his expectations came true, but the second half— “You’re telling me I spent years as the Demon King, ruthlessly amassing a fortune, wiping out princesses, saintesses, and heroes one after another, only to finally reach the endgame screen, and now I’m back…”
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance

title: The Early-Deceased Mother of the Male Lead
summary: Luo Wen Shu, a genius in the mystical arts, unexpectedly transmigrated into a novel on the night she became the sect leader, becoming the deceased mother of the male lead. Her husband in this world won't appear until much later, and the future selfish and ruthless dark-hearted male lead is currently only five years old—small, frail, yet clever and well-behaved. Luo Wen Shu: I can save him with proper nurturing! Facing their poverty-stricken household, she decides to resume her old profession. … “Friend, I see darkness in your forehead, indicating an impending accident. I have a blessed amulet here. Given our destined encounter, it's only 19,888! Take it home!” Witnessing this beautiful woman peddling ridiculously overpriced amulets while casually dodging a falling flowerpot, a speeding motorcycle, and even kicking away a knife-wielding lunatic—all within seconds— Jin Youqian, terrified, nearly kneels down. “Master, I’ll buy! I’ll buy right now! Please stop showing off your skills!” … Luo Xingyu (the male lead) created a short video account, documenting his daily life like a diary. X month X day: Bought Mom a bouquet of flowers. X month X day: Did laundry and swept the floor. X month X day: Collected money, collected money, and more money. His follower count gradually increased, with the comment section flooded with people wanting to be his mother. Later, Luo Xingyu posted a video: a woman in Hanfu, her hair adorned with a jade hairpin, sat under the eaves. A gentle voice said: “Xingxing, did you receive the money?” Immediately, a female voice announced: “Alipay payment received: 66,666 yuan!” Netizens learned that this little radish head they affectionately called “baby son” was actually the family’s treasurer, with at least hundreds of thousands in his account! The comment section took a turn: Brother, quickly ask your mother if she needs more children?! Luo Xingyu: …? PS: This is a fictional work. PPS: The female lead is incredibly powerful; the male lead Xie Fei is a supporting character.

title: The Guardian Knight Failed to Protect His Lord
summary: I could not protect my lord. I, a failed Guardian Knight, and to someone like me, a second chance arrived: a chance to go back, five years into the past. Into the body of the youngest young lord. The one who died young at fifteen from a rare illness. Why this body..? No, rather, this is perfect. “Hah. The body of the greatest genius, the family has ever produced.” This life will be different. Everything that threatens my lord, I will crush it. The source of the danger. The source behind that source. Every last one of them..! I will crush them all.

title: The Shadow of Great Britain
summary: “Next, please welcome the highest noble, the winner of the Order of the Garter, the Order of St. Michael and St. George, the Order of the Bath, the Victoria Cross, and the lower-ranking knights, the leader of the anti-colonial movement, the bell-ringer of the East India Company, the hero of the Crimean War, a fellow of the Royal Society, a lifelong friend of literary giants such as Dickens and Dumas, a staunch supporter of scientific stars such as Faraday and Darwin, who has served as an assistant minister, deputy minister, and permanent secretary of the Ministry of the Interior, the Ministry of the Navy, and other departments of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, the first cabinet secretary and civil servant of the kingdom, and the most outstanding alumnus of our school, respected Sir Arthur Hastings, who is about to give a speech at the 50th anniversary celebration of the University of London.” Arthur’s gaze swept across the audience, looking at the young faces, and he muttered to himself, “Agares, do you think I should say something?” The red devil’s shadow floated behind him, and his saliva almost dripped from the corner of his mouth. “Look at these ignorant souls, they still worship you as a hero. Why not say something they’d like to hear?” Arthur took a deep breath and let out a thunderous roar, “Oxford is all raised by prostit**es!” “Oh!!!!!!” The audience erupted in thunderous applause. “Cambridge is the same!” he added immediately. The applause grew even more intense.

title: The Magical Girl Can’t Stop Loving Her Best Friend
summary: "It's perfectly normal for magical girls to be girls, right?" "So, it's also perfectly reasonable that after Xiao Lian became a magical girl, her feelings for her best friend transformed into love, right?" Right? Of course not! That's completely unreasonable

title: The Parachute Hire is Too Competent
summary: Next Planet, a mega-scale theme park. You’re offering me a division director position—and telling me to bring Next Planet back to life? I’m just an ordinary office worker. Me? Seriously… me?

title: Dark Sky Lord
summary: "A child rejected by the world. Thrown into the darkness. He ate and slept amidst the tearing of human flesh and screams. One day, a small demon disappeared from the Fertility Chamber of Zeus, where the living cannot leave. Now, helpless and all but lost, he is reborn. As the Emperor of the Underworld. Emperor, the day is yours to rule, but I'm the master of the Dark Sky!"

title: Super Insight System
summary: Initially, he just hoped to earn wealth to better the lives of his family. When he became wealthy, he just hoped for power so that when the time came to protect his family, he wasn’t powerless to do so. When he obtained power, he just hoped to evolve his life to obtain immortality! Escaping death despite being struck by lightning; and obtaining the Insight System after the incident. This was no dream. Traversing thousands of worlds under the heavens, learning secret techniques of the powerful, and finally standing at the pinnacle! Searching for the secrets behind the evolution of the natural order all to obtain eternal life!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Martial Arts

title: Entertainment: From Street Interviews to Global Stardom
summary: [Hardcore Host Style] Interviewing The Climbers: For the nation, we reach the summit, not yielding an inch! Interviewing The Captain: Trust us! We are professionally trained, confident, and capable of ensuring your safety! Interviewing My People, My Country: The martyrs would smile with relief; the flag will always have its successors! Interviewing the CCTV Boys, Kang, Sa, and Zhu: Knowledge brings confidence; even witty banter can be humorous! Interviewing The Bravest, Operation Mekong, Operation Red Sea, and more… I am Host Yang Fan, taking everyone on a journey to explore the stories behind the films! Feilu Novel Network reminds you: This novel and its characters are purely fictional. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental. Please do not imitate.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: Heart-warming Meals with Mother Fenrir
summary: Femrude was born as one of the two twin children of one of the possible heirs to the throne of the kingdom of Ellansrild, a country with a strong discrimination against beastmen, and with a belief that twins bring misfortune and are cursed. Therefore his father throws him in the forest to die before the other royals know about his existence. Femrude is picked up by the legendary Fenrir as a baby. He was originally a Japanese but can't remember his previous life, except for random knowledge. The now 12-year-old Femrude spends his days being spoiled by his beloved new mother, while being brought up with lots of love. To give back to his precious family, he reproduces Japanese cuisine in this new world, one dish after another. To his surprise, not only his mother (Fenrir), but also the beastmen living in this world love his food. Solving problems one after another with his honest, gentle character, and the skills to attract both races, he aims to become a bridge between the humans and the beastmen!

title: Investment Return System, Start by taking Demon Empress as a Disciple
summary: Chen Daoxuan stumbled upon an extraordinary system after crossing into a new realm. Whenever he took an apprentice under his wing, unimaginable rewards awaited him, and the critical hits from his apprentices would return ten thousandfold. Puzzled, Chen Daoxuan wondered, "Why don't my disciples seem to regard me the same way?" The eldest disciple, the Demon Empress, declared with unwavering loyalty, As long as the master gives an order, the disciple is willing to sacrifice everything in the world for the master." Second Disciple, Saintess: "What is the highest state of Master?" Third Disciple, Sword Immortal: "Damn it, the world says I am the number one swordsman genius in the world, but why am I not even ten thousandth as good as my master?" As word of Chen Daoxuan's abilities spreads, the reverence towards him grows. Many Holy Places: "If we are a holy place, then his power is like a heavenly existence!" All Immortals in the Immortal World: "His strength is not comparable to that of our fairyland, and he is probably already the supreme saint!" Saint Supreme: "Don't get involved with me, I don't want to face that existence either!" Embark on a thrilling journey as Chen Daoxuan grapples with the consequences of his newfound powers and the complexities of his relationships with his devoted disciples. Unravel the mysteries of the system that granted him his strength, and discover the true extent of his abilities in a world where unimaginable forces collide. Prepare to be enthralled by this captivating tale of power, loyalty, and otherworldly encounters. Witness the rise of an enigmatic master whose might echoes through the realms. Brace yourself for an epic adventure that will leave you yearning for more!
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: Hime Gitsune no Servant
summary: 「Hikaru-kun will marry me! It’s written in stone!」declaring this proudly, childhood friends Asahina Murasaki and Mizuhara Hikaru were s**ked into an ancient scroll found in a decrepit shrine. Thrust into an unknown land, the one who saved Hikaru was a beautiful fox-eared girl who proclaimed herself the guardian of the capital. She declared this towards a dumbfounded Hikaru, 「Incompetent, what kind of attitude is that towards your master?」 Before he realized it, he had been made the servant of this foul-mouthed girl, but even so, what he got involved in while searching for his childhood friend was A conspiracy? Or bloodshed? 「I just wanted to live a peaceful life……」 The curtain splendidly rises in a fight of love and action in a different world.

title: Regressor of Yandere Academy
summary: Congratulations on your enrollment in the Academy. A grand battle against the endlessly encroaching yanderes awaits. Conquer them with your gaslighting skills and lower-body prowess, honed over eight lifetimes.
genres: Action, Adult, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Romance, School Life

title: Sewu Dino
summary: SEWU DINO is a sequel to JANUR IRENG, the beginning of Babad Songkor. When greed has infiltrated the human heart and clouded its vision, it drives people to justify any means just for the sake of an illusory glory in this fleeting world. This mixed Javanese and Indonesian horror story has been adapted into a film in 2023, directed by Kimo Stamboel and produced by Manoj Punjabi. This film is also enlivened by famous Indonesian artists such as Mikha Tambayong, Rio Dewanto, Karina Suwandi, etc. From the bestselling author of TRAH PITU LAKON UNIVERSE and KKN di Desa Penari, SimpleMan returns with another mystical tale from the heart of Java—a curse sent to devour human lives. The more we think we’ve found a way out, the more lost we become. Because this story is far greater than you can imagine.
genres: Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Slice of Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: God-given Musical Genius
summary: My life, knowing nothing but music, was filled with failure and regret. But God gave me the opportunity to live as a Korean, Lee Su-beom. I will correct all the regrets I had back then. And to my family, my friends, and everyone else, I will show them the music I couldn't show them.

title: So You Have Loved Me Too
summary: She is the Ji family's prospective granddaughter-in-law. But on the day of her engagement, she meets a blindfolded man. From then on, she gets unknowingly blindfolded and sent to a mysterious location repeatedly. Finally, she gets pregnant one day. Her mind is thrown into chaos. She tries to get the baby aborted at the hospital, but she gets blindfolded again on the surgery table and is sent to him. When she finally sees his face, she becomes even more flustered, “Why is it you?” The man smiles at her gently, “Marry me. All those people who bullied you will now have to respect you." Ji Anning: “…” One fine day, Ji Anning touches her protruding belly as she asks Mr Ji with a look of dilemma, “Honey, what should the baby call you after it’s born?” Mr Ji: “…”

title: Attending Court for My Husband, Listening to My Thoughts, Eating Melons, and Laughing Heartily
summary: [Mind-Reading + Gossip + Sweet and Lighthearted + Romantic Pairing] Shen Mingzhu accidentally fell into the water, transmigrated, and bound herself to a Gossip system. Before she could enjoy any gossip, she first learned that she had transmigrated into a book! In the book, she is a villainous side character, and even her mother and brothers are destined to be cannon fodder. How can this be! Gua Gua: Host, the emperor's true love is the empress, and his precious treasure is the Crown Prince. You've been betrothed as the Crown Princess! Shen Mingzhu: What? The beautiful, strong, and tragic character is my fiancé? Watch me turn him into a heartthrob! Gua Gua: Host, your maternal grandfather and two older brothers are about to be sacrificed! Shen Mingzhu: No! Watch me expose the traitor and sweep through the enemy army! Gua Gua: Oh, Host, Chaoyang Princess's Imperial Son-in-Law is having an affair with a maid, and they've pulled a 'civet cat swapping the princess' scheme. Shen Mingzhu: Poor Chaoyang Princess! Should I tell her so she can thrash the s*umbag couple?! Crown Prince Yan Beichen woke up one day to find himself with a little Crown Princess. Wherever she went, she was eating melons, immersed in the joy of gossip every day. Hey, hey, hey! Crown Princess, I'm the Crown Prince! Could you please pay some attention to me! Unwittingly, the entire Great Yan Dynasty began to treat Shen Mingzhu with the utmost courtesy. Shen Mingzhu: Gua Gua, I accidentally became a heartthrob! Hehe~~~ Yan Beichen: My Crown Princess is a heartthrob! I'll wave the banner for my Crown Princess! Gua Gua: ...Host, you're amazing
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Wind Heard Her Confession
summary: Synopsis: Lin Yuran never would have thought that the client sitting across from her, forcing them both to work together, was the high school classmate she had rejected long ago, Chi Ye. The two maintained a distant yet courteous relationship, keeping their distance as they worked together. However, Lin Yuran gradually felt something wasn't quite right. For example, why did this man insist on her working at his company instead of her own studio? And moreover, how come her office just so happened to be directly opposite his? Another instance, when Lin Yuran accepted a ride in another man's Rolls-Royce Phantom, Chi Ye only sighed, "I thought I'd never get to ride a luxury car like this in my life." The very next day, Chi Ye's car changed to a Bentley, then Bugatti, followed by Koenigsegg... Another time, Lin Yuran accidentally stumbled upon Chi Ye's Baidu profile and discovered that her favorite lollipop factory was registered under his name. But rumor had it that the factory closed five years ago, and that some mysterious big shot loved eating these lollipops, so he bought the factory and continued production regardless of profit or loss, no matter what the situation. Numerous clues led Lin Yuran to suspect— Chi Ye still liked her? Little did she know, even their second encounter was part of his plan. Yet Chi Ye remained unaware that on that sweltering afternoon six years ago, Lin Yuran had quietly watched his lonely figure from afar and murmured softly, "If we meet again someday, I hope I can respond to you." That year, only the wind heard her confession.

title: Sister’s Revenge
summary: I am the Concubine-born Daughter of the Prime Minister's Mansion. When the nation was in peril, as I fled for my life, I shared my rations with a beggar by the roadside, while my legitimate elder sister led our family to seek refuge with the general. Later, the beggar led an uprising and seized power, and I was made empress, honored as the mother of the nation. But my legitimate elder sister was reduced to a camp prostitute, forced to receive hundreds of men each day, living a fate worse than death. Living my life over again, my legitimate elder sister slapped the sesame cake from my hand and handed her exquisite pastries to the beggar: "Eat. If it's not enough, there's more here."

title: Aoharu Point
summary: People have "points". Everyone's lives are ruled by values or points based on various factors – looks, studying ability, and communication ability. Figures were floating above people's heads. For some reason, I kept seeing said/such points. For example, the figure hovering over the head of my classmate, Yui Kasuga, is 46. Considerably low points. She doesn't know how to read the mood and doesn't even have friends. In order to raise Kasuga's point, I end up getting involved with her–... Kasuga's rising points, and I who was supposed to have given up all hope on changing. This is the story of our "branching point" in life
genres: Completed, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Silent World
summary: Hadori Kento is a normal high school student whom can be found anywhere in the world, but "he" actually is not so normal. Kento holds a certain secret—he has the ability to accelerate himself to extraordinary speeds. Why he has this ability and for what he should use it, he himself does not know yet. Without finding the answer, he spends his life very peacefully... that is until he meets a person with the same ability. The person he meets is a serial slasher called "Silent Killer."

title: Manual for Using a Chaebol Lover
summary: “Let’s get married.” “You can’t mean… marriage as payment for saving your son?” “That’s about right.” Han Yeong-seo—born the black sheep of the Han family, forever branded the unwanted child. Despite her remarkable talent, endless obstacles and sabotage kept her from the spotlight, leaving her to scr*pe by as an unknown actress, doing odd jobs just to survive… Until one day, trapped in a hotel storage room, she saves a handsome little boy. Who would have guessed that this child’s father is none other than Yoo Si-hyuk—the illegitimate son of Korea’s top conglomerate, a man as famous for his chiseled, sculptural looks as for his icy demeanor! And with those cold eyes, he suddenly demands: Marry me, in exchange for saving my son. What kind of outrageous deal is that? Perfect from head to toe, yet hopeless when it comes to human relationships, Yoo Si-hyuk barges into her life. And from the moment Yeong-seo meets this complicated father-and-son pair, her world begins to change, little by little…

title: Beyond the Bullet Screen
summary: Yet another cold war with Zhou Xiao had begun. I was just about to send him a long, emotional essay to make amends when a stream of bullet comments suddenly flashed across my vision: [Here we go, here we go. The male lead's buddies egged him on to give the female lead the cold shoulder again. He's so s*upid.] [The male lead steps out from under his friends' "umbrella" only to realize it isn't even raining. LMAO.] [Keep playing games. Once he actually breaks up with the female lead, his friends will be tripping over themselves to get in line for her.] [Female lead, look at the male lead's childhood best friend-the one who supposedly hates you the most. If you so much as smile at him, he'd give you his life.] I froze. Skeptical but curious, I deleted my draft and sent a different message instead: "Happy breakup." A second later, my Moments feed exploded with likes.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Relaxed Journey of the Bag Hero in Another World ~ Exiled from the Royal Castle as a Failed Hero and Dropped into the Abyss. But in reality, the bag can absorb anything and was a cheat weapon that could order anything from Japan. There’s no intention to go back even if they beg for forgiveness now.
summary: One day I, Keisuke Sakudaira, a high school student, was summoned to another world as the “Bag Hero”. However, I was expelled by the queen who summoned me because she said a bag wouldn’t be useful. Later, I was thrown into the most difficult dungeon where I thought I would die. But… “Huh, this bag can store both attacks and monsters!?” “Huh!? I can summon food and drinks as much as I want!?” Surprisingly, this bag… was a cheat. Freed from the task of defeating the Demon King, I embarked on a leisurely journey through this different world with this cheat bag in hand.

title: For Those Returning Bastards a Beating Is the Best Remedy
summary: "Those returnee bastards need a good beating. The higher-ups just don't get it." The absolute supreme ruler who commanded the world, the hero who saved it, the witch who schemed in the city's shadows. All those returnee bastards are ticking time bombs, but there's one key difference. Unlike bombs, they quiet down in the face of violence.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Tragedy

title: The Land of Shadows and Fire
summary: The Land of Shadows and Fire follows Im An, a courageous woman betrayed by her closest friend and thrust into a mysterious, magical realm. In this new world filled with danger, ancient powers, and dark secrets, she meets Jin, a skilled warrior with a painful past. Together, they battle the Shadow Army led by her betrayer, uncover hidden truths about their destinies, and fight to restore balance to the realm. Along the way, Im An learns the meaning of strength, forgiveness, and love, transforming from a victim of betrayal into a powerful force of hope and fire.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural

title: I Caged By Stranger
summary: Cheng Songsong was saved by a man in a fire ten years ago, but she thought the man was Ji Mengran who was lying in the hospital …… Because of the opposition of Ji Mengran’s family, they had a serious car accident on the way to elope, which turned Ji Mengran into a vegetable. She took all the blame and had to suffer humiliation from Ji’s family, living like a poor s*ave! “sl*t, b*tch, you hurt my second brother, and seduced my elderly brother! ” She is framed at the birthday party of Ji’s father, she woke up to find herself in someone else’s bed and took all the blame. She never imagined that the one who saved her life was the big brother Ji Jingcheng who wanted her to atone for her sins. ... “Jingcheng, brother, I love Songsong, please let her go. Don’t ever tell her the truth. Don’t ruin my hard-earned happiness, please!” The voice of Mengran suddenly echoed in the mind, Meng Jingcheng hesitated and shopped the kiss to Cheng Songsong. But, Meng Jingcheng was scared, he was afraid of losing control of his feeling if he continued to spend time with Songsong…… Tell her, he loves her; Tell her, the truth about that fire.

title: The Urban Legend Has Become Widespread
summary: "Do you know about the Patrolman?" This is a tale about a new urban legend that is born from a series of mysterious incidents. After 8 PM at night, while walking and looking at their smartphone, people are warned from behind that—"it's dangerous to walk and use your phone at the same time". However, when they turn around, there's no one there. The "Patrolman" urban legend says that if you ignore the warning and continue to look at your phone, someone will push you from behind at a pedestrian crossing when the traffic light is red. At first, it seemed like a common urban legend, but strange events kept happening to those who heard the story… This is the story of how a new urban legend is born.
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Horror, Psychological, School Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Doppelganger: Slept With A Man Who Resembled The Child’s Father
summary: Her boyfriend, Gong Suha, a soldier, died during an operation. About six years after giving birth and raising his child alone, Yeoreum met Gi Hyunjae— a man who looked strikingly like her late boyfriend. His appearance, his build, even his voice. He was, quite literally, Suha’s doppelgänger. “That’s right. I’ve just been pretending to be a good guy all this time to seduce you.” “Are you crying because I might kiss another woman? Even though you already have a husband and a child?” Although only his looks were the same, with a dirty personality and a cynical way of speaking that were the complete opposite of Suha… “I must be crazy too. What’s so pretty about a woman who cries because she can’t forget another man?” “……” “Do you want to try meeting me while thinking of me as Gong Suha? If you want, I could even be that kid’s father.” Every time Hyunjae came closer, Yeoreum found herself helplessly shaken and drawn to him. At times, traces of Suha overlapped with Hyunjae, and Yeoreum dismissed it as nothing more than a ridiculous coincidence. At least, until his memories returned.

title: Longing
summary: Out of nowhere, I started hearing the Emperor's inner thoughts. While others are busy flattering one another, he's thinking: You moron! That man cuckolded you, and here you are calling him your brother! While reviewing memorials: I've had it. Is this Governor for real? Every single day he asks if I want mangoes. I don't eat mangoes! I'm allergic to them! On the imperial bed: I specifically wore the inner robes with the little dragons embroidered on them today. The Empress is going to love them once I strip down! Tee-hee! Me: ...Could you be any more ridiculous?!

title: I Am the Youngest Disciple of the Martial Arts World’s Mastermind
summary: Righteous sects and evil sects, dark path and light path. Even the demonic cult and martial arts alliance. The truth is, there’s actually a mastermind puppeteer controlling everything in the martial arts world from behind the scenes! Don’t believe it? Then where do you think all those miraculous elixirs and convenient coincidences come from when the protagonists need them? “Soso, did you place the Thousand-Year Earth Essence on the path for that Huashan disciple?” “Yes, Master!” “And did you set up the smoke for the Black King Mountain’s mechanism formation?” “Yes, Master!” It’s all been me, who became the martial arts mastermind’s disciple! Setting everything up! Diligently! Behind the scenes! *** “Your body is.” “Is it an Extreme Yin Constitution?” “No.” “Then, um, the opposite? An Extreme Yang Constitution?” “No. Soso, you are no-thing special. You just have internal energy like a pig.” What did you say? Oink oink? I’m just overflowing with an absurd amount of internal energy, so if I get caught by the demonic cult, they’ll devour me completely? That’s why Master rescued the original protagonist and future Heavenly Demon from being a s*ave of the demonic cult and took him as a disciple. But then he grew up so fast and. “You said you wouldn’t let me be alone.” This desirable martial hero, who’s now two spans taller than me. “I have feelings for you.” Oh my goodness!

title: Become God From Scratch
summary: Lin Xuan has started over. As a newborn, he became the weakest member of the family due to premature birth. His eldest sister, Lin Rou, is a martial arts prodigy with supernatural strength, His second brother, Lin Wu, is a genius mechanic with exceptional intelligence. And his third sister, Lin Long, is a mysterious scholar who can listen to all voices. But what about baby Lin Xuan? He is weak, helpless, and pitiful… Fortunately, shortly after birth, he discovered that he possessed an evolutionary panel that allowed him to infinitely grow through gaining experience: From [Nutritional Absorption] to the material-level [Absolute Devouring]. From [Tentative Steps] to transcending spacetime with [High-dimensional Travel]. From [Carbon-based Monkey] to immortal [Quantum Body]. … The clash between flesh and machinery, and the old world intertwines with the present! In this perilous world, Lin Xuan only wants to see where the limits of his evolution lie and enjoy the diverse scenery along the way.

title: Chattering Vampire
summary: It was supposed to be reincarnation in another world after becoming a vampire, but it turned out to be the modern world. No need for fantasy or battles. This is a story about living a normal life while streaming.

title: My Son is Cute and Adorable in My Second Life
summary: "Become the third wife of the Northern Duke." Elia, the illegitimate child of Viscount Arnes, was used by her family until the very end. A duke burdened with a curse-like trust, such was his third wife. The viscount pushed Elia into that position and pocketed a hefty dowry. So it went for 16 years. Their marriage was as cold as the freezing winds of the North. The couple, who had turned away from each other, only came together just before the collapse of the North. "...This is the first time. Holding you like this." Her husband, who turned out to be affectionate and steadfast, even the child who always followed her, longed for his mother's touch. Elia closes her eyes in realization, too late. And as if a gift from the gods, she goes back 16 years. Elia resolves. In this lifetime, she will protect her loved ones and the North. With nothing but her own abilities! *** Thud, thud, thud. As a vivid blue light pours from her eyes, warm rain drenches the earth. Filling the mana lost due to her step-sister's scheme, Elia begins to control the power to change the weather. Starting another life in the North with enthusiasm, she thought all that remained was to save the North and be happy with her husband and son... "Enough." "Don't talk to me!" "I don't want to." Soft pink curls and puffed-up cheeks like cotton candy. Her son may be cheeky... but cute?

title: Naruto System in Jujutsu Kaisen
summary: One day, Natsubi suddenly crossed over. Arriving in this world where only madmen can survive, Natsubi has gained the Shinobi World System from Naruto. How will Natsubi survive? Will he become a madman and go crazy with the cursed spirits, or will he just want to be an ordinary person?

Among them was the section chief of the sales department, Akaboshi. Akaboshi, a glutton, was unfazed by the struggles of middle management or the negotiations with colleagues, all for the sake of tasting the delicious food of the unknown world. With talent awakened in a pinch, vitality born from being a glutton, and negotiation skills honed in sales, he survived in the other world.

One day after class, amidst the crowd, he unexpectedly catches sight of a familiar profile. The normally cold and distant man is momentarily stunned and, in full view of everyone, chases her. A year later, my Private Banks had opened across the entire country; even the Ministry of Revenue had to come to me for loans to manage their cash flow. The Emperor finally arrived. Standing at the entrance of the Cold Palace, he looked up at the plaque above the door: "Admission fee for tours. Harem Consorts half price. No Emperors allowed." He fell silent for a long time before asking, "If I want to restore your status, what kind of package do I need to buy?"

Zhu Shiyu chose the former, and then she met Meng Siyi. In everyone’s eyes, Meng Siyi had good looks, a good job, and an impeccable personality, making their marriage a step up for Zhu Shiyu. He knelt down, reached out his hand to her, and said with a smile: “Miss Ji Xi, come back to Xingqing Palace with me.” She asked him what a Tianji Star Lord was, and he said it was to use one’s body to suppress the world’s inner demons forever. When Ji Xi was twenty-four years old, she was killed by Ju An with an arrow through the heart. At that time, she was the notorious Yinghuo Calamity Star, and he did not say a single word to her. Seven days later, she returned from the dead wearing a bright red wedding dress and found Ju An standing before her. She had been resurrected as Ju An’s widowed “Master’s Wife.” Clad in red and holding his master’s memorial tablet, Ju An said to her: “Master’s Wife, please accept my condolences.” Ji Xi calculated with her fingers and thought: What kind of damned twisted fate is this?

It is said her parents are senior government officials in the provincial capital who travel in cars and have meat with every meal. If she hadn’t decided to respond to the country’s call for youth volunteers, she would never have come to endure hardship in this village. The poor boy Gu Huai, by contrast, is known as a local troublemaker. His family is poor and he lives on coarse food like bran and vegetable dumplings and drinks cold water. He has a bad reputation mostly because he’s been falsely accused by others. Because of this, he can only earn half of the usual work points even after working hard all day. Most of what he earns goes toward medicine for his blind mother. The villagers never imagined these two would ever connect. But one day, the fair and beautiful Yang Xiaoye brought a lunch basket to Gu Huai who was working in the field and wiped his sweat with a floral-patterned handkerchief. For a moment, the entire village was left speechless.

title: The Former Princess Who Awakens from Fifteen Years of Petrification is Doted by Her Husband and Daughter

Camilla pitied Luke, her husband who was forced to marry a woman eight years older instead of her beautiful younger sister. Then their married life became awkward. Camilla eventually bore a daughter, but she got petrified when trying to protect her daughter from attackers. When Camilla awoke, fifteen years had passed. What awaits are her husband—whose age difference had now reversed, her daughter—who had grown into a beautiful young lady, and their affections aimed at her?!

Thanks to him, I learned all kinds of things and managed to get by day after day with his help and support.Best video game consoles I started learning magic and cooking, doing my best to support him in return. And as we kept helping each other, something began to change… We started awakening all kinds of abilities. Wait a second—Kotarou, aren’t you stronger than the Hero? title: Derailment

However, while she may be an unrivaled wealthy heiress in this universe, in another, she could just be a penniless working girl. Theoretically, these realms never cross paths. Yet, one fateful day, the affluent Jiang Xiaoyuan finds herself thrust into a meticulously orchestrated mishap, becoming another version of herself in a different realm. Stripped of her family background, education, looks, and wealth, what remains as the essence of oneself? What truly defines the self? This story takes the concept of X-Change[1] and will be written in a dimensional version. [1] 变形计: refers to a Chinese reality TV show where teenagers from vastly different backgrounds temporarily swap lives—often wealthy urban teens switching places with poor rural teens. The show explores themes of identity, privilege, and personal growth.

Keep them right next to you and observe them.” He turned to Argen across the armchair and smiled fondly. “But how could I let you go?”

title: Naughty, Fourth Young Master, You’re Out!
summary: Тhe daу she marriеd into the Jiаng family, the hеаvу snow hаd just сleared. The man gripped the gold pen she had forced into his hand, his gaze dangerous. “Stop making a scene…” He Yang asked, “Can you give my son back to me?” Jiang Siye stared at her for a long while. “We can have another one.” He Yang suddenly broke down. “I only want Zhengzheng! summary: After traveling through time, Qi Yun finally managed to sort out his identity issues. Just as he was about to leverage his skills in book copying and real estate to reach the pinnacle of his life, a corporation—Stark Industries—made him realize where he had arrived. To avoid becoming another innocent casualty, Qi Yun decided not to be human anymore! "I, Qi Yun, exploit the reincarnators, impose relentless work schedules on them, and withhold their benefits, yet I know, I am a benevolent God."

title: The Master of the City [Serial]
summary: Climbing the Himalayas to die. But at the edge of death, I encounter a chance encounter. Once again, my fate is given. Now, there’s no past. I cry out for justice for those I hold dear. The Master of the City follows Chutian, a man who has cultivated secretly for thousands of years and possesses immense hidden power. Though mortals see him as ordinary, he is actually extremely strong but chooses to keep a low profile in a bustling modern city. As he navigates life amidst urban society—balancing cultivation, power struggles, and conspiracies—he slowly reveals his extraordinary strength while dealing with enemies, allies, and challenges that threaten the city and his own ambitions. The story blends action, fantasy, and urban life as Chutian rises from obscurity toward becoming a legendary master.

Billions of players around the world were gearing up to enter the game and showing off their skills. Chen Fang was one of them. However, he gained enhancement points that other players did not have. He started with billions of enhancement points and strengthened everything. An enhanced weapon, an ordinary weapon that was enhanced by Chen Fang into an existence comparable to an artifact. The enhanced pet, a hare by the roadside which was enhanced by Chen Fang to become a beast. Enhanced Fireball, a fireball that was ten times more terrifying than Forbidden Spell… was born! Enhanced……

title: The Gods Are Fighting Over Me
summary: This is a sweet short story, but the main plot starts not as a sweet short story! It only becomes one after chapter 15! She would first stare at him blankly, then, after she came to her senses, she’d excitedly circle him and cup her face in her hands: “Kenji, I love you!” Kenji would wake up completely bewildered. Who is this girl? Why does she know my name? And why does she like me? Every night, he would dream of her. “Kenji, can I kiss you?” “Kenji, let’s get married.” “Yeah, yeah, when I wake up, I’ll go marry you.” Kenji would always answer so casually. After all, she was just someone in a dream. Later, after he joined the police force and was promoted to captain, the girl suddenly disappeared from his dreams. Feeling annoyed and frustrated, he was on his way to work when he passed through Beika Street. There, across the road, he saw the girl who used to grab him and confess her love—and she was on a date with another guy. Fuming, Kenji jaywalked across the street. “Didn’t you say you liked me the most?! Who is he?!” The girl: “?” The girl: “Who the heck is this cosplayer? title: Kapitan Sino
summary: There’s something strange in the neighborhood. The police once again are beaten to the chase for a jewelry shop hold-upper. And before that, someone has also caught a carnapper; saved a man atop a burning building; saved a baby held hostage by his father; helped an elderly cross the street; tipped off members of a Breaking and Entering gang; saved a family caught in a flood; landed a Boeing 747 with a broken engine; and exploded a giant robot. title: Smell of Green Plum
summary: Jiang Baoyi and Chen Siyu grew up together as childhood sweethearts. At an age when they didn't know what love was, they got married by the elders. After marriage, the two got along just like before, except that they had to sleep in the same quilt at night after every quarrel. After four years of marriage, after another quarrel, Jiang Baoyi went out of town to relax, but died accidentally on the way. In a blink of an eye, Jiang Baoyi returned to four years ago, when the elders of the two families were discussing her marriage with Chen Siyu. This time, Jiang Baoyi declined the marriage proposal: "I want to marry a man of my dreams, and I only regard Chen Siyu as my brother." That night, a gloomy-looking young man climbed over the wall and said, "Jiang Baoyi, what do you mean?" "We have disliked each other since we were young, and we can only be a pair of resentful couples after marriage. Instead of torturing each other, it is better for us to marry separately." The young man stared at Jiang Baoyi for a long time, and finally left with a sneer. Jiang Baoyi began to happily choose a new husband. She first fell in love with the talented and handsome Tanhua Lang, then the brave and powerful military general, and the humorous and witty young man from aristocratic family, but in the end, all of them failed. Jiang Baoyi was angry and incredulous: "Shengjing is so big, why can't I find a good husband who is worthy of entrusting my life to?!" "Because your eyesight is not good." Chen Siyu said faintly. Jiang Baoyi was so angry that she broke off her friendship with Chen Siyu. Chen Siyu ignore Jiang Baoyi for a few days to let her be more perceptive. As a result, within a few days, he received news that Jiang Baoyi fell in love with the cousin of her best friend. Whether in terms of appearance or temperament, the cousin was Jiang Baoyi's ideal husband candidate. Chen Siyu couldn't sit still for a moment. When he rushed over, he saw Jiang Baoyi smiling brightly at the cousin. Chen Siyu's face instantly turned as dark as the bottom of a pot, but fortunately, a few days later, Jiang Baoyi accidentally hit her head and lost her memory. Chen Siyu suddenly felt that his chance had come. Relying on his thorough understanding of Jiang Baoyi, he tried his best to impress the amnesiac Jiang Baoyi, and finally Jiang Baoyi agreed to marry him. Chen Siyu happily prepared for the wedding. But on the eve of the wedding, Jiang Baoyi suddenly recovered her memory. Chen Siyu: "!!!"

title: Bionic Era
summary: Lu Wen was reborn as a bionic housekeeper. He thought he would do just simple housework in this life. title: Super Random System
summary: Wang Xiaofei, who suddenly crossed over, obtains the ‘Random Reward System.’ The prizes acquired are random, their timing unpredictable, and the attainable items are always beyond control. However, with unwavering perseverance and occasional flashes of inspiration from the rewards, Wang Xiaofei steadily rises on the Yulong Continent, defeating demons, annihilating ghosts, and ultimately emerging as the ruler of the world.

title: No Evil Lady in the World
summary: The afterlife was unjust, but reincarnation wasn't easier. Born as the eldest daughter of a poor farmer, struggling to support her younger siblings, Meiana Dawson escapes to the capital. After tumultuous times, she becomes a live-in maid in a noble house, only to be wrongly accused and expelled. "If I see that wench again, she'll die by my hand!" Penniless and expelled, she's rescued by a kind old woman, only to be... "Fine, I'll hire you." ...Immediately employed by the renowned Duke of El Bluien. "Just do as you did before. Kick any scoundrel who dares approach my daughter." Will things really go that smoothly? "Young Lady, please dress properly!" "Why? Why should I?" "It's broad daylight! Will you wander in pajamas?" "Why not? Will I die if I do?" With a face that could make fairies weep and a temperament that could make devils flee, the Duke's unruly daughter, Arianthe. Her misdeeds could decorate every wall in the ducal mansion with tapestries. But Meiana believes, there are no bad dogs, err, young ladies in the world.

On their wedding day, news of war arrived from the border: Nan Yi had invaded. Helian Zhi was ordered to lead troops to reinforce the front, leaving for three years. At home, Xia Xing'er dutifully served her in-laws and cared for her younger siblings-in-law.
