title: Stolen Kisses in Spring
summary: [The bright and cheerful flower shop owner × the noble and elegant diplomat] [Double cleanliness, first love, sweet and pet-like, misplaced love, unrequited love becoming true, flash marriage] At 16, Shen Zhuying fell in love with a boy. The boy loved wearing white shirts, playing the drums, and had dimples when he smiled. He was like the sun that she couldn’t touch. At 18, she repeated a year of school and got into the same school as him, only to find out that he had transferred to England six months ago. At 22, she met him again at the graduation ceremony and wanted to give him a love letter. However, she heard that he already had a girlfriend he had been with for many years. At 24, on a rainy day, he burst into her flower shop alone and bought a bouquet of white roses. Shen Zhuying chased after him and gave him an umbrella and a bouquet of hyacinths. On that day, she decided to put an end to her eight-year unrequited love. However, due to fate, this chance encounter in the rain became the starting point for him to notice her. So, at the age of 26, they got married on the 33rd day after they met again, and it was the 10th year of her loving him. One day after marriage, Fu Sizhuo opened a dusty pink love letter, and it was signed by his new wife. The last sentence she wrote was: “Fu Sizhuo, I’ve admired you for a long time. Would you like to get to know me? My name is Shen Zhuying.” Thus, in the spring of another year, he picked up his pen and wrote her a reply. The first sentence he wrote was: “Shen Zhuying, I’m sorry to have missed so many years, but I’m glad to know you. My name is Fu Sizhuo.” In the 11th year of her loving him, her love finally got a response.

title: The Moon Is Far Away
summary: When she was young her hometown suffered a flood. Both parents and younger brother died. The orphaned Tiao Tiao was sold to the palace as a maid. At that time, the queen lost her children one after another. The national teacher said that the queen lacked opportunities in her fate and should find a girl with a compatible horoscope to adopt as a daughter. Tiao Tiao was lucky enough to become a princess and was loved by thousands of people. Nine years later, the queen already had a son and a daughter. The adopted daughter had long been forgotten in the deep palace and was pulled to be a pawn in the marriage between the two countries. She was full of worries and only dared to return to her hometown in the south of the Yangtze River in her dreams. The palace was lonely. Tiao Tiao only dared to tell her worries to her third brother Yuwen Huai, who treated her very well. The emperor had been lying on the sickbed for many years. He was gentle and always treated her like his own sister. "Don't be sad, Tiao Tiao. One day, the emperor will personally fulfill your wish." Tiao Tiao agreed with a smile, but she also knew that the emperor was just coaxing her. How could an adopted daughter who was going to be sent to marry as a chess piece return to Jiangnan? At the empress dowager's birthday banquet, the princes and princesses gathered together to celebrate. Tiao Tiao drank a few glasses of wine, her face flushed, like a lotus. Tiao Tiao made an excuse to go out for some fresh air. The moonlight was hazy, the lake was rippling, and the sound of the flute was melodious. She followed the sound of the flute and boarded the boat by the lake, but accidentally ran into the third prince and others who are conspiring to seize the throne. The usually gentle brother was actually a shrewd and calculating person who played with people's hearts. She panicked and almost missed a step and fell into the lake. The boat was swaying, Tiao Tiao was dizzy and breathless, and the third prince, who was always sick in the past, held her waist tightly, making her unable to move. With tears in her eyes, she said in a coquettish voice, "Brother." The third prince rubbed her slender waist with one hand and stroked her eyebrows with the other hand, "As long as Tiao Tiao is good, I am willing to do anything for you." Not long after, the eldest prince, who should have been the crown prince, made a big mistake. The emperor was furious and demoted him to a commoner. Anyhow, the third prince, who had been lying on the sickbed for many year finally showed his supremacy. One day Tiao Tiao finally got what she wanted. After returning to Jiangnan, she soon met her ideal husband. She was so happy that she only wanted to live in her hometown for the rest of her life. On the wedding night, the beautiful lady was wearing red makeup, but her veil was lifted by a bloody sword. Tiao Tiao looked up and saw Yuwen Huai, who was covered in blood, with red eyes. The gentle and considerate brother pinched her face, his eyes full of possession, "A Tiao, didn't you promise your brother that you would not marry him?" Tiao Tiao didn't know that the sickly brother who was usually gentle to others had coveted her for a long time, but he didn't dare to reveal his feelings because of the brother-sister relationship. Until he saw her wearing a wedding dress and marrying another man, he couldn't stand it anymore. What brother-sister relationship, his Tiao Tiao could only be his wife.

title: I Became a God, All Thanks to the Internal Competition Among My Junior Sisters!
summary: Li Xuan transmigrated to the Tianxuan Continent, a world where martial arts reign supreme and physical constitution is king. He was taken in as a disciple by a beautiful master, and he thought he was destined for a magnificent martial arts journey. However, he was soon tested and found to have a mundane constitution, making it nearly impossible for him to achieve anything significant in cultivation. Feeling helpless, Li Xuan decided to give up and live a carefree life under the protection of his beautiful master. Just when he thought he would live this lazy life forever, his master brought back a junior sister with a saintly constitution! The Most Powerful Senior Brother System was activated, binding him to his junior sister's cultivation progress. He could now gain random multiples of her cultivation results! The more his junior sister strived, the stronger he became! ...My name is Feng Jiuge, and I am the reincarnation of a female emperor! In my previous life, I was betrayed by my subordinates and reincarnated into this Tianxuan Continent, where I was accepted into the Duxian Sect. Fortunately, I possess a celestial tool, the Yin-Yang Heavenly Ruler! This tool periodically sets a comparison target for me, and as long as I surpass them, I can obtain various cultivation resources! My first target was my senior brother with a mundane constitution. This should be easy, right? I, the reincarnation of a female emperor, can't possibly lose to someone with a mundane constitution, can I? But after several comparisons, Feng Jiuge, who hadn't won even once, began to question her life. Is this really a mundane constitution?! Later, Feng Jiuge worked hard in her cultivation and formed a golden core! Facing the upcoming comparison, she was full of confidence! But in Li Xuan's residence, purple energy stretched for three thousand miles, and a vast, overwhelming pressure swept through, with a supreme dharma image towering between heaven and earth! Feng Jiuge: ??? I just formed a golden core, how did you become a supreme being already?! Li Xuan: Thank you, junior sister, for forming your core and helping me achieve supremacy! And as Li Xuan gained more junior brothers and sisters, he became invincible!"

title: I was Reincarnated as the Youngest Child of a Villainous Noble Family Who Controls the Kingdom from Behind the Scenes

A family so powerful that even the royal family couldn't lift their heads against them. They were the true rulers of the kingdom. Alphys Balfont, the third son, possessed strength and talent befitting the Balfont family, but he fell short compared to his brothers. summary: When Prince Sirius, the illegitimate child of the Sirius royal family, was 13 years old, his father King Bredin passed away. Benedict LeBlanc, who had been gaining power during King Bredin’s lifetime, usurped the throne. Deposed Prince Patrick, who was 17 at the time, was sent to a monastery. Sirius and his younger brother Robert, who were imprisoned within the royal castle, were taken out on the condition that Duke Cornelius would confine them in his private domain. However, during their escape, Robert was kidnapped and mu*dered by a mob. Sirius, who escaped the danger, has been imprisoned in the tower ever since. There is a young lady who visits there every day. It is Judith, the daughter of Duke Cornelius. This is a story about the daily life of Sirius, who is imprisoned in a tower awaiting execution, and Judith, who spends all her time there.

title: I Saved the Kaiser

Now that I've been unintentionally entangled with the Kaiser, there is only one way for me to survive: I must make the German Empire win World War I by any means necessary!

summary: "Canan, I'm breaking off my engagement with you." My fiancé's words made me rejoice! Thank you. Thank you! Thank you very much, God! This is a story about a money-hungry Heroine who wants to break off her engagement. It's a casual, easy-going engagement break-up.

title: Pursuing Immortality
summary: Meet Gu Yu—a college dropout and a talented incense maker, and at the same time, the rather stoic protagonist of this story. Despite his somewhat introverted manner, he has a tendency to make sarcastic remarks in his thoughts. One day, after saving a squirrel, a windfall (metaphorically and literally) dropped into his lap. Stumbling into the cultivation world with little help, he was not turned into Superman overnight (as he would like). Apparently, becoming a cultivator would not make your life easier, at least in the beginning. Somewhere along the road, he ran into Jiang Xiaozhai, a young woman whose got the brains, the beauty, and maybe one or two secrets of her own. As it turned out, the two made a perfect team—Mulder-and-Scully style. Motivated by many unanswered questions, they had been running up and down the country, getting into all kinds of trouble, and learning more of the modern cultivation world, which is by no means the same as in the ages long past…

title: Transmigrated into a Pitiful Little One in the 1960s, Using Wood-Type Powers for Farming
summary: Lin Qi came from a post-apocalyptic world to the 1960s, inhabiting the body of a starving fool. Even after half a year, she still couldn’t fully control this body that was never hers—her movements were slow, her speech sluggish, and her eyes often vacant and lifeless... As a result, people outside said—Lin family’s third child wasn’t crazy anymore, but had become mentally weak. In the end, she was still considered a fool. Foolish Lin Qi became a stumbling block for her brother’s marriage prospects. After her brother repeatedly failed at blind dates, her own older sister signed her up for the “Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside” movement, making her an educated youth sent to the countryside. The “fool” Lin Qi was assigned the simplest tasks at first. Life was fairly easy, except for not having enough to eat. But soon, this foolish yet beautiful Lin Qi caught someone’s eye. “A fool can get married too?” “Rare sight indeed. She’s foolish, but that doesn’t mean she can’t have children.” “She’s pretty, looking at her face every day lifts the mood.” “Better to marry her off. Once married and cared for, she won’t be a burden to us anymore.” Lin Qi: “...” Getting married isn’t a problem—what matters is who she marries, and she’ll choose that herself. Lin Qi reviewed the people she knew in her mind and finally chose that short, thin young man. “It’s you,” Lin Qi said.

title: The Beast Tames The Duke
summary: “If I don’t receive a kiss filled with love, I won’t be able to return as a human.” Terrifying fangs, Sharp claws, Black fur covering the whole body, Gleaming golden eyes! I’ve been reincarnated into a romance novel, (Blossom at the Cliff's Edge.) And to make it worse, I’ve been reborn as a minor character among the minor characters, cursed to be a beast that gets killed by the male lead! I thought I would die without turning back into a human, but something seems strange about this male lead. "Would you like to bark?" “Huh?” “Or maybe roll over.” “What on earth…” Not only is he not afraid of me, “Nathan is not a demon or a monster. She’s a puppy.” “She’ll wag her tail at just about anyone on the street.” He treats me like a dog. “Where are you going?” “When will you be back?” “Don’t go.” And separation anxiety is a given. “I’m sorry.” “It’s all my fault, so please don’t cry.” Kneeling down before me isn’t enough. “You thought you could escape and I wouldn’t find you?” “I promised to find you, no matter how many times.” “You vowed to wait for me unwaveringly.” “…….”

title: It’s Great That He’s an Art Student. The Science Community Is Saved
summary: Tell a colossal lie and make the world dance to it; if the road ahead is shrouded in darkness, then I shall become the darkness itself—BOSS Asakawa Kazuki. ——————— Many years later, facing Pinot Noir in the Twilight Annex, Rei Furuya would recall that distant afternoon when he first met the boy. Back then, Asakawa Kazuki was still a blazing new star of the ACG world; back then, Pinot Noir was still a genius programmer newly recruited by the Organization; back then… he brought Hagiwara and Matsuda back before him. “Why are you wearing such a sorrowful expression, Senior Bourbon?” Asakawa Kazuki patted Gin, signaling him not to be tense. “It’s nothing more than what I wrote on the IF route—the boy didn’t wait for his salvation and simply turned and walked into the darkness.” Why didn’t the Red Team share the plan with “Noah’s Ark” this time? I’m in disguise as Karasuma and chairing a Black Organization meeting right now!! Outwardly calm, Asakawa Kazuki’s palms were sweating; beside him, the floating Morofushi Hiromitsu chuckled softly. ——————— Conan: “Let an AI monitor everyone—is that what you call peace?” Asakawa Kazuki: “Are you speaking to Asakawa Kazuki? Follow this hedonist on his adventure of becoming a Hedonist Sovereign through doing real life quests, filled with action-packed battles and hilarious moments. A lazy and slothful hedonist doing exercise in the morning? A spoilt and self-entitled hedonist starting from the bottom as a salesperson? Watch as Qin Feng is changed by the Hedonist Sovereign System, inside and out!

title: Otherworldly Paradise
summary: Chaoyang lived an ordinary life for over twenty years, but a sudden “awakening” disrupted his life—he awakened as a demon from legends, one that feeds on wishes. The bad news is, wishes are hard to come by in this world. The good news is, before he starved to death, he opened a passage to another world overflowing with wishes. The bad news is, most of these wishes are already claimed. The good news is, no one understands wishes better than him. At first, Chaoyang only responded to wishes to survive, but as he grew stronger, he turned it into a business. The place where countless wishes can be fulfilled is the [Paradise] .

title: A Tale of Enduring Brilliance, Love, and Wealth Unfolds
summary: The story transcends geographical boundaries and takes place during a time when intellectual and spiritual horizons were on the verge of expanding. Joseph, a jeweler, is in search of a suitable spouse for his beloved daughter, Sophie. Despite turning away 23 individuals driven by greed, hope shines with the arrival of the 24th suitor, Alan, who happens to be the heir to the Duke of Rohan. Although one might assume that being the eldest son of a noble family, Alan would not be interested in money, he surprises everyone by expressing a simple desire, "Please feed me!" His true passion lies in mathematics, and he plans to relinquish his family estate to his younger brother to dedicate himself fully to his studies. Joseph is skeptical but intrigued by this unique approach, wondering if there might be alternative ways for Alan to find a patron to support his research without staying at his parents' house.

title: A Genius Composer Develops S-Class Talent
summary: I lived my first life as a failed idol. In my second life, I just wanted to live as a successful composer. I’m already too busy living my own life— And now I have to raise someone else into an S-rank star…? Are you crazy, system?

title: Supreme Pupil Master
summary: In the 24th century, the Supreme Pupil Master unexpectedly transmigrated, becoming the discarded genius eldest young lady of the Marquis Household in a low-ranking small country! Her cultivation was crippled, both her eyes were blinded, and her family status was seized? Luo Qinghong narrowed her blood-red eyes and smirked coldly: Come here! Big Sis will teach you how to be human! A pair of blood-red eyes, unparalleled and arrogant! Her medical and poison skills break through all defenses, making her omnipotent! She excels in both artifact crafting and pill refining, can control beasts, set up formations... She uses her life to demonstrate what it means to be supreme and peerless, utterly domineering! She just never expected to provoke someone even more monstrous and peerless than herself! (Sweet and satisfying, no angst, guaranteed quality. Also, millions of words of completed work in "Profligate Music Consort".)

title: Stepping on the Demon Sect Witch to Become the Strongest
summary: In my previous life, I was mediocre at best, never reaching the pinnacle. But after traveling back in time, this time... I will become the strongest in this world! Becoming the strongest in this world requires just three simple steps: 1. Find the demoness who just crossed over on the street. 2. Subdue demons and vanquish evil spirits. 3. Take her cultivation techniques. Alright! Invincible already! ———— Many years later, Yan Yu, who has earned the title of "the strongest," accepts an interview with a television host. Host: To achieve today's success, who do you most want to thank? Yan Yu: I want to thank a woman who is crucial to me. Host (brightening up): Oh, is she your wise wife? Yan Yu: No, more like a stepping stone. Host (awkwardly): Then... what about the other teammates in your team? They must have also helped you, right? Yan Yu: How could there be only one stepping stone on the path to Immortality?

title: Dragon Under the Bed
summary: Christian, the successor of a long-established venerable dukedom, is a narcissist who has never been in a relationship because he adored himself too much. But a woman is hiding in his bedroom every night? “Master, you look wonderful from head to toe as usual.” Declared the maid, Lynn, to the master she admired. “Stop lying about being a fan. What kind of fan would do this? Tell me who sent you right now!” He had to kick out this suspicious maid. Yet, Christian’s heart was unwilling. A romantic battle between a stalkerish maid x narcissistic master!

title: Firefly Calamity
summary: During the summer vacation of her second year in high school, Su Li participated in a school-organized campus carnival. What appeared to be a sweet, heart-fluttering invitation was in fact a carefully planned act of reproduction and slaughter by some unknown creature… As she watched the classmates she once knew begin to mutate and tear each other apart, Su Li became the only survivor. And so began her long and relentless escape. * * * “Are you afraid?” Under the enchanting night sky, the boy dressed in a black hoodie lightly tapped the black, gold-trimmed mask at his fingertips. His brows and eyes curved with a smile as he reached out and gently ruffled the top of her messy hair. “Don’t be afraid.” He lowered his head and leaned closer. His low and husky voice was almost bewitching. “Follow me, and I will help you reclaim everything you have lost in this world.”

title: From Ant to Abyssal Demon
summary: Upon waking up, Su Bai found that he had not only transmigrated but had also entered a game that could influence reality, becoming the lowest existence in the game world — an ant. Fortunately, he possessed the talents of soul augmentation and devour evolution. Su Bai evolved step by step from the lowest level of the game world, devouring insects, devouring slimes, devouring goblins, devouring two-headed chimeras, devouring frost wolves, devouring legendary dragons... By the time the game started and players appeared, Su Bai had already become a boss in the game. When players grew stronger, Su Bai had devoured countless beings and become the Great Demon God of the endless abyss. When the game and reality connected, bridging the two worlds, Su Bai took a step forward. In the next moment— The Abyss Descends!!!
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

However, when Bai Chen descends upon this world, everything changes, and the entire narrative takes an unprecedented turn! Feilu reminds readers: This novel and its characters are entirely fictional. title: Humanity Itself Is Strong
summary: Even though he wasn’t aware of the talent he had, Lee Jin Seong was on par with the rankers. When he was about to die, he went back to the days he was young. 『Human’s strength』 Between the monsters pouring in, the teammates started to collapse. Even his teacher, whom he trusted and relied on, lost his life. Soon after, when the devil’s black forearm catches Jinseong… [The wheel of fate chooses you] “……!” There is no mercy in my way, not anymore. Holding his sword, he stands in front of the world once again. He will rise higher than anyone else! Jinseong, his heroism has just begun.

title: Though Miss Witch Hates Men, She Can’t Help Falling for Me
summary: Reincarnated into another world, Aiden didn’t need to go on adventures or defeat the Demon King — he only had to change the heroines’ hatred of men to be able to return to the real world with the goddess’s blessing. Aiden originally thought it would be easy, but as the tasks progressed he began to feel that something was off. Why were these heroines, who were set up as extremely misogynistic, suddenly all fluttering at his presence and refusing to give up until they got him? [Ruby, doesn’t the character panel of the system still show their favorability as negative? Why are they all suddenly after my body!?] Facing four heroines whose cheeks were flushing, whose pupils sparkled with hearts, and who kept closing in on him step by step, Aiden was backed into a corner, looking small and helpless. [Master, the favorability shown on the character panel indicates their general like or dislike toward men as a whole — it doesn’t include you~] [But you never told me that before!] Aiden turned to run. He only wanted to be a friend to women; he never intended to throw himself away like this. “Aiden, where do you think you’re going?” Aiden looked back at the four heroines eyeing him hungrily and forced an embarrassed smile. “Weren’t we supposed to be good…uh…friends? What are you doing?” “We all like you~” “That’s not ‘like’, you’re after my body!” “So what?” “Ahem...listen...this sort of thing requires an emotional foundation. We’re just good friends — you might only feel dependent on me. Both sides need psychological preparation...gah!” “Stop babbling — put him on the bed!”
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: Artifact Planting Space
summary: Ye Tian is known as a genius throughout Lava Town. He opened his public region sea at the age of 10 years of age, and historically, can be said the first genius to do so. Later in Mo Academy, his awakened talent is just a waste field [Black Soil Space Field]. But he found that his black space is not simple: Anything from pills to artifacts, he just need to plant them in the black soil , and he can get more than a dozen pieces of same pill or artifact with an upgrade as fruits…
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Xuanhuan

title: Pathfinder
summary: Official: Garam became a pathfinder losing her ordinary life all at once and inevitably starting her life as a wanderer... But her journey was harsh, such as traveling through snowy mountains, the deep sea, and even the labyrinth. Will she be able to achieve the '"path" and come back home? Previous Blurb: Garam, an ordinary job-seeker, impulsively leaps into another world seeking “Paths,” wish-granting coins. Upon her return, she discovers Earth transformed into a desolate ghost town, devoid of all life. Her only hope to restore her family and the world lies in collecting enough Paths to make a wish. But the Paths are scattered across treacherous locations: avalanche-prone mountains, suffocating deep seas, and hellish labyrinths. Bound to a destiny of pursuing these elusive Paths, Garam faces relentless challenges. Will she overcome these trials and find her way back to her world?

title: I Heard There’s No Copyright Law in This Other World?
summary: The fantasy world is boring. Especially for someone like me—a complete incompetent with no magic—it’s unbearably dull. So, I decided to create my own OTT videos—content that could satisfy my dopamine cravings. “Yenika is Sena’s daughter.” “My god! What kind of divine joke is this?” “Participant, please remove your mask and reveal your identity!” “…Why is the Saintess coming out from there?” “The Falcons Knight Order defeats the Black Spear Knight Order and advances to the finals!!” “Waaaaah! I’m happy! I’m happy! I’m happy because it’s the Falcons!!!” …But somehow, things grew far bigger than I ever expected.

title: Unlawful Intrusion Stalker vs. The Man Who Silky-fies Stalking and Completely Ignores It
summary: It seems that I have a stalker. And apparently, they've been unlawfully entering my home periodically. I debated whether to report it to the police, but there doesn't seem to be any indication of theft or such activities. They've started doing household chores as if to assert their presence, so for now, I decided to ignore it and think of them as "Silky" or something. ...And then, I found myself unable to just brush it off.

title: Exiled with a Useless Skill ‘Gacha’, but It Turns Out to Be a Legendary Pull That Only Summons Gods – All I Get Are Beautiful Goddess!
summary: "One spin could topple a nation. My gacha is beyond all limits." The skill I was granted was called “Gacha.” Because of it, I was disowned and exiled from the royal court mage family. Everyone mocked it as a worthless skill only usable once per day, with no way to predict what would come out. But when I was cornered in the forest and prepared to die, I spun the gacha in desperation and out came breathtakingly beautiful girls who called themselves the Valkyrie of War and the Goddess of Abundance! Turns out, my gacha was an unprecedented cheat skill that summoned legendary deities.

title: The Most Ordinary Old Lady
summary: On her seventieth birthday, Song Xiaotao found an unconscious young man in her vegetable patch. Judging by her years of experience cracking melon seeds and shooting the breeze at the village entrance, this fellow was clearly trouble. Yet, she brought him home anyway. Song Xiaotao had seen off her last living relative ten years ago. Even if he brought a calamity that wiped out her entire household, she was the only one left to go. When the young man came to and saw Song Xiaotao’s wizened face, his vision swam, and he nearly blacked out again. Heavenly Bodhisattva, why was his Love Tribulation partner an old woman?!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: Trick the Cold Campus Belle into Becoming My Wife While She’s Still Innocent
summary: Twenty years ago, Chu Xing stepped on the gas and ruined the life of the Campus Belle, Xu Qingyu. Since then, he had lived every day in a nightmare. Until one day, he learned the truth—it was Xu Qingyu who had deliberately caused the crash. Reborn in the school days, Chu Xing yanked Xu Qingyu back from under the wheels. Looking at this top student with outstanding character and academics, the white moonlight in every boy’s heart, he raised his hand high. In the previous life, Xu Qingyu had chosen to end her life to stop her mother from remarrying, but in doing so, she had inadvertently dragged Chu Xing down with her. Chu Xing thought it was his fault and lived in regret, guilt, and self-destruction for twenty years. This time, facing the cold and stubborn Campus Belle, the slap Chu Xing had raised high came down hard. Such a beautiful girl, one slap…
genres: Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Soul Weaving

Therefore, your cultivation will now be improved to the Pure Yang Plane.] … Qin Chuan realized he could become stronger every time his son got into trouble. As such, he got addicted to tricking and pampering his son into becoming a troublemaker. … Qin Chuan said, “Son, I am invincible. So, do whatever you want and get yourself in trouble!”

title: The 380 Utterances of Kylin Zhang
I Only Left Because It Was Contract Marriage
summary: “There could be no life more miserable than this.” My family had fallen into ruin. And the duke who had destroyed my family said to me: “If you work as a tutor, I might at least help you repay the interest.” The family was ruined, and the debt kept snowballing. While I was at a loss even to pay the growing interest, he suggested I become a tutor. “Is it too difficult?” I knew very well that he wasn’t offering out of kindness — it was just to humiliate me. But I had no choice. “I understand.” And so, I became a tutor in the household of my family’s enemy. The duke had an adopted daughter. She was blind and gravely ill. “You can give up on me. Everyone else has.” But strangely, I found myself drawn to the child, and unintentionally, I did my very best for her. Then one day, the duke said: “She doesn’t have much time left. So fulfill her wish and marry me.” “…Your Grace.” They said the child’s life expectancy was, at best, one year. “Just one year.” Thus, I entered into a contract marriage with him. “Do you need time to think?” “I’ll do it.” Even if it was a one-sided love, I wanted to stay by the duke’s side.

title: Brother and Sister
summary: Arcs: (1) Song Yaoyao (2) Su Tingting

title: I, Kizaru, Only Join the Chat Group After Becoming Invincible
summary: After traveling through time and space, he became Borsalino, and after decades of wandering in the pirate world, he became a general with nearly invincible strength! Adhering to the idea of ​​"catching pirates all my life, can't I enjoy myself?", Borsalino... Just when Borsalino thought his life would continue to be so dull, a dimensional chat group invited him to join! Good news: Borsalino seemed to know all the members in the group! Good news: No one pretended to be an all-knowing and omnipotent immortal, only a humble time traveler who showed his cards! Good news: There is no group owner or group management, and the main theme is that everyone in the group is equal! Hmm... why are all the members good news?

title: The Investigator with Brown Eyes, Solver of Sorcery Cases
summary: There is an investigator who possesses special eyes, a unique trait belonging to the top 0.1% of the world’s population. In the present day, where almost everyone utilizes Sorcery, and tools infused with Spellcraft are used deep within daily life— There is [Lee Hye-yoom] , a unique individual who is part of the world’s top 0.1% with special eyes, yet who cannot use Sorcery due to a lack of Spiritual Power, nor can she even perceive Ghosts or Specters. Her profession is that of a Phenomenon Investigator, specializing in incidents caused by spiritual phenomena—namely, Sorcery, Ghosts, and Specters. She works as an investigator for the Republic of Korea’s greatest Phenomenon Investigator. “What sort of case is it this week? If it’s something the police can sufficiently resolve, like the last one, I won’t accept it.”

title: Mental Protector in the Apocalypse
summary: I woke up from my sleep, only to find myself trapped in an apocalyptic game. And of all things, it's one where the protagonist is a hopeless and worn-out character with no dreams and aspirations who’s driven insane by repeated regressions! I can't die in a place like this. I must see the ending and return home. To get back to my world, I needed the protagonist's abilities. Since he's just a game character anyway... I decided to use him. "I missed you, noona. I really missed you..." "...Why are you saying that all of a sudden? We've been together all this time." "Please don't throw me away. Okay? Don't leave me behind. I'll do better..." But this protagonist's mental state was far too weak. And using his abilities drained his mental strength even more, making him cling to me even more. I had no choice. It's not because he's cute or anything; it's for the sake of reaching the ending that I'm helping him recover. But instead of getting better... "Why do we need a plan? We're not escaping anyway." "Huh? What do you mean by that?" "You'll stay with me, right? I only need you. Nothing else matters to me." ...Will I be able to return to my original world safely? *** "Think back to some happy memories." He opened his mouth as if he’d calmed down a little while thinking about that. "Noona, the happiest memory for me was when I first met you."
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Psychological, Romance

title: The Emperor’s Strategy
summary: In the capital, the young owner of the Su Ji Coffin Shop is Su Li Li (苏离离 - the li is significant in her name because it represents leaving). As spring was just beginning, on one early morning, she by chance saved a woodblock that had met trouble. However, no one knew that she was the daughter of the previous empire's Grand Tutor (akin to the Imperial Adviser), and the other was the current empire's Lin Jiang King's son. They overcome many obstacles, to hide in this small town, to become forgotten by the people, they exchanged their hearts and wanted to never part even till their hairs turned white. However, even before anything could start, Mu Tou who had his own birth secret suddenly disappeared. In this world of chaos and power struggle, Su Li Li's identity was discovered by Qi Feng Xiang, his heart is scheming, his actions are cruel, he wants to reign supreme over the lands, he forcibly retains her by his side. But in the midst of using her then distancing from her, his heart gets clouded. But the road to become an Emperor is a lonely road, will he be able to give her the peace she wants, will she be able to give him his empire, and how about Mu Tou who said "If I can fly out, I can also fly back", where did he fly to and can he fly back? In this chaos, who is aiming to rule the sky, who is aiming for an ordinary life, who can without hesitation make the emotional attachments, and whose hand will she hold to look back on these memories of upheaval and peace?

title: The Only Summoning Sealer In The Entire Star Federation
summary: Su Lanjin, a professional Demon Slayer, is a god-level Summoning Sealing Master in the cultivation world, loved by everyone and feared by demons, who perished alongside the Demon King. Su Lanjin: "The demons are wiped out, the great task is completed, death is death." However, upon opening her eyes again, the manic, shrill laughter of the demons echoed from all directions. Su Lanjin leapt up: "??? Still not finished?" During a military academy selection competition, most of the contestants were killed by the demons, leaving only a few C-grade logistics freshmen. The faculty and students were shocked and immediately planned to stop the competition and rescue them. But they saw the C-grade freshman calmly draw out a formation no one recognized, and golden holes appeared on the ground. Hundreds and thousands of demons were devoured by the holes and could no longer escape. All the faculty and students were stunned and confused: "??? What’s going on? Are they seeing things? The rule that demons can be trapped but not exterminated has been broken?!" When the demons rampaged through the city, countless Demon Hunters fought until their spiritual power was exhausted, but they couldn’t stop the slaughter. A top-tier freshman descended from the sky, with countless healing elves flying out from the formation and landing on everyone’s wounds. The demon-infested wounds visibly began to heal. The freshman landed calmly, summoning with one hand and sealing with the other, tearing through all the demons in the city with her own strength! The city was saved, and the entire country was in an uproar. Wen Hanzhou, long hailed as the strongest in the star country, was stunned and muttered, "This... the Federation has hope... no, humanity has hope!" With demons rampant throughout the galaxy, swords couldn’t cut them, and spiritual power couldn’t kill them. People were helpless against them and could only struggle to survive. Legend had it that Summoning Sealing Masters were born to fight demons. However, the last Summoning Sealing Master died a thousand years ago, and since then, there were no enemies left for the demons. They wreaked havoc and destroyed everything, and human life became unbearable. Until one day, a woman walked out of the world management academy, waved her hand to seal millions of demons, scaring the high-ranking demon leaders into fleeing. People all over the world erupted in excitement.

title: From Descent to Ascendancy: The CEO Who Does His Job Too Well
summary: The Prince and the Pauper... or rather, the chaebol and the commoner? A chaebol heir excels suspiciously well in his role? He was once a clueless scion, something has changed! _“OhGa Kitchen Team Leader Jae-Yoon.”_ _“Let’s have a quick chat.”_ Small company team leader Lee Jae-Yoon becomes chaebol heir Min Ho-Jun, the CEO of a home shopping network?! _“I’ll quit, as I said before.”_ In a world where pedigree often precedes capability, Lee Jae-Yoon, an industrious team leader at a modest company, finds his life dramatically upended when he steps into the shoes of Min Ho-Jun, a chaebol heir tasked with leading a major home shopping network – It’s Home Shopping. This transformation not only alters Jae-Yoon's destiny but also shakes the foundations of the chaebol empire, intertwining fate, ambition, and identity in an unpredictable journey.

title: An Unconventional Strategy: The Hero Who Returned from Another World Gets Found Out and Roped into Dungeon Raids by His Acquaintances
summary: **The day of the middle school graduation ceremony.** Ren Yuuki was suddenly summoned to another world. — Five years later. Through sheer determination to survive, he became a hero and saved the other world. By defeating the Demon King, he was finally able to return to his original world. “So, a dungeon popped up during the five years I was gone, huh? Well, I’m done with fighting, so it’s got nothing to do with me.” Dungeons. Since they began appearing five years ago, they had brought significant changes to humanity. However, Ren Yuuki, weary from endless battles, showed no interest in them. Instead, he led a carefree life, working part-time and indulging in games. But his former bad friend, who had become a dungeon broker, wasn’t about to leave him alone. “Hey, hey, hey! What’s this, Ren? Your status says ‘Hero Who Returned From Another World’!?” “Oh, don’t worry about it.” “Don’t worry about it!? I absolutely *will* worry!” …To be continued.

title: The Demon Lord’s Goose Just Wants to Die
summary: Lu Linxi transmigrated into a melodramatic, angsty novel as the villainous female supporting character. This supporting character had a noble status, but due to her obsessive love for the male lead, she colluded with the villain and committed all sorts of evil deeds just to eliminate the female lead. In the end, her schemes were exposed, and she met a miserable end. Already well-versed in all the ways transmigrated female supporting characters change their fates, she never expected that the moment she opened her eyes, she would find herself mixed in with a flock of geese, being shouted at and herded into a goose pen. Lu Linxi: Did I transmigrate into the wrong book? System: Due to a spatiotemporal anomaly, the original owner accidentally fell into the Animal Realm and must undergo a trial in the mortal world. Lu Linxi: … System: As long as the host dies, you can retrieve your Immortal Form. Dying didn’t sound too difficult. However, there were many rules for an immortal’s trial, and taking her own life didn’t count. One by one, the geese beside her disappeared, yet the butcher’s knife never fell on her. Finally, one day, the paranoid, twisted, and psychopathic great demon villain from the original novel happened to pass by. Lu Linxi excitedly scraped her webbed feet on the ground, lowered her center of gravity, stretched her neck, and charged at him with the most ferocious momentum and an aggressive, swaggering gait, honking, “Honk, honk!” —And what happened later? —Later… she was seized by the scruff of her neck, the very chokehold of fate. —And after that? —After that, a rumor spread throughout the Three Realms: the Demon Sovereign was afraid of geese. —

title: Unrivaled Efforts of Ordinary Reincarnation ~When I Was Working Hard Since I Was a Baby, Before I Knew It I Was Shouldering Japan’s Future~
summary: “I don’t want to die anymore, so let’s aim for the strongest!” After being stabbed by a street thug, he was reincarnated in Japan, where “demons” such as youkai and monsters exist–and among them, it was a family of “exorcists” who exorcise monsters! Being an exorcist is an important job killing monsters, but it’s a dangerous job that can kill people. So he—Itsuki made up his mind. In order not to die again, I will try to be strong. Aiming to become the strongest, he has been practicing magic without fail since he was a baby――he noticed. “Huh? Isn’t this too much?”
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, School Life, Supernatural

title: Osananajimi kara no Waruguchi wo Kiite Shimatta Kaerimichi, Sora kara Futte Kita Bishoujo ni Kokuhaku Sareta
summary: 「I don't really think anything of Kanato. He's gloomy, timid, and not cool at all...」 Tsukishiro Kanato overheard the "true feelings" of his childhood friend, Shinosaki Honoka.

title: A Solution for Jealousy
summary: A novel adaption of HoneyWorks “Yakimochi no Kotae (A Solution for Jealousy)“ about Mochizuki Souta (nickname: Mochita), a third-year at Sakuragaoka High School, who holds long-standing unrequited feelings for her the air-headed pretty girl, Akari, who’s the president of the Art Club. As the Art Club helps the Film Club with making a movie, he musters up the courage to confess and she actually accepts?! But when they accidentally witness Natsuki and Haruki’s “confession,” things start to get complicated….?

title: I’m a Villain! Why Are You Trying to Date Me?

title: Only I Level up My Dungeon Equipment!
summary: 20 years ago, a huge tower that pierces the sky suddenly appeared in Tokyo Bay. And the dungeon weapon with mysterious power excavated from that tower changed the world. The equipped item is said to be able to give various abilities to the wielder such as impervious to bullets, can fly through the air, and even crushes rocks with bare hands. People who explore the dungeon have such dream like obtaining power-giving equipment and in search for it. The main character of this story focuses on Kenya Mitsurugi , one of the boys who also dreams of the same profession. However, Kenya was facing hardship along the way. He was being ridiculed as incompetent,exiled and fired due being possessing a profession of an alchemist An Alchemist was a profession that be considered an incompetent profession which resulting many people to be cast away. As a result, Kenya gave up on his dream. However, Kenya’s world changes completely with the power of an awakened alchemist. The hero who became the only one in the world who can evolve dungeon weapons rises with that power. This is a story full of dungeon adventure, dungeon encounters, and dungeon success.

title: Earning Money to Raise Cubs and Embrace a New Life
summary: Top designer Su Qiao mysteriously reincarnates, returning to the moment she was seventeen and jumping over the wall to escape an arranged marriage. At this time, her younger sister hasn’t been abducted yet, and her two younger brothers haven’t yet suffered one death and one injury from fighting. She still has a chance to change the fate of her family’s ruin! Su Qiao turns around, why run? Compared to rescuing her siblings, passing college or marrying a twice-divorced cripple as a stepmother is nothing! But… who is that tall, handsome man? Wasn’t he supposed to be a cripple? Su Qiao teams up with her fiancé, who she’s about to abandon, to save her younger sister and expose the ugly faces of her uncle and aunt, finally establishing independence. A weak family, no money, no connections, unable to rent a house? So what?! As a top designer, she not only needs to lead trends but also turn them into profit! Su Qiao buys scraps of cloth with her siblings and turns them into hairbands. At first, the villagers laugh at her, but soon the hairbands become fashionable in the city. Girls take out their savings, and some are even willing to trade all their eggs and hens just to get a piece of the premium hairband. These accessories become valuable and trendy. The surrounding aunts all want Su Qiao to become their daughter-in-law, and matchmakers are pounding on her door. Finally, someone can’t wait any longer and asks: “When are we having the wedding banquet?” Su Qiao: ??? Didn’t we agree to break off the engagement? Xiao Qifeng: When did we agree? Impossible. You must be my wife forever. Su Qiao: I definitely won’t marry you, but I can help raise your son. Xiao Qifeng: I don’t have a son!

title: World’s No. 1 Swordsman
summary: Wang Sheng is a fortunate soul who was granted a second chance by the heavens. After he died in his previous life, Wang Sheng finds himself waking up in his younger-self’s body while retaining all the memories of his past life. He remembers that he died in a gang fight due to his lack of cultivation level. He had wasted a lot of time in his past life on internet cafés and idling. In this life, Wang Sheng decides to change his fate once and for all by cultivating properly instead of relying on random cultivation methods from the internet. As he seeks guidance from masters of different sects, he is introduced to the world of cultivation, as well as the dangers and evils that lie within. Now that he is involved in the world of cultivation, will Wang Sheng be able to navigate through the dangers of the cultivation world while redeeming himself with the help of his past-life memories?

title: Why Did My 2D Isekai Turn Into a Bizarre Horror Story?
summary: Traveling to the second dimension, with both parents deceased, owning wealth and a house. Although the Cat Guest's rules prohibit having a sister, this is clearly the trajectory of a main character in a typical daily-life harem story. Surely next comes the charming development, surrounded by girls in a wonderful story, right? [Welcome to the "Sacrifice Game." We wish you to witness the end in true terror.] Wait a second, Isn't this script wrong? Corpse whisperings, creeping shadows, paper figures asking the way, eerie village night tours, eyes peering from under the bed... Bizarre rules weave bloodshed, inescapable, only facing the endless nightmare offers a glimmer of hope. So being entangled by these horrors, could I get a system, preferably one where just signing in makes you formidable? While thinking this, I realized I had obtained the ability to revert after death. It's truly a cheat code, but does that mean I must repeatedly risk my life to learn? No, I don’t want to be the kind of protagonist like 486! Someone save me, please! Then I turned around and saw the girls Kaguya Shinomiya, Chika Fujiwara, Hitori Gotou, and Miko Yotsuya trapped with me. Damn it, let's go! How can we let beautiful girls sacrifice themselves in such a place? I want to create a happy world without Urobuchi!

title: After Using My Crush’s Photo to Ward Off Suitors
summary: In Li Xia's twenty-sixth year of singlehood, her parents didn't ask for much. They just hoped she'd hurry up and get into a relationship. Tired of the nagging, Li Xia pulled up a photo of a random handsome guy she'd recently started following on Instagram and set it as her phone wallpaper. Whenever anyone asked, she'd simply hold up her phone for them to see. It was quick and effortless. He had fewer than a hundred followers—a total unknown. No chance of things blowing up. Or so Li Xia thought. On a business trip to a misty ancient town, she had just finished burning incense at an old temple when a sudden shower of beaded rain poured down. A late-arriving visitor asked her something. Li Xia unlocked her phone to check the time. When she looked up, she saw a face that was both strange and familiar. He gave her a half-smile. "Why are you using my photo?" "Quantum entanglement. Dreams do come true." *Popping Candy × Mint Soda Water *Crush vibes, full of teasing tension. *An urban fairy tale.

title: How To Put An End To The Villainess’ Deaths
summary: In her first life, she was killed in a noble's hunting ground as a commoner. In her second life, she was poisoned in the Imperial Palace as a descendant of a deceased marquis. And now, she's been given another chance. For reasons unknown, Evelyn has returned to life each time she dies, and this is her third life. In both her previous and current lives, thanks to her black hair and a friend's ring, she has been mistaken for the sole descendant of the Marquis of Ferrian and welcomed as a guest in the Imperial Palace. 'This was never my place to begin with.' In her previous life, Evelyn feared her true identity would be discovered. She thought she could escape the palace by marrying the Second Prince, who was far from power. However, Lloyd, the Empire's Second Prince, who was kind to everyone, never truly acknowledged her existence. Until now. "I will grant you what you desire." "…What I desire?" "I will marry you." In this third life, Lloyd approaches her first and proposes. Despite some minor differences, the overall situation remains the same. What has changed? No, it doesn't matter. This time, Evelyn is determined to escape the painful cycle of death and survive. She will escape the grand trap that is the Imperial Palace and ensure she meets a peaceful end.

title: The Monster Genius Pitcher Dominates the Major League
summary: Baekho has lived thirteen lives—each one ending the same way. On his thirtieth birthday, he wakes up again as a fifteen-year-old, with the same chilling message: [Lead the Tigers to victory] So he tried everything. Front office staff. Scout. Coach. Then hitter, pitcher, MLB superstar, even the greatest two-way monster baseball has ever seen. In his thirteenth life, he finally carried the Gwangju Tigers to a long-awaited championship. But the next morning… “Eat your breakfast.” Regression again. And for the first time, the voice continued: [That’s not the Tigers.] [The Tigers are across the Pacific.] [Lead the Detroit Tigers to victory] “You crazy bastard! Why are you only telling me this now?!” After wasting thirteen lifetimes chasing the wrong team, Baekho explodes. Now armed with MLB experience, KBO dominance, and skills honed over dozens of lives…he sets out to save the most hopeless franchise in American baseball.

title: Tender Pampering is the Best Strategy
summary: In the last life, Shen Shu had been forced to fulfill a marriage alliance, she was sent afar, to be married to the Huns. And after a few years of more clashes between the two, she-who-was-unloved ended up as a forgotten pawn. Everything she knew was balanced on the edge of destruction, when she suddenly witnessed how the so-called cold-blooded and heartless man, the one with unrivaled military power in his hands, died on the battlefield for her. The day she was reborn, just so happened to be the night before she was to be sent to fulfill the marriage alliance, As she haphazardly stumbled her way out of her palace chambers, somehow, she fell straight into Pei Yunqian’s embrace. The man’s expression was overcome by momentary confusion, as the young lady in his arms stared at him, the light from her eyes was like water, gently teasing his soul, “I don’t want to go and fulfill the marriage alliance, General, are you willing to marry me?” The whole world knew that in order to avoid being sent to fulfill the political marriage Princess Lingan chose to be married beneath her station, to a treacherous court official. Pei Yunqian’s moods were unstable, he was also sinister and ruthless. Many estimated that before long, the fragrance would diminish, the jade would perish, and the Princess would soon expire. Unbeknownst to them, in both lifetimes, that cold-blooded heartless man had treasured her like his life, and this life, he was even more dedicated to cutting away all the obstacles in her path, seeking to give her a life of tender pampering. Pei Yunqian was born cold-blooded, he cut men down without feeling anything, everyone was afraid of him, but Shen Shu loved him.

title: Inverse-Time Investigation Team
summary: The Time Reversal Investigation Team is composed of elite criminal police, cutting-edge scientists, criminologists, and network experts. One day, criminal police officer Lu Tianfeng discovered he possessed the ability to replay time, allowing him to relive the same day five times at irregular intervals. title: Yaksha’s Bride
summary: Sunhujung is a great kingdom that worships the god Yacha. Giru became a humble court attendant in the palace after being falsely accused of treason. She is in love with the First Prince, Iwu, who saved her life, but she receives all the favour of the somewhat aimless Second Prince, Ihhyo. “Giru… I cherish you deeply. Hmm? All I need is you, I do.” However, Giru finds his inexplicable obsession overwhelming and burdensome. The Yacha’s oracle will choose the new Emperor of Sunhujung at the coronation ceremony. The kind and gentle Iwu is expected to become the Emperor and take a noble woman as his empress. Giru planned to watch that moment for the last time, and then run far, far away. “Wha— Has the Young Master been chosen by the Yacha?!” “The Yacha, it’s the Yacha!” That was her plan, until she faced Ihhyo, who appeared wrapped in the god’s power on the day of the approaching coronation ceremony. The new Emperor opened his mouth with a languid smile. “Now, I shall choose my Empress.” As those words fell, Ihhyo’s icy-blue gaze turned toward Giru. title: The Engagement of the Baron of Flowers and the Withered Tree Lady
summary: Julia, the daughter of the Earl of Woodcliff, had a complex and challenging upbringing. Despite her noble lineage, she was born to a commoner and was later adopted two years ago. Blessed with her father's striking appearance, intelligence, and exceptional talents, Julia blossomed into an extraordinarily gifted and brilliant young girl. However, her remarkable qualities became a source of envy for her father's lawful wife and her legitimate siblings, who were born to her stepmother. Consequently, they treated her with icy indifference. Throughout the day, Julia endured meager meals and toiled tirelessly like a servant, except for the designated study hours set by her father. Her slender figure bore witness to the hardships she faced. In this harsh reality, Julia was scornfully labeled as the "Withered Tree girl" by her own family, while the household servants referred to her as the "Withered Tree Lady." Amidst these challenges, Julia's life took an unexpected turn when she received a marriage proposal from a baron of lower social status than an earl. Caught between her desire for freedom and the pressure imposed by her sisters, who opposed her union with a noble of lower rank, Julia found herself at a crossroads. The decision she had to make would shape her future and profoundly alter the course of her life.

But his life came to a tragic end—betrayed by a close friend. When he next opens his eyes, he finds himself in the body of Ernst Glockner, the third son of a prestigious swordsmanship family... a full 100 years in the future. Now thrown into the chaos of war and a brutal succession battle within his new family, Roden makes a choice: Survive—no matter what—as Ernst Glockner. And to do that, he’ll use a mysterious new ability: the power to master the sword just by reading books.

title: Obsessive Devotion – Atonement in Death for My Wronged Wife
summary: On the morning of her fifth wedding anniversary, Isabella Giovanni received a call. It wasn't from her husband. It was from his consigliere. "Mrs. Giovanni. You need to come to the office immediately. There is a… situation. An allegation against Mr. Giovanni. It concerns the unlawful confinement of a young woman." When she arrived at the law firm, she saw her—Sofia. A girl with a startling resemblance to a younger Isabella, weeping as she described how Vincent had "kept her" in a hotel suite for a week. And there was her husband, the cold and powerful Don, kneeling before the girl, soothing her with a soft murmur as he fastened a breathtaking diamond necklace around her throat. He turned, and his icy gaze found Isabella shrinking in the corner. "What are you doing here?" he asked, as if she were the intruder. No one remembered that Vincent Giovanni had once worshipped the ground she walked on. Until a sudden, devastating illness and a tragic accident twisted all his love into searing hatred. He replaced her with Sofia, indulging the pale imitation as she subjected Isabella to endless humiliation and torment, imprisoning her in a living hell disguised as a marriage. Isabella endured it all in silence, guarding a secret she would take to her grave. This is a story of obsession, misunderstanding, and brutal vengeance. When the truth is finally revealed, a devastating remorse will force Vincent to make his final choice—to descend into the abyss forever, or to pay the ultimate price for one last chance at atonement.

title: I Started Playing Solo In A New Game And Ended Up Becoming Famous Without Realizing It. Why Did That Happen?

She wants to crush them beneath her feet as their king.It is then that Kur appears before her with an unexpected offer.“Form an alliance with me. title: Got Into My Secret Crush’s Maybach by Mistake
summary: The day Jin Zhao reunited with Meng Yanxi, her students had just been egging her on in class, asking whether she had ever had a secret crush. The wind flipped the pages of the book. Jin Zhao smiled faintly and nodded. “Yes. Tall and handsome. He looks cool and aloof, and his mouth is sharp enough that you’d worry he could poison himself just by licking his lips, but actually his heart is very warm, very soft. Aside from occasionally being a bit silly and having poor alcohol tolerance, he doesn’t really have any flaws. He even has exceptionally good luck.” After class, she waited by the roadside for a DiDi. A black sedan stopped in front of her, unlocking with a “click.” She was lowering her head to reply to a message and, without thinking, pulled open the door and sat inside. The car drove off. At the same time, her phone rang, and the DiDi driver’s booming voice echoed in her ear: “You got into the wrong car! I’ve been honking like crazy behind you and you didn’t hear me? That’s a Maybach—over ten million! How did you dare?” Jin Zhao froze in shock and was just about to confirm with the owner when the man who had been silent in the driver’s seat suddenly lifted his gaze. Through the rearview mirror, Jin Zhao was caught completely off guard, meeting a pair of pitch-black peach-blossom eyes. Jin Zhao: “……” Help! She got into her secret crush’s Maybach by mistake! *Sweet girl x cool guy / outwardly soft, inwardly strong NPC x heaven’s favored big shot *Urban interwoven with campus / secret crush comes true / mutual redemption / double C, double first love *Coming-of-age story, from youth, to adulthood, to intimate relationships; the growth of all characters runs throughout.

My own clansmen drugged me and offered me as a tribute to the ruthless Wolf King, Zhan Yan. He pinched my chin, his eyes overflowing with contempt: “A weak little pet like you is only fit to warm my bed.” I lowered my head to hide the sharpness in my eyes, struggling to survive within the Wolf Tribe. But there was so much he didn’t know: The cub I saved on a whim would become the future God of War. The melodies I hummed reached the deep sea, awakening an ancient covenant. The herbs I brewed broke a thousand-year curse plaguing the Serpent Tribe. When the world-ending beast tide arrived, they tried to force me to sacrifice myself to appease the gods’ wrath. I turned and leaped into the Soul-Burial Abyss. But at the bottom of that darkness, I opened my Seven-Colored Divine Eyes. My memories returned: I am the Creator Goddess, Nuwa—the only True God of this world. And the Overlord of the Deep Sea, who had always guarded me in silence, raised a gargantuan tidal wave to offer a throne to my feet. They prostrated themselves, voices trembling: “Great Goddess, we beg for Your return.” I sat upon the Dragon-Bone Throne, a mere flick of my finger deciding the life and death of all creation. “Begging me now?” “Too late.”

title: Kyōkai no Kanata
summary: In the hidden world of Youmu, where the line between human and monster blurs, Akihito Kanbara, an immortal half-Youmu, yearns for an ordinary life. But fate has other plans. He encounters Mirai Kuriyama, a blood-wielding Spirit World Warrior haunted by a tragic past and burdened with the duty to exterminate Youmu like him. She aims to commit su*cide by jumping the school’s roof, but Akihito quickly notices and saves her. Despite Mirai’s initial mission to kill Akihito after learning his true identity, their destinies become irrevocably intertwined. Together, they face a relentless onslaught of supernatural threats, from monstrous Youmu to sinister forces lurking within the Spirit World. As they fight for survival, they uncover dark secrets about their own existence and the fragile balance between the human and Youmu realms. Their bond deepens, challenging their beliefs and blurring the lines between hunter and prey. Will they succumb to the darkness that surrounds them, or will they find the strength to forge their own path.
genres: Action, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: I Make Money and Buy Happiness
summary: Live happily while earning money leisurely.

title: The Earth Master Girl: Fengdu Ghost City
summary: My cousin is dead. His hands were tied to a ceiling beam, and he was wearing a red dress over a swimsuit-a swimsuit that was still dripping wet. The police report claimed it was a su*cide. But I know he didn't kill himself. And I know who's next. It's me. There is no escape.

title: Din no Monshou (LN)
summary: Our unfortunate hero died due to an unfortunate accident that occurred while he was looking for a job. When he woke up he realized that he had reincarnated in another world. “I will never live a lazy life again.” Then, he began his new life with that resolution in mind. The place where he was born was in the house of a family of fallen nobles. Whatever they are. This is the story of a boy who would fight to save his house from ruin with his companions

title: Warhammer: In the Name of Nirvana
summary: Before you stands the Emperor. Master of Mankind, Joint Ruler of Holy Terra and Mars, Heavenly Father, Caesar, Emperor, Augustus, Conqueror of the Stars, Bane of Xenos, Immortal Wisdom, Curse of Malevolent Gods, Watcher on the Golden Throne... And most importantly: Humanity's Eternal God, Indestructible Faith, Creator of the Greatest Suffering, Bearer of the Greatest Suffering. His legions are falling, his empire is dying, and all his most sacred, primal dreams are turning into the very ignorance and atrocities that will kill him. He is weeping. He is screaming. He is helpless, witnessing endless malice amidst infinite suffering. And I? I am the one who ended His suffering. (Female Primarch, original Legion, no devotion to Chaos. The author will try their best to maintain lore accuracy, "grimdark" flavor, and daily updates. The beginning might be a bit difficult to read, so feel free to read a few chapters to see if you can adapt.)

title: The Banished Son of a Nobleman Falls in Love at First Sight with a Barbaric Young Lady from the Frontier
summary: Born as the illegitimate child of a baron, I, Luke, was looked down upon as the “low-tier noble son” among the nobles of the kingdom. After losing my fiancée to my younger brother, I had my engagement publicly annulled at a royal palace party. In the harsh wilderness of the forest, my heart was captured at first sight by a tall woman who saved me from a wolf attack. Her name was Alexia, the daughter of the frontier lord who governed the area, notorious for being a “barbaric noble lady.” “What should I do? This is love. I’ve fallen in love—” In this brutal frontier land, I finally found a peaceful life for the first time. Interacting with kind people and yearning for Alexia, I gradually began to grow closer to her… * This is a story about a pure-hearted puppy-like young nobleman who falls head over heels for a physically strong older noble lady and grows along the way. The first half highlights his slow life after the annulment and exile, but the latter half shifts to a satisfying revenge narrative.

title: My Master Breaks Through Only at the Last Moment
summary: "Master, it's my fault for not helping you break through before the deadline," the disciple said, his voice filled with sorrow. "Don't worry, my disciple. I'm not going to die," Xu Fan reassured with a smile, looking at his distraught disciple. "It's my fault for not getting more Foundation Establishment Pills for you, otherwise..." the top disciple of the sect sobbed uncontrollably, kneeling on the ground. Xu Fan sighed, looking at his top disciple with a mix of helplessness and affection, then casually tossed a Foundation Establishment Pill into his mouth. Suddenly, a five-colored aura illuminated the heavens and the earth.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Excalibur Chronicle of Raidorl (LN)
summary: Born as the second prince of the Kingdom of Zain, Raidorl becomes the owner of Dáinsleif, the 'Cursed Sword', one of the twelve sacred swords said to exist on earth. However, his elder brother Prince Granard hates him as a threat to his royal authority and banishes him to a remote region. One day, while living a poor and harsh life in the lair of demons, he is called back to his kingdom - and is forced to leave. Raidorl is furious and disgusted by Granard, who forces him to defend his country against the invasions of other countries, and although he ostensibly obeys his orders, he decides to rebel! One after another, the holders of the Holy Sword appear, and the nobles betray them. Can Raidorl, in the face of all these hardships, take his revenge? This is the story of a boy who, in exchange for many sacrifices, becomes a hero with wings as powerful as phoenixes!

title: After the Body Swap, the General Tore off His White Moonlight
summary: Everyone in the general’s mansion discovered that their general and his wife had become very abnormal. The general who cherished words like gold, was extremely filial, respected his brothers and mother, and held Miss Lin in his hand, now became foul-mouthed, contradicted his mother, drove away his eldest brother, tear Miss Lin apart with his own hands. And their mistress is even stranger. Now she starts fighting whenever she disagrees, and she is even more obsessed with the old lady’s attitude. The strangest thing is that the relationship between the two masters has undergone earth-shaking changes. If you don’t believe it, take a look. What everyone sees on the surface: two people who haven’t slept together in two years, give each other clothes that fit each other without asking each other’s sizes. Eating together, picking up food for each other until the bowl is full of food.

title: After Transmigrating, I Was Actually Married by a White-Haired Beauty!
summary: Fifteen-year-old Qingyu was just an ordinary high school student living an ordinary life. He thought things would stay that way forever—until one morning, he woke up in a luxurious bedroom… And right in front of him stood a beautiful white-haired girl. “Um…” “Shh—” The girl pressed a finger to his lips, silencing his confusion. As Qingyu lowered his gaze, his heart began to race…

title: Gamers of the Underworld
summary: Sherlock is a new generation Dungeon Lord whose ambition is to become the greatest Devil King and building up the greatest Dungeon in the Underworld. He summons a group of other-worldly goblins who give themselves strange names, form cliques, engage in commerce, and even fight among themselves. They call themselves—Gamers!

title: Beast, Let Go of That Queen!
summary: All I did was see a poor dog lying on the road, killed in a car accident. I felt sorry for it, so I dug a hole and buried it. You don't have to do this to me, do you? Making me able to understand what cats and dogs are saying overnight is one thing, but what the hell is up with them calling me "Her Majesty the Queen" with every other breath? From then on, animals started showing up every few days to pay homage! Pay homage! Dammit! I'm not that goddamn shrine in Nihon! What the hell is there to worship! What's worse, animals are constantly bringing me food! Bones, mice, insects, grass... One day I even found half a leg of lamb by my pillow! A bloody, hairy leg of lamb, for crying out loud! All the various scares are one thing, but please, can you not make so many impossible requests?! The finless porpoises demand the water quality of the Yangtze River be improved. The giant pandas are crying and begging their keepers to stop forcing them to mate for the sake of breeding. Even the old hen in the kitchen naively asks, "Dear, is it possible for you not to eat us?" ... I finally got a chance to be reborn, and all I wanted was to get revenge on my s*umbag dad and take back the family fortune, not to dedicate my life to the national liberation movement for all the oppressed animals in the world, hello?! The cruelest revenge in the world is: making all your grandchildren call me Mom!

title: The Reason I Was Reincarnated as a Witch in a Novel
summary: “Why the heck is he here?” Lindsay’s eyes twitched when she saw the man collapsed in front of a small two-story building. He wasn’t supposed to be lying here at her doorstep—he should’ve been in some back alley of the capital. A black cat stretched its back legs, yawned, and meowed. [He just suddenly passed out, nya.] “…Why here of all places?” [How should I know, nya? Hurry up and give me food.] Ugh, seriously. It’s not even a real cat, but it keeps talking in “meow” speech! “You’re supposed to guard the house, right?” [Technically, this is the front of the house, nya.] Always has to have the last word. Or… should I call you ‘witch’?” Lindsay froze as she tried to push his face away from her legs. Taking that chance, the man grabbed her hand and pulled it down, locking eyes with her. His wide green pupils reflected her like a mirror, and in them shone his crescent-shaped lavender eyes. “Nice to meet you, Witch.” “No way… Witch? title: Dark Beast Summoner

All of you better watch her closely, and anyone who tries to hit on her shall be killed without exception!” “My Lord, are you blind? title: Global Evolution
summary: The Cambrian Explosion, now the largest life science puzzle… 500 million years ago,among single-celled life on Earth , there suddenly began mutations similar to evolution, a variety of gorgeous creatures were born “out of thin air”, all ancestors of today’s species appeared in that short period of time, each species were evolving at lightning speed; billion times faster than today, it was a brilliant era. And humans, were also one step faster during the turtle race, and become the leader of life on Earth. But now — a greater “second age” has come again. During the lightning speed of evolution, humanity was kicked off of the throne on the food chain in the shortest time possible, and life on Earth, welcomed the second brilliant big bang. The real end of the world, is no longer brainless zombies or desolate earth, but — the end of mankind, the whole earth’s paradise.

But Megumi was taken from him by Netori Shuji, who then rubbed salt in the wound by sending Yujiro an NTR video. What Netori didn’t know was that Yujiro had seen it coming — and had a response ready. He sent back a video of himself getting affectionate with Netori’s own girlfriend, Kawashima Hoshina. Shuji, who was genuinely in love with Hoshina, broke down in tears and sank into despair. This is a tale of revenge — where a man who was betrayed turns the tables by quietly stealing back what was taken, not from the woman, but from the man who wronged him.

title: Fake Daughter Of The Brium Family
summary: “I just want to live.” On a rainy evening, Rebecca, wandering the streets to save her sick younger sibling, is driven out by the clergy due to her lowly poverty background. Isabel, whom she coincidentally meets on the street, extends a helping hand to Rebecca. The joy of saving her sibling was short-lived. Mysterious men of unknown origin kill Isabel and target Rebecca’s life as well. Under the desperate desire to live, an unknown entity appears before Rebecca and presents her with a single proposal. “The Law of the Divine…?” [You have only one year. If you, as the deceased Isabel, swear ‘divine vengeance’ to God and bring despair and destruction to those who drove you to death, you will be granted one wish.] Given to her is a single opportunity. “I accept.” Rebecca, becoming Isabel, swears to God to bring destruction upon those who led her to death.

title: Immortal Cultivation: A Celestial Touch Bestows Eternal Life
summary: Gu Ning'an unexpectedly transmigrated into a Xianxia world and stumbled upon a mystical manual titled The Path of Dao. After years of diligent cultivation, he mastered its teachings, gaining the strength to slay a tiger with a single finger. Feeling confident in his abilities, Gu Ning'an descended the mountain and explored the mortal world for five years. During his journey, he roamed the rivers and lakes, forged new friendships, and vanquished demons and monsters. However, one day, he came across The Path of Dao at a roadside bookstall, only to discover that the so-called immortal technique he had relied upon was nothing more than a widely circulated folktale in the mortal realm. Determined to uncover the truth, Gu Ning'an returned to the mountain and immersed himself in studying The Path of Dao once more. Twenty years passed in a blink, and Gu Ning'an felt as though he had grasped the entirety of heaven and earth, with the ends of the world visible at a glance. In that moment, a strange realization dawned upon him—if he so wished, he could ascend to immortality on the spot...

summary: “If you walk alone for too long, loneliness will consume you. I need someone spotless to keep me company.” Camel bells echo across the desert, swaying through Jiayuguan toward the dazzling capital of Chang’an. There, amidst radiant beauties and passionate poetry, stands a legendary figure—Dali’s National Master, Linyuan. Since the founding of the dynasty, he has been its pillar: when rebels besieged the city and Taizu was trapped, it was Linyuan who ascended the tower and single‑handedly repelled thirty thousand troops. Yet once peace was restored, he withdrew into the Supreme Shrine, shunning the world and forbidding any mention of his age. In Lotus Lantern’s imagination, the national teacher should have been an austere elder with white hair and beard. But when she trespassed into the shrine, fate twisted unexpectedly—her intrusion into his solitude set events spiraling. From that moment, his words bound her: “From now on, you must put this seat first in all things. If I command east, you cannot go west. If I command you to stand and die, you cannot sit and die. You must obey me for life—and most of all, you cannot hold anyone else in your heart.” “Do you think your back holds any flesh worth looking at? How can there be such a brazen person in the world!” “What did you say? Do you dare call me old?” “Do you like me? Are you tempted by me?” In the Central Plains, there is a word for one who lived innocently all their life yet faltered in integrity at the end: the evening festival. He as walked alone for centuries, waiting only for the moment he would meet her.

The sole survivor, heir Cheng Shao, escaped death and spent a decade consumed by injustice and vengeance, walking alone through darkness. Now, he returns to the capital disguised as the enigmatic "Bai Yi." When a series of mu*ders entangle their fates, they begin to unravel a conspiracy buried deep beneath the capital's glittering surface. Together, they journey across provinces, solving cold cases and dismantling dangerous plots, inching closer to the truth behind the massacre that shattered Cheng Shao's world. As justice is finally served and past wounds begin to heal, their wedding approaches - until the groom shocks everyone by revealing his true identity: "Pleased to meet you all. I am Cheng Shao... also known as Bai Yi."
