title: The Despicable Villain of the Academy
summary: The Helios family is a prestigious noble house within the kingdom. For generations, it produced powerful heroes. However, the youngest, Ember Helios, was different. He was infamous for committing all kinds of atrocities. Not only did he mistreat commoners, but beating the servants within his own mansion was part of his daily life. There came a point when the deaths piled up so much that not even a family of heroes could continue covering it up. Ember was eventually executed. Talentless, but abusing the power and position of his family to commit evil—such was the end of the despicable villain. And I was reincarnated as that villain. As a reader who already knows the end of this story, I had to find a way to survive.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: This Hunter Punishes with Telekinesis
summary: Min Sa-hyeok, an 18-year-old survivor of the monster-infested Seoul District 3, harbors a burning hatred for monsters after witnessing his mother’s gruesome death. He meticulously documents his knowledge of monsters in a notebook, which later becomes the foundation for monster taxonomy, known as the “Blue Note.” A year later, Sa-hyeok joins the Monster Special Forces, a unit dedicated to monster extermination. However, the unit is gradually falling apart as Hunters, those with supernatural abilities, desert the military for lucrative civilian guilds. Despite years of rigorous training, Sa-hyeok remains unable to awaken his own abilities. During a mission, a fellow soldier, driven to despair by a superior’s relentless ab*se, attempts su*cide. In a desperate attempt to stop him, Sa-hyeok unknowingly awakens his ability – telekinesis – and unknowingly saves his comrade’s life.

title: You’re Telling Me This Is a Slice-of-Life?
summary: After being Reincarnated, You Realize: The world around you is brimming with the carefree air of a slice-of-life world. Surrounded by beautiful girls, a blissful life is unfolding before you. With your foreknowledge, you’re ready to play this life like a game. But then, a game invitation arrived: 【Welcome to the Reincarnation Game】 【You will witness the Blood Moon’s slaughter, escape the Devil’s Hospital, and experience the Six Paths of Rebirth…】 【You will connect with countless players across the multiverse, witness Fern’s elegant catwalk, face the origin of Ryougi Shiki , experience Aizen’s terrifying scheme…】 Wait. Did one of us get the wrong script!?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Reborn with My Wife
summary: Waking up drunk, Gu Xia found that he had been reborn ten years ago, and his wife had also been reborn. Whether they should live separately, or reunite, Gu Xia felt that this was a question worth pondering.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: A Reincarnated Villainous Aristocrat, Who Becomes the Greatest Adventurer to Saves His Favorite Character
summary: A boy from a villainous noble family learns of a future in which his favourite character is killed as the last boss, and after that day, he begins to learn magic with bloody hard work. One year later, he is convinced that his doomed future has been averted for now, but he is shocked to discover that it all happened according to the game storyline. The game scenario’s compelling force, which could be called a curse,—- but on the flip side, it meant that no matter how reckless he was, he would not die until he was doomed. The boy who became an adventurer learns not only magic but also swords and faces monsters. In order to save the girl of his dreams and the precious people he encounters, his efforts are accelerated to the point of sickness. And the boy pushes forward on the death line without a care in the world. Will the crazy boy be able to destroy the storyline and save his favorite character? —-

title: On the Wedding Day, the Substitute Foolish Bride Wants a Divorce
summary: Transmigrated into the body of a fool, she was bullied by the servants—until she fought back with a whip and trampled them underfoot. The short-lived prince tried to protect her, but she demanded a divorce right on the spot. Thrown into the back mountain to be fed to a python, she turned the python into roasted meat instead. To rescue her exiled family, she reached a cooperation agreement with the short-lived prince. When everything was settled, she clapped her hands and left without hesitation. The prince could no longer stay calm—he’d rather give up the world than lose his beauty.

title: On a Godless Planet
summary: Before Horizon, humanity ascended to the heavens, but how exactly did that happen? Kawakami's new series explores the Edge era in which legends must be recreated to reshape a distant planet.

title: Sweet Love in the ’70s: Spoiled by a Rough Military Officer
summary: Military Marriage + Historical Era + Child Rearing + Dimensional Space Supplies + Marriage First, Love Later + Sweet Romance + Mutual Purity After dying in the apocalypse, Song Li transmigrates into a male-oriented historical novel as the cannon-fodder original wife of the beautiful, strong, and tragic villain. The original Song Li had a terrible personality—lazy, greedy, abusive to children, and eventually pushed the villain to the edge of darkness. In the end, she was tortured to death. Song Li shivered at the thought. Fortunately, she arrived at just the right time—none of that had happened yet, and her dimensional space came with her. She began farming, selling spiritual tea, and opened a food factory. Before she knew it, she became the richest person in the country. As for the man who used to avoid her like the plague? He now couldn't leave her side. "Wife, isn't it time we had a second baby?"

title: The Unfortunate Girl Wants an Easy Mode in Her Second Life
summary: Minato, a 16-year-old girl burdened by a lifetime of misfortune, meets an untimely end at the hands of her own father. Instead of finding peace in death, she’s met by a well-meaning but naive God who offers her reincarnation into a fantasy world filled with magic and adventure. Minato, jaded by her past, initially refuses, but God insists, granting her a special power: the ability to change the difficulty of her new life, just like in a video game. Reincarnated into the body of a young girl, Minato finds herself in a harsh and dangerous world where she’s immediately captured by goblins. Using her “Difficulty Change” ability, she effortlessly escapes and sets off on a journey to navigate this strange new world. Along the way, she discovers a hidden talent for both thievery and magic, garnering the attention of various guilds and adventurers, including the headstrong Latifa, an illegitimate noblewoman determined to win the prince’s heart.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Supernatural

title: Mer, I Love You
summary: “Hello there, are you awake?” When the girl woke up, she was in a strange room with a person she didn’t know. She doesn’t remember anything, not even her name, but the stranger says to the girl…. “It’s nice to meet you, Mer Ivy.” This is the story of a girl and a doctor who never speaks his name. And the story that follows. Please read it again at least once to see if you can understand the meaning of the girl’s name.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Sci-fi

title: The Villainess’ Ending Was Death
summary: She became an insignificant villainess who was used for cider. She did her best to play the role so that the original story was not twisted. “You are nothing to me, Fresa.” The male lead despises her. “Why do you hate me so much? Because I’m an insignificant maid?” the original heroine resented her. “You are the disgrace of the family.” ‘Yes, yes. Everybody’s doing great. Keep hating me. Go on!’ And finally, on the day the original story had its ending, she decided to die. With a false poison, of course. She left her family and tried to live in a secluded countryside by cultivating a herb garden, but she saved the life of a man who had moved into a neighbor’s house. However this man, was the Grand Duke who killed and saved many people with a smile? “So you saw my naked body . . .” The subtlety intensified. “Let’s take it all off this time, shall we? Then it will be easier to look at it.” The Grand Duke was overly assertive. Moreover, the original male lead, who should enjoy a happy newlywed with the original heroine, has also arrived. “You’re the one I really love, Fresa.” Fresa said, almost hitting Rowan in the head with the homie he was holding. “No, did you just hit your head?” Even family members who ignored and persecuted her as a disgrace pleaded. “Come back, Fresa. Everybody’s waiting for you.” ‘Yes, no way I’m going back.’

title: Playing with Love
summary: After losing my memory, I mistook my nemesis for my husband. And even moved into his house. On the day my memory returned, I was tugging on his sleeve, asking for a kiss. The memories flooded back, and I froze, just about to run away. But the always-cold man frowned, lowered his head, and gave me a kiss, his tone helpless: "Alright, can you stay at home like a good girl now?"

title: After Cultivation, Became a Special Forces Soldier
summary: The underachieving young master, dissatisfied with his wealthy father's affair and subsequent divorce from his mother, constantly opposed his father. He then injured his classmate Zhang Shuai in a fight over a girlfriend and was expelled from school. Angered, he ran away from home and ended up wandering the streets, where he was noticed by a Daoist Immortal and taken in as a closed-door disciple. Three years later, after his master ascended to immortality, Liang Liang, near the Taoist Temple, coincidentally became involved in a battle between an undercover policewoman and a drug lord. To save the Taoist Temple and his innocent martial brothers, he willingly became a hostage to the drug lord and was kidnapped to an isolated island, where he engaged in a battle of wits and courage against the drug lord...
genres: Action, Drama, Martial Arts, Romance, School Life

title: A Primorsky Immigrant Hides Gold
summary: But I have a lot of money. Money can solve everything in the world.

title: Transcendence Through Training
summary: 25-year-old Kim Hyunseok, an orphan abandoned under a bridge. As he endures the harsh world, an invitation from the Tower arrives. Hyunseok, who was in despair after losing his only mother, accepts the invitation without hesitation. [‘Choose the difficulty level’] “Level 100.” He chooses level 100 without hesitation. The story goes that if you conquer the battlefield of Magnes, you can achieve anything. With that single-minded determination, the training for transcendence begins.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: After Traveling Through the Book, I Had a Happy Ending With the Vicious Man

In the eyes of the wealthy circle, this is a balanced marriage between the daughter of a poor family and the son of a mistress. Some people said that she had to settle for second best because she failed to marry Huo Shang, the eldest son of the Huo family. Huo Ran has been hearing other people’s gossip since he was a child. Marrying Qin Tian is just a step towards fulfilling his hidden ambitions, and his emotions will not waver in the slightest. After the marriage, he and Huo Shang appeared in Qin Tian’s ward at the same time. Huo Shang glanced at the fruit on the table and said nonchalantly, “She likes to eat strawberries, don’t you know?” Huo Ran remained silent, but his hands clenched unconsciously. Qin Tian said she was pregnant. His heart ached, and he tried hard not to let the moisture in his eyes overflow. title: Our Quest ~Climbing to The Top in Another World with T*ash Card~
summary: Masamune that died from accident, get his life picked up by goddess, and they go on to journey for defeating demon lord in another world. Masamune got only one cheat ability that is "Card that can conjure magic". Each card doesn't have that much power, but Masamune is a japanese champion of trading card game. With the combination of card that can't be expected by any people, Masamune defeat demon king's army. By increasing his companion and his card in his sleeve, he will be called by the title of ”Maten no Kenja". This is the story of boy with name of Masamune that will defeat demon king.

title: Don’t Be Scared, I’m Really Not a Yandere!
summary: “Yandere… Am I a yandere? Eww, no way! That’s not me~” “Too scary, too scary! The class president is practically a yandere! I gotta get out of this creepy place fast—I don’t ever want to run into her again!” Yixin Xue, the stunning white-haired beauty in his class, was aloof and untouchable, a goddess in the eyes of every guy. But was that really the case? “Ling Yuan, how could you have another girl in your eyes…”

title: A Misconception Triangle of a Foolish Butler, an Idiot Maid, and a Villainous Young Lady
summary: Our lady is the best! The tale of a villainess whose misdeeds are mistaken as virtuous deeds owing to her competent yet dim-witted attendants.

title: Kaiwa mo Shinai Tsurekko no Imouto ga, Naganen Issho ni Baka Yatte-kita Netoge no Friend Datta (LN)
summary: Kurai Subaru of high school 2nd grade who loves games. His father remarried 5 years ago, and he lives with his younger stepsister, Hiyori, who attends the same high school as his. Although he was not dissatisfied with his life, there was a wall between him and his quiet younger stepsister Hiyori, which he was unable to break open. One day, Subaru was supposed to meet with a best friend who he became so - online for the first time ......"You got to be kidding me" ― To his surprise, the transcendental beauty that appeared in front of him happened to be his younger stepsister, Hiyori! He couldn’t hide his surprise on seeing the gap between the plain and quiet Hiyori and the unexpected true identity of his online best friend being the same person. Even though they are supposed to be friends who can talk about anything over the game screen, they got tongue-locked when they face-to-face with each other ...... Under the same roof with a pretty-girl, and the boy who is at the start of his adolescence attending as a high school student, a heart-melting love comedy!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Romance, School Life

title: I’m the Hero, but It’s Pretty Clear That the Daughter Born in the Inn Where I Stayed Last Is Definitely Mine
summary: After a fierce struggle, the hero defeated the Demon Lord and saved the world. The legend of his deeds spread worldwide in an instant, and he received gratitude letters and return orders even from his home kingdom. However, the hero found the last village he stayed in to be quite comfortable and decided to settle down there. Eight years have passed since then, and now he’ve become a respectable adult in his late twenties. He spends his days in the village, providing swordsmanship and magic guidance to the village children and living a relaxed life with the savings he accumulated during his adventurer days. He is supported by the kind villagers and nobody seems to worry about him finding a spouse. It’s a peaceful life. Wait, one of the children just effortlessly learned a complicated spell? A spell that requires a magic sense on par with a hero? Oh, no, that child is the innkeeper’s daughter. Haha. Do I have any suspicions? W-What are you talking about?… Oh, come to think of it, that night at the inn… I think I’ll keep this story to myself forever…

title: My CEO Killer Simulator
summary: I have married my childhood friend thirty-eight times. Every time, my ex-fiancé Ji Guifan would come and ruin the wedding. He would tear off my veil with a grim, menacing expression and rough movements. "Ji Ran, how dare you marry another man without my permission?" He would ignore my cries and pleas, drag me back, lock me up, and torment me as he pleased. I have resisted, struggled, even called the police, trying every possible way to escape. But every time, Ji Guifan would catch me. He threatened me with the lives and assets of my childhood friend's entire family and with my career prospects. He forced me to compromise again and again. But when I finally gave in and obediently stayed by his side, he complained that I was dull and lifeless. I have been reborn thirty-seven times, and every life ended badly. On my thirty-eighth rebirth, I didn't want to endure anymore. If every choice is wrong, then I'll choose Ji Guifan's death!

title: Night Led By The Empress
summary: “The Empress was supposed to be my woman.” The Scarecrow Empress, Diane, lived as the last member of the bloodline of a rebellious family. In front of her, an unidentified man wearing an iron mask appeared. "That's too bad. I thought I was the first one to see the face of Prince Gotha, which everyone wanted to see." "Are you saying that you missed me?" The Prince was as relentless as someone who took pleasure in making fun of her. "Then I can take it off right away." "No! I didn't mean it like that!" As she stopped him from trying to take off his mask, the Prince pulled her towards him. The wind completely loosened the front of the tightly-tucked gown, and the fronts of the two people met, touching one another through a see-through chemise. The prince's voice echoed low inside the iron mask. "Right now, I'm holding it in, Your Majesty the Empress.” The moment the Prince's identity was revealed outside the iron mask, Diane had already become a northern woman.

title: Vast Dream
summary: 【Life is but a vast dream, within which only my senior brother and I exist】 【Who can use love, and make senior brother their own?】 The gentle and elegant, slightly enchanting senior brother vs his mischievous and willful little junior sister who causes trouble every day. “Senior brother died when he was sixteen.” “Senior brother is not my white moonlight, he is everyone’s white moonlight except for me. “My Senior brother and I depended on each other. He was very talented in everything he did, while my talent was poor in every endeavor. However, before our sect was destroyed, my former master made him swear to protect me. Consequently, he had no choice but to learn both cultivation and swordsmanship, and taking me with him wherever he went.” “I envied him, didn’t like him, and quarreled with him every day. Because everyone liked him, everyone treated me as his hanger-on. Female swordsmen and cultivators obsessed with him all detested me, who was always by his side.” “I wanted to escape from my senior brother, to stay away from his world. After I left, I learned from others that all of those those who claimed to love my senior brother and treated me as his white moonlight wanted to kill my senior brother under the excuse that they had no other choice.” “Sword light filled the sky, and my senior brother fought valiantly. How could I, the malicious woman whom everyone hated, let them have their way? I sneaked back, determined to save my senior martial brother.” One-sentence Summary: My senior brother’s widely known favoritism towards me.

title: The Flery Little Darling:Taming the Cold-Hearted Overlord
summary: Qu Qinzhi entered the book and became a vicious supporting female character. Faced with a man who would turn into a villainous big shot in the future, she shivered in fear but had to maintain the original owner's arrogant personality, arrogantly humiliating him: "Xie Muhuan, kneel down now and beg me to be your girlfriend." Xie Muhuan's handsome face remained expressionless, and he coldly uttered one word: "Leave." Years later, Xie Muhuan became a powerful tech tycoon, ruthless and cold. After enduring humiliation and bullying from him time and time again, Qu Qinzhi finally succeeded and retired, leaving his world. She had no idea that Xie Muhuan had gone crazy searching for her. Countless nights, he tightly held her in his dreams

title: This Primordial World Is Too Dangerous
summary: Traveling through the ancient Penglai Immortal Island, Yuan Lian became the incarnation of the true spirit of the Twelve-Rank Pure World White Lotus. As an innate saint, Yuan Lian said that he wanted to practice Taoism well and achieve sainthood at the same time. But he never expected that just after he transformed, Dong Wanggong came to block the door. With one strike from the Golden Immortal, billions of miles of void collapsed and billions of worlds were destroyed! The Taiyi strongman can manipulate the river of time at will and sweep away all enemies! The Golden Immortal of Daluo attains eternal enlightenment, with eternal immortality in the past, present and future, and eternal freedom! At this time, the world was just created, Daluo did not appear, and Taiyi became the master! The ferocious beasts wreaked havoc on the world and dominated one side. Rahu occupied the west and proclaimed himself king. Countless innate saints are struggling to find the way! Yuan Lian looked at his pitiful Golden Immortal cultivation and felt like crying but had no tears! “Is this the prehistoric world? It’s outrageous!” “This wilderness is too dangerous!” This book is also known as “This Great Wilderness is Too Outrageous!” “Yuan Lian, who only wants to survive, can only choose to be treacherous!” “In order to survive in the Great Wilderness, these spiritual treasures belong to me!” “This divine being is obviously extremely powerful, but overly cautious.”
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: After I Faked My Death, My Demon Lord Disciple Wanted Me Back
summary: I transmigrated as the Male Lead's malicious, high-maintenance Master, and then I faked my death to escape. I used to mock and ridicule him, bossing him around with every breath. Eventually, my conscience got the better of me, and I took a fatal sword strike meant for him. Even as I was dying, I couldn't stop being a drama queen: "This hurts like hell. If I'd known, I wouldn't have blocked it for you. I hate you most of all!" Then, I successfully faked my death and left that world. By the time I transmigrated back, three hundred years had already passed. Amidst a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, a pair of blood-stained hands cupped my cheeks. My disciple, now the Demon Lord, embraced me from behind. "Master, could you act spoiled with me again...?"

title: He Was Shining With The Stars
summary: After one night sleeping with him, she found he was her father’s sworn brother. She tried to hide herself from him and meant to bury these filthy pasts deep in her heart, but ultimately failed to escape from the beautiful memories. She loved him so much and so blindly that troubles found their way to her. He disappeared, loved and married another woman. This regretless love fraud tortured her, so much so that he finally turned into the sharpest thorn in her heart. She had love, and pain, but lost. As long as she closed her eyes, the very tender look that he had when doting on her to the utmost came to her mind…

title: I Got Scammed and Now I’m Taking Responsibility?
summary: “I will never fail.” I was scammed and I have to pay back all the money. And to the duke, the only one who can stand against the royal family. I promised to take responsibility because I've never failed in my life as a mercenary, but... "Aren't you going to do it right?" "Do it properly. If you want to repay your debt faithfully." It was hard to survive under the filthy, dog-like duke. I was thinking of leaving as soon as I caught the swindler... ... At some point, the duke's gaze became unusual, and he asked, "Do you think I'll let you go?" His obsessive gaze surrounded me.

title: I Want to Smile Beside you in the Spring That I Haven’t Seen Yet
summary: At first glance, Haruka seems to be enjoying her everyday life without any worries. But in fact, love, friendship, and her relationship with her parents are all going wrong. While struggling to breathe, she meets a mysterious boy named Amane. For some reason, Haruka finds solace in talking with Amane, who is unable to speak, after school. Haruka takes a certain action for Amane, but she ends up hurting him deeply… "I don’t care if you hate me, I want you to smile." The light that they have found gives them courage.

title: Summoner Dungeon in Another World: My Summoned Beasts Are Clearly Overpowered After Returning to the Modern World
summary: Reima Kariya, a summoner who saved another world but was executed because his immense power was deemed a threat, wakes up to find himself back in Japan—the same world he originally came from. However, this Japan is slightly different, as it is now overflowing with dungeons, and the profession of "dungeon streamers" has become highly popular. Wishing to live a peaceful life in the Japan he has returned to, Reima decides to conceal his powers and blend into this altered modern world...

title: Five Big Bosses are Too Clingy After Transmigrating into a Book
summary: Chu Xingchen transmigrated into a book, becoming the villainess Crown Princess in a world where women are honored and men are valued. The Crown Princess had five husbands, and upon transmigrating, the marriage-phobic protagonist suddenly had five husbands! Each of the five husbands was more outstanding and powerful than the last, with one of them even being a s*umbag. Facing the mess left behind, Chu Xingchen cleaned up the lowlife men and women, focused on infrastructure development, and strived for progress. Under her leadership, the State of Chu developed better and better. As her career flourished and her position stabilized, she realized that the gaze of her husbands began to change… They were supposed to be political marriages without feeling, right? (Ending is 1V1).
genres: Action, Adult, Comedy, Harem, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Silver Moon
summary: She was reborn with memories of her past life and a special ability. From a genius doctor Yoo Seung-ah, she became the princess of the Ladian Empire, Shuran.Shurina Ruth Ladian, the abandoned princess. Others pity her, but Shuran wants to live quietly without drawing attention in this life. For her, life in the Wind Palace isn’t so bad. However, situations keep coming up that force her to leave the comfort of her garden… “Shuran gently held the wounded hand of the Ladian prince.” Whoosh! A bright light flowed from Shuran’s hand and wrapped around the prince’s entire body. “Shuran, can you use divine power?”
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Tragedy

title: Hidden Power, Bloody Revenge
summary: This story follows Kairo, an ordinary young man whose life is shattered by a single brutal night. When he witnesses a violent incident, a mysterious power known as Aura awakens within him, dragging him into a hidden world ruled by strength, blood, and survival. As Kairo learns to control his newfound power, he discovers a society filled with secret organizations, ruthless fighters, and deadly power systems. Every battle makes him stronger—but each step forward demands sacrifice. Trust is fragile, betrayal is common, and the line between hero and monster begins to blur. Driven by pain, revenge, and the search for his true identity, Kairo must decide whether his power will protect the innocent or consume him entirely. This is a dark, fast-paced action manga–style web novel about hidden strength, bloody revenge, and the price of power.

title: Don’t be the Principal of the Academy
summary: After the war, I was hailed as a hero and planned to live a comfortable life, getting my fair share of scraps. But the Emperor gave me the position of Academy Principal. “Ancient ruins have been discovered near the northwest area of the academy! However, golems are emerging from there and are heading outside the ruins! Orders?” “Rebels from the Empire have sent a terrorist threat targeting the students! We need to prepare…!” “A massive dungeon has been discovered beneath the academy! The head of security is requesting a search party and reinforcements!” “Riley Terne has destroyed the combat room 1 again!” I should have bolted out of there early on. Damn it. ‘Is this an academy or some kind of monstrous, otherworldly place?’ Please, don’t make me be the Academy Principal. Shit, when I say don’t, just don’t.

title: Umareta Chokugo ni Suterareta kedo, Zensei ga Taikensha datta node Yoyuu de Ikitemasu
summary: Born into the prestigious Brazel family, a magical family, he is abandoned near the Magical Forest due to his low magical aptitude value. There is no way that a mere suckling child can live in a dangerous magical place…. “Oh my God, I was thrown away right after I was reincarnated.” ―Actually, the baby, in his previous life, was a great sage. As a baby, he survived the magical forest with ease, and when he left the forest with his beloved staff Lindwurm, which he used in his previous life, he decided to live as an adventurer in search of freedom. Eventually, he became the first 0-year-old adventurer in history, and he continued to blow the minds of those around him, sometimes making fun of him legally like a baby.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem

title: I Began Selling Jars from Naruto World
summary: Crossing over to the world of Naruto with the Transaction System. Shen Mo travelled across all heavens to sell jars as a travelling merchant. Tsunade: Don’t obstruct me Shizune, today I must pull a Life Token! Uchiha Sasuke: Can I really become stronger by opening jars? Use my entire family fortune to buy jars, I must surpass that man! Gol D. Roger: Why isn’t everyone going to seek my buried treasure but went to purchase jars instead? Misaka Mikoto: One side goes through, I will finish opening these jars then I will thoroughly flatten you! Uchiha Itachi: My foolish otouto, I opened more jars than you. …… Shen Mo is looking at the crazily cash recharging numerous protagonists with helpless expression… I initially just wanted to earn enough money to buy Ikaros, that’s all.

title: The 13th Descender Who Attacks Destruction
summary: South Korea has fallen into a cycle of repeated destruction. Returnees, reincarnators, and those who came back from other worlds all tried, but no one could alter the fate of the fallen nation. Placing their final hope in salvation, the guardian deities protecting the Korean Peninsula choose “Descent” as their last resort. Twelve failed attempts, now begins the 13th round. "Hyun Doyoon," the descender who returns to the past, carries with him 600 million strands of memory—memories of 50 million descendants from the 12th cycle. Now, he must fight endlessly, not as a god, but as a human. To prevent destruction, and to save the nation and its descendants.

title: Suo Jiao Long
summary: In the capital of Shangjing, there lived the Yun family, known for their many charitable deeds. Their youngest daughter was named Yun Xian. The young girl was refined and elegant, with a smile like a blooming flower. The city's matchmakers watched her with eyes red with envy, yet all knew she had been betrothed to the son of the Li family since childhood. Li Jingtang was as graceful as bamboo and possessed the talent to aid the world, but he was born into a poor household as the only son of a widowed mother. Fortunately, the Yun family provided relief for many years, allowing him to study and become a man of great potential. The two were childhood sweethearts, growing up together without suspicion. What the world praised as a perfect, golden match was severed in a single night. A sudden calamity befell the Yun family, and the entire household was slaughtered. Yun Xian narrowly escaped and sought brief shelter from the Li family, only to be betrayed. She chose to forget her past and focused solely on revenge. After enduring life and death to steal another’s identity, she married the son of her enemy, intending to slaughter everyone in the Xiang Prince's Mansion. To her surprise, on the day of the wedding, she saw her youthful lover serving as a s*ave, lurking within the mansion for her sake. The Heir of Prince Xiang, Wei Fengming, spoke with eyes full of tenderness: "For you, I am willing to cast aside my pride, seeking only that the two of us remain together year after year, day and night." Her childhood lover and her new husband were both sincere, yet she alone held a sharp blade, waiting for her chance to strike.

title: Phryne
summary: Phryne was born the daughter of a long time nanny to the prestigious Duke Grey family. Raised on the same milk, she eventually becomes the lover of Duke Grey himself, but the vast gap in their social status continues to torment her. "I’ll be known only as the Duke’s mistress, won’t I?" Yet what she fears even more is: "One day, I’ll be forgotten." Haunted by the anxiety of inevitable abandonment, Phryne declares that she can no longer continue their relationship, when he finally returns home after a long war.

title: I Have a Ghost Diary
summary: If you had a diary that could predict the future. How would you use it? These words are written on the first page. [Do not open this diary.] [Unless you are mentally prepared for a terrible ending.] These words are written on the second page. At this moment, the black diary with two pages stuck to it is in Chu Jiang's hand. After careful consideration, he finally slowly opened the cover. ...... The world is experiencing a mysterious revival, with strange things and mysterious events happening everywhere. This is a story about a deceased person, it all begins with him obtaining a strange diary.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Horror, Martial Arts, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Sci-fi, Supernatural, Tragedy, Xuanhuan

title: Lord: Make them obey
summary: People’s willingness to submit to power… may far exceed your imagination! As a noble of the Empire, Enan manipulates those around him with psychological tactics, turning beauties into pawns dancing in the palm of his hand. But this “demon” is driven not only by lust—he holds life itself in contempt! To seize greater power, Enan uses his golden finger to hunt for more and more “prey”… He even initiates war after war, all for the sake of becoming the supreme ruler! Under Enan’s domination and subtle coercion, everyone is pushed to commit acts that go against their conscience!

title: Living in a Magical World
summary: A miscast spell summons Lin Qian, a college student from Earth, to a magical world. Is this a mere coincidence, or is there a hidden agenda? What purpose does the prophetic girl who suddenly appears by his side serve? What changes will Lin Qian's arrival bring to this magical world? Follow the protagonist's journey as we gradually unravel the secrets of the magical world and uncover the ultimate mysteries of magic.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Supernatural

title: A Farewell to Mr. Luo
summary: Xia Weiwei had been in love with Luo Chejue for over eight years, and married to him for two. However, instead of a happy marriage, all she got was cruel torture. The man she had loved with her whole heart watched her struggle coldly and caused her the loss of her child… Siting in her wheelchair and forcing a smile at the dark muzzle of the gun, she felt that her heart had been torn to pieces.

title: Fifteen Dusks
summary: This port city is best known for its cruise vacations. The trip lasts fifteen days, with food and lodging all on board—and the second person gets half off. Ruan Xi grabbed a brochure and ran to find Cheng Daichuan. "You’re coming with me. We’ll split the cost." Cheng Daichuan flipped to the last page of the brochure. Fine print next to a star read— The half-price promotion applies only to travelers sharing a double room...

title: The Supreme Toxic Lord of Online Games
summary: The Oracle is a revolutionary game that quietly changed the world when its abilities could be transferred into reality. Is it excitement or fear when the game’s power becomes real? Wu Shaochen, an ordinary office worker, suffers food poisoning after accidentally consuming expired food, but after logging into the game, he unexpectedly gains a special talent, “Source of Deadly Poison,” turning his misfortune into fortune. From that moment on, he embarks on the path to the pinnacle of power.

title: Mage Adam
summary: Living things really are ignorant – the greed to obtain the key to knowledge and the fundamentals of energy overpowers them. Little do they know that knowledge is full of lies and energy is the root of destruction. Us, mages, have mastered travelling through space and time. We are invincible, we can turn worlds into dust and you, mere ants, will be wiped out with no trace. -Mage Adam An A.I.(Artificial Intelligence) gets reincarnated into a world where he becomes a mage.

title: I Thought I Was Dead After Getting Stabbed While Protecting a Girl From a Random Attacker, but a Goddess Gave Me a Special Reward and Brought Me Back to Life in My Original Body—Now, All These Girls Are Coming on to Me!?
summary: After I protected a girl from a random attacker, I started getting popular with girls. Why? Ryu Minase was an ordinary student who was about to become a high schooler. One day, after his middle school graduation ceremony had ended and he had nothing to do, he went out to buy snacks at a nearby convenience store. On his way there, he came across a scene where a man, who looked clearly suspicious, was going wild with a kitchen knife. If he got involved in something like that, it would be serious. So, I tried to quickly leave the place, but then I saw something at the edge of my vision. I saw two girls sitting on the ground. It seemed that they had collapsed from fear and couldn’t move. To make things worse, the man with the knife had locked onto the two girls as his targets. He grinned creepily and began to approach them. There was no way I could ignore something like that after seeing it. I made up my mind and jumped in between the girls and the man. The knif— (to be continued)

title: Blind Date Mix-Up: Hot Wife Marries Military Officer and Ousts Scumbag Father
summary: Gong Linglong endured for ten years to finally avenge her parents, reclaiming everything that belonged to her. Just as she was ready to enjoy life, her soul was mistakenly summoned to the underworld by a soul summoner! Damn it! They got the wrong soul? And she can't go back? She was in the bad mood, she causes a scene in the Hades Palace, argues with the King of Hell, and eventually wins a chance to traverse worlds, seizing some compensation along the way. Starting anew, the original host arranged a blind date to save her mother for a measly two hundred yuan dowry. Is she really going? Oh snap, the blind date is handsome and tall, a promising young military officer who helps her in battles against scum. He deserves full marks! However, she soon realizes there's been a mix-up: What? You're not my blind date? Did I go to the wrong table? Well, since it's a mistake, this man meets her aesthetic standards. She ab*ses the s*um while he hands her the stick. She causes trouble and he cleans up the mess. She scolds and he supports her firmly. He handles the money while she makes a fortune. Such a man is rare in the world; surely the King of Hell sent him specially to make amends, and she must keep him!"
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Found Out About the Red Potion of the Fantasy World Youtuber
summary: The red potion of the maid virtual YouTuber was none other than the imperial princess.

title: Now That I Have the Food Production Skills, I’m Thinking of Starting a Trading Company in a Different World
summary: Ryu, an ordinary office worker, was returning home from his work. On his way of return he was searching for a store to eat dinner. On that day, he decided to have ramen noodles and went inside a stall that he found on the roadside, by chance. However, there wasn’t any food nor any people inside the small stall. Seemingly disappointed, he had no choice but to visit another store on the other side of the street. But when he turned around and came outside, he saw a dense forest around him! Ryu realised that he had been transferred to a different world and had acquired the skill called “Stall”. Initially Ryu was disappointed, as he didn’t get any unrivalled combat skill. Later only he did realise that his cheat skill was ridiculously powerful and can produce “Food”! After exploring the new world and its surroundings Ryu decided to become a merchant and live a leisure life in another world. Interacting with various people and managing merchant associations with friends.

title: When I Pulled It Out, I Became a Pioneer with a Mandragora Partner in a Different World
summary: The story that begins with pulling something out is a common theme throughout history. The objects being pulled out can range from swords, spears, and keys, among others. The protagonist of this story, Kagariya Magari, pulls out something quite unexpected: a mandragora! With a sudden scream and fading consciousness, when Kagariya wakes up, they find themselves in a completely different world. They register with the guild and become pioneers, joining forces with companions to venture into the world of Isminsur, a world dominated by monsters. It's a grand adventure of exploration in an era of great pioneering!

title: Supreme Sword Dominates the World
summary: The Sword Saint’s Blade, Echoing Across the World 『Supreme Sword Dominates the World』 "You... possess a talent that reaches the heavens!" Born under the star of heavenly slaughter, Jin Je-yong carried a tragic fate—yet his martial talent was unmatched through all ages. The world soon came to revere him as the Sword Saint. "I will spread the glory of my master and our sect across the world!" Now begins the grand journey of the man destined to sit atop all sects and clans, the unrivaled sovereign of the martial world!

title: What, the Transition Failed!?……Wait, it was a Success!? (WN)
summary: Poor factory laborer, Todo Yoichi (35 years old, single, working poor) with a certain young man involved in truck incident. Then from the woman who called herself manager, inform him that he just involved in ordinary accident. With a cheat ability they will be reincarnated to sword and magic fantasy world, but unlike the young man, for Yoichi that didn’t have the existence for his reincarnation in that space he will be reconstructed in former body. There is no cheat ability for him but he get [standard skill pack] or something. Yoichi’s [judgment] [infinity storage] [language comprehension] [return] skill that often coming out in light novel. Working poor is want to break free from life that only working for live, while in order to live in another world with hope that begin swelling in his chest, whatever you think this is the former world….

title: The Collapsed Platform
summary: In the seventeenth year of Xianhe, the Cangnu army advanced with overwhelming force! Wind swept their lapels by the surging river, and 137 scholars left blood-written letters, throwing themselves into the river to show their resolve! The Canglang River washed their white robes, shaking the entire realm! General Yue Chong led 70,000 soldiers to defend against the enemy at Changdu River. Outnumbered, they fought to the death, bloody and resolute, ultimately defeating Cangnu. Subsequently, Emperor Xianhe passed away, and Emperor Zhaohua ascended the throne. The world enjoyed peace, and the people lived in harmony. In the twelfth year of Zhaohua, to commemorate the soldiers of Changdu River who sacrificed themselves for justice, Emperor Zhaohua decreed the construction of the Xijin Platform. The Xijin Platform, to celebrate great achievements and honor the realm. On the day the platform was completed, it unexpectedly collapsed, crushing the meritorious officials, master craftsmen, scholars, and common people who were present! That day, heavy rain poured down. Xie Rongyu was trapped beneath the Xijin Platform, yet in his heart, he thought: “That little girl, please, please don’t come...”

title: On – The Whole
summary: There was a war that began from the dawn of time. A story now forgotten by all in the world. It is the story of everything and a story about everything. And it is the story of the forgotten heroes. Part 1 – The Ten-Thousand Year War The Kur-Yaught, a race possessing strength enough to fell a running mammoth. As they were subduing all animals and bringing the world under their control, a new race appeared before them. Bodies that seemed weak, unlike their own robust physiques. And a completely new language. The Kur-Yaughts thought they could easily subdue them, but these beings possessed a completely new power, different from physical ability. Namely, the power of mental force and sorcery. And thus began the ten-thousand-year war. The brutal war between the two races begins now.

title: The Day She Never Asked Me to Get Back Together
summary: On the night of my ex-boyfriend's engagement, he cornered me in a fire escape and asked if I could really watch him marry someone else. Three years after a brutal breakup, buried truths resurface and two stubborn hearts finally choose each other.

title: Sword Art Online – Hopeful Chant
summary: Hopeful Chant (ホープフル・チャント) is an SAO side story written by Kawahara Reki that was distributed as a present to visitors of Sword Art Online The Movie -Ordinal Scale- in Japan in the third week of the official cinema release between March 4 and March 10, 2017. The SS features a background story for Yuna and Eiji, two of the original characters in the movie.

title: That Poor Little Husband Was Raised by a Tiger
summary: He Xunzhou from the modern era died from alcohol poisoning – quite a sensational incident indeed. The system claimed it was an error and offered compensation: a Dimension, Spirit Spring, farming capabilities, and a powerful physique. “I’m a King! Not bad, these terms are tempting.” “Awe-inspiring, everyone must obey me? I’m a King? A prince? Or an emperor?” The result: He Xunzhou: “…” A tiger? A black tiger cub? Damn! The black stripes stood out vividly against its yellow fur like black lightning bolts. Though still a cub, it was already breathtaking enough to suffocate anyone. He Xunzhou stared speechlessly at his reflection in the water – yes, he was that tiger. Awe-inspiring? (Well, it is a tiger) Everyone must obey me? (After all, what animal wouldn’t fear a tiger) You are indeed a King (Right, the tiger – king of the forest, king of all beasts) Was anything wrong? Nothing. “Heh, better not let it appear before him, or I’ll end it.” No matter how good-tempered one is, who could tolerate this? Straight up not human anymore! Please, I want to be human! Liu Shuhuai lived a lonely and miserable first half of his life, but fortunately encountered a soft-hearted deity in his later years who saved him. (This story is set in an alternate world. Please don’t take any illogical elements too seriously. This isn’t the Beast World – the system automatically added this and I can’t change it.)

title: An Old Adventurer Drinking in a Corner of the Guild
summary: I was reincarnated with a cheat. 35 years without achieving anything... I've finally surpassed my previous life's age.

title: Remind Soccer Genius
summary: Song Hyun-jun, a soccer genius who has lived ten lives. He has achieved everything a soccer player can achieve, except one: the World Cup. Now, starting his eleventh and final life, Song Hyun-jun is determined to win the World Cup!
genres: Action, Adventure, Mystery, Slice of Life, Sports, Tragedy

title: The Queen’s Rise to the Top
summary: At the beginning of transmigration, I almost killed my younger brother. If I don't complete the system tasks, I'll be electrically punished. Following the system's instructions, Nantian wen participated in a talent show for trainees. The other girls were singing and dancing... Nantian wen said: "Let me show everyone some brick breaking with bare hands!"
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: My Sister is a Monster
summary: Two cursed sisters. One lonely castle. Two strangers who awaken hope. Astina struggles against the darkness consuming her, and Brillin endures life in a beast’s body, yet for eight years they’ve survived relying on only each other. Then a gentle, silver-haired mage and a bold prince who believes in love at first sight arrive with promises of safety, freedom—and affection neither sister expected. But even love carries shadows, and every heart hides its own secrets. If Astina dares to feel and Brillin dares to dream, they may risk everything they’ve ever held dear.

title: Treasure Hunt Tycoon
summary: They love gold, and they love silver. Even more so, they love gems that dazzle, like stars across the skies. Firearms, jewelleries, and precious metals; A collector’s world will not be complete without antiques. Storage auctions, old goods trade, real-estate sales and gold-digging. But the truth is, if one wants to make money, then the supreme way is through searching for the legendary treasures. Holding the fort, there’s an ocelot, a wolf, and an Andes condor. At the side, there’s a loyal hound, an irascible ape, and an African honey badger. Who said that you can only rely on humans when treasure hunting?!
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: The Rich Second Generation Villain Fights Back
summary: Waking up after a night’s sleep, the down-and-out author Han Yi finds himself transported into the world of his own novel, becoming a genuine rich second generation! He has money, power, and girls, but Han Yi is far from happy! This world is filled with protagonists, and no matter where he goes, he gets humiliated and slapped in the face! "Damn, you're a military king? I just flirted with your girlfriend a bit, and you want to slap my face?" "What the hell, you know medicine and acupuncture? Are you saying I won't live long?" "S**t, you're a panda with a system? And you want to break out of jail?" One protagonist after another screams for revenge, putting immense pressure on Han Yi. Fortunately, he has the God-Level Villain Comeback System. Relying on the system's power and his familiarity with novel tropes, Han Yi starts his journey of counterattack. Han Yi declares dominantly, "What kind of s**t protagonists? I'll take them all down. Your systems are mine, and your girls are mine too!"
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, Xianxia

title: The Joseon Prince Went To America And Didn’t Return
summary: Korean-American second-generation lobbyist 'Park Byung-jun.' Reincarnated into the body of Prince Yi Kang, who studied abroad in the U.S.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mature, Psychological

title: Ex-level Player With the Greatest Civilization of All Time
summary: After the great upheaval in which the Tower appeared, the player became the object of admiration. One day, Kang Seon-woo also awakens as a player. And not just any player, but as an EX-class A-space user. When asked whether he would like to synchronize his previous usage records, he answered yes—and two years passed. Finally, letting out cries of joy, he faces the Transcendent Civilization inside the A-space where the synchronization has completed. “Hello, successor.” Seon-woo, who has become the successor of the Transcendent Civilization, begins his climb of the Tower.

title: Married To The Male Lead’s Paranoid Uncle
summary: When Shi Yin woke up, she found herself transmigrated inside the book. She had become the weak female lead who was ab*sed by the male lead and later committed su*cide while being pregnant. At the dinner table, when the commercial marriage between her and the male lead was being finalized. Shi Yin pointed to the male lead’s uncle, who was terminally ill, and said, “I want to marry Young Uncle Cheng Yuan!” After marrying the male lead’s young uncle, Shi Yin patiently waited for the day when Zhou Cheng Yuan would die and she became single again. But, why was this man getting better and better day by day? Shi Yin said, “Hurry up and die, I wanted to be a widow quickly!” Zhou Cheng Yuan said, “Either you choose to live with me, or you can choose to die with me.” Shi Yin said, “Let’s live together.” When Shi Yin first met Zhou Cheng Yuan, she thought Cheng Yuan was a cold and abstinent tyrant. But, after spending a long time with him, Shi Yin discovered that this guy was actually black-bellied and paranoid. Every time Shi Yiin looked at other men, he would stick to her and with a dissatisfied voice said, “How can Yin Yin look at others?” Every time Shi Yin was bullied and cried by him at night, he would smile and contentedly said, “Yin Yin is crying, I am very happy.”

title: Culinary World: Starting as Reba’s Food Devil
summary: Ye Chen crossed over to a parallel world where culinary fusion was the norm and became Reba's culinary devil! Just as despair set in, he bound a rebate system! As long as Reba consumed various delicacies, he could earn rebate rewards! "Ding, Reba consumes Kaila Giant Crocodile Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining 100,000 culinary cells!" "Ding, Reba consumes Gemstone Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining a special skill - King's Fist!" "Ding, Reba consumes Ma Wang Hercules Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining Gluttony Blood!" ".................." In no time, while others were still exploring the world of culinary delights, Ye Chen, with Reba in tow, had taken off completely! Reba: As long as my culinary devil is with me, I am invincible!
genres: Action, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Rain In Sunny Days
summary: Lan Yaoyang initially appears as the "inviolable noble son" in the media's eyes—reserved, dominant, and highly intelligent, like a dazzling star everyone pursues. A closer look, however, reveals the honest and interesting "Adorable Lan" to Ni Lan; he lays all his affection bare before her, deep and powerful, with immense strength. Ni Lan, before her memory loss, was seen by others as a beautiful but brainless actress, possessing only looks without talent. After losing her memory, she startles everyone; proficient in firearms and combat, she is like a female 'Rakshasa' who has broken free from her chains, sweeping in from the dark night with a fierce storm. He is her sunny day, like a ray of morning light in a warm winter; she is his rainstorm, stirring up huge waves in his calm life. A car accident leaves police officer Guan Fan severely injured and comatose, while actress Ni Lan suffers amnesia and becomes a major suspect. The "Mountain Forest" case enters a stalemate, shrouded in mystery and involving multiple parties. The dark web, informants, international powers, and a perplexing cold case from years ago... all clues related to the truth seem to be hidden within Ni Lan's memory. When a sunny day meets a rainstorm, we are certain to see the brilliant and magnificent rainbow of "justice" in the future.

title: Princess’s Journey: Easing This Life’s Sorrows
summary: In my previous life, as my Imperial Younger Brother and I were being hacked into mincemeat by a flurry of blades, the Imperial Son-in-Law stood outside the bamboo grove, cold and detached, as if he were a mere bystander. In this life, I looked at the handsome gigolo kneeling before me-the same man who had once died while shielding me from a blade-and I couldn’t help but smile. “You’ll do.”
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Fine Food Broadcaster
summary: A poor, down on his luck kitchen hand, Ye Fei was this close to thinking about sleeping with his landlady to avoid paying rent for his shabby little apartment when he was suddenly electrocuted while trying to turn on the lights. Unexpectedly, he did not die. Instead, a strange voice appeared in his head, "Divine Culinary Broadcasting System has successfully bonded with the host." Excuse me, who are you? Why are you living rent-free in my head?! Wait, where did that new laptop come from? Also, a 24-hour unlimited Internet access? "So long as Host performs your task well, the System shall also provide rewards and care packages from time to time.” The f*ck? Tasks? Are they like missions? Hold on, where did those ingredients come from? Whatever, Ye Fei was too hungry to care. Let's just follow the System's instructions for now and hope for the best!

title: You Are My Rare Passion
summary: A moment of vulnerability results in Ye Beibei being manipulated into marrying Young Master Gu, a wheelchair-bound man. Having imagined an idle and prosperous life within an aristocratic family—who knew that she would instead be ens*aved into becoming a young nanny every single day? Ye Beibei smacks the table. "Liar, I want a divorce!" Young Master Gu pushes a cute baby in front of him. "You want a divorce even when we already have a child? Dear Wife, wake up!" "..." Ye Beibei stares in confusion at the adorable baby who looks exactly like her. Can anyone tell her when she gave birth to a child?!

title: Your Highness, If You Act Like This, How Can I Possibly Kill You?
summary: Wherever he went, a storm of blood would rage, And the severed fingers of prisoners piled up like mountains. Contrary to his beautiful features, he was said to be utterly ruthless— The Crown Prince of the Norden Empire, Erich von Norhert. While waging wars for the glory of the empire, What he secretly targeted was none other than his own homeland. The corrupt powers within Norden. In pursuit of a vanished clue, Erich ventured into a rural village in enemy territory. The man he sought had died in vain, Leaving before him only the man's daughter, Yulaina. In the very moment he was about to plunge her into the abyss, He acquired unexpected information, and the situation reversed dramatically... "Indeed, killing you like this would be far too easy." "You'll have to take responsibility for dragging me into this affair. With your death!" Erich took her hand and returned to the empire. All the while plotting a scandal of epic proportions to topple the Norden Empire. "This is my revenge, and at the same time, a national reckoning."
genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Psychological, Romance, Tragedy

title: Fantasy X Hunter
summary: Roaming the starry oceans with time travel, machinery, science, and technology. The aim? Exploring the unknown star oceans!

title: Who Said My Wife Is A Demon!
summary: In a turbulent world, martial arts reign supreme. Yang Shifei, armed with a marriage contract, comes to the door to marry into the family. His wife is as beautiful as a celestial being, their home is filled with wealth and treasures, and she is as calm and gentle as water, always considerate. The maid is as stunning as a peach blossom, yet as cold as ice, possessing extraordinary skills, able to fight and endure. But this seemingly perfect family, praised by everyone in the martial arts world, is plagued by rumors. “Who says my wife is a demon? Stand up and face me!” Yang Shifei shouted, pointing his sword in all directions, his face full of indignation. Meanwhile, the martial arts heroes below can only tremble, on the verge of tears. With his wife's claws hovering over their heads, who would dare to speak out?
genres: Action, Comedy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: The Strongest Stepmother: Farming with Kids, Beautiful and Dashing
summary: Shen Ningsi was originally a Ph.D. from the Agricultural Academy, not only proficient in farming but also skilled in medicine. She was a shining future star of China! Who would have thought that one day she would be transported back to an ancient era where food was so scarce that people resorted to swapping children to eat? And to top it off, she became an instant mother? Shen Ningsi looked at the child in her womb and declared: Don’t panic, don’t panic! Raise the child scientifically, starting with farming! As for the child’s father, well, dead is dead! The supposedly dead child’s father: ? Whatever my wife says goes! If you disagree, bring it on!

title: Farewell from the Future
summary: The boy I loved died in the prime of his life. So, I traveled back twenty years, giving everything I had to bring him even a single glimmer of hope. Gu Zhixian, you probably won’t believe me, but I’m your future wife… Gu Zhixian, the future you is a wonderful, kind-hearted person. Gu Zhixian, we’re going to have a precious child in the future. They’ll have your eyes and my eyebrows. So, please don’t give up on yourself, okay? The boy I loved believed me. As the clock prepares to strike midnight, it’s time for me to go. I’m sorry. I lied to you. I am not your wife. And in our future, we will never meet again.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Divorced and reborn with her ex-husband
summary: "New Next-Door Novel 'The White Moonlight Whose Mother is a Wealthy Tycoon' is Now Live~" Many envy Meng Tingyu because her husband created a miracle, going from rags to riches and becoming worth billions. But no one knows that from the age of 18 to 36, during the 18 years she spent with Xu Chaozong, he became tasteless and unappealing to her, like a discarded chicken wing. After leaving the Civil Affairs Bureau, before Meng Tingyu could celebrate being single again with her girlfriends, an unexpected car accident brought her back 18 years ago, when she had fainted from heatstroke during military training and was lying in the medical room... What terrible news this was!!! The big villa was gone, replaced by a dorm room for four with no air conditioning; The luxury car was gone, replaced by squeezing onto public transportation and questioning life; The never-ending credit card bills were gone, replaced by living on a meager monthly allowance of 1,000 yuan, scrimping and saving every day. In her anger and despair, Meng Tingyu decided to date someone to distract herself, but just as she was holding hands with her potential boyfriend and following him to meet his roommate, Xu Chaozong's cold and sharp gaze made her feel like she was about to be thrown into a gladiator arena. Is there anything scarier than being reborn after a divorce? Yes. Her ex-husband has also been reborn. :) [Cautionary highlights↓] [I have written many sweet 1V1 stories (which I think are still quite sweet), so I want to try writing a gladiator arena story. I don't know if I'll succeed in the end, but I want to try.] [The male lead is arrogant, conceited, and disdainful of others, but I won't change the male lead (this doesn't mean I condone this type of person, as an author I just want to try different characterizations). Please understand.] [The female lead will date other people and have ambiguous relationships with others, so please don't read if you mind!!] [I don't dare to claim that this is a male-versus-male story, but the male lead will have conflicts with other male characters, including but not limited to verbal ab*se, physical fights, and scheming against each other. The main plot won't only revolve around the male and female leads, so please understand and go easy on me.]

title: Reborn as the Head of the Stolen Mage Family
summary: I thought I had achieved everything. Even though I died in an accident, I believed I had no regrets. But my death wasn’t an accident— And everything I accomplished was stolen from me. “Living twice really changes everything.” The second life of Archmage Edmund von Kirhausen, Starting over as an orphan and rebuilding his once-great family!

title: Why Am I Still Cannon Fodder Even Though I Know the Plot?
summary: Zhu Lan transmigrated to another world. Good news: she’d just finished reading the story and knew the plot—she could snatch the male lead’s destined opportunities! Bad news: she tried dozens of times and only succeeded once. (Tragic.) And worse still… the way the male lead was looking at her was getting more and more unsettling! Ye Feng also transmigrated to another world. Bad news: someone kept trying to steal his destined opportunities…

title: Zombie Evolution
summary: Coincidentally, indoorsy-guy Zhang Yang went to the cultivation world, being the lowest level of zombie. By using a manual book named: “ Tai Yin Refining Figures”, Zhang Yang find his own way to success and leaves a “If a zombie knows how to use a manual, nobody can stop it “ legend in the world.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Xianxia

title: Sweet and Seductive! Addicted to Being Spoiled by My Ex-Uncle
summary: [Double sweetness + secret love comes true + marriage first then love + mutual flirting] [Male protagonist waits for an opportunity to get promoted + male second chases his wife to the crematorium] [Pretty lady x powerful father] Pei Yuning, the youngest daughter of the renowned Pei family, has been pampered and adored since childhood. As her wedding day approaches, her fiancé Shang Heng betrays her with a famous actress, becoming a major scandal. Everyone anticipates Pei Yuning's humiliation, but she remains indifferent, choosing to flirt with a distinguished man to lift her spirits. At the wedding banquet, surrounded by family elders, Pei Yuning is stunned to discover that the charming, powerful man she's been flirting with is none other than Shang Heng's uncle! Later, a broken and desperate Shang Heng begs for forgiveness: "Ningning, give me another chance." The man looks down at him with disdain, "You don't understand the rules. She is your elder now, call her Auntie." --- Shang Yanci, the leader of the Sinoer Group, is known for his strictness, uprightness, composure, and an aura of unattainable nobility. Countless people are drawn to him. When news of his marriage to Pei Yuning breaks, the public assumes it's a strategic union driven by mutual interests, predicting inevitable discord. The socialites of Beijing and North yearn for the title of Mrs. Shang, eagerly awaiting their divorce. But what they ultimately witness is Shang Yanci's bold declaration of love. During a financial interview, a reporter asks, "Mr. Shang, rumors persist about your long-held secret crush. Will she affect your current marriage?" Shang Yanci slowly turns his wedding ring, his eyes filled with tenderness, his voice laced with affection, "No, because my wife is my secret crush of many years."

title: The King of Detectives
summary: A strange event leaves Han Yun in a coma, but when he wakes, his mind is a steel trap. He can deduce anything, and with this newfound brilliance, he crushes the competition on Beidu Satellite TV's "Ultimate Brain." His genius catches the eye of the police, who recruit him to crack their toughest cases. Suddenly, he's a star - even landing the lead in "The King of Detectives." But fame can't mask the horrifying truth: Han Yun isn't who he seems. He's a brilliant imposter trapped in a stolen life, haunted by the mystery that changed him forever.

title: The Prime Minister’s White Moonlight
summary: For Han Bi, her reunion with Shen Zhuo began as nothing more than a calculated move. Yet, when the man fell into the meticulously crafted trap she had set, she felt a sense of unreality. If not for unexpected events, Han Bi would have been like any other young lady from an esteemed family with an engagement: marrying Shen Zhuo at the proper age and living a plain, stable life. Unfortunately, life is often imperfect. The Cui family was falsely accused of treason, suffering the calamity of confiscation and exile. Han Bi, like the pomegranate blossoms scattered from the branch, fell into the Jiaofang Division (a government office for entertainment, essentially a courtesan house). Fearing implication, the Shen family distanced themselves from the Cui family after Shen Zhuo left the capital, and the engagement was naturally nullified. Unwilling to accept her fate in the Jiaofang Division, Han Bi went to great lengths to entice the Late Emperor, who took her into the palace. When the Late Emperor was near death, she set her sights on the Crown Prince. Sure enough, during the time she attended to the sick emperor, her calculated flirtations left the Crown Prince obsessively attached to her. After the Crown Prince ascended the throne, he brought Han Bi back from the Buddhist temple and made her a Zhaoyi (a high-ranking concubine). However, the current Han Bi is powerless, without influence or foundation, so she decided to turn her attention to Shen Zhuo, who had recently returned to the capital. She knew this calculation wouldn’t last, but she wondered what his reaction would be when he learned the truth. And when Shen Zhuo finally learned the truth, he pressed her against the desk, gently kissing the corner of her lips. She, who was usually composed, felt the situation spiraling out of control. With deep shadows in his eyes, he murmured, “Does Your Ladyship truly believe that by merely granting me a marriage alliance, you can be rid of me?”
genres: Adult, Comedy, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Shan He Ji
summary: Heaven and Earth, a furnace; Creation, its craftsman. Yin and Yang, the fuel; myriad things, the ore. —The day will come when the flames that forge this world shall be mine.

title: Empire in Progress
summary: Regardless of what country Each country had to fight for the right to exist Let us together to experience that unprecedented war Let us revisit the greatest war in human history, the Second World War .
genres: Action, Fantasy, Historical, Psychological, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Fleeing Famine and Farming The Eldest Sister of a Farming Family Works Hard to Support the Household
summary: This novel does not include any fantasy elements and is not a lighthearted read. The story of fleeing from famine is adapted from real historical records of common people escaping hardship. The female protagonist is only eight years old, so leading her family on the road to survival is extremely difficult very difficult. If you are looking for an easy, satisfying read, please exit now. Don't continue reading, only to later feel uncomfortable with the hardships the main characters face and then leave a bad review. Writing is not easy, so please be kind. In the fourth year of Jing, a great drought struck Jianzhou. The imperial court failed in its disaster relief efforts and ordered the people of Jianzhou to seek food in Lanzhou. A 3,000-mile journey to escape famine, fraught with danger Gu Jin sets out on this uncertain path with her pregnant mother and five-year-old sister. She thought that fleeing famine was already the worst situation possible, but little did she know that war and natural disasters would follow one after another…
genres: Adventure, Drama, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Evolution from Carp to Divine Dragon
summary: The photographer Lin Hao was on a shooting assignment in the ancient city of Lintian when he was attacked and killed by “ET No. 002”. After being reborn, he found himself transformed into a koi living in the Dragon Transformation Pond in the neighboring ancient city. He awakened the Dragon Cultivation System, which promised him a chance to become a true dragon by following the system’s prompts to devour and evolve continuously. ... After Lin Hao died, he was reincarnated as a small carp. Coincidentally, a catastrophe struck Earth, with mutated creatures, ancient behemoths, and indescribable things hidden in the deep sea emerging one after another. Activate the system, devour, evolve, and leap over the dragon gate to transform into a true dragon! On that day, amidst the mysterious descent and the siege of giant beasts, the Hualong Pond shimmered with golden light as a massive black dragon soared into the sky! People exclaimed, "There’s a real dragon in the Hualong Pond!"
genres: Action, Adventure, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: The Cannon Fodder Transmigrates to the 80s, and the Bullet Screen Explodes the Plot by Itself
summary: 16-year-old Wen Zhu suddenly gained the ability to see things called bullet screens, which claimed she was cannon fodder about to be kidnapped by human traffickers, have her organs harvested, and die without a whole corpse. Wen Zhu: Run! I must run, I don't believe it! Just when she thought her situation couldn't get worse, the bullet screens revealed: Her father was a bad element sent down to the countryside for reform, who secretly gave all the family assets to the Protagonist? Her mother was the vicious fake young lady supporting character who framed the true young lady in the true and false young lady scenario? Her eldest brother was the arch-villain who turned evil after having his civil service examination slot stolen? Her second brother was the short-lived military officer fiancé abandoned by the reborn Protagonist? Her third brother was the traitor falsely accused of stealing scientific research achievements? Wen Zhu: ?! Since the whole family were villains, they might as well go all out! Henceforth, their family motto became: Must follow the "Three Obediences and Four Virtues" - Engage in Politics, Join the Army, Engage in Business, Gain Power, Gain Influence, Gain Fame, and Gain Profit! So what if we're villains? We control our own destiny! Cannon fodder villains unite to change their fate, living prosperous and thriving lives. A righteous man approaches, "I'm of pure and upright background, the kind that comes free with no strings attached. Will you take me?"
genres: Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Corpse Worms
summary: I was in a rush to get home that night, so I hailed a taxi. The driver asked me, “What do you do for a living, young lady?” “I’m a fortune teller,” I replied. “Scary accurate, too.” The driver gave a short laugh. “Well then, can you tell mine?” “Sure.” I turned my head and stared intently at his face. He had the features of a truly wicked man.

title: I Only Summon Slime
summary: In a world where Mage Summoners are the elite among elites, revered for their ability to summon powerful vassals to their side and bring glory to their nations, one man has a dream: to summon the rarest of the rare -- a Dragon! There is just one problem. His every attempt at summoning results in Slime, the weakest of the weak. What is an ambitious Mage Summoner to do? Keep trying, of course. He will accept nothing less. ...But what is one to do with all these Slimes?

title: The Legend of the Jade Pendant
summary: The Legend of the Jade Pendant is an ancient mythological story that narrates the adventurous journey of a young warrior in search of the fabled jade pendant. He must overcome various obstacles and challenges, battle against the forces of evil to ensure the power of the jade pendant is not misused. Along his journey, he encounters numerous companions and showcases true heroic qualities through wisdom and courage. This story emphasizes the importance of bravery, friendship, and justice, delivering endless surprises and insights to its readers.

title: Refusing Physical Contact with My Tyrant Husband
summary: On the wedding night with the emperor of a vast empire, notorious as the greatest tyrant of the age— We should have been spending a night filled with excitement, but…Of all times, it happened when we were lying on the same bed. “ Player has entered the original game.’ That’s when I realized this world was actually inside a game. “ Warning! Departure from the original story detected. A penalty will be imposed on the player. Penalty: A condition that causes death upon touching the opposite s*x. If contact with the opposite s*x is not broken within 10 seconds, health will begin to drain.” Not only had I become the protagonist inside that game, but I had also received this absurd penalty, And on top of that, I had to personally kill this tyrant emperor with my own hands!—That was the harsh truth of this world I came to understand. [ Warning! 10 seconds have passed, health is decreasing. To protect the player’s mind, the player will be rendered unconscious as health decreases.] In the end, before I could even spend the first night with my husband, I disgracefully fainted in his arms. If my health runs out from continued contact with the opposite s*x, I will die.Since it has come to this, I decided to endure with sheer stubbornness. So whenever I nearly came into contact with the emperor, I avoided him like he was a bug.But it seems it had the opposite effect. One day, the emperor’s behavior started to change. “…Why do you keep avoiding me, Empress?” A man so busy with state affairs began personally chasing after me. “You’d better not think about running away. If you keep this up, I might just lose my mind.” He even started to become obsessed with me. …Will I be able to kill this man safely before I die?

title: After Dying a Gruesome Death With Her Heart Ripped Out She Was Pampered to the Extreme by the Abstinent Prince
summary: The shrewish woman angrily rebuked, “Li Qinghuan, all the Emperor seeks is immortality, yet you refuse to willingly have your heart ripped out. If it were me, I would gladly risk my life for my brother, even unto death!” Her half‑sister, serene as a chrysanthemum, added, “Eldest sister, as subjects of Great Qi, we must be loyal to the Emperor and love our country. How dare you join forces with the Li family to harm the Emperor? You’ve gone astray!” Her stepfather, a man from humble origins, declared, “As your elder, I must cleanse the house!” She was the Holy Maiden of the Witch Saint Family—respected by all—and possessed a rare seven‑aperture exquisite heart. Yet she ended up with her family wiped out, her heart torn from her chest, and her body mutilated beyond recognition. Even without a heart, she would seek revenge and drag every one of them to hell. But why, when she approached Night King Xiao Jiusi, did she feel a sharp pain in her chest… and an overwhelming urge to draw closer? That ruthless man, who had lived a life of decisive killing, was clearly her mortal enemy from a past life. Xiao Jiusi presented the items with both hands. “Do you know that it was I who watered you with my heart’s blood every day, allowing you to be brought back to life?” “Li Qinghuan, you must repay me with your whole life.”
genres: Fantasy, Historical, Mature, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: The Tale of the Death of a Cockroach
summary: The Life Story of a c*ckroach. Cockroaches shall prevail against humanity one day.

title: Hades’s Cub, Three and a Half Years Old
summary: "Hades's Cub, Three and a Half Years Old" The leader of the Huo family, the largest family in China, adopted a naughty dumpling child. She had a quirky and cute personality. During the day, she slept soundly and at night, she was energized! Everyone wonders if this is the reincarnation of a night owl? Ming Baby: I am just suffering from jet lag. The residents of the underworld live day and night after all! Daddy: My child may sleep whenever she pleases! The heir to the psychic family: Would you be interested in taking a trip to the underworld with baby Ming? Would you like to learn about the afterlife in advance? Hades: Welcome to my world! ...

title: I’ll Give my Ex-Husband to my younger sister
summary: “Both sisters offering themselves for my sake… the House of House of Lates is truly loyal.” She had lived her life as a model Crown Princess. Yet the only reward she received was her husband’s betrayal—he had taken up with her half-sister—and a miserable death. “I have no need for a child between us, Annabella.” She could endure everything else.
