But… she could never forgive the loss of her child. She would trust no one ever again. After miraculously returning to the past, she swore it—and tried to change her fate. “Take my hand. Then I’ll avenge your share as well.” Just who was that man? That arrogant man who stirred her heart into such chaos. “Ah, do you wish to run away?” A man who carried a dangerous scent she had never encountered before. “It’s useless. I have no intention of letting go of anything—not the Empire, and not you.” By the time she sensed the danger and tried to escape, she had already fallen to him.

title: The Iceblade Magician Rules Over the World
summary: Arnold Academy of Magic, a prestigious academy that has produced many great magicians. A boy, Ray White, decided to attend there as the only magician from an ordinary family to enter since the Academy began. Surrounding him are all students from aristocrat and magician families that disdain him. But people don’t know. He is a person who has made many achievements in the former Far East battle, and is now said to be the strongest among the seven great magicians in the world. Despite being disregarded as a magician, he eventually shows his power to the surroundings…!?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Romance, School Life

title: Earth Era
summary: Since the first written words appeared in human civilization, great human civilizations have been born and developed brilliant cultures. But this universe was not born for humans, and human civilization is destined to encounter one challenge after another and face one crisis after another.

title: Drunk Night
summary: “You need not hesitate.” The provocative words, spoken with a noble and composed expression, lit the fuse. As the lamp toppled and darkness spread across the room, Danseol’s body was pushed down onto the floor. “I came here tonight to be offered to Your Majesty, after all.” Despite the turmoil in her heart, Danseol spoke in a calm, detached voice. Now was the time to break the man’s guard—for the sake of revenge, for her parents and her homeland. Taking advantage of the moment his vigilance faltered, Danseol reached for the hairpin in her hair. Her plan was simple: plunge it into the neck of Lee Gyeom—the Emperor of Hwangseon, the man who had mercilessly crushed everything she held dear—and take her revenge. Just as she aimed the hairpin at his nape— ‘Why is that mark on his body…?’ Danseol’s face froze in shock as her eyes fell upon the plum blossom mark engraved just beneath the Emperor’s collarbone. “Why do you look so surprised? As if you never imagined I’d be the one to take you tonight.” Unbeknownst to her, the same plum blossom mark was etched into her own skin. Fate had already decided—Danseol was destined to be the Emperor’s consort.

title: The Mismatched Brides
summary: After falling into the water, my elder sister by the primary wife underwent a drastic change in personality. She threw a massive tantrum, rolling on the ground and demanding to break off her engagement with the Prince's manor. Then, she fled in the middle of the night to a remote mountain village. There, she entered into an illicit, unceremonious union with a scholar so poor he could barely keep food on the table. The entire family thought she had gone mad. Only I knew the truth: she had been reborn. Unfortunately, it seemed she had chosen the wrong person to pursue...

title: The Lazy Dragon Is Working Hard
summary: A high school student was run over by a truck and couldn't escape death. Ichiro thought that he was dead, in truth, he had been reincarnated into a different world called Gaia. He became one of seven divine guardians. Tough body, strong abilites, makes him excited. "I will spend my day lazily! Yeah!". However as a guardian he has lots of things to do. Today, the lazy dragon will be trying to protect the peace of the world again. Protecting the world peace so he can take an afternoon nap and spend his days lazily.

title: I Reincarnated into Another World with Zero Magic Power, So I Trained My Swordsmanship for 1000 Years ~The World’s Strongest, Who Believes He’s a Lowly Swordsman, Unconsciously Makes Enemies Tremble~
summary: The protagonist, Yuuri Izumi, one day loses his life due to a certain event and undergoes reincarnation in another world. However, according to the goddess, Yuuri’s magic power is zero. She is told that he is too fragile to survive in the other world. Therefore, before reincarnating into the other world, Yuuri decides to receive time for training. But, due to a mistake by the goddess, he ends up training for 1000 years, even though he was supposed to train until he became a lowly swordsman. Yuuri becomes the world’s strongest after 1000 years of training. But he mistakenly believes that he has finally become a lowly swordsman and sets off on a journey to the other world. There, Yuuri mistakes a Fenrir for mere dog. Mistakes the strongest dragon for a mere bird and instantaneously defeats it, and discreetly saves a S-rank party of beautiful girls renowned throughout the country. This is a story of the strongest swordsman without magic power, engaging in unconsciously overwhelming battles.

title: Farming and Becoming a Deity in Another World
summary: This is Faerûn. A world where countless intelligent races blossom with the flower of life, and humanity is but a newly risen branch. Elves, dwarves, gnomes, halflings, sea elves, and merfolk all hold fast to their isolated city-states. The wilderness is filled with tribes of various monsters: goblins, hobgoblins, orcs, gnolls, kobolds, and Shark-like Fishmen. For survival, for the continuation of their race, every intelligent species manages its affairs with caution. The Feywild, Shadowfell, Ethereal Plane, and Astral Plane—numerous planes are entangled with the Material Plane, difficult to distinguish from one another. In their Divine Kingdoms, the gods scheme and feud for the sake of faith, using all living beings as their pawns. Devils and demons whisper in the Hell Abyss, coveting the souls of the mortal world. Ancient Evils are imprisoned and dormant, awaiting the world's descent into a new round of chaos. The Giant Empire still echoes across this ancient land. The Dragon Shadow still looms over the skies of this world. Gavin, a legendary warrior reborn, has become a Fate Reshaper. Caught between powerful forces, he must use his foreknowledge to forge a new path, advance step by step, carve out his own future, and avert the tragedy that would tear the entire world asunder. Gavin will embark on a different kind of farming journey. Kobolds will mine for him, fey will farm for him, and giants will charge into battle for him—Magical Farming is the ultimate path to supremacy. ... This is a lord-style Magical Farming novel with a slower pace. Please be patient and show your support. A great deal of reference material has been prepared, the writing speed is fast, the backlog of chapters is large, and the author's integrity is guaranteed.

title: After the Hero Broke the Engagement With Me, the Village Girl, I Became an Amateur Tamer, but I Can Tame People Too!
summary: It’s been 3 years since I promised to marry the brave hero. But hero, who defeated the demon king and saved the world, after returning didn’t remember the village girl Setsuna at all. “Good Luck!” She shouted, before fleeing from the scene. Setuna, who was basically a girl with no common sense, planned to quit her job of farmer girl of village and switch to her dream job … a tamer! But … On the field in the application form, she chose “captives trainer”. She jokingly tried out her skills on her childhood friend, the guild’s receptionist, Lilim, and to her surprise, it was a success! She looked disconcerted at Lilim, who started calling her by her nickname. “It isn’t a hobby!” This is the story of a village girl who has a power that can brought even the heroes (and friends) to their knees.

title: Getting Stronger by Simping, Too Many Fairies to Handle!
summary: Qin Mu transmigrated into a fantasy world and was forced into labor by the Saintess Sect. Just as he was about to save enough money to buy his freedom and leave, he awakened the Strongest Simp System: as long as he flatters women stronger than him, his strength will increase. Qin Mu swore secretly that he would simp his way through the entire Saintess Sect! Senior Sister: “Little Mu Mu, didn’t you say you loved me so much you couldn’t live without me?” Qin Mu: “Sorry, I already have the Sect Master now.” Sect Master: “Qin Mu, from this day on, you belong to me alone!” Qin Mu: “I can flatter you, but not just you!” Getting stronger by simping… it feels a little too good…
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Eternal Life
summary: The mortal body, metamorphosis, longevity, immortality, and eternal life. These five realms, step by step, reveal themselves in front of you. As a normal person, how can one try step by step to reach and open the door to eternal life? Between the heaven and the earth lies the mortal body, the mysteries of metamorphosis, freedom of longevity, the power of immortality, and the hope of eternal life. A story filled with endless new magic, a new world of immortal styles, people, demons, gods, fairies, magic, kings and emperors. A world of love and hatred, revenge, and mystical battle, all in “Eternal Life.”

title: Sunsets Glow Red
summary: — I translated this novel as a tribute to the amazing novelist “Qiong Yao” by Hellowyellow. In 1986, the novel was adapted into a Taiwanese romantic drama called Many Enchanting Nights. The drama was directed by Liu Lili and also starred famous Hong Kong actress Liu Xue Hua, Taiwanese actor Chin Han, and Lee Tien Chu. Hellowyellow comment about the story: 5-10 out of 100 people must have experienced something like this. Maybe everyone who has experienced it has almost the same story framework, even though not all the details are the same… When old wounds are almost healed by time, life gives a test by sending acid rain on the wounds, which ultimately destroys faith and belief… When the body can no longer withstand the torture, the heart becomes cold and dead, hopes and dreams are destroyed by the cruelty of reality… Then, where should this self go?? To whom should this heart complain? And to whom is this hope anchored? —- Cruel?? regret? sad? hate?? ... Sigh, but life is always like that.
genres: Completed, Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Search for Treasure Worldwide
summary: Zhang Jing, who has just been dumped by his materialistic girlfriend, arrives in the Beautiful Country with a treasure-hunting system in hand. Ancient coins buried deep underground, precious antiques underwater in parks, treasure troves and relics inaccessible to others... All reveal themselves before Zhang Jing's eyes! Balancing treasure hunting with helping people, from a bankrupt heiress to a film and television superstar harboring dreams of being a butler, from a genius singer cleaning houses to a heavyweight boxer buried under obesity, from a young genius orphaned by his parents... It all begins in the Beautiful Country, treasure hunting across the world!

title: Temperature Control in Academy City
summary: “I’m just a useless person; I’m better off going back to the dormitory and reading manga.” Natsume Sonoko, a student council officer at Tokiwadai, secretary of the Joint Student Council of the Five Schools, permanent vice president of the District 7 Coordinating Student Council, and honorary president of the Academy City General Student Council, stared blankly at her bare luxury desk.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, School Life, Sci-fi, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: A Professor of Magic at Hogwarts
summary: Three years after graduating from Hogwarts, Felix entered the school again, only this time as a professor! What kind of sparks will come from the combination of Muggle wisdom and magic?
genres: Adventure, Martial Arts, Mystery, School Life, Sports, Supernatural

title: Engagement Mansion
summary: Her boyfriend is getting married—to a rich woman. Betrayed by her longtime lover, Seung-ah moves into a mansion. But the mansion’s owner, Han Yujin, is no ordinary man. “I thought you’d look beautiful even when you cry.” “I’m not that weak.” “No, I mean… under me.” He makes a dangerously tempting proposal: “The role is my fiancée. The duration: one year. The reward: this house.” Though shaken by the luxurious mansion, Seung-ah soon finds herself being drawn to Yujin. “I’ll seduce you every chance I get. Because I need you.” A one-of-a-kind “Get My Own Home” project! But… is this contract really okay?Excerpt Yujin set down his half-finished glass of wine. His straight, pale fingers reached toward Seung-ah’s cheek. “I’m confident I can kiss better than Kim Tae-jun.” “Are we even in that kind of relationship…? What do we even know about each other?” “That’s why it’s more thrilling, isn’t it?” He leaned in—gentle yet without hesitation.

title: The Fourth Miss of the Xie Family
summary: I was leaning down to help a beggar boy curled up in the corner of the street when several lines of vermilion text suddenly flashed before my eyes: [Young Miss, don't save him!] [He's a total ungrateful wolf! He's only getting close to you so he can trick you out of your money to save his childhood sweetheart!] [Sigh, this male lead... he clearly relies on the Young Miss to rise in the world, yet in the end, he returns her kindness with enmity and breaks her heart.] Is that so... I paused for a moment, looking flatly at the youth before me. Then, I spoke softly, "Are you here to save someone's life?" "In that case, I shall give you a bit more silver."

title: Battle Royale
summary: Koushun Takami's notorious high-octane thriller envisions a nightmare scenario: a class of junior high school students is taken to a deserted island where, as part of a ruthless authoritarian program, they are provided arms and forced to kill until only one survivor is left standing. Criticized as violet exploitation when first published in Japan—where it became a runaway best seller—Battle Royale is a Lord of the Flies for the 21st century, a potent allegory of what it means to be young and (barely) alive in a dog-eat-dog world.

title: The Supreme Immortal Across All Realms
summary: A single thought disrupts Yin and Yang—all laws yield! A finger's snap withers countless bones—blood dyes the heavens ninefold! He treads the void, fists shaking the starry river—realms quake at his passing! He shatters eternity, his blade severs rebirth—before the Great Dao, "I reign supreme!" "This cosmos cannot contain me!" "Across all existence, my name alone commands reverence!" From obscurity he rose, an indomitable force crushing all opposition! Be it peerless geniuses or primordial sovereigns—before him, they crumble like dust! Striding beyond the firmament, breaking the cycle of samsara—all paths turn to oblivion! Conquering the highest heavens, subduing the mortal realms—ten thousand worlds kneel! This era shall bear witness— What is true dominance! What is absolute supremacy! What it means to be the Supreme Immortal Across All Realms! (Ultimate invincibility, merciless resolve, an unstoppable ascent!)
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Confronting the Poison Lotus
summary: The so-called poison lotus flower can be pure and kind, or it can be ruthless and poisonous, domineering yet indifferent. It's whiter than white lotus in front of the white lotus and more malicious than the evil woman in front of her. Adaptable and charming, loved by everyone. She would rather offend the world than let the world offend her. A good man, she must have had, anyone who doesn’t let her have him is tr*sh. Towards other women, she always appears warm on the surface, but deep down, she carries deep-seated resentment. She sees herself as innocent and pitiful, yet she remains strong in the face of adversity, seeking revenge. She believes it's justified to retaliate against those who hurt her, but it's unacceptable for others to harm her. Any woman who is more beautiful, has a higher status, or is more talented than her, and any man who looks down on her or ignores her, deserves no mercy. Li Xia only knows that her father's new family has a white lotus as a mistress, but she doesn't know there's also a daughter of a poison lotus flower. Reborn into this life, Li Xia wants to stay away from the poison lotus, cherish life, and her life goal is to manage her deceased mother's business and take care of her comatose sister's son. Unfortunately, there are many despicable people and despicable things in the world, so let's confront them.

title: Scouted by the Ghost City
summary: “Wait, where exactly am I right now?” One day, after an unexpected accident, Sena is pulled into a city of ghosts. As if suddenly dropping into a strange place weren’t shocking enough, she soon becomes the target of all kinds of bizarre beings and even ends up entangled with two mysterious men. But after one frantic, dangerous night, she opens her eyes again… and finds herself back in the ordinary Seoul she knows. Sena decides to dismiss everything that happened in the ghost city as nothing more than a nightmare. However, for some reason, that “nightmare” begins creeping into reality, shaking up the peaceful routine of her daily life. And even those two unknown men start appearing. “Ms. Myung Sena, we’d like you to join our headquarters as an official member.” “So? Want to come with me instead?” …Ugh. I don’t want either of you.

title: Queen Mother is a Scientist
summary: She forgot who she was, but she remembered the knowledge of science and technology from a different time and space. Her personality is delicate and gentle, but she holds the most fierce and vicious guns and knives in her hands! Once she passes through the chaos, she becomes the beloved person of the countries. The General finally marries her into the family after a lot of hard work. She tactfully used weapons as her dowry, yet this man pampered her all the way. Looking back many years later, she suddenly realised that she already had become the Empress Dowager...

title: The Hero Has Returned
summary: The boy who dreamed of being a hero has returned. From his days of poverty, carrying the money he saved over a lifetime.

title: Listen, Flowers Bloom
summary: After announcing his marriage at a concert, the top-tier singer suddenly broke down in tears. It was because he had just received news of my death. Zhou Yan. We met at six and said our goodbyes at twenty-four. I never had the courage to tell you that I truly, deeply loved you.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Juuhime
summary: Delve into an epic fantasy alongside Ambrosia, Cedric and Elwing as they quest for the ultimate weapon in a magical world ravaged by war! Long ago, mankind's foolishness angered the gods and they were stripped of their magical abilities. Unwilling to accept this loss, however, humans discovered a way to seal magic into bullets. They regained their powers... and the world was again plunged into an era of war and chaos. Now, amid the turmoil, a youth called Cedric, his sister Elwing and their companion Ambrosia set out on a journey to recover the "Gun Princess," a weapon powerful enough to change the destiny of the entire world.

title: My Wife Doesn’t Want Me Anymore
summary: My wife suddenly wanted to check my phone. I wasn't nervous at all. Until she sent a message in the Brothers Group. "Guys, guess which girl I'm with right now?"

title: The Unique Skill “Territory” Overturns the Common Sense of Another World! I Really Don’t Want to Stand Out, but Thanks to My 10× Experience-Gain Skill, My Growth Speed Is off the Charts!
summary: What if someone who was born without talent in their previous life were to acquire a gift that only one person in the world could possess? Masaki is a middle-aged office worker who has been whisked away to a fantasy realm. In his former life he wasn’t blessed with any special abilities, but here he awakens a singular skill called “Territory.” He gradually realizes that this power is literally one-of-a-kind on Earth, and he begins to reevaluate the potential he’d long since abandoned in his last life. All the while, Masaki hides this extraordinary talent with every ounce of effort, desperate to maintain an ordinary existence. What does the future hold for him, and what outcome does Masaki truly desire?

title: I Became an In-game NPC
summary: 21st century kid got onto a virtual game 600 years into the future, with a freak combination of events gets to play as a NPC! The first system job is to undertake the roles of helping new players create their character. Want to choose as one of the hidden race? OK, this is a s*avery contract, up to you to sign it or not! Entering the game as a player and creating a personal game character, the only advantage I have… The choice of selecting a powerful race! Walking alone to the peak, bringing the present world to advance by leaps and bounds, the abnormal path starts from this first step!

title: I Am the Only One Beside the Fallen Grand Duke’s Daughter
summary: I was dying in the cold when the Grand Duke’s daughter saved me. But this lady... she's destined for a cruel downfall. So what choice do I have but to save her?

title: I Became a Hero Traveling with the Mischievous Saintess
summary: [Clumsy♡ To get hurt like this again… Your skills are still as foolish as ever~] …Why are you acting like this?

title: The Rich Family’s Sister-in-Law
summary: Six years after our marriage, Fu Jingchuan grew tired of me and wanted to separate for a while to recapture the feeling of first love. He went after my junior from university, and I went after his friend. After saying goodnight to each other on the phone, we ran into each other at the hotel. "I was just dropping my junior off at her hotel. She drank too much-I couldn't just leave her alone." Just as I was struggling to find an excuse, I pointed to his friend beside me: "He's drunk too. After all, he's your buddy. I couldn't just leave him on the street." The air froze for a moment before his friend broke the silence: "Why don't the four of us split a room? We might even get a discount." Fu Jingchuan's face turned green with anger. Three months later, he broke things off with the junior and said he wanted to come back to the family and have a child with me. But it was his friend who answered the phone: "He can't break things off here-she just got pregnant a few hours ago."

title: Daomu Biji: The Mystic Nine
summary: During the Republic Era, the town of Changsha was guarded by nine families known as the “Old Nine Gates” (or the “Mystic Nine”). They were incredibly powerful families who wielded supreme power over everything in Changsha. In 1933, a mysterious train pulled into Changsha station. The leader of the Nine Gates, Zhang Qishan, was also the army commander of Changsha station and started to investigate with Qi Tiezui. They discovered a highly suspicious mine just outside of Changsha.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Supernatural

title: Hidden Desire
summary: A year after losing Justin, Flora secretly works in a nightclub, pretending to be a tutor to appease her mother. Her world is shaken when she discovers Justin is alive. As they reconnect, Flora grapples with revealing her double life and her tumultuous relationship with a possessive CEO. In this gripping tale, Flora navigates love, loss, and the consequences of her darkest secrets.

title: When I Started a Food Delivery Part-Time Job, I Ended up Being Invited to the Home of a Gloomy, Clumsy Beautiful Girl
summary: The Food Delivery Destination Was the House of a Gluttonous, Clumsy, Gloomy Silver-Haired Beautiful Girl!? Yuki Aizawa, a first-year high school student, started a food delivery part-time job “Uber Meats” to earn tuition and living expenses. One day, the delivery destination he visited was, unbelievably, the house of Hiyori Yukishiro, the most beautiful girl in the grade who also worked as a magazine model. The secret of Hiyori that he learned by visiting. The true face of Hiyori, who looked perfect at school, was that she was a clumsy girl hopeless at cooking and housework, and on top of that, she was a big eater!? From this day onward, through the nomination system of food delivery, Hiyori started nominating Yuki many times. At first Yuki was confused, but as he repeated the deliveries, the two gradually came to understand each other. The time alone together in the room, the seasonal events, and the small invitations…… Through daily happenings, the clumsy gloomy beautiful girl in loneliness and the boy who left home drew a little closer in their awkward and bittersweet distance——.

title: There’s Fraud in the Cultivation World–Who’s Going to Stop It
summary: A newly inducted disciple rushed in, panicked. “Sect Master, this is bad! Eldest Senior Brother is robbing people!” “Why are you making a fuss? Your Eldest Senior Brother is securing benefits for the sect.” “Eldest Senior Brother is kidnapping people for ransom!” “I already told you, he’s securing benefits for the sect.” “But… Eldest Senior Brother has fallen to demonic cultivation! Shouldn’t someone stop him?” “Congratulations. His cultivation has finally improved.” “But… Eldest Senior Brother has even killed someone!” “Then what are you standing around for? Go help him! Disciples of the sect, grab your weapons!”
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Rebirth Before the Return of Spiritual Energy, Investing in the Future Empress!
summary: Before the return of spiritual energy and the awakening of all races, Ye Xuan died on the battlefield and unexpectedly returned to twenty years ago. At this moment, before the returned of spiritual energy, the future lofty Red Lotus Empress was still just a simple and helpless little girl. Ye Xuan seized the opportunity, deceiving the yet-to-awaken school beauty and deskmate Empress to become his wife, holding her in the palm of his hand, spoiling her to the skies! A month later, when the spiritual energy returned, the school beauty awakened an SSS-class talent, skyrocketing to fame! Passerby: You have SSS-grade talent, Ye Xuan is not worthy of you! Red Lotus Empress: Get lost! Ye Xuan is my man, whoever touches him dies!
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, School Life, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Fei Ke’s Banquet
summary: The Chinese Version of Agatha Christie’s And Then There Were None: The best Suspense comes from reality, hidden in the human heart. Luo Jia’s latest urban Suspense Masterpiece. Lies and truths are intricately woven into a meticulous web. A banquet where “no one survives”—this is a “the Talented Mr. Ripley”-style story. Faced with desire, human nature is laid bare. A mysterious banquet invitation brings six strangers, who seemingly have no connection, together in a lakeside villa. Yet, the host of the dinner party never appears. As the plot unfolds, memories and reality intertwine, gradually revealing hidden connections between them. It turns out they all share one thing in common: they have been deceived by the host. A series of stories, filled with desire and betrayal, temptation and melancholy, sketches out the bittersweet life of a man. However, even the kindest person harbours a sliver of selfishness, and even the most evil may have fleeting moments of goodness. The truth, perhaps, lies in the stories that remain untold. This novel has been adapted into a drama called Regeneration (2024), starring Jin Bo Ran.

title: Create a BUG Every Ten Hours
summary: I missed the game helmet and dropped a golden finger! Su Bai has an extra progress bar that no one can see, and he can create a bug every 10 hours! For the first BUG, ​​Su Bai entered the game more than ten hours ahead of the global players! After all the players enter the game, Su Bai has reached the upper limit of the Novice Village level and is still fully equipped! Just in time, the time is up, and we can create BUG again! This time, Su Baika entered the village chief’s house. Because there was something in it that made Su Bai very concerned. Emmmmm… Su Bai never expected that when this card entered, he was actually given by a goddess…
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Sci-fi

title: The God of Cooking Has Arrived
summary: Jang Hyun-gyu was living an ordinary and boring life. One day, a god appeared before him. Connecting to the “God of Cooking” system! A god? Sure… but the God of Cooking? “This taste… what on earth did you do?!” My cooking is just too delicious. My skills are improving day by day. Cooking… is starting to become fun.

title: The Serpent’s Bride
summary: At the palace banquet, I was bestowed the title of Princess. I was to be sent to Western Shu for a political marriage. My future husband is the King of Western Shu, and his people possess human bodies with a snake tail.

title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
summary: Long ago, the Gurongi Tribe terrorized the Linto until a warrior named Kuuga appeared and defeated the Gurongi, sealing their leader within a cave. In present day, a multi-talented man named Yusuke Godai finds himself linked to the mysterious stoned belt that was found within the excavated cave as the Gurongi are resurrected and resume their mu*derous game on the descendants of the Linto, humanity itself. It is up to Yusuke, along with the assembled Science Police, to use the various powers of Kuuga in order to stop and defeat the Gurongi Tribesmen from their continuous killing and ensure the happiness of others. However, as the endgame draws near, Yusuke learns that there is a horrible revelation behind Kuuga and the Gurongis' leader.

title: I Broke Up with My Girlfriend — Don’t Look Down on Me Just Because I’m Poor
summary: [Spiritual Energy Revival + Level-Up + Multiverse Travel + Single Female Lead, No Harem] In a world where spiritual energy has revived, Su Mo, who swore never to live off his monstrous girlfriend again, has just broken up. Then… [Ding! you stepped on an ant and leveled up.] [Ding! you swung your sword ten thousand times and leveled up.] [Ding! you received guidance from a master and leveled up.] …Leveling up is fine, but why does it come with reincarnation travel? And in every reincarnation world, I need to win over the Empress to return? What? That Empress is actually my girlfriend? And why does the Empress in every reincarnation world look exactly like my girlfriend? It turns out that no matter which world, an extraordinary monster like her…
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Martial Arts, Mature, Mecha, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Outside of Gwang-eumji
summary: A world devastated by the breath of the divine, the foreign substance. When the foreign substance reaches a certain level, people die. Heo Chan survives this devastated world, relying on an iron skewer. A devastated world, a devastated heart, a devastated future. One day, as he struggles through this miserable existence, Heo Chan discovers an amethyst. The amethyst possesses the power to absorb the foreign substance, and with this power, Heo Chan not only prolongs his life but also gains a foothold to become even stronger. Meanwhile, "janitors" appear before Heo Chan. The leader of the janitors invites Heo Chan to follow him. Where will Heo Chan's fate lead? Original title: 光阴之外 Author: Lee Geun Translator: Han Tae-jeong

title: Seducing Him
summary: “Lu Jin is like a dirty, unshakable dog that only knows how to go crazy.” This is the sentence Ci Yiyang has said the most. Shortly after her mother’s funeral, her father brought home a woman—and a beautiful, aloof boy—and said to her: “This is Lu Jin. He will be your… younger brother.” Ci Yiyang didn’t call out. She only stared coldly and viciously at Lu Jin. But Lu Jin smiled at her, his tone calm yet corrupt, carrying a faint lingering affection: “Sis, my name is Lu Jin. Your… younger brother in the future.” Later, she realized that “in the future” meant the real future. The two people she most despises are the ones trying to enter her life. She cannot bear another woman occupying everything that belonged to her mother. So she decides to seduce Lu Jin.

title: Shaping Tomorrow’s Light
summary: After my mother died, my father brought home an illegitimate daughter. She greeted us with a facade of sweetness, yet in her hand, she carried the very mangoes that had triggered my mother's fatal allergy. I caught my younger brother's eye behind me. Shedding his usual cynical smirk, he signaled back: I don't need you to tell me.

title: Song Tan’s Chronicle
summary: After returning from the cultivation world, I went back to my hometown to farm, live-stream, and sell vegetables! Having failed to transcend tribulation and attain the Golden Core, Song Tan returned to the modern world only to find herself at the scene of a multiple car accident. Saved by a kind stranger, she narrowly escaped death. What more was there to consider? She decided not to be a corporate s*ave and went back home to farm instead! Utilizing her cultivation experience, Song Tan created an idyllic pastoral landscape—harvesting wild vegetables, cooking country meals, picking cucumbers, live streaming, and selling rare mountain delicacies... [True farming, the real deal] [There's a male lead, but his role is limited]
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Master of Gods, Origin of All, Lord of Realms: The Primordial Snake
summary: Once, at the edge of the world, someone gazed upon me with reverence and called me the World-Encircling Snake—Jörmungandr. Once, at the end of the Underworld, my silhouette was seen, and I was named the Ancient Snake—Satan. The gods themselves once trembled before me, giving me the title of the Hundred-Headed Dragon—Typhon. I have borne many names: the Snake of Creation, the Snake of Sacrifice, the Snake of Rituals, the Serpent of Mortals... But when I crossed the chaos and stepped into the boundless wilderness, I had only one divine name—the Primordial Ancient Snake, the Origin of All Things.

title: Three Lines of Love Letter
summary: After her first film was released, Jiang Qitang became famous and won the Best New Artist award in four major Film Awards. A period of glory where she was known as “The Violet Star of the Entertainment Industry.” But after a year, the industry no longer saw her figure. There were a lot of opinions and discussions but the people concerned did not respond. The chaos in the entertainment industry gradually became more fascinating and just as people were accepting the fact that Jiang Qitang had retired, on the first day of the New Year, a new movie was released, breaking various box office records in one swoop, and it was in the limelight for a while. Fans jokingly said: “Well, your Violet star is back.” In June of the same year, someone uploaded a photo of lovers kissing in the shade of a tree in the background of Jianning City, the address of the new movie shooting. The eagle-eyed netizens found that this is not Jiang Qitang and Jiang Huai Zhou! Jiang Huaizhou, a top-tier actor who became famous at a young age, aloof and remote, and uncompromising, completed a grand slam two years after his debut, becoming the youngest actor with countless fans. After the relationship was exposed, the social platform completely collapsed. Later, during a live interview, the media finally had the opportunity to ask about the relationship. After the media said the name Jiang Qitang, the corners of Jiang Huai Zhou’s mouth gradually rose and his cold eyes were tinged with tenderness. During a live broadcast, Jiang Qitang’s Weibo account was exposed, and the people who ate melons looked for the code ID, and they were stunned for a while. -I’ve been crushing on the sugar for so long, only to find out they were my own sugar! -The CP fans are crying, my CP was so real! -It turns out the blogger is Jiang Qitang! sob sob sob, so every sugar I’ve crushed on was actually mine sob sob sob now that the love affair has been exposed, I’m no longer a CP fan but now I am sobbing uncontrollably because of my obsession!” – Double Violet Star CP, perfect match!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Transmigrated into the ’70s as a Delicate Beauty
summary: This is a romance novel, not a strong-female-lead story! It’s sweet and pampering! Please read the tags carefully before entering! If you want a strong female lead, leave quickly! (No matter the original host or the female lead, they are the same person!!!) Wen Qinghe, who held an enormous fortune in her hands, got drunk after a breakup and woke up to find herself transmigrated into the 1970s. She became a pitiful little thing with cong**ital heart disease, forced to go to the countryside. Just when she lamented that she still had so much money left unspent, sighing over her ill-fated destiny, she discovered that on the fifteenth of every month, she could return? Well then, that’s perfect! She had space, and once a month she could go on a grand shopping spree. Others were afraid of her sickness and unwilling to share a room with her? But unexpectedly, that was exactly what she wanted. When others bent their backs over the fields facing the yellow earth, she stayed at the educated youth spot to rest because of her frailty. Milk tea to her heart’s content, fried chicken in abundance, movies to pass the time… It was just that this weak little body of hers wasn’t very reliable… … The rough man in the village set his eyes on the newly arrived sickly little educated youth. Can’t do farm work? He’ll do it. Too frail? Then he’ll play the role of a snail prince, taking care of all the housework. But it was precisely this weak little body that kept the man worried day and night, his eyes reddened with concern. Such a dazzling pearl should not bloom only briefly, fading into obscurity in this world. He spent great sums of money and effort searching for famous doctors for the little girl. Yet before he realized it, her illness had somehow healed on its own. The man’s gaze turned deep, “Qingqing, you ought to let me be satisfied…”

title: The Silly Heroine Transmigrates into a Tragic Novel
summary: I had just transmigrated into a tragic romance novel, and I was currently in the middle of asking the Tyrant CEO for a loan. He had his arm around his White Moonlight, his expression cold and indifferent. "For every piece of clothing you take off, I'll give you ten thousand." Excited, I whipped off both my socks and tossed them at him. "Then let's start with twenty thousand!"

title: The Joseon Prince Went To America And Didn’t Return
summary: Korean-American second-generation lobbyist 'Park Byung-jun.' Reincarnated into the body of Prince Yi Kang, who studied abroad in the U.S.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mature, Psychological

title: Ex-level Player With the Greatest Civilization of All Time
summary: After the great upheaval in which the Tower appeared, the player became the object of admiration. One day, Kang Seon-woo also awakens as a player. And not just any player, but as an EX-class A-space user. When asked whether he would like to synchronize his previous usage records, he answered yes—and two years passed. Finally, letting out cries of joy, he faces the Transcendent Civilization inside the A-space where the synchronization has completed. “Hello, successor.” Seon-woo, who has become the successor of the Transcendent Civilization, begins his climb of the Tower.

title: Married To The Male Lead’s Paranoid Uncle
summary: When Shi Yin woke up, she found herself transmigrated inside the book. She had become the weak female lead who was ab*sed by the male lead and later committed su*cide while being pregnant. At the dinner table, when the commercial marriage between her and the male lead was being finalized. Shi Yin pointed to the male lead’s uncle, who was terminally ill, and said, “I want to marry Young Uncle Cheng Yuan!” After marrying the male lead’s young uncle, Shi Yin patiently waited for the day when Zhou Cheng Yuan would die and she became single again. But, why was this man getting better and better day by day? Shi Yin said, “Hurry up and die, I wanted to be a widow quickly!” Zhou Cheng Yuan said, “Either you choose to live with me, or you can choose to die with me.” Shi Yin said, “Let’s live together.” When Shi Yin first met Zhou Cheng Yuan, she thought Cheng Yuan was a cold and abstinent tyrant. But, after spending a long time with him, Shi Yin discovered that this guy was actually black-bellied and paranoid. Every time Shi Yiin looked at other men, he would stick to her and with a dissatisfied voice said, “How can Yin Yin look at others?” Every time Shi Yin was bullied and cried by him at night, he would smile and contentedly said, “Yin Yin is crying, I am very happy.”

title: Culinary World: Starting as Reba’s Food Devil
summary: Ye Chen crossed over to a parallel world where culinary fusion was the norm and became Reba's culinary devil! Just as despair set in, he bound a rebate system! As long as Reba consumed various delicacies, he could earn rebate rewards! "Ding, Reba consumes Kaila Giant Crocodile Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining 100,000 culinary cells!" "Ding, Reba consumes Gemstone Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining a special skill - King's Fist!" "Ding, Reba consumes Ma Wang Hercules Meat. Congratulations, host, on gaining Gluttony Blood!" ".................." In no time, while others were still exploring the world of culinary delights, Ye Chen, with Reba in tow, had taken off completely! Reba: As long as my culinary devil is with me, I am invincible!
genres: Action, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Rain In Sunny Days
summary: Lan Yaoyang initially appears as the "inviolable noble son" in the media's eyes—reserved, dominant, and highly intelligent, like a dazzling star everyone pursues. A closer look, however, reveals the honest and interesting "Adorable Lan" to Ni Lan; he lays all his affection bare before her, deep and powerful, with immense strength. Ni Lan, before her memory loss, was seen by others as a beautiful but brainless actress, possessing only looks without talent. After losing her memory, she startles everyone; proficient in firearms and combat, she is like a female 'Rakshasa' who has broken free from her chains, sweeping in from the dark night with a fierce storm. He is her sunny day, like a ray of morning light in a warm winter; she is his rainstorm, stirring up huge waves in his calm life. A car accident leaves police officer Guan Fan severely injured and comatose, while actress Ni Lan suffers amnesia and becomes a major suspect. The "Mountain Forest" case enters a stalemate, shrouded in mystery and involving multiple parties. The dark web, informants, international powers, and a perplexing cold case from years ago... all clues related to the truth seem to be hidden within Ni Lan's memory. When a sunny day meets a rainstorm, we are certain to see the brilliant and magnificent rainbow of "justice" in the future.

title: Princess’s Journey: Easing This Life’s Sorrows
summary: In my previous life, as my Imperial Younger Brother and I were being hacked into mincemeat by a flurry of blades, the Imperial Son-in-Law stood outside the bamboo grove, cold and detached, as if he were a mere bystander. In this life, I looked at the handsome gigolo kneeling before me-the same man who had once died while shielding me from a blade-and I couldn’t help but smile. “You’ll do.”
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Fine Food Broadcaster
summary: A poor, down on his luck kitchen hand, Ye Fei was this close to thinking about sleeping with his landlady to avoid paying rent for his shabby little apartment when he was suddenly electrocuted while trying to turn on the lights. Unexpectedly, he did not die. Instead, a strange voice appeared in his head, "Divine Culinary Broadcasting System has successfully bonded with the host." Excuse me, who are you? Why are you living rent-free in my head?! Wait, where did that new laptop come from? Also, a 24-hour unlimited Internet access? "So long as Host performs your task well, the System shall also provide rewards and care packages from time to time.” The f*ck? Tasks? Are they like missions? Hold on, where did those ingredients come from? Whatever, Ye Fei was too hungry to care. Let's just follow the System's instructions for now and hope for the best!

title: The Man Who Abandoned Me Has Returned
summary: “Miss Elissa Leslie, may I have the honour of this dance?” Elisa’s first love, her first boyfriend—and the bastard who abandoned her four years ago… Ethan had returned. And this time, as a celebrated war hero! Haunted by the hellish memories of their past, Elisa wanted nothing to do with him. “Elisa, you’re going to catch a cold again.” “I don’t need your help. Just go away.” No matter how much she pushed him away and ran, Ethan kept coming back, relentless, and slowly, Elisa found herself unable to ignore him. Even though he never explained why he left and remained a cold, distant man… “You still like me, don’t you, Elisa?” “No, I don’t.” “It’s okay. Because I still love you.” What is he feeling inside?

title: The Story of the Struggle in Another World of the Divine Cat MI-Chan and the Cat Supplies Summoner
summary: Mi-chan, the divine cat, loves ships. I felt so good jumping on a box floating in the river.I took a nap and found myself in the middle of a big river. He cries for help, but it doesn’t reach him… Renta Neji, also known as Nero, a ronin student, finds such a kitten. Showing his manliness, he dives into the river and successfully rescues a kitten! However, this person is allergic to cats. I brought the kitten home even though I was soaking wet, and my allergy to cats started! I fell down the stairs and ended up in the afterlife. I am Mi-chan’s owner, God. Because he saved Mi-chan, he was specially able to be reincarnated in another world. When we arrived in another world, for some reason, a hello appeared in Mi-chan’s bag. But for the time being, I can’t return to God. God panicked and gave Nero the skill to summon cat supplies. (without consent) This is the story of the divine cat Mi-chan and the cat supplies summoner Nero. Even if you aim for a slow life, isn’t it such an easy world? Good luck Nero, aim for a slow life with Mi-chan! Cat owned by God → Divine cat I plan to make it so that even Tsugikuru-sama can read it.

title: Do You Really Know Your Husband?
summary: My husband and I have been sleeping in separate rooms for two years now. We've grown distant, with no passion left between us. But last night, after he'd been drinking, he climbed into my bed and went absolutely wild... I said, "Honey, you were nothing like yourself last night!" Later, I saw a message from an unknown number on his phone: "You slept with my wife, so I'm going to sleep with your wife. Only then are we even!" My husband's latest reply was: "Now we're square, right!"
genres: Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Hello, Nice to Meet You
summary: Mint has been writting letters with her father, who is a soldier on the frontlines, since she was a child. One day, her father picked up a child near the battlefield and suggested to Mint to write letters to him, but he's a stiff person to write to.

title: The First Investigation of Rookie Career Police Officer Akechi
summary: As an extraordinarily handsome young character, rookie police officer Akechi, along with middle-aged Kobayashi and other amusing companions, faces challenging cases. Will Akechi be able to solve these cases successfully?

title: The Fate-Weaver’s Gambit
summary: Before my younger half-sister got married, I served her by washing her feet. "Sis, you've been my foot-washing maid for three years. Tomorrow I'll marry the Crown Prince, and I'm a little reluctant to leave you." I wiped the sweat from my forehead and smiled: "Just come home to visit me more often, little sister." Suddenly, my younger half-sister covered her face and began to cry: "Sis, back then you were kidnapped by villains in order to save me, and disappeared for three years without a trace. Later you managed to run back, but..." My younger half-sister looked up, yet there wasn't a single tear on her face, only a charming smile: "You returned in rags, branded with the Beidi s*ave mark, and your v*rginity Mark was gone. How could the Legitimate daughter of the Chancellor's Mansion be unchaste? From then on, Father let me take your place as the Legitimate daughter Su Yunqi... And you became a lowly servant." She took off her hairpin and handed it to me: "Sis, do you hate me in your heart?"

title: The CEO’s Social Death Diary
summary: The CEO's Social Death Diary I am the CEO's secretary. My daily job consists of cleaning up his messes. When he gets caught pinning a starlet against a wall, I handle the PR. When he totals a Rolls-Royce while street racing, I pay the damages. When he gets rejected after a drunken confession, I write the apology letter. Until one day, he got drunk, his eyes rimmed with red, and asked me, "Do you actually like me or not?" I handed him my resignation letter with a smile. "I don't. Furthermore, every single one of your most embarrassing moments over the last three years? I was the one who personally leaked them to the marketing accounts." "Oh, by the way, the video of your rejected confession from last night is already trending."

title: Who Did It with a C*ck like This?! A Strange Tale of Unintentionally NTRing a Harem of True Love

summary: Humanity's fear of death permeates the very bones. Precisely because of this, I am terrified of dying. To stay alive, I can abandon dignity, face, even my very self, just to cling to a few more days of existence. The initial reason I was constantly enveloped by the fear of death dates back to that summer. I developed a secret crush on a handsome male classmate from the next class. From then on, nightmares became ceaseless...

title: The Dynasty of Cultivating Immortality
summary: In the Croburg Kingdom, leap years mark a critical time when all 16-year-olds undergo a cultivation aptitude test on their birthdays. This tradition offers a second chance, especially for children from impoverished families, to be recognized for their potential as immortal cultivators. The renowned ""Leap Test"" can catapult ordinary individuals into positions of power, as seen with Prime Minister Xue Gui, who rose from poverty due to his exceptional talent. Among them is Ni Huibo, an orphan with a mysterious past and hidden talents. Will he defy the odds and secure a future for his family?

title: I’ve Started a Skill Gacha Shop~ Anyone Can Draw My “Skill Gacha Das”! Sell Gacha and Make a Ton of Money! Aim to Be an S-Class Explorer~
summary: 30 years have passed since dungeons appeared in the world. Being a Dungeon Explorer has now become a common profession. Tadano Hitori, an unsuccessful explorer, accidentally acquires an ability called "Skill Gachadas" that can materialize gacha draws. After realizing that not only can he draw gacha himself, but he can also let others draw, Tadano decides to sell the right to draw gacha for 10,000 yen per attempt. The gacha system becomes hugely popular, offering benefits like magic, skills, and status improvements depending on the rarity of the draw. Using the sales revenue from customers' gacha draws, Tadano also draws gacha himself and grows increasingly stronger. Having obtained both money and power, Tadano uses his capital to pursue his dream of becoming an S-rank explorer. This is a success story of a rock-bottom explorer on the brink of 30 who rapidly rises to the top.

title: School Young Maiden

In the school where no one could defy him, he was the ruler of all 2000 young girls.

title: He Became Sejong’s Lifelong Follower
summary: If you offer advice to King Sejong, you'll become a prime minister, never to be able to retire. I hate that saying more than anything in the world. Because that's who I am.

title: I Found a Broken Hero
summary: I gave a tearful thumbs-up to the novel with its happy ending, and when I opened my eyes, I had been reincarnated into that very story. But. The protagonist who should have been living happily came to me in a miserable state. Having lost everything, abandoned by everyone. I cannot forgive you all for turning the heroic royal fantasy I loved into a hero-banishment story.

title: Flying Whale’s Wonderful Life – I Who Has Fused With an Invincible Weapon From the Age of Gods Will Build a City on My Back
summary: Adventurer Kaito, in a stroke of misfortune, fell to his death due to the accident in the dungeon causing the crust to split and diverge. However to his luck, the place where he fell was a resting location of a Titanic Ship from the age of gods. Kaito who was left with only a soul, fused with the titanic ship in a form of a whale, gained an immense power strong enough to destroy even a country in instant.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Even if your Sword Pierces my Heart
summary: “I hate Mcthurden.” “Is that all you hate? I bet you’d like to kill me right now…” “Still, Izak.” But even so, Cayden missed Izak. As much as he resented her, he missed her more than he hated her, and sometimes tears would well up in his eyes. When he heard that the marriage to Izak was finalized, he felt a strange sense of relief, even as he hated her madly. When Izak went off to fight in the sudden war, he would start and stop writing letters at night. Both resent her for leaving him behind under the suffocating pressure of the Duke of Macthurden and fearing that she might be harmed. 💫 ‘If the world is split in two, I will protect the Crown Prince.’ ‘Izak must marry me!’ The sweet, glorious memory crumbled to ashes. “I’ll never marry a Macthurden.” “You want to kill me, you want to tear my father to shreds for driving the Empress to her death, then wait. Lie flat on your back and be patient until the time is right.” Izak was terrified of his power-mad father. Fear that even Cayden might die at his hands. So Izak decides to become the Crown Princess. To protect Cayden. 💫 The eyes of Cayden, her husband of six years, were dead. “Izak. Your heart is beating fast.” His gaze lowered enticingly, and Cayden’s head tilted, “Did the mere mention of your name turn you on?” Just before his lips touched hers, Izak’s eyes narrowed. Suddenly, Cayden let out a small laugh, “So what? I’m bored as hell, let alone excited.”

title: The Regressed Tyrant Princess Rewrites Her Dark History
summary: The fallen princess returns—to rewrite her own dark history! Ariadne, the infamous villainess, devoted herself to making her beloved brother king—the only person who had ever shown her kindness in this world. To secure his throne, she committed countless atrocities in his name. But her unwavering loyalty was met with betrayal. Branded as the "Tyrant Princess," she was executed… only to awaken at the very beginning of it all. Determined to change her fate, Ariadne abandons her past loyalties and sides with the First Prince—her former adversary—while vowing revenge on those who once manipulated her. With the knowledge of her past life, she will break free from her doomed destiny and rewrite the course of history!

He pretended to be the husband of a woman who’d lost her memory all to uncover the formula for a cure to his hereditary illness. But the more he’s around her—bright, bold, and sincere—the more his heart wavers. It’s supposed to be a fake relationship, and yet— “Even if I’m not the man you remember, would you still love me?” Why does he find himself wanting to ask her the very same thing?

title: RE:Yandere
summary: Linze used to be a normal 2nd year middle schooler who once had 8th-grader syndrome, and after being stabbed to death by his younger sister’s classmate, Linze realized that he is able to [Return by Death], restarting time back to the very beginning after dying. Surpassing innumerous situations of despondency, let’s look at Linze as he learns to sustain several love relationships, while searching for the hope of living on under the many paths of death.

title: I Wanted To Become a Contracted Archduchess instead of A Saint
summary: This is my third time as a middle schooler. I got reincarnated as Saint Reina in a rated-19+ dark fantasy novel. In the story, Reina is used by the crown prince and dies a miserable death. To avoid that sad ending, I tried to steal the Holy Grail — a tool that detects saints — so I could live a long life… But I got caught by the cold-hearted Grand Duke of the North, Kalheil! “You’re the first person who could heal my poison.” I only kissed him to heal a serious wound caused by the Holy Grail… But now Kalheil, who was supposed to die soon, won’t leave me alone?! He interrupts my blind dates and even threatens to reveal my secret unless I marry him?! I agreed to a contract marriage because I was scared of his obsession. My plan was to cure his poison, take a big reward, and divorce him… But this man keeps trying to touch me! “Why do you keep coming into my room, Your Highness?” “Is it strange for a married couple to share a room?” He enters my room without asking. “Kissing is enough to heal you, though.” “Isn’t it better to share more bodily fluids?” He’s always trying to get close and touchy when he can. Your Highness, our deal only included kisses!

His body was destroyed, his soul disappeared, his lover was dead, and there was no way to become an immortal! Let’s see how he uses the sword as his body and his mind as his soul. For the girl in his heart, he practices the sword and kills all the immortals! There is no system, no time travel, no Xiaobai, only a sword to break through this unfair world and kill all the evil immortals!

title: Welcome to the World Tree Boarding House

For an S-rank Hunter, one year is far too long. To heal as quickly as possible, Park Yeonwoo goes to the World Tree Boarding House. The World Tree can heal most illnesses in just one day, And the World Tree Boarding House is the only place where people without permission can use the World Tree’s power. “Hello, Mr. Park Yeonwoo. I’m Shin Haerin, the manager of the World Tree Boarding House.” Park Yeonwoo meets Shin Haerin, the manager and owner of the boarding house. ‘What kind of person is she?’ With just one gesture from Shin Haerin, the entire boarding house moves. She treats people with powerful and dangerous auras as if it’s nothing, and the World Tree listens only to her. In the hunter world, no one has ever heard of her. Even searching the internet shows no information about Shin Haerin. “It’s a bit late, but welcome to the World Tree Boarding House.” So who exactly is Shin Haerin?

title: Humanity’s Strongest by Shadow
summary: The protagonist, who was living a mundane life, undergoes a dramatic transformation when they unexpectedly regress. A story of regression. Targeted at a male audience. A hunter-themed tale.

title: Became an Instructor for the Affectionate Characters
summary: There exists someone with unwavering conviction about their game characters. A person who values affection over performance—and, driven by that affection alone, reaches the very end no matter how hard the path. This protagonist, once nicknamed a “tr*sh-connoisseur” by others for their fondness for the weakest characters, suddenly finds themselves transmigrated into the very game they used to play. There, they encounter the characters who had yet to receive their care and devotion—those so-called “tr*sh-tier” heroes. Now, there’s only one thing left to do: to raise these forsaken ones into the greatest champions of all. “Wait for me. You’re no longer tr*sh characters.”

title: Dream of the Red Chamber: Starting by Using a Subterfuge to Kill Jia Lian
summary: Transmigrated from the womb into the world of the Red Chamber, I fell into a life of banditry. Grateful for my actions, Lin Ruhai recommended me for a position, and I became a Trial Hundred-Household in the Jinxiyi (the Brocade-Clad Guard). Entrusted with escorting the salt tax revenue and guarding Lin Ruhai’s wife and daughter on their journey to the capital, my goals for this life are simple: “To sleep on the laps of beauties, to hold the power of the world in my hands; to be surrounded by the Twelve Beauties of Nanjing, and to make the whole world tremble at my name.” However, with the hundred officials mired in corruption…

title: Livestream: While Others Flirt, I Catch Ghosts

Repair bridges and roads, and you'll get no corpses!" "Others can kill and burn people, so why can't I, Chen Xue Wen?" "Others can treat human life as nothing, so why can't I, Chen Xue Wen?" title: One Piece: Maxed Out Conqueror’s Haki

Bullets to the head, cannon blasts to the chest, blades across his throat, drowning seas, and raging flames can destroy his flesh, but they can never claim his life. After countless brutal “deaths,” he realizes that mere immortality is not enough in a world ruled by monsters like Rocks, Roger, and Whitebeard.​ Determined to stop being a passive punching bag, he chooses the most domineering path in the One Piece world: to first max out his Conqueror’s Haki and then overwhelm the era itself. From the shadows of that legendary time, he crashes into the mainstream of history, clashing with Marines, pirates, and royalty, carving his name into the seas as the undying king whose will no one can suppress.

title: Thistle is A Flower of Revenge
summary: The second prince, Frederick, a mischievous fellow, learns that his maid, Thistle, was suddenly married as a concubine of a young new king in a neighboring country. Even though it was supposed to be a concubine situation, Thistle has been taken hostage in place of the royal family. Frederick rushes to his father, the king, and finds out from his brother their father had committed unforgivable sins in the past that had ultimately led to the current situation. What will Frederick do to save his maid and exact revenge on this new king?

title: The Golden Age is absolutely ruthless

genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: I Am on the Victim List
summary: The old phone was hidden beneath a false bottom inside my husband's bedside drawer. I only found it because I was looking for a spare charger. Inside the Notes app, there was a list of women, each graded like livestock. A-grade, marriage material. B-grade, backup. C-grade, discarded. My name sat at the very top. A-grade. Parents alive. Younger brother. Perfect for building a tragic image of a wife burdened by a parasitic birth family. I kept scrolling until I reached the last entry. Completed. Jumped from a building. Depression staged. When I looked up, my husband was standing in the doorway with a glass of warm milk, smiling the same gentle smile everyone praised. "Honey," he said softly, "it's time for bed."

title: On This Dark Windy and Endless Night… Husband Where Do You Think You Can Run?
summary: Feng Yuxi transmigrated into a novel and became Chu Xiaoqi. As soon as she opened her eyes, she found herself in a home with nothing but four bare walls, a reputation that stank far and wide. Heaven seemed intent on destroying her, but she refused to go down without a fight. She worked hard to earn money, just to survive. When she first arrived, she was so busy trying to make money and change the tragic fate awaiting her that she didn’t notice her puppy-like husband secretly trying to get close to her every day. Once she no longer had to worry about food and clothing, she suddenly turned around—only to realize that her husband had become more and more handsome. And from then on, every time she saw him, she just couldn’t stop herself from teasing him. Thus began her daily routine of flirting with her husband. One day, Chu Xiaoqi leaned over her husband's desk, beaming brightly and said: “Darling, I want to go somewhere.” “Where to?” “To your heart!” Her husband blushed furiously, struggling to hold back his emotions...

title: They Told You to Farm, and You Became the Emperor?
summary: The Middle Ages, warring knights, dragons, demons, gods, pirates, giant beasts... Barbarism, ignorance, backwardness, numbness, starving people everywhere, the populace in dire straits... Damn it! One punch to break this era!! Reclaiming land, farming, building bridges, paving roads, mining coal, extracting minerals! Gaining experience, recruiting apostles, forming an army! Mass production! Sweeping across everything! Hahaha! My steel legion is invincible!! Roman: "I am your destiny! Kneel before me, all of you!" So, how did farming lead you to establish a vast empire and become its emperor?

title: When Advanced Science and Ancient Magic Collide

While opening his eyes in the pure white light, he falls into another world… “What do you desire?” “Knowledge.” For greater knowledge, and for the advancement of science. Not with magic, but with science, he defeats the army of the Demon King. Because advanced science cannot be distinguished from ancient magic.

title: My CEO Boyfriend is a Ghost​
summary: On the third year after my death, I appeared in Chen Zhiyu's dream. "Husband, could you burn a Paper Effigy Cat for me to ease my loneliness?" Chen Zhiyu smiled, "Do you want a Gloomy Male Ghost?" "Yes, yes, yes! Preferably with eight-pack abs." He took out a hemp rope. "Alright, wait a moment, I'll go die now."

title: After She Was Burned to Death, Her Whole Family Regretted It
summary: In her previous life, Yu Shuwan had her tendons severed by her vicious adoptive mother. She returned to the Houfu crippled, thinking her suffering was over and she could finally receive the love she had always dreamed of. However, someone had long since taken her place as the apple of her parents’ and older brothers’ eyes. Everyone in the capital knew that the eldest young miss of the Zhongyi Houfu was gentle, beautiful, and renowned for her talent. The second young miss of the Zhongyi Houfu was crippled, insecure, timid, and an embarrassment. Anyone could step all over her! She thought she had met a good man who could be her salvation, but he only pushed her into an endless abyss. “The kind are always bullied!” “If there is a next life, I will not show a shred of mercy!” As she perished inch by inch in the scorching flames, she was blessed by the heavens and reborn at the age of fourteen, just before her tendons were to be severed and she was to be crippled! Yu Shuwan threw her head back and laughed: The wicked will be tormented by the wicked, and I am your retribution! A new rumor began to spread through the capital: How did the Zhongyi Houfu… produce a madwoman?! Yu Shuwan was fearless. So what if a person is a little ruthless? I have a powerful backer, and besides, I am one too! No one in the entire capital dared to approach her, yet there was one person who refused to play by the rules. Even after seeing her at her most despicable, his resolve to stand by her side never wavered. Yu Shuwan hesitated. This man was handsome, well-behaved, and a man of few words. Perhaps… she should give it a try?

title: Female CEO’s Master
summary: Chu Jiang, the leader of Mars, the top special organization in China, returned to the metropolis. In order to get a marriage contract, he entered Qingcheng Group and began his wonderful life among the flowers. Smacking the face, being a show-off and ambiguity emerged in endlessly. In the end, Chu Jiang stood at the top of the world, laughing at the world situation.

title: The Last Demon God
summary: 【Also known as: Invincible Three Hundred Million Years】 Starting with full attributes, invincible right from the beginning! I, the last demon god, have lived for a whole 300 million years. I've experienced 99.81 million su*cides, attempted 7,749 different ways to die, and have tasted poisons that could wrap around the world three times. Yet, I still persistently live on. Invincibility can be this lonely. Note: This is the story of a level 1000 pro showing off in a world where the max level is 100.

title: Secretly Replacing My Husband’s Lube with 502
summary: I found a bottle of women's lubricant in my husband's bag. I didn't argue or make a scene. I quietly replaced it with a bottle of 502 super glue. At 2 a.m., the new postpartum nanny was taken to the emergency room.

title: Remarried to Mr. Billionaire
