What I don't expect is that he cheats on me and has affairs with his colleague, a girl younger than me after one year. I have no choice but get divorce. Luckily, God favors me another time. I meet him. He is a divorce lawyer who helps me deal with all those problems with my ex husband and get out of the painful memories. He even promises me a new life. Should I believe him?

title: Mita Ichizoku no Iji wo Mi yo ～Tensei Sengoku Bushou no Honsou Ki～
summary: I was reincarnated in the Sengoku Period as one of my ancestors that was destroyed by the Hojo Clan. Can I really change history and avoid the destruction of my family?

title: The Suite
summary: “People always say only those who’ve felt pain themselves can truly understand someone who’s suffering.” Sehee’s voice shook, but her words cut through the stillness of the counseling room. “You’ve never gone through that, have you, Doctor? That’s why you can’t possibly know how miserable and desperate I feel.” Inhu replied without hesitation. “No, I don’t. But I also don’t want to keep breaking myself by caring too much about others. That’s why I can’t recommend it.” His cold stare made Sehee bite her lip. She tried to hold back, but the tears came anyway. Hot and silent, they slid down her cheeks. A knock broke the silence. Dongchan stepped in, sent by the nurses who insisted someone check on Counseling Room 6. He stopped at the sight of Sehee’s tear-streaked face and Inhu’s rigid posture. His jaw tightened. He looked at Inhu, eyes demanding an answer. “Dr. Kang, I told you to counsel her. Not hurt her.” He cleared his throat. “Hello. I’m the director of this hospital. I’m sorry. You must be very upset.” Dongchan turned to Sehee, his voice gentle. “This is Dr. Kang’s first time doing counseling. It seems he’s still learning. Please try not to take it to heart.” “Please do the surgery.” Her voice was small and flat. “Oh. Of course. If you’d like, I can do the surgery myself instead of Dr. Kang. My schedule is usually packed, but I’ll make time for this.” Sehee’s face began to soften under Dongchan’s calm reassurance. But then Inhu spoke again, his voice cutting through the moment. “If you go into surgery without even trying, with that mindset, you won’t change. Not now. Not ever.” The light in Sehee’s eyes faded. Her expression turned cold again. “Dr. Kang?” Dongchan kept his tone even, but the warning was clear. He couldn’t raise his voice in front of a patient, but the tension in his jaw said enough. Inhu didn’t stop. “If you walk out of this hospital and manage to lose the weight on your own, I’ll help you with your revenge. That’s a promise.”

title: My Wife, My Executioner
summary: A blaze swallowed the Shen household overnight, leaving nothing behind but ashes. Shen Xingyu was the sole survivor—only because she had stayed the night at a close friend’s home. With no family, no wealth, and nowhere to turn, she clutched a worn marriage contract and traveled to the capital, hoping her long-ago betrothed would still remember her. To her relief, the Gu family honored the old engagement. They welcomed her in, despite her now being a penniless orphan with no influence or dowry. And though her husband, Gu Xiu, was as cold as the northern wind—silent, distant, and unreadable—Shen Xingyu told herself it didn’t matter. Perhaps he was simply not used to expressing himself. So she learned to read his silence as care, convinced herself his distance was restraint, not rejection. She poured her heart into their life together. She never complained, never faltered. She cooked, cleaned, sewed his garments, even tended to his shoes and socks with her own hands. Day by day, she wove herself into the fabric of their household—not as a guest, but as a devoted wife. But Gu Xiu’s silence never warmed. His eyes never lingered. His hands never reached for hers. Still, Shen Xingyu endured, hoping time would soften his heart. Then came that fateful river voyage. Their pleasure boat was attacked by river bandits. Chaos erupted. Amid the crashing timbers and rising water, Shen Xingyu and Sheng Ruyue—a beautiful young lady with ties to the Gu family—were both thrown overboard. And in that moment, Shen Xingyu saw the truth. Gu Xiu jumped into the water without hesitation… but not for her. He swam past Shen Xingyu as if she didn’t exist, and lifted Sheng Ruyue into his arms. His only instinct had been to save the woman he truly cared for. A thousand memories surged through her—averted gazes, forgotten words, empty silences—and every piece clicked into place. He had never loved her. He had never even tried. A raw, searing pain bloomed in her chest. As the shouts grew faint above the water, Shen Xingyu dove deeper. Away from the wreckage. Away from him. Away from the life she had fought so hard to preserve. She vanished without a trace. And Gu Xiu? He went mad. He dove back into the river, again and again, searching for the wife he had overlooked—only realizing her worth in the moment she was gone. He would have drowned chasing her shadow, had the servants not dragged his unconscious body from the water. But Shen Xingyu was already gone. Far from the capital, she built a quiet life of her own. A small cottage. A flower garden. Tea in the morning, peace in the evening. She was no longer someone’s wife—just a woman living for herself. And she liked it that way. Three years passed. When fate brought them together again, Gu Xiu was no longer the man she remembered. The cold, aloof nobleman was gone. In his place stood a broken soul—eyes red with emotion, voice hoarse with longing. He gazed at her as if she were the only thing left in his world.

title: After Divorce, I Can Hear the Future
summary: "At thirty, a rare age in the past, and when the King of Hell doesn’t summon you, you go of your own accord." After his divorce, Lu Liang suddenly felt as though the dirt was already up to his neck, especially when he could hear the sound of a running memorial lantern. Until he discovered that it was a message from the future, and that’s when his life took a dramatic turn. ... Living in this world, we are all mere mortals. Being a mortal isn’t so bad—greedy, lustful, cunning, selfish...

title: Martial Mad Demon
summary: A mad demon who dreamed of being a chivalrous hero, striking down all kinds of villains and, in the process, also striking down good people. He awakens as a Taoist priest of the Wudang Sect.

title: Rebirth: A Drunken Kiss Night! Flirting and Coaxing the Enemy Into Marriage
summary: (The rebellious prince of the Beijing circle and the arrogant and lovely young lady, both clean, sweet and spoiled, chasing, teasing, coaxing and spoiling their husbands, 1v1 extreme ambiguous pulling) Lin Qingyou and Yin Hanyu were childhood sweethearts, but because of the green tea male second selling tea, they became mortal enemies who fought each other as soon as they met. Yin Hanyu's little mouth smeared with crane top red often made Lin Qingyou furious, and she wanted to spray him to death with a mouthful of salt soda. But when she was trapped in the sea of ​​fire and hell and was in agony, the people close to her either poured oil or poured oil. Only her mortal enemy, whom she could not avoid, ran to her, embraced her, accompanied her to death, and went to the underworld together. After rebirth, Lin Qingyou immediately dragged her mortal enemy to get married. But the mortal enemy was unwilling. She immediately started to pursue her husband, flirting with him every night, calling him her sweetheart. "My sweetheart, my bed is broken, can I sleep at your house?" "My sweetheart, your lips are so soft, I want to kiss you every day." " My sweetheart, your waist is so strong, I want to hug you every day." The man, whose face was flushed and heartbeat was beating fast because of the girl's flirting, pushed her against the wall fiercely: "Little Qingyou, if you dare to lie to me again this time, we will die together." But the girl smiled like a flower, her eyes were as charming as silk, and she stretched out her hand to hook his neck: "Can we change the way we die?" "What?" "Desire, life, desire, death..."

title: Together at Dusk
summary: After transmigrating into the Villainess's stepmother, the System told me to stop the Villainess from turning dark. In the end, I raised the Villainess into a little angel. The Main Cast came to visit one after another: The Male Lead looked aggrieved: Why don't you like me? The Female Lead hugged a Gaokao prep book: Don't leave after school, I'll tutor you in math today.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: When The Villainess Loves
summary: I got to possess the body of a villainess, whose life was limited to end soon. That’s okay, because I can cure the disease! The goal is a life, where I can do whatever I want to! First, I decided to educate the characters of my favorite novel. However, the reaction of the people around me, who called me a villainess, were strange. “How can you laugh like that even though you’re dying soon?”

title: Married To A Potential Fat Man
summary: Don’t ever underestimate the fat man around you, because – one slip and they could become a highly educated, multi-talented, six-pack hunk, and – your husband.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Kicking Out Her Ex-Husband, She Uses Her Max-Level Space to Slack Off and Raise Her Child
summary: When Han Yue woke up, she found herself inside a period novel—instantly becoming a mother of three without the pain of childbirth, and married to a cheating s*umbag of a husband. The s*umbag wants a divorce and even tries to pin all the blame on her. Her vile mother-in-law curses her for being “unvirtuous and unfilial,” saying she’s only fit to marry some old widower. Even her sister-in-law, who hasn’t even graduated high school, dares to boss her around. It’s like shining a lantern in an outhouse—just looking for trouble! Han Yue punches her vicious mother-in-law, kicks her unfaithful husband to the curb! And that arrogant sister-in-law? Han Yue gifts her a full set of combo punches, then lets her clash head-on with a truly irredeemable s*umbag. Han Yue sneers: “You begged on your knees to marry me back then. Now that you want a divorce, you’ll be begging on your knees again!” Refuse? Perfect. The countdown to the mistress’s family ruin begins. When the powerful backer collapses, the ex-husband’s elder brother ends up kneeling, begging for mercy!

title: I Want A Harem But She Is Very…
summary: Kazuhe Nomomiya, a boy who was given a gifted education from otaku parents. One morning in the kitchen he saw a mysterious vortex that changes his fate. A boy nurtured as an otaku, instantly recognizes that it is summoning magic. What does the future hold, for the boy who rushed to the vortex at full speed… A 16-year-old boy who loves otaku subculture goes to a different world.

title: Rebirth Begins with Rejecting my Childhood Friend
summary: Xu Xiuwen, who was battered and bruised, was reborn and found himself back at the farewell dinner after the college entrance examination. It was the year 2005. Facing the aggressive former love rival and the childhood sweetheart he once had a crush on, he decided to start a new life. After being reborn, he not only wants to recover the white moonlight that he missed in his previous life, but also builds his own business empire. Fame and fortune, career and love, he wants them all!
genres: Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: I Like You So Much
summary: Li Jiao was admitted to college, but her family feared that their little girl would get ruined by a pig of a man. But who would’ve thought that she would’ve gotten a boyfriend just immediately after military training. He was a special forces soldier that had come to training camp to help direct for a few days. He was cold and handsome, with an overload of aloof temperament. After knowing that he had no girlfriend, her journey to chasing her future husband began. But while chasing love for the first time, various deterrents had appeared in her way. While doing push-ups, she had accidentally thrown her body down because of exhaustion, yet he thought that she was trying to infuriate him. Walking forward, she had accidentally kicked her shoe out and almost hit him, which he considered as revenge. Listening to a lecture, she had not stood firm because of her love for looking at her handsome crush. As a result, she had to kneel down in a spot of a lecture hall in front of thousands of people. Li Jiao: “Speaking honestly, I’m not embarrassed. I just want to die.” She originally thought that she had no hope of getting a boyfriend, but who would have thought… Her shoes flew. He picked them up. “These are Cinderella shoes, wear them.” Seeing that she was getting faint, he stood behind her to provide shade. The instructor of another class brought a piece of watermelon, but he didn’t hold it and instead passed it to her. After a while, he said: “Li Jiao, I order you to eat the watermelon.” “Okay.” Zhang Jiuling had never expected to meet such a person. As long as she was coquettish, he would want to give her his life. “If your method of defeating your opponent is to be coquettish, then I wouldn’t even be able to lift my weapon.” “I love my country, and I also love her. For the rest of my life, I’ll be loyal to my country, and I’ll devote myself to her.” Note : Military training is optional in China, but it’s recommended. Students can choose to join and go to military training.

title: Mr. Lu, Your Wife Has Run Away with the Money!
summary: (A sweet-talking, stunning model × A disabled, obsessive painter) (First: Love-hate battles. Mid: Chasing the wife through hell. Late: Spoiling her rotten.) When two scheming, ruthless individuals play their games, who will come out on top? Shen Simo casually did a good deed—little did she know it would be the start of her downfall. She wanted money. He wanted love. On the surface, they seemed like a match made in heaven, yet both were luring the other into the quicksand called love. But Lu HuaiChuan’s love was suffocating, crushing Shen Simo under its weight. His endless tests left her disillusioned. It was time to take the money and leave. The night Shen Simo vanished from his world, Lu HuaiChuan leisurely pushed open the storage room door: "Simo, did you really think you could escape me?" "Lu HuaiChuan, you didn’t actually think I loved you, did you? Who in their right mind would turn down easy money? A few sweet words, and you’d give me everything—how is that any different from free riches falling from the sky? I could never love you. Never. Not in a million years!" "It’s fine. My love is enough. I love that you never pitied me for my flaws. I love how helpless you looked whenever my tests made you waver. I love even the pain I caused you. As long as you stay by my side, I’ll give you everything you desire. Even the stars in the sky—I’d pluck them down and hand them to you."

title: I’ve Turned Into a Ghost, What Should I Do
summary: Help, I died because of a girl's mistake, but now I have captured her, how should I get revenge? Hm? You ask how I can get revenge after dying? Because I'm a ghost!
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Heaven Awakening Path
summary: Infusion, Sound, Qi, Pivot, Strength, Essence, Excellence Soul’s seven forces. Perception of these seven souls has produced countless strong people. However, in an ordinary courtyard, a youngster was facing a crisis of banishment.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, School Life, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: I Enter the SSS-Class Gate Alone
summary: Kang Juhyuk, an F-rank Hunter scorned by everyone, known as the pinnacle of the bottom. To him, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity has arrived. [Skill, ‘Gate Creation’ acquired.] A gate has appeared that only I can enter.

title: Omnipotent Data
summary: Can Mathematics and textbook knowledge really save you from all the hassles in life? Cheng Nuo proves this statement positive and transforms from a mediocre high school student to one who succeeds with flying colours in every aspect of his life. One day, when he wakes up, Cheng Nuo finds out, to his surprise, that the entire world has changed. Everything he sees is translated into numbers and figures. Cheng Nuo looks at a cue ball and sees: Diameter: 57.15 cm; Weight: 170g; Length of cue stick: 145cm; Force required to pot Ball 3: 2.14 Newtons; Angle required: 68.54 degrees… Yes, apart from the basic details of an object, Cheng Nuo is able to compute other related statistics in his mind with the given details at lightning speed. Initially, Cheng Nuo is baffled by this sudden gain of superpower, but later realizes the immense benefits it brings to his life. You can call Cheng Nuo a genius, the King of Data or a human supercomputer. With his incredible data analysis skills, he has never failed to score a shot in basketball, soccer and billiards. He even manages to save himself from a fatal car accident, all thanks to his superpower in data processing and mental calculation. “Every question in this world can be solved mathematically. If not, use your knowledge in Physics and Chemistry!” This is Cheng Nuo, the genius student’s life philosophy.

title: While I Was Shutting in My Room for One Year, My Parent Remarried and Now I’m Living Together With Super Beautiful Stepsisters
summary: While I was shutting myself in, my parent remarried and I ended up with as many as 3 beautiful stepsisters...... The protagonist was dropped to the bottom of life because he failed the high school entrance exam and his relationship with the beautiful childhood friend who had the same aspired school also broke down. He was shutting himself in his room for about a year due to the shock. However, during that time his father who was his only blood relative had remarried. Before he knew it 3 beautiful stepsisters were living on the floor below his own house.
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Bizarre Terrors
summary: A mysterious mu*der occurs one night in an appartement. Li , a reporter, sensed it. However her brother An, a horror novelist, objects to her getting involved in this due to their past. The day after , Li senses another killing happening, and while trying to stop it, she meets Jin, someone with same ability like her. Now the three of them, including An try to understand what exactly is going on…

title: The Capitalist Heiress Was Transmigrated into the ’70s
summary: Song Kexing, a gorgeous yet unhinged heiress, transmigrates into a parallel 1970s—armed with her mystical spring space. The moment she opens her eyes, it’s already a catastrophic start. A capitalist heiress? Disowned by her family, disfigured, and beaten to death? Song Kexing’s bloodthirsty smile says it all. Perfect. They’ve managed to piss her off. s*umbag dad and scheming stepmother trying to flee abroad? Reported—ties severed. That two-faced white lotus who ruined her face? Time for her to taste what true pain feels like. As for those who beat her—where they struck, she’ll break. Once the revenge list is cleared and her tr*sh father’s fortune is emptied, it’s time to head to the countryside. After all, there’s still a vicious supporting character role waiting for her to play. What? She’s supposed to stir up trouble? Then she might as well break up the main couple while she’s at it! System Maruko: Big Boss, please… don’t go too off the rails! In short: A crazy, vengeful heiress armed with a magical spring space storms into the 1970s, wrecks scum, flips fates, and has way too much fun doing it.

title: Urban Strengthening System
summary: Wash your face once, improve your face value, raise your hand, increase your arm strength, read a book, improve your knowledge… it becomes stronger every second without limit, and from then on, Ye Hong began his journey of hegemony, healing, cooking God, Car God, God of Learning, God of War… Dominate the whole field!
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, School Life

title: Who’s Playing Who?
summary: The shattering of a champagne flute rang through the banquet hall like a piercing alarm, grating on the ears. I stood frozen, a mix of fury and humiliation tightening around my throat like a noose. My gaze was locked onto Zhou Qi’an. The rationality that had vanished from his face was as disheveled as his half-unbuttoned shirt. “Zhixia, let me explain-” His voice was laced with panic as he tried to grab my hand, but I shoved him away. Gu Lan stood behind him, her face pale, a flicker of what seemed like a plea for mercy and self-reproach in her eyes. Her lips trembled slightly. “Zhixia, don’t make a scene yet. There are still so many people outside…” I let out a cold laugh, one sharp with irony. “What, is kissing your man something that can only be done quietly in the restroom?”

title: I Love You as Much as You Do
summary: 1. A friend asked Chen Yao, “When did you like Jinxiu?” Chen Yao looked at Jinxiu’s back and smiled knowingly, “Because of a bowl of dumplings.” The friend suddenly realized, “It turns out that you found a potential wife!” Chen Yao lowered his head, his dark eyes warmed a bit. Because in his hunger and despair, Jinxiu brought him a ray of sunshine, warm and full of energy. 2. Jinxiu’s best friend asked her, “When did you like Chen Yao?” Jinxiu smiled slightly, revealing the deep dimples at the corners of her mouth, “Because when everyone is standing opposite me, only he puts me behind him.” Jinxiu would never forget the man holding a shovel in front of her while glaring at everyone, he guarded her behind him and said to her gently, “Don’t be afraid, I am here.”

title: Age of Empires From Scratch
summary: David became a pioneer in the Tiran Kingdom and acquired his own territory, becoming a village chief under the kingdom’s rule. Although his land was located in a somewhat remote and harsh environment where crops were difficult to grow, and the village was only inhabited by him, David believed these difficulties could be overcome. David declared, “My territory is open to all realms and dimensions. I won’t go looking for you; you come to me!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: The Noble Girl Is Beautiful
summary: Shen Yourong, as the eldest daughter of the Duke’s household, engraved the word “propriety” into her bones. Her words and actions never faltered. She neither harbored secret affections at a young age, nor engaged in the childhood antics of love-hate relationships. Moreover, she never encountered any strange encounters while traveling, smoothly embodying the epitome of a noblewoman. The only hiccup in her otherwise flawless life was her marriage, which didn’t go smoothly. Despite discussing marriage with her nephew, she ended up marrying her uncle, which was quite embarrassing. The Emperor, advancing in age, favored the fourth prince, Ji Chengyao, for the heir position. The fourth prince’s foster mother, Lady Shu Fei, hinted at a marriage alliance between Shen Yourong’s maternal family, the Duke of Qi’s household, and the fourth prince. Both overtly and covertly, they suggested that Shen Yourong should befriend the fourth prince. Ji Zhuo always felt that Shen Yourong, this so-called model noblewoman, was not as genuine as she appeared. A noblewoman who seemed diligent and earnest shouldn’t be casually snacking on melon seeds while watching the fourth prince flirt with other girls, as her family tried to curry favor with him.
genres: Completed, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Now, Everyone Will Say Their Goodbyes
summary: I asked the doctor. "How much time do I have left? The time given to me." "...About three months. But since there is still a good chance, you should consider having the surgery..." I gave a hollow laugh at the word "chance." Chance always holds people back. Everyone either despairs or holds onto hope with that word. It's the kind of hope that prays to be alive, no matter what. However, that small chance, wrapped in a pleasant-sounding hope, was just empty comfort to me. "That's enough. How should I put it... I'm tired." With that, I decide to cut ties and leave.

title: A Chan
summary: Zhang Jingchan, from a once-wealthy family, is a handsome, single, and rising star in the city's business world. His father went bankrupt years ago, owing 1 billion yuan, and he insists on taking on that debt, a situation that has trapped him like a dragon in a quagmire. One day, Li Weiyi, a heartbroken and unemployed office worker, wakes up to find herself transformed into Zhang Jingchan, who was a wealthy young master eight years ago. Zhang Jingchan: "If you can help me get this 1 billion yuan back, I'm willing..." Li Weiyi looked at his face and figure and swallowed hard. Zhang Jingchan: "I'll give you 100 million." Li Weiyi: "!!!!" ———— At first, I thought that time travel was just like any other, a fleeting moment. Later I learned that he had waited for a full eight years. Time loop + gender swapping.
genres: Completed, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: Monster Eater
summary: E-rank adventurer Lude was born with a unique skill. However, it was a questionable ability called [Nullify Status Abnormality]. To overcome his current situation, he dives into a new labyrinth but encounters a B-rank Minotaur. Abandoned by his teammates, he falls into the abyss. He was injured, his supplies were depleted, and the only thing he could eat was the Minotaur in front of him. However, in this world, eating monsters was taboo, and eating them causes physical abnormalities, eventually turning the perpetrator into a monster. While there was a large risk, Lude believed in his unique skill and ate the monster to survive. Then, Lude’s unique skill was activated, and the monsterification was effectively nullified. He was even able to acquire monster skills. Lude, who understood the true use of [Nullify Status Abnormality], earned skills by earnestly consuming monsters. This is the upstart adventure story of Lude, who dreams of becoming an S-rank adventurer.

title: Director Zhou Won’t Work Overtime Tonight
summary: A long-planned scheme / Age gap / Pure love / High-ranking official / Dual civil servants *Gentle and obedient younger sister vs. authoritative and paternal husband with bureaucratic charm *Culture and Tourism Bureau guide & Beijing elite with impeccable political background / Director within the system At 21, Shi Ye graduated from university. Without grand ambitions, she only wished for an ordinary, stable life. But a marriage contract with Zhou Junheng—given his position—shattered her hope of remaining an ordinary, unnoticed figure. "Director Zhou, do you consent to this marriage arrangement? If not—" "I do." He gave her a promise: "As my wife, I will protect you and ensure you receive dignity and respect." — After marriage, he kept his word. Providing her with unwavering stability; Offering her the most attentive care and guidance; And even more… Pinning her against his desk, kissing her breathless. "Shi Ye, I love you. Could you love me a little more?" He also said, "Our marriage is based solely on love, nothing else." — When she first joined the bureau, a colleague tried to set her up. She mentioned she was already married. The colleague was shocked—during the background check, she had been single. Was civil service now embracing whirlwind marriages? Later, at the office, she rarely spoke of her husband, sparking curiosity. When asked about his job, she didn’t want to deal with the prying. "He’s also in the system. His work keeps him busy, so he can’t pick me up." Everyone assumed it was a half-truth, an excuse to hide an unimpressive spouse. Then, when a colleague asked her to pull strings for a small favor, she replied, "His position can’t handle this." Only later did they realize how wrong they were. So this was what she meant by "also in the system"—including the position of Director.

title: Little Dog Friend
summary: My boyfriend is a total hopeless romantic. The most extreme thing he's ever done to me was cry a little too loudly. That was until one day, when bullet comments suddenly started flickering in midair. Only then did I discover the depraved thoughts he was hiding behind my back. Later, I followed him and saw the cage he had prepared for me. I was furious. "You should have said something sooner! Then I wouldn't have bothered going to work." "When exactly were you planning on locking me away?" "Are there snacks at home? I'm planning on moving in tonight."

title: Heart of Empire
summary: The curtains to an epic of a continental power struggle are pulled open. There’s an entire empire in Dane’s heart! Churches, tribes, prisons, forests, castles, graveyards, abysses . . . He controls the bases of all seven races in the fantasy epic war game, [Heart of Dynasty]; right before his eyes is the throne of a monarch! Elf rangers pull your bows, the heavy-armoured knights are charging! The Caesar Empire has collapsed. An era of war for the new ruler arises. The Kingdom sends endless expeditions; the Northern Alliance is unwilling to be excluded; the abyss and death begin to stir as they gaze upon the continent. Plots, tricks, religious wars. . . amidst these battles, only the victor can be called powerful! Dane, holding a blade dripping with blood, says with bared teeth, “f*ck! Let me use my ass to see whether that seat at the top is comfortable or not!”

title: My Childhood Sweetheart Gradually Puffed Up
summary: Before his reincarnation, Wen Yu always thought that his childhood sweetheart, Fu Chengque, was like the snow on the high mountain, unattainable. But later, he realized that she was not ice and snow at all. She was clearly a penguin standing on ice. With one slip of her foot, she tumbled down the mountain… —————— Next door. Fu Chengque looked at her golden finger and felt extremely puffed up! She wrote hastily: “I, the future empress, the superhuman, the destined deity Fu Chengque, am recruiting talents! Help friends regardless of reason, sign up quickly!” But her tasks were not only related to her childhood sweetheart Wen Yu, but each one was super difficult! 【Make Wen Yu say “But I like it.”】 【Have a candlelight dinner with Wen Yu.】 【Whisper to Wen Yu for ten minutes.】 … She’s just a girl, not a lover. How could she possibly complete them! What’s absurd is that, although things didn’t go as expected, she still completed them all! [Highly recommended for people who enjoy both male protagonists and/or female protagonists]
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Sniping
summary: [This isn’t a place you can just walk into.] […] The rooftop of a building about to be remodeled. Kwon Hyunse came to a halt when he spotted someone he hadn’t seen before, hidden by the structure near the edge. Someone leaning over the railing, looking at something. A small frame. A woman? [Your laces came undone. You should tie them properly when running.] Facing a small face filled with confusion and panic, Kwon Hyunse tucked the cigarette between his lips and stood in front of her, blocking her path. “…Are you going to report me?” “Kitty, is that what you were worried about?” As her eyes blinked blankly like an overloaded computer, Kwon Hyunse called to her in a low voice, as if trying to bring her back to her senses. “Kitty, I’m not the police, so I’m not here to arrest you. I need you.” “…W-what do you mean?” Watching her face change from moment to moment, the corner of Kwon Hyunse’s lips tilted into a crooked smile. “I need a sniper.” “There are plenty of snipers out there.” “Not just any sniper. The best sniper. Like you, Kitty.”

title: Misunderstood Lousy Cop: Getting Promoted for Running Criminals Over
summary: Shiraki Touya is a 29-year-old cop. He’s a total klutz that runs people over and accidentally shoots someone every few months. Luckily, everyone he has injured turned out to be merciless criminals! So, thanks to his intelligent looks coupled with his white hair and glasses, he began to be revered as ‘The White Enforcer’. You can’t hear it, but today, just like every other day, he’s screaming inside, saying, “Please don’t respect someone like me!!”

title: Don’t Tame the Tomboy
summary: “I’d rather not marry than lower my eyes!” Katya, the notorious villainess from the southern region, declares her opposition to marriage! The Duke sets up an intense showdown with his daughter, who rejects every suitor that comes her way. Caught in a crisis of being forced into marriage with the scoundrel Petrozsky, Katya decides to make her escape. During her escape, she ends up spending an unexpected night with a man she encounters… He turns out to be the tyrant Grand Duke Nikolai de Vasily. “At the moment you stood in my way, I couldn’t breathe.” “Well, then why don’t you visit the asylum, sir?” “For someone like me, a madman, you need to be at least as crazy to control me.” “Are you looking for… a bride or a caretaker?” “With you, I think both are possible.” In her attempt to avoid one madman, she becomes entangled with an even crazier one! Is this a choice based on reality? “If I ask for a divorce, you’ll kill me.” “What do I have to gain by doing that?” “I don’t know… A sense of conquest?” “I’d like you to conquer me a little.” “Obedient wife, doting mother, that sort of thing, I’ve had enough of that in this life.” “I like you just the way you are. Does that answer your question?” Don’t tame the tomboy. She’s pretty enough the way she is.

title: Soft and Delicate Girl from the ’80s Marries a Military Officer
summary: Lin Yiqing grew up in an orphanage. After finally graduating from college and landing an internship, she never expected her life to end so suddenly—an unforeseen death cut everything short. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself in the body of a poor, timid orphan girl in the 1980s. As if that weren’t enough, she even carried an arranged marriage contract on her shoulders…

title: His Xiao Qingmei is Super Fierce
summary: "Young Master, Miss Yi has arrived." "Unleash the dogs," Tan Mobai said nonchalantly. "Bastard, do you want to fight again?" Yi Qianqian rolled up her sleeves, looking aggressive. "One-on-one." Childhood sweethearts, innocently inseparable, yet they couldn't stand each other but were engaged. One day, Yi Qianqian woke up and found herself in a certain man's embrace, crying, "Shameless!" Tan Mobai lazily opened his eyes, "Last night, you were drunk, mm... you should take responsibility for me."

title: This is How I Became a Chaebol
summary: I regressed to the era of romance. It was a time also known as the age of success, the age of ambition. I would seize control of everything from textiles, petroleum, machinery, shipbuilding, to automobiles. I would become not just a chaebol, but a legend...
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Slice of Life

title: On the Day When the Tagger Goes Blind
The God of Baseball Who Makes the Losing Team Win
summary: Yang Min-soo, a major leaguer considered the greatest Korean catcher of all time, was unable to win the championship alone. Frustrated, the god of baseball appeared before him. He accepted an old baseball and a system window appeared... [Quest: The Path to Becoming a Baseball God] [Will you accept? Y/N] Yang Min-soo became a manager with the system. The story of leading a failing team to victory begins!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Sports

title: The Play of Ming Dynasty
summary: Wang Xiaowen became a baby with his memories. His mother was his father’s second wife, and she kept on brainwashing him every day--”You have a bad brother who loves to show off. He’s the one who loves to seek the limelight around here.” “When he was born, he gave a message through a dream, causing your father to be very fond of him.” “In the beginning, your father named him ‘Yun’ after the word ‘auspicious cloud’ and even changed the name of the place where he lives to Jade Cloud Tower.” “Bah!” Wang Xiaowen, who was still breastfed, understood that his mother had taken the role of an evil stepmother being mean towards her stepson. His unlucky older brother was named Wang Yun! Forget it. No matter what, she was his mother, so of course he would help her mother and not listen to reason! * Not long after, Wang Xiaowen heard his father introducing him to his unlucky brother, who had just returned home, while carrying him, “Shouren, this is your little brother.” Wang Xiaowen, “?????” Wait a minute, wasn’t his brother named Wang Yun?!

title: Pet Simulator
summary: Wang Ye transmigrated to a world of summoning pet monsters and made a contract with an ordinary little green sparrow as his pet monster. To his surprise, he awakened the Pet Simulator talent that allowed him to evolve his pet monster through simulations. The pet monster would evolve based on the ultimate evolution form set by its master. [0 years old. Little green sparrow was born. It practiced flying on a cliff. It encountered a strong current and dropped from the cliff. It was covered in wounds.] [1 year old. Little green sparrow learned how to fly after much hard work.] [2 years old. Little green sparrow saw a mysterious bird dancing in the air and sank into deep contemplation.] [5 years old. Little green sparrow got better at flying. It comprehended the skill of Sky Dancing.] [5.5 years old. Little green sparrow got bolder and attempted to learn how to swim. It plummeted into a spring from the cliff and drowned. It acquired the personality of Unstoppable Courage.] After the simulation ended, the pet monster could acquire either the skill or the personality it mastered during its life in the simulation. After going through a certain number of simulations, the pet monster had a chance of evolving into the predetermined ultimate evolution form. Wang Ye took a glance at his little green sparrow that was pecking away at rice. Without hesitation, he decided on its ultimate evolution form - the divine beast phoenix. His little green sparrow looked at him with a look of confusion.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Slice of Life, Xuanhuan

title: High Martiality: With One Hand, I Single-Handedly Repel Three Thousand Emperors!
summary: Martial arts reawaken across the world, ferocious beasts rampage, and countless races invade—each vying with humanity for dominance! At this chaotic dawn, the young Su Hong awakens his system, granting him peerless talent from the very beginning. C-level martial arts? One second to grasp it. Two seconds to master it. Three seconds to perfect it. SSS-level martial arts? One day to learn. Seven days to refine. One month to reach greatness. And that’s only the start. By defeating enemies, Su Hong earns martial arts points—points he can use to enhance his qi and blood, strengthen his bones, and forge a divine body. –1,000 martial arts value: qi and blood surge, stepping into the Warrior Realm. –1,000,000 martial arts value: divine body achieved, able to shake even the Emperor’s Dao-grade weapons! Thus begins Su Hong’s rise—one that will shake the world. Tianjiao: “Why is he learning my martial arts while fighting me? He’s already better at it than I am!” Monster: “Just one glance and he copies my techniques… What am I even supposed to do?” Emperor of All Nations: “I dedicated countless years to perfecting my imperial arts… and he masters them after ten exchanges?!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: Touch My Brother and You Die
summary: Get ready for the rip-roaring light novel that inspired a viral comic sensation! Two years after transmigrating into the fantasy BL novel Asterion of the Starry Blue Night, Rosalite—a minor character and the sister of the tragic male lead—learns that she is fated to repeat her life every time her brother dies. No matter how hard she tries, her brother, Rion, continues to attract toxic men and almost always perishes by the age of 20, whether by mu*der or by taking his own life, fating Rosalite to return to her 16-year-old body. After nearly two dozen attempts to get the timeline right, Rosalite has run out of patience for all these sleazy men: Touch My Brother and You Die!

title: I Became a God-Tier Newbie in the Horror Story Gallery
summary: In this dark fantasy world, everyone only gets one life. But me? I’ve got infinite lives. The only problem is… until I figure out the rules behind these horror tales, I’m going to get beaten to hell over and over again.

title: Prince, You Are So Cheap
summary: “I can finally marry you,” he told her, with smile like peach blossom shining in the garden, the spring color just pales in comparison. But the man by the city gate tower keep yelling non-stop, “If you dare to marry him, I will make sure you die.” Yet, until the last moment she realized her heart had selected him from the start.

title: I Became a Cult Leader in a Game
summary: While enjoying a game called "Cult Leader Simulator," Kim Yeon-su found himself trapped inside the game he was playing. He knew that this world was destined to perish...

title: Online Game: God-Tier Assasin, I Am The Shadow!
summary: [Online Game, Assassin, Game and Reality Merge] The mysterious game "Godforsaken" descends upon the world. Players can slay monsters to gain lifespan, and even consume lifespan to extract in-game abilities into the real world! Thus, the extraordinary arrives, and disasters sweep across Blue Planet! In his past life, Qin Feng, along with his sister Qin Xiaoyou, grew into one of the world's top 100 powerhouses. In the end, however, his stargazing sister gouged out his eyes, wanting to give his "Ancient God Eyes" as a gift to her idol... Reborn into this life, Qin Feng decides to walk his path alone! Sister? Let her rot! From that moment, a god-tier, invisible assassin was born. He is the Shadow, dancing with blades in the dark. In his hands, killing and death bloom like art… Surrounded by billions of corpses, he will eventually ascend to the divine throne! (Skills infinitely evolving: permanent invisibility, one-hit kill, 100x drop rate, slay gods with a single strike…)

title: Empress Return
summary: The year I first ascended the throne. A soul from another world, calling herself a strategy girl, appeared out of nowhere. She seized my body and filled the Imperial Harem. Obsessed, she stared at one handsome face after another. She sneered, "What's the point of being a Female Emperor? Conquering the world is nothing compared to conquering men." She used my identity to humble herself. She fawned over the men, showering them with care, displaying every manner of sycophantic disgrace. Until her strategy ended in failure. I opened my eyes. The Little Eunuch came rushing in to report, "Your Majesty, Zhou Shiqing and Liu Shiqing are quarreling again. Please go and comfort them." "Kill them." "Y-Your Majesty, what did you say?" "Zhou Shan and Liu Feizhi, grant them death." Barefoot, I stepped out from behind the pale yellow bed curtains, my gaze coldly sweeping over the room. "And you."

title: The Prince of the World
summary: A history graduate student Yan Li has transmigrated into a martial world where only the strong ones survive! Chaos Scroll! Bloody Demon Sword See how he goes through the enemies bodies to become the real king of the world!
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: The Academy Guard with a Terminal Illness
summary: No special abilities, no connections, no money. Just an ordinary academy guard. To make matters worse, I’ve even been diagnosed as terminally ill. But then, after a few casual conversations with some of the outcast students, their gazes toward me started to feel... unusual.

title: The Well-Behaved Little Green Tea
summary: Age Gap / The Aloof Beauty Breaks His Composure / Both Leads are virg*ns, Sweet and Pampering A "Green Tea" Drama Queen VS A Noble and Abstinent Crown Prince Posing as a little maidservant was a stopgap measure Jiang Zhuoying came up with in a moment of desperation. As the second young lady of the Guogong Fu, her father and younger brother had gone missing under mysterious circumstances, and her mother had passed away. To uncover the truth, she had no choice but to do everything in her power to get close to the current Second Prince. The Second Prince was ten years her senior, stayed away from the imperial court, and had a cold and indifferent personality. Jiang Zhuoying finally managed to find out that he liked obedient and delicate women. From then on, the pampered and beautiful her transformed into a delicate maidservant, as fragile as a willow in the wind, who would faint at the drop of a hat and sprain her ankle from time to time. "This servant feels dizzy and can't stand steady..." "This servant will listen to whatever Your Highness says..." "Second Prince-gege, why are you so good to this servant?" ... Until one day: The man, his face cold, pinned her against the corner of a wall. "How much longer do you intend to play this maidservant?" The young woman was shocked. Thinking her identity had been exposed, she was too anxious to speak. But the man leaned in and covered her tender lips. "Xie Ling, Zhao Xiping, Gu Yanqing..." The young woman trembled, weakly hiding in the corner. The man's eyes sharpened. "They were all acceptable, but what about me?" Having uncovered the truth, Jiang Zhuoying dared not stay any longer. She found an excuse and staged a "Death Escape" to return to the Guogong Fu. Just as she was in the midst of seeking revenge and dealing with her enemies, she unexpectedly received an imperial edict for her marriage. On their wedding night, the formerly idle and incompetent Second Prince had become the current Crown Prince— The man's expression was grim as he pressed her down on the large, red wedding bed. "Ah Zhuo, you truly have your methods." Jiang Zhuoying's eyes filled with tears. "...Sob, sob, sob, what you said back then about liking me, does that not count anymore?" [Male Lead's Perspective] At first, Qi Fan was cold and distant toward her, but his hardened heart was eventually captured by the beautiful and attentive little maidservant. The master-servant relationship gradually transformed... "I have been away from the court for a long time. I am not worthy of being called 'Your Highness'." An idea struck the young woman, and she cautiously softened her voice. "Second Prince-gege?" Just when he thought he had finally obtained his own precious pearl. The news of the young woman's death left him heartbroken and utterly devastated. Until he saw a certain someone in a teahouse in the city, chatting with other men and laughing so hard she swayed like a flower in the wind... Reading Guide: Female Lead's Perspective: Marriage before love Male Lead's Perspective: "Forcible seizure" A ten-year age gap, an old house catching fire. In the early stages, the female lead baits the male lead until he's hooked. In the later stages, the pampered female lead becomes strictly managed by her husband. Note: This is a completely fictional setting.
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: You Are My… Natural Mosquito Killer
summary: “You are, after all, the goods that I booked for myself more than ten years ago.”

title: Top Star with a Face that Makes Wishes Come True
summary: I made a wish to save my little brother. It says that in order to make my wish come true, I have to pay a price. But the system made me an actor. However, everyone calls me a genius. Why?

title: My Name Is Namikaze Naruto
summary: Is the strongest jutsu really "Talk no Jutsu"? Is there truly passion and sunshine in the world? A peaceful world of mutual understanding? No! This world needs change! Power is the only way to achieve peace. "Let the world begin to feel pain now!" Standing atop the peak, Naruto looked at the Allied Shinobi Forces in front of him and sneered.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: Staying in the Mountain Village as a Divine Doctor
summary: After graduating from university with a degree in Traditional Chinese Medicine, Su Xia is framed and forced to resign from her hospital job. Originally planning to return home to inherit her family’s herbal medicine shop, she unexpectedly obtains a Divine Doctor System. From then on, her life changes completely. Patient A: “I refuse to accept going bald at such a young age! Sister, please save me!” Su Xia: “Let me take a look… this will require several uses of a specially formulated shampoo.” Patient B: “Help! How can I lose weight easily while still eating and drinking freely?!” Su Xia: “Friend, have you considered medicinal baths, massage, and acupuncture?” Patient C: “My neck is ruined from office work—Divine Doctor, please save me!” Su Xia: “…crack… snap…” Using her medical skills and system, Su Xia treats all kinds of strange patients while building her reputation as a miraculous doctor in a quiet mountain village.
genres: Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Sword Among Us
summary: When he returned to the World of Martial Arts, the game was filled with blood and battles! Chen Kaixin had chased after the footsteps of the one emperor, two empresses, three princes, seven dukes, and thirteen aces for three years, but during the eve of the Sword Among Us tournament in Mount Hua, he was ambushed by evil bastards, and was killed so much that his level dropped to that of a newbie. He completely lost the chance to join the ranks of the powerful players in the game! In great disappointment, Kaixin quit the game and got drunk so that he could forget his sadness, but during that stormy night, Chen Kaixin found that he had actually dreamed for a total of three years, because when he woke up again, he woke up to three years ago, when he was still a student.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: The Art Student Yosuga Tsukinami ‘s Ghost Stories
summary: The story revolves around Yosuga Tsukinami, a talented art student with the unique ability to see and interact with spirits. She uses her abilities to help those around her who are troubled by supernatural occurrences. Yosuga is joined by Ashiya Keisuke, another student who becomes her assistant after being saved by her from a ghostly encounter. Together, they face various eerie and mysterious events, solving supernatural problems and uncovering the secrets behind them.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Horror, Mature, Mystery, Psychological, School Life, Slice of Life

title: An Isekai You Can’t Leave Unless ◯◯
summary: There was a bottom-of-the-barrel wannabe novelist who completely rejects sword and magic fantasies. At the edge of despair, he was summoned to an unfamiliar locked room. With the words “A Room You Can’t Leave Unless “, in front of him stands a beauty who pursues him. [There’s no way a world like this exists!] What awaits him as he reaches for “something” beyond his perversion and apprehension is heaven, or perhaps, was it hell?

title: The Lady Who Divines Fate Fell in Love with the Prince
summary: To predict the future of the Kingdom of Valdia, Serena divines the marriage prospects of the prince one after another. Yet no matter which lady she examines, the stars always indicate “ruin.” Whispers begin to spread through the royal palace, suggesting that “Serena might be the one preventing the prince’s marriage.” Amidst this, when the marquis’s daughter Isabella visits requesting a star reading, she turns the tables and asks Serena, “Divine your own love.” Confused, Serena proceeds to read her own fate—and then…

title: One Skill Point Per Second! I Turn the Fireball Into a Forbidden Spell
summary: The abyss is coming, and the Blue Star changes! This is an era of professionals. Everyone can acquire the first skill in life and become a professional when they reach adulthood! Lin Yi obtained the fireball technique and became an ordinary magician. At the same time, an SSS-level talent was awakened: Gift of the Gods! Effect: You can gain 1 skill point every second! Others can only get single digits of skill points to upgrade their skills in one copy. And Lin Yi can get one for free every second! 【Ding! After consuming 500 skill points, your fireball technique will be upgraded to: Level 2 Pyroblast Technique! 】 【Ding! Spend 2,000 skill points and your Pyroblast will be upgraded to: Level 3·Fire Storm! 】 … 【Ding! After consuming 100,000 skill points, your Flame Storm will be upgraded to: Level 7·Sky Flame Dragon Breath! 】 【Ding! Spending 1 million skill points, your supreme ascension will be: Ninth Level Forbidden Spell·Eight Desolate Heavenly Fall! 】 【Ding! Spend 10 million skill points, and your Eight Desolate Heavenly Fall will be upgraded to its ultimate form: Ancient Forbidden Curse·Burning the Sky and Boiling the Sea! 】 Then, ice system, wind system, thunder system, light system, dark system, space system, time system… Countless basic spells are in Lin Yi’s hands, and they can be upgraded into forbidden spells at the speed of light! A few years later, the Demon Lord of the Abyss came to Blue Star—— But he saw Lin Yi sitting on the throne of the Supreme Demon Palace, overlooking all living beings! Lin Yi: “How about you choose a way to die?”

title: If We Were Strangers
summary: Born into a wealthy and influential family, Mu Rong Qingyi accidentally rescues Ren Susu from a runaway horse at a riding club. This chance encounter sparks a romance between the aristocratic young man and the humble girl—was it fate or karma? After one night of passion, Mu Rong Qingyi leaves the country, forgetting about Ren Susu entirely for four long years. When they meet again four years later, she is on stage portraying the tragic character Zhu Yingtai in a performance, while he watches her from the audience, captivated by her still-beautiful face. This reunion reveals a shocking truth: they had a child together, who had to be sent away. The loss of their child awakens his feelings of love and guilt. Under his vow to stay by her side through life and death, they finally tie the knot. However, Ren Susu, born into a humble background, struggles to navigate her love for him with caution. The vast gap in social status and irreconcilable personality differences eventually lead to an irreversible tragedy. After seventeen years of separation and hardship, they journey through life’s trials, forever connected yet painfully apart.

title: Sword Emperor
summary: "Then what about now? Isn't our Shaolin the best now?" Without exception, the eyes of the young monks shone brightly. They thought that this time, they would surely hear the expected answer. And it was only natural, for Shaolin currently had the Four Divine Monks, who were shaking the martial world. And that wasn't all. There was also the Great Monk, Abbot Hye Jeong, known as a peerless master. But the moment the elder monk opened his mouth, the children's expressions froze. An unexpected, unforeseen name of a sect flowed from his lips. "Now, it is Qingcheng." And this came from an elder monk representing Shaolin. From the mouth of the Shaolin Abbot. "Currently, the Qingcheng Sect is the greatest."
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: Hunter’s Blade
summary: The Lawman Kingdom was located on the western border of the continent, and it was currently in a precarious situation — it was a time of darkness. Heretics were emerging endlessly, causing strife and chaos, and humans were in great danger. Devils were running rampant across the land. The so-called devils were creatures that fed on souls, and their hunger was insatiable. Correspondingly, in order to deal with these monsters, the devil hunting profession was formed. Shire and the other seven hunters gathered together. They were all here to chase after the Blade Devil. He was a cunning high-level devil, a devil god from hell. When he first entered the real world, he was severely weakened, and his power was incomplete. Taking advantage of his momentary weakness, the devil hunters immediately organized a strike force to attack him. He was chased into Twilight Forest by hunters. However, the devil was able to throw them off its trail, so the hunters had no choice but to expand their search range to prevent it from escaping. In their haste to do so, the devil hunters split them up. Danger is coming…
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Xuanhuan

title: Creating a Virtual World
summary: After transmigrating to a world similar to Earth, Jiang Qiao was approached by a former goddess—Ocean Blue. As Bluestar is also on the verge of collapse from invaders of other worlds, Jiang Qiao must find a way to save this one. With the ability to create a virtual game world, he creates the world of Sacred Souls. In order for this new world to grow, it has to devour other worlds. Thus, the greediest, most cunning, and horrible beings came into existence—Players.

title: The Story of How, After Highly Praising the Bento a Girl Classmate Shared with Me as “Delicious! Too Delicious!!”, Before I Knew It, I Got a Girlfriend
summary: It's really delicious, your bento. This is the story of how a girl classmate shared her bento with me and I kept saying "Delicious! Too Delicious"', before I knew it, I got a girlfriend.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Academy Storm: Beware of Handsome Men Arriving
summary: An aristocratic academy, a century-old prestigious school; gathering handsome men and beautiful women with diverse personalities. Calm on the surface, turbulent underneath, loving and fighting. Su Mu, regal like an emperor; An Yan, the Diviner; Qiao Yumo, who follows his own path. Each carries someone in their heart. For love and affection, this lifetime offers only one chance at love or protection. Whenever she drives, she inevitably crashes, yet mysteriously never gets into accidents. With golden hair and a red dress, her graceful figure steps into whose heart, step by step, and who does she place in her own heart? Who says parallel lines are the most terrifying? Clearly, intersecting lines are the most sorrowful—they meet once, only to drift apart forever.

title: When I Was Reincarnated, My Cute Childhood Friend Was a Younger Sister Who Died With Me. What Should I Do?
summary: A heartwarming, sisterly romantic comedy. It's a little awkward story about an ex-sister and an ex-brother who can't be together due to their ties of being an ex-sibling. I, Yukiya Ooyama, was killed in a bus accident on the way back from shopping with my sister Risa. When I came to realize, I was given another life as Yukia in a different world, which I guess is called reincarnation. Moreover, the memories of my previous life remain. I gave up when I couldn't help it, but there was at least one good thing while I’m there. It was my neighbor's daughter, who was born on the same day as me, she’s cute! I’m lucky to have this childhood friend! And so on and so forth, but then I was confronted with an unexpected fact ...

title: Marrying Up
summary: Zhang Zhixu was born with everything: an illustrious family background spanning centuries, enviable talents, and a career that rises steadily with every step. Yet, he found life to be very dull. It wasn’t until one day, when he unexpectedly faced an accident, that his soul entered the body of a woman. A woman who could not even recognize a single character, yet had the audacity to try climbing up to high ranks and transform into a phoenix. Chen Baoxiang traveled a thousand miles from the countryside to the capital, hoping to use her looks to marry into a wealthy family. She was greedy for wealth, flattering, stepping on others to climb higher, and opportunistic. In the end, no matter what methods she used, she still couldn’t win the heart of the man she desired. “Do as I say, and I’ll ensure you soar to the top.” This is the story of a noble-born man’s soul transferring into the body of a money-hungry woman, sharing her body, and helping her rise in status.

title: Help, We’re Not Going to Grow Old Together, Are We?
summary: When the slap came, the first thing she smelled was a fragrance. Secret crush from the male lead’s side / HE Qin Yuan transmigrated into an Early-era Male Protagonist Revenge and Rise Power Fantasy Novel. The original book was about the male protagonist, Li Yue, and how he went from a bullied, pitiful boy in high school to the head of a Trillion-dollar conglomerate, eventually topping the Rich List. The book also had a cannon fodder female supporting character who, relying on her family background, bullied Li Yue during their school days and later dedicated herself to tripping him up. The vicious female supporting character was beautiful but brainless, and in the end, she was so resentful that she even tried to hire someone to run him over. Of course, the protagonist retaliated, sending her to Southeast Asia, where she met a miserable end. This vicious female supporting character was named Qin Yuan. And now, Qin Yuan was this vicious female supporting character. Fate really knows how to screw with people. What should she do, having transmigrated as the vicious female supporting character who was destined to die sooner or later? She decided to live life on her own terms. Counting the long string of digits in her bank account balance, Qin Yuan grinned. Now that she was finally rich and powerful, of course she had to enjoy it to the fullest! She no longer maliciously provoked Li Yue, or even paid him any attention, hoping to gradually exit his life. But for some reason, every time she slapped someone, Li Yue happened to see it. Perhaps she could never shed this image of a vicious female supporting character. Qin Yuan decided to stay far away from him. After graduating from high school, she went abroad, distancing herself from all the people and events of the original novel. She had a blast, living a carefree and stylish life. Years later, a friend invited her back to the country. Qin Yuan thought, So many years have passed, Li Yue must have forgotten about me, right? Just as she returned to her homeland, Qin Yuan was kidnapped. When Li Yue saw the girl he had been thinking about day and night, blindfolded and tied to a chair, his heart shattered. With trembling hands, he knelt on one knee to untie her ropes. The moment the blindfold slipped off, before Qin Yuan could even see who her rescuer was, she was both furious and startled. She raised her hand and slapped him. Then she heard Li Yue let out a soft “Ah.” It was definitely not a sound of pain. It carried a hint of a hidden gasp, as if the slap had felt incredibly good to him. Qin Yuan: …
genres: Drama, Mature, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: Super Dragon Slaughtering System
summary: In the mainland of the dragon, humans can also cultivate. But even if human beings are stronge, they will still be suppressed by the dragons. The true ruler of the mainland is the Dragon! Ning Qi was a young mafia boss on the earth, but was betrayed by his most competent subordinate who pushed him down the cliff. When he woke up, he found himself located in the dragon's continent and became the 13th son of Champion Duke of Qin Tang empire. At the same time, the super dragon slaughtering system was also activated, which changed his fate. Who are Ning Qi’s biological parents? Where are they? On this continent, how is Ning Qi’s past-life identity amazing?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mature, Xuanhuan

title: I’m Heavy Too, but She’s Honestly Way Too Heavy
summary: It seems she bought not just my heart, but my body too, a long time ago… Karumi Kei is an ordinary high school boy from a poor family who spends his days working part-time at a small café. There, he meets Kujouji Satsuki, the café owner’s granddaughter and a familiar regular. Before he knows it, the two slip into a romantic relationship. Unsure how to act as a boyfriend, Kei does his best in his own clumsy way. But it turns out everything is already unfolding in the palm of Satsuki’s hand. Hiding the fact that he’s a heavy man himself, Kei gradually sinks deeper into the overwhelming weight of her love.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life

title: Chitra
summary: I spent years preparing for the civil service exam. But I can't believe I died so unfairly...! Maybe that's why? I was reborn as a beautiful countess. I even got the ability to play games from the God of Beauty. "Drawing..?" Yes, I have the ability to draw for characters. I have become the apostle of the God of Beauty and benefited the world widely by drawing out ultra rare characters. [Rare!] [Super Duper Ultra Special Rare!!!] Let's fill the world with handsome men to benefit all the women!

title: I Became the Hidden Mastermind
summary: Ghost stories, curses, female students… Things I should have nothing to do with became obsessed with me.
genres: Completed, Action, Fantasy, Harem, Horror, School Life

title: I Have a Girlfriend in Marvel
summary: Su Ye travels to the Marvel universe and gains a card-drawing system. Draws Gwen, and he becomes Spider-Man. Draws Catwoman, and he becomes Batman. Draws Wanda, and he becomes Vision. …… Draws Mera... Later, he also obtains the Zanpakuto "Shinsō," hosts the Nine-Tails (Kurama) within him, gains a rubber body, learns the "Kamehameha" technique, and receives the "Pegasus Cloth"...

title: Expired Old Love
summary: I fell in love with a poor boy, but later broke up with him because he was poor. Years later, he became successful and famous, while I, serving food, accidentally stained his girlfriend's bag. The young girlfriend sneered, "Do you recognize this bag? Can you afford to compensate for it?" I smiled and handed her my own bag: "A limited edition Birkin, three times the price of yours. Is it alright if I compensate you with this?"
genres: Comedy, Drama, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Kyūkei-san Wanna Take a Break!
summary: The protagonist, Kagami Tamae, is an office worker who sleeps a little better than other people. Also known as 『Kyūkei-san』 When she woke up after suddenly fell asleep in a chair, she saw a strange screen. 『Please input your level』 Just for fun, she typed in「9k」which means 9000. When the enter button was clicked, it was ...... what a surprise to see that she was reincarnated directly into another world. Her appearance is so blue with a pair of horns, she has turned into the strongest demon lord with a human heart, making her confused, however, she was lucky enough to meet some girls by chance and became friends with them, and today she is continuing to make more friends as an ally of humanity.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: I Possessed a Friend’s Account Who Is a Veteran of Dark Fantasy
summary: Deep Dark Fantasy. It’s a highly villainous game where having multiple rounds is the norm. This was a game my friend who I went to the military with would play every day. I only had vague knowledge about the game. “…. Isn’t that Jung Seung-min’s character?.” The problem was that I was somehow stuck in the game. And not just any character, but my friend’s highly experienced character who had been reset

title: The Sixteen-Year-Old Rimbaud’s Happy Ending Plan
summary: Main Story Summary Title: Sixteen-Year-Old Rimbaud's Happy Ending Plan Status: The Berlin and Daily Life arcs are complete; the Spain arc is in preparation. Updates are irregular. Synopsis: "I am Rimbaud, a 007-style, year-round, non-stop Singularity. Ever since I physically merged with my friend Verlaine, I'm no longer cold or tired. Continuously using my ability on myself every second of every minute keeps me energized. I'm confident I can keep Paul going for another 100 years without stopping! But then, with a blink of an eye, the scene changed. That's not important, though. What's important is this person right in front of me, who just hatched from a culture tank—my friend!!! And then, my girlfriend next door—Fumizuki Sakuya—comes into my room through the window. Sakuya is my classmate and was once a witch who fought against me as an enemy in another world. She still holds a grudge over losing to me and continues to antagonize me. My wish is to attain a peaceful everyday life. To achieve that, I must defeat her once more so that she won’t bother me again. I begin another battle with Sakuya—and in the process, I uncover her secrets and the true reason she came to see me. This is the story of how we, who had the worst possible first meeting in another world, come to experience the best of our youth.

title: Traveling With a Beautiful Girl (WN)
summary: Eat, talk, and fall in love with cute girls! I want to travel and get away from my hectic life! What if you could fulfill that wish with the most beautiful girl in your class? Kakeru Takahashi, a high school student in Tokyo, is tired with his crammed everyday life and decides to take a trip. When he arrived at the station platform, he encountered his classmate, Riho Nanase. Seeing her in a state of deep thought, Kakeru says, “Let’s go on a trip!” and then, he invites her to join him—— Even Nanase, who at first was in disbelief, takes off her usual iron mask and begins to enjoy herself to the fullest, dusting off her footbath and tucking into the local delicacies. “I’m not having fun!” “I think I liked the sunset.” “Thank you for taking me on this journey.” A travel romantic comedy with 120% liberating feeling, spun with a beautiful coup de grace girl with a strange history!

title: Cheerful Girl Group Maker
summary: I became the road manager for a 3rd-year failed girl group. I'm betting my salary and my entire being on this group making it big.

title: Gaining a Year of Power Daily, I Overwhelm Countless Geniuses
summary: My name is Song Zhong, and I have a talent for presiding over people’s ends. After his cultivation was plundered, Song Zhong obtained a peerless divine technique: one day of practice yields one year’s worth of power. “What? The Battle of Geniuses is only twenty days away, and I’m going to be disqualified?” Sorry, but in one day, I gain a year’s worth of strength! “What? Someone challenged me to a life-and-death duel in a hundred days?” Sorry, for me, a hundred days means a century of progress. I guess I’ll just have to prepare your funeral. “What? The opponent has an undying old monster backing them?” How many centuries of power could he possibly have? With my strength surging by a year every single day, I shall suppress the heavens and the myriad worlds!

title: I Run a Convenience Store in the Martial Arts World
summary: At the edge of Hubei Province lies a haunted bamboo forest. The Ghost Soul Grand Forest (鬼魂大森林). It's only been a few days since this place, where human footsteps had all but ceased, began to bustle with people. "Great Chef! Give me one bowl of lamian noodles!" "Medicine Sage! My younger sibling is sick, could you prepare some medicine? I heard you have Cold Relief Pills that reduce fever just by eating them!" "Great Hero! I'm so thirsty, could I have a cola please?" Great Chef, Medicine Sage, Great Hero, Reclusive Extraordinary Person, Hidden Master. All these titles refer to just one person. Ding-a-ling "Welcome!" That's me. Kim Jung-hyun, 28 years old, running a convenience store in the martial arts world. 'Today's income is looking good too~' It's been only a year since I crossed over to this martial arts world with my convenience store.

title: This Wasn’t in the Script, Duke!
summary: ‘Even in death, I’m still a side character!’ Five years into my career as a no-name actress, a stage accident led me straight into the casting call of a god-written romance fantasy novel. For the seventh time, no less, I’d landed the role of a maid; a role with neither romance nor a compelling story arc. Still, orders are orders. A side character’s duty is to prevent the leads from going off-script and ensure the story unfolds as planned. When the frustratingly naive female lead becomes unduly interested in some random extra... “What?! You didn’t know that knight prefers men, my lady?!” “Oh, really? I almost made a terrible mistake!” With my quick thinking, crisis averted! Another day, another incident-free performance. At this point, I’m practically a veteran professional among side characters. Content with these small victories, I was ready to nurture this female lead and send her off to marry the cold-hearted duke, as the story dictated… but then... “What happened to your hands? Is this how the Count’s household treats its servants?” “From now on, another maid will attend to Lady Travis’s bath. I don’t want your hands in the water.” “Eat your fill. This is prime veal.” Wait, this isn’t in the script! *** “Am I that intimidating?” Would it be easy? I looked at the sole Duke of the Empire. “I’m grateful for your kindness, Your Grace, but you are a nobleman and my employer.” “So you can’t be at ease with me?” “…That’s about right, isn’t it?” Oscar continued to avoid my gaze, silent for a long moment. Then, his usually relaxed lips pressed together, the full lower lip pushing out into a slight pout. Um… Is he… sulking? Could he be…?

title: After Blackening, I Lost My Memory
summary: I transmigrated as the vicious Female Supporting Character, living in constant fear for hundreds of years. When I woke up, it was two hundred years later. Two hundred years later, the Plot had completely collapsed. I had fallen into darkness, turned evil, and humiliated the unattainable Senior Brother hundreds and thousands of times. Senior Brother was hung naked from the beam, his body covered in miserable whip marks, white hair cascading down like a crumbling jade mountain. What a harmonious scene. I might as well just die...

title: Harry Potter: Platinum Dragon Wizard
summary: Dragon. In Western legends, dragons are seen as evil beings—symbols of greed and destruction. But beyond those darker meanings, dragons also stand for strength. That’s why he was named Draco. It was a wish for him to grow into a powerful wizard, one with the might of a dragon... His name is Draco. Draco Malfoy. This is the world of Harry Potter—but not quite.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: My Text-Based Cultivation Game
summary: My name is Yun Yang. Recently, I’ve become obsessed with a text-based cultivation game. I’ve been neglecting sleep and food just to level up. Although it’s just a game, it feels like I’m living a second life within it. I have family, friends, and even a childhood friend named Su Muxue. But in the end, it’s just a game. Until… until one day, I suddenly realized I possessed “superpowers”! And Su Muxue, my childhood friend from the game, actually appeared right in front of me! Only then did I realize—this game… is freaking real! ———————————————————————————— My name is Su Muxue. As an Empress, I have been reborn. I returned to when I was sixteen, just about to step into the world of cultivation. Since I’ve been reborn, I will make up for every regret and avenge every suffering from my past life! The first person on my list to damn is my childhood friend, Yun Yang—the man who entered the cultivation world with me and then kicked me into the abyss! However, in this life… Yun Yang seems a bit different?

title: The Lapis Lazuli Castle M*rders
summary: There exist in this world a set of six daggers that carry a terrible curse: the ability to inflict a death beyond time. Those under the daggers' curse shall reincarnate without end, never able to know happiness and always drawn to die once more by the dagger. This is the story of "Raine" and "Marie", two souls bound by the daggers' curse to kill one another, over and over again. France, 1243. Lapis Lazuli Castle is the name of an insignificant relay fort nestled away in a forest east of Carcassonne. Its ruler, Count Geoffroy, and his only daughter, Marie, are both believed to be insane. The root cause of their shared madness is the mysterious disappearance of Geoffroy's wife three years ago, which caused Geoffroy to grow detached from humanity and cast Marie into a deep depression. After three years of wandering in a state halfway to nonexistence, Marie works up the nerve to ask her chief bodyguard, Sir Raine, to investigate her mother's death, confiding that on the night of her mother's disappearance, she had witnessed something impossible. However, her investigation only prompts a new tragedy. The French-German border, 1916. As World War I rages on, Raine and Marie's latest reincarnations live the life of a sub-lieutenant in the French army and a medic with the Red Cross, respectively. The two lovers are reunited at the site of the Battle of Verdun, but no sooner have they met then Raine finds himself faced with a barrage of impossible circumstances. An enemy soldier's head suddenly vanishes, right before his eyes. One of his subordinates reports the same thing happening to an ally. Four more headless bodies vanish from a flooded bunker in the minute he looks away. These baffling events are a prelude to the return of their old tragedy. Northern Hokkaido, 1989. Kimiyo, age eighteen, is already dying, an inoperable tumor in her hypothalamus leaving her with less than a year to live. Refusing to despair in the face of her tragic circumstances, she spends her remaining days with her friends at "The Library at the End of the World", a private library so called due to its isolated nature. One day, a man named Kito approaches her out of the blue, regaling her with a story about a set of cursed daggers, knights in the 13th century, and the two of them being cursed, fated lovers. Naturally, Kimiyo is intensely skeptical, but the events that come next don't require her to believe in them. Arriving at the scene of these three tragedies is Snowy, an enigmatic figure of indeterminate gender who claims to be "a detective charged with managing the world's chaos".
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Historical, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: My Husband Hides His Beauty
summary: Halstead, the land where demons roam. As a demon hunter, a high-ranking lord has one secret. “I hear the face behind the mask is so ugly?” “Even demons will be afraid!” It’s the monstrous appearance of Lord Erden, hidden right below the mask! Everyone sympathizes with the lord’s wife Leticia, who married such a lord, but she also has a secret to hide- “I’m always grateful. This monster’s face must be disgusting and horrible, but he never shows it and does it so well. ” “Eh, what? Of course.” “Since your arrival, our land has developed remarkably. The demons are tied to their wives. That’s amazing. No matter how much you think about it, you’re too good for me. That’s why I have to divorce you myself!” Leticia, who was listening with a hazy face, was shocked. Divorce? But unlike her determined husband, Leticia had no intention of getting divorced! He wouldn’t either. The husband, known as a terrible monster, was actually a great beauty. Are you divorced now? The devil will cry and the trick + obsession will come.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance

title: Our Empress Has Changed
summary: Like a flower, she grew up seeing only peace and comfort. But flowers tend to wither when their environment changes. Unable to handle the cold-hearted emperor’s tyranny, she withered gradually. But the empress has changed overnight. Her shoulders were strong and wide like the sea. Her shoulder provided comfort. She had an appetite for food, eating dozens of serving without a care. What’s more, she goes to the emperor’s room alone without flinching, even going as far as sleeping with him.
