It’s shocking–she can even get rid of evil spirits in one go. The people of the empire wondered, Is she really our empress?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Build a Magic School in a Disaster World
summary: Ning Zhao tragically sacrificed her life saving her students, but was fortunately chosen by the management of the “All-Star Magic Academy” to become the rookie principal, poised to make a name for herself in another world and build a legendary magic academy. However, something went wrong during her journey— she accidentally stumbled into a book. A previously unfinished, dark, apocalyptic novel, reviled by readers for its incomprehensible, unfinished nature. The world of this novel will emerge with the eerie rusty sunrise in the sky, ushering in five different disasters: extreme cold as low as -150 degrees Celsius combined with blizzards, tidal waves powerful enough to swallow cities, scorching heat and volcanic eruptions that evaporate all rivers, devastating earthquakes accompanied by terrifying meteor showers, and hurricanes wrapped in acid rain that devour everything… And, all of this will restart again and again with the death of the heroine. Ning Zhao: This world is hopeless. Ning Zhao: …If you want to live, you’d better save it.

title: Second Life: This Time I Choose the Right Man
summary: In the first half of her life, Cui Yaoning was the envy of everyone. She was the legitimate daughter of the prestigious Cui clan of Qinghe. Spoiled and willful since childhood, she later married Pei Yu, the top scholar from an equally eminent aristocratic family, and was cherished beyond measure. Pei Yu had grown up with her as childhood sweethearts. They were deeply in love. On their wedding day, he promised her that he would never take concubines and would never have children by another woman in his lifetime. She believed he truly loved her. But when her father and brothers were falsely accused of treason, the very first thing he did was bring his mistress into their household. He said, "Ruiniang has a gentle temperament. She won’t compete with you. Even if she bears a child, the child will be raised under your name. No one will ever surpass you." Later, he said, “You can’t even tolerate one child? You truly disappoint me.” When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to the year she was fourteen. This time, at the Spring Banquet, as she looked at the many outstanding young men present, Cui Yaoning’s gaze passed directly over Pei Yu, who was looking at her full of expectation and was settled on that quiet and refined young man instead. Her voice was sweet yet domineering as she declared, "I choose him." He was the son of the Princess Royal of Jinyang. And also… Pei Yu’s legitimate elder cousin. Pei Yanshu was a young lord raised in a noble household. Elegant and aloof, as graceful as orchids and jade trees, he had engraved rules and discipline into his very bones since childhood. Throughout the capital, he was known as the model gentleman. Yet no one knew that from the moment he first saw his cousin’s fiancée, he had harbored secret desires for her. He never expected that one day, the bright moon in his heart would descend from the heavens and run toward him.

title: The Nine Cauldrons
summary: Emperor Zi Yu used 5 strikes of his axe to split mountains and unify everyone underneath the heavens. He partitioned the land into 9 areas, thus establishing the Nine Cauldrons which eventually became known as the 9 prefectures. When Emperor Zi Yu died, disputes unceasingly arose One thousand years later, a once in a generation genius, Heavenly Emperor of Qin Mountains was born. Able to split a one hundred meter river, equipped with his peerless martial prowess, he finally united the land under the heavens. However, when Heavenly Emperor of Qin Mountains died, chaos once again shrouded the land. Another one thousand years passed and no one was able to consolidate the nation. From contemporary society, great Chinese Martial Artist Teng Qingshan, unexpectedly arrived into this world.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Twelve Witches
summary: In the chaos of Yongqing, Su Lingxi orchestrated thrones and rebellions—a ruthless architect of power, branded a traitor by heaven. Exiled from Fu Yu, her memories faded over thirteen years, leaving only whispers of a life she once knew. When heaven’s pillar cracks, unleashing demons, she returns with mankind’s plea—and confronts the icy commander Ye Zhuxu. Their clashing silver bells ring with buried history; his storm-dark gaze hides a past she can’t recall. Now, as monsters hunt and her fractured truths resurface, Su Lingxi must choose: reclaim her ghostly legacy… or let both realms burn.

title: The Real Fake Heiress
summary: I am the True Heiress. On the day I came home, my so-called brother sneered at me: "I don't care about blood ties - someone as shabby as you couldn't possibly be my sister." He then shielded another exquisitely dressed girl behind him: "In my heart, Mingzhu is my only sister. Don't even think about competing with her for anything!" I was left speechless. "Hey - aren't you my younger brother? What are you getting so full of yourself for?" "Is it possible that you're actually the one who was switched at birth?"

title: Fairytale of Clowns
summary: There is an amusement park that is only open during the night. It is said that special invitations are handed out exclusively for specific guests. How is the amusement park still operating when there's hardly a single guest a day? "What's wrong with you these days? Are you sick? Had a mishap?" -An unlucky man "This is a service? If it is, then is the service freezing us to death?" -A woman infuriated because of her curiosity. "Even if you don't bring it up, I'm already like this." -And another one. This is the tale of these three people. Come see the dubious story unravel in this suspicious amusement park. We'll show you the sinister backstory of a beautiful fairytale and the unusual faces of the fine and gentle characters of the fairytale. Oh, of course, we can't miss out on the bizarre love stories, can we? Because this is a fairy tale.

title: C.S.O.
summary: The story focuses on Kuro Kanata. From the surface, he looks like an ordinary human, but he is actually a rare existence called a God Slayer. The God Slayer has the task of protecting the world from Fallen Gods that can appear at any time. Even so, he was still an ordinary school student who was not yet required to fight. It was during his school days that he started playing: The world's most popular VR game, Celestial Soul Online. In that world he not only experienced an extraordinary adventure, but he also married 3 people at once. How is his life after learning that the game world, is not an artificial world, but a parallel world that exists in legends?
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Zombies: Krypton Becomes Stronger With One-Click Hang-up in the Opening Game
summary: Due to an accident, Chen Xiu was transported into the zombie world and became a disciple of Maoshan. However, his talent and qualifications are ordinary, and it is challenging for him to achieve great things. Fortunately, the system started in time! Automatically unlock countless spaces with one click! One-click cultivation space, fully automatic cultivation, 24 hours of non-stop cultivation every day, reaching a new realm every second! One-click practice space, all skills are automatically maxed out, and you can practice a thousand top-level skills at the same time! One day to get started, two days to master, three days to achieve greatness, four days to achieve perfection... Is it difficult to practice Lightning Fist? Crush the Lightning King Shi Jian in ten days! Is it difficult to perfect the Maoshan formation? Sweep through Maoshan in one month, become a formation master, and enter the Tao with formation! That day, Maoshan was shaken! One-click alchemy space, one furnace of perfect elixir every five minutes, unlimited alchemy! Easily become the strongest alchemist in the cultivation world! It’s hard to find a pill! And all of this is practiced fully automatically! Not to mention, there will be one-click space breakthrough, one-click space synthesis, one-click space clone... Uncle Jiu: "I'm confused. How come I've never seen my junior brother practice, but he's about to ascend?"

title: Chronicles of an Extreme Yandere
summary: For your sake, I don’t care even if I’m to face against the entire world. The young girl’s extreme love obsession had already deeply hurt the young boy…. Years later, the boy had already grown up; he understood that he cannot face the other party’s feelings head on, so he chose to forget…. but little did he know about the kind of path that he walked on to, and what waited for him there, will be...
genres: Horror, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: After You Broke Off the Engagement, I Broke Through Twelve Realms in a Single Day!
summary: Bad news: Due to poor talent, he was humiliated by his fiancée who broke off the engagement. Good news: He obtained the Cause and Effect Reversal System, enjoying blessings first and repaying the debt later. In just one day, he broke through twelve realms and married his fiancée’s younger sister. Li Feng: "You were the one who proposed breaking off the engagement. Why are you crying now that I'm marrying your sister?"
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: If You Can Do It, Don’t Talk Nonsense [70s]
summary: In the post-apocalyptic world, powerful ability user Tong Nan unexpectedly traverses to Nanshan Village, where she is mistaken for the village's lunatic, Tong A'nan. To survive, she accepts her new identity. Seeing her idle and irresponsible father and brother, she gets infuriated. Without wasting words, she decides to beat them up first. A tough life doesn’t need too much explanation; just beat them up and be done with it. [Small Scene 1] Tong Laosan: In our family, my daughter is in charge! Tong Dazhuang: In our family, my sister’s word is the law! Tong A’nan stands to the side, holding a long stick, and nods in great satisfaction. [Small Scene 2] Tong A’nan uses advanced post-apocalyptic technology to achieve a dimensional reduction strike. Any piece of equipment she casually takes out is enough to shock the world. The nation's top scientific experts cling to her desperately and screams madly, "Boss, please take us with you!" Hostile forces from various countries hide in the corners, trembling, "Can’t afford to provoke her, can’t afford to provoke her..." The strongest soldier in the history of the special forces, a high-spirited soldier with eight-pack abs, proudly stands with his hands on his hips, "Hey, that’s my wife!"

title: Era Drama: Old Cao’s Dashing Life
summary: Transmigration to the Republic of China era to combine with film and television, becoming a smelly-footed patrolman. Here are the Seventh Master from the great manor, sweet dates from the hutong, little things from Yuxiang Garden, Bai Ling from the glorious era, Qin Huairu from the siheyuan, Chen Xueru from the small tavern, Brother Liu, Wu Jingzhong, and the waiter from spy dramas, and many more characters from era dramas. Watch Cao Weida play around in the combined film and television world, living a carefree and happy life.......

title: Hitting Up The Big Leagues with a Green Tea Personality
summary: Xia Bohe, a D-class actress struggling to make it big, wakes up to find herself transmigrated as a supporting character in a novel she's been reading. In this novel, the main character married a successful, wealthy and sexy CEO only to end up divorced with a ruined career and ultimately losing her life. With a second chance in life, Xia Bohe is not about to give up easily. But wait, what is this Goddess System with its beauty and acting skills? This can make things very interesting and fun as Xia Bohe navigates her way to success in her career and love life while getting rid of other pretentious cups of green tea in her path!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: A Cultivation Life Accompanied By A Beautiful Companion Is The Best
summary: The protagonist is accompanied by a captivating spirit companion, possessing an enchanting figure with ample bosom and slender legs. Immersed in the knowledge of countless books, he harnesses the power of wisdom to shape his destiny. With a unique physique, he exudes outward handsomeness while possessing inner refinement akin to Tang Sanzang. His mischievous junior sister constantly creates turmoil, while his reserved senior sister remains elusive. Amidst a string of unexpected events, he crosses paths with a saintess, leading to the blossoming of profound emotions. The queen of the demon clan finds herself captivated by his presence, and even the princess of the imperial dynasty relentlessly pursues his affection. Despite his aspirations to solely focus on the path of immortality, his own exceptional qualities make it a challenging endeavor.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Senior Who Crosses The Line
summary: Seo Haeju, a freshman at Korea University, has only one goal in life: to live safely, steadily, and for a long time. Nicknamed the “icon of misfortune,” she wants nothing more than to avoid risks at all costs. But then Jeong Taeheon, “the biggest risk in the business school,” shows up in front of her. Violence, gaming addiction, womanizer—the man carries every bad label imaginable. The red warning light blinks furiously, and Haeju hurriedly builds an unscalable wall between them. “One step closer, and you’d be within kissing distance. So go ahead and keep drawing that line all by yourself.” Not only does Taeheon climb over her wall, he grins down at her from the top. “Wait, did my junior just ghost me after using me?” “I’m not looking for a partner, so whether or not we date—let’s try a few times and see.” Then, like a bulldozer, he crashes straight through. “I’ll make an exception—just for you. I’ll be your fool, only yours.” Can Haeju really escape from this massive walking risk? A daring, full-length contemporary romance novel — Crossing the Line, Senpai.

title: Exchange Life
summary: My sister and I were reborn on the day our parents divorced. This time, she was the first to grab Mom's hand. "Mom, take me with you." Her voice trembled with suppressed excitement and anticipation. Was she trying to steal my life? I smiled, amused by her naivety. Following a weak and incompetent mother, clawing my way from a long-suffering stepdaughter to a woman of success... did she really think that journey was easy for me?
genres: Drama, Psychological, School Life, Slice of Life

title: I Became the Demon Lord’s Favorite Chef
summary: In this cursed world, "half-bloods" are treated as untouchables—the lowest of the low, despised and dehumanized simply for existing. And how do I know this so well? Because I've been reincarnated into the body of one. Struggling to survive amid the cruelty and discrimination that defines life for half-bloods, I was just barely getting by... Until one day—what?! The Demon Lord shows up out of nowhere?! W-Wait, My Lord! I’m not a bad person! Please… just try the food I made!!

title: I Will Make a Decision, Even If I Regret It
summary: Souji is a high school boy who is indecisive and can't make up his mind. Souji has two childhood friends who are good friends. Harumi and Shinya. The three of them have always been together since childhood. Until the graduation ceremony at junior high school, when Souji tries to confess his feelings to Harumi. ...... This is the story of how an indecisive BSS boy grows up through love.
genres: Completed, Drama, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: It’s My Life
summary: “It’s My Life.” This song, included on their 2000 comeback album, Crush, signaled a glorious comeback at a time when Bon Jovi was rumored to be “overdone” and “disbanding.” Will they become genius songwriters or lucrative businessmen? “Hey, let’s do both.”
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Sports, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: The Dishonest Son and The ‘Ghost’ Doctor Mother
summary: Yu Qingluo is a transmigrator previously known in the modern world for her marvelous medical skills and eccentric disposition. One day she transmigrates into the body of same name, a young girl who got pregnant after she was framed and abandoned cruelly by her own husband. The story follows Yu Qingluo and her son in their way to find a person. However, she suddenly again meets that cruel man from 6 years ago and decides to prepare to take her revenge. Except, that her plans goes awry as her son once again decides to misbehave…

title: The Gravekeeper of the Fallen Kingdom
summary: “Decaine,” the resting place of the heroes who saved the continent from the demonic race. Centuries have passed, and the heroes’ achievements have faded into obscurity, their traces slowly disappearing. Eventually, the kingdom falls once again to a demon invasion, and the last gravekeeper — the only one who honored the memory of the heroes — meets his end. But when he opens his eyes, he finds himself back in time — to the moment he first became a gravekeeper, before the kingdom’s downfall. [Your job has been set to ‘Gravekeeper’.] [You have acquired ‘Grave Eye] [You have acquired ‘Descent’] The souls of the graveyard begin to appear before his eyes. [Would you like to perform Descent?] And he becomes able to borrow the power of the souls. “Is this Decaine?” “Are you the Gravekeeper?” “I am a descendant of that hero.” From royal princes and high nobles, to saints of the continent, mercenary kings, and descendants of heroes — Powerful figures from all over the continent begin flocking to Decaine. “When you had forgotten all about it, why are you all coming now?” Even after the kingdom has fallen, the gravekeeper continues his struggle — to protect the kingdom once more.

title: I’ll Retire and Run a Snack Shop at the Academy
summary: Yujin, the strongest sage of the Hero’s Party and a grand mage who has reached the 6th Circle, once achieved the glorious feat of saving humanity. But one day he realized something: All that achievement and glory meant less than a single plate of the “Gimcheon Spicy Pork Stir-Fry” he missed from home. With that realization, he decided to leave everything behind. Hiding his past, Yujin moves to the countryside and opens a small snack shop in front of Demeter Academy. His goal is to recreate the beloved hometown restaurant “Gimbap Heaven.” However, the food he makes is anything but ordinary. With just one skewer of tteok-kkochi, even the student council president collapses, and it can supposedly defeat one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. And so begins the strange yet heartwarming business of the “Academy Snack Shop.”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Api di Bukit Menoreh
summary: Because the Pajang kingdom is approaching its end, There are a lot of rebellion to snatch the throne. Agung Sedayu, because his big brother is a figure in the pajang troops who fighting against the remnants follower of Arya penangsang who were conducting guerrilla. He was forced to change its nature from coward and weak to strong and brave. Follow his struggle to help panembahan senopati to establish Mataram Kingdom
genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance

title: My Ex-Husband And Younger Sister Are Getting Married
summary: "I really hope you get remarried, sis." Chloe intended to let her half-sister's words, who was about to marry her ex-husband, go in one ear and out the other as usual. But this time, she couldn’t. "Don’t tell me you still haven’t gotten over my fiancé?" "This is troublesome, Chloe." Because they had wounded Chloe’s pride. That’s why she spoke impulsively. "Sorry, but I’m seeing someone." It was a statement born purely out of spite. She thought it would be an obvious lie that would soon be exposed. Until that man sat beside her. "The handsome, capable, and younger man Chloe mentioned is me." Kaiden Verder kissed the hand intertwined with Chloe’s as he spoke. * * * The first time she held his hand, it was out of impulse. Every time she tried to draw a firm line, Kaiden kept stirring and shaking Chloe’s heart. She had sworn never to fall for love again. "Chloe, could you please love me?" Her once steadfast heart kept crumbling in front of this man.

title: Master’s Philia
summary: Tigaro was born into the Noros family, one of the three great noble families of the Kingdom of Shirsodi, and was spending happy days with his childhood friend, Aifietouka, and his kind mother, Tesia. One day, however, Tigaro is summoned by his father and discovers the true nature of the Noros family.
genres: Action, Adult, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, School Life

title: Match Point
summary: The most vulnerable moment in a tennis match is when you’re in the lead. Even when match points appear, anything can happen. Just as a soccer ball is round, a tennis ball is also round. After injuring his knee when he was young Gao Wen had to stop his young tennis career and he became just a normal office worker in China. But, fate didn’t abandon him, as he was reborn in a period before his injury, giving him a chance to dream again of becoming a professional tennis player. The only difference? This time he is armored with a system that is going to help him achieve his dream.
genres: Drama, School Life, Slice of Life, Sports

title: From Your Sincere Fan
summary: [To Actor Perry Humble] An anonymous fan letter was delivered to Perry, who moves from one minor role to another in small theaters. Claiming to be Perry's first fan, they express passionate affection and encouragement, and through a small coincidence, the two begin exchanging letters as "friends"... "I never thought anything was missing in my life, but whenever I see you, Perry, I realize my previous life was only half complete." "I'm not as great an actor as you admire me to be. Is that still okay?" A man with the same name as first love, an airplane pilot, awkward at talking about himself. While continuing to exchange letters of what might be curiosity or affection, Perry reunites with someone who kept her awake at night during childhood. "Humble, I—I don't hate you." "I know. You wouldn't have hated me." Never being the first to say what Perry actually wants to hear, "I made you suffer in this winter weather." "It's fine, I don't feel the cold much." How should this tenderness be defined? "That person asked to meet me today!" "If that man behaves rudely, please let me know." Between omitted truths and sincere feelings… will 'Yuan' say the words Perry wants to hear?

title: The Former Assassin Who Killed the Hero ~ A Second Life Beginning as an Unemployed Middle-Aged Man~
summary: After being abandoned by my parents, I was picked up by the boss of an organization involved in the assassination business and raised to become an assassin from a young age. Assassination is by no means an easy task, as it involves risking one's life and facing the possibility of death or being killed if one fails. As a hired killer engaged in this life-and-death trade, I have survived for over thirty years, continuing to kill people. The task assigned to me was the assassination of a hero—the most challenging assignment I have ever faced. Under the reward of being able to leave this assassination business behind, I took on the mission and successfully assassinated the hero. As promised, I was released from the boss, who acted as my foster parent and operated in the assassination business. However, I found myself in a state of tattered clothes, unkempt hair, and having only a meager amount of money, equivalent to a child's allowance. Moreover, having been focused solely on assassination since childhood... I have no social experience, and I am a middle-aged man nearing forty. No money, no home, no job. I was thrown into an outrageous situation, but in order to turn my incredibly harsh, gruesome, and hellish life into something meaningful, I made the decision to start my life anew.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Psychological, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Transmigrated into a Marquis Household as a Vicious Mother-in-law, I Backhanded the Heir Awake
summary: Jiang Wanning transmigrated into a novel. She became the mother of the s*um male lead—the notorious noble mother-in-law who aided the white lotus in tormenting the female protagonist. Recalling the frustration of not being able to slap anyone while reading the novel, Jiang Wanning rolled up her sleeves and delivered a resounding slap to her eldest son, who was begging to marry the white lotus as a secondary wife—*SMACK!* The eldest son was stunned: "Mother, you hit me?" Jiang Wanning: "Favoring concubines over your wife—this slap is exactly what you deserve!" "?" When her second son fished his junior sister out of the water, Jiang Wanning promptly gave him a slap—*SMACK!* The second son was dumbfounded: "Mother?" Jiang Wanning: "Who told you to abandon your pregnant wife to save another woman?! If this slap doesn’t wake you up, nothing will!" "?" Her youngest son eagerly led his new bride forward, introducing her, "Mother, Ah Wu is the girl who saved me on the battlefield..." Jiang Wanning delivered another merciless slap—*SMACK!* The youngest son was bewildered: "Mother?" Jiang Wanning: "You can’t even recognize your own savior? Blind as a bat—who else should I slap but you?!" "?" Late at night. The Marquis held the divorce papers, utterly perplexed. "Butler, I’ve never taken a concubine, had no junior sister, nor any savior... Why does my wife still want a divorce?" ---
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru
summary: Kimihiko Kimizuka has always found himself at the center of trouble and mystery. For as long as he can remember, he’s always been accidentally stumbling across mu*der cases, or handing mysterious attaché for him to deliver. When he met Siesta, a brilliant detective secretly battling an organization of pseudohumans, he couldn’t help but answer the call to become her assistant and embark on an epic worldwide journey. …That is, until a year ago. Now, he’s returned to a life that feels normal and dull by comparison, accepting that their adventure has ended. After all, the detective is already dead.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural

title: Bauhinia’s Decree
summary: The world embodies righteous energy, manifesting as graceful and fluid forms. Beneath lies the tapestry of rivers and peaks, while above soar the brilliant sun and celestial lights. Its majesty and splendor inspire awe in mortals, its vastness and richness reaching beyond the confines of darkness. Nurturing a righteous spirit, unbounded by distinctions of region, gender, or social standing. Nan Feng is his name, rising from the heap of the dead to be reborn anew. Wild and unbridled, yet never straying from the truth, he forges his own path through actions, and manifests a life resplendent with diverse hues through his abilities. The story begins with Bauhinia’s Decree......

title: One Vote for Goblin, One Vote for Dragon
summary: Cecile’s Diary (Common Tongue: phmrs cacla) is an essay written by ■■’s ■■■ Cecile, published in ▲▲▲ year. This work records, from a third-person perspective, the events Cecile experienced after beginning her career as a civil servant. Through this, it is regarded as a valuable historical source that vividly offers a glimpse into the turmoil and social climate of the Aurora Republic at the time. Part 1 of Cecile’s Diary was published in ■■■3, and Part 2 in ■■■4. However, despite the fact that the book is based on Cecile’s own writings, there is controversy over whether certain content was created or altered during the editing process. The original manuscript has been lost, and as a result, the debate is expected to continue for a long time.

title: You Have Guts!
summary: Having being plagued by same dream for the past six years, Chu Yanshen discovered a little boy who looked just like him out of the blue. It was only then did he, Chu Yanshen, learn that he had been deceived by the little lass six years ago…

title: Savage Castle
summary: "I have no intention of sharing my woman. It means that sharing a woman is not my taste." King Sibyl van Ricarlo. who left the throne due to his uncle's treason and went into hiding in the secluded and barren territory of Lugdun in Travasta. The pitiful and beautiful young lady who ens*aved him, Else von Roate. One rainy early summer, the young and frail only daughter of the lord, Else, got a beautiful boy from a s*ave trader who stopped by the castle. Not knowing that he was a boy King who had escaped from pursuit, Else gave him the name 'Ian' and fell in love with him endlessly. However, he... "Do you like me that much?" Her blood ran cold. Else looked at him with eyes that seemed as if they would collapse. "You have to come tonight too." It didn't matter anymore. She knew that she couldn't recover anymore. Else would never win his heart. He wouldn't love Else. Still... "You have to hold me tonight too." If it was a relationship with a set time limit, if it wasn't going to end soon, Else was determined to cling to him. She was going to take him by force. Then she thought she wouldn't have any regrets when she died. Even if she died giving birth to a child from a man she didn't even know. She thought she could live her life caressing what Ian had given her until it was worn out. "Who, who..." She didn't want to admit that the viridian eyes belonged to the man in her memories. "Don't you know who I really am?" It was a gentle question. He grabbed Else's chin, which was soaked in fear, and lifted it up. Else awkwardly faced him. "Don't you know who really I am?" She tried to push away that hand that was holding her chin, which had become even more mature and solid, was sharp as if it would cut her. Tears flowed ceaselessly every time she blinked. "Me, me..." "Kiss me." A monotonous command cut off Else's words. As Else, unable to keep her heavy body in check, began to collapse, a large hand came over and grabbed her again. 'Baby... Is it meaningful for you to look for your father now?' Else looked up at him. The child in her stomach seemed to be rolling its feet.

title: The Substitute Marriage Contract
summary: The ninth time I saw that marriage contract, Pei Linfeng was standing under the veranda, waiting for me to call off the engagement. In the previous eight lives, if I called it off, he would drop dead on the seventh day. If I married him, the one who died would be me. This time, I folded the marriage contract neatly and tucked it into my sleeve. I looked up at him and said: “I’ll go through with the wedding. But if anyone expects me to die in their place, I’ll send them to the afterlife first.”

title: Celestial Silver Spoon
summary: The tale unfolds with a banished daughter of the God of Wealth1, thrust into the mortal world. Alongside her, a dedicated disciple from Jiushan Yun Temple and a stunningly beautiful heiress of the Dragon Butterfly Gang take the stage. As battles rage between forces of light and darkness, old bonds are mercilessly shattered. Who will be left heartbroken? Who will be betrayed? As death looms and separations ensue, the urban landscape offers a unique perspective on their fates!

title: The Neighbor Smashed the Wall into My Home
summary: I was enjoying a leisurely weekend, surfing the internet on my sofa, when I came across a post: "Bought a new apartment, the property certificate says 130 square meters, but it feels way smaller. Why is that? Did they steal some of my space?" Someone kindly explained what 'shared area' means, but the poster didn't reply at all. Then a comment appeared: "If the place feels small, just smash the walls! Keep smashing and it'll get bigger! If you're lucky, you might even break into a fully furnished three-bedroom apartment!" The comment was clearly sarcastic, but the poster seemed to take it seriously and even liked it. I couldn't help but twitch my lips in disbelief-maybe they should smash their head instead? Just then, there was a loud "bang," and a hole suddenly appeared in the wall! A person holding an iron hammer stepped out of the hole and shouted sternly at me, "Who are you? Why are you in my home?!"
genres: Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Slice of Life

title: Young Commander’s Supernatural Sweetheart
summary: In the past life, Mu Qing Xin was an unknown citizen who met countless of s*umbags on blind dates. Once she transmigrated to the interstellar, she became a rich famous mentally handicapped daughter?! Sorry, her IQ is now online, and she is even more spoiled by the whole family. Space power awakens, changing the physique of a waste isn’t a dream, just that these monotonous and unpalatable nutrients cannot be tolerated. “Little sister, what delicious food are you making?” The three handsome brothers swallowed, waiting to be fed; “Baby, Dad has been working hard, send more food~” The famous commander expressed, what is solemn and dignity; “Miss Mu, welcome to our school.” The principal of the capital’s top college reminisced the delicious food, and his old face smiled like a chrysanthemum… The fragrance of the delicious food can improve cultivation and enhance abilities. There are consistent foodies and beautiful men gathering. A certain military commander, whose face is getting darker and darker, directly pack someone home, preparing to have a good talk!

title: I’ve Been Expelled From the Black Party and I’m Committing Immoral Acts With a “Carnivorous” Saint!
summary: He was a baggage carrier, a cook, a scout, and a tactical planner. Rocca, a young hunter boy steadily supporting the A-level adventurer party “Gold Water Lotus,” was suddenly fired from his job one day. On top of that, the adventurer’s guild gave him a bad reputation, which made it difficult for him to find a job after that. Rocca has no choice but to devote himself to his solo activities, but because he is always in the rearguard, he cannot complete subjugation quests on his own. So his focus is on collecting types of quests that take advantage of nature and the unique skill of “Life Sense.” But... “I’m still lonely by myself. I wish I had someone to talk to.” Sighing from the solitude and flatness of his life, which consists only of shuttling back and forth between the forest and the guild, Rocca is confronted by Clarice, a saint and one of the country’s heroes. She is a bit naughty and “carnivorous,” and the moment she sees Rocca, she falls in love with him.

title: The All-Powerful True Daughter Returns, Only to Find Her Family Living in a Doghouse
summary: The all-powerful goddess Xia Zhuozhuo returned home to acknowledge her family, only to discover they had been ruined and driven into bankruptcy. Father Xia was thrown into prison, Mother Xia lay gravely ill in bed, and her six Brothers were either crippled or completely broken. Meanwhile, the fake daughter of the family, upon sensing trouble, clung to another backer, abandoned them without hesitation, and even caused the family to be reduced to living in a doghouse. The world mocked the Xia family as stray dogs, trampled and humiliated by everyone. Yet with a single command from her, countless extraordinary figures from the Dark Division emerged, overturning the heavens themselves. Father Xia was released from prison, Madam Xia recovered her health, the crippled Big Brother was able to walk again, and under her guidance the other five Brothers each displayed their talents, rising to become giants of their respective fields. Still, some sneered that Xia Zhuozhuo was nothing more than a country-raised child bride—shabby and useless. But one by one, her disguises fell away. The genius Physician was her. The master of traditional painting was her. The queen of hackers was her. The mysterious film star was her. The leader of the Dark Division—also her! At that moment, the Empire’s Taizi (Crown Prince) shielded her within his arms. “Who dares say she is a country child bride? She is my, Si Shenxing’s, fiancée!” Xia Zhuozhuo glanced at him. “You’re not annulling the engagement anymore?” “Not a chance!” The little girl promised to him in a childhood betrothal was the white moonlight he had searched for tirelessly. Annul the marriage? Never. Even in death, he would not annul it.

title: Beastmen Rise, Cultivators Ascend
summary: Xu Wang, once the strongest rogue cultivator in the cultivation world, was ambushed and slain by immortals during her ascension. But instead of death, she awakens in a strange new era—the beast‑world—where towering beastmen roam. The first to greet her is a mighty white wolf, who gazes at her with devotion and asks: “Little female, I saved you. Will you be my mate?” Confused, Xu Wang thinks this must be some afterlife reward. Yet a system soon binds to her, revealing the truth: she has crossed into the beast‑world, and only by gathering beast‑husbands and harnessing their strength can she continue cultivating and one day take revenge on the upper realm. Xu Wang has no interest in romance, but the path to power is tempting. As she reluctantly accepts, she discovers that each beast‑husband carries a tragic past. Seeing their pain, Xu Wang softens. With quiet determination, she vows: “Enough. My beast‑husbands… I will cherish you.”

title: Did You Know That You Can Never Run away From the Final Boss and Your Childhood Friend?
summary: Why are you here? After all, I’m Mii-kun’s wife♡ Yuuki Miori has a childhood friend. Kazuha Shigure. She loves Yuuki so much, and her love has gone too far that she is sick. Yuuki is fed up with Kazuha’s erratic nature, who literally follows him to the restroom and wherever he travels, so when he enters high school, Trying to escape from her. It should have worked. Yuuki was sure that a rosy high school life was waiting for him. However, it soon came to an end. Yuuki’s hell begins here when Kazuha finds him and they end up enrolling in the same high school. Is there really a way to escape from the childhood friend? Or will Yuuki’s spirit be broken? Or perhaps, will there be growth and change for Kazuha? *This is not a horror story.*
genres: Completed, Adult, Comedy, Drama, Mature, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Tragedy

title: I Thought I Was Saving the School’s Princess, But Ended Up Having to Take Responsibility for Her Sick Twin Sister
summary: “Twins? That doesn't matter. Who cares if they’re twins?" Due to a conflict with an upperclassman, I was currently under suspension. Then, out of nowhere in the hallway after school, the academy's princess, Miki Tachibana, asked to exchange contact info with me. She’s a universally acknowledged beauty, a girl who’s completely out of reach for a troublemaker like me. Assuming it was some kind of mistake, I stopped by the men’s restroom on my way home. But there, I found her holding a mysterious gathering in front of a few male students. In the dim room, she smiled—but she didn’t look quite like the school princess everyone knew…

title: To Be With You
summary: That summer, cicadas buzzed loudly. During a student union interview, Ji Sixuan looked slyly at Qiao Yu, and with a sweet smile, announced publicly: "You are mine from now on." From then on, their love was entwined. Her smile surpassed the splendor of blooming flowers on the trees. Six years later, they met again. The two of them were playing a board game when Qiao Yu suddenly said, "Let's call a truce!" "Oh, how do we stop?" "According to historical precedent?" "What precedent?" "Marriage alliance." (Heqin - a term for marrying for peace between states) As he spoke, she saw a ring slowly slide onto her left ring finger. He spoke slowly, "What is the token of affection? A pair of silver rings." The things that can make me smile, are the soft daylight in the early morning, the gentle breeze in the afternoon, and your tender goodnight in the evening. The locust flowers outside the window are blooming perfectly, Every bit is your scent. --- Qiao Yu was actually very quiet and reserved, not the type to publicly display affection. But for Ji Sixuan, he did it anyway. He wore a very clean white shirt, sitting there, playing the guitar, and singing a folk song that wasn't like something he would sing... a folk song. The man she loved could be gentle and low-key, or he could stun the entire audience the moment he opened his mouth. "I keep you in my heart, engraved in my soul." He smiled and looked at her, his eyes full of her, and his heart was too. In that moment, Ji Sixuan burst into tears. Who was this man she was going to marry? How could there be such a good person in this world? She would forever remember that this wonderful, wonderful man invited her to keep a promise of a lifetime together on a day when spring was warm and flowers were blooming.

title: Anidatta Ore to Imoutodatta Onna
summary: A Pure and Creepy Story of a Celebrity Little Sister and Her Older Brother.

title: Bad∞End∞Night
summary: Bad∞End∞Night is a novel by Hitoshizuku-P, based on a series of Vocaloid songs, the NighT Series. The plot revolves around eight actors trapped in a never-ending play, seeking a way to escape.

title: COTE: Oreki Houtarou’s Strength-Supreme Classroom
summary: Oreki was admitted to an elite educational institution and placed in Class A. With his keen sense, he quickly understood what was different about this school. Just when he feels it might be troublesome, he awakens a system and he can get superpower rewards by completing tasks. Teleportation can allow him to go home and fall in love at any time, and transparency can eliminate his sense of existence. This life seems good and very energy efficient. Then he got telepathy. Sakayanagi Arisu: This school is so boring, but Oreki-san is very interesting. You can [play] with him. Horikita Suzune: Oreki, who doesn’t study at all, got higher scores than me. Sure enough, I didn’t work hard enough! I studied for 16 hours today. Karuizawa Kei: Houtarou, thank you for saving me when I was in junior high school. Please date me on the condition of marriage! Kushida Kikyo (regret): Clothes can’t retain fingerprints at all, so I just gave them away for free? ! (angry) “……” So even though you usually act serious, in the end, you are thinking about this?
genres: Drama, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, School Life, Sports, Supernatural

title: Wasteland Farming, Human Child Rearing Manual
summary: After transmigrating into a fetus and arriving in a globally mutated apocalyptic world, Zhao Xiaoxiu thought she had already hit rock bottom in terms of bad luck. Little did she expect that, upon waking up one day, her unreliable biological father would transform into a monster covered in tent**les. The monster mistook her for its own offspring and kept wanting to chop off its own tent**les to feed her. Its mind held only one thought: The child is so weak, so small, so pitiful! Feed her! Feed her! Three-year-old human child Zhao Xiaoxiu: "..." Smart people never create trouble for themselves, and a monster is still a dad! From then on, Zhao Xiaoxiu began her daily life of being carried by her monster dad while devouring meals. While others struggled to survive in dire circumstances, she and her monster dad busily planted melons and beans in their own territory, eating until their bellies were round. While others fought desperately against mutated flora and fauna, she and her monster dad amused themselves with monkeys and chased chickens in their self-cultivated farm, relaxing as if on vacation. As for mutated man-eating monsters? The three-year-old child raised her fists and violently pummeled them into submission! Then, somehow, they ended up establishing a chaotic neutral safe zone (more like a small shop for agricultural by-products). (This is a slice-of-life farming story about an ordinary human child and her eldritch elder dad striving to live well in a post-apocalyptic wasteland world. The female lead has no romantic pairing.)
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Graveyard Shift Dracula!
summary: Vampires can only go out at night, so he decided to work the graveyard shift at a convenience store in modern Japan!? Vampires are creatures that turn to ash if they are exposed to the light of the sun. He can only move around at night, but he’s actually been able to live quite comfortably in modern times. Why is that, you ask? That’s because there exists the concept of a “graveyard shift”. Toraki Yura is a vampire who lives in the modern age. He works at a convenience store in Ikebukuro (graveyard shift only), and lives in a semi-basement apartment that gets next to no sunlight (blackout curtains are a necessity). For the sake of going back to being human, he lives his life on the straight and narrow everyday. However, after saving a blond-haired beauty from a drunkard, he finds out that she is Sister Iris, a nun who found her calling in exterminating vampires! Moreover, his natural enemy ended up as an unwanted guest in his apartment!? What is going to happen to Toraki’s peaceful vampire life!? A slice-of-life fantasy brought to you by Wagahara Satoshi, author of the “Hataraku Maou-sama!” series!
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Silent Hill 2
summary: He received a letter from his beloved wife. A woman who had died three years ago. “I’ll be waiting for you in our ‘special place’.” Could Mary really be waiting in Silent Hill? In this town that holds far too many memories? There are many suspicious people there; including Maria, a mysterious woman who resembles his late wife. A red demon restlessly looms in the shadows. Can James discover the truth in Silent Hill? What message is his wife trying to send from beyond the grave? A novelization of the Silent Hill 2 video game.

title: Snowfall Decree
summary: On the day the Old Capital fell, the peach blossoms bloomed like blood. Clad in the wedding robes of an enemy consort, I sat within the bridal sedan chair bound for the State Preceptor's Manor. Everyone was waiting to see how I, the most neglected princess of a fallen nation, would be crushed by the man who was once my master.

title: God of Medicine
summary: A fateful encounter between ordinary surgeon Yoon Tae-sik and the visionary Blue Envelope Book of the medical immortal Hwa-tao. "With this, I can save more people!" With his insight into every patient, there's no illness he can't cure. With a divine scalpel in one hand and a divine needle in the other, the harmony of Eastern and Western medicine begins with him!

title: The Peremptory President: Stop Right There, Sugar
summary: She betrayed herself of her own accord in order to save her critically ill mother, but accidentally provoked a big shot—he was cold, abstinent and unfeeling, but went crazy only for her... She thought that his getting close to her was just another game of the rich, but he unexpectedly showered her with love and affection. Because of him, she finally mustered up courage to go all out and love again. However, it turned out that everything was less of a pleasure than she had imagined...

title: My Fiancé Cheated On Me, So I Had No Choice But To Break Off The Engagement
summary: At a night gala held for young aristocrats, my eyes chased one young girl surrounded by heaps of single men. Her name was Lulu Camell, and she was the second daughter of the Count of Camell, boasting radiant golden hair and emeralds for eyes. She was also Ruben Berner’s fiancée—my fiancée, two years younger than myself. An engagement is also a contract between two families, and the weight of breaking off a marriage instead of dissolving it is much heavier. For my part, I wanted to dissolve in the most peaceful way possible, but… I had no choice but to make up my mind.

title: My Wife Is Too Wild, the Rebellious Young Master Begs for Cuddles in Tears
summary: [Marriage first, love later + sweet love story + heroine trains her husband] [Fair-skinned and beautiful queen x rebellious self-strategy to win over the prince] To reclaim her company, Shen Qingci swiftly married Xi Xingye, the notorious heir of the Xi family. A three-year-old in Beijing could recount Xi Xingye's misdeeds. It's said that he once lost all eighteen of the Xi family's companies overnight and mortgaged over one hundred of his biological father's properties. He sent wreaths to his stepmother and tablets to his father, and kept fifteen dogs named after his enemies, whom he bossed around the house. So, on their first day, Xi Xingye naturally sneered at Shen Qingci and laid out eight rules for her. First, no physical contact. Second, no interference in his private life. ... And eighth, divorce after one year, leaving her empty-handed. Shen Qingci readily agreed. However, a year later, outside the Civil Affairs Bureau—the dandy young man had put away his flashy pink luxury car, donned Shen Qingci's favorite suit jacket, and rubbed his arms against her thighs. "Wife, I want to be intimate, just for a minute." "Wife, other people's wives care about their drinking, why don't you care about mine!" "Wife, you can beat me if I'm so excessive!" "Wife, I was wrong, I'll give you all my property, but don't divorce me, okay?"

title: The Strategist Knows Everything
summary: Kurei Yukito made a wish on the verge of dying. In his next life, he would like to become someone who can understand other people. However, the next time Yukito woke up, he had been reincarnated to a different world in the midst of war. Moreover, he was granted a cheat skill as a result of misunderstanding his last wish. He was picked up by the rebel Prince, worked as the go-between of messengers from other countries and did his best to talk to them despite his poor social skills. Yukito desperately lived in this different world in order to accomplish his dying wish. Nevertheless. In this world where wars are common, hints of war gradually crept up to Yukito…

title: I Transferred to a New School and Ended up in the Same Class as Three of My Ex-girlfriends
summary: Rukawa Aoto has had former girlfriends. In kindergarten, a promise with Kisaragi Noa, “When we grow up, let’s get married, okay?” In elementary school, a promise with Yozakura Koharu, “Will you be my husband in the future?” In junior high school, a promised to Onodera Himari, “Hey, can I always be next to Aoto?” In each of those times, he dated each of them, but they all ended in “natural extinction.” Aoto now has no girlfriends, and when he has to change schools for his parents’ reasons, he ends up with no friends. “My name is Rukawa Aoto. Nice to meet you.” This is the first time I introduce myself, the first time I meet my classmates. Nothing but nervousness, but first impressions are important. When I look up, my peaceful, peaceful school life begins. First, making friends — wait, Eh!!?? All three of my ex-girlfriends are in the same class! And they all seem to still “like” me! And what’s more, they were the top 3 cutest girls in the grade! “Because he’s my Aoto.” “He is my Aoto-kun.” “He’s my Aoto, after all.” From that day on, the three ex-girlfriends, who had ended up disappearing spontaneously, started a big love war to compete for Aoto–?!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: [The King’s Avatar] as a Game Planner, I Guide the Players
summary: Premise Ye Xiu is widely recognized as the “Glory Textbook,” one of the greatest players in the game’s history. However, at the start of the story, he is forced to retire from his professional team, Excellent Era, due to internal politics and commercial considerations. Left with nothing—no team, no account, and no place to stay—he takes a job at an internet café. A New Beginning At the internet café, using a newly created, unspecialized character named Lord Grim (with the weapon Myriad Manifestation Umbrella), Ye Xiu begins his climb from scratch on the new 10th Glory server. His deep understanding of game mechanics allows him to quickly dominate the leaderboards, attracting attention throughout the Glory community

title: Lin Xinyan Zong
summary: In one transaction, she was pregnant with an unfamiliar child. She was pregnant and married to a man who was bound to have a baby. I thought it was a transaction with their own minds at this time, but in this marriage, I entangled with affection that shouldn't be there. When she was pregnant in October, she woke up with a divorce agreement on the ground.
genres: Action, Adult, Drama, Fantasy, Mature, Romance, Slice of Life

title: My Beast Can’t Be a Demon God
summary: Beastmaster, but the spirit pet is a weed. [Ding! Congratulations to the host for awakening the world-saving system.] [Our ultimate goal is to kill the beastmaster named Zhou Lu in his cradle and save the entire world.] Zhou Lu: "???" [The spirit beast he trains will become a world-destroying demon god. All living things will wail beneath its vines. Please use all means to stop him.] Zhou Lu looked at the blade of grass fighting a bee. Weak, pitiful, and helpless. You call this a demon god?

title: Cult of the Sacred Runes
summary: The formless ancient world was infested with despicable demons. They hunted and feasted on mankind, keeping the human civilization constantly in a weak and suppressed state. During the first known year, a magical mountain descended into the world from the realm of the Gods. Carved on this enormous mountain was a message: ‘Heaven Prevails’… After the Grand Descent, a name that was given to the descending of the mountain, the Three Great Sages made their ways to Mystic Mountain where they learned to harvest what we now call magic, establishing the Mystic Cults and eighty-one sacred shrines to help aid mankind with the cult’s mystic powers against the eternal fight to the death with demons.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Xuanhuan

title: Unbridled Etiquette
summary: As the little princess of the Qinghe Group, Jiang Zhili grew up spoiled and doted on by her parents and two older brothers, molded into a bold and unrestrained character. Yet after hiding the Jiang family’s prestige to carve her own path in the entertainment industry, she had to temper her sharp edges, relying solely on her deceptively innocent and sweet face to win favor. Miraculously, she managed to thrive, achieving her desires and rising to prominence. However, when the boyfriend the public perceived as her pillar of support suddenly cheated, a torrent of misfortunes followed. This drove her to set her sights on Xiao Yannan—the decisive and formidable heir to the Desheng Group, who had recently returned to the country with formidable capital and a reputation no one dared challenge.

title: So You Have Loved Me Too
summary: She is the Ji family's prospective granddaughter-in-law. But on the day of her engagement, she meets a blindfolded man. From then on, she gets unknowingly blindfolded and sent to a mysterious location repeatedly. Finally, she gets pregnant one day. Her mind is thrown into chaos. She tries to get the baby aborted at the hospital, but she gets blindfolded again on the surgery table and is sent to him. When she finally sees his face, she becomes even more flustered, “Why is it you?” The man smiles at her gently, “Marry me. All those people who bullied you will now have to respect you." Ji Anning: “…” One fine day, Ji Anning touches her protruding belly as she asks Mr Ji with a look of dilemma, “Honey, what should the baby call you after it’s born?” Mr Ji: “…”

title: The Wind Heard Her Confession
summary: Synopsis: Lin Yuran never would have thought that the client sitting across from her, forcing them both to work together, was the high school classmate she had rejected long ago, Chi Ye. The two maintained a distant yet courteous relationship, keeping their distance as they worked together. However, Lin Yuran gradually felt something wasn't quite right. For example, why did this man insist on her working at his company instead of her own studio? And moreover, how come her office just so happened to be directly opposite his? Another instance, when Lin Yuran accepted a ride in another man's Rolls-Royce Phantom, Chi Ye only sighed, "I thought I'd never get to ride a luxury car like this in my life." The very next day, Chi Ye's car changed to a Bentley, then Bugatti, followed by Koenigsegg... Another time, Lin Yuran accidentally stumbled upon Chi Ye's Baidu profile and discovered that her favorite lollipop factory was registered under his name. But rumor had it that the factory closed five years ago, and that some mysterious big shot loved eating these lollipops, so he bought the factory and continued production regardless of profit or loss, no matter what the situation. Numerous clues led Lin Yuran to suspect— Chi Ye still liked her? Little did she know, even their second encounter was part of his plan. Yet Chi Ye remained unaware that on that sweltering afternoon six years ago, Lin Yuran had quietly watched his lonely figure from afar and murmured softly, "If we meet again someday, I hope I can respond to you." That year, only the wind heard her confession.

title: Sister’s Revenge
summary: I am the Concubine-born Daughter of the Prime Minister's Mansion. When the nation was in peril, as I fled for my life, I shared my rations with a beggar by the roadside, while my legitimate elder sister led our family to seek refuge with the general. Later, the beggar led an uprising and seized power, and I was made empress, honored as the mother of the nation. But my legitimate elder sister was reduced to a camp prostitute, forced to receive hundreds of men each day, living a fate worse than death. Living my life over again, my legitimate elder sister slapped the sesame cake from my hand and handed her exquisite pastries to the beggar: "Eat. If it's not enough, there's more here."

title: Aoharu Point
summary: People have "points". Everyone's lives are ruled by values or points based on various factors – looks, studying ability, and communication ability. Figures were floating above people's heads. For some reason, I kept seeing said/such points. For example, the figure hovering over the head of my classmate, Yui Kasuga, is 46. Considerably low points. She doesn't know how to read the mood and doesn't even have friends. In order to raise Kasuga's point, I end up getting involved with her–... Kasuga's rising points, and I who was supposed to have given up all hope on changing. This is the story of our "branching point" in life
genres: Completed, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Silent World
summary: Hadori Kento is a normal high school student whom can be found anywhere in the world, but "he" actually is not so normal. Kento holds a certain secret—he has the ability to accelerate himself to extraordinary speeds. Why he has this ability and for what he should use it, he himself does not know yet. Without finding the answer, he spends his life very peacefully... that is until he meets a person with the same ability. The person he meets is a serial slasher called "Silent Killer."

title: Manual for Using a Chaebol Lover
summary: “Let’s get married.” “You can’t mean… marriage as payment for saving your son?” “That’s about right.” Han Yeong-seo—born the black sheep of the Han family, forever branded the unwanted child. Despite her remarkable talent, endless obstacles and sabotage kept her from the spotlight, leaving her to scr*pe by as an unknown actress, doing odd jobs just to survive… Until one day, trapped in a hotel storage room, she saves a handsome little boy. Who would have guessed that this child’s father is none other than Yoo Si-hyuk—the illegitimate son of Korea’s top conglomerate, a man as famous for his chiseled, sculptural looks as for his icy demeanor! And with those cold eyes, he suddenly demands: Marry me, in exchange for saving my son. What kind of outrageous deal is that? Perfect from head to toe, yet hopeless when it comes to human relationships, Yoo Si-hyuk barges into her life. And from the moment Yeong-seo meets this complicated father-and-son pair, her world begins to change, little by little…

title: Scattered Immortal in a Chaotic World
summary: A gang leader got a strange stone by accident and was hunted down. He finally died in an atomic bomb attack, but unexpectedly traveled to the Nascent Soul in the Cultivation World. This Nascent Soul had failed its Tribulation Transcendence and was about to transform to cultivate as a Loose Immortal. Facing a completely unfamiliar domain, facing the legendary path of Loose Immortal cultivation said to have nine deaths and no survival, how would he walk this difficult road of immortal cultivation? How would he uncover the mystery of the tragic fate of Loose Immortals? How would he advance on the path to becoming a strong one...
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mature, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: The Relaxed Journey of the Bag Hero in Another World ~ Exiled from the Royal Castle as a Failed Hero and Dropped into the Abyss. But in reality, the bag can absorb anything and was a cheat weapon that could order anything from Japan. There’s no intention to go back even if they beg for forgiveness now.
summary: One day I, Keisuke Sakudaira, a high school student, was summoned to another world as the “Bag Hero”. However, I was expelled by the queen who summoned me because she said a bag wouldn’t be useful. Later, I was thrown into the most difficult dungeon where I thought I would die. But… “Huh, this bag can store both attacks and monsters!?” “Huh!? I can summon food and drinks as much as I want!?” Surprisingly, this bag… was a cheat. Freed from the task of defeating the Demon King, I embarked on a leisurely journey through this different world with this cheat bag in hand.

title: For Those Returning Bastards a Beating Is the Best Remedy
summary: "Those returnee bastards need a good beating. The higher-ups just don't get it." The absolute supreme ruler who commanded the world, the hero who saved it, the witch who schemed in the city's shadows. All those returnee bastards are ticking time bombs, but there's one key difference. Unlike bombs, they quiet down in the face of violence.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Tragedy

title: The Land of Shadows and Fire
summary: The Land of Shadows and Fire follows Im An, a courageous woman betrayed by her closest friend and thrust into a mysterious, magical realm. In this new world filled with danger, ancient powers, and dark secrets, she meets Jin, a skilled warrior with a painful past. Together, they battle the Shadow Army led by her betrayer, uncover hidden truths about their destinies, and fight to restore balance to the realm. Along the way, Im An learns the meaning of strength, forgiveness, and love, transforming from a victim of betrayal into a powerful force of hope and fire.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural

title: I Caged By Stranger
summary: Cheng Songsong was saved by a man in a fire ten years ago, but she thought the man was Ji Mengran who was lying in the hospital …… Because of the opposition of Ji Mengran’s family, they had a serious car accident on the way to elope, which turned Ji Mengran into a vegetable. She took all the blame and had to suffer humiliation from Ji’s family, living like a poor s*ave! “sl*t, b*tch, you hurt my second brother, and seduced my elderly brother! ” She is framed at the birthday party of Ji’s father, she woke up to find herself in someone else’s bed and took all the blame. She never imagined that the one who saved her life was the big brother Ji Jingcheng who wanted her to atone for her sins. ... “Jingcheng, brother, I love Songsong, please let her go. Don’t ever tell her the truth. Don’t ruin my hard-earned happiness, please!” The voice of Mengran suddenly echoed in the mind, Meng Jingcheng hesitated and shopped the kiss to Cheng Songsong. But, Meng Jingcheng was scared, he was afraid of losing control of his feeling if he continued to spend time with Songsong…… Tell her, he loves her; Tell her, the truth about that fire.

title: The Urban Legend Has Become Widespread
summary: "Do you know about the Patrolman?" This is a tale about a new urban legend that is born from a series of mysterious incidents. After 8 PM at night, while walking and looking at their smartphone, people are warned from behind that—"it's dangerous to walk and use your phone at the same time". However, when they turn around, there's no one there. The "Patrolman" urban legend says that if you ignore the warning and continue to look at your phone, someone will push you from behind at a pedestrian crossing when the traffic light is red. At first, it seemed like a common urban legend, but strange events kept happening to those who heard the story… This is the story of how a new urban legend is born.
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Horror, Psychological, School Life, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Doppelganger: Slept With A Man Who Resembled The Child’s Father
summary: Her boyfriend, Gong Suha, a soldier, died during an operation. About six years after giving birth and raising his child alone, Yeoreum met Gi Hyunjae— a man who looked strikingly like her late boyfriend. His appearance, his build, even his voice. He was, quite literally, Suha’s doppelgänger. “That’s right. I’ve just been pretending to be a good guy all this time to seduce you.” “Are you crying because I might kiss another woman? Even though you already have a husband and a child?” Although only his looks were the same, with a dirty personality and a cynical way of speaking that were the complete opposite of Suha… “I must be crazy too. What’s so pretty about a woman who cries because she can’t forget another man?” “……” “Do you want to try meeting me while thinking of me as Gong Suha? If you want, I could even be that kid’s father.” Every time Hyunjae came closer, Yeoreum found herself helplessly shaken and drawn to him. At times, traces of Suha overlapped with Hyunjae, and Yeoreum dismissed it as nothing more than a ridiculous coincidence. At least, until his memories returned.

title: I Am the Youngest Disciple of the Martial Arts World’s Mastermind
summary: Righteous sects and evil sects, dark path and light path. Even the demonic cult and martial arts alliance. The truth is, there’s actually a mastermind puppeteer controlling everything in the martial arts world from behind the scenes! Don’t believe it? Then where do you think all those miraculous elixirs and convenient coincidences come from when the protagonists need them? “Soso, did you place the Thousand-Year Earth Essence on the path for that Huashan disciple?” “Yes, Master!” “And did you set up the smoke for the Black King Mountain’s mechanism formation?” “Yes, Master!” It’s all been me, who became the martial arts mastermind’s disciple! Setting everything up! Diligently! Behind the scenes! *** “Your body is.” “Is it an Extreme Yin Constitution?” “No.” “Then, um, the opposite? An Extreme Yang Constitution?” “No. Soso, you are no-thing special. You just have internal energy like a pig.” What did you say? Oink oink? I’m just overflowing with an absurd amount of internal energy, so if I get caught by the demonic cult, they’ll devour me completely? That’s why Master rescued the original protagonist and future Heavenly Demon from being a s*ave of the demonic cult and took him as a disciple. But then he grew up so fast and. “You said you wouldn’t let me be alone.” This desirable martial hero, who’s now two spans taller than me. “I have feelings for you.” Oh my goodness!

title: Isekai Plastic Surgery: Battle in Progress
summary: A man for whom success was the only escape—Kang Min, a plastic surgery specialist. A single accident that occurred on the operating table sent him into another world where magic, souls, and flesh are all intertwined. In a world where healing is completed with a mere gesture, he becomes an anomaly who shapes “beauty” through incisions and sutures. A scalpel is more precise than a sword, and an incision more certain than any spell. His medical knowledge penetrates realms where magic cannot reach, dissecting “structures” even gods could not design. A new domain opens in this other world—belonging solely to Kang Min, who understands the human body. Neither a mage nor a knight. What is born from his fingertips—healing or injury? Combat is as cold and precise as surgery, survival as calculated as profit. On the boundary between healing and slaughter, can he always make the most efficient choice…?

title: Become God From Scratch
summary: Lin Xuan has started over. As a newborn, he became the weakest member of the family due to premature birth. His eldest sister, Lin Rou, is a martial arts prodigy with supernatural strength, His second brother, Lin Wu, is a genius mechanic with exceptional intelligence. And his third sister, Lin Long, is a mysterious scholar who can listen to all voices. But what about baby Lin Xuan? He is weak, helpless, and pitiful… Fortunately, shortly after birth, he discovered that he possessed an evolutionary panel that allowed him to infinitely grow through gaining experience: From [Nutritional Absorption] to the material-level [Absolute Devouring]. From [Tentative Steps] to transcending spacetime with [High-dimensional Travel]. From [Carbon-based Monkey] to immortal [Quantum Body]. … The clash between flesh and machinery, and the old world intertwines with the present! In this perilous world, Lin Xuan only wants to see where the limits of his evolution lie and enjoy the diverse scenery along the way.

title: Going to MMA Martial Arts World
summary: Geum-hyeon, the youngest of the Geumcheon Shopping Mall, dreams of becoming a gangster and has everything to envy. His life takes a major turn because of the name he jokingly wrote in the martial arts record. “No, no!” “The contract has already been made.” The condition for ending the forced contract is for him to become the best in the world! Under the guidance of legendary trainer Kim Jae-man, Geum-hyeon’s martial arts conquest begins!
genres: Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Mature, Mecha, Sports, Tragedy, Wuxia

title: After Being Told by My Fiancé That He Wanted Me to Become His Second Wife, I Lost My Temper and Punished Him With a Fist (Goo Punch). Afterwards, I Enrolled in a Magic School Located in the Royal Capital
summary: Misha, a viscount's daughter living in a snowy country, was suddenly told by her fiancé, "There is a child of mine in her womb." To her dismay, he had no intention of breaking off their engagement. Instead, he proposed making Misha his second wife, planning to pass the child off as the future viscount and even wanting to use their marriage funds for the child's education. Hearing this, Misha, who regained the memories of her previous life, punished her fiancé with a single punch and decided to cut ties with him. She had long admired a certain magic school and resolved to enroll there and make a life for herself. Though Misha managed to apply to the magic school, she couldn't avail of the scholarship program due to a past mishap caused by her uncle, who had also attended the school. As an ordinary magician, Misha almost gave up on attending the school, but an opportunity arose when a teacher from the pharmacology department offered to pay her tuition in exchange for managing the medicinal herbs used in class. Consequently, she was assigned to live in a cabin near the greenhouse where magical herbs were cultivated. Despite the school being fully residential, Misha began her life in a cabin without a housemother, taking care of her own cooking and laundry. Her eventful school life unfolded with visits from a supervisory student who was also a future grand duke, being adored by a tsundere duchess's daughter, and employing a rare gem slime. This marked the beginning of an exciting and enjoyable life at the magic school.

title: A Love Doomed to Die Anyway
summary: “Can you sleep with my fiancé?” The devil’s whisper was sweet— and Eun-hee, terminally ill and crushed under debt, chose to believe it was a hand of salvation.A purpose too obvious. A temptation too clear. Cha Young-hoon, a bastard with a polished exterior, finds himself—almost like charity—giving his heart to Eun-hee. “How far should we go?” But the one who decided how it would end was neither Young-hoon nor Eun-hee— it was Young-hoon’s fiancée, Mi-jung.A life destined to die anyway— there’s nothing to lose by throwing it away. “Let’s just live. I’m sorry, Eun-hee. None of it matters. Abandon me. And live. Please… just live…” At the very moment she resolved to die, everything she once thought meaningless began clinging to her for the first time.

title: Awaken the World with Formations
summary: Nie Wushuang was born on Tianling Star, as the illegitimate son of the Martial Warrior Clan. He married Zhang Xuanying, the legitimate daughter of the scholarly Zhang family. They built a small family that was not rich, but very happy. His mother's death and his wife's departure with an Immortal Master to embark on the path of cultivation shattered their once warm and cozy life. To find his beloved wife, Nie Wushuang, who had a Spirit Bone but lacked a Wisdom Root, threw himself wholeheartedly into cultivation. He hoped that one day, he would reunite with his wife. An unexpected soul intrusion gave Nie Wushuang the chance to step onto the Path of Immortality. Across the vast starry sky and the immense world, where was his beloved wife? During their journey to find her, what kind of magnificent epic would Nie Wushuang and his soul friend Luo Dong create?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Xianxia, Xuanhuan

title: The Good for Nothing Young Lady’s Otherworldly Domination
summary: “Girls from the Lin family were so beautiful that they were destined to be concubines of the powerful.” Recalling the last memories of this body, Lin Haoxue only felt hatred… Even if the He family was the most powerful family of the Wuhuan Empire, so what? I swear that if I don’t exterminate your He family, I, Lin Haoxue, am even lower than a demon beast! Therefore, the most powerful He family situated in the capital of Wuhuan Empire became the first challenging target of this twelve-year-old good-for-nothing Second Young Lady from an average family of Taixing town. Even without any profound power running in her veins, the adventure she had in Mount Bilu’s Falling Cloud Stream activated her eight elemental profound veins. Overnight she went from a having a garbage constitution to being a Middle-stage Profound Master realm cultivator, and since that fateful day, Lin Haoxue started down her journey of otherworldly domination!
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Martial Arts, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Doomsday Chat Group: Conquering the Multiverse Heroines
summary: In a world reminiscent of comic books, an enigmatic traveler journeys through unusual landscapes and encounters the intriguing Yotsuya Miko, who senses the world’s impending end. Concurrently, Yukino experiences an embarrassing incident while trying to call the police, which unexpectedly leads her to an invitation to join a mysterious “Doomsday Chat Group”. This marks the beginning of their collective struggle against the apocalypse. As the narrative progresses, Hayasaka Ai confronts a formidable demon, while Eriri faces a terrifying evil spirit. Yukinoshita Yukino finds herself entangled in a perilous doomsday game, further intensifying the challenges for the group. The Doomsday Chat Group also welcomes a determined new member, March 7, who is resolved to save the world from its impending doom. Each member of the Doomsday Chat Group brings unique abilities and complexities. Able Angel can invoke divine power, exclaiming, “In the name of the Divine! Let the barrage begin! Overload mode!”. Silver Wolf seeks refuge in gaming, often questioning hidden motives within the group. Nami desperately pleads for help, striving to survive, while Makima grapples with her identity and the enigmatic Ren Kazama, who casts doubt on the group’s solidarity. The fiery outburst from Tushan Yaya further heightens the tension, revealing underlying conflicts. This Doomsday Chat Group is more than just a random assembly; it’s a bond that will fundamentally alter their destinies. Filled with action, drama, and mystery, their journey promises unexpected twists and intense confrontations. Will they succeed in saving the world, or will the apocalypse spell the end of everything?
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: A Hero Who Wants to Help Others Wants to Live a Normal Life
summary: In modern times, where extreme wishes have begun to reach the gods, these wishes become a special power known as "Blessings." However, "Blessings" are not always positive; they are simply a manifestation of intense desires, with no regard for good or evil. After the emergence of "Blessings" in the world, someone with a curse-laden wish appeared. This led to the proliferation of "Monsters" created by "Blessings" throughout the world. These monsters are genuine abominations, impervious to bullets and even bombs. To combat these monsters, nations collaborated to establish a school dedicated to training individuals who possess "Blessings" and "Skills" derived from them. The protagonist, Seiji Sahara, who received a "Blessing" due to past events, ends up attending this school with his sister, despite his desire for a normal life.

title: A Retired War Hero has a Daughter
summary: Fifty years since falling into the game. With a body that never ages, I raised competent disciples. I was hailed as a war hero after ending a war that could have led to the destruction of the world. And finally, on the first day I decided to retire. ‘Waaah…!’ ‘What on earth is going on…’ Suddenly, I ended up with a daughter to raise.

title: I Became a Soul-Predator
summary: It was a normal life. Until my execution at the end of it…. But it seems that I became a little special after that. I became a soul and traveled freely around the world. I became a person again and became the center of the world. This is the story of a great adventure that spans hundreds of years.

title: Homeplate Villain
summary: A Korean baseball legend returns as the villain who protects home.

title: Sacrilegious Salvation
summary: I am the BL supporting character in a Western fantasy forced plot. When the Gentle God was imprisoned, I killed the Demon who coveted him and helped him escape a tragic fate. Unfortunately, he lost his memory while we were on the run. He always mistakes me for his wife. There are countless fanatical Believers who covet him. Helplessly, I had to pretend to be his spouse for the time being, coaxing him to regain his divine power and successfully sending him to the throne of God. I smiled as I bid him farewell. But why does he seem to have gone mad?

title: The Mother Cat and the Girl
summary: A tales of a girl and a certain mother cat

title: In the Sacred School
