summary: Teacher Han Se-ah has a tough life. Students give her a hard time, the principal yells at her, and a rich junior uses her. One day, she catches that junior cheating with her boyfriend. At the same time, her first love from high school, Shin Sunghan, returns as the new chairman. “Why are you the one avoiding them? Why didn’t you confront them?” “Why are you talking so casually? I’m a teacher here. Show some respect.” She wants to ignore him, just like the time he left her without a word. But he’s still the same—doing whatever he wants. “Revenge? Want my help? I’ll do it if you want.” He keeps provoking her—with a plan to get back at her ex.

title: Journey
summary: Unproven young coach? But all of the coaches were once young! It's said that all of big names players have talents and so do coaches! Without hard work, even the best potential won't be reached! Traveling back in time and transmigrated into the body of an Englishman, Wen Sheng has only one goal in this life, it is to realize his dream of managing a football team, to fulfill his love and passion for football. He would experience joy and misery along his journey to the top.

title: Cataclysm Card Emperor
summary: "Doctor, it seems there's something wrong with my emotions." "There's a clown in the West City Circus who can make everyone laugh. I think he can help you." "But doctor... I am that clown." "..." This is a fantasy world after a major catastrophe, where countless ancient dungeons lie buried beneath the fog-shrouded earth. In these dungeons, there are traps, monsters, and other-dimensional spaces, as well as ancient godly taboos and countless treasure legends left over from the old days. Disasters, steam, curse runes, ancient relics, a sequence of poker cards with extraordinary magic. Remnants of the old world, ancient relic shelters, poker monk associations, witch associations, fire thieves, the wall of the world... In the shadowy corners of the world, a treasure hunter wearing a clown mask walks alone in the darkness. He is Joker Ji Xun, the Cataclysm Card Emperor!

title: My Seatmate Tries to Make Me Fall in Love with Her by Teasing Me Repeatedly, but Somehow She Was the One Who Fell
summary: By some unsavory stroke of luck, Yuuki Narito found himself sitting next to none other than the mischievous Yui Takatsuki. This girl had built herself a reputation of stringing guys along only to reject them when they finally dared to confess their feelings for her. This, in turn, earned her a certain nickname: “The Seatmate Killer.” It was only a matter of time before Yuuki fell victim to the overly friendly Yui, but little did she know that he was as clueless as they come! The tables have suddenly been turned, and the hunter will soon become the prey. “Damn it! You think that poker face of yours is gonna get to me?! I’ll make you regret this, you’ll see!” This rom-com is off to a bumpy start as a now-determined Yui takes it upon herself to get her revenge!

title: Collapse Intersection
summary: Certain misfortune was better than uncertain happiness. It was a pathetic logic, but Seong-yeon believed in it. She had deliberately chosen misfortune, and she was content with that life. Until the day news arrived of her twin brother Seong-hyun’s death. Her world began to unravel from the moment she learned that the father she knew nothing about—Yoo Tae-geon, was the head of a private contract killing syndicate. “What’s with your face? Like you’ve seen a ghost.” Kwon San-ho, whom she encountered again after years, hadn’t changed. He had been her first boyfriend—and the first target she failed to kill. Drawn helplessly back into a world she never wanted to be part of again, Seong-yeon found him at the center of it all. “...You’re going to kill Yoo Tae-geon on your own?” “I wasn’t planning on doing it alone.” “...” “I took the job so we could do it together.” To avenge her brother’s death. To pay the price for the life she’d lived. Seong-yeon pulls the trigger once again. And the target becomes tangled. “I always told you, didn’t I?” “Don’t. Stop talking.” “If one of us has to live… it has to be Yoo Seong-yeon.” His whisper, as he guided her hand to the blade at his own throat, was like a spell. In a life where every choice is the wrong one. Can a right answer be found?

title: How I Ended up in a Game While Eating Cup of Ramen
summary: I thought I had seen every ending this game had to offer But there was still a hidden ending left. I want to see it. As a ten-year veteran, I can’t hold myself back. But why?! Why on earth do I have to go into the game itself to see it?!

title: Reincarnated as a Useless Prince, Starting by Voluntarily Requesting to Be Exiled to the Frontier
summary: “One day, Yè Chén found himself reincarnated as the useless Seventh Prince of the Da Chu Dynasty. Unable to excel in literature or martial arts, neglected by his father and unloved by his mother, he faces the additional challenge of being targeted by all the other princes who have joined forces against him. Yè Chén, in frustration, overturned the table and, in front of the entire court, voluntarily requested to be exiled to the frontier to fight enemies and serve the country. Years later, when he returns to the capital with a million troops, he looks at his former brothers, who had forced him to leave. With a mocking gaze, he says, ‘Back then, it was you who forced me to leave. Now that I’m back, don’t kneel before me!’

title: The Cyber Queen of Deception
summary: Yao Na found herself transported into the Cyber World, becoming a female Internet Celebrity known for her Internet Scams. The Original Host suffered from severe appearance anxiety and relied on her advanced internet skills to photoshop herself into a natural beauty, amassing 100 million followers online. Not only that, she also scammed men out of their money online. Her contact list was neatly organized with backup suitors numbered from one to ten, each with a uniform note format: amount, location, and surname. After crossing over, before Yao Na could even figure out what the Cyber World was, she faced the crisis of "her photoshop scam being exposed, being insulted by the entire internet, someone hiring a hacker to find her address, and in 10 seconds, they would storm into the Original Host's home, which was as messy as a dog's den." Yao Na: ... Am I the unlucky one here to clean up this mess? Just as the intruders burst through the door, Yao Na didn't hesitate to launch a Mental Power attack, stepping on one of their heads. Facing the stunned man, Yao Na calmly lied: "I am a Police Officer from the Cyber Anti-Scam Department. You have failed the online dating safety test. You are hereby ordered to correct your behavior and given a severe warning." "The money you were scammed out of? Consider it a fine." Real Cyber Police Officer Zhi Yi: ...? Wait, if you're the officer, then who am I? ... The Cyber World is highly developed in entertainment, with networks everywhere, 3D idols towering into the sky, and advertisements occupying brain circuits. But one day, normal TV broadcasts suddenly issued alarms, urging people not to look back and to flee as quickly as possible. Pretenders mixed in the network, pretending to be human, and Black Worms crawled through the internet directly into people's brains... Yao Na didn't care at all about "whether Cyber people with 0 Mental Power would panic when encountering sanity-dropping entities that intrude into the world." She only cared about one thing-damn it, this place bans undocumented people! Entry and exit require iris scans, and booting up requires brain marrow authentication. And Yao Na, with her full-level Mental Power, capable of resisting all horrors, but unable to live? She turned her gaze to the fake persona created by the Original Host: a wealthy heiress, a natural beauty with 0 cybernetic body, a top student at the Cyber Technology University... and so on. Yao Na: Fine, this fake persona is good, I'll take it. Next, all I need to do is turn the lies into truth~ Meanwhile, the fleeing Original Host, seeing that the account was still updating, actually came knocking... Who is this person and why is she taking over my identity? And how could anyone look exactly like the photoshopped image?!!

title: Gal-friendly Otaku-kun
summary: “Otaku-kun, look at this. This hairstyle in this magazine is amazing!” “I don’t really get it, but it does look amazing!” “So I’d like to ask again if you could style my hair like that…can you set it up for me, Otaku-kun?” “I might be able to do this with hair extensions. If you don’t mind, I’ll be glad to do it!” “Really?! You’re the best, Otaku-kun!” This is a school romantic comedy about an otaku who appreciates the hobbies of a gal and a gal who appreciates the hobbies of an otaku.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: My Otherworldly Life Seems to Be Quite Challenging
summary: The ordinary salaryman, after an accident, finds himself reincarnated into a different world as a powerless 3-year-old?! Troubles, disasters, and chaotic events ensue. Nevertheless, the lovable "second life" is about to begin! The protagonist is just an ordinary toddler, navigating a mysterious plot where infant humor, parent-crafted toys, and B-grade gourmet experiences intersect. He face and overcome challenges surrounded by adorable magical beasts.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Won an Island in the Lottery
summary: [No CP for the heroine, business story] [Business 60%, infrastructure 20%, daily 20%] The company where Li Yaolin interned went bankrupt, and the unscrupulous boss who owed her salary absconded with the money, leaving only a bunch of event lottery tickets to pay off the debt. Li Yaolin drew an island casually, and was also bound to an island management APP called “Poseidon Holiday”. The island is an uninhabited desert island with scarce fresh water, feces and garbage everywhere, serious marine pollution, and no development value. [Poseidon Holiday APP: It is your honor to be selected to contribute to the development of the island. Please ask the island owner to develop the island as soon as possible!] Li Yaolin: … Blacklist and report one-stop service. [Poseidon Holiday APP: Confirm the identity of the island owner to get a million cash!] Li Yaolin: Talking about money is so vulgar, mainly I like to develop islands. So, where can I get a million cash? [Poseidon Holiday APP: …] For money (not) to fulfill her duties as an island owner, Li Yaolin has embarked on the road of developing island tourism and vacation. Originally, Li Yaolin just wanted to develop some projects to deal with the APP, but she accidentally solved the pollution problem, and the island and the surrounding waters became a paradise for marine life; she also managed the island into the world’s No. 1 tourist resort, and she could make money even if she was lying down. From then on, Li Yaolin was worried about what to do with too much money every day…
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Heaven-Sent Milk Bun, Father Says I’m a Dragon
summary: Fu Jinli is a dragon, but her father is a human. The Emperor of the Great Qi had been childless for six years since his ascension, and everyone in the imperial court was worried sick. Until one day, the cold and stern emperor sat high on the dragon throne, holding a three-to-four-year-old milk Bun in his arms. The little girl was dressed in brocade, soft and sweet, and smiled at everyone she met. Ministers: Excellent! Excellent! Excellent! Heaven bless our Great Qi. The little princess beat up the Left Prime Minister's little devil until his face was a mess. The court officials: The princess has gone to the trouble of disciplining him for you. Why aren't you kneeling to thank His Majesty's grace? The princess was pushed by an envoy for a marriage alliance from a foreign state and scraped her hand. The court officials: Such insolent barbarians! We beseech Your Majesty to allow us to lead the troops on an expedition! The academy tutor asked the princess to call for her parent. The Emperor: Go on, keep calling.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance

title: The Strongest Prophet Who Had Trained 100 Heroes is Admired By His Apprentices Around The World Even As An Adventurer
summary: —The master of the strongest heroes is even stronger, but now he travels secretly to his apprentices— Eisen is a man who raised 100 heroes and saved the world by ending the war with an evil god. He had recovered from the wounds inflicted on his body in the「Other World」in exchange for protecting the heroes. During the times he has been recuperating, the heroes he had saved became successful due to his tutelage and developed the 「Human World」 as leaders of various countries. As a result, each of the hundred heroes reported to their Eisen-sensei whom they admired saying— “Please, come visit our countries.” Reading all of these, Eisen one day decided— “I’m going on a journey around the world and see these places that my apprentices recommended me. It looks fun.” “It sure sounds fun, Eisen-sensei. So, have you sent your apprentices a letter about this?” “Nope, everybody’s in a tough position. I’ll just quietly visit and greet them so I won’t be a bother.” Thus, Eisen the master of heroes, secretly set out on a journey to visit each of his apprentices and to sightsee different countries.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: No One Understands Reincarnation Better Than I Do
summary: “No one understands reincarnation better than I do!” While others only read about it in novels, Guan Ren actually reincarnated. He woke up in his small hometown county, back in 2011. “Let’s make reincarnation great again!” With this bold belief in mind, Guan Ren thought that simply enjoying his youth alongside his deskmate would be enough. It was his second chance to make up for regrets and create happiness. But when more and more girls from his past start appearing in front of him—girls he cannot bear to turn away—he begins to realize that this new life will not be so simple. The road ahead is filled with responsibility, and romance.
genres: Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Handsome Girl Who Stole My Girlfriend Seems to Be After Me Now
summary: I, Souta Sakuhara, an unremarkable, introverted geek, miraculously got my first girlfriend in the third year of middle school. Life with my girlfriend, who was way out of my league, felt like I was at the peak of happiness… until. “I’m sorry, Souta-kun… I’ve fallen for someone else.” In the spring of my first year of high school, she suddenly broke up with me. Moreover, her new love interest is a super popular model known as a “handsome” beauty in school… meaning, a girl stole my girlfriend from me. However, the handsome girl who took my girlfriend started to cling to me for some reason… What? Her real target was not my girlfriend… but me!?
genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: Did You Crush Today?
summary: "It's a bit complicated—I used to be the crush of my crush. Does that make sense?" — Naive vs. Unhappy — Short story, very brief Content Tags: Dedicated Love, Destined Match, Sweet Romance, Campus, Lighthearted Main Characters: Zhou Cheng and Song Yun One-line Summary: A love story that began as unrequited.

title: I Became the Only Savior of the Obsessive Maniacs
summary: She was reborn as the main character’s older sister in a R18+ BL novel. In this gold impoverished world, all the Omegas have died. And with no omegas, the number of Alphas soon dwindled. Originally in the novel, her younger brother was being beaten by the obsessives in Alpine because he smelt like an omega. As a useless extra, her life was also short lived.. *** In order to survive, I decided to become a priest of the Holy Land far from the obsessed maniacs. However, Schwarz, one of the obsessed maniacs who killed me in the original work, appeared! “Your lips are small. The way you bite your lower lip is so cute.” Even Cassius, the successor of Alpine, who never made an appearance in the original work, showed interest in me. “You, are you an omega?” I will walk the path of a priest and become the only surviving omega! Will she survive among the dangerously obsessed maniacs?

title: My Dear Forensic Scientist
No Longer Balancing
summary: After the government assigned me a pair of Beastman brothers as my mates, I made it a habit to prepare two glasses of milk every night. The older brother was cold and aloof, yet he would always accept the glass politely and offer a soft word of thanks. The younger brother, however, had a volatile temper. He often smashed the glass and lashed out at me with harsh words. I believed I was treating them both equally, balancing the scales with seamless precision. That was until my best friend happened to witness it. She hesitated for a moment before speaking up. "Don't you think that your version of 'fairness' is actually quite unfair to the one who behaves?" I spent the entire day reflecting on her words and realized she was right. That night, I walked out of the kitchen carrying only one glass of milk.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I Activated Cheat Mode in a Bizarre Game
summary: As a coward, I applied cheat mode to a game with monsters and got possessed.

title: Godly Student
summary: Once upon a time, an Alchemist Grandmaster from the World of Immortals accidentally took possession of a playboy, who hailed from a rich and powerful family, and became a student in the middle of his midterms. By the means of a miraculous immortal technique, he blended in and mingled amongst the femme fatales’ group to dominate the city! The nature of this novel’s origin is shamelessness to the core; having no sense of shame is just a basic foundation, but if the most shameless isn’t set yet, then become it!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Xianxia

title: A Three Inch Adorable Wife Hidden in the Sleeve of the Chu King
summary: (A fierce and adorable female lead VS an obsessive and sinister male lead, sweet doting + metaphysics + slight fantasy) Jiang Xiaoxiao, the great master of the Mystic Sect, was born with an incomplete soul. Every full moon night, she would also turn into a tiny three-inch tall person. The Grand Master said that in the sixteenth year of her life, she would meet a nobleman. The purple gold dragon aura on the nobleman's body could lift her curse. Xie Xun, the King of Chu, had his dragon aura taken away at the age of three. Plagued by bad luck, he was exiled from the capital. The first time he met his adorable wife, his adorable wife shrank with a swoosh in front of him into a tiny three-inch being, standing in his palm dozing off. Later, the King of Chu sewed a small pouch on the sleeve of each garment. When going out, he would put his adorable wife in the pouch. And he told others, "My little one is weak, pitiful, and helpless." The little ghost shivered in fear: Have you seen someone using a kitchen knife to hack ghosts at a mass grave? Yes, it's your weak, pitiful and helpless Queen! The ghosts wailed at the mass grave: Have you seen a living person who could scare the ghosts to tears? Yes, it's still your weak, pitiful and helpless Queen! The entire netherworld exploded: Have you seen a newly wedded bride escorted by two Ghost Emperors and two Ghost Kings? Yes, it's still your weak, pitiful and helpless Queen!

title: Intercept Charlotte Linlin At The Beginning
summary: El traveled to another world and was reborn as a Lunarian. One day, the nine-year-old El found five-year-old Charlotte Linlin on the coast of Elbaph. When two monsters come together, the strongest Lunarian in history is born! The eldest child, Perospero, is extremely powerful and invulnerable to swords and guns. He transforms into a phoenix and burns the sky with flames. The eldest daughter, Compote, perfectly inherited her mother's talent. She is like a steel balloon, transformed into Thor, and controls lightning. The second son, Katakuri, was born with immense strength. He transformed into a dragon and was able to call the wind and rain to dominate the sea. The 14th daughter, Smoothie, has an amazing talent for swordsmanship. She transforms into a seraph and splits the seas and breaks the mountains. Three Sweet Commanders? No! It's the Eighty-Eight Sweet Commanders! The Marine Headquarters and the World Government are trembling. "Please, don't make another baby with Charlotte Lingling!" "Go out and seduce other women!"
genres: Action, Adventure, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Tragedy

title: Not Your Childhood Friend You Promised to Marry — I’ll Be the One to Make You Happy
summary: Right before summer break ends, Mayoi Hazakura, who is about to transfer to a high school in Tokyo, sees a small, doll-like girl helping an elderly woman. She is so cute that he experiences his first love at first sight. However, based on her appearance, he assumes she must be an elementary or middle school student, so he gives up immediately. But fate plays its trick and brings them together again. Because at his new school, that same girl, Mahiru Fujiwara, turns out to be his classmate. His joy that this love hasn’t ended is short-lived, because he soon learns something: She has a childhood friend, a boy, and the two of them have feelings for each other. However, from what he hears, it seems they aren’t actually dating. In that case “If it makes her happy, I don’t mind if the one she ends up with is her childhood friend. As long as…”

title: Greek Mythology: I Open a Treasure Chest at Olympus
summary: Qin Qing played a game and suddenly traveled to the world of Greek mythology and became Apollo, the God of light. At this time, he discovered that the treasure chest system in the game had also traveled over. Looking at the densely packed light spots on the map plate, he couldn’t help but fall into deep thought. Um, Athena, don’t get me wrong, I’m just here to get a treasure chest. I didn’t break into your bedroom on purpose. Zeus, please move your butt. My god-level treasure chest is under your throne. Here, why is the super god treasure chest in Tartarus?

title: I Woke up and Found Myself a Dragon Slayer
summary: The Awakened appeared with the Gate’s appearance. After naturally forming a party and breaking through the Gate, the world became a place where fighting the monsters within the Gate and securing various resources became the reality. And the protagonist, Lee Hyun-woo, also happens to be born with an Awakened ability in this society… [Awakened Ability, ??? Rank: Past Self] He rubs his eyes and wakes up to a strange phrase. Could it be that his awakened ability is the cheesy character design I used in my second year of middle school? No, he has so many other cool abilities, so why?! Hiren is a smorgasbord of bizarre, chuunibyou-like traits. Specializing solely in dragon-slaying, and with a perfectly chuunibyou-like appearance, he’s afraid to step outside. He even talks about class and pride, obsessing over his own superiority! Meanwhile, the Gate’s difficulty skyrockets, triggering a series of Gate Breaks, sending monsters flying out. Even the most horrifying creature of all time, the Dragon, is flooding in… The dragon, considered the worst of all creatures, and the dragon slayer, Lee Hyun-woo. The story of Lee Hyun-woo, a man with the power to slay dragons, begins!

title: The Ghost in the Necklace
summary: My ex-boyfriend turned my ashes into a necklace and hung it around his son's neck for eighteen years. For those eighteen years, my soul remained trapped by the boy's side. Then one day, out of the blue, the boy told me something. He said he wanted to marry me.

title: My Civil Servant Life Reborn in the Strange World
summary: He was on his way to buy some beer to celebrate his acceptance as a civil servant when he was suddenly isekai’d by truck-kun. Reincarnated as Denburg Blade, the son of a legendary battle race chief, he caught demons at 8 years old and a dragon at 12 years old. Subjected to the spartan-style training of his muscular monster of a father, his daily life was inhuman. “I must leave this place that is far from peaceful!” Safety is the best! So, he chose to be a civil servant of the empire! Can Denburg really become a civil servant and live the peaceful and stable life he wishes for?

title: I Heard That the Cool Maid Had Feelings for Someone, so I Fired Her for Her Happiness, and She Came to My House Alone
summary: I had a maid girl whom I grew up with since I was a small child. She always supported me and helped me when I was in trouble. One day, I heard from my maid friend that she was in love with someone else. But she still serves by my side and can't take free time. She has always been by my side and supported me outside of college. So I came up with an idea to make her happy...
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Killing Time of God ーThe Six Abducted Man and Womenー
summary: One day, A male and 5 females who were living their lives normally were suddenly kidnapped and brought to a closed space by the power of Kami-sama and made them to play a deathgame and they will be killed if they refused. Six people will be allowed to participate in the game without having any defense. There are no evil people among the participants. Whether they cooperate or they kill each other, the deathgame full of good people begins.

title: How Far Can You Go with a Liter of Gasoline? I Refuse to Take Passengers When I Explode Like a Gasoline Explosion!
summary: Lin Yang crossed to a parallel world and found himself participating in a reality show where he randomly drew the job of ride-hailing driver. Female Passenger: "Driver, is it unreasonable for me to seek someone who earns 300,000 yuan per year when I earn 200,000 yuan per year?" Lin Yang: "Hmm! It's not unreasonable!" Female Passenger: "I have a car and a house. Is it unreasonable for me to seek someone who also has a car and a house?" Lin Yang: "Not at all, it's very reasonable." Female Passenger: "My parents have a retirement pension. Is it unreasonable for me to seek someone whose parents also have a retirement pension?" Lin Yang: "No problem at all, it's a good match." Female Passenger: "I'm 35 years old this year. Is it unreasonable for me to seek someone who is 40 years old?" Lin Yang: "Not at all, it's not unreasonable!" Female Passenger: "Driver, if you earn 300,000 yuan per year, have a house and a car, and your parents have a retirement pension, what kind of wife would you seek?" Lin Yang: "I would seek an 18-year-old..." Female Passenger: "Stop the car! I want to get off!! I'm going to file a complaint against you!" Netizen: "Men are more faithful; they always prefer 18-year-old girls!" Reminder: This novel and its characters are purely fictional. Any resemblance is purely coincidental. Do not imitate.

title: Don’t Fool Yourself into Thinking I’d Love You Forever, Idiot

title: How to Survive With an All-Purpose Stone
summary: Hyun Eun-soo, a tone-deaf, clumsy idol with nothing but his looks, has regressed to his pre-debut self. But… why is his face like this? And… why is he so good at singing?

title: An Ideal World of Loneliness: Cursed To Be Hated By Girls
summary: It was another world, much like our own. The only difference, however, is that the populational ratio was heavily skewed toward women. In such a world where the majority of the population was composed of girls, there was a man hated by the opposite s*x. It was so severe, abusive language was commonplace and he was subjected to heinous violence on a daily basis. For the young man, that daily hell had become the norm. Upon seeing his suffering, the two goddesses of the world muttered, “You, boy, are cursed,” and lifted the malison. From there, his life took a 180-degree turn. “I like you~!” “Hey, hey! Wait a sec! Come play with me~!” “Y, you’re wrong! Until now I… There was mistake! Forgive me!” “I’m sorry… I’m sorry…” This is a story about a slightly nihilistic young man and goddesses who love to crack dirty jokes without a shred of c*astity. Slowly, the world begins to revolve around him.

title: Divorced in the 1970s, Bound to the Fiercest Office
summary: [Alternate 1970s Setting + Mutual First Love + Military Marriage + Regretful Husband + Culinary Delights] Mu Wanwan died tragically in a car accident, only to be reborn on the night of her wedding. In her previous life, she was infatuated with Wen Lin. Out of gratitude, she married into the Wen family—rising from a village girl to the wife of an officer in the military compound. To everyone else, it seemed like she had climbed high. Even though Mu Wanwan knew Wen Lin was cold and never had feelings for her, she firmly believed that with enough effort, she could win his heart, so she spent her days chasing after him. But reality proved her devotion nothing more than a cruel joke. In Wen Lin’s heart, there would always be another woman more important than her. For three years of marriage, time and again, she was cast aside…
genres: Drama, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Sixty Days of Gentle Training by the “Strange Being”
Sign In: Becoming A Great Spell Deity Starting From The Magic Academy
summary: "Crossing over to a fantasy world of magic and battle auras, Lei Luo accidentally crossed over to the Xiluo Magic Academy and became a librarian. At the same time, he obtained a Sign-in System. He would receive various rewards if he signed in at different locations. Signed in at the library and obtained [Top-grade Meditation Technique] from the treasure chest! Signed in on the Magic Guide Book and obtained [Magic Increase] from the treasure chest! Signed in on the Magic Stone Tablet and obtained [Forbidden Magic] from the treasure chest! ... Lei Luo unintentionally activated something that would completely turn his life around He started signing in from the Magic Academy and slowly advanced from a Magic Apprentice to become the most powerful person in the Magic Academy. He led the Magic Knights that shocked the world to eliminate noble factions and fight against the invasion of the demon tribe. Changing the world began with him. From a desolate small town to the lord of the world, he reignited the glory of an empire that had been down and out for a century."
genres: Completed, Action, Adult, Fantasy, Harem, Mature

title: Rewind, Rewrite, Revenge
summary: Yun Mi is trapped in a xianxia game. To return home, she must "save" a pitiful early-game NPC who later becomes a twisted, beautiful, and terrifying villain. Unfortunately, even the younger version of this future demon lord is already a wolf in sheep's clothing. She spent 400 years clearing his path with kindness and sacrifice-only to be repaid with a blade through her chest as he said, 'You? Unworthy.' Yun Mi: "Oh? That's how it is?" In her final moments, she grabbed his hand and drove the knife in deeper. "Let's see how you handle it when I come back." What she didn't expect... was that he remembers everything too.

title: Gifting You With A City that Will Never Be Isolated
summary: In a quiet corner of the world, the mortal delight you indulged for me is my most romantic of my eternity. A never-isolated city I received, a mini forever I shall return. + “Gifting You With a City That Will Never Be Isolated details the romance between an awkward, quiet, introverted and socially handicapped female lead and a good-natured and sweet male lead. Their romance, in fact, is a steady stream that flows unnoticed slow if one doesn’t pay attention. This novel isn’t the most exciting, nor the most captivating – but it’s a sweet, lovely novel detailing the sweet and ordinary love between two common folks, and perhaps best expresses what healthy, ordinary relationships should aim to be like. It’s a story about growth, about trust, and about how a healthy relationship can really help one to change for the better.”
