title: Tombstone And The Wolf
summary: A short story about a young wolf and tombstone

title: That Time a Shut-in for 300 Years Continued to Make Antiques , but All of It Turned out to Be Cheat-Level Magic Tools
summary: So I continued to stay shut-in for… Huh? 300 years?! One day, a high elf named Edson realized this astonishing truth. Absorbed in his magic tool research, he felt that he had subconsciously let 3 years pass… but in fact, it has been 300 years! Edson decides to go outside and find out what happened to the outside world, now that 300 years have passed. However, even after 300 years, magic tool technology had not advanced; and even the junk among his magic tools are being treated as cheat-level tools!?

title: Two Realms Shuttle Gate: Don’t Call Me a Demon!
summary: Su Jie, capable of traveling between Blue Star and the Cultivation World, discovered that cultivation was just too difficult. Spirit Pills, Magic Artifacts, Pocket Worlds, and inherent comprehension—each was a mountain on the long road to immortality. Not until Su Jie found out that Demon Cultivators refined corpses by killing, extracted souls to cultivate fiends, and used fear as sustenance for their cultivation. Need souls to consecrate a Soul Summoning Banner? Get to know the pig farms that slaughter millions of pigs a year. Need human fear to cultivate fierce ghosts? Stock up on ghost houses, horror films, and horror games... Need fresh blood for Demon Techniques? Across the ocean, America is the world's largest grey market blood transfusion station... ...... Years later. "You devil, how many people have you killed? And you still have the face to call yourself a good person? Pah, today I shall act on behalf of heaven to mete out justice." The Tianyuan World's most beautiful person's eyebrows were furrowed with rage, as she stared at the terrifying Devil before her, enveloped in wronged souls, with thousands of ghosts parading on his Soul Banner, seated in a palace made of bones, she posed her soulful question. The Devil slowly stood up and pulled out a business card that read "Hua Country's Philanthropist of the Year / Founder of the World's Largest Chain of Ghost Houses / Owner of Blue Star's Largest Livestock Slaughter Business / Emerging Tycoon of the Entertainment Industry." "You see, I'm really not a devil, okay? Nowadays, who still uses such a lowly method as killing people to cultivate as a devil!"
genres: Action, Comedy, Harem, Mature, Romance, Xianxia

title: Reincarnated as a Slime in Marvel
summary: Look, the protein from this Abomination is fifty times richer than beef, but the texture is awful—downing it in one gulp is the best option. Look, there’s a lone Iron Man over there, the reactor in his chest has a strangely alluring vibe… Look, there’s a Time Stone here, we can… The Ancient One is coming! Run, run… Look, we’ve captured a beautiful girl, let’s try using some tent**les first… It’s just a weak, helpless, pitiful and greedy slime. But then… Humans slandered it as the greatest hidden mastermind of America, the manipulator lurking in the shadows. Aliens believe it to be the brutal and warlike Grand Duke of Asgard, who wipes out entire clans at the slightest disagreement. The Mad Titan Thanos calls it his greatest scourge, the destined enemy. Can this slime endure such slander? Of course not! So, they pulled out ten Infinity Gauntlets, fully loaded with stones, and performed a round of the Black Coffin dance.

title: The Heartless Mage
summary: Wu'xin is an immortal that has taken up the job of being a monster killer. During his adventure of expelling ghosts and monsters, he meets and befriends other people. The story only begins to unravel after he accidentally released a female demon that has been locked away for hundreds of years.

title: The Fate Thief – My Boyfriend’s Final Gift
summary: We were both writers. But ever since we got together, my stories have flatlined. His, on the other hand, have exploded—every novel a blockbuster, his income staggering. I posted about it on a forum, just venting my quiet frustration. That’s when a long-time follower slid into my DMs with a message that froze my blood: “Hasn’t his style started to sound just like yours? He’s stealing your talent. Your luck. And soon… he’s coming for your life.”

title: She Banished Me Yesterday, But Today She Calls Me Master?
summary: Asto Berg was reincarnated into another world as the "final boss" older stepbrother — but instead of fulfilling his original role, he used his knowledge of the game to guide his step-sister, Eltrinde, who was destined to fall into darkness and become the cause of the world’s destruction, onto a righteous path. Together, they defeated the Demon King who sought to plunge the world into chaos, becoming heroes in the process. However, after their victory, Eltrinde cast him aside as if he were no longer needed. Now, concealing his true identity, Asto lives quietly as a teacher at a remote frontier academy. One day, a devoted and overly affectionate s*ave named Linde appears before him. But in truth, this s*ave is none other than the very same step-sister who once exiled him—Eltrinde.

title: The Strongest Neutral Country of the Villainous Aristocrat
summary: I, Masahiro Mizuta, died in a traffic accident and found myself reincarnated into the world of "Legend of Lacua's Heroes," a game I had played extensively. I became Rogue von Aldea, the third-stage, weakling villainous noble... Rogue is a puppet lord of the Demon King's army who betrayed the kingdom. In the game, he's an easy-to-defeat character that even beginners with decent gear and experience points can take down without much trouble. Yeah, I'm definitely screwed... If I don't betray the kingdom and fight the Demon King's army, I'll be killed easily. If I team up with the Demon King, I'll be killed by the protagonist. In such a hopeless situation, the choice I made was to turn my territory into a neutral state. For the time being, I focused on building my country's strength and honing my magic just enough to make invading us seem like too much trouble. But things went better than expected... I ended up creating the strongest nation, catching the attention of both the kingdom and the Demon King's army... Now they both think I'm plotting some invasion, and worse, they're teaming up to attack me... This is the story of my survival strategy to live a peaceful life in my territory, away from all conflicts.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: Demon
summary: This work borrows some elements from Marius Petipa's ballet "Le Talisman" as its motif. All elements appearing in this work are fictional creations of the author's imagination. "Every head of the House of Etheldor goes mad." Ayesha conceals her identity as a journalist and visits the estate, hoping to break a major story about the tragedy of the House of Etheldor—a prestigious noble family that was once royalty. There, she meets the young and beautiful head of the household, Cyrex Etheldor. "Ayesha. 'It' is circling around me. Waiting for any opportunity to take over my body." An evil spirit, he says. Such things don't exist in this world. That's merely a sign of the hereditary madness that has plagued the House of Etheldor for generations. But before long, Cyrex suffers a terrible accident. Ayesha, who had stayed at the mansion out of concern for him, receives word that Cyrex has regained consciousness after hovering between life and death. Yet something about the man who opens his eyes feels strangely different. He looks at Ayesha and smirks. "We finally meet, don't we?" Ayesha realizes it instantly. This man is not the Cyrex Etheldor she knew. The evil spirit that stole Cyrex's body has awakened. At last, the curse of the House of Etheldor has begun.

title: The Reincarnated Demon King and the Hero Candidate’s Academy War: It Seems the Legendary Demon King is Unmatched Even a Thousand Years Later
summary: The Irregular New Student’s True Identity: A Mythical Demon King!? In the age of myths, a man reigned supreme as the king of demons. Bored with the world due to his unmatched strength, Demon King Lucas grew intrigued by the words of a persistent human hero: “One day, humanity’s power will surpass even the Demon King.” Determined to test this so-called “power of humanity,” Lucas reincarnates as a human a thousand years later. But upon awakening, he finds a peaceful era where the terror of demons has long been forgotten. To seek out a new-generation “hero” worthy of challenging him, Lucas infiltrates the prestigious “Hero Academy.” With his extraordinary abilities, he effortlessly defeats hero candidates one after another—!? “I’ll test for myself whether you’re worthy of being a true hero.” The reincarnated Demon King’s unrivaled academy saga begins!

title: Until the Middle-Aged Man Who Became Young Becomes a Harem Master in Another World
summary: Kojirou was bullied during his school days and had been reclusive for many years, but he finally managed to reintegrate into society. At that time, Kojirou was summoned to another world along with four high school students. Kojirou was “involved” in the summoning. Kojirou was banished from the castle by the king, but a high school gal named Midori followed him. Midori liked older men, but Kojirou wasn’t her type. However, it seemed that her maternal instincts were stirred by the unremarkable Kojirou. The king, angered by Midori’s departure from the castle, sends an assassin to kill Kojirou. Little did he know that this would lead to his own downfall… Kojirou welcomed Midori as his wife and spent joyful days together, but as the saying goes, “Good fortune is often followed by misfortune,” he was attacked by an assassin and suffered serious injuries.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature

title: Palace Drama? I Can Infinitely Reload, Making the Emperor Cry with Frustration
summary: Yun Xiao can infinitely reload her life. Therefore, even as a picky and delicate Junior Attendant who lacks the emperor's favor, she can still live a perfectly satisfying life in the rear palace. Don't like the food from the Imperial Kitchen? Reload, and get my favorite Steamed meat with rice flour. The color of the distributed fabric doesn't suit me? Reload, and this time I finally got my favorite lake-green. The emperor chose my nameplate for the night? Reload. Life is just as comfortable without his favor. ... The new emperor, Xie Zhixing, has a secret. Ever since the first imperial selection after his ascension, his life inexplicably keeps resetting to the past— The memorials he just finished approving are all cleared! The martial arts he just finished practicing were practiced for nothing! The consort who was just carried over to serve him in bed has been carried away! ... Xie Zhixing could never figure out the pattern of these resets, simply treating it as a massive joke played on him by the heavens. Until, on a stormy day, he met Junior Attendant Yun in Xianfu Palace. Later, he discovered that on the day he approved the same memorial 25 times, it was only because the Imperial Kitchen had failed to make Steamed meat with rice flour for Junior Attendant Yun. HE, Hilarious, Transmigration, Moe, Lighthearted

title: Lazy Stepmother of the 70s Island
summary: Ning Tang, a corporate s*ave, transmigrated into a novel about a stepmother on a remote island. Her cousin, Ning Xue, married a divorced military officer with two children who she treated as her own. Meanwhile, Ning Tang, who married another military officer stationed on the same island after becoming a widow with three children, constantly scolded and mistreated her stepchildren. She even let them go hungry and neglected them like beggars. One day, when the children complained about their treatment, Ning Tang decided to fully embrace her role as a lazy stepmother. She made seafood stew from the harvest of the sea and demanded payment from the children in exchange for food. Despite their initial protests, the children eventually gave in and used their money to buy food from Ning Tang. Ning Xue, on the other hand, had a job and made money to provide for her stepchildren. However, Ning Tang saw the harm in children constantly comparing themselves to others and began to appreciate her own laid-back lifestyle. When Su, Ning Xue’s husband, suggested taking the children to a dangerous part of the island, Ning Xue kindly refused. The three children of the Shen family told Ning Tang that they wanted to go to the mountains and the seaside to play. Ning Tang rolled up his sleeves and asked, “Are we going to catch rabbits or fish for seafood? When should we go?” Ning Xue’s stepson got into a fight at school, but she didn’t scold or hit him. Instead, she tried to influence them with reason. The three children of the Shen family got into a fight at school. The teacher said, “Your children got into a fight at school.” Ning Tang asked, “Did they win?” The teacher replied, “They won, but…” Ning Tang then said, “If they won, why are you calling me?” - Shen Lie came back from a trip at sea and found out that his own son and daughter were fighting with his new wife from his second marriage. The eldest child hugged Ning Tang’s leg, and the second and third children pulled Ning Tang’s clothes, saying, “Our stepmother is just like our real mother!” To all the military families: Captain Shen, please control your wife!! She’s almost become the Child Queen!! There’s no place she hasn’t blabbered about, whether it’s going up the mountains or down to the sea!!
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Weak-Waisted Educated Youth In The Era And The Loyal Rough Man
summary: SUMMARY:Lu Miao was reborn as a cannon fodder female educated youth in a novel about a reborn female supporting character. The original owner had a beautiful family background but was actually a big-breasted, brainless, and troublemaker. Because she liked the male protagonist in the compound, she followed him to the countryside. However, she couldn’t resist the aura of the reborn girl and ended up marrying an old bachelor. In the end, unable to bear the humiliation, she ended her life with a pair of scissors. Lu Miao was speechless. The original owner was confused. What was there to be obsessed with with the male protagonist’s arrogant temper? The strong and powerful male supporting characters are the real stunning! Fu Jingyou never expected that a girl as beautiful as Lu Miao would like him. He just wanted to help her silently. A delicate and tender girl would have to endure a lot of hardships when she came to the countryside. It was not until Lu Miao took the initiative to hold his hand that he suddenly understood her feelings

title: Mistaking Irritation Value for Conquest Value
summary: After successfully completing the conquest of the School Bully, I showed my true colors and started making his life a living hell. I forbade him from skipping class to go to internet cafes, demanded he be at my beck and call, and wouldn't even let him lose his temper with me. Despite all that, the Conquest Value above his head continued to rise steadily. I was convinced he was head over heels in love with me. That was until the System came back online a year later, and I confidently showed it the School Bully's Conquest Value. The System stared at the glowing red number above his head and remained silent for a long time. Finally, it hissed through gritted teeth: [That's his damn Irritation Value!]

title: Too Late To Say I Love You
summary: Dashing Mu Rong Feng had a chance encounter with Yin Jing Wan and was surprised to see the beautiful girl again when she plead with him to save her fiancé, Xu Jian Zhang. Mu Rong Feng agreed to help Yin Jing Wan as she saved him before during their first meeting. Mu Rong Feng fell for Yin Jing Wan as time goes by and after Xu Jian Zhang is released, Mu Rong Feng vow to make Yin Jing Wan his even if she is already engaged to marry her fiancé. How many times in a lifetime can one find their true love? Yin Jing Wan broke off her engagement with Xu Jian Zhang and fall out with her parents in order to be with Mu Rong Feng. However, Mu Rong Feng is force to make a decision between his country and his beloved woman; during a time of war and chaos, will their love become tragedy and will it be too late by the time you want to say the words ‘I Love You’?

title: How Did I End Up in a Mess Despite Being the Top Star at the Beginning
summary: Chu Zhi crossed into a parallel world and became the top star in the country, with tens of thousands of comments on every trivial update on Weibo. Due to a series of malicious schemes involving flaunting, plagiarizing new songs, and secretly marrying while having an affair, he ended up as a mess of a young heartthrob. As the sky collapsed at the beginning, fortunately, he had a “[Personality System]” that allowed him to do things most celebrities wouldn’t dare to do in order to earn points and draw blind boxes. “Let’s reverse the situation.” Chu Yan, the Emperor Beast, the Ambassador of Fan ab*se, said.

title: The Glory of the Tribe
summary: The Sheng Mei Tribe, known for its beauty, has been warring with the Shen Mu Tribe for three years. The men of the Sheng Mei Tribe are nearly wiped out, leaving the tribe on the brink of annihilation. In this brutal “tribal life-and-death war”, all the women of the Sheng Mei Tribe face the terrifying fate of slaughter, violation, and s*avery. The tribe is suffused with an air of despair. Some chose to flee, others betrayed their tribe. But 15-year-old Jiang Xuan, still half a child, steps forward. For the sake of his mother and younger sisters, he has been hiding his true strength. Now, he declares, “I won’t run! I won’t act weak! I—Jiang Xuan—am the last man of the Sheng Mei Tribe!”

title: Restart Reunion: In My Second Playthrough, I Inherit Everything and Surpass My Destiny
summary: In this world, high school graduates can easily choose to become an "Explorer." A young man once received a "mysterious power" as a high school graduate explorer and achieved remarkable results. He spent vivid days racing through dungeons with his partner. But now, his future, his bond with his partner, the days he spent with them, and the training he had put into them are all taken away from him. However, the next time the man awakens, he finds himself in a timeline "before high school summer vacation." Whether by a twist of fate or coincidence, the man chooses a "different path" from before, and "inherits and remembers everything."
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life

title: The Mistress Runs Away
summary: Although she was an innocent woman who did not know the world, Rowena fell into a love trap and became the mistress of Duke Killian. She devoted her body and mind to him for three years, but she was thrown away with repeated contempt and misunderstanding. One day she secretly gave birth to his child and lived in hiding like a sinner. After five years, he returned like nothing ever happened. “Long time no see. Miss Philone.” “… … Don’t you remember throwing money at me and throwing me away?” “I threw it away, so I have to pick it up.” Killian smiled, responding lightly. The cold eyes turned to the door where the child was hiding. “I didn’t expect that you would be so quick, but in the meantime, it must have been sweet.” “… … .” “Choose. Miss Philone.” A man who lifted my cheeks with a glance of appreciation of the object reported. “Will you be my mistress again, or will you die with your child on the street?”

title: After Their Engagement Was Canceled, They Entered Into a Marriage Based Solely on Political Reasons, Lacking Any Romantic Affection
summary: Liam, the son of the Duke, breaks off the engagement after witnessing his fiancée cheating on him. The next moment, he meets Princess Anastasia, who asks him to marry him. "Right now, I've fallen in love with you. Let's get married." "I refuse.

title: Skill [Luck] Overpowered — I Got Kicked Out of the Fully Equipped Party. With the Rebound of Luck, Their Drops Are Stuck at Normal and Now They’re Struggling for Funds? Like I Care! I’m Living Free Now! It’s Too Late to Apologize!
summary: This is the Power of Luck! One day, I was suddenly kicked out of my party. “A deadweight whose only selling point is the skill [Luck] is no longer needed in our party.” “What!?” Because of the nature of my skill, I never actually joined in combat. That’s why, sure enough, my level was abnormally low. But in exchange, thanks to my ability that guaranteed rare drops, my party—the Scarlet Sword—was financially blessed and managed to rise to success in a very short time. And now they’re telling me to get lost…? Don’t screw with me! “If we just hunt high-level monsters nonstop, rare drops won’t be that important anymore!” I looked around, but all the members only stared back at me with cold, silent eyes. That was the first time I realized— I had been used. A disposable pawn, only needed until the party could get on its feet. That’s all they ever thought of me as…

title: I’ve Already Reached the Nascent Soul Stage, But the Chat Group Finally Arrived
summary: [Ding. The Multiverse Chat Group invites you to join.] [Yes/No] Chen Changsheng: ??? After transmigrating to the cultivation world for two hundred years, I’ve managed to lie low and reach the Nascent Soul stage. Only now does my golden finger arrive?

title: The Witch and the Gourd of Stories
summary: In a land far away, there was a young man who was skilled at telling stories. The witch, who lived in an old mansion deep in the forest, desired to monopolize these wonderful stories. “Why don’t you stay here forever, making stories for me alone?” she asked “Very well" but, can forever really be enough?

title: Sato-kun Is Harsh Toward Girls
summary: In my first year of middle school, a girl faked a love confession to me, and it ended with bullying from other girls. In my second year, my mom confessed she had cheated and that I wasn’t my dad’s real son. Then they got divorced. Living with a father I wasn’t related to felt suffocating, so I left home and started going to high school on my own. Now I’ve completely lost trust in girls. Honestly, I think girls are the worst, and I go through my days feeling that way. “Hey, hey, what are you reading today?” “Why are you even talking to me?” Seriously, just leave me alone. Note: The story aims to be light but may sometimes get a bit heavy.

title: So L*sty! So Sweet! Mr. Huo Really Loves His Wife
summary: In order to allow her seriously ill grandfather to receive treatment, Lu Zhixin was forced to accept a marriage with her fiancé Huo Sijing, whom she had never met. After marriage, she originally just wanted to live an ordinary life. But she didn't expect that the man with a net worth of hundreds of billions in the financial magazines was actually her husband? ! Wait, are his genes so good? His younger brothers are so handsome, and they are elites in their respective fields. The chief jewelry designer, the movie emperor, the miracle doctor, and the school hunk of A University all call her sister-in-law, and they are trying to show her courtesy, just wanting her to say a few good words in front of her mother, so as not to drag them to blind dates! Only President Huo squinted his eyes, smiled at the corners of his lips, and said proudly. "What's wrong with blind dates? Blind dates are really good!"

title: Seventy Koi: The Unlucky Boss Hugged Me and Cried
summary: She, Mu Qing, was holding space supplies and dressed as a silly village girl in the 70s. The beginning was difficult, and it was still one woman vs two men. In the face of the upcoming arrest scene, she decisively gave up the goal set by her relatives and turned to the arms of the unlucky boss. From now on, she will fight for the best, seek justice, and clean up all those who want to harm her. By the way… Oh no, how could the luck of this unlucky boss get better, and he still hugged her and cried in the middle of the night?

title: Become Invincible By Super Reading System
summary: Pei Yu, a First Grade Martial Cultivator, faces a life of scorn and stagnation, barely surviving in a harsh society. His marital ties to the contemptuous Ke family only add to his woes. An encounter with the Super God Reading System offers a glimmer of hope, promising empowerment through reading novels. However, Pei Yu initially struggles with access due to his low cultivation level and the cost of purchasing books. With an unexpected talent boost from the system, he delves into ""Hundred Refined To Be A God,"" gaining rapid cultivation skills. Pei Yu embarks on a transformative journey, Could he unlocking his latent potential and challenging the limits of his martial abilities.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mystery, Supernatural, Xuanhuan

title: In a World Where Strength Is Ranked, I, a High School Teacher, Was Transported Along With My Students and Rose From a Mere Side Character to the Rank of Sword Saint
summary: Weak abilities? No problem! A teacher with unmatched swordsmanship dominates a fantasy world with nothing but his blade! --[The Strongest Rankings] In this world, people’s strength is ranked by a system, and high school teacher Shigeto Kusunoki found himself transported there along with his students. While his students gained overpowered abilities, Shigeto’s powers were weak, and his rank was among the lowest. Ridiculed by his students, Shigeto tried to adapt to this new world, supported by a priestess named Mirei. But then, one of his students, Yuzuki Kimishima, was sent to a monster-filled ruin from which no one had ever returned. Determined to save his student, Shigeto set off alone into the deadly ruins to rescue Yuzuki. In the depths of despair, his one remaining weapon, the swordsmanship he had honed before being transported, held an extraordinary power in this world. "You’re sacrificing yourself for me... I... I..." Yuzuki, who admired him, could only watch as Shigeto fought on, cutting down enemies to protect her. As he continued to fight, Shigeto’s rank soared to unimaginable heights, and soon his name began to spread throughout the world. --This is the story of how a mere side-character teacher dominated a fantasy world with nothing but his sword and became a Sword Saint.

title: I’m So Weak
summary: A beautiful girl who was inspired to be an O was differentiated into an A at the age of 18. A beautiful boy who was educated to be an A from childhood to adulthood differentiated into an O at the age of 18. Female A: Can you help others carry this bag~ Male O: Give it to me. Take two steps, panting. Female A: What's the matter with you, little brother? Male O: I'm sorry, I'm too weak. I'm weak, I'm really a weak man.

title: I Became the Commander in a T*ash Game Who Copies Skills
summary: I grasped a talent that allowed me to use any skill I had seen once. [[Warrior’s Insight] is active.] [Skill acquired.] [Infernal Meteor (Level 7)] In a world where the flames of war engulfed the entire continent. I would survive with my people.

title: Sending You a Man
summary: Fu Yan and I are arch-rivals, yet everyone seems to mistake us for a couple. I eventually grew tired of explaining myself and just let the rumors fly. That was until one day, a beautiful woman stormed up to my door with an aggressive look in her eyes. "Break up with Fu Yan. Whatever you want, I'll give it to you." I was just about to clarify the situation. Then, right behind her, I spotted Xu Qinghe-tall, long-legged, with broad shoulders and a narrow waist. He was the guy I'd crushed on for all three years of high school. My eyes lit up. "Are you serious? In that case, I want him!"
genres: Adult, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: She Comes Through the Window
summary: An honor student and a young lady. An exceptionally beautiful girl with an outstanding figure, a flower on a high pedestal. That was the image I had of my classmate, Fumizuki Sakuya. However, that was two years ago. Now, she's a real "witch." I'm the only one who knows that secret. And then she went out of her way to move next to me and kept bothering me for no reason. Why did that beautiful girl who was once out of my league turn into a tsundere witch who comes to my window every night? For the past two years, in a fantasy "another world," she was the final boss "witch," and I was the "hero" opposing her. But I know. That person used to like me. And even now, actually quite a bit──that person, she "likes" me. After all, she is so open and straightforwardly affectionate. However, I have no intention of dating or anything like that. I thought we would at most remain healthy friends, but... The comfortable relationship where we can talk without hiding our true selves, being the only ones in the world who can do so, is truly pleasant. Before I knew it, we had developed a distance like that of a married couple and had gradually fallen into a quasi-cohabitation state... "Don't get the wrong idea. I would do anything for your happiness... I'm not lying, you know?" This is a slightly fantastical and frustratingly slow romantic comedy about a tsundere witch who is easily flustered and full of gaps, who gradually becomes a clingy bride (with a hint of yandere) by showing her true self only to the protagonist. Or, the story of the two who were once the strongest in another world until they grasped true happiness.

title: Villain’s Delicate and Charming Wife
summary: When the beautiful lawyer, Jiang Yao, woke up, she transmigrated to a novel and became the green-tea female character of the novel. Throughout the story, this character has been creating strife between the male protagonist and female protagonist, and finally met her tragic end. She have all the money, beauty, and wisdom, and yet, they expect her to cling to that dog man? Only crazy person would continue to lick that dog! Lawyer Jiang quickly turned around and went to hug the thigh of the main villain, Lu Che. Although he is now covered with patches and despised by everyone, but in the future, he will be a famous business tycoon. So, when the educated youth site was on the verge of collapse, Jiang Yao took the initiative to take refuge in the Lu family’s house. However, when Jiang Yao happily lived in the Lu family’s house, she noticed that, the way the fierce man looked at her became more and more suspicious…

title: Reforming the Villain Family
summary: "I have come to find the Duke's biological daughter." At the age of 4, I unintentionally became an accomplice in the scam of the villainous Duke from a novel I read in my past life. But why does a normal person like me have to be involved with this villainous duke’s family? To survive the annihilation of the family, I must reform them before they fully turn into villains! "As expected, no matter where we go, my daughter shines the brightest." "If you don't want to go, then don't. Just ignore the Emperor or the Crown Prince." "So, who confessed? Just tell me their name." "What?! Which bastard dared to confess to my little girl?!" But wait... As long as they aren't villains, why are they acting so ridiculously overprotective? "I told you." I only stopped walking when I was cornered. The footsteps following me stopped too, and a resentful voice echoed in my ears. "You said you'd stay by my side." His eyes persistently locked onto mine. Honestly, I felt wronged. After all, back then, ‘I didn’t know you were the male lead!’

title: Please, I’m Trying to Study, Your Highness!
summary: Question: "If you transmigrate into the world of a classic urban wish-fulfillment novel, and as a modern Goblin, you have neither modeling skills nor economic resources, but you can bring one cheat item with you, which of the following abilities would you choose?" A: Time Stop (Train, classroom, infirmary, convenience store, playground... Let me say it one more time, time. It's about to stop!) B: Hypnosis Technique (Do you see this endlessly spinning purple vortex on your phone? Shh....) C: Minotaur Power (The blond punk is the eternal god. The novel's protagonist? Hmph, just obediently be the victim!) "Nonsense." Lin Hui snorted coldly. A real bro knows not to chase impossible dreams. It's getting late, the Goblin High Priest has already made dinner and is waiting for me to return to the nest. "Choose D: Study hard and make progress every day. Sorry, I'm here for pure love!"
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Baby Tyrant
summary: ‘Less than a month old… I became the great empire’s treasured princess…!’ In all my life, I wanted love. Love from my family, But the family I had, failed me in the end. Abandoned… ab*sed… I don’t want this so-called family. It’s a waste of time. I came to a new world after a miserable ending… ‘The empire’s treasured princess… that’s me… but why is father, the emperor, so strange?’ “Mabel, I will give you the Ponce Castle.” “My sweet child, the most fertile land is yours.” “No, wait, this whole country will be yours for the plucking.” ‘Father, he’s strange… is this what family love is like?’
genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Sweet Beauty
summary: The current Empress Dowager once gave birth to a daughter, Zhao Shu, before she was remarried to the Late Emperor. A’Shu was renowned for her beauty in Hebei since childhood. Before getting married, her elder brother and sister-in-law advised her that Liu Xun was a man of profound thoughts and schemes. Relying on her beauty, they feared that she wouldn’t last long. A’Shu said, “Everyone says that this man is kind and cultured, winning the support and love of the people, but he is indifferent to women. He is still single at such an age. So even if I am to use my looks to gain his favor, I’m afraid I wouldn’t know where to start either.” Only after the wedding did she discover that the rumor couldn’t be more wrong! Kind and cultured he may be but indifferent to women?? Haha, she couldn’t see it at all! Liu Xun’s elder brother recently died. Barely starting his mourning period, he married the daughter of his enemy. In the beginning, they were as incompatible as fire and water. Who would have thought that before long, he would be brought down on his knees, worshipping the very hem of his wife’s skirt. From then on, the couple slowly overcame enmity and suspicion, gradually knew and cherished each other through the struggles of enduring humiliation and trying to turn the tides together.

title: I Use Poetry to Slay Demons and Banish Evils
summary: Song Mu, a Chinese language and literature major, experiences a strange time-travel, only to discover that the world after the Tang Dynasty has reached a turning point. In this world, there are demons and monsters, and scholars can harness the power of literature. Through poetry, essays, and prose, they can exorcise demons and use the works of great scholars to suppress evil! Armed with a *Compendium of Ancient and Modern Poetry* that he obtained by chance, and drawing from the Song and Yuan era poetry stored in his mind, Song Mu embarks on a path through the imperial examination system, slaying demons and upholding the righteous way! As stars fall and chaos reigns in the world, literary power rises to bring peace. In a world of illusions, I wield my pen to strike down demons!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Supernatural

title: Peerless Little Misfortune
summary: Someone has laid an inescapable trap, intending for me to be betrayed by all and deserted by my loved ones. Luo Yinyou braved countless perils to unlock the seal on the Northern Domain, officially opening up the world to its new structure of Five Domains, One Island, and One Holy Capital. However, she discovers that danger is ever-present, entangled with the secrets of the great ancient war and the dealings between gods and demons. "It's fine, I have a system..." Luo Yinyou comforted herself. "Even if the system is a total troll!" The world's structure has undergone a massive shift, and destiny is being redistributed. Countless geniuses are emerging one after another, with the most dazzling among them being the Young Lord of Dragon Island, Ye Ci, hailed as the number one Divine Soul Realm cultivator of the current era! "Ye Ci? Isn't that my childhood..." Luo Yinyou's eyes lit up as she said with a grin, "Hello everyone, my name is Ye Ci." ... This book is also known as 《After I Became Wildly Successful in the Cultivation World Using the Male Lead's Name》 and 《Good News: I'm Famous. Bad News: I Used the Male Lead's Name to Make Him Famous》. ... ——"Have you heard of the Nine Clans of the Divine Progeny?" Luo Yinyou: "Nope. I only know that I'm going to slaughter the Nine Ghost Sects." ——"Have you ever bathed in the holy light of the divine Dao, and do you know that Zhaoge is eternally bright while the Ghost Domain is eternally dark?" Luo Yinyou: "I haven't. But I know that when my judgment descends, both gods and demons will get out of my way!"

title: Martial Arts Overlord
summary: Luo Feng was just an ordinary student until the day he met an accident on his way to school. By the time he awoke, he had transmigrated to a different world and was in possession of the body of another person who was also named Luo Feng. Blinded by love, the former owner wasted three years of his life pursuing the girl before dying of a broken heart. Reawakening in this new body and given another chance at life, Luo Feng set his mind on regaining the pride lost by its former owner. This is a story of a transmigrator traveling out to triumph over those who tried to undermine him. Join Luo Feng in his journey as he rise to the top as the Martial Arts Overlord!
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: The Overpowered Traveling Supporter Just Wants to Leisurely Sightsee in Modern-Day Dungeons
summary: A girl leisurely goes sightseeing in dungeons—while shattering society’s common sense. Kōjima Yūna is a solo explorer who, based on the notebook left behind by her late mother, takes her time streaming dungeon explorations. She visits scenic spots and mysterious sights in the modern-day dungeons, recording them along the way. The only thing that sets her apart from other explorers is that she can use a variety of support magic—buffs, debuffs, and the like. One day, on her way back from a dungeon, she happens to see a party being attacked by monsters. On a whim, she lends them roadside support—and ends up drawing the public’s attention. The reason is simple: her buffs and debuffs were so ridiculously overpowered that they defied all common sense. And that public attention becomes the catalyst for the world to start changing—bit by bit, as she single-handedly smashes through all kinds of norms.

title: I Became the Archmage That Transcendents Are Obsessed With
summary: I came back with the intention of getting revenge on the transcendents. But why are they gathering around me even more…?

title: My Sister Confessed To Me Out Of The Blue, But How Am I Supposed To Go Out With Her?
summary: The night before entering high school, my sister came to my room and suddenly confessed to me. “Onii-chan, go out with me.” The first confession in my life was from my sister... I couldn't say no when I saw my sister's tears, so I went to the entrance ceremony with my answer on hold. My sister who goes to the same high school as me. How am I supposed to date my sister? A flirtatious love comedy between a super Brocon sister with superb comic skills and her kind, normal brother who is a nobody. ~Imagine if you could love a sister like that~
genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Ancient Assassin Meets Modern-day Career Woman
summary: Ruan Qing picked up an ancient man. The man said, “I have worked in the industry for many years, earning ten thousand taels of gold and boxes full of jewels.” Ruan Qing asked, “Where are they?” The man: “...In ancient times.” “Then that’s fine.” Ruan Qing stuffed the mop into his hands, sweetly saying, “Mop the floor clean, wash the plates and bowls, and remember to take the clothes out of the washing machine and hang them. The washing machine is that square thing that spins. Then, obediently wait for me to come home.” She slammed the door and left. The man looked up at the sky and sighed: Still have to earn money to support the family to gain status. Later, a man who could run on eaves and walk on walls exploded in popularity online and became a mysterious internet celebrity. Ruan Qing frowned: “You changed to a new car? Where did the money come from?” “Just saved a little private stash,” the man coughed and said, “I handed over everything else to you. This is household money earned by your husband.”

title: There’s a Demon King Inside the Hero
summary: I was summoned to another world, became a hero, and killed the Demon King. After fulfilling my duty and returning to my original world, what greeted me was an ordinary body, still holding the memories of my time as a hero. And then. “…The Demon King?” [...Hero?] All that’s left in my mind is the lingering thought of the Demon King, my sworn enemy, who has now settled there. But I can’t give up like this. “Teach me magic, Demon King.” [...What?] I will become strong once again.

title: The Magic Empire’s Greatest Genius Knight in History
summary: In a world ruled by wizards, Anflus, of noble blood, is unable to manifest magic. Treated as a useless Mage and a liability to his family, he chooses a single sword. A swordsmanship more magical than any other magic begins to emerge from the hands of one man.

title: That Village, That Person, That Fool
summary: In a faraway village, the Lee family’s eldest daughter, Hehua marries the village fool Changsheng… A lighthearted story about a simple village fool and the winsome village girl.

title: One Day, I Started to See Other People’s Secret
summary: One day, I started “being able to see” the “status” bar that could be said to be someone else’s secret. My childhood friend Segawa Haru is "pure maternal instinct". The girl is rumored to be a gyaru and a bit*h? You have to check whether it's true or false. If I could understand the other person, it would be easier to talk to her. While I thought it was a good opportunity to get close to the prettiest person in school and my secret unrequited love Takauji-san, I saw that she was shot by (Ikemen) the prettiest guy in school (this guy has the feeling that it's more important than sex)!? It's also possible that Takauji-san, who looks "weak under pressure," was reluctantly forced to be unable to refuse his confession... I have to save Takauji-san from the hands of the devil! And if there's a chance...! If he holds the secret in him hands, even an ordinary weakling will become a strong man in love! The NORMAL ROMCOM show has officially begun!
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: My Brother Dares, Does Yours?
summary: I got into an argument with the male lead's sister. She shrieked, "My brother has a beautiful girlfriend, does yours?" "My brother's parents are alive and well, does yours?" I sneered, "My brother dares to eat poop. Does yours?" That night, my brother came home, dejected and heartbroken after being rejected for the seventh time. He saw me squatting by the door, a fawning smile on my face. He paused, then asked with a helpless sigh, "What trouble did you get into now?" Just as he spoke, his phone rang. The man on the other end hesitated before speaking. "You win, alright?" "Eating... that thing. I really can't bring myself to do it."

title: The Woman Who Bought The Red Thread
summary: “Would you like to sell your red string? I will grant you one wish. Anything you want.” A tempting offer is made when life is at its hardest — a woman named Yeo-heun buys the red string. And a man named Yoon-gyeol follows her. What is the truth about the red string that he will finally discover?

title: I Will Try Raising an Enemy.
summary: Vasha, a subordinate vampire, is trying to regain lost memories and abilities. Todd, the sole survivor of a fallen lineage, seeks revenge against humans. They enter into a soul contract, each hiding their own purpose. However, when making a contract, one must read the terms carefully... "I, 【 Vasylisha, 】propose a 【 Binding Contract.】" "I, 【 Todd Van Drake...】" "What? Todd Van Drake?" "...accept the 【 Binding Contract! 】" Vasha, unaware that Todd is both a vampire's enemy and a renowned vampire hunter. "You... aren't you a high-ranking vampire?" "... Did you notice that?" "No wonder! A high-ranking vampire wouldn't consider making a mere human brat their familiar!" "What do you mean by 'brat'..." Todd, realizing too late that Vasha, whom he thought to be a high-ranking vampire, is just a lower-ranking one. They become reluctant companions due to the existence of an unknown letter. But is it just because they are enemies? Despite being the closest relationship one could have in the world, Todd, who is sharp and aloof towards everything in the world, doesn't easily open his heart to Vasha. Yet Todd is still young. Until Todd grows up, there's time to slowly become friends! While Vasha tries to raise this stubborn enemy... Can they each achieve their goals?

title: After Transmigrating to the Modern Era, the Metaphysics Master Dazzles the World
summary: The once revered Grand National Teacher, worshipped by millions, is reborn in the modern era, 1800 years later. Saddled with a fate reading of "born a waste," and with a breathtakingly talented twin sister ahead of her? Having lived a life as a world-shaking genius, Fu Ziqi declares: How novel! Onlookers all laughed at Fu Ziqi's ridiculously good luck, exiled for twenty years and still able to be taken back by the Fu Family! But later, they suddenly realized that Fu Ziqi, this "waste," wasn't quite what they imagined… She is the strongest ancient physician, mastering lost acupuncture techniques, snatching people from the jaws of death! She is the current era's number one Word Spirit Master; once she speaks, no one can stop her! She is an ancient martial arts genius, entering at the Heaven Rank, shocking half of the Ancient Martial World! Graceful and charming, that's her! Uninhibited and free-spirited, that's her! Sarcastic and sharp-tongued, that's still her! Everyone is bewildered: Who was the blind idiot who called her a waste? A refined gentleman, Yan Jiuxian of the Yan Clan. He is the current number one figure in the Ancient Martial World, noble, aloof, and indifferent. Born with a weak constitution, yet possessing extraordinary talent! No one knows that he has staked his life on a gamble, his whole life obsessed, waiting only for someone beyond the cycle of reincarnation. * A Gentle Gentleman Meets a Cunning and Sharp-Tongued Woman * Dual Pampering, Ancient Martial Arts, Word Spirit

title: Genius in Steel
summary: In the era of Duel League, where human consciousness is implanted into competitive robots and they fight, the greatest martial artist of all time awakens. However, his body is composed of oil and steel, not flesh and blood.

title: Iron Blooded Wolf
summary: In order to protect his relatives, he fists the rich and stepped on the rich and powerful, and gradually rolled people into an abyss. In order to survive, he can only return as a wolf and make his own path of iron-bloodedness.

title: Orc Taming Guide
summary: The Competition-grade Service Beastman I bought doesn't like me. He only wags his tail for my younger sister. Later, I brought home a Low-grade Vent Beastman. But then, he was so anxious he was on the verge of tears. "Qin Zhao, you're only allowed to keep me as your puppy!"

title: The Record of Unusual Creatures
summary: Hao Ren (literally means "good man"), as his Chinese name suggested, is a good man, and his ideal was to live a restful, comfortable life as a landlord. At least that was his plan before a couple of abnormal creatures rented his house. A remote, outdated big apartment, a bunch of rather abnormal non-human creatures, and a labor contract from the "god", the three factors combined lead him to be the busiest landlord and most supernatural "babysitter". The story of the most complicated, erratic and abnormal landlord and tenants started from here. "Ever since I put my fingerprint on the labor contract, I knew I was roped into something terrible..." As a person who is down-to-earth as well as a good Samaritan, Hao Ren desires to live the rest of his life as a benevolent landlord. Stumbling into a curious yet mysterious lady, he began his journey of "collecting" abnormal and supernatural tenants. His life only became more chaotic when he receives a labor contract from "God". Discover the many races, myths and worlds that lie beyond what humans define as normal! This bizarre fantasy full of fun is sure to bring you on a crazy rollercoaster of emotions!
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Naruto: Tsunade, I’m the Hokage!
summary: Kyōen transmigrated to Konoha and awakened the Hokage System but to get stronger, he must become Hokage first.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Burning Paper Every Day, I Became a Taoist Ancestor
summary: When Wang Hun woke up and stood in a mass grave, he found that he had become a ghost... Burn "three pheasant feathers" and enjoy the [Black-bone White Phoenix Fragrance]. Burn "half a volume of broken scriptures" with one stick and enjoy the "Ten Thousand Buddhas Chaozong". Incense] Burn "a foxtail" with one stick, and enjoy the "Incense of Bliss" with one stick... "When you are alive, you should burn some treasures for yourself!" In a world where gods and Buddhas are everywhere, and demons are everywhere, Wang Hun Looking at the bright fire in the brazier, I enshrined myself as the Taoist ancestor! ! !

title: I Reincarnated as a Villainous Noble Doomed to Die in 3 Years!
summary: I reincarnated as a villainous noble in another world. To make matters worse, I've already triggered a death flag that guarantees my demise in three years. No matter how hard I try, there's no way to avoid it. If that's the case, I might as well embrace it! For the next three years, I'll make a bucket list of everything I want to do in this world and live freely! As a villainous noble, I've got plenty of money and power, so why not make the most of it?
genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: Rising Star
summary: “It was the most important match of his career, yet professional golfer **Kim Sang-hyun** hit a wall and failed. To clear his head, he went to Jeju Island—only to meet a death straight out of a movie. And then… **Lee Hyun**, who inherits his will. A new storm is about to sweep through the Korean pro-golf scene. **Lee Hyun!** His debut is about to begin.” ---
genres: Action, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Sports

title: Fairy Tail: Collapsing Stars
summary: Evan crossed over, but he wasn’t worried at all… because he had the character template from the mobile game and five devil fruits obtained from a lottery draw with him. Evan believed that he could rely on the special physique obtained from his first recharge, as well as the devil fruits in his backpack, to become a powerful figure in the world of One Piece. But it wasn’t until Evan opened his eyes and saw a crimson dragon that he realized this wasn’t One Piece at all, it was Fairy Tail! Starting by capturing Erza? Nope, starting by being captured by Irene!

title: The Case Where I, Who Reincarnated as the Villain in an Erotic Game, Saved the Heroine’s Little Sister and a Lot of Amazing Things Happened
summary: When I woke up, I had reincarnated as the villain Tendou Ryuusei from the erot*c game "My Girlfriends Being Corrupted." And on my way to school, I saved Hiiragi Kaori, the heroine's little sister, who was being hit on. From then on, I began to have a relationship with Kaori. And furthermore, with the heroines as well. Eventually, I came to be liked by all of them.

title: Safe Transaction
summary: “Stop it, unless you want to die a dog’s death.”Jaehyuk, a high school classmate she reunites with after eight years.She had to stop him.“…I don’t know what you think you know, Lee Hyun, but this is official business.” “So I’m telling you to back off.” “Could you at least make sense?” “Anyway, I warned you, okay? Let’s not see each other again.”But Jaehyuk wouldn’t be Jaehyuk if he actually listened.He refuses to step away from a dangerous investigation. Hyun goes undercover at his side as a secret Interpol agent, and they continue the case together.…Somehow even ending up living together.“Anything you want to eat?” “Delivery’s so good these days.” “Right, so something that doesn’t deliver.” “Octopus hot pot?”A man who cooks her octopus hot pot— what is she supposed to do with him?—Smack.This time, Jaehyuk tilted his head the other way and lightly pressed his lips to hers again.Apparently unsatisfied with just twice, he pulled away only to lean in once more. With a bright, playful sound, his lips touched Hyun’s and parted again.“Tastes good.”At his single remark, Hyun’s face flushed as red as her lips. Jaehyuk loved seeing that look on her. “Strawberry again, huh?”

title: GODZILLA: Monster Apocalypse
summary: The prequel story to [GODZILLA: Monster Planet] released nationwide on 2017-11-17! Here is a collection of records from the age when humanity battled against the monsters. Facing immense despair, how did humans confront it, and how were they defeated? This is the one and only prequel to the anime version of GODZILLA.
genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-fi, Tragedy

title: Junior Sister, Your Junior Brother Is About to Be Kidnapped!
summary: Flower Rain Ling, who cultivated the Ruthless Dao, was extremely irritated. That junior brother’s courtyard was getting noisier and noisier—more and more… annoying. Demon-fallen Sword Immortal: “Didn’t expect that, did you? He’s completely different when he’s with me. Look at that delighted expression of his~ Does he ever act like that when he’s with you?” The “delicate” junior sister: “Heeheehee, Senior Sister, since you don’t care about Senior Brother anyway, why don’t you just give him to me~” The gentle fox…
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Sports, Xianxia

title: Narcissu
summary: The anonymous protagonist is diagnosed with lung cancer shortly after his twentieth birthday, and is admitted to hospice care at a hospital in Mito, Ibaraki. There he meets Setsumi, a woman who is two years older than he is, who is also terminally ill. Finding that they both refuse to die in the hospital or at home with their families, they run away together in a silver Honda Integra belonging to the protagonist's father. They travel west across Japan's many highways and prefectures, initially not knowing where to go, but later collectively decide on taking the narcissus fields of southern Awaji Island as a somewhat arbitrary destination.
genres: Adventure, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: The Cutthroat Adventurer
summary: There is a history in this world of multiple battles with the demon race for survival. Although the Demon King was sealed away by the third generation of heroes, the entire continent is still a cutthroat and brutal land. Traveling through such a world is the unsympathetic wizard, Johan. Johan, the wizard, is a man who keeps his public and private affairs separate. However, he occasionally lets his emotions run wild. His hobbies include killing bandits and thugs. Also, lecturing people and picking fights. In this dark fantasy, Johan, who lives in the current era, travels through a world that has been ravaged by multiple major battles with the demon race. ※ This work is also published on Kakuyomu and Hameln. There is a heroine, but no harem. There is no shortage of depictions of violence.

title: Transmigrated to the 1970s to become a Military Wife, Pampered to the Heavens by the Compound’s Commander
summary: [Era setting + space ability + educated youth sent to the countryside + sweet military marriage + revenge drama] The psychic squad leader Xu Zhixin opened her eyes and found herself transmigrated to the 1970s. She had become a pitiful girl whose mother died early, who was bullied by her stepmother’s family, and whose stepbrother even tried to take advantage of her. Her heartless biological father even wanted to sell her to a notoriously wicked old widower for 500 yuan. Outrageous! They all deserved to die! After making sure all the bad guys got what they deserved, she was forced to go down to the countryside. No problem—she had powers, she had space, and even in the countryside, she could live large and thrive. Life was beyond satisfying... Wait—why does that military officer keep staring at her? What? He’s fallen for her? He wants to marry her...?

title: Please, Save Me
summary: Elena Castaya, who lived as the vain fiancée of the Crown Prince, finds her family falling into ruin for treason. Rather than clinging to a pitiful existence, she chooses death, only to wake up in the body of an orphan girl named Evelyn. With only the foreign languages she learned during her time as the Crown Prince's consort, Elena earns a living by translating. One day, someone appears seeking a young woman fluent in Esperanto. "I need someone to closely monitor the fallen Second Prince. Someone who can report everything, from whom the Second Prince meets, exchanges letters with, and even down to the petty gossip the servants indulge in." “........“ "You look pretty and you're intelligent. I've taken a liking to you." After waking up, she had deliberately avoided the news. But… the Second Prince Vincent had been disgraced for the crime of assassinating her? "I'll do it. Please let me." ‘Vincent, I… I thought you'd live well even if you let me kill myself. Since you saved me, I'll live this life for you.’

title: I Was Born as the Protagonist’s Daughter!
summary: What is this?! I was born as the daughter of the villainous male lead and the angelic female lead from a novel! And I was just a side character in a brief extra chapter…! They say my personality improved after meeting the female lead, but who would believe that? I’ve read the whole extra chapter! But then, "Really, you look so much like Serli. How are you so beautiful?" "Oh, you’re so sweet… I love you, Hidden." "I love you too." ...Wait, they seem surprisingly normal? It’s been 4 years since my reincarnation. Ligenia is now living happily as the noble daughter of the Nehiris family. "Your reincarnation is to preserve the original story, which isn’t finished yet." The joy of my second life was short-lived. A black dragon I met in a dream told me that I am the only one who can prevent the destruction. Damn it. Why does it have to be me?!

title: Phoenix’s Requiem
summary: Painfully shy and conflict-averse, Yun Ruoyan is a scion to a noble house only in name, a puppet embroiled in political machinations beyond her ken. At the tender age of eighteen, poisoned and at death’s door, she finds herself thrown out into the streets. Her relatives have all been executed, betrayed by her dear husband and her cousin. With her dying breath, she curses her own weakness and swears revenge. When Yun Ruoyan awakens once more, she is thirteen, transported five years into the past by the will of the heavens. Her death-defying experience has changed her: no longer is she the malleable creature she once was but more questions await at every corner- What is the truth behind the birthmark that disfigures her appearance? What are the circumstances surrounding her mother’s mysterious death? Will the phoenix rise from the ashes, or will she fall once more in thrall to fate?

title: Setsuna no Fuukei
summary: Setsuna Sugimoto is summoned to another world as the 68th hero only to be abandoned because of his weak and sickly constitution. But everything changes when he's given a third chance at life by his dear friend Kyle, the former hero, thereby inheriting his vast knowledge, power, and lifeforce. Freed from the tethers of his past, Setsuna begins a journey as an adventurer where he'll encounter all walks of life, each experience bound to leave their mark on both him and his world.

title: Transmigrating into a Matriarchal World to Be a Couch Potato
summary: Medical student Ji Zhaohe stayed up late working on an experiment and unfortunately passed away. She woke up to find herself transmigrated into the Jingde era—the peak of matriarchal power. And she had actually become the notoriously brutal Third Princess! In the original story, after the female lead seized the throne, her fate was utterly miserable, a cause for universal celebration. So Ji Zhaohe decided to take advantage of her wealth and power to indulge herself while she could. Youth has no price tag—with money, you can explore the world! She planned to take it one day at a time! Unexpectedly, on her very first day, she was set up and forced to marry the most virtuous and beautiful young gentleman in the capital. On their wedding night, the young gentleman tearfully attempted to end his life. Ji Zhaohe quickly snatched away the dagger. With a healer’s compassion, she advised, “If you can’t untie the knot in your heart, turn them into a bow.” She then tucked the young gentleman into the blankets, wrapping him up like a rice dumpling, and tied a bow to reassure him she wouldn’t lay a finger on him. To her surprise, the young gentleman cried even harder after hearing this. Later, Ji Zhaohe spent her days taking the young gentleman on leisurely trips to enjoy the mountains and waters, living a carefree life. In the second year of their marriage, because the young gentleman had yet to bear a child, the Empress bestowed upon Ji Zhaohe three consorts: one pure and cute, one charming and alluring, and one gentle and kind. That night, the young gentleman knelt by the bed, trembling as he untied his robe, tears welling in his eyes. “My wife, please don’t abandon me.” How did she accidentally make it all the way to the story’s happy ending? Couch Potato & Little Crybaby Content Notes: 1. Mpreg, slight angst for the male lead. 2. A lighthearted romance focused on travel and leisure, with minimal political intrigue. Slice-of-life! Slice-of-life! 3. The female lead is a true couch potato—no ambition, purely lazing through life!

title: Ah, Demon King, That’s Not How You Do It
summary: “Dare you send me back in time…?” The last swordsman of humanity who fought the Demon King until the very end returns to the past using the Demon King’s power. But something feels a little strange. “It becomes an amazing weapon when anyone else touches it, but when I use it, it becomes disposable?” Kim Jeonghyeon, a porter who can only survive by working like a dog for others. Today as well, he pushes his subordinates hard. “That’s the only way we can smash that bastard!”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: I’m a Hero, but I’ve Given Up on Saving the World
summary: My friend and I were transported into a game. Of all things, my friend was chosen as the hero, and I became a nobody. "Why are you wasting food here? Just go back to Earth." "What's your value for existing?" "Aren't you ashamed to be alive?" "How are you any help to us?" The bullying and contempt started under my friend's leadership. I just ignored it. They could go on their adventures or not; I just wanted to go home. But then, the hero died during an expedition. The same people who ignored me yesterday are now begging me to become the new hero. Why should I? I'm just going to go home.

title: Even If I Killed This Love, Only You Wanted To Protect It
summary: You throw yourself into the darkness. I want to save you this time. Moka is a first year high school student who has had bad experiences due to her stutter since childhood and is afraid of what tomorrow will bring. When Terumichi, a sociable transfer student who is the complete opposite of Moeka, shows up, her days gradually begin to change. He seems to be teasing Moeka, but then he casually helps her… Moeka wants to keep Terumichi away from her, but one day she finds out that he has the same scars as her… Seeing Terumichi’s willingness to sacrifice himself in order to save Moeka, she takes an action that no one would have expected. This is a pure love story that will make your heart ache for the bond between the two.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Heart Break Detective Momose
summary: “Love eventually ends──” Caught up in the words of his junior, Momose Chiyoda, Tsukumo Nonomura finds himself helping the ‘Heartbreak Detective’. Operating from the Mystery Research Club’s room as their base, this unofficial school detective activity investigates the truth behind heartbreaks. Clients, each harboring their own woes of lost love, come to them seeking answers. This is the story of a girl detective who hasn’t experienced love, solving the sweet and bitter story of love’s end.

title: The Campus Queen’s Kept Physician
summary: The world's number one assassin is asked to play the role of a decoy boyfriend in a honey-trap scheme - and decides he's going to enjoy the free ride.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance

title: As the Result of I, a Former Eighth Grader Syndrome Patient, Took Advantage of Psychology Effect, Somehow I Ended up Having to Conclude an Agreement with the School’s First Beauty
summary: Going through a gloomy middle school period covered with dark history, he is Kido Souta. Souta was going through a peaceful high school life without any problem, until the thing about he took advantage of psychology effect had been discovered by Minase Eri. As a result, he had to make an agreement with the school’s number one, Minase Eri. “Then, will you make an agreement with me? “ Could Souta, whom the school’s number one had an eye on, maintain his peaceful and safe school life?

title: Surviving the Heroines in the Game
summary: I, a player, was transmigrated as the protagonist of a game I had played for 4 years. But instead of receiving a congratulatory message, I got a penalty. And now the heroines are trying to kill me?

title: In the Place where the Golden Rose Was Broken
summary: "Our ballet company has the greatest treasure." Karen Shaner, a ballerina with beautiful looks and innate talent. Karen, once a noble flower, turns to a sponsor to save the dance company crumbling under financial deficit. And at the moment when the sponsor reveals his dark intentions and tries to mol*st her, She receives help from Duke Acturus, the hero of Gloretta. "Come into my arms, unfortunate Miss." "......Thank you, Sir who enjoys others' misfortunes." Acturus, pressured by his family to marry, and Karen, who needs an investor and protector for the ballet company. The two begin a contract relationship to use each other, but… "What if it's a fleeting dream? When I'm with you, I feel like I'm dreaming." The relationship that started as a lie gradually becomes sincere. Then one day, Acturus discovers the thorns Karen had been hiding beneath her petals....... *** "Tell me you didn't, that you're wrongly accused." "Acturus." At Karen's gentle voice, Acturus felt the urge to run away. The damned Karen Shaner was, even at this moment, devastatingly beautiful. Enough to willingly endure the humiliation of this reality. "I wish I had never dreamed such a dream." Acturus pointed the ice-cold gun barrel at Karen's forehead. Bang! It was the end of a moment that had been beautiful as a dream.

title: Gentle Knife
summary: Tang Xicheng walks out of the dormitory building and sees Liang Yuzhi talking on the phone by the railing. She hears three sentences: “Sending someone to school.” “Well… it’s a relative’s child.” “What can I feel?” He laughs faintly, “Can’t even talk, so boring.” The story revolves around a 6-year age difference. It’s about a narcissistic male protagonist who thinks a naive and sweet female protagonist is deeply in love with him, only to find out that’s not the case.

title: The Ouyang Clan’s Greatest Genius Rascal
summary: Gu Yangcheon, heir of a fallen swordmaster clan, becomes possessed by the greatest martial artist in the world.

title: Sword Sovereign’s Return
summary: He had risen from a third-rate ronin to the Sword Sovereign of the Black Path, yet there was always one step missing to reach the very top of the world. In the end, he could not take that final step, and his life came to an end at the hands of the Heaven Piercing Cult Leader—but fortune favored him. A regression arrived like a miracle. And so, he took up the sword once more. Whether it was Heaven Piercing, Black Path, or White Path, the world was filled with things that had to be cut down.

title: Into the Book: Finding Their Long-Lost Father
summary: Su Zhaozhao stayed up all night to finish reading a novel set in a past era, and when she woke up, she found herself in the world of the book, becoming the male protagonist’s early-deceased wife, who wasn’t even mentioned by name and was only briefly mentioned. He thought she was gone, she thought he was dead, and the former wife, struggling to survive with their two children, eventually died from exhaustion! And then Su Zhaozhao found herself transmigrated into her place… In this time of scarcity, with little to eat or wear, Su Zhaozhao, who was not skilled in any practical tasks, looked at the meager porridge in the bowl and decided to take the two kids to find their father! Whether he’s a good husband or not doesn’t matter; what’s important is not going hungry, and if there’s a stable job, that would be even better!"

title: Redemption

This catastrophic disaster-was it caused by a viral outbreak, a natural calamity, or a sinister human conspiracy? A group of teenagers finds themselves trapped in their school amidst the unfolding apocalypse. The once peaceful campus quickly descends into a hellish battleground as they struggle to survive. Each step forward is paved with bloodshed and growth, bringing them closer to a truth so horrifying it's difficult to bear. Yet survival remains the ultimate goal. Having fallen into the depths of hell, their only chance to escape is to climb over the bodies of the fallen, using them as stepping stones to move forward...

The struggle of Yeon Hojeong, the eldest son, to unite the martial world.

Remembering that Wen Ci was married, the doctor curiously asked, “Where does your husband work?” Just as Wen Ci was about to answer, she saw Huo Jingyuan standing at the door in casual clothes, his expression cold. The doctor tugged at Wen Ci’s sleeve and whispered, “That’s him, the King of Hell!” Wen Ci walked over to his side and asked, “Why are you here?” Huo Jingyuan replied calmly, “To take you home.”

title: I am Cat!!? Wanderlust of an Isekai Cat

As the second young lady of the Guogong Fu, her father and younger brother had gone missing under mysterious circumstances, and her mother had passed away. To uncover the truth, she had no choice but to do everything in her power to get close to the current Second Prince. The Second Prince was ten years her senior, stayed away from the imperial court, and had a cold and indifferent personality. Jiang Zhuoying finally managed to find out that he liked obedient and delicate women. From then on, the pampered and beautiful her transformed into a delicate maidservant, as fragile as a willow in the wind, who would faint at the drop of a hat and sprain her ankle from time to time. "This servant feels dizzy and can't stand steady..." "This servant will listen to whatever Your Highness says..." "Second Prince-gege, why are you so good to this servant?" ... Until one day: The man, his face cold, pinned her against the corner of a wall. "How much longer do you intend to play this maidservant?" The young woman was shocked. Thinking her identity had been exposed, she was too anxious to speak. But the man leaned in and covered her tender lips. "Xie Ling, Zhao Xiping, Gu Yanqing..." The young woman trembled, weakly hiding in the corner. The man's eyes sharpened. "They were all acceptable, but what about me?" Having uncovered the truth, Jiang Zhuoying dared not stay any longer. She found an excuse and staged a "Death Escape" to return to the Guogong Fu. Just as she was in the midst of seeking revenge and dealing with her enemies, she unexpectedly received an imperial edict for her marriage. On their wedding night, the formerly idle and incompetent Second Prince had become the current Crown Prince— The man's expression was grim as he pressed her down on the large, red wedding bed. "Ah Zhuo, you truly have your methods." Jiang Zhuoying's eyes filled with tears. "...Sob, sob, sob, what you said back then about liking me, does that not count anymore?" The master-servant relationship gradually transformed... "I have been away from the court for a long time. I am not worthy of being called 'Your Highness'." An idea struck the young woman, and she cautiously softened her voice. "Second Prince-gege?" Just when he thought he had finally obtained his own precious pearl. The news of the young woman's death left him heartbroken and utterly devastated. Until he saw a certain someone in a teahouse in the city, chatting with other men and laughing so hard she swayed like a flower in the wind... summary: "What?! The Young Master took another concubine?!" After Gu Changge binds to a mysterious system, he discovers that by forming bonds with Dao Companions, he can share their talents and cultivation achievements. Whether it's taking pills, absorbing heavenly treasures, or daily cultivation—everything can be shared! From that day on, he realized—rather than cultivating hard himself, it’s better to take in more Dao Companions. Why eat the pills himself when he can feed them to his wives? A cold-on-the-outside, warm-on-the-inside Holy Maiden of the sect, a mischievous imperial princess, a white-haired loli dragon girl in human form... 【Your Dao Companion cultivated all night—shared cultivation progress acquired!】 【Your Dao Companion comprehended sword intent—insight shared!】 【Your Dao Companion consumed a supreme snow lotus and comprehended a law—shared!】 【You spent a passionate night with your Dao Companion—reward incoming...】 As he happily "feeds" his wives every day, Gu Changge unwittingly steps into the realm of Immortal Lords, perfects the Sacred Body, and stands above all beings! Even domestic cars had regressed by ten years, with the domestic market dominated by foreign capital. Even more absurdly, there was now an Xapp on his phone, with powerful technology and tools that came with black technology, even capable of directly exchanging car production lines! With his phone filled with black technology, Li Fanfu declared war on all the car manufacturers. "It's not that I'm targeting anyone, but what I mean is, everyone here is rubbish!" Ezen also tries to accept her death, but Cliff does not kill her, but instead makes her as his wife. Sleeping with an unknown enemy, a life in which too much has been lost. After suffering, Ezen dies after giving birth to a child. But… Even after death, her soul, trapped in Cliff’s mansion, returns to the moment of her death, realizing the unexpected truth. The man and woman who couldn’t be together in a fierce destiny, a spring breeze permeates their dry hearts.

Until their anniversary, when she came home early and heard him on the balcony, speaking into the phone: “How could I ever love a deaf woman?” “I only married her out of duty.” “She depends on me. title: Reincarnated for the Second Time into a Harem Academy! I’ve Already Graduated from Being the Strongest, Now I Save Beautiful Girls from the Scumbags in This World of Reversed C*astity

But then, I got the cheat-reincarnation I’d always dreamed of— —or so I thought. Instead, I was thrown right into the middle of a battlefield with nothing but the stats of your average guy! Still, I fought tooth and nail. I kept fighting and fighting… until I became the strongest in that world. And then—I died again, taking the Demon King down with me. So, standing once more in the afterlife, I had some complaints. To the goddess, I said: “I’ve had enough of being the strongest!! He ends up having to start life from scratch again as an unwanted one, with no protection as a reincarnator whatsoever. However, this man realizes something. ——Unfortunate circumstances, life at the bottom of the caste system, no, this feels like a villain! Not magic, but Kasuya's unique power. The various events that occur, wait, aren't these the same things happening as in the god-tier game Life Field? Does that mean there's someone else besides me doing mastermind villain play!? When he keeps feeding exaggerated stories to impressionable beautiful girls of higher existence, he ends up being worshipped as the King of Curses. Somehow he becomes the leader of an organization lurking in the darkness of the world, created by high-spec beautiful girls. He gets targeted for his life and c*astity by serious beauties of higher races. Eventually, he even has to kill gods. All for escaping mob status! To enjoy mastermind villain play! Can I… go back to my original world? *** “You know, maybe…” Only then did Seoya realize. This world, perhaps this world… .

In his previous life, he died in a high-profile manner; in this life, he wishes to live quietly and keep a low profile. However, when his master falls victim to a villain's scheme, Lin Feng is forced to reveal a hint of his talent, shocking the world.

She was entrusted to a temple and the Duke who came to know about her, and dreamed of a reasonably hopeful life. But it wasn’t enough for her to be mistreated; she ended up starving to death in a dungeon, deprived of her divine powers. But God gave her a second chance. As soon as she was back at the age of five, she ran towards one place without looking back. The Duke who had taken her, and the only rival of the Temple, the Duke of Vieherville!

title: Anata wo Akiramekirenai Moto Iinazuke ja Dame desu ka?
summary: Shiroki Tsubasa and Amami Nanato were your run-off-the-mill pair of childhood friends. But after their parents decided to declare them fiancées, they both grew more conscious of the other, and right as a sweet and heartwarming romcom would have awaited them—Nanato was forced to move away with his mother! Five years later, however, the two of them are reunited during their first year of high school. Tsubasa aims to tell Nanato of the feelings she had kept all these years, but Nanato’s new gal friend and rival Chiba Reina won’t let her! Once the both of them realize they each hold feelings for Nanato, they decide on a bet: The one who makes Nanato confess to them wins! But what happens when both girls have practically zero experience to show and fail at every attempt of seducing Nanato?! And will the old-fashioned promise of being fiancées triumph over everything after all?!

Now, it’s his turn to rise—for the sake of humanity’s future. This time… as a Necromancer.
