Because she used to be in the drama club… because her name sounds similar… because every guy who hits on her gets shot down and winds up in a tragedy… for reasons like these and more, the nickname she earned from her popularity is “Juliet of the PR Department.” I thought there was no way I’d ever get involved with her, since my motto in life is to avoid hassle at all costs… This is a classic-flavored office romcom about a senpai who shines on stage like a heroine, and an utterly average, low-energy corporate drone who just muddles through life.

summary: In the midst of an explosion of the X Psychiatric Hospital, Yun Zhonghe, the hospital director, traveled back in time. 29 genius mental health patients’ souls entered his brain, equipping him with 29 peculiar abilities. The next moment she woke up, Chelsea realizes that she somehow slipped into her childhood, at the age of eight. This is a story of a villain girl who got a chance to start over and aims for a happy future with an adventurer who truly loved her for the last week of her previous life.

According to the original plot: after marriage, she would endure her husband “caring for” his late friend’s widow, hand over her family’s entire conglomerate just to please him, and eventually drive her parents to their graves. When she finally wakes up and begs for a divorce, she’s locked away and starved to death… “What kind of bullsh*t plot is this?!” Shen Nanxing scoffs. On the surface, she acts like she’s head-over-heels in love with him; however, her inner monologue prays for his death every single day so she can inherit his billions! “Heh! What a hypocritical, shameless woman!” he thought. But somehow, he couldn’t take his eyes off her. As more and more suitors began swarming around her, a jealous Shang Yan finally snapped. He scooped her up, changed into the exact “male model uniform” she’d been fantasizing about in her head, and crawled into bed to seduce her. “Wife,” he whispered darkly, “don’t you think it’s time we had a child of our own?”

She fights against the outrageous, ab*ses the scum, and becomes wealthy and joyful. She goes to university, engages in scientific research, and raises children with a loving husband. Even her in-laws, who shared meals with her, looked healthier, their faces flushed with vitality. Her eldest brother-in-law and his wife loosened their belts, still able to eat a little more. The other children in the family would ask her everyday: "What is Second Aunt cooking for us today?" But... can someone explain why her martyr husband returned? Wasn’t he supposed to have sacrificed himself? Wasn’t this supposed to be her solo effort? Well, never mind. Since he’s back, they could raise the children together... But who could explain why, while raising their children, she suddenly found herself being spoiled by the three men in the family?

title: On Her Majesty’s Knees
summary: A fantasy romance between a girl abandoned by her first love and the emperor who abandoned her! "He abandoned his youth, and I lost my words. When I reunited with him, now an emperor, I was already broken. 'Your Majesty, shall I kill the woman and send the noblewoman back?' 'No, let her go. I will take care of it.' Bella, a war orphan, chased after Kiris to survive. However, upon reuniting with Kiris, now an emperor with his body and heart scarred by betrayal, Bella is not recognized by him. Can Bella, filled with resentment, and Kiris, who abandoned her, overcome their wounds and find love?"

In the hospital room, the girl next door said enviously, "Your husband risked his life to save you. He really loves you." I forced a smile. "Yes." title: Ever Since I Carried Out the Penalty Game of Accidentally Confessing “I Like You, Please Go Out With Me” in the Class Group Chat, the Girls in My Class Have Been Acting Weird
summary: …What do I do? This isn’t the kind of atmosphere where I can just say, “It was a joke”.
genres: Completed, Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Mannen D-rank No Chuunen Boukensha, Yotta Ikioi De Densetsu No Ken Wo Hikkonuku
summary: Lucas has a hard life. In his mid-thirties, a mixture of failures has left him old and crippled, playing pack mule to a couple of young adventures. Then one day, he pulls a magic sword from a stone that tells him he has been chosen to become a hero. Given a youthful form, Lucas must use the power of the sword to vanquish evil and attain a massive harem.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem

title: Transmigrated as a Female Military Doctor in the 1950s
summary: April, 1950 Widow Xu Hehua picked up a frail, skin-and-bones eight-year-old girl in the back mountains. Xu Hehua was illiterate. Since the peach blossoms behind her house were in full bloom, she simply named the girl Taohua (Peach Blossom). The neighbor, Doctor Cao, was an educated man. He scoffed at the vulgar name, saying, “It’s the end of spring in April—call her Wanchun (Late Spring) instead.” Xu Hehua always admired educated people and was quick to seize an opportunity. Using this small favor of a name as leverage, she shamelessly sent her adopted daughter to study medicine under Doctor Cao. A few years later, she even managed to reel in the Cao family’s only promising son as her daughter’s husband-to-be. Now that was ability. Xu Wanchun had originally been a clinical medical student, straight through bachelor’s, master’s, and doctorate, plus residency training. After years of hardship, she had finally become a resident physician—only to die in an accident and wake up in the year 1950. She had become a parentless orphan, abandoned by her uncle as a “money-losing burden.” Looking at her bean-sprout-like body and remembering that economic reforms were still thirty years away… After ten grueling years in modern medicine… she wanted to cry. Fortunately, Heaven did not shut every door. Her adoptive mother truly loved her. Schooling, apprenticeship, food and clothing—everything was arranged perfectly. Since that was the case… sitting another college entrance exam wasn’t impossible. As for the so-called fiancé? Not important. Cao Jingliang had joined the revolution at sixteen. In the second year away from home, his parents wrote to him: he now had a little junior sister. Grateful, he thought of her as someone fulfilling filial duty in his stead. In the seventh year, his parents wrote again: his little junior sister was now his fiancée. Cao Jingliang laughed and shook his head. He didn’t take it seriously—a fifteen-year-old girl? Impossible. By the fourteenth year, his fiancée appeared at the military hospital holding his parents’ letters—now grown, now his colleague. When the bright-eyed young woman sweetly called him “Senior Brother,” the always composed and dignified Director Cao… had his handsome face turn red under his white coat.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: When Two Opposite Otaku’s Fall in Love
summary: Yamato, a plain, unremarkable guy, is actually the strongest player in a popular game. But because of his self-centered personality, he doesn’t stand out in class and spends his youth in a gray haze. Then one day, after he helps Karin—a popular girl from his class who’s being harassed in town—she somehow takes a liking to him… Karin keeps it hidden because she worries about what people will think, but she’s actually a hardcore gamer otaku. And without either of them realizing it, the two have even met inside the same game!? Yamato looks plain at first glance, but he says exactly what he thinks. Karin looks flashy at first glance, but she tends to read the room. A youth romance between two total opposites—two people who should’ve never been able to get along.

title: Universal Sword God
summary: A magical ring and a mighty spirit inside the ring, coupled with a genius who lost his cultivation and got named worthless tr*sh. That's Xiao Yan, the poor genius. You think Xiao Yan got it bad? Well, you clearly have not met Jing Yan. Jing Yan was once the shining star of the whole East City. However, his cultivation dropped because of the Universal Ring that was left to him by his dead grandfather. Without anything but the Universal Ring, he will once more rise towards the top and beyond! He is Jing Yan, The Universal Sword God.
genres: Action, Adventure, Harem, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: You Were Sent to the Capital as a Hostage, Yet You Took the Throne as Emperor?
summary: Wei Ran transmigrated and became the stand-in for the heir of a different-surname royal family. The real heir enjoyed a carefree life in his own fiefdom, while Wei Ran was forced to be a political hostage in the capital? Since that was the case, then he might as well replace the real heir completely. The Emperor of Great Li said, "Prince Wei, I will grant you a marriage with the Third Princess!" The real heir’s aunt said, "Even though you're my fake nephew, I’m still your real wife!" The real heir cried out, "Father, that impostor stole my princess and my aunt! I want my identity back!" The King of the foreign-named royal family replied, "Son… it's too late. My army of three hundred thousand has already been wiped out by him..."
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xianxia

title: I Am Not Playing the Game the Way I Was Told To
summary: After conquering the world, I realized. Come to think of it, was this originally an Adult game?
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: The Genius Actor from a Chaebol Family
summary: I was born into a rich family and lived a life lacking nothing. But there was one dream I could never achieve— I wanted to become an actor. In this life, I decided I wouldn’t follow the path others chose for me. I wanted to live the life I wanted, and I believed I could achieve my dream and become even more successful. Then one day, a mysterious wardrobe appeared before my eyes.

title: The Life of Mary Sue
summary: After a car accident, Cheng Xueyi transmigrated into a book and became the supporting female lead who bullies the female lead and even handed the male lead her room card. The first time she opened her eyes, she was dissed by the CEO male protagonist, “Don’t try to climb high”. In this regard, Cheng Xueyi decided to follow the good advice. Who cares about climbing high branches? I, the cannon fodder female supporting role, want to counterattack online! In fact, Ms. Cheng, who is ambitious and idealistic, was successful. She got rid of her bad life in her previous life, and she quickly became a god in the entertainment industry, and with that came a constant stream of luck. Small Theater: When filming a reality show, the director's camera swept across Xu Qiyan's room. On the day the show aired, some careful netizens found out that the cover of the magazine next to the president's pillow... is Cheng Xueyi?

title: The Return of the Legendary All-Master
summary: The first-ever virtual reality game, New World. {The time has come.} {Synchronization starts.} That marked the beginning of the catastrophe. As the game became reality, the Earth began to crumble. However, there was hope. All-Master Jeong-hoon, who had survived until the very end, was just one step away from finishing the game. "Gah!" But ended up being betrayed by his comrades. "Should I say, from the moment you said you wanted to end this game?" The reason for their betrayal was simple, if the game ended, their power would disappear. The moment they thought it was all over. [An unknown mysterious force is protecting you.] [An unknown mysterious force is sending you back to the past.] [Warning! The system attempts to intervene… failed.] [Warning! Warning! The system attempts to intervene… failed.] [Warning! Warning! Warning! The system attempts to intervene… failed.] [An unknown mysterious force dissipates.] Thanks to that unknown force, he returned to the past.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts

title: Gate of Stellar Scars
summary: In this world, there exists Star Gates. Those who enter it become gods. Ren Ye, who has already served three and a half years in prison, was suddenly visited by a mysterious figure. The person said: "If you’re willing to join a game, you can leave now. The price… is that you might die." Many years later, Ren Ye stood alone within the Star Gate. Looking back at the past, the faces in his memory have long since blurred… 2024, the tides are rising, and the travelers must keep vigil.

title: 1970s Military Marriage: Remarrying a Disabled Commander, Pregnancy Before Love
summary: In her previous life, Shen Fuyao married a disabled veteran to save her grandmother, despite the fact that he could no longer consummate their marriage. Shortly after, her husband brought home a pair of twins, claiming they were orphans of his fallen comrades. Shen Fuyao, unable to have children of her own, raised the twins carefully while working tirelessly to build her career. She eventually succeeded, taking her company public. But on the day of the IPO, her husband arrived with his first love to ring the opening bell. The twins attempted to poison Shen Fuyao, revealing that they were actually the biological children of her husband and his first love. Enraged, Shen Fuyao killed them all before taking her own life. In the afterlife, the King of Hell initially refused to let her reincarnate—but then granted her a vast magical space where she could have anything she wanted and sent her back to 1977. This time, Shen Fuyao will waste no opportunity. She takes revenge on everyone who wronged her, reunites with her real grandfather, and even ends up marrying the strongest officer in the army, beginning a sweet “marriage first, love later” life. One day, the King of Hell reveals in a dream that her chance at reincarnation was all made possible by her husband’s desperate efforts…
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Yajin Tensei
summary: Hitoshi Nozaki, a man who enjoys karate and survival shows, is hit by a truck and dies. When he opens his eyes, he sees a god in front of him! The apathetic deity sends Nozaki to another world without giving him any explanation. Nozaki wakes up in a strange forest, completely ... naked.

title: My Younger Brother Is The Chosen One
summary: Qin Feng had reincarnated into Huang Gu as the young master of the Qin family, and his younger twin brother was a person rumoured to have been chosen by the heavens, born with a one-in-a-million skeletal frame of Sovereign Bones. Initially, his plan was to latch onto his younger brother’s thighs and ride them to the pinnacle of life. However, his aspirations were shattered when he met an illogical system that instructed him to follow the path of a villain. “Ding dong! Dig out the Sovereign Bones of your younger brother. The reward is the Undefeatable Dense Pupils!” …… Qin Feng: “Are you kidding me? That is my dearest relative and friend, my blood-related brother…… Hehehehe, my s*upid brother, are you in despair? From that point onwards, every single person in Huang Gu came to despise Qin Feng for his unscrupulous methods, but when the truth was finally revealed, countless people were moved to tears at the depth of misery that Qin Feng had suffered these few years……

title: Cohen of the Rebellion
summary: This is a story about a badass, He lived a playful life and sang wild songs… This is also a story about a hero, He fought wars and crossed battlefields… Two lives in one unyielding man, born again in a new world. Burdened with endless destinies, struggled between fate. He wished nothing but safety and well-being of the family, never has he fulfilled One promise, half dream, Chaotic times opened followed with touching and glorious music. One saint befriended with blood, one warrior defended with honor. When twilight slashed desperate clouds, the dark king returned with a miracle! Hear the rhythm of battle, and wield the war with blood, Swing his master blade, an unbending willpower will become the sword that cut off the world’s shackle and brings hope to this land, and death.
genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: Love Caution
summary: There's a girl who poured everything into her first love, like it was going to be her last. Hwang Na-yoon, from twenty to twenty-three, her whole world was just Do Seol-woo. But when campus couples break up, all that's left are the gross remains of the split, like his friends becoming your friends. "Na-yoon, I'm getting married next month. Can you make it? But you know, right? My boyfriend and Seol-woo are best buds. He's singing the congratulatory song, so won't it be awkward?" She can't even chill and go to her college friend's wedding because she doesn't wanna run into her ex. Dating Rule #1: Never, ever date a guy from the same scene! She dodged relationships left and right, and now she's already thirty. Then, her only love, Do Seol-woo, pops up again. And guess what? Same department, her direct boss. Dating Rule #2: Never, ever fall for your ex again! But Do Seol-woo is acting super sus. He dumped her so easily before, and now he's just as easily barging back into her life. "Is the project dorm a hotel room or something? I just want to have a quick meeting in my room." Dating Rule #3: Never, ever get back together with that jerk!

title: My Best Friend is the Real Daughter of a Wealthy Family?!
summary: Yu Linghuan wakes up to a shocking revelation—she’s a supporting character in a “switched-at-birth” novel. Her role? To grow jealous of her sworn sister, Meng Xin, after she’s recognized as the true heiress of a wealthy family, and ultimately sabotage their bond, leading to her own tragic end. But Yu Linghuan has no intention of sticking to the script. Why ruin herself when she can bask in the benefits of having a wealthy and doting bestfriend instead? Determined to rewrite her fate, Yu Linghuan goes all in as Meng Xin’s fiercest ally. When Meng Xin is ridiculed for her lack of social finesse, Yu Linghuan takes down her critics with sharp wit and even sharper actions. Cakes get smashed, insults get hurled, and reputations get shattered. Grateful for Yu Linghuan’s unwavering loyalty, Meng Xin showers her with lavish gifts—a dessert shop here, a trove of luxury jewelry there, with promises of more to come. But their dynamic catches the attention of Meng Xin’s cold and aloof older brother, Meng Yichen. Yu Linghuan and Meng Qichuan clash at every turn, their arguments fiery as her temper. Meng Xin, eager to bring peace between her bestfriend and her brother, schemes relentlessly—arranging movie nights, shared dinners, anything to bridge the gap. But her plans take a surprising turn when she overhears an unexpected conversation. “Does your hand hurt from hitting me? Don’t move—I’ll help you massage it,” Meng Qichuan says, his tone unusually tender. Caught between her sworn sisterly bond with Meng Xin, her growing tension with Meng Qichuan, and her mission to dodge her tragic ending, Yu Linghuan must navigate a whirlwind of emotions, schemes, and unexpected sparks. A tale of fierce loyalty, fiery romance, and a girl determined to forge her own destiny.

title: Backstreet Villain School
summary: He dreamed of becoming a hero, but ended up becoming a villain. And not just any villain—the worst and strongest of them all… or rather, an actor playing that villain.

title: Little Princess Waits for the Breakup
summary: “You won’t want to, but please spare my mother.” When her father died in an accident and her mother fell ill, Sabina visited the Duchess Charlotte with her father’s keepsake. “Why should I?” “I am the only child left by the Duke’s brother.” Thus, Sabina, in exchange for entering the mansion, decided to cut off all ties from the past and live as Princess Charlotte. ‘The problem is that I’m destined to be killed by the psychopathic male lead!’ There was only one way to survive, and she must avoid him at all costs! With all kinds of schemes, she claimed to be the male lead’s henchman and lived flat on her stomach… “Next time, if something untoward happens to you, tell me right away.” Why was it that her uncle, who she haven’t seen a few times in the novel, and… “Will you be able to bring me tea so often in the future?” …her grandfather, who she thought he hated her, “The prince has a more handsome face and a better personality than I do. Do you really think so?!” Her cousin’s brother, who was like an enemy, pretended to be a family member who didn’t fit in “You just need to be by my side.” Even the male lead’s obsession that had turned around even more than the original! She didn’t want to mortgage her life to a psychopath! ‘Let me just blow it up!’

title: The Grand Duchess’s Pride
summary: “You’re quite good at pretending to be ashamed.” On the first night of her long-awaited wedding, Hezenne, now the wife of the man she loved in silence for years, is met not with warmth—but with cold contempt. Grand Duke Ian, her husband, looks upon her with suspicion, his gaze frigid and unforgiving.Their marriage, born not of love but of hidden agendas and tangled misunderstandings, begins to unravel from the start. Despite yearning for this union, Hezenne finds herself slowly breaking under the weight of mistrust and emotional distance.But when the secret she tried so desperately to conceal is finally revealed to the world, Ian’s fury erupts. He turns away, accusing her of deception and betrayal. “When exactly did you and your father conspire to get close to me?” “I didn’t know… I had no idea my father was using our marriage as leverage. Please, believe me…” “How far am I supposed to trust you?” “…” The accusations cut deeper than any blade—of lies, manipulation, and even bearing another man’s child. Each word he hurls at her is heavy with wrath, each silence more damning than the last.As Ian’s rage grows and Hezenne pleads for just one more chance, the question lingers:How much pain must she endure to be seen, not as a traitor, but as the woman who truly loved him?

title: The Runaway Sister-in-Law
summary: The System sent me to the wrong world. Others got scripts about true and false heiresses or romantic school stories, but mine was all about dog-blood drama in a wealthy family. As soon as I arrived, the male lead grabbed my wrist and snarled, “Be a little more aware of your place as a substitute. Don’t show up in front of Suisui unless I tell you to.” The System fell silent for a moment. Then it started plotting with me. [Get rid of it. I'll find a way to get you out of this world ahead of schedule.]

title: Space Speed Xing Hen
summary: Darkness’ devouring energy and mysterious space energy. The two different types of energy appeared in one person. A glance that can kill? That is the power of space. Men will be r*ped by beautiful women? That is the fate of the protagonist? In a world with Special powers, Vampires, Witches and Demons, where the forces of Darkness and Light collides. His women will be his guiding lights and change his fate! – from eveningBoat
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mature, Mecha, Mystery, Sci-fi, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: Burning Sacrifice
summary: “In the village where I lived, there’s a saying that the tears of a white crow are a panacea.” To cure her father’s illness, Yeohwa headed to Yeongmyosan (山君), the mountain of death. What awaited her there was the betrayal of her family and the brink of death. The mountain god, Baekoh, discovers Yeohwa dying, trapped in a pit. “You’ve brought back something strange.” “I couldn’t leave her in the god’s land.” “But what are you supposed to do bringing back a corpse?” “Seeing as she isn't dead, I think she has a connection with us.” Baekoh's gaze glanced over the limp female body. “Fine. Whether it's a good connection or a bad one, we’ll see.” He took the hand of the woman burning with fever. In that instant, the woman's heat began to absorb his coldness. It was a moment of freedom from the chill that had plagued him his entire life. ‘This is like an offering just for me.’ Baekoh grasped the small hand, a dangerously alluring smile on his face.

title: Controlled by an AI
summary: Now it’s the 2020s in South Korea. But for some reason, I have a 2082 model combat support AI. Who am I? Where am I? I don’t remember anything.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The Hated Young Lady, Hilda Fields, Puts an End to It
summary: —A poignant love story born of misunderstanding: Can two souls, scarred by tragic pasts and numb to emotion, ever find true happiness?— Hilda Fields, a countess's daughter living in the tranquil isolation of a remote region, held a tender affection for Rudolph, a commoner boy her age. One devastating day, the scheming of a girl obsessed with Rudolph leaves Hilda with a permanent and crippling injury to her left leg. The blame, a cruel twist of fate, falls upon the innocent Rudolph. In the rigid world of the aristocracy, a blemished noblewoman is considered damaged goods, forever barred from marriage. Hilda’s parents, driven by desperation, secretly coerce Rudolph into a loveless engagement, a desperate attempt to salvage their daughter's future. But the truth, a bitter pill, is soon revealed. A girl claiming to be Rudolph’s lover confronts Hilda, accusing her of being a thief who stole her beloved. The crushing blow follows: Rudolph only agreed to the engagement out of a misplaced sense of responsibility for Hilda’s injury. Heartbroken but resolute, Hilda chooses to protect Rudolph by feigning coldness, pushing him away and finally breaking their forced union. Then, tragedy strikes again. Caught in a maelstrom of events, Hilda selflessly takes the blame for another, accepting exile from her beloved home and embarking on a new, uncertain life in a foreign land... alone and heartbroken.

title: How To Melt the Ice Lady
summary: After entering high school, "Ice Lady" Himuro Fuyuka moved to a room next door to Kagami Asahi, who started living alone in an apartment which was just a short walk away from the nearest station. She always kept her distance from everyone, never spoke to anyone beyond what was necessary, and always maintained a straight face. A lady that was as cold as ice or so Asahi thought. “..I can't eat anymore, munyamunya...” “Where did the ‘Ice Lady’ go…?” The relationship between the two of them continued with a mysterious connection. They share dinner at night, go out together on holidays, and eventually whisper sweet things to each other. Staying beside the blunt but caring Asahi, the ice that covers Fuyuka slowly but surely melts away.
genres: Comedy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Ore Ga Chōzetsu Na Osananajimi Ni Seishin O Hakai Sarete Ochiru Made
summary: Please read the prologue to get an idea of the novel as the synopsis contains spoilers. Basic Summary: Kaito Tsurugi grew up with two half Japanese twins and saved the female twin Ellen Kisaragi from bullying. Now in high school every girl Kaito likes falls for the male twin Alan Kisaragi. However behind the scenes Ellen is actually manipulating Alan to NTR every girl Kaito ever likes and then consoles him herself, thereby slowly breaking him and making him dependent on her till he is finally hers alone.
genres: Completed, Drama, Psychological, Romance, School Life

title: After Signing in at Yunlan Sect for Three Years, Xiao Yan Comes Knocking at the Door
summary: Transmigrated to Battle Through the Heavens and became an outer disciple of Yunlan Sect. Faced with this opening, Lin Fan panicked. Who doesn’t know that Xiao Yan will attack Yunlan Sect in the future? Isn’t this sending himself to death? Fortunately, at this time, the sign-in system is activated. Signed in and got [Supreme Bone] at the beginning! And he was also accepted as a disciple by Yun San, becoming Yun Yun’s junior brother and Nalan Yanran’s junior uncle! “Ding, the host signed in Yunlan Sect for one month, and is rewarded with the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Art” “Ding, the host signed in Yunlan Sect for one year, and is rewarded with the alchemy of Taishang Laojun” “Ding, the host signed in Yunlan Sect for three years, and is rewarded with the swordsmanship of Tongtian Sect Master” …. In this way, Lin Fan either signed in to receive rewards every day, or teased his senior sister and niece from time to time. But on the day when he signed in silently for three years, a young man carrying a strange ruler broke into Yunlan Sect alone, and then a roar resounded throughout the world! “The revenge of stealing my wife…”

title: The Youngest of a Magical Family in a Gender-Reversed World
summary: I've Been Reincarnated as the Youngest Son of a Prestigious Magic Family in a Gender-Reversed World.
genres: Action, Fantasy, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Ostentatious Zhao Yao
summary: In a hilarious and sweet xianxia romance set in Ancient China, Lu Zhao Yao went through life living ostentatiously in every way possible. She lived her entire demon life in a loud and brazen manner, reigning over legions of demons, and yet——just before she was about to retrieve the sword of the ancient demon king and rightfully claim her spot on the throne——she died. In the most quiet and unobtrusive manner possible. How? By accident. Mo Qing, one of her lowest ranking lackeys at that point in time, had killed her after he retrieved the demon sword and unintentionally unleashed the sword’s demonic aura onto the heavily injured Lu Zhao Yao. Her quiet and untimely death, coupled with her firm belief that Mo Qing had sneakily betrayed her by lying in the shadows and waiting to strike the final blow and reap all the rewards, nurtured a heavy grievance within her. Lu Zhao Yao refused to head to the underworld and reincarnate, hanging around in the human world in her spirit form. Lady Luck, however, had not completely abandoned her. One fine day, a female disciple of the Immortal Sect (Zhi Yan) fought with her childhood friend and banged her head onto Lu Zhao Yao’s grave. To Lu Zhao Yao’s utmost delight, she was able to possess Zhi Yan’s body for short periods of time after this. Thus began her journey to avenge her very own death by destroying Mo Qing——and, in the process, resume her rightful place as the King over all demon sects!
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Xianxia

title: Farewell When Fireworks Bloom
summary: I was diagnosed with cancer, but my boyfriend doesn't know. He once gave up the university of his dreams for me. At the scene of a car accident, he left me injured and anxiously ran toward another woman. I died on the day he set off fireworks abroad with his female secretary.
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Homemade Shaved Ice of a Highschool Girl who had her Common Sense Altered
Engaged to Hualan, Younger Sister Is Daiyu
summary: In a crossover world where The Story of Minglan, Dream of the Red Chamber, and Joy of Life are intertwined, Lin Yi became a person who originally did not exist. The biological older brother of Lin Daiyu from Dream of the Red Chamber. When he realized that his own younger sister was Lin Daiyu, that the magistrate of Yangzhou was named Sheng Hong, and that Sheng Hong had a daughter named Minglan, Lin Yi understood—this wasn’t just Dream of the Red Chamber, it was far more complicated. At this time, two sages co-ruled the court; the retired emperor remotely controlled state affairs, and the reigning emperor was little more than a puppet. The Great Chu was surrounded by wolves on all sides, its downfall merely a matter of time. To change his fate, Lin Yi resolutely put down his pen and took up arms, enlisting in the military to guard the borderlands. Looking back later, he had already reversed the collapse of the nation, reclaimed Yan-Yun, was granted the title of Prince under a different surname, became the overlord of the North, and held power that shook the world. Emperor Qing: "This youth, at such a young age, is already a Grandmaster!" Lin Yi: "Standing before you is a man with the bearing of a dragon and a phoenix, the visage of heavenly brilliance, Grand General supporting the state of Great Chu, Pillar of the Nation, Prince Yan of the Northern Territories, Grandmaster, and the spokesperson of the Eastern Hemisphere… I am none other than Lin Ziyi!" Lin Daiyu, Sheng Minglan, Sheng Hualan, Zhao Pan’er, Shaoyao, Si Lili... Feilu Novel Website reminds you: This novel and its characters are purely fictional. Any resemblance to real persons or events is purely coincidental. Do not imitate.
genres: Action, Adventure, Harem, Historical, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Xuanhuan

title: Collecting Rent from Villains
summary: Wow, is this for real? I died falling off a cliff in the 36th novel, and now, in the 37th novel, I’ve been resurrected and inherited a building! Not just any building—it’s a seven-story mansion coveted by a count’s family! Every time I die, I get transported again, and this is my first chance at a complete life turnaround. But the moment I felt happy, I discovered something shocking: the real Charlotte Able was poisoned to death. Terrified of dying again, I ran to the mansion, only to find terrifying tenants waiting for me this time. I thought I was stepping onto a bed of roses, but is this actually a th**ny path? To make matters worse, they discovered I’m a transmigrator. “Who are you? You are definitely not Charlotte Able.” Facing Racal Statua, a double personality, Charlotte Able just wanted to cry. I’ve finally become the building owner I dreamed of, and I want to bury myself in this novel… but is that even possible? Can I finally live a peaceful life?

title: Monster Refining System
summary: After a deadly car accident, Xia Fukun finds himself transported to a mystical world with monsters, cultivators… and a gorgeous woman. It’s a dangerous world, but fortunately, he’s blessed with a cheat that can create special beasts to help him deal with his enemies and even take on the prestigious background of his crush. Watch Xia Fukun go on a thrilling yet silly adventure with his beasts!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Harem, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Self-Proclaimed: I’m in Desperate Straits Because I’ve Been Fired From All My Side Jobs and My Main Job as an Adventurer, but It’s Not a Problem Because the Power of [Holy] Is So Freaking Huge ~Enough Already, Just Let Me Earn Experience Points!~
summary: Self-proclaimed: A man, an ordinary salaryman, was killed in a car accident. He was later reincarnated in another world as a boy called Josiah. In order to get ahead as an adventurer, he uses magic circles to increase the efficiency of his magical power and earns a lot of experience points. He kept raising his magic level, but he couldn’t acquire the only attack magic of light magic, [Holy]… By the time he finally gets it after two years, he is fired not only from his (public) side jobs but also from his main job as an adventurer due to the government’s cost reduction policy. After moving to a neighboring country, he began to become an adventurer again while developing a magic circle that sought further efficiency.… but, “This is a new technique!? It’s a great discovery!” “Huh? Magic circles are old-fashioned, in this day and age, there’s no way it’ll be acknowledged, fool.” “You’re working too hard! Why don’t you take a break…” “What’s wrong with earning achievements! In this world, results are everything!” “This person is crazy…” He got involved in a number of troubles (?). Moreover, the country Josiah left is in great trouble… Is this a story where Josiah, who has a slightly different sense of values, is trying to live a normal life in another world? Maybe.

title: I Became the Black Blood Clan’s Troublemaker
summary: I was possessed and it was three days before I was to marry the strongest and worst final boss. For now, I ran away.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: Even an Orange Cat Can Win Over a Sick and Deaf Handsome Man
summary: Medical student Fei Yan suddenly transmigrated to ancient times and turned into an orange cat that could only meow. To make things worse, she gets picked up by a sick and deaf man named Chen Miansheng, who lives in a small town. The system told her that she could only return to human form when someone truly fell in love with her. But the person she spends the most time with every day is only Chen Miansheng. __ So Fei Yan started trying all sorts of things each day—catching little fish, sneaking herbs, rolling around to act cute, and begging for hugs. Fei Yan: What evil thoughts could a little orange cat possibly have? She just wants to be good to Chen Miansheng. __ Later, when Chen Miansheng’s illnesses are completely cured thanks to Fei Yan’s secret efforts, Fei Yan proudly swishes her tail: Do you like this cat now? But Chen Miansheng bends down, scoops her into his arms, and smiles helplessly: “Why is this little thing getting chubbier again?” Fei Yan’s swaying tail froze: @#%&??? This cat is done. This cat is tired. Chen Miansheng, you heartless man. __ Chen Miansheng is known in Dongfeng Town as the sickly, deaf pushover. He wheezes every three steps, coughs every five, and can't hear a word you say, no matter how loudly you speak. Everyone said he seemed to wear a mask—always calm and indifferent. That mask only began to crack after he brought home a little orange cat. On the first day the cat arrived, all the classics and ancient texts in his house were shredded beyond recognition. On the second day, a huge slab of cured meat mysteriously disappeared from the kitchen. __ By the nth day, Chen Miansheng had fully recovered, but the little orange cat was nowhere to be found. He searched every corner of the town like a madman but still couldn’t find her. It wasn’t until he returned home that he saw a woman with skin as fair as snow sleeping on his own couch. Chen Miansheng was stunned. But when he noticed the handmade cat collar on her neck, he calmly pinched it like always and gently asked with a smile: “Young lady, who are you? And where’s my cat?” Reading Notes: ❁ 1v1, mostly sweet and slice-of-life. ❁ Completely fictional world. Medical knowledge isn’t highly accurate—please don’t fact-check too strictly. ❁ Some events will be explained later in the story, so stay patient!
genres: Completed, Historical, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Marvel, Beginning with Mastery of the Darkhold
summary: He lived at Kamar-Taj, held the Darkhold in hand, and remained a proper sorcerer. After awakening the Eye of Truth and the Immaculate Body, Jiang Yu could master any magic with astonishing speed, without fear of backlash or corruption. Though he studied dark magic, Jiang Yu insisted he was a proper sorcerer! He only dreamwalked occasionally. He truly hadn’t done anything bad. Dark magic? Clearly just proper magic in disguise. Jiang Yu: “I’m a respectful, kind-hearted, gentlemanly sorcerer with no desire for power.” The Ancient One: “Your idea of respect is learning what I forbid you to learn?” Strange: “You’re certainly friendly, aside from magically controlling me, tricking me out of the Eye of Agamotto, dreamwalking recklessly, and dragging me into trouble.” Wanda: “So the latest gentlemanly sorcerer trend is barging in forcefully? And flirting with women across dimensions while offering them sleep aid services?” Thanos: “The Infinity Stones were mine—mine! You said you didn’t crave power. Then why are you fighting me for them?”
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: The Cat’s Globe
summary: A world after humans. Tolk, a ‘castle’ floating in space where cats and their robot partners dance in deadly zero-G duels. A certain cult of the cats, the Skywalkers, have conducted research that denies the foundation of the whole cat religion. Now the last Skywalker is trying to complete their blasphemous work and achieve the dream of his people. To go where only the dead are said to go. To descend, in the flesh, to the holy land of Earth. Too bad his robot partner is a little girl robot with more than a few little bugs to work out.

title: Don’t Worry, I’m Just an Ordinary Bandit
summary: I was born as the son of a bandit in a martial arts novel. Forget the original story, I just want to live an easy life as a bandit. “Protagonist! Take care of the world! I’ll just stay here and be an ordinary thief!”
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Harem, Wuxia

title: Transmigrated as the Richest Man’s Wife
summary: Tang Ruan transmigrated into a book, becoming wife of a rich man who neither cared for her nor loved her. According to the script's development, as long as she caused trouble, she would get divorced and receive a hefty divorce settlement. As someone who had been dirt-poor in her past life, Tang Ruan thought it over and decided: this sounds great. She rolled up her sleeves, ready to stir up trouble, thinking she'd get the divorce and the money sooner to live a life of shopping and luxury. But the storyline seemed to be heading in a strange direction— The rich man, Ji Jing, cornered her against the wall. With one long leg propped up, he smiled with an air of teasing intimacy. “Baby, you’re so adorable.” Tang Ruan: ? “You do all these things every day, isn’t it just because—” To divorce you. “To love me passionately.” Tang Ruan: ???? What the hell???? As he spoke, Ji Jing undid the buttons of his shirt with his slender fingers, advancing toward her. His voice deepened, burning and seductive: “Come on, let me fulfill your wish.”

title: It Seems That If You Train From Infancy, Your Magical Power Becomes Incredibly Powerful.
summary: One day, I suddenly found myself reincarnated into another world. Not just any world, but a world filled with swords and magic. I learned that if I trained my magical abilities from a young age, my magical power would significantly increase. So, from the age of one, I began my magical training. Before I knew it, I had one of the world's greatest amounts of magical power.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance

title: Chronicles of the Demonic Cult Conversion
summary: The Heavenly Demon's Physique Returned to the Past, Defected to its Divine Cult.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Wuxia

title: Bluebird, Redbird
summary: A young noblewoman writes a letter to the fiance she's never met.

title: After Defying the Villain’s Fate for Nine Lifetimes, the Heroines Turn Mad!
summary: Jiang Chen travels to a fantasy novel world and becomes the villainous senior brother. He didn’t have any golden finger (cheat) and didn’t want to end up as villainous cannon fodder, so he repeated nine reincarnation cycles, only aiming to be an upright senior brother. Yet fate is unjust, bestowing upon him the aura of a villain, causing him to suffer countless misunderstandings and disdain. Until the ‘Tenth Life’! In this life, Jiang Chen gave up. His heart grew cold, and he also finally let himself go. Jiang Chen: “Since heaven wants me to be a villain, why should I defy it?” …… My name is Jiang Lianyue, and I have a villainous senior brother who is despicable. I despise him, detest him, and even wish he would die quickly! But one day, I witnessed a flashback of nine lifetimes… In the first life, my senior brother sacrificed his own core to help the second brother rebuild his core, damaging his own foundation in the process. In the second life, I was afflicted with a cold poison, and my senior brother, with his modest cultivation, refined pills for a hundred days to cure me at the cost of destroying his own core. In the third life, I finally understood everything…
genres: Completed, Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: Joined The Army And Already Expecting Multiple Pregnancies, The Laid-Back Wife’s Good Fortune Begins
summary: (Era + Military Marriage + Soldier King + Everyday Life + Multiple Pregnancies + Sweet Romance + Double Purity + 1960s) After traveling back to the 1960s, Jiang Qian becomes the “comparison subject” to her cousin in the village. Her cousin is skilled, gentle, and virtuous, while she herself is arrogant, domineering, and busty but brainless. In response, Jiang Qian, who came with a personal space packed full of supplies, says there’s no problem at all! When the person she was going to be engage with apologizes for falling for her cousin and even sends a matchmaker to cancel the originally arranged marriage, her sisters-in-law are furious, and her brothers are clenching their fists in anger. But after slapping the man twice, Jiang Qian simply says it’s no big deal, because three-legged toads are hard to find, but two-legged men are everywhere! As for the man who can be stolen away, she definitely doesn’t want him! Regarding the matter of marrying the officer Han Shiguo, who had been rejected by her cousin, Jiang Qian initially expresses the same nonchalance. Who cares who she marries? Why not pick a tall, handsome man who can crush both her cousin and the s*umbag? Besides, the key to happiness in marriage lies in herself. As long as she remains lazy like a “salted fish,” no one can exploit her. However… it turns out that this “salted fish” has caught someone’s eye, and it turns out that someone loves frying salted fish—crispy and golden on both sides! Jiang Qian leans against the wall, eyes wide in shock. The strong male lead from the novel has come to life in reality! With a satisfied and gentle look on his face, Han Shiguo says, “Wife, this is no big deal!” Jiang Qian: “…” She wants to ask— is it still too late to consider divorce now?

title: Idols Are Good at Writing Novels
summary: Min Hyo-won, an unpopular member of the fourth-generation idol group , suddenly finds herself possessing the body of novelist Seol Jin?! Why, of all people, does she possess the body of a poor, debuting author? Could it be because she, Min Hyo-won, graduated from Hanyang Arts High School's Department of Creative Writing? She must somehow make a living, but how? Min Hyo-won begins her fan creations with ... But why am I a writer? This is the novel where I sell my group.

title: Opening a Breakfast Shop at the Subway Entrance
summary: Hua Chunmu has traveled through time. The original owner in the book was an adopted daughter, driven from her home and bullied. After their precious biological daughter returned, she was no longer of any use. With no real talent, she suddenly developed a food-reading mind. Tomato: It'd taste better if you blanched and peeled me. Potato: Thickening with starch will lock in moisture. Pork Knuckle: I want to stew me until tender and fall off the bone. An hour and a half is just the right amount of heat!! That night, Hua Chunmu decided to open a breakfast shop at a busy subway station. The crowds were always rushing, yet they never stopped. The shutters parted, and silence fell—the breakfast shop was open! Later, white-collar workers in suits and leather shoes, students wearing red scarves, and all kinds of workers, carrying salted tea eggs and pancakes in their hands, couldn't stop chewing. Because compared to going to work, they were more worried about the queues tomorrow morning. At first, Hua Chunmu just wanted to open a small breakfast shop, but later, the shop she opened not only became a chain, but the amount of breakfast sold could circle the earth twice... Wow... The screenshot is here.
genres: Drama, Romance, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: So This Is What You’re Really Like, Secretary Lin
summary: [Pure love, sweet romance, love at first sight, CEO & Secretary] After firing three secretaries in six months, He Yuan was finally very satisfied with the fourth one—Lin Yue. However, this secretary is always going on blind dates, which makes He Yuan think she is eager to get married. But… Secretary Lin seems to have terrible luck—she either meets mama’s boys or very strange men. And then… Secretary Lin cries. In six months, she went on seven blind dates—and cried seven times. He Yuan couldn’t stand it anymore. He wiped her tears and said, “How about you marry me?” Secretary Lin was so shocked that she ran away. She never expected her powerful and wealthy boss to have such thoughts. Lin Yue loves money and works hard to earn it, but she has no interest in marrying into a rich family. Unwilling to give up, He Yuan stopped her. “Are you really not going to consider it?” Lin Yue hesitated. “I want someone I can live a normal life with.” He Yuan said, “What? Does my face not look like someone you can live a normal life with?” Lin Yue couldn’t resist his calm yet persistent pursuit. The moment she nodded, He Yuan immediately took her to the marriage registration office. After marriage, He Yuan revealed his possessive, lion-like nature—territorial, very jealous, and extremely protective. Lin Yue snapped, “He Yuan, I want a divorce!” He Yuan pinned her down and said, “Don’t even think about it for the rest of your life, my dear Secretary.”

title: Until the Saint Loves Back
summary: A one-shot about a saint being courted.

title: Bleaching
summary: In the winter of that year, the city of Xuecheng lay gripped by an unrelenting cold. Chief Detective Peng Zhaolin had seen his share of brutality over the years, but nothing prepared him for the horror he discovered in that ordinary apartment building. The dismembered remains spoke of a darkness he'd never encountered before. What haunted him most was the memory of passing the suspect, Deng Ligang, in the hallway—a chance encounter that would lead to a decade of sleepless nights and cold trails. Deng Ligang and his associates preyed on vulnerable women working in nightclubs, leaving a trail of extortion, kidnapping, and mu*der across multiple provinces. Despite the major crimes unit's relentless pursuit, the criminals seemed to vanish into thin air, their identities washed clean through underground channels. They melted into society, building quiet lives while their victims' families waited for answers that never came. Night after night, Peng Zhaolin's dreams were filled with the faces of young women he'd failed to save. Their silent pleas for justice followed him through the years, until a single thread of information emerged from the past. Now, after all this time, Peng finds himself chasing shadows across China, determined to bring long-delayed justice to those who thought they'd escaped it.

title: Eagles Over the Vast Land
summary: "大地飛鷹: Dàdì Fēi Yīng, meaning “Eagles Over the Vast Land,” also known as “Desert Fury,” also known as “Eagle Earth,” is a masterpiece from Gu Long's later years! A decisive battle between wanderers, heroes, and villains! The novel has been adapted into a wuxia television drama titled 金色: Jin Se, known in English as “Remnants of Gold” (title subject to change without prior notice). The drama features a star-studded cast, including Xin Zhi Lei, Yin Fang, Chen Kun, Gao Wei Guang, Ken Wu, and many others. The story follows how three hundred thousand taels of lost gold spark a tempest that shakes the heavens and earth across the desert. To which side—righteousness or evil—will victory belong? Entangled friendships, treacherous battles, and the poignant depiction of the sorrows and helplessness of Jianghu wanderers make "Eagles Over the Vast Land" an unforgettable gem of wuxia literature! Exceptional wuxia novels often excel through their artistic conception. Vivid characterizations and extraordinary settings together form the story's foundation, and this book is no exception. The author begins by presenting a dire situation: gales, sand, the vast desert, and the "Thirty-Six Ironblood Riders (Tiěxuè Sānshíliù)" standing firm in the raging storm. This desperate scenario becomes the perfect stage for wuxia, a forbidden zone for life yet a grand arena for knights-errant to display their skills, thus leading to a series of tragic tales
genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Martial Arts, Psychological, Romance, Tragedy, Wuxia

title: As Long as I Outlast You All, I’ll Be Invincible
summary: The practice of cultivation seeks eternal life and immortality, but one’s lifespan inevitably has an end. Thus one must continue to cultivate, and become a saint or great emperor, in order to prolong one’s life. Chen Xia, however, completely reversed this. Since his transmigration, he has gained immortality, and also a system that awards him with attribute points for every year he lives. Thus between the myriad worlds, the legend of an unparalleled senior appeared. “A gentleman takes revenge; it is never too late even after ten thousand years.” “When you were at your peak I yielded, now in your old age I shall trample on you.” – Chen Xia
genres: Completed, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Psychological, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: Breakup? After the Corn Harvest!​
summary: Lu Xianchuan carried me home from the bar for the 10,086th time. As usual, he served me with a cold face. Just as I was about to coax him, he lowered his eyes and calmly spoke. "Jiang Xiaoyu, let's break up." I sobered up instantly from fear, crying and begging him to stay. Please don't break up with me. The corn back in my hometown is still waiting for him to harvest next month.

title: When Strength Reaches Its Extreme, Humiliation Follows
summary: I lay in a pool of blood, the gloomy sky looming above. Plague and death clung tightly to me, refusing to let go. Everyone gathered around, watching as my life slowly faded, their faces twisted with greedy desire. My heart gradually grew cold, my vision blurred. But at that moment, I saw Yuan Ge step out of a high-ranking military vehicle. His uniform was impeccably neat, draped with a long black trench coat. His appearance startled the crowd into retreat. Surrounded by soldiers, he walked toward me, the sound of his military boots hitting the ground matching the rhythm of my heartbeat. I watched as he half-crouched, leaning close to me, his voice cold yet casual as he whispered in my ear, “Little sister, I’ve come to save you.” I knew he could save me, but I also knew that sooner or later, he would be the one to end my life. It was only a matter of time.

title: Bakuen teru-jutsu-shi Rūche!
summary: A girl named Ruche, who goes to a school in a city in southern Kingdom, is one day helped by a young man who apprentices a guru in a slum out of town. A story that starts with a chance encounter. A departure from a familiar city. Hidden powers to arouse. A story of a girl’s love and adventure travelling through a vast world with friends and eventually fighting the devil.

title: It’s Not My Fault that I’m Handsome
summary: "Dashing and brave, laughing proudly across the land, who wins the ultimate battle of the sexes for the most handsome man? Handsome men are innocent, but who is the most charming? In the empire of handsome men, who is the most golden and dashing? Flawless faces—one by one, handsome men are arrested. A fantasy world, an urban fantasy creating a realm for young men. Introducing with great fanfare our number one golden-medal handsome man: Gongsun Wu, truly dashing."
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural

title: A Pirate’s Diary
summary: A tale of adventure, piracy, founding a pirate republic, and waging war.

title: When the Blizzard comes
summary: Sui Ye and Jiang Huaiyi once shared a time of mutual dependence. She thought their relationship was nothing more than a secret dalliance. He had wealth, looks, and talent—a future with him was beyond her reach in this lifetime. Until one day, he held her bare hand and asked, “How about I give you a ring?” The girl tilted her head to look at him, confused. “A ring for what? We’re not even officially together.” Jiang Huaiyi couldn’t help but laugh at her bluntness. “Be my girlfriend—give me the title I’ve been longing for, alright?” Later, Sui Ye loved him deeply, but on the day they registered their marriage, she discovered he had been lying to her all along. For years, she thought the name Jiang Huaiyi symbolized a burden she could never bear—a wound that would remain fresh forever. After three and a half years, she encountered the man who once haunted her heart. He was more mature, standing at the center of attention, exuding charm and sophistication. This man, with whom she shared countless nights of passion, was now the major sponsor she had to thank for making her event possible. Sui Ye approached him respectfully, raising her glass. “Mr. Jiang, thank you for your sponsorship; the event went off without a hitch thanks to you.” The man’s gentlemanly demeanor vanished. “Just a verbal thanks?” Understanding his insinuation, her cheeks flushed. “Please, behave yourself.” That evening, as the banquet concluded, Sui Ye returned to double-check the equipment, only to find herself cornered by the man in a narrow space. “Mr. Jiang, please respect boundaries.” He stepped closer. “Boundaries? Between us? Negative ones, maybe.” — About the Female Protagonist: The first time Sui Ye met Jiang Huaiyi was in a foreign country. He risked his life to distract a criminal, saving her in the process. Later, he came back to check if she was safe. Through the car window, illuminated by the streetlights, she saw a man with sharp features, short hair, slightly double-lidded eyes, and an enigmatic aura. She was captivated by the red mole on his Adam’s apple, her gaze lingering involuntarily. The second time they met was during a stormy night. She had just graduated and was drenched. He stopped his car and held an umbrella for her. That night… Sui Ye found herself on his kitchen countertop, ensnared in his fiery embrace. Her body trembled as he whispered in her ear, “Your reaction says you want me too.” — About the Male Protagonist: On the day his mother committed su*cide, a young Jiang Huaiyi stormed into a neighboring school to confront the culprit, only to find it was a tiny girl. From then on, whenever he felt unhappy, he would sneak over to watch her, gaining perverse comfort from her misery. Gradually, he realized that she, like him, was a victim of a ruthless world. They were comrades in the same trench. He clapped for her performances from the shadows, followed her home after school, and visited her abroad. His last memory of secretly admiring her was seeing her clutching books under a store’s awning, sheltering from the rain. He captured the moment in a photo, placing it in a heavy journal, and penned bold words beneath it: The little girl graduated today, soaked like a drenched chick. Raising his head, he saw her running into the rain. He opened his car door, followed her, and shielded her with an umbrella.

title: Don’t You Need My Kiss for Your Youth?
summary: Isn't it sad that I'm in high school and I've never kissed? I'm proud to be a perfectionist and aspire to be a doctor, but I, Kotaro Kuroki, am struggling. Is kissing necessary for a perfect life...? No, love and kissing are confusing to me! Then I met Hino Koyuki, a classmate rumoured to be 'the girl who kisses everyone,' and by chance, I ended up playing a certain game with this girl. "Hey, how about I kiss you if I lose?" "Geez!" "Haha, Kuroki, that's funny... So do you want to?" "Who needs a kiss?" I thought, but I couldn't take my eyes off her. I'm sure she has something that I don't, yet why does her smile seem so sad sometimes? --There are many kinds of people in this world: unrealistic, slu*ts, shady, and b*tches. In this world, there are people who suffer from 'being abnormal.' But who in the world has the right to call it a disease? A coming-of-age romantic comedy that goes back to the basics and prescribes for all the misfits!

title: Myriad Realms Gu Venerable
summary: First, he travels through the world of novels, then gets pulled into the realm of the main god. The familiar plot is actually misleading and full of pitfalls. Emerging from the world of Gu, Zhou Ming travels through various realms, relying on his knowledge of Gu to forge a path as the greatest Gu master across all worlds.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mature, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Tragedy, Xuanhuan

title: Love You, Love You Not
summary: Parsad Empire's proud and noble duke, Kasar de Blahnaht. He falls helplessly in love with his first love, whom he reunites with while tracing his mu*dered father's tracks... His large eyes narrowed into a smile as beautiful as a blooming flower. "Does this dishonor you, Duke?" He pulled back the woman trying to distance herself from him. Her soft and warm lips seemed to wash away all sins. If she insists on leaving my side, I can lie as much as this. "I don't love you, Scáthach." A grey-tinted romance of a man who can't tell his truth and a woman with a hidden secret.

title: After the Strategy Mission Was Exposed, the Childhood Friend Became a Sinister Male Ghost
summary: In order to survive, Ling Luo spent a long time attempting to "capture" the heart of her childhood friend. After being offline for ages, her System finally reappeared. Upon seeing her getting close to the story’s Villain, the System let out a sharp, piercing shriek. 【You have targeted the wrong person! He is the Villain!】 The System continued, 【Our actual target is the Male Lead!】 Only then did Ling Luo realize she had focused her efforts on the wrong man. Without a second thought, she turned away to begin her mission with the actual Male Lead, but her childhood friend, who was actually the Villain, followed her closely. To successfully complete her new mission, Ling Luo tried every possible way to rid herself of this Villainous childhood friend, only to be cornered by him at every turn. The Villain lifted her chin, his eyes filled with a fanatical obsession. He spoke tenderly, "I remember you saying that since we are childhood friends, we are a match made in heaven. Please do not quit halfway. Do not loathe me, and do not abandon me, alright?" Unable to shake him off or make a clean break, Ling Luo had no choice but to persevere and continue "coaxing" him. She had no idea how he eventually discovered the truth about her "strategy mission." Now, the Villain exudes a gloomy, damp, and cold aura. Pinning her by the waist with a suffocating gaze, he declared in a tone that allowed for no refusal: "In this lifetime, you are only permitted to be with me!"

title: Spare Me, Great Lord!
summary: This is the story of an orphan, Lu Shu. He is not any regular orphan, but a metahuman experiencing the changes in himself, his country and the world during the dawn of the magical era. Watch as Lu Shu embarks on a journey to hone his peculiar abilities together with his sister, the adorable and charismatic Lu Xiaoyu. Along the way, they’ll encounter supernatural events, obstacles and even the most powerful people in their country. How will Lu Shu make the best of his abilities and oust his never-ending list of rivals and opponents?
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, School Life, Supernatural

title: Please, Abandon Me
summary: "You are the spoils of war promised to me by His Imperial Majesty." For 10 years, I lived as Leitria, a sacred maiden of the prosperous and mysterious Belial. Just before I was to be sacrificed for the duchy, I ended up becoming a s*ave. Into the hands of Lucifer, a man who looks exactly like my most cherished friend. I only have 1 year left anyway. Is this salvation, or is it the beginning of another torment? My remaining time was short. So was the time I fell for Lucifer. But the people of this world pointed fingers at me. A corrupted s*ave ruining the young grand duke's future. Or a cowardly sacrifice who brought disaster to this land by defying her fate. "Hold your head high. As my person, you need not bow before anyone." But I couldn't let you go. So much that I was terrified I would end up ruining you. So please, abandon me.

title: Crazy! Criticizing the Prime Minister for Being a Servant
summary: Xu Beisheng has been wandering outside for eighteen years. Eighteen years later, she returned to Beijing to reunite with her biological parents and twin sister, but she was forced to die as a sacrifice for the prince by her twin sister. God has mercy on her and gives her a chance to be reborn. Xu Beisheng embarks on the journey to Beijing to find her relatives again. On the way, she saves the seriously injured and unconscious prince. After returning to Beijing, she fights her sister and worships Prime Minister Lang Zhuo as her teacher. She is so successful all the way. She abandons love and family affection and just wants to save her life in the treacherous capital, but she is unknowingly stolen by the crazy and clingy Prime Minister...

title: The Villainess Is Going To Have It All
summary: A month ago, Erina realized she had been reincarnated into a novel. The male protagonist of the original story was her husband, Phaylon Eols, and Erina herself was the villainess created to highlight the love between the main characters. She harbored a faint hope that if she acted differently from the original story, something might change. "This woman, she's the one I love. She'll be staying in this mansion from now on." But when she was confronted with the sight of the two together, she found it utterly unbearable. She would take everything that was meant to be Rose's, and she would destroy everything Phaylon had built. She would tear apart the filthy affair that they dared to disguise as love, the affair that had shattered her and cast her as the villainess. She would ruin the Eols family, who sought to confine her and let her wither away. If necessary, she would gladly become a selfish villainess and take everything away from them.

title: Dungeon Master of Slime Dungeon
summary: When I woke up, I was in a room I didn’t know, and there was a crystal ball claiming to be a dungeon core. According to the crystal ball, I seem to have been selected as an experimenter for this dungeon core. Summoning a different world + dungeon management, isn’t it my favorite! I’ll be the strongest master … eh? Can only slime be summoned? Is it weaker than a baby if it hasn’t evolved? Alright! Let’s sell to humans so as not to be killed! I also posted on Alpha Polis and Novel Up +
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Compensation θ ~ I Might Be Late for Reincarnation, but Since I Was Born as the Talented Eldest Son of a Prestigious Noble, I Might Be on the Winning Side
summary: The protagonist, along with his classmates, finds themselves in a different dimension and gets reincarnated into a fantasy world. Their granted class turns out to be a magical class just as they wished for. Even though the protagonist could potentially gain incredible cheats, the class specifications confine him to his bed. Nevertheless, he strives for the pinnacle with an unbreakable spirit! With a rare lineage and exceptional talents, the protagonist gradually grows in a different world with history spanning several centuries.

title: The Skyrider
summary: “The strongest system, I am the strongest! And only me!” Ye Feng looked at the people whom the Gods favored, his face indifferent! With the strongest system, he can copy other’s cultivation methods, skills, and can also upgrade the level… Which means he is omnipotent, and the strongest in the world! Now, let’s go and hit all who are dissatisfied!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xuanhuan

title: After the Maid Ran Away, the Prince Went Crazy
summary: After being sold to the Ji Mansion by her biological father, Mu Jin had no choice but to become the maid of the Fifth Young Master. The Fifth Young Master had someone else in his heart and hated her for climbing onto the bed, and he ab*sed her. He even aborted her baby! After paying a tragic price, she escaped to death. She didn't know that after she left, the man fell ill and became crazy. He asked everyone with red eyes: "Have you seen my Ah Jin?" In a few years, she climbed out of the bottom of society with blood dripping from her body, became a famous craftsman worth a lot of money, and recognized a prince as her younger brother. She was doing well, but she heard that the Fifth Young Master was actually a fake young master, and became a homeless dog who was driven out of the house! When Mu Jin was just rejoicing over the misfortune, the prince who had just been brought back to the Rong Palace came to the house, knelt down in front of her with a thud, "A Jin, I was wrong!" Mu Jin: "???" Isn't this my damn ex-husband?

title: If I Let You Be the Clan Leader, You Only Accept the Protagonist?
summary: Seeing his declining sect, Lin Fan established the following rules: 1. Those surnamed Xiao, Ye, Shi, or Lin will be given priority for admission. 2. Those who like to talk to themselves with rings or other objects will be given priority for admission. 3. Those who have survived more than three near-death experiences and whose fiancée has a mysterious background will be given priority for admission. 4. Those who have been disengaged and whose parents have mysteriously disappeared will be given priority for admission. 5. Those who are targeted and deliberately made things difficult for as soon as they arrive outside the sect gate will be given priority for admission. 6. Those who like to wear a mysterious smile on their lips and whose enemies also like to laugh "jie jie jie" will be directly designated as personal disciples. 7. Those who have had their bones dug out and are on the verge of death will be directly designated as personal disciples. 8. ... One day, the Fifth Elder reported: "Sect Leader, great news! Someone outside has been disengaged, wears a mysterious smile on his lips, and also likes to talk to a ring! His parents are also missing?" "What? Quickly bring him in. I will accept him as my... By the way, what is his name?" "It seems his surname is Tang." "Surname Tang?! Wait, don't bring him in. This Sect Leader will personally take action to shield the heavenly secrets and write a letter for you to take and introduce him to the opposing sect..." "Remember to be tactful! Also! From today onwards, this Sect Leader is going into seclusion. Under no circumstances should you call this Sect Leader out of seclusion unless it is extremely important!" "Oh right, be sure, be sure to keep a close eye on all the sect's secret manuals, lest they be stolen!" Fifth Elder: "Huh?!"
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mature, Psychological, Xianxia

title: I Became a Rolling Madman
summary: Humans summoned to the insanely difficult new Soulslike game 'Death Call'. They can never return unless they clear the game. I tried hard to clear it, but ended up becoming a crazy guy rolling around all day
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Horror, Mystery

title: My Animal Legion
summary: Su Yu, an orphan, loves small animals by nature. Even when she’s short of living expenses, she still chooses to study the veterinary profession for five years. It took her five years to collect money and graduate successfully from university at the age of 23. She finally found an area of less than 100 square meters with three kittens, four puppies, and five hamsters, two parrots, two turtles, and three rabbits. But she didn’t expect that she had only been operating for two months, and when she was just preparing for her grand plans, the end of the world came. The apocalypse was extremely cruel, and she’s just an ordinary person without any abilities, but she did own one golden finger, [Apocalypse Pet System] APP. Being alive is actually not difficult. (0o0)! Cats: The claws were like sharp knives, and they run like lightning. It’s not difficult to discharge electricity, but it’s really difficult to raise a human. Rabbits: It’s fluffy and white. And it’s not difficult to dig holes for planting vegetables. But it’s really tough to raise a human. Dogs: Three meters long and extremely strong, and can also hunt. But it’s really challenging to raise a human being. Hamsters: With bulging cheeks, it’s not difficult to hide things, but it really is hard to raise humans. Turtles: The shells are hard, the teeth are sharp, it’s not difficult to catch fish, it’s not difficult to dive, but it’s really hard to raise a human being. Birds: Wings like the wind, claws like a blade. It’s not hard to fly in the sky. It’s not hard to walk in the wind, but it’s really hard to raise a human being. Su Yu: Water, land, and air, all together! It’s not difficult to live!

title: The Tang Sect Crisis
summary: In this fifteenth installment of Long Chengfeng’s Snowblade Vagabond series, there is trouble in the Tang Sect, the famous hidden weapon and poison sect of wuxia novels from Bai Yu to Liang Yusheng to Gu Long to Wen Rui’an. Tang Zhi thinks himself smart, but he’s not selected as the Tang Sect successor. So he starts his own sect. Now the Tang family is pitted against itself, and the Snowblade Vagabond Long Chengbi and company are in the middle of it…
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Wuxia

title: Chasing Fairies with Assassin Skills, Only to Be Chased Instead
summary: Lin Xingjian was once a feared assassin of the Shadow Sect—silent as a ghost, ruthless as a blade, the one who cleaned up after the mighty Xuantian Dao Sect. But times have changed. With peace reigning under Xuantian’s dominance, the Shadow Sect has lost its former glory. The assassins who once made cultivators tremble… are now reduced to odd jobs, like pursuing fairies on behalf of wealthy clients just to earn spirit stones. Yet when Lin Xingjian takes on one such task, things don’t go as planned. After all—what happens when the fairy you’re supposed to chase… starts chasing you instead?
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: Time to Return
summary: A young prince comes to visit an ancient Venerable with news of his aunt's death. He then is told an unexpected tale of the Venerable's youth.

title: One Piece Admiral Silver Fox
summary: Parted hair, red nose, inverted eyebrows, and triangular eyes—my appearance is like a fox with hair standing up, wearing a purple fur coat, looking as sleek as a human but with the demeanor of a scoundrel. That's right, I am the infamous user of the Noro Noro no Mi, the flashy and sleazy Silver Fox Foxy. A man who uses the powerful Devil Fruit ability to slow things down for comedic purposes. In a world where the strong eat the weak, slowing down is king. “Damn it, I need plastic surgery.”

title: I Added D*ugs to Romantic Fantasy
summary: I got beaten up for no reason and reincarnated into a romance fantasy novel. To survive, I flooded the world with drugs.

title: To Get Stronger, I’m Forced to Grind Their Affection
summary: Favorability System: [You're going to be a simp!] Resentment System: [You're going to be a jerk!] What the hell did I do to deserve this? I'm stuck with two systems like this. "So, this is your reason for forcing that girl to take her clothes off in broad daylight?" No, well... let me explain! The story goes like this— Want to know what happened...

title: Way of Heaven
summary: “My fate shall not be dictated by the heavens. If the heavens dare dictate my fate, I shall erase the heavens!” Mu Yuan impassively looked at the screaming monarch who was undergoing a heavenly tribulation and secretly turned the power of the tribulation up a few notches… “Since the heavens are unjust to me, I shall eradicate the heavens!” A teenager who had just transmigrated climbed to the peak of a mountain and swore. Mu Yuan, understanding that the kid wanted to return to where he came from, hurled a lightning bolt at the teenager, sending him “home”… “Our bodies are unfettered. Who can reign supreme?! Today I shall rebel against the heavens!” “The heavens treat the living like dogs.” “The heavens shall not cover my eyes. The earth shall not bury my will. The living shall recognize my intent. The divine shall evaporate!” …. Mu Yuan raised his head and sighed. Why did so many people want to die? The story is about Mu Yuan, the world’s Heavenly Dao, the creator of his own world, treading the Way of Heaven!

title: Stranded on an Island with the Girls
summary: Ancient beasts, modern humans, futuristic technology, and a chaotic island lost in time. From the Stone Age, to the Age of Power, to the Age of Electricity—civilization on this deserted island develops at lightning speed. Stranded on an uninhabited island, Qin Tian starts his survival journey with nothing but a system. Campus beauty, goddess-like idols, a blonde onee-san, even a rampaging loli—I want them all. Taming golden eagles, subduing wolf kings, driving away giant pythons—this island will be ruled by me!
genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Slice of Life

title: The Demon Lord’s Romantic Redemption Arc
summary: Ah Wan had stayed up all night to read a novel. The Demon Lord Chu Changqing caused trouble everywhere, believed in neither gods nor Buddhas, and with his inherent luck and strength, defied the heavens, born with boundless arrogance, until the author finally ran out of plot for him and simply killed him off. Oh, that is, he fell into a ditch while cultivating to his peak and breaking through the void. Ah Wan nearly choked on her own blood after finishing the book. Author: “The Heavenly Dao cycles, evil receives its retribution.” ‘There’s this kind of wild twist?’ ‘You’re pulling my leg!’ Author: “How about, you teach him to do some good deeds?” Transmigrated into the book as a 'saintly b*tch' named Chang Wan, who was dismembered by the Demon Lord: ‘Heh heh.’ The Demon Lord Chu Changqing failed his tribulation and suffered heavenly wrath. He received a chance at rebirth, the only price being that he had to obey a woman. Demon Lord Chu Changqing: ‘Heh heh.’ Later. Great Demon Lord: “So good.” He loved her delicate softness to his very core, loved her alluring, silken eyes. When he was powerless, he coveted her beauty; when he had absolute power, he caged her. No madness, no life.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Xianxia

title: My Ghost Mom’s Horror Book
summary: An Xin, a young girl whose parents were divorced, had been living with her father since forever. When she was twelve years old, her father had to move to an African country for business. So he sent An Xin to live with her mother who had been living alone. Her mother lived in a remote mountain village. A village far away from the city but very rich. Her old house was large, quiet, elegant, and a little creepy. One day, An Xin went into her mother’s study and found a thick, tattered, and red notebook. Out of curiosity, she flipped it open and soon walked into a world with horrors and mysteries.

title: Exchanged Sisters
summary: When the Zheng Family was banished from Shangjing City, the lady of the house couldn't bear to let her infant daughter endure the hardships of the journey. She bribed a midwife to swap her daughter with the child of the Qin Family, who lived next door and was traveling to Shangjing to take up a post. For the next decade or so, all was peaceful. But in the second year after the Zheng Family returned to Shangjing, the Crown Prince was deposed, and the Qin Family was sentenced to exile. Unwilling to let their biological daughter be sent away to a distant land, the Zheng couple plotted to swap the two girls back. On the day Zheng Xuetong was reunited with her biological parents, I shouldered my pack, ready to find my own parents as they were being escorted out of the capital. My foster mother, unable to remain indifferent after all, called out to me.
