"Wanqing, if you just lower your head and admit you were wrong, I will convince the Master to take you in as an adopted daughter. You wouldn't have to go to the Northern Desert to suffer." "There is no need, Madam." I declined with a faint smile and walked away without looking back. So what if it was the Northern Desert? I knew it all too well.

title: 39 – The Legend of Sun Knight
summary: I am a holy knight. To be precise, I am the Church of the God of Light’s Sun Knight…in training. The Church of the God of Light worships and serves the God of Light, and theirs is one of the three largest religions on this continent. As the whole continent knows, the Church of the God of Light has the Twelve Holy Knights, and each one has his own unique personality and features. To be the Sun Knight is to have shining golden hair, sky blue eyes, a compassionate nature, and a brilliant smile. …even the Sun Knight-in-training is no exception. The 38th generation of the Twelve Holy Knights have completed their term of office, yet the time for the 39th generation to take over is still far in the indefinite future. The Judgment Knight is brash and easily angered; the Storm Knight and the Leaf Knight are always fighting nonstop, day and night. Since childhood, the Sun Knight-in-training has watched the others grow from kids into adolescents. What must he do in order to become comrades, who will fight through thick and thin for each other, with this group of “younger brothers”? “Benevolent God of Light, may I ask when I will complete my training that has taken more than ten years?”

title: A Farmer’s Son, but a Superior Person (Keju)
summary: Wang Jingyu traveled to ancient times and became a fifth-class peasant. The peasants worked hard, producing more and more food, but the food was getting worse and worse. A head of a household in Dongxiang, Linnan County, bought the land of the original owner at a low price and said to him: “Never work, but have no worries about food and drink, wear gold and silver, and reap the profits of fishing. This is the best of the best.” Wang Jingyu: ? ? Are you teaching me how to do things? The first step for modern people to refresh the concept of “the best of the best” is to earn cash that his family has not seen for a long time – 50 copper coins, relying on the experience of mushroom cultivation in the next raw material base of the family business in the previous generation . After Wang Jingyu had a full stomach, he started the second step – rolling up his sleeves to study for the imperial examinations. He won three first prizes in a row, was named in the imperial examinations, was in charge of the three departments and two governments, ruled the world, and became a “superior” in the eyes of the world. A hundred years later, the first volume of the “Da Jing Hui Yao” recorded: Taifu Wang Wenzheng, born in a peasant family, has been a master for twenty years, and the world’s civil and military lives are peaceful. The former peasant family is also a noble family, everyone is noble, and there is no “superior” anymore.

title: A Beautiful Duchess with a Dark Heart
summary: In the capital's elite social circles, rumors abound about Wen Yu's ruthlessness. Even the Emperor, upon hearing these tales, has repeatedly nodded in agreement! Wen Yu, upon learning of this, responded with a cold smile: From a young age, her mother was mu*dered, her grandmother showed no affection, and her father offered no love. She was the target of envy and constantly schemed against. After much hardship, she finally secured a good husband, only to find her marital home a chaotic mess! Should she play the innocent fool? If so, would a husband of exceptional talent and beauty, intelligent and considerate children, a devoted mother-in-law, and the title of Duchess simply fall from the sky?! In her past life, the Duchess met a miserable end! Our protagonist first sets her sights on the male lead, unceremoniously claiming him as her own. After marriage, she employs every tactic imaginable: throwing herself into his arms, playing hard to get, alternating between gentle affection and playful dominance, expressing care while subtly tormenting… From then on, the exceptionally handsome, ruthless, yet capable Fifth Young Master Qi, whose emotional intelligence borders on naive innocence, is repeatedly berated by the Emperor, who points a finger at him and scolds, "You spineless fool! What kind of life is this?! Divorce her immediately! Don't be afraid, I will support you!" Fifth Young Master Qi blushes slightly: Actually, this life… isn't so bad… This story portrays a strong female lead who makes every effort to achieve happiness. *** Overlooked and undervalued, Wen Yu, the legitimate daughter of the Wen family, endures a life of quiet suffering. On her fifteenth birthday, tragedy strikes, setting in motion a chain of events that culminates in her agonizing death. Miraculously reborn, Wen Yu returns to the day it all began, armed with the bitter memories of her past life and a steely resolve to change her fate. This time, she won't be a pawn in her family's games. She will reclaim what is rightfully hers, expose the hypocrisy and cruelty of those who wronged her, and forge a new path for herself. But as she navigates the treacherous landscape of family politics and builds her own power, she must confront not only her past enemies but also the unexpected attention of powerful figures who see her as a valuable asset in their own games. Will Wen Yu succumb to her thirst for revenge, or can she find a way to break free from the cycle of pain and create a different future for herself?

title: Natural Born Winner
summary: The newly launched System 9526 from the Time-Space Bureau has been bound to a host with amnesia—who unexpectedly turns out to be a big shot. With a laid-back, Buddhist mindset, the female protagonist traverses various worlds to complete her missions. However, without realizing it, she always ends up becoming the ultimate villain/big boss. Whether in ancient times or interstellar empires, she effortlessly dominates, subverting conventional tropes in this fast-paced transmigration adventure. [Written by 昔我晚矣]
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Martial Arts, Mystery, Slice of Life

title: Dating a Younger Man Is Dangerous
summary: Her ex-boyfriend cheated on her. He was someone she started dating at work and even promised marriage with.Seo Yeon-ha, barely piecing together her shattered heart, threw herself into work. But her daily life is interrupted by the suspicious new employee, Nam Do-hyun.“I’m interested in the team leader.” “Do-hyun, you’re more naive than you look. Just because we slept together once doesn’t mean we’re dating.”It was her first one-night stand. Even though she tried to act strong to avoid being caught, Do-hyun was relentless.“If you don’t want a serious relationship, we can keep it casual.” “Are you saying you want to toy with me, Do-hyun?” “Yes. Drink when you want to drink, call me when you feel lonely.”The warmth she feels from a stranger. The woody scent that lingers on his collar. Everything slowly breaks down Yeon-ha’s boundaries.“Let’s keep it easy. I’ll come running anytime.”She realizes she’s made a mistake. This man is not someone who will just end casually.

title: With Han Geng @ Midnight
summary: All of your love is my wings, giving me the strength to bypass storms. Touched smiles are our beliefs, we share our happiness and sorrow. This year, 2015, marks the tenth year anniversary of my debut. Ten years hold a special meaning in my heart, and so I wanted to do something to commemorate this special date. Throughout these ten years, the person I came to understand the most is myself. In the past few years, friends have suggested that I publish a book, yet I never got to it. What can I write about? Lazy, fickle, irritated. At the present day, after experiencing so much, I prefer the times where I had no schedule and had time to be alone. When you converse a lot with yourself, a lot of stories will pop up. These stories drew me in, and so I wanted to share them with you. And thus this book came to exist.

title: Doomsday Game: Life Expert
summary: When the Doomsday Game arrives, plants and animals mutate, zombies and ghosts flood into the human world. Fighting monsters, leveling up, and looting gear becomes the new way for humans to survive. Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Life Expert talent. Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Food Appreciation talent. Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Medicine Analysis talent. …Su Ning just wants to say: I think… my life is about to become effortlessly victorious.
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-fi

title: Crimson Splendor: Protector of the Realm
summary: Not a “Power Fantasy” (Non-Shuangwen): This is not a “quick-satisfaction” or “overpowered lead” story. It focuses on the struggles and complexities of the era. Beyond Romance: The protagonists’ actions are not just for each other; they are driven primarily by family and responsibility. Political Marriages: The Princess has consorts (husbands), but there are no physical/intimate relations with them. Marriage with Xue: To avoid a political marriage to a foreign land (heqin). Marriage with Wu: To gain a strategic advantage in the struggle for power. These are relationships of mutual exploitation. Historical Creative Liberty: Some plots may not strictly follow the historical timeline. This is a work of fiction; please do not treat it as a historical textbook.

title: A Dragon Girl’s Journey Through A Post-Apocalyptic World
summary: A girl wakes up in a dark room. An abandoned hospital. A deserted post-apocalyptic world. The girl with horns and a tail travels through the ruined world to find out who she is.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Mystery, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: I Won’t Raise Your Child
summary: Elise, the illegitimate child of a marquis, lived her life in silence. She desired nothing and wished for nothing. The only thing she desperately wished for was one. The simple happiness with the man she loved. But the price of love was betrayal. Even her mother coldly turned away from her, and everyone wanted her dead. Just then, a man approached and asked. She decided. To take revenge on everyone who wanted her dead and erase her existence. The woman who returned decided to seduce the man who abandoned her. Until he falls into ruin, I will become even more wicked. You will regret it, you.

title: The Adopted Heroine Who Stole My Health
summary: I was stolen from by the adopted female lead. "Sister, I'm sorry. Your fiancé confessed to me." This is the fifth time. Once again, my adopted younger sister has taken what was mine. I thought that if I gave up everything and treated her kindly, I could at least avoid a tragic end. "Why are you doing this to your sister when you're the older one?" "Try to be half as good as your sister." Even my parents didn’t love me. Just when I thought I couldn’t endure any more, I discovered a shocking truth. The real daughter was my sister, and I was the 'fake' who was meant to suffer in her place. "I won’t let myself be taken from her so easily anymore." To take my revenge, I decided to claim the one thing my sister had never had. I chose the male lead of this novel, Calix. "Three years? If you want, I can marry you tomorrow and make you a duchess." But for some reason, this man wants me?

title: Silversmith
summary: Summary Seo Han, an orphan raised by the humble wanderer No Geul-gae, has lived his entire life in the shadows. To earn enough money to give his guardian a proper funeral, he joins Samra Jeon, a ruthless organization of assassins. But when he is ordered to kill a young woman who once shared a meal with him in childhood—a tiny act of kindness he never forgot—Seo Han chooses betrayal over blind obedience. Hunted and with nowhere to turn, he encounters Chang Hae-ryu, a notorious master whose very name strikes fear in the martial world. Under his tutelage, Seo Han begins to forge his own path, sharpening both his skills and his convictions. As he wanders, allies and enemies alike are drawn to him, their fates intertwining around the mysterious Yeongrongak, the central sect of the righteous factions. There, Seo Han uncovers a vast conspiracy capable of shaking the entire martial world to its core. With darkness spreading and great evil rising, Seo Han stands at the heart of the turmoil. Together with the companions he gathers along the way, he must rely on every skill, every lesson, and every ounce of will he has honed throughout his life. The final battle is not just for survival—it's for the fate of the entire world of martial arts.

title: Please Permit Me To Love You Forever
summary: She conspires and provokes the most powerful young master in Beijing! They sign a contract and with his every call, she has to go anywhere and do anything his bidding. When their contract ends, she smirks and said, “I’ll take the money and you can leave. We don’t owe each other anything.” He is Young Master Ya who rules Beijing. He controls the business empire during the day, and he is the strongest king at night. He is cold and women are merely playthings to him. With his power, the women he has eyes on have never been willing to leave him, yet she is an exception. She loves money, like all the previous women, but she is never shy of showing her greed. And he never realizes that he will ever grow a heart for such a promiscuous and cheap woman… He points a gun straight at her heart. “Die with me, or accept my love—which one do you choose?” She pouts and turns around, before she pushes an adorable child into his arms. “Here, there’s your answer.”

title: Scandal: Eoudong Lawsuit
summary: I will serve as Jiabi for the rest of my life.” “I will protect you until the end of my life.” Eo Woo-dong’s breath flowed down the nape of Lee Gyeom’s neck. The scent from his mouth wafted into his nose. I couldn’t come to my senses like a drugged person. Lee Gyeom put his hand behind Ou-dong’s neck and gently hugged her. “I may be clumsy, so please don’t imitate me.” As he pulled Eoudong deep into his arms, the faint scent of roses touched him. From the moment they became one, they were passionately conscious of each other as if they were about to melt. The souls of each other began to flow inside their bodies. They thought that an eternally happy future awaited them, but the interruption of Tae Kang-soo’s move forced them to separate forever.

title: Different World Business Symbol
summary: A young boy, Asuma Haruto, is transferred to another world. Without having any means to return home, he has no choice but to live in this parallel universe. Armed with only his knowledge of making soap, will Haruto be able to safely make a living here? This is a story about how our protagonist creates his own business out of his hobby of making soap and then gradually manages his business and gets rich.

title: The Sister Who Hated Me, Now Loves Me
summary: With beauty, noble blood, and extraordinary talent, my older sister seemed to have it all. Born as her rival, it was inevitable that I would die at her hands. After escaping once, when half of the empire turned to ashes, I gave up and accepted death. Shh- The moment her cold sword touched my neck, I was reborn at the age of 8. “What’s going on?! Do I have to die again?” This time, I swore I wouldn’t just accept it, clenching my small fists tightly. “Harper, my sister, even if my dreams shatter, I want to protect you.” …Huh? “How dare anyone try to harm you in the Luperne mansion, Harper?” There are so many crazy people in this world. My sister had changed. A lot. “Killian, what do you want to be when you grow up?” “What kind of person do you like? A rich merchant?” “No.” “A Duke?” I shook my head again. “Then the Emperor?” “…What?” “That’s right.” “…” “You want me to become the Emperor.” For a split second, did my inner thoughts show on my face, or was this child more sensitive than I thought? “Then I’ll become the Emperor, Harper. I don’t want anything else.” He grabbed my hand tightly as if there was no more doubt in his mind.

title: The Mad Duke’s Perfect Maid
summary: Female Protagonist: Ella - Born to a noble mother and a commoner father, Ella takes on debt to support her younger siblings after her parents pass away and enters the duke's household as a maid. There, she becomes the maid in charge of Duke Glois, known as the mu*derous and mad duke. Everyone fears and dreads the duke, but to her, the duke is nothing more or less than a master to be served. *Male Protagonist: Luichen Glois - The empire's only duke, nicknamed a warmonger, mu*derous, and mad dog. He has achieved countless merits in war and led the war to victory, but people fear him because of his hysterical and sharp memories of the bloody battlefield. But the moment his eyes meet the bold Ella, a mere commoner maid, the Duke is bewildered by his first feelings. The moment he realizes it's love, there's nothing he won't do to have Ella—even if it means beheading the Emperor. *Read this when: You want to read the special, gentle story of the maid who made the mad Duke, who everyone fears, fall in love. And you want a story without the keyword "Hwibinghwan." *Relatable quote: "If everyone were equal... wouldn't it be truly happy?" Ella's flushed cheeks were so adorable that the Duke smiled involuntarily. At Ella's single word, the Duke finally made up his mind: to destroy this empire. Story Introduction: Ella , sold to the Duke's household as if to pay off her father's gambling debts, becomes the maid in charge of the mad Duke, whom everyone shuns. The Duke looks at the maid standing beside him, feeling a strange sense of alienation. The maid who had prepared the meal, unlike the other servants, did not tremble in her voice, nor did she show any signs of anxiety or cold sweat. She simply stood calmly next to him. “Name.” For the first time since arriving at the mansion, the Duke asked the name of the maid in charge. “Ella.” “Ella… This time, the head maid sent a pretty good maid.” * * * Duke Glois had never expected it. He would fall for an ordinary maid like this… … . However, since there was no turning back now, the Duke resolved for his maid. To destroy this empire.

title: Exiled From the Brave Party, I Save the World as a Rare Occupation “Holy Water Messenger”
summary: This is a nonsensical parody about a kid who is paid to leave his party for no understandable reason, after which he pisses in a bucket and offers it to people to drink before continuing on...his journey?

title: After Being Deeply Hurt, I Chose Divorce, But He Called Me the Bad Woman
summary: At twenty-two, Lu Zhenzhu married Gu Huai. Everyone said she was lucky. But not long after the wedding, she found an old photograph in a drawer... The girl in the photo looked just like her—even the mole at the corner of her eye was identical. On the back of the photo was a complete verse: "Half the river emerald, half the river red; Dew like pearls, the moon like a hook." But the handwriting of the two lines differed—one delicate, as if written by a girl, the other bold, unmistakably his style. The signatures at the bottom read "Jiang Sesè" and "Gu Huai." Lu Zhenzhu stared at the photo and understood everything...

title: On the Rearing of Zombies and Children
summary: I stared blankly at the zombie leading the pack, feeling a bit dazed. What was going on? Even a guy with such honest, handsome features had betrayed the cause? He glared at me. "What, never seen a zombie before?" "...I've just never seen such a handsome zombie," I replied.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Horror, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Hero-Slaying Bandit
summary: The protagonist is an adventurer and a bandit. A rascal of sort. Varde is the third son of a noble, and is a bastard who was born of an affair with the maid. Still, his family did take care of him until he was five years old, allowing him to live, although with much shame. On his fifth birthday, however, his magic affinity was tested, and his affinity was found to be poor. In the end, he was chased away from his house, sent to his mother’s relatives, and forbidden from associating his name with his noble relatives. After that, he went out on an adventure with the brother of his mother, his uncle. As his uncle was an adventurer, he was able to learn many techniques to allow him to survive. When she awoke from her coma, it wasn't her beloved husband who greeted her, but Li Tingyu, a ghost of her past. What did his appearance signify? She had no time to ponder—she only wanted to return to the days she could never reclaim, to the warmth she had already lost. Yet Li Tingyu had once again entered her world...

"You're the one who killed Olivia!" Overcome with rage, Olivia dares to attend her own funeral, determined to uncover the truth behind her death. There, she crosses paths with an unexpected character - Duke Kaiden Arendt. He seems to harbor a deep grudge against Eric Anderson, and he begins to press Olivia for answers about what really happened that day. Driven by the need to see her ex-fiancé suffer a fate far worse than her own, Olivia decides to join forces with Kaiden to take her revenge... But then— "Why... why on earth... why would you..." She could hardly believe her eyes - the man who had seemed too cold to bleed even when stabbed was now shedding bitter tears... right in front of her grave. ‘Kaiden... why are you crying? why are you mourning my death?’

Since her task was to be a cannon fodder, the role she played was always either arrogant, hypocritical, or greedy for money — which would contrast sharply to the true, kind, and beautiful female protagonist who would stand next to the male protagonist in the future. However, the Lord God told Jing Zhao that the male protagonists that she had ab*sed was so deeply hurt that they no longer believed in love. title: Bloody Revenge

After receiving two insurance payouts, they got married and lived happily together as a family. Occasionally, That Woman would get scared: "The mother and daughter who died-won't they turn into Vengeful Ghosts and come back to take revenge on me?" My father would laugh at her for being superstitious. But they didn't know-I wasn't dead. And the me who returned alive for revenge would be far more terrifying than any Vengeful Ghost.

title: The Deer King
summary: Van is the leader of Lone Horn, a group of soldiers on a hopeless mission to defend their country from the encroaching empire. Van had expected to die in the war, but somehow he ends up a prisoner, chained with other s*aves in a salt mine. A sudden vicious attack interrupts this hopeless existence. Wild dogs with strange skill and purpose race through the mine attacking everyone in it. Van defends himself, but he too is bitten. The dog runs off; but the bite carries an infection. When Van regains consciousness, apparently some days later, he finds that all his fellow prisoners are dead. Breaking free of his chains he searches the camp. The guards, prisoners and other workers are all dead. But in one hut, a woman had died hiding her baby daughter from the dogs. With this little girl, whom he calls Yuna, Van sets off out of the camp.

Until one day, after causing a catastrophic blunder, he accidentally stumbles upon a miraculous contemporary medical technique, mastering a forbidden skill unknown to both the medical and martial worlds: Soul Transplantation. Yet, as foreign threats loom and a devastating plague descends upon humanity—bringing with it the Black Death, hemorrhagic fever, pandemic influenza, depression, and more—the question remains: Will the Medical Warriors' lancet become a force for salvation or a tool of destruction?

"How cute. Are you trying to be adorable?" — Quack! Quaaack! (No! I'm not!) The previous emperor was a tyrant who carried out a policy of exterminating human-animal shapeshifters! His son, that red-haired emperor, is... "Duckie, soon a golden duck statue modeled after you will be placed in the imperial palace. I've ordered it to be put on top of the fountain." — Quack! (You bastard!) Bestia stomped on Canian's palm with her yellow webbed feet. — Quaaack! (I'll escape within two days!) As she firmly grasped the tip of her wing and made a resolution, his handsome face caught her eye. Is it just her imagination that she feels like they're going to be deeply entangled somehow?

title: Destiny in Cinders
summary: Eons ago when destiny was first forged, empires formed through conquest of the realm with impressive steeds and gleaming halberds. Heavenly sects rose to prominence and maintained ordered dominion over the realm, ushering in a harmonious celestial melody to all corners of the realm. In the present, calamities continue to brew. The splendorous glory of the past continues to get chipped away, reducing everything to withered ruins. As the sects grow restless with ambition, who is left to worry about the wellbeing of all? As the wealthy and powerful indulge in debauchery, who will tend to the common folk's grievances? Desperate pleas for the Heavens to spare the remains of one's child ripple through tears of blood. The profound workings of fate stresses the world to its limits, sparking beacons that herald the quelling of chaos. Sever the processions of fate on the heavenward path. A single sword strike shall rend all in this gloom-infested world, reducing everything to cinders! Synopsis First, An Jing sold himself to a demonic cult for medicine to heal his mother. Then, he found an unlikely ally: a disembodied voice coming from within a rusty sword. The demonic cult was up to something, but neither of them quite knew what. Well, it's not like the dynasty of Grand Chen is much better off than the Heavenly Demon Cult anyway, with all the corruption in its ranks. But the cult's plans are far from innocent. They're not raising and training us children of disaster for free. The fragmented memories from his past life had wiped the naivete in him clean for him to know that the demonic cult was not a charity. Enter a world ravaged by fiends in the distant past and mountains of unending snow in the present, a world of warring nations and sects, the world of Void Embrace. With his sword-soul companion's help, An Jing is able to slip into another world entirely: a world of qi cultivation with advanced technologies and soulless corporations that try to wipe out the competition by any means necessary. How do I keep getting wrapped up in all this? First, there's the demonic cult in Void Embrace and the ritual that unsealed the heavenly fiends. And just as I was peacefully shopping at a black market in Skysource, a mechanized battalion of cultivator super-soldiers crashed through the concrete above, blasting away at everything with their spirit-beam guns! Something was truly up with An Jing's celestial lifearc, the destiny which the Heavens had forced upon his story, one that sent sparks flying no matter where he went and what he did. Will he harness the spark and become a beacon of light for the two worlds? Or will a stray spark eventually set him and everything around him alight and leave nothing but smouldering cinders in its wake?
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Sci-fi, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Final Boss: Shadow Running towards the Light
summary: Kang Sung-Tae, who lost both his parents and his memories before primary school. "You bad guy, you graduated!" "Aunt, aunt. I don’t think I can get this money." "Here you go, punk. If you don’t want your aunt to be upset, you can’t refuse." There was a place I wanted to go…
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mature

title: I Tried to See How Far My Devoted Childhood Friend Would Go
summary: My childhood friend will do anything for me. She is what you’d call a devoted person. I suddenly realized that I was in love with my childhood friend. I made up my mind. I decided to see how far my childhood friend would go.

title: I Will Try To Prevent The Extinction Of The Dokgo Family
summary: A retired national kendo champion ends up inside a failed martial arts novel. And not just any story—one where the protagonist loses her entire family to the Demonic Cult and seeks revenge. And that protagonist? It’s me. I became the youngest daughter of the Dokgo family, destined to be wiped out by the hands of the Demonic Cult. If I don’t want to die a meaningless death, I have to change the future somehow. But there’s a problem… my brothers are all hopeless. “Hahaha, even my own little sister can’t resist this handsome face of mine!” The eldest brother, heir to the family, is a complete narcissist. “Ah, this wound? It’s nothing, Seol-ah. Don’t worry about it.” The second brother is smart but traumatized by the sword—he can’t even hold one. “There are plenty of martial artists out there. Why do I need to wield a sword?” And the third brother, who’s supposed to become the main character and avenge the family later, refuses to train at all. Seriously, do these guys not realize they’re living in a martial arts story?! To make things worse, our clan’s strongest warrior—our great-uncle, Dokgo Pae—has been wandering the martial world for twenty years and has no plans to come back anytime soon… “As your bodyguard, my lady, I also intend to teach you how to protect yourself.” And now, the guard hired to protect me says he wants to train me in martial arts. Excuse me? You’re telling me, a girl suffering from meridian blockage, to learn martial arts? Why me? There are plenty of perfectly healthy siblings to choose from! “One day, I’ll become strong enough to protect you, Seol-ah. I promise.” Oh, and let’s not forget the future Heavenly Demon I rescued before he got kidnapped by the Demonic Cult. Funny thing is, he keeps saying he’ll save me. No, really—if you’d just stay out of trouble, I’d already be grateful. Twenty years later, I finally meet the legendary great-uncle who left the clan for mysterious reasons… And the first time we see each other, we’re pointing swords at each other. “Then go ahead and strike me down! Let’s see how well you live after killing your own granddaughter!” “Wait… you’re Jungseon’s daughter?” His shocked gaze lingered on me, and before I knew it, my bottled-up feelings burst out. “Other people’s grandfathers dote on them since they’re kids! Why is my grandfather the only one like this?!” #KendoGeniusHeroine #StrongFemaleLead #HeroineGrowthStory #PowerfulHeroine
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance

title: The Symbiotic Relationship Between Rabbits and Black Pa
summary: I was a rabbit beast who couldn’t become human even after my coming‑of‑age ceremony. My family tossed me into a basket and threw me away, calling me half‑human… “Are you crying? Cry some more.” That was how I ended up being picked up by a grumpy black panther. “You lack guts. I’ll eat you the day after tomorrow, so try hard.” This ruthless beast. As I glared at him, his whiskers twitched, and the black panther’s eyes narrowed with an oddly innocent look. “I think I just got excited.” Mom, this kid must have gone crazy! Surviving a rather unhinged black panther… “They say wild beasts are possessive, no matter what.” …Is it possible?

title: Lost Murim

In the end, it's just the government outsourcing what it cannot handle—using the murim as its hired enforcers. But what happens when the authorities no longer tolerate the martial world? When the ruling class decides to erase the very warriors they've relied on? "We're all going to die..." Correct. Without their enforcers, the officials start dropping like flies. I don't care if it's the Cloud Qi Pavilion or the Ifrit of Mount Hua—just bring back the murim already!
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Martial Arts, Romance, Wuxia

title: I the Demon Lord Am Being Targeted by My Female Disciples
summary: I The Demon Lord am being targeted by my female Disciples is story of Bai Feng who never expected a dating game to turn into his death sentence. After transmigrating into an ancient cultivation romance game, he awakens as Bai Qingling—the infamous Demon Lord destined to die in the game’s final chapter. Cold-blooded, ruthless, and obsessed with immortality, Bai Qingling once cultivated forbidden Gu techniques, refined human puppets, and treated his three stunning female disciples as nothing more than expendable chess pieces. Worse still, those very disciples are the final villain bosses of the game’s “Pure Love” and “Evil Fall” routes. And now? Bai Feng arrives at the moment of absolute despair—his cultivation crippled, his power gone, and three former disciples standing behind him… blades raised. Just as death seems inevitable, the heavens intervene.

title: I Want To Live A Good Life
summary: Heeran, the granddaughter of Mazon, lived a life of luxury and enjoyment. One day, she was brutally murdured by her stepmother. ‘Fortunately, I came back.’ A tooth for a tooth. An eye for an eye. She dreamed of revenge for her stepmother, saying she would have her pay for her life. “I’m happy because of you!” But she gave up revenge for the nanny who truly cared about her because she thought she wouldn’t be touched if she just lived quietly. She believed she could keep this little happiness. ‘But…’ “I guess I looked to easy, nanny.” Heeran smiled faintly, turning her back to the grave. “Now it’s time to go back to being a wicked villain.”

title: When I, an Otaku, Helped a Beautiful and Clumsy JK, We Become Friends and Go to Each Other’s Houses
summary: Shimazaki Osamu, a loner and gloomy high school writer, was eating alone at a family restaurant. On his way out, he encountered a beautiful girl who seemed to be troubled. When a worried Shimazaki called out to her, she seemed to have forgotten her wallet and looked as if she was about to burst into tears on the spot. Intending to treat her, he paid for her share as well, but after that, the beautiful girl took him to her house, saying that she will have the money then. At first, they are just curious about each other, but gradually they become attracted to each other──slowly but surely, their relationship deepens. The two, who are clumsy when it comes to love, gradually grow closer to each other while making those around them jealous.
genres: Completed, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: From Now On, Real Actors
summary: A top star possesses a truly unknown body! The story of a once frigid superstar becoming a genuine actor with a genuine humanity, and finding his true self. #RealActor #TopStar #Possession #Actor #Humanity #Parenting #FirstTimeDad #JinHaNeul'sGrowth

title: Who Is Whose Substitute
summary: Zhou Xingzhi was disfigured while saving the woman he truly loved. In the hospital, I cried my heart out, my sobs echoing through the halls. I kept pestering the doctor, asking over and over if his face could be fixed. Everyone thought I was hopelessly in love with him. Only Zhou Xingzhi’s younger brother handed me a tissue, a smirk playing on his lips. “Sister-in-law, my brother’s face is beyond saving.” “You might as well choose me instead. After all, my face looks much more like Wei Qiao’s now than my brother’s does.”
genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Qianmen: The Prince
summary: Humans do not have the claws and teeth of tigers and wolves, nor the strength of lions and elephants, yet they can capture and train these animals because of their wisdom. -- Qianmen: The Secret Book, Prologue

title: The Villainess Is Threatened by the Heroine to “Bully” Her, or the Cat Will Pay
summary: The protagonist, Merucha, is an ordinary noble lady with a fiancé. Both attending the same aristocratic school. However, a woman who claims to be the heroine suddenly appeared and forced her to become a bully, saying, “I want to capture your fiancé, so bully me!” “If you don’t obey, the cute cat will pay for it.” From that day on, Merusha became a villain, and her days of bullying the heroine started, all events according to the heroine’s instructions. “How silly, I’m too embarrassed… I have to bully the heroine because of a stray cat… “ Merusha doesn’t have friends. Only a cat and a priest she can talk to … and her fiancé… she would gladly gift him to the heroine. The cat is more important!

title: Love Me Again, Mom
summary: The day I died, my sister's wedding went on as scheduled. She wore a wedding gown and married my boyfriend. My mother called me several times. When no one answered, she angrily called me an ungrateful wretch. My brother sent me a text, scolding me: "Are you really that petty? Still holding a grudge over something from two years ago?" My usually taciturn father said with a cold face, "Tell her, if she doesn't come home today, we'll act as if we never had this daughter." They didn't really want me home. They just didn't want my sister's wedding to be anything less than perfect for lacking my blessing. But I was already dead.

title: Scrapped Princess
summary: The story takes place in a fantasy world and revolves around a 15-year-old girl Pacifica Casull who is a girl child born in a set of twins into the royal family of the kingdom Leinwan and then abandoned. The 5111th Grendel Prophecy predicts that she is the "poison that will destroy the world" before the sun sets on her sixteenth birthday. As a consequence, she is dropped off a cliff as an infant. Believed to be dead, no one realizes her continued existence until after Pacifica is already 15 years old.

title: Ordinary Person × Modern Dungeon × Summer Vacation Life = Rise to Success!? 〜A Private Dungeon Was Made at the Remains of a Secret Base From Childhood〜
summary: Everyday Summer Vacation. And Before I Knew it, I Was the Strongest & Rich! A world where dungeons suddenly appeared everywhere. Even here in Japan was no exception. And in each prefecture, several large dungeons exist. In the dungeons, magic stones are found, an unknown energy source. And materials never seen before could be harvested. Those with talent all rushed to become [Explorers] and built up wealth. Meanwhile, the protagonist, Natsume Koichi, did not have any remarkable talent recognized even in the dungeon aptitude national test. And while still admiring explorers, he spent his days working as a corporate s*ave. Moreover, perhaps because of his clumsy personality bringing misfortune, he ended up getting fired from his company. At the bottom of despair, he returned to his family home. He then casually peeked into the secret base in the mountain that was his childhood playground. But there, a dungeon gate swaying and writhing had been born. Inside the dungeon gate, the summer vacation mountain spread out, where cries of cicadas poured down. Even though it was winter outside, the sense of seasons seemed bugged. According to an inspection by the authorities, the dungeon was certified as "just an empty space" with no monsters or items. But in truth, it was not like that――. Through self-training in the private dungeon, and repeatedly challenging the dungeons in the city areas, Natsume becomes famous and gains wealth.

title: The Most Profound Love is to Live Up to You
summary: The biggest mistake Lu Man made in her life was falling in love with a man named Han Lucheng. She gave up everything for him, only to receive hurt time and time again. After five years in prison and experiencing the pain of losing her child, she finally realized that loving herself is more important than loving him. "Han Lucheng, I will never forgive you in this lifetime!" "But Lu Man, it is you whom I love!"

title: The Eldest Sister of the 1980s Became Rich with Her Space
summary: When An Xin opened her eyes, she found herself back in the 1980s. Her mother was critically ill and younger siblings so hungry they were skin and bones—all of whom now relied on her for survival. To make matters worse, she woke up to the entire village witnessing her in an embarrassing moment and inexplicably ended up married to a cold and distant man! What a joke! An Xin resolved that in this era of scarcity, armed with her portable warehouse, she would never let herself be tied down by a man. However, after marriage, the penniless geological survey captain transformed into a rising star in the jade industry. Meanwhile, An Xin's identity as a queen in the transportation world gradually came to light. As they each shone brightly in their respective fields, they came to realize that only the light of one another could illuminate their worlds. "I always believed the greatest love in the world was meeting the best version of you at the best time, until you appeared before me in a mess. In that moment, I knew—you were the one, for eternity."

title: The Chaotic Immortal Wood Sect: Immortal Cultivation War
summary: Reborn into a cultivation world, a former combat hunter with a gift for plant-craft and summoning uses his botanical talents to ascend within an immortal wood sect. As he takes root in the vast celestial realm, his quiet mastery of plants grows into a force that may change the world.

title: Otakkies Case File No. 114 – The Reason She Wears Fishnet Tights
summary: One day, a “Reality Rift” occurred in the holy city of Akiba! The invasion of interdimensional people, space-time pirates, and science gangs was about to begin! And then a beautiful superheroine stood up to the crisis in Akihabara. An epic tale of superheroines in Akihabara, the sacred land of Otaku. The 114th episode of this Young Adult fiction is “The Reason She Wears Fishnet Tights “. Now then, during a popular magic show in Akihabara, a magician disappears and is found dead. As the magic industry’s grudges, a suspicious ex-boyfriend, an even more suspicious magic designers emerge, the Otaku’s desire for fame comes to the surface in a hilarious way…
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, Sci-fi

title: The Crime Novel Villain Forces Himself onto the Righteous Path
summary: During a capture operation, Yu Song died in the line of duty—only to awaken inside a crime-investigation novel as the villain. Surrounded by drug addicts and mu*derers, and targeted by a serial killer who wanted her as his disciple, she gradually fell until she became the ultimate big boss. In the original plot, she was arrested by the leads and sentenced to death. Faced with this identity, Yu Song reluctantly accepted reality—but as someone raised on the righteous path, how could she ever be a villain? What “uncontrollable force”? She was the uncontrollable force! Anyone who broke the law went straight to prison. That mysterious serial killer? She would find him early. So what if her parents went to jail? She could still be a volunteer cop, handing over clues for bonuses. Determined to walk the righteous path, Yu Song fought crime harder than ever. She even reported Ji He, the rich heir pursuing her: "You were driving drunk and speeding. I don’t like unlawful behavior." Ji He wept, convinced she loved him. She also reported Gu Zhiye, the officer who hunted her: "Fishing for evidence is illegal. Please uphold justice." Gu Zhiye, too, thought she cared. Yu Song: "March in step, walk the righteous road. Building a harmonious society starts with me!"

title: My Deceased Childhood Friend is the Horror Game Boss
summary: This is the bloody and terrifying Infinite Game. Other people's tasks: Village Corpse, Doll Wraith. I tremblingly flipped over my task card: [Sit on the Boss's lap and kiss him.] [Become the ghost's bride and spend an unforgettable wedding night with him.] [Invite the Boss to stay the night and tie him to the bed (belts or tent**les are recommended).] ? Are you guys really a serious horror game?! And that notorious, terrifying ultimate Boss... Why does he look exactly like my childhood friend who died years ago?
genres: Horror, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Supernatural

title: Famitsu Bunko’s Horror Anthology
summary: After breaking the city “rule”, the girl’s life gradually broken, and finally she pass across the forbidden white line──. Along with Ayasato Keishi’s spine-chilling 『Nekono Tenoko』, there are Sasaki Ichiro’s 『Vertical』, Tao Noritake’s WEB published work 『Kobito no Geemuya』, Maisaka Kou’s story of a man experiencing the worse fear in the middle of test courage with the popular girl in class 『The Two in the Test of Courage at Night』, Takeoka Hazuki’s 『Ainosainou』, and state-of-the-art Nishino Sego’s newly written 『Ghost Tunnel』. Presenting these six stories, this is the first volume of the summer night light novel horror!

title: A Maxed-Out Foodie Lying Flat in a Period Novel
summary: After transmigrating into a book, Rong Xiaoxiao faced two choices: — Either marry someone, or — Go to the countryside as a "sent-down youth." Looking at the men her neighbor aunties tried to introduce — limping, blind, or total mama’s boys — Rong Xiaoxiao felt like her laziness was about to be cured. She immediately turned around and went home to pack her bags. ... Two pretty educated youths arrived in Hongshan Brigade. One wore crisp Dacron clothes and polished leather shoes, looking down his nose at everyone. People said he was from a high-ranking family — clearly someone you didn’t want to mess with. The other wore rough linen clothes, lugged a big bag, and grinned brightly. Villagers whispered that this girl looked like a real worker, strong and capable. Rong Xiaoxiao, who would rather sit than stand and lie down than sit, dropped her bag and thought: Got it, they were definitely not talking about me. Not long after... Watching the "intimidating" youth toil under the sun every day, nearly roasted into charcoal, while Rong Xiaoxiao grew rounder, fairer, and could often be found cracking melon seeds at the village entrance, engrossed in gossip from the next village — everyone fell silent. — This... this... you’re straight-up fraud! Rong Xiaoxiao, strolling back from the fields with her hands behind her back: "Fried? Sounds good. Let’s have fried chicken tonight!"

title: American Comics Start With Level Five Mutants
summary: In a cosmic twist of fate, Su Yao finds himself thrust into the heart of the Marvel universe, awakening as a mutant within the confines of an experimental base. As the reality of his situation sinks in, panic courses through his veins like a turbulent river. Yet, just as despair threatens to engulf him, a dormant power within him sparks to life at the crucial moment – the mutant ability of ‘imitation.’ Su Yao can now mimic the abilities of those around him, a gift that could either be his salvation or his downfall. With a heart pounding with uncertainty, Su Yao tentatively experiments with his newfound powers. His first imitation takes the form of Orochi, the Sun God and Will of the Earth. The sensation is both exhilarating and overwhelming as he grapples with the immense power at his disposal. As he delves deeper into his abilities, Su Yao’s next imitations include Wanda, the Scarlet Witch, and even the enigmatic Sun God himself. Each mimicry unlocks a fraction of their incredible powers, leaving Su Yao in awe of the vast potential within him. However, the elation is short-lived as Su Yao discovers the harsh reality of his situation. His mutant abilities come at a cost – a ticking clock counting down his remaining days. With a mere 83 days left to live, Su Yao is faced with a race against time to understand and master his powers. In the larger Marvel universe, ripples of Su Yao’s existence reach the ears of formidable figures. Professor X, Magneto, Thor, and even the mischievous Loki become aware of this unexpected mutant with a lifespan hanging by a thread. Their reactions vary from urgency to familial surprise, setting the stage for an unpredictable journey where Su Yao’s destiny becomes intertwined with the fate of the Marvel multiverse.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance, Supernatural

title: Please Don’t Kill Me
summary: Bliss, both a villainess and a catalyst for the main characters’ meeting, was destined to die today. Her mu*derer would be none other than her own husband, Marquis Caelan Adrian. Around her neck lay her husband's gift—the very thing meant to take her life. Without a chance to avoid it, Caelan's hand reached out in an instant and wrapped around Bliss's nape. She tensed up at the feeling of the large hand on her neck. "I'll put it on for you." The cold touch seemed to drain every bit of warmth from her body, leaving Bliss breathless. As she braced herself for death, 'What's going on?' Something impossible happened. Even though the poisoned necklace was clearly constricting Bliss's neck, her breath didn't stop. * * * "Caelan, please don't kill me." Bliss met his gaze directly as she spoke each word with determination. While she pleaded for her life and promised to end her wicked ways, Caelan merely watched her in silence.

title: The Pampered Daughter Returns to the Capital, Causing the Whole Family to Spit Blood in Anger
summary: [Sharp-tongued + Villainess + Strong Female Lead + Political Intrigue + Wish Fulfillment + Decisive in Killing + Delicate] Six-year-old Xie Sangning, who should have been the pampered official daughter of the General's Residence, was sent to the desolate West Cold due to the jealousy of the second branch of the family, where she froze to death. Bad news: she died. Good news: not completely dead—she time-traveled. She crossed over to the 22nd century, saw a different world, rolled up her sleeves and studied hard, hoping to return one day. Heaven rewards the diligent. She finally returned to Qing Country, reborn at the moment she was near death at six years old. In this life, the cousin who stole her place, the princess who bullied her elder brother, the two-faced younger cousin, and that person in the palace... she will spare none of them. What elegant lady? What refined and intelligent? She is just a delicate villainess! Since there is no justice to speak of, she will no longer be bound by conventions. Since imperial power reigns supreme, then she will replace this very sky!

title: All-Powerful Chip
summary: Zhou Xing was once a Migrant Worker who was as ordinary as ordinary could be. While working, he dug up a small black box. Inside the box was a high-tech, highly intelligent Chip from the future. Chip: "Master, I am the All-Powerful Chip! I can do anything!" For example, martial arts, medicine, and running away from danger... Zhou Xing: "Can you help your master, me, pick up girls?" Chip: "Sorry, Master. My previous master did not input that system for me."

title: As An Immortal, I Only Learn Forbidden Skills
summary: When Jiang Ming woke up in a strange world, he learned he had obtained immortality. In the dangerous and ruthless world of cultivation, he was determined to carve his unique path. Taking advantage of his immortality, he vowed to learn forbidden skills that would normally eat away at the user’s life. As he continued on his path, Jiang Ming realized that with his forbidden skills, he could become the strongest.

title: I Told You to Obediently Keep Your Head Down, but You Ended up Rampaging Through the Apocalypse?
summary: [Post apocalypse + Zombies + Strong Female Lead + No Romance Pairing + Base building + Spatial Ability + Hoarding + System + Overpowered Cheat] In her previous life, Mo Yuwan scraped and clawed her way through the apocalypse for over a decade, only to be thrown into a tide of zombies. When she opened her eyes again, she’d been sent back to half a month before the outbreak. Looking back, her s*umbag father had shoved her pregnant mother into the zombie horde and then seized their house. Since heaven had given her a second chance at life, she would never let that happen again — this time she’d build a happy life for herself and her mother. But why does she have something weird in her head now? An “Apocalypse Lying Flat System”? That sounds totally unreliable. She figured it was useless — until, before the apocalypse even arrived, she unexpectedly awakened a spatial power. And it’s the upgradable kind! With an early space ability, Mo Yuwan immediately taught her s*umbag father a harsh lesson, then used his money to start stockpiling supplies like crazy — and built her own apocalypse fortress. Hotpot ingredients, barbecue supplies? Bought! Cold noodles, grilled cold noodles, guobaorou (sweet and sour pork), barbecue, milk tea? Bought! While others were out fighting zombies and struggling, Mo Yuwan sat to the side, milk tea in one hand and a burger in the other, happily snacking. While others had nowhere stable to sleep and feared being eaten in their sleep, Mo Yuwan rolled from one side of her two meter bed to the other and slept soundly. Just as everyone began to envy and resent her comfortable life, Mo Yuwan started building a base and taking ordinary people in. In no time, everyone was clamoring to join her base! Watch how she single handedly carries everyone through the apocalypse! Female strong · Feel good power fantasy · System driven · Rebirth

title: Adopting a Big Cat to Raise a Cub Together [Interstellar]
summary: Ruan Qiao transmigrated to an alien world and inherited a nurturing institute, gaining a bunch of fluffy creatures. There were squirrels with green horns, rabbits with pink tufts, cats with aqua-blue eyes, and golden eagles with black-and-white long feathers… Each one was obedient and soft, irresistibly cute. But no matter how well-behaved or cute the cubs were, they still needed to eat, and the nurturing institute was poor. To make sure the cubs could eat meat and delicious fruits, Ruan Qiao had to roll up her sleeves and start the hard work of earning money. Planting vegetables, clearing wasteland, growing mushrooms… Feeding, cleaning, walking the cubs… This became her daily routine. Although she had a golden finger, any fruit she produced could sell for a fortune, the family was large, and hungry mouths were countless. At the poorest moment, an injured big cat even staged an accident, forcing her to adopt the massive creature. What Ruan Qiao didn’t expect was that this big cat turned out to be a skilled little earner and family provider. With him— The cubs had someone to care for them, the wasteland was tended, and even meat was delivered to their door. He could even livestream their daily life raising cubs, earning his own food. Ruan Qiao finally enjoyed a life of petting cats, walking cubs, and having enough to eat and drink. But the good days didn’t last long. Later, Ruan Qiao had a dream, she realized she had actually transmigrated into a book. In the book, the original owner sold the nurturing institute, and the fluffy creatures were abandoned again, meeting tragic ends… And the big cat she rescued? He was the ultimate villain sent to take revenge for his nephew, coming specifically to kill her! — Looking at Jiang Qi, obediently leaning by her side, pushing his silky black hair into her hand, waiting to be petted— Ruan Qiao: “……” #I adopted a big cat, but he wants to kill me# #I thought I was obsessed with cloud cat-petting, but it turns out I was petting an interstellar commander! Earned something?# #The fluff I raised in the cloud turns into a human# PS: All the cubs will eventually take human form; they are not always animals. The male lead’s animal form is a black-and-white long-haired Maine Coon cat—handsome and super pettable.

title: White Horse Neighing in the West Wind
summary: White Horse Neighing in the West Wind by Jin Yong was first serialized in the newspapers in 1961. Li Wenxiu, a young Han Chinese maiden, loses her parents in the Gobi Desert while escaping from a group of bandits who are after a map of the Gaochang labyrinth. Placed on a white steed, she flees to Kazakh territory and is taken into the care of Old Man Ji, an elderly Han Chinese man. While growing up, she meets Supu, a Kazakh boy, and starts a romance with him. However, Supu's father disapproves of the relationship between his son and a Han Chinese girl, so they are forced to separate. Several years later, Li Wenxiu meets Hua Hui, a hermit, in an oasis in the Gobi Desert, and helps him cure his wounds. Hua Hui feels grateful to her and accepts her as his apprentice and teaches her martial arts. She returns home in the midst of heavy snowfall and sees Supu, his father, and his new lover taking shelter in her house. Chen Dahai, the leader of the group of bandits who killed Li Wenxiu's parents, arrives at Li's home and suspects that the map he has been hunting for is inside the house. He ransacks the house for the map and eventually finds it. The secret of the map is revealed when blood is spilled onto the cloth. Chen wants to silence Supu and the others but is stopped and defeated by Li, who has disguised herself as an old man. Chen Dahai flees with the map and finds his way to the labyrinth, while Li Wenxiu and Supu gather five others to join them in pursuing Chen and the bandits. The seven of them make their way to the labyrinth, where they are surprised to find ordinary items associated with Han Chinese culture instead of treasure and riches as they expected. To their horror, they encounter a "ghost" who haunts them by killing their companions without leaving any traces. Just as they are about to flee, Supu learns that his lover has been kidnapped by the "ghost" and he tracks the "ghost" to its lair in the labyrinth, where he discovers that the "ghost" is actually a martial arts expert in disguise. The "ghost" tells his story and reveals that he was forced into exile because he was betrayed by his apprentice, who is actually Old Man Ji. The "ghost" is the hermit Hua Hui, whom Li Wenxiu saved earlier. To everyone's surprise, Old Man Ji is revealed to be actually a man in his 30s in disguise as an old man. Old Man Ji and Hua Hui start fighting with each other. Li is shocked to realise that the two, who are close to her, are actually enemies. Hua Hui eventually dies in his futile attempt to kill everyone in the labyrinth. After leaving the labyrinth, Li Wenxiu hears the true story behind the items hidden in the labyrinth and their origins. She decides to leave the land for central China as she feels miserable after the loss of two of her loved ones and the marriage of her lover to another woman.

title: Love Apartment: Tomb Raiding System
summary: He time-traveled! That’s nothing special! But was there something wrong with the way he traveled? Ending up in "Love Cemetery"... no, wait—"Love Notes"? What’s that about? Wrong again, "Tomb Raiding Apartment"? Yeah, that’s more like it! Not only that, but he also became another mysterious figure besides Xiao Hei, the one who never shows his face! And the system he brought along was clearly off-track—what’s with this "Tomb Raiding System"? But then again, thinking about the movies he watched in his past life… teaming up to raid tombs… actually doesn’t sound too bad.
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Psychological, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Dressed as the only ordinary girl in the military school
summary: Due to an accident, ordinary high school senior Alyssa found herself unlucky enough to be transported to a bizarre ABO world. To make matters worse, she found herself in a prestigious military academy, rooming with and attending classes alongside a group of either wealthy or noble. Though these high and mighty young masters were somewhat easy on the eyes, unfortunately, they were a bunch of arrogant, conceited lunatics with high combat prowess who discriminated against the weak. And Alyssa, among them, was a weakling who couldn’t run 800 meters in five minutes and couldn’t lift a finger. Alyssa: “…” In this world, she had no foothold. To avoid being bullied or expelled and left to wander the streets, Alyssa gritted her teeth and resolved to survive in this terrifying military academy. First of all, we must start with a good relationship with this group of young masters of the Tianlong people – She not only played the role of a caring logistics assistant to the coolest guy in the dormitory, holding an umbrella when he fought and cooking when he hunted, striving to become his best combat partner; She also carefully chose sides in the factional wars among the young masters of various military academies, building trust with them. The premise of not becoming a target of their bullying was to first become their friend, partner, and good brother. One day, she even inadvertently rescued the passionate period of the ABO guy from the neighboring dormitory! After Alyssa’s efforts, her hard work paid off, and everyone’s attitude towards her improved. Except for occasionally giving her strange looks, it was evident that they considered her one of their own. …But did they really have to invite her to bathe and sleep together? And did they have to secretly climb into her bed at night? Alyssa, struggling in her female disguise, shivered with fear amidst the boys’ enthusiastic desire to open up to her. However, she only thought this was how Alphas expressed their affection. Until one night, she woke up to find them all gathered around her bed— Wait a minute?! Why were her good brothers coming to bite her neck?!

title: My Homeroom Teacher Keeps Getting Way Too Close To Me…
summary: Asano Yuichi, an unremarkable high school student, enters his second year thinking his school life will continue to be aimless and without purpose. However, his encounter with his new homeroom teacher, Morihara Yui, brings a change to his life. Somehow, the teacher… keeps getting too close! During class, during breaks, and even after school!! His mind is on the verge of exploding every day because of her!? This contact comedy between a teacher and student starts now!!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: Who’s the Prey Now?
summary: My sister is dead. She committed su*cide for a man. When I was sorting through her belongings, I found a pair of handcuffs and some photographs. In the photos, she was completely naked, her body covered in bruises. A rush of blood surged through me, my whole body turned cold, and I was instantly overwhelmed by an indescribable terror and confusion. But I didn't know yet that the person who started all this had no intention of stopping. And I was his next target.

title: Bio-Crisis Dynasty
summary: I often wanted to cut open my chest to see what my heart looked like now, but I had no heart left... When the Bio-Crisis broke out, the world became a wasteland. This was the Doom for Humans, but it was... the dawn for the Undead.
genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Sci-fi, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: Spotted By Grindelwald And Went To Hogwarts
summary: A letter from Nurmengard School of Witchcraft and Wizardry came to his door. Grindelwald has been waiting for his arrival at the school he has built. But he has also received a letter from Hogwarts about his enrollment. Two different magic schools wanted him, one run by Gellert Grindelwald himself and the other run by Albus Dumbledore. This world of Harry Potter seems a bit different from what he knew because one thing is for sure, something's not quite right with this world. He has so many questions about it, and he'll try about to find out the things that have been altered from the actual timeline.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mystery, School Life, Supernatural

title: Comprehensive Martial Arts Great Ming: Intercept and Grow Stronger Starting from Joy of Life
summary: After crossing into a comprehensive martial arts world, I became Zhu Xiongying—the eldest grandson of the Hongwu Emperor in the high-martial Great Ming Dynasty. I soon discovered that this world was far more complex than I imagined. Not only did it include the Great Liang Kingdom from Nirvana in Fire, the Liyang Dynasty from Sword Snow Stride, the Great Qin Empire from Qin's Moon, and the Qing Kingdom and Northern Qi from Joy of Life—but it also housed major martial factions like Snow Moon City, the Invitation Palace, the Ancient Tomb Sect, the Buliangren, and the Tianxia Society! Even more terrifying, demonic beasts roamed freely across the lands. Fortunately, I awakened a system: As long as I intercepted opportunities involving key female characters, I could grow stronger! And so, Zhu Xiongying embarked on his path of interception. Li Hanyi, the Mistress of the Invitation Palace, Si Lili, the Princess of Northern Qi, the Little Dragon Girl, Jing Ni, Yan Lingji, Jiang Ni, the Fox Demon Princess, and more… "Of course, my answer is—take them all!" Feilu Novel Network Reminder: This novel and its characters are purely fictional. Any resemblance is coincidental. Do not imitate.

title: The Female Lead Doesn’t Need to be Too Normal [Silly]
summary: Jiang Yu accidentally knocked her head in an extremely awkward position. After waking up, she discovered that she was actually the female protagonist in an old-school melodramatic “dog-blood” novel—a character perpetually tormented in body and soul, serving as the stand-in for the tycoon male lead’s white moonlight. According to the original plot, she was the one who took all the bad luck, endured relentless torment, bore his child, and in the end, she was also the one who died together with the domineering CEO. But all of the CEO’s love belonged to the white moonlight. Even after Jiang Yu and the CEO died, the child was adopted by the white moonlight, who conveniently inherited the enormous family fortune as well! System Announcement: Complete the “torture-to-sweetness” KPI for generous rewards~ Jiang Yu: ??? I’m truly impressed by you! Yet the system failed to grasp the gravity of the situation until— *Jiang Yu, who had accepted the mission, was lying on the same bed as the domineering CEO. The CEO, who should have been subjected to extreme temptation: Why aren’t you moving? Jiang Yu: If the enemy doesn’t move, I won’t move either. System: ??? *Jiang Yu, who had accepted the mission, was supposed to perform a kabedon on the CEO. The CEO, suddenly slapped across the face: !!! Jiang Yu, who failed to find the right landing spot for her hand: This is my reward for you… a kabedon. System: ??? *After learning that she could use points to rewind the plot, and that rewinding one minute required one point— Jiang Yu caught the exact moment when the CEO slid to his knees: Rewind this one minute ten times for me. Ten minutes later, the CEO couldn’t stand up: …painful face.jpg Jiang Yu: Heh, what a cunning man~ … System: Where the hell is my sweet romance novel???

title: The Servant is Formerly the Strongest Assassin!?
Daigaku de Ichiban Kawaii Senpai wo Tasuketara Nomi Tomodachi ni Natta Hanashi ~ Yotta Senpai wa Ore o no “Suki” ga Tomaranai~
summary: “A Drunk Senpai Can’t Stop Confessing Her ‘Love’ for Me!” Tennouji-senpai, who’s usually cool and expressionless, just can’t seem to be honest without alcohol. Every night, she shows up at my place with a glass of highball in hand—getting close to me with a look she never shows anyone else…!? A slightly dangerous, drinking-themed romcom featuring a senpai who gets way too bold when she’s drunk!
