Ironically, the very weakness she considered her greatest flaw becomes the most valuable asset in this contractual marriage.“Now I’ve ended up living with a child who cries for his mother. My situation really has become pathetic.” “Please forgive my discourtesy. Some monsters can take human form and mimic us, so verification was necessary.”Caught between her cold husband and the dismissive servants—“What should I call you…? Your fur is reddish, so how about Berry?” “Grr-umph!” “Then Rose?” “GROOO-um!”Once a month—when her husband is away—she finds solace only in the bear she secretly meets.But then…“Why did you come to pick ribbon colors with me? That’s what I want to ask. Why wasn’t I called to such an important occasion?” “I am your… husband, after all.”…Her husband is acting strange? “As for the details of the curse…” “Obviously we have to keep silent.” Yuri’s lips twisted sharply. “How could we ever tell them? That a person turns into a bear.”

title: Embers Ad Infinitum
summary: In this latest work by Lord of the Mysteries author, Cuttlefish That Loves Diving, be prepared for a well-thought out and detailed apocalyptic, cyberpunk world with a setting superseding Lord of the Mysteries! Our protagonist, Shang Jianyao, is crazy—literally crazy, at least that's what the doctors said. Living in a huge, underground building of Pangu Biology, one of the few remaining factions in this apocalyptic wasteland known as the Ashlands, he acts in unfathomable ways that's head-scratching, comical, and shrewd. So is he really crazy? Probably. He has a grand dream: to save all of humanity. Intricately tied to this dream is something everyone in the Ashlands believes in: Deep in a particular ruin buried away by danger and famine, a path leading to a new world awaits. To step into the new world, one only needs to find a special key and open that certain door. There, the land is bountiful, as if milk and honey flows freely. The sunlight is dazzling, as if all coldness and darkness are washed away. The people will no longer have to face desolation, monsters, infections, mutations, and all kinds of dangers. There, children are joyous, adults are happy, everything is fine as they are supposed to be. Every Antiquarian, Ruin Hunter, and Historian roaming the Ashlands knows: That's the New World.
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: Above Pirate King
summary: Saints, Titans, Shinigamis, Ninjas… World Government, Marines, Shichibukai, Four Emperors… Everyone took turns coming on stage.. On top of the Red Line, the Celestial Dragons reign supreme. Under the Holy Land, a series of steam trains roared past, passing through the four seas…

title: The Insignificant Me Can Only Cultivate the Villainous Young Lady
Stockpiling Supplies on Campus After the Apocalypse
summary: A few hours before the Zombie Virus outbreak, I was trapped at school. I posted a message about stocking up for the epidemic in the class group, then rushed into the supermarket with my roommate. In the apocalypse, I dared not draw too much attention. Keeping a low profile is the true way to survive the end times.

title: Green Plums And Bamboo Horse
summary: Gu Qingwan was born into the head of the prestigious scholarly families. Her demeanor is cold and elegant, like a lonely orchid in a deserted valley, standing independent from the world. She has three wishes in life: To bring glory to her family clan. To obtain her freedom. To be with Xiao Heng. Xiao Heng, the unruly and profligate Heir Apparent of a Duke, is wild, rebellious, and notorious. He also has three wishes in life: To avenge his mother’s death. To seek liberty. To marry Gu Wanwan (his nickname for her). One day, the Emperor asked with a smile: “Little Seventh Miss of the Gu family, what kind of husband do you desire?” Gu Qingwan replied: “One who can bring peace to the state through civil arts, stabilize the country through martial might, possesses peerless beauty, and belongs to me alone.” Xiao Heng’s eyes brightened instantly. He crossed his arms and laughed softly: “Isn’t that exactly me?” On their wedding night, her voice was hoarse, her eyes seductive as silk, as she gritted her teeth and called out: “Brother Heng… have you heard enough?” He leaned down, his smile like a spring breeze: “My dear Wanwan…” “Then conquer the two cities of Yunshuo and Liangchuan for me as a betrothal gift, how about it?” With the spirit of youth and a night of deep infatuation, who would have thought she would push him all the way to the throne of the Son of Heaven (Emperor). A childhood cry of “Brother Heng” was exchanged for a lifetime of boundless indulgence.

title: The Sword Dynasty
summary: After annihilating Han, Zhao and Wei empires in succession, the dynasty of Qin is ushering in an unprecedented flourishing age with powerful cultivators emerging endlessly. People take pride in being part of the Qin dynasty. However, Ding Ning, a young lad of humble origin in Changling, Qin, is determined to subvert this dynasty and kill the emperor who breaks in the Eighth Realm.

title: The Duke’s Useless Son Returns
summary: He was the youngest son of a prestigious family, yet his life was a miserable one. And after losing everything, he regressed. "There would be no second regret." “Now I will change everything.”

title: Another World Homecoming Club ~This Time, I Will Surely Save the World Heroic Tale~
summary: High school student Rindou Asuha, who returned from another world to the modern world. Asuha, who retained the skills from the other world, encounters others who have also returned from reincarnation in another world—known as Returnees. A boy who rose to the top using his cheat skills gained from reincarnation, Akahara Tsumugi. A sorceress girl who reincarnated into the body of a princess and ruled a kingdom, Kamichika Riri. Invited by these two, Asuha joins the Another World Homecoming Club! While the two lived glorious lives in another world, what Asuha experienced there was... What awaited them, the Returning Home from Another World Club, was the encroaching presence of the other world into the modern era! The emergence of Returnees plotting to destroy society, the sudden appearance of monsters in the city, and the advancing influence of the other world. Heroic tales, adventure tales, tragic tales... The struggles of reincarnators with their pasts intersect on the stage of the modern world! This is the heroic tale of those burdened with despair, chasing their dreams once again in the modern world!!
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, School Life

title: Aiming For A Sustainable Life In A Different World That Is About To End
summary: One day, I was chosen by a goddess just like my company’s as*hole boss used to do. She sent me to a different world where failures have piled up and is about to end. Her power as a goddess has almost reduced to none so she couldn’t give me enough support. A good situation for such a modern office worker!? If you don’t give up, you can do anything. Let me show you how knowledge and a little (?) cheat ability can save the world.

title: When I Went Out for a Housekeeping Service, There Was a Two-Faced Beauty ~She’s Gradually Dropping Her Act and Won’t Leave Me Alone??~
summary: 「It's my time to leave, can I go home?」 「...Not yet. You're not allowed to go anywhere.」 Yamanaga Takumi, the eldest son of a housekeeping service company, was helping out with the family business as a part-time job. One day, a request came in, and it was for housekeeping at the home of Hoshino Michika, the class's healing-type beautiful girl. When he actually went to the house, the healing aura that Hoshino had before was nowhere to be seen, and she was just like any other cheeky high school girl. In other words, she's usually just putting on an act. At first, he worked while enduring her sharp tongue, but gradually her attitude began to soften... 「Hmm, so you prioritize other girls over me??」 「Hey, are you perhaps jealous?」 「I-I'm not jealous... idiot.」

title: Apocalyptic Disaster, I’m Crazy About Making Money and Stockpiling
summary: After struggling to survive for ten years in the apocalypse, she is reborn back to the time before the disaster strikes. Of course, she plans to stockpile like crazy… But where does the money come from? As an ordinary worker, she doesn’t have tens of billions casually lying in her bank account, nor does she inherit a huge fortune—just the wages she’s managed to save. Facing the coming extreme heat, extreme cold, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, years of acid rain, and mutated creatures… All kinds of natural disasters and man-made calamities, she must be fully prepared. No money? Then make money! Crazy amounts of it! Buy, buy, buy! Everything she can get her hands on! Food, drinks, daily necessities, clothes. She won’t stop until she has stockpiled enough supplies to last a lifetime! At the same time, she will settle scores, repay grievances—anyone who has bullied her will get double in return. In this second apocalypse, Jiang Nuo is determined to live richly, freely, and with absolute satisfaction!
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mature, Sci-fi, Supernatural

title: There Is No Ward 407
summary: At one o’clock in the morning, I received a sudden phone call from the Anning Rehabilitation Center-a facility that had been decommissioned for five years. They told me to come to Room 407 on the fourth floor to sign a death certificate. But the person who had been locked in that ward five years ago in my place was Qi Zhaoyuan, a man who should have died in a fire long ago. A list of rules was posted at the entrance of the old building. The very last one read: If someone calls you “Ningning,” do not look back immediately.

title: Danzai no Exceed
summary: Yamato Fujima found himself caught up in a serial mu*der case. On the brink of death, he was saved by the new transfer student from his school, Shizuma Shinonome, using magic. Yamato then awakened at her house, offering to assist her with the investigation, only to be rejected. However, he didn’t give up. Despite the rejection, he decided to follow her and was thus determined to stop the mu*ders being committed by a monster.
genres: Action, Adult, Drama, Ecchi, Mature, Supernatural, Tragedy

title: The War Horse of Cao Cao’s Army [Romance of the Three Kingdoms]
summary: Cao Cao said, "This child will become the war horse of our family." I have become a blood relative of the Cao Cao family during the Three Kingdoms era. So, I will shine to my heart's content.
genres: Action, Adult, Harem, Historical, Mature, Wuxia

title: Game Bosses Always Likes to Chat With Me
summary: Strange horror games, all kinds of survivors, and one of the horror game bosses who love to talk to people. One of the bosses: I should have summoned the courage to get rid of the single status Boss three: Do you think I will like you? No, I won’t (really fragrant)

title: Passionate Love with Teacher Zhou
summary: I had a flash marriage with a University Teacher. Half a month after getting married, I couldn't stand his indifference anymore and started to regret it. Bracing myself, I brought up divorce: "I think we're not suitable for each other..." But he pressed me down with a serious face, his voice hoarse: "How do you know we're not suitable if we haven't even tried?"

title: Married My Most Hated Man
The Three Realms Chronicle: My Triday Updates
summary: In a world where everyone mysteriously transports to the legendary Three Kingdoms realm, players start with nothing but a small territory. Their fate depends entirely on how they develop it. Qin Mu discovers he possesses a rare ability—every three days, he can refresh for an exclusive entry that grants him extraordinary powers. While others struggle with the basics of survival and kingdom-building, Qin Mu’s fortunes rapidly ascend. Short on resources? His [God of Lumberjack] entry transforms him into a deity who commands endless materials. Lacking good fortune? With [Auspicious Signs from Heaven] , the beautiful Su Daji descends from the skies, not only blessing Qin Mu with incredible luck but offering him the romantic pleasures once enjoyed by King Zhou of Shang. Need strength? The [Stay Away from Women] entry presents a challenging choice—resist feminine temptations and watch his power grow exponentially. While rival lords exhaust themselves developing basic infrastructure, Qin Mu has already mastered the art of effortless success. Others toil day and night; he simply leans against walls and watches his empire flourish. As determined players across the world painstakingly build their territories brick by brick, Qin Mu leads unstoppable armies that sweep across the realm. Foreign lords whisper in frustration: “How are the people of Daxia still finding ways to cheat even in this otherworld?” Beautiful female lords sigh dreamily: “Every day I just want to catch Lord Qin Mu’s attention and have him take me flying through the heavens!”

title: Impossible Lovers
summary: Zheng Baozhu and Qu Zhi grew up together, but they didn't become the enviable childhood sweethearts; instead, they grew up to be arch-enemies. Zheng Baozhu thought Qu Zhi was hypocritical, pretentious, and self-righteous. Qu Zhi thought Zheng Baozhu was vulgar, materialistic, and superficial. Everyone said they were the least likely to become a couple. Their mutual friend Cen Tongtong declared, "If they end up together, I'll eat all the keyboards in my house." Later, she threw away all 17 keyboards from her house overnight. One-sentence summary: What's it like to be in a relationship with your arch-enemy?
genres: Completed, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The Strongest Ability Through The Max Level Tutorial
summary: Max level tutorial... I passed through it.

title: A Beautiful Girl Confessed Her Love to Me as a Punishment Game, but After We Started Dating, She Started Getting More and More Obsessive
summary: “You lost, Kirino! Now you have to confess to the guy you most want to date in the class!” This was the punishment game given to the class’s number one beauty, Kiryu Kirino. In our class, there’s a perfect guy named Tetsu Fujisaki. He’s handsome, comes from a wealthy family, has excellent grades, and is the ace of the sports club. Both of them belong to the same group, and I, an introverted guy who usually reads light novels in the corner of the classroom, assumed this was just a push to get these two who were likely mutually interested to confess to each other. However, the person Kiryu-san confessed to wasn’t Fujisaki-kun—it was me, the introverted nobody. In front of everyone, I couldn’t bring myself to reject Kiryu-san and embarrass her, so I went along with it, thinking she’d break up with me at some convenient moment... "Um, don’t you think it’s about time we break up?" "Why would you say that? Don’t joke around about something like that." "But we only started dating because of the punishment game." "I like you. I’ll do whatever you want, so please don’t leave me." This is...getting really intense.

title: Water Ghost’s Nightmare
summary: It is said that those who drowned will, on a night of torrential rain, climb ashore, step by step. Soaked to the bone, their faces dark and sullen, they stand before your door. "Knock, knock, knock-" "Open the door, hurry, I'm back."

title: The Wielder of the Holy Sword
summary: Reynart, an illegitimate son of the King of the Istella Kingdom, was never meant to inherit the throne, nor was he permitted to be adopted by a noble house to take up their mantle. Yet, in the spring of his seventeenth year, having just completed his coming-of-age ceremony alongside his younger brother, Prince Alexander, Reynart received a command from his royal father: he was to succeed the House of Duke Lindenmars—a noble family drowning in debt. He was sent forth with the very sword he had claimed during his rite of passage. And so, the young seventeen-year-old Duke began his desperate struggle to climb out of a hellish pit of debt, accompanied by vassals who were champions from every division of the nationwide martial arts tournament. In time, he would learn that the blade in his possession was none other than the legendary “Sword of Evil-Breaking,” passed down from the ancient Great Kingdom of Ishtaria. Thus, he found himself drawn into a conflict between humanity and demons that would consume the entire continent…

title: Yue Chen Yin
summary: She is the reincarnation of the Sea Dragon's daughter, born with extraordinary wisdom and talent. Yet because she was born in troubled times, suffered tragedy and became an orphan. After ten years of grinding, she finally cultivated an exceptional set of martial arts. With XiaoHun sword in hand, she begins a journey to seek revenge, even disguising as a man to enter court. At first, revenge was her everything. Until she met those two equally exceptional men…

title: The Day Love Turned to Paper
summary: My brother is the devoted second male lead in a novel. At this very moment, consumed by unrequited love for the female lead, he has decided to end his life. I didn't try to talk him out of it. Instead, I lay on a hotel bed and faked a few hickeys on my neck. Then, using a third-person perspective, I snapped a photo of myself pretending to be asleep. Adopting the persona of a "Blondie," I sent the photo to my brother anonymously: "Your sister smells so good. I've decided to marry her. I might be a Blondie, but I'll make her happy. Can you stop being so overprotective?" "Also, your sister is so well-behaved. She's my treasure. I'm gonna love her for the rest of my life. I want to give her mwah-mwahs every day." My brother had a gun pressed to his head, ready to pull the trigger, when these two messages popped up. His vision went dark. He ground his teeth in fury. His left hand crushed his phone, while his right hand mangled the barrel of the gun. su*cide? Postponed. Some Blondie dared to seduce his sister? He was going on a killing spree!

title: The Girls Around Me All Like My Best Friend, It Was Supposed to Be That Way
summary: Nagatsuki Kouki’s best friend, Shimomura Taiyo, has been popular with girls since junior high school. Some girls approached Nagatsuki, but it was all just a means to get close to Shimomura Taiyo. Because Shimomura Taiyo was too popular, he kept getting into trouble, and the two of them chose high schools far away. However, for some reason, Kamiyama Fumika, from the same junior high school, was there as well. Furthermore, he saved two popular girls in his class, Mizusaki Yayoi and Satouchi Yoko, from being picked on, and they ended up spending their lunch break together. All three girls, Mizusaki Yayoi, Satouchi Yoko, and Kamiyama Fumika, were after Shimomura Taiyo, and it was supposed to be none of Nagatsuki Kouki’s business……
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: My Younger Sister Was the Best F*p Material the Reason Why the Composed Her Softens up During S*xy Time Only
summary: Say, Onii-chan—you’re really a hopeless siscon, huh. After being seen busting one out on eroge about younger sister by his actual younger sister, for some reason, she is taking care of it with her mouth. Despite being scorned for having dispositions of lusting for his own biological younger sister, the play is becoming extreme; from titty f*ck, to loli cosplay bl**job, and even unprotected cr**mpie! Is this younger sister really going to cure her older brother s*xual disposition!? *Alternate rewritten story exclusively for Bishoujo Bunko

title: He’s the Wildest
summary: At the No. 3 middle school, a strange little girl who seemed like a mute arrived, always wearing a hoodie and jeans one size too big, with her small face hidden tightly. Everyone thought she was frightfully ugly, but once she revealed her face, she turned out to be astonishingly beautiful. Soon, the little beauty became famous throughout the school, and the teenage boys couldn’t help but gossip: “Wow, is that the new girl, Su Miao Miao?” “She’s like a porcelain doll, with skin as white as snow!” The boys chatted excitedly, unaware that someone had noticed the lazy boy standing in the corner. “Yan, have you seen that little beauty?” Someone chuckled, “How could Brother Yan notice such a weirdo?” Shang Yan didn’t say anything, casually glanced over, and gave a disdainful snort. A few months later. In front of the whole class, Shang Yan blocked the startled girl in front of his desk. He lowered his head, a smirk playing on his lips— “You beg me once, and I’ll let you go.” “……” “Twice, and I’ll be yours from now on.”

title: Once Upon a Time, There Was a Mountain Seeking Immortals
summary: In a world where martial arts reign supreme and legends of immortals whisper through the mountains, Du Yu is an anomaly. The Head Disciple of the obscure Boundless Sect, he possesses no martial prowess, only a gentle heart, a mysterious past erased by amnesia, and a Master he secretly reveres as a goddess. Life on Mount Seeking Immortals is peaceful, filled with trivial tasks and the adoration of his spirited, sword-wielding Junior Sister, Gongsun Ruo. But when Du Yu descends the mountain to visit his estranged family in Lotus Seed Town, his tranquil existence begins to unravel. He encounters Li Qingya, a beautiful and melancholic rice shop owner seeking revenge on a fiancé who vanished eight years ago—a man she calls "Dummy." He meets his own sister, Du Yao, a girl with a ghostly aura and rumors of a fox demon clinging to her shadow. And as he delves deeper into the town's secrets, he finds himself entangled in a web of past loves, hidden identities, and a destiny far grander than he ever imagined. With a jealous Junior Sister, a mysterious Master, and a town full of eccentric characters, Du Yu must navigate the complexities of the human heart and perhaps, finally, uncover the truth about who he really is.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Mystery, Xuanhuan

title: I Kissed My Girlfriend’s Little Sister
summary: Hiromichi Sato has been dating Haruka for a month, and their relationship is quickly heading in a good direction. But one day Hiromichi’s parent announces they’re remarrying and he’ll be getting a new step-sister. When he meets her, he’s shocked to see that she looks exactly like Haruka. No worries, though — they’re totally different people. They’re just twins, each one living with a different parent since the divorce. Certainly nothing to worry about. It’s not like there can be any wacky misunderstandings brought about by living with your girlfriend’s identical twin, right…?
genres: Completed, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life, Tragedy

title: Skill [Fight]
summary: Ten years have passed since the discovery of dungeons in Japan. As magic stones, which are produced as drops from monsters, are put to practical use as a next-generation energy source, the profession of “adventurer” has also begun to attract attention, and the country has shifted its focus to the establishment of “Adventurer’s Guilds” and the development of elite adventurers through “Dungeon High Schools” and “Dungeon Universities”── ──This is irrelevant to our background. Our protagonist, Hino Masato, lost his parents at a young age and inherited a large fortune, becoming a free spirit after just graduating from high school. His hobby of “adventuring” began because “a beginner-friendly dungeon happened to appear nearby.” He spent his days diving into dungeons without questioning the initial skill “Fight,” which he gained upon entering the dungeon, which turned the battles into turn-based battles. While society sees him as a free spirit, at the end of April, on his 18th birthday, he received his official adventurer’s license and immediately headed to the entrance of the dungeon. There, he met his middle school classmate, Ban Maho, who was attending National Dungeon High School, for the first time in two years. They didn’t know yet that their reunion would be a major turning point in their lives.

title: One Sword to Immortality
summary: A story about an obese teenager who is hard working and honest with his feelings for a girl, however, he is bullied because of his stature. However, one day, under the night sky, he obtained a mysterious power that allowed him to phase through walls! And he discovered that his world might not be what it seems on the surface…
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, Xianxia

title: Are You the Devil in the Labyrinth?
summary: Was it all a dream? Something that dark and twisted? No. No it wasn't. But despite my doubts I carried on like how I did in the 'dream'. and now, now I'm back, and there's no way I'll go down like that again, ever.

title: Old Love
summary: On the third day of the cold war, I ordered ultra-thin 001s online and had them delivered to my boyfriend's house. After dressing up carefully, I knocked on his door: "Gu Yanqing, I think I have a package..." Before I could finish speaking, a cold laugh sounded above my head: "Is this fun? "Wasn't it you who slapped me and told me to get lost?" His slender arm blocked the doorway. He shouted toward the bedroom: "Baby, there's a beautiful woman trying to seduce me. Hurry and make her leave!"

title: Back to Ancient Times to Make Pen Pals
summary: Zhu Yuan transmigrated back to ancient times. Then, in this backward times without Internet, mobile phone and all kinds of entertainment, how did she spend her time? She made a pen pal – Yes! a pen pal. Zhu Yuan took out her little book, took out her brush, made a few stokes: Son of a b*tch, come out to chat! Xie Zheng, who was practising calligraphy in his study, slipped and ruined the whole calligraphy. One can find a glowing beauty in the book. The ancients did not deceive me! By: Xie Zheng many years later.

title: If I Don’t Get Married I’ll Die
summary: You and I, our lives depend on this marriage. “If you’re going to die anyway, hurry up and die. Hmm? Once you die, everyone will be happy.” They took my whole life and used even my death to fill their stomachs. Was it because of resentment? With an opportunity to take revenge, I came back from the dead. 'In this life, I won't die after being foolishly used.' I will offer this life I have gained again on the altar of revenge. That's why I decided to open the door to revenge by marrying the man they hated so much and save him and me. However, 'You resemble him.' Encountering him up close, he looks so much like an old friend of mine. Although he has a completely different taste. "Do you think my cannibalism is just a rumor?" Perhaps choosing this man was a mistake. "Marquis, are you going to eat me?"

title: The Rose is Wild; The Young Heir Willingly Takes the Bait.
summary: Shen Zhiyi, a certified “Villainess,” is chosen by a System and dropped into the world of a tragic angst novel. Endure ab*se to follow the plot? Sorry, she chooses to crash into everyone like a wrecking ball while she targets the yandere villain for “conquest” instead! System: [Host, you are terminally ill. Only the kidney of the Big Bad, Lu Junyue, can save you.] System: [Lu Junyue is an overt psycho and a closet yandere. Good luck with the mission.] Round One: The “Mad Dog” Lord Lu meets her for the first time. She says: “Be a good boy and listen, it’ll hurt less.” Round Two: She says: “Call me Master.” Lu Junyue grabs her by the throat: “Are you training a dog? Shen Zhiyi, I will kill you with my own hands!” Two months later: Lu Junyue takes her hand and places it around his own neck: “Baby… train me.” For the sake of that kidney, Shen Zhiyi hides her wicked nature and plays the “good girl,” step-by-step training the yandere CEO into the most obedient puppy. Overnight, the Villainess is pampered into the “Little Princess of the Capital!” System: [Host, whatever you do, DO NOT lie to a yandere villain! He will lock you in a gilded cage and give you that ‘forced gold-chain’ love!] Shen Zhiyi (looking at the solid gold chain on her ankle): “A bit too late for that…” Later, she discovers a System bug: Lu Junyue could hear her inner thoughts the entire time! — The one played like a dog was CEO Lu. The one left alone in an empty room, hugging his wife’s blanket and crying secretly, was also CEO Lu. The peak-power psychotic tycoon kneels for love; he is Shen Zhiyi’s subject. Lu Junyue: “There’s no such thing as ‘destiny’—I only got the girl because I fought, snatched, and obeyed orders.”

title: The Original Female Lead Ran Away
summary: I reincarnated in a R-19 reverse harem novel as a villain who attempts to kill the female protagonist but fails and dies. I want to break off my engagement with the fiancé who's supposed to kill me and live well, but the female lead, who successfully seduced one of the male leads, has returned to her original world. Leaving me with the remaining male lead candidates! "I hope you, as the new female lead, will overcome the adversities well. Fighting!" "Wait, just a moment. Wait! What am I supposed to do if you leave like this!" * * * "I swear I will not make a mistake with you again.” The crown prince said, regretting how he carelessly treated me. "If it’s a sin, I’m committing it at every moment." The commander of the holy knights declared, ready to break his vows. "It doesn't seem too bad. If enduring that hell means I get you." The mu*derous northern duke said, intending to repay his debt with his body. And then there's an unknown male lead with an identity shrouded in mystery. The four men started insisting that I choose one of them.

title: Moonhyo! Managing the World
summary: Jung Jungho, who graduated from Korea University with a degree in Oriental History and completed a doctoral program in Business Administration at Harvard. A man with nothing but a bright future ahead of him encounters a plane crash. When he opens his eyes… it’s the Joseon era? And not just anyone—he’s the Crown Prince? Jung Jungho becomes possessed by the body of the five-year-old Crown Prince Munhyo, who was supposed to have died. With a heart full of compassion for the people and a desire to cherish life, he begins to transform society, the economy, customs, and daily living. King Jeongjo’s reform has not ended. Crown Prince Munhyo, who overcame death, now leads Joseon—and the world!

title: My Beloved Mr. Mu
summary: Before their marriage, Mr. Mu was a cold, handsome, and wealthy big boss. A lot of young girls fell for him. But, he only had his eyes on his little assistant. He was cold and harsh toward her. The little assistant was pitiful. “Big boss, please be gentle.” The wicked big boss smiled wickedly, “Marry me and I’ll give you the kind of gentleness specially for you.”

title: Gourd Farm
summary: In the bustling urban center, Yang Feng couldn’t make ends meet washing dishes, so he reluctantly returned to his hometown. However, he never expected that he would discover a gourd on his way back that could grow top-quality crops. Starting with selling strawberries at a roadside stall, Yang Feng gradually made his way to the pinnacle of success. The fruits and vegetables he grew were all top-notch ingredients, sought after by five-star restaurants. “I want 500 pounds of tomatoes!” a group of guys in Mercedes-Benz cars shouted, waving wads of cash. “Why don’t you go steal them yourself!” another person yelled. “Who the hell stepped on my foot?!” They all surrounded Yang Feng’s vegetable garden, hoping to get their hands on his produce. Riding his cargo tricycle, Yang Feng arrived and said, “What are you all doing? Line up and take turns. Today, each person is limited to purchasing only 30 pounds of tomatoes.”

title: Genius Pitcher Hides 170KM/H
summary: Were you happy to succeed as a major leaguer? No, it was the wrong choice from the beginning.

title: Star Sea Lord
summary: Is the deep flowing star sea eternal and without end? Is the symphony of civilization, playing a song of glory or of tragedy? A tragic fallen star sounds the horn to the way of immortality! Fate’s hidden mysteries are in the art of sculpting life! Embrace the universe, children! Remember, the lord is with us!

title: After Returning from Hell, Being a Villain Is Too Easy
summary: Jae Choi was never aiming to be a hero. Born to immigrant parents chasing the American Dream, Jae spent his life on the fringes—bullied, sidelined, and underestimated. But he found solace in villains. Not the heroes who stood for justice, but the ones who clawed their way through life with rage, wit, and pain. He dreamed of becoming an actor who could embody them—Joker, Hannibal, Loki… figures more human than heroic. But Hollywood doesn’t want Asian villains. On the day Jae finally lands his first lead villain role, he's dropped—replaced without a second thought. Humiliated and broken, he drives the director to set, only to be blindsided by a fatal crash. Then he wakes up… in Hell. His sin? Admiring evil. There, he's punished by being forced to feel every shade of human darkness—suffering the memories and emotions of the damned. But unlike others, Jae doesn’t break. He studies. He adapts. And eventually, Hell spits him back out. Back to the moment before his death. Armed with the raw essence of humanity’s darkest urges—and zero illusions left—Jae returns to a world where he's still poor, still Asian, and still seen as “less.” But now? Now he knows exactly how to play the villain. And this time, no one is taking the role from him.

Just as he broke through to the Transformation level, his master had abruptly died, forcing him to inherit his senior sister, Liu Ruyan. Five years later, he had ventured into the capital with his beauty by his side. On the very first day he moved into Compound 95, Yan Bugui had come to his door to extort him, only to receive a swift slap in return. While Auntie Zhang from the quadrangle had been coveting the wild boar meat in his home, Lin Yan had been leading his Ming Jin squad to empty the ancient city. When Qin Huairu had tried to throw herself at him, the undersea palace had already been swept clean by Lin Yan, leaving not even a trace behind. As Yi Zhonghai had schemed to get his hands on Lin Yan’s grain ration booklet, even the millennia-old zombie in the imperial tomb had been tremblingly offering Lin Yan a cigarette. No one had known that the King of Hell who made the entire martial world tremble—Lin Yan—had once been nothing more than an honest, simple-minded young man who entered the city to earn money and support his family.

title: I Run a Gas Station in the Northwest
summary: The son inherited his father’s business. My parents have worked hard for a lifetime in the Northwest, and I will inherit it from today.

title: The Crazy Gun-Shooting Count

So, with his oldest friend and second-in-command, who shared his belief, he decided to return in time with Barros and start over. However, something seemed wrong with this timeline. Now is the beginning of the new adventure of the Death King Karnak.

title: Hell Beast
summary: Spiritual energy allows all things to strengthen and evolve. God seemed to have closed the door on humanity when humans discovered only they could not absorb spiritual energy. But while one door closed, a new window opened. Humans gained the ability to contract spiritual beasts! After hundreds of years of evolution, under desperate situations, mankind has established 20 shelters to resist monsters! In this era of beasts, only beasts symbolize honor, wealth, power… Qin Yu, whose abysmal F- talent does not allow him to contract beasts, decided to take a unique road, a road that only belongs to him! Lose humanity, lose a lot… Lose savagery, lose everything! “I have lost my humanity. As for savagery…” “I have too much!!!”

title: The Affairs of Expelling Demons and Capturing Ghosts with Second Martial Uncle
summary: My name is Tong Yi, an orphan raised by a slovenly old Taoist. When the old Taoist kicked me off the mountain to experience society, my Second Martial Uncle, who had fallen out with the old Taoist years ago, suddenly found me and said he wanted to help me build a career. I was young then, and I believed my Second Martial Uncle's nonsense and followed him. From then on, my life spiraled out of control, and the gears of fate began to quietly turn the moment I followed my Second Uncle. Or perhaps that's not right... I should say... the gears of fate began to turn when I was seven years old...
genres: Action, Drama, Mystery, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Eternal Reverence
summary: Pinnacle of martial, mountain shifting and sea filling, catching stars and seizing the moon, reverse the flow of time! Extremity of the sword, one sword to form the dao, one sword to reach the immortals, one sword to break the laws! The young Li Fuchen, chanced upon the Golden Talisman which allowed his spirit soul to constantly evolve. In this world where prodigies and experts were everywhere, he used the sword in his hand to ascend to the absolute pinnacle. The world will decay one day, but my reverence shall be eternal.

title: The Bitter Heroine of the Era Saw the Barrage of Comments
summary: Lu Qingyuan was blessed with bright eyes, white teeth, and a graceful, captivating figure. Not only that, but she was also highly capable in both household and outdoor tasks. Through an introduction by a relative, Lu Qingyuan went on a blind date with the son of the mayor of Heizhu Town. The two sat in a state-owned restaurant. Just as the slender yet handsome man across from her began introducing himself, Lu Qingyuan suddenly saw a strikingly red barrage of comments floating above his head. At the same time, a cute mechanical voice rang in her mind, informing her that she had been bound to a system. Through this system, she could trigger pop-up comments, learn about the plot, and once she gained enough followers, she could even receive gifts from them! 【Sigh, Xiao Qingyuan, run! He’s the source of all your misery!】 Lu Qingyuan’s heart wavered upon hearing this. 【Sisters, say what you will, but this male lead does have something going for him! Sure, he was a premature baby with a weak constitution, and… well, he’s small down there too. But in this era, he comes from a dual-income household, has a bit of talent, and is quite good-looking. No wonder our clueless heroine doesn’t realize he’s all looks and no use.】 Lu—Lu Qingyuan clenched her hands, both embarrassed and shocked. Small where exactly?! Was it what she thought it was?! 【What’s the point of good looks and talent if he can’t even fulfill basic marital duties? The heroine was married to him for five years and never got pregnant, giving her in-laws every excuse to torment her! They even forced her to adopt several children, all of whom turned out to be ungrateful brats!】 【Exactly! The male lead is just a useless pushover! He’s good for nothing except lying in bed while our heroine does all the hard labor. And yet, he still manages to stay well-fed and comfortable!】 【If the male lead wasn’t like this, would the heroine even be a tragic lead? His weakness is the reason she suffers so much…】 After reading the comments, Lu Qingyuan understood—she was the heroine of a melodramatic tragedy, and the man in front of her was the male lead. Whether the comments were true or not, Lu Qingyuan had no intention of taking this blind date any further. Not long after, Lu Qingyuan successfully matched with Shu Beiqiu, a skilled technician at the machinery factory. 【Tsk, tsk, tsk, this guy really got his wish granted!】 【Well, in his past life, he’d rather stay single than stop protecting the heroine. My ship has finally sailed!】 【This devoted second male lead is the real deal! Finally, our heroine can live a blessed life!】 Seeing Lu Qingyuan blushing as she looked at him, Shu Beiqiu’s ears also turned red. After their wedding, the newlyweds returned to visit her family, both looking radiant and healthy. It was then that Lu Qingyuan learned her cousin, Lu Yanyan, had gotten engaged—to her former blind date. People gossiped that Lu Qingyuan had no luck, missing out on such a great dual-income family. But only Lu Qingyuan knew the truth—there was a barrage of comments floating above Lu Yanyan’s head, calling her an idiot even after reincarnation for choosing such a worthless man. As it turned out, Lu Yanyan had been reborn. The first thing she did in this life was seduce the man who had once been her cousin’s husband. In her past life, Lu Qingyuan had lived in a grand townhouse in town, inherited her mother-in-law’s job, and eventually became the wealthiest businesswoman in the country! Lu Yanyan believed that it was all thanks to her cousin’s in-laws. So when she found out that Lu Qingyuan and her cousin-in-law hadn’t gotten together in this life, she knew this was her golden opportunity. But never in her wildest dreams did she expect that life after marriage would be pure suffering. When she wanted a divorce, everyone accused her of being ungrateful. No one understood her pain. Meanwhile, the very cousin people pitied—Lu Qingyuan—became one of the first students to return to college after the reinstatement of entrance exams. She later started her own factory, ventured into foreign trade, and, together with her husband, built their own business empire…
genres: Completed, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

Looking closely, it was clearly visible that the moon was suspended on a ship, drifting forward with the large ship, which was like a small mountain. He played the part of a refined gentleman to perfection. I, in turn, fulfilled my duties as a dignified mistress of the house. We both tacitly assumed our lives would continue this way forever. But then, my elder sister returned. She collapsed in front of my husband's sedan chair, clutching a token of their former love in her hand. My husband sent her to a medical clinic and left immediately, shaking out his sleeves in a cold display of indifference. He told me that the past was the past, and what was gone was gone. Yet my sister was determined to make amends. She pestered him, knelt before him in supplication, offered prayers for his well-being, embroidered handkerchiefs for him, and hand-copied rare books for him-all while ignoring the scandalous whispers that filled the city. On the day the three-year term expired, my husband suddenly asked me, "Are you truly content to let our lives pass by in such mediocrity?" I replied calmly, "I am not. That is why we are getting a divorce."
