She wore a wedding dress identical to mine and was smiling at him. Before I could even scream, he dropped to his knees. "My lady, I have brought her home as my bride."

title: The Wizard World
summary: Ye Song, who once lived in a technologically-advanced world, died and reincarnated into a noble teenager’s body in another world. A fantasy world filled with magic! A series of events filled with tragedy, action, etc. began to unfold one after the other when he fatefully encountered one of the most guarded secrets of this world, obtaining the legendary power of Wizards. Watch how he reaches unreachable heights as a powerful Wizard in this new world.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Mature, Tragedy

title: The Hall of a Thousand Schemes
summary: Throughout the dust of history, countless towering figures have risen and fallen. The protagonist once looked up at them — but vows that one day he will trample all those great figures beneath his feet. Armed not only with unmatched power, but with boundless wisdom. This is a story of a true avenger. Real revenge requires extraordinary willpower. For the sake of an ultimate dream, the protagonist Ning Ye resolutely casts everything aside to face an overwhelmingly daunting mountain standing before him. Everything begins on Hell difficulty.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Tragedy, Xianxia

title: Please Be More Serious
summary: Serious, workaholic man meets free-spirited girl. Qiu Zheng Qing is an elite manager at a well-known corporation whose life plan does not include dating but simply getting married because it is time. While meeting a former university classmate who fits his criteria for a life partner, he keeps on coming across a free-spirited rich, young miss and subsequently falls in love with someone who will turn his life upside down. Yin Ting (depressed): Whenever I pursue guys, I would always pinpoint the wrong target. That’s why I keep on failing. The next time I must definitely choose the right one before making my move. Qiu Zhen Qing (serious): Why is that you always fail, how do you say it when you are confessing, let me hear it. Be more serious, this is a solemn matter. Consider me your target, how would you make your confession, how would you say it? Yin Ting (sighing): That is, I like you a lot, let’s date. Qiu Zheng Qing (serious): Okay. Yin Ting (dumbstruck): Ah? Qiu Zheng Qing (serious): I said, I agree. Yin Ting (dumbstruck): …

title: I Was a Dropout Who Couldn’t Use Magic for 16 Years, but Then I Remembered My Past Life as a Scientist and Became OP in Another World
summary: Magic isn't fantasy—it's science! Ronnie F. Narazario, the eldest son of a count’s family, was a failure in a world where everyone could use magic as if it were the most natural thing. He couldn’t use any magic whatsoever. Ever since his younger brother, Johann, began to show signs of magical talent, Ronnie had been ignored daily by both his parents and the servants. Then one day, Ronnie slipped on the stairs and— When he woke up, he remembered his past life as a scientist. In a world where science had no place, Ronnie began researching on his own, convinced that magic could be explained through science. And through his studies, he realized something remarkable: his body had been storing up a monstrous amount of magical energy for the past 16 years. What will happen next—?

title: Inheriting Billions After Being Retrenched
summary: '…Did I see wrong? That Luo Qiao, the same Luo Qiao who was trying to throw herself at the top celebrity… is actually the daughter of the wealthy Luo family? Have I gone insane or is this world insane?' 'The pampered daughter of the Luo Corporation? Are you talking about the Luo Corporation, the same Luo Corporation with assets in the hundreds of billions? The boss actually has a daughter and it's Luo Qiao?' 'Exactly! So what if she's fair, rich and pretty? Even so, have you forgotten that she tried to seduce a top celebrity? In the end, she's still a fair, rich and pretty girl who is cheap as hell! That's shameless, shameless, shameless, shameless!' Luo Qiao has been in the entertainment circle for only a year before she shot to fame. About three months ago, there was a sudden exposé of her entering the room of a top celebrity and not leaving till the early hours of the morning. It spells the end of her career as a rising female star. Following this, she falls into a depression, until... "I've decided," Luo Qiao purses her lips and says with much difficulty, "To return and inherit the family fortune.”

title: When the Regressed Dirty Spoon Becomes a Golden Spoon
summary: You need to become an [Influencer]. Are you ready to start? Envious of the glamorous lives of influencers, I started my own YouTube channel. But the reality is… 513 subscribers. I lived the life of an unemployed icon until one day I fell into the Han River and woke up to find myself… [Skill: Quick Shot of Life (D)] [Skill: (Not) Sorry (B)] I thought it was the [You Need to Be an Influencer] skill. *** Three years after moving to Apgujeong due to her father’s business success, she was living a life of luxury. The sudden failure of his business left us penniless. Suddenly, the past returns and a strange status window appears in front of her. Luxury bags, department store VIP lounges, exotic cars, fine dining. YouTuber, influencer, and fellow alumna Ha Jein has it all. [Reveal the dressing room, ranging from plain luxury bags to limited editions] 20:38 [ENG/DM Mom’s Favorite Diamond Accessories] 15:46 -You have the best face. Just take a picture of your face and show it to me for an hour, please~ – Born with a view of the Han River, a golden spoon, and harmonious parents… I wonder what it’s like to live like that. I used to secretly look at Instagram every time with a mixture of superiority and envy. Now, bye-bye… Now I’ll do it too. The Golden Spoon Influencer. *** “But why are you being so nice to me?” ” Well, because I wanted to~” He smiles, then slowly walks over to her and gives her a shoulder to lean on. “Because you asked me to… so I’ll do anything.” “That’s okay, let’s start with something easier.” And the man who said he wanted to be by my side for a long time. Will I do well in high school again?

title: Primordial Beginning
summary: A single tree gives birth to ten thousand blossoms; under heaven, all Daoist sects are but one family. Though spells may change in a thousand ways, the human heart has remained unchanged since ancient times.
genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Supernatural, Xianxia

title: Dropping Disguises One After Another Young Miss Don’t Be So Domineering
summary: After the real heiress returned, everyone thought Shi Sheng would fall from the clouds and be crushed into the mud. Instead, when her adoptive father forced her into a business marriage, she sneered, “Why not let your wife marry him? The seniority fits better!” When her adoptive mother scolded her for having no manners, she curled her red lips and replied, “Of course I learned from you.” The white-lotus real heiress tried to make her embarrass herself, but Shi Sheng slapped her backhandedly. “Stop acting. Go back to wherever you came from!” — At their first meeting, Shen Luli glanced at Shi Sheng and coldly uttered two words: “Vase.” Only after their contract marriage did he realize his wife was anything but simple. She was a world-renowned master of calligraphy and painting, a mysterious jewelry designer, a comic novelist with countless fans… and even the underground organization leader he had hated with a passion. The wildly popular superstar turned out to be her cousin? And her grandmother, grandfather, and uncle were all hidden powerhouses as well… Later, when Shi Sheng was ready to leave in style, the noble and reserved man pinned her against the door, his eyes bloodshot. “Divorce? Over my dead body.” Shi Sheng smiled lightly. “President Shen fell for a vase?” He kissed her, nearly out of control. “Yes. Madly in love.” 【Extra Scene】 Reporter: “Mrs. Shen, we heard the male lead in your latest comic was modeled after President Shen?” Shi Sheng’s face remained expressionless, but the camera clearly caught the tips of her ears turning red. “Just a misunderstanding.” That night, Shen Luli posted the original comic draft on Weibo: “My wife’s drawing is pretty good though the bed scenes were a bit too conservative.”

title: Kaguya – Tsuki no Usagi no Gin no Hakobune
summary: The one who had the useless ability to “let others see what he was seeing,” was Sanada Souta. Living on while keeping this ability a secret, one day Souta encountered a strange girl in front of his apartment complex. She was bare and wrapped in a sheet, and it also seemed she couldn’t see…The strange girl, Tachibana Hinata began living with Souta, and it seemed she had a special power as well…It’s the birth of a wonderous Heroine and Love Story.

title: Time and Age
summary: Save the sentient beings or save yourself, this is a question? Suihe’s opinion is that if she can save others, she should do it! She doesn’t want to die (T＿T) Suihe’s reputation in the six realms is not very good. Everyone says that she is an iron-faced bodhisattva who will take revenge for the slightest thing. The girl who is almost eight thousand years old is still the Lord of Gods, but she can’t even be called a relative. Susheng’s reputation in the six realms is not very good either. His origins and life experience are unknown, but he can become the Lord of Demons at the age of five thousand. No one in the six realms wants to provoke him. Until one day, the two of them got together and got married.

title: Finally Retired From the Hunter Association
summary: This is so sweet.

title: Modern Dungeon with Vampires
summary: A few decades have passed since dungeons, transported from another world, appeared in modern society. The protagonist, who lost his family in a man-made disaster during the early days of dungeons, became distrustful of people and led a gloomy life as a solo explorer. His only source of comfort was a pendant his family had given him, embedded with a magic stone from the dungeon. However, on his way home from work, the pendant was targeted by a robber, and after being beaten up, the protagonist found himself in the labyrinth, facing life and death…

title: Time Travel: Princess, You Are So Sweet
summary: It isn't difficult to face a situation like a sudden-pass-to-another-world because it has been a stereotype start for a fantastic journey. But waking up as the top girl at a brothel and finding herself trapped in the body of the General's daughter in another world is freaking unacceptable! Let alone there is an engagement with a playboy prince granted by the emperor waiting for her. What is it? A revenge? Or... Let's see how two haters fall for each other? "I like you it's my business," said the prince.

title: The Betrothed of House Minazuki
summary: First-year high school student Rikka Minazuki loses her will to live after she hears the dying words of her beloved father. However, on her sixteenth birthday, a young man who calls himself the Head of the main family appears and tells her that he has come to welcome his “betrothed” Rikka. “Although I am bound to this marriage by ties of blood, I believe that it is possible to find love.” In his words, Rikka finds a faint hope – House Minazuki: the descendants of a celestial maiden. Bearing the fate of a special clan on their shoulders, the two begin a true romance.

title: The Days of Being Favored by The E-Sports Team
summary: Before the age of five, Yu Lufan lived in another world, able to converse with the “people” within, becoming their “Ge¹”. Waking up, she was confronted by unfamiliar streets, buildings, and crowds… Little brat: “I can only rely on a few underlings to barely make ends meet.” * In the MOS Professional League, there’s a famous “withered just-pretty-faces” team called RTG. So broke that the players have to juggle multiple roles just to cover expenses, and their performance is so bad that fans are ready to curse them. In the first game of the Spring Relegation Tournament, before RTG had even had a chance to warm up the bench, they were defeated and packed up. Just as they reached the stadium entrance, they encountered a strange little girl. The girl stopped them and said in a soft, lazy voice, “From today on, you’re all under my protection!” Team members: “???” Little girl: “Be good, call me Ge!” Team members: “Holy crap! Are you trying to scam us?”
genres: Comedy, Drama, Slice of Life, Xuanhuan

title: After Rebirth, President Bo Tears Up the Scumbag Script and Kneels to Win Back His Wife
summary: [Yandere + Sweet Doting] Bo Jinye, who was deceived by his best friend and his unrequited love in his past life, is reborn. After his rebirth, the first thing he does is apologize to his precious, delicate wife, whom he had misunderstood for six years! "Baby, I was wrong." But An Sheng, who once loved him deeply, throws out the divorce papers. "I'm tired. Let's get a divorce." Bo Jinye panics and decides to play dumb to begin his journey of winning back his wife! "Sheng Sheng, I'm hungry. Feed me." "Sheng Sheng, time for sleep." "Sheng Sheng, kiss me~" As Bo Jinye continues his act, he discovers that the way his precious wife looks at him is becoming increasingly strange. Finally, one day, his bigshot, delicate wife, who has many aliases, pins him down for a kiss. "Master Bo, it must have been hard pretending to be a fool."

title: I’ve Become The God Of The Subculture World
summary: The masterpiece manga I read doesn't exist in this world. Not knowing this manga is a loss in life — so, I'll draw it myself for you.

title: [Horror Crossover] Wholeheartedly Towards Goodness
summary: This is a story about a "bad guy turning over a new leaf" who gets tricked so badly by a ghost that he ends up completely off track. Early on, he’s farming in the ghost world and being hunted in the real world; later, he’s fighting monsters in the ghost world and also battling them in real life.

title: The Woman Who Raised Me
summary: My parents divorced, and neither of them wanted me. My grandmother raised me all by herself. When I got accepted into a top university, my parents suddenly started fighting over me again. They didn't know that when my grandmother passed away, all she had was fifty yuan, pieced together from a handful of small change. She told me to buy more meat to eat. She died alone in the old house, with no one to care for her in her final years.

title: God-level Store Manager
summary: In Tianlan Continent, there is a magic store called Origin Mall. The Coke here can make people full of vitality in an instant; the spicy bars here can make people fight one another; the games here can make people improve their cultivation; the novels here can make people understand profound techniques. Here there are infinite goods to choose from, including leisure, entertainment, dining, and training. Oh, by the way, remember one thing. Don’t cause trouble in the store, because the owner is very strong.
genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Immortals vs. Grim Reapers
summary: In a world decimated by a zombie plague, Colonel Ju Gangrim learns the truth from the King of the Underworld. The heroes who have survived thus far were actually immortals fleeing from death, and they were the root cause of the catastrophe. "I'll kill them all. Not a single one will be left alive!" Immortals versus Grim Reapers. To slay those who cannot die, he has returned as a Grim Reaper! Keywords: #Zombies #Chaos #Apocalypse #Growth #Swordsman #DemonSwordsman
genres: Action, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Mystery, Supernatural

title: Reaching for the Capital’s Branches
summary: [High-ranking official + Secret Marriage + Mutual Love + Happy Ending] Meng Chu, the youngest Governor of Cloud Province, appears dignified, handsome, and reserved to the public, with a future full of promise. Only Tao Wanxing knows how wild he truly is in private. On the day of their reunion, Tao Wanxing initiated a night of passion, only to find herself blocked at the door by a marriage certificate when she tried to leave. He ignored all protests, forcing her into a secret marriage—cold and distant in public, yet possessive and domineering behind closed doors. When a colleague sent her intimate photos of him with his childhood sweetheart, she thought she could walk away cleanly, presenting divorce papers without a trace. But he pinned her against the door with reddened eyes, growling, "Not pregnant? Then we’ll keep trying." "Tao Wanxing, you want a divorce? Don’t even think about it!" "I, Meng Chu, only become a widower—never a divorcee!"

title: You Think It’s Fine to Just Summon Me to Another World? Huh?
summary: I, Kaya Minafuchi, a Japanese high school girl, was summoned to another world by its god, in order to protect it. Their god had summoned me to defend this world, and to the people that summoned me, my reply was of course: “I don’t care about that. It’s your world, so do something about it yourselves.”
genres: Completed, Adventure, Fantasy, Mature, Psychological, Tragedy

title: I Became the Beloved Father of the Princess
summary: The emperor who asked me to take care of his daughter for a while… died. … Just like that, I became a dad.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Slice of Life

title: I’m Incompetent and a Failure, and My Childhood Friend, Who Is a Beautiful Kyoto Dialect Vice President Idol on the Outside but in Reality Is a Menhera Yandere, Is Dependent on Me, but Please, Leave Me Alone!
summary: My name is Tadano Akiru. I’m just your average high school student. I’m not very smart, I’m not very good at my thing, and I have a bad memory, but that’s all there is to it. However, I regret to say that I have a childhood friend of the opposite gender. Of course, she is not just a childhood friend, but a beautiful girl who everyone will look back on. A beautiful girl who would certainly be a heroine if this world were a story of some kind. Her name is Kosaka Akemi. I have known Kosaka Akemi since kindergarten, and unlike me, she is extremely talented. She is so talented that she was scouted for vice president by the charismatic student council president at this school. She is a beautiful girl with her outstanding appearance, academic ability and leadership skills that allow her to join the student council already in her first year. She is a different creature from me, living in a world too different from mine. She is a special existence that I would normally never have anything to do with. There was no way I could get along with such a distant existence just because we were childhood friends, and we hadn’t exchanged a word for more than a year now. And yet… “Well..! The cleaning is over, let’s go home!” “Eh? go home….Where?” “Eh? Of course! To your room, right Aki-kun?” Why are you getting involved with me after all this time?
genres: Completed, Psychological, Romance, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Countess Lady’s Pet Dragon
summary: When I opened my eyes, I was reincarnated as a dragon. As the pet dragon of the count’s daughter. However, the dragons of this world are a little different from the dragons I knew.

title: The Rich Family’s Sister-in-Law
summary: Six years after our marriage, Fu Jingchuan grew tired of me and wanted to separate for a while to recapture the feeling of first love. He went after my junior from university, and I went after his friend. After saying goodnight to each other on the phone, we ran into each other at the hotel. "I was just dropping my junior off at her hotel. She drank too much-I couldn't just leave her alone." Just as I was struggling to find an excuse, I pointed to his friend beside me: "He's drunk too. After all, he's your buddy. I couldn't just leave him on the street." The air froze for a moment before his friend broke the silence: "Why don't the four of us split a room? We might even get a discount." Fu Jingchuan's face turned green with anger. Three months later, he broke things off with the junior and said he wanted to come back to the family and have a child with me. But it was his friend who answered the phone: "He can't break things off here-she just got pregnant a few hours ago."

title: Daomu Biji: The Mystic Nine
summary: During the Republic Era, the town of Changsha was guarded by nine families known as the “Old Nine Gates” (or the “Mystic Nine”). They were incredibly powerful families who wielded supreme power over everything in Changsha. In 1933, a mysterious train pulled into Changsha station. The leader of the Nine Gates, Zhang Qishan, was also the army commander of Changsha station and started to investigate with Qi Tiezui. They discovered a highly suspicious mine just outside of Changsha.
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Supernatural

title: Hidden Desire
summary: A year after losing Justin, Flora secretly works in a nightclub, pretending to be a tutor to appease her mother. Her world is shaken when she discovers Justin is alive. As they reconnect, Flora grapples with revealing her double life and her tumultuous relationship with a possessive CEO. In this gripping tale, Flora navigates love, loss, and the consequences of her darkest secrets.

title: When I Started a Food Delivery Part-Time Job, I Ended up Being Invited to the Home of a Gloomy, Clumsy Beautiful Girl
summary: The Food Delivery Destination Was the House of a Gluttonous, Clumsy, Gloomy Silver-Haired Beautiful Girl!? Yuki Aizawa, a first-year high school student, started a food delivery part-time job “Uber Meats” to earn tuition and living expenses. One day, the delivery destination he visited was, unbelievably, the house of Hiyori Yukishiro, the most beautiful girl in the grade who also worked as a magazine model. The secret of Hiyori that he learned by visiting. The true face of Hiyori, who looked perfect at school, was that she was a clumsy girl hopeless at cooking and housework, and on top of that, she was a big eater!? From this day onward, through the nomination system of food delivery, Hiyori started nominating Yuki many times. At first Yuki was confused, but as he repeated the deliveries, the two gradually came to understand each other. The time alone together in the room, the seasonal events, and the small invitations…… Through daily happenings, the clumsy gloomy beautiful girl in loneliness and the boy who left home drew a little closer in their awkward and bittersweet distance——.

title: There’s Fraud in the Cultivation World–Who’s Going to Stop It
summary: A newly inducted disciple rushed in, panicked. “Sect Master, this is bad! Eldest Senior Brother is robbing people!” “Why are you making a fuss? Your Eldest Senior Brother is securing benefits for the sect.” “Eldest Senior Brother is kidnapping people for ransom!” “I already told you, he’s securing benefits for the sect.” “But… Eldest Senior Brother has fallen to demonic cultivation! Shouldn’t someone stop him?” “Congratulations. His cultivation has finally improved.” “But… Eldest Senior Brother has even killed someone!” “Then what are you standing around for? Go help him! Disciples of the sect, grab your weapons!”
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: Rebirth Before the Return of Spiritual Energy, Investing in the Future Empress!
summary: Before the return of spiritual energy and the awakening of all races, Ye Xuan died on the battlefield and unexpectedly returned to twenty years ago. At this moment, before the returned of spiritual energy, the future lofty Red Lotus Empress was still just a simple and helpless little girl. Ye Xuan seized the opportunity, deceiving the yet-to-awaken school beauty and deskmate Empress to become his wife, holding her in the palm of his hand, spoiling her to the skies! A month later, when the spiritual energy returned, the school beauty awakened an SSS-class talent, skyrocketing to fame! Passerby: You have SSS-grade talent, Ye Xuan is not worthy of you! Red Lotus Empress: Get lost! Ye Xuan is my man, whoever touches him dies!
genres: Completed, Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Mature, Romance, School Life, Sci-fi, Slice of Life

title: Fei Ke’s Banquet
summary: The Chinese Version of Agatha Christie’s And Then There Were None: The best Suspense comes from reality, hidden in the human heart. Luo Jia’s latest urban Suspense Masterpiece. Lies and truths are intricately woven into a meticulous web. A banquet where “no one survives”—this is a “the Talented Mr. Ripley”-style story. Faced with desire, human nature is laid bare. A mysterious banquet invitation brings six strangers, who seemingly have no connection, together in a lakeside villa. Yet, the host of the dinner party never appears. As the plot unfolds, memories and reality intertwine, gradually revealing hidden connections between them. It turns out they all share one thing in common: they have been deceived by the host. A series of stories, filled with desire and betrayal, temptation and melancholy, sketches out the bittersweet life of a man. However, even the kindest person harbours a sliver of selfishness, and even the most evil may have fleeting moments of goodness. The truth, perhaps, lies in the stories that remain untold. This novel has been adapted into a drama called Regeneration (2024), starring Jin Bo Ran.

title: Create a BUG Every Ten Hours
summary: I missed the game helmet and dropped a golden finger! Su Bai has an extra progress bar that no one can see, and he can create a bug every 10 hours! For the first BUG, ​​Su Bai entered the game more than ten hours ahead of the global players! After all the players enter the game, Su Bai has reached the upper limit of the Novice Village level and is still fully equipped! Just in time, the time is up, and we can create BUG again! This time, Su Baika entered the village chief’s house. Because there was something in it that made Su Bai very concerned. Emmmmm… Su Bai never expected that when this card entered, he was actually given by a goddess…
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Martial Arts, Sci-fi

title: The God of Cooking Has Arrived
summary: Jang Hyun-gyu was living an ordinary and boring life. One day, a god appeared before him. Connecting to the “God of Cooking” system! A god? Sure… but the God of Cooking? “This taste… what on earth did you do?!” My cooking is just too delicious. My skills are improving day by day. Cooking… is starting to become fun.

title: The Serpent’s Bride
summary: At the palace banquet, I was bestowed the title of Princess. I was to be sent to Western Shu for a political marriage. My future husband is the King of Western Shu, and his people possess human bodies with a snake tail.

title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
summary: Long ago, the Gurongi Tribe terrorized the Linto until a warrior named Kuuga appeared and defeated the Gurongi, sealing their leader within a cave. In present day, a multi-talented man named Yusuke Godai finds himself linked to the mysterious stoned belt that was found within the excavated cave as the Gurongi are resurrected and resume their mu*derous game on the descendants of the Linto, humanity itself. It is up to Yusuke, along with the assembled Science Police, to use the various powers of Kuuga in order to stop and defeat the Gurongi Tribesmen from their continuous killing and ensure the happiness of others. However, as the endgame draws near, Yusuke learns that there is a horrible revelation behind Kuuga and the Gurongis' leader.

title: I Broke Up with My Girlfriend — Don’t Look Down on Me Just Because I’m Poor
summary: [Spiritual Energy Revival + Level-Up + Multiverse Travel + Single Female Lead, No Harem] In a world where spiritual energy has revived, Su Mo, who swore never to live off his monstrous girlfriend again, has just broken up. Then… [Ding! you stepped on an ant and leveled up.] [Ding! you swung your sword ten thousand times and leveled up.] [Ding! you received guidance from a master and leveled up.] …Leveling up is fine, but why does it come with reincarnation travel? And in every reincarnation world, I need to win over the Empress to return? What? That Empress is actually my girlfriend? And why does the Empress in every reincarnation world look exactly like my girlfriend? It turns out that no matter which world, an extraordinary monster like her…
genres: Action, Adult, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Martial Arts, Mature, Mecha, Romance, Xuanhuan

title: Outside of Gwang-eumji
summary: A world devastated by the breath of the divine, the foreign substance. When the foreign substance reaches a certain level, people die. Heo Chan survives this devastated world, relying on an iron skewer. A devastated world, a devastated heart, a devastated future. One day, as he struggles through this miserable existence, Heo Chan discovers an amethyst. The amethyst possesses the power to absorb the foreign substance, and with this power, Heo Chan not only prolongs his life but also gains a foothold to become even stronger. Meanwhile, "janitors" appear before Heo Chan. The leader of the janitors invites Heo Chan to follow him. Where will Heo Chan's fate lead? Original title: 光阴之外 Author: Lee Geun Translator: Han Tae-jeong

title: Seducing Him
summary: “Lu Jin is like a dirty, unshakable dog that only knows how to go crazy.” This is the sentence Ci Yiyang has said the most. Shortly after her mother’s funeral, her father brought home a woman—and a beautiful, aloof boy—and said to her: “This is Lu Jin. He will be your… younger brother.” Ci Yiyang didn’t call out. She only stared coldly and viciously at Lu Jin. But Lu Jin smiled at her, his tone calm yet corrupt, carrying a faint lingering affection: “Sis, my name is Lu Jin. Your… younger brother in the future.” Later, she realized that “in the future” meant the real future. The two people she most despises are the ones trying to enter her life. She cannot bear another woman occupying everything that belonged to her mother. So she decides to seduce Lu Jin.

title: Shaping Tomorrow’s Light
summary: After my mother died, my father brought home an illegitimate daughter. She greeted us with a facade of sweetness, yet in her hand, she carried the very mangoes that had triggered my mother's fatal allergy. I caught my younger brother's eye behind me. Shedding his usual cynical smirk, he signaled back: I don't need you to tell me.

title: Song Tan’s Chronicle
summary: After returning from the cultivation world, I went back to my hometown to farm, live-stream, and sell vegetables! Having failed to transcend tribulation and attain the Golden Core, Song Tan returned to the modern world only to find herself at the scene of a multiple car accident. Saved by a kind stranger, she narrowly escaped death. What more was there to consider? She decided not to be a corporate s*ave and went back home to farm instead! Utilizing her cultivation experience, Song Tan created an idyllic pastoral landscape—harvesting wild vegetables, cooking country meals, picking cucumbers, live streaming, and selling rare mountain delicacies... [True farming, the real deal] [There's a male lead, but his role is limited]
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Master of Gods, Origin of All, Lord of Realms: The Primordial Snake
summary: Once, at the edge of the world, someone gazed upon me with reverence and called me the World-Encircling Snake—Jörmungandr. Once, at the end of the Underworld, my silhouette was seen, and I was named the Ancient Snake—Satan. The gods themselves once trembled before me, giving me the title of the Hundred-Headed Dragon—Typhon. I have borne many names: the Snake of Creation, the Snake of Sacrifice, the Snake of Rituals, the Serpent of Mortals... But when I crossed the chaos and stepped into the boundless wilderness, I had only one divine name—the Primordial Ancient Snake, the Origin of All Things.

title: Three Lines of Love Letter
summary: After her first film was released, Jiang Qitang became famous and won the Best New Artist award in four major Film Awards. A period of glory where she was known as “The Violet Star of the Entertainment Industry.” But after a year, the industry no longer saw her figure. There were a lot of opinions and discussions but the people concerned did not respond. The chaos in the entertainment industry gradually became more fascinating and just as people were accepting the fact that Jiang Qitang had retired, on the first day of the New Year, a new movie was released, breaking various box office records in one swoop, and it was in the limelight for a while. Fans jokingly said: “Well, your Violet star is back.” In June of the same year, someone uploaded a photo of lovers kissing in the shade of a tree in the background of Jianning City, the address of the new movie shooting. The eagle-eyed netizens found that this is not Jiang Qitang and Jiang Huai Zhou! Jiang Huaizhou, a top-tier actor who became famous at a young age, aloof and remote, and uncompromising, completed a grand slam two years after his debut, becoming the youngest actor with countless fans. After the relationship was exposed, the social platform completely collapsed. Later, during a live interview, the media finally had the opportunity to ask about the relationship. After the media said the name Jiang Qitang, the corners of Jiang Huai Zhou’s mouth gradually rose and his cold eyes were tinged with tenderness. During a live broadcast, Jiang Qitang’s Weibo account was exposed, and the people who ate melons looked for the code ID, and they were stunned for a while. -I’ve been crushing on the sugar for so long, only to find out they were my own sugar! -The CP fans are crying, my CP was so real! -It turns out the blogger is Jiang Qitang! sob sob sob, so every sugar I’ve crushed on was actually mine sob sob sob now that the love affair has been exposed, I’m no longer a CP fan but now I am sobbing uncontrollably because of my obsession!” – Double Violet Star CP, perfect match!
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Transmigrated into the ’70s as a Delicate Beauty
summary: This is a romance novel, not a strong-female-lead story! It’s sweet and pampering! Please read the tags carefully before entering! If you want a strong female lead, leave quickly! (No matter the original host or the female lead, they are the same person!!!) Wen Qinghe, who held an enormous fortune in her hands, got drunk after a breakup and woke up to find herself transmigrated into the 1970s. She became a pitiful little thing with cong**ital heart disease, forced to go to the countryside. Just when she lamented that she still had so much money left unspent, sighing over her ill-fated destiny, she discovered that on the fifteenth of every month, she could return? Well then, that’s perfect! She had space, and once a month she could go on a grand shopping spree. Others were afraid of her sickness and unwilling to share a room with her? But unexpectedly, that was exactly what she wanted. When others bent their backs over the fields facing the yellow earth, she stayed at the educated youth spot to rest because of her frailty. Milk tea to her heart’s content, fried chicken in abundance, movies to pass the time… It was just that this weak little body of hers wasn’t very reliable… … The rough man in the village set his eyes on the newly arrived sickly little educated youth. Can’t do farm work? He’ll do it. Too frail? Then he’ll play the role of a snail prince, taking care of all the housework. But it was precisely this weak little body that kept the man worried day and night, his eyes reddened with concern. Such a dazzling pearl should not bloom only briefly, fading into obscurity in this world. He spent great sums of money and effort searching for famous doctors for the little girl. Yet before he realized it, her illness had somehow healed on its own. The man’s gaze turned deep, “Qingqing, you ought to let me be satisfied…”

title: The Silly Heroine Transmigrates into a Tragic Novel
summary: I had just transmigrated into a tragic romance novel, and I was currently in the middle of asking the Tyrant CEO for a loan. He had his arm around his White Moonlight, his expression cold and indifferent. "For every piece of clothing you take off, I'll give you ten thousand." Excited, I whipped off both my socks and tossed them at him. "Then let's start with twenty thousand!"

title: Xianxia’s Working Emperor
summary: In the Xianxia world, growing a field, making an opening in a mountain, creating a city, establishing a country, all are different. Who? XX Emperor invited me to be his Chamberlain, don’t have time, My numerous types of spirit plants will fetch a costly price. What? A Celestial Goddess invited me to manage her garden, is she beautiful? Possible to negotiate! Shopkeeper, this money I’ll give a split, You can have one portion while I’ll take the other nine, not satisfied? Alright then I will find someone else, go handle it yourself. All these cultivators, too vexing, want me to manage this and that, I, your father am really busy! Believe it or not I will definitely fire you guys.

title: The Outcome of Giving Up on My Elusive, Teasing, Tomboyish Older Childhood Friend
summary: Distancing Myself from a Flirtatious Childhood Friend Yuri Nishino had feelings for Akari Satake, his childhood friend who was a year older. He had even confessed to her. However, nothing had progressed. It had been a year since he confessed his feelings to her, a boyish girl who referred to herself as ‘boku’. Yet she had never given him a reply. After a certain incident, his feelings for her began to fade, and he tried to distance himself from her… but…

title: Senior Brother, Yes You Are Right!
summary: "Senior brother, brooms can't fly!" "I'm thinking that adding some magic should do the trick." "Senior brother, what's the configuration for mixing uranium ore with herbs?" "I'm thinking of creating a nuclear reactor.” "..." "How did you manage that?" "Nothing is impossible as long as you're willing to figure it out!" Song Yin turned to the younger disciples and said, "As long as you think about it, the rest can be left to the almighty magic. Do you agree, junior brothers?” The younger disciples bowed their heads, "Senior Brother, yes you are right!” —
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Xianxia

title: You Must Pity Me
summary: Ever since she was young, Mo Yun was tenacious. When other girls fell, they would cry and wail in pain. Only she would press her lips tightly together, plastering on an obstinate expression instead. She would never attempt to gain pity or affection from others. Even when her Master told her about the 8 sufferings in life: birth, aging, sickness and death, parting with the ones you love, meeting with the one you hate, unattained aims, and all the ills of the five skandhas. Everything was supposedly predestined, nothing could be forced. Even so, Mo Yun would lift her head up stubbornly and sneer: Parting with the ones you love and unattained aims? It merely applies to those who have no guts. Even if it can’t be forced, I will force it! Not long after she said this, Mo Yun met Shen Yue. Shen Yue was just like the biggest joke the heavens played on her, as a reminder to Mo Yun that in this world, there were things that she could not obtain by force.

title: Last Boss, Wants to Try Retiring ~I’ll Pretend to be Defeated by the Heroine and Try to Live Freely~
summary: The emperor of the Noah Empire who commands ten thousand mamono— — The Demon Emperor Menace. Feared throughout the world, he one day learns he is [The last boss of an RPG]. Menace believes continuing as he is won’t end well and decides to stop being the last boss. In an event at the beginning of the game, he “pretends” to be defeated by the heroine Alec and then secretly sneaks out to go on a journey. However, having hidden himself away in his castle (The Last Dungeon) that entire time, the common sense of the last boss is lacking. Furthermore, the level of the outside world is lower than expected— — This… is a runaway last boss, one who is living freely while greatly destroying the story.

title: The Charming Cannon Fodder
summary: Ying Rusheng was bound to a cannon fodder system. The system gave her two options: A. Be a qualified cannon fodder, even if the male lead ab*sed her thousands of times, she would treat the male lead as her first love. B. Counterattack. Given the low IQ of the host, the smart system recommended option A. Ying Rusheng: I originally wanted to choose A to lie down, but if you say that, I won't choose A. Later, the system discovered that his host wasn't tortured to death by the male lead, but that the male lead and the second male lead were tortured to death by her, and loved her to death. System: ... [World One: Why is the third-rate actresses so miserable] No one knew that the third-rate actress that everyone scolded was a genius painter, but unfortunately, the genius painter was destroyed by the one she loved and his aristocratic family, and she couldn't even pick up the brush again. Later, the male lead found out that he loved only the one who had never looked back from the beginning to the end; The aristocratic family was even more repentant, because the third rate actress who they suppressed was actually their real daughter. [World II: The sweet and gentle person is sly, ah!] In the beginning, the step-sister was the female lead, the step-brother was the male lead, and the uncle was the supporting character. So Ying Rusheng chose task A happily, thinking that she could lie down and win, but didn't expect her step-sister to be a man at all. Ying Rusheng: Emmm

title: Elizabeth In Pure White
summary: She became the heroine. A strong and beautiful heroine with special powers, Elizabeth Lily. However, the path to the flowery path is extremely difficult. Ens*aved, brainwashed, ab*sed… … . And the suffering of the heroine in the original work is still far from over. At this rate, she’ll die before even meeting the male protagonist! In the end, she made up her mind. She was saved by the evil and dangerous supporting wizard Asheroth, and decided to change the original work! But. “Okay, I’ll raise it.” “Are you serious? Asheroth, do you know what it means to raise a child?” “I’ll take responsibility for their entire diet, educate them, keep them safe, and if they marry, I’ll thoroughly vet them and get rid of them…” No! That’s not right!

title: Click to Claim Your Isekai Survival Guide
summary: If you unfortunately transmigrate and want to stay alive, please follow the rules below: Rule One: Don’t provoke a queen you can’t afford to offend. For example, a heterochromatic-eyed queen who’s currently gripping your throat. Rule Two: If there’s a captured child asking for your protection, you must protect them properly. For example, the orphan of a captured Demon King. Rule Three: If you fall in love with that icy, aloof female knight, be prepared to be utterly exhausted in both body and mind by a straight woman—and to deal with one trouble after another…

title: Back to the Wedding Day in the 1970s: Dumping the Scumbag Fiancé to Marry His Uncle
summary: [Rebirth + Retro Era + Marriage Spoiling + Getting Rich + Past and Present Lives + Revenge on s*umbags] Meng Xue returns to her wedding night after taking the antidote — only to catch her fiancé cheating. Unexpectedly, something goes wrong… and her white lotus cousin is also reborn. Stealing her s*umbag fiancé was bad enough, But now she even wants to steal her birth parents by pretending to be her? This is absolutely intolerable! How could Meng Xue let her get away with it? Let’s see who really comes out on top. Huh? What’s with this man? Wasn’t he just used as an antidote? Why won’t he leave her alone now? Watch as Meng Xue rips apart the s*umbag and the green tea b*tch, thrives in the old era, and captures a lifetime of happiness. (This story takes place...)

title: I Hope You’re Still Alive When Tomorrow Comes
summary: My childhood friend kissed a guy I didn't know. "I want to die." I murmured subconsciously, only to be stopped vehemently by a girl I didn't know. The girl turned out to be my stalker. "If your heart is broken then... Why don't you go out with me?" "It's fine even if you don't like me." A bitter tale of youth featuring a boy who couldn't accept his unrequited love for his childhood friend and a girl who was following him around.

Arataki Itto: "Welcome to the Arataki Gang! Watch me devour a pig in three bites - don't stop those tips coming!" Yoimiya: "Thanking Traveler for the rocket tip! title: Dolce
summary: Ouji Uru is a big fan of the idol group "Dolce", whose popularity is rising rapidly. One day, the members move into the house next door, and she happens to see Toujo Sara, the No. 1 member, slipping out of practice alone. Do you know the real face of the perfect idol...?

title: The Saintess Master Refuses to Be Killed by Her Demon King Disciple
summary: After perishing together with the Demon King, Lulu is reborn to the moment she first transmigrated into the other world. Facing the Demon King—who is still just an innocent little boy this time—Lulu smiles sweetly and decisively takes him in as her disciple, fully intending to “train him wrong” from childhood and ruin his future before he can grow into a threat. But to her shock… the Demon King has also been reborn! And he can even hear her inner thoughts? “Xiu’er, this slime bounty is basically free money! You should hurry and take it!” 【Heh. What she doesn’t know is that this ‘slime’ is actually a calamity-class Demon King in disguise…】

title: High School DxD EX
summary: A Spin-off novel of High School DxD by Ichiei Ishibumi bundled with the Blu-Ray special editions of the Season 3 Anime, High School DxD BorN. Set in a time-travel setting between post-Volume 14 present timeline and thirty years into the future.

summary: This world doesn't have truck protests, but siege tank protests.

title: Gateway of Immortality
summary: A mortal youth accidentally stumbled upon the path of immortality and struggled to move forward on the arduous journey of seeking immortality. The road to immortality is more difficult than reaching the heavens, yet despite the countless obstacles, his determination to pursue immortality remained unwavering. Looking back, the green mountains still stood, but his old companions had all turned to bones.

title: I Can Create Perfect Accidents
summary: John, who had been framed and wrongly imprisoned, was finally released. His five-year jail time had fostered his hatred toward the son of the Waters Conglomerate, Niel. However, John, who had no connections, could not do anything about it. When he had almost lost all hope while accompanying his girlfriend who was in a vegetative state thanks to Niel, he suddenly realized that there was a search bar right before his eyes! This search bar was just like the search bar in Google Chrome!

title: Forcibly Taking Over The Heartthrob Guide? S-Rank Sentinels Are Scrambling Fiercely!
summary: Song Nanxi was born in the first year after the apocalypse. Her parents both died when she was ten, and she was taken in by a safe base. Outside, the world is full of mutated plants and animals—commonly called “hetero-species.” Even the safe bases aren’t always safe. She can’t see the future of this world, nor her own future. So she firmly believes that instead of struggling to change her life, it’s better to just lie down early and enjoy everything! No matter how hard a salted fish tries, it’s still a salted fish! As long as she’s alive, she’ll do whatever makes her happy! In order to deal with the hetero-species, some humans began to evolve. Evolution splits roughly into two paths: Sentinels, who gain extreme strength, speed, and senses but tend to lose rationality; and Guides, who seem unchanged except for an ability to calm Sentinels. Sentinels are common, Guides are rare, and every Guide receives special treatment. Song Nanxi never expected to become a Guide. Her first thought was: Yay! I don’t have to work hard for the rest of my life! The bad news? She got bound to many Sentinels and might not be able to just lie down and relax after all. Worse news? Maybe she’s a little tasty? Why do all you crazy Sentinels want to eat me?! Unable to fight or resist, Song Nanxi had to adjust her attitude and start enjoying it: So, please be gentle when you bite.

title: Hell Mode Survival Guide
summary: The young master is dead. He was unmarried, and my unborn child is his only heir. I'm wondering how I'll survive now.

title: On Their Wedding Night, the Reborn Prince Spills Her Contraceptive Potion
summary: [Rebirth + Sweet Doting + Satisfying Story + Dual Purity] Ye Chen was reborn on the wedding night with his Qiu'er. In his past life, he couldn't even keep his Qiu'er's remains. In this life, he will stay by her side at all times. In her past life, her biggest regret was not having her own children. In this life, he wants to have many children with her. In her past life, she was always trapped in the capital. In this life, he will travel with her across the nine provinces

title: Celestial Employee
summary: An ordinary run of the mill employee, a recently graduated new employee. An unlucky guy frustrated with life, a nobody always being bullied by his superiors and colleagues. Unexpectedly, a nobody like this obtained a fabled power, a thing of the legends, the celestial arts of the Immortals. He turned into the only remaining disciple of the legendary magical treasure refining sect, the Three Treasure Sect, from aeons ago. With this, he gained the ability to refine all kinds of magical treasures, isn’t that amazing?
genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life, Xianxia

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Club “Guren no Kenki” – Flame Sword Princess [LN]
summary: “Flame Sword Princess” is a beloved light novel series by Setsuna Yuki. Inspired by his passion, the Nijigasaki Middle School Idol Club embarks on an extraordinary project: creating a mini-movie adapted from a novel. In their endeavor, Setsuna takes on the role of the enchanting Fire Princess, her admiration for the character resonating within her. Together, they put forth their efforts to wholeheartedly capture Setsuna-chan's deep affection and devotion. Let us unite and strive to convey Setsuna-chan's boundless love!”
genres: Comedy, Fantasy, School Life, Slice of Life

title: The Genius Director Uses a Future App
summary: "Director! Please explain that amazing filming technique!" "You're called a genius ahead of your time—what do you think about that?" "Director! You promised I would be the lead actress in your next project!" All I did was click the app... And now I’m being mistaken for a genius director.

title: Reborn into Young Master Huo’s Little Fairy
summary: In Yun City, there are rumors about Young Master Huo being temperamental and extreme. He is cold-hearted and will kick any woman away if they get close to him. Little Fairy Wen was at loggerheads with Young Master Huo in her previous life. Little Fairy Wen: "Can I suck up to you?" "Scram." That was expected. It would only be strange if Little Fairy Wen could succeed. Not long later— "Young Master Huo brought Little Fairy Wen to the countryside to watch shooting stars." "Young Master Huo beat his love rival up so badly the latter is in the hospital." Little Fairy Wen, the person involved, is pushed into a corner by Young Master Huo. "I dare you to break up with me." Little Fairy Wen smiles brightly. "You were the one who told me to scram." The fierce Young Master Huo becomes a meek little puppy in the next second. "Don't break up with me. My life is yours from now on." ... Wen Ruan died brutally in her previous life. Young Master Huo, who was terminally ill, collected her corpse and even laid into the crystal coffin with her after consuming poison. Now that she's reborn, her goal is to tear the s*umbags and b*tches apart, cure his illness, suck up to him, and become his precious little fairy. [The Little Fairy who is sweet and delicate, meek and charming VS The temperamental Young Master Huo who is extremely faithful and only pampers the little fairy ]

title: Joker Game
summary: In autumn of 1937, as the coals of World War II are beginning to smolder, Lieutenant Colonel Yuuki of the Imperial Army secretly establishes a spy training organization called the “D Agency.” Those chosen as members of the agency, in opposition to the national trend toward reverence of native-born soldiers in the army, are civilian university graduates who pass the superhuman selection test with flying colors. Under the resourceful Lieutenant Colonel Yuuki, they learn not only how to work with gunpowder, wireless communications, vehicles, and airplanes, but also various skills essential for spies, from pickpocketing to safecracking. “Don’t die. Don’t kill.” Su*cide and mu*der are the worst possible options in the D Agency, which values a low profile above all else. Even as its agents bear under extreme opposition from the army’s control center, they continue to betray allies, deceive foes, and conduct secret maneuvers all over the world. Tokyo, Shanghai, London… Their military intelligence reaches every last corner of the globe.

title: In the Summoned Other World, A Story About Raising My Dream Beast Girl with All My Might Using the Unique Skill “Gamer.”
summary: The fluffy, soft, and cuddly characteristics of kemonomimi (beast girls) have interesting traits. No matter how much you talk about it, their tails and ears always honestly express their true feelings. They are pure. Duran (the protagonist) loved beast girls, and then—he is summoned to a different world where beast girls exist. There, he becomes known as the "worst hero."

title: Knight, the Dark Emperor starting from Moon Knight!
summary: Lu Jie travels back in time and is reborn into the dangerous world of Yueqi. The game started at Hell difficulty, and I happened to encounter Rook from Checkmate 4, who was trying to eradicate the werewolves, and was targeted by him. When the crisis comes, Lu Jie discovers that he has an extremely powerful power hidden in himself. He is the Dark Emperor who should have appeared in the Sentai World - Jet! It can continuously strengthen itself by devouring everything. —————————— King: Maya, who is this guy? Why would you betray me for him? Madam Haidong: I just came here to steal some treasure, but you want to steal my driver? Wang Xiaoming: This doesn't make sense! Isn't it my privilege to travel the world?

title: I Was Reincarnated as a Villain Noble in a Game, so I Want to Surround Women Like a Villain and Do Whatever I Want With the Power of a Noble. But I Don’t Want to Be Condemned, so I’ll Keep My Distance From the Main Character’s Camp… Wait! ? Don’t Come Here, Heroines!
summary: "The eldest son of a useless duke family, a dropout, a man who had everything stolen by his brother, tr*sh, evil, a mu*derer... it is said that he has completed all the notorieties that roar in this world, committing evil deeds, killing people, and mu*dering women. Noah Reinhardt, the worst s*um aristocrat who forcibly commits crimes. He is one of the villains in the game "Stuffy". He used his power to forcefully pursue a relationship with one of the heroines and was destined to be condemned by the protagonist's hands. So, what do we do? Do I want to change our minds in order not to be killed by the main character and become a good child like the main character in the usual series? But wait a minute. Do I really need to change our minds so that the hero won't kill us and become a good boy? A life of luxury where we can have as many women as we want. Should I abandon that and adhere to good morals... even though we were born into a privileged class? However, if I don't get involved with them in order to avoid being killed by the main character, the problem will be solved. I have knowledge of the game and are familiar with the character and behaviour patterns of the protagonist. It would be as easy as standing around to avoid being killed. "Hahahahahahahahaha! I'm going to embrace women in this world!" With this , the reincarnated villain who makes full use of his clever brain is here today. Once again, today I've been indulging myself in luxury over and over again, and I'm... wait a minute ! Why are the heroines coming to me one after another!? The main character! The hero is coming! Go away!"

title: Starting with a Billion Supplies, the Villainous Female Supporting Character Wins the Apocalypse Easily
summary: Wen Yu transmigrated into a book, becoming the fiancée of the male lead who dies early in a post-apocalyptic story. Early death? Impossible. With a billion supplies, a Death-Immune Shield from the underworld, and a Dimensional Trading System, Wen Yu could effortlessly conquer the apocalypse even with her eyes closed. Zombies roam, disasters strike, order collapses. The once-arrogant fiancée’s gaze at him has changed. Before: “What stray dog is this? Don’t get near me.” Now: “Come here, little puppy, let mommy rub your legs.” Pei Ye was flustered, but no matter how things changed, she always stood firmly by his side, facing the unknown world together. And he would protect her completely for a lifetime. Wen Yu: “Huh? Your male lead has so many scenes? I just picked a bodyguard, that’s all…”

title: Onrain (Online – The Novel)
summary: A horror online game that one should never ever participate in… One day, a mysterious parcel arrived. Inside, there was a new type of game model I have never seen before. That was the start of my horror. A demonic game that is linked online. 『Nightmare』 ……With that, game activated.

title: Starting with the Recharge System Awakened, I am the King of Another World
summary: Martin transmigrated to another world, arriving on this extraordinary Continent of cultivating Magic and Knight's Power. Becoming the Earl's Son, he awakened the System. Recharging Gold Coins could make his Subordinates stronger; as long as the Gold Coins piled up quickly, his Subordinates could reach Domain Knight in minutes. Have you seen a fully formed Domain Knight regiment launch a full-frontal assault? Knight Strength: Knight Attendant, Black Iron Knight, Bronze Knight, Silver Knight, Golden Knight, Sky Knight, Legendary Knight, Domain Knight. Magician: Apprentice, Black Iron Mage, Bronze Mage, Silver Mage, Gold Mage, Sky Mage, Legendary Mage, Domain Mage.

title: Becoming the Delicate and Beloved White Moonlight of a Big Shot From the 1970s
summary: Upon waking up, Song Wanyue found herself transported to another world. She became the youngest daughter of the Song family's eldest son, blessed with a delicate and beautiful appearance, cherished by the entire Song family. The girls in the village envied her good fortune, except for the female antagonist who sneered at her. The reborn antagonist had already set her sights on the village's handsome but aloof young man. Despite his current hardships, she knew he would become a top-notch business tycoon in the future. Her plan was simple: win over the struggling youth, and her life would be set. However, later, when she saw the youth pinning Song Wanyue against a corner, kissing her passionately, the antagonist was driven mad with jealousy.
genres: Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Put Away Your Magical Powers Now!
summary: [My child, remember, there are ten points of luck in this world, of which three points are literary, seven points are martial, and one point is decisive! ] […10…3+7+1…Huh? My dear, something seems to be wrong!]
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mature, Mystery, Romance, Sci-fi

title: After I Returned, How Did the Yanderes Manage to Hunt Me Down?
summary: After being reborn, Jiang Li’s life took a sudden, catastrophic turn, leaving him in a desperate situation. Just as he thought he was destined for a tragic end on his deathbed, a "Golden Finger" that was twenty years late finally appeared, offering a glimmer of hope: to survive, he must successfully "capture" the female leads from various mission worlds. From the Blackened Yandere Heroine and the Spirit Medium suffering from severe emotional dependency, to the Sect Leader living with a lifetime of regret...

title: The Super “Dog Food” System

Even get stuff like cultivation manuals and secret weapons？Ever since he got the Super Dog Food system, Ye Tian's life is awesome—all he does is spread Dog Food (PDA in Chinese）with beautiful women.

title: The Despicable Villain of the Academy
summary: The Helios family is a prestigious noble house within the kingdom. For generations, it produced powerful heroes. However, the youngest, Ember Helios, was different. He was infamous for committing all kinds of atrocities. Not only did he mistreat commoners, but beating the servants within his own mansion was part of his daily life. There came a point when the deaths piled up so much that not even a family of heroes could continue covering it up. Ember was eventually executed. Talentless, but abusing the power and position of his family to commit evil—such was the end of the despicable villain. And I was reincarnated as that villain. As a reader who already knows the end of this story, I had to find a way to survive.
genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School Life

title: This Hunter Punishes with Telekinesis
summary: Min Sa-hyeok, an 18-year-old survivor of the monster-infested Seoul District 3, harbors a burning hatred for monsters after witnessing his mother’s gruesome death. He meticulously documents his knowledge of monsters in a notebook, which later becomes the foundation for monster taxonomy, known as the “Blue Note.” A year later, Sa-hyeok joins the Monster Special Forces, a unit dedicated to monster extermination. However, the unit is gradually falling apart as Hunters, those with supernatural abilities, desert the military for lucrative civilian guilds. Despite years of rigorous training, Sa-hyeok remains unable to awaken his own abilities. During a mission, a fellow soldier, driven to despair by a superior’s relentless ab*se, attempts su*cide. In a desperate attempt to stop him, Sa-hyeok unknowingly awakens his ability – telekinesis – and unknowingly saves his comrade’s life.

title: You’re Telling Me This Is a Slice-of-Life?
summary: After being Reincarnated, You Realize: The world around you is brimming with the carefree air of a slice-of-life world. Surrounded by beautiful girls, a blissful life is unfolding before you. With your foreknowledge, you’re ready to play this life like a game. But then, a game invitation arrived: 【Welcome to the Reincarnation Game】 【You will witness the Blood Moon’s slaughter, escape the Devil’s Hospital, and experience the Six Paths of Rebirth…】 【You will connect with countless players across the multiverse, witness Fern’s elegant catwalk, face the origin of Ryougi Shiki , experience Aizen’s terrifying scheme…】 Wait. title: A Reincarnated Villainous Aristocrat, Who Becomes the Greatest Adventurer to Saves His Favorite Character
summary: A boy from a villainous noble family learns of a future in which his favourite character is killed as the last boss, and after that day, he begins to learn magic with bloody hard work. One year later, he is convinced that his doomed future has been averted for now, but he is shocked to discover that it all happened according to the game storyline. The game scenario’s compelling force, which could be called a curse,—- but on the flip side, it meant that no matter how reckless he was, he would not die until he was doomed. The boy who became an adventurer learns not only magic but also swords and faces monsters. In order to save the girl of his dreams and the precious people he encounters, his efforts are accelerated to the point of sickness. And the boy pushes forward on the death line without a care in the world. Will the crazy boy be able to destroy the storyline and save his favorite character? —-

title: On the Wedding Day, the Substitute Foolish Bride Wants a Divorce
summary: Transmigrated into the body of a fool, she was bullied by the servants—until she fought back with a whip and trampled them underfoot. The short-lived prince tried to protect her, but she demanded a divorce right on the spot. Thrown into the back mountain to be fed to a python, she turned the python into roasted meat instead. To rescue her exiled family, she reached a cooperation agreement with the short-lived prince. When everything was settled, she clapped her hands and left without hesitation. The prince could no longer stay calm—he’d rather give up the world than lose his beauty.

title: On a Godless Planet
summary: Before Horizon, humanity ascended to the heavens, but how exactly did that happen? Kawakami's new series explores the Edge era in which legends must be recreated to reshape a distant planet.

The original Song Li had a terrible personality—lazy, greedy, abusive to children, and eventually pushed the villain to the edge of darkness. In the end, she was tortured to death. Song Li shivered at the thought. Fortunately, she arrived at just the right time—none of that had happened yet, and her dimensional space came with her. She began farming, selling spiritual tea, and opened a food factory. Before she knew it, she became the richest person in the country. As for the man who used to avoid her like the plague? Instead of finding peace in death, she’s met by a well-meaning but naive God who offers her reincarnation into a fantasy world filled with magic and adventure. Minato, jaded by her past, initially refuses, but God insists, granting her a special power: the ability to change the difficulty of her new life, just like in a video game. Reincarnated into the body of a young girl, Minato finds herself in a harsh and dangerous world where she’s immediately captured by goblins. Using her “Difficulty Change” ability, she effortlessly escapes and sets off on a journey to navigate this strange new world. summary: After losing my memory, I mistook my nemesis for my husband. And even moved into his house. On the day my memory returned, I was tugging on his sleeve, asking for a kiss. The memories flooded back, and I froze, just about to run away. But the always-cold man frowned, lowered his head, and gave me a kiss, his tone helpless: "Alright, can you stay at home like a good girl now?"

title: After Cultivation, Became a Special Forces Soldier
summary: The underachieving young master, dissatisfied with his wealthy father's affair and subsequent divorce from his mother, constantly opposed his father. He then injured his classmate Zhang Shuai in a fight over a girlfriend and was expelled from school. Angered, he ran away from home and ended up wandering the streets, where he was noticed by a Daoist Immortal and taken in as a closed-door disciple.
